Colin narrowed his eyes slightly, not surprised by this. Calling these creatures demigods would not be an exaggeration. Unless they ate an origin like that demon, ordinary people really didn’t have a good way to deal with them.
Colin even felt fortunate that, so far, he hadn’t encountered demigod creatures like the true form behind Beast Transformation Syndrome.
Otherwise, just dealing with “Deadly Insight” would be enough of a headache…
However, at this moment, just as Colin was preparing to confront the enemy, he suddenly noticed several thick bolts of lightning crossing countless kilometers in the Deep Sea, then striking directly at the three divine creatures, constraining them like a cage.
In a moment of shock, Colin realized that the Queen of the Holy City had taken action!
But oddly enough, seeing that fleeting lightning, his first thought was: Wait, how could there be lightning in the sea?
Shouldn’t it blend into the ocean the instant it appeared?
Colin felt his physics knowledge had failed him.
But his astonishment was brief. Recovering, he immediately took advantage of the gap and pressed on towards the Holy City.
With assistance from the other side, Colin made his way smoothly across the battlefield, arriving outside the Holy City, less than a hundred meters from the blue barrier protecting it.
As they arrived, the blue barrier opened a gap just large enough for them to pass through.
Colin and the others immediately quickened their pace…
And it was at that moment an enigmatic voice appeared in his mind:
“‘Bonfire Campsite’, your era has come to an end!”
The strange voice was filled with an indescribable sense of sublimity, the aura inherent in it made ordinary people feel compelled to submit.
“In a hurry?”
Colin immediately felt from this aura that the voice came from something beneath the Crimson Abyss.
In a roaring voice, the lightning restraining the three divine creatures burst apart, and an even more terrifying sense of oppression suddenly intensified…
Its true form was still unable to come, only able to intervene in this place through “Containers”.
‘Wasn’t certain before, but now it’s clear, this is likely one of those who were persecuted by the company back then… Tsk, the intensity of the aura is almost on par with the Twilight Angel…’
Thoughts flashed in Colin’s mind, and without paying attention to what was behind him, he led a group of Fishmen through the barrier.
The barrier closed immediately after they passed through.
Colin did not look back, heading straight for the largest hall, and soon he saw the noble “Sea Siren” Queen.
But compared to the last time he had seen her, the Queen now appeared quite disheveled, covered in blood, looking frail, yet her demeanor remained noble and calm, clutching a sceptre inlaid with blue rhombus gemstones, staring intently at Colin, whose presence was enhanced by the fierce flames.
In her eyes, the meager and slender figure radiated a majesty that even she found burdensome.
Despite her inner confusion about the flames on Colin’s body, it was undeniable that it was the “Holy Fire”, and moreover, a Holy Fire of extremely high purity!
At this moment, without any pleasantries, Colin looked towards a grand Sanctuary also protected by the barrier:
“I will represent the will of ‘Bonfire’, entering there to retrieve a Holy Relic lost from our side. But do not worry about the light diminishing, for my arrival indicates that once again, light will shine upon this place.
“All anomalies present will dissipate the moment I retrieve it.
“As for you, who walk alongside me, you shall forever receive the Bonfire Blessing.”
After saying this, Colin breathed a sigh of relief inside.
He had mustered a great deal of willpower to change the exit line “Pray to me, seek to become a believer under my command” to “Walk with me,” and “I shall grant you lowly ants the privilege to bathe under the bonfire” to “You shall forever receive the Bonfire Blessing.”
If he had spoken those two sentences exactly as they were, he would have likely sparked a serious diplomatic incident.
Even so, upon hearing Colin’s words, the Queen couldn’t help but raise an eyebrow, feeling the urge to rush over and punch him.
As for Dog Brother and the others, they secretly tucked their heads into the mermaid’s embrace, feeling their faces flush with heat and embarrassment, playing the ostrich while they couldn’t help but fidget with their toes…
However, not everyone felt awkward. A Fishman stepped forward, looking up adoringly at Colin’s back:
“Mother… Her Majesty the Queen! Sir Bonfire, he really is the emissary of the Holy Fire! Chosen by the Holy Fire, the Ambassador who walks the Deep Sea on its behalf!”
“With Sir Bonfire here, better days are upon us!”
No, stop, oh my god, those things I said just to show off, how could you remember every single word… Colin felt his scalp tingle on the inside.
Little Tina, unaware of Colin’s inner turmoil, continued, “You can ask them, they can testify.”
The Queen looked toward her Guards, and seeing them all nodding vehemently, she clearly had immense faith in Colin.
Feeling the stirring Flame, she let down her guard, “Only you may enter.”
She didn’t trust Colin, but she trusted the Holy Fire. A person chosen by the Holy Fire must be truthful!
As she spoke, she handed over a blue gemstone.
“I can.” Colin nodded, accepting it.
But just as the Queen was preparing to open a pathway to let Colin into the Sanctuary, a massive vibration suddenly came from above.
Above them, a vast crimson cluster of tentacles had launched an attack.
“The Holy Relic is in a Holy Furnace at the deepest part, a long way down. You must get there quickly; this place won’t hold much longer. If within ten minutes you haven’t done what you promised, I will completely seal off this place…”
“Three minutes will suffice.”
Colin, alone, charged into the passageway, making his way straight into the Sanctuary.
This hall was constructed of copious amounts of white gold-hued stone blocks, with a long descending staircase at the center. Flanking the staircase and lit by the flames stood rows of guards fashioned from an unknown metal.
As Colin approached, these guards turned their necks, with red dots of light shining from beneath their helmets.
However, since he held the token, they did not attack him.
Colin paid no mind to these trivial figures and continued on his way.
The deeper he went, the higher the temperature of the air became.
But for him, it wasn’t much of an issue…
After covering nearly five kilometers, he finally came upon that so-called Holy Furnace.
The contraption was circular, with numerous pipes of varying sizes connected to it, drawing forth the fiery red energy it emitted to power the entire Holy City.
And within this circular Holy Furnace, there was only one thing ablaze—
A hand, palm up, severed at the wrist.
“You’ve got to be kidding me…”
Upon seeing this, Colin fell silent, having not anticipated that when they said they were leaving a hand behind, they meant it quite literally.
But then, considering this was a Firebearer, it made sense to him all at once.
However, before Colin could ponder any further, he suddenly noticed the severed hand, which had been cut for who knows how many years, twitched, and then a middle finger lifted up.
At the tip of the middle finger, a small mouth appeared, uttering a hungry whisper:
“Hungry, so hungry, food, eat, eat, you look delicious, come here, let me eat you, let me eat you quickly, didn’t you want Grease? I will secrete plenty for you…”
And as the mouth on that middle finger spoke, a surge erupted within Colin, and his stomach uncontrollably grumbled, filling with an indescribable sense of hunger.
A voice he hadn’t heard in a long while, “0-9 ‘Hunger’,” exploded in Colin’s ear:
“Eat it! Eat it! Eat it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - 313 311 0-9 Hunger Limited Time Experience
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 313: Chapter 311 “0-9 ‘Hunger’ “Limited Time Experience Card!_1 Chapter 313: Chapter 311 “0-9 ‘Hunger’ “Limited Time Experience Card!_1 “Hiss, two ‘Hungers’…”
Colin clutched his stomach, bending slightly, suppressing the intense hunger within. He could feel that both aspects of the “Hunger” were now harboring massive cravings to devour each other.
And that severed left hand in his eyes had turned into a roasted pig trotter, oozing with fragrance and dripping with oil…
From the trotter, continuous whispers emitted: “Eat, eat, eat!”
More eerily, Colin could sense that this “roasted pig trotter” also had a strong desire to eat, yearning to consume him.
Damn it, the roasted pig trotter actually wanted to eat a person!
“No, no, no… I can’t eat! This is a hand! A human hand!”
Colin shook his head vigorously, and when he looked ahead again, that “roasted pig trotter” had transformed back into a severed human hand.
Rational instincts once again brought back a semblance of clarity…
Unfortunately, it would have been better if it were just the hunger in his belly, but having that “roasted pig trotter” there too, the mutual reflection of the two hungers was unstoppable in its revival!
The left hand, ever more appealing in scent and look, once again took on the appearance of a roasted pig trotter…
“Gurgle gurgle gurgle…”
The rumbling sounds from his intestines grew louder.
“Eat, eat, eat…”
The eerie whispers lingered by Colin’s ear while saliva secreted wildly from his mouth, his will gradually controlled by the primal urge.
“This is trouble…”
Colin felt a headache coming on, as the intense feeling of hunger once again began to erode his reason.
“There’s no such thing as a human hand, that’s clearly just a roasted pig trotter you love to eat, it’s even taunting you, let your guard down, it’s just a pig trotter after all, you haven’t eaten for so long, you must be very hungry…”
“You haven’t done anything wrong, you’re just hungry and want to eat, that’s all…”
“Eating doesn’t go against any of your conscience, the Gluttonous Buddha once said…”
Murmuring whispers emanated from within him, continuously enticing Colin to devour what was before him.
In the course of this process, Colin’s eyes uncontrollably shifted into the vertical pupils characteristic of Beast Transformation Syndrome, his body hair coarsened and lengthened, turning blood red as he began to undergo a conspicuous transformation…
And the Bonfire that had been draped over him flickered, dimming and brightening like a candle in the wind, threatening to snuff out at any moment.
“Crack…”
The crisp sound of a bone breaking echoed, followed by a surge of excruciating pain from his fingers. Colin shook his head and glanced down at his right hand to see one of his fingers broken by his own doing.
“No, this feeling is all wrong. I have a strong premonition that if this continues, using ‘0-9′ Hunger’ I’ll definitely lose complete control. Was the mission serious about me using the power of Hunger here?”
Colin was somewhat skeptical, but the stamp in the mission indeed indicated it was from Lady Bunny.
But without allowing him further thought, the inexplicable sensation of “Hunger” struck once more.
“I can’t stay here, I’ll really go mad if I do, the two halves of ‘Hunger’ bickering here, I simply can’t control it…”
He took a deep breath, planning to leave this place, but just then, he suddenly saw the “roasted pig trotter” in the furnace before him stand upright, no longer emitting tempting chewing sounds.
This gave Colin some relief.
“‘Simulated Space’ test, lasted 19 seconds, exceeding the standard by 1 second, assessed as satisfactory, barely qualifies as a pillar of strength… oh no, an appropriate vessel.”
An unseen voice echoed in his ear, seemingly evaluating the circumstances here.
Next, Colin saw the “roasted pig trotter” float up, its thumb and middle finger came together in a flick, producing a sharp snap of the fingers.
A burst of flame suddenly exploded into being.
In that instant, the intense feeling of “Hunger” inside Colin vanished without a trace.
And the left hand before him fell back into the Holy Fire furnace, looking exactly as it had when he first arrived, without any change.
Everything seemed like a fleeting moment of cold sweat-inducing distraction.
Or perhaps it was a non-existent illusion.
However, after this moment of “distraction,” Colin suddenly realized that the “hunger” within him was as quiet as if it had died…
Before this, he had always felt a presence slumbering inside him, but now, that “slumber” had almost entirely disappeared.
Colin had a premonition that even if he used the power of “hunger,” it would not trigger any backlash.
“What’s been done? A snap of the fingers and everything’s resolved?”
Looking at the hand in the furnace, Colin couldn’t help but take a sharp breath.
In his mind, it was as if he had amnesia, unable to recall the sound just now, only vaguely remembering that what he had just experienced seemed to be merely a minor test?
Shaking his head, without thinking too much, Colin continued to look at the hand in the furnace ahead.
“This hand…”
Although he wasn’t certain, he felt there was a good chance that this was the left hand left behind by Rosen…
At that moment, he saw the left hand’s middle finger raise, and a mouth appeared on the fingertip.
“You’ve got to be kidding, not again?”
Seeing this scene, Colin’s breathing hitched, but then he saw the mouth on the fingertip open wide and, with a “wow,” spit out a rolled-up piece of parchment.
Before he could pick up the parchment to examine it, he saw the mouth on the palm transform into a wisp of blue energy that flew towards him.
Almost before he could react, the blue mist had merged into his body.
Then, his mind was filled with many experiences of using “hunger,” experiences that were not in words, but rather existed in a way that seemed almost instinctual…
And at the same time, he also understood some things.
“There isn’t any part of ‘0-9 ‘hunger” in this hand, only some essence remained, specially left in the hand and merged with certain characteristics of it—in a sense, apart from not having gone through the evaluation phase by the assessment department, this hand could be considered a ‘prop’ of the Bonfire Company.”
Sorting through these thoughts, Colin couldn’t help but fall silent, thinking to himself that it was just like a Firebearer to ruthlessly turn himself into a prop without a moment’s hesitation.
Afterwards, he looked at the parchment that had been rolled up and spat out, guessing it contained some key information about this place.
Colin took a few steps forward to pick it up but before he could unfold it, he heard some noises coming from outside.
After a moment of thought, he tucked the item away into the Storage Room.
“Let’s deal with the situation outside first.”
Colin pursed his lips, then suddenly remembered something and began to speak, “Given the special circumstances of ‘World Code-4’, I, as the employee ‘Unnamed123456’, hereby request the intervention of the ‘Bonfire Protocol’…”
As he spoke, clumps of flame danced before his eyes, each flicker of light seeming to represent a letter.
Then, these flames were sucked into an invisible transparent vortex and vanished.
And then… there was no more after that.
The request had definitely been sent, but it was hard to say if there would be any follow-up.
But it wasn’t a big issue…
Colin felt the dormant power inside him and couldn’t help but smile slightly: “I have already obtained the ‘0-9 ‘hunger” limited-time experience card!”
Although this power was incomplete, it was enough to solve all the current predicaments!
With that, he strode towards the exit, ready to take care of the trouble here.
But before he could leave, a tremulous whiff of energy from the “Yukionna” suddenly emerged from within him.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - 314 312 Buffet Underway_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 314: Chapter 312 Buffet Underway_1 Chapter 314: Chapter 312 Buffet Underway_1 “Oh right, let me tuck you all away first, so I don’t accidentally eat you later and make trouble.”
Colin canceled the effects of the items on his body one by one and stored them in the “Storage Room”—
With the time-limited “Hunger” experience card available, why bother with this trash?
After completing his final preparations, Colin stepped onto the staircase, traversing dozens of meters in a single bound, and quickly left the bottom of the Sanctuary.
The terrifying waves of battle intermittently came from outside…
Soon enough, when he arrived at the temple gate, he saw that the fight outside had reached a certain fever pitch.
Several lambs exuding an appetizing scent were lying on the blue barrier, tearing multiple fissures with their own strength, allowing a great number of little desserts to pour into this world.
Compared to the three lambs when he first entered, the number seemed to have reached five now.
The tasty grilled mermaids, no, the mermaids were trying their best to block these invaders, but their efforts seemed somewhat feeble compared to the massive numbers of the enemies.
Many enemies had already come to the outside of the Sanctuary, actively damaging the last barrier.
If it wasn’t for the fact that these infected beings seemed to have set their sights on striking at the Sanctuary, their situation would likely be more than just suffering heavy casualties by now—most would probably be dead.
“Ah, the wonderful time to feast is about to begin.”
Colin took a deep breath, his index finger twitched greatly, feeling the urge to barge in and have a big feast.
But the question was whether to start with the main course or the small desserts first.
Just then, at the dome, he felt the gaze of a lamb lock onto him. Colin looked over and saw an old acquaintance, Omar.
But different from before, what emanated from him was not a sense of oppression, but an irresistible fragrance!
The moment he saw Colin, it seemed he made some kind of judgment and then suddenly stretched the barrier open.
“He didn’t get that hand, take him down!”
Omar quickly realized that the outsider had not obtained the item that was critical to the survival of the Deep Sea World.
Hearing his words, the other four “Containers” stretched out their limbs, piercing into his body and injecting a blood-red spore into him.
With the support of his comrades, his strength climbed another level!
Uniting the power of five people, he felt confident he could take down the opponent!
In an instant, he tore through the barrier, becoming the first human to breach the “Sea Siren” Sanctuary!
And at that moment, a barrage of attacks came, numerous spires unleashed lightning and ice spikes, along with a massive assault from the Fishmen’s spells, blanketing him from all directions.
“Can you fight against the power of my ‘Master’?!”
The blood-red spores erupted from Omar’s body, his blood-red limbs lashed out, directly piercing through the storm-like onslaught.
Whether it was lightning or ice spikes, everything that hit him shattered in an instant, unable to harm him at all.
The attacks discreetly released by some people from Bonfire Company were also easily torn apart.
With his arrival, hundreds of “Sea Sirens” were contaminated, screaming and falling to the ground, with strange things squirming under their skin. The spires that he passed through began to wriggle grotesquely, growing limbs and undergoing strange transformations.
Seeing this scene, both the queen and Dog Brother and others all showed shocked expressions.
It was one thing to hold these creatures at bay outside, but once they broke in, their formidable individual qualities were enough to change the tide of the battlefield!
However, Omar did not directly attack the mermaids blocking him. His target remained clear—Colin, standing in front of the Sanctuary.
The momentum of his advance, like a hurricane and huge waves, caused many to be blown away.
“This is bad!”
Dog Brother and the others also noticed this and felt deeply uneasy when they saw Brother Shunzi in front of the sanctuary.
The pirate’s strength had risen significantly since before; Brother Shunzi had already struggled to fight previously, could he still fight now?
However, very soon, their eyes widened as they saw the tide of the battlefield change in an instant.
Before the platinum sanctuary, Colin suddenly opened his mouth and his neck eerily stretched out, his head growing larger during the process, swiftly becoming bigger than a small building!
The scene turned bizarre and horrific in a flash.
Then, in a moment when everyone was still struggling to react, his head bit down on Omar, who was moving at high speed as if sliding into a tackle.
“What?”
Omar gasped as he saw the gaping maw coming straight for him. The thing wasn’t moving fast, it was visibly several times slower than him, yet for some reason, he had the misleading impression that he couldn’t dodge it.
But, driven by the instinct to survive, he twisted his body, attempting to evade the abyssal jaws…
“Aaahhh!!!”
Omar, now reduced to less than a third of himself, screamed in mid-air as blood rained down.
If not for his last moment reaction, he might not have even that third left!
Colin’s head retracted, returning to normal size, as he chewed with his mouth repeatedly, and a tentacle tried to wriggle out, but he slurped it back in like a noodle.
“Admirable courage, tastes good.”
A satisfied smile on his lips, Colin gazed at Omar in front of him and smiled, revealing his pearly white teeth:
“Indeed, the feast should always start with the main course.”
As he spoke, a bonfire burst forth from above his head, not to battle his enemy, but to stabilize himself.
Afterward, he stepped forward towards the sumptuous feast before him.
With each step he took, a dark greenish-black aura dispersed from his body, spreading rapidly in all directions, and buildings, infected ones, even the microorganisms in the air, were digested upon coming into contact with this aura, turning into nutrients that returned to his body.
“Damn it! Run!” Omar realized almost instantly that he couldn’t handle the creature before him, and his body exploded with a copious number of blood-red spores like a cuttlefish, then he fled outward.
“Run? Hehe, ever seen a descending palm strike from the heavens?”
Colin’s eyes changed to blood-red vertical pupils as he eyed the plump sheep before him, extending his tongue to lick his lips.
He stretched out his hand leisurely and gently pressed towards the distance.
Suddenly, an immensely huge, dark greenish-black hand descended from the sky, smacking the rapidly moving Omar hard onto the ground like swatting a fly.
Countless mouths emerged on the palm, frenziedly tearing and biting into the remaining piece of the lamb.
It was at this moment, following that arm’s trail upward, that the crowd realized a Buddha statue’s phantom, towering into the heavens, had appeared at some point.
There one moment and gone the next, it moved with Colin’s movement, as if it was an external avatar of his.
“Holy shit, how the fuck did this thing show up.”
The Arsonist and others, recognizing the same dark stone-textured massive hand, seemed to remember some unspeakable past trauma, and nearly couldn’t help but tumble away.
The “World Code-13” elective trial incident back then had given almost everyone a psychological trauma from being smacked by that thing.
But luckily, this time it seemed to be on their side.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - 315 313 Become a Part of Me (Extra for Monthly
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 315: Chapter 313 Become a Part of Me! (Extra for Monthly Tickets)_1 Chapter 315: Chapter 313 Become a Part of Me! (Extra for Monthly Tickets)_1 “Brother Shunzi has invited quite a formidable entity to possess him…”
Dog Brother swallowed hard.
According to the plot of “World Code – 13,” they roughly inferred that this thing was eventually contained by the Corps.
But they had not expected it to reappear now.
Meanwhile, as Colin was moving, blood-red fur grew on his body, and his human appearance began to mutate.
“Is this the ‘Tyrant Body’? What’s going on, Brother Shunzi’s ‘Tyrant Body’ looks quite different from ours?” “Surfing for Pigs” said in surprise.
“The fur is blood-red, and the aura is much stronger than ours…”
“Strange, does this thing also have chromatic skin?”
“Blood-red is cool—sob, sob, sob, I want one too…”
“I’m hungry…”
“Wait, something’s not right, I feel like our minds are a bit off…”
The men were shocked to their core, but soon some of them noticed that their minds seemed out of control, so much so that they began to think of all sorts of strange things on such a severe battlefield.
Apparently, just the direct gaze at Brother Shunzi caused a significant decline in their rationality.
However, before they could avert their eyes, a message suddenly appeared before them.
[Extra Event One: Please observe “Unnamed123456” as much as possible to ensure some data can be more accurate.]
At the same time as this content appeared, a string of data flashed onto their retinas.
[Observation of “0-9 ‘Hunger'” revival in progress, current real-time value approximately 0.71%.]
‘Damn it!’
Their inner selves couldn’t help but curse, now they had no choice but to keep watching.
Colin, who was eating in the distance, also noticed the movement on Dog Brother’s side, but he didn’t come over. Instead, looking at the infected all over Holy City, he opened his mouth and sucked in deeply.
On his body, the phantom of “Hunger” made the same motion…
Suddenly, a terrifying suction erupted, whether it was the polluted spires or human infectees, merfolk infectees, or those weird clusters of creatures, none could escape. All were swallowed whole without a chance to resist.
[Observation of “0-9 ‘Hunger'” revival in progress, current real-time value approximately 0.74%.]
“Hahaha, this is what it feels like when it’s on, damn it, this is what I call being on!”
Colin licked his lips and laughed wildly.
More and more dark blue gas spread, corroding and digesting the world in front of him, bringing him a continuous sense of satisfaction.
At this moment, he smacked his lips, slightly suppressed his emotions, opened his mouth, and exhaled.
A large number of merfolk that hadn’t been completely parasitized were spat out from the gigantic phantom, splashing onto the ground, causing a torrential “rain” of merfolk.
“Okay, this place is dealt with, now it’s your turn.”
Colin looked around Holy City. Although there were still some infectees, he didn’t need to deal with these creatures himself. Once the dark blue mist, turned from his “gastric juices,” spread out, it would resolve everything.
Then, he walked straight toward the barrier outside.
His figure tread in the air as if stepping on invisible steps. With each step, he seemed to teleport, appearing hundreds or even thousands of meters away.
Outside, there were still a considerable number of monsters, and more importantly, a few main courses!
“Running away when you see a teammate killed is not a good habit!”
Colin caressed his belly while walking over with a smile.
Because he was too close before, Omar might not have noticed the phantom, but those few outside could see it clearly. They not only failed to warn others but turned around and ran, which really wasn’t a good team spirit.
Even, the moment he appeared, the gaze from the “Crimson Abyss” immediately vanished…
It was obvious that it too had abandoned its believers and left.
However, Colin was not in a hurry. His pace was leisurely, not the least bit concerned about their escape…
And in a far-off sea area, several fleeing “Containers” stopped, their faces filled with despair as they watched ahead. They saw a layer of dark blue mist had appeared in the sea not far away.
This dark blue mist was thin and faint yet indestructible…
Suddenly, a few “Containers” gasped in horror, hearing a terrifying voice in their ears:
“Hehe, you didn’t see this coming, did you? I’ve already used my ‘stomach’ to take in this entire area. Breaking through my stomach walls is even more troublesome than killing me.”
They turned their heads in terror, only to see that the Outsider had somehow appeared behind them at an unknown time, a bundle of fire eerily burning atop his head, unaffected by the water of the deep sea.
But more terrifying than this was the phantom of a greenish-black divine statue on his body, colossal like a mountain range.
That phantom was indistinct, its eighteen grotesquely long arms waving softly in the murky green sea water.
Countless mouths of varying sizes cried out in hunger from those arms.
“No need to run, you won’t escape, kekeke!”
Colin let out a strange, eerie laugh, and with a thought, several greenish-black arms elongated, reaching out toward the fleeing lambs.
The lambs tried to escape but found themselves unable to move, as if bound by some invisible force.
However, at this moment, one of the lambs suddenly self-destructed, the massive energy temporarily breaking the bind.
The remaining three lambs quickly took action and attacked Colin.
Countless blood-red spores merged into the sea, “parasitizing” this part of the water and stirring up a powerful undertow—contact with this water could lead to parasitic infection for those not strong enough.
However, in the face of this torrent, only a toothless, gaping mouth grew on the outstretched palm.
There was no charge, no explosion…
Everything was directly devoured by the mouth that had appeared on the palm.
Colin patted his belly, surprised to find that he could still enjoy some “jelly,” which felt quite good.
The phantom behind him became more solid…
[Observation of “0-9 ‘Hunger'” revival in progress, current real-time value approximately 1.1%.]
“No good, I can feel him getting stronger. We have to beat him head-on; otherwise, there’s no escape!”
A “Container” gritted his teeth, seemingly coming up with something, and pulled something out of his body—this was a summoning method given to him by his Master when they had arrived.
According to the Revelation, this could summon an ally to assist them.
“This is… a demon? Is there still a bonus meal?”
Colin was startled, not expecting the others to be in cahoots with a demon, but he did not continue to attack and did not prevent their actions—
If there was a bonus meal, why not enjoy it?
Soon, as some kind of channel opened, a terrifying humanoid figure over ten meters tall emerged, and before it even arrived, its voice was already heard:
“Very well, I, the Count of Terror and Death, will make that one who dares to play with our great demon, pay the appropriate price…”
“Hm? What is this thing…”
“—’Hunger’!!!”
Before he had finished speaking, he suddenly realized something and looked up, shocked at the sight of that massive figure.
Without a second thought, he prepared to cancel the pact and self-destruct on the spot.
At this point, he couldn’t care less about any losses; being devoured by that thing was no joke…
If it happened, not to mention regenerating in subspace afterward, even being able to regenerate at all was in doubt.
However, what caused his heart to palpitate was that the pact could not be canceled, and he could not return…
It was one thing for the spatial realm here to be blockaded by the enemy.
What left him desperate and cold-hearted was…
His own people in the subspace seemed to have discovered something and also closed the “door” on him.
“Hahaha, since you’re all here, why not become a part of me together!”
Colin reached forward with an empty grasp, and all eighteen grotesquely long greenish-black arms moved in unison, reaching for the self-service feast from all directions.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - 316 314 The Most Infamous Level 0 Containment
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 316: Chapter 314: The Most Infamous “Level 0” Containment Subject_1 Chapter 316: Chapter 314: The Most Infamous “Level 0” Containment Subject_1 Eighteen huge, azure-black palms covered the sky and earth, nearly sealing off all corners, bringing an oppressive and suffocating terror.
On each of these palms was a mouth like an abyss, vast and without teeth.
“Damn it! How could I encounter such a cursed thing the moment I got out?”
The Demon Earl couldn’t help but recall the deep-seated fear of being dominated by “Hunger” from the depths of his memory.
Originally, he thought the human coaxing the bloodthirsty demon was just an ordinary human, at most a lower-level employee, the kind without high-level permissions; observations had indeed confirmed this.
But unexpectedly, while the lower-level employee was indeed a lower-level employee, why the hell did he have a “Level 0” Containment Subject with him?
And it was one of the most infamous among “Level 0″…
Muttering curses under his breath, he glared resentfully at a few individuals behind him, wishing he could slaughter them first.
However, at this moment, there was no time to think about that, as memories from his “ancestors” awakened within the Demon Earl’s heart, giving him a sense of something. A terrifying black mist erupted from his body, shaking off some invisible restraints around him.
“That was close, I almost got controlled to death.”
The Demon Earl let out a breath of relief, thoughts flashing through his mind of countless “ancestors'” tear-stained experiences dealing with this accursed creature. He knew that had he reacted a moment slower, with the space around him solidifying, he would likely have been instantly killed.
Next, he swung his axe in an attempt to cleave through space and achieve teleportation, but regretfully, the “stomach” that had enveloped him was incredibly tough, an impossibility to break through.
Taking a deep breath, he watched the overwhelming barrage of attacks with eyes like a blazing furnace, quickly pondering strategies to counter the assault.
“Fortunately, the level of control doesn’t seem to be very high yet; traits like ignoring spatial laws, consuming rules, or being an unknowable and unseeable entity have not yet emerged, or else there truly would have been no chance of fighting back.”
After rapidly searching through his memories, his gaze suddenly fell on a red figure beneath the mountain-like phantom shadows. The figure was covered in red hair, radiating an ominous presence, clearly the bearer of “Hunger.”
If he could behead it…
The Demon Earl extended a huge hand, reaching out across a considerable distance, trying to launch some kind of curse-based attack.
However, just as he initiated his attack, a hand suddenly blocked it, cutting off the space between them.
Normally, once he had locked onto a target, his “curse kill” was not something to be simply blocked.
But inexplicably, that’s exactly what happened…
As one of the azure-black hands sucked in air, his attack dissipated like a stone sunk into the sea.
“Truly a monster.”
The Demon Earl inhaled sharply, his combat instincts telling him that ambushing its true body was most likely impossible, so he immediately abandoned that course of action and targeted a comparatively less substantial hand without a mouth for a surprise attack.
Under the current circumstances, it was impossible for every hand to possess the same strength.
The several “Containers” by his side also didn’t hesitate to follow suit after seeing this.
Facing their full-force attack, the slightly weaker hand was breached.
However, one “Container” acted a bit too slowly and failed to escape the encirclement. In his panic, he threw out an energy blade filled with terrifying force, filled with an array of torpedo bombs.
Yet, to his shock, before the blade could explode upon striking the enemy hand, it was swallowed by the mouth on the hand.
The giant hand drew ever closer to him…
Seeing this, he hastily released a mass of spores and tried to command other infected individuals to take the blow for him.
But at that moment, his body stumbled, rapidly losing vitality.
Dozens of giant hands grabbed onto him, and like tearing dried squid, they shredded him and consumed his pieces.
“You!” The remaining two “Containers” looked at the Great Demon with uncertainty.
They had just witnessed how their companion, upon being seized by a mere gesture from this being, suffered catastrophic injuries, only to be easily slain by the enemy afterward.
“He can’t escape now, instead of letting him carry a load of nourishment and give his Divine essence to that monster as an added meal, I prefer to hasten his end,”
stated the Demon Earl coldly.
One of the “Containers,” after a moment of silence, gazed at the massive demon before them, towering at over ten meters tall, and asked, “So what should we do now? How can we defeat that thing? We summoned you specifically to beat it!”
‘Defeat it? Come, come, come, take the title of Demon Earl for yourself, and you try to beat it.’
The Demon Earl almost laughed at his words. If the other could truly defeat “0-9 ‘Hunger,'” then what was he doing as an Earl? He would have run for the position of Demon Duke or Prince long ago!
The harsh reality he faced after searching his ancestors’ memories was a message of despair.
Under current conditions, “0-9 ‘Hunger'” was unbeatable.
Even though, in actuality, his strength or various attributes were actually slightly higher than the opponent’s.
But against “Hunger,” if it wasn’t a significant advantage, then it hardly mattered at all.
In battle, the enemy could continuously devour their attacks, growing stronger as the fight progressed, while they themselves would be gradually consumed…
In other words, if you slash at it with a sword, it could devour the force of your blow, and from the next attack onward, each strike would be a combination of your attack + its own, acting as a sort of high-level, perverse deflection…
To defeat it, you needed some special rule-based methods.
“Stop dreaming, it’s impossible to beat it, especially now that we are fighting inside its ‘belly,'”
said the Demon Earl.
“Then what do we do? Just wait to die?” another “Container” spoke up.
At that moment, the eerie laughter sounded again, as the terrifying creature, having finished off one of their companions, approached once more.
“Hahaha, all of you must die, none of you can escape, to be devoured by me is your honor! It is also your only choice!”
Colin’s smile was slightly twisted as he reached out with both hands, extending them forward, and once again reached over. After swallowing another lamb, his recovery had now reached 2.1%.
The strange cyan-black miasma, like his stomach acid, grew ever more plentiful within the gastric spatial realm…
Many weaker creatures, not even requiring his direct intervention, had been completely digested.
And he wasn’t in a rush to devour the larger, fattier “sheep” scurrying about either; instead, he toyed with them, relishing in the pleasure of fishing in murky waters…
“Happy little fresh produce, happy little grilled catfish…”
Humming a tune, Colin launched his attack, his eyes growing increasingly insane.
In his eyes, those twisted creatures, all festooned with distorted tentacles, had become a seafood feast, ready to be stuffed into his mouth…
Meanwhile, the Demon Earl struggled to defend himself, narrowly escaping several times from beneath the large hand, and seizing the momentary gap in the attack, he hastily spoke:
“Just because we can’t handle it, doesn’t mean nobody can!”
“Who?”
“‘Bonfire Campsite’!”
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - 317 315 What on Earth is Going on with This
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 317: Chapter 315 What on Earth is Going on with This Year’s “Bonfire Camp”!_1 Chapter 317: Chapter 315 What on Earth is Going on with This Year’s “Bonfire Camp”!_1 “I refuse to believe that those guys from ‘Bonfire Camp’ will let this guy run out of control!”
The Demon Earl felt that, no matter what those “Bonfire Camp” guys were thinking, they definitely wouldn’t let this thing completely lose control.
“‘Bonfire Camp’?” The two “Containers” were somewhat perplexed.
Seeing their expressions, the Demon Earl knew that their “Master” certainly hadn’t told them much information.
He guessed they were just disposable pawns, used once and then discarded…
He wanted to say this, but considering his own situation, he silently closed his mouth.
“Just cooperate with me, and first, control your subordinates to sacrifice themselves willingly. Once that guy has eaten enough, something will surely come to deal with him, and that will be ‘Bonfire Camp’.”
“As long as ‘Bonfire Camp’ arrives, the situation will improve!”
The Demon Earl, while hastily dealing with those large hands, conveyed his plan to them.
They needed to let the opponent feed but not to the extent that was too fierce, lest ‘Bonfire Camp’ arrived and they themselves were devoured.
The Earl was convinced that once a certain extent was reached, ‘Bonfire Camp’ would inevitably take action.
By then, he would have the chance to escape this damned place.
Although the other two didn’t understand, they could only cooperate and execute the plan.
As the plan unfolded, Colin’s “revival” indeed gradually increased step by step.
Ten minutes later, as Dog Brother and the others watched, the “Hunger” revival value reached “2.5%” while the Demon Earl’s eyes, reflecting on Colin, showed an increasingly solid divine effigy.
It was then he suddenly realized something; he tried to close his eyes but was a step too late.
With a “pop,”
the reflection in his eyes suddenly launched an attack at him. A black-green hand extended from his eyes and then reached back towards his head, as if trying to crawl out of his eyes.
However, at the crucial moment, the demon steeled his heart and, with a backlash, chopped off half of his own head and then quickly fled.
It was then that a terrifying, blood-colored figure crawled out from his half head.
“Hmm, why run so fast?”
Colin watched the fleeing figure with dissatisfaction, shaking off the blood-colored long hair on his body, then opened his mouth and crunch, munch, including the bones, devoured the half-brain sashimi.
In the distance, the demon felt terrified, daring not to look back. The state of recovery had already reached a point where he couldn’t even afford to look.
Its “invisibility” power began to show its early stages…
Just by looking, the opponent might directly appear from his eyes.
And according to the “ancestor’s” memories, this was only the very first stage. If it progressed a little further, just by thinking of It in his mind, there was a certain probability It would directly burst forth.
Fighting it would become more and more troublesome as its recovery level rose…
Another key point was that after so many years, the ancestor’s knowledge might not be effective anymore, because no one knew how many things “Hunger” had devoured during this time, or how many abilities it had acquired.
Just like, now among those eighteen black-green large hands, several were covered with blood-colored long hair.
The movement of these hairs could lead their emotions to extremes.
This was an ability they never had before…
“What on earth is ‘Bonfire Camp’ doing! Come out quickly! Do you really want to let this guy run out of control?!”
The Demon Earl internally cursed ‘Bonfire Camp’ for their inaction.
He clearly remembered, according to the rules and regulations, lower-level employees were not supposed to carry threats of this level.
But this damn low-level employee actually had this thing on him, wasn’t this a serious violation of the relevant rules and regulations?
What the hell was going on with this session of ‘Bonfire Camp’?!
Although he was well aware that it was only a fragment, “Hunger” had a very peculiar aspect; even Its broken parts could continually devour to replenish itself, even though for some reason, it was impossible to surpass the main body, there would be a limit.
But reaching around thirty percent was still possible…
At this stage, it could be said that it was an apocalyptic disaster. Only dukes or champion chosen ones had the power to confront it then.
As he grumbled and cursed the whole time, Colin’s “resurrection” reached another phase…
“3％”
“Why, why, I just wanted to have a good meal, why won’t you cooperate?”
Colin muttered to himself, suddenly struck out, and killed a “container” to consume.
But this time, the food he had just obtained had its most anticipated “divinity” destroyed.
“It would all be over if you just let me eat in peace, why won’t you?”
Colin’s expression twisted somewhat.
This time, not only the demons but also Dog Brother and others began to feel that something was amiss.
They had been happily watching the show from below, laughing as Brother Shunzi rode the “Xu Neng Zuo Hu”, devouring his way through, but as they watched, they suddenly felt that something was off.
A ghastly algid smog had started to envelop them at some point, emitting strange “chewing” sounds…
Instantly, they could no longer laugh, feeling as if they themselves had turned into walking drumsticks.
At the same time, the Demon Earl was extending an olive branch to them, seeking cooperation…
After hesitating for a while, they noticed that Brother Shunzi’s reason seemed to be increasingly impaired, so the two sides covertly united, erecting a united front against “Hunger”.
The demon and his summoner together controlled the food entering Colin’s mouth, managing the resurrection progress.
Dog Brother and the others covertly kept score, while the “Sea Siren” queen also intermittently used her means to assist the demon from being consumed, to avoid the “Hunger” resurrection progress suddenly accelerating, leading to a loss of control…
Now, Dog Brother and the others felt that the only thing to be thankful for was that Colin still retained some sanity, not targeting them, but… listening to the increasingly clear chewing sounds in the algid black smog, they did not know how long this situation could last.
But just then…
[“0-9 ‘Hunger'” resurrection observation in progress, current real-time value is approximately 3.51％.]
An ancient and distant tolling of a bell echoed in their ears.
“Dong—Dong—Dong—”
With this resounding toll, the Deep Sea World before their eyes had acquired a layer of thin grey mist at some point.
At the same time, lines of text emerged before their eyes.
[“Bonfire Protocol” application approved…]
[“Bonfire Protocol – Special Support Project” proposed, mission dispatch in progress.]
[“….Lady” applies for mission claim.]
[Claim approved, “….Lady” will take full responsibility and execute the mission.]
[During execution, follow the detailed regulations carefully (click to open details).]
[…]
[Notice: “0-9 ‘Hunger'” data detected, resurrection level has reached “3.7% (essence 0.5%)”, given the special circumstances, Bonfire Company will activate a special support mechanism through multiple protocols.]
[Summary of content: Due to the urgency of the mission and the inability to obtain assistance in a short time, Employee “Unnamed123456” must resort to special means to utilize the power of “0-9 ‘Hunger'” to procure enough time to ensure the arrival of rescue…]
[Organizational unit appointed for the incident: Corps “Zoo” combined squad*12.]
[Execution details: 1. Recover items of significant value. 2. Assist employees in danger.]
[Target unit locked.]
[“Descent Protocol G-3” initiating.]
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - 318 316 Is this reinforcement ours _1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 318: Chapter 316 Is this reinforcement ours? _1 Chapter 318: Chapter 316 Is this reinforcement ours? _1 “It’s coming! Finally, it’s coming! Hahaha!”
When the grey mist rose, heralding the arrival of some dreadful will, the happiest of all was neither the Mermaid Queen nor Dog Brother and his group, but the Demon Earl himself, who had been directly confronting Colin this whole time!
At this moment, after holding out for so long, he finally saw the first light of dawn on his way home. With only half a head left and one pair of his demon wings torn apart, he couldn’t help but almost burst into tears—
Thanks to the ancestral memory passed down by demon forebears, summoning the remnants of a hundred demonic spirits, he had managed to endure for hours under that most infamous seal!
Even in that era, with his strength, few could have accomplished what he had!
“This reinforcement… It’s on our side, right?”
The “Sea Siren” Queen, upon seeing the outburst of joy from the unknown summoned creature in the distance and sensing its excitement, was a bit unsure whether the one approaching was ally or enemy.
Upon hearing her words, Dog Brother and others fell silent for a moment, then with some uncertainty, nodded:
“It should be…”
In the span of speaking, they saw the Demon Earl in the distance suddenly laughing, feeling his joy, and they actually became a bit unsure.
This damn…
If they couldn’t be sure this was the “Bonfire Company’s” signal, they might have thought the Demon Army had come charging in.
And it was after the “Bonfire Company” notification and the emergence of the murky mist before their eyes that the sensation of something arriving grew increasingly strong, transforming the entire world’s regions in a matter of seconds.
Red and blue lights, whose origins were unknown, lit up across the world, flashing continuously.
And with the arrival of these flashing red and blue lights, came a sharp and strange siren sound.
“Miss Nell’s Dog,” “Arsonist Tao Tie,” and other employees, upon hearing this sound, instantly realized that the strange hunger in their stomachs had disappeared, and the BUFF effects they had just bought, as well as the negative impacts of some items, also vanished…
All effects on their bodies, positive or negative, that were not inherently their own, were lost!
At this moment, their minds too reverted to clarity, feeling suddenly sobered.
“Hiss… this, is this what happened in ‘World Code-13’ before? Indeed, experiencing it for oneself is far more shocking than choosing it in a trial,” Dog Brother shook his head, looking up at the distant “battle of gods,” and couldn’t help but be moved.
Above them in the sea, they could see multiple converging clusters of grey mist, within which shadows of large doors covered in crimson rust faintly appeared.
Perhaps as a form of protection, they couldn’t see too many details of these doors.
However, Colin, who was trapped in the sea, could clearly see the thick heavy doors covered with mottled red rust and many signs of destruction and gaps left by wars.
“Are you also here to stop me from eating… no, hurry, help me… I can’t control myself anymore…”
Colin clutched his head with one hand, battling against his innate instincts.
Even though “Hunger” had subsided, the terrifying instinct triggered by this power still made him feel as if his will was rapidly eroding…
His stomach grew hungrier, and everything around him seemed more delectable…
It was as if a second personality had taken over his body, one that knew nothing but the desire to eat.
Colin’s will began to muddle; the flame atop his head that represented consciousness dimmed further until just a moment ago, when notifications flitted before his eyes and the siren sounded, giving him a bit of clarity.
Simultaneously, with a clank, the thick doors quickly opened.
From behind the doors enveloped in dense grey mist, pure white chains shot out rapidly, wrapping around his massive phantom shadow and then, pulling tight, the energy-forged chains locked him in place on the spot.
[Target controlled. “Zoo” mixed special team “Bunny” group will intervene in the battleground!]
Behind each door, several figures clad in thick steel armor stepped out, wearing what seemed to be overwhelmingly heavy suits but moving through the water as if unfazed.
This time, however, Colin noticed that due to the different setting, they seemed to have added some underwater gear to their attire.
“Reporting, battlefield deployment complete! Requesting new instructions.”
“Bunnies, commence the joint suppression operation!”
Upon receiving the order, the one with long ears and the pair of eyes glowing red under the hood raised the massive gun cradled in their arms, aimed at the phantom on Colin, and, without hesitation, pulled the trigger.
In an instant, a barrage of bullets with special effects shot from all directions like a sudden downpour, targeting only those large hands and sparing the rest of the body from attack.
“Doesn’t this feel a bit off…”
Colin did his best to control himself and not attack these members.
But he soon realized that their attacks seemed to be holding back?
And wasn’t it said to be a special mixed squad?
Why haven’t the others come out yet?
What about those heavy armored vehicles and the like from before?
And those missiles?
Colin was very clear that the First Legion had many odd pieces of equipment, but now none were being used, just limited assaults on him. Were they worried about injuring him?
At that moment, on the other side, a special mixed squad had caught up with the Demon Earl and others…
“Why? What are you doing? With this degree of attack, how could you possibly take down that guy? You haven’t even breached the ‘stomach wall’!”
The Demon Earl, puzzled, also sensed something was amiss.
But before he could think further, a squad of twenty-three approached them, and without a word, launched an attack.
The lead soldier, a long-eared heavy armored squad leader, waved his hand, and then a diamond-shaped, hive-like object moved closer, spewing out tens of millions of mechanical entities, each as small as a human fist.
These entities surged towards them…
The Demon Earl, without a second thought, took advantage of two “Crimson Abyss” “Containers” near him being off guard, grabbed them, and threw them directly at the swarm.
The two individuals were both shocked and furious, but had no time to think about that and busily engaged the enemy.
But the tens of thousands of entities, firing an extremely dense barrage of lasers, devoured them in a split second.
Under the dreadful attack, they didn’t last even a minute before being killed outright.
“Eighth Corps ‘Hive’ queen strain individual likes to engage in large-scale unmanned combat, from ‘Zoo’…”
The Demon Earl recognized this mechanism and tried to avoid it but suddenly heard a piercing “cackle” of a sonic charge attack, causing him to freeze on the spot. He struggled to turn his head and saw an individual without the long ears symbol but with a pair of pristine white wings.
Only then did he notice that many members of this seemingly normal squad were from other military corps.
“‘Zoo’s’ third corps, mental warfare, Swan…”
“…Pollution counteraction and counter-infiltration warfare… Fox…”
“Space and naval battles… White Shark…”
“These golden spikes on the head… all from elite units that have participated in over a hundred containment battles of at least Level 1 hazard…”
Under the intense Mental Shock, the Demon Earl’s thoughts flickered with difficulty, and he felt increasingly absurd—
This damn squad could be fit to fight a Demon Prince, let alone him…
And weren’t they supposed to be dealing with “0-9 ‘Hunger'”?
What business did they have coming for him?
The Demon Earl didn’t know the reason, but just when he thought he should be defeated soon, he suddenly found himself exchanging blows with the enemy.
“Have they weakened, or have I grown stronger?”
He was confused, but soon realized that neither guess was correct. These guys had some other objective and seemed to be forcing him towards “0-9 ‘Hunger'” unintentionally.
He vaguely sensed something, but at that moment, a bomb exploded beside him, blasting him in front of the giant shadow of “Hunger.”
And just then, a huge gash tore open in the shadow’s abdomen, sucking in hard like a mouth…
Consciousness plunged into nothingness.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - 319 317 Extermination Order_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 319: Chapter 317 “Extermination Order”_1 Chapter 319: Chapter 317 “Extermination Order”_1 “I’m so hungry…”
Having devoured the Demon Earl, a terrifying power surged within Colin, and the empty, pale sensation of hunger once again tried to take dominance as his second personality nearly seized control of his body.
But it was at that moment that a chain of light which had bound Colin earlier suddenly exerted its force, violently pulling him from beneath the enormous phantom shadow, freeing him from the original “hunger.”
When he came back to his senses, Colin found himself pulled into the Holy City, seemingly far from the battlefield.
“What’s going on?”
Colin was somewhat puzzled.
Then, another message appeared on his retina!
[Warning! Detection of growth in non-primary part of the original containment subject “0-9 ‘Hunger'” has reached 5%!]
[Request for further firepower intervention!]
[Warning!]
[Target is escaping! Target is escaping! Target is escaping!]
Amidst the barrage of messages, Colin saw that the massive form of “Hunger” seemed to be drawn to something, suddenly moving rapidly in the direction of the deep sea…
And the reinforcements that had arrived were quickly chasing after it.
“It doesn’t look like they want to contain it, but rather use this thing to carry out some other task that wouldn’t normally be permitted.”
Even if Colin was slow to realize, he knew something was wrong.
However, he was unclear as to what the corps’ goal was and why they had come to him…
But the corresponding operation reminded him of the pirates in Somalia or somewhere on Earth—were the world powers truly incapable of dealing with the rampant piracy there?
Impossible…
Then why not deal with it?
If they did, what excuse would they have to send warships there?
At this moment, Colin couldn’t help but reflect on how the company’s rules were strict, but the execution methods were flexible.
“Sir Bonfire, have you recovered?” Tina’s concerned voice came from the side.
Colin turned his neck, lifting his head slightly, and saw the Little Mermaid, taller than himself, standing to the side, propped up on her tail, surrounded by many other mermaids.
They seemed to be in relatively good condition, considering the corps apparently hadn’t dispatched any medical teams, or perhaps the situation really didn’t seem to necessitate it.
When he was still capable of controlling himself during the release of “Hunger,” he had swallowed all the seriously injured or infected mermaids, and when he spat them out again, their wounds were mostly healed.
At this moment, Colin belatedly realized that the “Gluttony Power Mark” might have a connection with “Hunger.”
Because their principles seemed almost identical…
Only the surface appearance was similar, with no actual part of “Hunger” contained within.
Shaking his head to dismiss the thought, Colin responded with a smile:
“Don’t worry, I’m fine.”
“Brother Shunzi, what’s the situation now?” Dog Brother and the others also walked over, their condition wasn’t too bad despite some injuries, but not severely affected.
More than that, they were confused about the current situation.
“I’m not very sure, something else might be going on with the higher-ups, but it should be fine now.”
“The higher-ups…”
Listening to Colin’s words, everyone couldn’t help but catch their breath—frankly, they knew through various channels that Bonfire Company’s ranks didn’t stop at D Level, and they surmised there were people and other departments above them from the descriptions on various items.
But guesswork was always just guesswork, this was their first actual contact…
“That’s good… but about that thing on you…”
“That’s no longer a problem either.”
While speaking, Colin felt his own condition, the “Beast Transformation Syndrome” and “Hunger” was still there, but it had quieted down as if the food he had just eaten was suddenly yanked out, causing it to faint from hunger—
Although it sounded annoying, it was the first description Colin could think of.
However, those things he had digested had become another type of monster very similar to it, due to the influence of its aura.
That was the part that was now “escaping.”
‘Unfortunately… the main part within my body has taken root too deeply; aside from relying on my own growth, it seems not so easy to extract it,’ Colin thought to himself with a sigh.
At that moment, the Arsonist asked, puzzled, “By the way, is our mission completed now? Why is it not showing any progress?”
It seemed like everything that needed to be done was finished, yet the mission had not indicated completion.
Hearing this, Colin was also confused, but soon, a thought struck him, and he suddenly realized something was missing—the message about reading the parchment…
“There should be one final step.”
Having said that, Colin didn’t read it on the spot, but turned to look at the “Sea Siren” queen:
“Choose a thousand of your people to come down to the Sanctuary…”
He did not wait for a response and glanced once more at the former battlefield, making sure after he had eaten all the threats, he headed straight toward the Sanctuary; that “Holy Relic” definitely needed to be recovered…
It wasn’t recovered previously because it was needed for the operation of the Holy City, but now that the issue had been resolved, it definitely had to be taken away.
After all, this was a massive mission reward!
Upon taking it away, whether to hand it over or keep it for himself, he was sure to profit…
The queen watched his retreating figure with a complex gaze, and although Colin didn’t state it explicitly, she had a premonition that what was most important to them might soon be leaving them.
After a few seconds of silence, she flicked her tail and signaled the mermaids to follow.
“Speaking of which, this hall is most likely not built by the ‘Sea Sirens,’ but I wonder how it came into their possession…”
Colin arrived at the entrance to the stairs within the Sanctuary and looked at the staircase that led downwards—
If it were built by mermaids, these stairs would seem rather superfluous given their physiological structure.
But not dwelling on this matter, he walked downstairs while taking out the parchment he obtained earlier from the “Storage Room.”
He was not worried about others seeing it, as he noticed the parchment had some kind of protection.
Dog Brother and other associates might not be able to see it, not to mention the mermaids…
At this moment, as his gaze swept over the parchment, he could roughly judge that it was something akin to a casual diary entry, but the contents of the report made Colin’s heart tremble with alarm.
“Currently, the situation in ‘World Code’ has deteriorated to an indescribable extent. It’s hard to imagine that such a highly-anticipated project, even under the personal execution of that tycoon, would have come to this state…”
“According to my assessment, the current status of this tycoon… is probably not too good.”
“With my abilities and strength, I am most likely unfit for any task regarding him, even if his information is completely transparent. But since ‘Mister Huang He’ has entrusted this mission to me, I will attempt to complete it.”
“Now, my team and I have, with the permission of ‘Bonfire,’ implemented Extermination Orders in completely out-of-control areas such as ‘World Code-5’, ‘World Code-6’, ‘World Code-9’, ‘World Code-11’, ‘World Code-12’, erasing all containment subjects below Level 1, and eighty percent of Level 1 containment subjects, along with the worlds they reside in…”
“The progress has been very successful.”
“Additionally, a few worlds such as ‘World Code-4’ and ‘World Code-8’ have been left with an unactivated ‘Extermination Order’ on standby. If the situation turns sour, subsequent personnel can resolve potential threats with minimal force.”
“And for the innocent individuals, I’ve reserved safer regions such as ‘World Code-13’ and ‘World Code-7’ as evacuation points. Once they obtain the authorized documents, we can arrange for the ‘Infinite Train’ to transport and evacuate them…”
“Above is the current progress of the work.”
“Soon, after I successfully circumnavigate ‘World Code-4’, I can leave here in the normal way and continue to delve deeper.”
…
The information was brief and ended there.
However, the content above made Colin’s heart race, and he also understood why their appearance caused such a great reaction from the ‘Crimson Abyss’.

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - 320 318 The company has a lot of cunning
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 320: Chapter 318 The company has a lot of cunning tricks. _1 Chapter 320: Chapter 318 The company has a lot of cunning tricks. _1 “What exactly does this ‘Extermination Order’ do? Can it even destroy ‘Level 1 Containment Subjects’?”
Colin couldn’t help but draw a sharp breath.
When he had been in “The Seventh Box Garden World,” he had heard that even if the world were to be destroyed, those things might not necessarily perish. Otherwise, when they left, those terrible ‘Level 1 Containment Subjects’ would probably not have just sat there idle.
To them, it mattered little whether the world was destroyed or not, for even if the planet exploded, most of them had the power to preserve themselves; hence, they could just ignore the departure of the train…
But unexpectedly, here, a single ‘Extermination Order’ would leave nothing unscathed.
Even beings akin to gods, the ‘Level 1 Containment Subjects,’ would die…
Even if a few survived, Colin estimated their lives would not be pleasant.
At this moment, although it was not explicitly stated what the ‘Extermination Order’ entailed, Colin didn’t need to think too hard to guess that it was probably the “backup plan” left by the ‘Firebearer.’
If he could get his hands on it, he might have the chance to completely destroy this place…
Ordinary employees, even if they obtained it, most likely wouldn’t have the authority to initiate it, but Colin knew he had some special privileges because of the ‘Firebearer’s’ aura…
No wonder the ‘Crimson Abyss’ had such a strong reaction, to attack this place in defiance of common sense.
He remembered the Queen’s Guard mentioning before that the powers of the ‘Crimson Abyss’ were heavily restrained by the ‘Holy Fire,’ and they usually didn’t want to have any contact with the ‘Sea Siren.’
But this time, for some unknown reason, they launched a massive assault, even at great cost.
Timing it, it coincided exactly with their first use of the ‘Book of Fate: Fragment.’
‘Perhaps at that time, the ‘Crimson Abyss’ suspected we were here to find the backup plan? But why wouldn’t it dare come directly itself?’
As Colin descended the stairs, he pondered that there might still be some kind of measures specifically targeting them.
Forcing those beings to merely provide power assistance while their true bodies dared not to engage.
Upon closer reflection…
He suddenly realized there was a problem with the script he was given for this mission.
“This… Aren’t we supposed to be saving the world? Why does this script seem odd, as if the roles of heroes and villains have been swapped?”
Although Colin had no intention of activating the ‘Extermination Order,’ those higher beings probably didn’t care about that. What mattered to them was…
He had the ability to activate it!
In a sense, the true entity that wanted this world not to be destroyed was the ‘Crimson Abyss’…
Thinking of this, Colin glanced inconspicuously at the ‘Sea Siren’ queen who was following behind him, as well as the large group of little mermaids whose eyes showed adoration for him…
He wondered if they knew about all these intricacies, whether they would still look at him the same way.
“According to the company’s style, even if we did activate this thing, they would probably transfer these mermaids and the like to another world before executing it…”
“But then again, I don’t know the situation with ‘World Code-7,’ but is it true that ‘World Code-13’ is safer, as they say?”
Colin recollected the conditions of ‘World Code-13,’ feeling that although not extremely harsh, they didn’t align well with anything good either.
“Looking at it now, the goal of ‘Bonfire Company’ has been very clear from the beginning, which is to reclaim the backup plan. Otherwise, there’s no way they would be nearby just by coincidence. It’s only because the ‘Book of Fate’ caught the attention of the ‘Crimson Abyss’ that all these extra complications arose.”
He pursed his lips. Without using the ‘Book of Fate,’ there was a chance that nothing would be triggered. Once the information gathering was complete and the path confirmed, they could go directly to the Holy City—if they could also persuade the fishmen, likely without any incident.
But it was also possible they would be ambushed and suffer heavy losses…
This account was not easy to settle, the only thing worthy of gratitude was that the current outcome was still acceptable.
“Fortunately, we’re not too far from the ‘Sea Siren’ Holy City. If time had been drawn out a little longer, I’m afraid the enemies arriving at the end would’ve been more than just one ‘Crimson Abyss’…”
The information previously obtained from Little Tina suggested that there were more than one high-level containment subjects here.
It’s just that the ‘Crimson Abyss’ had the largest range of activity.
Colin silently felt thankful. Had that been the case, he might not have even had the chance to use “Hunger” to break through.
Without a “fallback” to rely on, suppressing the will within “Hunger,” using it would likely mean there’s no going back.
After all, even with a fallback, he had almost lost control of himself, let alone without one.
“It’s just that I don’t know what mission that group of Corps teams dispatched here has.”
Colin pondered for a moment, but finding no answers, shook his head and no longer dwelt on it.
At this moment, as he walked bit by bit into the depths of the Sanctuary, that huge circular “Holy Furnace” once again appeared before his eyes.
During the recent battle, in order to make greater use of the Holy City, the Queen had thrown in quite a bit of food, and the “fallback” was currently lying inside it, feeding…
Its middle finger’s mouth was devouring the bodies of some infected one by one, then quickly digesting them, becoming fatty. The pale yellow human fat emerged from the severed end of the hand, and was then scorched into flowing grease by the flames.
Most of it was incinerated, but a small part that was not fully burned flowed into a specially prepared basin to enable sustainable exploitation.
“…The people from the company sure had a lot of tricky ideas.”
For Colin, this was clearly a path he had never imagined.
Meanwhile, the Queen suddenly spoke from behind him, “Sir Bonfire… I want to know, if you take it away, what will happen to the flame?”
If they were without the light of the fire, it wouldn’t take long for them, the ‘Sea Sirens,’ to lose their sanity and become wild beasts wandering the Deep Sea.
Apart from looking pretty, they would be utterly useless.
It was just as she finished speaking, and Tina was about to say something, that Colin spoke first:
“Don’t worry, I will bring you the true ‘Holy Fire,’ a flame that belongs to you.”
Colin had previously understood the special circumstances of the ‘Sea Sirens.’ He felt that the Firebearer who had left this place must have used some method to bind them here, making them act like guards.
But now, Colin was going to undo this “binding”.
“A ‘Holy Fire’ that belongs to us…”
The Queen murmured to herself. She wanted to ask for proof, but then she remembered the fire on that island when reinforcements had arrived, and the Holy Fire now dancing upon his body.
Seeing that the Queen had nothing more to say, Colin withdrew his gaze and walked toward the hand.
In a short while, he arrived in front of the Holy Furnace. He hesitated for a moment, then reached out and touched the wrist of the hand, the feel was almost like that of a living person’s, only the temperature was slightly higher.
The overall sensation was indescribably subtle.
And at that moment, Dog Brother and the others had the information of mission completion appear in their minds.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - 321 319 The Specifics of the Extermination
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 321: Chapter 319 The Specifics of the “Extermination Order”._1 Chapter 321: Chapter 319 The Specifics of the “Extermination Order”._1 [The first round of the “D Level Promotion Mission,” the “Trial Task,” has been completed.]
[Note: In ten minutes, all participants will return to reality and the rewards for this mission will be settled.]
“Finally done!”
Dog Brother and the others took a deep breath, as if depleted of strength, and seated themselves on the stairs, no longer concerned with appearances.
At that moment, Colin’s expression shifted slightly as he held the severed hand. He suddenly felt a connection to something, and at this instant, the image of a terror-inducing entity flashed across his mind—
A massive blaze, capable of devouring entire star systems, burned in a barren expanse.
Pain and screams emanated from the burning flames…
It seemed many life forms beyond comprehension were suffering from the scorching.
And now, should he wish it, and certain conditions be met,
Then…
At the moment it would come into effect, endless, terrifying flames would spurt forth from this vast fireball—whose location and actual size were unknown—following some connection and guidance, ignoring spatial distances, and pouring directly into this place, no, more precisely, into this world.
In a fraction of a second, it would ignite the entire deep sea, incinerating and striking down everything within the scope of “World Code -4.”
By then, even those beings who seemed godlike in his eyes might scarcely escape the fate of becoming kindling and perishing…
“‘Extermination Order’…”
Colin couldn’t help but whisper to himself.
He realized deeply that this might be one of Bonfire Company’s mightiest powers, or perhaps even the mightiest.
The terrifying vision did not last long, vanishing after a few seconds, but Colin felt that what he was holding was no longer just a hand, but a button for a super nuclear bomb.
However, even though it was now in “ready to launch” status, the conditions for actual activation remained incredibly stringent.
Transferring ordinary innocents was merely a basic preliminary step…
It also required a large amount of reports, evidence, and multiple on-site investigations, along with a long list of requirements that Colin found incomprehensible.
“That’s good, it indicates that the company wouldn’t use this power at will unless it’s truly the last resort; they would not destroy a place out of mere spite,”
Feeling the harshness of the activation conditions, Colin dared not imagine how dire the circumstances in the other “World Codes” had been to justify its repeated use.
“When he left these messages, it seems he only had three worlds left to investigate; I wonder what was in those last three worlds that led to his downfall.”
Colin remembered that this place was described as an important project in the hands of a Bonfire Company magnate.
The project must have failed…
His former colleague was then dispatched here for recovery work on what remained of the magnate’s project. Initially, things went smoothly, with a few worlds blown up along the way, but, unfortunately, it appears he ultimately failed.
“The question is, if he probably died in one of the previous three worlds, how did his head get back to that small chapel in ‘World Code -13’?”
Colin was somewhat puzzled, surely the “head” wasn’t carved off by himself to be used as a prop there, right?
But then again, he felt it was unnecessary because having an extra ace up his sleeve seemed more practical…
The ability for a high-level employee to regenerate severed limbs shouldn’t be too difficult; there were more back-up plans than one could use, so there was no need to sever one’s own head…
In the end, he shook his head in secret, took a deep breath to suppress the doubts in his heart, and looked again at the severed hand he was holding.
For him.
The greatest benefit of having an ace up his sleeve was not that button but the grease that was secreted after the hand consumed matter.
The flames produced using that substance were at least twice as powerful as ordinary flames, and that didn’t even account for its special properties…
“Next time I encounter that ‘Liping,’ even if I don’t use ‘Repulsion,’ I can still shatter her domain with flames, or even defeat her directly; there won’t be a stalemate…”
“The only thing I need to worry about is whether the production is enough.”
“However, with a rough estimate, as long as I feed it some low-level monsters or something, I should be able to extract one or two liters of grease a month, which isn’t too bad.”
In the midst of his thoughts, Colin roughly figured out how to extract the oil and then prepared to store it in the “Storage Room”.
But it was at this moment that a piece of information popped into his mind.
[Event Two: Collect the “Remnant – Left Hand”.]
“Reward Content”: ‘3L of Pure Bonfire Grease’, with a substantial amount of additional points as reward.
“Note”: “Pure Bonfire Grease, repeatable reward of 3L per week.”
…
At first glance of the mission, Colin felt a bit annoyed inside, although he had a hunch that Bonfire Company would make him hand over the item, the reality of it still made his feelings quite complex.
But after reading the details, Colin suddenly felt that one shouldn’t only look out for their own interests.
It was very selfish of him to keep such an important thing and use it for himself—
“Damn, by my estimate, getting one or two liters a month would be good, but once it gets to the company, they would squeeze out at least ten liters a month…”
When it comes to capital, when it comes to exploitation, when it comes to draining resources dry, it has to be the company!
No wonder they are the company and I am just an employee…
During his contemplation, he clicked agree, and a transparent vortex appeared, sucking away the hand with a mouth.
As the severed hand disappeared, the whole Sanctuary seemed to lose a source of power, and suddenly dimmed.
However, before the queen and the other mermaids could express any more emotion, Colin stretched his hand forward pointing, and the “Level 1 Bonfire” wrapping around his body flew into the furnace.
The humanity’s radiance emitted from these flames was not any less than that of the “Holy Relic”.
It’s just…
There was considerably less of it.
“Add something to it, upgrade it a bit…”
As the thought flashed across Colin’s mind, ready to proceed, he saw a familiar transparent vortex appear over the bonfire, and from within the vortex, a piece of paper flew out and ignited in the flames.
It burned rapidly, and by the time Colin noticed, he could only see a signature from “Lady Bunny”.
Then, as the paper burned up completely, the flames suddenly underwent an extreme explosion, rapidly expanding and growing.
Soon…
The entire Sanctuary was lit up as a massive flame shot up more than a hundred meters high, enveloping everything around.
The “Sea Sirens” saw the flames rushing toward them, ready to engulf them, and panic surged initially, but they soon realized that even within the flames, they remained unharmed, which helped them to relax.
Feeling the deep warmth in the flames, an indescribable happiness welled up within them.
Even the queen seemed to forget about the so-called “Holy Relic” for a moment—what was that thing again?
At the same time, Colin also received the latest information about the fire.
[“Bonfire Sacrificial Site”: Level 5.]
[Remaining Burn Time: 364 days 23 hours 59 minutes.]
[Feature 1 “Will of the Cinder King”: A bonfire made up of numerous pieces of kindling. When the deepest depths of despair arrive, try praying before this fire. The will emanating from the bonfire will descend from the flames in the form of a king, doing everything in its power for its believers.]
