chapters.title: Chapter 360 - 360 358 Killing Beyond Ones Level_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 360: Chapter 358: Killing Beyond One’s Level!_1 Chapter 360: Chapter 358: Killing Beyond One’s Level!_1 “No matter if it’s combat experience, the ability to make choices, or judgement, they’re all much stronger than the current D Level, at least stronger than the one we encountered on the train previously. Even the level of props they’re using is just green.”
Colin recalled the recent battle, noting that the group of D Level hadn’t used too many particularly powerful props.
For the first ten minutes, they had been testing them, trying to understand their base level.
Apart from the two squad leaders who led the charge, there hadn’t been an intense battle between both sides.
Even so, their side had a tough time fighting.
It could almost be said that just one D Level Squad Leader was nearly suppressing all of them, and the teammates beside the squad leader were only observing and occasionally taking the chance to strike…
Moreover, each time they attempted, they could quickly come up with intelligence and find a solution.
At this moment, “Son of Sadomasochism,” while healing on the ground, followed Colin’s gaze to glance at the corpses scattered everywhere and shook his head, perhaps thinking of something:
“I guess just a few more minutes, and the battle would have likely ended…”
More than anyone else, he felt the pressure most acutely, clearly sensing that the artifact on him was being relentlessly targeted and deciphered by the enemy, and it wouldn’t be long before it was shattered.
“It’s a pity it was just a few minutes short.”
Colin agreed with this.
In the final minutes, the rationality of the D Level Personnel had evaporated as quickly as boiling water under high heat and, in a short time, turned into a beast-like existence, ultimately making them easy prey.
Regarding such a victory, they didn’t feel any guilt, but to say they were happy about it would be an overstatement…
Regardless, it left them feeling somewhat bland and uninspired.
‘However, isn’t what I’m experiencing now similar to what those exploration teams encountered when they first came here?’
‘The replicas didn’t show the true form of those contaminations; were they omitted by the company for being too dangerous? That seems quite similar to my “Self-selected Trial Event” replica…’
‘But there haven’t been any additional events; could it really be that this mission only involves battling through three train carriages?’
As Colin provided healing and chatted to recap the battle, his mind raced with thoughts.
Having faced many unexpected events in the past, the lack of surprises almost made him paranoid.
However, if it was really just about fighting through three or five carriages, then this mission would indeed be easy.
Despite “Son of Sadomasochism” and the others struggling so bitterly, if he took action himself, the situation would have immediately turned around, with the opponents merely holding out as long as they could.
Although he might be slightly behind these people in accumulating combat experience,
It wasn’t a big problem; with his props and enhancements, his overall power level was higher. If those people were at level ten, he must be at level thirty, making an over-level slaughter no issue at all.
“Forget it, let’s just keep observing for now; if something happens, it happens, if not, then let it be.”
Colin shook his head secretly and collected his thoughts.
Later, with the aid of the Little Maid’s Nano Intellectual Mechanism, the Mark of Gluttony, and the “Colorless Crystal,” their various injuries had largely healed in just half an hour.
“Damn, this is what it feels like to have healing support…” “Fuer Mushroom” held the “Mark of Gluttony,” taking a long breath of relief.
The others nodded in agreement with his sentiment.
It truly is a different feeling when fighting with or without support.
After their last fight in the first carriage, although they didn’t lose anyone, they ended up with one severely wounded and four with minor injuries.
Nothing like now, where after the fight was over, not only were they not tired, but they felt full of strength.
At that point, “Emperor Sun” spoke up, “As long as nothing unexpected happens and we don’t run into those nine special D Level Personnel, we should be quite stable.”
“Even if we do run into the group of nine, it’s not like we don’t stand a chance. Anyway, we can fight till the third carriage…” the Squad Leader “Son of Sadomasochism” said confidently.
“I’m dead, we couldn’t beat them before because we had no sugar daddy, but now we’ve got one, and not bragging about steamrolling them is already a big concession,” said a team member, half-confident, half-joking.
Before long, as the last ten minutes passed, the train once again coupled with other cars.
The door to the Mist Gate materialized.
Like last time, voices from a conversation drifted through it.
“Huh? Does it sound clearer now?”
Colin was startled, wanting to listen more, but seeing the squad leader had already entered, he didn’t hesitate and followed inside.
He didn’t want to end up in a situation where these four would start fighting on the other side and he couldn’t get through; that would be troublesome.
And just as everyone entered, the voices of conversation quickly disappeared as if realizing someone had arrived.
“Only four people! Top-notch luck!”
Seeing the number of personnel, the Son of Sadomasochism and the others felt a surge of joy inside.
Facing these guys, the fewer they were, the easier it was for them to handle.
However, before they could rejoice further…
They quickly realized that among the enemies, one D Level staff possessed a special summoning item, which created a blood pool that continuously spouted all kinds of bizarre creatures that attacked them.
The strength of these monsters was not weak; dealing with them was even more troublesome than the previous round’s D Level Squad Leader…
Moreover, aside from the special item of that D Level employee, the other three D Level members were incredibly strong, and seemed to be without any injured members. Hence, the tactics adopted by these four D Level staff were completely different.
After less than three minutes of probing, they chose to launch a full-scale attack directly.
If it hadn’t been for Colin’s covert interventions several times, the scene might have been overrun by the monster horde, with only Plentiful Fruits remaining.
Fortunately, when the timer reached ten minutes, these people began to gradually lose their rationality and at around the fifteen-minute mark, they reached a peak, completely lost their sanity, and dropped their items to charge at them.
Facing D Level Personnel, they were helpless, but facing a horde of “beasts,” they only needed to raise their weapons.
The battle came to a swift conclusion with the emergence of this situation.
Right then, except for Colin, the injury-riddled group collapsed on the ground, gasping heavily.
“Huff huff huff, damn it, I was careless, we almost flipped over…”
“This time it seems like new items, new characters? I haven’t heard of anything like this blood pool before…”
“Hey, this is fresh intel, isn’t selling this info for a thousand a bit much?”
“Too little, you’re asking for too little, selling for fifteen hundred or even two thousand is possible.”
The group said this as they were catching their breath.
Colin, almost completely unharmed, was once again healing these people like he did in the previous car, though this time the wounds of the group were horrendous and bloody. However, “Nano Intellectual Mechanism” was particularly adept at handling such injuries.
Less than half an hour later, everyone was more or less back to normal.
Feeling their bodies’ conditions, they couldn’t help but be impressed; this was the prowess of the Righteous Father!
If it wasn’t for him, even if they hadn’t flipped this round, they probably wouldn’t be able to continue next time.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - 361 359 The Great Expedition Far Away._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 361: Chapter 359 “The Great Expedition Far Away”._1 Chapter 361: Chapter 359 “The Great Expedition Far Away”._1 “Just one more fight to go!”
The Son of Sadomasochism stood up, brimming with eagerness. This was the first time, even after finishing the second carriage, that his status was almost at full. Even during the first half of the year when he had just been promoted, he hadn’t managed to achieve this!
After a moment of thought, he looked at the others and said:
“By the way, how about this, after we collect all this intelligence, we give half of our mission points as a reward to the Righteous Father to boost him up?”
“I have no objections…”
“Neither do I…”
As the words were spoken, everyone nodded in agreement.
According to past conventions, the points for such missions were quite substantial, usually around fifteen hundred.
Splitting half would be at least seven hundred…
But these few hundred points were nothing compared to the immense favors and kindness of the Righteous Father!
For the four of them, that was three thousand points. Plus the earnings from the intelligence, it would be a considerable reward for the vast majority of the company members.
It was just a pity…
‘Giving me points is kind of pointless, …’
Hearing their conversation, Colin couldn’t help but feel a mix of amusement and bemusement. Right now, he truly had no interest in points.It was probably “The Light Chaser” who would most likely relish the opportunity to fleece them.
Of course, although internally he was refusing, Colin didn’t turn down the kind gestures from his brothers…
In the mix of idle chat and battle debriefing, an hour quickly passed.
As the BOSS door shrouded in mist emerged, and they were about to enter, this time Colin stopped them.
“What’s the matter?” The squad leader, The Son of Sadomasochism, didn’t understand but didn’t continue either.
As the “true big daddy” of the squad, Colin’s voice still carried weight.
“Don’t you hear it? The voices… from inside.”
Colin gestured towards the interior; at this moment, he could hear faint voices quite clearly.
“Voices?”
The others looked at each other, shaking their heads. They had always been aware of some noise, but it was indistinct, like the hustle and bustle of a busy market, catching only fragments here and there.
In the past, after each battle, they were too exhausted to give any thought to it.
But now, it seemed that the Righteous Father could hear clearly what was being said inside?
Seeing their reaction, Colin could roughly guess that they probably couldn’t make it out. He didn’t have time to elaborate, but he made a “shush” gesture and continued to half-close his eyes and cock his ear to listen intently.
What was being discussed inside seemed to be just ordinary chatter, but the information within hit him with a shock.
“Hehehe, let me tell you guys, the higher-ups have added three hundred new C Level positions! This time, our corps has made outstanding contributions to the suppression of the Planetary Surface Overturning Level event. We’ve received first-level commendations, and the chances of promotion are very high!”
“Out of our more than seventy people, at least one-tenth of us have a chance to succeed!”
“Wow, doesn’t that mean seven C Level members will emerge just from our corps? Is your information reliable?”
“I’m not sure, but the likelihood isn’t small! By the way, what’s your next destination?”
“What destination could it be? Of course, it’s to apply to join ‘The Great Expedition Far Away!’ Mankind’s dream since ancient times has been to conquer the stars! When the time comes, I will etch my name on the edges of the galaxy billions of light-years away, making those ancient beings tremble at the sight of my name!”
“What? Isn’t this expedition still years away from starting?”
“That’s all news from seven or eight years ago. Don’t tell me you’re stuck in your crappy ‘Old Scroll’ all day and don’t even check the news?”
“No, I was part of a special experiment last time, got frozen as a subject for a few years, just came out not long ago, and was immediately pulled for this urgent mission.”
“Fine, anyway, currently, 500 ‘World Codes’ have already been completed, and now there’s a large scale expansion of the corps going on, starting with action in the neighboring regions. From what the decision-makers suggest, ‘World Code’ will eventually reach three thousand, corresponding to the ancient legends of three thousand worlds…”
“Tsk tsk tsk… ‘The Great Expedition Far Away,’ eh? Once out of the Solar System, it’s not safe. It’s going to be an exceptionally fierce battle; even with resurrection methods, there’s no guarantee of coming back to life. I don’t have that kind of guts. My triplets just turned two this year; I plan to apply to ‘Box Garden World’ for a safer experience, do some experiments, retire, take care of the kids, and see what happens when they grow up…”
“Well, that’s a choice, too. As for me, I’ve been assigned to the manufacturing department…”
“What? The manufacturing department? Are you crazy… Ever since Boss Huang took over, the style of the manufacturing department has become unbearable.”
“I know, but the good news is, I applied to be under Boss Rosen, and I got in…”
“Rosen is not bad, much more normal, just a bit stingy. He gives half the points others do, always looking to save on everything. But at least you don’t have to worry about social death. The bad news? You’ve been assigned to the lowest evaluation staff, haven’t you?”
“Not exactly, but my resume was noticed by Boss Huang’s subordinates. Then they thought that ‘Script City’ had a project about structural research optimization that needed someone like me, and I was forcefully transferred there…”
“Hahaha, that’s hardly good news. Well, Boss Huang may be inhumane and petty, but he offers really high benefits and pay, probably the highest in the company, right? Just be careful if he gives you any props…”
“You better not laugh, for if the ‘Book of Fate’ captures you badmouthing Boss Huang, you might end up being snatched into ‘Passionate Paradise’ to play as a female NPC for a few years, heh, do I need to come and patronize your business then?”
“Scram, scram, scram! But listen, come in closer, I have something to tell you…”
…
Meanwhile, compared to “The Son of Sadomasochism” and others, who were utterly confused, Colin was listening with great interest,
“Three hundred C Level positions,” “The Great Expedition Far Away,” “500 ‘World Codes,'” and some information about those high-ups…
From this gossip and idle talk, Colin had gleaned a great deal of highly valuable content.
However, towards the end, as the voices of these people suddenly grew softer, he slightly tilted his head, his pupils vertically slitted as he enhanced his auditory senses to continue gathering information…
But at that moment, a surge of heart-palpitating sensation flooded over him.
At the same time, a vision of death emerged in his mind—
From beyond the Mist Gate, a phantom greatsword sliced through the carriage, targeting him with precision like reaping wheat, bisecting him diagonally, and then countless silver sword energies wreaked havoc inside him, reducing him to a pile of blood and flesh.
“Watch out!” Colin cried, leaping backward.
And a several-meters-long phantom greatsword burst through the wall, nearly grazing Colin’s face as it swung down.
At the same time, a figure in a brown Hunter’s Coat emerged from after the Mist Gate, his presence crowned with a three-faced, six-armed phantom that seemed like an Ancient God of war.
Upon seeing Colin and the others, he sneered, “Tsk, just as I thought, we’ve got a rat sneaking in.”
Without further ado, the phantom raised its weapons and viciously chopped down at the crowd.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - 362 360 The Squad Leader who Leads by
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 362: Chapter 360: The Squad Leader who Leads by Example_1 Chapter 362: Chapter 360: The Squad Leader who Leads by Example_1 “Swoosh!”
As the sound of the sharp weapon sliced through the air, the giant ghostly cleaver, as substantial as a door, crashed heavily to the ground, causing the entire carriage to shudder.
Though the strike once again missed its target, it wasn’t without some measure of success.
“Emperor Sun” slowed down just a step too late, his left leg severed from the knee and sent flying…
In the instant he lost the limb, he hardly felt any pain.
Had he not seen the process unfold with his own eyes, “Emperor Sun” would have believed his leg was still attached to his body.
“Hurry up!” the squad leader, “Son of Sadomasochism,” shouted.
As the words fell, “Emperor Sun” rolled backward, leaping into the range of “Son of Sadomasochism’s” item effects.
A brilliant, kaleidoscopic light burst forth, blocking the oncoming ghostly cleaver.
“Son of Sadomasochism,” who carried the Purple Gear “Nine-Colored Blessing Light,” could see things that ordinary people couldn’t.
These were numerous, strangely colored orbs of light zipping past him, and as they did, he reached out his hand to touch them…
Subsequently, multicolored dazzling lights exploded as he made contact with them.
To touch as many lights as possible, he moved hands and feet in sync, hopping and jumping so that to Colin and the others, it seemed as if he were competitively dancing in a bout.
“Quick reflexes,” commented the figure in the brown Hunter’s Coat, kicking aside the ripped flesh on the ground and raising an eyebrow in surprise that his ambush had yet to take effect, especially since the one causing the surprise…
He turned his attention to the young man being shielded and emitting a faint light.
On the face of it, this guy seemed to be merely a support character.
But a certain inexplicable intuition told him that this guy was the biggest threat among these types of life forms.
Even did this guy seem to possess some power similar to his?
At that moment, the battlefield fell silent for a few seconds as his assault paused.
Yet, in their internal communicative telepathy, it was anything but quiet.
“This carriage is where Meng Hui is located, but there’s no sign of her, suspected total annihilation…”
“The intruders possess intelligence, but their race and power are indeterminate, as are their motives,…”
“These people bear no malice; they seem to want to stall for time. Next, try beheading the one who is using the blessing. Be careful, he seems to have a kind of precognition of death and is very quick to respond. And be extra cautious, if it’s not possible, you can kill the others first, the rest are dumber, slow like pigs, easy to kill…”
“If you really can’t kill them, then try to split up the battlefield, and prevent them from grouping together.”
“…Also, immediately request assistance and inform the other carriages about the situation here. When you go for the beheading, remember to be careful around the protected one, there’s a big problem with him, and also evacuate the wounded as fast as possible…”
“Next, I’ll first see what these guys are all about.”
“Then, Kong… when you come over, attack the enemy from the right, I will create a weak point for you over there…”
“…”
In just a few seconds, a series of methodical commands were issued in the internal group chat.
It was after several commands were given.
A terrifying aura again emanated from the five-meter-tall shadow, its head almost extending outside the carriage, equipped with three heads and six arms like an ancient warlord.
From his main weapon, the blood-red cleaver, a thick scent of blood surged forth.
This time, however, the D Level Personnel manipulating the phantom didn’t rush to attack but instead seemed to have a sudden thought. Controlling the dreadful general shadow, he lifted an arm holding a flag and waved it vigorously.
In an instant, a wave of blood energy exploded at the right side of the defense.
A second too slow, he steered the phantom towards the left side of Colin’s squad for an assault.
“Fuck!”
The squad leader “Son of Sadomasochism” saw the situation and his expression changed.
He spied on the internal group chat, secretly strengthening the barrier’s right side defense, but that unscrupulous guy actually did something different from what he said!
In the haste, his body swayed, triggering several spheres of light, bursting forth with more dazzling light, enhancing the protection.
Boom!
The giant blade continuously sliced through dozens of radiant lights that seemed to have a physical presence.
The D Level Personnel controlling the three-headed six-armed apparition, just as he was about to tear through the defense, suddenly felt a powerful repulsion force applied to his great blade.
Then, his unstoppable momentum was hindered.
“Huh? It was actually blocked?”
“Son of Sadomasochism” was somewhat surprised, he felt that the opponent’s attack should not have stopped, but there was no time to think further, he hastily created more dazzling lights, knocking that guy flying away…
“Hehe, where did you guys pop up from?”
The D Level Personnel controlling the apparition stumbled back several steps, coughed twice, then straightened up and stared at Colin and the others as he spoke.
During the conversation, he felt deeply shocked, not by how strong they were, but by the fact that…
This group of outsiders had silently infiltrated their internal communication channel!
Just now he had deliberately said he was attacking the right side, and he immediately felt the energy on the corresponding side strengthen, and the positioning of the people also changed accordingly.
Then he caught them by surprise by attacking the left side, and immediately confirmed his suspicion from the shocked expressions of the opponents.
This also profoundly startled him because normally, even those Level 1 Containment Subjects couldn’t breach the communication channel protected by the “agreement”.
And if there were those with such ability, they wouldn’t need to do it in such a manner, as it was much harder than directly controlling them…
However, before he had time for further thought, signals from other members came through the internal communication channel.
“…It seems our carriage has been isolated, apart from yours, we can’t contact anyone else…”
Hearing this, the D Level Personnel was not surprised at all.
He didn’t wait for his teammates to speak and immediately responded with a line of special brain messages—a speedy exchange in his mind not using any language, but incomprehensible frequencies instead.
It was right after he sent this message that all participants in the internal communication channel changed their “frequency”.
No longer was it information that Colin and the others could understand…
“Hiss, this is the first time we’ve encountered such a situation, it feels a bit tricky…”
“Fuer Mushroom” couldn’t help but mutter.
Actually, being caught secretly peeking wasn’t entirely strange; he had heard that other teams had encountered this before.
However, they had been fighting for over half a year and this was the first time they had come across it.
This gave them an inexplicable feeling…
It was as if they were playing a game with a cheat that made the entire map visible and the opponent had discovered it, both embarrassing and uneasy.
‘These people are stronger than the previous ones, we usually need to fight for a while to grasp the situation, but they have made many things clear in only two exchanges, even discovering our peeking…’
Colin once again couldn’t help but marvel at the rich battle experience of these people.
They seemed to have a very clear understanding of many abilities, being able to distinguish the situation quickly upon contact, arranging attack tasks, and their entire approach to combat gave off an impression of being quite efficient and decisive.
Moreover, it seemed that every D Level squad leader was accustomed to leading by example, positioning themselves in the forefront?
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - 363 361 The True Source of Divine Strike
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 363: Chapter 361 The True Source of “Divine Strike” Technique! _1 Chapter 363: Chapter 361 The True Source of “Divine Strike” Technique! _1 “It seems each squad is indeed led by a squad leader, but that’s not a big issue. What’s more impressive is their internal communication method during battle—it’s very effective, but for some reason, it’s no longer available now.”
Colin pursed his lips, reflecting on how the method allowed a group of people to communicate during battle as if two brains were directly conversing through brainwaves, bypassing any middlemen and significantly increasing the speed of communication.
It was a pity that such a method seemed to have disappeared now.
Meanwhile, that D Level Personnel had switched their communication method and launched another attack within seconds.
At the same time, three more figures entered from the Mist Gate and joined the battle.
Initially, Colin thought they would easily overpower the Son of Sadomasochism and the others with overwhelming force right from the start, as it took them less than a third of the time to see through their tactics compared to the ones in the previous carriages.
But once the fight started, it seemed as if they were being cautious of something else, advancing steadily but without much ferocity—it felt like they were holding back, prepared for something else.
“Is this… suspicion that we have additional allies?”
Colin mused, feeling almost certain about it, as he too would have his doubts if he encountered a mysterious group, weaker than him, yet bold enough to challenge him. He would be reserved…
Especially that D Level individual who manipulated the phantom with three heads and six arms; he kept glancing around, suspicious and paranoid.
Oh, they probably hadn’t figured out that it was me knocking their blades away at critical moments.
Colin chuckled secretly to himself.
After making some educated guesses, he continued to provide support while occasionally using Repulsion to covertly lend a hand, focusing his attention mainly on that phantom with three heads and six arms—
He noticed that technique seemed to not be a “prop” or a “Talent,” but rather an extraordinary ability based on the individual’s own capabilities.
And it looked familiar, although he wasn’t completely sure.
But…
“It seems essentially like ‘Divine Strike,’ and apparently much more complete, and ‘Divine Strike’ at his level must be at least level seven,” he thought.
“Normally, that would mean a stone-faced expression. Oh, I forgot, the officials said that it might not be the case if one has the medicine…”
“Also, if it really is ‘Divine Strike,’ his version seems stronger. Even without considering the ‘Gene Compensation Medicine,’ the overall technique appears more… complete?”
Colin’s thoughts flickered through his mind, and he wondered whether “Divine Strike” might also have leaked from the company just like the Book of Fate did.
However, before he could ponder further, he saw several D Level Personnel simultaneously extract a Cubic Crystal containing a vast amount of energy, merge it into their bodies, and then launch a fierce attack on the Son of Sadomasochism.
“Are they preparing to stop testing us and resolve this immediately?”
Colin thought intently and, without being stingy, he reached into the Storage Room, and ten Colorless Crystal Bodies were flung out in quick succession, enhancing everyone present as well as their equipment.
After all, “World Code-13” could produce nearly two hundred Colorless Crystal Blocks a week, so there was no concern regarding usage.
The three attackers outside, witnessing this wealthy “Colorless Crystal” usage, all twitched at the corners of their eyes as a fierce murderous intent and hatred arose…
“What’s going on?”
Colin was startled, for just as he had successfully evaded several attacks, these people seemed to have temporarily spared him.
But as soon as he used the “Colorless Crystal,” they suddenly directed their murderous intent towards him.
Could it be? Surely these people didn’t have an exclusive right to use the Colorless Crystals, and they wouldn’t allow him to use them?
“Perfect, you killed our comrades and took our stuff, using it right in front of me. Very good, very good. I had planned to save some strength for the coward hiding behind you, but now I’ll deal with you…”
The D Level Personnel, enhanced by the phantom with three heads and six arms, spoke in a chilling tone.
‘This is my own damn hard-earned stuff!’
Hearing these words, Colin couldn’t help but want to roll his eyes, realizing the other party thought he had stolen these items.
While he was irritated by the misunderstanding, his teammates, busy fending off enemies, were confused—
“Someone lurking behind us? What do you mean?”
The Son of Sadomasochism and the others were perplexed, but before they could think further, they saw dozens, if not hundreds, of fissures tear open on the opposing phantom.
These splits wriggled like mouths, making crunching “crack, crunch” sounds as they chewed.
An indescribable sense of hunger suddenly rose in the bellies of everyone present.
“Fuck, this is ‘hunger’?!”
Seeing this, not only Colin, but everyone widened their eyes. They were not unfamiliar with this sensation, after having experienced it many times during the self-selected mission event in “World Code-13”.
Feeling it now, their hearts instantly cooled by half.
With this thing involved, how the hell were they going to fight?
“No, it seems to not be ‘hunger’…”
Colin, with his familiarity with “hunger,” quickly realized that this didn’t seem to be the real thing, it didn’t even have the real thing’s aura… was it just an indirect use of power?
As thoughts flickered, Colin vaguely understood the reason.
“That makes sense, that demon had said that according to the ‘Bonfire Company’ rules and regulations, direct involvement with such high-level entities is strictly forbidden before reaching C Level. So, it must be an imitation… Yeah, now I’m sure, it’s definitely ‘Divine Strike’, borrowing power is one thing, but the source is a bit terrifying. I’ll have to check with Old Master Wu later if there was ever such a person before.”
As for now, even if they were only facing a mimicry of “hunger” through “Divine Strike”,
they couldn’t afford to be careless…
Colin silently drew out the Bone Spur, holding the Golden Card, ready to end the fight without further concealment. Otherwise, if they let the enemy “feed”, things could become difficult to manage.
Just as everyone was bracing for a tough fight, that person suddenly stood in place, bowing his head without moving, and the shadows on his body began to flicker on and off, like the fragmented flame of a candle in the crashing waves…
“What happened?”
Everyone was surprised, but they quickly realized what was happening…
It was at that moment that a large number of the split-mouthed shadows dispersed.
Raising his head again, the eyes that looked back held nothing but madness and ferocity, not a shred of reason to be seen.
Seeing this scene, relief mixed with an indescribable sadness and discomfort for Colin and the others.
“Sigh, let’s do it, let’s send them on their way.”
As the words of the Son of Sadomasochism fell, everyone stopped playing defense and began their counterattack.
By the time they reached the third car, even though these guys were still very strong without their sanity, no matter how strong, they were no longer a match for those armed with “tools”.
Another ten minutes or so later, Colin and the others had completed their task.
“Finally! We’ve finally completed the task!”
Apart from Colin, the others present somewhat wanted to cry.
Though the ending was slightly unsatisfactory, at least the ordeal was over, and they had been stuck on this for half a year!
However, before they could continue feeling happy for long, they quickly noticed an awkward problem.
“How come we can’t return to reality yet…”
While speaking, an employee flipped through the completed tasks in his mind and suddenly noticed that the content of this task was slightly different from before…
For instance, the footnote for “Event One” used to have three parts.
It should read: “Upon completing the investigation of the three detached, out-of-control carriages, the task will be considered complete, and you will automatically return to reality for task settlement.”
But now, it only had two parts…
“Upon completing the investigation of the three detached, out-of-control carriages, the task will be considered complete.”
.
.
.
There’s a good chance that updates will resume during the day starting tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - 364 362 In-depth Investigation of the Ghost
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 364: Chapter 362 In-depth Investigation of the “Ghost Train”. _1 Chapter 364: Chapter 362 In-depth Investigation of the “Ghost Train”. _1 “Unexpected, late but arrived,” he said. ”
Colin felt not a ripple in his heart, and even wanted to laugh a bit.
He knew that the company sending him on what seemed like an easy task wasn’t for him to retire on.
Oh no, it wasn’t just late but arrived, it was that the surprise was made clear from the beginning.
It was just that he and the others hadn’t paid much attention…
That three paragraphs had become two was not a small difference – missing the “voluntarily return to reality for task settlement” part meant…
The task was completed, but they couldn’t return.
Colin hadn’t noticed because it was his first time and wasn’t clear on the details. “Son of Sadomasochism” and the others didn’t notice because they’d been there too often, never imagining that such a small detail on the brief would change.
“There couldn’t be a bug, could there…”
“Son of Sadomasochism” and the others, exhausted from the battle, dazedly absorbed the information in their minds.
“So what do we do now?” team member “Fuer Mushroom” asked, looking perplexed.
However, the company didn’t keep them waiting too long. After the resentful corpses on the ground slowly vanished like sandcastles…
[The task “The Disordered Ghost Train” has been updated to “Conduct a deeper investigation on the ‘Ghost Train'”]
A new task appeared before everyone.
Without much thought, everyone opened the task at once.
And then…
Except for Colin, everyone present was shocked by the requirements of the task.
[Conduct a deeper investigation on the ‘Ghost Train’]
“Description”: In one hour, carry out a more in-depth investigation of this train that has experienced a disaster, to obtain more information.
“Requirement”: After successfully subduing the seventh carriage, remain in said carriage for a duration of three hours.
“Note”: In addition to the original reward, everyone will receive a minimum of five thousand points and one “Excellent Item Draw Ticket” as a mission reward.
“Attention”: You will not die in this task, but from this moment, items may begin to show real wear and tear.
…
“The seventh carriage? How is it possible to fight our way there…”
“Son of Sadomasochism’s” face changed; just getting through the third carriage had exhausted them. Reaching the seventh was impossible…
Even if he moved twice as fast now and twisted his waist, he couldn’t stop the enemies behind him that were ferocious like wolves.
As one who had challenged what came next, he knew just how much the difficulty spiked after the third carriage…
“Sigh, are we really doomed to never advance?”
“No.7 Little Chicken” and the others suddenly felt deflated.
Even though the task rewards were high, like a minimum of five thousand points and an excellent (purple) gear extraction ticket, the problem was, they had to be able to win!
Then, “Emperor Sun,” after reading the details, suddenly noticed something and laughed bitterly, “To be honest, rather than worrying about whether we can advance, I think we should be more concerned about whether we can go back…”
On hearing this, others almost replied that they could just die and return.
But it was then that they clearly noticed something…
The task mentioned revival upon death but didn’t say they could go back…
“Fuck, don’t tell me, if we can’t make it through, we’ll be trapped here forever?!” team leader “Son of Sadomasochism” exclaimed as he stood up in alarm.
Not only would they fail the mission, but in the end, they might not even be able to leave?
This time they were no longer concerned about whether they could advance.
One by one, they started to worry. If they really lost too many times, wouldn’t the company turn them into “instances” to be used by the lower E level players for practice?
It’s over, it’s all over…
One terrifying thought after another rose in their minds.
Meanwhile, having read the information, Colin guessed that it must be the handiwork of some unknown “Lady Bunny.”
“An excellent draw ticket… only for purple gear? It’s good, but I feel like it’s restrictive for me. With my luck, I could draw another golden card, which is much better than purple gear…”
“The seventh carriage, I should be able to manage the fight. Just need to be careful of those game-changing item effects. For now, it seems that D Level Personnel standard gear is only about one piece of purple gear, haven’t seen anything higher. Is it non-existent or just unusable?”
After quickly browsing the information, Colin had some thoughts about what he needed to do next.
Later, gathering his thoughts, he saw “Son of Sadomasochism” and the others looking like deflated eggplants, totally different from before, and couldn’t help but laugh and cry at the same time.
But, as the partial instigator, Colin thought it over and decided to cheer them on, “Whatever the situation, now that we have no choice, why not try forging ahead.
“There’s a chance if you don’t give up, but if you do, it’s all over.”
As he spoke, Colin extended his hand and conjured an orange-red flame in his palm.
Feeling the warmth coming from the flame, their minds cleared of distractions.
The company, mechanical and hollow, was cold and ruthless, only the buffs from their Righteous Father retained some warmth…
“Yeah, we’ve come this far, since there’s no way back, let’s just go forward,” the team leader “Son of Sadomasochism” also adjusted his mindset.
He paused, then looked at the flame in Colin’s hand, “What’s that…?”
He hadn’t seen Daddy use that buff before…
“Just some of my secret abilities,” Colin replied with a smile. He didn’t elaborate much but rather started to restore their statuses.
The losses in the third carriage were significant for everyone, and the biggest problem…
“Emperor Sun” was missing a lower leg.
But it wasn’t a big issue, as Colin allowed a portion of the “Nano Intellectual Mechanism” to temporarily serve as a prosthetic.
“Alright, let’s give it another go. But for the first time, I suggest we consider gathering some intelligence first. We don’t have to fight until we get the intel clear,” “Son of Sadomasochism” suggested as he looked at the others.
None of the others refuted his decision, since it was very likely that they couldn’t win…
Rather than fighting and potentially losing, they preferred to exchange their lives for intelligence and return next time.
Otherwise, if they weren’t careful and their items got damaged, they might lose the chance to fight their way through entirely.
At that moment, “Son of Sadomasochism” suddenly remembered something and turned to Colin, curiously asking, “By the way, did you gather any useful information from hearing those people’s conversations just now?”
Upon hearing this question, the other members also turned their heads curiously.
They were quite eager to know what Colin had heard…
It might contain the secret to clearing the level.
“It’s mostly stuff about the company, kind of like complaints and gossip. It’s not very helpful for our current situation…”
As Colin spoke, he recalled the information he had heard, seemingly not much concerned on the surface, yet inwardly, he was profoundly shocked.
He didn’t know much about “The Great Expedition Far Away,” but he was familiar with “World Code.”
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - 365 363 Limited C Level Positions_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 365: Chapter 363 Limited C Level Positions_1 Chapter 365: Chapter 363 Limited C Level Positions_1 “The ‘World Codes,’ there are actually over five hundred of them…”
Colin muttered to himself, as he had originally thought these artificial worlds, comparable to Earth, numbered thirteen was impressive enough, but the actual count was a staggering five hundred!
Moreover, it seemed likely that the final tally might rise to three thousand!
And on each “World Code”, a multitude of personnel would be arranged, with how many high-level employees comparable to Level 1 Containment Subjects he had no idea…
Such a vast force…
Just thinking about it, Colin was shocked to his core.
“From what we can see now, the people on those ‘World Codes’ must be the descendants of the Company’s zenith era expedition forces. Although they are aware of multiple worlds, they seem to be clueless about the true nature of the worlds they inhabit…”
“Civilization has clearly experienced a discontinuity…”
“It’s just unknown what they encountered that led to the state of being mere civilization remnants.”
According to Colin’s understanding of the Company, at that time, the Company had likely taken full control of numerous Level 1 Containment Subjects, and even Level 0 ones were not few in number, such as “0-9 ‘Hunger'”.
Furthermore, existences of high stature who worked for the Company, like the “Father of the Sea God,” whether coerced or voluntary, were probably not just one.
What exactly did the Company, wielding such immense power, encounter in the end to conclude in this state?
Was it that so-called 2044?
‘Some of the senior containment subjects sealed on the ‘World Codes’ seem to know something. Once my strength improves, maybe I can try making contact with that one in the underground labyrinth.’
Thoughts flickered through Colin’s mind, and he formed some rough ideas.
Of course, if he were to attempt contact, it would be best to bring “The Light Chaser” along as a precaution…
After all, that was “The Light Chaser’s” home, and he probably wouldn’t want an accident to cause a disaster there.
“Speaking of which, according to the recent intelligence, the hierarchy at C Level and below post-D Level isn’t clear, but starting from C Level after D, the Company’s authority is allocated one to one, not unrestricted, and moreover, the difficulty of promotion is quite high…”
According to what those few said, their group of people had participated in a “Planetary Surface Overturning Level” disaster event and all received first-degree commendations or something similar, yet still less than one-tenth could get promoted…
Hearing this, it seemed like the odds were already quite significant.
Colin wasn’t sure of the specific circumstances surrounding this catastrophic event, but the name alone sounded dangerous.
Completing such an event just to earn a chance at promotion…
At this thought, Colin suddenly had a bad premonition—Lady Bunny had said that as long as he could investigate the status of the “Book of Fate,” she would personally assist him during his promotion.
Originally, he thought the task would be difficult, but manageable…
But now, comparing it, the “difficulty” might be a bit higher than he had anticipated.
“No, not necessarily, considering the Company’s current situation, there may not be many C Level personnel, which might make getting promoted a bit easier?”
While pondering the newly acquired information, Colin discussed the recent events with his teammates.
Of course, he mostly just listened and repeated responses like “okay, okay, okay,” “sure, sure, sure,” “ah, right, right, that’s the way to do it.”
After all, aside from instructing them to stay in the seventh carriage for three hours, the mission didn’t specify any time limits, and Colin wanted to see how long these few could hold out.
And as they discussed and healed, an hour quickly passed.
Once again, a slight jolt was felt from the coupling.
A mist gate opened up.
Upon seeing the door, everyone present couldn’t help but hold their breath and feel utterly drained.
“Sigh, this is tough. Why did this high-level requirement have to fall on us? Doesn’t the Company have any clue about our capabilities?”
“Instead of worrying about that, how about trying to recruit Brother Shunzi to take over? He specializes in difficult tasks, and with him, we might actually stand a chance…”
“Stop dreaming, it’s better to rely on ourselves. Let’s fight our best—no one wants to be trapped here forever, do they?”
Although his soul resisted greatly, his body honestly took steps forward.
This time, Colin, just like before, asked everyone not to rush in and let him listen first to see if there was any new information.
Compared to the eagerness to enter the door last time, this time the others had no objections to this idea.
After all, in their view, the mission was almost certainly going to be a failure, unless they did as the “Fuer Mushroom” muttered and managed to summon Brother Shunzi from another copy; otherwise, there was almost no chance of clearing it in one go.
So they might as well accept their fate, gather as much information as possible, and prepare for the next attempt.
Colin was unaware of their thoughts, standing beside the Mist Gate, tilting his head slightly to listen attentively.
With his passive “Deadly Insight,” he didn’t have to worry about being killed in an instant.
Unlike the D Level old guy from the last carriage…
The fellows in the fourth carriage all chose to enter the “Box Garden World,” seemingly ready to conduct research and deepen their understanding…
“Why do I feel like D Level is akin to graduating from university, all discussing where to get a job? From what I see, ‘World Code’ is for external warfare and ‘Box Garden World’ conducts some kind of experiments…”
Colin raised his hand to his chin, feeling an inexplicable sense of déjà vu.
However, before he could gather more information, he felt as if he was being watched.
“We’ve been spotted, be careful,” Colin immediately warned.
As his words fell, dozens of chains made of icy steel shot out from the Mist Gate…
The battle was about to erupt at this moment.
This time, seeing the listless mood of “Son of Sadomasochism” and the others, Colin thought the fight wouldn’t last long and was ready to intervene…
But to his surprise, after nearly ten minutes, they actually won the fight!
Even though Colin had been covertly assisting, he hadn’t done much; it was mostly their own effort.
“Feels like it wasn’t harder than the third carriage, and with the item advantage, it even seemed a bit easier. Damn, with some luck, we could really win…”
“No.7 Little Chicken” suddenly felt as if he was capable again.
The others nodded in agreement; if it continued like this, they might indeed make it through to the end!
“If we really win against the seventh carriage, I’m going to write this experience down, copy and paste it every day so all those folks at the company know I made it to the seventh carriage!”
“Keep it up, only three more to go!”
“And you’re not thanking the big boss? If it wasn’t for him, we might not have even made it past the third carriage.”
“Thank you, Righteous Father!”
“…”
Before long, the door to the next carriage appeared once again.
Colin continued to eavesdrop, but after a while, he couldn’t help frowning.
“Why isn’t anyone talking?”
There was no sound from behind the Mist Gate…
After listening for a while longer and finding no noise, Colin and the others entered.
But as soon as they did, they were stunned…
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - 366 364 Holy Shit Is This a Daddy_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 366: Chapter 364: Holy Shit, Is This a Daddy?_1 Chapter 366: Chapter 364: Holy Shit, Is This a Daddy?_1 In the broad expanse of the train compartment, there were nine figures, positioned in battle stances, looking at them…
“Nine, nine persons?! The worst-case scenario!”
Son of Sadomasochism’s scalp tightened and tingled, his pupils shrank to pinholes as he realized he was facing the most daunting challenge of legend.
A squad formed by nine D Level Personnel, even if placed in the first compartment, was enough to decimate them.
Not to mention, this was actually happening in the fifth compartment…
Thus far, no E level promotion team had ever won in such circumstances, to the extent that the replica’s people commonly referred to it as “minor loss of control,” treating it as a bug that couldn’t be passed.
This number was beyond what delaying tactics could manage.
And at Son of Sadomasochism’s side, the others were equally stunned, at a loss for how to act, as if the air itself had solidified…
However, for some reason, these nine did not attack the moment they walked in the door.
Both parties were observing each other, though among Colin’s group, only he still had the presence of mind to observe, the other few were clueless about what to do…
‘They had already noticed us in advance? Tch, I didn’t even realize…’
Colin’s gaze swept over the nine figures, focusing on three of them in particular.
One was a young man who kept one eye open and the other closed, observing them with just one eye. His body seemed young in every aspect, but his hair, interwoven with black and white, appeared aged, and behind him were countless fine, dark tendrils.
Another was barely over a meter and a half tall, and, set against the others, she looked like a little girl, dragging with her a large sword covered in veins that gave off an uneasy feeling.
Yet another was a middle-aged man, wrapped in innumerable chains as though he were bound.
…
‘I’m not sure about the other two, but the one with one eye open and the other closed should be a user of the ‘Book of Fate’ power?’
“Not likely to be wrong. The users of the ‘Book of Fate’ power have those black, fine threads behind them, too distinctive…”“But is this person from the official side or the company side? Hmm, the ‘Book of Fate’ originated from the company. Given the identity of these people, they should be bona fide company personnel, tch, their status is quite strong, at least level seven, but still looking so young…’
Colin’s thoughts flickered, and he roughly assessed the situation.
Only, he didn’t know why this group hadn’t attacked as they had previously. Were they perhaps biding their time?
If they were just stalling for time…
Colin had no objections, as if it came down to a drawn-out fight, the victors would only be his own side.
However, a minute later, among the nine, the man with one eye open and the other closed seemed to notice something. He glanced at Colin, seemingly pushed to the front by the rest, and suddenly chuckled, “Indeed, my intuition told me if I just waited here quietly, concealing my presence and muffling any noise, some troublesome creature would inevitably walk in…”
Before he could finish, a D Level Personnel interrupted him, “Quit blabbering, have you saved your data yet? I’m ready to take all these people down.”
In the eyes of this personnel, the enemies ahead seemed pathetically weak…
Only a bit stronger than the minor mobs encountered in past disaster events.
“OK, but be careful, don’t be complacent,” the man with one eye open and the other closed said with a smile, making a gesture and then shutting his eye.
At the same time, their comm-links in their brains activated once more.
“Take out the guy at the back of the squad first, he should be the support, the tough guy in front can be ignored.”
…
“Be careful to protect the healer!”
Son of Sadomasochism was about to say this when he saw that one of the nine D Level Personnel had locked their gaze on him.
In an instant, he felt a lethal threat looming.
At that moment, Son of Sadomasochism instinctively used a prop, causing a blaze of brilliant light to erupt.
“Nine o’clock, twenty-one meters, height 1.7 meters, armor-piercing rounds,” the D Level Personnel rapidly murmured.
As the words fell, a high-density incendiary bullet violently shot out from nowhere, aiming directly at the pulsating Son of Sadomasochism.
Bang bang bang!
Streams of brilliant radiance pierced by bullets, tearing open a large gash.
“This strong?!” The Son of Sadomasochism was shocked inside, wanting to create more dazzling lights quickly, but his feet tightened, and unbeknownst to him, chains had wound around his feet from below.
And the moment the chains touched him, an overwhelming sleepiness assailed him.
Following this unexpected turn, a dark figure charged into the breach that had been torn open, their body covered in cracks like shattered porcelain.
“Feel the art!” The figure spread their arms wide, laughing strangely.
The next instant, an orange-red glow flickered, and the figure exploded on the spot!
In the massive explosion, The Son of Sadomasochism was sent flying, tumbling a few times before barely stopping beside Colin, lying on the ground, his face filled with disbelief.
They’d just started fighting and not even three seconds in, he had already been defeated?
Not just him, almost everyone had been hit, and although they weren’t completely disbanded, they were close enough.
Those guys hadn’t even all taken action yet, and they were already struggling to hold on…
In the scene, the only one who hadn’t been attacked was Colin, standing slightly behind the center.
“Hahaha, look, I just casually mentioned hitting someone, and they actually believed it, really shifting their focus to the person at the back, heh, if we use that mysterious item properly, at least we could hold out for a few minutes, haha, joy…”
Within the internal brainwave communication, a sneering laugh sounded.
It was precisely this statement that made several people realize that from the beginning, they had seen through the fact their internal channel was being spied on.
And they had set a trap with it.
“I can’t do it, wait for the next time…”
The face of The Son of Sadomasochism ashen, after being blown up like that, his whole body was in pain as if it had fallen apart, and not just that, the explosion was very special, scattering the “spirituality” in his brain.
It could be said that although he did not die on the spot, he had almost lost the ability to continue fighting.
Hearing his words, the others, though reluctant, had no choice but to admit defeat.
If 9 D Level people were in the first carriage, then adding the nursing from Righteous Father, it wasn’t impossible to resist a bit, although they would probably still lose, there was at least a small chance.
After all, in the earlier carriages, especially the first one, the enemy seemed clear-headed but in the actual combat, they would find they were somewhat muddled, or even “stupid”.
But the further back, the D Level Personnel on the train, the closer to their former strength…
By the fifth carriage, it was almost indistinguishable from their past strength.
In such a situation, there was no way to hold on…
However, just thinking about dying and resurrecting soon, possibly still on the train, they couldn’t help but feel a bit of despair.
But at this moment, Colin, who had been silent, just observing, spoke up:
“Actually, there’s no need to be so hasty in giving up.”
As he spoke, his teammates saw Colin pull out several crystal pieces, and a pure white light appeared.
“It’s really not necessary anymore, better save our resources for the next one…”
We can only give up on this one, right!
The Son of Sadomasochism and the others were about to say just that, but they saw Colin suddenly clench his hands, crushing the “Colorless Crystal Body” in his grasp, its pure energy flowing into his body.
And the white light did the same, adhering to his body, forming a thin layer of light on his surface.
“What???”
Seeing this, the others were stunned—If they were going to keep resisting, shouldn’t it be them receiving the BUFFs?
It’s not much use to buff yourself as a healer, right?
But it was at this moment, an enormous aura and terrifying flame burst forth from the healer Dad, silencing all their doubts…
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - 367 365 Face Off Against the D Level Elite
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 367: Chapter 365: Face Off Against the D Level Elite Squad!_1 Chapter 367: Chapter 365: Face Off Against the D Level Elite Squad!_1 Boom!
Under everyone’s gaze, rolling flames spread outwards like giant waves in succession…
The entire carriage shook incessantly due to the explosion of the flames.
This…
“Righteous Father” seems a bit off…
Just feeling the momentum, everyone realized that “Righteous Father’s” strength might have exceeded their imagination.
At this moment, everyone felt a bit short-circuited and a question arose in their minds—”Who exactly is this person?”
A guess confidently emerged in their minds.
Meanwhile, the nine D Level Personnel who had not yet properly moved showed grave expressions, no longer as relaxed as before, each bearing a look of facing a formidable enemy!
‘These guys talk big but play it safe in practice.’
Colin looked at those guys, not knowing whether it was because of the “Fate Propeller” D Level Personnel, but during the battle just now, none of them had moved forward.
“You were pretty tough when hitting my teammate, huh? Why aren’t you moving now?”
Amid the howling flames, Colin smiled and spoke to the opponents.
As he spoke, he beckoned with his hand, pulling several pitch-black, eerie, and explosive figures from the shadows with tendrils of flame.
‘The self-destructing shadows resemble someone; they must be that person’s item.’
After giving one of them a glance, Colin’s hand shook, and a gush of flame erupted, incinerating the figure just before it exploded.
“Be careful of close combat, spread out, and attack from a distance as much as possible. He’s very strange, hard to observe; go at him with all your might, don’t hold back, and don’t be complacent…” The D Level Personnel known as “Fate Propeller,” who had his eyes closed, replied using brainwaves.
A D Level Personnel asked, “What if he gets close?”
“Take the blow.”
The closed-eyed “Fate Propeller” D Level Personnel was succinct.
…
Knowing full well that we are spying, and yet, unlike those before, not using any special code for communication… Colin suspected that this was likely intentional.
The guy’s approach reminded him of that “Human Patchwork Monster” who liked to use trash talk to disturb his enemies.
The goal was to distract them…
However, before he could contemplate further, a D Level member carrying a satchel suddenly pulled out dozens of yellow papers from his pocket and threw them into the air; the next second, each fluttering talisman paper had a gun barrel extending from behind.
“Infinite Gun Creation!”
With that command, the gun barrels spat out flames, and a barrage of bullets came at him.
Colin’s eyes twitched slightly; what the hell kind of combination of mysticism and technology was this…
He didn’t take these elites lightly, and not just those whom he felt were the most troublesome; he immediately deployed the “Firebearer’s” grease.
He extended his hand, gathering a searing wall of fire in front of him, causing all incoming bullets to melt in midair.
“Since you won’t come to me, then I’m coming for you.”
Colin’s eyes narrowed slightly as he looked at the group, squatting slightly, then like a cheetah, he charged forward abruptly, closing the ten-plus meters instantly, drilling directly into the enemy ranks…
Just at that same time, attacks from almost every direction surged towards him.
Various chaotic “death scenes” flooded into Colin’s mind…
Clearly, even he would struggle to withstand the full assault of this group.
Yet Colin remained unfazed, channeling his spirit into a Golden Card with his left hand…
The sound of an invisible engine roared in his ears.
The world seemed to be dragged into stasis by an invisible force at that moment.
Be it chains on the ground, specially crafted bullets in midair, a fierce and blood-red sword qi, or even invisible, hard-to-detect limbs in the air that were nonetheless tangibly present, or a large flock of strange birds with sharp beaks resembling crows…
All incoming attacks froze mid-air…
“Kill the one with closed eyes first.”
During those seven seconds of stasis, Colin didn’t hesitate; he slipped through the array of attacks like a ghost, pulling out a white bone spur covered in black cracks, and unceremoniously stabbed it into the opponent’s head.
Dada dada…
The clock hands moved, and everything began to return to normal.
On-site, people only saw Colin’s figure escape from their lock-on without understanding what had happened.
“Ah!” A young man with eyes shut tight and hair salt-and-pepper in color clutched his head, writhing in pain and wailing on the ground, while his originally thin body suddenly began to swell up.
From his facial features, viscous black liquid seeped out, looking as though he would explode at any moment…
Everyone was shocked by this sudden instant kill.
However, shocked as they were, they didn’t stop their actions.
“He died really quickly.”
A woman around one meter fifty in height muttered under her breath, gripping the greatsword in her hands, allowing the spikes on the hilt to pierce her palms so that it could draw her blood.
Then, vitality burst forth from the sword, slashing towards Colin.
She hadn’t forgotten the advice given by her now blindfolded teammate…
If the opponent managed to kill one of them instantly, they should act quickly to follow up, as there would at least be a few seconds’ gap between such instantaneous kills!
As a wielder of the “Book of Fate” powers, the opponent clearly had some foresight into the “future,” having given plenty of instructions beforehand.
“Quite the quick reaction…”
Facing this ferocious blow, Colin raised an eyebrow, not intending to take the hit head-on, because if he didn’t escape now, he feared he would soon be overwhelmed by the group using all sorts of methods to directly forcefeed him to death.
In the moment he dodged to escape, Colin activated the maximum effect of “Force – Repulsive Force.”
Boom!
Terrifying repulsion pushed against the air, forming an extremely fearsome shockwave, scattering all attacks in the vicinity.
The large flock of attacking bizarre birds were even blasted into chunks of flesh.
All other attacks were also dissolved directly by the Repulsion Burst.
A nearby D Level Personnel who didn’t manage to dodge in time even fainted, and Colin didn’t miss this opportunity, drawing the cheap long sword he had bought earlier and hurling it, bisecting the person at the waist.
“Such a strong ability…”
All the D Level onlookers were internally shocked.
They felt as if they were dealing with a human-shaped Level 1 Containment Subject.
‘Damn it, where has the Squadron Leader run off to at a time like this?!’ Someone couldn’t help but curse inwardly.
D Level Personnel generally dealt with incidents involving Level Three or Fourth Containment Subjects, and even if their squad faced a Level 2, it would be a tough fight. Facing a Level 1 Containment Subject, even the weakest, holding out for thirty minutes would be difficult.
Such a threat necessitated a C Level Personnel leader…
Yet no one knew where the Squadron Leader had gone, and they were unable to get in touch with him until now.
Meanwhile, as Colin found a safe position after breaking free, he moved his eyes left and right. Upon confirming that the man on the ground had started to emit black liquid, he quickly locked onto his next target—
A female D Level Personnel with a gentle appearance who seemed to be a support, manipulating plants.
All over her body, evergreen vines grew, actually reattaching the one he had casually cut in half!
Not only that, many vines were attached to the blindfolded man, covering him as if trying to draw out the black liquid, and from the looks of it, it seemed there was indeed a chance to heal him!
“She can really heal, huh…”
Colin narrowed his eyes slightly; this person seemed troublesome if left unaddressed.
Noticing Colin’s gaze, the woman wielding the crimson greatsword shouted, “Be careful, block him!”
“Heh…”
Colin pulled out a triangular shield emblem, targeting the supportive female.
“In the presence of the ‘Shield of Fairness and Justice,’ I hereby initiate a sacred duel!”
As soon as the words were spoken, Colin and the gentle-featured supporter found the environment around them suddenly stretched away, with all other employees cut off outside, lost in a hazy expanse.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - 368 366 The Power of the Fate Observer (Long
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 368: Chapter 366 The Power of the “Fate Observer”! (Long chapter plus, asking for monthly votes)_1 Chapter 368: Chapter 366 The Power of the “Fate Observer”! (Long chapter plus, asking for monthly votes)_1 “Damn it! Xiaoli!” The short woman cursed loudly, but there was nothing she could do.
Meanwhile, they turned to look at the “Son of Sadomasochism” and others huddled together in a corner of the wall, looking utterly confused.
When their gazes swept over, their scalps tingled.
Then they tried to put up their defenses as best as they could…
Although their brains were short-circuiting and they hadn’t figured out what was going on, they knew one thing.
As long as they held on, it seemed the “Righteous Father” could win.
And he was fighting solo!
However, facing such a terrifying enemy, the D Level Personnel on the scene had no intention of sparing a few minutes to deal with a few small fries that they could easily kill.
They began laying out various offensive measures and traps, just waiting for Colin to appear…
It was at this moment that they faintly heard some voices coming from a blurred battlefield.
“I promise, during this battle, I will abandon all defense, and for fairness, my opponent must not use any defense either…”
Colin finished speaking, took out a Golden Sun Ornament to buff himself, and used a “Colorless Crystal,” then continued:
“I promise, during this battle, I will forsake using any amplification or blessing BUFFs, and for fairness, my opponent must not use corresponding methods either.”
Hearing this, the D Level female healer was stunned for a moment before trying to apply a “Colorless Crystal Block”
However, just as she was using it, the sound of a whip cracking was heard.
With a smack,
The energy blessing on her body was directly whipped out, causing her excruciating pain and her physical condition to deteriorate.
“How could this be?!” exclaimed the D Level female healer, her eyes wide.
Didn’t he use one too…
“Damn it! Damn it! How could they do this to my Xiaoli!” The short girl holding a blood-red sword was furious.
“You must not act against my law while it is in effect.”
Colin couldn’t help but give a reminder.
Then, after casually establishing the third rule, Colin looked at his opponent and said, “I’ll give you a chance, surrender now and I can spare your life.”
Truth be told, he could decisively kill a combatant, but when it came to a medical healer, he preferred to wait until she lost control before making his move.
However, hearing Colin’s words, the D Level female entangled in withered vines looked resolute:
“I absolutely will not!”
Upon hearing this, Colin no longer hesitated and his figure dashed straight towards her like a meteorite.
Having the “Shield of Fairness Adjudication” to initiate a duel, he could easily get a rough sense of the enemy’s strength, knowing that she alone might not even be able to beat the few F Level “Sons of Sadomasochism.”
“Withered Wood Entanglement!”
The D Level female healer activated her ability as a mass of trees surged up, trying to block the enemy.
But, those vines were easily torn apart by Colin.
Then, before she could react, a stifling sensation suddenly came from her neck as Colin’s right hand choked and lifted her up.
The D Level female Personnel looked at Colin, gritted her teeth, and tried to detonate the special explosives that were already on her body.
However, Colin acted faster than she did.
With a burst of icy blue chill rushing at her,
The female healer immediately lost all consciousness.
From the time Colin declared battle, the whole fight lasted less than a minute.
The effects of the “Arena of Honor” were also lifted after the D Level female healer perished.
When Colin’s figure reappeared, he immediately faced a barrage of attacks; prepared for this, he used “Time Stasis” once again.
Those D Level Personnel who stood far away only felt as if the scene had frozen, while those who were closer found the enemy had suddenly vanished.
The carefully laid traps were easily circumvented once again.
“Next, let’s kill that one with the chains…”
Colin set his sights on a D Level Personnel covered in chains – that pervasive lock and chain technique was indeed quite troublesome.
He had accidentally touched it earlier and felt a sudden weakness in his body.
Just as he was about to act, a voice popped into his mind…
“Old Cheng, he’s targeting you, blow it up with him…”
This guy isn’t dead?!
Colin instinctively looked at the ground and then hesitated – the corpse that had been impaled by a Bone Spur was decomposed into a mess, clearly lifeless, so how could it still be alive?
Then, he realized something amiss when he looked at a chubby D Level Personnel who had been standing oddly all this while, crouching in a corner.
His presence had been low ever since the start of the battle…
But an instinct told him that the seemingly undying “Fate Propeller” among the D Level Personnel must be related to this one.
However, it was while he was distracted for that moment.
A D Level employee who hadn’t made a move suddenly said, “Twelve o’clock direction, 31 meters, 1.6 meters tall, a high-penetration bullet designed for fighting a Level 5 Ancient God!”
Before the words finished, Colin sensed a fatal attack coming—
A bullet the size of a fist, engraved with mysterious patterns and extraordinary in nature, shot at him.
It withstood the flames’ protection, and could even curve to some extent, aiming straight for his chest.
He couldn’t dodge it with ordinary means!
“Repulsion Burst!”
Colin stopped aiming to kill and activated the Golden Card’s effect; a terrifying Repulsion Burst emerged, and the bullet, as if hitting an iron wall, exploded into countless pieces mid-air.
Yet, the blast was just a shell; a smaller, dark bullet broke through the Repulsion Burst!
Colin’s heart tightened, feeling that getting hit would cause serious trouble.
Yet, with other enemies attacking at the same time, he had nowhere to hide!
Furthermore, using “Time Stop: Pause” again would mean using it three times in a short period, which would bring about negative effects that would make his combat very passive.
But at this critical moment, Colin noticed the piles of ravens, carrion, and employee corpses on the ground…
Without a second thought, Colin activated the effect of a card.
“Smiling Mountain of Corpses”!
“┗|｀O′|┛ Ah~~——??”
A massive mound of flesh suddenly appeared in front of Colin, as if it wanted to let out a loud howl.
But just as its mouth opened a crack, before any sound could emerge, everything came to an abrupt stop…
The dark bullet hit its flesh.
In an instant, the newly appeared Corpse Mountain hadn’t even had the chance to open its eyes to see the world before it exploded on the spot…
“Hiss, ‘Smiling Mountain of Corpses’ is dead, and even his card has lost 7% of its integrity?”
The feedback to Colin’s brain from the prop left him shaken.
‘No wonder he’s Elite D Level, his methods are so numerous. He’s been alive the whole time but didn’t speak up until just now, distracting me.’
Colin felt that these tactically minded people really had dark hearts.
If it had been someone less skilled, just now they most likely wouldn’t have escaped being assassinated.
“Ah, still can’t kill him? All methods ineffective, getting as much information as possible to pass on to others…” Thought waves similar to those of a ‘Fate Propeller’ D Level Personnel appeared again.
Feeling the source of these brainwaves, Colin looked again towards the D Level staff member in the corner, feeling a sense…
That the voice was coming from the belly of the portly D Level staff member.
However, that person must have had some extremely powerful shielding method, making it impossible for him to be sure of the situation.
But this time, Colin turned towards the unremarkable sniper who needed only a signal to take his shot.
He had to kill this person…
“‘Yukionna’, you and Little Maid go together, and drag one or two of them down.”
Colin gave the order and then resolutely took action again. Despite being attacked by several D Level employees, he managed to kill the sniper after three minutes…
Then his gaze shifted to the D Level staff member who had been standing in the corner the whole time.
“They’re rushing me, I can’t die, what a pity, seems I can’t get any more information.”
When this voice appeared, a pair of hands suddenly burst through the skin of the D Level staff member’s fat belly, and with a swoosh, tore open a slit.
A head with closed eyes extended from it…
It was the ‘Fate Propeller’ D Level employee that he had “successfully” stabbed at the very beginning!
“Seeing is believing, hearing is deceiving. If I haven’t seen something happening, then clearly, it hasn’t…
”
As he spoke, he opened the eyes that had been closed from the start.
Numerous black threads erupted from those eyes…
A force seemingly directly from the ‘Book of Fate’ briefly enveloped the area.
Everyone present experienced a moment of distraction.
The next second…
When Colin regained his senses, he suddenly realized that it seemed like he had just entered the door, and in front of him, stood nine unharmed D Level Personnel.
Everything that had just happened seemed to have been restarted!
“Fuck, nine people again?!”
The “Son of Sadomasochism” looked ahead in shock, but soon realized something was wrong—
Err? Why is it “again”?
He felt like they had just experienced something extra, yet he wasn’t sure, as if there was a blurry dream in his head.
In this dream…
He vaguely remembered that Righteous Father scorned them for being too weak to buff them, he buffed himself and then fought against nine others alone!
And he even won!
Hiss, how could that be so fierce?
However, compared to their bewilderment, Colin’s brows were tightly knitted.
His mind clearly remembered everything that just happened…
‘A higher caliber ‘Fate Propeller’, or rather, a user of the ‘Book of Fate’s power, actually has the ability to reset like reading a save file?’
Colin inwardly felt alarmed, then enwrapped himself in flames.
“Huh? You actually remember, and your memory wasn’t reset?”
A surprised voice came from the ‘Fate Propeller’ D Level staff member, seemingly filled with astonishment, but thinking of the power the other had shown, it wasn’t that surprising.
At this moment, after activating such an ability, his eyes, compared to their previous pitch black purity, became exceptionally murky, and seeing anything became a lot blurrier.
And his hair had many more white strands than before…
Although he still looked young, there was a noticeable presence of decline.
“Looks like we lost a round,” said a D Level staff member sensing the “extra” memories in his brain and seeing the state of the ‘Fate’ observer, immediately realizing what was happening.
“Yeah, can’t fight, use full strength to ask for the lifting of ‘Containment Protocol’ item restrictions, then run. This place isn’t directly under the control of Bonfire Camp, can’t be resurrected if we die, Squadron Leader’s whereabouts unknown, if he doesn’t come we can’t win. If I live and make it back, I’m going to accuse him of dereliction of duty for not holding his position… Huh?! Wait…”
The ‘Fate Propeller’ like D Level personnel hadn’t finished broadcasting his brainwaves when he suddenly saw a familiar flame flickering in front of him through his blurry eyes.
This…
This?!
The ‘Fate Propeller’ like D Level staff member abruptly felt as if he had just awoken from a dream:
“This is the ‘Primordial Fire’? You are the ‘Firebearer’? No, the ‘Firebearer’ isn’t this weak, but the flame is genuine, or should I say, are you the ‘Firebearer’ reservist?”
Sensing this brainwave, Colin, who was about to act and quickly deal with the D Level staff member, stopped, hesitated for a second, then nodded and said “Yes.”
“This, then why, why are you attacking us…”
The D Level staff member’s eyes widened… If so, why the fight?
Why try to kill them?
Could it be, a traitor?
No, it’s impossible for ‘Firebearer’ reservists to betray; he’d rather believe they betrayed than these people—
And it was at this moment that he suddenly realized something.
Right…
Indeed, it seemed like…
“You guys… no, it’s not you guys who have a problem, it’s… us?”
He murmured to himself, as under the protection of his own special abilities, some suppressed memories resurfaced, as if realizing the nature of the situation.
But before he could ponder further, a terrifying sense of crisis emerged.
Turning his head, he saw his former comrade-in-arms whose eyes were now filled with a massive amount of dense blood vessels…
In those eyes, reason was being lost uncontrollably at a rapid pace.
It was also then that he remembered…
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - 369 367 Send Us Off with a Bonfire (Long
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 369: Chapter 367: Send Us Off with a Bonfire (Long Chapter)._1 Chapter 369: Chapter 367: Send Us Off with a Bonfire (Long Chapter)._1 “In this incident, it seems… that we didn’t successfully make it back home…”
A “Fate Propeller” D Level personnel muttered to himself, his face displaying a mix of emotions—frustration, powerlessness, and others that couldn’t be clearly defined.
And it was at that moment that he saw the comrades who had survived the calamity by a hair’s breadth dropping the items in their hands, their eyes blood red, completely losing their sanity, behaving like wild beasts.
Perhaps it was due to a similar aura emanating from him, these “beasts” did not attack him but rather pounced toward Colin who had approached him.
However, against these virtually defenseless D Level staff,
Colin didn’t even feel the desire to lift a finger…
Even though they were employees with above-average physical fitness, capable of sustaining only minor injuries from being hit by a dump truck unawares, with their current conditions, their enhanced physique was almost meaningless unless it was off-the-charts superior to normal humans.
Soon, as an icy blue storm blew through, eight of the nine D Level Personnel present were frozen into lifelike ice sculptures, immobile.
Amidst the eight differently posed ice sculptures, a blurry ice-blue shadow giggled “hehehe” while flitting among them, moving gracefully like a fish through water.
She occasionally reached out to knock the icicles off the frozen D Level Personnel, seemingly to further “polish” the sculptures.
‘This “Yukionna” is starting to become more whole in her “humanity,” and I think she might be ready to be released from the ring soon. After all, she seems to have taken a liking to the freezer compartment at home, has made it her nest, and doesn’t wander off…’
‘Once fully released, she’ll likely be equivalent to Purple Level Equipment, though her nature is a bit mischievous, like a child who loves to play pranks. There might be a need to teach her some respect for life…’
‘Otherwise, if she plays a prank on an ordinary person with her breath, it could be lethal…’
Various thoughts about “Yukionna” flashed rapidly through Colin’s mind.
Realizing that no other unexpected incidents had occurred, Colin shifted his gaze from there and looked toward the “Fate Propeller” D Level employee:
“And you, what exactly is your situation?”
“Me?”
