The “Fate Propeller” D Level personnel looked down at himself and said, “I haven’t gone mad, probably because I’ve just used the power of the ‘Book of Fate,’ but this won’t last long…
“After this time, I’ll likely die completely…
“The contamination has seeped into our very marrow.”
As he spoke, a hint of intense red began to appear in his eyes…
The change wasn’t fast, but it was unstoppable.
Seeing this, Colin fell silent for a moment before asking, “What exactly happened here at the beginning?”
“I can’t remember clearly, and I dare not try to recall too much, or else I will lose even these last few minutes of clarity… Whatever it is seems to have properties beyond our comprehension. I can only tell you that, according to my vague intuition, the source of the contamination has not been completely resolved…”
Not yet resolved? Colin’s pupils contracted, and flames erupted involuntarily from his body.
He could handle these contaminated D Level Personnel, but that didn’t mean he could deal with the contamination behind them.
Regarding the still-unspecified oddity, he remained very vigilant at heart.
At the same time, Colin was puzzled about something else. Hadn’t “Bonfire Company” found the train in the past?
They had even turned it into a mission, so why hadn’t they resolved the issue?
“Hehe, no need to be so scared. You, coming here, must be protected by some of the company’s items, and besides, you have the power of ‘Primordial Fire’ on you. Although you’re not a true ‘Flame Bearer,’ as long as you keep yourself augmented with this flame throughout, you don’t need to worry about contamination. Hey, bro, can I borrow a light? Lighting a smoke with ‘Primordial Fire,’ I haven’t experienced that yet. Sss, right, what’s your mission here?”
The “Fate Propeller” D Level personnel, as he spoke, fished out a pack of Red Double Happiness cigarettes, expertly flicked one out, borrowed a bit of Colin’s flame to light it, and deeply inhaled.
“Not entirely sure,” Colin vaguely replied.
“Don’t know?” The man slowly exhaled smoke and said, “Could it be that you actually do know? As a ‘Flame Bearer’ reservist, coming here, you either came to wrap up the incident or to retrieve something important. With your strength, it’s likely the latter.”
‘Sorry, but I really don’t know…’
Colin remained outwardly unmoved, his lips pursed in contemplation.
‘Retrieve something important?’
“Do you know what it is?” Colin asked curiously.
“I’m not sure. If you really don’t know, and the mission didn’t spell it out from the start, then you’re probably here to investigate…”
“Ugh.” Colin pursed his lips; he was, indeed, in the investigative phase.
At that moment, the “Fate Propeller” D Level Personnel suddenly seemed to realize something after a deep drag of his cigarette, a complex expression on his face as he shook his head and sighed:
“If I’m not guessing wrong, we have become part of some repeating event, haven’t we?”
“You could guess that?” Colin was surprised.
It was as bizarre as an NPC in a video game suddenly questioning whether they were an NPC.
“Need to guess?”
The “Fate Propeller” D Level personnel took another drag and casually said, “I’m a ‘Scriptwriter,’ I’ve created a lot of similar stuff. Although my scripts don’t sell well and I don’t know why nobody’s buying them, I’m not unfamiliar with these things.
“Before realizing what was happening, I couldn’t have thought of it, but once you realize it, it’s like poking a hole through a piece of paper on a window—it becomes clear.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - 370 367 Send Us Off with a Bonfire (Long
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 370: Chapter 367: Send Us Off with a Bonfire (Long Chapter)._2 Chapter 370: Chapter 367: Send Us Off with a Bonfire (Long Chapter)._2 During the conversation, he couldn’t tell if it was an illusion, but even though he had only exchanged a few words with the “Flamebearer” reservist in front of him, the “Fate Propeller” D rank personnel couldn’t shake the feeling that the fellow before him seemed… pitifully lacking in common sense?
The newbie that had just come in didn’t even seem as clueless as this one…
Could he be a special hire from outside the civilized world?
Thinking about the other’s strength and the level that didn’t match it, the “Fate Propeller” D rank personnel felt it was about right.
However, he didn’t dwell on this and continued, “I’ll tell you something you might not know. If things go as expected, they probably want to use our location as a stepping stone to go deeper…”
“And whether you’re here to finish things off or to recover something, I estimate that there’s a high chance you won’t be able to avoid one person.”
“Who?” Colin had a suspicion in his mind but wasn’t certain.
“Our Squadron Leader Kong Shiping, C level authority… I have an intuition that your mission this time is probably aimed at him…”
As he said this, the “Fate Propeller” D rank personnel seemed to sense something. Without waiting for Colin to speak, he switched to communicating through brainwaves rather than speech, seemingly to convey the information more quickly:
“I don’t know his fate, but it probably won’t be good. If you encounter him, it’ll be okay if he’s not rational…”
“But if he is rational, like when we just communicated, then you need to be careful. He excels in ambush close combat, capable of ‘flashing’ eighteen times within a hundred-meter radius in one minute, followed by a three-minute cooldown. His weakness should be under his left armpit, where there’s an old wound from a past incident…”
“Remember, never assume he will engage in close combat. The Squadron Leader has a once-a-day trump card, which he releases when you are beyond one hundred fifty meters and within three hundred meters.”
“That move is very powerful, it’s a locking technique, and the specifics of its execution and release are classified. Only B Level Authority would know, and I have no idea how to avoid it, also, I’m not sure if you have any means to avoid.”
“But, if you have a choice, try not to trigger it. It’s much stronger than the bullet used on you previously. If it hits a vital spot, even a First Level Containment Subject could be put out of action for a considerable length of time…”
“If you really can’t beat him, it’s best to injure his right hand, then try to escape during his ‘flash’ weakness period.”
After quickly conveying all this, the “Fate Propeller” D rank personnel seemed to breathe a sigh of relief.
Then, he added, “Besides, although you as an E level Personnel seem particularly abstract and awkward to me, if everything goes as expected…”
“The other D level Personnel should not pose much of a threat to you, so I won’t elaborate further. Finally, regarding contamination intelligence, you’ll have to find out on your own. I can’t provide more, I can’t help you with that…”
“It’s enough…”
Colin nodded, feeling moved. He hadn’t expected the other to assist him unconditionally.
Letting out a slight breath, he looked at the other’s eyes gradually filling with bloodshot:
“Is there anything I can do for you?”
The “Fate Propeller” D rank personnel hesitated for less than half a second, without any pretense: “I’m someone who came out of the large hatchery, and after coming out, I was raised by the unified society along with the tens of millions of brothers and sisters from the hatchery, so I don’t have family or much, have friends but not many, nor do I have any messages to pass on…”
“However, there is one thing. I have a flat in Shen City, and inside, there are a few hundred TBs of… cough, study files… on the physiological side…”
As he spoke, an even more specific address “Inspiration” appeared in Colin’s mind.
But…
Large hatchery? What is that, and what are these few hundred TBs of study files—are you copying every file in the world… Colin’s expression was odd, giving a knowing look: “Don’t worry, I will help you destroy them.”
After saying that, he wanted to ask about the “large hatchery,” but the other person panicked and spoke first…
“No, not destroy, definitely not!”
The “Fate Propeller” D rank personnel turned pale with fright, coughing twice, and rambled on:
“If possible, share them with others, sigh, those things cost me a lot of points to collect…”
“Inside, there are precious educational materials from before the ‘Great Annihilation Era.'”
Hmm? ‘Great Annihilation Era’ from before? When was that, or rather, what world’s events were these?
Colin’s mind was filled with many possibilities in an instant, wondering if he had misunderstood, were these really some valuable educational materials?
With doubts, he queried this D rank personnel who had perished in the past.
However, the other party didn’t respond to his question but lost focus, shaking while smoking, and started to speak about something irrelevant.
“…To offer everything for humanity’s fate is a mentality everyone is prepared for, after all, what helped us survive those dark times was sacrifice and contribution…”
“I don’t really have any thoughts on the matter, it’s just regrettable that not long after, I would have had a chance to get promoted… and here I am, gone without an explanation…”
“I’ve learned so much experience, and I don’t even have a girlfriend…”
“My death wasn’t as glorious as I imagined…”
“There are no epic hymns, no biographies or anything of the sort. I’m like a little minion in a game that got killed, maybe even less than that…”
“In some obscure corner that I don’t even know of, we perished without clarity, and no one remembers. Even I don’t remember my own name…”

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - 371 367 Send Us Off with a Bonfire (Long
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 371: Chapter 367: Send Us Off with a Bonfire (Long Chapter)._3 Chapter 371: Chapter 367: Send Us Off with a Bonfire (Long Chapter)._3 “I… I can’t accept this…”
It sounded like he was murmuring to himself, yet also like a complaint…
His turbid eyes filled up with more and more blood, and after choking out another “I… I can’t accept this…”, a tear streamed down from the corner of his eye.
Finally, he lifted his hand, wiped away the tears in his eyes, and sat up as straight as possible. He straightened his collar and looked ahead with a vacillating gaze, and said in a somewhat hoarse voice,
“Colleague, I feel that madness is about to catch up with me.
“Use the bonfire to send us on our last journey…
“It would be more dignified that way.
“In the end, I wish you all the best with your upcoming tasks.”
As his words fell, flames surged over Colin’s body, and before madness completely overtook his body, the power of the bonfire whisked away his last bit of rationality.
And then…
A booming sound.
The scorching flames erupted further, rolling through the carriage…
Before long, one ice sculpture after another turned to utter ash in the flames.
“Huh…”
Colin took a deep breath, quickly suppressing the complex emotions in his heart and recalling the other’s words.
“The ‘Great Hatchery’ doesn’t sound like it naturally produced humans…
Plus, producing tens of millions at once…
“If there really is a hatchery project producing tens of millions of people, then it should not be on Earth; otherwise, I would definitely have that information. So, all in all, it’s either ‘World Code’ or ‘Box Garden World’…”
“Just don’t know what this ‘Great Annihilation Era’ is. Is it the reason for the company’s decline?”
“No, that shouldn’t be it. From what he said, it felt like they’ve already gotten past that?”
“So it seems that what caused the company’s current situation must be some other event…”
“However, where is that ‘Shen City’ he spoke of? I don’t seem to have any recollection; could it be a more remote area…”
“Forget it, I’ll think about these matters after I get out. Right now, the key thing is what comes next.”
Colin furrowed his brows, thinking about the information provided by the “Fate Propeller” D Level personnel regarding that “Squadron Leader.”
A C Level who can flash eighteen times in a minute and has a deadly trump card sounds quite difficult to handle.
And that’s not even considering any dangerous items he might possess…
“It’s also a hassle; if I could go in and have a heart-to-heart talk like with this colleague, and solve all problems through dialogue, that would be great…”
Colin raised his hand and massaged his forehead, feeling somewhat headache-stricken.
Shaking his head, he gathered his thoughts and stood up to face the employee who was standing at the door.
Seeing Colin’s gaze turn toward them, a few employees inadvertently held their breath for a moment.
“Have your memories been restored?” asked Colin curiously.
Upon hearing this, they looked at each other and then “Son of Cruelty” stepped forward: “I roughly know what happened. It feels like a dream, there’s a sense of unreality, and I can’t recall the specifics.”
Shit, the boss thinks they’re weak; empowering themselves and slaughtering en masse wasn’t just a dream!
Recalling the strength the other party had demonstrated…
“Son of Cruelty” couldn’t help but ask: “Could you please tell us… who exactly are you?”
He didn’t believe that someone with such combat capabilities could be just a simple “stay-at-home dad.”
At this moment, when they remembered the other party’s ID again, not only him but everyone around started recalling a terrifying existence within the company…
Brother Shunzi!
Of course, guesses are just guesses; they couldn’t affirm that there weren’t other big shots in the company.
But soon, Colin indirectly gave them a definitive answer: “‘Unnamed123456’ was my previous ID.”
Upon hearing this, everyone’s faces simultaneously revealed an expression of “So it is.”
Indeed, it was normal for the other party to change their name after not doing so for so long.
It’s just that they truly had not expected this person to be in their own team…
And at this time, the two who touted Brother Shunzi’s prowess, “No. 7 Little Chicken” and “Fool’s Mushroom,” couldn’t help but feel their scalps tingle and their toes scrape the floor restlessly, sensing an inexplicable social death looming.
They boasted so much, and it turns out… it’s the same person!
“Emperor Sun,” thinking back on the unexpected events of this mission, couldn’t help but mutter: “No wonder, no wonder. I was saying how our bunch of people could be so unlucky… It turns out Brother Shunzi had come…”
Smack!
Before he could finish, “Son of Cruelty” raised his hand and pressed back the rest of his words with a slap:
“What nonsense are you spouting? What does it mean that it’s like this only because Brother Shunzi arrived? It’s because we took on a doomed mission, and Brother Shunzi couldn’t stand by, so he applied to come help us out. Understand the order of events, got it!”
Looking at the people in front of him, Colin couldn’t help but feel a mixture of amusement and helplessness: “Alright, stop talking about this.”
“It’s time to discuss how to continue with the mission.”
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 372 - 372 368 Containment Protocol Unleashed (Mega
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 372: Chapter 368 “Containment Protocol” Unleashed! (Mega Chapter)_1 Chapter 372: Chapter 368 “Containment Protocol” Unleashed! (Mega Chapter)_1 “First of all, whether you like it or not, I’ve already arrived here, and luckily I’ve completed the fifth car…”
Hearing Colin address the current situation with an important speech, outlining the experiences and circumstances at hand…
Everyone couldn’t help but mutter at the bottom of their hearts, how incredibly lucky that was!
It’s said that Brother Shunzi specializes in difficult missions; they hadn’t quite understood this before, but after a direct encounter, they finally got it.
Even a mundane mission would sprout all sorts of strange occurrences once it reached Brother Shunzi’s hands.
What used to be a static advancement after completing three cars, now looked like only halfway progress after finishing the seventh car.
They had no idea what they would have to do next.
However, in response to Colin’s words, no matter what thoughts they had in their hearts, their faces all showed, “Willing, very willing.”
Although the situation had become slightly more complicated, Brother Shunzi’s mission success rate was still something they could count on.
At this moment, after Colin finished speaking briefly, the “Son of Cruelty” couldn’t help but ask:
“Brother Shunzi, what exactly is the situation with this mission…”
They had not been close enough to hear clearly what Brother Shunzi had discussed with that replica NPC, but from the looks of it, it seemed like he had gained quite a bit of information?
“I’m not entirely certain yet; we have to finish the seventh car to be sure. If nothing unexpected happens, our final target should be that C Level Employee.”
“C Level Employee?!”
The “Son of Cruelty” and others felt their breath catch in their throats.
Although no one at the company had encountered a C Level before, from various missions and scattered channels, they roughly knew that this level represented… a qualitative change compared to D Level.
However, despite being shocked, they weren’t entirely surprised…
After all, if Brother Shunzi wasn’t quite at C Level in terms of authority, his strength was likely not too far off.
In that case, C Level fighting C Level seemed reasonable…
Not to mention fighting a C Level, if Brother Shunzi claimed he was a C Level Employee himself right now, they wouldn’t find it surprising at all.
What they didn’t know was that what Colin truly dreaded was not that Level C Employee but the unknown anomaly that had thrown the entire train into disarray…
“You’re all very accepting.” Colin scanned their expressions with a glance.
Then he continued:
“Of course, what I said is just a possibility. As for what’s going to happen afterward, I’m not very sure either. What I know for now is that this mission has encountered some issues. So, to avoid more accidents, for the upcoming events, I hope you can cooperate with me.”
“Sure, sure, sure.” The former squad leader “Son of Cruelty” showed not a hint of refusal.
In his view, it was quite a privilege for them to even be informed.
Colin wasn’t expecting too much cooperation from these people; he merely asked that they assure their own safety in the upcoming battles. As long as they were safe, they were helping him.
Of course, if a situation arose, he would provide assistance as much as possible.
He was determined to ensure everyone would survive this unexpectedly troubled mission.
This consideration inexplicably moved the “Son of Cruelty” and his companions.
Brother Shunzi, so powerful, was actually concerned about the safety of their “little shrimps!”
‘Although the mission didn’t provide any hints this time, having a few more signal points for this kind of task would probably be better,’ Colin thought and pursed his lips as he observed their status.
Thanks to the “Save and Load” ability of D Level “Fate Propeller” Personnel, they had all been restored to their original states upon entry, so there was no need to waste resources tending to their injuries anymore.
‘The “Destiny Propeller” possessing the “Save and Load” ability really took me by surprise; it feels quite eerie. Suddenly going back to a previous moment without reason, but more troublesome than that is that kind of special bullet,’ Colin thought back to the shot he just took, with a lingering sense of trepidation in his heart.
Luckily, at the critical moment, I used “Little Fist Stone” to block it; otherwise, I have no idea what the outcome would have been if I had been hit.
‘Besides, “Save and Load” seems to invoke the power of the Book of Fate, which allows the practitioner to momentarily break free from the past madness. If there are more Extraordinary Ones like this in the next two cars, I should consider making an effort to give them a chance to start over.’
These former D Level Personnel know far more than the current employees.
Colin still had many things he wanted to ask, such as about the “Great Annihilation Era,” the 500 “World Code,” and the identity of the higher ups in the Bonfire Company…
Soon, an hour’s rest time passed.
“Oh and if you notice any obvious anomalies in the flames on your body, remember to tell me,” Colin reminded the “Son of Cruelty” and the others before they set off.
He had ignited flames on all of their bodies…
From this moment onward, he didn’t dare conserve resources, using unadulterated, additive-free “Flame Bearer” Grease to escort himself the whole way.
Although this approach would consume a lot of grease, it was still better than having an actual emergency with no chance for regrets.
“Understood,” the squad mates nodded gravely, realizing that Brother Shunzi might still have some things unspoken.
But with the credit Brother Shunzi had built before them, they didn’t think too much about it.
And it was at this moment…
The train aligned its cars, and the door to the next car once again opened.
Colin, as usual, listened in from beside the door.
This time there was some noise…
Unfortunately, the topic was still about joining the “Corps” and such discussions.
Other than additional information on the benefits of joining the Corps, everything else was information they already knew…

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - 373 368 Containment Protocol Unleashed (Mega
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 373: Chapter 368 “Containment Protocol” Unleashed! (Mega Chapter)_2 Chapter 373: Chapter 368 “Containment Protocol” Unleashed! (Mega Chapter)_2 Before long, Colin was discovered once again.
“There are five people in this carriage, and it seems there isn’t a ‘Destiny Propeller’ among them. So it looks like there’s no need to hold back…”
“However, speaking of which, aside from the fifth carriage where a ‘Destiny Propeller’ used his unique trait to detect me one step ahead, in the other carriages…”
“It seems like every time they only find out after eavesdropping for a while? Until now, I haven’t been aware of the reason they discovered us. Is this to avoid a bug and forcefully create a plot trigger?”
As the thought flashed through his mind, Colin charged forward, plunging directly into the enemy’s formation.
Soon after, a glob of grease was flung out, and a massive burst of flames erupted, almost entirely filling the carriage in an instant and scattering the enemies’ combat positions, swallowing them into the sea of fire…
And it wasn’t just them; the “Son of Cruelty,” who was “breakdancing” in the corner, also changed color.
“Hiss, damn, Brother Shunzi, Brother Shunzi, please control your Divine Skills, keep them in check, please…”
The terrifying flames didn’t affect them much personally; they just felt a bit hot and a little short of breath…
But the problem was the effect on their equipment!
Even though it wasn’t a direct attack, the “Son of Cruelty” noticed that the integrity of his equipment had actually suffered some damage!
This was something that had never happened before during a mission!
Of course, they only cried out in their hearts and didn’t dare to speak up, afraid that if they really affected the other party, it wouldn’t be good.
However, under Colin’s full-on assault, the fight didn’t last long.
In less than ten minutes, without them even having the chance to go all out, all the D Level Personnel ended up as ashes in the bonfire…
The sixth carriage, passed!
“Withdraw!”
Colin gestured with his hand, and the fire rolling through the train carriage receded, transforming into a fireball burning behind his head.
Seeing this, the “Son of Cruelty” in the corner breathed a sigh of relief, mournfully glanced at his equipment, which had lost almost one percent of its integrity, and then walked over to them.
“Nothing weird happened to you guys, right?” Colin asked.
“Apart from some damage to the integrity of the equipment, it seems nothing else happened. At least to our own senses, we haven’t noticed any abnormalities…”
Damage to equipment? Isn’t that an anomaly? Why would there be damage to equipment all of a sudden…
Colin furrowed his brows, “What’s going on? Why is the equipment damaged?”
But after he asked, he noticed the others’ expressions were a bit strange, and, hesitating a little, they still explained the reason.
“Uh… sorry, I really didn’t know this would happen.”
Colin awkwardly laughed; he truly didn’t know that his flames could damage equipment.
Especially when not targeted, just some AOE damage had caused a problem.
Colin couldn’t help thinking of a saying—”When immortals fight, mortals suffer.”
But speaking of which, his own equipment seemed to be unaffected by bonfire.
It was just “Yukionna” who had some complaints, not very fond of it, but in the case that Colin didn’t specify, the flames wouldn’t harm her, so the impact was not significant…
‘Perhaps it’s because these items are bound to me?’
Colin pondered.
However, while that was a nice thought, he didn’t plan to change his fighting style. In critical moments, they would just have to put “Son of Cruelty” and the others through a bit more hardship.
As long as they could pass through and leave, this minor sacrifice clearly wasn’t too much of a problem.
“The next one is the seventh carriage. It’s highly probable that the Level C Employee is there. I’m not sure I can take him down smoothly. If things go south, you guys will have to ensure your own survival as much as possible.”
“Do not think of dying and coming back next time. Although you can be resurrected in this copy after death, that’s only the case for the first few carriages…”
“If you die later on, resurrection might still work, but there’s a good chance it will come at a cost. That happened to me in ‘Passionate Paradise,’ you could be resurrected there, but resurrection meant almost no chance of leaving again…”
Colin took out a piece of milk hazelnut chocolate, put it into his mouth, and started telling the employees about his past.
Hearing his words, their expressions turned serious, and they began to prepare.
None of them wanted to be trapped here for a lifetime…
Seeing them taking it to heart, Colin, while sucking on the chocolate, also started to check his own supplies to ensure there would be no problems in this aspect for the upcoming fight.
‘There’s bound to be trouble in the seventh carriage, either during the fight or after it…’
Colin considered the mission requirements for a moment. It stated that the duration of the stay in the seventh carriage had to be three hours, but it didn’t say what would happen after those three hours.
Unable to think of anything more, he shook his head and collected his thoughts.
Then, Colin took out the “Shield of Fairness Adjudication,” and under some sort of guidance, looked toward “Fool’s Mushroom.”
“Sure enough, it’s not an illusion. Holding this thing, even without using the powers of the ‘Arena of Honor,’ grants some subtle passive effects, immediately locking onto the weakest person present, and giving a rough sense of everyone’s combat power, as well as the most threatening individual…”
Colin muttered to himself. When he had used it just a moment ago, he had sensed through the “Shield Emblem” that unsightly guy, feeling he had a somewhat deadly aura.
However, he himself had thought that guy, who only deserved a passing mention, wouldn’t pose much of a threat, but it turned out the Shield’s judgement was slightly more accurate.

chapters.title: Chapter 374 - 374 368 Containment Protocol Unleashed (Mega
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 374: Chapter 368 “Containment Protocol” Unleashed! (Mega Chapter)_3 Chapter 374: Chapter 368 “Containment Protocol” Unleashed! (Mega Chapter)_3 After all, it was a Golden Artifact…
Just didn’t know if the guy who appraised this artifact was slacking off, as he didn’t even bother to mention this effect in the summary.
However, missing effects was not an entirely new phenomenon.
He didn’t pay it much mind.
‘Using this effect, it should be possible to quickly take down some easy targets, finding the weak spots within the enemy team.’
Colin nodded to himself and then slipped it into his pocket.
Then, as everyone waited in silence, time slowly passed by.
When the familiar noise of alignment came once again.
The train’s Mist Gate opened…
This time, Colin didn’t continue to eavesdrop and charged through the Mist Gate with Fire-Embraced.
Behind the gate, seven D Level staff stood at various spots in the carriage, looking astonished.
Colin took in the scene before him.
“Seven people, no ‘Destiny Propeller’, they didn’t anticipate my arrival in advance, the weakest in the middle, the strongest and most deadly feeling one is in the corner, the ‘Shield Emblem’ made a judgment similar to mine, just a feeling, that guy doesn’t seem to be up to C Level…”
“But overall, they might be about the same as the nine people in the fifth carriage…”
As his thoughts raced, Colin first blanketed the entire area with flames to segregate the battlefield, then weaved through the flames to close in on the person in the corner. In their surprise, he initiated Time Stop and pulled out a heavy replica Han Sword…
A barrage of effects like that, the minor D Level could not withstand at all.
“This reaction, no use of ‘Flash’, that’s definitely not C Level, yeah, one slash down, the sensation of cutting through flesh and blood, indeed remains at most at D Level.”
After killing the person, Colin turned and faced the other six.
“Whoosh.”
He swung his sword-wielding right hand, intending to perform a fancy flourish, but unfortunately lacking the skill, he could only brutishly shake the blood off the blade.
And at that moment, the six who had come to their senses didn’t hesitate at all. They didn’t show much emotion over their comrade’s death and immediately launched an all-out counterattack.
However, this time, the attack of this group surprised Colin.
“‘Containment Protocol’ Item Liberation request! ‘Demon Sword•Spectral Witch’ item 15% liberation!”
“‘Containment Protocol’ Item Liberation request! ‘Dawn Blade’ item 15% liberation!”
“‘Containment Protocol’ Item Liberation request! ‘Demon Carlos’s Left Hand’ item 15% liberation!”
One after another “voice” appeared in his mind.
“The company has this method for using artifacts? Why haven’t I seen anyone mention it in the internal group? Another damn lost technique?”
Colin saw some of those employees’ artifacts, after the “liberation request”, partially reverted to their original form…
And their might, at that moment, saw a substantial increase.
In his surprise, the assault was already upon him, and he had no time to think as he began to face the group’s siege.
The fight instantly escalated to a fever pitch!
In the corner, “Son of Cruelty” struggled under the weight of repeated combat AOE, nearly unable to hold on several times.
Fortunately, those D Level Personnel, after the initial attempt to attack them,
soon realized their attacks had little to no effect on the battle and thus didn’t continue to target them…
Still, the rolling shocks of impact left “Son of Cruelty” and the others groaning in discomfort.
“Hiss, my… Purple Gear, if this continues, my equipment will be ruined…”
Feeling the wear on his equipment, “Son of Cruelty” was on the verge of tears, his heart seemingly bleeding.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 375 - 375 369 Time Stasis Item Liberation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 375: Chapter 369 “Time Stasis” Item Liberation Application! (Two in One)_1 Chapter 375: Chapter 369 “Time Stasis” Item Liberation Application! (Two in One)_1 “Heh heh heh…”
A ghostly greatsword with a translucent, gray hue that lacked substance hovered in mid-air, seemingly phasing in and out of existence at different moments.
Its hilt bore the alluring face of a woman, emerging occasionally from various hidden spots on the frenzied battlefield to slash at Colin.
Each time it would leave a cut on his body, neither too big nor too small…
However, taking advantage of the moment when the Old No.6 Sword appeared again, Colin, who had been sliced several times, clenched his right fist and, timing his strike perfectly, swung a powerful punch at the head on the sword.
In an instant, a terrifying repulsion erupted, vibrating explosively.
The so-called Spectral Witch’s sword screamed as it was smashed away, its beautiful visage caved in.
“Clever sword, trying to inflict non-lethal damage to avoid ‘Deadly Insight’ and slowly drain my health, huh? But after so many cuts, you still gave me an opening. Now who’s laughing.”
Seeing that the sword with a human head wouldn’t be rejoining the battle anytime soon, Colin shifted his gaze and dodged another incoming attack.
Next, his attention turned to a staff made in the likeness of a hand that was attacking him with various telekinetic-like abilities after its Item Liberation.
Yet this telekinetic power could not penetrate the “Flame Bearer” flame, only managing to pick up and throw other objects, making the overall effect rather weak.
During the skirmish, Colin continued to observe these objects closely.
These items were said to be liberated by fifteen percent, but the total power and effect after liberation seemed much more than that.
In his estimation, it was at least more than double.
“Their current status is somewhat like an uncontrolled Yukionna…”
Colin subconsciously made a comparison and felt the difference probably wasn’t significant.
Just wondering which demon had such good fortune to be turned into a company artifact and immortalized despite having had a hand severed.
Just then, a furious shout came from the side.
Not too far away, a glow as bright as the morning sun erupted.
In Colin’s pupils, a fierce greatsword bursting with enormous amounts of pure white light reflected.
On it, every strand of light radiated a terrifyingly potent energy.
Some people on the battlefield merely glanced at it and felt their eyes and pupils sting with pain…
“Demon, die!”
A D Level staff member wielding the radiant greatsword roared, veins bursting and blood spraying as one of the prerequisites for swinging this sword was the simultaneous overuse of thirty “Colorless Crystals,” far exceeding his bodily limits.
Although he would not die from the use, severe injury was inevitable.
But he paid it no mind and swung the sword at Colin with all his might.
“Good!”
Colin raised his right hand, lifting his own replica greatsword with flames clinging to it.
The spectacle was no less impressive than the opponent’s Item Liberation.
This time, he didn’t dodge but instead moved directly towards the massive lightsaber falling from above. He didn’t dodge because he could sense that the attack was a lock-on.
To avoid it, he would have had to use “Time Stasis,” but with an opportunity at hand, he had to save its uses whenever possible.
Besides, Colin wanted to experience just how powerful the opponent’s equipment was.
So far, it seemed like the liberated equipment should all be Purple Gear.
“Heavy Strike·Matchless Strike!”
As he silently chanted, flames converged on the blade, and he struck horizontally with a swipe of his sword.
In the collision of light and fire, an explosion of vibration occurred at the point of contact. The incredibly bright light caused everything present to lose its color.
Finally, when the brightness receded, tangible light fragments fell like snowflakes from the sky…
And the flames were nearly extinguished.
In the arena, only one figure remained standing.
“Is this… did we finally win?” a weary D Level Personnel murmured to himself.
Meanwhile, “Son of Cruelty” and others felt a sense of dread: “Brother Shunzi didn’t get taken down in one hit, did he?”
The light that had burst forth was so intense that even people with enhanced physical attributes were left with large spots of brightness in their vision, leaving them unable to see clearly…
However, before they could dwell on it, a flame ignited atop that silhouette.
“Only a D Level, but, not weak,” came a calm voice amidst the arena.
Sinking the hearts of all D Level Personnel…
“Close call, but it’s still Brother Shunzi,” “Son of Cruelty” and the others sighed in relief.
If Brother Shunzi had been defeated, they would have been doomed too.
In the center of the battlefield, Colin’s right hand continued to bleed, the drops falling along the blade of the ancient greatsword to the ground.
Upon closer inspection, one would see his right hand’s skin densely cracked.
For the first time, Colin felt a sense of threat from Purple Gear.
‘Purple Gear, the effect varies significantly in different hands. Many of these items here may be Purple Gear, but they don’t feel as strong as the one Dog Brother possesses. Yet, their effectiveness is far beneath that of these people’s usage…’
Colin couldn’t help but reflect and compare.
Even without an “Item Liberation,” he could tell that the use of items by people on the train had a high “proficiency.”
Beyond that, he noticed something else…
The D Level Personnel on the train had items that complemented each other well, though the quality was somewhat average. And generally, each person only had one piece of Purple Gear, at most two, accompanied by two or three greens.

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - 376 369 Time Stasis Item Liberation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 376: Chapter 369 “Time Stasis” Item Liberation Application! (Two in One)_2 Chapter 376: Chapter 369 “Time Stasis” Item Liberation Application! (Two in One)_2 Even one third of them don’t have Purple Gear, only a few pieces of Green Gear.
‘But no matter what, the quantity and quality of items can’t compare to the current Employees. You know, even Squad F almost has one item per person, and the ‘Son of Cruelty’ even has two pieces of Purple Gear. Inside the company’s group chat, it seems all D Level Personnel have a baseline of two to three pieces…’
Colin’s thoughts spun as he guessed whether it was due to too many deaths.
Resulting in a situation where there are more items than people now.
Especially since many items were of very low integrity when first obtained, and had to be slowly repaired with Points and the like.
But before he could ponder further, gazes from all around fell upon him. Colin slightly reined in his sprawling thoughts, took a deep breath, and as the Little Maid swiftly repaired the wounds on his right hand, his gaze shifted towards the few remaining D Level Personnel.
Under his scrutiny, their expressions were grave. Despite knowing they stood no chance of victory, they showed no signs of retreating.
And inside his mind, a rapid exchange of information took place.
“Vice-Captain, what do we do next…” It seemed to be a D Level Employee speaking.
“We’ve been blocked in here, unable to communicate with the outside world, and he’s probably here to kill us all. Given our status and the combat strength he has shown, escape is impossible. So, we must try to break the blockade at all costs and transmit the information about this place before we die…”
“Otherwise, with such a person infiltrating the train, everybody will be in great danger…”
“Next…”
“Do not retreat, do not dodge, do not yield, fight to the death!”
As the information settled, a female D Level Employee gestured, merging the ‘Demon Sword’ with a human head into her body, and then she took off her hat. Below the brim of her hat, her eyes shimmered with a blood-red light, and her hair wildly grew and writhed.
Seeing their Vice-Captain fight desperately, the rest of the Personnel also spread out and continued their attempts to kill Colin.
“Although I admire your determination, unfortunately, time’s almost up. I can only send you off early to retain some dignity,” Colin said with a sigh, and then he made his move once again.
This time, to ensure their “honorable deaths,” he used his full strength.
After several more minutes, as the last person was consumed by flames, the battle finally ended.
The seventh carriage, cleared!
“Phew!”
Colin heaved a heavy sigh, feeling somewhat tired after the successive battles, despite his strength.
The delaying tactics and this direct crushing approach really differed immensely in terms of effort required.
The former would likely not prompt these D Level staff to resort to desperate measures…
The latter required absorbing full damage, and even for Colin, it wasn’t easy, because some of the D Level Employees’ tactics indeed posed a nuisance.
“With my strength, facing more than seventy of these D Level Employees head-on without adding Level C Employees, I probably would have had to activate ‘Hunger,’ right?”
As Colin thought it over, he suddenly felt that he was still too weak.
“Right, there’s something I can try…”
Colin took out a Golden Card and then silently thought ”Containment Protocol’ Item Liberation request. ‘Time Stasis’ Item 15 percent liberation’…
After voicing his thoughts internally, Colin eagerly looked at his Golden Artifact—
If the D Level’s Purple Gear liberation was that powerful, what about a Golden Artifact?!
Yet, after one, two, three, four, five, six seconds, Colin didn’t see any changes in his ‘Time Freeze’.
‘Could it be that I need to say it out loud?’
Colin hesitated for a moment, then glanced around. Seeing flames burning everywhere and figuring his voice would likely not be heard by others, he moved his lips:
“‘Containment Protocol’ Item Liberation request, ‘Time Freeze’ Item 15 percent Liberation!”
Suppressing a certain sense of embarrassment after saying this out loud, he continued to wait expectantly.
Regrettably, even after several seconds, no new effect manifested.
Item Liberation failed.
“Strange, I’m sure the original words were just this…”
After pondering for a bit, he tried another card, but to no avail.
“Could it be that my level is not high enough to unlock the seals on the Golden Artifact?”
Thinking this, Colin attempted to use an Orange Gear, still with no success…
Even the Purple Gear seemed to not work.
“Could it be uniquely D Level? But outside, I’ve never heard of D Levels having this technique. Alas, looks like it’s either an exclusive technique for the previous Employees or requires some special conditions. And speaking of which, not every D Level Personnel on the Ghost Train has this technique. Only a part can liberate the seals…”
Colin sighed and quietly put away his equipment.
Then, with a thought, the flames began to slowly retract from all directions…
Seeing the flames that covered the entire carriage retract back behind Colin’s head, forming into a small sun-like ball of fire, those like the ‘Son of Cruelty’ realized the battle must have ended.
They first looked at their items with pained expressions before stepping out.
Then, seeing Colin with a pale face and bleeding body, they changed expressions and hurried to inquire, “Brother Shunzi, how are you holding up?”
“I’m alright, just surface wounds,” Colin waved his hand, taking out the ‘Gluttony Power Mark’ to heal himself.
His injuries were mostly ruptured blood vessels and internal bleeding, which, with the help of ‘Nano-smart Machinery,’ should heal in less than an hour…
While treating himself, he continued to check the mission status.
It seemed to be because he had successfully suppressed the seventh carriage.

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - 377 369 Time Stasis Item Liberation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 377: Chapter 369 “Time Stasis” Item Liberation Application! (Two in One)_3 Chapter 377: Chapter 369 “Time Stasis” Item Liberation Application! (Two in One)_3 The mission now included a three-hour countdown ticking away…
“Three hours should be enough,” he muttered, “to restore it by at least ninety percent without any issue.”
Colin estimated and made some judgements.
Unless something unexpected happened, the real trouble was yet to come…
“I hope the ‘Flame Bearer’s’ power truly can avoid contamination as that guy claimed,”
Colin silently prayed within his heart.
However, while he was pondering, another new mission popped up.
[Event Two: It is anticipated that in one hour, you will align with the eighth carriage. Please prepare as required to enter the subsequent carriages and carry out a suppression action in the 8th and 9th carriages.]
“Note: Investigation of the ninth detached out-of-control carriage upon completion will be regarded as the completion of this mission, with a substantial reward granted.”
“Caution: You may choose whether to conduct a deeper investigation.”
…
Huh?
Colin gave a start, finding the new mission seemed to be in conflict with the current one he was carrying out.
The current task was to stop in the seventh carriage for three hours.
This one was about continuing into the next carriage…
“What’s this about?”
While the “Son of Cruelty” also received the mission, he looked puzzled, turning towards Brother Shunzi, “If I remember correctly, this seems like the usual mission progression, from 3 to 5, 5 to 7, 7 to 9… Which one should we be carrying out?”
Hearing him, Colin recalled something and said with confusion, “I’ve always wondered, besides us here, has anyone ever made it to the seventh carriage?”
At that, the others were startled, then thought for a moment, and one by one, shook their heads.
“Seems not… the fifth is the limit, 5 to 7 is certain, but 7 to 9 is uncertain. Besides us here, I’ve never heard of anyone else getting this far.”
“Then how do you know that it will continue in order after 7?”
“Well… it seems there was this notion, but no one knows who started it.” After some thought, they all seemed unsure.
With this new variable in the mission, staying here one couldn’t know what might happen, but venturing into the subsequent carriages was equally unknown.
A wrong choice might lead to serious trouble, perhaps being trapped here forever.
Seeing everyone’s expressions, Colin bit into a piece of concentrated chocolate to supplement energy, then licked his chapped lips before continuing:
“Then, let’s stick with the mission to stay here for three hours and ignore the one about moving to the next carriage.”
The previous mission was likely sent by “Lady Rabbit,” as one could see her stamp. Ever since the incident in “The Seventh Box Garden World,” any mission from “Lady Rabbit” seemed to have a stamp that others couldn’t notice.
As for this newly appearing one, there were two possibilities…
One was that the “Ghost Train” carried it intrinsically.
Meaning, reaching a certain point automatically triggered the next task, a part of some mechanical procedure.
The second possibility was akin to the mysterious trap mission that had thrown him into “The Seventh Box Garden World” previously; perhaps some fiend or specter was exerting influence in the dark, attempting to ensnare him.
If it were the second scenario, whether one could return after entering was highly doubtful.
Weighing the options, Colin chose “Lady Rabbit.”
“So, will the people from the eighth carriage come in?” the former team leader “Son of Cruelty” couldn’t help asking.
So far, it seemed that if one stayed away from the Mist Gate for too long, people from the other carriages might take the initiative to come over.
“Not quite sure, but if they do come over, I’ll deal with them quickly,” said Colin reassuringly.
During the seventh cycle, he had not used the Bone Spur to preserve some dignity for them.
But in the eighth cycle, he would need to employ Time Stop to quickly end the battle for each of them.
As things stood, D Level Personnel still didn’t have many effective countermeasures against the “Time Freeze” item.
Relieved by his words, the others trusted Brother Shunzi implicitly.
And as time ticked by…
One hour later.
The faces of “Son of Cruelty” and the others changed slightly as the spacious double doors of the Mist Gate once again appeared before them.
.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - 378 370 Descending Upon the Actual Area of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 378: Chapter 370: Descending Upon the Actual Area of the “Ghost Train”_1 Chapter 378: Chapter 370: Descending Upon the Actual Area of the “Ghost Train”_1 ‘This time, the train did not move again, yet the car door still emerged; it felt like it came on its own?’
Colin was fully focused on what lay ahead, not daring to let his guard down.
Behind the mist gate leading to the eighth train car, the dim yellow light remained, and one could faintly hear some subtle noises…
It was like someone was whispering or like the madness-inducing murmurs of a bizzare dream.
Next to Colin, ‘Son of Cruelty’ and others watched in that direction, their bodies stiffening, not even daring to take a deep breath for fear of startling something.
This time, compared to the previous train cars, there was an inexplicable sense of eeriness behind the eighth car.
‘I always feel that whatever is on the other side is in some kind of twisted state…’
Colin narrowed his eyes; the door he could see looked relatively normal.
But in his mind, that mist gate appeared to be writhing.
And those voices, if one listened carefully, weren’t normal human speech at all; they were a bunch of chaotic, bizarre screams. Listening too much, even Colin would begin to feel his mind uneasy.
He also genuinely felt an indescribable sense of palpitations…
Clearly, the entity behind the eighth car since its inception could have unpredictable changes.
However, the one thing worth being thankful for right now was.
Ten minutes passed, and those D Level personnel had not breached this side.
‘Logically speaking, they should have noticed something in no more than five minutes, but this time, it seems that this hasn’t happened.’
As Colin analyzed the situation in his mind, he remained vigilant of the mist gate.
Then, several more minutes slowly passed, and when thirty minutes arrived.
The continuous whispers suddenly ceased…
Shortly afterward, the sound of a glass shattering on the floor startled everyone present with a ‘thump’ in their hearts.
All eyes turned again towards the mist gate of the eighth car.
This time, some inhuman growls rose one after another from that side, making the whole mist gate look even more distorted.
In the brain, it seemed like a vortex…
And from this vortex, there was a kind of indescribable and barely perceptible breath slowly seeping out.
However, under the light of the ‘Flame Bearer’s’ flame, all those unseen things evaporated.
‘Tch, if we go in now, we might really experience, the true horror of D Level staff losing control,’
Colin pursed his lips, having some guesses about what was behind him.
Currently, when the D Level personnel on the train went insane, they were merely showing pure madness without any other strange qualities. Likely, this was because the company had removed these dangerous elements when creating the ‘copy.’
But after the eighth car, things didn’t seem quite right.
For the first time, Colin sensed a definite ‘corruption.’
If they went inside, the chances were high that the D Level staff they encountered wouldn’t just be in a ‘weakened by three percent after turning evil’ type of state.
However, feeling certain breaths evaporate under the light of the flame, Colin also felt somewhat relieved.
This showed that his flames could indeed dispel these entities.
Fortunately, after another fifteen minutes passed, even though the mist gate seemed more and more distorted, Colin was fairly confident that the abnormal staff of the eighth car wouldn’t come over…
At that moment, seeing ‘Son of Cruelty’ next to him with a horrified expression, Colin thought for a moment and comforted in a low voice amid the bonfire:
‘If nothing unexpected happens, as long as we stand still here, they won’t come over.’
Hearing Colin’s words, several people nodded at the sight of the flame, feeling somewhat reassured.
They were not as experienced as Brother Shunzi; after feeling the bizarre and heart-pounding breath beyond the mist gate, they had the sensation of standing on the edge of a cliff or looking down from the top of a high-rise building…
That throbbing made them especially uneasy, and what was more unnerving was this inexplicable urge to ‘jump off’ the building kept brewing inside them.
Thankfully, with the bonfire burning beside them, they were able to suppress that thought.
And in Brother Shunzi’s experience, since he said it was okay, it should be okay…
But no sooner had their hanging hearts settled than they suddenly saw Brother Shunzi’s face change slightly.
At the same time, before they could ask what was wrong, they heard terrifying, inhuman shrieks coming from behind the mist gate.
Accompanied by a great deal of disordered footsteps, all the out-of-control staff in the eighth car stirred.
‘What’s happening?’
Colin subconsciously clenched the Time Stop Gold Card in his left hand, drew out Bone Spur from his pocket with his right hand, and the flame at the back of his head flared.
However, the scene of a multitude of aberrant staff rushing out of the mist gate didn’t happen.
Instead, the sound of combat came from within the eighth car.
‘Clang clang clang!’
In the sound of some heavy metal weapon colliding with the surroundings, a series of dreadful vibrations ensued.
‘Hiss, what’s invaded the eighth car?’
Colin suddenly stood up, his heart heavy, feeling the power of the entity clashing with the aberrant staff, and it was very strong…
The entire eighth car sounded like it was about to fall apart at any moment.
The fight didn’t last long, only about three minutes, after which it seemed everything had settled.
From the somewhat unsteady footsteps that could be heard…
The victor seemed to be the one who had just invaded the train car.
And…
After dealing with the out-of-control staff, it was walking towards the mist gate of the seventh car.

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - 379 370 Descending Upon the Actual Area of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 379: Chapter 370: Descending Upon the Actual Area of the “Ghost Train”_2 Chapter 379: Chapter 370: Descending Upon the Actual Area of the “Ghost Train”_2 Colin’s expression was grave as he held his breath slightly and without any hesitation, decisively used several “Colorless Crystal”s, bringing himself into an energy-saturated state.
Meanwhile, “Son of Sadomasochism” and the others were also ready to shrink back into a corner and observe from a safe distance.
However, just when Colin thought that a battle was inevitable…
The figure dragging some sort of heavy metal weapon, step by step, eventually stopped its footsteps behind the Mist Gate.
Shortly after…
A very hoarse voice that seemed to be suppressing some pain came through.
“…Leave…”
“..You… can’t handle this…”
“Leave… this place… is dangerous…”
“…”
Leave? Colin frowned slightly, unsure of how to respond.
He had some speculation about the guy behind the Mist Gate.
‘There’s a not so small chance that it’s the only Level C Employee from the train before, a kind of Destiny Propeller like the D Level Personnel, who can rely on their own unique traits, to realize the fact that they’ve become NPCs, so there’s a very high probability that the Level C Employee who may have experienced a significant change in life strata has something special. It makes no sense that he wouldn’t notice this.’
‘Right, the one whom ‘Lifecoach Kawaii-many’ spoke of, the help they encountered when they were almost unable to hold on in the fifth carriage, was it this person?’
‘Looking at it this way, this Level C colleague, although contaminated like the others, has managed to maintain a certain state rather than being crazy like the other D Level ones, without the slightest resistance.’
In Colin’s mind, a series of thoughts flashed through.
However, just at that moment, seemingly feeling they were still not leaving…
The voice behind the Mist Gate began to grow increasingly frenzied and impatient.
“Leave! Leave! Leave!”
“Leave this place!!”
“Leave!!!”
The hoarse voice suddenly became repetitive and anxious.
‘Sorry mate, it’s not that we don’t want to leave, but that we really can’t.’
Colin silently muttered to himself as the fireball at the back of his head expanded even more, and shed copious amounts of flame, as if to set his very body alight.
At the same time, several shouts yielded no response.
The figure behind the Mist Gate moved again, as if intending to personally “help” them leave if they did not do so themselves…
The entire Mist Gate at this moment underwent a terrifying distortion.
Then, a few seconds later…
A pitch-black hand covered in cracks reached out from the center of the swirling Mist Gate.
An extremely creepy eerieness spread from the hand…
However, just as the hand had barely entered the range lit by the light, it retracted sharply.
And then…
Colin, who was already prepared for battle, heard…
The guy… had left?
The heavy footsteps gradually faded away, with the sound completely disappearing after a while.
The Mist Gate, which had nearly turned into a vortex, also returned to its original state at that moment.
“What’s the meaning of this, they let us go?” Seeing this, “Son of Sadomasochism” and the others couldn’t help but be astonished, not quite understanding why the other party would abruptly leave.
At this moment, they felt an uneasy sensation as though they might suddenly find the enemy behind them.
However, Colin was sure that the other person had truly left.
“According to his words, he probably felt that we lacked the strength, so he told us to leave. However, perhaps because he had just reached out, he sensed something… and thus acknowledged our strength,” he said, his hand stroking his chin thoughtfully.
He saw quite clearly that the reason for the other’s retreat was probably because he sensed the aura of the “Bonfire.”
Still, there were some things he didn’t quite understand.
‘Supposing that this guy is really a Level C Employee and the company’s target is also him, wasn’t that just now a good opportunity to make contact?’
‘But looking at the task situation, the company doesn’t seem to intend to proceed with the subsequent carriages or make contact with him.’
Colin’s brow furrowed slightly.
If this was the case, either the company’s target isn’t the Level C Personnel but something else, or the Dissuasion Bro from the eighth carriage who seemed like a Level C Employee actually isn’t one…
After pondering for a moment and feeling there were too many variables and both possibilities existed, Colin decided not to think further on the matter.
And with the departure of “Dissuasion Bro,” the seventh carriage once again regained the previous calm and tranquility.
But as time continued to tick by, and the last hour approached…
“Zzzt,” an electrical current flashed past…
In the vast carriage, the Mist Gates that opened one after another dispersed at the sound, and moreover, the antique electric gas lamps that had always been steadily dim throughout started to fade gradually.
And with the dimming of the lights…
The grey fog that had been outside the carriage slowly dissipated.
This process was not quick…
Moreover, with both issues occurring, they all felt as if the carriage were slowly descending “downward.”
“At this rate, the lights will go out in an hour, and the fog should also dissipate at that time. Well, overall, it’s exactly at the end of the third hour as required by the mission…”
“And this sinking sensation, it’s like being in an elevator…”
“Looks like, just as that ‘Destiny Propeller’ D Level Personnel said, the company plans to use this as a springboard to enter the original disaster site?”
Colin speculated quietly, then intensified the flame.
He remembered that the mission description mentioned that the company had found the missing personnel, learned about this situation, and had even created a copy as a promotion mission to test new employees…
But it seemed that it indeed didn’t mention how the company ultimately dealt with the disordered Ghost Train.
Looking at it now…
It seems the company didn’t resolve everything at that time?
‘Was it deliberate, or were they unable to spare the personnel?’
In Colin’s view, with the company’s peak combat capabilities, it definitely couldn’t be that they were unable to deal with the anomaly here. Let alone what the three company giants could do, just sending Rosen, who holds the ‘0-09’ ‘Hunger’, could undoubtedly handle it.
The mission description also mentioned that the company took this matter very seriously, and it was not unlikely they dispatched high-level combat forces.
However, in the end, it seemed the company did not thoroughly resolve the issue here…
Therefore, there’s a not-so-small chance that they left it deliberately, but the specific reason was unclear.
However, at this moment, there was no time to think further.
Time was running out…
Inside the train carriage, as the lights gradually extinguished, it became more dilapidated.
Shaking his head, Colin withdrew his thoughts, and while keeping a vigilant watch around him, he kept an eye on the countdown in his mind.
Finally, a few minutes later, the countdown ended.
The lights inside the train were completely extinguished.
The descent was complete.
Colin and the others couldn’t care about completing the mission and peered through the train carriage, using the light of the fire to observe the situation outside—
A very open and desolate place, the surrounding scenery revealed a greyish hue in the light of the fire.
Within the greyness, there were many chunks of sticky matter, wriggling like flesh.
But before they could take a closer look, a sudden change happened.
Bang.
A gigantic chunk of flesh full of blood vessels suddenly broke through the door on the right side of the carriage, and on that chunk of flesh, there was a very simple, hastily drawn face.
It had features crowded together like a plump baby’s.
Seeing something coming, Colin didn’t hesitate and was prepared to take action.
“Friend… good friend… are you, friends?” a childish voice, like that of a small child, came from the crude face on the flesh.
“Friends?”
Colin showed a puzzled expression, stopped his actions, and hesitated before asking the big chunk of flesh squeezing at the door, “Who are you?”
While speaking, he sniffed the air and quickly picked up on a familiar scent—
Was this monster… made of human flesh?
“Friend, friend… are you friends?” the child-voiced flesh chunk didn’t answer but continued to squeeze at the door, repeating monotonous words without showing any malice or hostility.
Did one have to answer if they were friends to provoke a further reaction?
Colin thought about it, feeling there wasn’t much danger, and then responded, “Yes, we are friends.”
As soon as he spoke, the entire chunk of flesh trembled, then it joyfully shouted with a childish voice, “Great, I have friends now, good friend, good friend… tasty… something tasty…”
“Yes, we are good friends. Can you tell us what happened here?” Colin tried to get more information immediately.
But as soon as he finished speaking, he sensed something was wrong…
‘Eh? Good friend, tasty?’
As the thought crossed his mind, Colin’s expression tightened, and he suddenly saw it.
The chunk of flesh that had shown no ill intentions just now suddenly opened a mouth several meters wide and lunged at them with a gaping maw.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - 380 371 The Abnormal Behavior of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 380: Chapter 371: The Abnormal Behavior of the Uncontrolled Containment Subject_1 Chapter 380: Chapter 371: The Abnormal Behavior of the Uncontrolled Containment Subject_1 “Buzz!”
An invisible engine roared to life.
In front of him, the huge mass of flesh, the employees around him, the dust floating in midair, everything seemed to freeze in place like a paused photograph.
“God damn it, friends taste so good…”
Muttering a complaint in his heart, Colin looked around but saw no other enemies. Without hesitation, he pulled out a Bone Spur and stabbed it toward the gaping maw of the gruesome flesh before him.
The flesh itself was not particularly tough and lacked protective skin, so the Bone Spur easily penetrated it.
At that moment, the ticking sound of a clock’s second hand began…
“Aaah!!!”
A sharp scream suddenly pierced the air.
The enormous mass of flesh seemed to undergo some horrifying torture, bouncing and thrashing in pain, emitting an unbearable wail.
Its screams were so piercing that they made the ears of “Son of Sadomasochism” and others tingle with numbness.
However, observing the suddenly changing scene, they were slightly stunned and, for a moment, couldn’t grasp what was going on or why the enemy they were just about to engage had suddenly retreated.
“It’s time stasis!” “Little Chicken No. 7” suddenly recalled Brother Shunzi’s famous tool.
Brother Shunzi had become well-known in the company because of this item.
In front of them, Colin watched the tormented flesh wailing externally and did not pursue further.
At this moment, a new mission event surfaced in his mind.
[Event Three: Complete containment of the original artifact “Blood of Rebirth,” which has gone completely out of control.]
“Note”: Extra evaluation points and rewards will be gained.
…
“The ‘Blood of Rebirth,’ an original artifact that has completely lost control?”
Colin murmured to himself, then guided by some intuition, looked toward the mass of flesh convulsing and wailing outside the carriage.
This time, he understood what this thing was all about…
‘So it’s the remains of an employee’s artifact that once died here? No wonder it’s so weak; I thought it was the anomaly causing issues here…’
‘Didn’t expect it’s just a green-named artifact. No wonder it doesn’t seem very strong; a simple poke caused it to act like it’s dying, although surviving the Bone Spur attack should mean it started off as an uncontrollable Purple object.’
Colin’s thoughts flashed in his mind, and then instead of taking immediate action, he looked at the task requiring him to stay in the seventh carriage for three hours.At this moment, the task had been updated.
Instead of delving deeper for investigation, the task had shifted to, [“Light a bonfire.”].
Colin glanced at the mission description, which essentially tasked them with finding materials nearby to light a temporary bonfire.
As for the materials needed…
Colin pursed his lips, cast a kindly glance toward the convulsing mass of flesh outside the carriage.
He had to turn it into kindling before it died in pain.
The process of gathering kindling went smoothly without any incidents…
After Colin had dissected the monster, which had become uncontrollable from “Blood of Rebirth,” and thrown its parts outside the carriage door onto the empty ground, then casually doused it with a bit of Grease, a bonfire seven or eight meters high was immediately lit.
“Trash, only burns this high.”
Colin looked up at the two to three-story high flames and shook his head, dissatisfied.
However, the flesh he had killed seemed to be only a part of “Blood of Rebirth.” Within the surrounding dull area, there were still a vast number of “Blood of Rebirth” flesh masses.
Looking at it, it resembled some sort of bizarre fleshly moss…
But he did not dwell on this matter for long. As soon as the bonfire was lit,
Colin and “Son of Sadomasochism” among others had a map-like entity appear in their minds.
This area continued to expand consistently with the emergence of the bonfire.
After experimenting a bit, they could sense that the maximum range of this “small map” should be just over one kilometer; anything beyond that became incredibly blurred.
Of course, it was still growing, but the rate of expansion was getting slower and slower.
“So the ‘Bonfire’ also serves as a little map.”
Colin pursed his lips again, sensed their vicinity, and combining the small map with his sense of smell, quickly noticed that a few hundred meters away, apart from the wriggling flesh masses of various sizes, there seemed to be other anomalies present.
One of them was quite familiar…
A figure wearing a black, complicated lace gothic coat dress, like a ghostly entity, had on its forehead an unsettling eye roaming restlessly.
Of all the anomalies nearby, only it posed the greatest threat.
At the moment, it seemed unaware of Colin’s presence and was kneeling on the ground, grabbing chunks of flesh flowing from “Blood of Rebirth” and stuffing them into its mouth, chewing briefly before swallowing, eating until its stomach was slightly bulging.
“Isn’t that the ‘Demon Sword•Spectral Witch’?”
Colin expressed surprise; during the previous battle, he had been cut several times by this level 6 sword, only to smash its head in with a punch, so he was very familiar with its scent.
However, compared to before, this entity now seemed completely out of control, reverted to its original form.
Its head no longer bore any signs of being caved in…
“It appears that this is probably the true form of the Demon Sword; the one in the train replica must be fake.”
Colin thought to himself, intrigued.
However, soon after he looked over, whether the Demon Sword had eaten its fill or something else had occurred, its form became volatile and disappeared from the spot.
Apart from that, in several other places, there were also a few likely out-of-control artifacts present.

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - 381 371 Abnormal Behavior of the Uncontrolled
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 381: Chapter 371: Abnormal Behavior of the Uncontrolled Containment Subject_2 Chapter 381: Chapter 371: Abnormal Behavior of the Uncontrolled Containment Subject_2 It’s just…
What made Colin slightly tense was that these anomalies were either consuming “Blood of Rebirth” that had transformed into flesh, or they were on their way to consume it.
And those pieces of “Blood of Rebirth” flesh, it was unknown what they were eating to replenish themselves.
In any case, as far as he could see, although it was only active in the lowest local levels, it seemed to be doing quite well for itself.
“What are these chunks of flesh, and why are so many monsters eating them?” “Son of Cruelty,” perceiving the images in his mind, said with astonishment.
The few of them did not have that side mission, so they were unclear about the specifics.
But soon, with Colin’s explanation, he understood the situation.
“Most of these things are out-of-control items?” Hearing this, they couldn’t help clicking their tongues, and it also confirmed something for them—that nowadays, the company’s item materials indeed all came from anomalies.
However, before they could think further, the “small map” of the bonfire stopped expanding after it reached a three-kilometer radius with the bonfire as the center and finalized its expansion.
At the same time, the mission content updated once again, adding a line to the existing “light a bonfire” task:
[Temporary Event 1: “Collect ten pieces of kindling to expand the detection range of the bonfire, locate and investigate the ‘Phantom Witch,’ and find the location of at least one deceased D Level staff member.”]
“Note”: A standard unit of kindling is roughly equivalent to one Second Order Beast Transformation Syndrome patient.
“Precaution 1”: Try not to look up at the sky deliberately…
“Precaution 2”: Do not pay attention to any minerals with strange patterns.
…
“…Find the location of a deceased D Level employee? Ah, this, I could have just followed her directly after seeing that ghost earlier, then I can simply catch up,” Colin said, rubbing his forehead, feeling a bit regretful.
If he had done so, he probably could have saved quite a bit of time and would have been able to leave this strange and ghostly place sooner…
Next, he glanced at Precaution 1. Although he hadn’t deliberately looked up at the sky, he could still see with the corner of his eye that the sky above was covered with a very strange aurora.
It was somewhat like the Northern Lights, but the shapes were entirely different, forming twisting spirals…
Even with just a peripheral glance, Colin felt an unease, as if he was being drawn in.
‘This must be from that thing that led to the annihilation of the staff, right?’
Colin pondered briefly, then without looking any further, gathered his thoughts and called out to “Son of Cruelty” and the others.
Then, they began to collect the surrounding “kindling”…
Besides the chunks of flesh that had transformed from the “Blood of Rebirth,” Colin subdued all the other out-of-control Containment Subjects and tossed them into the bonfire as fuel.
Although these Containment Subjects were far stronger than their item forms.
But without a user, their own intelligence was not high, so dealing with them wasn’t too difficult…
Besides the abnormal creatures, Colin also encountered the mysterious patterned minerals mentioned in “Precaution 2” of the mission.
They appeared to be multicolored metallic mineral crystals, emitting strange lights, resembling coiled curls.
Just gazing at them for a few moments could cause dizziness and a sense of disarray.
After cautioning everyone to be careful, Colin did not interact further with these objects and continued to search for other Containment Subjects.
About an hour later, the task of gathering kindling was essentially complete, and the “small map” bonfire also continued to expand for several kilometers in the process. When the range diameter reached about ten kilometers, Colin once again perceived the “Phantom Witch.”
At this time, it seemed to be drifting towards a hole in the ground, and inside the hole, there seemed to be a rather large blurry object…
“Feels like… a train carriage?”
Colin tried to focus his attention, peering into the interior through the “small map.”
But unfortunately, no matter how he observed, it was all a blur.
After thinking for a moment, Colin turned to “Son of Cruelty” and the others, saying, “Stay here and don’t move. I’ll take care of this mission. Just as before, if you notice any issues with the flames on you, make some noise and I’ll come over.”
“No problem.” They all nodded in agreement.
Seeing that there were no issues, Colin headed towards the target direction.
As he got close, he had “Yukionna” possess him and then took out a badge to pin on his collar before holding his breath.
The next moment, his presence rapidly faded, practically invisible…
With his current strength, he could easily use this item for over a dozen minutes without any issue.
Before long, Colin arrived at the edge of the large pit and indeed saw an old, discarded train carriage that had been out of use for who knows how long.
The exterior paint of the carriage had peeled off, and from within, there wafted the foul smell of blood and flesh…
He could also hear the sound of chewing.
“This… the smell of a living person? Could it be that one of the former staff members is still alive?”
Colin controlled himself and slowly floated over.
Then, when he saw what was inside the carriage, he couldn’t help holding his breath.
In the center of the vast train carriage, he saw an obese “person” about three meters tall, lying on a “bed” made from a large number of chairs, squirming continuously.
His limbs, head, and torso were all bound by dark chains.
Yet due to his extreme obesity, his struggles seemed like the writhing of maggots.
“So fat, it doesn’t look like it, but my gut feeling says it really might be a former D Level employee. No wait, the mission isn’t completed, so I’m not sure…”

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - 382 371 The Abnormal Behavior of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 382: Chapter 371: The Abnormal Behavior of the Uncontrolled Containment Subject_3 Chapter 382: Chapter 371: The Abnormal Behavior of the Uncontrolled Containment Subject_3 Colin saw a kind of madness in those nearly swollen shut eyes that felt hauntingly familiar.
This madness was almost identical to that of the employees who had lost control on the train…
Had it not been for the chains that restrained him, he had no doubt that this guy would have violently snapped.
Whether he was a former employee was unclear, but it was certain that he was beyond help.
“By the way, where’s the ‘Phantom Witch’? She didn’t go out again, did she? What is she doing locking up a former employee like this? Raising him like a pig for slaughter?”
As Colin thought of the “Phantom Witch” eating flesh, he was perplexed. Suddenly, there she was, materializing out of thin air, her delicate beauty and pale complexion set off by a black, intricate lace Gothic coat dress…the “Phantom Witch.”
What happened next made Colin’s gaze turn slightly rigid.
She floated over to the side of the man who might have been a former employee, skillfully brought her head close to the man’s mouth, opened it to reveal sharp fangs, and kissed him.
Then, with her blood-red long tongue, she pried open the man’s mouth and, like ruminating, slid her throat to regurgitate some mushed meat that had been chewed up and swallowed earlier, pouring it into the bloated body…
After a while, having stuffed the food from her stomach into his body in such a manner, the “Phantom Witch” finally raised her head.
Then she reached out a delicate hand, plunged it into the obese mouth, and pushed what might have remained in the throat down into the stomach.
Finally, the “Phantom Witch” sat motionless on a nearby chair like a doll, her exquisite face and a pair of delicate black eyes staring at the man who emitted strange roars and struggled like wriggling maggots, seemingly anticipating something to happen.
She watched the man in front of her as if he encompassed her entire world.
“Hiss… After going mad, this employee has survived for so long, all because of this?”
Colin found it hard to understand his own feelings as he watched, never anticipating a containment subject would go to such lengths for its possessor.
Moreover, it seemed…
This had been going on for not just one or two years, but for decades, or even longer.
Regrettably, Colin couldn’t help but shake his head inwardly:
“Although I don’t know how it manages to keep a former employee alive just by feeding him flesh… this expectation is doomed to be unfulfilled; the madness has seeped into the marrow, incurable.”
“Also, there’s always this strangely familiar aura I feel from the ‘Phantom Witch’…”
It was as this thought emerged that a cold presence surfaced.
Upon deciphering the message within the cold aura…
“You’re saying the ‘Phantom Witch’ shares your mother’s aura and she might have been cultivated from the ‘City of Scripts’?”
Colin looked somewhat bemused, yet not entirely surprised.
The sentient anomalies he had encountered so far seemed to be connected to the “City of Scripts” one way or another…
Boss Huang may be unscrupulous, but the artifacts he messes with indeed have something about them.
As the cold presence continued to manifest, he learned from “Yukionna” that this kind of anomaly, with humanity almost intact and few flaws, should be bona fide graduates, not like her who had escaped through a crack.
“Sigh, look at them, then look at you, always just knowing to ask me for ‘Colorless Crystal’ to eat.”
Glancing at the “Phantom Witch” and then thinking of “Yukionna,” Colin frankly felt a bit envious.
But before he could reflect further, the task in his mind finally completed.
And that meant…
This bloated, enormous “corpse” was indeed from a certain employee.
Then another new event emerged.
After quickly scanning through it, Colin couldn’t help but sigh.
[Temporary Event 2: “Use the power of the ‘Bonfire’ to incinerate the aberrant corpse left by the former employee after death, thus locking onto the contamination source of the ‘Ghost Train.'”]

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 383: Chapter 372: “Red Moon” Descends! (6K, mega chapter, seeking monthly tickets!)_1 Chapter 383: Chapter 372: “Red Moon” Descends! (6K, mega chapter, seeking monthly tickets!)_1 “Looking at the mission requirements, there’s really no way around destroying this tragic romance, even if I didn’t want to.”
Shaking his head, Colin dragged out the extremely long replica Han Sword from the “Storage Room.”
He actively dismissed the prop effect that reduced his presence…
Following that, flames erupted and rolled over his body.
