It was at this moment that the “Spectral Witch,” standing beside the body of a former employee and clad in a complicated black gothic lace dress, glanced over for the first time. The exquisite array of eyeballs on her delicate forehead met Colin’s gaze.
It seemed she recognized Colin’s identity and knew he should be a member of the company, so she didn’t attack immediately.
The standoff lasted several seconds before Colin finally spoke, “He’s already dead. If possible, I’d like you to let it go, so I can help him find peace, rather than continue to exist in this form…”
Although the employee’s flesh had persisted in this state, his essence had already died, more completely than even brain death; his genes and everything else had been collapsing for who knows how many years, completely distorted.
Even with cloning techniques, it was unlikely anything could be cloned…
Even looking at it from a more esoteric perspective, Colin could not feel any trace of a soul or the like within the body.
So there really was no chance of saving him.
At least with Colin’s knowledge, there seemed to be nothing that could save him… No, that wasn’t quite right. Suddenly, he remembered a terrifying existence…
‘If the “Red Moon” took action, there might be a chance. After all, when the “Father of the Ocean” was just a lump of polluted, rotting flesh that had decayed for who knows how many years, it was brought back to life, a true miracle.’
‘If It were to take action, perhaps there would be a chance to save this pile of rotting flesh.’
‘But…’
Expecting the “Red Moon” to come and save someone?
Colin wasn’t so naive to believe that. That being not causing trouble was fortunate enough. Hoping It would save someone felt even less realistic than expecting “0-09 ‘Hunger'” to give up its desire to “eat.”
Of course, this was just his opinion. The likelihood of that ghostly woman accepting his rationale was almost zero.
Still, if there was a chance, he wanted to try to communicate and resolve the issue peacefully, avoiding conflict.
Unfortunately…
Before Colin could finish speaking, a sharp, ringing shriek like tinnitus burst in his ear.
A swelling and stabbing pain attacked his mind…
‘It seems negotiations have failed. But, is this some kind of psychic attack?’
Colin’s head throbbed, and he was beset by ringing ears, but he didn’t think it was a big problem.
Although the attack wasn’t weak…
But comparatively, when facing directly against a Level 0 Containment Object or an Ancient God, this was too feeble.
With his mental resistance, he barely considered this attack anything of note.
Meanwhile, as the “Spectral Witch” saw her attack had no significant effect, her figure disappeared into the air. The surroundings suddenly became extremely dim, as if the shadow effect intensified countless times, joined by a shrill and bizarre laughter echoing throughout the carriage.
Countless eerie and dark chains studded with thorns emerged from the shadows.
In addition, black spikes shot from every corner…
Feeling the chilling atmosphere above, Colin knew that if even a single spike hit him, the outcome would not be good.
‘The change in the scene around me is quite rapid… This method feels a bit like the ‘Domain’ only used by Eighth Level official personnel…’
‘Compared to that, which only unleashed fifteen percent on the train, this is indeed much stronger. Even if a D Level Personnel came, they would probably struggle to handle these things. It’s no wonder she graduated from ‘Script Heaven’.’
Internally commenting, Colin gripped the long sword and slashed forcefully, emitting a sword-energy-like flame.
The surrounding gloom seemed to be torn open by a rift.
Colin was about to ignite the flames on his body, but a sense of danger flashed in his heart, causing him to turn and slash with his sword.
“Clang!”
The heavy sword cut into a pair of finely curved blades inlaid with obsidian.
“Interesting,” Colin remarked, glancing at the slender hands holding the short blades.
With his brute strength that could easily overturn a bus, he was unable to suppress these runaway props in terms of power, even for a moment.
And after a stalemate that lasted less than a second, countless chains and spikes attacked, while the “Spectral Witch” focused her eyes on Colin again, attempting a close-range and powerful psychic attack.
If this combination hit, even Colin would have to pay a price.
But before she could complete this series of techniques…
Colin puffed up his mouth and blew out a breath forcefully. That breath turned into a burst of flame that engulfed the “Spectral Witch.”
Amidst a scream, the “Spectral Witch” faded away once more, her figure vanishing.
“In my life, I’ve never been afraid of being backstabbed,” Colin muttered to himself, having done plenty of work to ensure he wouldn’t take a knife to the kidney.
And it was after forcing the “Spectral Witch” to retreat that Colin’s flames burst forth even more, tearing through the “Domain” that hadn’t fully formed via the “rift” he’d created.
“Now it’s my turn to create a domain…”
Colin let the flames spread, ready to draw out the hidden “Spectral Witch” and restrain her.
But at that moment, as the flames reached near the portly “corpse” of the former employee, the “Spectral Witch,” who had been hidden all along, reappeared and stood in front of the body, her dense black aura erupting to prevent any flames from touching the “corpse.”
“It seems I have no choice but to offend you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - 384 372 Red Moon Descends (6K mega
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 384: Chapter 372: “Red Moon” Descends! (6K, mega chapter, seeking monthly tickets!)_2 Chapter 384: Chapter 372: “Red Moon” Descends! (6K, mega chapter, seeking monthly tickets!)_2 Colin dragged his Han Sword forward, charging toward the enemy with a strike that met their hostile gaze.
Although he wasn’t particularly skilled at using any specific techniques…
It didn’t matter, force can work miracles.
Moreover, this “Spectral Witch” should have been better at stealth and assassination, but to protect her former master, she had no choice but to engage Colin head-on, which severely limited her.
In the midst of a continuous clanging noise that sounded like a blacksmith hammering iron hundreds of times, the “Spectral Witch” began to falter.
Her body made of dark mist thinned, becoming somewhat transparent…
Finally, seizing a flaw, Colin, clutching the great sword wrapped in flames, secretly executed a “Heavy Strike·Unparalleled”.
Before contact, the “Spectral Witch” seemed unaware that the strike, which appeared no different from a normal attack, but the moment she was hit, she realized something was wrong and tried to counter with more force.
Unfortunately, it was already too late…
The only way to escape harm was to become ethereal and momentarily evade reality.
But if she did so…
Her master behind her would be injured.
In an instant, the great sword enveloped in flames bisected the “Spectral Witch’s” slightly transparent body at the waist.
The flames that followed engulfed her completely.
Amidst a shrill scream, the “Spectral Witch” dissipated into a pool of dark mist and vanished.
Her weakened state seemed to trigger the remnants of a contract once again…
Then, with a clatter, an intricately jeweled short sword adorned with obsidian, resembling a piece of art, fell to the carriage floor.
However, unlike when he had first seen it, all the gems on the sword were shattered, and its splendor was no more.
“Phew…”
Colin let out a deep breath, not bothering to pick up the broken artifact but instead turning to the corpse in the train carriage that should have died long ago. He outstretched his hand towards it, and a fire blazed from the flesh.
The corpulent “corpse” struggled desperately, letting out agonized howls, but to no avail.
In a few seconds, the noise died down.
Just then, the sword lying to the side let out a piercing female wail.
From the obsidian in the sword, a slender pale hand emerged, grasping at the ground, dragging itself into the flames, letting the fire consume her, until, beside the corpulent “corpse,” the missing half of her body reformed.
She took the twisted, disfigured head into her embrace.
Seeing this, Colin fell silent, then took out a small bottle of “Flame Bearer” grease and poured it over the flames—
His fire was certainly capable of burning the body.
But with an artifact involved as well, it was not quite enough.
Watching the two figures in the flames, Colin couldn’t help thinking that if the former employee could make a final farewell with the uncontrollable artifact that was protecting him, it might make up for a lot of regrets…
Regrettably, that touching scene never happened.
After ten minutes, with the flames intensified, the artifact and its former owner were both reduced to ashes.
Among the heaps of ash, all that remained was a single irregular, pitch-black gemstone.
But before Colin could pick it up, an invisible vortex appeared, sucking the item into it.
“Ah, come on… It’s a dirty job but it’s mine, shouldn’t I be the one to receive the remains?”
Colin blinked.
However, just as he was pondering this, the task in his mind updated to show completion after the gemstone was reclaimed.
Immediately following was a new task appearing before his eyes…
This time it wasn’t a minor task, but an independent task entry.
[Event: “Completion of legacy artifact retrieval for Level C Employee” has been added to the “Task Panel”.]
“Such a straightforward task title, it’s definitely from Lady Bunny, but in the end, I still have to deal with that Level C Employee,” Colin mused, not surprised, yet curious about who exactly the Dissuasion Bro on the train was.
While reflecting, he opened the detailed page of the task.
[“Completion of legacy artifact retrieval for Level C Employee”]
“Description”: In this shattered world that has been destroyed, the company now has a confirmed way to determine the precise locations of all deceased individuals. However, using this method will trigger a series of unknown consequences.
“Requirement”: Please be prepared, and before the task officially begins, stay by the Bonfire, waiting for the task to commence. Enter the “Inner World” of that area swiftly to complete the inheritance and retrieval of the legacy artifact from the former company’s Level C Employee.
“Hint”: Time remaining “2 hours 59 minutes 57 seconds”.
“Note”: The retrieval of this artifact will have a significant impact on the current situation. It has been determined that upon the start of the task, followers of the “Red Moon”, entities of a “Primitive Demon’s” partial will, demon minions, “Bonfire Hunters”, and other enemies will appear with a 100 percent probability…
Besides, followers of the “Exiled Demon”, “Child of Voice”, “Destined Ones”, “Kunshan Sanctuary”, “Apocalyptic Revelers”, and so on, will appear by a percent of…
Additionally 2, the “Eternal Life” Institute, “Mirror World”…
…
Additionally 9…
“Hiss…”
The first half of the task was somewhat normal, but the latter half’s notes made Colin’s scalp tingle.
What the hell was this thing he was supposed to collect?
Why were so many complications suddenly cropping up?
And what were all these…
“Damn it, how are we supposed to complete this task with just our small team, and a few extras in tow? Even releasing ‘0-09’ ‘Hunger’ seems a tad insufficient…”

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - 385 372 Red Moon Descends (6K mega
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 385: Chapter 372: “Red Moon” Descends! (6K, mega chapter, seeking monthly tickets!)_3 Chapter 385: Chapter 372: “Red Moon” Descends! (6K, mega chapter, seeking monthly tickets!)_3 Colin’s expression and gaze turned towards the first line; he was unfamiliar with the other organizations, but these “Red Moon” followers…
If they could summon some of the “Red Moon’s” power, they might be able to stand against “Hunger.”
Plus a whole bunch of other messy stuff…
It was simply impossible to fight!!!
However, at this time, Colin noticed, after the mention of “Additionally 6,” that their reasons for coming were not uniform: some were there to prevent the company from retrieving items, while others were interested in something else, such as the source of this “Ghost Train” disaster…
There might even be enemies of enemies amongst them, yet not actually allies.
Finally, some might just be there to watch the drama unfold but wouldn’t mind taking advantage if the opportunity arose.
“Why does this feel like a grand free-for-all with piled up chaos and people seeking fun?”
Looking at these notes, Colin only felt a headache coming on.
At this moment, he suddenly realized that when those few train carriages were attacked initially, it probably wasn’t just bad luck—it was highly likely related to the items they were now tasked to retrieve.
Taking a deep breath, Colin glanced at the time and then quickly returned to where the Bonfire was located.
Upon arrival, he saw “Son of Sadomasochism” and others with extremely grim expressions.
Even without speaking, Colin felt he could read from their faces, “We’re just E level, for God’s sake, how did we end up with such a task?”
“Brother Shunzi, is there any assurance with this task?” “Son of Sadomasochism” quickly asked.
The task’s “Additionally 7” mentioned that assistance would be provided if possible, but it did not specify the kind of help.
The only thing they could rely on now was Brother Shunzi.
“We’ll do our best.”
Colin shook his head, indicating he also wasn’t sure, which made everyone’s faces turn even grimmer.
The task clearly stated they wouldn’t die, but it didn’t say whether they would be left to live as though they wished they were dead.
“Let’s not get bogged down in this. Since the task was issued, there must be a chance to complete it, it’s just slightly more difficult than usual.”
Having done plenty of thankless tasks in the past, Colin was quite unperturbed; he knew that Lady Bunny wouldn’t issue an impossible mission.
Then, Colin asked, “Do you have any knowledge about the organizations mentioned in the task?”
Among these, he seemed to have had direct encounters only with the “Red Moon” followers and demons…
Others, he had heard of, like the “Destined Ones,” which apparently were one of the official nemesis of the company, always coveting the Book of Fate. As for the rest, some he hadn’t even heard of.
Upon hearing Colin’s query, the group took another careful look at the “Additionals.”
“I’ve encountered the followers of the ‘Child of Voice’; they seem to be able to manipulate sound waves and control vibration attacks, so when these people show up, be careful of the sounds around you, because the words you speak might be altered. Once, following mission orders, we kicked over their ‘Holy Grail’ or whatever it was, disrupting their ritual…”
“I’ve come across a ‘demon’ on a mission abroad before; it seemed deranged but physically very strong. However, later on, as per company orders, we burnt it to a crisp and handed it over…”
“As for the ‘Apocalyptic Reveler’, I’ve heard that other employees burnt down their lair…”
“…”
Gathered around the bonfire, they discussed the intelligence each of them knew, and while they were doing that, they all started to feel something was off—
How come it seemed like each one had been persecuted or indirectly affected by the Bonfire Company?
“Are there any that might be allies in all this?”
Colin rubbed his chin, suddenly posing the question.
“There could be possibly…” “Emperor Sun” said:
“The people from ‘Kunshan Sanctuary’ seem to be able to manipulate exotic beasts. Our last encounter with them seemed friendly; could they be allies this time too?”
“Ah? They’re allies? Then why did we have a mission at F level to blow up all their eggs underneath some factory…” Emperor Sun was quite surprised.
Upon his remarks, everyone fell silent for a moment.
“Sigh, forget it, we’re not sure; we’ll see when the time comes…”
Colin massaged his forehead; after some more talking, they decided not to dwell on the topic.
After sharing all their intelligence, they still recognized fewer than half of the names in the task, and a considerable portion remained unknown to them…
There were simply too many entities that the company had antagonized.
Colin suspected that there was a good chance that individuals not on the list might appear.
The company might not even know how many entities they had actually offended.
“What exactly is this Level C Employee carrying that just the retrieval attracts so many people? Brother Shunzi, what exactly happened on that solo mission you recently undertook?” the “Fool’s Mushroom” in the squad asked, puzzled.
As soon as this was mentioned, everyone turned to look at Colin, hoping to obtain some information from him.
Unfortunately…
“I don’t know either; that mission was not particularly unusual…”
Colin didn’t conceal the truth, recounting his recent experience with the “Spectral Witch” and her former owner, evoking envy and astonishment from the others that such a thing could still involve true love…
After finishing that story, he circled back to the topic:
“However, I suspect that even the retrieval of a lost Golden Artifact wouldn’t cause such a huge fuss, so the value of the item that person is holding might be even higher than a Golden Artifact…”
As he spoke, Colin grew more puzzled; if the value was that high, why hadn’t the company recovered it during their heyday?

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - 386 372 Red Moon Descends (6K mega
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 386: Chapter 372: “Red Moon” Descends! (6K, mega chapter, seeking monthly tickets!)_4 Chapter 386: Chapter 372: “Red Moon” Descends! (6K, mega chapter, seeking monthly tickets!)_4 Instead of remembering this when there wasn’t even a handful of Little Cats left, it had to be dragged out until now…
“Higher than the Golden Artifact…” each of the few murmured to themselves.
Then, “Little Chicken No. 7” let out a long sigh, “Sigh, this damn thing, feels hardly any better than dealing with an Out-of-Control Copy.”
“Hehe, looks like this time, we’ve got a not-so-small chance of becoming ‘former employees,’ or maybe even copies for the E level Personnel to farm…” “Fool’s Mushroom” laughed self-mockingly.
However, even though they felt an immense pressure, they hadn’t completely given up hope.
After all, according to Brother Shunzi, this task was not impossible to complete; it was just a tad bit difficult.
Of course, essentially speaking, this task existed because of Brother Shunzi in the first place…
But every Employee present had been salvaged by the company in their most desperate moment and had experienced plenty of incidents. They knew now was not the time to play the blame game, and as long as there was a glimmer of hope for victory, they couldn’t just give up.
As the exchange of intelligence deepened, time ticked away…
When the third hour arrived, Colin and the others noticed that a piece of paper had suddenly appeared next to the bonfire.
At the same time, an inspiration struck their minds:
“Throwing the paper directly into the bonfire to ignite it signifies the official start of the mission. If not thrown in, the mission will still officially begin after ten minutes, but somewhat more passively.”
“I’ll do it,” Colin said.
After speaking, Colin stepped forward, picked up the piece of paper from the ground, and threw it into the bonfire.
Whoosh.
The bonfire instantly set the paper ablaze.
Then, as if blessed with some power, the flame violently engulfed the paper and rapidly expanded at that moment, bursting into a conflagration that soared a thousand meters high, enveloping everyone present while continuously spewing flames into the sky.
The colorful auroras spinning in the sky gradually dissolved under the reflection of the flames.
Revealing a rift…
The surrounding landscape, at this moment, became even more distorted.
Everything presented itself in a vortex-like pattern…
There were numerous, differently-sized, twisty, colorful mineral crystals all around.
At this moment…
Colin and the others knew they had entered a deeper layer of the “Inner World.”
And at the same time, a complete map appeared in the minds of him and the other Employees present.
On this map, there were a dozen “X” markings, each containing one or more brighter red dots.
They were also located within one of those “X” markings.
“‘Markings’ are carriages, dots are employees. There are over thirty dots. It seems that not every Employee is in the ‘Inner World’; some are still on the surface…”
Colin almost immediately understood the meaning of these elements.
Then, almost subconsciously, he turned his attention to what should be a nine o’clock direction relative to himself, towards an “X” that was neither the farthest nor the closest.
There was a bright point larger than the “X” itself.
The task’s guidance simultaneously informed him…
That was the location where the Level C Employee had been.
“Let’s start—no, this is bad!”
As Colin spoke and was about to move, he suddenly felt a vibration in the strange, whirling world around him, followed by an extremely majestic and powerful surge descending from somewhere in the dome.
This aura was so terrifying that just sensing it made them feel their hearts palpitate.
“Crack…”
Within a sort of faint noise,
An image emerged in Colin’s mind: Above in the sky, part of the “vortex” bizarrely animated, then grew two hands and tore open a gash, revealing the profound darkness of outer space…
And within that profound darkness, a blood-red light appeared, and a fearsome entity nearly as vast as a celestial body was arriving.
Throughout its approach, many meteors or whatever was near it came to life…
Then, emitting strange praises, they followed and advanced together.
“What the hell, what the hell, what the hell, wasn’t it supposed to be the Followers of the Red Moon? Why is it the Red Moon itself?”
“Damn, it’s happening again? Damn, it’s happening again, damn me!!!”
In Colin’s head, two different voices of terror erupted from each hemisphere of his brain—
How on earth could we possibly defeat this thing if it’s coming in person?!
But, just as the blood-red light was about to shine through the gap, a vague mist emerged, blocking the bloody radiance, and at that moment, within the depths of the mist, a pale, monotonous sound of a train whistle blew from afar…
.
.
.
ps: Begging for a monthly pass at the end of the month, with all due confidence!
Update first, cover later

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - 387 373 Extremely Chaotic Battlefield_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 387: Chapter 373: Extremely Chaotic Battlefield_1 Chapter 387: Chapter 373: Extremely Chaotic Battlefield_1 “Is this ‘Lady Rabbit’s’ or the company’s assistance?”
Colin’s eyes lit up, his heart skipped a beat, and the chaotic sense in his mind quiets to dead silence amidst the sound of a flute.
The seemingly endless number of carriages of the train, with no end in sight, had appeared as usual, a significant portion already present by the time he became aware of its appearance.
And unlike before, this time it seemed from each carriage of the train radiated considerable dreadful life force.
However, more than the entities within the train, what made Colin feel truly unsettled was…
At the top of the train carriages, it seemed that with some special method, a bright “sun” had been dragged into the scene.
In the terrifying power bursting from this “sun,” a weirdly eerie blood-red light rapidly evaporated, vanishing into the misty fog…
The two previously activated vortexes also burned up in the fierce light.
“Is this… the power of Bonfire?”
Colin wasn’t sure, he subconsciously delved into the scene in his mind for a closer inspection.
Then…
He vaguely seemed to see within the “sun” what appeared to be a bone, a human skull…
But he wasn’t certain.
However, before he could contemplate further, something seemed to follow from behind the crack in the sky. It did not possess a form observable by the naked eye but existed as a vibration-like immaterial form…
It seemed to want to sneak in while the company was colliding with the blood-red hue.
But before it could succeed, several carriages of the endless train suddenly flung open, and many bizarre, seemingly non-human but perhaps employee-like figures appeared, who moved together to block its entry.
The lifeform existing in the form of vibrations and waves seemed not so resolute about entering this world.
Facing opposition, it immediately engaged in combat…
Not only that, more entities were trying to enter this place.
The chaotic battle exploded at this moment…
Above the entire dome, the scene was now in complete disorder.
The uncontrollable inspirations made Colin realize many things.
For instance, he knew that the battle beyond the crack was not close but rather separated by multiple astronomical scales. Yet, for these entities, a certain distance seemed ignorable…
Also, those beings could instantly find this place because it was not under some kind of protection. So, the acts of Bonfire were like lighting a candle in a pitch-dark room…
Or perhaps the true names of some higher beings were being faintly deciphered…
…
“No, stop deciphering! I don’t want to know! Stop it…”
More and more inspiration burst forth, and more knowledge exploded in his mind like fireworks.
Colin’s brain felt like it was about to burst.
It wasn’t that he wanted to know these things now, but for some uncontrollable reason, deciphering continued non-stop.
However, just at this moment, from a window of one of the train carriages, someone suddenly extended a hand that didn’t seem male and gently waved at the crack above the space.
Following that, the fissure torn by “Red Moon” was erased and disappeared.
The immense pressure suddenly vanished…
“Phew…”
Colin rubbed his forehead; he was drenched in sweat from the intense short-lived ordeal.
He shook his head vigorously and reached out toward the door with the “wills” within his body, summoning the Bonfire.
Torrents of flame came at his beckoning, fortifying his being…
At once, all the “wills” melted away and disappeared under the might of the flames.
After briefly recovering and extinguishing the remaining “stray thoughts,” Colin looked at the others—
The four of them had already fallen to the ground. Their eyes moved uncontrollably within their sockets, and their mouths emitted strange, muddled sounds.
“It seems they are affected too, but the problem doesn’t seem too severe. They have taken in less ‘Red Moon’ light than I have…”
While Colin distributed some of the fire to cover them and aid their recovery, he sensed the direction in his mind and silently calculated. At his speed, he estimated he could arrive in about an hour.
With that thought, Colin took out a bundle of nylon rope and with the assistance of Little Maid, quickly tied up the others before preparing to move out.
Yet at this moment…
A strong sense of crisis suddenly struck him.
He instinctively looked up and saw that without knowing when, a strange activation reaction had occurred in the train carriage. The steel carriage ceiling writhed like flesh, sprouting a multitude of grotesque fleshy growths.
Amidst the dense fleshy growths, numerous flesh tendrils grew out…
Then, the entire dome ceiling suddenly split open like a gaping maw, lunging at the people hiding in the carriages.
And beneath them, many flesh-and-metal blended growths shot out steel wires that entangled their legs.
“Hmph.”
Colin’s eyes narrowed slightly, calm and collected, as his left hand clutched a Golden Card and infused it with spiritual energy.
In an instant, a Repulsion force erupted violently.
The entire activated carriage exploded into countless fragments under this force, scattering everywhere.
He did not delay further; gripping “Son of Cruelty” and the others who were still recovering as if they were little chicks, he swiftly carried them toward the target direction…
However, he hadn’t run far when he felt a sudden jolt in his heart, and then he saw…
In the sky of this world that teemed with vortex luminescence, a red object like a giant jellyfish emerged, and from this jellyfish, many strands fell down, resembling tendrils or more like umbilical cords between infants and mothers.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - 388 373 Extremely Chaotic Battlefield_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 388: Chapter 373: Extremely Chaotic Battlefield_2 Chapter 388: Chapter 373: Extremely Chaotic Battlefield_2 And then, from the umbilical end, a large amount of blood sprayed out…
The blood dispersed in midair like rain, and when it finally fell onto the ground, the blood writhed and formed a figure that emitted a faint red glow.
“Followers of the ‘Red Moon’? Always showing up no matter the occasion, and what an entrance…”
Colin quickly recognized that some of the figures landing in front of him were those troublemaking cultists.
He paused momentarily and then suddenly sped up, taking advantage of the figures not yet fully formed, his flames erupted, incinerating all the cultists he encountered on his path…
Although Colin wasn’t sure if there were any allies among those returning.
But these guys…
It was certain that he should kill every single one he met.
However, the number of “Red Moon” followers dropping from the sky was too many, and Colin couldn’t take care of them all at once, so he quickly saw some of the cultists whose forms had solidified, tearing open and sprouting blood-red appendages that lashed out at him…
Another large part, after taking shape, surged toward the area where the Level C personnel were situated, seemingly intent on reaching the belongings left by the Level C Employee before anyone else.
“Tsk, just these misfits think they can stop me? That’s underestimating me…”
Colin did not stop moving, in fact, he even accelerated, shrouded in flames and wielding Bone Spur, like a meteor trailing a long tail of flame, he vanquished the cultists blocking his way.
Some of the weaker “Red Moon” followers couldn’t even get close before being scorched by the flames…
For the stronger ones, it simply took a casual stab to dispatch them.
There were indeed formidable cultists, but it seemed that compared to Colin, they were more interested in the location of the deceased Level C Employee…
For nearly half an hour, Colin didn’t stop for a moment and had no idea how many “Red Moon” followers he had killed.
Initially, he had been considering to completely annihilate them, burning the red glow from their bodies with flames.
If he did not do so, the cultists would resurrect under the protection of the red glow after not too long…
But later, as he encountered too many of them, Colin couldn’t even bother with that anymore, and merely shook them off.
And in his hands, “Son of Sadomasochism” and others had been revived more than ten minutes before.
It’s just that, with their strength, they couldn’t keep up with Colin’s speed at all, so they had to continue being dragged like little chicks…
Though it might affect his speed, the impact wasn’t significant.
Colin took advantage of these few to trigger the “False Mighty One” effect, which compensated for their shortcomings.
“Hiss, Brother Shunzi is like he’s activated a hack, mowing through the minions like cutting grass.”
Seeing Colin holding the special nylon rope in one hand and a glowing Bone Spur in the other, mowing down any god or Buddha in his path, they couldn’t help but show astonishment on their faces.
Colin ignored their exclamations, and while on the move, besides the numerous “Red Moon” followers, he also saw many other forces…
However, the vast majority didn’t do much upon seeing him; at most, they tested him a little, then distanced themselves and ran wildly toward the site of the Level C Personnel incident in the distance.
The only ones who fought to the death were the “Red Moon” followers. Yet, Colin discovered that these guys seemed to not only target him.
Because on his way, he saw that, whether it was against him or other forces outside the “Red Moon,” they treated them equally, with part of them launching desperate assaults upon sighting them, almost as if they were the enemies of the entire world.
He’d seen demons teaming up with cultists in starry sky robes, groups riding strange beasts accompanied by clusters of eyeballs, and all sorts of teams…
But only the “Red Moon” followers did not team up with anyone.
“Indeed, the ‘Red Moon’ and its followers are as the ‘Narrator’ in ‘Passionate Paradise’ said, enemies to all, at the very bottom of the scorn chain…”
Colin muttered to himself, remembering that the reason for this situation seemed to be related to the “Red Moon.”
The ultimate goal of this entity apparently was to reclaim the biomass of all living forms…
So, everyone would kick them given the chance.
Of course, Colin also noticed that it seemed nobody was willing to team up with them…
Another tens of minutes passed, and as Colin exploded a demon parasitized by a “Red Moon” follower with a punch, he slightly lifted his head to gaze into the distance.
He saw that within the target area, there was a mountain peak emitting strange colors and a metallic texture, with many whirlpools of varying sizes standing in the distance…
The odd colors radiating from the mountain peak were somewhat dizzying to behold.
“The Level C Employee should be up there…”
Colin murmured to himself, then sniffed the air and turned his gaze towards the foot of the mountain— at this moment, that area could be described as utterly chaotic.
First coming into view were densely packed figures emitting red light, crowding every corner of his vision— these identically red figures were all “Red Moon” followers, their numbers definitely exceeding six figures.
And from all sides, more of them continued to pour in.
If it hadn’t been for the giant jellyfish Colin saw getting blown apart by some higher entity, who managed to free up some time amidst extremely high-level combats, perhaps there would be an order of magnitude more “Red Moon” followers on the scene.
However, even so, their sheer numbers were more than enough to fill the entire area ahead…

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - 389 373 Extreme Chaos on the Battlefield_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 389: Chapter 373 Extreme Chaos on the Battlefield_3 Chapter 389: Chapter 373 Extreme Chaos on the Battlefield_3 In the sky, on the ground, underground, Colin could sense the presence of these guys almost everywhere.
Then, apart from them, there were various demons, strange creatures, all kinds of cultists, and so on…
At this moment, nearly all forces were charging at that peak emitting strange colors, and in this process, the chaotic battles never ceased, turning the entire battlefield into a gigantic flesh-grinding mill.
At every moment, no one knew how many lives would perish within it…
Even Colin, upon viewing this scene, felt somewhat horrified.
He had experienced large-scale battles before, but he had never seen a scene like this, where so many lives, without relying on tactics or strategies, were just brawling in close combat.
“These Followers of the ‘Red Moon,’ one by one, putting their faith in their particular resurrection, truly dare to fight…”
Colin saw that many Followers of the “Red Moon” were attacking all forces with a suicidal fervor, as if they were not afraid of dying at all.
They were not worried about their own deaths in the slightest…
The chaotic situation on the battlefield was mostly due to the Followers of the “Red Moon.”
“Hiss, Brother Shunzi, are we really going to charge down there?” The unshackled “Son of Sadomasochism” said, his eyes dulling.
The thought of charging in felt pointless, even if one could be resurrected…
“If we don’t charge, we’ll have no chance.”
Colin’s pupils transformed into vertical slits as he looked at the surging blood qi in front of him, taking a deep breath through his nose.
He faintly felt as if the vast space in front of him had an indescribable sense, as if it wanted to come alive…
Although the “Red Moon” had not arrived, the corruption had not stopped.
Besides that, Colin also noticed that, for some reason, all the people present, foes included,
harbored no “divine” power on them…
No, to be more precise, even if some people bore “divine” power, they had not attempted to use it.
“Although I don’t know the reason, intuition tells me not to try sneaking in by lowering my presence; otherwise, great trouble will ensue. If we charge, we must do so in our strongest form…”
Immediately, without further hesitation, Colin took out a 5-liter jug of raw Grease and set it ablaze.
This time, he didn’t let the Flame burst out but compressed it as much as possible onto his body…
Using such a big quantity of flame, Colin felt a burning pain in his body, which he had not experienced for a long time. Taking a deep breath, he continued to stack “Potential Burst,” took a “Colorless Crystal,” and had both “Yukionna” and the Little Maid possess him…
“You guys, try to keep up…”
After struggling to say that, Colin plunged into the bloody grinding mill like a meteor, heading toward his target.
The moment they entered the battlefield, he and those behind him felt as if they had sunk deep into a quagmire.
With the stench of blood approaching,
the entire spatial area became abnormally viscous, suffocating their lungs.
However, with Colin leading the way, the “Son of Sadomasochism” and the others could barely keep up.
One after another, Followers of the “Red Moon” of varying sizes were forcefully slain…
Colin tore a bloody path from the very edge of the battlefield through sheer force.
The huge commotion this caused also drew the attention of many others.
“Dammit, it’s those damned evildoers! Are these lunatics following the ‘Red Moon’ not fed? They’re eager to block us, but when it comes to blocking key personnel, they can’t stop anyone. If he succeeds, we’re finished,” a Starry Sky Robe Cultist roared in anger.
“We can’t let them succeed! We’ll intercept him! You must destroy that thing, or our millennia of planning might be wasted…” a Wise Demon also gave orders.
Even amid the chaos, many groups spared forces to intercept Colin, to prevent him from successfully completing his mission.
However, not everyone harbored hostility against the company.
And in the shadows beyond…
Many more figures entered the fray, rolling into the battlefield through these shadows.
“Let it be chaos! Rise in chaos! Let chaos reign!”
In the darkness, a multitude of unseen “The Rat” voices, only heard but unseen, yelled in unison…
…
Meanwhile, in front of Colin, a demon creature gushing lava arrived, initially looking ordinary, but as it drew closer, a burst of divine power within it exploded, transforming it into a powerful entity over ten meters tall.
“Although I will die after this strike, neither will you live! Die, you devil!”
In a voice filled with profound anger, the Demon swung its sword, and after locking onto Colin, it fiercely slashed down.
The earth started trembling and cracking even before the sword struck.
“Bring it on!”
With an arrogant look, chin raised slightly, Colin stood firm, pulling out an equilateral Shield Emblem and aiming it towards—
a Pawn not far from his side.
“Here, I initiate a duel of fairness and justice!”
In the bewildered gaze of the Demon, Colin and a lowly Pawn vanished from their original spot…
Its all-out attack, though rending a kilometer-long, massive chasm in the ground and killing countless Pawns,
was ultimately in vain…
“You damn cunning devil—”
As the Demon roared in fury, a specially made bullet, a Sound Blast, and a multitude of indescribable attacks, bypassing several layers of worlds, ignoring Spatial distances, directly targeted the divinely erupting creature.
The next second, its magnificent body shattered on the spot like porcelain.

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - 390 374 Resist the Bonfire Coalition Front
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 390: Chapter 374: Resist the “Bonfire” Coalition Front! (5K)_1 Chapter 390: Chapter 374: Resist the “Bonfire” Coalition Front! (5K)_1 “Holy Fair Coliseum”…
An absolutely fair and just battle was underway.
Before the fight came to a halt, all external factors were prohibited from interfering with the progress of this righteous duel.
Upon entering, all chaos and bloodshed seemed to fade away instantly, making Colin feel as though he had suddenly become deaf and unable to smell, disorienting him for a moment.
However, he quickly adapted to it.
“…That demon, it seems to have died?”
Colin had a hunch, but wasn’t entirely sure, because after being pulled into the coliseum, he could no longer sense the situation outside and had no idea what had specifically transpired there.
Even the effects of his “False Mighty One” status were so weakened that he could barely perceive them.
But one thing he knew for sure was that the blow that seemed to tear the earth had just come slashing down…
If he were to block it, he would have to pay a significant price.
After all, according to the demon, that strike was a fatal blow that required the sacrifice of life.
“Is it really necessary? Why should I be attacked and killed because of the troubles caused by the company before, when I’m just a minor employee…”
Colin complained inwardly, then gathered his thoughts and looked across to the other side of the battlefield.
There stood a short-statured female demon with wings, scantily clad, displaying a certain exotic charm of different races, looking confusedly around her.
She was just a little succubus who followed her lord, chanting “666” to buff him, so how had she suddenly become the protagonist?
Colin quickly assessed the aura around her and realized…
This was going to be a tough battle against a higher-level adversary.
“Very well, since you have responded to my duel request, I have no choice but to go all out,”
Colin muttered, beginning to announce the rules of combat, earnestly neutralizing his advantages.
Although, many times, some so-called “powerhouses” disdain to battle against foes with vastly inferior strength.
But to Colin, this was simply a manifestation of weakness.
True powerhouses dare to confront the enemies that they disdain inwardly!
They dare to attempt and courageously fight above their level!
Shortly, after establishing three rules and without waiting for the enemy to try to surrender, Colin’s figure flashed, appearing before the still confused little succubus.
Then, he brought down a heavy slap on her.
The petite figure, not even having the time to scream, had her head smashed into her majestic chest…
Followed promptly by a surge of flames.
The duration of the battle after it had started didn’t even last a second before it abruptly ended.
When the “Arena of Honor” effect wore off…
the stench of blood and overwhelming chaos returned once again.
At that moment, Colin immediately saw a terrifyingly long fissure in the earth stretching over a thousand meters.
Numerous “Red Moon” followers, as well as enemies from some other forces, had unfortunately died in the chasm…
And the demon had mysteriously turned into a pile of crushed flesh on the ground, its divinity extinguished.
The remnants of some power, even just perceived by Colin, caused his heart to palpitate; these were the traces of a high ranking being taking action, and it seemed that there was more than one involved…
Some “Red Moon” cultists tried to defile the remains, integrating it into their flesh to become part of themselves, and with such a high-level corpse, they would undoubtedly strengthen themselves significantly.
However, the entities that had acted seemed to have anticipated this situation.
All the pieces of flesh carried a “poison”; those “Red Moon” followers who dared to do this died instantly…
Their blessings of red light disappeared along with their ability to continue resurrecting.
“Indeed, it must have been divine power that caused this!”
Colin felt a shudder within, and although he didn’t know the specifics, he could guess what had led to this outcome.
‘To think that the being, not any weaker than the demon summoned by “World Code-4”, just burst into death after using a bit of divine power, the cost was even higher than I thought.’
His thoughts raced, but before he could ponder further…
No sooner had he re-emerged for a second than some enemies lying in wait launched an attack upon his appearance.
But this time, seemingly wary of the crafty and cunning member of Bonfire Camp using another special method to evade a killing blow, they didn’t reveal their strongest attack…
As a result, although his advancement was challenging, Colin could still make headway.
The columns of fire spewing from his body, like tongues of flame, furiously swept all around, continuing to tear open the path to the bizarre vortex of the mountains…
At this point, he was at most a few kilometers away from that mountain.
In times past, with no one around, it would have taken him less than a minute to cover this distance…
But now, on this crowded battlefield, advancing three hundred meters in a minute was considered rather impressive.
The enemies were just too numerous.
“According to the current situation, it seems that some high-ranking cultists have made it up there, but my mission hasn’t shown failure yet…”
“Could there be another crisis up there? Oh, I forgot, the source of the ‘Ghost Train’ tragedy also seems to be in that direction, and that thing isn’t so easy to provoke either…”
“However, I need to hasten my pace. It won’t do if someone manages to reach the summit before me…”
Upon this thought, Colin consumed two “Colorless Crystals,” replenishing his status.
Then, surveying the noisy and chaotic environment in front of him, and looking at the massive variety of creatures, he couldn’t help thinking that if he released “Hunger” now, it seemed like he could directly frenzy…

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - 391 374 Resist the Bonfire Unified Front
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 391: Chapter 374: Resist the “Bonfire” Unified Front! (5K)_2 Chapter 391: Chapter 374: Resist the “Bonfire” Unified Front! (5K)_2 It’s just a pity that it can’t be released.
Not to mention the issue of losing control, Colin remembered there were divine beings after the “Hunger” outbreak.
He guessed that as soon as it was released, before even getting a few bites in, it would be instantaneously killed by some mysterious force…
“Boom!”
A high-pressure fireball erupted forward, repelling several blocking enemies.
Colin’s figure advanced once again.
However, at that moment, he suddenly remembered he had apparently left behind a few teammates, the “Son of Sadomasochism” ones…
Relying on the sensations from the “False Powerhouse,” he could vaguely feel that, apart from “Little Chicken No. 7” and “Fool’s Mushroom,” he didn’t know where the other two were…
The only thing Colin could be sure of was that they weren’t dead, but he also had no idea where they were.
And just as he thought of this, Colin sensed the presence of these two from different directions suddenly appear.
“Is this a random location ‘resurrection’? The company actually kept its word this time, they really did resurrect…”
Colin had an epiphany and roughly judged the situation.
Of course, what he didn’t know was that during the recent charge into the thick of the enemy, “Emperor Sun” and “Son of Sadomasochism” had followed him most closely, both thinking that being nearest to him would certainly be the safest.
Unexpectedly, a Great Demon suddenly appeared and swung a lethal slash…
Then, as that slash fell, Colin vanished from sight.
Not to mention that the Demon was dumbfounded, the two employees who planned to cling closely to him were equally stunned.
Just like many others, they almost effortlessly became part of the horde slain…
But fortunately, the company kept its promise and resurrected them.
“The distance is a bit far, several hundred meters, and it’s not really realistic to go over and bring them back now. Even if we brought them along, they would most likely die anyway; it’s better to let them strive on their own, they might have a chance to blend in…”
As his thoughts churned, Colin decided to fully trust in the wisdom of his employees, not to intervene too much.
After all, the ones who previously couldn’t keep up, “Fool’s Mushroom” and “Little Chicken No. 7,” were somehow still alive.
However, just as he thought this, Colin suddenly noticed that the presence of “Fool’s Mushroom” had disappeared…
Not dead, but probably on a countdown to death.
“Uh…”
Colin paused mid-step, raised his hand, and with a Bone Spur, drove back an enemy riding a fierce beast, then steadied his mind and focused on moving forward…
The only thing he could pray for regarding the other employees was that death was not limited by the number of times…
Of course, while he knew resurrection was possible, Colin, for his part, certainly wasn’t planning to try it.
Who knows what price one might have to pay after dying…
However, as Colin got closer to the mountain peak, he encountered more and more obstructions and the intensity of the attacks increased.
In just a short distance of a few hundred meters, Colin spent nearly ten minutes, grappling with various bizarre forms of life, enduring countless types of attacks that left him looking very ragged, covered in wounds all over his body.
“Damn it, what the hell snuck up and cut off my ear; you’d better not let me catch you!”
Colin cursed under his breath, then had the Little Maid quickly help him to stop the bleeding.
As the battle reached this phase…
Many enemies and indescribable anomalies discovered that deadly, one-hit kills were difficult to achieve; they often went all-out only to find Colin unscathed and themselves vanishing from existence.
Thus, amidst the chaos, some enemies switched tactics, pursuing something new, aiming not to kill but to inflict minor wounds…
While this too would trigger Colin’s sense of danger, it didn’t do so frequently.
A little carelessness, and his body would gain a few more scars, or even lose a few parts…
Besides his ear, half of his foot was also lost to a stealth attack.
“You damned villain, die! I will use your head to honor the Spirit of Crystalline Ancestors that you have massacred!” a roar filled with fury and a massive energy charge came from the side.
‘Your ancestors aren’t killed by me, go find the company executives if you dare; they’re battling it out overhead, fly up and you’ll see them, why come after me for your problems…’
Colin caught a glimpse from the corner of his eye as a Silicon-based Species, whose main feature was their resemblance to an irregular Crystal Stone, attacked him…
These crystals contained a mysterious energy.
Hmm…
Seeing the energy within these crystals, Colin knew that the company was probably capable of such an act…
Of course, the purpose might not have been to slaughter their ancestors.
And before he could think further, another enemy rushed at him: “It’s all because of you, our ascension ritual was disrupted, die!”
At first, hearing such accusations, Colin might have felt a bit emotional at heart.
But after hearing them repeatedly, he just became numb…
At this very moment, Colin even strangely felt that the “Red Moon” followers weren’t so bad; if these guys hadn’t constantly attacked everyone, disrupting the battles, he might not have been able to advance much at all…
“Burn, just burn, when everything is burned there will be no voices of doubt left.”
Colin muttered to himself as he saw enemies from all sides launching a coordinated attack at that moment, so he employed some new techniques he had grasped during combat.
As his words fell, a surge of flame almost like liquid magma erupted violently.
The extremely high heat flames caused Colin to suffer some backlash…
But, as a result, it became quieter around him.
Taking this opportunity, Colin’s figure burst forward with increased speed, tearing a path with the Power of the Bonfire through the enemy crowd, reaching the base of the mountain peak.
But before he could celebrate, a voice came through.

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - 392 374
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 392: 374 Chapter 392: 374 “Watch your step!”
As this voice emerged, Colin felt a high-energy reaction forming beneath the ground…
Then, the ground suddenly bulged upward.
In the roaring explosion, everyone held their breath, hoping to see Colin’s body blasted into pieces.
Unfortunately, a staggering figure burst through the sky full of gunpowder smoke…
Although he looked utterly disheveled, regrettably, he didn’t seem to suffer much damage.
All factions present were vastly disappointed…
“Right behind us is the future of our people! Once he succeeds, and those guys are allowed to return, we will have nowhere to retreat! We will be captured into a dark cage once more, drained to death. All Crystal Cluster Race here, sacrifice with me!”
A wave of psychic energy spread, and dozens of huge silicon-based lifeforms with immense energy charged in.
“For the dawn of a better world, for the will of the Master to shine upon the land, stop them!” yet another unknown enemy cried out heroically.
“Say hello to the Great Sage and my wife for me. If I die, you must hold this position until we succeed in destroying that relic. Don’t let the Followers of the ‘Red Moon’ ascend, and don’t let the guys from the ‘Bonfire Camp’ break through…”
A cultist, wearing a robe studded with stars, left his last words and then resolutely turned around to impede Colin’s advance.
“Charge! All you sealed demons! Follow me and fight for freedom!”
“…”
“Damn it…”
Colin, his clothes stained red with blood, looked at the enemies coming from all directions and felt incredibly screwed up inside.
The battle, at this moment, escalated even further…
Even as formidable as Colin was, amidst such relentless attacks by numerous enemies, he still faced numerous close calls.
“┗|｀O′|┛ Aoo~~!”
The “Mountain of Smiling Corpses,” made of high-quality bodies, roared with two heads upon its entrance, shielding Colin from the front and blocking a bunch of attacks.
The next second, it exploded, turning back into a card in Colin’s “Storage Room.”
However, this brief defense gave Colin a moment to breathe, and he then broke out using “Force Repulsion…”
“Damn, is Brother Shunzi getting focus-fired that badly…”
At the back, “Little Chicken” and others from a few slow-moving teams “teaming up” to slip through the chaos saw the continuous explosions ahead and each felt a sense of trepidation.
At that moment, perhaps because the battlefield was too chaotic and Colin was too conspicuous, other enemies hadn’t noticed “Little Chicken” and the others.
So much so that they could even form teams with people from other factions.
After all, with so many people on the scene, with Colin taking the brunt of the attack, they just had to follow and curse phrases like “damn Bonfire Camp” and “damn ‘Flame Bearer'”… to keep moving forward.
It could be said that as long as everyone cursed at “Bonfire Company” and formed a united front against them, they might not be comrades, but they wouldn’t immediately become enemies either.
As for the vanguard, Brother Shunzi…
‘Brother Shunzi is so formidable; let’s just have him suffer a bit longer…’ several employees thought in unison.
Once they made their way up the hill and took advantage of everyone’s distraction, they’d clandestinely recover the items, and it’d be fine as long as the mission was complete.
With this thought, they continued to angrily denounce the various evil acts of “Bonfire Company” while secretly advancing toward their objective in the mountains.
“Ptui, damn it, don’t force me to unleash ‘Hunger’ and let us all die together! Anyway, I can revive!”
Spitting out a mouthful of black blood forcefully, Colin looked at the relentless enemies and grew grim inside.
At that moment, a dark shadow surged over and enveloped him…
Colin was about to take action, but he then heard a familiar voice.
“Don’t move, I’ll get you through this area…” From within the shadow, a female figure spoke.
It wasn’t a known language, but the company’s powerful passive translation let Colin understand the meaning.
‘Do I really have allies?’
Colin was astonished, watching the shadow move him swiftly, and felt an inexplicable touch of emotion.
Meanwhile, a roar came from outside:
“Damn it, there’s a traitor among us!”
In a company that has done so many inhumane acts, at last, something good happened. Otherwise, why would anyone be willing to help under these circumstances?
At this moment, this act of kindness, contrasted by countless enemies, seemed so dazzling and precious.
However, there was one thing Colin did not understand as he looked towards the person in the shadows; he could sense a strong enmity from this person towards him, so why would they still help him?
“Why are you helping me?”
“Although I despise you, it doesn’t mean we are willing to let the Bonfire die out, to let our world be completely devoid of its protective power, to allow foreign enemies to invade unimpeded, destroying the homeland of my children,” the person in the shadows quickly replied.
So, there are still some rational people in this world… Colin was moved:
“Rest assured, if there’s a chance later, I will compensate you with something as a reward…”
Fighting all on his own was just too difficult…
If the situation just now had continued for a while longer, even he would have struggled to hold on.
Now that he had finally found a teammate, he needed to seize the opportunity.
However, in response to his words, the person in the shadows suddenly showed a face full of disgust:
“Shut up! You almost killed my entire family. If not for my children and the will of the saint, I wouldn’t even want to lay eyes on you…”
‘Uh, seems like I was overthinking it, the company never engages in human affairs…’
Colin wiped the blood from his face, his expression awkward, unsure of how to respond, so he remained silent.
But before he could think any further, a sudden palpitation surged in his heart.
“Watch out!” Just as Colin was about to say this, the surrounding shadows were violently torn apart by a terrifying energy.
The woman in the shadows was forced to drop her status…
Then, Colin saw a hand as large as two or three stories reach for him, grabbing him in its grasp, looking as if it would crush him…
“Up you go!” After saying this, the woman braced herself for death.
However, at that moment, she saw Colin, who should have continued to scale the peak, appear beside her in a flash.
“Repulsion Burst!”
With a roar, everything within dozens of meters was pushed away by the terrifying force.
Bearing the pressure of the Repulsion on his internal organs, Colin dragged the woman by the neck, charging up the mountain.
But after only a few steps, another group of enemies attacked, blocking their path.
And behind them, more enemies rushed up…
“Huff… forcing my hand, huh?”
Colin’s resolve hardened, and without another word, his pupils shifted, preparing to call upon someone who was equally “infamous” in the past.
If they wouldn’t let him complete his mission, then they would all die together!
Before he could call out, Colin suddenly abandoned the idea of a mutual destruction.
Because he suddenly sensed a similar flicker of light atop the mountain peak…
It was in that moment, a certain final positioning was completed, and a special thing seemed to have connected with him.
And then, suddenly, a line of information popped up on his retina.
[Bonfire Pipeline Network Space has been connected. Would you like to issue a “Rally Command” at this location?]
“Yes!”
Colin spoke up immediately.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - 393 375 The Man on the Cliff Edge (6.2K large
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 393: Chapter 375: The Man on the Cliff Edge! (6.2K, large chapter!)_1 Chapter 393: Chapter 375: The Man on the Cliff Edge! (6.2K, large chapter!)_1 In reality, an alert surfaced above the field of vision for all company employees:
[“654321” has initiated a “Rally Command”, all marked personnel will enter the “Kuiper Belt-C Zone-2437 Relay Station-Lost Fragment World” through “…(E level confidentiality)” in three minutes.]
“Remark”: This mission is non-lethal, please prepare for intense combat.
“Note”: Specific mission details will be provided after the mission starts.
…
“Here it comes, that mission from a few hours ago…”
Within Base No. 5, amid a crowd of people, an employee who had joined the company through official channels exclaimed to those around him.
As he spoke, all of Bonfire’s “double-duty” members tensed up.
However, those prepared beforehand didn’t all speak up; instead, they let the E level leader among them speak on their behalf.
The waiting high-level personnel eagerly asked, “What’s the situation now?”
“We need to be ready for combat. In three minutes, we’re heading into that Kuiper something or other, C zone, 24-something… some Lost Fragment World,” said the “double-duty” representative.
“Did they clearly state whether or not we can die?” the high-level personnel asked urgently.
“Yes.”
Upon hearing this, the high-level employee breathed a sigh of relief, “Previously, the higher-ups indicated that we probably can’t avoid this, so don’t resist the task. Be careful and use what we provided earlier.”
As he spoke, he recalled that nearly five hours ago, all double-identity company personnel who were idle received a message.
The message roughly stated that for the next day, all company employees should prepare for battle.
Those who had completed missions would not be assigned new ones in the short term…
Then, possibly a few hours later, this group would be transported to a battlefield to assist the company with a certain task…
This almost alarmed the entire world.
Now, these “double-duty” agents, or rather, employees, were the prized possessions of all forces. Usually, they would be protected by a fleet if possible on their missions. Then suddenly, they received such a strange task. Many feared it was a trap set by enemies, aiming to catch them all at once.
After all, the mission looked obviously abnormal, and during this period, they were not completely unaware of the company’s circumstances.
It seemed highly likely that the damnable company was once again possibly invaded by something unknown…
They immediately discussed how to resist and not carry out the mission.
However, at this crucial moment, Old Master Wu, who was at the front line, appeared at the “Global Supernatural Alliance” conference and forcefully argued for everyone’s cooperation with the mission…
Given Old Master Wu’s prestige and his exclusive communication channel with the Bonfire Company’s higher-ups…
Eventually, the majority opted to follow the minority’s decision to execute the task without resistance.
Thereafter, all forces crammed their ace agents with various items, packing artifacts. Many heirloom treasures were brought out…
“By the way, Xiao Mei, this is a Life-saving Charm that I received when I was promoted to Level 7. Take good care of yourself when it’s crucial. Try to avoid any accidents if possible…”
A Level Seven Official whispered, pulling an employee aside from the crowd and slipped a powerful artifact into her hand.
Although the company’s mission claimed that death could be reversed, it was Bonfire Company after all—those in the know understood…
And such scenes weren’t only occurring at “Base No. 5”, but also at the other four numbered bases, and in significant locations around the world…
“This is our Federation’s Super Enhancer and Super Explosive…”
“Our family’s Holy Relic is now in your hands; you must come back alive…”
“This is a flag said to be from the Mythological Era, remember, do not get involved with excessively dangerous things…”
…
While all the forces were giving their instructions, inside the company’s group chat…
One message after another flashed by.
“Damn, a support mission? A large-scale compulsory one? We definitely don’t want this kind of thing!”
“It’s over, everyone is doomed, looks like nobody’s coming back…”
“Shit, would that I hadn’t rushed my last mission, now I’m in for it…”
“What do we do, where’s Brother Shunzi?! Brother Shunzi, come and save us…”
“The mission was initiated by Brother Shunzi…”
“What, ‘654321’? Did Brother Shunzi change his name or what?”
“What’s going on, can someone tell us? Why is there such a mission…”
“@Professor Cute Cuddle, I know what’s going on, but because of confidentiality rules, I can’t outright say it. Give me a location, and I’ll sneak over and tell you privately…”
“@Unnamed 114514, there’s still a chance to survive the mission, but if you come to me, it’s certain death…”
“What?! ‘654321’ is Brother Shunzi? Easy peasy! As long as Brother Shunzi is here, everything will be fine!”
“When everyone is panicking, only I will tell you, it’s all good! Everything’s under control!”
“Guys, the final three-second countdown, get ready to go!”
“Wait, I have to go on the mission too, take me with you!”
“The Unyielding” was so anxious that he started to mistype, but at this moment, the entire channel suddenly fell silent:
“Has everyone gone? I haven’t even started yet, I’m part of the company too, I’m also on stand-by, take me with you! I want to contribute to the company, wuu wuu wuu!”
…
A boundless flash of flame and smoke arrived!
All the employees assigned the mission disappeared upon seeing the flash, then felt themselves rapidly travelling through a corridor of flames…

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - 394 375 The Man on the Cliff Edge (6.2K large
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 394: Chapter 375: The Man on the Cliff Edge! (6.2K, large chapter!)_2 Chapter 394: Chapter 375: The Man on the Cliff Edge! (6.2K, large chapter!)_2 In this process, subtitles appeared.
[All personnel involved in this operation, please abide by the following guidelines:]
“1. Prohibited from using ‘Book of Fate: Fragment’ to predict this area…”
“2. Prohibited from using items with a ‘Divinity’ value exceeding a certain amount (which has been sealed)…”
“3. Prohibited from conducting in-depth observations of the sky…”
…
Meanwhile, amidst the extremely chaotic battlefield, Little Chicken and the others groped their way forward, occasionally looking up to see “Brother Shunzi” fighting in front of the mountain waist, each sighting making their hearts race and their flesh crawl.
The place now seemed like it was continuously being bombarded by missiles, the noise frighteningly loud…
Even giant mushroom clouds would rise from time to time.
The intense battle had not stopped since it started over ten minutes ago.
“You vile criminals! From the ‘lesser dimensions’ to the ‘backside of the Universe’ to the ‘Infinite Layered Starry Sky’, and even the physical Universe, your infamy is known by all! Just go to hell right here!”
The roar travelled a great distance, as another mushroom cloud rose.
Seeing this, “Little Chicken No. 7” and the others scattered around tensed up until they saw Brother Shunzi’s figure emerge from the smoke, allowing them all to breathe a sigh of relief again.
If it weren’t for Brother Shunzi drawing all the enemy’s attention, they definitely wouldn’t have been able to sneak through.
“Damn, worthy of being the company’s super rookie, he is really amazing, to be able to hold on for thirty minutes and still be full of vigor…”
“Little Chicken No. 7” couldn’t help but feel amazed internally; he had observed using some special means, and as of now, it seemed Brother Shunzi only had a few injuries, and had lost some minor parts that didn’t seem very significant.
But when he put himself in the same situation, if he were up there…
Damn, not to mention ten minutes, even enduring ten seconds would be difficult.
However, just then, “Little Chicken No. 7,” who was slightly distracted in thought, felt a sense of crisis rising within him…
A huge meatball shrouded in red light surged toward him!
‘Done for, I have to re-spawn so soon…’
“Little Chicken No. 7” thought quickly, knowing he couldn’t dodge in time.
But at the crucial moment, behind him, a “New Day” Cultist wearing tattered robes swung his scepter, causing a flame filled with corrupt power to shatter the meatball.
“Thank you…”
“Little Chicken No. 7” was momentarily stunned.
“It’s a small effort, nothing to worry about. Right now, we are all comrades on the same front, we should unite…” The Cultist waved his hand, indicating it was no big deal, then continued to kill the frenzied “Red Moon” followers jumping around.
Hearing this, “Little Chicken No. 7” suddenly felt that there was a human touch about these Cultists…
They all seemed quite decent, so how could they be labeled as Cultists?
Could there have been some kind of misunderstanding?
While pondering, “Little Chicken No. 7” couldn’t help but ask obliquely.
“Curse the ‘Bonfire Camp,’ the damned tyrant of the old order. The world is already so filthy, humanity doesn’t deserve protection. We just want to destroy the world, bring forth the ‘New Day’ to dominate and purify it, what’s wrong with that? If humans don’t feel the agony of destruction, how can they grow? Why stop us?!”
“When the day of ‘God Descent’ arrives, everyone will be reborn from death, become the children of the ‘New Day,’ receive His protection, rather than being part of the ‘Red Moon,’ becoming its meaningless cells and nutrients…”
“But this beautiful future was ruined by those people from ‘Bonfire Camp,’ and even exiled us and the ‘New Day’ out of The Galaxy…”
Upon hearing Little Chicken’s words, the “New Day” Cultist’s mind was filled with resentment and his brain waves surged.
‘Uh, you guys might as well die…’
Little Chicken suddenly felt that his earlier thoughts were naive; empathizing with a Cultist was indeed a bad idea.
And at that moment, a “New Day” Cultist pointed at Little Chicken:
“You, you’re pretty good, I just saw that. Though you’re not strong enough, you had the courage to face the enemy with a sword against Bonfire. Our ‘New Day’ Church needs talents like you!”
Huh? When did I do something like that? Little Chicken was puzzled, but quickly realized.
This group had mistaken his previous desperate chasing of Brother Shunzi’s silhouette as “drawing a sword.”
“Right, since you’re here, you must be from some force. I haven’t figured out which one yet. What’s your background?”
Hearing this, “Little Chicken,” who was experienced in such matters, fluently replied, “Our family because of persecution by ‘Bonfire Camp’…”
But he had only spoken halfway when he suddenly felt something was wrong…
It was as if something had targeted him.
Immediately after, a column of fire connecting heaven and earth erupted from above his head, engulfing him.
Seeing this scene, the Cultists present were stunned.
But quickly, a “New Day” Cultist reacted, shouting:
“That guy is from Bonfire Company! Damn it! We have a mole among us!”
“Quick, kill him! This is a teleport! Something is using our coordinates to teleport here!”
“Kill them!”
At the same time, “Little Chicken No. 7” found out that apart from himself, there were three other places on the scene where fiery pillars connected to the sky, with confused employees at the bottom and unknown connections above…
And what made them all go blank was that when the pillars of fire appeared, their entire bodies were pinned down by the force of the flames.

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - 395 375 The Man on the Cliff Edge (6.2K large
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 395: Chapter 375: The Man on the Cliff Edge! (6.2K, large chapter!)_3 Chapter 395: Chapter 375: The Man on the Cliff Edge! (6.2K, large chapter!)_3 He couldn’t move at all…
“Little Chicken” looked at the cultist who had just been trying to recruit him, but was now swinging a scepter at him with a face full of despair.
The thing could even smash those “Red Moon” followers, who were like small cargo trucks; if it hit his head, he would definitely be dead on the spot.
However, at this critical moment, an orange flash flickered.
A figure stood in front and with a flying kick, sent the smelter wielding the scepter flying.
“It seems my orange flash has arrived just in time!” the figure declared as he stood straight and looked around slowly.
The newcomer was handsome, except the name above his head kind of ruined the mood.
“○God? Activate!”
Little Chicken wasn’t entirely unfamiliar with this person, after all, they were on the same instance mission, always competing for the role of “daddy” in the internal group chat.
The two would often bicker over “daddy,” giving each other grief, and it wasn’t just once or twice.
He just hadn’t expected that the person now saving him would be this guy.
“Good brother, I’ll never call you an orphan again!” Little Chicken thought to himself.
At this moment, one figure after another quickly emerged from the four bonfires that connected heaven and earth and solidified into tangible forms, entering into this chaotic and terrifying battlefield…
The first batch of reinforcements had arrived!
“Holy shit, what the hell is going on here?” exclaimed an employee as he entered and saw the overwhelming swarm of enemies, feeling the repulsive stench of char and blood, nearly suffocating him.
“This world, indeed, has become more corrupt!” remarked another employee, who had activated a “calming” talent and crossed his arms, shaking but not forgetting to strike a pose.
Just then, more and more figures arrived, giving them some confidence…
Following various mission requests that appeared in their minds, all employees began to carry out their tasks and the battle commenced at this moment.
“Attack, outnumber them! They beat up our Brother Shunzi so badly, thinking we don’t have people? Brothers charge!”
Now a D Level, “Miss Nell’s Dog” shouted, his dagger plunging into a belly, and as he relished the thrill, shadows spread and exploded, and dozens of four-armed citizens emerged from the shadows.
The four-armed citizens’ sharp claws quickly cut many less powerful enemies into pieces.
“All D Level personnel, don’t linger in battle, don’t waste time bullying the weak, follow me and assist Brother Shunzi!” “Life Coach Kawaii-many” of the big company said in the group voice chat as he unfurled a landscape painting.
All incoming attacks, along with a small number of heretics, were sucked into the apparently only three-meter-wide painting…
“Cover me for a second, let me activate this ‘Holy Mech’…”
An employee named “Fish Pond Master” kept pulling out various items from the Storage Room, piling them together and then expertly knelt down with a “plop,” raising his hands high in praise.
“From the endless wars, God of Myriad Machines, grant me strength!”
“From the temptation of desire, God of Myriad Machines, protect my heart!”
“From the prison of flesh, the God of Myriad Machines….”
In the midst of these prayers, the mechs on the ground automatically connected, emitting pleased electronic sounds.
“Holy crap, as expected of a rich guy, he really gathered a whole set of purple gear?” a few old employees who knew exclaimed in surprise…
And at this time, another large group of people followed the bonfire channel and descended near the four teleport points where Little Chicken and others were.
“Please, ‘Nine Li Warlord,’ possess me!”
A “double-company” employee arrived at the chaotic scene and, without a word, used the charms given to him by an Eighth Level “Divine Strike” employee as he entered…
“True Ancestor’s Blood”…
“Oh great spirits, please gather under this banner…”
“Make way, everyone, let’s assemble this… -239, just say the word if it needs to be detonated…”
…
“Holy shit, are these the ‘Emperor of Labor’ guys? Damn, this is not fair! How come they have such strong items? Even Brother Shunzi hacking wouldn’t be like this, right?!”
Some regular company employees couldn’t help but cry out when they saw this.
No wonder this bunch can complete missions so quickly, with these items they will only get faster!
As a large number of employees joined the fray, the different races, heretics, anomalous beings, and so on, all immediately reacted!
“I recognize that one, he’s the guy! He broke into our secret realm, blew up our calamity beast hatchery! He killed my son!” a member of a persecuted secret realm bellowed.
“You, it’s you! You… you disrupted our ‘Ultimate Carnival’ return ceremony! Overturned our Holy Grail! I must kill you today, even if no one else!”
“Damn it, that bastard actually used our ancestor’s head made into an item to fight us! It’s outrageous!”
“…”
In the midst of the roars, it was especially bitter to meet an old foe, and almost instantly they were at each other’s throats with murderous intent.
Aside from the “Red Moon” followers who, like orphans, were still being ignored.
The other factions finally put aside all their grudges and formed a temporary alliance, fighting against the vast number of bonfire employees who had arrived.
And down at the hillside, the pressure on Colin was greatly alleviated with the arrival of these people…
Many of the enemies who had rushed in were now intercepted by the bonfire employees.
However, this also made some guys restless…
Three divine fluctuations suddenly erupted.
“It’s a bit tough to resist, but if I can hold them off, then probably nothing else can stop me,” Colin took a deep breath, pulled out a Golden Sun Seal, ready to fight it out.

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - 396 375 The Man on the Cliff Edge (6.2K large
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 396: Chapter 375: The Man on the Cliff Edge! (6.2K, large chapter!)_4 Chapter 396: Chapter 375: The Man on the Cliff Edge! (6.2K, large chapter!)_4 Although trying to avoid battle would definitely be the best option…
the Shield Emblem, Time Stop Gold Card, and Repulsion Gold Card had all reached their usage limits, and further use would come at a significant cost, so there was no choice but to bear it and charge…
The only option now available was this Golden Mark, which hadn’t been used much until now.
However, before he could use it, Colin suddenly discovered that the Golden Sun Seal in his hand ignited on its own, emitting a pale light mist.
From within the mist, a figure in white emerged.
“The Light Chaser?” Colin was a bit surprised, and then subconsciously waited for the payment notification to pop up on his retina.
Across from him, the three figures rushing to attack, upon seeing this personage of light, and sensing a certain essence in them, one of the well-informed, authentic old demons from the Zhenghuang Flag couldn’t help but exclaim in shock…
“Light?! Damn it! Wasn’t this guy supposed to have died in some unknown universe beyond the light cone? How has he returned? Have those despicable fellows at Bonfire Company dragged him back into the known physical universe again?!”
“This presence, it’s not him… otherwise, today’s affair would have been resolved long ago!”
“Never mind, let’s do this!”
After several cries of astonishment, they attacked at the same time.
However, “The Light Chaser” showed not a trace of panic, raising both hands to form a barrier of white light, thick as glass, to face the three powerhouses.
“Boom!”
A massive explosion rang out, but before the shockwaves of the blast had subsided, the three beings determined to self-sacrifice did so, one after another.
Seeing this, “The Light Chaser” in front of Colin had an odd expression on her face…
She hadn’t even made a move yet, so why had the enemy killed themselves?
But a second later, a flash of inspiration came, and she suddenly realized why the reward for this mission was so unusually high at “300” points, but the parchment indicated that the mission time was most likely less than ten seconds…
Because just by arriving here, she feared she would vanish.
However, not dwelling further on this realization, and before that barrage of attacks could reach them, she reached out towards Colin, flicked her finger, and shot a condensed ray of light into his body.
