In an instant, Colin felt most of the negative effects from the various accumulated artifacts within him erased…
“Thank you…”
Colin said his thanks, feeling that this rescue was worth at least ten thousand points!
Wait, had he not yet paid?
Had he forgotten, or had someone else paid already?
However, as soon as he spoke, Colin heard “The Light Chaser” emit what seemed like a faintly pained grunt, and following that, her projection burst like a bubble in an instant…
Seeing this, Colin didn’t think too much of it and turned to look towards some figures on the road leading up to the middle of the mountain.
“So you like to fight to the death, huh?”
Colin took out a Bone Spur, a cruel smile creeping across his lips…
With the negative effects cleared, and without those “divine” beings that were like walking bombs, everyone here was going to die!
Soon, amidst sharp cries of anguish and the fluttering debris of bodies, Colin’s blood-soaked figure staggered up the slope to a clearing midway up the mountain, and then his heart “thudded” at the sight that greeted him.
Various heretic human cultists, different non-human races, demons, and even powerful followers of the “Red Moon”…
All of these beings bore a certain amount of “divinity” on them!
But soon, Colin breathed a sigh of relief.
He noticed that these beings seemed to be caught in some unknown predicament, all standing rigid in place, heads bowed towards a certain direction.
Out of caution, Colin refrained from attacking them rashly.
Then, narrowing his eyes, Colin looked past this crowd and towards the deeper area, on the mountainside cliff, where he saw a derailed and damaged train and next to it, a large, pink plastic stool of the kind common in food stalls…
Though the plastic stool was somewhat faded, it stood out starkly amongst all the monstrous entities.
And then, on the faded pink food stall stool…
Colin saw a man in a brown-red Hunter’s Coat, motionless as a corpse, back turned to everyone.
And behind him, all the different races stood eerily still, faces bowed towards him…
Their state seemed to be that of beings caught in some form of deep slumber…
The scene was extremely eerie.
But, guided by the mission’s instinct, Colin could confirm…
The target on the pink stool was that one individual employee of Bonfire Company at C Level in the entire incident!
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - 397 376 I Sit Atop the Corpse of God._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 397: Chapter 376 I Sit Atop the Corpse of “God”._1 Chapter 397: Chapter 376 I Sit Atop the Corpse of “God”._1 In the spacious mid-mountain area, an indescribable and eerie silence flowed…
Not far away, the massive, chaotic, and bloody battlefield seemed unable to affect this place at all, as if everything was being blocked by something.
As a result, this area appeared strangely quiet, completely out of step with other places.
“This person’s aura seems a bit similar to the one in the eighth carriage of the train…”
Colin’s nostrils twitched slightly, his gaze firmly fixed on the figure above, though not entirely certain, he felt there was some similarity between the two.
But the question was, if the person on the train was him, then why had he entered this place?
The doubts in his mind bubbled and surged like dumplings in boiling water…
But after pondering for a while with no success, Colin shook his head and stopped thinking, retracting his gaze. Then he glanced at the group of powerful, but now all bowing their heads submissively, facing the man’s back, a collection of various heretics and alien species.
So far, Colin could only surmise that their current status was directly related to the death of the Level C Employee.
Yet he knew nothing about how the other party had managed to do it…
Barely any signs of battle were visible at the scene.
“There’s a significant possibility that something he’s carrying, a ‘Containment Subject,’ went out of control, like the ‘Phantom Witch,’ or there’s a chance that it was an incident caused by the source of contamination. Lastly, it’s possible that he didn’t quite die?”
“Whatever the case, we have to be careful. The power level of a Level C Employee, compared to a D Level, can’t be simply described by awareness. In terms of overall strength, the gap is even bigger than between me and the dog downstairs…”
“But since I’m already here, and I have confirmed that the containment subject is on him, I can’t back down at the last step…”
Taking a deep breath, Colin cloaked himself in flames, stepped forward, and cautiously approached.
Throughout this area, there were bizarre vortex-shaped crystals…
They radiated a faint, twisted luster, constantly distorting the surroundings, but with the protection of flames, Colin wasn’t particularly worried that these things would corrode him.
He tiptoed through the wax-figure-like crowd, approaching the pink plastic chair at a slightly slower pace than usual.
As he got closer to his target without any sign of danger, Colin couldn’t help but relax a bit.
However, just then, an unexpected change occurred.
A faint groan came from one side…
Instantly, Colin’s muscles tensed, his body engulfed in firelight as he prepared for battle while looking in the direction of the sound.
He saw a follower of the “Red Moon” radiating an intense red glow, his face grimacing and contorting in pain with his eyes shut tight, then strange vortex pits appeared on his skin.
His body trembled continuously, his eyes under the lids moving restlessly, as if longing to open and awaken from some plight.
However…
A few seconds later, Colin saw the man being devoured by the vortexes that appeared on his own body.
He died without a chance to awaken, and not even remnants were left behind…
“Hiss… A being with ‘Divinity’ just vanished like that?”
Colin was inwardly shocked. Before coming up here, he had been worried that these people would ruin his mission target, but now he realized he might have worried too much…
The situation here was hardly better than the chaotic battlefield below.
If anything, it was even more mysterious.
Because so far, Colin still hadn’t figured out what was going on with these people.
Even though it was such a bizarre place, his passive sense of crisis from “Fatal Insight” hadn’t been triggered at all…
“No good, I can’t overthink it. The answer is right ahead. Overthinking on the way there will only scare myself.”
Shaking his head, taking a deep breath to suppress the alarm inside, Colin silently strengthened his protection and then continued to advance.
Two minutes later, to his relief, aside from seeing a few mysteriously dead enemies, he could say that he arrived without incident at the pink chair.
And the man seated on it, like The Thinker, bowed his head, looking down at the battlefield from the cliff.
Colin couldn’t help but follow the man’s line of sight to gaze at the war below the cliff.
Amongst the sky-high aura of blood, the appalling melee of all manner of demons and monsters continued.
At a glance, one could roughly make out the three factions: Bonfire Company Employees positioned at the foot of the mountain relying on various paraphernalia, holding back the allied armies of different races, both sides locked in a frenzied battle.
In such intense fighting, even the company’s employees had considerable casualties.
Except, like the followers of the “Red Moon,” upon death, the employees would resurrect near transport points like “Son of Cruelty,” “Little Chicken No. 7,” and “Fool’s Mushroom” after a certain period of time.
Perched on the mountainside, Colin could faintly hear cursing from the chaos below.
“Damn it, which bastard let out an uncontrolled anomaly, I died because of you…”
“Fucking Never-Setting Sun thugs, I want to see how you’re going to reclaim this later…”
“Is it possible they just dumped it here and aren’t planning to reclaim it at all? I strongly suspect these bastards came here just to toss the anomaly over…”
“Guys, bring some people, help us break through a distance, I’m going to release a high-level uncontrolled containment subject, I can barely suppress it!”
“Crap, that’s harmful, hurry up and stuff this bastard into a cannon and blast him out…”
“…”
“Pretty lively down there, looks like they could hold on for a while. It’s just that I currently can’t see what the penalty for dying is…”
Colin’s eyes moved again to glance at the followers of the “Red Moon.” Most of the strong among this group were now all standing at the mid-mountain level, causing the battlefield below to lack quality despite having numbers.

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - 398 376 I Sit Atop the Corpse of God._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 398: Chapter 376 I Sit Atop the Corpse of “God”._2 Chapter 398: Chapter 376 I Sit Atop the Corpse of “God”._2 Such a strange situation arose on the battlefield…
Whether it was employees of the Bonfire Company or the members of the Heretic Races Coalition, everyone was killing indiscriminately, but only the “Followers of the Red Moon” were being killed in the chaos…
However, looking at the fearless “Red Moon” followers…
Sensing a strange and indescribable “activity” on the battlefield that seemed to grow stronger with the deaths of the “Red Moon” followers, Colin could not help but feel that they were playing a very big game…
“Whoosh!”
A swishing sound suddenly came from the sky.
In the sky above, a flock of strange winged eyeballs swooped uncontrollably toward the train carriage halfway up the mountainside.
Colin squinted his eyes and drew out a Bone Spur, ready to make a move.
But before he could truly act, all winged eyeballs seemed to touch some vortexes of floating light in this area and melted away, falling from the sky, only to be shredded into pieces by the chaos of the battlefield below…
“Didn’t expect this to be a no-fly zone,”
Shaking his head, Colin did not think too much about it and withdrew his gaze from the battle below. He took a few steps forward to a spot about three meters in front of the pink chairs at the food stall.
Then, he directed his gaze towards the person sitting at the edge of the cliff—
A very rigid person.
This was the first impression that came to Colin’s mind upon seeing the person’s appearance.
Unlike the expected desiccated corpse, the person before him was not overly rotten but rather seemed more robust due to the skin being tightly stretched over muscles that had not shrunk or decomposed too much.
However, on the body were also many vortexes and spiral crystals emitting traces of a twisted space.
“This muscle… it doesn’t feel human, is it specially modified?”
As the thought crossed his mind, Colin glanced at a broken sword beside the seat, covered with Crystal Stones, then his gaze moved to the chest area of the person, where, under a faded and open brown coat, he saw an opening in the bare ribcage area.
Through the opening, he could see something inside emitting a scorching red light…
A heart.
“The target for this harvest seems to be this heart… So does that mean this is a ‘Flame Bearer’?”
With the help of the mission sensor, Colin confirmed one thing.
Then, he licked his lips and couldn’t help but mutter to himself about why missions about “Flame Bearers” are always about harvesting various organs.
While others traveled through different worlds overcoming all hardships to save worlds like a messiah, he was just collecting all sorts of body tissues.
This made Colin feel like he was some kind of organ smuggling criminal…
If it wasn’t collecting skulls, it was collecting hands, and now a heart was needed; actual containment missions were few and far between.
“Speaking of which, back at the seaside, that domineering female ‘Flame Bearer’ also left a heart behind, but at that time, the company didn’t seem to want to retrieve it? Is it because that heart still had the mission to suppress evil spirits…”
As he thought about this, Colin looked at the man on the seat once more, and silently apologized with a “no offense” in his heart, all the while maintaining respect for the elderly, he cautiously reached out towards the gap between the ribs on the man’s chest.
As he started to move, he also prepared himself to deal with a situation in which nearly 50 “Divine” powerhouses nearby might wake up as soon as he removed the heart.
After all, taking away the heart would undoubtedly disrupt the scene.
Without the power of the “Flame Bearer” to suppress it, everyone would most likely wake up…
Even the fearsome source of pollution, now hardly noticeable, might reappear.
However, just then, a sudden jolt went through Colin’s heart…
He felt his outstretched hand, as if it was grabbed by something—
A grey-and-white hand!
Tracing the hand backward…
Colin saw that the man who should have been dead on the seat actually moved!
In an instant, Colin’s pupils shrank to the size of needles, wanting to withdraw his hand, but he found that the man’s grip was as unyielding as a vice.
“Has no one told you not to disturb the rest of the dead?”
An indifferent voice came from the man.
Under Colin’s horrified gaze, the Level C Employee slowly raised his head, and on a face half-swallowed by a vortex, with just one eye remaining, the eyelid slowly opened to reveal a silent and rational pitch-black pupil.
Rattled, Colin’s flames burst forth, lunging straight at the man in front of him.
“Thump.”
The heart, beating like a battle drum.
A deeper hue of flame also erupted from the man in front of him.
The two sets of flames collided head-on through their touching hands, causing an extremely violent collision.
‘Hiss, this is the true flame of a ‘Flame Bearer’? The purity is so high, if not for the grease, it probably wouldn’t even hold up…’
Colin was shocked once again.
Then he quickly reacted, intending to use “Time Freeze” and the Bone Spur to strike down this old relic.
But just at that moment, he suddenly felt the man’s grip, as strong as steel, loosen.
Right after that…
The man, along with the chair, appeared a few meters away, as if by Flash.
Colin had a feeling that even if he used Time Stop, he probably wouldn’t be able to react faster than the other man and secure him…
“Ah, does he have ‘Deadly Insight’ or some such ability to foresee the outcome? But then again, does this not also suggest that the gear in my possession still poses a threat to him?”
Colin’s thoughts raced as he likewise prepared for combat.
However, the Level C Employee sitting not far away did not hurry to make a move but instead stretched out his right hand, brought it to his face, and inserted it into the vortex swallowing half his face, pulling hard…

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - 399 376 I sit upright on the corpse of God._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 399: Chapter 376 I sit upright on the corpse of “God”._3 Chapter 399: Chapter 376 I sit upright on the corpse of “God”._3 The face that had been devoured re-emerged, pulled back by him.
Aside from appearing a bit asymmetrical, it now looked no different from that of an ordinary person.
“Can it really be done this way?” Colin muttered in astonishment,
But then, he saw a cluster of red flame ignite within each of the man’s eyes.
“A Reservist without Level C Clearance, yet possessing ‘Flame Bearer’ material? Hmm, and I also sense the presence of a Level 0 Containment Object, along with some familiar but unnameable Fate threads, I’ve never seen someone as complex as you…
The man said in a calm and indifferent tone while looking at him.
‘Is he seeing right through me? But, this… why does it feel a bit off?’ Colin frowned,
He could sense a profound madness and chaos emanating from the guy, its intensity exceeded that of all the D Level combined on the train.
But now, the man was neither mad nor chaotic, he appeared to be very rational…
This feeling was very conflicting.
However, since he seemed able to communicate, why not try to resolve the crisis through dialogue?
With this in mind, Colin spoke up, “What exactly happened here? And where is the source of the contamination?”
“The source of the contamination? It’s right under my feet,” the man with Level C Clearance spoke without any emotional fluctuation in his voice.
“Under your feet?”
Colin was taken aback, then immediately realized that the man was referring to the entire mountainous peak thousands of kilometers tall!
This damn thing isn’t a mountain, it’s the anomaly itself!
Just as Colin’s breath began to hitch, the man sitting in the seat ahead casually glanced at the ground and then lifted his gaze to Colin, saying:
“It is the source of this incident, it attacked the transfer station, ambushing us, I should have detected the problem earlier, but due to the physical damage I sustained from the previous incident, and because I let my guard down after disengaging from the incident…
“This led to the tragedy, we were dragged into an area not sheltered by the Bonfire, and we were ambushed…
“Although by harnessing the power of the ‘Primordial Fire,’ I forcefully elevated myself and suppressed this incident, sadly, including myself, no one could return, only left to wander on the dark side of the universe…
“Finally, under the arrangement of a certain high-level authority…
“I sat atop the so-called ‘God’s’ corpse, waiting for the curtain to fall on this matter.”
The man spoke in an exceptionally cold tone, showing no hint of emotion as if he were simply recounting past events.
“A certain authority?” Colin picked up on the hidden message in the words.
“I know who it is, but if I can’t say it, then there is no need to pursue it further,” the man’s words were filled with a kind of ‘rationality’ tinged with madness.
Upon hearing this, Colin nodded, wanting to ask about the others, like the one on the train.
But the man spoke first: “Before Level C, coming into contact with the power of the ‘Flame Bearer’ to become a Reservist is generally strictly prohibited because, before that, you don’t have the ability to hide yourself. Countless entities would try to stop you from succeeding…
“Even if you reached Level C, you may not be able to protect yourself. In some ways, this attack is somewhat related to my impending transformation into a ‘Flame Bearer’…
“‘Flame Bearer’ is one of humanity’s strongest forces facing disaster, a pillar of human spirit, but not a single non-human entity wants to see more ‘Flame Bearers’ emerge…
“Therefore, I’m not sure who arranged for your situation or why they would take such a huge risk, but I can feel that the person has high authority…
“And now, the aura I sense from you gives me a very unfamiliar feeling…”
At this point, the man paused in his speech, and then suddenly changed the subject:
“However, all of that is irrelevant. Are you here to finalize this incident?”
“Yes,” Colin nodded.
“Although this is only its dying dream, if you die here on this part of the mountain range, you too will suffer consequences. So, let me confirm one last time, are you the one to finalize this incident?”
The indifferent voice spoke again, and as Colin nodded once more, the man closed his eyes as he left one last sentence.
“Then be careful, ‘it’ that has merged with ‘me,’ is about to awaken…”
“It’s about to awaken? What do you mean?”
Colin hastily asked, but at that moment, he realized that the other had completely closed his eyes.
And in the next second, a distorted aura and dazzling light burst forth from the man, and the previously impassively rational face showed an expression of extreme pain as his chest seemed to be covered by layers of crystal…
“Ah…ah…it’s so uncomfortable…who…help me…”
“Sorry… I wasn’t able to bring you all… safely back…”
“Why is this night… so endless…”
“How much longer… how much longer… until awaken…”
Whispers filled with self-blame, pain, and confusion echoed repeatedly around him…
The man at the food stall seat stood up slowly from the chair, his face devoid of light and twisted, turning into a terrifying vortex of confusion.
And within the vortex, numerous figures could be glimpsed…
It was at this moment that Colin felt this was the same person he had encountered on the train!
But before he could think further, Colin noticed that within the vortex on that face, it seemed as if a gaze was directed at him.
“Ah… you are… who are you? We seem… to have met before?”
In the midst of the strange murmurings, Colin suddenly felt an overwhelming sense of dread hastily approaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - 400 377 The Firebearer Inheritance (6.2K words
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 400: Chapter 377: The Firebearer Inheritance! (6.2K words, big chapter)_1 Chapter 400: Chapter 377: The Firebearer Inheritance! (6.2K words, big chapter)_1 Images rapidly surfaced in Colin’s mind—
Several meters away, the figure of a C Level Personnel suddenly disappeared and reappeared inexplicably right in front of him, lifting a fist as big as a bunker. He countered with a Bone Spur, but when the fist came down, the Bone Spur penetrated the enemy’s hand, and at the same time, he exploded into a cloud of blood mist.
“Hiss, wasn’t it just the talking phase, how did it suddenly come to blows? And I’m gone with just a Flash and a punch? What kind of monster is this…”
As thoughts flickered, Colin deftly reached into his pocket and pinched a card.
The next second, the C Level Personnel’s figure suddenly appeared, and as anticipated, raised his right fist and smashed it down fiercely…
Aside from the Flash, this movement was not fast, if not for “Fatal Insight”.
Colin would most likely have targeted with a Bone Spur…
However, now, “Force Repulsion” activated!
A terrifying Repulsion burst forth…
Everything within the area was affected and pushed aside straight away.
After tumbling for a bit, the enemy finally stopped his body from moving, and instead of attacking immediately, he looked this way with a face covered or consumed by vortices, his figure staggering…
“…So strong… item… so strong… you are the enemy… so strong… don’t be afraid… I will take you home…”
“Everyone can go home…”
“Go back…”
Muddled whispers came from nearby, the tone laced with clear self-reproach.
Even a soft cry could be heard…
‘The presence is the same as the one before, it can be confirmed that it’s indeed the same person. However, the one before spoke with uncanny rationality, unlike this one who’s continuously guilt-ridden and repeating the past events, they are practically two different people…’
Colin observed carefully, trying to find a breakthrough, perhaps provoking a reaction with his words?
Or should he drag out time like he did on the train before, waiting for the enemy to completely lose rationality?
Yet, as Colin pondered, he noticed that with the enemy’s crying and wailing, a lot of strange vortices had appeared around, and the whole world started to feel more and more unreal to him…
In this vast mid-mountain area, the figures of the other Cultists also began to slowly disappear.
Everything seemed unchanged, yet an indescribable distortion seemed to have occurred invisibly.
“This effect, is a bit like being pulled by the ‘Shield of Fairness Adjudication’? No, I can’t let him influence this place like this, I need to take the initiative…”
With that thought, Colin casually took out a “Colorless Crystal” and swallowed it, with a surge of flames erupting from his body, stirring the surroundings, dispelling that intangible sinking sensation.
Then, he took out the “Revolver Reverser” and pulled the trigger aimed at the enemy.
With a flicker of light from the gun muzzle, the enemy still did not move.
Dang dang dang…
The bullets, ablaze with flame, hit the enemy’s skin, making a crisp metallic sound, and then sparks scattered.
“This body is harder than it looks…”
Seeing the shattering bullet fragments, Colin’s eyelids twitched.
But he had used this gun to trigger the “Lethality” effect of the thirty-three bullets; he hadn’t really expected these ordinary bullets to inflict much damage.
“‘Lethality’ can have a clear effect even on a Level 1 Containment Subject. If all shots hit him, there should be no problem, hmm, there are still nine shots left.”
After a round of shooting, Colin immediately reloaded the bullets and continued firing.
But this time, it’s uncertain whether the crying and wailing figure felt some threat, but his aura suddenly changed, as if he had switched personalities. He tore off his brown coat with one hand and flung it, swiping all the bullets from the air.
A form with slightly grey skin but a metallic sheen and well-defined muscles was revealed.
“You are one of those… who detest mechanical life? Unfortunately for you, you’ve encountered me…”
The C Level man carried an arrogant tone as if he hadn’t encountered such an enemy before and regarded Colin as a certain kind of enemy:
“Feeble machines can’t compete with my body, tempered through a thousand trials!”
‘Why is his tone suddenly like ‘The False Powerhouse’? But even so, this item shouldn’t have an effect on C Level…’
Colin couldn’t help but think, but before he could ponder further, as the voice fell, the man with a body shaped like iron in front of him slightly bent down and then suddenly appeared nearby like a Flash, coming at him with a punch.
Driven by a powerful instinctive warning, he first stepped back several steps to dodge the attack, creating some distance with the aim to reload the last round of bullets. But at that moment, the enemy’s figure flashed again…
‘I remember that D Level Personnel said that one of this guy’s famous moves is being able to Flash eighteen times in a minute?’
As his thoughts raced, Colin manipulated the flames, raising a magnificent wall of fire between himself and the enemy…
“Boom!”
An overwhelming Charge came, and Colin’s pupils shrank as he saw the wall that could handle a dump truck explode like paper.
Still, as if he had anticipated this, Colin simultaneously activated another Golden Card’s effect.
“Now to use ‘Time Stasis’, he won’t be able to dodge!”
Hum!
Within the invisible roaring sound, everything at the scene was pulled into an invisible Stasis. Colin, without a second thought, took a dagger and tried to stab into the enemy’s body…
Unexpectedly to Colin,
the tip of the Bone Spur stopped just before the skin, failing to penetrate!

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - 401 377 The Firebearer Inheritance (6.2K words
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 401: Chapter 377: The Firebearer Inheritance! (6.2K words, big chapter)_2 Chapter 401: Chapter 377: The Firebearer Inheritance! (6.2K words, big chapter)_2 “Damn, it’s too tough.”
Colin held up the Bone Spur with his right hand, a look of shock on his face, then his gaze quickly shifted, trying to find a wound on it or something.
However, at the opponent’s chest, the original metal fracture was already filled with a mass of swirling metal crystals…
There was hardly a place left to strike on the entire body!
In a rush, Colin quickly drew his revolver, aimed at the opponent, and began his final shooting—
The “Lethal” effect would trigger as long as the bullet hit, no need to breach the defense!
Just as he fired a few shots, with only the last three bullets left, he heard the sound of a clock ticking by his ear…
He frowned but still chose to create some distance.
When “Time Stop” ended…
Colin had thought the other would charge at him, but surprisingly, the other pulled away, increasing the distance between them.
“You seem to have… a super high-quality item that can affect space?”
The Level C Personnel, filled with a sense of power, whispered.
Upon hearing this, Colin was startled inside: Had he sensed the effect of “Time Stop”?
Most who were caught in “Time Stop” would mostly assume he could Flash, but this one seemed to have faintly touched upon some truth.
And taking advantage of the opponent’s unstable psyche pausing their attack, Colin used the “Gene Compensation Panel” for “Combat Power Observation.”
At this glance, Colin’s eyes widened.
[Name]: Kong Shiping.
[Strength]: 53.7 (Strong!)(Note: 1.)
[Physique]: 77.1 (Very strong!)
[Agility]: 19.9 (Seems weak compared, but actually very strong!)
[Description]: Damn, such a statistical freak!
[Overall Evaluation]: Also considering he might have some items unknown, if encountered, better haul ass immediately!
[Caution]: The above data does not represent the final combat power, everything is based on actual contact…
…
“Shit, what kind of monstrous stats are these?”
Colin gasped, recalling that the Eighth Level rogue personnel “Liping” had a physique in the twenties or thirties and was already a bit too much for him to handle.
Now this guy, strength fifty, physique almost eighty?
“I remember, my three stats are all in the teens now, add them up, and they probably don’t even match his single strength value.”
Colin was dazed.
Was this… the face value and stats of Level C Personnel?
No wonder he couldn’t penetrate the skin with the full force of the Bone Spur…
With these numbers, forget the Bone Spur, Colin even doubted whether a nuclear bomb landing directly could cause effective damage!
However, seemingly feeling some sort of observation, Colin saw that statistical freak of a man slowly shifting his gaze from behind the swirls of his face:
“I feel a familiar and respectable power, it seems you have other strong items on you…
“Unfortunately, the way you utilize these items is still too naive…
“Let me teach you more detailed methods…”
As the words finished, Colin felt the hair on his body stand up, and his brain sent out frantic warnings.
The next instant, the man Flash again to less than three meters in front of him and swung a heavy gravity punch at him.
“Repulsion Burst!”
Colin did not dare to slack, silently reciting in his heart and then directly triggering the card effect.
But what surprised him was that the power that had previously been unstoppable, even able to repel “Divine” beings, seemed to be somewhat ineffective this time…
The Level C man first Flashed to fifteen meters away, then swung out a heavy punch.
Boom!
Amid the terrifying vibration…
A fist broke through the impact barrier of “Repulsion Burst”!
“???”
Colin was shocked when he saw this!
This was the first time he had encountered such a situation.
“Was it that item that affected ‘force’ just now? However, it’s a pity, I told you your item use was too rudimentary; its effect is limited, standing within the effect range, you’ll face rejection from all directions…
“And outside the effect, I only need to face the shockwave it pushes out, not the repulsion…
“With this quality of an item, even without ‘unleashing’ it, it would be difficult for me to contend…”
“You only needed to step forward to avoid this outcome, but you didn’t…”
“…You haven’t discovered its flaws and strengths well, haven’t developed it deeply, and even the precision of control is concerning…”
Whispers kept haunting him.
Then, he came at Colin again like a bullet, besides Flash, no fancy items, no bizarre methods, only the purest, simplest physical power release!
The air around them would erupt with terrifying blast sounds with each punch he swung…
And this time, the Level C Personnel was prepared, usually not Flashing close, but relying on his body to get near, and then, when Colin might use the Golden Card, would Flash away to avoid being involved in “Time Stop.”
Colin struggled to cope with each blow, and after being unable to react quickly several times and taking two punches directly, he felt like he was falling apart, truly experiencing the gap between Level C and those at D Level!
Now, the only consolation was that this Level C Employee didn’t seem to use items much.
And there was another piece of good news; perhaps due to the contamination, the attacker’s moves lacked discipline and were erratic, making them easier to dodge…
The bad news was…
Colin always felt, unlike those who became brainless the more they fought on the train, this one seemed to become sharper as the battle went on.
Some madness was gradually changing through the constant fighting, and Colin felt like he was being drilled…
“Your hand swings lack strength, your body’s unstable, your steps are loose, reactions are slow; in all the basic movements, none is completely satisfactory. With this condition, you were actually sent here?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - 402 377 The Firebearer Inheritance (6.2K words
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 402: Chapter 377: The Firebearer Inheritance! (6.2K words, big chapter)_3 Chapter 402: Chapter 377: The Firebearer Inheritance! (6.2K words, big chapter)_3 “Even all the gear on my body, except for fairly good timing of usage, not a single one is mastered. Poor basics, poor handling of tools, the whole thing is hesitant…”
“Doing tasks means finding ways to complete them by any means necessary, what are you hesitating for?”
“As an employee heavily invested in by the company, your strength hasn’t broken my defenses, but your practical combat level is about to break them!”
“You are the weakest in terms of fundamentals among all the employees I’ve seen!”
“…”
In the midst of the harsh reprimands, Colin truly felt his own weaknesses and was continuously suppressed by the other party using these points…
But finally, among numerous attacks.
Colin noticed that the left-hand attacks of this C Level Personnel seemed a bit… out of rhythm?
‘Wait! Right from the start, I’ve been cornered and beaten up so much that I almost forgot, the ‘Destiny Propeller’ D Level Personnel mentioned that their leader had received a very serious injury under the left armpit…’
With this thought, Colin, while dealing with the onslaught, finally found an opportunity during a gap in the opponent’s attacks, willing to pay a certain price.
“Time Stop”!
An invisible force drew everything around it into stasis…
Looking at the Level C Employee who hadn’t teleported away in front of him, Colin, touching the somewhat dented chest where he had been punched, spit out blood while unable to suppress a surge of hot tears in his eyes.
“Finally, I’ve fucking stopped it again!”
Immediately, he drew out the Bone Spur, his gaze focusing on the left armpit.
After confirming there indeed was an almost healed wound, he took out the Bone Spur and plunged it into the wound.
This time, the attack was effective, the Bone Spur sinking more than three inches deep into the flesh!
‘You’re the one who told me to be ruthless, don’t blame me for not fighting with honor…’
With a successful strike, Colin pulled out his Revolver again, and taking advantage of the last few seconds of the seven-second window, he fired three more shots until the ticking of the countdown timer indicated that time was about to start again.
Colin quickly pulled away, only to see the opponent seemed to be preparing to give chase.
But then the body abruptly stiffened, followed by shaking, and stood frozen in place.
“Whew… the Bone Spur and ‘Lethality’ worked.”
Colin breathed a sigh of relief; he was exhausted from the fight…
But then, an unexpected change occurred.
A strong sense of crisis came over him, and he saw the figure of his opponent appear right before him, swinging at his face.
At the critical moment, the Nano Intellectual Mechanism on Colin’s neck surged, pulling at his muscles to make his neck twist and dodge the strike.
The terrible force grazed the side of Colin’s face, where his ear should have been…
Just a few centimeters more, and it would have been instant death.
But before Colin could catch his breath, his scalp tensed, and with stiff eye movements, he saw a hand, seemingly forged from metal, land on his right shoulder.
The figure in front of him vanished like an illusion…
At the same time, a voice came from behind him:
“The final lesson: never let your guard down unless the enemy is completely dead. Even a beast will bite with its last breath…”
“It’s over…”
Colin’s pupils constricted into needle points.
This guy’s physical constitution was inhuman; being hit at such close range was almost certainly fatal.
However, just when he thought everything was over, a sound like a heavy object hitting the ground came from behind him.
Colin snapped back to attention and leaped to the side, only to find the Level C Employee who had been continuously pointing out his weaknesses, acting like an Instructor, lying on the ground, trembling as if enduring great pain…
One after another, Vortex Crystals fell from his body, and from the spots where they fell, thick black liquid oozed out.
Yet, even while enduring such pain, he was still trying hard to get up, sitting on the ground and looking at Colin.
The swirl on his face also began to slowly fade at this moment, revealing a resolute and emaciated face…
“You’re pretty harsh. Looks like it can’t hold on any longer.”
The Level C Clearance man looked at Colin and said slowly.
At this moment, his tone regained some rationality and gentleness…
While speaking, he took a deep breath, his right hand’s fingers coming together before he forcefully plunged them into his own chest, and seemed to grab something. With a fierce pull, he extracted the heart that Colin had previously seen.
“Since the part of ‘it’ that was in me has finally faded, I no longer need to use it to suppress…”
After completing this step, his complexion turned ashen, like that of a corpse.
Then, looking at the heart in his hand which began to burn with a reddish-orange flame when exposed to the air, his eyes revealed complex emotions.
“My family and I survived the dark chaos thanks to the protection of the ‘Flame Bearer.’ My dream has always been to become a powerful ‘Flame Bearer,’ to face all of humanity’s enemies. I’ve made lots of efforts toward it…”
At this point, he paused, his tone filled with infinite regret, “Unfortunately… I was one step too short.”
Shaking his head, the Level C Employee looked up at the sky as if seeing through the layers of aurora to a distant battle, then looked down the cliff…
Finally, he turned to Colin: “There’s not much time left. We don’t seem to have the upper hand in this battle, but there should still be a little time to talk. You seem to have some questions?”
“The one on the train, what’s your relationship with him?” Colin didn’t beat around the bush.
“That’s me… but the real me just faded away along with ‘it.’ Years ago, a big figure found the dark side of the universe, found us who had already perished with our enemies. He used some means to merge part of us, creating the ‘Chaotic Phantom Train’…”

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - 403 377 Flame Bearer Inheritance (6.2K Big
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 403: Chapter 377: “Flame Bearer” Inheritance! (6.2K, Big Chapter)_4 Chapter 403: Chapter 377: “Flame Bearer” Inheritance! (6.2K, Big Chapter)_4 “”I received the final task, waiting for a closer, to recover the items here…”
“I don’t understand why the higher-ups want to do this, but, I took on the task.”
In longer conversations, he communicated directly via brain waves, and even as he spoke, his mouth did not stop:
“There’s something I must clarify, you’re not the worst group I’ve seen; or rather, you’re not bad in this group, the truly bad ones are those challengers on the train…
“And that part at the bottom of the mountain, I’m really a bit worried, if the real ‘me’ saw such a wasteful usage…
“He might get so angry that he’d come back to life…”
“Er…”
Colin felt a bit embarrassed listening to the other party’s brain waves and voice at the same time, not knowing how to respond.
Because just now, he had also been beaten quite badly…
“I rank within the top three hundred in combat at C Level, and you are currently only at E Level, unable to keep up with many things. It’s perfectly normal for you not to beat me, and under the circumstances of not releasing any items, being able to take a few moves is already pretty good. At D Level, you’re considered one of the elite, so, the words of that ‘me’ who was out of his mind, besides the fact that your basics are truly lacking, you can disregard everything else that denied you, and you don’t need to doubt yourself too much…”
“However, if it weren’t for the situation being wrong, I’d really like to have you release that thing inside you, to have a proper fight, but your comrades are waiting for you to complete the mission…”
“Go… go fulfill my unachieved dream, and become a… ‘Flame Bearer.'”
As he said this, he handed over the “Dream” to Colin.Colin reached out to take it, initially wanting to draw it back, but found that the other party was still holding on firmly…
What’s this?
While he was confused, Colin heard the other person’s voice again: “It seems like you haven’t prepared any powerful moves for after you become a ‘Flame Bearer,’ have you?”
Colin nodded, then saw a smile form on the other person’s lips.
“How can a qualified ‘Flame Bearer’ not have a move they can call out? I’ve left some things inside; remember… you can try to learn them. These were originally the moves I intended to use to wreak havoc.”
“Okay.” Colin nodded.
Then, like taking a torch from another’s hand, he took the burning heart from the other person.
It was in the instant the heart left the hand that the man in front of him lost all life force as if a fan had been unplugged, losing all power at once. His body fell to the ground, black pus seeping from the surface of his skin.
And at that moment, the eerie feeling of unreality around him rapidly dissipated…
The “Dream” of God began to shatter.
A surge of knowledge flowed into his mind, and Colin came to understand the last thing the other left behind.
“Sky Light Fall!”
It was the terrifying ability the “Fate Propeller” D Level personnel spoke of, which, upon affecting even a Level 1 Containment Subject’s main body, had a chance to cause an immediate system crash for some time!
This had now been developed into a sort of “skill” that could be used upon acquisition.
“Thank you…” Colin expressed his sincere gratitude.
At that moment, on the ground, the life of the body rapidly fading, the man looked at Colin as if he had something to say but seemed hesitant.
“Is there something you want to ask?” Colin spoke up.
“There are some questions that I actually don’t want to ask… but in the end, I can’t help… wanting to know, I’m not clear on what’s really going on with the company…
“But… are we still… on the right path?”
“The ‘Flame Bearers’… do they still fight for humanity as I envisioned?”
Hearing this last feeble murmur, an image of each known “Flame Bearer” flashed in Colin’s mind as he replied: “Yes.”
“Good, then, I… can rest easy… I can… rest peacefully now…”
“Finally, the mission is complete… bring them back with you…”
“For this mission, they… haven’t been home for a long time.”
They? Who were they? Colin wondered, then saw the man whose body was gradually collapsing on the ground reach into his trouser pocket, and pull out a bunch of iron tags looped through a chain and hand them over.
On each polished, gleaming iron tag, the names of those gone were clearly engraved…
And there were seventy-two tags, representing seventy-one D Level personnel, and one C Level personnel, no more, no less.
“Okay.”
Colin squatted down, carefully receiving the names from the other’s hand and placed them into the “Storage Room.”
After all was done, the life force of the C Level personnel before him had already disappeared, his eyes closed as if he were in a deep sleep…
“Goodnight.”
Murmuring softly, Colin slowly stood up.
And with the death of the other…
The disillusionment of this world seemed to accelerate like an avalanche.
Suddenly, a shiver ran through Colin’s spine as he saw a layer of blood-red light emerge above the sky…
Without the “Dreamscape” as a barrier…
The powers of those horrifying existences also began to infiltrate this place quickly.
But, at that moment, a message from the upper echelons of the company surfaced in his mind.
[Special Event: All personnel are to evacuate through the “Mist Gate” immediately!]
.
.
.
Note: 1.
The numerical standard for average humans is around 1, most people who stay at home and don’t exercise can’t even reach 1…
ps: Huge chapter, begging for monthly tickets.

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - 404 378 Mist Gate Massive Retreat (9.2K huge
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 404: Chapter 378 “Mist Gate” Massive Retreat! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_1 Chapter 404: Chapter 378 “Mist Gate” Massive Retreat! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_1 In the taskbar, a more detailed event unfolded before Colin’s eyes.
[Special Event: All personnel must leave this place by entering the “Mist Gate”!]
“Note: The ‘Mist Gate’ will be established at the weak point in the mountain’s spatial fabric, approximately taking fifteen minutes to manifest and will remain open for forty-five minutes.”
“Caution: Please try to leave through the gate as much as possible. If unable to pass through it, certain risks will occur, and it will be at least three months before you can return the same way. There is no upper limit to this maximum period of return…”
…
“No upper limit to the return period? Isn’t that a roundabout way of saying there’s a chance you might never be able to return?”
Colin was taken aback; he had thought that once this special event was triggered,
everyone would return suddenly, just like during the previous “Descent Type” event, but unexpectedly, it seemed there was a slight hiccup this time?
As these thoughts flickered through his mind, he stood at the edge of the mountain’s midway cliff, seemingly gazing down at the battlefield below, but in fact, he was glancing at the horizon with his peripheral vision. He could sense more than the evening glow, occasional bursts of fire in the sky, and an eerie aura permeating…
The battle continued from all sides, though the company seemed to be at a disadvantage?
The employees below might not have noticed, but from his vantage point, he vaguely spotted that the red glow on the “Red Moon” followers seemed to have intensified a bit…
“Tch, they’ve been buffed again… But by the looks of it, the company should be able to hold out for another hour. As for the retreat, we should be able to evacuate at least ninety-nine percent…”
Colin withdrew his gaze from below then turned around to survey his position on the mountain slope.
With the death of this C Level Personnel…
The dreamlike unreality that surrounded them rapidly dissipated.
The other Cultists, who were “invisible” before, now began to gradually emerge, as if rising to the surface of water.
“The wounds I received earlier seem to be healing…”
Colin took a moment to assess himself, then turned his attention to the group of heretic, Different Races, and abnormal things…
Most people seemed still caught in the “Dreamscape,” unawakened.
While a small portion trembled, looking as though they were about to awake at any moment…
“Sleep tight, don’t hurry to wake up.”
After some thought, Colin didn’t hesitate to draw out his Bone Spur and poked the nearest about-to-awaken one.
The tip of the Bone Spur touched just against the cultist’s eyelid without piercing…
But with just a little more force exerted by Colin’s hand.
Pff.
He felt like he was puncturing rubber.
Then, it smoothly and accurately penetrated the eyelid, went through the eyeball, and stabbed into the brain…
“Right, this is the sensation! That feeling tougher than diamond and more tenacious than steel was all wrong!”
Regaining some of his familiarity with using the Bone Spur from this Cultist, Colin couldn’t help but feel a lump in his throat.
And as the Bone Spur pierced neatly through…
Thud, the figure collapsed to the ground.
“You, you…” wearing a bizarre robe, another Cultist with eyes bloodshot opened one eye, reached out a finger in Colin’s direction as if he wanted to curse at him…
But with another unprincipled stab by Colin,
the Cultist’s Divine essence shattered instantly. His body swelled up, black water flowing from every orifice, and he died on the spot.
After confirming his death, Colin didn’t hesitate and moved towards another ‘lucky’ Cultist to finish him off while they were still trapped in the “Dreamscape.”
Colin regained the touch he had lost while using the Bone Spur on these frail bodies.
However, among nearly fifty figures on the scene, he had eliminated less than one-sixth when suddenly, an accident happened.
A stroke of red light unexpectedly spread out…
Colin took defensive measures and saw several “Red Moon” followers emanating red light, suddenly opening their eyes…
Yet, just when he thought a fight was about to break out, these “Red Moon” followers showed a trace of panic on their faces and then exploded into pieces, turning into a blood-red glow that shot toward the base of the mountain.
“They escaped?” Colin was surprised; he had thought that these stronger “Red Moon” followers
would fight mindlessly, attacking whoever they saw, like the regular “Red Moon” followers.
But it seemed they actually had some intelligence…
As the “Red Moon” followers self-destructed to escape, another anomaly occurred at the scene.
“Aaah!!!” A strange scream sounded from a creature full of crystals, with an energy aura not weak but motionless on the ground like a rock…
Then, Colin saw a series of crackling sounds.
Fist imprints emerged on its stone body.
Eventually, it exploded like a rock packed with dynamite, shattering into countless fragments that scattered across the ground…
“Did the encounters in the dream feedback into reality?”
Colin pondered thoughtfully.
After that, with the death of this first “employee,” the bodies of several dozen others began a chain reaction, and the air was filled with harrowing screams and pained moans, as noisy as a marketplace…
At the same time, various injuries began to manifest on them.
Some had dozens of depressions like hammered rice cakes, some exploded on the spot like they were makeshift bombs, others seemed as if sliced into pieces by countless blades, some grew swirling crystals on their bodies and died, and yet others mysteriously turned black and gave off the aroma of roasted meat as if ignited by fire, though no flame was seen…
All the figures present died in that moment, each in their own bizarre way.
Their souls were forever lost in the “God’s” not yet fully dissipated dream, unable to ever break free…
“This, his methods, seem more elaborate than I imagined…”

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - 405 378 Mist Gate Great Retreat (9.2K huge
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 405: Chapter 378 “Mist Gate” Great Retreat! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_2 Chapter 405: Chapter 378 “Mist Gate” Great Retreat! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_2 Through the various ways these people died, Colin realized that the C Level Personnel was not only physically powerful but clearly had other methods of combat; even if they were unused, that didn’t mean they were absent.
A certain bladed weapon, or bonfire powers…
Even from those bodies covered with spirals and mural crystals, Colin suspected that the adversary might have begun to master a part of that “God’s” powers…
“Hiss… If this had been a fight to the death, even if I released that small part of ‘Hunger’ within me, I still might not have been able to win.”
Colin swallowed his saliva.
No wonder he always felt like the opponent was holding back…
Otherwise, he might have been accidentally killed without even realizing it.
‘Thinking back now, whether he used some technique or not, my memory is exceptionally clear, almost as if watching a high-definition movie. I can recall at any time, zooming in and out, and even make out the pores on my skin…’
‘After I return, if I reflect on this, I should be able to improve quite a bit.’
“However, to think that the first few hundred of C Level are as terrifying as this, fighting some Cultist Angel Envoys who have been given divine powers is as easy as playing. No, if he can survive and make it back now, he might not even be just within the first few hundred…”
In the midst of these churning thoughts, Colin knew that besides the “Flame Bearer” heart trait that the other left behind, the most precious thing was the memory in his mind.
At the same time, thinking of this battle, he couldn’t help but think of “The Light Chaser.”
Their ways of fighting were not exactly the same, but both were extremely experienced in using their strengths to find the enemy’s weaknesses, then striking at them.
‘On the way back, I could see if I could spend some points to get “The Light Chaser” as a sparring partner, to assist me in my cultivation…’
However, before Colin could continue his thoughts, on his left hand, the heart…
Suddenly let out a “thump.”
The heart began to beat.
Then, on the ground, all the Divine Corpses spontaneously combusted without fire, ignited by a sudden rise of orange-red flames, burning and evaporating into wisps of white mist. The mist seemed to be drawn towards the entrance at the midpoint of the mountain, coalescing into form.
A grand ten-meter gate that led to who knows where, slowly erected…
The grand gate was currently closed, not yet opened, apparently needing to form completely before it could be opened.
This process was not very fast, as if someone were drawing it in the air with a pen, needing a certain amount of time.
At the same time, from below the mountain waist, a commotion suddenly started.
Among the united heretics, there was some reaction to the rapid deaths of their high-level personnel.
“What’s going on, what’s happening on the mountain? Why, why is the presence of our Envoy of God gone!”
“Why, why are only Followers of the ‘Red Moon’ coming down? Did they succeed?”
“No, the expressions of Followers of the ‘Red Moon’ don’t look like those of victors…”
“…”
In the ensuing chaos, the various alien beings, looking at the quiet midpoint of the mountain, felt a surge of great unease.
Soon, as Colin’s figure with flames surging around him emerged, their unease peaked…
Realizing something, a portion of the heretics immediately began to retreat quietly, slipping away from the battlefield.
Others, desperate, had faces ashen with despair…
“Have we… failed?”
Someone saw the figure and murmured in anguish.
Since their leaders were dead, and the enemy had emerged unscathed, especially considering the recent retreat of several Followers of the “Red Moon”…
The answer was obvious.
They… had been defeated.
Some demons looked at the figure enhanced by the bonfire, and memories of suffering inherited from ancestors of long ago surged in their minds…
Once again, they remembered the fear of being dominated by the “Flame Bearers.”
The despair of history seemed to be about to repeat itself.
For a moment, the morale of the various alliance species plummeted.
Some Cultists, in extreme despair, even ignored the swinging chainsaw greatswords of towering mechs in front of them.
Welcoming death amidst regretful memories…
On the other hand, with the appearance of Colin’s figure, company Employee morale soared.
“Kill! Slaughter these Heretic Cultists! Especially those drummers! Damn it, I’ve seen it before, that drum is made from the skin of young girls with immense resentment and pain!”
“Peeling the skin off pretty girls while they’re alive, there’s such a thing!? Unforgivable!”
“Ah? I didn’t say they were pretty girls, don’t add descriptions recklessly…”
“Don’t let those with three eyes embossed on their foreheads escape! These people will steal your eyes while you’re asleep. Last mission, we saw a remote village where everyone’s eyes were gouged out alive, and several beauties suffered too…”
“Don’t spare that ghost-like aberration either! That thing specializes in attacking the lower half, cutting off many a man’s ‘little brother,’ making it impossible to stand before a beauty in the future…”
“Damn it, it was this bastard that cost me my ‘little brother’ during a heated battle; I died once because of that! And now, I’m afraid to spread my legs widely while fighting, kill it!!!”
“Disloyal, unfilial, unkind, unjust, impolite, foolish, unfaithful, they are all malignant tumors, kill!”
“Brothers, follow Brother Shunzi’s lead, kill all these cultists, don’t leave a single one alive!”
In the rising battle fervor, the company Employees took the initiative, bearing the onslaught of the frenzied “Red Moon” cultists, launching a full-scale counterattack.
However, apart from them, a few Employees also shouted for a withdrawal.

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - 406 378 The Great Retreat of Mist Gate (9.2K
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 406: Chapter 378: The Great Retreat of “Mist Gate”! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_3 Chapter 406: Chapter 378: The Great Retreat of “Mist Gate”! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_3 “Stop killing, stop killing! Didn’t you see the retreat task? If we get left behind, we probably won’t be able to leave!”
“Brothers, pay attention to the notifications in front of you! A little brother might regrow, but if you’re gone, you’re really gone. Retreat quickly!”
“Regroup halfway up the mountain!”
In the midst of shouts and cries, some bloodthirsty individuals finally took notice of the notifications.
After that, the retreat officially began!
Apart from some who were still reviving and those whose minds or mental states had been slightly affected by overuse of various items, everyone, upon seeing the potentially endless respawn time that might arise, chose to follow their innermost desires, put down their killing intent, and gathered for the retreat…
Just like someone said, a little brother might regrow, but if the big brother is gone, he’s really gone.
“Whoosh!”
A fireball, as large as a little sun and over fifteen meters in diameter, rose on the battlefield.
In the warmth of the firelight, those who were not seriously muddled quickly recovered, and then, with the assistance of some company employees, escaped from the battlefield, while those who were severely muddled…
Let’s deal with them first.
After all, reviving only takes a few minutes, maybe ten at most. In such chaotic situations, it’s better to talk physics than reason with them. Otherwise, if the enemy launches a sneak attack amidst the confusion, there’ll be no chance to reason at all.
It’s like rescuing someone who’s drowned; rather than letting them flail, it’s better to knock them out first.
You should know, on the battlefield, in addition to the morale of various races plummeting, there’s also a bunch of uncontrolled aberrant life forms released by both sides.
Once these guys lose control, they will kill indiscriminately like nuclear pollution…
Colin didn’t join the fray but instead stood at the gate, diverting a portion of his power to control the large fireball, overlooking the utterly chaotic battlefield below…
As he watched, he quickly noticed something that others on the field didn’t.
“There are ‘Red Moon’ followers who have also started to become bothersome.”
Colin’s brow furrowed as he looked at those whose red light was becoming increasingly intense.
The ‘Red Moon’ followers, after a wild melee from both sides…
Did not decrease in number; instead, there seemed to be even more of them, often parasitizing the corpses of enemies outside the company, taking over the flesh.
Even some shattered aberrant beings couldn’t escape the fate of being parasitized and corrupted.
Originally, Followers of the ‘Red Moon’ only had numbers, but now, as they multiplied while others decreased, not only did their numbers grow, but their quality improved as well.
However, Colin didn’t see the few elite ‘Red Moon’ followers who had just fled; he didn’t know where they had gone. Protected by the power of the ‘Red Moon’, he couldn’t track them effectively by any means…
But although he couldn’t easily leave the mountainside to avoid a dishonorable sneak attack on his base, that didn’t mean he couldn’t interfere with the situation below.
He occasionally struck from a distance at the edge of the cliff, targeting troublesome individuals to aid the retreat of thousands of employees.
“Clang! Clang! Clang!”
A distant and ancient sound came from behind, and when Colin turned around, he saw the tightly shut gates slowly opening like a pair of outstretched hands.
The ‘Mist Gate’ had formed!
“Hurry up and go!” Colin, seeing some employees who were seeing this gate for the first time hesitating, immediately urged them on.
Hearing his words, some employees entered without objections.
Once there was a leader, the others quickly followed suit.
Seeing this, Colin swept a glance over the crowd, confirming nothing inappropriate had slipped in, then looked back down to the fray.
“More people make the retreat quite troublesome, but luckily this mountain is still a no-fly zone for now. If not, it would be a bit of a hassle. Also, there are more D Level Personnel than I expected, feels like a hundred or even two hundred?”
While looking at the various internal organs, brains, eyes, limbs, weapons, clothes, and even resurrected dentures fluttering in mid-air, influenced by the power of the Red Moon, Colin unconcernedly picked up a stone from the ground, swung it in a circle, and hurled it down the mountain to kill or drive away some bothersome enemies.
Meanwhile, at the foot of the mountain, company employees also carried out their tasks in an orderly manner.
“All D Level Personnel, carefully guard the respawn points, prioritize the evacuation of all E level and Below employees, then retreat!”
“Damn it, help me, my doll girlfriend has come alive and run off…”
“Damn it, there’s no talking sense to these steely second-dimensional types. Just revive and retreat quickly instead of dawdling. Missing a doll won’t kill you. My brand new PS5 got lost and I didn’t fuss about it!”
“Why did you bring a PS5 to a battle?”
“Shut the hell up! Focus on defense! Focus on completing the task!”
On the battlefield, D Level Personnel cooperated with each other to repel the invading enemies.
The only good news now is that the Heretic Alliance, thanks to Brother Shunzi’s success, has been shaken to the core.
Otherwise, it would be quite troublesome to orderly withdraw personnel scattered across the battlefield.
But just then, within the heretic ranks, a determined voice rang out…
“Fight on! Is it just because of a setback here that you want to give up everything?!”
“The long struggle has only just begun!”
“We haven’t truly failed yet! Believe me, even if the Bonfire’s cage comes again, as long as there is resistance, we cannot say there’s no hope of breaking it!”
A strong being with Divine power present in his body shouted, his power surging.
Facing the gaze of numerous Different Races, he clenched both fists to his chest and spoke out loud.

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - 407 378 The Great Retreat of Mist Gate (9.2K
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 407: Chapter 378: The Great Retreat of “Mist Gate”! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_4 Chapter 407: Chapter 378: The Great Retreat of “Mist Gate”! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_4 “Don’t you want to return to that era of freedom? The era where we could freely raise human livestock, where sacrifices could be made on the streets at will, where one could leave their home to capture blood food anytime?”
“Are you willing to let humanity’s future fall into the hands of the ‘Red Moon’, or to be buried in the hands of these fire-obsessed maniacs!?”
“For the continuation of all mankind, for the ascension promised by the Master! To survive the disaster that has yet to come… We must unite once again!”
The voice of this cultist was exceptionally infectious, instantly igniting the fighting spirit in the hearts of many members of the Heretic Alliance.
Moreover, his words were peculiarly eerie; a seemingly identical phrase, when heard by different people, conveyed different messages.
Some heard the call to fight for the Master, others for freedom, and yet others for the survival of humanity…
Whether demons, cultists, or some other strange beings, all heard messages that excited them.
On the mountainside, Colin heard these beguiling and bewitching words and quickly identified a rather odd person among the enemies, one without a trace of life…
“A dead person talking?”
No…
This was no simple dead man.
Colin noticed an intangible, immaterial thing lying on this powerful enemy.
The intuitive spiritual feedback…
Seemed to be a red-glowing rat?
And that person, in the midst of a fervent gesticulation and spittle-flecked “speech,” the nearly imperceptible “rat” on his head mimicked the same movement.
Or more accurately, the “rat” was manipulating the corpse to make the same gestures.
However, without much thought, Colin saw that under its crude oratory, the once demoralized alliance of different races and heretics burst forth with fighting spirit once again…
“The ‘Flame Bearer’ hasn’t appeared yet, we haven’t failed, there’s still a chance! Go for it! Kill as many as we can! Since we arrived here, I never expected to return alive!”
“We only wanted to raise a few hundred million humans for bloodstock, and for that, we faced the ruthless onslaught of the bonfire people, nearly wiping out our kind in the process, I want revenge!!”
“To return humanity to the right path, it’s our inescapable duty!”
“Even the Followers of the ‘Red Moon’ seem to have stopped attacking us, unite and charge!”
“Reclaim sovereignty over this Star Domain! Let humanity be reborn from destruction!”
“To free ourselves from a fate of enslavement and exploitation…”
“…”
Under the influence of various invisible forces, amidst the multitude of war cries, the monsters launched a resolute charge once again…
Some cultists noticed something wasn’t quite right…
For example, weren’t those who were shouting dead already?
How could the dead speak?
Though puzzled, caught in the forming torrent of collective spirit, they “numbly” joined the masses in attacking the enemies at the foot of the mountain.
At this moment, the pressure on everyone in the area had grown tremendously!
Many employees were ambushed midway and entered a revival readout…
On the battlefield, at least one-fifth of the people had not retreated, a vast majority of whom were the stronger D Level staff!
Seeing this situation, Colin, even though he was still not joining the fray, continuously increased his support, creating various large high-heat, high-pressure fireballs and smashing them towards those below.
There were “Revolver Reverser,” the “Flame Bearer’s” original extracted grease, the “Flame Bearer’s” heart, and some of the knowledge inherited from them…
His control over flames had achieved a new level of improvement.
Each time a fireball fell, it would blast a huge crater and inflict substantial damage on a swath of enemies…
Some enemies, hit directly by the fireballs, even had their revival red light ignited.
A few minutes later, all E Level and below personnel had returned to behind the defensive line formed by the desperately fighting D Level Personnel.
Just wait for the last of the personnel to revive, and they would be able to retreat completely.
“One more minute! The final batch of personnel will all revive! This round of people is our limit, if there are more, we won’t be able to cope, and then this ‘revival point’ will be cancelled… Pay attention to coordinate the retreat, be extremely cautious, don’t die again!”
“Life Mentor Adorable” reminded everyone through some special artifacts: “Even though we can revive after three months if we die… it’s better not to.”
As his voice fell, another batch of people was reborn from the bonfire.
It was at this moment that the pillars of heavenly flames dispersing from the bodies of the “Son of Cruelty,” “Little Chicken No. 7,” and several others.
They finally could move again…
But it was right after the dispersal of the firelight that a rich darkness surged forth.
It was like a thin veil that covered the dozens of D Level Personnel and a significant number of other personnel…
“What is this?!”
Within the veil of darkness, the enveloped employees felt an instant darkness surrounding them, descending into profound silence, from which disturbing rustling noises arose, inducing extreme unease…
“Damn it! We’re… trapped,” an employee said in fear and despair.
There was no response…
Though just moments before, multiple comrades had been less than half a meter away, they were now isolated.
In this darkness, any source of light was erased, everyone could feel a chilling cold, and as the body temperature plummeted, it felt as if life itself was slipping away with the dropping heat…
If they died here, they might not truly die, but who knows when they could live again…

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - 408 378 Mist Gate Great Retreat (9.2K huge
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 408: Chapter 378 “Mist Gate” Great Retreat! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_5 Chapter 408: Chapter 378 “Mist Gate” Great Retreat! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_5 Outside the dark curtain, due to a breach here, a group of C Level cultists broke through the encirclement, preparing to charge the retreating employees and leave more people on this battlefield.
“This dark curtain feels somewhat familiar, a bit like the one at Ao Island, and also reminds me of the night under ‘World Code-13’. Overall, it seems to be a pretty powerful artifact, but… is it coming for me?”
Colin stood on the edge of the cliff, his expression unchanging, as he vaguely sensed.
Some enemies hidden behind the scenes were forcing him down the mountain…
This mountain, in essence, was the remnants of a powerful and ancient being, and that C Level Personnel had said that he and the other had perished together, their consciousnesses melding…
It’s hard to say whether the other had left any tricks behind, waiting here for the ‘clean-up crew’ for so many years.
So it was normal for those guys not to dare to come up the mountain…
With this kind of intuitive sensing, the most rational decision obviously would be to give up and sacrifice a small number of people, to avoid accidents, since among those present, his “value” was undoubtedly the greatest.
But…
“Today, I’m going to take everyone with me, and I will see who dares to stop me!”
A fierce and magnificent blaze of fire rose from the edge of the cliff and then suddenly plummeted down, tearing apart everything that stood in its path on the way.
The very next moment, as if a meteor had struck the ground, Colin joined the battlefield!
Boom…
The land was smashed into a huge crater, the ground trembled incessantly, and within the explosive range of the flames, many bizarre shapes were burned to ashes…
And on the melting ground, Colin’s figure slowly emerged.
At this moment, above his head, the heart rose on its own, continuously spewing out flames, igniting everything around him.
Even the strange black mist was rapidly evaporating in the firelight.
Among them, some employees who had thought themselves doomed to die, their faces filled with despair, also saw a streak of firelight, like a hot knife through butter, melting away the black curtain that had rendered them helpless…
At the same time, everyone present could hear Brother Shunzi’s voice coming from afar.
“All personnel, retreat. I’ll cover the rear!”
Even as he spoke, after Colin had landed in the battlefield, besides feeling the gaze of the ‘False Mighty One’ receiving attention from both allies and enemies, garnering a great deal of acknowledgment, which rapidly increased his own strength,
he also sensed an array of powerful gazes that seemed to have been hidden for a long time, coming from all directions…
In Colin’s mind, three eerie figures dressed in torn rags and holding scythes emerged.
They seemed light and airy, as if they had existed in this area for a long time without showing themselves, and the aura they emitted was much stronger than that of the Divine Angels he had encountered before.
Their strength was at least at the level of a Level 2 Containment Subject…
Even without utilizing “Divine” powers, their combat prowess was still very formidable!
At the same time, behind Colin’s head, the heart spit out a streak of flame.
Invisible inspiration emerged…
“‘Bonfire Hunter’?”
Colin glanced at these beings and then at the ‘The Rat’ giving a speech, his chin lifted slightly, his eyes brimming with flames as he mocked:
“You know you can’t beat him, so you’re afraid to face him, and that’s why you’re trying to force me down with such a tactic?”
In response to his words, these beings did not reply, but ‘The Rat’ perched on a parasitized corpse opened its mouth, emitting an alluring whisper.
“You’re lucky, and very domineering, but in front of the Mother, it means nothing…”
“Everything returning to the ‘Red Moon’ Mother is a natural law, an unstoppable trend!”
“Now, if you can bring the ‘Primordial Fire’ will to submission, I can, on behalf of the Mother, grant you one outrageous request, which is…”
“To allow you to return to Her Nest as a special being, and then come forth as the Saint Heir…” (Note: 1)
“To become Her envoy in the world before Her full resurrection, receiving Her boundless indulgence and love…”“In Her Nest, there will always be a place for you…”
“…”
‘Is something wrong with my ears to hear such blasphemy…’
Colin remained silent upon hearing these words, sensing the tone of “this is your honor” within the speech, and couldn’t help but think that the cultist was indeed mad…
Merely hearing the surface meaning of this speech was enough to give him goosebumps…
Immediately, with a “snap,”
Colin snapped his fingers, and the eerie whisper burnt away to nothing as the flame consumed it.
“It seems, you have rejected the Mother’s kindness…”
The unseen ‘The Rat’ made its last utterance.
No sooner had the words faded, the ground began to writhe as if it had come to life. As Colin was about to make his move, a ‘Bonfire Hunter’ floating in mid-air like a specter suddenly produced a bloody ear.
Then, using a dagger wrapped in talismanic script, it stabbed down.
The next second, all over Colin’s body, a multitude of wounds appeared, and from within them, eerie writings like maggots emerged, seemingly trying to envelop him…
“A curse? Damn it, was it you who secretly cut off one of my ears?”
Flames kept burning on Colin’s body, consuming the ‘writings’ to ashes.
Just then, the writhing ground, countless flying organs in the sky, various curses, and both visible and hidden attacks were approaching at the same time, seemingly eager to take Colin down quickly…
“That is… Brother Shunzi, be careful!”
Among the numerous assaults, the most shocking for everyone was the writhing and converging red light at the pinnacle of clouds turning into a tendril of flesh that hung from the heavens like an umbilical cord or a tentacle…
Upon it, a dreadful Red Light was gestating!

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - 409 378 The Great Retreat of Mist Gate (9.2K
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 409: Chapter 378: The Great Retreat of “Mist Gate”! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_6 Chapter 409: Chapter 378: The Great Retreat of “Mist Gate”! (9.2K, huge chapter!)_6 Some Bonfire Employees merely witnessing the scene felt reborn within, bombarded with countless thoughts, finding it troublesome to even suppress them, let alone offer any practical help to Brother Shunzi.
However…
“Don’t worry, I’ll leave in one piece. There’s no way I’ll stay here.”
After Colin spoke, he looked ahead and dragged out a replica of the Plain Han Sword from the “Storage Room”:
“Afraid of him but not of me, you truly don’t take me seriously…”
“My sword, too, has never been dull!”
Veins on his right hand emerged, facing an onslaught akin to a tsunami. Countless flames surged from the heart behind him and converged upon the blade.
He opened his mouth, and as he swung fiercely, he bellowed:
“Sky Light Fall!”
Shouting the ability’s name didn’t enhance the attack’s power, but…
How could a qualified ‘Flame Bearer’ not have a technique that could be shouted out loud?
The next moment.
Boom!
A burst of perpetual daylight seemed to explode at that instant.
Majestic and scorching flames swept forward like a fearsome sandstorm of fire, engulfing everything on the battlefield, and within the flames, a longsword ablaze with fire struck the “umbilical cord.”
In an instant, the hanging umbilical cord ignited and burst apart.
The enemies caught in the path of the fiery storm vanished under this one strike…
The vast battlefield was strewn with casualties…
“How can this be…”
“The, the umbilical cord of rebirth was cut? Impossible, absolutely impossible!”
“This completely surpasses a normal Divine Envoy’s power. Why wasn’t he attacked?!”
“It’s over, we’re going to be captured and exploited again…”
The surviving members of the Heretic Alliance, seeing the shattered world before them, murmured in shock and despair, losing all will to act.
At the foot of the mountain, Colin alone held off countless enemies, and after that move, his figure staggered slightly.
Yet, at that moment, no one dared to come forward…
“C Level Personnel Brother was right, I may not be very strong, but… my use of artifacts is top-notch.”
Gazing at the ravaged battlefield, Colin touched the blood on his face and smiled.
Though he might need to lie down for a while after returning, perhaps even suffer from sequelae…
But as long as he didn’t die, nothing else mattered.
Afterward, he took out the “Mountain of Smiling Corpses,” letting this fleshy mound pounce across the battlefield, accurately finding an ear cut in half and lying on the ground, picking it up before hopping back to Colin…
And presented his lost ear with its tongue.
However, looking at the ear licked clean by saliva, Colin’s mouth twitched, feeling that this creature seemed to have sneakily slurped it a few times on the way back, as all the blood was gone…
But he didn’t dwell on it, instead, Colin reattached his ear and then pulled a Bone Spur from his pocket, forcefully stabbing it into a certain direction in the air.
A hidden Bonfire Hunter was instantly pierced, screaming before bursting into countless black droplets…
Colin then turned to the bizarre races and said, “Instead of watching me, you should think about how you’re going to deal with the Followers of the ‘Red Moon’…
“They might also have the idea to stop me, but their goal, I’m afraid, is not just to stop us…”
“What do you mean?” Some slow-witted Cultists failed to understand.
But Colin did not pay attention to these voices. With a forceful swing of the Bone Spur in his hand, a flame blade spread outwards, carving a horizontal fissure a hundred meters long on the surface of the earth…
“Those who pursue me, die!”
As he spoke, Colin turned and walked toward the Mist Gate halfway up the mountain.
Countless figures hidden in the shadows, their red lights eying that seemingly defenseless back, were itching to move…
But ultimately, upon glancing at the boundary on the ground…
They chose to give up.
After all…
Just as Colin had seen through and said, their goal was not entirely about stopping the emergence of the ‘Flame Bearer’.
Unlike those persecuted, they weren’t particularly afraid of the ‘Flame Bearer’…
However, since there would be no more profit in continuing here,
All the figures glowing with red light then turned their attention to the remaining beings.
Especially those powerful bodies of Demons in reality…
All of them were biomass, and it made no difference which one was recycled.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - 410 379 Return and The Sealed Right Hand._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 410: Chapter 379: Return and “The Sealed Right Hand”._1 Chapter 410: Chapter 379: Return and “The Sealed Right Hand”._1 After stepping through the Mist Gate, wisps of fog curled around him, like pairs of soft hands…
All around him, apart from the thick fog, nothing could be seen.
The thousands of employees who had just entered were nowhere to be seen…
In the midst of the fog, Colin’s expression gradually became somewhat vacant as he stood still, unmoving.
But just then…
“Dong— Dong— Dong—”
The eternal and ancient sound of a bell echoed from deep within the mist.
It was only then that Colin seemed to snap out of it, moving toward the source of the sound.
Soon, he saw a “sun” suspended above his head, not very large, but the flames that fell from it were far more fierce than its size would suggest…
