At the same time, Colin saw many strange things evaporating from his body.
There were bizarre texts that screamed as they burned…
There were various kinds of strange lights…
And the most abundant among them was a vermillion light that squirmed as if it were alive.
“Even though I was incased in flame, I was unconsciously affected by many things.”
Colin’s face was vacant, basking in the light, muttering to himself.
It was only when nothing more seemed to emit from his body that he saw a ball of flame fly out from within him and merge into the great fire…
Intuition told Colin that this was something important.
However, before he could ponder further, a bell tolled from an unknown place.
In an instant, during a momentary daze, his vision suddenly darkened.
“I’m back…”
Colin shook his head vigorously and then opened his eyes to see the familiar ceiling.
Propping himself up on his elbows, he sat up and stared blankly at the scenery in his bedroom.
Screaming was still echoing in his ears, or perhaps he could also see the faces of powerful beings, resolute as they rushed at him to self-destruct…
This battle, aside from the bizarre demons and ghosts above, might not have been the highest-level battle he had participated in, but it was certainly the one with the most frequent fights…
From beginning to end, and especially when breaking through the encirclement, he was targeted by a large group of enemies.
The relentless attacks did not cease…
He himself had been seriously injured, but had forcibly persevered—at least, if those aliens had truly caught up to him, he felt he might not have been able to continue fighting.
So it could be said that it was all a bluff.
Nevertheless, he had thought he would have to lie immobile in bed for some time upon returning.
But this notion clearly underestimated the company…
Other than feeling a bit tired, Colin felt no other abnormalities in his body.
“Phew!”
After zoning out for a few more minutes, Colin’s thoughts gradually calmed, and he took a deep breath before he truly “returned.”
He glanced at the time: December 22nd, 7 PM.
“I entered on the 20th, the time I spent there was about two days as well, so it seems the task time ratio this time is one-to-one.”
“Hmm, I wonder how the battle above is going now, whether the company side has withdrawn.”
While Colin thought about this, he took out the parchment, eager to unfold it.
Soon, on the spread-out yellowed paper, he saw the comprehensive evaluation of this mission.
[In this event, your evaluation is: A.]
[You have completed this event with outstanding performance.]
[The following is the settlement of your rewards after this event: “Bonfire Points*87351”, “Advanced Talent Extraction Ticket*1”, “Advanced Item Extraction Ticket*2”, “Golden Clearance Certificate*9”, “‘Chaotic Phantom Train’ Specific Item Draw Ticket*1”.]
[All items have been transferred to the “Storage Room”, please check.]
…
“Plain and simple points, guaranteed green talents and guaranteed purple quality items, nine Gold Mission Vouchers are good, eh, ‘Chaotic Phantom Train’ specific item acquisition?”
Colin wondered at the end of the reward settlement.
Quickly, he remembered that as long as one could pass through the fifth carriage, one could receive a specific item.
“This is indeed nice…”
Colin stroked his chin, recalling what he had encountered.
Most of the attacking items those people held were average at best; they couldn’t even compare to many F Level hands in terms of quality…
Just like “Son of Cruelty” managing to hold out in the first few carriages, where out of a ten-fold contribution, seven was due to the defensive street dance item, merely three due to his own merit, and the rest was all thanks to him.
“Nothing but trash who rely solely on items for tricks!”
Colin made an objective assessment.
“Defensive items seem to be no good either, as for functional ones, there are decent ones, but they seem to be lacking in level… I still need to choose one with healing BUFF effects…”
When it came to healing items, the train crew’s level of items markedly improved.
After all…
Currently, only a few company employees had similar items, so having any at all was outstanding.
Having formulated some ideas, Colin was in no rush to start choosing right away.
After the comprehensive score dissipated, another prompt appeared.
[Congratulations, you have completed this round’s promotion task…]
[Your Authority Level within the company has been adjusted from “E” to “D”. Your corporate privileges will be updated. Here are the details of changes—]
[“Storage Room”: 300 liters increased to 1000 liters (1 cubic meter).]
[“Personal Profile”: “Talent Grid” → “Talent Grid*2”]
[“Personal Profile”: Adds “Skill Grid”.]
[“Trading Area – Storefront”: Available items for purchase increased, for details please open “Storefront” to view.]
[You have received one “D Level Item Draw Coupon”.]
…
“Finally, the Storage Room is expanded again…”
Colin’s eyes swept over the information; now with this space, he could bring even more items.
However, if going to “World Code-13″…

chapters.title: Chapter 411 - 411 379 Return and The Sealed Right Hand._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 411: Chapter 379: Return and “The Sealed Right Hand”._2 Chapter 411: Chapter 379: Return and “The Sealed Right Hand”._2 The one cubic meter of space to carry items seemed insufficient to feed the ever-growing number of Bonfire Followers.
“I remember Li Ming and his trio from the Other World,” he recalled, “they had mentioned that they were going to level up from Temporary G Level to F Level this week or next, right?”
Colin remembered that these people had mentioned during their last mission that they could upgrade after one more visit to “World Code-13”.
But it seemed that leveling up only increased the space from 10 liters to 100 liters, which wasn’t too significant.
‘I wonder if the parchment will unlock features like chat channels after they level up…’
Colin remembered that their parchment only had the Store and the “Storage Room”, nothing else.
He guessed it would improve after leveling up…
Without thinking too much about it, Colin opened his “Personal Profile” and took a glance.
In addition to a new “Talent Grid”, he also had a new option for “Skill”.
“There are three ways to obtain it. The first is to spend One Thousand Points for self-enlightenment. Usually, the thing you’re most skilled and used to would become a ‘Skill’, but if I’m already familiar with it, why bother…”
“The second way is through drawing with a voucher or buying from someone else. Like item drawings, vouchers can only be obtained upon completing a mission. As for buying it from someone else, I don’t seem to see anyone selling, and it seems the selling requirements are not low…”
“The third way, if you’re sufficiently familiar with someone else, there’s also a chance to directly steal one of their skills. That’s somewhat interesting, but the stealing chance is pretty low. It’s the hardest method among the three, so it’s not that meaningful…”
“However, once it becomes a ‘Skill’, it can be used regardless of the physical condition and launched directly without any cost. That’s pretty good. And if the ‘Skill’ doesn’t fit, you can switch it without any cost. I’ll check later if anyone is selling it…”
Colin somewhat understood the details of this thing.
In his view, the biggest advantage was the possibility of acquiring a method he wouldn’t normally be able to learn without any cost.
With this in mind, “Skill” was not entirely without its merits.
After thinking it through, Colin tried spending One Thousand Points. Quickly, he saw many points of light flying from his body and converging into the empty “Skill Grid” on his “Personal Profile”.
The entire “Skill Grid” trembled more and more violently, as if something was taking shape.
“Not to mention anything else, the company has always been meticulous with the special effects they provide for these inconsequential areas.”
His instinct told Colin that these effects were sometimes superfluous.
However, he didn’t dwell on it. After about three seconds, a skill named “Crisis Sensing” appeared in his retinas.
“Ah, this…”
Colin’s mouth fell open, stunned for a moment. With “Fatal Insight” already in his possession,
what use was this thing?
“No wait, this is an active skill. It can actively provide feedback, giving information about all threatening entities within a three-hundred-meter radius around me, complementary to ‘Fatal Insight’. It’s like radar…”
“Can be used once every thirty minutes…”
After a careful examination of the content, Colin suddenly felt that the One Thousand Points were somewhat worth it.
The actual effect was yet to be determined, but the range of its effectiveness was quite broad…
Colin decided to use it immediately, and he soon sensed something akin to a radar map forming in his mind, showing all potentially threatening entities within a few hundred meters around him.
It was only a fuel tanker that was passing by at quite a distance…
There were none that posed a real threat.
“Not bad, at the very least it can be used as a mini-map…”
Colin refocused, opened the “Storage Room”, and took a peek inside.
The entire space had expanded several times over.
It could now hold many more items…
But just as he had only glanced at it, his facial expression suddenly turned somewhat unsightly.
“The ‘False Powerhouse’ is almost completely damaged, ‘Smiling Mountain of Corpses’ has lost about thirty percent of its integrity, and all the rest, except for those above orange quality, have issues with their integrity, hiss, even the ‘Analytical Lens’ I used once is broken?”
“Wait, the ‘Yukionna’ ring…where’s ‘Yukionna’?!”
“It’s gone?”
Colin was startled, taking out the slightly broken ring and infusing it with his spiritual sense.
“Yukionna” did not appear as she used to…
And she did not suddenly emerge to blast him with a breath of cold air.
It was as if…she was gone?
The “Yukionna” ring was a bit different from other items; “Yukionna” existed by relying on human nature. If her human nature had been extinguished in the previous battle, then…
The effect of the item might still be there, but the entity that would come out would perhaps only be a creature restricted by the “Containment Protocol” to item form, and no longer “Yukionna”…
Just as a chill went through Colin’s heart, a slice of cold air came through, allowing him to breathe a sigh of relief.
Yesterday, no, his actions from earlier were too extreme, causing “Yukionna” to be overly exhausted and currently sleeping…
“Slept like the dead, scared me for a second.”
Colin let out a sigh of relief, had a brief chat with the “Yukionna” inside to make sure everything was alright, then gave a few “Colorless Crystals” and stored them in the “Storage Room.”
After that, he glanced at his other gear.
“Besides a few common white items that are completely ruined, everything else can be fixed, it’ll just cost a bit of money, twenty to thirty thousand points plus some Silver Task Certificates…”
Colin opened each piece of information to check and felt there wasn’t a big issue.
The one thing he had in abundance now was money, and anything that could be solved with money wasn’t really a problem.
However, Colin soon noticed something…
“Where has my heart gone?”
Colin had suddenly realized that after entering the Mist Gate, the heart he had stored in the “Storage Room” was gone.
He scanned the vast space carefully…
Gone…
The large “Flame Bearer” heart he had placed there was missing!
But then, an image came to his mind…
The image was of the moment after he entered the Mist Gate and saw that flame, his heart had leaped out on its own and merged into the “sun-like” flame.
“Damn, taking my stuff while I’m not in my right state…”
Colin’s eyes widened.
This… giving it up wasn’t impossible, but after giving it up, the deal wouldn’t be the same as it was for this mission!
A mere few tens of thousands of points, how could that possibly buy his “Flame Bearer” heart?
If that thing were turned into an item, it would start at least at orange quality!
“I have served the company, I have bled for the company…”
Colin murmured helplessly, but then, a message bright as a flame appeared in his mind, bringing him a little peace.
The heart was only taken to extract some information…
Soon enough, it could return to his side.
“Apart from that, the ‘Nameplate’ seems to have been claimed by the company as well, but that’s not a big deal.”
Colin was fairly confident in the company’s reliability.
Generally, what they said they could do…
He was just afraid of what they didn’t say.
Colin then looked at the three different kinds of extraction tickets. He wasn’t in a hurry to draw; he was no longer who he used to be and would not rush to use something right away, especially since it was evening, and drawing at night wasn’t as good as during the day—
Odd indeed.
“Activate the ‘Advanced Item Extraction Ticket’!”
Colin decisively used one of them.
Quickly, a glimmer of orange light appeared.
The smile hadn’t fully formed on Colin’s lips before it turned a bit strange…
[Name: “Special Card: The Sealed Right Hand”]
[Quality: Rare.]
[Status: Stable (76% completeness)]
[Energy Level: B+ Class.]
[Effect Description: This item is a special item, normally used as part of the “Card Divine Kingdom” to carry out “Time Freeze,” “Time Acceleration,” “Time Reversal,” and other “time series” within the “Containment Protocol – Item Liberation.”]
[Without possessing any “time series” cards, this item cannot be used independently.]
[Remark: It is one of the essential conditions for “Item Liberation” of the “time series.” A Bonfire Company item inventor, Mr. Kattu, who prefers to remain anonymous, stated: It’s a rather unique item, if unsealed, and conditions permit, it can control the power of time within a certain range. Believe me, it won’t disappoint you.]
[Note: For every minute this item is used, at least one percent of its completeness will be consumed.]
[—Repair condition: For every 1% of completeness, one thousand points are required for repair, with the completeness able to be enhanced up to 95%.]
[This item has been transferred into the “Storage Room,” please check.]
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - 412 380 Containment Protocol Item Liberation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 412: Chapter 380 “Containment Protocol ‘Item Liberation'” Feature Unlocked!_1 Chapter 412: Chapter 380 “Containment Protocol ‘Item Liberation'” Feature Unlocked!_1 “As a ‘Time Stasis’ ‘Item Liberation’ to use? No wonder I couldn’t liberate it before, so it was lacking this thing? Does this mean that I can now liberate Golden Artifacts?”
Colin picked up the card and glanced at it…
Its style was similar to “Time Stasis” and “Force Repulsion.”
Only, the name was orange.
And the main pattern on the card was a right hand with fingers spread, wrapped in various chains and aflame.
What’s more, within the palm of the hand, one could vaguely make out three simplistic patterns…
One was a clockwise semicircle with an arrow, another was a counterclockwise semicircle with an arrow, and within the semicircles were hour, minute, and second hands moving in different directions…
And there was an “X” symbol.
Etched in the center of the palm, they seemed to imply complete control.
“Tick-tock, tick-tock, tick-tock…”
Whenever Colin focused on any one of the patterns, it was as if the illusory sound of moving hands appeared near his ears, and he could feel that something was off with the sense of time.
Looking at the clockwise one sped things up, counterclockwise was rewinding, and “X” was stasis…
“It only affects the viewer, no problem with the alarm clock or anything.”
Colin glanced at the electronic clock and found no change in time, so this should be similar to the sensory disruption experienced when using “Time Stasis” too much…
Thereafter, Colin excitedly took out “Time Stasis,” planning to test it right away.
Such a high-level artifact, even if only one percent of it was liberated, its power would probably be unimaginable!
But just as he started operating it, he discovered that it seemed to be a no-go.
“What’s the matter… Huh?”
It was then that Colin noticed the detailed note on “Special Card: The Sealed Right Hand”…
“A necessary condition for use… number one? Does this mean there are other conditions required?”
He’s all set to go, only to end up with this?
Colin shook his head, slightly disappointed, and put the items away again.
“The conditions for liberating Golden Artifacts are much harder than I thought. Watching other people liberate their artifacts, they just had to say a word, and it was done… hold on…”
Colin’s eyebrows shot up as he suddenly thought of something crucial.
‘There are D Level staff around now, just from looking at the battlefield before, there were a few hundred, and many D Level players have two or even three Purple Gears…’
‘On average, each D Level Personnel probably has two Purple Items, right?’
‘But from the battlefield just now, among so many people, I didn’t see anyone with an artifact in a liberated state…’
While his thoughts flickered, Colin couldn’t help but doubt something.
Does the “Containment Protocol – Item Liberation” feature still exist today?
It couldn’t possibly be lost or in a state of repair like the “Gene Compensation Panel,” could it?
After thinking for a dozen seconds, Colin let out a long sigh, considering the state of the company… the odds weren’t low.
Looking at the few extraction tickets in the “Storage Room,” he lost all desire for them.
Then…
“‘Advanced Item Extraction Ticket’ activated!”
Colin decided to take another draw, and then he saw a blush of Purple Gear appear before his eyes: “Just Purple Gear? No, no, this Purple Gear seems a bit special.”
Within the Purple light, rows and rows of related information surfaced.
[Name: “Automatic Base Vehicle”]
[Quality: Excellent.]
[Status: Still usable (33% intact)]
[Energy Level: D Class.]
[Effect Description: A functional truck that, when unfolded, covers an area of about 300 square meters and includes modules for “Command Room,” “Light Industrial Factory Workshop,” “Kitchen,” “Radar,” “Automatic Defensive Firepower,” ‘Mineral Processing,’ “Medical Ward”…]
[Effect “Intelligent Work Servant”: 50 Points to summon for seven days use, current maximum limit (0/2).]
[Effect “Special Portable Modification”: Each time it’s stored in the “Storage Room,” 1,000 Points are required for “Portability” and upon folding up, all living things inside will be forcibly expelled.]
[Note: A limited-edition luxury civilian model handcrafted by the renowned Heavy Industry World, Fourth Box Garden Northland Heavy Industries…]
[This model consistently makes it into the company’s annual sales ranking first place! Only 0.1 Point consumption per thousand kilometers, environmentally friendly! Super idiot-proof operation, no driving license needed, even a three-year-old infant can smoothly operate it! The first choice for employees traveling to pioneer in Other Worlds! Now with trillion-dollar subsidies! Instant kill in pioneering seasons, desire isn’t as good as action, hurry and place your order, and if you buy now, you also get a free adjustable maid (or butler)…]
[— Pay 14,354 Points can restore status to 85%, increase the “Intelligent Work Servant” limit to 5, expand covered area to 500 meters, enable “Burden Transport” Skill, open “Self-Destruct” Skill…]
…
“Ah, this…”
Colin looked at the palm-sized base vehicle in his hand, and at the introduction above, he was momentarily bewildered.
Every section of the information above could be expanded upon, very meticulously.
It was also by far the most detailed introduction Colin had ever seen; it just felt a bit less serious.
“This note feels like an advertisement, and all these explanations… really, the lower the quality of the artifact, the more it’s decked out in bells and whistles… but, the item really is a good one.”
After reading it through, Colin confirmed that it was a functional item.
For an employee like him, who enters and exits Other Worlds from time to time, it indeed was a good thing.
But, for those homebody employees who stick to Earth and don’t move around like a territorial spirit, it seemed a bit superfluous.

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - 413 380
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 413: 380 Chapter 413: 380 “It looks like the people of ‘World Code-13’ are in luck, they should be able to harvest a bunch of faith, no, rescue more innocent civilians. Speaking of which, my ‘Colorless Crystals’ are also running out.”
Colin quickly thought about its use scenarios, feeling that it was a pity to be a bit slow.
If only this had come a month or half a month earlier…
“The next entry time is on the 25th, but speaking of that place, the key issue is still the lack of people.”
Colin rubbed his forehead, it had been those same three people for a long time.
He could imagine how they would complain next time they went in…
However, given the current situation, he could only push the employees harder, draw some more big pictures, and promise to hand out some items like Gene Compensation Medicine.
“Add a bit more, this is the ‘company values you, that’s why it gives you such an important task’ kind of talk?”
Stroking his chin, Colin gave it some thought and then refocused his attention.
Next, he used the remaining “D Level Item Draw Coupon” and the “Advanced Talent Extraction Ticket.”
“Green Talent ‘100℃ Body Temperature’? This… this is freaking useless… I’m running a fever now, and it’s definitely over a hundred degrees…”
“Green Named Item ‘Cough Blood Greatsword’, draws blood from friends and foes, turning it into sword energy for slashes, and has a few special skills that consume blood… not very useful… but it can be used when drawing big pictures for Li Ming and the others.”
Looking at the two items, Colin shook his head and sighed.
Then came the last coupon…
“The Disordered Ghost Train” designated item retrieval.
Colin used the coupon, and a long list of items appeared on his retina.
“‘Dawn Blade’…”
“‘Blue Soul Entangled’…”
“‘Demon Calos’s Hand’…”
“‘Precision Strike’…”
….
“Eh, that Demon Sword ‘Phantom Witch’ isn’t on the list? That’s good too, otherwise if it were selectable, the plot would seem a bit off…”
Remembering the “Phantom Witch’s” obsessive love for that employee, and then suddenly becoming someone else’s property…
Colin cast aside some thoughts in his mind.
Then, his gaze swept over the hundreds of purple and green pieces of gear…
“As expected, not a single piece of orange gear, but this one looks good, and this one looks good too…”
“Ah, it’s a pity, you can’t have them all…”
After pondering for quite a while, Colin finally picked his prize, an item named “Mark of the Fire Tree” from an employee’s possession.
It appeared as a tattoo mark, and when used, it could summon a burnt flame-like anomaly, providing the summoner with a continuous healing effect as long as there was something to feed the flame…
Putting aside other effects, just the healing alone was more than three times that of “Gluttony Power Mark.”
“Colorless Crystals can burn too, with a high conversion rate, pretty good. The only negative effect is, to bind with it, you first have to subdue it in some dream before you can use it…”
“Hmm, this bully’s approach clearly looks like the company’s style.”
“Once recovered, it’s likely to want to incinerate and assimilate the holder, but it’s not a big problem, the energy level of purple gear is limited, assimilating me is almost impossible…”
Colin nodded in satisfaction, not in a hurry to move right now, and pocketed it.
Closing the “Storage Room,” Colin’s gaze then turned to the “Interactive Hall,” which seemed to be breathing rapidly.
With such a big deal this mission…
The Interactive Hall must be quite lively inside.
Sure enough, just upon entering, he saw every discussion board and chat room in a state of explosive activity.
Messaging flashing by at a frenzied pace…
“Holy shit! Did you guys see Brother Shunzi’s last sword strike? I would call it, a sword that cleaves gods and opens heaven’s gate!”
“I always felt so embarrassed when you guys hyped up Shunzi, we’re all F Level Employees, how strong can you really be? At best, beat a few D Level staff, but now… you useless bunch, didn’t eat enough food, can’t even brag properly?!”
“I declare, Brother Shunzi has now ascended to a ‘father’ figure!”
“Too strong! Too strong! Brother Shunzi is too strong! He doesn’t seem like a mere human at all, beyond understanding, I suspect he’s an undercover alien sent from outside the Solar System…”
“Pure passersby, no flattery, no slander, fair appraisal, doesn’t seem like an Earth person.”
“You’re right! But that’s Brother Shunzi! Thick-skinned, powerful, with Time Stop, instant kill abilities, healing methods, and almost no visible cooldowns, like a cockroach that can’t be killed, and when things get tough, he can even explode his Microcosm, once the Microcosm explodes it’s just aaaahhh!!!!”
“So frustrating, I was executing a task at the time and couldn’t make it…”
“That’s your loss then, you didn’t get to see Brother Shunzi and me fighting side by side, slaughtering countless enemies in a frenzy…”
“Why, why… Even though I’m not in a mission status, they still won’t let me go… I would do it for free, without any compensation…”
“Hahaha, speaking of which, I earned 1800 points from this mission!”
“Only 1800 and you’re bragging? Obviously, you’re an inexperienced little F Level, I got 2500+!”
“Tsk tsk, just passing by with 3000 points…”
“I’ve got 4100 points in the bag!”
“5000…”
“6000…”
“8000…”
“…”
“300 points, got ’em!”
Surrounded by countless perils of the catastrophe mists, Shana was in a good mood as she looked at the points rewarded for completing the mission.
In addition to points, she also received a thousand loaves of black bread—
And not the sour and hard kind!
But the slightly soft and fragrant black bread!
The place they entered for the mission might have been a bit dangerous, but the reward was very good!
Of course, compared to that seemingly normal “Bonfire Agent” with five thousand points, these 300 might seem trivial, but for her, such earnings were quite good…
At least, compared to sudden riches, this stable accumulation of points felt more reassuring.
Just that…
Thinking this, she remembered the place she had previously intervened, the environment there, and wondered how the others were faring.
“I hope all is well.”
With a prayer in her heart, Shana then withdrew her thoughts and cast her gaze towards the distant land enveloped by layers of catastrophe, awaiting rescue.
Here… many people still needed to be saved; she couldn’t stop.
…
“One or two of them, at least they have a good attitude.”
As Colin looked through the various messages, the corners of his mouth curled slightly, finding this group’s mentality to be quite optimistic.
They were able to recover so quickly from the previous battle…
You should know, that last fight wasn’t a game; the enemies didn’t just vanish after they died. The intensity throughout was extreme, with all sorts and sizes of torn flesh and broken corpses everywhere, scenes too brutal and bloody to pass censorship even with pixelation.
In comparison, the “Human Patchwork Monster” dish in the underground labyrinth was child’s play…
Just one glance was enough to give the average person several days’ worth of nightmares.
And yet, these people… at least the majority of them appeared to have no issues, judging by their replies.
After scanning briefly, Colin felt his own morale had also recovered quite a bit.
“Hmm, maybe it also has something to do with that ‘Mist Gate’, perhaps passing through it provides some sort of mental protection?”
Colin recalled the scene at that time.
After emerging, he felt as if his entire body had been cleansed thoroughly, injuries healed, and he returned just as he had departed, free from any lingering troubles.
After watching for a while longer, Colin was about to leave when he suddenly noticed all the messages had stopped moving.
As he wondered what was going on, a golden official announcement emerged on the parchment…
[Announcement: “Parchment” functionality update, “Containment Protocol” Item Liberation’ feature is now available. All qualified employees can apply in writing to activate this effect…]
[Below are the application standards:]
[1. The minimum clearance level to initiate this function is D Level, and each D Level staff may specify one item for the ‘Containment Protocol’ Item Liberation’ effect.]
[2. The item must be of at least “Common (Green)” quality and must be at least 85% intact.]
[3. The specified item must have sufficient proficiency, have 10 times B+ level permissions, or have passed at least 3 tasks at A level or higher, and the item must have played a relatively significant role in such missions for the applicant.]
[Note: The maximum item level that D Level employees can liberate is “Excellent (Purple)”, and “Common (Green)” can be liberated by 30%, “Excellent (Purple)” by 15%.]
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - 414 381 True Revolver Contrarian Item
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 414: Chapter 381: True “Revolver Contrarian” Item Liberation!_1 Chapter 414: Chapter 381: True “Revolver Contrarian” Item Liberation!_1 After the official announcement ended, the stagnant chat channel once again sprang to life.
“Only risqué pictures reign supreme”: “Containment Protocol ‘Item Liberation’? Any D Level bosses care to comment…”
“Big Orange Priority”: Feel pretty average about it, the requirements are too high, I’m D level, I have the right items, but not enough completeness, getting green completeness to 85% requires at least six to seven thousand points, and purple is even more absurd, almost 20,000 and other additional conditions, and in the end, only a 15% upgrade?
“Sea God Bright Moon”: Looking at it this way, it seems a bit of a loss, but I don’t have D level and I’m not considering this…
After reading the messages, some people were pessimistic and felt it was pointless, but those who had experienced it immediately jumped out.
“Lifecoach Kawaii-many”: @Big Orange Priority, damn it, don’t talk nonsense if you don’t know, a 15% liberation doesn’t just mean a 15% improvement! Once that 15% is liberated, the overall enhancement could be two to three times the original item!
“Son of Sadomasochism”: Exactly! Don’t talk crap if you don’t understand, I saw it with my own eyes in the seventh carriage, damn, that liberation was simply terrifying! If it wasn’t for Brother Shunzi and me working together, we might not have made it through…
“Little Chicken No. 7”: Exactly! It’s not just twenty thousand points, even thirty thousand would be worth liberating!
…
After glancing over each message, Colin took another look at his colleagues’ conversation.
To be honest, he also felt it was somewhat trivial…
He had items that met the criteria, just short of completeness, but fixing that was doable, no big issue.
However, there was a limit to purple items.
For an average employee, this might be very powerful, but for him, it seemed a bit pointless.
“Useless for high-level matches, and seeing this, doesn’t it mean that the Golden Card requires at least B Level to use? Then my ‘Sealed Right Hand’ was a waste…”
Colin sighed, but it was at that moment, while he was focusing on that announcement, that a supplemental message suddenly appeared…
[Congratulations, your application has been approved, you have been granted eligibility to join the “Bonfire Excellence Talent Training Program”, upon confirmation of joining, the quality upper limit for your “Containment Protocol ‘Item Liberation'” will be “Rare, 5%”.]
[Please confirm whether to join the “Bonfire Excellence Talent Training Program”.]
“Huh? Excellence Talent Training Program? Just when I felt purple was not good enough, this came out, and isn’t the timing too good? Wait, when did I submit an application? Who submitted it? ‘Lady Bunny’?”
Colin felt like it was like when his download speeds were slow, and suddenly a membership recharge popped up.
But after a moment of confusion, he quickly had a hunch about what it might be.
However…
He was in no hurry to confirm, his gaze fixed on the words “Bonfire Excellence Talent Training Program.”
Soon, more detailed information appeared…
“A training project prepared specifically for reservists who have been nominated as ‘Flame Bearers’, capable of fully mobilizing the initiative of ‘Flame Bearers’… Below are the benefits…”
After reading carefully, Colin felt that the benefits seemed not bad.
“Firstly, in addition to my own one cubic meter of space, I get an additional three cubic meters of extra space…”
“Secondly, each mission comes with an extra excellence talent special subsidy, like bonus points or something? What use are points, I’m already overflowing with them…”
“Thirdly, in cases like the ‘Containment Protocol’, I can get further access, and if someone initiates an ‘Extermination Order’, if the situation permits, I might even get a corner to sit in and give my opinion”
“Oh, just observe, have no right to give opinions…”“…”
“With the comprehensive improvement of benefits, was C Level Elder Brother also part of this program?”
Colin stroked his chin, feeling overall it was good, but some parts seemed slightly off…
For example, after joining the program, his current assignment would no longer be like every employee’s, from one to three times a week, but would be adjusted to a more flexible ‘elastic work system’…
The company details stated that this would allow him more leisure time and freedom.
Colin felt something was off but couldn’t pinpoint what it was…
“It seems like the ‘Descent Project’ is still at the same time… So what’s the point of the flexibility? Isn’t that the only project I have now every week?”
While reading the plan’s content, Colin scratched the back of his head.
Additionally, each mission would now be personally reviewed, tracked throughout, with the company prioritizing them for high-reward, high-quality missions, enjoying exclusive VIP mission treatment different from others!
“This… Missions can actually get some kind of exclusive VIP treatment?”
Colin’s instincts told him there was a catch, but after some thought, he figured the jobs he was currently taking were already full of pitfalls.
One more wouldn’t make much difference…
He probably already had “personal review and full tracking” for his missions; otherwise, there wouldn’t be so much trouble every time…
So he didn’t think much about this point.
“I refuse to believe there could be worse than the ones I’m already taking.”
Colin shook his head, skimmed through the rest, and noted several appealing things.
Aside from the authority for Orange Equipment Liberation, another draw was that after joining the Excellence Talent Training Program he could also, to a certain extent, mobilize some of the company’s human resources!
According to the details above, he could find 30 “volunteer” employees in the “Interactive Hall” to start their “Other World journey”…
“3 D Level, 6 E Level, 21 F Level employees, huh, seems like I saw some cuties complaining about not having any tasks to do? ”

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - 415 381 True Revolver Contrarian Item
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 415: Chapter 381: True “Revolver Contrarian” Item Liberation!_2 Chapter 415: Chapter 381: True “Revolver Contrarian” Item Liberation!_2 Colin’s lips slightly curled upward; he had a kind heart and couldn’t stand to see anyone without a task.
He thought about bringing a few people along to enjoy a relaxing and delightful journey to the Other World…
“Overall, as long as this ‘flexible work system’ doesn’t cause any trouble, I can accept the other aspects…”
“No wonder ‘Lady Bunny’ helped submit my application; many things indeed alleviate my current needs…”
“Although earlier, my attempts to contact ‘Lady Bunny’ went unanswered, it seems that the leadership has noticed my struggles. I’m touched…”
Colin quickly read through the document, felt the benefits outweighed the disadvantages, and decisively signed his name on this plan, which seemed to be a “seasoned workhorse training program.”
Afterward, he immediately felt that many things had been added to him.
First was the “Containment Protocol Item Liberation” limit increase.
Colin immediately sensed that his “Revolver Reverser” had met some of the key requirements.
All that was left was to repair it to eighty-five percent…
Then he could carry out the Item Liberation!
Immediately, Colin took out the revolver and glanced at its current status.
“Integrity 19%… Next round of repair requires 8,761 points + 1 Gold Mission Voucher…”
“I hadn’t noticed before, just seven or eight thousand points, so cheap; repair it!”
With a lot of money in hand, Colin didn’t think twice and immediately proceeded with the repair.
He was very aware that even though the item was somewhat useless now, once it was repaired and underwent Item Liberation, even at 5%, its power would be far beyond what Purple Gear could compare with.
They weren’t even in the same league!
“Integrity 29%… Next round of repair requires 17,552 points + 1 Gold Mission Voucher…”
“Repair!”
“Integrity 39%… Next round of repair requires 23,397 points + 1 Gold Mission Voucher…”
“Repair.”
“Integrity 49%… Next round…”
“Repair…”
“Integrity 59%…”
“…Repair.”
“Integrity 69%…”
“…Repair, go ahead and repair.”
“Integrity 79%… Next round of repair requires 53,641 points + 1 Gold Mission Voucher…”
“Hisss, that expensive? Are they trying to rob me?”
Colin glared, watching the numbers above, feeling the sting of cost for the first time.
Seeing people talk about Green Gear costing a few thousand, Purple Gear twenty or thirty thousand, he thought Orange Weapons would cap at seventy or eighty thousand at most—it was just the points earned from previous tasks being spent…
Yet, before reaching the final step, his points were already running low.
After this repair, although he would be able to liberate the item, he would be left with barely more than his underpants…
“Can we negotiate to just repair six percent for the next part?”
Colin couldn’t help but speak out, but unfortunately, he didn’t receive any response…
But… he had already repaired up to this step.
He had spent six figures!
It was the final step…
Just one more step!
Only one step!
No, just half a step!
“What happened to the promised ‘Exceptional Talent Development Program’? They start with this kind of trap, squeezing my wallet dry. Ah, forget it, I’ve already repaired so much; I’ll just sell some stuff… Damn it! Repair!”
Colin gritted his teeth, sold some common items, gathered tens of thousands of points, and then confirmed the repair.
The next second, the heavily damaged revolver was restored to its original condition.
It was adorned with patterns that flowed like flames…
It had an indescribable artistic flair.
Before he had the chance to explore the new abilities inside, he saw an information prompt appear on the revolver.
[This item now meets the “Containment Protocol Item Liberation” requirements. Would you like to bind this item?]
[Note: Each binding must last for one month before it can be removed.]
“Repair! No, I mean, confirm the binding!”
Colin’s eyes reddened slightly as he made the decision.
“Click.”
A subtle sound seemed to emanate from the revolver, as if something had been unsealed.
The binding was complete!
Holding the item in his hand, Colin took a deep breath and then spoke slowly.
“Containment Protocol Item Liberation! ‘Revolver Reverser’ five percent liberated!”
As his voice faded, the flame patterns on the once lackluster orange revolver seemed to come to life, emitting a lava-like solid flame glow…
The flames first covered Colin’s entire body, and even in his mind, he received a lot of new information.
He felt as if a ball of intensely hot flame stored within the gun…
“If combined with the original Grease, the fireballs I can control can reach over a hundred meters in diameter, control spanning several kilometers. Wherever the flame’s light touches, it’s as if I can see everything, and my field of vision becomes immensely wide…”
“Then mixing ‘Air Bullet’ with ‘Bonfire,’ a single high-pressure, high-energy concentrated bullet could precisely kill an enemy eight kilometers away. It only takes two or three bullets to kill a being like the Deep Sea Messenger with a hint of divinity…”
“Thirty-three fire-laden bullets hitting their mark could probably send a Level 1 Containment Subject into an unconscious state for more than three minutes, and in those three minutes, there’s a lot that can be done…”
“Hisss, is this the true power of an Orange Weapon?”
Colin felt the power within and was profoundly shaken.
This once useless revolver was finally displaying its true potential…
Eager to unleash the flames, Colin quickly suppressed the idea…
Using the flames would likely cause a lot of chaos, not to mention that Ninth Level Personnel would probably come with a group to interrogate him within seconds.
Shaking his head, feeling it once more, he deactivated the Containment Protocol.
The next instant, a wave of exhaustion overwhelmed him…

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - 416 381 True Revolver Contrarian Item
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 416: Chapter 381: True “Revolver Contrarian” Item Liberation!_3 Chapter 416: Chapter 381: True “Revolver Contrarian” Item Liberation!_3 Colin’s figure swayed.
“Hiss, so tired. Didn’t feel it during use, but after it’s done, you realize even though it doesn’t have many side effects, it really drains your physical energy…”
Colin gulped down two “Colorless Crystals” before his body barely recovered from the weakness.
Then, he looked at his specialized skills again.
He found that when the repair had reached this stage, the gun’s own skills were also quite impressive…
“‘Expanded Magazine’ expanded to an independent 1-cubic-meter loading space inside, compatible with 155mm caliber bullets… Is a 155mm caliber still considered a bullet?”
“‘Quick Draw Slash (American Style)’ changed to 0.01 seconds.”
“‘Air Bullet’ kinetic energy enhanced. Click for details. Oh, so many formulas, kind of complex. I won’t look at that. Knowing the effect is good enough…”
“‘Devouring Plunder,’ allowing for the devouring and fusion of suitable items or anomalies… Huh? So this is the real reason why my ‘Flame Dominator’ got enchanted? Speaking of which, isn’t this the power of ‘Hunger’…”
Colin felt it for a moment, indeed there was the power of “Hunger” present, but perhaps it had already been completely integrated and refined.
So even “Hunger” couldn’t retrieve its power.
Besides these, this pistol also had a whole bunch of various “specialized skills.”
For example, “Perfect Grip,” “Constant Temperature,” “Auto Repair,” “Malleability Change,” “Sword Mastery,” and so on, over thirty items…
Its specialized skills were exceedingly numerous, as if it had everything, but nothing was really perfected.
“Malleability Change”…
With a thought from Colin, he saw it shimmer and transform into a Han Sword as he remembered, then it shifted into a Tang sword, a spear, a whip, and so on with each recurring thought…
This thing could actually transform at will.
Colin realized that perhaps because the final image had been set with a revolver, that’s why it ultimately took the form of a revolver.
For a weapon of this level, its external form usually isn’t the focus.
The focus is on the intrinsic core that was turned into an item.
“In melee, it can work with my ‘Matchless Strike,’ even can be combined with ‘Heavenly Lightfall.’ Geez, with a strike like that, with all the BUFFs stacked, I can even reproduce the C Level Elder Brother’s level of single-hit accuracy, that can knock a Level 1 Containment Subject unconscious for half a day with ‘Heavenly Lightfall’!”
“Haha, now, in my hands, I finally have a weapon truly powerful apart from the Bone Spur!”
Colin was satisfied internally and turned it into a ring with magma texture, wearing it on his right index finger.
To use it, a light pull would turn it into a powerful weapon!
Then, he checked the chat channel, where after the announcement lasted for a while, a flood of D Level Personnel, who had been silent for eight hundred years, jumped out and wouldn’t stop wailing.
They had managed to earn some points and finally had some savings, but before they could even warm them in their hands, they were taken back by the “Bonfire Company” in this way.
And even took them back with interest…
One by one, they were so poor all they had left were their underwear.
As a result, the “Trading Path” saw a good deal of green-named items appear, and even some long-unseen purple gear names!
Of course, not everyone was wailing. Many company employees who hadn’t reached D Level but were envious laughed loudly, especially the E level Personnel who let out a lot of sarcastic remarks, like: knowing full well they can’t afford purple gear, yet still they insisted on liberating it, and so on…
Ignoring those lower-level employees, looking at the few pieces of purple gear on auction, Colin sighed deeply in his heart.
“The effects aren’t that great, but purple gear is still purple gear. If I had the money, I’d definitely take it and talk later…”
“Unfortunately, I’m out of surplus points now, only about three hundred left. When will there be a mission? I need to make some money. Next time I enter ‘World Code 13,’ I still have to pay tuition to ‘The Light Chaser’…”
“With his greedy nature, without a few thousand points for tuition, I’m afraid I won’t get it…”
“No wait, damn it, I have a bunch of damaged items in my backpack that I hardly repaired!”
Colin was startled; he just remembered that some items, such as the “False Powerhouse,” were so damaged that they couldn’t be used without repairs…
But now, he didn’t even have the points to repair them…
Colin, feeling both mentally and physically impoverished, couldn’t help but think that if he hadn’t spent two hundred points on a useless item half a month ago…
Then he would have had an extra two hundred points in his pocket now.
And there were the expenses for his talent then…
“Sigh, if only I had known then what I know now, why would I have done it?”
Colin shook his head and sighed, never having imagined that one day he would be troubled by a lack of points.
And even thinking of wanting to do a mission because of it…
It was simply unthinkable.
At this moment, Colin suddenly understood what the “Bonfire Talent Development Plan” meant when it said it could fully motivate a “Flame Bearer’s” initiative…
If it weren’t for opening up an Orange Equipment Liberation, he wouldn’t be thinking of doing a mission for just a few points.
But before he could ponder more, a new announcement appeared on the parchment.
[Notice: The E→D advancement dungeon “The Disordered Ghost Train” will be cancelled effective immediately, new dungeon “Script City: Horror Zone” will replace it as the new E→D advancement quest…]
[Note: All advancing personnel will be prioritized to select this task as the second phase.]
[For details about this dungeon, please click to view.]
The information surprised the company employees.
Immediately after, all smiles from the scornful E level Personnel leaked onto the faces of the D level Personnel.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - 417 382 The Terrifying D Level Promotion
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 417: 382 Chapter The Terrifying D Level Promotion Mission_1 Chapter 417: 382 Chapter The Terrifying D Level Promotion Mission_1 As the information about the replacement of the copy appeared, the stagnant chat content began to scroll again.
Some rejoiced, but many were saddened…
“Miss Nell’s Dog”: Hahaha, what’s this, “Script Heaven · Terror Zone”? Too bad, I’m already D level, can’t experience it anymore. You guys keep it up, @Wandering Speedy Lad, @Loafing Immortal…
“Loafing Immortal”: Why, why did it have to be like this? I missed the “Disordered Ghost Train” and lost the chance to score hundreds of millions of points. Why, when just four or five more regular missions would have given me a chance to unlock the D level promotion, and I could have tried for D level in about three months… It should have been a happy thing, why did it turn out this way…
“Wandering Speedy Lad”: Oh no, this is bad. Canceling the mission is one thing, but how come they brought “Script Heaven” up here? I’m allergic to a few words…
“Storm Warrior Gay Lot”: Damn it, “The Disordered Ghost Train” is canceled, so all the dozens of item effects I memorized over the past few months, as well as information about more than thirty people, were memorized for nothing?
“Life Mentor Adorable”: Tsk tsk, it seems like Brother Shunzi has been too haunted by high-difficulty copies, now he’s starting to turn the tables on the copy. Just waiting for Brother Shunzi to level up and breakthrough the D level promotion copy…
“Confused Cutie ①Sob Sob⑦”: Brother Shunzi and the copy, one of them has to disappear eventually, right?
…
As lines of information scrolled by, Colin was a bit surprised: why on earth was the mission canceled?
“I guess it’s probably related to that big move before…”
Colin felt that even if it was just the train part, as a promotion mission, it was quite good.
The D level old-timers up there were indeed good at honing people…
But on second thought, when deep inside the copy before, too many strange and bizarre beings had come, and problems with the mission were quite likely, if they didn’t replace it while they had the chance, it might become another Out-of-Control Copy.
“Besides, after working for so many years, it’s time for the old guys on the train to take a break.”
Thinking of this, Colin glanced at the parchment that had been changed to a wail, without the slightest self-awareness that he was the “culprit”.
After chuckling to himself for a while, he got up, made a phone call downstairs, and ordered a trotter rice takeaway.
Next, he initiated a private chat with “Life Mentor Adorable” from Bonfire Company, asking about some information on D Level Personnel…
Especially about D Level promotions.
‘I remember, the D level promotion missions, seemed to always have something special about them, causing no one with a chance to promote to have appeared so far, right?’
Colin pondered internally, having heard before that it was related to the high difficulty…
But considering what he overheard on the train, it probably wasn’t just about difficulty, but also about quotas.
It seemed like C level positions were limited…
For all those people inside that train, having just gone through a major event, with the entire crew receiving first-level commendations and some with other unique distinctions, the recruitment rate seemed to be just around ten percent.
Even so, listening to their tone, it seemed unusually high already.
If the difficulty hasn’t changed much, then it makes sense that no one here has been promoted.
The D level personnel here seemed to have given up, to an extent.
Colin saw a lot of F and E level personnel discussing promotion tasks, but hardly saw D level personnel discussing this aspect; it’s like each and every one of them didn’t want to rise up and become a boss.
…
Meanwhile, receiving the message from Brother Shunzi, “Life Mentor Adorable” couldn’t help but feel touched, worthy of being acknowledged as number one by everyone in the company.
Just upgraded from E level, and already starting to consider things about promotion.
But thinking about Brother Shunzi’s performance in the previous battles, he wasn’t too surprised, and after reflecting for a while, he began to put his thoughts into words, carefully responding to topics ranging from regular missions, to D level enhancements, and then to promotion task situations.
“Normal D level tasks are not very special, just a few times harder and more complicated than E level, but for you, that shouldn’t pose much of a problem.”
“As for enhancement, besides the Gene Compensation Medicine, you just get one more Talent, one more Skill, and the ability to purchase Murky Energy Crystals, of course, one more Talent and Skill, that itself is a significant boost to combat power.”
“For instance, the current universally acknowledged strongest T0 match-up is ‘Tyrant Body’ plus a green nimbleness-type Talent, or one that can ‘Flash’, or has immunity to physical attacks. With a double Talent combination, it’s much more powerful than a single E level Talent…”
“For something slightly less, you can choose a Talent that strengthens the skin. I remember a D level with the purple-colored Talent ‘Alloy Transformation’, with that thing, you could ignore Barrett’s consecutive sniping, also very strong…”
“However, exactly how it goes, depends on which Talents you have…”
Err… I can handle these things without relying on Talents though… Colin muttered to himself as he read through this information.
He had advanced too quickly, with not enough accumulation, and lacked suitable things to pair with his Talents…
As the other person finished talking about the enhancements, they started on the subject of D level promotion.
“The D level promotion missions are similar to before, with two phases. The first phase is generally instant type, and the second is copy type…”
“However, unlike before, it’s been clearly stated that after completing the D level promotion missions, you won’t be promoted directly like before, but will only get a qualification, or rather, a chance…”
“Once you get this qualification, what to do next, is still unclear to most people.”

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - 418 382 The Terrifying D Level Promotion
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 418: Chapter 382 The Terrifying D Level Promotion Mission_2 Chapter 418: Chapter 382 The Terrifying D Level Promotion Mission_2 “Because so far, there aren’t many who have just obtained the qualification, and that doesn’t include me, so I don’t have much information on hand…”
Looking at this information, Colin found it not difficult to understand why there was only a qualification after the promotion task.
From the information he had received, C Level was like a carrot for each hole.
To be promoted, not only did one need sufficient ability, but there also had to be an open position…
‘However, looking at this, not many people are clear, which means there really are people who know?’
Colin tried to inquire and quickly received a response.
“There are suspected cases of passing, but it’s just not very certain what the final situation was…”
Suspected cases of passing? Could this even be a suspicion? Colin was puzzled, but before he could ask, the other party continued:
“Currently, as long as the first phase of the D Level Promotion Mission is completed, it will unlock a large team instance mission called ‘Joyful Farmstead Seven Days Tour’, which is extremely difficult. Fifty people are required to enter at once, but luckily, there is no death. If you die, you simply exit…”
“The year before last, a group of people entered it and were about to clear the mission.”
“According to the last person who died and exited halfway, the ones still inside were basically assured to pass.”
“At that time, we thought that a group of people was finally going to clear the path to C Level, but we waited several days, even past the maximum mission time limit, and we still didn’t see anyone come out, and there’s still been no news even now…”
“It can be roughly determined that the people who continued inside in the end probably had one of two outcomes.”
“One possibility is that when the time came, they completed the mission and ‘ascended’ like in the novels, losing all communication with us from then on…”
“Another possibility is that when the time came, they completed the mission, but completing it didn’t mean clearing the instance, nor did it mean they could leave. Instead, for some reason, they might have been trapped inside the mission, unable to return, unable to respond…”
“If it’s the former case, then they are the ones who know about the situation after D Level.”
“If it’s the latter, then this mission might as well be considered an ‘Out-of-Control Copy’, except that without people delving deeper, its true nature wouldn’t be noticed…”
“Apart from these two, there are some other conjectures, but I personally feel they’re not very likely. If Brother Shunzi is curious, you could browse some posts by D Level promotion candidates…”
“However, no matter which conjecture it is, none are quite acceptable to everyone, which is also why D Level employees generally have a somewhat defeatist attitude.”
“As a result, no one has really attempted to clear this instance since then…”
“…”
Clearing or rather, suspected clearing, and then everyone disappears without a trace?
His gaze scanned line by line over the information, and Colin’s eyebrows furrowed.
As far as he knew…
After C Level, they shouldn’t disappear like in ‘ascension’, so it’s quite likely that something else happened at the end of the second phase of the task.
Especially with the name of that instance mission.
“‘Joyful Farmstead Seven Days Tour’? Just by hearing it, you know it’s not any serious mission…”
According to Colin’s knowledge of the company, the stranger the name of the mission, the more difficult it was.
However, having thought of something, he sent an inquiry: “For the second phase of the D Level instance mission type, is there only one?”
You should know, there were a dozen or so instance types for each level before…
“Not just one, but usually, it defaults to ‘Joyful Farmstead Seven Days Tour’; only occasionally does it select others, such as ‘Mirror Starry Sky World’, ‘Abnormal in the Night Primitive Forest’…”
“The difficulty of these missions is just as immense; usually, within a few minutes of entering, one by one, they are sent back by death, spending even less time than in the farmstead…”
“At least the farmstead had some hope of clearing. These others didn’t give any hope at all, feeling like they weren’t designed for us…”
“So we don’t have much information about them.”
…
Colin glanced at the names mentioned by the other, feeling that these two sounded much more normal and didn’t have that absurd, bizarre sense.
It’s like in a horror movie where suddenly a cartoon character like Peppa Pig pops up…
At that time, it’s really hard to say which one is more terrifying.
“Maybe the difficulty of these two other missions is the norm, but because we’re missing quite a few things, this group of employees lacks the strength of the previous one, giving them the feeling that the missions weren’t prepared for them…”
Colin mused, thinking that perhaps with “Item Liberation” plus the “Gene Compensation Panel” as well as other potential deficiencies made up, it might just be perfect…
The real problem still lay with the eerily named “Joyful Farmstead Seven-Day Tour”.
However, Colin didn’t dwell on it and asked for some more information about the farmstead mission.
Unfortunately, the response he got was quick; it seemed the mission had some sort of memory protection mechanism, as people who came out could only remember vague general impressions and couldn’t give detailed specifics.
Moreover, these impressions would become fuzzier with time.
“What a pity, looks like the cause will remain unclear…”
Colin rubbed his forehead.
Although there was a chance of being selected for a different copy, an unfounded intuition told him that the mission he would most likely end up with was the “Joyful Farmstead Seven-Day Tour”.
“Never mind, there’s still plenty of time, let’s take it one step at a time.”
Shaking his head, he heard the delivery call, stood up, and took the pig’s trotters and rice from the delivery person.
Then, he sat down to eat while contemplating his next move.
“Today’s the 22nd, the next entry into the Other World is on the 25th, three days away… The ‘Shield of Fairness and Justice’ has to be returned by then, if not, the ‘Bone Spur’ will have to be returned, but the Bone Spur is critical too, my second weapon…”
Colin swallowed a big mouthful of rice, feeling a bit melancholy; both items were very useful.
The Shield Emblem could avoid fatal damage and pluck the enemy general from an army…
As for the Bone Spur, well, it currently turned anyone it pricked into a soprano…
He wanted to keep them both.
“No, I have to think of a way to earn some Points and negotiate with him properly.”
Colin remembered from their last interaction that the “Light Chaser”, apart from being slightly greedy, was quite decent, and most importantly, the other party was somewhat poor at negotiating.
Coupled with his comparatively kind nature, he was practically an ideal negotiation partner.
Maybe there was also a chance to extend the contract…
Of course, all this was predicated on him having Points in hand.
After some thought, just as he was about to volunteer for a mission, he had a sudden epiphany and noticed that the “Large Parchment” and the “Small Parchment” each had a mission offer.
On the Large Parchment, a message surfaced.
[Detected that your combat experience in the “Nightmare Origin of the Dying Ancient God” meets the requirements for creating a “Copy”.]
[Would you like to submit information from the “Nightmare Origin of the Dying Ancient God” to create an “Employee Trial Copy”?]
[Note: After the creation of the “Copy”, all employees can participate in the trial by paying a certain number of Points. Bonfire Company will split the earnings from the copy in a 70:30 ratio with the provider.]
[Remark: The “Copy” will remove the provider’s information, ensuring personal privacy and avoiding unnecessary issues.]
“Whoops… the employees are in for a treat.”
Seeing this mission prompt, Colin couldn’t help but reveal a cruel smile on his lips.
Now, all company employees would have the chance to experience the horror of the Ancient God’s nightmare, to witness the prowess of the C Level elder brother, and to feel the impact of those iron fists…
‘To be honest, even if it doesn’t make me any money, just to enhance the employees’ combat abilities, I ought to turn it into a mission…’
Without much hesitation and abiding by his sense of responsibility, Colin confirmed the submission of his copy experience.
Soon after, a familiar eye pattern emerged from the parchment, looked at him for a moment, and then quickly vanished, and along with its disappearance, the submission of the mission copy was completed.
“Heh, I hope everyone can learn something useful from it…”
Colin chuckled and then opened the “Small Parchment”.
At this moment, there was a new immediate task on it…
The requirements for the task weren’t too difficult.
“The distance doesn’t seem too far, just somewhere a couple hundred kilometers away. Destroy the ritual held by Cultists of the ‘Starry Sky’ belief tomorrow night, and collect the items used in the ritual. The reward is barely adequate…”
Colin glanced over it, somewhat disdainfully, but chose to accept it regardless.
After all, if these people dared to conduct a cult ritual not even two hundred kilometers from his doorstep tomorrow, he didn’t even want to think about what they might do the day after…
A heavy-handed approach was a must!

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - 419 383 The Ancient God Hit List (6.2K
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 419: Chapter 383 “The Ancient God Hit List”! (6.2K words)_1 Chapter 419: Chapter 383 “The Ancient God Hit List”! (6.2K words)_1 With a few loud gulps, he finished off his pig trotter rice…
Colin retracted his thoughts from the minor task at hand and once again opened the “Storage Room” to check on his equipment status.
Items like the “False Mighty One,” “Analytical Lens” and the like were temporarily unusable; others such as “Mountain of Smiling Corpses” were operational but in a damaged state. Until they’re repaired, their attributes might be a little skewed…
As for the “Widow Yukionna,” as long as the “Yukionna” herself is fine, it doesn’t matter much if the ring is broken.
It’s just like walking a dog without a leash.
If the “Yukionna” gets playful and runs off, Colin might not have the time to fetch her back.
“Still, I need to choose and repair them at some point, but fixing them all to a usable state would probably cost tens of thousands of points, and to fully repair them, it would take twenty thousand…”
After glancing over the information for each piece of equipment, Colin sighed.
If he didn’t repair his orange gear, he’d still have more points than he could use, but that wasn’t possible…
The effects upon release would be stronger than the total effect of all the purple gear combined.
Shaking his head, Colin roughly memorized the condition of his equipment and then looked at a D Level Gene Compensation Medicine in the “Storage Room.”
The design was a test tube with a stopper, taken orally.
It was a reward from the Box Garden World or some other task settlement…
Which one exactly Colin had forgotten, and he was too lazy to ponder over it. As long as it was usable, that was all that mattered.
With a “pop,”
Colin used his thumb to flick off the stopper of the test tube, then brought the medicine close to his mouth and gulped it down in one go.A faint taste slightly salty like tap water…
It was like drinking tap water with a few grains of salt added, void of any stimulation. As the liquid passed over his lips and down his throat, it felt very “smooth,” almost like ordinary tap water.
If it weren’t for opening his personal profile to see the panel indicating the usage of (1/3),
Colin would have doubted whether he had used a fake product…
“When I used this at F Level and E Level, it seemed like there was some feedback. The higher the level, the less feedback there seems to be. But if you pay close attention, you can still feel the body growing, like going through another bout of growth, and during this process, the connection with the company seems to be deepening…”
As thoughts flowed, Colin pondered over the next usage time, which should be a week after the medicine was fully absorbed.
If it weren’t for this limitation, he reckoned he could soon start on C Level tasks.
Afterward, Colin tidied up the room and took out the “Mark of the Fire Tree,” quickly scanning the contents again.
[Tip: Upon entering the “Dreamscape,” you will make contact with the active part of the Containment Subject within the mark. If you are not strong enough to gain its consent through normal means, you can use food or items as offerings in exchange for its assistance…]
“Oh, I didn’t look closely before. Did the previous employees provide it with offerings?”
Colin became interested upon seeing the word “offerings.”
He immediately returned to his bedroom, holding the “Mark of the Fire Tree,” his thoughts slowly sinking in.
Before long, Colin felt himself regaining consciousness in his dream. Looking around, the surroundings were shrouded in a mysterious, hazy grey fog, and beneath his feet was a stretch of tough, black soil.
“Huff…”
Colin took a deep breath and could faintly smell a slightly decayed scent in the air.
Without further thought, he followed a certain intuition, striding continuously forward.
Soon, Colin glimpsed through the hazy fog a vast, pitch-black tree rooted in the distance.
Upon a simple visual estimate, the tree stood at least thirty meters tall with a trunk width of four to five meters…
Standing before it, Colin felt like an insignificant ant.
He looked up at the lofty, cracked tree crown, which could be described as covering the sky, but it was bald, without a single leaf, revealing only a confusion of hair-thin branches…
“What sort of fire tree is this?” Colin muttered to himself.
However, no sooner had this thought crossed his mind than he heard a “rustle.”
Bright flames erupted from the dark tree crown…
A giant face emerged from the base of the trunk, opening its eyes. The wooden eyeballs looked up at him and spoke with a sigh:
“A million autumn dreams pass in slumber, aware not of the current year. Has another human entered this ‘Fire Tree Dreamland’? Well then, have you brought the offerings I require?”
Heh, it even comes with its own opening poetry…
Colin blinked, feeling the strength of the entity amidst the flames.
In an instant, the oppressiveness brought on by its colossal form eased.
It wants offerings at this level?
Colin bluntly said, “Fire Tree, I demand that you come under my command to assist me with my tasks to the best of your ability.”
Upon hearing Colin’s uncompromising words, the tree’s wooden eyeballs turned to him:
“Boy, do you know the consequences of speaking to the ancient one in such a manner?!”
As it spoke, a storm-like terrible presence bore down.
Who taught this thing social skills? The way it talks is so weird and annoying… Colin narrowed his eyes, sensing from the oppressive aura a hidden gaze observing him.
Before Colin could speak, the giant tree in front of him laughed mockingly again.
“Hehehe, the ancient one thought it was someone significant, but it turns out to be merely a D Level member! A mere D Level, laughable, truly laughable, oblivious to the vastness of heaven and earth…”
“Even though the essence of the ancient one is bound, just a slight effort is still the limit for your level!”

chapters.title: Chapter 420 - 420 383 The Ancient God Hit List (6.2K)_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 420: Chapter 383 “The Ancient God Hit List”! (6.2K)_2 Chapter 420: Chapter 383 “The Ancient God Hit List”! (6.2K)_2 “With your level, you could easily have your way of the heart shattered by an old man like me,”
“But considering it’s your first mistake, I, being generous and kind, am willing to give you a chance to amend your ways. Just hand over three times the offerings, and I will make your mission more convenient…”
Listening to the great tree utter these words, Colin had a peculiar expression on his face as he opened his “Storage Room” for a glance.
The “False Mighty One” was clearly still in his pocket…
Why did it feel like it had been assigned to this great tree?
Yet, without dwelling on it, Colin slowly took out the “Revolver Reverser.”
He had barely drawn the gun when a gaze had already swept over.
The “Fire Tree” failed to realize how special this item was, but judging by its level, one could not possibly obtain a purple-tier item unless they were saving the world!
And among the purple items, how many could battle it?
Thus, the Tree People’s face immediately eased up, showing a compassionate expression, “There are always those who, new to this place, think they can stand against me just because they have another purple item in their hand!”
“Alright, alright. It seems that the passage of years is too great. My venerable name is no longer known to anyone, otherwise you would never dare to say such a thing in front of me!”
“It’s alright, let me teach you about the difference between purple items!”
As the voice fell, a large wooden hand stretched out from the tree trunk, reaching into the sky and grasping at nothing: “Fire come!”
Countless flames from above its head converged into its large hand, forming a flame spear several meters long!
Then, without hesitation, it hurled the spear towards Colin.
But the spear had barely left its hand when it felt a sudden throb within, and then saw Colin swiftly raise his hand, the muzzle of his gun flashing with light, a bullet shot out.
Boom!
The bullet collided with the spear, resulting in a violent explosion.
A vast amount of flame scattered.
An enormous presence spread out…
“What?!” The Tree People’s face widened in shock. How could the opponent block his attack so effortlessly?
Moreover, it seemed that he did that without even “liberating the item”…
Since when did the purple gear containment realm have such a formidable character?
Could it be… this isn’t purple gear?
“It’s indeed quite strong. Plus, with the advantage of the terrain, it’s a bit stronger than the Deep Sea Messenger of The Seventh Box Garden World. An average D Level really might not beat it…” Colin felt the vibrations in the air, making a rough judgment.
But he didn’t ponder much further. He flicked his revolver holding hand, and a large eight-sided sword floated in his hand.
Then, he charged forward at breakneck speed.
“Young man, don’t think you can truly stand against me just because you have one impressive item in hand! Let me show you my true strength!” the Fire Tree shouted angrily, and countless thick roots burst out of the ground, whirling towards that charging figure.
And from the canopy, countless sparks formed into myriad sharp swords raining down…
Each strike was no less powerful than the previous move.
“Heh.” Colin looked at the sky filled with attacks, the corner of his mouth lifted, and the flame poured into the blade of his sword, swinging with all his might towards the sky.
In the next instant, a fiery blade ripped through the sky, and the swords formed of sparks exploded like fireworks, none threatening Colin…
And the roots surging on the ground like a deluge were severed by another sweeping strike.
“What! Impossible!” The Fire Tree’s face showed disbelief.
But before it could contemplate further, the figure with the big sword had already rushed to the front of the tree trunk.
Then, a fist enveloped in flame smashed into it.
The Fire Tree hastily put up numerous branches to block…
But they were blown away just two seconds after being hit by the fist.
“This… this, you are not just a mere D Level!” Feeling the aura in the flame, the Fire Tree trembled violently, as if recognizing something. Its face’s wooden eyeballs bulged out—two round wooden eyeballs fell out of their sockets!
Damn it, this guy seems to be a “Flame Bearer”?
No, a Reservist?
Crack!
The fist penetrated the wooden barrier and pounded on the face, directly embedding it into the trunk.
“It’s a bit tough and still not dead…” Colin withdrew his gaze, looking upward, where another face emerged.
“Friend, a misunderstanding, a mis—Ahh!!!”
Facing a formidable opponent, the “Fire Tree” always showed great meekness and politeness.
However, before it could finish speaking, it suddenly felt as if something pricked its tree body, followed by an intense pain that even it found unbearable.
“Good, for this level, the Bone Spur is still notably effective.” Colin casually pulled the bone spur out of its body.
Then he raised his fist and hammered down on the wailing tree once again.
It was rare to find such a sandbag; he couldn’t miss the opportunity to let off some steam.
After about fifteen minutes, in the “Fire Tree Dreamland,” the ten-meter-tall aberrant lifeform was beaten to pieces by Colin…
The broken eyeballs looked at Colin, seemingly flickering with numerous thoughts.
‘This, why would a D Level employee have such high-level items? He didn’t actually save the world, did he?’
‘And why would fire burst out of a D Level like this?’
“This isn’t something a D Level employee should have, is it?”
“…”
One doubt after another arose in its mind, but before it could reflect any further, everything turned to darkness.
The giant Fire Tree scattered into countless fragments…
Colin stood still, quietly watching everything in front of him.
Seconds later, a special force brushed over the ash-covered land, and everything began to revert.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - 421 383 The Ancient Gods Hit List (6.2K)_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 421: Chapter 383 “The Ancient God’s Hit List”! (6.2K)_3 Chapter 421: Chapter 383 “The Ancient God’s Hit List”! (6.2K)_3 The shattered great tree restored itself once again.
This time, as soon as it appeared, it yanked countless roots from the ground and, mimicking the stance of a human, stood upright.
Colin thought this was some new trick and had already prepared himself.
But then…
The giant tree stepped backward, clearing a large space, and then with a “boom,” its massive roots transformed into legs and knelt down in front of Colin in a standard kneeling posture.
“I’m sorry, I failed to recognize the Bonfire, I will join your ranks immediately, at your command…” The buzzing echoed through the misty spatial realm.
‘Eh, I rather liked your untamed look…’
Colin stood on the still-vibrating ground, feeling a bit disappointed; he had many other tactics he wanted to try.
Such a shame…
But without dwelling on it too much, Colin nodded at it, “I heard you might have something like a tribute around here?”
The Flame Tree shivered and quickly responded: “No, no tribute.”
“Hmm?” Colin raised an eyebrow as his fists ignited with flame.
“It was actually a gift I had prepared for you all along…” the Fire Tree hastily explained.
“Acceptable.”
Colin nodded, then saw atop the Flame Tree, where countless branches interlocked to form a life-sized wooden replica, this replica reached out and pulled a blue plastic bucket from the canopy.
“What’s this…”
Upon receiving and inspecting it, Colin’s brow furrowed once again.
It seemed this plastic bucket contained a spatial pocket, but its contents didn’t seem very important — all trifles that appeared to hold little value…
Like a few tattered novels, a half-eaten tub of potato chips, cola, and a handheld gaming device?
After giving the covers of several dozen books a cursory glance, Colin immediately grasped the reason behind the tree’s strange manner of speaking—
“Skyspanning Hand,” “Complete World,” “Ordinary People’s Immortal Cultivation,” “Swallowed Starry Sky”…
‘These are all rather dated works, but why do I feel like there’s something off with the translations or the printings? And I thought your way of speaking was odd, turns out you learned to communicate from this stuff, right?’
Colin pursed his lips, then took his gaze away from the plastic bucket and looked at the other.
“This is your tribute? Just this?”
Colin was pleased with the Fire Tree’s gesture of submission but was dissatisfied with the offerings it had handed over.
He didn’t feel the sincerity that should have been there!
No sincerity…
“Crack.”
Colin inadvertently squeezed his fist, causing a crisp sound of bones colliding.
“Yes, yes, these are all of my offerings, no, wait, there is also this…”
Sensing Colin’s displeasure, it hastened to pick up something: “These are some Points I’ve saved up for your use, please accept them…”
While speaking, it tremblingly handed over the Points it had tearfully saved from healing and helping people.
It had planned to use these Points to exchange for a set of premium plastic figures, but unfortunately, something had happened, and communication with the previous owner was suddenly cut off, and there has been no response for many years.
When someone finally showed up, it turned out they were a wolf in sheep’s clothing, ready to plunder its foundations…
Even stealing the Containment Subject’s things!
That’s just inhuman!
“Well, this is quite acceptable.”
Colin was oblivious to the great tree’s complex emotional turmoil; otherwise, he might have marveled at the depth of its humanity.
With a wave of his hand, he swept away the 11,254 Points from its hands.
Then, Colin flipped the bucket upside down, shook out all of its contents, and appropriated the bucket too.
After all, this thing was also a prop with its own internal space, apparently capable of holding quite a bit…
The “Fire Tree” extended its branches to hold all the books and snacks with its root-made hands, not daring to show anger or to speak.
“Don’t worry; if you stick with me, I won’t let you down. Since you like these, I’ll bring you more in the future, all brand-new versions of things you haven’t seen or played with before,” Colin promised.
“Thank you for your generous gift, master!”
“Tsk, you really need to work on your way of speaking, but I don’t have time for it right now, so let’s leave it at that for the moment…”
Colin shook his head, pondering what to bring to correct the other’s manner of speaking, then turned to leave, but suddenly heard the other speak up.
“Great Master, I have a question to ask, may I seek enlightenment from you?”
“What is it?”
