“The ‘Child of Voice,’ ‘Eye of Terror Observation,’ ‘Sovereign of the Azure Star,’ and similar entities perished in the chaotic fight, ‘Dawn Star’ and others disappeared, numerous First Level contract employees from the first and second ‘Box Garden Worlds’ were severely injured, leaving hardly a few…”
“On the regular battlefield, all who were lured over essentially returned to the Mother…”
“This time, a large amount of high-quality biological matter was reclaimed, and the ‘Red Moon’ Mother has moved one step closer to awakening.”
“It’s a pity that the ‘Flame Bearer’ seed also emerged…”
As “Big Rat” muttered to himself, he was essentially understanding the aftermath of that battle.
This unexpected event could be described as two wins and one loss…
The “Red Moon” Mother harvested a vast amount of high-quality biological matter, he obtained enough raw materials, but the Bonfire Company also reclaimed a considerable portion of the lost information, and so on…
“No, it should be two wins and two losses. That ‘Flame Bearer’ reservist has now become a true seed.”
While “Big Rat” murmured to himself, he showed enormous hostility.
If a “Flame Bearer” truly reappeared, it would become a significant variable in the future.
The actual strength of a newly emerged “Flame Bearer” may not be a problem; the issue is that “Flame Bearers” possess many privileges for mobilizing other company authorities.
Their relationship with the company is not like the typical evil force’s ‘God’ and believer arrangement but rather like a special relationship between a ‘body’ and its ‘brain cells.’
Under special circumstances, they could even use some methods to somewhat revive the Bonfire Camp Special Item Company…
This was where these fanatics, obsessed with the kinder aspect of humanity, presented a real problem.
“If it weren’t for the ‘Mother’s’ divine revelation that this bait was obviously poisoned, I truly couldn’t resist eradicating it…”
“However, as long as the plan goes smoothly, once the ‘world barriers’ are overturned and the ‘Red Moon’ begins to fully resurrect, even if the other side successfully advances, it would be hard for them to take any significant action…”
“Big Rat” put away his thoughts and threw all the crystals into the crucible, commanding the other “Rats” to grind and pulverize them.
Once the “paint” was ready…
He would be able to depict himself, shedding his current abnormal “physical” form to reveal his true appearance.
…
On the returning helicopter, Colin counted his points and felt a bit of a headache.
He thought everything had concluded smoothly, but suddenly a swarm of Rats emerged and gnawed away a large chunk of his points.
He had surmised early on that if blessed enough by the “Red Moon,” one could largely ignore Time Stop.
But encountering such a thing for the first time still unsettled him…
“I have to be more cautious in the future. Until a mission is truly completed, there are still many variables.”
Colin silently noted this lesson to himself.
Aside from the “Starlight Maiden,” there wasn’t much else lost in this mission; only a few bites were taken out of the Fifth Level Personnel, and everyone, including the undercover operatives, had been rescued.
Such wounds were within the official capability to handle, ensuring no permanent disabilities resulted…
“It seems there are no other special missions before the promotion missions start. I need to significantly improve my combat abilities, whether it’s the thought process for using tools, proficiency, or other physical aspects; I have to get more skilled.”
Colin had already roughly planned for what came next.
However, before he could delve deeper into his thoughts, he suddenly became aware and lifted his head to look at an empty seat opposite him within the helicopter.
Unbeknownst to him, a middle-aged man with an older appearance had appeared there.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - 434 389 Under a Restless World..._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 434: Chapter 389 Under a Restless World…_1 Chapter 434: Chapter 389 Under a Restless World…_1 “Xu Duojin?”
Colin recognized the other party at a glance.
The two had interacted many times; often, the other party was there on behalf of Old Master Wu to speak with him.
After all, even if Ninth Level Personnel had clones, those clones were mostly too busy to spare time.
Thus, they had to find someone specifically to interface with him…
Though using an Eighth Level Personnel for this kind of legwork was somewhat wasteful, Colin’s identity was too special, the stakes too high – so even though there was a significant shortage of high-level combat power in many places, they still squeezed out a senior member to correspond with him.
However, under normal circumstances, Colin remembered, this guy wouldn’t show up so easily; he wondered what he was here for now.
Without any pleasantries, he directly asked for the reason.
At this moment, upon hearing Colin’s words, Xu Duojin, a middle-aged looking man who was actually only in his thirties, nodded.
As he put on his sunglasses, he looked at Colin:
“I’m here to answer some questions about ‘Destiny Propeller’ abilities on behalf of Mr. Wu. Before that, though, may I ask you something first?”
“What is it?” Colin nodded.
“Where did you learn about ‘fate reset’?”
Xu Duojin, confused behind his sunglasses, said, “That’s considered a high-order skill, usually kept secret; even high-ranking members other than ‘Destiny Propeller’ would hardly know…
And it’s a measure only used as a last resort.
Then… among the high-ranking members of ‘Destiny Propeller’, there doesn’t seem to be a traitor, so how does he know about this?
Could it be that someone silently took down a high-order ‘Destiny Propeller’ member?
It’s said, though, that some of the Extraordinary Ones possess similar methods, but if that were the case, Mr. Colin would not have come to them directly…
“It’s related to a train mission I had a couple of days ago; if you’ve been paying attention, you would know that on that train, I encountered many former Bonfire Company personnel…”
Colin didn’t hide much and roughly explained the situation.
“Is that so…” Xu Duojin slightly bowed his head upon hearing Colin’s explanation and showed a look of realization behind his sunglasses, as if he had figured something out.
He then took a deep breath and began to explain, “A similar method to this one is internally known to us as ‘Fate Correction’, a skill that can be used by those who are at least Level Seven…
“The exact method of execution involves observing both friend and foe before the battle, then capturing the moment as if in a photograph as much as possible, afterwards they would close their eyes…
“When the time comes, they open their eyes again to revert everything back to before it all happened.”
Hearing this, Colin couldn’t help but recall the words of that ‘Destiny Propeller’ D rank personnel: “‘Seeing is believing, if I have not seen it with my own eyes, does it mean it’s false?'”
“Hmm?” Xu Duojin, surprised, glanced at Colin through his sunglasses before nodding:
“Yes, that’s roughly the gist. This effect would activate upon his death or whenever he felt it was appropriate…”
“Activation upon death? Then decapitation in advance is pointless? With such a bug, if he can’t win, can’t he just keep resetting indefinitely?”
Colin took a sharp intake of breath; if the opponent’s strength wasn’t too much higher, wasn’t it simply a matter of dragging it out?
“Not really, first of all, the number of uses isn’t infinite. Generally speaking, we Level Seven Personnel can use it once or twice a week, three times at most—Bonfire might have more uses, but certainly not infinite…”
“Secondly, factors like the venue and the enemy’s power affect this thing. The smaller the venue, the better, otherwise ‘recording’ takes a lot of time. As for power, the stronger the enemy, the worse the efficiency of the skill…
“If it’s activated in the midst of battle due to his death, the effect is particularly poor.”
“Also, if the enemy receives reinforcements, the resulting variables can significantly impact the ability, even with a certain probability of breaking the effect completely…”
“However, once successful ‘recording’ is made, those included in the record have a hard time escaping; usually, they can only resort to brute force, fighting it out all over again.”
With a wry smile and a shake of his head, Xu Duojin cleared up the relevant issues before further inquiring Colin for details about that battle.
Then, he roughly confirmed that Bonfire indeed possessed some deeper methods…
For instance, from Colin’s accounts, the adversary clearly had less power, yet the ‘recording’ time was much faster, more than double his speed, and the state after usage was much better than expected…
And more importantly…
The mental and physical state of that Bonfire personnel was still that of a young person.
No whitened hair, no baldness, and the skin hadn’t aged…
Xu Duojin raised his hat with his left hand while his right hand reached in to touch his hair…
But he felt nothing at all.
‘That form, is it the state after having taken ‘Gene Compensation Medicine’…’
Xu Duojin sighed inwardly; unfortunately, he was already Eighth Level personnel, too late to use it.
After letting out a breath, he continued to look at Colin: “You must have noticed, those ‘Destiny Propeller’ users, they talk a lot during a normal fight; don’t think it’s all nonsense…”
“Actually, that’s their way of deepening the connection between you two. How well the various ‘Destiny Propeller’ methods are triggered mainly depends on their understanding of you, as well as the relationship between both parties…
“Because of your overpowering presence at the time, his ‘Fate Correction’ was obviously not perfect enough…”

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - 435 389 The World Undercurrents Stirring..._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 435: 389 Chapter The World Undercurrents Stirring…_2 Chapter 435: 389 Chapter The World Undercurrents Stirring…_2 “A truly perfect ‘Fate Correction’ can make it so that our allies remain unscathed, while the enemy retains their injured status, even to the point where you can’t recall something that happened before…”
Hearing Xu Duojin describe this, Colin couldn’t help but be amazed at these flamboyant abilities.
Then, he suddenly felt that he should perhaps promote “Hu Zheng” a bit…
Having something like “Fate Correction” to fall back on was still pretty good.
‘If all those extras leveled up to higher ranks, it would be like I had infinite lives…’
Colin suddenly felt an impulse to power-level some alt account.
At this moment, while Xu Duojin internally lamented his lack of fortune to experience the effects of the potion himself, he began to talk about the other abilities of “Fate Propeller.”
“Besides, the main combat technique of ‘Destiny Propeller’ is an ability known as ‘Fate’s Third Hand,’ which is the most powerful attack at our disposal…”
Hearing this, Colin felt a chill in his heart, as he saw an odd “hand” extend from Xu Duojin’s chest.
He had a feeling that if that thing caught him, he would either die or be severely wounded…
“Once I touch an enemy with it, if I so desire, the enemy could instantly age, have their abilities restricted, or I could simply crush them. With preparation, I can stop a train traveling at 200 kilometers per hour head-on with this hand…”
“At the same time, it can also extract a person’s strings of fate, interfering with and rewriting their fate and memories, among other things…”
“The downside is, it’s not fast, even slower than a normal human. It’s easy to dodge if you want to avoid it. Plus, if it is attacked by extraordinary means, it’s easy to get injured, and if it gets hurt, it’s more troublesome than losing my head…”
“So we generally use it as a last resort to settle things.”
While talking, Colin saw Xu Duojin manipulate this hand, passing it through the helicopter door to touch the body of that Fifth Level Personnel and the undercover agent, seemingly making some modifications…
And after showing off this thing, Colin felt that many invisible “hands” extended from Xu Duojin’s body.
“In addition, ‘The Third Hand’ has many auxiliary hands which lean more towards combat, with strong power and speed, but without special abilities like altering memories. The advantage is, their destruction doesn’t affect the main body…”
“According to the standards, starting from Fourth Level, you get two auxiliary hands, and with each level up, the number doubles, along with increased strength and range…”
“Just like how everyone develops differently, the growth varies too. Some extras might have too little experience, and even upon reaching Fourth Level, they don’t have this ability, while some geniuses, not even at Fourth Level, have a number of auxiliary hands comparable to Fifth Level…”
Listening to it, it sounds a bit envious. Are you hinting at Hu Zheng?
Colin muttered in his heart, looking at the numerous “hands” on Xu Duojin’s body, aside from the black lines. It reminded him that he seemed to have not seen that colleague use this method on the train.
However, if there were no problems in the second round of fighting, he would probably encounter it.
After all, it was during the second round that those people brought out their trump cards. It’s just unfortunate that, at that time, those people had just been “Reset” and lost control within seconds…
Shaking his head inwardly, Colin continued to listen to Xu Duojin for more relevant information.
Beyond these, Xu Duojin also spoke of several other abilities Colin was already familiar with, such as precognition, luck manipulation, and spiritual insights similar to “Fatal Insight” and so on…
This gave Colin a better understanding of the high-end combat capabilities of this power.
“Overall, their combat effectiveness is decent, but not geared towards combat types. They’re extraordinarily effective as support. Of course, with the right tools, it’s not impossible to take an alternative approach to fighting…”
Listening to the other’s words, Colin summarized in his mind.
With this information in hand, if he encountered similar situations in the future, even if it was only a C Level, he wouldn’t be caught off guard due to lack of information.
After exchanging relevant information, Xu Duojin didn’t leave but instead asked with a serious face:
“Mr. Colin, there’s something we’d like to ask about. There might be some problems with the ‘World Barriers.’ Based on your understanding, are there any related reports inside the company?”
“The ‘World Barriers’ are having issues? Can I ask what kind of problems first?”
Colin asked confusedly, and then saw the other nodding and continuing, “This matter also relates to your last incident, didn’t a vast majority of people get drafted for that mission?”
“At that time, we had many people seal some anomalies and intended to throw them out of there…”
Shit, the situation was so chaotic back then, you guys really helped a lot…
Hearing Xu Duojin’s words, Colin couldn’t help but curse internally as he had thought they were all dumped on some island nation. He didn’t expect everyone was tossing anomalies over there…
‘It’s like they’ve been catching anomalies with nowhere to put them, and as soon as they found a trash can, they started throwing without a care…’
Muttering to himself, he heard the other person continue.
“According to our estimates, tossing such a large amount of anomalies out should have raised the reality stability index by seven to nine points, maybe even ten points. This, in turn, would significantly strengthen the ‘World Barriers’…”
“But the reality is, the stability index has only increased by about three percent, which is severely off from our expectations.”
“At a previous joint meeting, everyone felt that as we were throwing things out, something might be silently occupying those voids…”
Xu Duojin spoke with concern, sharing the current information.
Usually, when they encounter “alternate dimension” spaces, they can’t just throw things in carelessly because there might be a limit, and if things are thrown in and the “alternate dimension” bursts, it could become a greater disaster.

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - 436 389 Under a Restless World..._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 436: Chapter 389 Under a Restless World…_3 Chapter 436: Chapter 389 Under a Restless World…_3 Or, after they cast it over, the entities on the other side might throw it back to them…
There might even be a breakout of combat.
Being able to casually toss “trash” without worrying about the consequences, as this time, was truly rare.
However, what should have been a cause for joy now failed to lift their spirits because such a situation meant that a massive threat was unfolding, and they knew almost nothing about it…
Listening to the other party’s words, Colin pondered for a moment, and combining it with his own experiences, he roughly speculated.
“Be wary of those that induce chaos, disease, alteration, and the like, and pay attention to their origins. This incident might be related to the other world that Qin Chuan and I visited before…”
Colin relayed the response written on the envelope from “Lady Bunny” at the time.
“Is that so…” Xu Duojin pondered and nodded, then asked for more details.
Colin answered each one, and after a short while, when the questioning ended, he withdrew his “third hand” from the Fifth Level Official Personnel, glanced outside the helicopter, stood up, and seemed ready to jump down and leave this place…
However, before he left, Colin inquired about Old Master Wu’s situation.
The reply he received was…
Apart from the situation with the “world barriers” being pessimistic, everything else was more or less okay.
Then, after Xu Duojin had the pilot raise the helicopter a bit higher, he pulled open the hatch door, stepped out, and like jumping off a building, he leaped from thousands of meters in the sky.
Colin leaned his head against the window, curious to see what special methods this person had for taking off.
What he saw was Xu Duojin casually donning a glider wing that he produced out of nowhere mid-air, and then something jetted out from the ends of the wings, and he flew away…
“Ah, that’s a rather plain and simple method.”
Colin blinked, unsure of what to say, as he found that official personnel generally avoided using their extraordinary abilities during routine operations…
However, after giving it some thought, he understood the reason. It wasn’t that these people didn’t want to leave in a more flamboyant manner, but rather that using their abilities came at a great cost, so they were as economical as possible when employing them.
The stronger ones were even more so…
Under normal circumstances, they would never squander their power as frivolously as young folks like Qin Chuan did.
Shaking his head, he didn’t dwell on it. Colin closed his eyes and reviewed the information about the “Rat” encountered during the recent battle. Unfortunately, he didn’t learn much, only that it involved a troublesome group related to “The Seventh Box Garden World.”
Some time later, as the helicopter landed on the rooftop of a large building in the city, the awakened Fifth Level Personnel remembered Colin but had forgotten the specifics of what had just transpired.
In his memory, it wasn’t Colin who had dealt with everything, but rather Mr. Xu Duojin who had arrived and changed everything.
Despite feeling something was off about this portion of his memory, he didn’t harbor much suspicion.
After all, in his memory, Colin was indeed strong, but no matter how powerful, it was unlikely that he alone, a Fifth Level Personnel, could have dealt with hundreds of Heretics, right?
Yet, even so, he still maintained utmost respect for Colin, who held the Heaven-reaching Document that could summon an Eighth Level Boss.
“The power of ‘Destiny Propeller’ truly sends shivers down one’s spine…”
Upon seeing the Fifth Level Personnel who seemed to have forgotten the recent events, Colin murmured to himself, then joined Qin Chuan and the others on the road home, arriving at his small bedroom a few hours later.
“Next is the trip to ‘World Code’ 13. I need to prepare for that as well.”
Colin sat on his bed, unfolded the parchment, and his gaze swept over an employee.
Planning to pick out a few “lucky employees,” he intended to bestow upon them the “Other World Seven-Day Tour” gift package he had prepared with great effort.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - 437 389 The Terrifying Steel Behemoth_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 437: Chapter 389: The Terrifying Steel Behemoth!_1 Chapter 437: Chapter 389: The Terrifying Steel Behemoth!_1 On the parchment, many colleagues were still discussing the recent experience, where, aside from the point rewards, the most mentioned was the scene where Colin single-handedly held off a million-strong army.
Without a doubt, that scene had left them with a tremendous psychological impact…
“Blow it up, blow it up, I love to watch.”
Colin, holding the parchment and lying on the boat, glanced over the flattery, searching for those fated to journey with him to the Other World.
Of course, compared to yesterday, the topic had cooled down quite a bit today…
Many more people cursed the group of “Emperor of Labors” and “King of Rollers.”
“Domineering Sky”: Yo! These roll dogs came prepared, with all kinds of props on them, many gears not Purple Gear but better than Purple Gear, even stronger items, making their task efficiency better than a mule’s. How are we supposed to compete with such opponents, how on earth can we even compete!
“Supreme Preserved Egg・Alden Beast”: No chance, humans can’t beat beasts, we’ve already been utterly defeated…
“Call me Your Queen!”: Damn it! I’d better not find out the real locations of these traitor workers, or I’d go offline and sort them out in reality!
“Unnamed 114514”: @Call me Your Queen! I know where they are, it’s just that it’s not good to discuss this online in the internal hall. I suggest we meet in private, and I’ll take you to find them…
“Master of the Fish Pond”: @Call me Your Queen! Now that I think about it, I do know the origins of this group of people, they are from the officials, literally the real-life officials, heh, if you storm in, you’ll definitely be able to get in…. Also, keep collecting Bonfire Points, the highest ratio in the whole company.
“Dream Chaser with Childlike Heart”: Brothers, quit struggling and come ashore, it’s direct entry without examination now, and the treatment is still pretty good, plus you’ll be fully protected and safe throughout the tasks, super comfortable!
“Wandering Speedy Lad”: Conspiracy! I advise everyone to keep yourselves safe offline, exposing yourselves is definitely not good…
“Fate’s Empty Sky”: What if there’s no mission, I can’t even lift the pot, now even if the legendary ‘The Descent Project’ comes, I might just take it, after all, Brother Shunzi and that group haven’t had any trouble…
“Professor Cute Cuddle”: Someone else fights ten at a time, can you also fight ten at a time?
…
“Okay, okay, after half an hour of watching, are there actually people actively requesting? ‘Fate’s Empty Sky’, right, let me make a note of you first…”
Colin nodded his head in satisfaction, instructing the Little Maid beside him to note down the name.
Then, he continued his search, this time he could bring 21 F Level Employees, 6 E Level, and 3 D Level.
The time was the day after tomorrow…
He should be able to pick the people.
But whether the people he picked would choose to accept the mission, that was a question mark.
Keep in mind, employees have the right to decline missions, don’t be fooled by these people’s bluster about accepting “The Descent Project”, when in fact, when a real mission is issued, they’re likely to run faster than Usain Bolt.
Therefore, how to get employees to voluntarily undertake a mission is also an art.
“The only advantage now is that, generally, when ‘The Descent Project’ is issued, not accepting doesn’t mean automatic refusal, but automatic acceptance…”
“Once they fail to refuse in time, it will be like my first time entering the event, straight into the event, by then it will be too late…”
Colin thought for a moment, the key lying in how to catch his opponents off guard.
“If F Level Employees won’t do, I should be able to borrow some from the officials, for E Level, these guys are slippery, there’s a chance they’ll detect something’s off and outright refuse. The trouble is with the D Level staff, these old slickers won’t be easy to coax in, hmm, and I should pick people who are suitable for the job…”
Colin had his own set of criteria for choosing people.
Generally, he values the “functionality” of the individual more, whereas their combat strength is less important as no one is stronger than him—
Aside from a few exceptions.
After jotting down a list of names, Colin started to draft the specifics of the mission descriptions.
The original company mission description was to send employees to the real “World Code-13”, but after some thought, Colin changed it to investigate an “anomalous location”…
Unfortunately, this modification was rejected as the location could not be changed, but after some brainstorming, he successfully revised it to “proceed to non-standard locations (for location details, open ‘note 1’) for constructive tasks,” and so on…
As for the reward description, it stated that the mission was repeatable, guaranteeing a minimum of 200 Points for F Level, 500 for E Level, and 800 for D Level…
“Nope, the description still needs to be reworded…”
Colin licked his dry lips and polished the statement a bit.
[Reminder: This mission guarantees a minimum of 800 Points to start with, and can be stacked with ‘grading’!!! (For details, open ‘note 2’)]
“Yeah, people usually go straight for the rewards, so they’re likely to look at ‘note 2’ first and then ‘note 1’, and as long as it takes more than fifteen seconds, the mission will start…”
A smile slowly spread across Colin’s face.
He had already selected more than a hundred people for his list, and when the time came, he could distribute the missions in a way similar to grabbing red packets; whoever got one, it was theirs…
Of course, if there’s an opportunity, he could arrange for some official F Level Staff to join in and compete undercover.
In the end, out of these hundred people, as long as one-fifth agreed, the recruitment task would be considered complete, and with these people entering “World Code-13”, the situation there should see a swift development.
As for whether these people would behave after crossing over, Colin wasn’t particularly worried.
He wasn’t completely sure about the company’s specific requirements for hiring employees, but one thing was certain, the employees generally had a readiness that amounted to “if I die, so be it; if not, earn more.”

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - 438 389 The Terrifying Steel Behemoth_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 438: Chapter 389: The Terrifying Steel Behemoth!_2 Chapter 438: Chapter 389: The Terrifying Steel Behemoth!_2 “Let the legendary tasks no longer be mere legends, let everyone have the chance to become part of the legend, and fulfill everyone’s dream of being the protagonist in another world…”
Colin nodded, then began waiting for the day after tomorrow, which was December 25th, for The Descent.
Afterward, he checked the time, it was only three in the morning, still early. So he picked up his phone and started arranging tasks for Qin Chuan, requesting a batch of about 3.5 cubic meters of emergency supplies…
The special supply food obtained through official internal channels was far better than what he could get his hands on.
“This should initially resolve the food and warmth issues, not having a bunch of people relying on drinking ‘Holy Water’ and compressed starch to survive every day…”
As thoughts swirled in his mind, Colin methodically planned his next moves.
For now, as long as he methodically used the two Gene Compensation Medicines, he would be able to smoothly commence the D Level Promotion Mission.
In the meantime, he could take the rookies to clear the surroundings.
If nothing unexpected happened, there should be no accidents…
“A flexible work system is indeed not bad. Usually at this time, I would have to consider how to deal with cyclical tasks, but now I can start preparing for the promotion instance.”
Colin muttered to himself, roughly organized the events, and slowly closed his eyes.
A day of free time passed quickly…
On December 25th, Colin received ten F Level Employee slots from the officials.
If possible, he would’ve preferred that all the lower-level employees be from the official side, but regrettably, as soon as the officials heard that he was carrying out “The Descent Project,” each of them turned pale with fright…
In the end, after some haggling, he got ten people.
That was half the number of the twenty he had expected…
“Is it necessary to act like going to another world means never returning? Those otakus dream of escaping reality to travel to other worlds every day, yet have no way to do so!”
Colin complained with exasperation and glanced at the time, realizing it was about right. He then lay back in bed to await the coming of the fog and the ring of bells, as they had in days past.
…
Meanwhile, at this very moment, Bonfire Employees were receiving an emergency task.
[Special Event: “Head to an unconventional location (see ‘Note 1’ for location details) to carry out a construction task.”]
“Description”: On a barren land (see ‘Note 1’ for details), a group of refugees is in dire straits, with many innocent boys and girls suffering from disease…
“Requirement”: Join thirty other employees in executing this task to assist the refugee group and obtain relatively generous rewards (current need for F Level slots 11/21).
“Task Difficulty Assessment”: Almost no danger (current).
“Tip”: This task has a minimum guaranteed points start of 800, and can be stacked with ‘Assessment’!!! (see ‘Note 2’ for details)
“Tip2”:…
…
“Note1”:…
“Note2”:…
“Construction task? What kind of odd job is this? Relief and rescue work?”
Some of the F Level Staff were puzzled, their gaze sweeping over the details, and upon seeing the minimum guaranteed 800 points start, their eyes suddenly lit up.
Such a high-point reward task at their rank was rare…
Especially since the participant count had already reached eleven, and the difficulty assessment was almost risk-free, plus it was a rescue and relief type of task…
Just a relief effort, what could go wrong?
Seeing there were less than ten spots left, some hurriedly confirmed acceptance.
However, once securing a slot, before a smug smile could spread across their faces after scrutinizing the fine print, hopeless expressions spread one by one!
“Damn it, can’t stand firm, it’s ‘The Descent Project’!”
…
Compared to the F Level, the E Level staff sensed something amiss. Most, as Colin had thought, first glanced at the rewards and noted issue two, realizing the first problem. But even with the realization, a guaranteed 500 points was quite appealing.
However, while pondering whether to undertake it, they casually opened “Note 1” and with a glance at its content, shock appeared on their faces.
“Crap, it’s…”
Before they could finish, the bell sounds and the haze arrived.
Some rejected on time, some not so timely…
As for the more seasoned D Level staff, they instantly recognized something off about the mission upon receiving it, realizing the unusual style of the task description and that they could view the details directly without having accepted it. Suspicious!
Without a second thought, some outright refused the task that reeked of irregularity.
However, there were those who intended to refuse but opened “Note 1” and after seeing its content, especially the words “World Code -13,” they instead wore pensive expressions and didn’t reject right away…
…
The ancient and distant bell faded slowly from earshot…
When Colin reopened his eyes, he found himself in a familiar little church, with the Third Level Bonfire slowly burning before him.
First thing, he opened his own mission content and started checking the recruitment situation for this Descent.
“30 people, twenty-nine came, tsk, only two D Levels, eh? Seems like it really isn’t easy to fool these folks…”
Though it was a bit disappointing to be one person short, it wasn’t a task that could only be issued once.
There would be future opportunities to post it again; if the fish didn’t bite now, eventually, others would…
At that moment, the figures of the trio from the Other World appeared behind Colin. Li Ming looked around with anticipation, but not seeing any new colleagues, he turned to Colin:
“Hey, boss, where are the other people you talked about?”
Last Sunday, the boss had summoned them to that office with the hanging fireball and told them new colleagues were coming. This time, there should be about thirty people, and they would be available for immediate use upon arrival – not livestock, but labor…

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - 439 389 The Terrifying Steel Behemoth_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 439: Chapter 389: The Terrifying Steel Behemoth!_3 Chapter 439: Chapter 389: The Terrifying Steel Behemoth!_3 This excited them tremendously, finally they wouldn’t have to work non-stop for seven days and nights!
Although Colin always led by example and never slept, after the initial excitement, they suddenly sensed something amiss. What was the leader’s constitution, and what was theirs?
The other party could go without sleep as if it were a game, but if they didn’t sleep, they would truly be worked to death!
“They are pretty much like you when you first arrived, now scattered in various places, needing a summons. But I estimate it won’t be long before they all arrive. Hmm, there are already four or five outside, you can start gathering them for a meeting. As for the others, it won’t take long for them to find their way back…”
Colin explained briefly.
He wasn’t too worried about these newcomers meeting with accidents, for they had three chances at resurrection, and a fair number had even been through the self-selected trial of “World Code-13,” knowing what to do…
As for the official crowd that joined later, the problem was, these show-offs were theoretically at level one but were decked out in various “ungraded” equipments provided by the officials, potentially of level fifty or sixty, so there wasn’t too much to worry about.
After a brief sense check, Colin turned and left the church.
He didn’t rush to summon the Saintess but planned to deal with the territorial matters first.
At that moment, many stood outside, Warden Calder with his nephew, Nun Vanessa of the “Light,” Little Red, and so on…
“Big brother!”
Having waited the whole day, Little Red wanted to greet him but knowing that big brother usually wanted to get caught up on the territory’s situation, she stood beside Nun Vanessa and others to listen to them report on the territorial conditions, refraining from disturbing him.
However, Colin at the doorway waved her over and as she approached, he took out a lollipop and handed it to the little girl while patting her head and saying to the others:
“Since there are no major issues, let’s start the mass, bring all the injured here, I will treat them. Oh, and afterwards, let’s hold a commendation ceremony, the ones I mentioned last time…”
In the last Mist Disaster, many had stood out bravely, and these people needed to be encouraged.
Besides, those who worked hard also deserved some rewards.
Such commendation ceremonies were not novel on Earth, but for this world, it was somewhat like fighting at a lower dimension…
It was unheard of for refugees to receive any honors or rewards for working for their lord…
While giving out orders, Colin dragged out various supplies from the “Storage Room,” and upon seeing this, Vanessa and others about to speak gaped in astonishment:
“Is, is there so much this time?! Are all these the same as that food from before?”
They looked at Colin incredulously.
All of the previous supplies combined didn’t even make up a tenth of what was here, barely enough to keep a large part of the population alive.
This time the quantity had increased so much that it seemed enough to fill the bellies of tens of thousands in the territory!
“Yes, you go distribute it, oh and there’s also this thing… The few of you should familiarize yourselves with it, try operating it.”
As Colin spoke, he looked towards a group of three, pulling out a vehicle model the size of his palm from his pocket.
How could they operate this?
As they wondered, Colin threw it on an empty space and the vehicle burst into a thick fog like a smoke grenade.
Soon after, a truck much larger than the average super heavy-duty truck appeared from the dense fog.
“Sss… What kind of creature is this, some kind of giant beast?”
Vanessa and the others widened their eyes again, awestruck by the Steel Behemoth before them, feeling an overwhelming presence exuding from this unknown creature…
And it was at this moment that the Steel Behemoth let out a deep roar, causing the ground to tremble, its pair of eyes emitting a blinding light.
That light was particularly dazzling, with everyone except Vanessa unable to meet its gaze.
Calder and others instinctively braced themselves…
But, feeling the heavy aura of the behemoth, they felt their defenses were like a joke in its presence.
They had a strong premonition…
If they collided with it, they would surely end up either dead or injured!
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - 440 390 Enemy from the Sky_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 440: Chapter 390 Enemy from the Sky!_1 Chapter 440: Chapter 390 Enemy from the Sky!_1 “It’s nothing, this is just a type of special steel construct…”
Colin reassured everyone with a phrase.
He looked at the doubtful expressions on the faces of this group of people and was surprised. He didn’t expect them to be so cautious about these gadgets…
They hadn’t been this nervous even when facing high-level monsters before.
However, after thinking about it, Colin understood the reason. Compared to abnormally grotesque evil creatures, this mechanical construct’s unknown form was indeed making its first appearance in this world.
After his soothing, everyone’s expressions relaxed considerably.
At that moment, Li Ming, who had climbed onto the vehicle, sat in the cockpit, and ideas started popping in his head like popping candy, almost effortlessly understanding the purpose of various buttons and levers…
After becoming somewhat familiar with the buttons, he grasped the steering wheel and felt the surging power from beneath him, unable to help but exclaim:
“A real man should drive a big truck…”
This kind of big car must be far more exciting than those little ones!
Following Colin’s instructions, Li Ming drove the truck towards the town square.
Along the way, many Bonfire Followers who had already noticed the “Steel Behemoth” looked on with a mix of shock and curiosity, especially when they saw the behemoth walking “tamely” behind Envoy of God…
Consequently, countless believers bowed and bent over, praying and voicing praise for the Bonfire.
Even those who didn’t know what was happening, seeing others praying, also knelt down one by one.
“This, it’s one thing to praise knowing what’s going on, but those who don’t know what’s happening, what are they kneeling with such fervor for… Sigh, compulsory education has a long way to go…”
Colin grumbled, glancing around.
It’s not that he hadn’t tried to stop such matters; it’s just that the best he could do was changing kneeling praises into standing praises…
If he outright banned it, the people would panic, scared they had been abandoned.
Of course, some of the new additions didn’t understand these “rituals”, and many of the old kneeling crowd in the noble class and church-heavy Other World had turned kneeling into an instinct as natural as breathing, which was hard to correct even if he wanted to…
At this very moment, Colin was just grateful that his recent weeks spent on sanitation campaigns against open defecation had been effective. Otherwise, the scene of these people praying in a pile of shit and piss would simply be eye-watering…
‘But then again, if it weren’t for the deep-seated faith here, tackling the sanitation problem through ‘rewards and punishments’ alone would be pretty tough.’
‘Yeah, the ‘kitchen module’ of the Base Vehicle seems to convert trees and such into digestible food without much cost, given Points, and with the weekly influx of vitamins and such, sustenance shouldn’t be a problem. It’s a pity there’s no carbon dioxide to starch synthesis…’
‘Now that food is plentiful, it’s time to consider some basic education on common knowledge, but it’s hard to compile teaching materials…’
As each plan took shape in his mind, Colin and his group arrived at the town square.
At Colin’s request, Li Ming drove the vehicle onto a vacant space and then pressed the expand button…
In an instant, the entire Base Vehicle lit up with mysterious patterns like breathing lights, flickering, and then with a click, various seams opened and strange mists sprayed out, completely covering the area.
Amidst the mist, the “clang clang” of construction sounded, shaking the ground…
The overall noise was immense, resembling a large group of construction workers breaking the ground.
Of course, this was with the special effects turned up to the max. Without them, there probably wouldn’t even be this kind of “transition animation”.
In that case, a few flashes of PPT images later, the deployment would be done.
But then, the Points earned from faith would be less…
At this very moment, many Bonfire Followers, feeling the tremendous vibrations of each hammer strike through the misty air, grew more devout in their shock.
And their devout faith flowed into the church Bonfire like water…
The production of “Colorless Energy Crystals” sped up.
Feeling this change, Colin couldn’t help but internally criticize, those Bonfire Company’s prop makers were really meticulous when it came to irrelevant RPG light effects and such…
If they removed these things, the company could probably reduce the overall energy consumption efficiency by several percentage points.
Of course, the downside would be Faith might take a -10 hit.
Meanwhile, other Bonfire Company employees who hadn’t rushed to come forward, blending in with the refugees, watching the commotion in the square, and seeing the figure with the burning Flame…
Mostly confirmed that it was Brother Shunzi.
“Who would have thought, he even started a Church in the Other World…” said one undercover Bonfire Company employee, observing the devout believers around him, feeling a mix of admiration and reflection.
Although he suspected the crappy assignment before was mostly Brother Shunzi’s doing, he had no proof.
But talking about it now was too late anyway.
Better to make some money first…
For now, it seemed that the biggest danger, those things from the “World Code -13” self-selected trial event, had been resolved by Brother Shunzi, so there probably wouldn’t be any danger… probably.
In the end, some employees stopped observing and planned to come forward after Brother Shunzi’s matter was dealt with for a meet up…
And just then, cries of astonishment rose from among the crowd of believers…

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - 441 390 Enemy from the Sky_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 441: Chapter 390 Enemy from the Sky!_2 Chapter 441: Chapter 390 Enemy from the Sky!_2 The employees, weighed down by heavy thoughts, looked towards the sound and instantly felt a twitch in their eyelids: where the hell did Brother Shunzi get this bizarre vehicle?
What used to be the base vehicle was now transformed into a compound-functional building with a ground floor that spanned 500 meters and stood three stories tall.
Colin walked up to the entrance of the expansive base.
Upon seeing this, Tang Ken from the trio from the Other World hastily turned and called out loudly,
“Next, the award ceremony will begin. Please come forward when your name is called. First up, Yeager…”
After he spoke, a man from the top 25, wrapped in bandages in many places, slowly walked up, excitement written all over his face as he approached Colin…
As a former top 25 and now a Bonfire Follower, he had managed to lead a squad of the top 25 and reclaim dozens of acres of land in just half a month with sheer force of will, making even Colin feel astounded after hearing Tang Ken’s report, considering him extraordinarily strong-willed.
Moreover, they contributed quite a lot to the reconstruction of the townhouses…
Of course, during the onslaught of the Catastrophe of the Magic Fog, he had also done a lot, even saving Little Red at a critical moment…
Although on the whole, Nun Vanessa, Calder’s nephew, among others, saved more lives during the magical disaster, considering some special factors, Colin still gave this young man the chance to be the first to take the stage.
Soon, Yeager saw a “Money Slave” approach Colin, carrying a box of Old Tang’s Pickled Cabbage Beef Instant Noodles, a pack of sausages, eggs, a set of rice bowls, a noodle cooking pot, and the like.
Instantly, his face lit up with a pleased smile, clearly satisfied with the rewards he had received.
Especially the Old Tang’s Pickled Cabbage Beef Noodles, he had only tasted a few bites once before, when he won a competition against another top 25 squad in opening up new fields; although it didn’t look impressive, the rich blend of spices left an unforgettable taste.
Of course, it’s not that there weren’t delicious foods in this world.
But what did those have to do with him, the bastard of a disgraced minor noble?
On the other side, Lin Yilan watched this scene with a peculiar expression and couldn’t help but whisper to Tang Ken,
“Isn’t it a bit cheap to reward such great contributions with these things…”
“No, there will be other subsidies in the future, but even with just these, he’s happy, I’m afraid he’d still say ‘thank you’…” Tang Ken responded softly, as he was in charge of land clearance and building construction and knew his subordinates well.
After speaking, he raised his hand to clap, prompting others to join in the applause.
“Thank you, Envoy of God!”
As Yeager took the prize handed to him by Colin and scanned the envious expressions of the other Bonfire Followers around, he felt an excitement stirring within him.
After a while, as they sent him off, Colin went on to give out rewards to the others, one by one.
Calder’s nephew couldn’t come up because of his status, so Colin gave it to him privately.
Nun Vanessa didn’t want to come forward either; after all, she was a bona fide Nun of the “Light”, and what business did she have receiving rewards from another Church?
But…
‘The reward is a big bag of White Rabbit Creamy Candies…’
After hesitating, Vanessa still went on stage and, with a blushing face too shy to look at anyone, took away the prize.
Time passed, and the award ceremony came to an end.
Colin could feel that the invisible faith in the air had become much thicker…
‘It appears that the ceremony was a bit rough, but overall, it went smoothly.’
With a slight nod, he glanced at Tang Ken, who immediately understood and brought forward all the people injured during the magical disaster, along with some others with severe injuries.
The Believers were somewhat puzzled, not knowing what the Divine Envoy was about to do.
But as confusion set in, they saw the Envoy extend his hand and grasp a seal.
Suddenly, their eyes widened as they watched an ancient tree’s projection swiftly sketched out behind him, growing continuously, its canopy shedding healing flames that fell like snowflakes, indiscriminately healing those who were injured…
People’s wounds healed rapidly, diseases were eradicated…
While the faithful enjoyed the healing light of the Fire Tree and revered it, what they didn’t realize was…
From the “Fire Tree”, a stream of consciousness continuously whispered in Colin’s ear.
“Wow… stop feeding me… I can’t take it anymore…”
“This is already my limit…”
“Really… I can’t handle it… I’ll break if this continues…”
“…”
The Fire Tree pleaded for mercy, begging Colin not to stuff it with “Colorless Crystals” anymore.
Watching the “Fire Tree” that had reached a height of sixty to seventy meters, Colin ceased the action in his hands.
“It’s quite different from the one in my dream, probably only about half its size? No, even less; it was still in a suppressed state in my dream, and if it were to be liberated, its strength would probably double…but for now, it’s enough.”
Colin shook his head inwardly, thinking that if he wanted to expand it further, he would have to proceed with an “Item Liberation”.
But doing it himself was certainly not an option…
And giving it to someone else also didn’t seem quite right.
However, before he could ponder further, Colin, standing at the top of the tree’s canopy, suddenly heard a wave of commotion coming swiftly from the outer edge of the crowd, and then off in the distance, a black-gray Magic Fog surged on the great land…
Within it, there seemed to be some terrifying creatures attracted by the Fire Tree’s radiating light.
It would probably take only a few minutes before they arrived here…
“A small Magic Fog, huh?”
Colin took a moment to sense it and felt it was neither strong nor weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - 442 390 Enemy from the Sky_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 442: Chapter 390 Enemy from the Sky!_3 Chapter 442: Chapter 390 Enemy from the Sky!_3 If he hadn’t come this time, the domain would be prepared, but not as disastrously as before; nevertheless, many would likely still perish…
Unfortunately for them, this time, he was there.
“Now, as long as I don’t enter some special locations, like the depths of the ‘Plague of Magic Fog,’ I can basically claim to be invincible in the world. However, apart from the Magic Fog, it seems that some other people have also arrived…”
Colin’s gaze swept over and noticed some teams that could still be considered strong on this land, rushing towards his direction.
…
Meanwhile, in a southeastern direction, a three-hundred-person troop was slowly advancing towards Colin’s territory from outside the Knight Kingdom…
They were from the neighboring Snow Empire, well-equipped, and even the least among them had the strength of a trainee knight.
Grouped together, they could even launch a large-scale war charge, facing a massive battlefield composed of tens of thousands of combatants…
“A minor ‘Plague of Magic Fog’ by the looks of it, those people of some Bonfire Church or whatever will probably suffer again, hehe…”
An Imperial Knight Legion Commander, with a scarred face, glanced at the distant Magic Fog and sneered.
“The monsters in the Mist Disaster seem to target that little town church; are we heading there now?”
“No, there’s no rush, we’ll approach them according to our other plan,” the commander said, waving his hand. He planned to intervene after the invasion of the Magic Fog, to co-opt their strength and make them serve the empire.
Although he did not understand why the people of The Kingdom of Knights recognized such a minor church on the border…
Even allowing it to become a completely independent domain.
It didn’t matter, after recruiting them, their further plots against The Kingdom of Knights could be signalled.
A “Church of Light” priest accompanying the troops seemed to want to say something. According to his intelligence, the Bonfire Apostle was far more terrifying than the others knew, but after a moment’s thought, he remained silent.
These people were customarily arrogant and hardly ever listened to his advice.
“Whoo-hoo-hoo!” A whimpering spiritual storm spread out like a low weep…
In the distant sky, a huge figure appeared from above.
Seeing this figure, the commander’s expression grew solemn, “A tiny ‘Wailing Angel,’ huh…”
It was indeed a troublesome creature. Not to mention that it could fly hundreds of meters high, making it extremely difficult to attack, even if it landed, it would still be a hassle to deal with…
However, considering the benefits of recruiting the so-called “Bonfire” force under his command, he decided to go anyway…
Just then, the light in the dim sky suddenly brightened.
Everyone instinctively looked up, immediately seeing what seemed like a sun rising gently over the silent woods around the small town. It rose to a certain height and then fell towards the Magic Fog like a meteor…
“Boom!”
A mushroom cloud ignited with flames slowly ascended.
Within the firelight, the Magic Fog was burned to nothingness, and the figure of the “Wailing Angel” vanished entirely…
For a moment, the Knight Legion was enveloped in an eerie silence, so profound it was as if you could hear a pin drop.
“Gulp…” An officer on horseback took a deep breath, then broke the silence, “Commander, do we still covertly subdue them and then intervene…”
“Impudence!”
The commander snapped back to reality. He glanced at the non-Knight Legion personnel within the troops and then fiercely lashed his whip against the officer:
“What intervention? What are you talking about? Don’t speak nonsense and spread rumors! Respecting his holy sovereignty and not interfering with the internal affairs of other forces is a consistent practice of the empire…”
Feeling the vibration in the air, he finally understood why The Kingdom of Knights, a nation known for its exclusivity, would actually recognize an obscure small church…
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - 443 391 As an Extraordinary One could I
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 443: Chapter 391: As an Extraordinary One, could I possibly be exhausted to death by moving just two bricks?_1 Chapter 443: Chapter 391: As an Extraordinary One, could I possibly be exhausted to death by moving just two bricks?_1 “Lucky hit, seemed to hit the weak spot, and killed it instantly…”
Gazing into the distance, he noticed the once formidable figure within the fog now languishing. Colin nodded, feeling pretty satisfied.
Last time he encountered such a creature, it took a melee combo to take it down.
Now, with a bit of grease, some invisibility, stacking some BUFFs, he could kill it from a mile away without breaking a sweat. All things considered, he felt quite good about his progress…
It’s a shame, though, that monsters born from this unknown fog evaporate so swiftly once they die.
Except for some flesh that could be burned, there wasn’t much in the way of valuable loot left behind.
“Damn, boss, did you just roll a mini nuke with your bare hands…” Li Ming and the others couldn’t help but gasp upon witnessing this.
It wasn’t nearly this exaggerated when they last saw him.
No, to be precise, every week they entered here, the boss seemed to rapidly grow stronger.
It was even more outrageous than drug enhancements…
They exchanged glances and could all see the shock in each other’s eyes.
Many Bonfire Followers were even devoutly kneeling on the ground, loudly singing his praises.
On the other hand, when other Bonfire Company employees saw this scene, they weren’t too shocked, after all, during the Ghost Train aid incident, Colin’s “Clearing Skies” was far more extreme.
That was a terrifying move that literally reshaped the landscape…
However, compared to Colin’s power, they couldn’t help but recall the monsters’ aura they had just felt…
That creature, while the D Level Personnel scattered across different locations thought they could handle it, would likely take several days of planning to deal with, and even then it wasn’t a sure thing. Such a troublesome enemy, and Brother Shunzi seemed to kill it effortlessly.
The disparity between people could be so vast…
They suddenly realized that the “almost risk-free” part of the mission referred to when Brother Shunzi was around; if he wasn’t here one day, the situation might not bode well.
‘It’s “The Descent Project” after all, it can’t really be without danger…’ a group of employees couldn’t help but sigh to themselves.
It’s easy to board this ship of thieves, but difficult to get off.
Meanwhile, Colin, seeing no further threat nearby, paid no attention to other forces soon to arrive. He leapt down from the Fire Tree canopy and then saw seven employees approaching…
During this process, several employees exchanged looks as if they were just now confirming that the others were employees as well.
Colin glanced at them and could confirm that they had undergone Soul Transference.
Based on the characteristic that “Bonfire Company” employees attract each other, Colin could determine they were employees and could roughly guess their levels through certain traits…
However, it was still not enough to identify who was who specifically.
“Turn on your ID display and let me take a look.” Colin unceremoniously requested.
At the same time, he displayed the name “654321” above his head.
This name could only be seen by official company employees…
Seeing this, the people didn’t delay and displayed their company names.
“‘Life Mentor Adorable,’ ‘Big-Eared Tutu,’ ’17 is My Wife,’ ‘Health is Blessing’…”
Colin quickly swept his gaze over them, one D Level, two E Level, and four F Level, three of which were official personnel…
As thoughts flickered, he withdrew his gaze, surprised, and looked at “Life Mentor Adorable”: “I thought someone like you would definitely not come here.”
This person was indeed a seasoned old-timer; much of the basic knowledge in the company was published by them.
If he came here, it was likely not because he was tricked…
“I’ve been stuck at a plateau for a long time, and I need to break through to progress. To take on promotion tasks, I have to find a way to break through from somewhere else.” “Life Mentor Adorable” succinctly explained his situation.
Before coming here, he had gathered quite a bit of new intelligence through the few people from “World Code-4” and thus understood more about “The Descent Project.”
In his opinion, as long as someone could firmly establish a foothold in “The Descent Project” and set up the first base…
The difficulty of what came next wouldn’t be unacceptable.
Moreover, with the incentive of high reward Points…
To further improve himself.
It was indeed worth a try.
However, without indulging in too much idle chat, “Life Mentor Adorable” glanced at the others and curiously asked:
“So, what should we do next?”
“For now, just follow me, and we’ll go to the Bonfire to register…”
As Colin spoke, he moved forward, gesturing for them to follow, and headed towards the Church while saying:
“Unless something unexpected happens, it’s all minor stuff, like planning for territory construction, very easy tasks,
“Then later, some Church personnel might come to visit, and you’ll probably need to receive them,…like explaining our principles to them…”
“Also, you should get acquainted with these three people first and learn about the situation here.
“They are Employees too, but the difference is they’re my direct recruits…”
The people nodded in response, feeling that it wasn’t a big issue, but “Life Mentor Adorable” was taken aback by the last part of the statement.
“Directly recruited employees?” He wasn’t quite sure and asked again.
Oh, I didn’t elaborate. To be precise, it should be “Lady Rabbit” who gave me the list, and I chose from it. In some sense, they indeed could be considered to be recruited directly by me, so the description is not a problem…
While his thoughts raced, Colin confirmed, “Yes.”
It was then that the other veteran employees finally registered the importance of this statement…
“Damn, Brother Shunzi has the qualification to recruit employees directly now?”
They held their breath involuntarily.
They wanted to ask more, but unfortunately, Brother Shunzi didn’t seem willing to elaborate further.

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - 444 391 As an Extraordinary One could I
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 444: Chapter 391: As an Extraordinary One, could I possibly be exhausted to death by moving just two bricks?_2 Chapter 444: Chapter 391: As an Extraordinary One, could I possibly be exhausted to death by moving just two bricks?_2 An employee changed the subject and asked curiously:
“Are there only a few of us here? I thought the mission said there were more than twenty of us…”
“The others are still on their way, and they should all arrive by tomorrow at the latest. It’s similar to that ‘selective trial event’ you did; everyone is currently scattered around and has to complete registration before they can reliably appear from the church…”
After Colin’s brief explanation, except for a few official “double duty” employees who did not understand the reason, the others nodded to show they understood.
The official personnel didn’t understand because they didn’t have much demand for props. Besides saving money to buy more “Gene Compensation Medicine,” they basically didn’t spend points on anything else and wouldn’t try “selective trial events” on a large scale…
However, it wasn’t a big problem, as their first task upon showing up here was.
The first thing everyone did was to register at the location of the Bonfire…
“They might have to spend the night outside if they don’t arrive until tomorrow at the latest? Those might have bad luck,” an employee said involuntarily.
The nights in this world aren’t something to mess with. If one doesn’t light a fire and gets trapped in it at night…
“So the main task this time is to go out and fetch people back,”
Colin said, “But even if we don’t bring them back, mixing with those refugees and spending a night shouldn’t be much of a problem.”
Throughout this time, he had also gained quite an understanding of the darkness of this world.
For example, when the disaster survivors wander, they can’t possibly have a fire every time, so they try to fall asleep before night falls. Once asleep, they can remain asleep amidst the darkness until they wake up the next day.
The probability of encountering danger during this time drops to almost negligible…
Within the night’s veil, all things are stilled.
Even the anomalous succumbs to the same fate…
Besides that, burying oneself in a dirt hole or entering a completely dark enclosed space can also achieve a similar effect.
And if one doesn’t use these methods to avoid the risks of nightfall, there’s a not-so-small chance of disappearing or going mad.
However, this is only feasible for ordinary people and some low-level Extraordinary Ones, while stronger Extraordinary Ones, such as those above D Level, seem more prone to accidents whether asleep or awake…
The stronger they are, the more likely they are to encounter problems.
That’s why it’s also known in this world as the “Transcendent’s Nightmare,” the “Curse of the Mighty,” and the like.
So as long as Colin could ensure that E-level and above personnel were brought back on the first day, that would be enough.
“Speaking of which, I remember when I first came in and was chatting with Calder and Vanessa, they mentioned that the reason for the nights in this world being like this seems to be related to the ‘Light’ Church?”
Colin stroked his chin, recalling their words, and had some thoughts, but unfortunately, they didn’t know much, having only heard rumors that it might be related to some event hundreds of years ago.
“Three or four hundred years ago, the ‘Light’ Church was known as the ‘Holy Light Conclave,’ but something happened, and it fragmented, falling from its position of uniting most of ‘World Code-13,’ into countless branch churches. The ‘Light’ Church is the largest of them, and that was also the biggest event at the end of the last epoch, the beginning of this one…”
“Unfortunately, the local people I know don’t have very high status, so they don’t know much inside information.”
“But one thing is worth noting; that time point hundreds of years ago… seems to also be when the company had problems?”
Colin speculated randomly, but unfortunately, there were no significant revelations.
Afterward, as he brought several people to the Bonfire to complete their registration, he tried to contact the Saintess through the Golden Mark, which was now the size of a fingernail.
But for some reason, his call this time fell on deaf ears, with no response…
“She’s probably on some other task,”
Colin shook his head, then gave a few instructions to the employees present, and went out on his own to fetch people.
As for those Church personnel who were about to visit…
He wasn’t in a hurry to make contact.
Soon, as Colin left, Li Ming and the others turned around at the church gate and looked at this group of “senior employees,” feeling a bit of pressure in their hearts…
He had just learned that every one of them held a higher position than their current G Level!
Especially since one of them seemed to be on the same level as the boss…
Could there be two individuals capable of nuclear-level interventions?
The trio had been looking forward to experiencing what it was like to be leaders, but now they only felt immense pressure.
Seemingly sensing their dilemma, “Life Mentor Adorable” stepped forward and said, “Since Brother Shunzi has told us to follow your lead, just arrange things as you see fit, and we will try our best to complete them…”
These were Brother Shunzi’s direct subordinates—they couldn’t just be treated as low-level employees. If they became unhappy and complained to Brother Shunzi, that wouldn’t be good!
Brother Shunzi, the boss’s nickname within the company? Li Ming mumbled to himself, then promptly got started with the work arrangements.
“We just need to farm, build houses, treat illnesses, and hold training sessions… Are these really all we’re supposed to do? No need to go out and investigate anomalies?”
An employee, upon hearing the arrangements, couldn’t help but express surprise: “This is so easy?”
“Yeah, it’s like retirement, eh? If I had known it was this simple, I would have come earlier…” another employee couldn’t help but add.
They had thought they’d be sent out into dangerous areas to investigate, but instead, they were asked to do ordinary things…
Like moving bricks, farming, saving people and such…
How could they, esteemed Transcendants, with their extraordinary bodies, be worn out by moving a couple of bricks?

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - 445 391 As an Extraordinary One could I
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 445: Chapter 391: As an Extraordinary One, could I possibly be exhausted to death by moving just two bricks?_3 Chapter 445: Chapter 391: As an Extraordinary One, could I possibly be exhausted to death by moving just two bricks?_3 “Relaxing?” Li Ming and his trio pursed their lips, exchanging glances, seemingly still able to see the traces of fatigue and dark circles on each other’s faces…
They didn’t say anything, though.
After all, these people would understand in a couple of days…
But now, with their joining and the supplies and new equipment brought by Colin this time,
the work had become much easier…
Aside from keeping one person at the church to welcome other arriving employees, the rest quickly dove into the work at this place.
After a hectic half-day, as evening was approaching, everyone in the territory suddenly heard a thunderous noise from the sky like a plane passing by…
The noise immediately put everyone on alert, but before they could act, they realized it was Colin returning.
At this moment, another was enveloped in flames, flying about a hundred meters above, with a rope in his left hand, from which a dozen or so people were hanging…
Upon reaching the territory, Colin lowered his height, aimed his right hand at an open space below, and a burst of flame erupted, while with a flick of his left hand, he dropped the people into the fire’s buffer zone.
“Good, all 29 people have arrived…”
Colin nodded, then landed on the ground, and pulled this workforce into the church for registration.
Then, he set them to work with the others, starting the high-intensity tasks of the territory…
After dealing with this group of people, representatives of other forces finally found their chance to visit and took turns approaching.
Colin thought for a moment and decided not to keep refusing, receiving them one by one.
Generally, these people came to express that if he had any needs, he could make a request, showing how friendly they were and mentioning the protection they could provide…
What really struck Colin was the knight legion organized by that empire, which consisted of three hundred knights.
None of them brought a weapon, but instead, they brought loads of supplies across the vast wilderness to aid him…
“Good people, eh.”
Colin didn’t hesitate to accept everything, but as for the requests for various alliances and collaborations from these people, he skipped over all of them.
In addition to that, there was a noble messenger who brought along his twin daughters…
They were sixteen or seventeen years old and very pretty.
Unfortunately, Colin had no interest in these things for the time being, and he chose to decline directly.
If he were really interested in such things, he could have played around as he pleased in reality…
Finally, after sending all the messengers away, Colin stayed alone in the small church, ready to perform another summoning.
However, at this time, from within the bonfire, came the faint sounds of a girl’s voice…
It seemed someone was murmuring softly…
“The bonfire can talk? No, that’s not right…”
Colin frowned, but he quickly recognized the voice.
With a bit of concentration, he could tell…
It sounded like Tina, the Little Mermaid.
“Bonfire, oh bonfire, Li Ming… I can…”
“When will I be able to… see… Mr. Divine Envoy…”
“…he will come… soon…”
“Bonfire, oh…”
“Can I see… him again… please…”
“…Mr. God…”
The voice was intermittent and somewhat distorted, as if it had traveled a great distance, filled with a sense of longing and emotion.
Hearing these words, Colin couldn’t help but envision a scene in his mind: a small mermaid less than a ton in weight praying in front of a massive bonfire, wishing for a glimpse of a desired one, sadly never accomplished…
“Er…”
Colin couldn’t help but cover his mouth with his hand, feeling somewhat guilty.
Although he didn’t have a girlfriend, why did it seem like he somehow owed a lot of emotional debts?
“That being said, the bonfire can transmit messages, too? Wait a minute, both places have ‘World Codes’… does that mean if the bonfire is strong enough, it could facilitate communication between the two worlds?”
Colin suddenly realized something.
If he upgraded the flame to Fifth Level, he should be able to achieve this…
“A Third Level Bonfire allows only one-way reception. At Fourth Level, it can barely transmit some information or perform clearer reception. However, the next upgrade conditions are a hundred thousand people’s belief, a Level 2 Containment Subject as fuel, and ten thousand Points…”
Colin found it didn’t seem too difficult, something he could complete in a week or two.
But before he could think further, he sensed something…
Then he turned his head and looked to a corner of the church, where he saw an ethereal figure glowing faintly approaching.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - 446 392 The Light Chasers One-on-One
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 446: Chapter 392 “The Light Chaser’s” One-on-One Teaching._1 Chapter 446: Chapter 392 “The Light Chaser’s” One-on-One Teaching._1 “An entity?”
Colin saw, beneath the hazy glowing shadow, another figure.
But upon closer inspection, he realized it seemed to be Vanessa…
This… was it possession?
Colin roughly judged the situation.
At the same time, the hazy glowing doppelgänger directly approached the bonfire, first glancing at the bonfire, then turned back to look at the Bonfire Envoy whose status was theoretically at the same level as his own:
“Good evening, ‘Bonfire’ sir, you seem to have something to call upon me for?”
If it were not for hearing someone calling her, she might not have come for a private meeting this week, because her true body had already delved deep into the heart of disaster…
Though operating a doppelgänger didn’t greatly affect her, it was best to stay focused during such times and not be distracted.
However, for this fellow traveler, after finding a relatively safe area, she split off a doppelgänger and came here through Vanessa…
“Yes.”
Colin nodded without much pleasantries and went straight to the point, “There are mainly two matters; first, I would ask for your assistance in my training, oh no, rather to help enhance my strength…”
“Enhancement of strength?” “Vanessa” tilted her head to one side, her gaze resting on him, signaling him to continue.
Her first thought was that the other party wanted a long-term blessing to strengthen themselves, then carry out some other task, but it seemed the request was not just that?
“Yes, I’ve learned one thing from this brief tenure as an employee: my abilities are limited. The more tasks I carry out, the more I feel my inadequacies. If I content myself with now, sooner or later I’ll fall in some unexpected adversity, so I seek to become stronger. Only then might I have a chance to survive…
Colin slowly conveyed his epiphany, then said, “I would like to ask for your help, to further develop my experience and weaknesses through combat methods…”
Although ‘The Light Chaser’ company’s authority level was slightly low and she was a bit greedy, no one could deny her formidable combat strength, making her an excellent choice for enhancing one’s power.
Of course, he had also considered seeking the help of someone like Old Master Wu, but considering the massive costs of these people using extraordinary abilities, which might lead to losing control and dying explosively in training, he had to look elsewhere…
“Ah… sorry, I’m actually not very good at fighting.”
Upon hearing Colin’s words, Shana had intended to simply decline, but what Colin said next made her choke…
“Six thousand points…”
“Eh?” Shana blinked, stunned for a moment.
Having had one transaction experience with him, she knew he could indeed produce such a large sum of points.
Although already inclined to accept the task, and even beginning to recall previous combat experiences to identify areas in need of guidance, those points…
They were a bit too much…
Beyond just the training, there couldn’t be any other requirements, right?
She had to negotiate it down; otherwise, she’d feel uneasy earning so much…
However, just as she was about to speak, Colin realized something and preempted her rejection, raising his hand and saying:
“I know, for you, such time-consuming and laborious tasks… six thousand might be a bit low. Let’s make it eight thousand…”
“So it’s… ah??”
Shana was about to settle for that price but paused in confusion upon his response.
When Colin raised his hand, she initially thought that he elevated the points so high just to attract her attention, then once she leaned towards agreement, he’d use some tactics to push down the price.
Such ploys were often seen in the markets.
But she truly did not expect the price to rise instead of fall, from six thousand to eight thousand…
And before she could even voice an opinion, she saw a mission prompt appear.
[“654321” has completed the mission “Priority Enhancement Project”…]
[You have received “Bonfire Points 8000”, which have been transferred to “Storage Room (with a 10% service fee deducted)”].
“Ah???”
Shana’s eyes widened; she hadn’t even agreed, so how had the mission been completed and transferred?
The next second, an inspiration clarified the reason…
This was a unilateral type of mission; strictly speaking, it wasn’t a transaction, and essentially, the mission’s content was just the other party stuffing money into her pocket…
Completing it was all that was needed.
“Can tasks really be done like this?”
In the distance, amidst the dense darkness of a ruined city, Shana sat atop the head of a gigantic, mutated monster.
She rifled through her little pocket and looked at the sudden appearance of 7200 points.
The entire occurrence left her in an indescribable silence…
Adding on to the three thousand-plus points she had saved up from living frugally over time, she now had over ten thousand points on her!
The 500 points she had saved over a year or two made up only a tiny proportion thereof.
What she received from this “Divine Envoy”…
It was more than all the points she had earned over her entire lifetime in the crusades!
“This…”
Shana had never been so affluent in her life…
But if it was simply to develop some combat experience, let alone eight thousand, even eight hundred or eighty felt like it would have been sufficient…
After all, in her view…
Colin, no matter how tough, wasn’t as hard to handle as the disembodied Ancient God she had defeated for eight hundred points.
In comparison, a so-called “Ancient Deity” was worth eight hundred points…
This session of teaching was valued at ten “Ancient Deities”!
But before she could ponder any further, through her doppelgänger, she heard the distant voice of the Bonfire Envoy.

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - 447 392 The Light Chasers One-on-One
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 447: Chapter 392: The Light Chaser’s One-on-One Teaching._2 Chapter 447: Chapter 392: The Light Chaser’s One-on-One Teaching._2 “Now that we’ve settled that matter, let’s talk about the second thing, regarding the shield emblem…”
“The shield emblem…” The duplicate muttered, as if only just recalling such a trinket.
Although the item was made of gold, to her nowadays, it belonged to the category of things that were nice to have but not essential. During combat, it could hardly provide any effective help other than spiritual assistance…
Unless it could unleash the true power hidden within the artifact.
But forcibly unleashing that power would bring major trouble, and whether it could be reined in again was another question altogether…
At this moment, reading the expression of the Divine Envoy, Shana guessed what the other wanted to say:
“You still want to use it?”
“Yes.”
Colin was quite satisfied with the effects of this item, it had many uses in addition to its offensive capabilities.
Hearing this, Shana wasn’t particularly surprised. This time, not waiting for Colin to continue, she directly said:
“Okay.”
“Lately points have been a bit… Huh?” Suddenly, Colin was puzzled, unsure as he looked at the “Light Chaser” before him, “You mean… no points needed?”
“Yes.” The fuzzy light shadow nodded, enveloping Vanessa.
Strange, when had they become so generous? Colin wondered. In his eyes, the “Light Chaser” was someone who wouldn’t let slip any chance to earn points, always keen on any profitable opportunity…
Was it because they had made enough lately, acquiring all the artifacts and equipment they wanted, so they didn’t care about the meager thousands of points for renewal?
As his thoughts flitted by, Colin continued to listen as the other spoke with Vanessa’s voice: “You… I won’t be able to come and take the item away soon. Without it, you might… find yourself in a tight spot. We’ll talk when I arrive…”
She seemed to have found an excuse to convince herself.
“Alright.” Colin didn’t say much else.
After joining some excellent talent cultivation program, he quickly understood why the “Light Chaser,” who possessed formidable strength, would still be interested in mere points.
Because once the program started, the costs of upgrading were enormous.
The basic requirement was often tens of thousands of points…
Even he felt it was hard to cope.
“But look at it this way, no matter how much money one makes, the company has a way to earn it back. The talent program seems designed for those of us who can earn points, doesn’t it?” Colin sighed inwardly and then asked, “When does the training begin?”
