“We can start now, but before that, I have a request…” The fuzzy light shadow spoke with some hesitation.
“What request?” Colin asked, curious.
“Perhaps in due time, there will be a group of about thirty thousand refugees fleeing from the Catastrophe of the Magic Fog. Could you accept them? I can offer…”
At this, the “Light Chaser” paused, seemingly unsure of what price to propose.
Even with tens of thousands of points at their disposal, they felt less confident than when they had just 500 points.
At that time, they might confidently have offered a price of three hundred points…
Then…
Shana wasn’t familiar with the term “social death,” but she knew that such a move would probably…
However, just as she considered long-term usage rights to the “Shield of Fairness Adjudication” or points as compensation, Colin instantly agreed without a second thought…
“It’s our sacred duty at ‘Bonfire Company’ to succor innocent refugees; just entrust them to me without worry, even if there are more…”
He hadn’t imagined that the other party would directly bring forth such a substantial addition, especially as upgrading the “Third Level Bonfire” also needed people.
As for compensation, Colin wasn’t too concerned…
If he mentioned compensation, later on, it would be harder to ask those people to stay.
“Sir Bonfire, thank you immensely,” Shana expressed her gratitude earnestly.
“Yeah, then… when will the training start?” Colin looked forward expectantly.
“We can have a preliminary try right now. Use the shield emblem to create a battlefield. Try to defeat this replica of mine by all means, with full force. The more formal battle might have to wait a couple of days. I’ll arrange it first…”
As she spoke, the blurry silhouette stepped out from Vanessa, carefully laying down the “Light” believer on the ground.
On hearing this, Colin didn’t say much. He simply commenced the battle.
He was curious to see how much of a chance he stood against his opponent this time around…
Especially since this time, he had the Orange Equipment Liberation!
…
And just as the battle began, off to the side, Shana was still a bit out of sorts looking at the ten thousand points in her pocket.
For some reason, she suddenly felt a bit like one of those evil nobles from certain kingdoms who used cheap glyph-engraved glassware to deceive and intimidate the barbarian tribes, exchanging it for precious gold in an unscrupulous manner.
Especially because…
In her heart, Colin was one of the kinder and friendlier ones, also trying to save the suffering denizens like her.
Many refugees on his lands had a kind of vitality hard to find elsewhere…
Comparing the two, her sense of guilt grew a bit stronger.
But at this very moment, after having interacted with Colin twice, she started to realize there might be some issues, like his channel for earning points seemed a bit different from hers?
Shana had calculated before that to earn tens of thousands of points, even doing three or four missions a day, it would take half a year.
But…
This “Bonfire Envoy’s” mission history…

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - 448 392 The Light Chasers One-on-One
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 448: Chapter 392: The Light Chaser’s One-on-One Teaching._3 Chapter 448: Chapter 392: The Light Chaser’s One-on-One Teaching._3 Setting aside combat experience, it didn’t seem particularly abundant.
Could it actually be that she was not trying hard enough?
However, before she could come up with something, a new task popped up.
[Recover the “Nightmare Lantern”…]
Shana narrowed her eyes and, ultimately, took a deep breath before standing up from the corpse of the deformed creature beneath her.
“That dream object, huh? It does seem suitable for some…”
Shana pondered for a moment, her mind filling with quite a few ideas. In her view, facing terror and engaging in battles of life and death was the way to truly advance.
Training, no matter how much one does, is at best just a warm-up…
“I remember, that thing is in the ‘Spirit of Rebirth of Earth and Nature’ Rebirth Grand Cathedral of a fallen town nearby. If I snatch, no, retrieve it, creating a semi-real dreamscape, maybe it would further enhance my experience…”
“Hmm, I could also first capture various anomalies with different characteristic powers, lock them in the ‘Nightmare Lantern,’ and then gradually enhance my combat experience against various enemies in the dream…”
“However, that item’s level isn’t strong, so I’ll still need to… pick up some stuff from other churches to enhance the ‘Nightmare Lantern.’
In her mind, ideas coalesced one after another.Afterward, she glanced beside her, at the few dozen survivors rescued in this town, and then in her right eye, rings of light rippled outward…
Blood tears, radiating with the glow of daybreak, streamed down from the corner of her eyes.
Layers of radiance in reality projected a door emanating a terrifying aura.
Then, from within the door, chains of light led them into it.
After that, Shana closed her right eye, rubbed it with her hand to alleviate the discomfort caused by summoning the “Gate of Light.”
Meanwhile, the blood that had just flowed out broke down into light and was reabsorbed as she opened her mouth to inhale it, avoiding the waste of power.
Having done all this, her figure transformed into a streak of light and thrust into the roiling Magic Fog filled with countless roars and bizarre shapes.
Several hours later.
In the sealed cellar of the “Spirit of Rebirth of Earth and Nature” Rebirth Grand Cathedral.
Accompanied by a dying scream…
The deer-shaped Holy Beast, which was cultivated by the “Spirit of Rebirth of Earth and Nature” Church to guard this grand cathedral but had now become completely twisted and deformed, thunderously fell.
In its eyes full of dying madness, there was a hint of relief.
It looked at the figure enveloped in blinding light, struggled to move its eyes as if trying to convey something.
“Saint… my body… might still have some… value… don’t hesitate…”
Struggling to convey this message, the once Holy Beast breathed its last.
“I understand,” Shana said, glancing at it and then at the direction its eyes had moved, where there must be some survivors it had desperately protected.
Soon after, she entered the cathedral’s interior and retrieved the “Demon Lantern.”
Then she rescued the survivors from this location and continued sealing them into the Gate of Light…
Afterward, she returned to the hall and glanced at the massive carcass of the Holy Beast. She actually understood that what the creature meant was to purify its contaminated parts and share its flesh with the survivors to quell their hunger.
If it were before, she would have done that, but now her pocket had many more Points.
There just wasn’t much need…
“Rest in peace,”
Shana erased the body and then turned to leave, planning to first move the nearly full “Gate of Light” survivors to a safe location before continuing to collect “teaching materials” and rescue more people.
Of course, she also had to devote some effort to one-on-one tutoring with Colin.
Receiving feedback from that side, she was surprised to find that this time, his strength had improved a lot…
His experience had also become significantly richer.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - 449 393 The Light Chaser Turns Out to Be a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 449: 393 Chapter “The Light Chaser” Turns Out to Be a Female?!_1 Chapter 449: 393 Chapter “The Light Chaser” Turns Out to Be a Female?!_1 Within the frozen space, Colin was surrounded by scorching flames that condensed and compressed into several spear-shaped projectiles, shooting out in a particular direction…
After an instant of flashing light, a glowing figure, immobilized by the stillness of time and space, was pinned to the ground.
Then Colin, having already exhausted all his strength, immediately had a thought and detonated the spears.
In the midst of a thunderous roar, flames surged, and light and shadow shattered.
“Finally succeeded?”
After battling for three hours, Colin, somewhat drained, felt a surge of joy in his heart.
But before the joy could fully blossom, it quickly faded.
Because the effects of the “Shield of Fairness Adjudication” had not yet dissipated…
This also meant that the enemy’s avatar “real body” was unharmed.
Then, as if realizing something, Colin turned, squinted his eyes, and saw a vague silhouette of light standing quietly not far away, watching him.
‘This is really tough…’ he hissed.
At this moment, Colin did not rush to attack, unsure whether the silhouette of light was real or an illusion.
Reflecting on the past three hours of battle, he couldn’t help but remember the feeling of helplessness when dominated by C Level Personnel…
The only difference was that the oppression from C Level Personnel came from their physical strength…
Whereas “The Light Chaser” had developed their unique abilities and practical application in combat to a profound depth.
Compared to the C Level Personnel’s physicality, his methods were very special, able to split into a multitude of shadows nearly identical, making it difficult to discern which were genuine and which were false.
At first, every time he killed a shadow, Colin felt as if the opponent “weakened” by a fraction…
But after annihilating more than a dozen shadows, Colin belatedly realized it was like playing a Whac-A-Mole game.
It seemed as though one more strike could net him a red packet, but in reality, he might hack away for two more hours, strike three thousand times, and still not bring it down…
It was purely a trap.
Yet Colin had more than just this concern…
Breaking the shadows was futile, but each seemingly fake shadow,
If it could attack him, would become the “real body”…
That is to say, Colin’s attacks were ineffective against the opponent, but the opponent’s strikes could affect him.
This… This made things very difficult.
However, not long ago, an “Inspiration” suddenly emerged in his heart: when “The Light Chaser” attacked and it was effective, the attacking shadow seemed to brighten slightly, so he guessed that the true body might only reveal itself during an attack…
But in the critical moment earlier, he hadn’t thought too much about it, until he had given it his all and finally seized the opportunity to strike down the adversary when they “materialized.”
Then…
After putting in his utmost effort and becoming thoroughly exhausted, Colin realized that the so-called “Inspiration” was actually false information fed by “The Light Chaser” through some means.
“This thing can even be used in this way…”
Colin had indeed learned something new.
And he also felt somewhat relieved that this was merely a training exchange; if it had been a fight to the death…
He likely would have been thoroughly deceived by the enemy.
‘Yet on the other hand, a combat intuition tells me that if I can spot multiple avatars and strike precisely at the same time, I could attack the enemy…’ he thought.
Colin could be certain this time that it was his own thought.
Unfortunately, targeting multiple units at once was difficult for him, as these duplicates all stood in the blind spots of his field of vision, making it hard to lock onto several at once…
More critically, Colin had been duped to a point where he was starting to feel insecure, worrying that this might be yet another trap…
Furthermore, after such an intense battle, his stamina was nearly at its limit.
His mind was somewhat blank.
If he wanted to continue with high-intensity maneuvers against “The Light Chaser,” he would need to operate at an overload…
That would be more damaging to his body.
It was at this moment that “The Light Chaser’s” voice resonated:
“Let’s end the direct combat here for today…”
At the same time, Colin saw many glowing figures approach him from all directions, eventually converging into one true body.
To his surprise, among these avatars, there were some he hadn’t noticed at all since the beginning!
“Compared to before, you’ve made significant progress, at least in the use of your various items… you’ve improved quite a bit,”
Shana recalled the last battle, when the Bonfire Envoy before her had a tendency to use the shockwaves squeezed from a certain card technique to attack her.
Each time, she would stand on the effect’s boundary, allowing her body to partly elementalize and dodge the charge,
And would use illusions of light to create an image of herself being hit, causing the other party to waste their effort…
But this time, the opponent noticed this and would wait for her to be within the effect before using it.
In addition, the timing of certain spatial solidification techniques and the proficiency of using the Bonfire, among other things, had all significantly improved…
However…
In her eyes, Colin’s overall approach was still somewhat naive.
For instance, his defenses against mental attacks were somewhat lacking, almost invitingly open, otherwise she wouldn’t have been able to plant “Inspiration” within him under equal conditions and engage in “information warfare”…
Then, his response to close-quarter combat seemed a bit too slow to keep up.
And his development of his flame abilities was also somewhat lacking.
But with a little guidance, it shouldn’t be a big issue.
“Too often, you rely excessively on your eyes. As a rule, you only decide to make a move after you see your target. But as one of the Extraordinary Ones, relying solely on your eyes is inadequate, especially amid a barrage of attacks; it’s very difficult to keep up with the response,”
“Usually, many fighters of comparable strength, at this stage, develop their intuitive awareness, allowing it to provide all-around feedback and perception just like the eyes…”

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - 450 393 The Light Chaser Turns Out to Be a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 450: 393 Chapter “The Light Chaser” Turns Out to Be a Female?!_2 Chapter 450: 393 Chapter “The Light Chaser” Turns Out to Be a Female?!_2 “But based on your abilities, I think you can try to combine your consciousness with your flames to achieve this, through it, to perceive the world, what it brings you is not just strength, but it can also become your eyes…”
“I’ve observed a bit, and you should be able to do this step, so for our next lesson, let’s start with you perceiving your surroundings through fire perception.”
Shana explained simply, planning to start with the aspect of “vision”.
During their previous exchange, she had confirmed that when she was under the light of the fire, the other party had some perception, although they wouldn’t launch an attack based solely on that perception unless they saw with their own eyes, even if just to test…
This made Colin’s chances of beating her at the same level become extremely slim; at best he could only ensure he wouldn’t lose in a short time.
From this, she could roughly tell that the other party hadn’t developed too deeply in this area.
But that wasn’t a problem.
The other party was now in a situation where a casual remark could lead to an epiphany…
After further coaching for a while, Colin suddenly felt as though he had pierced through a layer of sandpaper; within the range touched by the surrounding flames, he could see everything crisp and clear, and his field of vision instantly broadened!
It was as if a small knife had suddenly opened an eye on his buttocks!
Even with his eyes tightly shut, as long as the flames were kindled, everything around him would be projected into his mind in a special way.
At this moment, Colin felt a sense of “wherever the Bonfire radiates, it’s as if seen by the naked eye.”
And compared to what was seen by his vision, this perception seemed even more comprehensive…
“Learned another key skill, but come to think of it, I had noticed it before but really kind of neglected it, hmm, I have to name my new passive…”
Colin, feeling that his tuition fees were well spent, gave a name to the passive skill he had just understood.
Let’s call it “Killing Intent Fluctuation”…
No, it’s called “Flame Perception”.
Unadorned and simple.
But upon carefully observing through “Flame Perception”, Colin quickly noticed that in various corners, there were still a few “Light Chasers” copies present.
This time, he would finally not become passive because of blind spots in his vision!
But before he could feel happy, Colin observing the other party suddenly sensed something was off…
‘Why do I feel… it’s a female?’ Colin felt weird.
Something was amiss…
Another look—
It seemed to be really a female?
Within the “Bonfire Vision”, the blurry glowing figures were still not clear, but compared to what was seen by the naked eye, one could generally make out the outline of a lean and slender woman…
‘This…’
Colin was taken aback; in his memory, “The Light Chaser” was supposed to be a bulky man.
He hadn’t expected it to be a woman…
This felt like when a guy you often chat with online, whom you thought was a foot-scratching big dude, turns out to be a beautiful young girl when you meet offline one day!
But before he could think any further, the “The Light Chaser” spoke up again, with a voice still neutral and indistinguishable as male or female:
“It seems you should be able to initially grasp this way of observation. Next, we will use this as a basis to gradually expand other areas of enhancement…”
“But let’s stop here for today’s training. I am currently connecting through Vanessa, and if we continue, it will be hard on her…”
“Tomorrow I need to make some preparations, so I will probably come again the night after tomorrow.”
“Oh, okay…” Colin nodded blankly, then dispelled the effect of the “Shield of Fairness Adjudication”.
Afterward, the figure of “The Light Chaser” instantly disintegrated and disappeared…
Simultaneously, not far away, Nun Vanessa of the “Light” lay on the ground slowly opening her eyes, feeling fatigue in her body as if her limbs had fallen apart, she couldn’t help but inhale sharply, muttering a complaint under her breath.
Although there was some distance, Colin still heard her words.
“Ouch, why do I feel, exhausted a bit too much, this time it seems to have lasted long, what did the boss do this time…”
No big deal, just borrowed your body for a fight… Colin mumbled to himself.
Then he reached into the Bonfire, pulled out a “Colorless Crystal” and tossed it to Vanessa, and then helped to relieve her fatigue with the light of the flames…
“Thank you, Lord,” feeling the warmth of the flames, Vanessa sat on the ground, graciously thanked him.
“By the way, I have some questions I want to understand; may I inquire, among the higher echelons of your ‘Light’ religion, how many are female members?” Colin asked casually, as if making small talk.
And hearing Colin’s question, Vanessa suddenly became alert, then as if thinking of something, a look of wisdom appeared on her typically simple face:
“Are you asking who just came over?”
“””
“Uh…” Colin hesitated, then smiled, nodding in confirmation.
Actually, at this moment, he had some speculations, but he wasn’t quite sure.
“If I tell you this, can you reward me with a bag of White Rabbit Creamy Candies?” Vanessa asked expectantly.
Are you selling out your people for a bag of candy?
“No problem.”
Colin took out a bag of candy from his pocket and handed it over.
Having received the desired reward, Vanessa did not hide anything and directly said, “The one who just came over is His Holiness the Saint…”
Only His Holiness the Saint could have come down through the nun, and even if Colin didn’t ask her, asking someone else would have quickly clarified it.
This was a basic fact that almost everyone knew.
So Vanessa didn’t feel at all like she had betrayed her faith…
“His Holiness the Saint…” Colin murmured, now able to confirm his correct guess through this.
The “Light” doesn’t have any mechanism like a Grand Elder or Supreme Elder, and the only ones who can be publicly addressed as “Your Holiness” are the Pope and the Saint…
Since the prefix wasn’t Pope, but Saint, it was almost like a clear signal.
As far as he knew, within the church, the term Saint commonly referred to either the Saint Heir or the Saintess…
And this generation’s Saint was a female…
That is to say, the so-called living saint who walked upon the Earth, who didn’t seem to do much but somehow inexplicably snatched away a portion of his faith’s power: the “Light” church’s Saintess Shana.
Even now, Colin could occasionally hear his believers on his Bonfire Territory thanking her.
The key was that while thanking her, their faith in the Bonfire remained incredibly pure…
Apart from “loyalty,” Colin had no idea how else to describe it.
“However, come to think of it, I didn’t expect this existence to actually be an employee of the ‘Bonfire Company,’ tsk, no wonder her strength is so fierce…”
Recalling her achievements, Colin suddenly felt relieved.
It’s just that I wonder why, with such strength, she seemed to have been stuck at F Level for quite a while.
Could she too be trapped by an Out-of-Control Copy?
“‘Passionate Paradise’ was not long ago fully staffed, so it’s probably not that, which makes it seem, if she’s stuck on an Out-of-Control Copy, it’s likely the other F Level copy: ‘Lightless Zone’?”
Colin pondered thoughtfully.
He felt that with her strength, if she really was stuck on a copy, it wasn’t that she couldn’t complete it, but rather there weren’t enough people.
Moreover, from the fact that he could see through her light and shadow…
Colin guessed that “The Light Chaser” probably hadn’t made much effort to hide herself, otherwise, he likely wouldn’t have been able to see her at all.
“Employees on Earth hide themselves because they are afraid of being located offline or something, Lady Bunny once said that if I reach D Level, I can arrange offline fights…”
“Of course, the opponent can’t be a mindless robot, and in this world, it seems only she gets to find someone’s real location, not the other way around…”
Shaking his head, Colin didn’t dwell on it too much, anyway, there would be opportunities to learn more about these things in the future.
Afterward, he walked out of the church and slowly closed his eyes.
Yet despite his eyes being closed, his brain “saw” even more.
Under Flame Perception, he could clearly understand which guys were not working diligently and slacking off in the middle of the night, and which ones were earnestly and diligently working…
“Very good, most of them are working hard.”
Colin felt relieved and then joined in to supervise and encourage everyone to work hard.
After all, how diligently the employees worked would affect his rating for this mission.
And the current state of his territory was still a bit too rural…
He needed to speed up the development of basic infrastructure to ensure every refugee could move into a new home…
In the following days, a group of employees suddenly realized something.
Even those with supernatural bodies could collapse on the road to overwork…
The tasks seemed never-ending, just as they managed to settle thousands of people and thought they would catch a breath, suddenly tens of thousands more arrived…
The work… seemed endless at a glance.
Under Colin’s leadership, all employees buckled down and also came to realize one thing.
As it turned out, Brother Shunzi is the real danger when there’s no danger around.
“””

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - 451 394 What on Earth Are You Two Doing Every
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 451: Chapter 394: What on Earth Are You Two Doing Every Night?!_1 Chapter 451: Chapter 394: What on Earth Are You Two Doing Every Night?!_1 Day Five, outside the Bonfire Church.
Employees who had been working non-stop for five days and nights, sustained only by the “Colorless Crystal,” finally received a thirty-minute break as the night was about to end.
They scattered in small groups, surrounding the newly lit bonfire, eating the rough cornbread that had been distributed.
“I’m done!”
An Employee Level E said while gnawing on the cornbread in his hand.
Hearing his words, other equally exhausted employees looked surprised, then someone who had just finished their cornbread asked,
“Really quitting? Completing each event can get you more points rewards, and if your evaluation is high, you might even get items like an Item Extraction Ticket!”
Though the workload is a bit intense, the salary is tempting indeed.
But before he could finish, the E level Personnel shook his head with a look of disappointed expectation:
“Just a few points have bought you out?”
“Think about it, we are the Extraordinary Ones, how can we accept such exploitation?!”
“When we were ordinary people, we had no choice but to be exploited by the capitalists, and now that we’ve become Extraordinary Ones, we are still being exploited…”
“Haven’t we become Extraordinary Ones for nothing?”
“Can you even refuse a difficult task?” asked a double-duty F Level Employee curiously.
“You can. Anyway, I’ve decided. I’m not doing any so-called tasks for the next few days. I can’t stand this anymore, and of course, it’s not that I have any issue with Brother Shunzi, I just feel that the task assignments are unfair…”
“The company simply doesn’t treat us as humans, assigning tasks one after another with deadlines, giving us no chance to catch our breath…”
“I, an E-level Extraordinary One with two and a half years of service, should not have to endure this exploitation!”
“Believe me, if we continue like this, we’ll certainly work ourselves to death!”
“…”
The E level Employee, holding a baton in his hand and waving it, had dark circles under his eyes as he spoke with great conviction, his words stirring the others and nudging them toward agreement.
However, just as he finished speaking, an F Level Employee who was somewhat persuaded wanted to ask something but then noticed that it had suddenly become light without warning.
He wasn’t surprised by this, but for some reason, he saw the E level Employee’s body suddenly shine with a black metallic luster, and with an increased aura, he shot off like a bullet towards a certain direction…
“Eh? What’s going on?”
The few listening to him were all taken aback by this scene.
Why the sudden dash?
And it seemed like he wasn’t alone…
They saw other Employees rushing toward a certain direction of the territory.
The speed was incredibly fast…
“Could it be that everyone doesn’t want to accept exploitation and has united to force the company to make task distribution more reasonable?” the group thought, reflecting on the words that had been spoken.
Otherwise, why else would these people suddenly take action, and looking at them, they all seemed to be higher-level employees.
The few of them exchanged glances, unsure whether to join the struggle.
But just as they thought about it, a passing D Level staff member, who couldn’t bear to watch any longer, couldn’t help but remind them with a bit of special advice.
“Look at the tasks in your heads, you’ve been working for three days, oh no, five days. Haven’t you noticed? Every night before it ends and day begins, new tasks are refreshed…”
“At this time, there are some tasks that can be actively accepted. These tasks not just improve the evaluation rewards but also provide a basic minimum of points.”
“Don’t get swayed by those people, get moving…”
A slew of information spread through their minds, quickly understood by the group.
Upon hearing this, a few people instinctively opened their task lists for a glance, and then their faces abruptly changed.
…
[Event 996: Travel to the open-pit iron mine 1.3 kilometers from here, lead the Bonfire Followers in mining and transportation…]
“Notice”: Upon reaching the area, you may accept the task, requiring 3 employees.
“Remark”: On completing the work as required, you may receive 150 points and a higher task evaluation score at the end.
…
[Event 997: Proceed to the “Automatic Base Vehicle – Construction” unit, input the recently mined minerals, and assist in producing enough specialized lime powder…]
“Notice”: 1 employee required.
“Remark”: 100 points can be earned…
…
[Event 998: Proceed to the newly developed wasteland, instruct the Bonfire Followers on farming…]
“Notice”: 1 employee required, knowledge of farming necessary.
“Remark”: 100 points can be earned…
…
“Damn, that bastard Lao Liu, didn’t he say he wouldn’t do it no matter how many points were offered?!”
A few who were late to realize cursed, miffed that for just about a hundred points or so, everyone was rushing off!
And it wasn’t just the rush; just now they had seen that rascal muster all his strength and even use an item, all to get a task with a guaranteed minimum of points faster…
And that was one thing, but to get a chance at a task, he had fooled them with a bunch of nonsense.
“These E level old dogs are just too damn vile!”
They cursed as they rushed off…
Of course, among them, not everyone believed the others’ words; a “double-duty” official had already taken action early…
He wasn’t very interested in points, but he was very interested in money. The official internal recycling price was 300 yuan for under 100 points, and 400 yuan for over 100 points, the more points, the higher the ratio.

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - 452 394 What on Earth Are You Two Doing Every
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 452: Chapter 394: What on Earth Are You Two Doing Every Night?!_2 Chapter 452: Chapter 394: What on Earth Are You Two Doing Every Night?!_2 As long as he grabbed any active-type task, he could leave thirty thousand for his family!
For this, who the hell would believe those guys’ bluffs?!
And after reminding them, his “Life Mentor Adorable” slowly made their way toward another construction site.
As one of the only two D Level staff, his job opportunities were indeed secured, and he would be assigned some more important tasks.
However, compared to the work on the territory, at this moment he seemed to have a lot on his mind.
Because in the past two days…
He had collected some information about Brother Shunzi.
The information wasn’t serious if he didn’t think about it, but once he did, it was terrifyingly detailed.
‘This trio came in about a month ago, right when Brother Shunzi joined the company, which means, even when Brother Shunzi was at F Level, he already had the ability to recruit people…’
‘This…’
“Life Mentor Adorable” took a deep breath, well aware of one thing, an F Level newbie definitely couldn’t have this capability!
It was impossible for Brother Shunzi to have joined with assets, he felt.
Then again, he clearly remembered something…
At that point in time, shortly after Brother Shunzi had appeared, something big had happened within the company!
There was an invation by the “Descenders”…
And every employee was given a new task.
“‘Unyielding Guardians’…’Descenders’…hiss…it couldn’t be…could it?”
Adorable couldn’t help but mutter to himself, he had noticed before but hadn’t given it much thought.
But this time…
He had a bold idea.
Combining it with Brother Shunzi’s extraordinary behavior upon joining…
“Life Mentor Adorable” found his breathing becoming heavier, a sense of crisis enveloping him as if thinking any further would cause him to disappear from this world.
And the figure of that Brother Shunzi grew increasingly enigmatic in his mind.
It was at this moment when inside the small church, a flame suddenly burst forth.
The warmth that was usually comforting almost made him leap with fright this time…
“No, I can’t think any further, this is definitely not a secret I should know…”
“Life Mentor Adorable” steeled his heart, took out a golden finger cot from the “Storage Room,” slipped it onto his index finger, and pressed it against his own forehead.
This thing was a special item capable of temporarily modifying memories.
Soon, he sealed off several key words temporarily…
“It feels like I’ve forgotten something…”
“Life Mentor Adorable” looked baffled, glancing at the golden finger cot on his hand, wisely choosing not to associate any further.
This wasn’t his first time doing this; adeptly storing away the tool, he began another busy day.
…
Meanwhile, atop the territory, Calder and others chatting with some other church messengers watched the “upper echelons” of the Bonfire Church get busy again and couldn’t help but crack open some seeds named melon seeds, sharing their feelings with others nearby.
The Extraordinary Ones of the Bonfire Church seemed unique compared to other churches.
At the very least, he had never seen high-ranking members of any other church quietly and selflessly help refugees with tasks like reclaiming land, building houses, digging toilets, and carrying manure…
And they all worked with a passion unusual for such tasks, pushing themselves as far as they could without actually dying.
However, unlike his relatively positive view, many other church envoys and even nobles held different opinions!
How could noble Extraordinary Ones engage in such activities?!
It was ridiculous!
But, it was exactly at this moment that the doors to the Bonfire Church burst open, a heavy presence leaking out…
A radiant figure slowly emerged.
Seeing this, envoys from the other churches displayed smiles, commenting that the Bonfire Church indeed cared for the people and offering help if needed.
“Then I won’t be polite, there are indeed some areas a bit short on labor…”
Colin said with a grin, causing the group to pause – had their politeness been taken seriously?
Having said their piece, it was hard to back out now, so they had to begin assisting with establishing the territory.
And as they were dispatched…
A worn-out Vanessa stepped out of the church.
“Ah, I’m so tired. What are you and the Saint Master doing all day? Why am I so exhausted…” Vanessa couldn’t help but complain.
In recent days, Saint Master had been arriving punctually every night, taking possession of Colin’s body and then going to meet the Bonfire Envoy…
After each awakening, Colin always looked excited while the Saintess was nowhere to be seen; neither of them knew what they were doing with her body all day long, which was really wearing her out as a third party…
According to the plan, she still needed at least two more days before she could truly rest.
“Don’t ask too much; go get some rest now. We still have to continue tonight, yes, I need to rest a bit too.”
Colin waved his hand. Despite the excitement on his face, he was actually a bit tired.
Ever since the third day, when the Saintess brought a special Lantern Sealing Object, he had been dying continuously, about eight to ten times each night.
In that lantern were all kinds of strange and powerful creatures that the Saintess had found somewhere, using them to provide nearly real combat training.
And then, in this life-and-death real combat training, she would point out his weaknesses…
Her instructional strategy was very flexible. She first asked him about the type of enemy he encountered most frequently, then found creatures of that type and conducted targeted training while improving his basic skills.
According to Shana, basic skills were important, but so was the right direction.
One must focus on the critical defenses!!!
Otherwise, one might find themselves in a situation where they’ve mastered the art of slaying dragons, only to be flipped over by the bite of a venomous snake.
“I’ll try going on a copy task when I get back, fight with the C Level Elder Brother, and check the results…”
Colin clenched his fists, feeling that he had a chance to last about an hour this time.
He even had the chance to force his opponent to use a prop…
However, without dwelling on it too much, Colin, using the Third Level Bonfire, sensed the situation of the realm and, seeing that it was still a scene full of competition, vitality, and prosperity, couldn’t help but show a relieved expression.
Compared to the first day, he could now clearly “observe” the details of the entire realm…
He could spot anyone slacking off and then secretly apply for a task for them that had a guaranteed minimum of Points.
And give them a “Colorless Energy” crystal as a little extra…
“It’s the kind of monitoring ability every leader and boss dreams of.”
Colin shook his head, withdrew his gaze, and turned to go back to the house to sleep.
Normal days passed one by one…
Soon, the seven-day period had arrived.
Above the realm, dozens of employees, standing like zombies and withered as bones, gathered inside the Bonfire Church, looking at Colin.
“Brother Shunzi, when are we going to recruit some more people? We’re short-staffed…” an E level Personnel couldn’t help but speak up.
He was pale and haggard, with dark circles clearly visible around his eyes, looking as if he could pass away at any moment.
On the first day, they felt it was nothing more than moving two bricks, no big deal.
But now, he couldn’t muster the bravado he had on the first day.
When he finished, everyone looked at Colin with expectancy…
Honestly, although they were very resistant to accepting tasks, the stimulation of the Points made their bodies honestly move…
The more tasks they did, the harder it was to stop, as they might get a lower score.
A few more people were needed to share the blessings of this world.
Otherwise, they really might drop dead.
To know, an employee who possessed a Necromancy Tool had his summoned undead worn out and killed several times due to the endless task of dusting…
At this moment, the only comfort they had was…
Seven days here were equivalent to three hours in reality…
They seemed to have worked for seven days, but in reality, they only worked for three hours, yet they received seven days’ wages.
“My personnel recruitment has reached its limit, I can’t recruit any more people…”
Colin shook his head, causing everyone present to express a look of despair.
After a pause, he added a hint: “But isn’t there a suggestion box thread on the company forum? You could try persuading others to apply for this place. Maybe if enough people apply, the quota will be opened…”
Colin wasn’t sure if it would work, but he knew that offering them a “pie in the sky” was very important at this moment…
Whether the pie was actually attainable didn’t matter as long as it was theoretically edible.
Indeed, upon hearing this, the employees didn’t doubt much. They narrowed their eyes, whispered to each other, and began discussing how to bring more new people in.
However, before they could contemplate much further, the sound of the returning bell came with the fog as before.
In the blink of an eye, Colin once again saw the familiar ceiling.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - 453 395 The whereabouts of other lost Golden
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 453: Chapter 395 “The whereabouts of other lost Golden Cards in the Kingdom in Cards”_1 Chapter 453: Chapter 395 “The whereabouts of other lost Golden Cards in the Kingdom in Cards”_1 “I’m back.”
Colin slowly got up from the bed and looked at the wall, where the time displayed just after three o’clock in the afternoon.
He took a deep breath, eased himself for a few seconds, and then recovered from the time discrepancy.
Next, he took out the parchment and opened it to check; this week’s task was shown as completed, but the reward was somewhat plain and simple.
“A golden, almost fifteen thousand points…”
The task reward itself wasn’t anything special. Colin glanced at the 14,999 points that had just been credited to his account, didn’t think much of it, and, together with his previous points, he started to further repair other items.
The last repair he did was only to bring the items to a usable state.
This time, as his points were rapidly depleting, the items damaged in the “Ghost Train incident” were finally restored.
“Finally sorted these out, but why does it feel like I’ve been taken advantage of? Did a few events, used up so many points and they just got back to their original state.”
Muttering to himself, Colin then looked at a golden Sun Badge in the “Storage Room.”
It was a new consumable item the Saintess had given him during the last training.
Compared to the last one, it was clearly more refined, made with more substantial materials, and endowed with a stronger and more durable BUFF effect.
Just holding it in his hand, Colin felt his thought processes become exceptionally smooth.
“Eight thousand points, even if I don’t count the training, this badge alone makes even.”
Colin silently calculated and felt that doing private trades with the Saintess was always hugely profitable.
It was only when she took the initiative to provide support that he would be at a loss…
Nevertheless, not dwelling on it much, Colin prepared to open the parchment to chat but, at that moment, he saw a document sent by Old Master Wu.
“‘The Seventh Box Garden World Black Box Research Progress Report…'”
Colin paused, almost forgetting about this thing, and casually downloaded the document to take a look.
After a cursory glance…
He wore a look of half understanding—honestly, he found it quite difficult to comprehend.
It was all written in Chinese characters, numbers, and letters, but combined together, they were somewhat baffling.
“Xiao Yin, you take a look…”
Colin called his Little Maid, asking her to interpret and explain those overly technical terms to a level that the average person could understand.
Soon, through the Little Maid’s interpretation, he roughly grasped the technological situation regarding “The Seventh Box Garden World…”
In general, the technology from the Box Garden World could be applied in this world.
At least for now, there haven’t been many technology results that can’t be replicated because they’re from a different world…
The things from within could bring about a significant technological revolution to Earth, even causing a technological explosion within a few decades.
In every area from biology to communication to machinery…
However, among the array of innovative technologies, there was one project that researchers of any kind couldn’t make headway with—
“Nano-smart Machinery.”
Colin, while having the Little Maid assist him with the interpretation, looked over the document’s contents.
According to the document, this “Nano-smart Machinery,” even within The Seventh Box Garden World, belonged to the level of the “Zenith Star People.”
Each of its nano units could operate independently, was extremely difficult to damage, could execute different task commands precisely, and regarding the 0.01 gram of “Nano-smart Machinery” borrowed from Colin for the research…
The researchers couldn’t even find where each “Nano-smart Machinery” unit stored or obtained its energy.
They couldn’t locate the communication module either…
If it weren’t for the physical object being there, the researchers would definitely think that such a thing couldn’t possibly exist.
To date, aside from knowing about its existence, their understanding of it was virtually zero.
“You don’t know the technology used to create you either?”
Colin looked at the Little Maid and asked curiously.
“I don’t know. Theoretically, only hundreds of years from now, with all materials being sufficient, would I have a slight chance of replicating a ‘Nano-smart Machinery’ like myself. Currently, I can only make technology generations behind my own…” The Little Maid’s voice was pleasant, yet she stated it in a calm tone.
“Hundreds of years… the end of the world might come several times by then.”
Colin couldn’t help but quip, however, the technology items that the Little Maid described as generations behind were still very advanced.
The officials were clearing a space to set up a factory, planning to have her produce “outdated technology products.”
Then, refocusing, Colin shifted his gaze to other contents in the document.
Like some related information about “2044.”
Unfortunately, there wasn’t much related intelligence, and people still had no idea what would happen that day, only knowing that as the day approached, more dreadful higher beings became active, causing one terrifying calamity after another…
“So, to find out about this, can we only get information from those ‘gods’?”
Colin reflected thoughtfully. It seemed the company must be aware of this matter.
After all, they’ve captured more than one “God.”
But it’s unclear if it was a matter of clearance level, Lady Bunny appeared not to have plans to inform him about more.
Shaking his head without giving it much thought, Colin closed the document.
Then he saw that Old Master Wu had timely sent a new message…
“About the ‘world barriers’ matter, we already have some initial clues. It appears that some ordinary people have, for some unknown reason, awakened extraordinary abilities. According to them, it happened at a moment of intense emotion, when they suddenly ‘awakened’…”
“I can feel through them that there might be something more behind the scenes, but I’m not entirely sure…”

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - 454 395 The whereabouts of other lost Golden
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 454: Chapter 395 “The whereabouts of other lost Golden Cards in the Kingdom in Cards”_2 Chapter 454: Chapter 395 “The whereabouts of other lost Golden Cards in the Kingdom in Cards”_2 “”However, if there really is someone behind the scenes, intuition tells me that perhaps it will truly burst forth around nine months later at the time of the ‘destiny’ succession…”
“In any case, the current progress of the matter is not very ideal.”
…
“Ordinary people obtaining extraordinary abilities through unknown means?”
Colin raised an eyebrow, considering his understanding of anomalies, this seemed somewhat unrealistic…
Because the “Extraordinary” wouldn’t just appear out of nowhere without reason.
Ordinary people couldn’t just awaken some sort of superpower out of nothing based solely on their willpower.
“Without extraordinary power, one can steal or rob, whether it’s anomalies or some demon, they’re acquired through extraordinary methods…”
“Even praying to some so-called higher beings works…”
“But to ‘awaken’ so spontaneously, without any reason, that’s a bit off.”
Colin’s heart sank slightly, knowing something must have had a profound impact on the world.
After pondering for a moment and stroking his chin, his gaze shifted to Old Master Wu’s other words: “The time of ‘destiny’ succession…”
This…
Although the other party did not specify, Colin remembered Old Master Wu saying he had only about a year of life left… The meaning of “destiny succession” was not hard to guess; it should be that he would pass on his position and legacy to a successor when the time came.
Chaos, perhaps, would erupt at the moment of succession?
“Only nine months left, huh…”
Colin suddenly felt an inexplicable sense of sorrow.
The means to completely control his extraordinary abilities had already appeared, yet unfortunately, these higher officials couldn’t use them.
Carrying an undefined emotion, Colin ended the conversation with Old Master Wu.
However, before he could wallow for even a few minutes, Colin suddenly became aware of something and turned to the parchment, where he saw a message appear:
Dear “654321”, you have a new mission “Investigate a lost artifact through the ‘Gate of Starlight.'” Added to [Mission List].
“Oh, so they’re adding a friendly salutation before missions now? But what’s this ‘Gate of Starlight’ I’ve never heard of before, could it be related to that ‘Starlight Maiden’ from the mission I caught with my alternate account?”
Colin pursed his lips, composed himself, and opened the [Mission List] to find the task.
[“Investigate a lost artifact through the ‘Gate of Starlight'”]
“Description”: Through certain special methods, the company has already ascertained the general location of a lost high-quality artifact through a defector.
“Requirement”: On January 1st, at noon, utilize the “Gate of Starlight” for a special descent, gather and investigate the intel from that area.
“Hint”: The lost artifact is suspected to be one of the seventeen Golden Cards from “Card Divine Kingdom”.
[Do you accept this mission?]
…
“A defector, so the ‘Starlight Maiden’ really did turn coat…”
Colin clicked his tongue, considering how that person had taken the lead as a “Chosen of God”, a “Divine Envoy”, one couldn’t help but wonder if their “Dawn Starlight” would explode with fury upon finding out.
He then looked at the requirements and turned his eyes to the hint…
“One of the seventeen Golden Cards from ‘Card Divine Kingdom’; I wonder which one it is, but overall, it looks like it’s tailored for me.”
Thinking it over, Colin chose to accept.
Golden Cards, items with absolute effects and minimal side effects, were of course more the merrier for him.
“Why do I always feel like the company wants me to collect all seventeen cards? They wouldn’t keep feeding me similar artifacts otherwise…”
“I just wonder what would happen if I actually managed to collect all seventeen Golden Cards one day…”
“Today is the 25th, there are about five or six days left, no rush, but the mission seems to be a solo type with no teammates, it’s been a long time since I’ve taken on solo missions…”
As thoughts swirled through his mind, Colin’s gaze swept over the mission details again and, after confirming there wasn’t much else, stored them away.
Next, he routinely opened the internal communication hall to check in.
Not much different from before, except now there was a group advocating for “The Descent Project”…
However, he only looked for a while when a sudden phone call came through.
The screen showed the name “Xia Liufang”.
Colin was taken aback; normally, it was either Hu Zheng or Qin Chuan who contacted him; Xia Liufang contacting him was rarer.
“Hello, what’s up?”
With curiosity, he answered the call, and upon hearing the other party’s words, Colin’s expression quickly grew odd.
“You mean to say that Qin Chuan and Hu Zheng have been cornered in the bathroom by several… elementary school kids and are getting beaten up?”
Colin began to doubt whether he had heard correctly.
No matter what, these two were Extraordinary Ones; how could they be cornered and beaten up by common people, especially elementary school kids?
However, he quickly realized something.
‘Could it be that group of “awakened” Transcendents?’ Colin thought of Old Master Wu’s information.
At the same time, Xia Liufang continued, “Yeah, we don’t know if these kids are influenced by some anomaly, but they are very strong, they’ve even created some kind of barrier that makes it hard for us to enter…”
“And the higher-ups’ request is that we resolve the anomaly without harming them as much as possible, but we can’t find where the anomaly specifically is…”
“So, we might need you to come over.”
The information on the Awakeners was still being confirmed and had not been made public, so they were still unaware of the situation with this group and were using old methods to search for the anomaly, leading to them finding nothing.
In fact, the “anomaly” was the group of “Awakeners” themselves.
“Okay, just send me a location.”
After hanging up the phone and waiting for the location to be sent, Colin couldn’t help but laugh a few times when he thought about what Xia Liufang had said.
It’s unclear what positions Qin Chuan and Hu Zheng would be in the future, but being cornered in the bathroom and beaten up by elementary school students was something they would probably never live down in their lifetime…
Soon, his location was sent from the other side; it was a bit remote.
However, that wasn’t a big problem. Holding the Badge of Humility, Colin held his breath, leaped out of the window, and moved swiftly through the city.
A few minutes later, he arrived at the given location and saw an elementary school that had been cordoned off.
Then, looking at the several dilapidated school buildings, Colin understood why Qin Chuan and the others had been hung out to dry by the elementary school kids…
“Truth be told, they seem quite strong…”
Colin arrived on the scene, scanned the area, and saw there were many fist prints of various sizes on the walls.
Even many of the load-bearing pillars had been forcefully broken.
Thew “elementary school kids'” might was truly frightening!
And as the Badge of Humility was lifted, Xia Liufang also noticed the suddenly appearing Colin:
“Mr. Colin, do we need to enter together?”
“No need, leave the rest to me; there should be no problem.”
Rejecting Xia Liufang’s offer to enter with others, Colin walked into the school building alone.
The strength of those inside was enough to take Qin Chuan down, but they were not of much significance against him.
Of course, he needed to be cautious…
Otherwise, if he also ended up cornered and beaten up in the bathroom, it would be quite the spectacle.
Warm flames emerged on the surface of his body, enveloping him as Colin entered the schoolyard and immediately felt a unique anomaly enshrouding the place.
The effectiveness of electronic communication began to dwindle…
“If an ordinary person were to come in, they would probably experience something like Ghost-Hitting-the-Wall, is this what they call a barrier?”
Colin sensed quietly, then continued along the campus path, delving deeper into it.
As long as he was bolstered by Bonfire, this thing had almost no impact on him…
A minute later, he suddenly heard a series of shrill, childish roars coming from a school building…
Hearing this commotion, it seemed like someone was chasing after something.
And coincidentally, they seemed to be heading in Colin’s direction.
Based on the information he had received, Colin thought it should be Qin Chuan and his group, as there wasn’t anyone else.
But quickly, as the footsteps got closer, he realized it was apparently not them.
A figure covered in long hair jumped down from the third floor, not bothering to brace for impact, and rolled forcefully to the side.
Simultaneously, another figure, with muscles bulging as large as a bull’s yet with the head of a child, landed with a thud at the first figure’s previous spot, causing a vibration.
Upon landing, he delivered a punch straight to the long-haired figure.
“Muscle enhancement, Power of a Thousand Horses!”
In the midst of his roar, the “child’s” right-hand muscles swelled as he swung his head-sized fist, smashing it towards the figure covered in hair, who appeared neither fully human nor completely like a beast.
With a loud thump from the impact, the beast-like man with long hair was sent flying more than ten meters away, landing just a few meters aside from Colin…
Colin glanced at the “werewolf,” then at the formidable elementary school kid, and couldn’t help but exclaim:
“Can this really be an elementary school kid?”

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - 455 396 Abnormal Attrition Within the Company
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 455: Chapter 396 Abnormal Attrition Within the Company. _1 Chapter 455: Chapter 396 Abnormal Attrition Within the Company. _1 An E-level Personnel who mastered the “Body of Tyranny.”
To be beaten up and forced to flee by an “elementary school student” with heavy fists…
This, in the past, would have been something Colin couldn’t even dream of, yet at this moment, it really happened.
“Is this what they call an ‘Awakener’?”
Colin watched the other party, his thoughts swiftly turning, when at that moment, the “Werewolf” who had just climbed up beside him glanced at Colin and then warned:
“Be careful not to take it lightly, this guy is tough and has super strong healing abilities, even bullets can hardly affect him…”
Although unsure of Colin’s specific intentions, he felt that, without any surprises, this should be a company rescue personnel.
And as soon as he finished speaking, the “elementary school student” in front of him, whose physique could almost compare to a sumo wrestler but whose fat was replaced with muscle and topped with a child’s head, looked at Colin and said:
“That guy with flames, I don’t kill the innocent, are you here to bully me and to stop me from finding my true love as well!”
“Er, cough cough…”
Bullying was not possible, but true love? Colin almost couldn’t hold back his laughter and involuntarily gave a few dry coughs.
“Are you mocking me?”
“No, cough cough cough…”
“You’re always laughing, you never stop! You adults are the worst, it’s all because of you that my love with Xiaoling was torn apart!”
“Pfft…”
“You’re dead!”
Watching Colin’s uncontrollable laughter, his face turned red with anger, and he charged at Colin.
‘This temperament is prone to loss of control…’
Colin wasn’t flustered, still analyzing, feeling that the other party seemed even more prone to losing control than the official Extraordinary Ones.
At the same time, the large body of the other party rolled towards him like a boulder.
“Power of a Thousand Horses!”
Amid the furious shout, for some reason, the “elementary school student” who grasped extraordinary methods raised his fist and struck Colin in the head with all his might.
In previous battles, this move had been nearly invincible.
All enemies’ methods would be smashed to pieces by his punch.
What Talisman Paper, what Beastman, what Flame!
All were no match for his muscle skill which he had practiced for forty-nine days and had small success!
However, at this moment, he saw the other party also casually extending a fist…
And then, in the clash of fist against fist, the other party didn’t fly away.
Instead, his right hand throbbed painfully, and the bones in his fist cracked with a snap, breaking apart.
“This is impossible!”
In a state of disbelief, he was sent flying, with numerous fissures appearing on his right arm and his blood vessels bursting, while that despicable guy was still wrapped in flames, standing in place with a mocking look at him.
After landing with a thud, he looked at that guy’s arrogant expression, unable to contain his rage…
“You forced me to do this!”
He ran his tongue forcefully over his teeth, prying off a molar, then took a deep breath, aimed it at the guy’s head, and sprayed…
The molar shot towards Colin like a bullet.
Colin did not choose to intercept it head-on; instead, he dodged it with a swift move.
However, behind him, several old green trees weren’t so lucky; they broke one after another under the impact of this tooth.
“Tsk, it can be considered not weak,” Colin said.
Colin did not look back, but he was well aware of the situation behind him.
The force of the guy’s tooth projectile was quite strong…
‘Plus, whether it’s company staff or official personnel, they seem not to want to deliver killing blows, so it’s understandable for them to be at a disadvantage here. I just don’t know where he gets this strength from.’
Colin became even more curious because through his sense of smell, he didn’t detect any other abnormal odors leaking out.
As for this little brat, besides being a bit overemotional and possibly having killed some people, he didn’t seem to notice any severe pollution or the like?
Even faintly, he felt that the other party’s abilities had a somewhat familiar feeling…
But before he could think further, the brat lying on the ground ran his tongue over his teeth again, seemingly preparing to spit out more teeth.
This time, however, Colin extended his hand first, aimed at the other party, his index finger drawing downwards from above.
Immediately following, a terrifying Repulsion force suddenly descended from the sky…
The elementary school student suddenly felt that his body was pinned down by an invisible force, unable to move, along with the ground in a certain radius around him being pressed down several centimeters by the powerful Repulsion force.
An intense suffocation washed over him, his consciousness gradually sinking into drowsiness, reluctantly closing his eyes.
“Fuck, what kind of monster is this,” an E-level company personnel watching was wide-eyed.
Having battled with the muscle-bound elementary school student for several hours, he was well aware of how strong the guy was. Initially, his mission requirement was to suppress him without killing, if possible.
But later he discovered that the guy’s healing was amazing, even intestines blown out could regenerate quickly…
And the more he fought, not only didn’t his strength weaken, but it grew stronger.
Yet such a guy was now casually suppressed by this person with just a few movements of his fingers…
Looking at the figure surrounded by flames, the E-level Personnel had some guesses, but wasn’t quite sure.
However, at that moment, as the source was suppressed by Colin, the surrounding chaos slowly dissipated, and the words “mission completed” appeared in his brain.
“Buddy, thanks, I’m leaving now. Looks like the cops are on the way, if you don’t want to get their attention, you better hurry…”
Seeing that the mission was accomplished, the E-level Personnel promptly thanked Colin and took the route provided by the mission to return.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - 456 396 Abnormal Attrition within the Company
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 456: Chapter 396 Abnormal Attrition within the Company. _2 Chapter 456: Chapter 396 Abnormal Attrition within the Company. _2 The next second, Colin saw the figure disappear from the spot just like it had been erased by an eraser.
“Is this what it’s usually like when I disappear in front of others?”
Colin had used many methods to return, but still witnessed others disappearing in front of him.
And he knew from some official internal documents that after the person disappeared, the memories of the company’s mission executors seemed to blur…
However, Colin didn’t know if it was because he was also an employee that his memory hadn’t faded.
“Go and inform Qin Chuan and the rest that everything is fine now.”
Colin waved his hand, sending the Little Maid to deliver the message, then continued to gaze at the unconscious, strong figure in the pit.
If it had been before, his use of the Repulsion card could only push the little brat away.
But after Shana’s careful teaching and development, Colin had mastered more experience and techniques, allowing him to manipulate the direction of the repulsion within a fifteen-meter radius at will.
It was no longer like before, where he could only push and squeeze outward.
Shaking his head to clear his thoughts, Colin continued to sense the items on the man.
As the flames spread and enveloped the person…
A few minutes later, as his observation continued, Colin’s brow furrowed ever tighter, and his expression grew more solemn…
At this moment, he finally understood why he had felt a sense of familiarity earlier.
Because the other party’s ability seemed somewhat similar to the kind of skill or talent found within the company…
Uncertain, but very similar, there was an indescribable sense of resemblance.
This discovery made Colin realize that everything was not simple behind the scenes.
“The officials seem to have captured a few similar existences, and Old Master Wu also mentioned that he felt there might be some sort of plot behind everything, a plot that is likely to erupt after his death.”
“And here I am, finding this person whose abilities seem to come from the company…”
Colin felt as if he was eating the melon from his own garden.
“Mr. Colin…” a call interrupted Colin’s thoughts.
He turned to see Qin Chuan and Hu Zheng, along with several other members, limping over, their bodies bearing signs of fractures, with Hu Zheng’s leg even broken, swinging like a pendulum as he was carried, and they were covered in dust and blood, looking utterly disheveled…
“It seems there shouldn’t be any serious issues,” Colin nodded.
Hearing Colin’s words, the group exchanged glances, not too surprised, but revealing bitter smiles.
In his eyes, probably even if only a head was left, as long as there was a chance of survival without death, it could be considered not too serious…
However, before they could ponder further, they saw Colin wave his hand in the air, and quickly a transparent outline of a Fire Tree was dragged out of nothingness.
The ancient tree grew rapidly until it reached a height of seven to eight meters, then countless aerial roots dropped from its canopy.
These aerial roots spread toward them, penetrating their skin.
Then, with a surge of special energy, they could feel their bodies rapidly healing.
“Mr. Colin’s methods have increased…” they couldn’t help but remark.
After doing all this, Colin didn’t look further but continued to control the flames to penetrate this “Awakener.”
When Old Master Wu spoke of these “Awakeners,” he didn’t mention the company, which Colin suspected was due to the inability to observe the company…
But for Colin, an insider, the situation would be different.
While Colin was conducting a thorough examination on the “Awakener,” at the top of the burning Fire Tree, a face slowly emerged, cautiously glancing at Colin and then at the injured receiving treatment.
Seeing that no one’s attention was on it, the face acted as if holding its breath, quietly sending several roots into the ground, reaching out in a certain direction…
Seconds later, its roots finally touched the target—
A packet of half-eaten mushroom and beef snacks that someone had dropped on the ground!
Taking advantage of the distraction, it sneakily pulled the snack into its trunk.
In addition, some unfinished spicy strips, a lollipop thrown away halfway through, unopened shrimp chips, and other ignored rubbish were all slyly taken away…
“Haha, jackpot!”
The face within the Fire Tree’s trunk looked at the thing it had dragged back and felt quite pleased with the haul.
This stuff would last it for quite a while.
However, at this moment, its face abruptly flashed with surprise, as if a navigator had just discovered treasure.
“Is it… Could it really be…”
In shock, it slowly extended more tendrils, stretching in that direction.
A few seconds later, it found a small plastic figure with a purple body and green stripes that someone had dropped on the ground!
Afterward, the face on the tree carefully looked around, making sure no one had noticed its little gesture before dragging the plastic figure slowly back…
Before long, when the object was placed inside its trunk, the Fire Tree couldn’t help but let out an excited cheer.
“Got it! The Unit-01 figurine! And it’s an authentic limited edition!”
On either side of its tree hollow face, countless roots spread out, forming two hands that joyfully lifted the prize that would normally cost at least one hundred thousand points to redeem.
Its entire face broke into a grin…
Although there might be some scratches from falling on the ground, it wasn’t a big problem.
But just as it was about to reach out and lovingly touch its collectible, there was a loud thud, and a hand violently pierced through its trunk.
That hand snatched away the plastic figure that it hadn’t even had time to warm up.
“Tsk, I thought you were up to something sneaky while I was busy with other things, but it turns out you’re just picking up trash…”
Colin looked at the plastic figure in his hand, then glanced at the other things inside the tree hollow and couldn’t help but snicker.
“You’ve lived for what, eighty or a hundred years, and you still like these trinkets…”
Hearing Colin’s words, the Fire Tree didn’t dare to get angry or say anything but silently extended its tendrils to hug some of the snacks that hadn’t been snatched away…
“You can keep those snacks, but this thing needs to be returned. You can’t develop a habit of stealing, I’ll buy you a new one later.”
Colin confiscated the item.
As he spoke, he also noticed something…
‘These anomalies that turn into humans seem to generally have some severe character flaw, or rather, a strong interest or hobby?’
Colin remembered that Yukionna liked to find the coldest layer in refrigerators the higher the power, the more she enjoyed…
This Fire Tree on the other hand was extremely interested in snacks and models….
And then there was the Spectral Witch on the train, who had an unhealthy obsession with her master…
Every one of these artifacts seemed to have interests akin to character flaws, and he wondered if this was a deliberate “backdoor” left in their creation.
However, he didn’t pay much attention to it and tossed the figurine to Qin Chuan.
Colin withdrew the Fire Tree Mark and glanced at the “Awakener” elementary school student on the ground.
Even though he didn’t know where the kid’s tricks originated from, Colin was fairly certain from his observations that the kid’s abilities were definitely related to the company.
‘Either someone has imitated the company’s methods, creating these things and then releasing them in secret…’
‘Or, there’s some issue within the company itself…’
‘Regardless, without taking Gene Compensation Medicine, using these things will likely end badly…’
‘I should give Old Master Wu a heads-up first…’
‘Still, if I really want to get to the bottom of this, my only option is to contact Lady Bunny. Only someone with her high-level status would know the exact reasons.’
As he mulled this over, Colin took out his phone and started drafting a message to Old Master Wu while considering how to contact Lady Bunny.
But at that very moment, his phone suddenly rang.
“Xu Duojin?”
Colin raised an eyebrow and then answered the call, immediately hearing the voice on the other end speak anxiously.
“Mr. Colin, Base No. 5 is under attack, it’s urgent!”

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - 457 397th The Tragic Scene at the Periphery of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 457: 397th Chapter “The Tragic Scene at the Periphery of Base Number Five.”_1 Chapter 457: 397th Chapter “The Tragic Scene at the Periphery of Base Number Five.”_1 “Base No. 5 is in emergency?”
Colin was stunned for a moment before snapping back to reality almost half a second later, hastily responding.
“What happened? Do you need me to reinforce?”
As he spoke, Colin glanced at the elementary school student lying on the ground and realized that the situation might not be simple.
The attack on Base Number Five gave him the feeling of having his home broken into.
“Yes, although I am also on my way, I can’t move that fast. If you have the time, I hope to request your assistance. As for the situation at Base Number Five, I’m not very clear about it myself; I only know there might have been an accidental loss of control during supernatural containment…” Xu Duojin’s voice was very quick.
Then the call was disconnected.
“Mr. Colin, is there something urgent again?” Hu Zheng asked.
Witnessing the changes in Colin’s expression, along with the powerful inspiration from “Fate Propeller,” he realized that something bad might be about to happen…
“Yes, there’s a bit of a situation at Base No. 5; I need to get there immediately. Take care of things here yourself, Xia Liufang is outside, and she’ll be coming in soon…”
With Xia Liufang’s backup support, there shouldn’t be much of an issue here.
Colin quickly explained and without saying much more, began to prepare for action. However, before setting off, he seemed to remember something, taking out his phone from his pocket and dialing Old Master Wu.
Although Xu Duojin could be considered Old Master Wu’s ambassador, it was best to be extra cautious and confirm things in times like these.
Especially since Colin had been inexplicably tricked into “The Seventh Box Garden World” last time, he had become very vigilant in this regard.
Regarding this account, Colin had discussed it with Old Master Wu before, having received the contact information directly from him. As long as he wasn’t confirmed dead, there was no need to worry that the person replying wouldn’t be him.
For on Earth, no one could impersonate him…
The phone rang for a few seconds before being hung up actively.
Then, Old Master Wu, with a black tower profile picture, sent a message: “You can go, but do not pursue too deeply.”
“1.”
After a brief response, Colin felt at ease, and his body shot through the air like a comet.
In the midst of the thunderous vibration, even though he used the effect of the Badge of Humility, due to the loudness of the noise, many people noticed.
“What happened?!”
“Did the enemies from the sea strike?”
“It’s a missile! Hurry, find shelter, take cover!”
“…”
Disregarding those below, Colin kept accelerating, and some of the higher floors even started to crack from the windows.
However, compared to the drop in his anonymity that exposure to the extraordinary might cause, it was better to reach Base Number Five quickly.
This was an extremely important facility. If something went wrong, the impact would be far greater than the repercussions of his hasty exposure.
“I remember that at least one very powerful Eighth Level personnel is stationed to guard Base Number Five. With various enhancements from his domain, it’s almost like his own territory. But to be able to infiltrate under these circumstances means the enemy must be equally strong…”
“There’s also the sudden incident involving Qin Chuan and Hu Zheng that occurred just before the attack, which seems like it could have been deliberate. Looking back, the distance indeed seems to have been widened…”
“It appears to be premeditated rather than an accidental loss of control.”
As thoughts flew through his mind, Colin dared not be negligent any longer, stacking up all the buffs he could while midair.
Before long, he could see the distant scenery, his heart sinking slightly.
Though still some distance away, he could already pick up on many unusually active “scents” emanating from the massive base…
…
Meanwhile, at Base Number Five, within a containment unit.
With a loud bang, an official personnel suddenly fell to the ground, his face twisted in agony, vomiting foam and convulsing violently.
It was as if he had a seizure…
However, what was more terrifying than a seizure was that after only a few seconds of convulsing, he exploded into a pool of blood on the spot.
This blood slowly flowed toward something in the front…
There, a gray stone statue entwined with numerous chains stood erect.
The statue was shaped like a cabbage wrapped in dozens of pitch-black wings, and in the center of this “cabbage,” a tongue with eyeballs on it was licking restlessly towards the blood on the ground.
It seemed desperate to lap up that blood…
Seeing this, a Sixth Level Official Personnel had to call out again, reminding the dozens of people in the area:
“Keep an eye on it, don’t look away! Otherwise, you’ll be attacked directly by it!”
The statue was only one meter tall and was not considered large. Even during a danger level assessment, it would only be rated as moderate to low risk. But at this moment, it had everyone there on high alert.
Normally, they would only need to keep their gaze fixed on it while backing away, reaching a safe distance of a thousand meters.
But now, with many anomalies suddenly erupting within Base Number Five, exiting might not be any safer than their current location.
After all, releasing this particular anomaly had been their own doing…
It was done to prevent other uncontrollable entities from sneaking into this containment unit and disrupting the seals within.
As for what was happening outside this containment chamber, they could no longer afford to care.
In any case, no matter the cost, they had to hold this containment unit. If it were breached, many newly transported anomalies that had not yet been further sealed would erupt…
At that point, the core internal area of Base Number Five might remain untouched, but all those in this outer perimeter would be doomed without doubt!
“Hold on, we…”

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - 458 397 The Tragic Scene on the Periphery of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 458: Chapter 397: The Tragic Scene on the Periphery of “Base Number Five”._2 Chapter 458: Chapter 397: The Tragic Scene on the Periphery of “Base Number Five”._2 Sixth Level Personnel were about to say a few words to encourage everyone, but the next second, he and everyone present felt a sudden heaviness in their hearts, realizing that the scene before them had darkened.
The area had inexplicably become damp, and the surrounding walls were covered in countless mold spots.
Drip, drip…
The sticky footsteps, as if walking on water, came one after another, from far to near.
With its approach, a rich and unbearable stench began to pervade the air, like flesh that had been left to rot in a refrigerator for over a dozen days before being discovered.
And the already damp space began to fill with a faint mist.
Within the mist, silhouettes like wronged souls fluttered to and fro…
“No way, this can’t be, Director Chen…” an employee said while keeping a close eye on the statue and noticing the changes in the air, immediately realizing something.
“Damn, controlling ghosts, fungal corruption, these abilities…”
Sixth Level Personnel understood what he meant; such powers were only possessed by his leader, “Divine Strike,” who had reached the Seventh Level.
As expected, at that moment, a figure suddenly appeared at the doorway.
A figure with flesh and skin in advanced stages of decay.
His skin had vanished, exposing the white bones, but oddly enough, his internal organs were still in place and writhing as if they were still functioning normally…
“The leader has lost control…” The Sixth Level Personnel’s heart grew cold upon seeing this.
Earlier, the leader had left alone to divert some extremely troublesome anomalies, and in less than ten minutes, he had returned in this state…
“Ugh…”
Several clerical staff who had fled to this place finally couldn’t hold back, and as their gaze shifted away, they began to vomit.
They were not combat personnel and didn’t have as strong a psychological resilience.
But before they could throw up anything, all of a sudden, their bodies stiffened, their faces twisted horribly as if they had seen something terrifying, and then, they all dropped dead, their blood flowing towards the statue…
The Sixth Level Personnel couldn’t worry about that; he could only keep his eyes on the statue and pray that the leader would leave quickly.
However, to everyone’s despair, the highly decayed figure didn’t head straight through the containment unit door but slowly turned around at the entrance and staggered towards them, murmuring to himself,
“Stand guard, protect, stand guard, protect…”
Instinctively, it entered the containment unit.
“Damn…” The Sixth Level Personnel cursed under his breath, realizing that the worst-case scenario had occurred.
Although from that indistinct murmur, he guessed that the leader had returned here based on a strong sense of duty present at the moment of his death, this didn’t bode well…
Upon its arrival, it made contact with the cabbage-shaped winged sculpture.
On the damp ground, multiple pale arms reached out, grabbing at the statue, while in the mist, the souls also launched their attack…
Its targets weren’t limited to the statue but included other people as well.
“Prepare for battle! We must hold this position, every second counts! Remember, during the fight, keep your eyes on the statue, and give it priority…”
The Sixth Level Personnel clenched his teeth and raised his broadsword.
A phantom image, like an ancient warlord, slowly emerged behind him.
Both the statue and his former leader possessed wide-ranging attack methods. It might be manageable to deal with one, but now that they were combined…
They might not be able to bring each other down in a short time, but it spelled disaster for the rest of them.
The Sixth Level Personnel kept his eyes on the statue while he began to hack away at the arms at his feet.
However, it wasn’t long before a flash of red light passed, and the phantom image on him collapsed…
“Great, something else has come in…”
The Sixth Level Personnel was stunned, then his face filled with despair as he saw a strange scarecrow, which had somehow entered the room and targeted him for an attack.
Moreover, as his gaze strayed, he was struck with an intense sense of terror…
He had triggered the statue’s attack pattern!
“It’s over…”
In an instant, the surroundings went pitch black, with seemingly countless hideous creatures moving to engulf him.
