Night Owl had nothing to hide about this; their only secret was the specific locations and statuses of several hundred ‘Breeding Halls’…
Beyond that, it didn’t really matter.
Soon, under his explanation, Colin understood the situation with this thing.
The ‘victory bell’ rumor has been passed down from some high-level starship personnel many years ago, but there wasn’t much in the way of specific descriptions; it was only said that if one day they heard a special bell ringing…
It would mean humanity had achieved the ultimate victory.
‘Damn it, clearly it’s the Extraordinary Ones from the ‘Book of Fate’ who put this forward, these guys… would they die if they spoke in more detail?’ Colin grumbled.
The only notable point about the ‘victory bell’ was that it seemed to have a certain connection with ‘2044.’
According to the prophecy, that bell was to ring at this particular time, space, place, thing… right?
‘What do you mean?’ Colin asked for clarification.
‘Sorry, in the prophecy, we can’t accurately describe it with a predetermined term because it might not necessarily be time; it could also be space, or perhaps something else entirely… What we only know for sure is that the ‘victory bell’ will ring at a certain moment, which might be when you find something called ‘2044,’ or it could be a time…’ Night Owl explained uncertainly.
This was hard to explain, he felt even his ability to articulate was becoming problematic.
‘2044 might not be a time, but it could also be something else?’
Colin was momentarily stunned; this was something he hadn’t considered.
Although it seemed like he had gained more information, the number of mysteries had also doubled—the damned riddlers.
Taking a deep breath, he suppressed some inexplicable restlessness in his heart.
At this moment, Night Owl, sitting opposite Colin, said, ‘Although this matter is somewhat vague, overall, we can roughly determine that we’re getting ever closer to victory…’
‘Oh? How so?’ Colin was curious.
His and the other employees’ feelings were quite the opposite of the other party’s…
As a certain time or event approached, everything was getting worse; nearly every place was suffering disasters, nearly every place was experiencing hardship, and so far, not a single place appeared normal.
While pondering, he saw Night Owl stand up, take out a document, and handed out a copy to him and the others.
‘You guys might not easily notice this trend, but we, who are constantly in a state of war, have observed some peculiar things. For the specific details, you can take a look at this document…’
Colin flipped through the stack of dozens of pages of the document handed to him.
The first section was about the ‘Flood Devil,’ with pictures and texts, like some sort of encyclopedia entry.
‘The trend of the Flood Devil’s change…’
Colin silently read the words, turned the pages, and examined the state of this special Level 2 Containment Subject with the others.
The earliest ‘Flood Demons’ were considerably different from their current state, being a kind of life form without much solid substance that resembled fog, but after a period, they began to develop flesh and became quite fierce and terrifying in appearance…
After more time, the ‘Flood Demons’ gradually developed various organs and flesh.
Until recently, as Colin saw them…
Lots of organs, limbs, viscera… even brains.
Compared to the beginning, they now had additional abilities like causing mental disturbances.
Their form became more terrifying, bloody, and chilling, like mixing together human pieces after dismemberment, causing unease.
‘It feels like the earliest version of the ‘Flood Devil’ was much more presentable than it is now…’
Colin flipped past the content on the ‘Flood Demon’ and looked at the others, noticing that many anomalies had begun exhibiting strange flesh mutations.
Faintly, he seemed to understand why the people here were saying victory was getting closer.
However, at this moment, ‘Fool’s Mushroom’ scratched his head on the other side, pressing his hand on his document, and said in confusion:
‘Excuse me, but, but what does this have to do with… getting closer to victory?’
Apart from these thing growing more disgusting, he couldn’t see anything of value.
However, as soon as he finished speaking, he noticed the look in the eyes of the people around him became ambiguously meaningful…
This made him feel as though his intelligence was being questioned.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - 493 414 The Victory Bell in the Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 493: Chapter 414: The “Victory Bell” in the Ancient Prophecy. Chapter 493: Chapter 414: The “Victory Bell” in the Ancient Prophecy. But, when you think about it, isn’t asking questions when you don’t understand a good habit?
Next to him, “Son of Cruelty” and “Little Chicken No. 7,” though they didn’t quite understand either, also watched their former teammate to avoid being suspected of low intelligence.
Night Owl shook his head, about to speak, when “Life Mentor Adorable” beat him to it, offering his explanation:
“If you pay attention, you’ll notice that they are becoming more like humans. Never mind whether they currently look like it or not, but… this is a major trend.”
Night Owl glanced at his colleague and nodded approvingly, adding, “Not only that, but they’ve also developed preferences and emotions that they shouldn’t have, otherwise their behavior would be even more chaotic…”
Hearing his words, the three who were in the dark finally understood.
“Whether they want to or not, they are becoming more like humans…”
Colin concluded in a definitive tone.
He thought of many things he had encountered, some anomalies that were clearly not human, but inexplicably took on human form…
It was probably not because they wanted this shape.
‘If this continues, many things will ‘humanize,’ including some powerful individuals. Tsk, no wonder those higher beings are so nervous…’
Colin still didn’t know what changes would occur after they took on the shape of humans.
But those high-level executives in the company must not be so eager to engage in such activities just for fun…
“It always feels like they are playing a very big game of chess.”
Colin raised his hand, stroked his chin, considering the company’s methods…
Could it be that once these things become human, all suffering will disappear? That seemed unlikely.
Or was there some other, deeper arrangement?
After pondering for about ten seconds, with a multitude of thoughts rising and falling, unfortunately, he couldn’t be certain of the correct answer due to insufficient information.
‘We can only cross the bridge when we get there…’
Reining in his scattered thoughts, Colin glanced outside the command vehicle, where the battle with the “Flood Demon” was still ongoing, though the front line had been pushed further away.
Then, he turned to his companion and said, “It seems we have about an hour left… If you don’t mind, we could ask about those things, the black fog, the eye on top…”
Night Owl followed his gaze outside, pondered for a few seconds, then agreed:
“The eye above was once an important part of the local ecosystem, having functioned as the ‘sun’ and, at the same time, it was part of the ‘defense system’ of the mother planet. After the war, they have been continuously using that power to make the anomalies here lethargic, causing them to slumber.”
“Similar ‘suns’ exist in every independent region of the ‘living layer,’ though many have developed problems to varying degrees, some not distinguishing between friend and foe.”
“Every independent region?” Colin interjected.
He had initially thought that there was only one of these giant spaces here.
But it seemed that wasn’t the case?
“Yes, there are many similar spaces. Some are completely sealed, others are somewhat accessible, like this one here, which is accessible.” Night Owl didn’t specify how many spaces there were, but gave a vague idea.
Colin didn’t press further and instead asked about the black fog.
He noticed that it seemed to originate from this area and not from a lower layer…
“Regarding that, you might need to come with me to understand the situation fully. Otherwise, it’s hard to grasp just from verbal explanations,” Night Owl had apparently anticipated their question and stood up, pointing outside.
Colin nodded and stood up, following his lead to a certain area of the temporary base.
There, in the distance, thick black smoke could be seen billowing into the sky…
And it was only a few minutes later that Colin and the others saw what was emitting the smoke—
A number of highly specialized large armored vehicles.
By estimation, there seemed to be sixty or seventy of them; on each side of the vehicles, there were cylindrical “canisters,” with numerous pipes on top of the “canisters” connecting to the center of the vehicles.
As they got closer, Colin saw that each “canister” was filled with people.
Traces of anomalous pollution were being drawn out of them.
Colin narrowed his eyes, focusing to see that the pollution was not the black fog, but after being extracted and filtered through something, it turned into black fog that was expelled?
Just as he was about to ask about the situation, he heard a “click” from one of the armored vehicles.
A row of cans on the vehicle opened…
The people inside walked out.
‘They seem ‘cleaner’ than before I saw them; the black fog actually comes from the anomalous pollution on them? I just don’t know how they deal with that pollution.’
Colin silently nodded to himself, and just as he thought this, he saw the back of the vehicle open after all the people had left.
Inside, the space was filled with a dozen or so human skeletons…
The pale skeletons looked as if they were brand-new, without a trace of flesh.
“What’s going on here?” Colin frowned.
Night Owl looked at the scene and explained, “If you stay here for too long, you’ll certainly accumulate various kinds of pollution. If it exceeds a certain threshold, abnormalities will occur…”
“To prevent this, we select individuals whose bodies have reached their limits.
“We make them assume the duty of serving as ‘filters,’ taking on the burden of filtering the pollution from others before it’s processed harmlessly…”

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - 494 414 The Victory Bell in the Ancient
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 494: Chapter 414: The “Victory Bell” in the Ancient Prophecy._3 Chapter 494: Chapter 414: The “Victory Bell” in the Ancient Prophecy._3 He pointed calmly to the skeletons: “After these are checked once, if there are no problems, they’ll be concentrated, crushed, and sprayed out from a special pipeline…”
Hearing his explanation about the situation, everyone fell silent for a moment.
‘So that’s how the surface of the Starship got covered with a layer of skeletons? But how many people died to create such a thick layer?’
Colin could no longer imagine how many lives were lost in this prolonged war.
“Is this the only way to deal with the abnormal smell?” Life Mentor Adorable from the side asked.
“Not the only one, but to solve the problem with as small a cost as possible and on a large scale, we only have this method,” Night Owl explained simply.
“This method cannot be sustained forever because no matter how we transfer it, there will be pollution left, and it’s deep-rooted. So after a certain time, if we haven’t sacrificed due to an abnormal event, then everyone’s ultimate fate is to become a ‘filter’…”
It was at that moment, another batch of people who served as “filters” was brought in.
Colin’s gaze shifted, and he immediately noticed that one of them was a member of the squad that had just broken out with them…
This person, who had just acted together with them, seemed to have sustained injuries on the way back, with the most serious one being a large opening in the abdomen.
At the time, Colin had not helped to treat the wound, thinking that these people must have their own medical camps, but unexpectedly, those with severe injuries were just wrapped up and sent to be consumed.
Here, “severe injury” was almost the same as death.
Yet, Colin did not see any resentment from the one still lying on the stretcher, instead, there was a sense of calm acceptance of death…
Night Owl, upon seeing this batch of “filters,” also did not show any other kind of emotion.
Because, after a while more, when he reached his limit, he too would become one of the “filters,” contributing his remaining strength for the stability here.
However, at this time, Colin suddenly spoke up, requesting the teams to stop.
Then, he strode over to the stretcher of the acquaintance, reached out, and grabbed the injured member of their breakout squad: “Perhaps, we can try some other way.”
As he spoke, the power of Flame burst out from his body, covering the person on the stretcher and everyone in this batch…
He could clearly feel the anomalies being melted away by the flames.
Meanwhile, a phantom tree shadow emerged beside Colin, a few tentacles fell, and rooted themselves in the other person’s body.
Rapidly repairing the other person’s injuries…
Watching from the side, Night Owl, who had maintained an expressionless face, finally showed surprise, his eyes widened. It wasn’t so much amazement at the healing effect, but surprise at something else:
“Actually, completely cleansed the pollution? Thoroughly…”
However, thinking of the other’s words, he shook his head, speaking quickly and clearly to persuade:
“I know your kindness, but this method won’t help us much.”
“In a little while, you’ll have an even tougher battle. Don’t waste your strength on this; it’s not worth it.”
“Because, there are just too many of us. You can save one person, ten, a hundred, or even thousands, but can you save millions, tens of millions, or even more who are about to be born…”
“Right, I really can.”
Colin interrupted him, taking out a long sword with flames from his pocket.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - 495 415 In the 40th millennium..._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 495: Chapter 415 In the 40th millennium…_1 Chapter 495: Chapter 415 In the 40th millennium…_1 “If I hadn’t intended to accept your help, hadn’t asked about this, didn’t know the situation here… Maybe I wouldn’t care, but since I do know, and happen to have the ability to resolve it, there’s no need to hesitate.”
The longsword, forged from “Revolver Contrarian,” burst into rings of astonishingly fierce flames in Colin’s hands.
Seeing this, Night Owl’s face behind his helmet opened his mouth, and finally said,
“What… do you plan to do?”
He couldn’t imagine how the other person was going to help everyone eliminate the contamination.
“Pass the flame…”
Colin responded with a smile, then scanned the surroundings, “But we’ll have to wait a moment.”
He planned to leave something behind here.
Of course, this wasn’t like what certain “Flame Bearers” did, creating an actual hand from himself.
Even if he wanted to, he couldn’t do that, since that guy had combined his own hand with some containment subjects to make a tool, that… perhaps he might have the chance later, but definitely not now.
Colin’s method was to light a “Bonfire Ritual Point” here…
As an exceptional talent, he now qualified to ignite such “Bonfire Ritual Points.”
However, this sudden idea also received support from someone who might be monitoring from behind, and he got an additional new mission.
[Special Event: Find suitable materials, ignite a special-type bonfire.]
…
‘It must be help from ‘Lady Bunny’, she really…’
Colin was touched for a moment.
Although he could ignite the bonfire himself, the effect was far inferior to the support from the big shot backing him.
As for the suitable materials for igniting the bonfire…
There were generally two types, one from himself, and the other from others.
On this resource-rich land…
He didn’t even think before choosing the second option.
After that, Colin gazed at the space around him, briefly recalling the locations of some of the anomalies he had seen while traversing the land.
Then, exerting force in his legs, he leaped out.
Like a swiftly soaring missile leaving a long trail of flames behind…
Night Owl stared blankly as the other vanished before withdrawing his gaze to look at the four people left behind:
“Do you know what he’s doing?”
“Not really sure,”
Life Mentor Adorable stroked his chin while speaking, remembering the time in “World Code-13” when Brother Shunzi once threw some monster carcasses into the bonfire, then said with a slightly odd expression:
“But it seems some anomalies are going to be unlucky.”
Having spoken, he paused for a few seconds, and without waiting for further questions, he added, “Just wait.”
And just as he finished speaking, they heard some deafening vibrations coming from a far distance from time to time.
The four colleagues were unsurprised, but Night Owl and the others couldn’t help but inhale sharply, the strength was more than excessive.
It had been so long since they had seen such a powerful individual.
The wait wasn’t too long, just about half an hour or so, when the sky rumbled loud.
A huge fireball plunged from the sky.
Colin dragged a chain in his hand, which was wrapped with some heretic carcasses that were still emitting terrifying auras.
“Do you have a suitable place, I need to light a fire.” Colin flew in mid-air, flames enveloping him like a deity.
Night Owl and the others, looking at those creatures killed in the other’s hand, were shocked once again.
If it were up to them, they might need several days of planning before they could take action, and even after sacrificing a large number of personnel, success was not guaranteed.
Yet the other had gone and back in less than half an hour, killing several.
Seeing the expression on the group’s faces, Colin descended from mid-air and repeated his earlier question.
At the same time, he also attempted to “compress” some ideas to throw as “inspiration” toward these people.
Night Owl immediately understood what Colin was planning to do.
‘This thing is quite useful…’ Colin mumbled quietly to himself, this “inspiration” was not that difficult, it could be used as long as one was mentally qualified.
It allowed the other party to have a clearer understanding of what he wanted to convey…
Thus avoiding misunderstandings.
After mastering this technique, Colin found that missions also had similar methods, although he only knew how to convey face to face and wasn’t sure how the company managed to add “inspiration” to inanimate objects or tasks.
“Can… this thing be ignited on a war chariot and then be moved with it?” Night Owl asked.
“That can be done.”
Seeing Colin nod, Night Owl immediately called for a relatively large war chariot.
Soon, with the residual wails coming from the remains of anomalies, an unusually bright flame rose in Colin’s hands.
[“Unplaced Bonfire Ritual Site”: Level 3.]
[Remaining burn time: 184 days, 23 hours, 59 minutes.]
[Trait 1 “Bonfire Blessing”: As long as enough offerings are presented, one can receive the bonfire’s blessing to be protected from external contamination, each blessing lasts for three hours…]
[Trait 2 “Anomaly Incineration”: When human entities voluntarily pass through the bonfire, they can stabilize their humanity, burning all non-self heretic incursions (the effect is subject to the anomaly’s danger level, and contamination depth)…]
[Trait 3 “Unextinguishable Flame Bearer”: The flame can reach up to Level 4, with sufficient fuel it can split into thirty-three additional flames of up to Level 3. Additionally, if the main fire is accidentally extinguished, other bonfires can reignite a cluster of Level 4 flames with high-grade fuel.]
[Additionally, each subdivision of the flame can select a Fire Keeper Squad (13 people).]

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - 496 415 In the 40th millennium..._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 496: Chapter 415 In the 40th millennium…_2 Chapter 496: Chapter 415 In the 40th millennium…_2 …
“This is good, theoretically, as long as they’re separated and the flame isn’t extinguished all at once, there’s a chance for it to reignite,” Colin nodded and turned slightly, holding the flame in his right hand, and glanced at Night Owl beside him. Seeing his shocked expression, Colin knew the other had also received information about the flame…
He then revealed a smile and said, “Friend, shall we ‘Pass the Flame’?”
Hearing Colin’s words, Night Owl slowly came back to his senses and then nodded earnestly:
“Pass.”
Merely standing beside it, being illuminated by the flame for a few seconds, his body’s deep-rooted contamination had already dissolved by a lot.
If he directly touched it…
Wouldn’t it burn all the impurities from his body clean?
After speaking, he cautiously stretched out his hands and took the bundle of flames from Colin’s.
The moment the flame landed in his hands, he immediately felt a warmth he had never experienced enveloping his body.
The leftover essence from the anomalies melted away as expected…
“Incredible…” Night Owl murmured to himself.
As an elder of this battlefield, one of the few with a long life experience of thirteen years.
He knew very well the significance of the flame, which meant that the “loss” would be reduced to a very low level in the future, and they might even have the chance to return to the peak number of the twelve-million-strong legion.
Taking a deep breath, he carried the flame to the chariot and set the exceptionally bright flame down.
With a bang.
The flame immediately erupted and rose.
After the scorching light radiated out, the people around immediately felt their pollution rapidly dissipating.
“With this, the lifespan of the Expedition Army soldiers will probably be able to break through nine years old universally, even surpass ten years!” an accompanying officer exclaimed, unable to contain his emotions.
However, no sooner had he finished speaking than Colin and the “Life Mentor Adorable” looked at each other in stunned silence.
“What did you just say?”
Little Chicken couldn’t help but ask, “Universally nine or ten years old? I’m sorry, I didn’t hear clearly, could you say that again?”
“Yes, nowadays soldiers have an average lifespan of around seven years. Even under the best protection, an individual can only live a maximum of fifteen years before they must leave, otherwise they cannot withstand the pollution. Like Night Owl, he is already thirteen years old…”
The accompanying officer did not conceal any details, and repeated roughly the same thing, especially stating his own age, which silenced everyone.
“You’re… only six years old?”
“Life Mentor Adorable” suppressed the urge to curse and twitched his lips, glancing at the people around him.
It was hard to imagine, this guy is not even of age yet?
Seeing their astonishment, the officers weren’t surprised; they had seen some materials and knew not everyone was like them, able to grow in a month and learn all the basic knowledge and war-related instincts from genetic memory within three months…
The officer continued, “When the population is tight, we can grow even faster; otherwise, we can’t fill the gaps.”
‘This feels like they’re coming out faster than broiler chickens…’ Although it was inappropriate, Cute Duo couldn’t help but think.
“As for food, do you have enough?” Colin asked.
This time, before the officer could speak, Night Owl walked down from the Bonfire and explained on behalf of his companion:
“We don’t lack for materials, our only trouble is pollution, which you have now solved for us.
“As for the content related to our own growth, sorry, I cannot discuss that, but my genetic memory tells me that after the war ends, we should slow down our birth rate and grow more … healthily.”
Ah, this…
Colin wasn’t sure how to describe his own feelings at the moment.
But thinking about it carefully, it also seemed normal; how could such a deadly place afford them another chance at childhood…
“Breeding Hall” probably used some advanced “tools” and mystical effects in addition to ordinary technology.
“By the way, the Level 4 Flame requires the core entity of a Level 2 Containment Subject, do you have such a thing here?” Colin asked.
It was certain that there were creatures of this caliber in such a godforsaken place, but he had not found any just now, he had only seen some containment subjects that were neither strong nor weak, at most Third Level.
“Flood Demon” is indeed a Level 2 creature, but it’s a bit special; its main body isn’t even here.
However, even if Colin found a Level 2 Containment Subject, he couldn’t leave to confront it, as he would be fighting at this level for a long time…
“That’s not a big problem, we’ve dealt with a lot over the years, when the time comes I’ll make sure the flame spreads, don’t worry…” Night Owl said, expressing his gratitude.
In this place, there’s not much of anything, but there’s no shortage of anomalous creatures.
To say nothing of Level 2 threat containment subjects…
Even instances of Level 1 appear occasionally.
The question is whether they can be defeated or not.
Upon hearing this, Colin didn’t pursue the topic further and spent the final moments conversing while standing on a hillside, looking out at the distant battlefield.
According to Night Owl’s words, under normal circumstances, the situation here would take a few days to resolve.
But soon there might be a “Reversal.”
So they were almost ready to retreat.
At the same time, Colin also understood some of the habits of these “Flood Demons,” knowing that it was their arrival that awakened them.
If the aura was not leaked, they would remain dormant.
And the legion could then sweep up these things while they were dormant, without spilling blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - 497 415 In the 40th millennium..._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 497: Chapter 415 In the 40th millennium…_3 Chapter 497: Chapter 415 In the 40th millennium…_3 ‘If I had casually brought the Badge of Humility Knight with me at that time, I might have avoided their awakening, but then again, I wouldn’t have been able to move quickly or search for people on a large scale…’
Colin shook his head silently. If he had to do it over, he guessed he would make the same choice.
Otherwise, searching bit by bit, who knows how long it would have taken to find anyone.
Afterwards, looking at the battlefield ahead of him, overall, there didn’t seem to be any major problems, it was just that, seeing the somewhat irregular advance, he somewhat wanted to voice his opinions, like moving a certain position forward a few hundred meters or something like that.
But after thinking it over, he held back—
That was something for a certain chairman to do.
He couldn’t do that.
After watching for a while, he suddenly felt vibration from the side. Colin turned to look and his pupils slightly changed as he saw another wave of “steel floods” approaching.
Night Owl, seeing his movement, also turned his head but didn’t see anything.
However, it didn’t take long for him to realize why Colin was staring in that direction.
“They are here to assist with the operation in a bit. We have half an hour, maybe we should head to the assigned location now, wait for the set time, and open the path to the core layer…”
“The ‘core layer’ area is extremely chaotic, with many anomalies and Heretic Cultists caught in ‘Time Reversal’, and their strength is very formidable…”
“Neither the environment nor other factors support us sending a large army into it.”
“So, we can only send a group of personnel familiar with the situation, lead you to the specific target location, and open some special channels…”
“When your mission is complete and you come out, we will be on the outside to support you.”
Listening to Night Owl’s words, Colin and the others nodded, indicating there were no issues.
Usually, during “Reversal,” the troops garrisoned here would hide and hunker down in safe areas, to avoid coming into contact with certain entities and suffering heavy losses.
They would stay hidden until the “Reversal” ended and then come out to “clean up” the place.
However, to ensure the success of their colleagues’ mission, they decided to make some sacrifices.
‘If it weren’t for the real need for someone to show the way, I feel, maybe just going in by ourselves would suffice. After all, according to past patterns, there’s a certain chance the moment we lay hands on the item, we could immediately leave through the ‘Descent Protocol’…’
If it really came down to that, then the squad going in with them, after their sudden departure…Their fate probably wouldn’t be too good.
‘Based on what they said about ‘Reversal’, it’s very likely the squad would be sacrificed outright, this… right, if that’s the case, we should give them a certain amount of time, time it right to get people out, then return…’
Colin’s mind spun with thoughts, and he roughly devised a plan.
Then, taking advantage of the last bit of time, he opened up the team information exchange in his mind.
He planned to remind the people outside that some trouble was likely to arise in a bit and to get them ready.
But, looking at the chat logs of these recent times, Colin’s expression became somewhat strange.
“Blue Shirt and Green Water”: So bored, finished eating barbecue, a bit stuffed, seems like we can go back soon. Guys, share some of those links you know, watch something when I return…
“Little Chicken No. 7”: You’re a D Level Personnel, one of the current higher-ups of the company, and you still watch this stuff?
“Doujinshi Magician”: What? If ordinary folks can watch it, D Level Personnel can’t?
“Little Chicken No. 7”: No, I mean, send it to me, I’ll check for him.
“Ancient Ruler – Ying Zheng”: Holy shit, didn’t notice, the Doujinshi big shot is here. Perfect, @Doujinshi Magician, bro, there’s a doujinshi I’ve been looking for a long time… roughly, it’s about…..
“Doujinshi Magician”: Easy, @Ancient Ruler – Ying Zheng, in the 40th millennium, the Emperor personally led me and 19 genetic primordials, and in a short time, we took down 29 Great Demons…
“Life Mentor Adorable”: @Doujinshi Magician, this… I don’t know whether to comment on your 40K Emperor rising from the toilet or to comment on something else…
…

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - 498 416 Dont worry its basically impossible
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 498: Chapter 416 Don’t worry, it’s basically impossible for anything to go wrong. Chapter 498: Chapter 416 Don’t worry, it’s basically impossible for anything to go wrong. ‘Ah, this…’
‘If I didn’t know we were on a mission, just by looking at your log, I’d think we were out here sightseeing or on vacation, what with camping and barbecuing and all. Full bellies lead to lustful thoughts, you guys seem to be making good progress…’
‘If you’d brought a camera, you’d probably have taken a few ‘V’ sign group photos.’
Colin was silent for a moment. He was slaving away here while that group was out there having fun…
The people the company recruited this time, it’s hard to say how capable they are, but their mindset is pretty solid.
‘Speaking of which, the strongest mindset at the moment should belong to that guy in the hospital, calling for help day after day without going mad or suffering a psychological collapse. Just don’t know… if that guy is still ‘human’ or something else now.’
His thoughts drifted for a few seconds, then Colin interrupted the group’s ‘vacation’, asking everyone to be ready.
The big event was probably coming…
According to Night Owl’s intel, when the time came, “Time Reversal” would return to reality from some special spatial domain that did not belong to the present and its appearance would leave only a few places on the starship unaffected.
‘So far as I can see, even being cloaked in bonfire, it’s easy to fall prey without realizing it. I fell for it before, but unlike some weaklings who never realize it no matter how many times it repeats, I caught on rather quickly…’
Colin pinched his forehead, being the holder of “The Sealed Right Hand”, he wasn’t too worried about it.
It was just the D Level staff outside that he didn’t know about…
‘With a temporary Bonfire Sacrificial Site in place, even if there’s a problem, it won’t be too big, and once I collect the items, this phenomenon will be resolved, and everything should be fine.’
Thinking it through, Colin felt that his logic should be correct.
After reminding the group that seemed to be on vacation, they also got themselves ready, waiting for the arrival of that team.
It didn’t take more than about ten minutes for Colin to see the support team mentioned by the others.
A fully armed elite squad of about thirty people.
Their uniform was black covering armor, but the various weapons they carried on their backs were a bit different, consisting of standards of plasma, laser-class weapons, and they were equipped with thermal knives for close combat.
‘Cool gear…’ muttered the Little Chicken, unable to help expressing his admiration.
‘Pure human physique, without a hint of mysticism, but their quality is surely much stronger than the average person on Earth. With that special armor, even their individual combat strength is quite impressive.’
Colin looked them over with curiosity, surmising roughly, although he didn’t sense any special artifacts, the standardized weapons they were equipped with.
If used against D Level Personnel, they would likely stand a good chance.
Night Owl’s gaze swept over the team, then looked toward Colin, “They’re the ones who’ll be working with you shortly. Different from those grown in three months, these have all been trained over a year to be elite units, all at the peak of their abilities at three years old…”
‘Uh, when I was one I had just started walking, and at three I was only just starting to talk clearly a bit…’
Colin muttered to himself, keeping a straight face, “So, are we going now?”
“Right, I’ll accompany you for a bit, but I won’t enter the core with you; when the time comes, you look for her—let’s call her Nightingale—she’s the captain of this team…”
Night Owl called out the squad leader of the small team.
They communicated among themselves, since they had special auxiliary systems implanted that enabled them to quickly identify one another.
But to outsiders, they probably all looked identical…
After a brief exchange, the operation commenced. Colin and his group followed the thirty-plus-member squad and started heading toward the core layer.
“There’s a main gate pathway leading to the core layer, but now, it’s certainly impassable, so we can only advance through some special passages that were reserved long ago…”
“These passages are regularly checked by our people, and under normal circumstances, nothing unexpected happens.”
“You just need to follow the preset route to get in.”
At this, Night Owl seemed to remember something and added, “But should something arise, when it’s time to give up, do so decisively and don’t worry about us.”
“To us, death is merely a return to ‘bonfire’, it doesn’t mean the end of everything.”
Considering the beliefs of this group sent by the company, he was very worried that they might ‘lose the big picture for something minor’.
‘Isn’t it a bit bad to say such things in front of others?’
Colin glanced at the other members of the elite team, but regrettably, they were motionless, showing no sign of any unusual emotions.
He neither nodded in agreement nor did he refuse, but Colin asked about other matters:
“What’s in the ‘core layer’? What has happened there?”
“It’s not very clear, we only know that every so often, a lot of abnormal things and contamination seep out of there, and our existence is to ensure that this overflow of contamination doesn’t exceed a certain threshold…”
Is that so… Colin nodded, “Then, if I retrieve that item, will it affect this in any way?”
It’d be quite inappropriate to take it if the place collapses right away.
“Yes, but not much, because the spacetime here has long been altered in some special way by the first batch of people; whether this item is here or not doesn’t affect the bigger picture…”
“On the contrary, it might be better without it.”
“Because ‘Time Reversal’ was originally one of the defensive mechanisms of the starship, meant not to affect our own people, but due to this out-of-control item, it started causing confusion between friend and foe and disrupted the original setup. After it’s gone, we won’t have to worry about it causing additional ‘Time Reversal’.”

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - 499 416 Rest assured its basically impossible
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 499: Chapter 416 Rest assured, it’s basically impossible for anything to go wrong. _2 Chapter 499: Chapter 416 Rest assured, it’s basically impossible for anything to go wrong. _2 Night Owl briefly explained the current situation, assuring them there was no need to worry.
Even, according to their explanation, the reason they kept checking the passageways leading down was not only to assess the entire situation but also to deal with the thing that had been incessantly “going berserk” down there.
After hearing the explanation, Colin felt much relieved and asked about the enemies.
“Among the abnormal entities, aside from a few high-level Containment Subjects, the most troublesome is the ‘Flood Devil’. We have markings for the Containment Subjects, which we can avoid, but that’s not the case with these. They occupy a vast space below, have assimilated and devoured many other anomalies, and have even modified the environment to a certain extent…”
“Regarding other Heretic Forces, what we need to pay most attention to are the ‘The Night’ followers, as well as the ‘Chosen of God’ from various heretic groups, but we’ll only know the specifics when we go down since every ten years or so, new entities emerge down there. Now, it’s become so chaotic that we are unable to conduct thorough investigations.”
“Besides, there are various demons that have lost their sanity… However, because some special projects require fuel, all lower-middle-class demons have already been wiped out by us, leaving only a few high-level demons.”
Night Owl slowly informed them about the core layer’s situation.
Apart from various control rooms, it was actually a residential area, albeit with a higher level of secrecy.
However, eventually, after the outbreak of the prolonged war, it turned into a battlefield.
At this point, “Life Mentor Adorable” seemed to remember something and began to speak:
“Right, it seems I heard you mention that disasters below burst out periodically, but after a while, they would subside on their own? Is there any concrete explanation for this?”
“We’re not very certain because during this period, we are supposed to be hibernating; otherwise, mass deaths occur. The reason is the emergence of higher beings, even those more powerful, ineffable entities that should not be heard or known…”
“You probably don’t need to worry about this. It last appeared three years ago, and if we go by the unchanging ten-year cycle, even if it’s sooner, it would still be two years…”
“So rest assured, it’s highly unlikely that anything unexpected will occur, and you don’t need to worry.”
Night Owl asserted that these matters were of no concern at all.
However, upon hearing his words, “Life Mentor Adorable” and others didn’t feel at ease but instead became even more anxious, and then instinctively glanced toward Brother Shunzi, who was sitting next to Night Owl—
Under normal circumstances, issues indeed shouldn’t arise.
But with him present, things weren’t necessarily certain.
Noticing their gaze, Night Owl followed suit and looked over: “What’s up?”
“Nothing, nothing, I was a bit worried before, but now that you’ve said this, I feel much more at ease,” “Life Mentor Adorable” said with “tears.”
Night Owl, who didn’t interact much with others, didn’t notice much.
Colin remained silent on the side. To be honest, he was somewhat panicky too.
Logically, taking away a Golden Card, not venturing into deeper areas, and not doing anything taboo should be fine.
It’s just…
‘Sigh, never mind, I’ll just take it one step at a time. No matter what happens, I’ll prepare for any eventuality,’ Colin thought to himself, regaining focus and continuing to gather information about the “core layer” from Night Owl.
After another ten or so minutes, the battlefield convoy came to a stop in front of a colossal pillar with a diameter of three hundred meters.
The pillar connected above and below, casting a black and cold gloss, forged from some unknown metal.
“This is the place,” Night Owl got off the vehicle and pointed to a particular spot.
There was an archway that was five meters wide and three meters tall…
If placed in an ordinary building, this portal would already be considered large, but on this pillar, if one didn’t pay attention, it might not even be noticeable.
Colin looked over, the archway opening to reveal a pitch-dark and fearsome interior, with a vaguely unsettling aura emanating from within.
Outside the archway, there was a fully armed legion of troops stationed.
After a simple final farewell, Night Owl left to head towards that legion.
“Sir, from here on out, we shall lead you. If you have any questions, just ask,” said Nightingale, the squad captain, stepping forward to stand beside Colin, though her voice, processed through her armor, was an indistinct electronic sound.
Compared to Night Owl, her speech was much more concise, seemingly not fond of conversation.
“Hmm,”
Colin nodded, then his gaze returned to the archway.
Then, without hesitation, the event began.
The thirty-plus person squad divided into five teams, with three in front, Colin and his party in the middle, and another two covering the rear.
The moment they stepped through the gate, they immediately felt an unusual sensation in their bodies.
Everyone felt strangely top-heavy and unsteady, as if they might topple over at any moment.
However, the issue wasn’t too severe, and after being forewarned, Colin and others didn’t say much. They steadied themselves and continued forward.
This time, Colin didn’t let the Flame spread out; instead, he formed it into a fireball and held it in the palm of his hand.
Even with flames at the ready, ensuring one’s defense at all times…
they also attracted the eyes of enemies.
No matter how powerful a “Flame Bearer” is, their abilities are not suited for concealment; instead, as soon as the flame lights up, all eyes are drawn to it.
The team’s progress was mostly made in the dark, with faint visible light coming solely from some dim overhead lights…
But for them, this was enough.
Behind the arch was a “Z”-shaped staircase similar to the usual emergency stairs.
The air was stuffy and cold, with occasional whispers that were barely audible.
Walking in the middle of the team, Colin was preparing to move forward while also ready to take a couple of deep breaths to assess the situation.
But before he could use his nose, he already heard a deep inhale near his ear…
Clearly, his four teammates had begun to “exert their power.”
“Tch, really feels like I’m becoming a dog…”
Colin muttered to himself, not quite trusting the weakened Talents of his companions, and then he also took a stealthy breath.
‘Overall, it’s a mix of Flood Devil’s stench, occasionally intermingled with some very powerful scents, but not many, probably far away, yes, or perhaps still trapped in “Time Reversal.”‘
He made a tentative assessment of the danger at hand.
After continuously descending for about ten minutes, Nightingale, who was in the front, which was the third-row position for Colin and the others, suddenly gestured.
The team immediately halted, and then, under Colin’s puzzled gaze, she pressed her hand against the metal wall beside her and pushed hard; the metal revolving door was nudged open, revealing a passageway.
“Is it that hidden?” Colin expressed his surprise.
Without further thought, he followed the squad directly into the passageway.
Afterward, they passed through several more corners and unexpected secret passages, and Colin’s vision suddenly brightened as he saw a city space enveloped in some surreal glow…
Their exit seemed to be a perfectly ordinary park.
But there was no time to focus on that.
At the same time, a terrifying presence suddenly erupted, and everyone paused in their tracks.
Then, they saw a bloodied figure, dragging a bloody saw-toothed long knife, rush out of the woods in the small park, his expression delirious.
On his body, a large number of worm-like parasites the size of a human brain were ceaselessly gnawing at his flesh.
“Don’t, I don’t want to continue…”
“It hurts so much, damn bugs get off me, stop biting, stop eating…”
“Let me die! Let me die ahhhhhh! Stop repeating this!”
“Die, die!”
“Ha ha, haha haha, ah—”
“…”
“This seems to be a Heretic? Because of his sufficient strength, he became aware that he is in a constant repetition?”
Colin was inwardly startled.
However, it seemed that this was not necessarily a good thing.
They watched as the delirious man sawed at his own body with the serrated blade while taking his blood-drenched head to slam against the surrounding buildings.
It appeared he wanted to die in such a manner…
Unfortunately, his strong physicality meant he couldn’t easily die like that.
Several minutes passed…
The scene here seemed to rewind like a movie, returning to the beginning.
“We can continue. It will take at least five minutes before it appears again. If things go smoothly next, reaching that position should take about thirty minutes, but…”
As she spoke, Nightingale, who was leading the team, looked toward Colin, seemingly hinting at something.
Colin nodded and, without any hesitation, took out the Orange Card “The Sealed Right Hand” from his pocket.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 500 417 He does not wish for The Night to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 500: Chapter 417 He does not wish for “The Night” to descend once again. _1 Chapter 500: Chapter 417 He does not wish for “The Night” to descend once again. _1 Spiritual Infusion, an intangible Secret Force spread, covering both Colin and everyone around him…
Essentially, this orange card didn’t possess any substantial power.
However, in some special scenarios, like the present one, it could grant them exemption from “time series” effects.
Once he was certain there were no issues, Colin reminded them, “Alright.
“Alright?” Nightingale paused, puzzled. She was rather curious about how the other party planned to remain unaffected by the “Time Reversal.”
But unexpectedly, she felt nothing, and it was all over?
Nevertheless, she didn’t voice any questions. Since the other party said there was no problem, they just needed to make the final preparations, and then they could take action.
Standing at the edge of the exit, Nightingale looked at Colin and the others, once again instructing:
“Remember, first, you must ensure your body is always in motion. If you stop, you still need to move, swaying your body, waist, turning your head, waving your hands, silently stepping in place—anything will do, otherwise, in a few seconds, you’ll be rigid dead…
“Second, if you feel someone calling out or someone calling your name, endure it, do not look back, do not respond…
“Third, try not to look up, don’t make Direct Gaze at the sky…”
After finishing her warnings and seeing Colin and the others nodding, she didn’t hesitate to make a hand gesture, and the whole team immediately sprang into action. Pushing aside a large stone that blocked half of the exit from the artificial hill in the small park, they filed out one after another…
In action, Colin didn’t look up, but he glanced at the sky through the corner of his eye.
The entire sky was flowing with an indescribable hazy strange light, making the space here filled with an indescribable distortion.
“Thump…”
His heart suddenly gave a fierce beat.
A nameless sense of impending doom rose from within.
Colin decisively shifted his attention away from contemplating what the entity above might be.
‘Hiss, that was close. It felt like something was trying to come through my “line of sight.” Whether it could make it or not, I’m not sure, but if it got to me like that, it’d definitely be death or injury…’
‘But then again, the stuff overhead seems incredibly complicated, feels like there’s a mix of everything, First Level Containment Subjects and even higher. Sheesh, this place is more dangerous than I thought. Just not sure why they appeared here…’
As the thought briefly crossed his mind, Colin refocused his attention and continued to hasten along.
Compared to the “living area” they had passed through, the “core layer” still had quite a few buildings standing and was more spacious, but the level of danger was several orders of magnitude greater than the outside.
Merely a dozen or so minutes into their walk, Colin within the squad saw multiple entities on the level of “Chosen of God.”
But with Nightingale leading, they skillfully avoided them.
Most of these figures were trapped within “Time Reversal,” and after countless repeats of events, their sanity had long shattered. They didn’t notice Colin and the others, lashed out in frenzy for a bit, then returned to their “past.”
“The weaker ones here are fine; the stronger ones that aren’t quite strong enough are quite miserable.”
Colin internally assessed.
After the most recent lunatic crying out “Ah, ah, ah, where is this? I can’t tell…” vanished into reverse, the squad continued moving in the predetermined direction.
In the process, they occasionally encountered the ubiquitous “Flood Devils.”
However, the squad dealt with them without Colin needing to act.
Only when they encountered some powerful individuals that the squad couldn’t deal with did Colin move, stealthily approaching them until a Bone Spur was thrust down…
Just some offshoot “Flood Demon” nodes were certainly not enough to withstand the might of Bone Spur.
After a few cries of pain, the body shuddered and dissolved into a puddle of black sludge.
Having slain a “Flood Demon” almost the size of an elephant with one move, Colin, still holding the Bone Spur, was about to return when his heart suddenly tightened, hearing an unknown female’s whisper beside his ear…
“Hello…”
In the chilly breath, it felt as though a gentle body was pressing against his back, and lips came near his earlobe, softly calling out.
Colin instinctively wanted to ignite a Flame to drive this thing away.
But heeding the earlier warning, he merely paused in his step and then casually returned to the squad.
“Hello… hello… hello… hello…”
The girl’s voice persisted without stop.
But as it went on, it started to distort, growing increasingly desperate and anxious.
The air at this moment became somewhat solidified, as if its irritation at his continuous non-response was growing…
A chilly sensation came from his neck.
It faintly made one feel as if a rope were looped around his neck.
And the “girl” holding the rope seemed to be sitting on his neck.
However, in reality, Colin could feel that his body wasn’t affected in the slightest; it was just some kind of intense hallucination.
‘Damn it, daring to ride on my back. If it weren’t for the peculiar situation here, in another setting, if I didn’t burn you into charcoal and turn you into fuel, my name isn’t Colin…’
Colin muttered darkly to himself, continuing to pay no attention and rejoining the team.
It was only a dozen meters more before the voices by his ear disappeared altogether…
At that moment, the team members waiting for him to deal with the obstructing Flood Devil stood about two to three hundred meters from the Flood Devil, remaining stationary, continually swaying their heads from side to side.
In these gloomy, oppressive, and dilapidated surroundings, their behavior seemed somewhat possessed.
The impact of this scene was on par with that of a group of middle-aged women silently dancing a square dance in the wilderness while wearing wireless earphones as seen in a horror film…

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 501 417 He does not wish for The Night to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 501: Chapter 417 He does not wish for “The Night” to descend once again. _2 Chapter 501: Chapter 417 He does not wish for “The Night” to descend once again. _2 Although he knew that it was due to the influence of some large-scale, high-standard anomalies that he had to do this,
the sight still felt eerily bizarre…
“A type of rule-based anomaly, but from the feel of it, as long as I have Bonfire with me, it shouldn’t be able to affect me. Its hierarchical level, at most, would not exceed that of a Level 2 Containment Subject.”
“It’s just that the core key cannot be found, and dealing with it will be difficult if we want to.”
Colin silently estimated and, once he determined that the threat to himself was not significant, he felt considerably more at ease inside.
Afterward, when he rejoined his team and the group once again started moving forward, according to their schedule, they would arrive in at most ten minutes…
Colin slightly raised his head, gazing towards the direction of their target, but regrettably, for some reason, it was very dim and hazy there, as if covered by some sort of pitch-black curtain, obscuring everything from view.
However, from that profound darkness, he could hear quite a few strange noises.
Clearly, there were quite a number of creatures gathered there…
Meanwhile, on the road leading to this final target, the number of various human corpses had increased, the vast majority of whom seemed to be company employees by their death, a particularly miserable sight.
Either missing arms or legs, or in pieces here and there, various mummified corpses nearly paved the road ahead.
Taking a deep breath and a few minutes later, Colin and the others came upon a massive pit.
The expanse of the pit was too large to see its edges at a glance, and it contained numerous building remains, but at the moment was completely empty.
However, upon arriving here, everyone felt that the visibility had dropped a few notches. Despite the presence of light, one could not see anything clearly.
They seemed to have already entered some kind of “Night” barrier.
Fortunately, aside from causing some sensory discomfort, this “Night” barrier did not have any further effect.
Everything was still within an acceptable range.
“We have arrived… It’s here,” Nightingale stopped leading the way and stood on the edge of the pit.
“This?” Colin glanced at the empty space ahead.
This massive pit was one of the rare places where it was impossible to discern what the original facility had been, as it was thoroughly destroyed.
“Yes, we might need to wait a bit longer, the time probably hasn’t come yet…” Nightingale simply explained.
This was the precise location they had determined after decades of efforts, losing countless people along the way, and through various means.
In a “normal” situation, just avoiding various “Time Reversals” would mean,
they would need four or five days to complete this leg of the journey…
But with the blessing of this group, they arrived directly at the target area in just over half an hour.
“Right, can you confirm the exact location of that item?”
Colin stood on the edge of the pit, swinging his arm while asking.
The pit was a bit too large, probably several kilometers in diameter at a rough estimate. It would pose quite a bit of trouble if they couldn’t find the precise location.
“I am sorry, although we’ve sent many teams here, with about a thousand people, regrettably, after the ‘Reversal’ began, we haven’t had anyone bring back specific intelligence from here. We can only ascertain that it is within this area…”
Nightingale shook her head, “Apart from knowing there’s a ‘Night’ Descendant here, everything else is unclear… From now on, we are unable to provide you with more information.”
‘Over a thousand deaths? The Legion’s information gathering has been a bit brutal… But these “Night” Descendants… According to the Legion, they count among the ‘Chosen of God’, but have gone through certain enhancements. From what I can sense right now, their hierarchy is not low, and may even rival the aura of ‘Red Moon’, signifying another follower who transcends Level 1 existence; indeed, caution is needed…’
Feeling the faint darkness around him, Colin shook his head cautiously and stated,
“No worries, this is enough.”
After that, without further inquiry, he swayed his arms as he turned his gaze toward the inexplicably dark pit, trailing his eyes over some residual signs of battle on the ground, and then walked into it.
The other members followed suite…
If they strayed too far from Colin, they risked being swept into the “Time Reversal.”
For them, that would be little different from death.
At this moment, following the traces left behind and with the Little Maid reporting in his ear, Colin roughly located a position that might be the center…
“The battle here was the most intense. I’ll take a gamble—even though it won’t be a big problem if I’m wrong…”
With this thought, Colin began his preparations, taking out one explosive device after another from his pocket and instructing the “Nano-smart Machinery” to arrange them…
At the same time, he spread specially-made “Flame Bearer” Grease around as much as possible.
He did this to ensure that when the battle erupted, he could immediately enter full combat mode.
And incidentally, to give a big surprise to everyone here with the explosions…
However, just as everything was half done, something inside Colin sunk as he felt the surrounding incomprehensible darkness grow denser…
Did it seem to have come alive?
Colin’s eyes suddenly narrowed slightly at the sight of some battle traces on the ground beginning to shrink—
“Reversal” was about to begin!
“Let’s move back a bit first, to a safe distance…”
With a wave of his hand, Colin led the others away from the scene. Just as they left the area, they abruptly saw several figures emerge out of thin air from the middle of the pit.
The aura of each figure was immensely powerful…
“Tick tock tick tock…”
The sound of the clock ticking surfaced abruptly by his ear, but unlike before,
from the details, it seemed to be reversing.
However, this unique sound could only be heard by Colin, who held “The Sealed Right Hand.”

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 502 417 He does not wish for The Night to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 502: Chapter 417 He does not wish for “The Night” to descend once again. _3 Chapter 502: Chapter 417 He does not wish for “The Night” to descend once again. _3 Meanwhile, the mission content updated.
[Event Nine: Recover the partially lost artifact “Time Reversal”.]
“It’s here!”
Colin’s heart tightened as he suddenly felt a terrifying power erupting ahead.
A blurry Golden Card materialized out of thin air.
Unlike the one in his hand, this Golden Card had only half its part remaining as a card; the other half was a semi-illusory, ancient object resembling a clock…
Its true form wasn’t a clock, but the only part humans could recognize was the “clock”.
The rest appeared to be in a murky, chaotic state…
“Time Reversal”!
As it emerged into reality, the entire area immediately became restless.
The darkness engulfing the massive pit traced back in time, and next to “Time Reversal”, it converged into a dark shadowy figure akin to a black hole…
“Hahaha! After a hundred years, soon, you will be mine!”
The moment he appeared, a dark torrent erupted from his body, covering the sky and shrouding the Golden Card beneath it.
However, at the same time, other figures who had battled here before returned.
Upon their arrival, without any nonsense, they attacked the “Night” Descendant, among them were Heretic Races and Heretic Cultists Colin recognized, such as Followers of the “Red Moon”, various Demons, and others he did not know…
“You’ve died millions of times and still, you haven’t realized just how weak you are before me?”
Blocked by various attacks, the “Night” Descendant showed no irritation as his hands spread wide.
His body erupted, sending countless shadows sprawling out.
All incoming attacks were erased from the world with the simplest of methods.
“If it weren’t for the ‘Time Reversal’, you would have died countless times by now, but don’t worry, I’m about to assimilate it and let you die completely.”
“No, once I release the eternal ‘Night’, even those who come after you won’t have a chance to live!”
The black figure mocked, looking at more attackers converging from all sides, then turned to another side where several humans emanated a “crimson” light, with everything around them constantly reviving.
Looking at them, he pointed at the people surrounding the field: “Hold them off!”
“Yes.” Several figures clad in long robes, radiating red light, responded.
He was very confident in the strength of his subordinates, these “Chosen of God”, knowing they were more than capable of fighting off the enemies.
During this time, he could continue to devour “Time Reversal”.
Once fully assimilated into his being, he would have a chance to summon that ancient entity!
However, on the other side, Colin watched the scene unfold before him, his eyes wide with disbelief, wondering if his mind was clear—
What did he see?
‘Oh my life, Followers of the ‘Red Moon’, actually listening to this “Night” Descendant? And this level of power fluctuation, seems like they’re the high-rank individuals among Followers of the ‘Red Moon’, right?’
Colin was extremely astonished, as he had never before seen such a scenario and wondered if he too was contaminated.
But just as he was puzzled, he suddenly saw three extremely powerful individuals, even surpassing the average Level 8 Official Personnel, who appeared to be Followers of the “Red Moon”. After repelling many enemies, they seemed to exchange glances.
Then they abruptly turned around, disregarding the enemies rushing at them, and shot out a blood-red, sharp tendril each.
They struck towards the “Night” Descendant.
In that moment, the special existence composed entirely of darkness reacted, but regrettably by the time it responded, the tendrils had already pierced into its body.
‘That’s more like it… now the world makes sense again,’ Colin felt as if his worldview had returned to normal.
“You, betrayers… why…”
The “Night” Descendant looked at the three massive tendrils embedded in his body, sensing some substance being injected and making it stiff and immobilized, he had never expected these three to betray him.
“We have just received a revelation from ‘Mother’…”
Facing their once leader, the three Followers of the “Red Moon” whispered, continuing to inject their “blood” through the crimson tendrils, attempting to take over the opponent’s body…
“‘Red Moon’? It’s Her, She commanded you… No, impossible… ‘Red Moon’ was born from ‘Night’… How could She… betray…”
The “Night” Descendant’s mental fluctuations weakened, but before he could finish speaking, he fell silent into death.
However, the silence lasted for less than half a second.
With a faint rending sound, three massive gashes appeared on his body, revealing an eerily round crimson light.
Suppressing the consciousness of the “Night” Descendant within, “he” murmured to himself:
“Although it’s incredible, I don’t know what happened…”
“But, ‘Mother’ said, She didn’t want the night to come again…”
After speaking, his darkness erupted, easily blocking all the attacks of the incoming enemies.
In the absence of C Level interference.
Unified, they forcibly controlled the “Night Descendant”, practically invincible!
Then, they turned and reached for the high-level artifact that was causing the spatiotemporal chaos here.
After killing the C Level Bonfire personnel who possessed this artifact, their corruption had taken an exceedingly long time.
But this time, with the strength of “Mother” reinforcing them.
Unless something unexpected happened, they could directly seize it…
But it was at this moment…
A deep red flame rose from beneath the ground, and the surging flames swallowed everyone at the scene in an instant.
Colin had made his move.
.
.
.
The last ten minutes, please vote for the monthly ticket…

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 503 418 When the True God Descends Everything
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 503: Chapter 418 When the True God Descends, Everything Will Get Better_1 Chapter 503: Chapter 418 When the True God Descends, Everything Will Get Better_1 Boom~
The terrifying red flames engulfed the entire scene; neither of the battling parties seemed to have expected this sudden turn of events.
At that moment, as they felt the power of the flames, all showed expressions of shock.
“Flame Bearer?!”
In great surprise, they all stopped their attacks, withdrew their power, and protected themselves.
However, the next second, everyone regained their composure, realizing that it definitely couldn’t be the “Flame Bearer,” because if it were truly the ‘Flame Bearer,’ just the sneak attack alone would have turned everyone present into charred remains by now…
There would be no chance to ponder here.
“A reservist? Or perhaps some special existence that can borrow power?”
Some “Chosen of God” speculated internally. After steadying their own status, they quickly used their own methods to locate the other party.
Soon, everyone saw amid the flames blanketing the field a figure, like a “fish,” rushing towards the “Night” Descendants who were being occupied and corroded by the “Red Moon” followers.
No, to be more precise, it was the artifact near them that was partially out of control.
“Caught off guard, taking a bunch of C4 without even a severe injury, at most only a leg broken, their reactions and strength are commendable…”
Sensing the entire field through the flames, Colin couldn’t help but sigh.
At that moment, when he decided to take action, he had given the Badge of Humility to “Life Mentor Adorable” and others, allowing them to leave the pit first through this item and wait outside.
Their strength was only good enough for self-preservation with care in such a place.
But expecting them to be of any help was a bit unrealistic…
Meanwhile, the trinity of “Red Moon” Chosen of God, upon seeing Colin rushing in with the intention of seizing the artifact, instantly showed an air of disdain.
What could corporate personnel do?
What about a reservist?
This artifact had been abandoned here for more than a hundred years, and during that time, they’d continuously corroded it.
Using their abilities, they gradually erased its restrictions and activated it with blood containing specific qualities. Even if corporate personnel arrived, they wouldn’t be able to take it away.
Unless they were killed…
But with just this “Bonfire Reserve,” the thought of achieving this seemed like a pipe dream.
A scarlet tentacle writhed within the body of the “Night” Descendant, controlling it. Immediately, a rich and eerie darkness spewed out from its body…
The surrounding flames were instantly erased by half.
Even Colin had to avoid it upon seeing it, feeling that a direct hit would likely cost him dearly.
At this moment, the three “Red Moon” Chosen of God within the “Night” Descendant were acting as one: one controlled the body of the “Night” Descendant, decaying the high-quality special artifact; one managed the body of the “Night” Descendant to fend off enemies…
And one suppressed the inner subconscious of the “Night” Descendant.
After all, this was a non-human being who had received a direct blessing and completed an ascension.
Even with their occupation and parasitism, it was hard to completely overcome him.
“This is slightly troublesome,”
Colin observed the swollen figure in front of him, all over the body were fissures filled with blood-red, watching the rich darkness spreading from it, shrouding everything around and making it difficult for him to proceed.
Hesitating for a moment, he decisively pulled out his trump card…
The pervasive battlefield flames reversed greatly, converging on his right hand, and then poured into the “Contrarian” transformed into a long knife.
The next instant…
A streak of scarlet sword energy flashed by.
The enveloping darkness ahead was instantly split in two, revealing the scene ahead for yet another time. Following the scarlet sword energy, Colin drove a large amount of flames into it, aiming directly at the out-of-control Golden Card.
At the same time, behind him, a horde of alien life followed suit…
“Hahaha, as long as I am alive, it’s impossible for you to take it away; otherwise, wouldn’t all our years of corrosion and ‘temptation’ become a joke?”
The trinity of the “Red Moon” followers sneered.
Over the years, they had continuously worked on this object with methods including, but not limited to, “intimidation,” “enticement,” “corrosion,” “activation,” and currently, had achieved significant success.
If the “God Revelation” was to be believed, reinforcements might arrive before long.
Once the power of the True God descended…
Everything here would get better.
Now, facing the terrifying strike of the Bonfire Reserve, their hearts were disdainful. The “Red Moon” follower responsible for continuing to corrode the Golden Card, enduring the pain, sacrificed a portion of the “Red Blood”…
Then, remotely controlling the artifact, issued a roar-like command, “Back off!”
“Click, click, click…”
The crisp sound of a ticking mechanism immediately followed.
All advancing enemy figures froze and then, with each tick of the sound, they were forced back, back, and back…
However, seeing this unfold, the trinity of the “Red Moon” Chosen of God hardly had time to smile at their success in maneuvering the terrifying artifact before they abruptly stiffened, looked down, and saw a bone spur riddled with cracks piercing their bodies…
At the end of the spur was a pale hand, and following the hand backward…
The “Bonfire” Reserve had somehow gotten close without their notice!
“How, how is this possible… how are you unaffected…” they found it inconceivable.
Even “Mother” would be affected to a certain degree under the chaotic influence of “Time Reversal”!
But before they could ponder further, excruciating pain exploded.
“Ahh!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - 504 418 When the True God Descends Everything
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 504: Chapter 418 When the True God Descends, Everything Will Get Better_2 Chapter 504: Chapter 418 When the True God Descends, Everything Will Get Better_2 The part of the body that was pierced let out a sharp, agonizing wail on its own.
However, amidst the screams, they reacted quickly. The other two in this body temporarily set aside a part of what they were responsible for and attacked the suddenly appearing Colin together.
‘Tsk, after all, they are from the era of war. They endure much more than those Followers of the ‘Red Moon’ I met before. The Bone Spur can’t have a lasting effect. But, it seems he didn’t notice that I just used Time Stop to get close?’
Colin mused, then without thinking, he tossed out a “Flame Bearer” Grease Grenade to provoke an explosion.
It directly blocked the attacks of those guys…
Immediately after, he reached out toward the object a few meters away, half made of playing cards, half of a clock.
“Impossible, it already has a part that is connected to me…”
In excruciating pain, the Followers of the “Red Moon” suddenly widened their eyes. At that moment, they felt they had lost contact with the artifact…
Right after, the Golden Card that they had struggled for over a hundred years to move even slightly.
Actually flew towards that newly appeared guy…
“How is this possible?! It partly came to life already. Even without us, it would not be willing to return to a sealed state…”
“We have shed so much blood, offered so many sacrifices…”
“How could this be?!”
Three roars of anger came simultaneously from the consciousness of several “Red Moon” Chosen. They were the ones who arrived first, be it for unsealing or something else…
How could this be possible?
‘What I want is the artifact itself. What does it matter whether it’s willing or not?’
Colin looked at the lunatic before him, muttered to himself, and forcibly brought it before him using “The Sealed Right Hand,” and then he reached out, gripping the card…
It was at the moment of touching it that Colin’s gaze became vacant for a moment.
Time felt infinitely elongated at that moment…
Like waking up from an afternoon nap, blinking, and finding the whole world has changed.
But soon after, using the orange aura from “The Sealed Right Hand,” Colin forcibly suppressed that negative effect.
“Hiss, if it weren’t for this orange card, just touching it feels like it could kill someone instantly…”
Colin thought with lingering fear.
At this moment, he wanted to put it into the “Storage Room” and leave directly, but he couldn’t do so before suppressing it further…
However, there was also some good news aside from this.
[Task Ten: Bring “Time Reversal” back to the Starship Ground.]
…
“This is the shortest task description I’ve seen, but why didn’t the company just retrieve it here? Is it because they can’t or there’s some other reason?”
With this question flashing through his mind, Colin didn’t have time to think further.
He saw a terrifying dark shroud descending upon him…
This time, Colin didn’t choose to fight head-on; his long sword instantly transformed back into a revolver at its origin. Aiming at the enemy, the sound of more than ten bullets nearly merged into one stream, firing directly into the shadowy target.
The bullets, combined with flames, surprisingly were not affected by the darkness, penetrated through and directly hit their original form.
At the same time, the “Lethal” effect was triggered.
Combined with the previous effect of the Bone Spur, the cries from within the humanoid shadow abruptly ceased.
The entire humanoid shadow dissipated on the spot…
Red blood continuously flowed out from the cracks of the shadow…
“Hmm? This isn’t right; something feels off…” Colin’s eyebrows lifted as he grasped the Golden Card and fled, while suspicion arose in his heart.
Indeed, bullets fired from this revolver seemed to ignore most other influences besides actual physical objects.
But…
Logically speaking, the opponent should have many other means to block them.
Not like this, dying so straightforwardly. The odds of such an accident were too low.
At this moment, Colin suddenly realized something. Without turning his head, he “saw” a pitch-black figure standing up through the flames.
“Night” Descendants.
“As expected, this person didn’t die.”
Colin was not surprised, knowing that it must have used his hand to make a borrowed kill.
Without time to think further, a chill went through him as an image appeared in his mind—
Beneath his feet, within a hundred meters radius as if liquid darkness seeped out from the ground, he used Time Stop. Though time stood still and took effect.
The range of the dark entity was greater, enveloping him and the surrounding space beyond the effect.
Like a giant egg…
Then, after a countdown of seven seconds, darkness covered, engulfing and devouring him. Aside from a few powerful artifacts, everything returned to nothingness.
Its attack pattern was very simple, just some eerie form of erasure.
…
“What the hell is this?”
Colin was shocked. In the blink of an eye, his thoughts raced, turning the revolver into a long spear and thrusting it forcefully downward.
“Matchless Strike!”
A great amount of flame surged down the long spear into the ground, causing it to bulge upwards and a large area to melt. In the deep red glow, countless shadows evaporated…
Seeing this, Colin breathed a sigh of relief and continued to flee the area.
The “Night” Descendants tried to catch up, but inside their battered bodies, a red light emerged again…
Clearly, using that strange power had come with a great cost.
It caused those parasitic beings to appear once more.
“Good! In desperate times, still rely on the ‘Red Moon’.”
If the situation weren’t so dire, Colin would have shouted “Good!”
While they were hindering each other, he immediately set about escaping the large pit. However, just then, the various miscellaneous xenomorphic races that had been repelled by the “Time Reversal” came back again…
At this moment, upon seeing the transformed battlefield, they were all taken aback.
But after seeing the detestable flames, they all ground their teeth in anger again.
Compared to the Followers of the ‘Red Moon’, these days, no one’s hatred value could rival that of the company’s employees…
Especially those bearing flames.
The big ones couldn’t be defeated, but this smaller one…
“Damn ‘Flame Bearers’, I’m going all out against you…” A bizarre non-human entity, speaking in a language that the company’s passive translator could understand, charged forward.
But unfortunately for it, after the sound of a gunshot, it was blown into countless pieces.
At the same time…
A demon, covered in red and with green fire clinging to its skin, not weak in strength, showed a flicker of fear in its eyes upon seeing Colin.
Other people, seeing the “fireworks” of the explosion, also paused for a moment.
As entities active during the company’s pinnacle era, compared to the “newborn calves” Colin usually encountered, they understood all too well the horrors of the company…
They deeply knew how powerful the company was during that era.
Everywhere they went, they were like locusts crossing the land, often not only plundering all resources of a star system but also detonating or dragging away the stars themselves upon departure…
They were also fond of capturing various xenomorphic races and subjecting them to numerous inhumane experiments, exploiting their full value.
….
To let humanity assert its dominance, countless xenomorphic lives went extinct, and many creatures were forced to change their nature and take on human forms; even higher beings fell to become human…
In just a few hundred years, across the sea of stars, there was nothing but tragedy.
However, it was exactly the remembrance of the Great Will they each revered that fortified their resolve once again.
“Immediately release my master unconditionally, or else you’ll never leave!”
An alien creature, wrapped in a yellow-green aura of decay and determined like a moth to a flame, charged at Colin with a ferocious expression.
‘How much does your master pay you to be this desperate?’
Colin did not strike immediately but waited until it was within ten meters before decisively activating the Golden Card’s “Force Repulsion” effect.
The next instant, the aggressor exploded once again and returned to the “Time Reversal”…
When it would reappear next was anyone’s guess.
‘These guys are much weaker than I expected, barely at the level of common D Level Personnel. No wonder, their ranks aren’t as high as the “Night” Descendants’, and after so many repetitions, their essence was probably worn down a lot…’
Although he defeated it with a single move, the troublesome part was that, because of its leading the charge, others seemed to find their courage again.
They didn’t pause for grief over the death of an unknown Chosen of God; the next one blocking the way was a demon.
Boom.
They didn’t pause for grief over the death of the demon; the next one blocking the way was an unknown Chosen of God…
Bang, bang, bang…
There was no pause for grief because…
‘Damn it, when will this ever end?’
Watching one enemy fall and another take its place, Colin was getting somewhat of a headache.
Although these foes were not as powerful as before, their experience remained…
They wouldn’t charge at him all at once but came one by one, others providing support from the side and cooperating with each other, they managed to roughly hold him back.
While Colin was unlikely to be killed by them, an unsettling intuition grew stronger as time went by…

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - 505 419 The Nights Will_1
chapters.content:
