﻿Chapter 505: Chapter 419 “The Night”‘s Will!_1 Chapter 505: Chapter 419 “The Night”‘s Will!_1 We must solve these guys in one fell swoop!
Colin’s eyes narrowed slightly, thinking about how to finish them off all at once. In fact, he had a few ways…
For instance, using all his enhancement methods to forcibly elevate his own strength and unleash “Sky Light Fall” right then and there.
But in doing so, should there be anything outside the pit, it would be difficult for him to handle.
After all, that move truly consumes a lot of power…
Besides that, there was another relatively simple method.
Thinking of this, his gaze slightly lowered, looking at the “Time Reversal” he was holding in his left hand.
If he could use it, he could immediately send these guys, who had been trapped in “Time” for so long, back into the past.
However, using it was not without risk, since it was a semi-uncontrollable item. If not for the suppression of “The Sealed Right Hand,” he was sure he would be swept up into the chaotic flow of time in an instant…
“Kill!” A furious shout interrupted Colin’s thoughts.
Watching the aggressive demon and the dozens of pairs of eyes looking on with avid anticipation, he no longer hesitated.
First, he stimulated “The Sealed Right Hand” further.
Then, a thread of spiritual energy was infused into “Time Reversal.”
“Dododo…”
The sound of the backward-moving hands resonated beside his ear.
Everyone in front of him hesitated for a moment.
Then, one by one, they began to move backwards – not just their bodies, but also the surging energies, everything was rapidly reversing.
The only thing not moving backward was their consciousness within their bodies.
“Damn it, this guy…”
“How could he possibly use this damn thing?”
“It’s over, it’s over, wait, he’s getting backlash!”
“Hahaha! I said it, the ‘Night’ clan has strived for a hundred years with little to show for it, and he, an ordinary member, has immediate success. How could that be possible?”
“Screw it, kill him!”
Within each retreating body, soul fluctuations spread continuously. Then they suddenly noticed the guy who had rushed out from nowhere, who, after initiating the effect, had stopped moving.
This gave them hope!
Simultaneously, a dazed and vacant expression surfaced on Colin’s face.
At this moment, all sorts of long-sealed memories flooded his mind – elementary school, middle school, even kindergarten; a chaotic jumble of memories like a pot of great Chaos…
These memories occupied the majority of his thought space, causing him to stand still on the spot.
But the next second, a strong sense of crisis struck…
Colin shook his head violently and came to his senses, only to see a humanoid creature, holding a scepter covered with various types of mushrooms slowly approaching, as if wanting to hit him with it.
To Colin’s surprise, the creature had somehow managed to withstand the effect of “Counterflow” for the time being.
‘Is this… burning its own life to forcibly increase its rank?’
Colin quickly noticed that the creature’s life force was burning rapidly, its status significantly rising, ascended to extreme conditions, reaching and even surpassing peak status.
This was how it barely managed to resist Time Reversal and attempt an attack on him.
No, that’s not all…
Colin also noticed that, aside from it, there were others from corners unknown who also ascended their own selves, transferring power to assist it, resisting Time Reversal.
‘Touched, they really are giving it their all to take me down, too bad the premise is that I keep standing here doing nothing.’
Colin muttered to himself, watching the one struggling to approach step by step, he started moving again towards the outside.
Under the force of “Time Reversal,” their movements were hardly any better than those of an old lady with gout; holding the scepter, they took awkward, minced steps as they came at him.
“How~can~this~” It slowly turned its head, its movements sluggish, and saw the figure leave directly.
Instantly, a look of despair darkened its eyes.
Clearly, the attempt had failed…
The other party had withstood the negative effects of that item for a total of no more than ten seconds, or more precisely, everything had ended within three seconds.
However, at that moment, it suddenly saw a blaze of flames rushing towards it.
Before it could react, it saw the other party’s revolver transform into a pair of tongs…
The next second, its scepter, which had once been bestowed by the Great Will to a Sub-God, was snatched away!
“You, you, you, steal…”
Trembling, it wanted to curse out something, but in the end, nothing came out and its life force was extinguished in an instant.
“What steal… the one I picked up…”
Colin mumbled to himself, as the other party was going to die anyway, it was clearly an unclaimed object!
He had simply picked up a no-longer-wanted thing from the ground a bit earlier.
Right then, he took off at a mad dash while examining the object he just picked up: a wood scepter enveloped in a strong sense of ominous decay…
Although he didn’t know what it was, since it was chosen to make a move on him, it must be extremely lethal.
Moreover, most of the people’s belongings had already vanished under “Time Reversal,” yet this object still maintained its effect, proving its extraordinariness…
It was worth taking the risk to make a return trip for it.
Once the object was in his hands, Colin made sure he could put the thing into his “Storage Room,” and without further thought, he threw it in there, planning to have a look later when he got back…
Before long, as all the people were being forced back to the “past” without any resistance,
Colin quickly made it back to the edge of the pit…
On this side, “Life Mentor Adorable”, “Son of Cruelty”, “Little Chicken No. 7”, “Fool’s Mushroom”, and Nightingale’s team immediately deactivated their low presence state.

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - 506 419 The Nights Will_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 506: Chapter 419 “The Night”‘s Will!_2 Chapter 506: Chapter 419 “The Night”‘s Will!_2 The two parties met, exchanged no superfluous words, and immediately turned back the way they came.
Not only Colin, but even they also felt an indescribable sense of unease.
However, they had not taken many steps before the skin on the back of Colin’s head suddenly tightened…
He didn’t turn around, but through the “Flame’s” light, he could “see” that within the pit, a completely black figure had appeared at some point, staring at them.
“Night” Descendants.
Right now, his body had many cuts, but there was no red light inside, clearly indicating he had dealt with those traitors…
‘These “Night” Descendants are strong, huh? To be parasitized by three ‘Red Moon’ beings and still able to counter-kill. If it were me, I probably couldn’t handle even one,’ thought Colin as he immediately braced himself for an attack that, however, didn’t come.
‘Is it… unable to leave that area?’
Colin’s eyes moved slightly, a flash of inspiration crossing his mind, realizing that these beings were trapped in the pit much like land-bound spirits.
If they wanted to leave and take the normal path, the only way would be through “Time Reversal.”
‘So it seems, if I take this card, they are, in a sense, directly “contained” there, and can no longer act?’ he pondered.
With that thought, Colin breathed a sigh of relief.
As long as that “Night” Descendant couldn’t come out, nothing else would stand in their way.
However, it was at this moment that he suddenly heard ethereal words by his ear…
“The immature ‘Flame Bearer,’ you can’t escape. They have already noticed you, hehehe…” the dark figure communicated through some unknown means.
‘So you’re, what, tattling to the ‘parents’ after a little private scuffle, huh?’ Colin couldn’t help but curse under his breath, starting to realize why his feeling of unease had been growing.
It was then that he saw the black figure lift a foot, stepping towards the edge of the pit as if attempting to leave…
However, the next instant, the figure vanished.
‘Entered the next cycle of Time Reversal?’
Colin’s guess was confirmed. In some sense, they were already contained in “the past.”
After that, not wanting to waste mental energy on matters concerning the figure, Colin stopped in his tracks.
“What’s wrong?” Little Chicken and the others following behind were taken aback.
Colin’s gaze turned to Nightingale: “Other than that small path, is there a closer route to get back to the surface?”
If they took the secret road, even at full speed without stopping, it would still take at least an hour and a half to get out.
“There is, about a ten-minute distance from here. There’s Gate 64, which used to be a major road, but it’s likely there are a lot of dangerous things on that route,” said Nightingale.
“How does that compare to that all-black guy just now?” Colin quickly asked.
“Very different. ‘Night’ Descendants, according to the information we currently have, there are a total of eleven, but only one in this area; we won’t encounter the others…”
“In addition, the beings strong enough in this place, those who likely fought over that Golden Card, the majority are in that pit, other areas, aside from some ‘Flood Devils,’ have few comparable to them,” said Nightingale with a shake of her head. In their view, there were many “Life Forbidden Zones” here besides the big pit.
However, none were as problematic as the ones in that pit.
Each “Chosen of God” there was a troublesome existence in their eyes.
They were not like some monsters or anomalies that would just stand there and let you hit them; without equivalent strength, it was very easy to be wiped out.
But that was all relative…
The “forbidden areas” in their eyes probably didn’t pose much trouble for him.
“Gate 64, the main entrance? Where is it?”
“Over there…” Nightingale pointed in the direction of their nine o’clock: “There’s a chemical plant area, with many Flood Devils, if we take a slight detour…”
However, before she could finish speaking, she suddenly felt a dazzling brightness before her eyes.
They saw the terrifying Flame rise from Colin’s body, lighting up the area like an erupting volcano.
This time, the Flame wasn’t as huge as before but was more “pure.”
All those covered by it felt a tremendous boost and enhancement to their own strength.
“Detour? No need, let’s just charge through,” said Colin.
He took out the Golden Sun Seal, infused it with spiritual energy, and a streak of white light emerged from the Sun Mark, intertwining with his Bonfire, making him resemble an intense midday sun that was hard to stare at directly.
“Hiss, a new form? Has Brother Shunzi got a new feature for his cheat again?” mumbled someone.
“The Life Mentor Adorable” squinted painfully, involuntarily shielding his eyes with his hand.
And then, just as he was about to ask how they were supposed to keep up if they couldn’t even look directly at Colin, he saw Brother Shunzi take out another seal shaped like a tree.
From the seal extended numerous tendrils, similar to branches.
Each tendril wrapped around a person…
Suddenly, a forceful pulling sensation occurred, lifting a whole group of people into the air.
“Damn,” someone inadvertently let loose a curse from mid-air.
“Life Mentor Adorable” looked in the direction of the voice and saw it was the “Son of Sadomasochism”—that guy who was always bragging in the internal chat about fighting side by side with Brother Shunzi. So, fighting side by side meant this?
…
Without regard for what the group was thinking, Colin dragged them into the air and shot towards the target location like a comet.
The bright firelight startled many of the outlying aberrant lives…

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - 507 419 The Will of Night_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 507: Chapter 419 The Will of “Night”_3 Chapter 507: Chapter 419 The Will of “Night”_3 Apart from a small portion, the vast majority of things, upon sensing the aura of the “Flame Bearer” in the flames, could not help but reminisce about the fear of being dominated by the bonfire, and consequently scattered and fled on instinct…
A very small portion who were hard-headed attempted to attack Colin, but it was of little significance.
‘Just as Nightingale said, the strong ones have all been trapped by “Time Reversal”, and the vast majority pose no threat, their attacks are like spitting, and they might not even hit me,’
Colin murmured to himself, then forcefully crossed the factory area and came upon a grand wall.
On one side of the wall, there was a very large gate.
A brief glance was enough to tell that this was also one of the main battle zones back then, with a great number of employee corpses, as well as many abnormal things remaining.
‘Most of them are about as strong as Level 8 Official Personnel, or similar to Level 3 Containment Subjects. Although killing them is a bit of a hassle for me, that’s not my goal. As long as they can’t stop me…’
‘I’m close now, just need to get past this gate, and rush out…’
As the thought flashed through his mind, Colin’s speed surged again, intending to forcibly break through.
However, just at that moment…
A terrifying oppressive force came crashing down.
“Oh no…”
Colin’s heart chilled, and the next second, the world before his eyes suddenly darkened.
An intense sense of crisis overwhelmed him, and without a second thought, he used “Time Freeze”, but even so, while in the frozen time, he still suffered an unknown attack!
A mouthful of blood spat out with a “splat”.
Every bone in his body cracked as if crushed, and fractures appeared.
The flames clinging to Colin were scattered as if by a strong gust of wind…
People fell from the sky like dumplings.
Fortunately, with various enhancements, none of them were smashed into a pulp on impact and died on the spot…
“What just happened?” The people who fell to the ground were utterly confused.
In front of them, Colin landed and rolled several times before coming to a stop, coughing up large mouthfuls of blood, looking very disheveled.
But luckily, it seemed to be just an appearance of disarray…
‘It’s over… Huh?’
Colin regained his senses, and his first realization was that under such an attack, the other employees had likely been instantly killed.
However, as the Nano Intellectual Mechanism quickly and forcibly connected the broken bones and internal injuries, upon opening his eyes, he discovered that aside from falling, the others were unharmed.
“Are they targeting only me?”
Colin, enduring the pain all over his body, stood up, looked around, and confirmed this point.
That… could only be considered a stroke of luck within misfortune.
The mysterious and unknown attack that was invisible and unfathomable, among those present, probably only he could withstand it momentarily.
But now, he had no time for these matters…
“Buzz, buzz…”
The terrifying oppressive force descended once again, making the entire world even more dim.
Even though there was light around, everyone still felt as if they could not see their own hands in front of them.
Just then, sensing this atmosphere, Nightingale seemed to realize something:
“This is… a disturbance in the core layer? How is that possible? This should only happen once every ten years at least… It can’t possibly occur so soon!”
Upon hearing his words, people like Little Chicken were frightened yet unsurprised.
However, just at that moment…
Colin saw countless “Flood Demons” rising into the sky, gathering mid-air into a grotesque mass resembling a huge “meatball”.
Then, a crack split open upon this “meatball”.
Within it was an eyeball, eerily black like a black hole.
An incomprehensible power that surpassed human understanding erupted…
The entire world seemed to be collapsing under the effect of an unknown force, everything caught in its Direct Gaze was wiped from existence, turning into the purest form of nothingness.
‘To be erased upon being seen? What in the world is this monster?’
Colin was profoundly alarmed.
At the same time, an Inspiration flashed through him, and he finally realized what the Great Will on the “Flood Demon” meant…
It was… “Night”!
At that moment, Colin felt his scalp tingle, seeing that the eyeball seemed to be looking in their direction.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - 508 420 Employees Returning from the Past._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 508: Chapter 420: Employees Returning from the “Past”._1 Chapter 508: Chapter 420: Employees Returning from the “Past”._1 “Time Reversal”!
“Force Repulsion”!
As that plain and unremarkable gaze was cast his way, Colin didn’t hold back, decisively activating two Golden Cards in quick succession.
The Time Stop effect would completely envelop everyone present…
In a sense, it was also a unique form of protection.
Combined with the effects of Repulsion…
Colin felt as if he were blocking something out, and yet, it was as if he wasn’t.
It seemed…
Nothing had happened?
Just as this thought had begun to surface, Colin was abruptly met with the sight of the area several hundred meters outside the Time Stop zone collapsing instantaneously, turning into a void under some form of assault.
“Damn!”
Colin let out a harsh cry, his eyes widening as he swore for the first time in a while.
Throughout this entire process, he hadn’t noticed anything unusual, hadn’t sensed any attacks coming.
But by the time he came to his senses, everything had already been annihilated…
‘What the hell is this thing? Aside from a slight sense of crisis, I can’t feel anything else…’
Suddenly, Colin remembered the female D Level Personnel when entering the living area.Not long after she sacrificed herself, the flames were extinguished in an instant.
There were no signs at all.
At the time, he thought it was because time was up, but now he realized that it must have been the doing of this thing.
At this moment, Colin’s heart sank once more.
He noticed the range of the “Time Stop” was actually shrinking, its effect starting to crumble bit by bit from the outermost periphery!
“What the hell, what kind of monster is this?!”
Colin had been using this card for so long, yet this was the first time he had ever seen such a phenomenon.
Most importantly, he still hadn’t seen how he was being attacked.
Suddenly, the pressure on his mind and body increased dramatically.
He immediately used the “Force Repulsion” effect once again.
Some invisible entity was knocked away.
The crumbling stopped.
But another piece of bad news was that the “Time Stop” was reaching its limit!
‘Although I can continue using Time Stop in the next second, during this one second, I might die ten or eight times. This thing is too bizarre; there’s no room for any kind of luck, I must go all out, upgrade to the highest status, and then break out…’
With this thought, Colin unhesitatingly used every tactic at his disposal.
“Colorless Crystal”, “The False Powerhouse”, “Potential Burst”, and the rest…
Once everything was stacked up.
Colin’s body was ablaze, shining as brightly as a little sun.
‘With this, I should be able to resist for a while, then burst out. At the critical moment, I can use this to block.’
Colin pulled out the “Fire Tree Mark”.
Overall, this tree was quite resilient, though it might get completely destroyed after blocking just once, and the consciousness inside would most likely be ruined as well.
But, the death of a mark versus his own death and that of many others was a decision Colin could make without a second thought.
‘I’m sorry, but if it really can’t hold up, you’ll have to be sacrificed.’
Colin took a deep breath, as if hearing the sound of a ticking countdown by his ear.
Just as he was bracing himself to withstand one second before breaking out, he suddenly heard a faint noise coming from one side.
“This is bad!”
Colin abruptly noticed, not far away, on the ground that was obliterated flat, there lay a corpse.
The corpse was wrapped in tattered clothing, the flesh was dried up around the bones, unknown how many years it had been dead.
Under normal circumstances, Colin would not care about such a corpse at all.
But the problem was…
In this area, except for the place covered by the effect of the Golden Cards, all other areas had been directly erased by the unknown attack of “The Night” will.
How could it have deliberately left a body?
Especially since…
Colin could feel that the thing was shuddering, with the sensation that it might stand up at any moment.
Moreover, on its body, there were massive traces of non-human presence, among which was that of the “Night” Descendants!
“We’re in trouble…”
With his eyebrows deeply furrowed, Colin could no longer ponder, as the Time Stop effect was about to end, and everything around began to move!
It was the instant that the “Time Freeze” effect vanished…
Colin felt a surge of intense crisis in his heart; right before he could step forward toward the direction of the gate, his body suddenly felt heavy; he could feel a terrifying force pressing down on him, making it hard for him to move.
The bones in his body, which had been originally stitched together, cracked and broke apart again under this pressure.
As a result, Colin’s body looked extremely distorted.
At the same time, everyone else experienced the same thing, feeling an extraordinarily strong pressure descending upon them, pressing them to the ground, not even able to move their fingers.
They were only affected by the aftermath and were not directly struck.
“Crack.”
A faint sound of bones clashing echoed; Colin internally cursed, sensing trouble.
Right after that, he saw the skeleton on one side suddenly brace itself on the ground with its hands and stand up.
“If I freeze and don’t move later, drag me away immediately.”
Colin transmitted a message to Little Chicken and the others, then divided his consciousness into three parts: the first part further activated the “Golden Seal” given by the Saintess, while the second and third parts poured into “The Sealed Right Hand” and “Time Reversal” respectively.
At this moment, the only thing that could change the situation was this Golden Card, which had not been completely retrieved.
Of course, although it was in a semi out-of-control state.
But from another perspective…
It could also be seen as an “Item Liberation” state, only it was not as controllable as a proper one.
Just then, as Colin was preparing to go all in, he saw the corpse had already stood up, but it did not look towards them. Instead, it directed its hollow eye sockets towards the giant spherical object in mid-air, made up of the “Flood Demon”.

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - 509 420 The Employees Returning from the Past
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 509: Chapter 420: The Employees Returning from the “Past”. _2 Chapter 509: Chapter 420: The Employees Returning from the “Past”. _2 “Hmm?” Colin was startled and vaguely sensed something, halting his desperate actions.
“Bang!”
In the next second, he saw the corpse raise its right hand and fiercely slap it over the heart in its chest.
All sorts of abnormal auras burst forth from its body…
Immediately afterward, Colin felt a force drawing him in, as numerous free-floating flames were directly absorbed into the body…
‘Is it… drawing out my fire?’
Colin was taken aback and then saw the other party heavily slap their chest again.
And then…
A streak of scorching flame suddenly erupted.
A massive quantity of flames, much like a mushroom cloud, rose up and actually cleared away the attack from the “Night” will.
And it was at this moment that time surged around him, and the dirt-stained robe on the corpse, which was too filthy to see its color, seemed as if it were cleansed of all impurities, revealing a shade of maroon.
“Is that… an unsanctioned C Level Personnel?!”
Colin’s eyes lit up.
He suddenly understood the reason the Garrison Legion said that the disaster here would “solve itself”!
The senior employees who once guarded this place had not completely perished!
‘Time Reversal’ wasn’t there for those anomalies, its real purpose was to bring back these beings of the past to suppress this place.
Colin felt as if he had an epiphany, understanding a great deal more.
Meanwhile, a vague whisper suddenly reached his ears.
The skeleton seemed to be chanting the name of something…
“Dharma-Aspect World!”
As soon as the words were spoken, the enormous mushroom cloud that had shot up into the sky rapidly transformed into a Flame Giant with eighteen arms, covered in countless mysterious patterns that moved across its body.
A few meters, dozens of meters, hundreds of meters…
The figure of the Flame Giant rapidly grew taller, and its aura grew even stronger.
In the end, its eighteen arms reached out towards the “Flood Demon” cluster, harbored by the “Night” will. Although most arms disintegrated in mid-air, unable to close in,
what mattered most was that the focus of the battle had shifted from Colin and the others to this giant.
…
“Hiss, mama mia, that’s scary…”
Colin glanced up slightly at the hundred-meter-tall figure; he could confirm that this person was not the “Flame Bearer,” but they had somehow “borrowed” his power.
And what’s more, they used it more smoothly than he did!
This left Colin feeling somewhat ambivalent.
However, this method gave him an inexplicable sense of déjà vu. As he pondered, a name came to mind—
“Divine Strike”!
A means of borrowing power from certain “idols.”
Moreover, the company’s methods seemed more mature than the official ones, for this C Level Personnel borrowed his power right in front of him, something the officials seemed unable to do…
It’s fine that the power was borrowed, but using it better than he did was just unacceptable…
‘But then again, if this route has nothing to do with the company, I’ll eat the ‘Flame Bearer’s’ heart in one bite when I get back!’
Colin shook his head, reined in his thoughts, enduring the pain, and didn’t continue to spectate. He rushed towards the gate, dragging a large group of people with him.
Some anomalies attempted to launch an ambush against him.
Unfortunately for them, with the main adversary otherwise engaged,
nothing here could stop him anymore.
Passing through the gate, Colin saw a wide sloping road leading upwards, lined with buildings on both sides, though most were damaged in the fight.
Besides that, there were various bizarre creatures and some figures trapped in the “past.”
At this moment, a figure suddenly appeared ahead.
Huge outbursts of bloody energy emanated from them…
Various chaotic thoughts spread from their body, turning into countless whispers.
“Am I dead? I should be dead, right? Why can I still speak? Am I dead? I should be dead, shouldn’t I? Am I really dead? Why does it seem like I’m still not dead!”
It was at that moment that the guy seemed to have fixed his gaze on him, emitting an inexplicable, mad cackle anew…
“Am I dead? Can you help me check if I’m dead?”
“Can you help me die?”
Colin frowned, although this guy was insane, his level of strength seemed to be quite formidable.
At the very least, he was comparable to some Third Level Containment Subjects…
The trouble didn’t end there, as more abnormalities began to appear along this road.
However, before he could take action, just as that guy had only traveled a short distance,
the fragmented bones on the ground nearby suddenly trembled, then levitated, reversed, and reassembled into figures wearing tattered Hunter’s Coats.
Their faces were withered, resembling zombies, and upon appearing, they merely glanced at Colin before looking away.
Without a word or conversation, they joined forces to strike at the crazed individual, successfully holding him back.
Nevertheless…
As Colin felt the overall oppressive feeling of the world intensify, various foes from “the past” resurfaced.
Of course, at the same time, a large number of employees also reappeared.
The events here clearly weren’t happening for the first time…
Although the road was still far from safe,
their reappearance could be said to have smoothed Colin’s passage considerably.
Those figures from days past appeared, wordless, charging in silence, standing their ground in silence, and then perishing in silence…
Only to reappear on the next day of battle.
‘The bells of humanity’s victory have yet to ring, and the battles here will never end.’
As Colin advanced, he watched those skeletal figures out of the corner of his eye, recalling Night Owl’s recent words with complex emotions.
Compared to the “Flame Bearer,” they were equally consuming themselves, just in a different way.
And…
The vast majority of those steadfast here likely had no chance of witnessing the moment of victory.
Of course, the good news was that if they were to fail, they wouldn’t know it either.
Meanwhile, the few employees being dragged behind Colin looked around with equally mixed feelings; however, knowing less about the inner workings, they weren’t as sentimental but rather concerned for other reasons.
“Hiss, these people, they seem to be D Level too…”
The “Son of Cruelty,” wrapped up by tree roots like a sticky rice dumpling, couldn’t help gasping as he looked at a battle area.
Four D Level Personnel, relying solely on a few Purple Items, were actually managing to suppress a Containment Subject of at least Third Level in head-on combat?
Even though each time it seemed like these D Levels would be crushed the next second,
Inexplicably, they managed to dodge every time!
Their proficiency in nimble positioning and battle experience made him quite envious.
On one side, “Life Mentor Adorable” nodded in agreement upon hearing his words.
Thus far on their journey, they had encountered four Heretic “Chosen of God” level beings, one mid-to-high level Demon with Divine power, and two Third Level Containment Subjects not in prime condition…
By his estimate, at least forty to fifty seasoned D Levels, along with several hundred E Levels, would be needed to suppress them.
As for F Level… he didn’t even consider them.
Sending a few would be nothing but cannon fodder.
However, in total, there were only about twenty-some D Level Personnel present at the scene, and the assisting E Levels barely numbered over a hundred; yet even so, they managed to nearly subdue this path.
If it were them, they most certainly couldn’t have done it…
Additionally, the state of these personnel’s equipment seemed to be extremely deteriorated.
However…
“We’re all D Level, so why is there such a big disparity?”
“Life Mentor Adorable” sighed.
After being brutally beaten by a C Level “Instructor,” he had optimistically thought that if they grouped up now, they might stand a slim chance against these figures who appeared to be former D Level staff.
But now… forget about a narrow victory, not being completely defeated would be difficult.
Of course, he didn’t include Brother Shunzi in this assessment, as that model was a bit too formidable…
Applying the standards of D Level to him was purely seeking discomfort.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - 510 421 Who Can Kill Me Who on Earth Can Kill
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 510: Chapter 421 Who Can Kill Me! Who on Earth Can Kill Me?_1 Chapter 510: Chapter 421 Who Can Kill Me! Who on Earth Can Kill Me?_1 Another ten minutes had passed when, finally, everyone saw the end of the road. The sound of various bombardments drifted faintly from that direction—it was clear that, after the kind of “great disaster” that occurs once every decade had unveiled itself.
It wasn’t just the core layer; other areas were also restless. A large number of things were attacking everywhere.
Colin gathered his thoughts and then, once again, his aura increased dramatically, and his speed surged as he charged out of there.
It was just as he emerged that he faintly saw, beside a huge pillar some distance away, a large group of the Garrison Legion engaged in battle with many of the local “Flood Devils.”
And the situation looked very grim…
Under normal circumstances, they would have hidden inside a “safe zone.”
Waiting for everything to settle down before coming out to “clean up the battlefield.”
But now, to ensure that Colin and others could be met with reinforcement upon leaving rather than plunging headfirst into a monster horde and getting surrounded…
They had dispatched a great number of legion members.
‘Fortunately, the “Flood Devils” here haven’t been possessed by “The Night” will…’
Looking in that direction, Colin hesitated for a moment before deciding to go over and pass them a message.
Although doing so would slow down the departure and bring more unexpected incidents…
But if he didn’t, Colin suspected that they might keep guarding that secret passage until the entire army was wiped out.
‘By the way, I can also send Nightingale and the others back first. Otherwise, if something else happens, they won’t have any chance of survival…’
Having made his decision, Colin didn’t hesitate; after adjusting his direction, he quickly rushed towards them.…
“Send a scout team down… What’s that?”
In the command vehicle, where Night Owl had been waiting for Colin’s message, he was about to dispatch someone to check the situation.
But at that moment, he sharply felt vibrations in the air as something was amiss.
Everyone looked up, following the direction of the vibration, only to see a very bright fireball moving rapidly across the sky at an astonishing speed.
It seemed it was heading for them.
“It’s the colleagues from before!”
An observer, while looking at that direction through a special tactical telescope, spoke out.
“Hmm.”
Night Owl had realized the true situation of that object without needing to be reminded.
Even though the flame was piercing to the eyes and merely observing it caused a slight sting in his pupils, the feeling was unchanged, it was those colleagues returning.
Only, for some reason, they didn’t return via the original route as planned but took a different path.
After several dozen seconds, the huge fireball reached directly overhead.
All the “Flood Devils” capable of flight were incinerated by the scorching flames, belching out smoke and falling from the sky with the odour of charred flesh.
Seeing that things were nearly settled, Colin released his grip and dropped down the thirty-some members, including Nightingale.
It was a rough method, but upon landing, the dozens of legion members stood up as if nothing had happened.
“Not a single casualty?”
Night Owl looked at them, his face behind the helmet showing a hint of astonishment.
Given the current situation, he had thought that the squad would be completely annihilated.
Contrary to expectations, there wasn’t a single injury.
Just then, Colin’s voice came from above: “The real danger hasn’t yet erupted. What’s coming will be very dangerous, so retreat quickly. Which way to go?”
Hearing Colin’s words, Night Owl fell silent. If he revealed the direction, should the other party have any ill intent…
Even the slightest bit meant that a safe point, even the Breeding Hall, might be compromised…
But within half a second, he roughly pointed in one direction.
Immediately afterward, he saw a strong energy reaction in the other’s hand.
A condensed fireball formed in the other’s hand.
Then…
He lightly tossed it in the indicated direction.
The fireball left his hand and flew out, expanding continuously during its flight, transforming into a massive, raging fireball over thirty meters in diameter, rolling along the ground.
On its path, all Flood Devils were burnt to ashes by its horrific heat.
It was like a rolling bowling ball; though not particularly fast, it cleared all the anomalies on the road, clearing a breakthrough path.
Then he was about to tell the other party the specific location of the “safe zone” to take cover for a while.
But then he saw the huge fireball fly away quickly in a certain direction.
“Sir, it looks like they don’t plan to join us,” said Nightingale, regrouping at his side.
“Hmm.”
Night Owl gave her a look and, without saying much, issued the order to breakout.
…
Elsewhere, after providing them the last bit of help, Colin decisively headed back the way they had come, without pausing for a moment, not even considering taking shelter there.
Although Night Owl and the other legion members had somehow managed to survive for who knows how many years depending on the safe zone,
It would have been impossible without some special self-preservation methods.
But compared to trusting them, Colin trusted himself more—
After so many missions, he believed that as long as the mission wasn’t over, no matter where he was, accidents would appear…
If he went with them, the “safe zone” might not remain “safe.”
The only real “safe zone” was Earth.
Only by completing the mission and returning to Earth would everything truly be at an end!
Before long, after another burst of speed, Colin saw the giant metal wall where they had descended.
He approached it quickly, reaching out to press on it.
The elevator doors reopened…
Inside was as empty as it had been before.
Colin first infused a flame to ensure there was no issue, and only then did he step inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - 511 421 Who Can Kill Me Who on Earth Can Kill
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 511: Chapter 421 Who Can Kill Me! Who on Earth Can Kill Me?_2 Chapter 511: Chapter 421 Who Can Kill Me! Who on Earth Can Kill Me?_2 Click click click…
The elevator doors slowly closed.
A row of glowing text appeared in mid-air.
[Abnormal situation detected, the elevator will ascend at maximum speed. Arrival at the target floor in three minutes, please…]
“Hurry up!”
Colin skipped the dialogue directly.
The next second, the elevator emitted a loud noise as it suddenly shot upwards like a rocket heading for the sky.
A certain potential energy pressure made everyone’s breath stop for a moment…
At this speed, if it suddenly stopped, if the people inside were ordinary, they might directly hit the ceiling from inertia and become a heap of flesh.
However, this was not a big problem for them.
Not to mention that Colin had already forcefully infused them with a lot of power, even if he hadn’t.
Their physical condition alone could withstand these…
‘Three minutes, there are some oddities caught in the Time Reversal on the negative third floor outside, it’s no big deal to force through with some injuries, it should take at most three to five minutes here… it’s just… I feel like I’m forgetting something…’
Colin’s brow furrowed slightly, sensing that something was amiss.
It was at that moment “Life Mentor Adorable” suddenly spoke, “Brother Shunzi, there’s something I need to say, it seems, something has happened outside, their messages suddenly stopped…”
“Outside?” Colin paused, then as if a flash of lightning passed through his mind, he opened the team’s information feed.
Only then did he notice that almost ten minutes had passed since the last message, around the time they had just left the “Core Layer”…
Colin scanned the contents. If nothing had been tampered with, their last messages were about trivial issues like whether to dip meat into mustard when eating hot pot…
After that, there was no follow-up.
The dozens of D Level Personnel guarding the flames outside, seemed to have dropped off the network in an instant.
This…
Almost everyone began to have ominous thoughts—had all of them dropped dead in an instant?
Apart from that, they couldn’t think of any other possibility that would cause the whole group to disappear in such a short time.
Especially since the thing in the core layer indeed had the capability to do just that.
“Brother Shunzi, what… what do we do?” Fuer Mushroom spoke.
All eyes turned to Colin.
Given the situation above, it was equally dangerous, dangerous to the point that a group of D Level Personnel couldn’t even send out a warning before collectively disappearing…
In this scenario, was it certain they still wanted to go up?
However, under everyone’s gaze, Colin took less than a second to make a decision:
“Continue to follow the tasks as assigned.”
Or rather, apart from trusting in the mission, there was no other choice.
Colin and the rest of the soy-sauce party didn’t have any means to return on their own…
‘Given my “Special Bonfire Talent” status, I shouldn’t be abandoned here with no regard, and according to the mission requirements, I should be able to return immediately upon reaching the surface, if there’s any danger, at most I’ll just have to withstand it.’
His mind rapidly processing, Colin looked at the card in his hand and felt slightly reassured.
With these two high-level items.
No matter what was above, as long as it wasn’t a Super First Class Containment Subject like “Night”, it shouldn’t be a big problem.
At least it wouldn’t be a problem to hold on for a minute or two.
If worse came to worst, there was still “Time Reversal”. Even if it meant paying a certain price, it wouldn’t be out of question to use it.
‘If all else fails… then I’ll just have to release myself and feast.’
Colin secretly stirred the power stored deep within his body, his eyes changing, turning into vertical pupils.
Although “0-09 ‘Hunger'” was always underwhelming under the various Corps of the company.
The reason for its underwhelming performance wasn’t that it was not strong enough.
Instead, it was because the company had many specialized tactics to suppress it; if it were something else…
The situation may be uncertain.
“Gurgling…”
A sound of hunger rumbled from the stomachs of several companions nearby.
“Hungry? Why now… sss… ‘Hunger’?”
“Life Mentor Adorable” touched his belly, at first puzzled by the arising hunger, but in the next second, he realized something horrifying and looked at Brother Shunzi in shock.
Based on the various pieces of scattered information they had, he almost instinctively knew this had something to do with Brother Shunzi.
Following his gaze, the others were a bit slower, but they, too, came to a realization.
Then, they couldn’t help but share a similar thought…
‘It turns out to be this Level ‘0’ Containment Subject… Brother Shunzi’s cheats are never-ending…’
As they inwardly exclaimed, they also felt somewhat relieved.
“Ding.”
The elevator chimed crisply to indicate they had arrived at their destination.
Compared to the last time, it was much faster.
[Outside the door, there is no…]
“Open it fast!”
Colin skipped the dialogue again, his voice carrying an indescribable impatience.
With a “click,” the elevator doors swiftly parted to both sides, revealing an empty street.
“No one?”
Colin, who had been prepared to face enemies, was surprised. In his imagination, the place should have been swarming with enemies.
He had even thought that people might try to break in before the door opened.
But the reality was the opposite…
However, soon after, feeling the oppressive atmosphere in the corridor and on the street,
he realized that perhaps it was not that there were no surprises, but rather that when the staff outside had died, they had also been eliminated…
‘All the better, saves me some trouble.’
Colin collected his thoughts, turned into a flame, and rushed out carrying four Signal Towers.
With the path ahead clear and unobstructed…
It took him less than three minutes to traverse all the roads.

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - 512 421
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 512: 421 Chapter 512: 421 When he saw the final spiral staircase, Colin held his breath, ready, and charged straight up.
Seconds later, on the starship ground, from an arched exit.
Colin’s figure burst out directly.
The outside appeared the same as when he had entered: bones everywhere, black fog, and even a burning bonfire in the distance.
The only odd thing was that aside from some pots and pans set up, there were no other people around.
In the air, one could faintly smell the aroma of a tomato hot pot base…
“Son of Sadomasochism” sniffed the scent and couldn’t help but curse softly, “Damn, are these people so vigilant? Serves them right!”
However, as soon as the words fell, everyone suddenly saw.
A majestic pillar of fire penetrated the black fog, descending from the sky, connecting to the bonfire, and inadvertently enveloping them as well…
But before the teleportation began, the nearby pillar of fire suddenly dispersed.
“What’s going on?” everyone exclaimed in shock.
“Boom!”
An indescribable sound of tearing came from below their feet.
A strong inspiration formed a “picture” in Colin’s mind.
Somewhere in the “core layer” of the starship, a rift in space-time that defied accurate description had been torn open.
It existed in a dimension either higher or lower, invisible to reality, and even the basic matter had not been affected, so much so that if not for the blessings of the company’s passives and the Bonfire, Colin might not have even been aware of it!
As for the others, they could only feel an absolute horror.
At that moment, from within the rift, Colin thought he saw countless terrifying creatures writhing and squirming; they had no physical form, yet they all tried to break free from this intangible crack, to return to reality once more…
“Damn it,” a shout of alarm came from the side.
Colin shifted his gaze from the ground, turned his head, and saw “Son of Sadomasochism” staring dumbfounded at the sky with a shocked expression.
He too looked up and was instantly transfixed, his pupils contracting to pinpoints.
The endless black fog that had covered the dome had disappeared…
From the perspective of the starship, looking outward through the asteroid belt, what should have been seen was the pitch-black universe.
But at this moment, the stars were dazzlingly bright, unbelievably so…
And what was shining was what Colin had initially thought to be the lifeless “asteroid belt”!
Every “asteroid” encircling the starship was trembling.
“This damn thing isn’t an asteroid belt… these… these things are the actual bodies of First Level Containment Subjects! A whole bunch of them…”
Colin muttered to himself.
Before he could finish, a nearby larger “asteroid” suddenly cracked open, and countless twisted limbs extended from those cracks, with something terrifying trying to break through the seals quickly…
After this one, other “asteroids” began to show cracks as well.
Colin stared at the sky, completely dumbfounded…
Uncontrolled inspiration made him realize many things.
Within each “asteroid,” a part of a First Level Containment Subject was sealed, and in that special dimensional rift, there was no substantial higher consciousness, not truly without a physical form…
But because their consciousness had been stripped from their bodies.
At this moment, they were frenetically trying to reestablish a connection with their once corporeal selves…
That’s why the previously quiet and desolate asteroid belt had come alive.
Yet, if it had been one or two it might have been manageable, but with the number now present…
It instilled a sense of heartfelt despair.
Colin didn’t know how the former company managed to deal with so many terrifying beings at once, but now, they had become a problem.
Even if they hadn’t awakened yet, just the commotion from their attempted awakening…
Had caused the column of teleportation fire to shatter.
‘Instinct tells me, the only way to leave is to reach the original landing spot because it’s on the periphery of the “asteroid belt,” with the least impact…’
‘And that spot is as far from here as several circuits around the Earth…’
‘Even without any obstacles, I’d have to run until I’m completely exhausted, let alone now, it’s over…’
Colin’s complexion turned pale, ashen like death.
Yet, after two seconds of silence, he seemed to have made some decision, looking at the others: “Soon, I’ll figure out a way to get you out of here. You, just hold on as much as you can…”
“What do you mean…” Little Chicken and the rest looked puzzled.
This…
Can we really still get away?
At this moment, they had pretty much resigned themselves to their fate and weren’t looking to blame anyone; after all, they were mentally prepared for this long ago.
“Yes, through ‘Hunger,’ I can send you away.”
Colin stared into the sky, feeling that every part of his field of vision was writhing. Those things, merely by direct gaze, were already evaporating his sanity.
As he spoke, he conveyed his decision to them, using the method of transmission provided by “Inspiration.”
“This…” Several people widened their eyes. They didn’t understand the specifics, but it felt broadly feasible; however…
“Brother Shunzi, what about you?”
Hearing this, Colin fell silent for half a second, then slowly shook his head.
If “The Light Chaser” itself had come, there might have been a chance to leave together, but this place seemed too remote, and it was highly likely that the other party didn’t even know…
Otherwise, he would be willing to spend all his points.
Setting aside this unrealistic expectation, the only way to leave right now was to release “Hunger,” not just a little, but completely!
The corpses of unconscious Ancient Gods were scattered everywhere here; eating just a couple could make the “Hunger” inside him reach its peak in an instant, revealing the true rank of a “Level 0” Containment Subject!
With the power of the bonfire, he could control this force for a short time, and before his sanity burned up, he would certainly be able to throw these people out.
But for himself…
Colin wasn’t sure if he would still exist by then.
‘If I’m lucky, I’ll return safely; if I’m moderately lucky, I’ll be babbling for the rest of my life; if I’m unlucky, I’ll become a part of ‘Hunger.’
‘Tch, becoming a part of it, huh? After going around in circles, I didn’t expect to end up benefiting it.’
‘No matter what, I don’t have the chance to choose now, I can’t worry about this, I can only leave it up to fate, and bet it all.’
As his thoughts flashed through his mind, Colin’s consciousness sank, connecting with the slumbering will that resided within him, which was almost imperceptible without actively sensing it…
Just then, an unexpected incident occurred.
A dark screen suddenly enveloped what Colin and everyone else could see…
An aura of terror rose from beneath the starship.
At the core of the starship, a tiny, invisible crack was suddenly forced wide open, and an enormous hand made of pure darkness, incredibly black, thrust out violently, its target directly aimed at Colin…
“‘Red Moon’… ‘Red Moon’… ‘Red Moon’…”
A hollow, inhuman whisper lingered in their ears.
You yell for ‘Red Moon,’ but you come at me—what’s the meaning of this… Colin cursed in his mind, and even without looking back, he could feel that he was targeted.
Under this targeting, he was unexpectedly cut off from “Hunger!”
Moreover, he could clearly sense that the pitch-black hand seemed to be constantly extending, and everything in its path was being erased by an unknown power.
“Who can kill me, who could possibly kill me?! Who is able to kill….No, no, no, no… save me, save me!!! No, please!!!”
In the habitation layer, a madman uttered words of lost sanity; however, under the fear brought on by the presence from above, he suddenly came to his senses—
In less than a second, he was erased on the spot.
Besides him, many other anomalies were also erased without any substantive contact…
“Damn it… there’s something below that won’t let any of us leave!” Little Chicken and the others felt a chill in their hearts.
Everything before their eyes was pitch black, they couldn’t see anything, and felt as if they were being dragged into an indescribable darkness.
However, at that moment, within the enveloping darkness, a line of information suddenly appeared on Colin’s retina.
[Event Eleven: Please cease observation, provide immediate assistance, to avoid accident.]
‘Cease observation, provide assistance? What does that mean?’
Colin didn’t understand at first.
But before he could ponder any further, in the profound darkness that not even the bonfire could illuminate, a gleam of fire suddenly traced an arc…
He was initially startled, then belatedly “put two and two together,” recalling some things…
…
.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - 513 422 Give up obsession instantly become a better
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 513: 422 “Give up obsession, instantly become a better person”?_1 Chapter 513: 422 “Give up obsession, instantly become a better person”?_1 “The thing I didn’t remember… wasn’t an employee… it was…”
“There’s another ‘Flame Bearer’ here…”
“Such an important matter, it seems, I never asked about it at all?”
Colin felt a sudden clarity in his heart and realized who the “end observation” on the event sign referred to…
It wasn’t him, but the one here…
A former “Flame Bearer”!
As for those employees… indeed, I had forgotten, but since I remembered halfway through, it doesn’t count as forgetting.
He subconsciously turned his head to look around and found that all four employees had fainted.
But he couldn’t concern himself with that, as a tremor in Colin’s heart suggested there might be a “Flame Bearer” still alive here.
And had they been observing him all this time?
Without further thought, at this moment, a light burst forth from the profound darkness before him, illuminating all the darkness like the first explosion in the universe.
The pitch-black view before him finally cleared, and the entire scene came into view once again.
And at that moment, Colin was taken aback.
He didn’t see the figure of the “Flame Bearer,” but he did notice, somewhat unexpectedly, the “meteorites” above had caught fire, and the limbs of the First Level Containment Subjects were twisting as if screaming soundlessly…
“The coal, it’s screaming…”
Colin looked at the scene and couldn’t help thinking this thought.
With his uniquely powerful vision and a power similar to the “Flame Bearer,” Colin focused intently and vaguely “saw” that these remnants of First Level Containment Subjects were not simply chopped up, bundled haphazardly with rock and soil, and discarded into space.
On their bodies, they bore an indelible stamp similar to the “examination passed” mark on pork.
“‘Containment Protocol P-… What? It’s too far, the letters are so small, and with the glare like light pollution, I can’t see it very clearly.”
Colin muttered to himself, but regardless, the situation here still shocked him.
However, they were indeed high-level containment subjects, and given their numbers, even if ignited by the bonfire, they wouldn’t be easily destroyed and couldn’t be dealt with all at once.
But at that moment, under the severe heat of the flames, many “grease” like essences began to ooze from the numerous limbs…
Once these essences emerged, they were absorbed by the special stamps above.
Subsequently, a peculiar force spread from the “Containment Protocol” stamps, petrifying them and continuously producing more stone-like structures reminiscent of granite…
Eventually, they were completely engulfed and floated in the sky, just as before.
The dizzying resurrection that afflicted everyone seemed to stop so readily.
‘Yes, judging from the current situation, relying solely on a few regular Level C Employees’ ‘The King’s Return,’ it’s hard to hold back such a large group of superior entities. The real key lies still in the backup left by the original ‘Flame Bearer.'”
Colin was moved by what he saw.
As the activities of the old debris halted, within the starship, behind the invisible fissure, the various wills started fading after their failed rush in both directions, emitting feelings of unwillingness, anger, and so on…
“‘Flame Bearer’… give it back to me…”
“Let me out…”
“Let me return here, and I will grant you the greatest glory. Just release me, and I will help you handle the ‘Hunger’ in you, letting you truly master it…”
“…”
Colin heard all manner of not-quite-human whispers in his ears again.
Some threatened him, some roared, and some attempted to promise something to get him to release those creatures.
A severe sense of throbbing pain bombarded his mind with every word…
But just then, Colin faintly felt as if the bonfire beside him began to speak…?
“When I come, you shall bow your heads. I will permit you to speak, and then you may speak…”
The intangible words were transmitted away.
Colin was startled. What’s going on, had his flames gained sentience?
That’s not right, is it… the “Flame Bearer” responding through his power?
‘Where is he? Why can’t I sense him at all?’ Colin wondered, puzzled.
Ever since just now, he had been trying to sense the exact location of the “Flame Bearer,” but had not had any success.
He could vaguely tell what the other party was doing, but he couldn’t see the person.
Logically, the “Flame Bearer” is bright and not adept at hiding.
But so far, he still hadn’t seen where the entity was…
However, it was after this response emerged that those terrifying voices in his mind that could kill a mere mortal stopped causing him pain…
But just at that moment, a profound darkness took advantage of the weakening old wills, pushed them aside, and gained control of all the fissures. It started to gather some sort of force, extending a dark, massive hand towards Colin.
It was more condensed than before, unstoppable by anything, not even by the special, supposedly Ancient God-resistant and self-repairing starship steel…
During this process, the dark hand expanded, calling out to the “Red Moon” with the intention of seizing Colin.
However, this time, it had barely extended halfway…
Colin felt a bonfire near him go out of control.
Turning into a sphere, it was then kicked away as if by a foot.
This fireball was also peculiar, much brighter than when Colin manipulated it himself, and it seemed to travel in another plane, unrestricted by physical matter, piercing through steel and most substances.
It headed straight for the black hand…
Suddenly, the two made contact.
Contrary to expectations, no explosion occurred; the blackness of the hand melted away under the glow of the light…

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - 514 422 Give up obsession instantly become a better
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 514: 422 “Give up obsession, instantly become a better person”?_2 Chapter 514: 422 “Give up obsession, instantly become a better person”?_2 Just as the sun rises and The Night retreats without any hitch,
in the light of the Flame, Colin and the others felt a gentle warmth, but for the ancient beings, the sensation was the complete opposite—they experienced an extreme, terrifying, and violent heat.
All remnants of impurity that lingered from the days of old were incinerated under its illumination.
‘What’s going on…the ‘Bonfire’ hasn’t received any other amplification, has it? Aside from seemingly moving on a different track, why couldn’t I do this just now?’
Colin was utterly perplexed.
He could distinctly feel that the other party used the Flame in a rather unique way, but the gap was so vast that it was hard for Colin to discern anything valuable; he simply couldn’t learn anything from it.
And as the dark entities vanished in the glow of the fire, wills from beneath the rift surged forth once more.
“Defying the Divine, one day, you will utterly fail, be completely obliterated!”
“You are attempting to destroy this universe, you are destroying the path to everything’s ascension…”
“Why, after achieving ascension, would you betray yourselves…”
“…”
The terrifying whispers lingered in his ears once again, only this time, they seemed to be some sort of questioning.
At the same time, Colin also realized that a part of his scattered Bonfire had “spoken” in response.
This voice wasn’t language in the normal sense and was hard to convey.
It went straight to the meaning. After some interpretation, Colin felt it was roughly…
‘We have never defied the Divine from the beginning. It’s still allowed to exist. However, only the Divine that has passed through the review of humanity, extensive discussion, public opinion, and… the final thorough research and discussion of the company is allowed to exist. Is that… good Divine?’
‘Let go of obsession… embrace humanity… become a person on this earth and be reborn into freedom?’
Colin’s expression was enigmatic; he found these words a bit abstract.
Meanwhile, as The Night faded, the rifts also disappeared, vanishing without a trace in a matter of seconds.
After all, it was “The Night” that kept the rift open in the first place.
With it gone, the rift naturally faded away.
Aboard the Starship, aside from a few minor abnormalities, all chaos had vanished.
‘These messy beings, just happen to be within the purview of the Garrison Legion. But, come to think of it, what is the status of the ‘Flame Bearer’ who was supposed to deal with the local situation?’
‘Why does it feel like he’s here, but also not?’
Flames flickered around Colin as he tried to sense the other party, but he found nothing.
However, through some feedback and the inexplicable mission just now,
he was certain that there probably should be a “Flame Bearer” here.
“Hello, are you there? May I ask what happened here? What do those special beings mean by talking about Divine this and Divine that?” before leaving, Colin tried to inquire.
Unfortunately, he didn’t receive any clear response…
But just when he thought the other party wouldn’t appear, a mysterious inspiration surfaced in his mind.
‘Let ‘humanity as the foundation’ replace ‘everything has Divine nature’…’
This interpretation seemed abrupt, but at the same time, it vaguely explained the fundamental conflict between the two sides.
Out of the blue, Colin remembered the “Flood Demon,” which was taking on more and more human limbs; this creature was shifting from its unique form to something closer to humanity—was the company trying to forge a new path?
But the beings of the ancient days seemed to have cast their dissenting votes.
And then they were dealt with…
However, before Colin could further comprehend the reason, another “inspiration” like response appeared.
‘This way of communication kind of resembles talking with ‘Yukionna.’ It also requires one to interpret by oneself. However, ‘Yukionna’ isn’t very sharp-witted, possessing the body of a young woman yet with the expressive ability of an eight or nine-year-old girl, nowhere near as capable as this one.’
As Colin thought, he deciphered the inspiration, and upon doing so, he muttered to himself,
“Good choice, not entering the safe zone of the Legion, escaping through a special passage by sacrificing them…”
Without acknowledging the previous question, huh? Going to the safe zone, sacrificing them? Isn’t that a dead end?
Colin was subconsciously confused, but soon, he understood the reason—the safe zones where the Legion took refuge had a special passage to the outside world for sending ashes.
If they took this passage, they could leave at a speed two or three times faster than usual.
The cost, however, was that a portion of the Garrison Legion would be completely erased as a result…
‘Good thing it seems they can’t read minds, otherwise that would be slightly awkward.’
For a moment, Colin felt a hint of guilt since he didn’t take that route simply because, in the heat of the moment, he was unaware of such an option.
If he had known, what he would have chosen at the time is difficult to say.
Nevertheless, Colin also realized that the status of this existence here, whether alive or dead, was a bit special.
It was as if they had become ‘conceptualized’…
“Boom!”
Just then, a massive column of fire descended from the sky, interrupting Colin’s thoughts.
The escape route was opened once more…
With no intervention from the ancient beings, it was successfully established, and an ethereal bell sounded as if it was about to ring.
But before that bell could chime…
Colin suddenly had a hunch, turned his head, and looked not far to his side, only to see flames swirling, coalescing into something that resembled an eyeball. Then, as if held by a hand, it was slowly brought over…
And upon seeing its form clearly, Colin couldn’t help feeling a bit speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 515 - 515 422 Give up obsession instantly become a better
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 515: 422 “Give up obsession, instantly become a better person”?_3 Chapter 515: 422 “Give up obsession, instantly become a better person”?_3 This thing seems to be truly an eyeball, not a mere resemblance!
An inspiration emerged:
”A Flame Bearer’s eyeball under some form, plug and play, convenient and quick…”
Looking at the object floating before his eyes, a gift resembling a human organ.
Colin was certain that he was an elite, professional agent from Bonfire Company, performing advanced tasks and undertaking disaster relief, not some organ trafficker or body harvester; he had no interest in various organs…
But his hand wouldn’t listen to him.
Colin’s body honestly extended a hand, grasping the eyeball made of flames, crystal-clear, into his palm.
Just as he took it into his hand…
The ancient bell of the “Descent Protocol” sounded leisurely.
In an instant, Colin and the others vanished.
After they left, darkness once again enveloped the starship, as if returning to its former deadly silence.
But inside, an unknown war went on, unbeknownst to anyone.
Meanwhile, a distance away, the entity that had initially been drawn by Colin, upon sensing the “Flame Bearer”‘s presence,
turned away silently, pretending to know nothing and departed.
….
In a daze, Colin opened his eyes to the familiar ceiling.
‘Back again.’
Colin propped himself up, sitting up from the bed, shaking his head.
“When we left, it was through ‘Starlight Maiden’, but returning seemed to be direct, bypassing it; I have no idea how it is now.”
Muttering to himself, Colin suddenly remembered something; he seemed to have forgotten to ask about the encounters of his employees…
“The four guys who moved with me should all still be alive; they were unconscious but the amplifier’s effects were still active, and we just left together. The rest…hard to say.”
“However, no big deal, just open the parchment and check; if not dead, one or two should now be bragging in the internal channel…”
“If I’m right, even if they died, it was within the predestined time, an incomplete death, there might be a chance for them to come back to life later on.”
Colin prayed silently and took out the parchment at once.
First, the mission evaluation and points etc…
A modest fifty thousand and some points, three Gold Mission Vouchers, and some other common rewards.
“Not bad, save up more points for the next golden artifact upgrade; use the vouchers to upgrade the basic panel attributes.”
This time, Colin was no longer disdainful of the abundance of points.
After all, if he managed to level up to C Level, he should be able to unlock a golden artifact.
And that would certainly require a massive amount of points…
It’s better to save more now.
Afterward, Colin opened the communication hall to take a quick look and found that most of the employees had safely returned; based on the time of their messages, they had returned much earlier…
They must have come back a lot earlier than him.
‘It must be the work of that ‘Flame Bearer’.’
Colin nodded in agreement, and without lingering, proceeded to open the “Storage Room”; then he discovered the out-of-control “Time Reversal” wasn’t in there.
He wasn’t surprised by this; after all, it was a half-out-of-control item…
Using it could bring about disastrous consequences for a large area of Earth.
But…
“Sss, the scepter I just picked up is gone too…”
Colin couldn’t help but complain.
He had taken a risk to go back to that not-quite-dead body to retrieve the special scepter…
But the company had directly snatched it away!
In Colin’s view, there was a certain chance it could replace the Bone Spur!
However, another “inspiration” emerged, giving Colin some relief; the company was currently “itemizing” it and would later return it to him.
Besides, the special eyeball given by the “Flame Bearer” was lying inside.
“What’s with these Flame Bearers, why do they all like to turn parts of their own bodies into artifacts so much?”
As Colin murmured, he took it out and opened its detailed information panel.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 516 - 516 422 The Good Intentions of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 516: Chapter 422 “The ‘Good Intentions’ of the Firebearer”_1 Chapter 516: Chapter 422 “The ‘Good Intentions’ of the Firebearer”_1 [Name: “Favor of the Flame Bearer”]
[Quality: None.]
[Status: Perfect.]
[Ability Level: None.]
[Description: An auxiliary learning tool made of unique materials. Through it, one can better unleash the power of the “Flame Bearer” and further master more techniques. It is the most suitable adaptive learning tool before becoming a “Flame Bearer”.]
[Usage: Can be used when one enters the “Fire-Embraced” status. It operates with a plug-and-play mechanism, and automatically disassembles itself to return to the “Storage Room” once the status ends.]
[Direct Gaze: By locking on a target with the eyes or will, it can ignore most defenses and directly cause the flames to burn the target seen, igniting the life force of the adversary…]
[Direct Gaze – First Flame Summon: Once a target is locked, it summons a strand of “Primordial Fire” through one’s own flames, delivering a direct burning strike to the enemy. The flame’s intensity is capped at Level 5 (this item can summon up to three times.)]
[Negative Effects: When using “Direct Gaze” and “Direct Gaze – First Flame Summon”, eyes will bleed, fatigue, and temporary vision decrease will occur.]
[Note 1: Initially, this ability was developed by a kind-hearted “Flame Bearer”. She always liked to give some of the Different Races who were still capable of turning back, a chance. Thus, she specifically developed this ability. As a result, the enemy would be burned to the brink of death, unable to resist or even commit suicide, instead of being directly turned into charcoal (does not apply to ‘First Flame Summon’…]
[As a result, it’s also known as the “Favor of the Flame Bearer”.]
[Note 2: What are you looking at?]
[Upgrade Conditions: Unable to upgrade.]
…
“Item name ‘Favor of the Flame Bearer’… a special auxiliary learning tool… Direct Gaze, Bonfire Summon, Level 5 flames…”
His gaze swept over this special item, and Colin quickly noted down the key points.
When he saw the Level 5 intensity of the flames, he paused, what kind of rating system was this?
Soon, holding a warm orb as if it had just been plucked out…
Colin was suddenly struck by an inspiration, and he began to understand this thing.
‘According to this assessment, Level 1 could easily melt common steel bars and the like, Level 2 could easily melt some special kinds of steel. For Level 3, there seems to be no good reference at the moment…’
‘However, under my normal status, I generally have Level 2 flames, and with some buffs, I could probably reach Level 2.5…’
‘In peak condition, I can reach Level 3, then piling everything on and performing ‘Item Liberation’, I could reach Level 3.5. This level of strength is sufficient to deal with Level 2 Containment Subjects…’
Colin drew his revolver, silently making some calculations in his mind and getting a rough idea of his current strength.
Then, with this ocular item, he could directly lock his gaze onto an enemy, ignoring their defenses and striking them directly with fire…
Below a First Level Containment Subject, this ability was very effective.
“Besides, there’s a trump card; with it I can summon Level 5 strength flames. Although it’s just a wisp and the cost is pretty big, once I lock onto the target’s body, unless there’s an accident, even a Level 2 Containment Subject can be instantly killed or a First Level Containment Subject can be repelled or severely injured. Even against higher levels, it can have a certain effect…”
Colin took a sharp breath.
Although there were only three uses available, these three times could change the entire situation.
“Even without these three moves, as a ‘Flame Bearer’ pre-school item, it’s quite good. But it seems that once you reach the level of a ‘Flame Bearer’, its usefulness doesn’t seem that great anymore?”
After reading some of the knowledge that had mysteriously emerged, Colin faintly understood.
The flame strength of an official “Flame Bearer” is around Level 5, so this trump card isn’t a big booster to a “Flame Bearer”…
“Yeah, speaking of which, the strength of flames is one thing, and the method of utilization is another.”
Colin remembered that a “Flame Bearer” had once used part of their flame to directly repel “Night”.
That person had demonstrated an extremely sophisticated technique of flaming…
The same Bonfire, under their control, showed a force far beyond what he could muster.
“My eyes tell me that, at least theoretically, I can do it too, it’s just that practically, this move seems a bit beyond me. Proficiency, this thing is a comprehensive matter, it can’t be rushed…”
Colin recalled it for a moment and felt like he understood but also didn’t quite grasp it.
The only certainty was the enemy’s control was very precise…
As if they’d mastered every wisp of flame.
If he could also utilize flames like them, then aside from those floating in space, other attacks, such as those following the crack beneath the Starship, Colin himself could also thwart.
It could be said that the other person had hand-held him to understand the victory of “technique”.
“Well, I still can’t figure it out, not knowing whether it’s unique to the ‘Flame Bearer’ or some other circumstance.”
With a long sigh, Colin put away his envious longing.
Then, looking at the information below the eye, especially the notes, he couldn’t help but twitch the corners of his mouth slightly…
“Good Lord, I thought ‘Favor of the Flame Bearer’ referred to the goodwill expressed to me when giving me this equipment, but I didn’t expect, that this goodwill was quite another kind of kindness…”
“To burn a savable enemy to the point of near-death and incapable of suicide… that’s really too kind, isn’t it.”
After a silence of two seconds, Colin, to be honest, felt that this “kindness” needed some quotation marks…

chapters.title: Chapter 517 - 517 422 The Good Intentions of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 517: Chapter 422 “The ‘Good Intentions’ of the Firebearer”_2 Chapter 517: Chapter 422 “The ‘Good Intentions’ of the Firebearer”_2 However, compared to some of the other radicals who wouldn’t give different races much of a chance, “Flame Bearer,” her methods could actually be considered kind…
Of course, that’s kindness from their perspective.
At least she gave the alien heretics a chance to be “human,” unlike the others who only offer the choice to be firewood.
“This ‘eyeball’ seems to have quite a few techniques concealed within it, I could learn something, and later go find C Level Elder Brother to practice. Even though his skills as a ‘Flame Bearer’ are half-baked, he must be stronger than me…”
Having silently made up his mind, Colin took another look at some other aspects of the item: “Regrettably, it seems to be a special item that isn’t part of the company’s mainstream item system, which means it cannot be liberated…”
But on second thought, even if it were liberated, it probably wouldn’t be as good as “Revolver Reverser.”
The revolver’s potential is still very high…
Colin could liberate five percent of it, but in actual use, it’s likely even less.
Or perhaps it’s that the potential of high-level items is very high.
“Time Reversal,” for instance, could cover an entire starship while in its semi-uncontrollable state.
The one at the same level, “Time Freeze,” could currently only stop for seven seconds and cover a few dozen meters, but if liberated to a certain extent, even if it’s inferior to “Backflow,” the difference wouldn’t be much…
It was only after this mission that Colin truly understood the terrifying power of the golden artifacts.
“Just don’t know how much taking this thing will affect the starship…”
Colin thought about it, and it probably wouldn’t…
When those employees were revived, there was no sensation of “Backflow” being activated.
Possibly they were blessed in some way during their lives.
So they could emerge from history time and again, standing before that great rift, preventing the appearance of humanity’s enemy…
Gratitude.
“Sigh…”
Colin placed the eyeball, warm like a red crystal, into his pocket, closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and gathered his scattered thoughts.
Then, after clearing his mind for about ten seconds, he looked up at the wall clock.
“January 2nd, evening, tsk, New Year’s just passed not long ago, the last entry was January 1st, this time it’s pretty much one to one, if not almost the same, but this isn’t much of a problem…”
“Later, I should ask Xu Duojin or Old Master Wu about ‘Divine Strike,’ see if I can find out more information about the company…”
“Then, there’s the routine descent of ‘World Code 13’ on January 3rd.”
“Right, there’s also the matter of using ‘Starlight Maiden’ as a lure for fishing heretic organizations, supposed to last half a month, and we’re not even halfway through it yet, I wonder how it’s progressing, I’ll have to look into it…”
All the tasks to be done were organized by Colin, and then he remembered something else.
It seems…
I can use the second dose of “D Level Gene Compensation Medicine” now?
Colin calculated, indeed a week had passed, and he could consume the second dose.
Immediately, he opened the parchment, entered the “Marketplace,” and glanced at the D level potions available for sale.
“Three Gold Mission Vouchers plus one thousand eight hundred points, points are small change, but the vouchers are not easy to earn, though it’s not much of a problem, at least for me, buying D Level Gene Compensation Medicine is no big deal…”
Colin briefly looked at the price, then directly proceeded to buy.
The D Level Potion could be selected for different methods of use when purchased outright compared to obtaining it through missions:
“Microneedle injection type, liquid oral type, chewable tablet type… Huh? There’s also a suppository type? Ah??? Does anyone actually choose this?”
Perplexed, Colin saw that there was a “Sold 11 this month,” and fell silent.
He was a bit curious what went through the minds of those who chose this method…
However, aside from these free options, he also saw some methods that charged a fee, like a skin-application type for absorption.
100 points…
And a custom formula tailored for one’s constitution.
300 points each…
“The application type seems to have additional benefits, making it more comfortable? But regardless, the indirect time is always seven days, and the effect is consistent, who would be so silly to spend money on these things?”
Colin shook his head, the company always had some inexplicable operations in some areas.
He had become somewhat accustomed to it…
He casually chose a liquid to drink, took it in hand, opened the cap, and drank it down in one gulp.
It had an ordinary water taste…
“The earlier level compensation medicines would elicit some reactions like fever after drinking, but the higher the grade, the blander the taste seemed to be when consumed…”
If he hadn’t already tried it once and knew that was simply how it tasted,
Colin might have suspected that he had drunk a fake medicine.
Logically, shouldn’t it be like those novels where after consuming the miraculous elixirs, the body continuously heats up, secretes various dark impurities, and undergoes shedding and bone tempering?
How come it just tastes like mineral water…
‘However, one thing is certain: after drinking, the body is indeed subtly changing. You might not notice anything on the first day, but after a couple of days, you can generally notice it.’
‘There will be a slight increase in physical strength, and then adaptability will be further enhanced, especially the resistance to various abnormal pollutants will continue to increase.’
Colin felt as if the “crap mountain” code originally in his body was being continuously modified.
