The high priest felt somewhat desperate.
However, at this moment, the orb suddenly burst forth with a terrifying power and, against all odds, scattered the blood-colored tentacles.
Immediately after, a horrific might erupted as if heaven and earth were collapsing.
Everyone on the battlefield stopped in their tracks under the rolling divine aura.
They all looked incredulously ahead, despair tinging their eyes… Had “God Descent” succeeded?
Had they… still lost after all?
…
“Is this… the ‘Master’s’ arrival? We’re saved!”
In the center of the altar, the high priest mumbled incredulously to himself, feeling the overwhelming pressure and couldn’t help but be ecstatic. All the despair and humiliation endured over so many years seemed to be released at this moment.
Finally, finally… it was a success!
The high priest wept with joy, and along with the surrounding believers, they all knelt towards the Great Will.
In this moment, even if he died, he would be content!
“You have worked hard, let me take over from here, rest well for some time…”
Hearing such caring words from the “Great Will,” the “Dawn Star” high priest lifted his head with tears in his eyes, just about to speak that he was not tired and could still contribute his last strength for the dawn of this world when…
He narrowed his eyes as a flash of orange-red flame passed before him.
“What’s happ…”
Then his consciousness froze in confusion…
The great fire that erupted from within the “Dawn Star” consumed all the unsuspecting higher-ups of the “Dawn Star” in an instant.
One by one, bodies turned to char and fell in the flames.
But before they hit the ground, the charred bodies had turned to ash, scattering on the ground, leaving only some residual characteristics.
Colin casually tossed out the “Smiling Mountain of Corpses” to collect those things on the ground.
…
At a distance, the sudden turn of events left everyone’s minds scrambling—how could the “Dawn Star” have just appeared, only to annihilate their own people?
“Hahaha, look, they’re dead, aren’t they? This is the fate of those who worship a false god!”
“That’s the end of those who believe in heretic beings, nothing surprising!”
Hateful laughter came from the heretic forces.
Clearly, seeing this scene, not an ounce of sympathy arose in their hearts.
“Attack! We must fight! Now that this thing has just arrived, its power is surely not at its fullest, we still have a chance!”
“We can’t let this thing endanger our world!”
“Charge… You! What are you doing…”
A high-ranking heretic was ready to give his all and confront the True God with a willing-to-die stance.
But just as he took his first step, the back of his head, the small of his back, his kidneys, his groin, and other vital areas all suddenly hurt…
A series of blood-formed crystal spikes pierced through from behind him.
Yet even so, he did not die on the spot but instead, with a sudden effort, broke all the sharp spikes, shook off the assailants beside him, and staggered to stand in his original spot, blood spurting out of multiple holes in his body.
However, rather than the pain, it was the sight of the Asian man in a cowboy hat and the people around him that filled his eyes with rage.
He opened his mouth to say something.
But with his throat partially severed, only blood gushed out from his mouth.
At this moment, he suddenly realized everything…
It was indeed a trap.
Despicable government officials!
“Heh, when did you start to delude yourself that we were in this together?”
The man with the cowboy hat flashed a polite smile, his pupils a deep crimson, “Haven’t you noticed? Charging up here… you’re the only one left alive.”
“Although I was somewhat moved by your determination to rush forward and stop the Descent, I must apologize… I am a policeman.”
As he spoke, he lifted his hand and with a “snap”, a crisp snapping of his fingers echoed.
“Blood Explosion Technique!”
The blood remaining inside the opponent’s body exploded.
An isolated Level 8 Personnel was thus sneakily assassinated by them!
However, just as they were preparing to move on and hunt other targets, he suddenly felt a thump in his heart. Almost without thinking, blood spurted from the pores on his body, forming a crystal stone to block the path ahead…
It was at that moment that a green-rusted copper arrow shot towards him…
“Crack.”
The blood-red crystal shattered upon contact with the strange arrowhead.
The Asian man with the cowboy hat felt his scalp tingle with the stiffness of being targeted all over; he realized he was finished.
But at that very moment, a hand ablaze with flames reached out of nowhere, catching the arrow.
“Ninth Level strength, yet you ambush someone not even at Eighth Level… what a weakling.”
Colin’s right hand exerted a slight force, and he instantly snapped the arrow, causing the man behind him to catch his breath.
At the same time, not far in front, a figure hidden midair, upon seeing him appear, hardly thought twice before choosing to retreat, unwilling to fight to the death.
However…
No sooner had he taken a couple of steps away than Colin had already pulled out a special badge, requesting to initiate a fair and just battle.
“Now that you’re here, don’t be in such a hurry to leave. It’s my first time killing a Level 9 Personnel; I hope it entertains me.”
As his words fell, both figures disappeared on the spot, leaving the dumbfounded man with the cowboy hat, the sole survivor amidst the calamity.
…
Meanwhile, on another front, as the “Dawn Star” higher-ups had been captured in the blink of an eye by Colin and the power of the “Skirt of Myriad Starlight” had been severed…
They took little time to deal with all the remaining followers of the “Dawn Star”.
“What in the world is going on?” some of the officials, confused by the situation in front of them, began questioning the high-ranking officials leading the team.
“Don’t overthink it. Now is not the time for you to be pondering. Just await further instructions.”
The higher-level official being questioned replied—
In reality, he also had no idea what was happening. At least on the surface, their mission was to prevent the arrival of a Heretic Evil God.
But it didn’t seem to be the case now…
The real situation was probably known only to a select few, and this didn’t include him, even though he was a Level 8 Personnel.
Before they could think any further, a burst of Inspiration emerged in their minds.
Then, as if receiving some kind of command, they abandoned their advance towards the city center and, turning around, headed towards the combined forces of the Heretics.
“Damn it, this really is a trap!” Some members of the Heretic Forces vaguely realized something.
Having been suspicious of this place, they immediately understood that the “God Descent” was indeed a trap. As for what exactly was happening with “Dawn Star”, they didn’t have time to think or care…
Of course, not all Heretic Forces showed outraged expressions at this scene.
On the contrary, a significant number of them even showed smiles:
“Hahaha, it’s just a trap after all…”
This meant that “Dawn Star” had not descended; they still had a chance!
They still had a chance to save the world!
But compared to the Heretic Forces, who were already in chaos due to the meddling of the 25 gang and fighting amongst themselves…
The officials who had entered the area were, in fact, more cautious and apprehensive, especially towards the rolling, blood-colored fog hovering in midair…
The aura emanating from above was indeed very ominous.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - 568 444 Todays Weather Clearing Skies. _1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 568: Chapter 444: Today’s Weather, Clearing Skies. _1 Chapter 568: Chapter 444: Today’s Weather, Clearing Skies. _1 “Da-da-da…”
The sound of the clock hands ticking rose slowly…
The frozen time thawed.
At the same time, the effect of the “Holy Colosseum” gradually faded, signaling that the battle was about to draw to a close.
“Did a Ninth Level Personnel just die like that?”
“Disappointing, unbelievable…”
“Too weak, too weak, far too weak…”
Colin’s right hand held the Revolver, his left the Golden Card, and a look of helplessness appeared on his face.
After dealing with the high-rank “Dawn Star” group, he directly targeted the Ninth Level Personnel in the arena, first approaching with the “Emblem of the Humility Knight,” then quickly invoking the “Shield Badge of Fairness and Justice,” promising three rules swiftly, and initiating “Time Stasis.” A Bone Spur pierced through his brain first, followed by the lethal effects triggered by “Kindness of the Firebearer” and “Revolver Contrarian”…
Apart from passive buffs and some standard items like “The False Powerhouse” and “Colorless Crystal”…
The other strengths hadn’t even really begun to rise…
And yet, after a standard procedure, the opponent was directly gone.
“If it were up to Big C Teacher, by now he’d only have taken half his life, entered the Second Order, and after a few more sets, there might have been a chance of killing him.”
Colin had come to understand why, on the surface, top-tier powerhouses of Heretic Organizations didn’t seem much fewer than that of the official forces, yet there was always silence—probably because, apart from the constant cutthroat competition among themselves, the quality was concerning.
Of course, Colin thought, if he himself were hit by such a combo, not counting that special “death exemption” skill, he wouldn’t die, but he wouldn’t fare much better either.
And with the complete death of a Ninth Level Personnel from whom nobody even knew the name…
Colin’s figure reappeared in the battlefield.
Immediately, he felt an indescribable gaze locking onto him; following the sensation, he immediately saw a tumbling surge of red mist spreading from afar…
Within that mist, countless red vapors polluted the surroundings, vivifying everything.
At first glance…
Colin felt as if the world over there was coming to life.
‘A dangerous contaminant source rapidly nearing Level 2 Containment Subject strength…’
In his heart, he roughly made some judgments.
It appeared that the followers of “Red Moon” had been absent until now because they were holding back a heavy blow.
An anomaly of Level 2 Containment Subject strength.
For this place, it was already the pinnacle.
‘However, speaking of which, the followers of “Red Moon” on Earth seem to be a notch lower than those followers of “Red Moon” encountered in the “Ghost Train” incident…’
Colin remembered that in that incident, most of the Heretic Forces present did not come from Earth.
But from other places…
Otherwise, with the level of fluctuation at the time, the official forces wouldn’t have failed to notice, and would have taken the opportunity to raid them.
“Sir, that thing seems to be coming this way, should we retreat?”
A voice came from the side, interrupting Colin’s thoughts.
He shifted his gaze from the terrifying contaminant anomaly afar and looked at the speaker.
A man wearing a cowboy hat, with blood-red eyes, and an aura of sharp, blood-colored mist swirling around him…
If Colin was not mistaken, this should be an undercover embedded within the Heretic Forces, estimated based on previous observations to be around Level 6 or 7 in strength.
Not strong, but not weak either…
At this moment, the man in the cowboy hat felt an immense pressure as soon as Colin looked his way.
Especially after witnessing a Ninth Level Personnel inexplicably annihilated in an instant.
Fortunately… this one is an ally…
Otherwise, he estimated that by now he would probably be lying down just like that corpse.
“I’ve seen that kind of blood fog created by the ‘Red Moon’ followers in other places, very tricky to deal with, has caused multiple high-ranking officials to be seriously injured, might need to retreat and go back to discuss countermeasures…”
“Retreat?”
Colin interrupted, his eyeballs moving as he turned his gaze back to the rolling blood fog, his hands in his pockets, not moving an inch:
“It’s the one that should be retreating.”
“Um…” The man wearing a cowboy hat was stunned for a moment, but he wasn’t too surprised by the other’s ‘confidence’ due to the special nature of his identity, having dealt with many such Ninth Level powerhouses before.
He knew that at this stage there were some problems with their personalities.
The priority was to coax him back before anything bad really happened.
However, before he could speak, he suddenly felt an incredibly terrifying surge of flames erupt from the other person.
“Holy shit!” His heart leaped, thinking they were all going to be killed.
But fortunately, it seemed like that hadn’t happened.
The flames, filled with terrifying energy, hadn’t hurt him but instead gave him a sense of warmth.
At the same time, the officials who had been worrying about how to deal with the blood mist, suddenly saw a dazzling and blindingly bright giant fireball leap up from the shattered ruins of the city.
It rose like the sun, and its fearsome flames twisted the air as if they could ignite anything.
The “City at the Lake’s Bottom,” dimmed by the dispersal of the “Dawn Star’s” light, was once again illuminated.
And some keen-eyed people could vaguely make out through the hundred-meter diameter of giant flames a silhouette standing within, like a deity…
“Who is this? Is it an enemy or an ally?”
“What’s happening? There’s no mention of this person in the reports…”
“Wait… I remember now, he seems to be… the mysterious powerhouse from the ‘Bonfire Company’…”
“We’re cooperating with the ‘Bonfire Company’ this time? Why didn’t anyone mention it beforehand…”
“…”
The coalition of official forces from various countries was initially shocked.
Then quickly, someone realized that this must be the existence known as “Brother Shunzi” within the “Bonfire Company,” his body of flames almost a trademark…
However, before they could ponder further, a faint whisper suddenly entered everyone’s ears.
“Today’s weather report, clearing skies.”
As the words fell, the giant fireball, like the setting sun, crashed down towards the swirling blood fog.
At the moment of impact, the fireball exploded.
“Boom!”
A massive flame mushroom cloud soared into the sky, devouring all the mist in sight, and amidst the terrifying vibrations of the earth, a horrifying shockwave spread out in a circular pattern, causing the “City at the Lake’s Bottom” to shake violently, as if it were about to collapse at any moment.
And when the light dissipated, the swirling blood-red fog had already turned to ash…
Seeing this, personnel with some understanding of the “Bonfire Company” took a deep breath.
They finally understood why “Brother Shunzi” was referred to as a human-form nuclear bomb within the Bonfire Company…
What used to be thought of as an exaggeration turned out to be realism.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - 569 445 Lady Bunnys Veto Power. _1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 569: Chapter 445 “Lady Bunny’s” Veto Power. _1 Chapter 569: Chapter 445 “Lady Bunny’s” Veto Power. _1 The gray haze slowly faded from before his eyes…
There were no bell chimes.
Colin opened his eyes, propped up his body, and immediately saw the familiar room.
After dealing with the blood mist created by the Followers of the “Red Moon”, he returned directly through the task without a hint of lingering.
‘The situation there should be secure now. The critical Level 9 Personnel and the blood mist that the Followers of the ‘Red Moon’ turned into have been taken care of by me, and many of the stronger ones were injured as a side effect when I used ‘Heavenly Lightfall’…
‘As long as the official personnel are even a little bit clever, they should know how to clean up the aftermath.’
Colin did not continue to ponder and immediately took out the “Parchment” from his pocket.
As expected, he saw that his previous mission had been completed.
[In this event, your evaluation is: B-.]
[The following is the settlement for this event’s tasks— “Bonfire Points*14000”, “Golden Clearance Certificate*1”, “Random Item Draw Ticket*1”.]
[All items have been transferred to the “Storage Room”, please check.]
…
“Hiss, I took down so many Heretic Forces and even defeated a Level 2 follower of the ‘Red Moon’, and for all that I got just this handful of Points?”
Colin had thought he might be in for a large harvest of Points.
But to his surprise, it was only a little over ten thousand…
This was his first mission initiated proactively, and he had spent so many days carefully planning it, only for the rewards to be far fewer than anticipated.
‘But… on second thought, it seems the Company really didn’t acquire anything valuable, did it?’
Colin thought it over; “Bonfire Company” hardly issued any extra side tasks for this mission.
In other words, according to the rules for mission rewards, this task may have dealt a severe blow to the audacity of Heretic Forces, but indeed, they had not seized any valuable items…
However, he wasn’t overly fixated on this.
Among the mission rewards, the most important “Random Item Draw Ticket” had already been acquired.
“Time for the draw!”
Without any hesitation, Colin immediately opted to use it.
The next second, a strand of golden radiance flickered on his retina, forming lines of text.
Although he knew it was very likely predetermined,
It was not until he saw this radiance that he felt somewhat relieved.
[Name: “Time Reversal”]
[Quality: Extremely rare.]
[Status: Barely usable (Integrity 17%).]
[Energy Level: Class A.]
[Effect “Backflow”: After using this card, you can activate the effect “Backflow”, reversing the state of things and events within a certain spatial area. Except for the user, objects and entities not of the same caliber will have a difficult time resisting this effect, which has an absolute effective range of 3 meters around the holder.]
[Can actively reverse up to 2 seconds in the past.]
[Life forms that leave the range of the reversal while it’s being cast will be freed from the effect.]
[Negative effect “Time Perception Disarray”: For a while after use, there may be a possible disarray in time perception, the intensity of this negative effect increases with the frequency of use in a short period.]
[Can be used once per hour…]
[Note: One of The Seventeen Gold Cards from “Card Divine Kingdom”, can be combined with other “Time” series for composite effects…]
[A product inventor from “Bonfire Company” who wishes to remain anonymous, Mr. Kattu, stated: This is far more convenient than using “Time Freeze” to carry someone down the stairs and then back to their original position.]
[Moreover, trust me, do not under any circumstances use it while excreting if you haven’t reached a certain proficiency with the card!]
[While the damage itself may not be significant, the psychological impact is not negligible, and it definitely won’t be a pleasant experience.]
[To repair the status to 39%: it will cost 39712 Points, and the number of uses, the effect range will be enhanced, along with obtaining updated skill effects.]
…
“As expected, it’s this card.”
Colin’s gaze quickly passed over the content, noting that its introduction was very similar to that of the “Time Stop” Golden Card.
However, due to the low integrity, its various effects seemed rather crippled…
“The effect range impacts only a three-meter area, which is a bit small, and the reversal time is only 2 seconds? And this frequency, only once an hour… this is far from the uncontrollable ‘Time Reversal’ that could affect an entire starship back then.”
Reading the description, Colin almost doubted whether this was the same card at all.
The differences were just too vast…
Of course, compared to the previously uncontrollable state,
The effects of this card now seemed significantly more stable.
At the very least, Colin no longer needed to trigger “The Sealed Right Hand” to carry it, nor did he have to worry about accidentally being trapped in a “Time Reversal” predicament.
‘That being said… the “Time Perception Disarray” negative effect is similar to others.’
‘Looking at it this way, the negative effects of the ‘Time series’ are consistent, and there must be another Time Golden Card that’s also…’
‘As for the note, it’s still filled with that two-dimensional humor; I don’t get these two-dimensional references. However, the warning about not using it while defecating… that’s correct…’
Colin recalled the few times he spat out thick phlegm and then reabsorbed it.
This…
The image was too beautiful to contemplate in detail.
However, ever since he took various Gene Compensation Medicines and became a semi “Flame Bearer”, Colin scarcely needed to visit the bathroom anymore…
If he really had to, he could use flame to dispose of all the residues in his body.
As his thoughts moved, Colin’s gaze shifted to the last section about repairing the card’s status.
“So, almost forty thousand Points for just the first round of repairs?”
Colin couldn’t help but hiss a breath.
From his experience repairing the “Revolver”, he knew that as the item approached further stages of restoration, the average cost per percentage point tended to increase; an early percentage point might only require a few hundred or a few thousand Points.

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - 570 445 Lady Bunnys Veto Power. _2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 570: Chapter 445 “Lady Bunny’s” Veto Power. _2 Chapter 570: Chapter 445 “Lady Bunny’s” Veto Power. _2 But in the later stages, I’m afraid you can’t get it without a five or six-digit figure…
Even though Colin felt that, aside from “Lady Rabbit” and “The Light Chaser,” he should be the person earning the most points in the company, he still couldn’t manage this.
The number was simply too vast…
Colin suspected that within the “Bonfire Company,” there must have been a group of employees just like him who could earn a large amount of points.
Such as “The Light Chaser,” and others…
To prevent their points from rotting away in the storage, the company had special means and methods to earn them back.
The poor have their way of being exploited, and the rich have their own…
For instance, the “Bonfire Excellent Talent Development Program.”
Before joining, Colin’s view of points was that they were tasteless to eat but too precious to discard.
But now, all he could say was that he was naive back then and had spoken some foolish words, hoping that if there are high-point, safe, and risk-free tasks in the future, he’d like to be given priority.
“Just repairing it to be almost usable is fine.”
He didn’t aim to get rich in one go; he looked at the point requirements, felt confident he could obtain them, and promptly proceeded with the repair.
“Clang clang clang…”
The special effect sound of a hammer striking an item echoed in his ears.
Then, a few seconds later, the item description changed…
“The range expanded from 3m to 10m, the number of uses changed to three, reversing time from 2 seconds to 5 seconds—it’s still a bit short, but much better than just now. Next, the cost of the following repair, 49%, will require a six-digit number of points.”
Time to make a swift exit…
“In addition, a new exclusive passive skill ‘Irreversible’ appeared… When proficiency reaches a certain level, it allows specifying certain things that won’t be affected by ‘Time Reversal’…”
“This way, it avoids the embarrassing situation of reviving the enemy along with oneself.”
“However, I don’t see that previous ability, the one that traps people in a ‘time loop,’ making them repeat endlessly…”
“Is it because the completeness isn’t enough yet…?”
Colin stared at the item description in front of him, unconsciously flicking three Golden Cards in his hand.
From the current look of things, this item inherited the characteristics of “Card Divine Kingdom”. Its effects are simple but brutishly robust, with a high base effectiveness and an even higher limit. There’s no complex theory involved; even a three-year-old could use it…
If used appropriately, it could certainly be a key item in turning the tide of battle.
“Speaking of which, if one card is so powerful, what if all seventeen cards were collected, and then all were used for Item Liberation… hiss…”
Just the thought of it made Colin’s scalp tingle.
He wondered if anyone in the company had ever managed to hold seventeen cards at once…
“If it could be done, it wouldn’t be too different from having a God Kingdom at your disposal, hmm. By ‘God,’ the term probably describes a certain aspect, not those specific Level 1 or Level 2 Containment Subjects…”
Colin murmured to himself.
After letting his thoughts wander for a while, he stowed the item back into his pocket, then turned to see if there was any significant new event involving his colleagues or the company on the parchment, only to hear a “buzz” sound suddenly.
On a bedside table nearby, his phone screen lit up, an information message from someone with a beautiful girl avatar.
“Old Master Wu?”
Colin picked up his phone and glanced at it, then unlocked the screen with his fingerprint to check the details.
“Thanks to the information you provided, we successfully found ‘City at the Lake’s Bottom’ and dealt with ‘Dawn Star’ and a large group of top Heretic Forces. Finally, the world’s anomaly index has begun to decrease.”
“And as the most important source of information for this operation, I promise that within three to six months, you will become a Sixth Level Personnel and receive the rewards you deserve.”
Three to six months?
Colin was taken aback. That long?
He remembered that this sort of promotion should happen quite quickly.
Such as Hu Zheng’s rise to Level 4 position; it didn’t even take a week.
And as if knowing his confusion, Old Master Wu’s message followed up immediately:
“Normally, such a promotion would be resolved within a month, but your case is obviously special. We must ensure full preparedness. I have a feeling that it’s highly likely something unpleasant will occur when the time comes…”
Interestingly, “Lady Rabbit” had said the same thing.
Colin pursed his lips, accepting the other party’s reasoning.
His status was indeed sensitive; in this respect, caution was indeed warranted.
It’s just that…
“Three to six months. In the meantime, it’s quite possible that I could earn a promotion to C Level or above by completing some other tasks.”
Colin criticized inwardly. He then inquired if Old Master Wu had any other matters to discuss.
After receiving a “No” in reply, he ended the conversation and returned his focus to the parchment.
Looking for ways to safely earn more points.
Or to acquire more Gold Mission Vouchers would also be fine.
His Gene Compensation Panel was still not fully leveled up due to a lack of vouchers.
…
While Colin was wrestling with the points issue, in a vast, empty area on Earth untraceable by ordinary means.
A cold-light bulb emitted a steady glow, and within the light refracted from this bulb, one could see countless Rat-like projections surfacing.
“Finally, it’s happening. Soon I’ll understand the current status of the person behind that book. It wasn’t in vain that I risked getting caught by that madwoman and enticed the Heretic Forces to go in, to increase their merit…”
A Rat-like creature, nearly the size of a ten-year-old child, with a human face, murmured to itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - 571 445 Lady Bunnys Veto Power. _3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 571: Chapter 445 “Lady Bunny’s” Veto Power. _3 Chapter 571: Chapter 445 “Lady Bunny’s” Veto Power. _3 This time, the force behind “City at the Lake’s Bottom” was not only Old Master Wu, but also his silent contributions behind the scenes.
For the same reason as “Lady Rabbit”…
To be aware of the current user Status of the “Book of Fate,” if that guy isn’t dead, he might have to run away.
But…
If that guy is dead, he won’t need to stay deeply hidden, after all, with the company anomaly, here on Earth, neither the high-ranking officials nor the Corps can get in.
In such a situation, who could stop him?
But if that guy is really alive, even if just barely,
He could only hang on.
So at this moment, before getting the results, he is determined not to leave this place.
…
Meanwhile, behind a heavy, ancient, rusted gate, there is a simple and seemingly ordinary office.
At the back of the office, a woman wearing professional attire, with a curvaceous figure and long legs crossed on one side, sits behind the desk, reviewing documents in her hands.
Only, for some reason, if someone were here, they would find that no matter the angle,
They couldn’t see her face clearly…
And this is none other than the “Lady Rabbit,” who let Colin in on many secrets.
Currently, in her hands was a file about an “Outstanding Talents Training Program,” featuring well over a hundred names. However, most of them…
Were only targets to attract hatred, to divert risk for the rare ten “Sparks.”
To train a “Flame Bearer” as much as possible in this era.
To reignite the Bonfire…
In the quiet review, after a while, she lifted her pen and wrote a few names on it.
Just then, she seemed to realize something. She put down the documents in her hands and muttered to herself:
“It seems it’s almost time.”
She would soon understand that guy’s current Status.
But before she could think further, another document suddenly appeared in front of the desk.
A few vague words could be made out from the topmost document.
[The company at… time… “Zoo” Corps stationed… application rejected…]
With a glance, “Lady Rabbit” showed no surprise, which also meant that, without a proper reason, they were still strictly restricted from taking action…
This would continue until a “Flame Bearer” was granted the authority.
Of course, soon after learning the specific state of the “Book of Fate,” everything might change…
Shaking her head, the blurry figure of “Lady Rabbit” shredded the pile of documents.
Just then, the entire office suddenly changed in color, a snowy screen-like distortion appeared!
At the same time, streams of black and Red text continuously scrolled across various parts of the office.
[Attention! An anomaly with Employee “Lady Rabbit” has been detected, “Bonfire Protocol” initiating an investigation request…]
[Attention! An anomaly with Employee “Lady Rabbit” has been detected…]
[Attention! An anomaly with Employee “Lady Rabbit” has been detected, “Bonfire Protocol” *…￥%…]
…
Dense dark Red text emerged, compressing the Spatial area.
But “Lady Rabbit” sat still behind the desk, her gaze calm, not showing panic.
It seemed that this wasn’t the first time she encountered such a situation.
Amid the oppressive streams of black and Red text, she sat quietly, as if waiting for something.
She was well aware that to carry out such a special command, an Employee of sufficient rank must consent.
And now…
There was only one person of the same rank who could consent.
A few seconds passed, and a contract file appeared on her desk, seemingly out of nowhere.
It outlined the anomaly regarding “Lady Rabbit” and suggested initiating a “judgment order” against her, then requesting her signature to pass the agreement.
“Lady Rabbit” took out a stamp, and stamped “No,” terminating and shelving the proposal.
[Report: “Lady Rabbit” has vetoed the investigation request into “Lady Rabbit’s” anomaly, and the project will be halted.]
The snowy screen-like Blockade vanished.
The scrolls of black and Red text fraught with a terrifying atmosphere also disappeared.
Everything receded…
The office returned to its original state.
“Lady Rabbit” shook her head and looked at the stamp in her hand, only to see that the stamping surface had already begun to blur.
.
.
.
ps:
Taking a day off tomorrow (November 6), I’m about to enter the fast track of the final phase. But I’ve had quite a few upsetting matters lately that affected my writing mood, hence the poor quality of text. I need to adjust and think about how to write…
If you have any suggestions or the like, feel free to put them forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - 572 446 The Gaze from Beyond Known
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 572: Chapter 446 The Gaze from Beyond Known Dimensions…_1 Chapter 572: Chapter 446 The Gaze from Beyond Known Dimensions…_1 “The appearance of this thing is becoming more frequent. It’s starting to become more active. However, the remaining number of times should be enough to support us until the conditions are met, without too much interference.”
“Lady Bunny” put away her seal and carelessly tossed the investigation file about her to one side.
Such investigation requests meant little to her, at most they were just annoying and disgusting distractions.
If it weren’t for the fact that some other more important documents required her authority…
She would be able to completely resolve this trouble right now.
Then, with the same calmness as ever, “Lady Bunny” picked up another file that had been interrupted unexpectedly—
Some intelligence regarding “Employee Number 654321”.
“Three months, or perhaps half a year… that should be the ‘Fate Principle’ chosen time. By then, it should be an active period for the ‘Red Moon’…”
“Lady Bunny” had a rough understanding of what might happen then.
At that time, a war might break out over there, and in her eyes, though the intensity might not be very high—possibly just at the level of planetary destruction or the collapse of civilizations—the number of participants would be considerably great.
And this war would determine the direction of many futures.
No matter whether they ended up winning or losing, the impact would be significant.
After all, the world named “Earth” had too much symbolism attached to it.
It was a pity she couldn’t interfere much.
Her strictly limited authority was one thing. Another was that as the former domain of influence dwindled, many advanced beings were dragged by the company into a dimension beyond, and with the disappearance of “Bonfire Company,” its influence in this lengthy period had dramatically waned…
More and more beings were casting their eyes here and acting more brazenly.
Especially…
As the final time node approached.
These “unknown” actions would no longer remain simple observations.
They would attempt to act!
For those beings…
Whether “Bonfire Company” succeeded, or whether the “Red Moon” took over, or something else dominated this region, none of it would be what they wanted to see.
If left alone, it was highly likely they would upset the whole table.
For this, they would even give up the “delicious feast” on the table. After all, although they might not get a taste, at least they would avoid being eaten by those “delicious feasts”.
To prevent the “table” from being overturned, she was bound not to invest too much energy here in the future.
Her final authority must also be used for a few key things…
While contemplating, “Lady Bunny” seemed to tilt her head slightly, glancing at three files not far from the neat desktop.
Each of the files had a “Level 0” subject code on it.
Her gaze swept over them.
She reached out, conjuring a blank document out of thin air, and began writing a letter in reply to Colin.
…
Meanwhile, in the room, Colin suddenly felt a strange, subtle sensation—
as if someone were spying on him.
This feeling lasted a few seconds, then quickly vanished…
After it disappeared, reflecting on it, he could not pinpoint the source of that sensation.
“Spiritual Intuition… maybe there really is something spying. If these things in the shadows want to look, they should just do it openly; what’s the deal with peeping and then running away?”
Colin murmured to himself.
Based on his experience, it would certainly be impossible to track down…
Given the situation.
It’s time to get some sleep.
Colin returned to his bedroom, lay down on the bed, pulled up the small blanket, and prepared to sleep.
But just at that moment, a mission notification popped up…
[Event One: Take a deep breath…]
…
“Uh…”
He knew right away this task was sent by “Lady Bunny”.
Colin sat up, followed the instructions, and quickly received a reward of 5 Bonfire Points as well as a letter.
“In the middle of the night, who knows what it’s about…”
Casually opening the letter, Colin saw that the first part was about the next transaction.
“By the end of January…”
He noted the time in his mind, moved his gaze downward, and saw the contents of the second part.
It seemed to be some suggestions about future arrangements?
“In the coming period, endeavor to build giant ships, submarines, large underwater structures, and so on…”
Colin was slightly stunned as he read this content.
Why suddenly all these ships? Is the sea level going to rise?
Wait a second?
Colin subconsciously thought that this was probably related to what he was going to sign in “World Code-4”.
Could it be that “Lady Bunny” wanted them to move to that World Code in the face of future danger?
Or was it an impending disaster that would cause the sea level to rise?
Amidst these ponderings, Colin continued to read, but saw no direct explanation from “Lady Bunny”.
Instead, he saw more specific execution plans mentioned below.
For instance, how to pair certain special containment subjects with existing technology to construct similar deep-sea refuges…
Moreover, there was also a point stating that the plan should be executed secretly within a certain scope; Eighth Level officials and below were not allowed to know the full name or reason for the plan.
Even Eighth Level Personnel would need special restrictions to avoid leaking the plan.
Looking at these deep-water related plans…
“Is this… Lady Bunny so certain that the future disaster will definitely be related to water?”
Colin was slightly perplexed.
But speaking of which, considering these things, he suddenly remembered something in his head that seemed to be either an egg or a sphere…

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - 573 446
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 573: 446 Chapter 573: 446 This was the legacy “Father of the Ocean” left to him before his death.
But after this thing was stored in his head, there hadn’t been any activity. Colin had been seriously injured several times, and whether using “Bonfire” or “Hunger,” it didn’t react…
So much so that most of the time, he forgot that there was such a thing in his brain.
“At this point, it seems like it’s not just stored in my brain, but rather, it feels somewhat like it’s stored in some system of ‘Bonfire Company’ within my body, stuck there like a quest reward…”
“That makes sense, otherwise, it would have probably been consumed by me when I released ‘Hunger’ last time.”
“‘Father of the Ocean’ is aware of ‘Hunger’ and values this egg so much; obviously, he wouldn’t have left it inside me without preparations…to add to my meal.”
Colin stroked his chin, and when he focused, he could vaguely feel the presence of the object.
Its form was somewhat like a quest…
But its current appearance was much the same as before; he didn’t know what was being incubated inside or what the conditions for hatching were—it simply remained silent…
“I don’t even know if it’s still alive. If it’s dead, could I take it out and add it to my meal?”
Colin remembered that in novels, consuming the eggs of such super creatures might allow one to ascend on the spot or something…
He thought whimsically for a moment, chuckled, then refocused and pulled out his phone to contact Xu Duojin, asking him to come over.
The other party informed him to wait for about half an hour, and he would soon arrive, then hung up the phone.
Only, right after hanging up, Colin realized something was off…
“Wait, isn’t the cleanup battle in ‘City at the Lake’s Bottom’ still ongoing? Didn’t they say he went over there too? And that desert is quite far from here…”
Colin’s expression turned bizarre, this… Could it be that he came back on a missile?
Or maybe…
Does the official side have some special means of transport?
He vaguely remembered there were such things, but they were the type to be sealed, not turned into items by the Company.
Those sealed containment subjects were pricey to use.
Considering how these people were as frugal as the village-slaughtering granny, they likely wouldn’t be willing to try using these things for mere travel.
And to arrive within half an hour, Colin suspected this guy either slacked off and didn’t go, or he came back on a missile.
It seemed the officials actually had people who could ride missiles for travel…
…
“Phew, it’s finally over.”
Xu Duojin came out of a large building, drenched in cold sweat. Inside the secret containment warehouse underground, some peculiar things still hadn’t been fully dealt with.
It seemed they noticed Mr. Wu’s departure, recognized him as an impostor, and thus immediately started to act.
Fortunately, he managed to hold on until just now, when the real Master returned…
And as soon as he stepped out, that disaster-star sent a message.
“Buzz, buzz, buzz…”
The sound of an airplane engine came from not far away.
Xu Duojin looked to the side and saw a fighter jet, about to take off in the middle of the night.
If nothing unusual happened, it would “coincidentally” pass right above the neighborhood where Colin lived.
“Not giving me a moment to breathe, it’s straight onto the next thing, Mr. Wu is…”
Mid-sentence, he paused, then sighed with resignation, “Growing more and more skilled.”
Another half-hour later, while putting on sunglasses, he knocked on the door. Upon hearing “come in,” he pushed the door and entered.
There he saw Colin sitting on the couch playing with his phone, leisurely picking at a king crab feast on the table. A delicate-looking maid was massaging his shoulders and back…
“Huh…” A chill swept through.
Xu Duojin turned his head and saw a ghost-like aberration toss a streak of frost towards them.
Without waiting for his reaction, it giggled “hee hee hee” and drifted away like a child…
‘That breeze would freeze an ordinary person to death.’
Xu Duojin inwardly lamented the lack of discipline in Colin’s House, swatted the frost from his clothes, sat down on the couch, and vengefully grabbed a crab leg:
“Mr. Colin, what’s the matter?”
“Hmm, take a look at this.” Colin, as always, didn’t beat around the bush and simply tossed the handwritten pages over.
“This is…” Xu Duojin asked while taking the pages.
Then, upon hearing the latter part of Colin’s explanation, he stopped eating his crab legs, put them on the table, and became entirely serious.
“Some suggestions and directions for the future provided by some company executives.”
After Colin finished speaking simply, the room was filled with nothing but the sound of pages turning.
Clearly, the mysterious executives of “Bonfire Company” still held significant weight in the hearts of official personnel.
Colin didn’t disturb him but simply slurped on the crab legs while waiting.
After a good while, Xu Duojin finally put down the documents.
“Can I take this document with me when the time comes?”
“Yes.”
“Hmm, then, I have some questions to ask. According to this, might the future disasters be related to the sea?”
“I guess it should be related to it, and it might also shift to another world, but I’m not certain about the specifics. What I can let you know is all there on the paper.”
Colin did not guarantee this point and straightforwardly indicated that he wasn’t very clear about it either.
After a pause, he continued, “So, is there an issue with the demands listed there or what?”
“It’s not that the demands can’t be met…”
Adjusting his sunglasses, Xu Duojin browsed the contents once more before speaking, “We have always had contingency plans for various scenarios. After all, when predicting the future, we knew disasters would happen but never knew what kind exactly.
“So, plans for underground structures, floating islands on the sea, or even limited space stations were all in place…
“However, if we follow the instructions here, a significant amount of resources will have to be allocated in this direction, which… will require a solid reason to get everyone to agree.”
“Is that so…” Colin nodded, unsurprised.
It’s indeed not easy to unify everyone for an uncertain project…
After all, if everyone put all their resources into building ships and then it turns out the doomsday crisis is due to a meteorite falling, what then?
“The main thing is, according to our future estimates, none of the types of disasters we expect seem to include this scenario. Without a proper reason, it will be tough to execute… Do you have any suggestions?”
“My suggestion is to follow the instructions, but if you’re saying I need to provide something concrete, I’ve got nothing.”
Colin expressed his opinion.
“Is that so…” Xu Duojin nodded, once again reviewing some of the specific implementation details in the document, feeling secretly alarmed.
He realized that the company seemed to be aware of the horrific containment subjects they secretly detained, and had even provided usage suggestions, giving him the eerie feeling that they had thoroughly seen through their own depths.
But then again, it seemed normal…
Those company employees were always investigating this or that…
They certainly weren’t investigating for nothing.
Sometimes the company would assign some “freebie” tasks.
Go to some place that obviously has nothing, take a casual spin as if window-shopping, do nothing, and then return.
The employees thought it was a freebie…
But when the authorities stepped in to investigate and extracted some reports, they found that although these places are uneventful now, they had incidents in the past, often being the former locations of anomalies before containment.
Employees might not know what they actually did.
But in reality, the company had already gathered information about a containment subject through them.
Just a little bit of information is enough to understand the majority of situations.
‘It’s a pity, we don’t know the actual motive of this ‘company’…’
Xu Duojin sighed. They had never quite understood the ultimate aims of the company. All the information they had found thus far indicated that all actions of Bonfire Company seemed to be driven by the aim of saving “humanity” as a whole.
That’s why they provided “unconditional” assistance to them…
But even Xu Duojin, who was amiable toward the “company,” couldn’t help but shake his head in skepticism at this thought. It didn’t feel quite true.
It couldn’t really be some noble desire to save the world and humanity, could it?

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - 574 447 The Enthusiastic Little Mermaid
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 574: Chapter 447 The Enthusiastic Little Mermaid “Tina”._1 Chapter 574: Chapter 447 The Enthusiastic Little Mermaid “Tina”._1 Many thoughts flashed through Xu Duojin’s mind…
But in the end, he shook his head and looked at Colin, saying,
“I can’t give you a definite answer on this matter. I will report it to the higher-ups. So, aside from this, is there anything else?”
“Yes, the next transaction time…”
After Colin finished speaking, they had a brief exchange, and then he saw Xu Duojin off at the door.
As for whether or not to implement this suggestion, he had said all that he needed to say.
The rest was up to the officials to decide.
“The domestic part is likely to follow this process, after all, Old Master Wu and I are somewhat close, so it is very likely that this ship and artificial island construction project will be pushed forward…”
“As for other countries, it’s not so certain, as international officials have a variety of tangled and messy thoughts that are not unified.”
Thinking about future scenarios, Colin couldn’t help but shake his head.
The biggest issue right now was insufficient resource allocation. There were those who wanted to leave, those who wished to stay, and some who wanted to lead the way—each with many different directions. For example, those who wanted to leave were fighting over destinations and trying to take as many resources as possible…
On the surface, it seemed like a unified whole, but in reality, it was a complete mess.
Everyone was pulling resources for their own plans as much as possible.
Then suddenly came a request to build deep-water structures, large artificial islands, ships, and so on.
Colin just thought about it and felt the competition would become even fiercer.
The only thing he could pray for now was that a perfect solution would appear in the future.
For instance, if a real high-level executive born on Earth from some company took charge, leading the entire Earth or even the “Solar System” to escape, ensuring the Earth’s ecosystems remained unaffected through extraordinary means, executing some cosmic wanderer plan, that would likely solve everything…
Unfortunately…
Such thoughts were only wishful thinking.
Colin shook his head, casting these various troublesome thoughts out of his mind.
Once disaster struck in the future, no one could remain unaffected.
Even Bonfire Company had become what it was now…
He too needed to improve himself as soon as possible.
“Next, it’s time for ‘The Descent Project’ to go to ‘World Code 4’ instead of 13. Yeah, I’ll talk to those few dozen people later to prevent them from thinking I’ve croaked if they don’t see me, pondering lottery draws on my inheritance…”
“Hmm, as for supplies, I still have some left from last time. If I skimp a bit on food, I should be able to get by. If worst comes to worst, using a few items selected from the officials to produce a batch of potatoes or something for emergency should suffice.”
“It’s just that the taste of those forcibly ripened isn’t that great, but it seems they don’t mind much, as having food to eat is good enough…”
“Sigh, the food situation in World Code 13 is still a long way from self-sufficiency…”
Colin leaned on the sofa, thought for a moment, and then took out a piece of parchment to contact “Arsonist” and the others—
These people seemed to be living fairly well.
Nowadays, because of his involvement, “The Descent Project,” while still high-risk, could turn into something else entirely if the descent was to either “World Code 13” or “World Code 4.”
“The Descent Project” became significantly safer once the initial ongoing disasters were dealt with and a foothold was established, mitigating the fear of dying at any moment…
Of course, if it hadn’t been solved, or not solved thoroughly…
Then it was just a matter of praying for a roll of “Luck.”
“But speaking of which, I’m still not clear about something. Those who have previously failed ‘The Descent Project,’ I wonder if it was in ‘World Code 13’ or ‘World Code 4’…”
Colin pondered, aware of two World Codes, but there was no talk of recovering their bodies.
Either they probably went to some other unknown area, so they couldn’t be found…
Some “Descent Projects,” like the “Starships,” occurred in space.
If an average person went, even a higher one up to D Level, it’s likely they’d die without even encountering a creature…
Besides, if they didn’t go to another area, then they likely died cleanly.
The kind where they couldn’t be found at all…
“Previously known ‘Descent Projects’ before mine seem to include only three or four employees who completed the first stage and briefly returned, then disappeared during the second stage. These… it’s also unclear whether they are dead or alive. There’s a chance they’re not dead but cannot return due to unmet conditions and are still struggling to survive disconnected from Bonfire Company.”
“Of course, it’s also possible that they really kicked the bucket.”
If they weren’t dead, Colin suspected that someday one of those employees might return from an Other World as some grand emperor, which would be quite a spectacle.
Without dwelling much on it, the parchment lit up immediately with replies from “Arsonist-Tao Tie,” “Surfing for Pigs,” and others.
They seemed very excited—Brother Shunzi finally decided to go to “World Code-4”!
If he didn’t go soon, they feared they might not die during their missions but from Tina, the Little Mermaid’s nagging.
Although Bonfire had successfully established communication, clearly, making a “phone call” didn’t compare to a face-to-face meeting, especially since Brother Shunzi tended to end conversations within half an hour.
And the rest of the time was their suffering time…
If it weren’t for the fact that they really couldn’t beat Brother Shunzi, they truly wanted to knock him out with a hammer, tie him up, and throw him into Tina the Little Mermaid’s room to be…
…
Unaware of their resentment towards him, Colin simply communicated with these few employees about the situation and, learning that things were relatively stable on their side, he felt somewhat relieved.
“From the looks of it, it should be fine…”

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - 575 447 Enthusiastic Little Mermaid Tina._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 575: Chapter 447 Enthusiastic Little Mermaid “Tina”._2 Chapter 575: Chapter 447 Enthusiastic Little Mermaid “Tina”._2 Colin stroked his chin; he vaguely remembered that they didn’t really have any conflicts with the advanced life forms from “World Code-4.”
The conflict had arisen because they went there to retrieve items and were mistakenly thought to want to destroy the world.
So a bunch of innately evil gods had desperately tried every possible method to prevent them from launching the “Extermination Order” and destroying “World Code-4″…
But now, it was known that they were not there to destroy the world.
So, indeed, there was no conflict between them…
Although they still didn’t quite see eye to eye, they kept to their separate paths without interference.
“Looking at it this way, it seems there really won’t be any accidents, and I can start thinking about what comes after,” he said.
Colin then thought about what would happen after he returned and could confirm that…
After returning, in two days’ time, he would be able to use the third D-Level Gene Compensation Medicine…
And after that would be the advancement qualification task…
“The first is the ten-ring rapid random task, which shouldn’t be too difficult. Then comes the ‘Joyful Farmstead Seven Days Tour,'” he said.
Colin frowned slightly; it seemed he had not seen any response from “Lady Rabbit” in the letters regarding this matter…
Was this… assuming that he would be able to pass at that time, or was it too early to say anything?
Half an hour later, having not figured out anything conclusive, Colin ended his pondering. Seeing that it was late at night, he first sent a message to Qin Chuan and others, asking them to prepare some necessary items and then turned around to go back to sleep.
…
Time passed quickly, and when the next Monday noon at twelve o’clock arrived, Colin punctually heard the distant and ancient bell chimes.
Right after that, a thick fog engulfed everything in front of him…
After an inadvertent moment of haziness.
Everything started to recede again.
Colin shook his head, not yet opening his eyes, but suddenly felt an indescribable deep sea pressure.
“It seems like the pressure has gotten stronger along with my strength?” he mused.
Upon opening his eyes, he saw the interior of a hall wrapped in flames.
These flames didn’t suffocate or scorch but rather gave off an inexplicable warmth.
“Anyone here, anyone here, when is the Agent of the Bonfire coming… Ah!”
The somewhat childlike female voice mid-greeting suddenly turned into a shrill dolphin-like screech.
Just as Colin turned his head, he saw a little mermaid, no more than a ton in weight, with a stunning appearance, excitedly swooping towards him and hugging him tightly!
It had been a while since they had last seen each other; Little Tina seemed to have grown quite a bit and was noticeably larger.
“‘Bonfire’ sir, you finally came to see me!” she exclaimed.
After holding onto Colin tightly and taking a deep sniff, much like one does with a little cat, Little Tina coiled up her long serpentine lower body, stood upright, and held Colin in her arms, lifting him high like a doll.
Her eyes, clear and sparkling, stared at him as though they were glistening with light…
“Mhm, mhm, mhm…” At a loss for what to do, Colin could only smile awkwardly and nod.
The atmosphere had reached this point; he certainly couldn’t say he was there just to carry out a task, could he?
Meanwhile, on the other side, the quartet tensed up at the first sight of Tina, almost reacting instinctively, but upon seeing Brother Shunzi finally arrive, they all breathed a sigh of relief—
It seemed that this time, the mission would finally be peaceful.
“‘Bonfire’ sir, I’ve caught a lot of tasty fish and seaweed lately, I’ll take you with me to eat…” Little Tina chattered away but was cut off halfway by a majestic female voice.
“Tina!”
The figure of the Queen of the Sea Sirens appeared inside the hall. She bore a strong resemblance to Tina, equally delicate and stunning but more mature, and she was looking at her little daughter with a serious expression:
“Quickly put ‘Bonfire’ sir down, he doesn’t have time to be indulged in your antics,” she said.
“Oh, alright…”
Being one of the people Tina feared the most, the queen’s words were clearly effective; after several minutes in the air, Colin’s feet finally touched the ground again.
While wiping off the saliva that a delighted Tina had left on his cheek, Colin turned to look at the queen slithering towards him and her entourage of guards:
“Your Majesty the Queen, good afternoon…” he greeted.
“Yes, good afternoon … On behalf of Tina, I apologize for her inappropriate behavior,” the Queen of the Sea Sirens said, bowing slightly to express her apologies, while the blue crystal earrings at her ears swayed lightly, sparkling brilliantly.
“It’s no problem,” he replied.
Colin waved his hand and glanced at Tina who was by his side like a child who had done something wrong, “It’s fine, I do have a mission, but it’s not urgent, and I can take the opportunity to stroll around here. I’ve missed Tina after so many days…”
Upon hearing his words, Tina’s eyes lit up without any doubt about the truthfulness of his words, and her happy fishtail swished back and forth.
The Queen of the Sea Sirens gave a stern look to her little daughter before inviting Colin and the others to move to a more appropriate place for conversation.
Then, twisting her serpentine lower half, the Queen followed Colin and opened up, “You have come here suddenly; I presume there must be some other reasons. May I ask, is there anything that you need our help with?”
Although the “Bonfire” Agent was an outsider in a sense…
The rise of “Bonfire” had resolved the long-standing threat of their lost “humanity.” Thus, Colin’s status among the “Sea Sirens” was only higher, never lower, than their Queen.
If there was any need, they would be as helpful as possible…
“Although it’s not very urgent, but… there is something indeed…”
As Colin spoke, he retrieved the requirements of his mission from his brain.
[Event One: Before the return of this event, proceed to the Emperor Level Deepwater Battleship “Deep Sea Titan King” and participate in and complete the signing of the “Dark Deep Sea Treaty.”]
[Note: Do not make too many actions that may provoke them…]
…
‘Tsk tsk, what a domineering name for a deepwater battleship, ‘Deep Sea Titan King’…’
‘And then, the ‘Dark Deep Sea Treaty’? I wonder what sort of terms have been drafted…’
‘However, the note not to make actions that provoke them… Is it referring to those high-level containment subjects still present in ‘World Code’ 4?’
As thoughts flickered, Colin looked at the Queen and asked, “Do you know about this ‘Deep Sea Titan King’ thing?”
“Yes, it’s one of the three most powerful constructions of the Pseudo-Humans Federation, very large. I’ve heard it hosts a population in the millions…”
The Queen of the Sea Sirens said, “However, as far as we know, they did not build it themselves but discovered it within some ancient ruins…”
A battleship that could accommodate millions of people?
Colin felt that this description didn’t seem quite compatible with the word ‘battleship’, and he became curious about just how big this thing was to hold so many people.
Of course, it doesn’t take a genius to guess that such a thing is likely a creation of the “Bonfire Company.”
After giving a brief introduction of the battleship for Colin, the Queen curiously inquired, “Does ‘Bonfire’ Mister have any particular thoughts about such a thing? Are you planning to… reclaim it?”
As for what exactly “Bonfire Camp” was all about, they could only speculate.
And they knew that these people were probably the masters of those ancient ruins.
Just like the race’s sanctuary of the Sea Sirens, which is the Underwater Floating Island where they are currently residing, in all likelihood, it was constructed by them, not the Sea Sirens themselves—
Otherwise, the Queen of the Sea Sirens would be baffled thinking about why, with their body structure, they’d bother with so many stepped terraces. Climbing them always hurts the tail…
Wouldn’t filling passages with water for swimming be far more convenient than these terraces?
“No, once things are in their hands, they are theirs. I just need to handle some affairs there,” Colin responded without concealing anything, simply mentioning the task he had to perform.
“Then, can you take me with you?” Before the Queen could speak, Tina on the side blurted out eagerly, her face full of anticipation.
“If the Queen doesn’t mind, there shouldn’t be a problem,” Colin replied, kicking the decision back to Tina’s mother.
The Queen didn’t object, and after reminding her daughter to follow the rules and not to cause trouble, she agreed to the request.
Just as she was about to have someone prepare deepwater vessels to lead them to the battleship, she saw one of the Sea Sirens’ subordinates hurriedly wriggling her snake tail over.
The subordinate seemed to want to say something, but noticing Colin and others, she swallowed her words back.
“Speak up, ‘Bonfire’ Mister is not an outsider…”
Upon hearing the name “Bonfire” Mister, the Sea Siren’s eyes widened in surprise as she took another look at Colin.
Although she had heard numerous stories about how “Bonfire” Mister saved their race, this was her first time seeing him up close…
However, she did not dwell on it and said:
“…We just received a message; the ‘Deep Sea Titan King’ battleship of the Pseudo-Humans Federation is approaching, and they have requested permission to enter within a hundred sea miles of the sanctuary…”
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - 576 447 Dark Deep Sea Treaty_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 576: Chapter 447 “Dark Deep Sea Treaty”_1 Chapter 576: Chapter 447 “Dark Deep Sea Treaty”_1 “Oh, what a coincidence.”
Colin said offhand upon hearing the news.
Without much thought, he could roughly guess that this Emperor Level Deepwater Battleship was probably already on its way here before they entered…
He just didn’t know whether the elite squad that had infiltrated this place before was aboard it.
The Queen of the Sea Sirens was also somewhat surprised and turned her head to look at Colin, “Then… should we let them come over?”
This was a famously bellicose machine…
If it were normal times, they would never allow such things to enter.
After all, their relationship with the other side could not be said to be loving, it could at best be described as water and fire, not mixing.
First of all, they had some not-so-minor conflicts with those Pseudo-Humans, such as some of their kin being poached, wanting to seek revenge on the Pirates…
And it was the Federation that stepped in to prevent it and to intimidate them.
Although later, due to another “Queen of the Ocean Sirens” conducting a level of cooperation with the Federation,
the racial relations eased slightly, but not by much.Secondly, even if the relations eased, having such things approach could be dangerous; if they turned hostile, one slip could result in this place, along with its sacred ground, being taken and turned into a fish soup.
However, according to what Agent Mister said, it seemed this thing was coming because of him?
Then…
As the Queen was hesitating over her decision, she suddenly heard the Agent’s voice…
“I suggest, reject their request, let them stop outside the alert line, and we’ll go over ourselves…”
Seeing the Queen’s concern, Colin didn’t intend to make it difficult for them.
Though his visits here were few, through the intel from “Arsonist” and others, he also knew some information about this place.
He knew regardless of whether those guys had hostile intent or not, it was very inappropriate to let them through.
“Let’s do it Mister ‘Bonfire’s’ way.”
The Queen of the Sea Sirens instructed her subordinates, and after they left, she earnestly said, “Thank you for your understanding.”
“It’s nothing…”
Colin waved his hand and then said, “By the way, what’s the deal with those ‘Pseudo-Humans’? Why are they called ‘Pseudo-Humans’?”
As he spoke, he couldn’t help but think of those on Earth—
Those guys were still living like nobodies there, often a family member was about to die, they would take over the body, staging a “back from the dead” scene, taking over that body’s previous identity and so on.
Regular humans, even officials, found it difficult to spot them.
Colin wasn’t sure whether this situation was good or bad…
But for now, it seemed that because of this, families that should have fallen apart were also “revived.”
He was a bit skeptical it might be some sort of Containment Subject group that had turned over a new leaf and started a new life, but he wasn’t certain.
Yet before he could ponder further, the Queen, after listening to his words, thought for a few seconds and then said, “They have, to a certain extent, tainted their own genes. Over a long period, because of the combination with various anomalies, they are no longer so pure…”
“Tainted genes?” Colin repeated with surprise.
The Queen nodded, opened her mouth, and then, shaking her head, said, “I can’t really say much about it, but later I will accompany you there. Once you come into contact with them, you will understand what I mean.”
“Okay.”
Colin grew curious about this so-called genetic corruption, wondering how corrupted it could be for mermaids to say they’re not human.
In this regard, the group of four didn’t seem to know much; their recent missions were at most to inspect some floating “ancient” structures, and they hadn’t encountered proper humans from “World Code-4″…
All they knew was that the “Sea Sirens,” these mermaids, considered themselves to be human.
It seemed the corporation recognized this too.
Or rather, as long as any beings considered themselves human, the corporation would agree: you’re right.
They even had means to transform and assimilate a high-level lifeform into a human individual, issuing identity cards and the like, not to mention mermaids…
As for why the mermaids, who are human, have sharp teeth and fish tails along with other bodily appendages outside of common recognition, that’s not for in-depth scrutiny.
From another perspective, from their point of view, they probably had similar perplexities.
The term ‘Pseudo-Humans’ was probably related to humans not taking mermaids seriously, possibly colored by emotional reasons…
‘Of course, there could be other reasons too, seeing as the mermaids never called the Pirates ‘Pseudo-Humans’.’
But given the company’s attitude… ‘Pseudo-Humans’ should also fall within the category of humans.’
Colin mused internally, forming a rough guess.
…
Several hours later, in an open area of the ocean in front of the “Deep Sea Titan King” warship, Colin and others sat in a vessel that resembled a submarine but was obviously much more spacious, meeting up with a team sent from that warship…
Then, Colin finally saw the so-called “Pseudo-Humans”…
At a glance, aside from noting, perhaps due to environmental reasons, these people had elongated bodies with some minor differences, there didn’t seem to be anything amiss?
“Seems fine? Hmm?!”
While surprised, Colin suddenly heard… something wasn’t quite right inside these people?
First, he felt the heart, aside from the chest area, seemed to have other parts with a heartbeat-like rhythm, and in one body, there were multiple signs of life…
Nearly taking a breath, Colin could sense something akin to fungi.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 577 447 The Dark Deep Sea Treaty _2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 577: Chapter 447 “The Dark Deep Sea Treaty” _2 Chapter 577: Chapter 447 “The Dark Deep Sea Treaty” _2 Then, his eyelids drooped slightly, and his pupils changed:
“Fuck, are these things even human anymore?”
Inside the others, Colin found that his previous perception was not wrong; indeed, there was a lot of other stuff in these people’s bodies.
There were weird things, similar to parasites or fungi, nesting inside them…
And what the fuck, there was more than one kind of parasite.
Each person’s guts, lungs, bone cavities, blood vessels, even their brains housed something—be it worm-like, fungal, or some kind of peculiar bacteria—living in symbiosis…
Moreover, some of the organs that a normal human body should have were downright missing in these people.
For example, the stomach had been replaced by some strange parasitic creature.
Even some individuals had no bones at all.
‘Sss, what is this, cultivating Gu in their bodies?’
Colin scratched the back of his head; without a close look, it was okay, but once you got a close look, there was an unnervingly eerie feeling.
No wonder the mermaids called them Pseudo-Humans, this truly…
Aside from looking human, they were barely like people at all.
At this point, a Federation official who appeared to be a diplomat stepped forward, a somewhat pale smile on his face:
“Welcome, ‘Bonfire’ Agent sir, I am the Vice-Captain of the ‘King of the Deep Sea’ battleship, and the special envoy in full charge of this exchange, Chuck Howard. It’s an honor to meet you…”
With that, he turned to the employees beside Colin, extending the same courtesy.
“Yeah, it’s also a pleasure to meet you.”
Despite having a lot on his mind, Colin did not let it show on his face; at least from the other party’s words, these “people” were still capable of conversation and hadn’t become as distorted as their bodies.
Getting a response, Chuck glanced at the Queen of the Sea Sirens and bowed slightly, smiling, “Her Majesty the Queen, Queen Dollys couldn’t be here for some reasons, but she asked me to send her regards to you.”
“Okay.” The Queen of the Sea Sirens nodded. “Then please convey my regards to her as well.”
Queen Dollys was another queen of the Sea Sirens…
“Of course, I’ll remember to do that.”
Once the conversation ended, Colin spoke up, “Do you know the purpose of my visit?”
He wasn’t very used to such elaborate ceremonial meetings because he never knew what to say.
“Of course.”
Vice-Captain Howard nodded, his gaze on Colin filled with a trace of fear:
“The documents are now placed in the royal castle hall of the ‘King of the Deep Sea’, and I will lead you there to complete the contract signing…”
During the conversation, he couldn’t help but recall those barely a dozen individuals, clad in strange, heavy steel plates…
Those folks had been chasing a very dangerous creature, passing by their side, claiming something about protecting the Deep Sea people from the ‘Level 0 Containment Object ‘Hunger” persecution.
They forcefully demanded that the captain at the time, Omir, sign some document of unknown efficacy…
Such an impertinent demand, how could Omir agree? He outright ejected them.
And then…
They encountered an attack by a bizarre idol with “eighteen arms,” and most tactics had no effect on it. Omir was about to sacrifice hundreds of thousands of people to awaken the machine spirit of the ‘King of the Deep Sea’…
However, before they could act on this order, the individuals who were turned away appeared again, and on the grounds of viciously persecuting ordinary humans, enacted some special provision, sentencing the captain for anti-humanity crimes…
And then there was no ‘then’.
The captain died suddenly—one of the mightiest humans of this world inexplicably dropped dead.
Vice-Captain Howard was thus pushed to the fore.
Although he did not understand the meaning of the contract, seeing those outsiders with an attitude of changing minds or replacing people, he still signed the document, afterward being instructed to wait for a special envoy to arrive and sign to officially activate the contract.
After all this, those people left.
Howard was unclear whether he should be happy about his promotion or depressed for becoming someone else’s puppet…
But, to his shock, after some time, the Patriarch of the Heretic Races ‘Crimson Abyss’ came, stating he was signing on behalf of ‘Crimson Abyss’…
This meant… these people probably “persuaded” them with the same logic…
They even “persuaded” the ‘Crimson Abyss’!
After that, ‘Sea God Church’, ‘Separatism’, and other officials from the Holy Deep Sea Human Federation also sent delegates…
The more Howard greeted, the more horrified he became; with the pretext of “protecting the children of the Dark Sea,” those people had scoured the entire Dark Sea.
Good or bad, none escaped their grasp…
Even the mighty “Gods” might be compelled to submit.
With this in mind, his gaze toward the Agent grew ever more respectful.
“Let’s go, then.”
Colin wasn’t clear on the deputy captain’s line of thinking, but he could feel a certain fear the captain had towards him.
He could probably guess it had something to do with that special squad.
‘Well, I had wanted to impose ‘Bonfire’s’ authority a bit, but now it seems unnecessary,’ a thought flashed through his mind.
Right after he spoke up, the deputy captain, not daring to dawdle, hastily led everyone towards the main hall inside the battleship.
And as they started to approach the legendary warship that was said to station millions of people, Colin and his group could roughly make out the shape of the thing through the murky seawater…
“Wow… fuck.”
“It’s huge…”
“My goodness…”
Several employees exclaimed in awe at the sight of that object.
Through the specially reinforced thick glass of the submarine, everyone could clearly see a gigantic ship floating in the deep sea, with no end in sight…
Numerous indicator lights were flickering on it, and it was surrounded by a large number of escort vessels.
But in comparison, they were like small fish beside a blue whale.
Moreover, on that gigantic ship, one could see densely packed large gun barrels, each of which was of a caliber…
That made people involuntarily feel calm and peaceful…
The overall effect was visually striking.
Even Colin couldn’t help but take a slight breath.
Although, compared to a starship, in both theory and technology, this huge ship was no match for a starship, but…
‘Giant ships and big guns are the real romance.’
Colin mused that the things on starships were too advanced; he didn’t even know which were weapons and which were not.
The shock was far less than what was in front of him now—
It was just unknown whether those gun barrels would burst if fired in the deep water…
It was somewhat contrary to scientific knowledge.
“I guess it must be some employees who did this specially, technical redundancy, no matter what it looks like, it’s already irrelevant, just chasing the look is enough…”
Colin shook his head inwardly, and after the rendezvous ship got closer, he saw many temple-like buildings fixed on the battleship.
They looked somewhat like barnacles on a large whale…
And at the very top of the “King of the Deep Sea Battleship,” they saw a castle encased in bubbles, inlaid with a multitude of colored gems that twinkled under the light, which could be described as luxurious.
When Colin arrived, he immediately saw a large group of humans of various forms who had been waiting for a long time.
Among them were even the powerhouses from the “Crimson Abyss.”
But this time, it seemed they bore no hostility but rather had unnerving smiles on their faces, holding a document in their hands, awaiting his arrival…
With an explanation from Deputy Captain Howard, he also understood the purpose of these people being here.
‘It’s a pity, that squad seems not to be here.’
Colin scanned the scene.
Then, surrounded by a crowd, he walked into the great hall, and after sitting down, received the original “Dark Deep Sea Treaty” contract handed to him by the deputy captain.
After skimming through it quickly, Colin roughly understood the contents…
“…When ‘0-0’ ‘Hunger’ appears… all forces have an obligation to cooperate with ‘Bonfire Company (Bonfire Camp Special Item Containment Company)’s extermination operation, and allow the invocation of ‘Dark Sea World (World Code -4)’ world jurisdiction…”
At first glance, it seemed like it was just about gaining some sort of right of passage…
It didn’t seem all that special, did it?
Colin felt there must be more to it, took out the Golden Mark Shana had given him to boost his brainpower, and spent some time quickly glancing over the contract, which was about as thick as a fist.
In the midst of it, he noticed a detail that didn’t stand out much.
“In special circumstances, the company can mobilize over seventy percent of the world’s water resources…”
“What do they need water resources for?”
Colin suddenly thought of Lady Bunny’s request.
Ah, this…
They couldn’t be planning to flood Earth, could they?
At that moment, he had the absurd feeling that, to avoid doomsday, they were ready to destroy the world first.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 578 448 Lady Rabbits Crazy Plan._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 578: Chapter 448 “Lady Rabbit”‘s Crazy Plan._1 Chapter 578: Chapter 448 “Lady Rabbit”‘s Crazy Plan._1 “…No wonder ‘Miss Bunny’ was so certain…this…”
Colin muttered to himself, holding the contract imbued with special efficacy.
If it was really as he had surmised…
Then it would explain why the other party could prepare things like shipbuilding in advance.
It seems…
This damned “Deep Sea Era” was brought about by them!
And from what he could see at present, everything was already in place; as soon as he signed his name, entering the Deep Sea Era was inevitable.
“However, why would they do this?”
Colin didn’t rush to sign. Under everyone’s gaze, he flipped through the contract while pondering.
With “Lady Rabbit’s” usual habits, it was unlikely that she’d seriously embrace a bizarre idea like “to avoid the end of the world, let’s destroy it first”…
Since they had taken this action, there had to be a reason.
As thoughts flickered, Colin suddenly thought of something.
‘Are they planning to draw from the situation of “The Seventh Box Garden World”? If an apocalypse erupts in the future, then use the ocean to drag everything into the depths to suppress…’
Colin recalled some behind-the-scenes events related to the “The Seventh Box Garden World.”
“Father of the Ocean” was at risk of having his divine power source plundered; during that period, the sea engulfed the land due to the uncontrollable might of his authority, and later, as he was dying, he made the waters recede back into the ocean, taking with him a multitude of anomalies, sealing them in the Deep Sea.
“Lady Rabbit” seemed to be planning to do the same?
“Isn’t this…playing with stakes a bit too high?”
Just thinking about it made Colin’s scalp tingle.
However, unlike the passive situation of the “Father of the Ocean,” this seemed to be a proactive move.
There should be considerable room to maneuver…
The only uncertainty was whether submerging “anomalies” in water was really useful?
“It seems that many such things aren’t afraid of seawater at all. Or is it that, at that time, the water will be mixed with some potent substance?”
“Right, there’s still an egg or a chicken in my mind that I reckon will be important later… Hm.”
“Earlier on, I didn’t see ‘Lady Rabbit’ proposing any ideas about building massive ships. This suggests that the corresponding preparations were likely made after my return from ‘The Seventh Box Garden World.’
