A wait was still needed, to snatch what he desired from among the crowd of jackals and leopards.
Meanwhile, just as Shana paused momentarily, she suddenly felt a strong sense of crisis approaching and immediately blinked away, dodging…
“Whoosh.”
A cold gleam flashed by…
In an instant, Shana’s left hand was severed from her arm, and blood spurted out.
But simultaneously, she caught a glimpse of the assailant – a knight wrapped in black armor, entwined with numerous cloth strips, and a crown on his head bearing four diamond shapes…

chapters.title: Chapter 590 - 590 453 0-09 Hunger and Light._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 590: Chapter 453 “0-09 ‘Hunger'” and “Light”._2 Chapter 590: Chapter 453 “0-09 ‘Hunger'” and “Light”._2 “Virtue Knight of the four virtues… Evil Spirit.”
When Shana saw it, her brain flickered with a related memory at breakneck speed.
Decades before she was born, there had been a Virtue Knight of immense talent, who had acquired all four virtues., who, during a certain attack, was killed by an unknown heretic force.
The incident caused quite a stir.
Unfortunately, no matter how many forces The Kingdom of Knights dispatched, they couldn’t find the enemy.
They couldn’t even reclaim the body.
Rumors circulated in certain black markets that the organs of this knight were being sold as magic materials…
Unexpectedly, she had now encountered it.
And it seemed to have been refined into some sort of Evil Spirit puppet.
Its organs were clearly hollowed out and filled with a large amount of mystical materials to ensure its combat power and characteristics remained.
She felt acute pain looming over it.
In Shana’s eyes, which gleamed with a white light, a hint of sadness was evident…
Both for the knight and for every same-species enemy she faced in the ongoing siege—
“Disaster of Magic Fog” had already enveloped the entire world.
Yet people still couldn’t come together to fight against the future…
And while she pondered, the knight’s figure vanished again, and its presence greatly weakened.
However…
This was meaningless to her.
In front of her, once discovered, it could no longer hide; she could clearly see that puppet, eerily approaching, and trying to drag her into some sort of “fair and just” one-on-one battle.
Nevertheless, Shana did not move but swept her right hand and caught her still-warm severed hand before it hit the ground.
Then she turned her gaze toward an area that seemed to be empty.
Suddenly mimicking the motion of throwing a javelin, she launched the severed hand in an instant…
During this process, her left hand emitted a strong light, stretched, elongated, and ultimately transformed into a spear the moment she let go.
After the flash of light…
A figure was directly impaled in a cave dozens of kilometers away, dying instantly after being pierced.
At the same time, the Evil Spirit puppet advancing upon Shana also halted its movement…
However, she didn’t let her guard down because of it.
For the uncontrolled knight puppet, following a brief pause, its shadow suddenly spread and then began to move again as if it was once more under someone’s control.
Yet, at the same time, Shana’s figure flashed and she appeared right in front of the Evil Spirit puppet.
Her not-too-large right hand grasped its face…
Beams of light flowed along her arm and into the Evil Spirit puppet.
Immediately…
The seemingly about-to-revive Evil Spirit fell to the ground, completely incapacitated.
“Aaaaah!!!”
Screams emanated from beneath the shadows of the Evil Spirit.
The shadows, which had infested it at some unknown time, quickly detached from the Evil Spirit and rose as many figures standing on the ground.
To Shana, this was not surprising; her icy blue eyes emotionlessly swept across the group called “Shadow Treant Mother,” or rather, those who professed to be the “Tree of True Knowledge” followers…
At her left arm’s broken section, clusters of light particles gathered to form a new hand.
Ahead, the heretic followers suppressed their emotions, their expressions instantly turning devoted and fanatical as they collectively spoke out…
“You are now so weak that you can’t even reveal your Mythic Form…”
“The ‘Tree’ has given me a revelation, and out of pity, it allows me to inform you, that now you have one last opportunity to offer your eyes as a sacrifice to us…”
“Then we will not only spare you but also assist you in escaping this place…”
“You must understand, your current state is nearly a dead end; choosing us is your only chance.”
“This is the benevolent expression of a great existence; I hope you will appreciate His goodwill, you cannot refuse…”
“…”
Before all intentions could be fully conveyed, a chaos of dense beams shot across and all the figures were instantly shredded into myriad fragments.
Shana didn’t even consider the unrealistic demands made by these heretic forces.
After dealing with the group, she took a step forward, intending to move but felt an intense pain throughout her body.
Blood uncontrollably trickled down…
In that short hesitation, she saw a mountainous situation break through the fog and smash towards her.
“Boom!”
The earth trembled, dust billowed into the sky, numerous explosions occurred, and fissures spread across the ground…
Amidst all this, streams of light flew out and formed into Shana’s luminous figure.
“Join us, submit to us, open that sealed door…” Another group of heretic forces appeared, each of them large in stature; the tallest was even over eight meters tall, with whitened hair despite an old visage, their bodies rippling with muscles and exuding powerful auras.
“War God Cult, it seems you’ve chosen to betray the Alliance Covenant. Is your action prompted by your Patriarch’s signal?”
Shana looked up at the towering man, her facial expression unchanged, but she rarely spoke out.
“Patriarch? No, your elder is too weak to be fit to lead the cult. Besides, the so-called War God they worship is nothing but a false deity, a man-made false god that responds like a machine, similar to those devout to other churches’ gods…”
“But us, once we rescue the true War God, everyone will understand the truth…”
“All the churches will realize that what they worship now is merely a false god! The real God is suffering behind that sealed door right now…”

chapters.title: Chapter 591 - 591 453 0-09 Hunger and Light._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 591: Chapter 453 “0-09 ‘Hunger'” and “Light”._3 Chapter 591: Chapter 453 “0-09 ‘Hunger'” and “Light”._3 Standing at a height of eight meters, the white-haired old man, resembling a giant, boomed like thunder, but he suddenly realized something was amiss mid-sentence.
He lifted the greatsword, which was even larger and heavier than his body, and swung it down toward his opponent…
However, “Shana” did not move from her spot and after being struck by the greatsword, she simply dispersed and disappeared—
It was nothing more than a false visual illusion!
Deceived, his body turned red with His veins bulging, he entered a state of furious rage.
…
Shana paid little attention to that group of physically strong but simple-minded members of the War God Cult who had betrayed their own.
After covering a considerable distance from this place and suffering several rounds of intense attacks, she suddenly exited her light-shadow state as if out of strength…
She plummeted to the ground like a crashing plane, tumbling over a dozen times upon impact.
Then, Shana stood up, covered in dust and disheveled, with some difficulty. Her first course of action was to stretch out her hand and pluck the short sword, which was embedded in her neck and cursed, straight out.
Before the various attacks, both overt and covert, could arrive, she repelled them all.
However, it seemed she was too exhausted to enter her light form again to flee from this place…
And with just her normal physical speed, there was absolutely no chance of escaping.
…
“The time has finally come, it’s time to make our move,”
Far away, a group of people dressed in red clothes saw this scene and immediately stopped hesitating. They inserted their hands into their navels and with a forceful yank to both sides…
There was a ‘whoosh’ as a vertical slit tore open in their stomachs.
And from the slit poured out thick mists of green-black smoke, which merged together in mid-air…
Turning into a somewhat transparent, green-black hand with a stone-like texture, and a mouth where the palm should be.
And just as it appeared…
Everything within the area fell suddenly quiet.
A terrifying pressure swept over the entire field…
Whether they were out in the open or hidden from view, even those members of the War God Church who had just caught up, their bodies red with blood rage, stopped in their tracks and calmed down upon seeing this not-so-large arm…
Even feeling a bit of ‘Hunger.’
Almost everyone was acutely aware that this… was not something they could easily confront.
“‘Hunger’…”
Shana looked at this entity and immediately recalled the horrifying oppressive sensation she had felt around Helena.
She also remembered some related information she had learned during her exchange with Colin.
Simultaneously, she knew that the most dangerous group lurking behind the pursuit had finally made their move.
“Clang clang clang…”
The green-black hand, akin to a stone sculpture, began to move.
This sculpture differed slightly from the one Colin had encountered; it had numerous mysterious chains and yellow Talisman Paper seals on it.
Clearly, it was under some sort of strong restrictive state.
Yet, even so, the strength it demonstrated still caused everyone present to feel frightened.
Some even felt desperate, thinking that they stood no chance of claiming the fruits of victory in the presence of this terrifying entity…
However, paying no heed to their thoughts, the “Hunger” arm did not linger long after appearing and immediately reached out for Shana…
Its speed seemed slow, yet it seemed to ignore spatial distances.
Even Shana couldn’t help but feel somewhat suffocated as she watched the large hand open its mouth and reach for her.
But…
Before the green-black hand could grasp her.
All the attacks that were originally aimed at her fell upon the hand instead.
“Stop Him! We cannot allow these Outer Gods to infringe on our interests! The Saint is ours!”
“It’s the result of our hard work; we cannot allow outsiders to take it away!”
A Mental Shock roared out from some Heretic Force, calling everyone to unite.
In an instant, even more power was unleashed against the green-black arm.
But at the same time…
The green-black arm, still reaching for its target, sprouted countless mouths of varying sizes. Like pores on an arm, these densely packed mouths opened and immediately spewed out vast amounts of green-black mist.
Everything that came into contact with this mist rapidly dissolved and disappeared, as if it were corroding in strong acid…
Like digestive juices, they devoured all incoming strikes.
Then, while withstanding these assaults, the arm stretched out, reaching for that ball of light.
After crushing the obstructing barrier of light, it opened its gaping maw to swallow up the exhausted light figure, ready to consume all the surrounding space within several kilometers into its belly…
A flash of intense light surged within Shana’s eyes.
However, just as she prepared to stop hiding and fight with all she had, she suddenly felt the temperature around her skyrocket.
It was a familiar sensation…
Then, to her amazement,
A bright orange-red fireball descended from the sky.
.
.
.
ps: Update first, revise later.

chapters.title: Chapter 592 - 592 454 Shana So Fragrant Give It a Lick..._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 592: Chapter 454 Shana, So Fragrant, Give It a Lick…_1 Chapter 592: Chapter 454 Shana, So Fragrant, Give It a Lick…_1 “Boom~”
The moment the fireball hit the ground, a scorching torrent of flames exploded violently, accompanied by deafening blasts. Countless rocks and boulders were hurled into the air, spreading rapidly in all directions along with the high-heat shockwaves.
Wherever the crimson flames passed, everything within several kilometers ignited.
The ashen hues of the Magic Fog churned like fiery clouds, ravaging…
The numerous nearby figures with insufficient strength didn’t even have the chance to scream before they were pulverized by the terrifying force of the explosion, while many of the farther enemies were set ablaze, screaming in agony.
A few, although not killed instantly, sustained injuries varying from light to severe, with parts of their bodies that barely touched the flames completely carbonizing.
Even the once-invulnerable dark “Hunger” hands, which could nearly ignore all attacks, had to retract.
Just before the onslaught arrived, Shana suddenly perceived something appearing behind her.
She was about to reflexively snap the neck of whoever it was and kill them with a single blow.
But just as this thought crossed her mind, after noticing the newcomer, she restrained herself from acting.
The next second, her vision shifted as she was scooped up around her waist by the newcomer.
Shana’s face, which had remained indifferent even when directly facing “Hunger”, showed a clear moment of astonishment when she saw Colin.
This… How did this Agent of the Bonfire appear here?
He couldn’t possibly have come specifically to rescue her, could he?
Shana had helped many people and rescued many others, but someone coming to save her…
This was a first for her.
All the major powers, whether kingdoms or the Church, had a poor attitude toward her due to historical reasons; by the time they acted, she had usually already resolved the situation herself.
So… this feeling of being saved by someone was indescribable.
As a result…
She wasn’t entirely sure whether Colin had come here for some other purpose or specifically for her.
If he did come specifically…
In a moment, feeling the continuous warmth emanating from his body, Shana, while enjoying the warmth, also felt a sense of unreality.
And there was a little bit of embarrassment…
However, before she had a chance to ask, the surging flames had already enveloped the entire place.
Amidst the roaring flames…
It momentarily became “quiet” here.
“The effect is not bad…”
Colin, using Flame Perception, confirmed that virtually all of the weaker enemies within a one-kilometer radius had been incinerated.
The enemies beyond one kilometer were also having a tough time.
It wasn’t in vain that he used nearly one-third of his fuel in one go to create this explosion.
‘I’ll have to check out the nuclear warheads later. If I get stronger, with adequate preparation, I might be able to throw this thing right in their faces…’
As thoughts raced, Colin didn’t just stand there doing nothing.
During the first wave of flame spread that cleared the area, he scooped up Shana and ran, with no time to worry about the wounds on her body—
On this journey, as an “observer,” Colin saw way too many enemies.
And not to mention their considerable strength, most had some kind of God-given items, making them quite troublesome…
However…
‘Is this Holy Woman really her? She’s so light… even lighter than Little Red. Holding her feels like it’s all bones with not a bit of flesh.’
Colin carried Shana and suddenly pondered.
If it weren’t for her ample garments, she would probably feel like a mere skeleton to the touch…
As for her appearance, with her face covered in bloodstains and dirt, aside from knowing she must not be ugly and that her eyes were beautiful, he couldn’t discern anything else.
It was hard to believe that this was the woman who rubbed against him every day.
But regardless, after a half day of fear and trepidation, seeing a living person and successfully rescuing her from a crowd of enemies also brought him a sigh of relief.
Of course, they hadn’t completely escaped yet…
What followed was a predictable onslaught of massive enemies determined to hunt him down like mad.
The intensity of the battle was about to spike…
“Damn it, someone got her!”
“We were careless…”
“Stop him! Don’t let him take our prize alone!”
“Why isn’t the Holy Woman resisting and just letting herself be taken away?”
“What’s the deal with this guy? A follower of the ‘Eternal Flame’? No, that seems not right…”
…
In the moment Colin broke away, a large number of enemies immediately realized the situation. Not everyone here recognized the Bonfire, and at first, they all thought the Saintess had been captured, but soon noticed…
She didn’t seem like someone who was being taken against her will…
‘What’s this about someone getting their hands on her, as if grabbing an item? That’s quite a vulgar way to put it.’
Colin had just broken through when he saw a multitude of enemies chasing after him.
At the same time, he was bombarded with various propositions and offers…
“Given the situation here, it’s impossible for you to escape. How about this… I only need her right arm, just agree, and we can collaborate…”
“My Master will not only assist you two in escaping but will also allow you to become a distinguished guest of our sect, promising you one chance for help.”
“And you can distribute the rest of her as you see fit, however you choose to enjoy it…”
…
“Give us a pair of eyes, and we will compensate you with a Holy Relic bestowed by the True God…”
…
“That Outer God from the ‘Feast of Devouring’ has entered the fray, agree to the deal, get our help, and you’ll have a chance to claim your share. Otherwise, nobody gets anything…”
…
“I…”
…
“Damn it, you all treating this like divvying up a piece of pork?!”
Colin couldn’t help but curse under his breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 593 - 593 454 Shana So Fragrant Give It a Lick..._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 593: Chapter 454 Shana, So Fragrant, Give It a Lick…_2 Chapter 593: Chapter 454 Shana, So Fragrant, Give It a Lick…_2 The most crucial part is that these “voices” weren’t even whispered, even Shana, who he held in his arms, could hear them.
Their hearts were truly despicable!
At the same time, he couldn’t help but glance at Shana and just happened to see, beneath her pale golden hair—covered in a great deal of dust and blood—a somewhat disheveled face with a pair of ice-blue, lucid eyes staring at him.
There was no discernible emotion, but it seemed as though she was contemplating something?
“I…” Colin was about to speak.
“Don’t pay attention to them, don’t get distracted,”
Shana nestled in Colin’s arms, motionless as usual, her instructing voice brushed through Colin’s heart.
After a pause, she added, “I believe in you, thank you.”
And at the same time, some organized “inspiration” about this place unfolded neatly in Colin’s mind.
Through this information, Colin quickly understood the situation of some of the heretics on the scene.
“Hmm.”
Colin inexplicably breathed a sigh of relief; this was the first time he truly met this Saint, although the timing wasn’t great.
It was then that he suddenly saw a thick shadow thrusting out from the ground…
On it was the aura of a High Order Containment Subject…
“What kind of ghostly thing is this.”
Colin’s brow twitched, his left eye sparked with flame, and in an instant, he ignited the shadow.
Ignoring the screams that came from the thing…
Next, he stamped powerfully on the ground.
With a boom.
The ground around him shattered, and another burst of flame erupted, spreading outwards.
“Aaaaaah!”
Some who had just approached using various methods were directly reduced to ashes under the cover of the flames…
Colin, carrying the flames, shot out like a meteor.
While Shana, taking advantage of this rare safe period, quickly stabilized her internal injuries, but also grew increasingly curious about something…
Mr. Colin—did he really, just for her sake, sneak into such a dangerous place?
…
“Just stopped for a moment and the enemies are becoming more numerous. They saw me succeed, oh no, saw me rescue someone, and some others thinking of the mantis stalking the cicada with the oriole behind are getting restless…”
Colin wasn’t clear about Shana’s thoughts, his mind racing as he pondered a retreat path.
Currently, there were two directions for retreat: one was to directly break through the encirclement, carrying Shana and crossing the “Disaster of Magic Fog” back to his territory…
The other option was to return to the underground labyrinth they had just emerged from, use the “King of Madness”‘s authority to leave the encirclement of the “Disaster of Magic Fog,” and go directly back to his territory.
And once he returned, the local forces, whether they liked it or not, would have to take action.
Only, both plans were not particularly secure.
The first—if he attempted to execute it, the pressure and difficulty would be extremely, extremely high…
Aside from being surrounded by the enemy all the way, he also had to face various derivatives of the “Disaster of Magic Fog.”
As for the second…
Given the “King of Madness”‘s temperament,
Colin couldn’t predict whether it would continue to help or if it would just sell him out upon seeing so many enemies…
‘Why didn’t I make it a character that’s one hundred percent reliable and honest when I first shaped its personality?’
He couldn’t help but complain to himself.
However, in choosing which side to take, Colin didn’t hesitate much.
He decided to trust the “King of Madness” for once!
Just then, a fatal sense of crisis emerged in Colin’s heart. His first thought was that “Hunger” had returned, but as the inspired images surfaced, he realized it wasn’t—
A huge boulder, carried by the might of the heavy sound explosions, smashed through the firewall and struck him from mid-air, crashing him to the ground.
…
“What kind of rock is this vicious?”
As Colin’s thoughts whirled, his figure flashed, appearing dozens of meters away.
However, the sense of crisis unexpectedly did not diminish—
This several hundred-ton boulder even had targeting capabilities!
No space left to dodge, Colin let go of Shana, a pair of silver Nano Intellectual Arms extended from his body to take over the task, then his left hand pulled out a Golden Card…
“Force Repulsion!”
An invisible Charge Blast erupted, the huge stone directly flung away under the influence of higher dimensional rules.
At the same time, a giant over eight meters tall with a surging aura, brandishing a great sword, descended from the sky, chopping down forcefully.
The giant vaguely sensed that the opponent was unlikely to be able to use similar powers consecutively…
Large amounts of dust flew up under the heavy blow.
But, the next second, the enemy in front of him suddenly vanished, his pupils constricted, and his colossal body froze in place.
“What… happened?”
Before the words fell, his vision skewed, and his head hit the ground.
Blood spurted hundreds of meters into the sky…
However, this mere decapitation was not fatal; his headless body stretched out a hand, picked up the head, and reattached it.
…
‘They sure are tough, one by one.’
Colin did not turn back, but through the flames, he roughly knew what was happening behind him.
However, this was not surprising, as those who came to partake in the hunt in the depths of the Disaster of Magic Fog were all elites; killing them easily was not an option.
Moreover, he couldn’t afford to kill every attacking enemy.
Because the situation was such that a slight misstep or pause might lead to being surrounded…
Once encircled, even he would not be in a good position.
‘And where has “Hunger” run off to now?’
Colin kicked away a charging Heretic Believer of some unknown faith.
He had a vague feeling that something was not quite right…
That thing hadn’t shown up again after he repelled it half an hour ago.
With his understanding of the creature, it was not one to easily give up on a “delicious meal”…
“Be careful of what’s above…” Shana’s voice came through.
Heeding the warning, Colin also noticed a dark blue palm with a mouth descending from the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - 594 454 Shana So Fragrant Give It a Lick..._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 594: Chapter 454 Shana, So Fragrant, Give It a Lick…_3 Chapter 594: Chapter 454 Shana, So Fragrant, Give It a Lick…_3 He was just about to dodge when he saw that the palm strike didn’t fall. Instead, it exploded in mid-air, and immediately after, a faint layer of cyan-black fog wall materialized within a large area.
“Hiss…”
Colin’s scalp tightened. As ‘0-09’ “Hunger” pillar, the company-designated “Hunger” human form, he had a deep understanding of “Hunger” and knew this was the activation of the “Stomach Wall” ability of “Hunger”.
Back in the Deep Sea, he had also used this tactic when he manipulated “Hunger”…
He knew it was a means to blockade the spatial area, conceptually enclosing the entire region within its “stomach”.
To break through the “Stomach Wall” was not an easy task…
Colin, who was within it, also felt a tremendous amount of pressure applied to him.
The flames appeared to be somewhat “digested”…
However, at the same time, a strong sense of hunger surged from within his stomach, accompanied by countless whispers.
“Release my bonds, open the cage of my body, let me consume it…”
“So fragrant… Eat it, eat it!”
“Eat eat eat eat!”
“Fragrant…”
“Release me, let me eat it!”
“Only I can confront ‘me’, hurry…”
“…”
Colin’s inner self fiercely desired another fragment of “Hunger”.
He, no, it instinctively yearned to be more complete.
Under the potent influence of “Hunger,” he even felt that the one he was holding in his arms…
Suddenly smelled delicious.
He really wanted to lick it…
He really wanted to bite it…
He really wanted to taste it…
“Shana, so cute, I want to eat one…”
“No no no no…”
Colin’s eyes blazed with fire, suppressing his desire, struggling against it, his expression involuntarily becoming dazed.
Shana seemed to sense something, decisively wriggling free from his embrace, with cold blue pupils sweeping over him, and then she stretched out her hand, placing it on his stomach around his navel. Waves of white light emerged, turning into chains and pouring into him.
But during this delay, numerous enemies arrived almost at the same time.
“Kill him!”
“I have confirmed it, this man is an emissary of the Outer God!”
“We cannot allow these outsiders to run rampant like this!”
“…”
They had abandoned all illusions and resolved to fight to the end…
Shana frowned, enduring pain as if being sliced all over her body, creating a shadow of light to help Colin soothe his form, then she turned around to face the approaching offenders…
Now, all the enemies due to appear had done so.
It was time to settle this once and for all…
But just then, Colin’s shoulder suddenly felt heavy, followed by his eyes regaining their clarity.
Shana opened her mouth as if to say something, but Colin spoke first.
“Let me do it, you stay by my side, so you won’t be hurt by mistake…”
Colin stepped forward and saw that the leaders of the charge were a group of warriors as tall as small hills.
“If you insist on courting death, then don’t blame me… ‘Fire God Embodiment’!”
Colin took out a small box, his consciousness connecting with the object inside.
The very next moment!
Everyone stopped their actions, slowly lifted their heads, and watched in shock at the sight before them…
A fierce torrent of heat violently erupted upwards, transforming into a Flame Giant several hundred meters tall and still rising, with its magnificent presence rippling in all directions.
Clang clang clang…
Assaults from all directions, various types of attacks hit the giant, and they couldn’t even breach its outer layer.
At that moment, the Flame Giant with one hand against the sky, resisted the descending cyan-black “Stomach Wall”, taking a step forward…
Splat.
Bearing a gigantic sword, towering several meters high, the frontmost group of War God Cult believers instantly burst into countless exploding fragments.

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - 595 455 Expel all the Outer Gods leave none
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 595: Chapter 455 Expel all the Outer Gods, leave none behind!_1 Chapter 595: Chapter 455 Expel all the Outer Gods, leave none behind!_1 After repelling the first wave of attack, Colin didn’t pursue further, instead standing his ground.
The “Fire God Embodiment” attached to him also stood motionless…
All actions of the disposable trump card given to him by Old Master Wu must be driven by his will.
However, that’s not to say it can’t be released to act on its own.
But the official technology isn’t quite up to snuff…
It’s like launching a satellite, easy to send off, but a bit difficult to retrieve.
At least they hadn’t solved this issue yet.
So, it’s just a one-time-use high-end product made with the “Divine Strike” concept in mind.
“Hungry…”
Colin clutched his stomach, not taking any further action.
Admittedly, before he came here, when he saw the followers of “Gluttonous Feast,” he had a premonition that he would confront this hard-to-find “Hunger” fragment hidden in “World Code-13″…
At that time, he thought he should be able to cope with it, but upon the actual encounter.
Colin found it somewhat difficult.
Not just the unknown size of the fragment outside, but also the one inside him; both were not exactly settled.
The one outside, trapped and not attacking, seemed to want others to make a move, or perhaps it was an influence from afar, trying to force out the “Hunger” within him, bit by bit, to consume…
The one inside, while clamoring “Let me out” and the like, kept screaming “Hungry”.
Colin, caught in the middle, was in quite a dilemma.
The intense desire to feed, akin to a poison, coursed through his veins, demanding constant suppression.
Otherwise, he might accidentally smother Shana beside him in a moment of carelessness.
“I need to slow down a bit…”
Colin glanced at the intensity of the “Fire God Embodiment,” took a deep breath, and assured himself that the enemy couldn’t breach this defense in the short term, so he immediately dived into his mind to address the internal crisis.
But at this moment…
Seeing his followers crushed after a failed assault…
The eight-meter-tall “War God” follower became enraged!
“You deserve to die!”
His face reddened with fury, he gathered his strength, dragging his heavy sword and delivering a powerful slash on the terrifying fiery apparition.
“Bang!”
The eight-meter stature, imposing among humans, was insignificant before this towering Flame Giant.
Barely reaching its ankle…
And as soon as he leapt up, he felt a strong laser flash into his eyes…
Afterward…
Taking advantage of the opportunity the Saintess created, Colin casually waved his hand and sent him flying without much effort.
With a boom, he landed heavily on the rocky soil.
“Damn it!”
He struggled to his feet, eyeing the formidable Outer God’s Messenger before him, and looking at Shana, who’d been tricked to stand beside the being, his face showed a look of unwillingness.
They were so close, just a little more, and they might have succeeded.
In freeing the tormented gods…
But to his surprise, at this critical moment, not one but several Outer Gods intervened.
What he didn’t expect was that Shana, the Saint, would actually join forces with an Outer God’s Messenger.
Didn’t she realize how dangerous this was?
At this moment, he tried to rise but felt weak and in pain all over.
“No… I can’t fall here, for the Dawn of the Gods must be ushered in by us.”
The “War God” follower murmured to himself, feeling an invisible force infuse his body…
This power reignited his will to battle.
At the same time, memories from his past flashed through his mind.
He remembered joining the War God Temple as a young man, recalled every prayer before the War God statue, and one day realizing something wasn’t quite right…
The responses from the “War God” were very… mechanical, as if forced.
Afterward, upon contact with some Heretic Forces and uncovering some truths, he returned to the temple only to indeed hear the “War God’s” agonized wails…
He began to understand everything!
Why for centuries, the Great Will no longer responded to mortals.
Because of the conspiracy of the “Holy Light Cathedral,” the gods had been trapped outside space by the “Light.”
Originally, once defeated, the gods should have returned.
But some despicably greedy humans didn’t want that, seeking even greater power, they bound the gods…
God… was pleading for his help!
Initially, he sought out the Saintess’s elder, whom he deemed a loyal “War God” Believer, the Prelate of the Church, hoping for help with his revelation, but…
The Prelate, even with his knowledge, remained skeptical and didn’t assist him.
Their disagreement soared into a fierce argument, and he eventually chose to defect.
To the outside world, this was unknown; otherwise, the Saintess wouldn’t have asked whether he had approval.
Of course, he didn’t see himself as a traitor.
After leaving, he took his followers and joined the “Dawn of the Gods,” an unrecognized organization striving for the liberation of the gods.
They realized after much effort that to free the gods and bring back the dawn, they had to obtain something from the Saintess…
Even if doing so would lead to the death of a talented junior he regarded as a niece and had once doted upon.
Yet…
He had no choice but to act.
For the Great Will to descend once more, for the world to receive the guidance and protection of the True Gods.
Despite the overwhelming pain of staining his hands with the blood of a loved one…
He still had to do it!
“Let me bear all the sins!”
The “War God” follower’s emotions surged, his fighting spirit soared, and a majestic force from an unknown source descended upon him, crafting a set of golden, splendid sacred armor on his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - 596 455
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 596: 455 Chapter 596: 455 …
“What’s happening here?”
Colin, although most of his energy was still focused on dealing with “Hunger,” also had to fend off various enemies, so he could sense a powerful aura erupting ahead.
It seemed that the person who caused the eruption was the same one he had just swatted away.
He just didn’t know why it had suddenly erupted…
“He’s connecting with some dangerous entity… to achieve an effect similar to ‘God Descent.’
Shana glanced at the former Church believer and roughly figured out what he was trying to do.
As for the pain or whatever the believer was thinking about, she didn’t know, nor did she particularly care…
Even though some elders told her that he was an uncle with no blood relation to her.
But, she had no real memory of him.
After all, who would remember things so clearly from when they were two or three years old?
Especially since this “uncle” had been put on ice by the Church over a decade ago, no longer mentioned.
“‘God Descent’?”
Colin’s eyebrows twitched. This child was terrifyingly powerful and must not be left alive!
Ordinarily, he was not afraid of any “God Descent.”
But the situation was special now, showing signs of danger, and it was best to snuff it out as early as possible.
Immediately, his thoughts whirred into action and his immense embodiment also moved, launching a fist towards the figure erupting in a cosmic burst.
However, just as the fist was about to fall…
Some figures rushed out, wielding lightning, fierce winds, and many other magics, with the resolution to sacrifice themselves, they met the attack.
“Friend, I understand your determination, let me help you!”
“We won’t let you disrupt our hope!”
“The gods shall be liberated!”
“People are ignorant, but a thousand years from now, they will understand our efforts!”
“…”
In the massive collision, over a dozen figures shouting loudly were incinerated by flames.
Seeing this, the “War God” followers’ eyes split with rage, and their fighting spirit climbed even higher.
At this moment, as his armor finished congealing, his form, though still not as towering as the divine embodiment, was already sufficiently intimidating in presence.
“I will not let your efforts and sacrifices be in vain!”
The “War God” follower beckoned with his hand, and the mightiest longsword that seemed capable of slicing through everything in the world coalesced into his hand…
“I shall fight for the salvation of humankind, I shall liberate the gods, bring about the dawn, and drive out all Outer Gods, without leaving a single one!”
“Outer God’s Messenger, taste the wrath and counterattack of this world!”
The “War God” follower did not speak, but his powerful will loomed over heaven and earth as if it was tangible.
He had reached his ultimate limit, his condition a hundred or even a thousand times greater than ever before!
He took a step forward, his fighting spirit ablaze, like flames, swinging his great sword at the Outer God’s Messenger coveting this world.
“Charge with me!”
Hurtling forth as a streak of light, engulfed in an unstoppable momentum, the great sword came crashing down with a heavy blow.
The immense embodiment’s fist shattered upon impact.
He stormed through like a juggernaut, continuing to charge towards Colin’s chest.
At this moment, he—or rather, they—their target was no longer just the Outer God’s Messenger before them but also to cleave through the darkness clouding this world, to forge the path to a glorious future!
With the determination of humankind to never bow before unknown terror, even in the face of death!
“Damn it…” Some people stood far off, doubting whether Colin could withstand this decisive strike filled with resolution.
If the other side got there first, it wouldn’t be good.
But, some people stayed motionless as if they had received some message and were not in a hurry to move.
However…
At that very moment, the two sides finally collided directly.
“Bang!”
Colin first shielded Shana behind him, then suppressed the sensation of “Hunger” again, before generously deploying his various abilities.
“Tick, tick, tick…”
In the sound of invisible clock hands moving…
Colin’s strength gathered in his fist, between his index and middle finger, a bone spur hidden, and then he threw it out, sending the eight-meter-tall man in golden armor flying with a punch.
Directly inflicting severe injuries and rendering him semi-unconscious, embedded in the ground, his body convulsing ceaselessly.
The heavy great sword lay discarded to the side…
The actual energy-formed golden armor dimmed and dispersed.
“Damn it, just this? I really thought there was something lurking, gave me quite the fright.”
Colin couldn’t help but curse under his breath, feeling utterly shortchanged after all this trouble for such a meager result.
Wary of an accident, he had used many skills…
Only to find out after throwing a punch that despite stacking buffs for ages, all it did was make his voice louder and his physical form a bit more resilient, able to withstand his punch.
Everything else was below par…
In other words, he possessed a constitution that surpassed quite a number of Level 2 Containment Subjects but had no substance.
Now, recalling this guy’s rambling, Colin almost thought he had returned to Earth.
In his hometown, he had seen more than enough of these acts done supposedly for the world’s good but actually involved summoning evil deities.
Only, he hadn’t expected to find such a “specialty” outside of Earth.
“Isn’t your political commissar, the one who ‘guides your thoughts’, all one and the same person?”
Colin’s expression turned slightly odd.
“By the way, did I just sense that he has some… other ideas about you?” Colin communicated directly with Shana in the form of an “inspiration.”
Shana’s response was quick: “An uncle who is not related by blood, isn’t very familiar, and has gone astray.”
“Uncle?”
Was that punch too hard? Although Colin didn’t tap into his full power, he hadn’t really held back.
“No, the force used was still a bit light, and I didn’t hit any vital spots. He still might have a chance of surviving…”
“Uh…”
This comment seemed to suggest I should have aimed to kill.
Colin grumbled in his mind but the brief exchange didn’t last, and he didn’t have time to ponder.
Right after the “War God” follower was knocked out with a punch, the powerful beings worshipped by various Heretic Forces immediately intervened in the next moment’s battle…
They interfered with the scene through special “God-given” artifacts carried by some people around them.
Shadows spread rapidly from underground towards this place; a bronze door opened, out of which flowed a great volume of viscous liquids, as numerous eyes peered outward; a swath of clouds crackling with lightning…
Besides these, a large, mouth-ridden, dark blue hand also fell from high above.
Even amid the ever-growing “Fire God Embodiment,” Colin spotted the well-sought “Human Patchwork Monster.”
This creature was numerous and its power levels were getting close to that of a Level 2 Containment Subject.
“The real trouble is ‘Hunger’.”
As the thought crossed his mind, Colin saw the dark blue hand descending from the sky once again.
This guy finally chose not to hide anymore…
‘Pity, it’s just an intervention of power, the true body isn’t here; otherwise, it feels like we’ve almost met the conditions to summon the ‘Zoo’ Corps…’
With an inward sigh, Colin’s consciousness shifted, and countless bonfires exploded atop the “embodiment”…
Shattering all attacks from surrounding enemies.
“Crack.”
The dark blue hand with stone-like patterns landed, biting off half of the “Fire God Embodiment’s” head…
And then, the hand exploded.
“Flame Bearer’s grease flame, tastes good, doesn’t it?”
Colin sneered.
His power level wasn’t much stronger than most high-order containment subjects in form, but because of certain targeted skills, he had a natural advantage over such threats, which enabled him to repel them.
Then, after finally holding back the urge for “Hunger,” he took a deep breath.
The embodiment that had its half head bitten off became solid again…
And it continued to grow taller and larger, propping the sky with one hand, pushing heaven and earth apart with each inch it ascended.
“After letting you all fight for so long, it’s about time I took action.”
Colin stood at the chest of the embodiment, overlooking the crowd of enemies, and slowly extended his hand.
The fire’s intensity rapidly increased…
Even some high-order containment subjects began to grow wary, sensing the threat.
Ignoring their reactions, Colin gathered all his strength into his right hand, focusing on the “Revolver Reverser”—
“Sky Light Fall!”
An attack that seemed to tear through spatial dimensions flashed by.
Everyone was shocked, but soon enough, they noticed that the strike appeared not to target anyone in particular but aimed instead at a seemingly thin layer of dark blue misty barrier.
“Boom!”
A gap was torn open, and without a second thought, Colin scooped up Shana and bolted.
At the same time, he also dispelled the impressive but somewhat uncontrollable embodiment…
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 597 - 597 456 Corps Radiant Angel Intervenes. _1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 597: Chapter 456 Corps “Radiant Angel” Intervenes. _1 Chapter 597: Chapter 456 Corps “Radiant Angel” Intervenes. _1 With the “Fire God Embodiment” as a barrier, Colin managed to escape the “Hunger” designed “stomach” without any harm.
And completely freed himself from the control of the “Fire God Embodiment”…
“Wooo~”
The massive phantom’s internal flames pulsated, emitting bizarre roars, its figure expanding continuously, indiscriminately striking at all life in its vicinity.
In reality, this phantom had been expanding constantly, and it wasn’t Colin’s intention to do so.
The bigger it gets, doesn’t mean it’s better…
But because of “Hunger’s” interference, he couldn’t fully control it, leading to this situation.
Of course, to those unaware, the ever-expanding embodiment still possessed a considerable deterrent force…
“Finally got out.”
The moment he passed through the “stomach wall,” Colin felt an intense desire to eat diminish rapidly inside him.
The ceaseless murmurs about eating dissipated…
His mind became clear again; he felt like he was entering sage mode, losing any desire for Shana who he was holding in his arms.
Shana, who was in his arms, was equally sensitive; after noticing this change, she also sighed with relief.
After all, even if she could handle the resurrection of that thing,
it was hard to ensure that Colin would remain unharmed in the process.
However, sensing the situation at the scene, she glanced behind her, saw the blue-black barrier disappear after their escape, and then brought her gaze back to Colin’s expression. Pressing her pale lips together, she seemed to have something to say…
But having just escaped death, she felt the atmosphere didn’t quite permit her to speak.
At that moment, thinking she was concerned about the “Hunger” stomach wall, Colin explained, “For a short while, it shouldn’t be able to use the same method, but of course, we still need to guard against some of its unknown abilities…”
He was very clear about some abilities of “Hunger,” but in addition to itself, every fragment of “Hunger” could acquire the abilities of the enemies it consumed, and right now, he had no idea what this fragment had swallowed.
Yet, before he could finish, Colin suddenly felt a wave of weakness wash over him…
Having used various powers just now, now that everything was “quiet” for a few minutes, the negative effects were about to surge.
Those things were quite draining to use.
Seeing this, Shana took the initiative to cast a BUFF to help him negate some of the negative effects.
At the same time, Colin bit into several “Colorless Crystals,” which made him feel somewhat better…
But it was at this time, some consciousness latched on from behind.
“Useless embodiment, can’t even hold them off for half an hour?”
Colin cursed under his breath; of course, he also knew that once that thing was out of control, it would simply kill every life form around in a frenzy, without any particular attempt to block the way.
So it was quite normal for others to avoid it.
“Nevertheless, they’ve managed to catch up even after I ran ahead for over ten minutes. I need to think of a way to improve the long-distance movement methods for my next step…”
Colin recognized his shortcomings.
“Bonfire”-fueled high-speed movement within ordinary battles could be incredibly fast.
But in a high-level battlefield tug-of-war, it was still somewhat lacking.
Colin took a deep breath, intending to have Shana act first and go to the underground labyrinth to find the “King of Madness” while he held the rear, waiting for the pursuers to catch up again.
But then he abandoned the thought.
If the “King of Madness” really had any ideas considering Shana’s current state,
it would be like delivering himself to the doorstep…
With Colin there, he could prevent this, after all, there was a contract.
Even if forced by various enemies not to make a move, they would not necessarily act against him.
‘Sigh, it’ll still be nearly half a day’s distance to get there, and if luck is bad, and he doesn’t help, then the whole trip will be even more troublesome. There are the magic fog spawns, and the high-level containment subjects with attacks from afar, and I guess those Knight Legions and Mage Corps are probably still wandering around the periphery…’
As he raced against time, Colin’s thoughts churned with a bit of a headache.At this moment, he was like a meteor darting through the mist, while several hidden entities behind him used their own authority and traits to chase after him in various ways…
At this time, Shana, seeing that Colin seemed to have made a decision, used the “Light” to transmit information.
A line of text appeared before Colin’s eyes…
“Let me down.”
As he contemplated how to break through the situation, Colin was startled by this line of text.
“Don’t worry, we’ll both live. If I left you here, what would be the point of my coming in?” Colin responded using the method of “Inspiration.”
Ah, so he really did come specially for her… Shana felt touched.
But…
“No, I’m worried they’ve run off.”
“It’s fine, I… hmm?”
Colin paused, questioning his own eyes while reading the message on his retina.
At that moment, the Saintess raised her head, placing her hand on his shoulder, whispered something into Colin’s ear.
“Can we really counter-attack here? Even find the ‘Hunger’ itself? But your body…”
Colin looked at her with surprise.
Even if Shana was telling the truth, her body might not be capable of doing the things she mentioned.
He could be sure of her current condition; she wasn’t faking it. She really had taken a lot of damage, enough to kill those useless D Level trash from the “Life Mentor Adorable” several times over.
She was able to endure simply through sheer strength…
If she continued to forcefully use her powers, the outcome would not be good.
“Maybe on my own the risk would be great, but with you here, both of us together, it will be much better. Give me ten minutes…”

chapters.title: Chapter 598 - 598 456 The Radiant Angel Corps Intervenes. _2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 598: Chapter 456 The “Radiant Angel” Corps Intervenes. _2 Chapter 598: Chapter 456 The “Radiant Angel” Corps Intervenes. _2 Hearing Shana’s words, Colin ultimately chose to cooperate and halted his actions.
Meanwhile, the Saintess broke free from his embrace, landed on the ground, closed her eyes, and seemed to be connecting with something…
Colin manipulated flames to protect her so tightly that not a breath of air could get through.
At the same time, following behind him, a mass of shadow caught up first. It landed and initially transformed into a group of silhouettes of people, then these silhouettes stretched and interweaved with each other, forming a Shadow Tree covered with eyes…
Following this, a cluster of clouds flickering with lightning appeared, with vague figures looming behind the heavy Dark Clouds.
For the moment, they pursued him but did not act immediately, as if cautious.
After all, the other side clearly still had some strength left; there was no reason for them to stop.
“Could this place be a trap?” someone began to doubt.
“Impossible! Absolutely not! The Saintess has been fighting up to this point, and she’s at her limit. Are you questioning the content of the ‘God Revelation’?”
“…”
A kilometer away, across from them, Colin and these adversaries faced each other across the gap.
‘According to the “Saintess,” before she even entered the Golden City, she had already sensed dangers different from other places, but she still stepped in, not just to save people but also because…’
‘Here, some powerful legacies left by the “Holy Light Court” can be activated…’
‘And this serious injury is a crisis, but also an opportunity to solve some troubles. She had long wanted to deal with those shadowing her, especially this entity called “0-09 Hunger,” but there never seemed to be a suitable opportunity…’
Recalling Shana’s words, Colin suddenly felt that this tactic seemed familiar—
Wasn’t this… just like fishing?
Not long ago, back on Earth, Colin had given the global cults a major blow through the “Starlight Maiden.”
Unexpectedly, Shana seemed to be planning something similar here.
Everyone knows that the Saintess is kind-hearted and willing to step into traps for the sake of mortals.
But probably few people would realize that she would use her own kindness to plot a massacre…
However, compared to Colin’s nearly foolproof baiting strategy, which had the backing of Earth’s official forces, Shana was taking a big risk here as she was like an orphan with no one to help, with teammates who were not contributing, risking her life to play the tank.
Even if successful, she would still genuinely suffer significant injuries, and it could even be worse…
But… Colin’s arrival was unexpectedly within her calculations, and because of Colin, many of the suspicious enemies had been drawn out, with more and more “fish” entering the big net…
Besides worrying about Colin’s success, there was another reason—
If the Saintess, who has been without teammates for a lifetime, needed rescue, could this still be faked?
Meanwhile, as more enemies arrived, some beings would not stand by and watch; they began to attack, but all were blocked by Colin.
‘I don’t know how powerful these so-called “Holy Light Court” legacies are to make her so confident,’ Colin thought.
While fending off a strange curse attack from behind a bronze door with one hand, he pondered.
Present were not only “Hunger,” a man-made “Level ‘0’” Containment Subject, but also roughly ten Heretic Believers dispatched by the other First Level Containment Subject entities. Unlike Earth, it was unclear whether it was due to better mystical signals here or some other reason…
The power that strong beings could send down was far superior to Earth’s.
However, as various Heretic Forces launched attacks sporadically and while also protecting Shana from harm, Colin had no spare energy to ponder further.
The surrounding enemies seemed to realize something, and the intensity of their attacks rapidly increased.
Even within the layers of Bonfire defenses, Colin’s hairstyle was struck into an explosive-looking style, and he suffered multiple injuries.
But just as he felt increasingly strained, he suddenly heard Shana’s voice in his ear:
“It’s ready.”
Ready?
Just as Colin was about to say something, he suddenly saw something appear on his retina.
[Receipt of the report from ‘Bonfire Company-24-Code 774311,’ ‘The Light Chaser’…]
[“World Code-13-01 Area” defense system has been activated, investigation underway… Warning!]
[Warning! You have entered the ‘No. 1 Special Containment Subject Nature Reserve,’ please leave immediately, otherwise… You have now obtained a pass…]
The explanation changed from red to normal, seemingly granted authorization by Shana.
But Colin was still confused, “Eh? A report?”
He scratched the back of his head, feeling that the term didn’t quite match the big move Shana had mentioned…
And the words that followed sounded equally odd.
“Nature Reserve? Special Containment Subject… Natural ecology?”
Then soon, as more information emerged, Colin finally understood why Shana had such confidence…
Because in the next second.
[Detection of multiple unauthorised high-risk lifeforms illegally entering!]
[“1-773” ‘Shadow Tree of Eyes,’ “1-774” ‘King of Madness,’ “1-779” ‘Substanceless Worm,’ “1-801” ‘Deep Sea Thundercloud’…]
[Detected Level ‘0’ entity presence… ‘0-09’ “Hunger”!]
[Attempting to connect with executor…]
[Danger! Danger! Danger! The containment subject has no executor, confirmed to be in a state of loss of control!]
[About to initiate highest alert status!]
[Sending ‘Containment Protocol’ usage instructions to ‘Bonfire,’ requesting activation of ‘0-11’ Wall, to ensure smooth operation…]
[Sending ‘Bonfire Protocol’ usage instructions to ‘Bonfire’….]
[Proceeding…]
[No feedback.]
[Sending request to ‘Seed of Light’…]
[…Corps “Radiant Angel” Second Legion “Angel of Wisdom” rapid response team has received orders, will soon proceed to Area No.1 for suppression operation…]
[Guidance unit: Code 774311…]
…
A mass of information appeared on his retina all at once, making Colin’s brain struggle to catch up.
He heard Shana mention something about mobilizing the “Holy Light Court” reserves.
He had thought it would be some ancient lost array or something similar, but this, this was beyond his initial imagination…
“Wow, are all these first-level containment subjects serial numbers?”
“And this, what’s with no feedback?”
“And, the ‘Radiant Angel’ Second Legion…”
As Colin muttered to himself, he suddenly felt the world brighten up dramatically.
The next second…
From the heavens obscured by thick, dark Magic Fog, thousands of beams of light pierced the clouds like swords…
The sight was spectacular, resembling the legendary Dary’s Garden, no, the Tyndall effect.
At the same time, a beam of bright light descended from the sky, enveloping him and Shana together.
“Damn! It’s a trick—” a heretic believer exclaimed in shock.
Before he could finish, the beam of light began to wriggle strangely, erasing him instantly, but this did not mean the attack was over, as more light penetrated into the beings behind him.
Compared to the initial conflict with the “Zoo” Corps, the mode of battle here seemed more tranquil…
A shadow tried to escape but was pinned to the ground by massive tangible beams of light.
In the sky, clouds flashing with lightning erupted with violent thunderbolts striking the beams of light, but regrettably, more brilliance fell, enveloping it…
However, compared to these, at least more than half of the beams were flying toward a hidden dark blue great hand, and during this process, they transformed into Chains of Light, attempting to bind it.
“These so-called ‘Angels of Wisdom,’ they don’t seem alive…”
Colin squinted his eyes to their smallest, and he didn’t sense even a hint of life force from these beams of light.
It felt more like some kind of robotic mechanical action…
“Hm…” a muffled grunt came through.
Colin was startled, only then realizing he had been negligent in protecting Shana due to his shock at what had just happened, but he soon breathed a sigh of relief. Because of the many abnormalities present, they did not have the capacity to launch an attack on them.
Shana was merely having difficulty sustaining the strain of the guidance.
He immediately stepped forward, reaching out to place his hand on Shana’s shoulder that felt like it was all bone, transferring the “Colorless Crystal” along with some basic BUFFs inherent to a “Flamebearer.”
Shana opened her eyes slightly, looked at him in thanks, and then continued to maintain the guidance.
At the same time, deep within a labyrinth beneath a distant expanse of land, the entity that the “King of Savage Sound” had transformed into was pressing its ear against the ceiling, listening to the commotion outside…
Through his own authority abilities, he could remotely observe the “Flamebearer” reservist above ground with sound waves, vibrations, and other methods…
It’s like watching a spectacle while munching on melon seeds.
In his current trapped situation, he definitely couldn’t help, all he could do was mentally cheer them on from afar…
But as he listened, he suddenly paused, feeling that something was amiss.
“Hmm?”
The next second, a multitude of beams of light penetrated into the Underground Great Labyrinth.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 599 - 599 457 The Disappointing King of Savage
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 599: Chapter 457 The Disappointing ‘King of Savage Sound’_1 Chapter 599: Chapter 457 The Disappointing ‘King of Savage Sound’_1 Above the firmament, one beam of light after another pierced through the thick, gray fog, then as if conscious, swiftly moved towards enemies within various regions…
And with the rapid increase of light,
The entire world became increasingly pale, to the point where Colin eventually had to close his eyes.
After all, even with the identity recognition given by Shana, when directly gazing upon such an amount of light, he still felt a slight sting in his pupils.
However, through the flames on his body, Colin could still sense the situations occurring around him.
“The range and effect of this onslaught are quite spectacular.”
Colin could “see,” one by one, the Heretic Forces personnel immobilized by the light, then used as points to strike down the heretics behind them.
It appeared that they weren’t being killed, but rather were subjected to some other treatment…
In fact, it was indeed as he had guessed, all heretics were indirectly entering the fray.
Even though Shana had summoned the defensive forces here, she couldn’t kill them, but she could use the power here to strengthen the seals that were already in place on them.
As a Saint, Shana knew many secrets.
She knew that most of the Heretic Forces, even the “True Gods,” were under certain restrictions.
Merely strengthening the seals, although not lethal, also meant that, for a considerable time in the future, they wouldn’t think of causing trouble again.
The Heretic Forces related to them, without any response, would disappear completely like weeds with their roots cut off after not too long…
Of course, after several years, a decade, or even longer, anomalies might emerge again.
By that time…
Shana could only trust the wisdom of future generations.
At this moment, Colin, who had been standing by Shana’s side, channeling energy into her through his grasp on her shoulders, suddenly felt her slender body sway and the light before him dim a bit…
She seemed unable to sustain herself any longer.
And deeper within the Magic Fog, it seemed as if something was lingering…
“The sovereign abnormality after the ‘Plague of Magic Fog’?”
Colin frowned, having heard about these things more than once from the Heretic Forces on his way here.
He had also gotten further descriptions from the “King of Madness.”
But to truly perceive it, this was the first time…
‘It feels… like something very abstract, but one thing is for certain, these things are strong.’
Colin’s thoughts flickered.
However, it seemed that because of the Angel of Wisdom’s fast-acting powers, these entities were wary and didn’t come any closer. They seemed to possess a certain level of intelligence compared to most brainless derivatives of the Magic Fog…
Colin didn’t doubt whether the ‘Radiant Angel’s’ Corps could deal with these creatures.
But he questioned whether Shana could hold on…
‘This ‘Radiant Angel’s’ Corps is a bit unreliable, huh? Using it requires someone to maintain a real-time connection, unlike the ‘Zoo’ Corps where people just need to show up.’
Looking at Shana’s condition, Colin couldn’t help but have some criticism.
He felt there was a clear gap in comparison, and the special effects were too prominent, causing a serious issue with light pollution; ordinary people couldn’t keep their eyes open.
“Boom!”
A loud collision sound came from far away.
This seemed to signify that the last abnormality had been dealt with, and Shana finally could not hold on and disconnected, her figure wavering as if about to collapse.
Colin promptly stepped forward to support her and used a “Colorless Crystal” to alleviate the energy depletion within her body.
After taking a moment to catch her breath, Shana opened her somewhat dim eyes:
“The vast majority of the trouble has been thoroughly resolved, except for ‘Hunger,’ which we have only roughly located and can’t act further upon…”
Colin wasn’t surprised by this outcome; after all, it was a “Level 0” entity, not so easy to deal with. But hearing the last part, an event suddenly surfaced in Colin’s mind.
[Event Two: Within twenty-four hours, obtain the current specific coordinates of “0-09 ‘Hunger'” from The Light Chaser (time of task assignment as a reference).]
Remark: A higher mission rating will be earned.
…
‘Coming from my mind, Lady Bunny?’
Colin was about to speak, but seeing Shana’s utterly worn-out state, he changed his words, “You should adjust your condition first.”
Obtaining this thing seemed to require more than just naming it; it required a lot of coordination…
If it’s within twenty-four hours, there was ample time, no rush for now.
As he spoke, he glanced around again.
The beams of light were visibly beginning to fade.
At this rate, it would probably take about fifteen minutes, half an hour at most, for them to disappear completely.
But from now on, it was time to start running again…
Then, he reached out to scoop Shana up in his arms once more. She looked at Colin’s actions, hesitated for a moment, but in the end, did not refuse and let herself be embraced.
‘Feels like she’s lost several more pounds.’ Colin felt the Saint had obviously become much lighter again.
She was not short in stature, visually she might even appear taller than him…
But her weight, it probably wasn’t even as much as Little Red’s when she was around ten years old. If it weren’t for the voluminous Church robes, wearing even slightly less, she would probably not have looked much better than a utility pole…
Well, speaking of which, compared to some comic Saintesses who show off their legs and chests, Shana’s attire is really quite wholesome, covering everything but her hands and head, even her neck can’t be seen, uh, what am I thinking?
Shaking his head, Colin cast away the stray thoughts and, taking advantage of the remaining white light, rushed towards the direction of the Underground Great Labyrinth…

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - 600 457 The Disappointing King of Savage
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 600: Chapter 457 The Disappointing ‘King of Savage Sound’_2 Chapter 600: Chapter 457 The Disappointing ‘King of Savage Sound’_2 If there’s no one to stop us, we should be able to get there within an hour.
“By the way, do you know anything about those ‘Radiant Angels’ rapid response teams?”
Colin asked curiously as they moved.
He was quite interested in this second Corps he had encountered.
“‘Radiant Angel’?” Shana’s ice-blue eyes flickered with confusion.
“You don’t know?”
Shana shook her head, “We call them ‘Guardians of Wisdom from the Heavens’…”
She paused, and without waiting for Colin to ask, she explained what she knew.
“In this world, there are places called ‘God’s Forbidden Zone’. One reason the ‘Holy Light Court’ was so powerful was that they had the ability to operate these special things…”
‘God’s Forbidden Zone’? That’s obviously called the “No. 1 Special Containment Subject Nature Reserve”.
Colin vaguely realized that either the “Holy Light Court” didn’t know the details, or they intentionally changed the name.
Then, something suddenly occurred to him, and he spoke, “The text we saw earlier, you seem… not very familiar with it?”
“Those mysterious texts? I’m not very clear about them…”
As Shana spoke, a line of subtitles appeared before them— “No. 1 Special Containment Subject Nature Reserve”.
“We deciphered it and could roughly interpret it as meaning some sort of special forbidden area, that for unknown reasons, one cannot operate within without a special blessing. Even gods are not allowed to enter. So, if I were to interpret it, should it be called ‘God’s Banned Area’?”
She blinked, looking at Colin, seemingly seeking confirmation.
The understanding was correct, but…
Colin did not immediately respond, realizing where the issue lay.
It seemed like Shana didn’t recognize these kinds of texts at all…
‘But that shouldn’t be, the information from the Company isn’t in any particular language. It appears as Chinese if you think it’s Chinese, English if you think it’s English, and it can translate adaptively based on the situation…’
Colin tried asking and received a positive response from Shana—she couldn’t understand it and could only roughly guess its meaning through mystical methods.
“Strange, why would this happen?” Colin wondered.
But at that moment, an inspiration flashed, revealing the reason to him…
The fault lay with the “branch office”.
This entity didn’t have the same kind of passive translation features that Bonfire Company did. So, even though Shana seemed to be able to communicate normally with him, as if there were no issues,
it would be a different story if she were actually thrown onto Earth. Even if Earthlings spoke the same language as Colin, Shana would be completely illiterate…
Unable to understand a single word.
Realizing this, Colin felt a mix of amusement and chagrin.
He originally thought it was a standard feature but found out that Shana didn’t have it.
At the same time, Colin basically confirmed the previous “Holy Light Court” indeed had some control, but it was due to their own characteristics that they possessed such authority.
The “Radiant Angel” was not very related to them.
It was like an archaeologist finding a star-destroying cannon, figuring out how to use it after much effort, but not understanding a thing about its principles and construction.
“If there is a chance, may I ask for your help in providing some information on these kinds of texts?” Shana asked, looking forward with anticipation after understanding this. She had many similar pieces of knowledge she wanted to unravel.
“No problem,” Colin nodded.
He then continued to learn about the situation regarding the so-called ‘God’s Forbidden Zone’, which in reality was a ‘Nature Reserve’.
Currently, the vast majority of mainstream human nations in “World Code-13”, or rather, human settlements, all exist within similar confines…
Besides the characteristics of the “Light” Church, there were other factors, such as the massive pleading of humans.
These could potentially trigger the activation of a ‘defense system’…
That’s why in this era, lower-class humans are meaningless to the upper class Extraordinary Ones, and yet they still actively maintain a population of refugees.
The aim is to have a chance to activate the emergency response systems within the ‘ecosphere’ at certain critical moments…
Of course, apart from Saints who can summon more reliably, other methods of awakening this entity have a low success rate.
“Looking at it this way, this indeed is the territory of the ‘Radiant Angels’. However, I don’t know much about other legions within the ‘Radiant Angels’, but the second legion, ‘Angel of Wisdom’, looks like some kind of intelligent AI, no, just an ordinary low-level intelligence system, not AI…”
Colin felt that the situation with this corps was likely not very optimistic.
However, setting that aside to consider the current state of the world…
He was somewhat at a loss for words.
‘The “ancient ancestor” used it to confine some special and valuable containment subjects, and now you’ve moved in yourselves…’
‘Isn’t that just like driving the animals out of the zoo and then moving in yourselves?’
Colin couldn’t help but feel a mix of amusement and bewilderment.
But then again, if the reserve did indeed offer protection, it seemed there was nothing wrong with that.
“Speaking of which, if I weren’t here, what would you have planned to do with this situation?” Colin inquired.
“Within this area, I can ‘summon’ them at any time, although under rushed circumstances, the results might not be ideal. Nevertheless, I would be able to eliminate a significant portion of the threats. After that, I would enter a special place and sleep for a while, maybe a month or two if quick, about a year if slow, or perhaps even longer. But no matter what, it’s all profit…”
Listening to Shana’s explanation, Colin mentally corrected her in his mind: it’s “squeal,” not “summon.”
Having read and understood all the feedback, he knew the situation better than Shana.
And there was this self-harming strategy of injuring the enemy at a great loss to oneself… Colin felt he had to correct Shana’s habit of using herself as bait.
At that moment, Shana blinked, as if she had thought of something else, and continued, “Of course, I wasn’t planning to implement this plan originally, but because of you, I was able to make this choice.”
“Oh?” Colin’s eyebrows rose; so this fishing expedition had something to do with him?
“You’ve taken care of my concerns…”
“At first, after leading the refugees out, I still had to figure out how to settle them before considering the possibility of coming back to save others. But by that time, there likely wouldn’t have been a chance…”
Upon hearing this, Colin understood the reason—it was because of his involvement.
Thus, Shana could rest assured, leave the people with him, and then dive back in to attempt to resolve a bunch of restless heretics.
So far, there have been twists and turns, but everything was proceeding relatively smoothly.
“By the way, what about the people you rescued?”
“Some are already hiding in the outer areas with lots of black bread. They can hold out for a long time. Later, um, Helena’s sister will come to their aid. Besides, there’s another group that I’ve tucked away, and I’ll release them once it’s safe.”
Black bread… Colin nodded his head.
He had previously had it analyzed by “Small Intestine Taste Buds,” and it could meet all the nutritional needs of a person—
The only problem was that it was hard to swallow.
You’d need to soak it in water, and the already indescribable taste would become even more so after soaking.
“How do we leave now? What’s the plan? The effect here can only last a little while longer, and soon, the anomalies from the Catastrophe of the Magic Fog will come over…”
Shana was still unaware of Colin’s plans, but she had a mental map in her head.
Knowing the current direction was not the right one…
“Through a sealed first-level containment subject.”
Colin did not hide anything and explained.
Now, he just hoped that the guy wouldn’t be ungrateful…
Based on the current situation, “King of Savage Sound” most likely wouldn’t stand him up.
After all, the enemies that had been tracking them were almost taken care of, lessening the pressure on him…
However, when Colin arrived at the Underground Great Labyrinth with Shana after a while, they didn’t see that figure.
“Where is he?”
Colin frowned, sensing around for a while but discovering nothing.
Normally, given such an overt arrival as his,
The “King of Madness” would have shown up by now…
But now, there was nothing.
Releasing flame and waiting a bit longer without seeing anyone, Colin’s heart sank, and his frown deepened in disappointment with the “King of Madness”‘s decision.
Just as he thought!
A heretic is a heretic, with divided loyalties, not to be trusted!
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 601 - 601 458 I King of Savage Sound address the Bonfire_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 601: 458 I, “King of Savage Sound,” address the “Bonfire”!_1 Chapter 601: 458 I, “King of Savage Sound,” address the “Bonfire”!_1 Although he didn’t fully understand why the “King of Savage Sound” chose such a critical moment to fail…
Colin decided that, in the future, he shouldn’t easily trust such things.
Of course, he vaguely recalled something, that perhaps there was more to the “King of Savage Sound” than met the eye, but given the urgency of the situation, he couldn’t afford to ponder that any further…
“It seems we may need to take an overland route now.”
Colin looked towards Shana and asked if there was an exit route—
He had been riding the “King of Savage Sound” express lane all the way here.
Without many markings on the surface or related intelligence, he certainly wasn’t as seasoned in navigating the “Magic Fog” as Shana, who was almost pickled in it…
“There is one.”
Shana nodded, bright lights emerging in her ice-blue eyes.
These lights shot from her pupils and intertwined in mid-air, eventually forming a large topographical projection.
‘This looked just like a human projector…’
Colin muttered to himself, then saw that on this topographic model, there were several routes and a dense array of numerous markers.
With the help of some shared “inspiration,” he easily understood some of the unknown marks made by Shana.
“We are here… If we are going to go above, let’s follow this route.”
As Shana spoke, a slightly winding route on the model lit up.
The path was not direct, but it avoided many danger markers.
Overall, it only meant a slightly faster speed…
While discussing retreat, Shana did not mention rescuing others again.
She had done all she could to find all the ordinary people she could, other survivors might exist, but it was not certain, and searching under such uncertainty carried great risks without assured results…
“Following this route, we should be able to withdraw to the outer area in about three days. Once we’re at the outskirts, we can then bring out the remaining personnel originally stationed there…”
“Most likely, it will take about five days to reach your territory.”
Shana’s voice was light and quick as she pointed out a location at the end of the model.
Then she continued to combine inspiration with a more detailed explanation: “In a while, I will use a clone to lure away those powerful derivatives from the depths of the ‘Plague of Magic Fog’…
“After that, we’ll take the opportunity to gain some distance, and although the main heretic forces in this area have been dealt with,
“there are still some alive, we don’t need to be faster than the ruler-level derivatives of Magic Fog, just faster than them…”
Uh, this is turning into a grand escape…
Colin nodded in agreement with Shana’s plan.
However, recalling the recent battle, he couldn’t help but think of a group of old acquaintances—
“It’s surprising that there are no Followers of the ‘Red Moon’ in this world…”
Colin had thought these guys were as ubiquitous as cockroaches…
Yet he had seen no sign of them here.
Afterward, within a few minutes, upon rapidly deciding on a method of departure, the two did not delay further and prepared to leave.
But it was at this moment…
Colin suddenly felt faint vibrations coming through the air.
This sensation was distinctly different from the massive disturbances outside.
It was just so faint that it almost seemed like an illusion.
But then, Shana also spoke up: “There seems to be something here, doesn’t there?”
With her judgment alongside his own, Colin confirmed it wasn’t an illusion, nodded and said, “Yes, wait, it seems the situation might be changing…”
Shana nodded, standing by his side, silent, not even breathing, nor making any heartbeat sounds.
Colin was briefly astonished, feeling as if Shana’s blood might not even be flowing.
However, after another minute had passed,
Yet another set of delicate, faint fluctuations arrived…
This feeling was like something knocking from under a thick layer of ice or a heavy stone coffin lid,
communicating in a specific rhythm…
“Is this the ‘King of Savage Sound’? What’s the situation with it?”
Colin was puzzled, but the frequency felt somewhat familiar.
After listening for several minutes…
A certain “inspiration” emerged, and the frequencies heard combined into a phrase.
“‘I, number 1-774 ‘King of Savage Sound,’ request to converse with the envoy of ‘Primordial Fire’?'”
Colin silently read the sentence.
Immediately after, confusion flooded his mind.
What was happening? Why not just come out and say it, instead of using such a method?
And once the sentence was pieced together, Colin didn’t hear any more sounds afterward…
An indescribable premonition made Colin realize that if he didn’t agree,
this “King of Savage Sound” probably wouldn’t have a chance to send a second word.
He glanced at Shana, who was blinking her ice-blue eyes, also looking at him.
After exchanging a look with Colin, Shana’s gaze retreated, and, confirming that the phrase was just talking and would not mean agreeing to any terms, Colin orally consented to the visit request.
In the next moment, the entire underground palace began to shake as if an earthquake had occurred.
The grand power of a Higher Life Form spread and proliferated unchecked.
‘An ‘Ancient God’s’ power…’
Shana stood by Colin, her pale lips pursed, gathering strength silently within, ready to pull Colin out at the first hint of crisis.
She could confirm this was the direct power of an extremely strong Higher Life Form,
fundamentally different from the indirect actions they had encountered before.
Mr. Colin had not had much experience dealing with such levels, and she had to be careful; otherwise, one misstep could lead to an inexplicably sudden death…

chapters.title: Chapter 602 - 602 458 I King of Savage Sound address the Bonfire_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 602: 458 I, “King of Savage Sound,” address the “Bonfire”!_2 Chapter 602: 458 I, “King of Savage Sound,” address the “Bonfire”!_2 It was at this moment that both of them clearly and distinctly felt.
Beneath the endless expanse of the underground palace, there appeared a set of indescribable vibrations, as if they signified the presence of something alive.
Although invisible to the naked eye, in their intuition and inspiration, it took the shape of a person.
