Although she could understand much of the information through spiritual analysis, there were many terms she couldn’t quite grasp.
When Colin heard the description involving the number ten and units like t and tnt, his expression became stunned.
“How much?”
Colin asked incredulously.
“Roughly like this…” Shana created a projection, displaying the string of numbers.
“Damn, 10E equivalent…”
Colin clicked his tongue, and after listening to the rest of the words she said, his expression turned peculiar, musing to himself that the Saints sure had a knack for exploiting bugs and dragging enemies into self-destructing with them.
At the same time, he subconsciously thought about how he would cope with such an adversary.
‘Having “Deadly Insight” ensures I detect the explosion first, then “Time Stop” to gain time, followed by using the Shield Emblem to find any enemy or if all else fails, apply to duel with “Yukionna” or Little Maid; I should be able to avoid it…’
Thinking this, Colin felt it wasn’t particularly scary after all…
Unless the enemy added some more advanced mysticism or technology into it.
But, according to Shana’s words, this thing is for the “Radiant Angel” project’s demolition use, so it probably wouldn’t have those extra ingredients…
Then, Colin gave Shana a brief explanation about her uncertainties regarding the matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - 613 463 The Immoral Firebearer and the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 613: Chapter 463: The Immoral “Firebearer” and the “Subsidiary”._3 Chapter 613: Chapter 463: The Immoral “Firebearer” and the “Subsidiary”._3 Shana seemed to half-understand.
As time slowly passed by, into the latter half of the night, Colin gradually stuffed several pounds of meat into Shana’s mouth amidst their casual conversation. After feeling full and satisfied, their dialogue ended, and Shana returned to the cabin to start her proper rest.
Little Red had also fallen asleep early during the conversation between the two.
Colin sat silently in front of the bonfire, waiting for the next day to arrive.
As far as he could see…
This “dangerous day” seemed not to hold too many surprises.
However, just as he held that thought, Colin suddenly felt something appear beside him.
Immediately afterward, a mission appeared on his retina.
[Event: A Secret Transaction…]
“Requirement”: Hand over “Three Hundred Thousand Points”.
“Reward”: 1. “Containment Divine Kingdom” coordinate anchor and related intelligence, 2. One set of unshaped modules / or a piece of “Holy Remains” / or the current intelligence on “Seed of Light”.
…
Colin’s eyes narrowed as he realized that it was that “branch” showing up.
“Three Hundred Thousand Points? Where would I have that much… Wait, it’s talking about this?” (Note 1:)
Suddenly, Colin remembered something. “Lady Rabbit” had once given him a special letter that contained three hundred thousand points, which were viewable but not usable…
The purpose was to lure out the “branch”.
However, there had been no response for so many days that Colin had almost forgotten about it.
Unexpectedly, it had now suddenly appeared, targeting directly at the “bait”.
“They chose a good time, just when the ‘company’ can’t contact me. It seems they’ve come prepared.”
Thoughts flickered, and Colin’s gaze shifted to the listed rewards.
“Containment Divine Kingdom” coordinate anchor and intelligence…
‘This thing, for me, isn’t of great importance… The other items, choose one of the three?’
‘Modules are useful in that they can be combined with some things, developed into various functions in my office? But it seems the ceiling isn’t high, at most it adds a health bar for enemies, a small function like another map, and not necessarily accurate, or maybe develop it into some sort of automatic response system? Seems quite versatile…’
‘The second option, “Holy Remains”…’
Colin clicked his tongue, as he could tell from the mission’s inspiration that what was offered were the spiritual remains of a “Light” Saint…
Similar to that Bone Spur he had in hand.
He figured if the Saintess knew about this, she might very well tear this “branch” apart.
But thinking about it, he wasn’t sure how clear the ownership of the “Holy Remains” was. If it was clear, then they could have “Lady Rabbit” make it into an item, which would definitely be powerful…
But since it was not explicitly stated above, Colin guessed there might be some controversy involved.
‘No, no, no, how could I even think of making tools out of someone else’s remains? That’s just Hellish! Damn, it must be those “Flame Bearers” with a penchant for turning themselves into gear that are a bad influence…’
Colin shook his head, suddenly realizing that his moral compass had slipped unintentionally.
He had to stay alert!
Last, the information regarding the “Seed of Light”.
This held the least attraction for him…
“Let’s set this mission aside for now and talk about who you are. Why don’t you show yourself?”
Colin spoke silently, but unfortunately, there was no response.
“Lady Rabbit” used to want to reclaim this “branch”, but it seemed this thing was too cunning to be easily reclaimed.
However…
‘”Lady Rabbit” gave this to me, she probably anticipated this turn of events…’
After pondering for a moment, Colin decided to hand over the “bait”.
Among the three options, he briefly deliberated and chose the first, the unshaped module…
Then, he took out the letter containing “Three Hundred Thousand Points” from his pocket, saw an invisible vortex appear that sucked it away, and soon after, two items were added to his “Storage Room”.
Both were letters, but he couldn’t open them now; he’d have to wait until he got back.
At the same time, Colin faintly felt something leave.
“Quick escape…”
Colin sat in the chair, raised his hand and touched his chin, curious about who was running this so-called “branch”. Was it some person, some power organization…
Or was the “branch” itself alive?
.
.
.
ps: Update now, edit later.
Note 1: The matter of “Three Hundred Thousand Points” is roughly around Chapter 257.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - 614 464 Employees Above E Level Fall In_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 614: Chapter 464: Employees Above E Level, Fall In!_1 Chapter 614: Chapter 464: Employees Above E Level, Fall In!_1 Reflecting on the “branch office,” it was quite difficult to come up with any effective conclusions.
Colin could only acknowledge that this thing might be even better at hiding than the Rat on Earth, making it hard to get a clear picture of the situation.
“Can’t figure it out, just can’t figure it out…”
Colin sighed.
After the “branch office” left, peace returned here once more, without any further incidents…
However, he hadn’t completely let his guard down either.
Previously in this world, he would often feel an invisible sense of being watched; in the beginning, he could chalk it up to paranoia, but later on, it clearly became improbable.
So, with great probability, there really was something that occasionally spied on him.
Today was his “most dangerous day.”
If given the chance, those things would have a significant likelihood of approaching…
Of course, that didn’t necessarily mean an attack or revenge, but could also pertain to discussing some sort of cooperation.
Just like the “King of Savage Sound” asking for release.
Only…
Just when Colin thought that after his night shift at the “branch office,” there would surely be more things coming to guard the church at night.
And he was already considering how to bargain for more benefits for himself…
No further movements occurred thereafter.
Even the occasional “sense of being watched,” was almost entirely absent this night.
“Tsk, could it be because the ‘Radiant Angel’ sealed them all in a swoop?”
Colin muttered to himself.
The “King of Madness,” a bystander last time, almost got encased in concrete.
Other onlookers looking for entertainment probably weren’t few in number either.
Hours passed by once more.
Suddenly, Colin felt the oppressive sensation that had been looming over his heart disappear.
Subsequently, he instinctively looked outside, and noticed that the originally profound and pitch-black night had imperceptibly transformed into a hazy daylight.
“Creak~”
The door of the little church was pushed open, and Shana, who had slept a few hours, came out.
Her skin, which was a bit gaunt before, now appeared much filled out and had some color; on the whole, she looked much livelier than before she went to sleep last night.
Her countenance had evidently become more beautiful.
Certainly, she had digested yesterday’s meal well.
‘The absorption rate of a Saint is high indeed…’
Colin smacked his tongue, thinking to himself that he should stuff Shana with more food later for a good replenishment, as despite looking better, she still seemed very thin.
Nonetheless, only he could see the Saintess’s true appearance.
In the eyes of most ordinary people, Shana’s exact image was somewhat vague, her demeanor gentle and within the haze, filled with a sense of sanctity, leaving room for imagination…
Even her gender characteristics were somewhat diluted due to the image she presented.
Some employees questioned whether she was male or female…
Some female employees felt Shana leaned towards male, but some male employees thought she appeared feminine, of course, there were male employees who believed she presented as more masculine…
As for the last point, Colin thought it wise to be vigilant.
“Good day, Mr. Colin,” Shana greeted.
“Day, oh, good morning,” Colin was not quite accustomed to that phrasing.
Shana didn’t mind that response; through her interactions over time, she knew that this Divine Envoy of Colin’s was somewhat different from most of the Church, with almost no sense of ritual, very… casual.
Of course, from the perspective of some nobles, he would be an impolite savage.
However, Shana rather liked this easygoing nature.
She wasn’t very fond of using the odd intonations and affected words and mannerisms unique to the upper class.
But opposite her, Colin was pondering something; he remembered that last night he had made a deal with the “branch office,” which seemed to involve some matters related to Shana or the group of Saints.
He had planned to tell her when dawn broke…
However, as soon as he saw Shana and was about to speak, suddenly he couldn’t remember the specifics, as if struck by amnesia.
He only knew what he had given and what he had gained, the information in between was lost.
‘Hiss… that branch office is indeed cunning.’
As Colin’s thoughts flashed by, he realized that the fellow had used some means to make him forget some critical content when the main company wasn’t around to respond.
It wasn’t memory erasure, as that would have alerted him.
In principle, it felt more like an invisible ink pen; after writing, the words would disappear after a while.
Such that when he wanted to speak, he found that some content was missing.
At that moment, he suddenly heard Shana speak, “It seems you have something you want to say?”
Shana, who had just stepped out, had already come to his side.
“Mm…”
Colin hesitated and said, “I can’t remember, but you might want to be careful of something eyeing the contents of your pocket…”
That was all he could remember.
“Be careful of what’s in my pocket?” Shana looked at Colin with an air of forgetfulness and thoughtfully nodded.
Her Spiritual Intuition didn’t raise any alarm, yet she was also certain Colin wasn’t lying.
Could it be a situation where something without malice towards her was eyeing a thing, which didn’t pose a major safety threat to her?
She kept this in mind to a slight degree; to prevent Colin from delving into deep thought and risking danger, Shana didn’t pursue the subject any further.
After all, her lack of a premonition of danger didn’t mean Mr. Colin was in the same position.
Especially when he was in his “most dangerous” moment.
Shana then asked, “Is there anything I can assist you with?”

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - 615 464 Employees Above E Level Fall In_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 615: Chapter 464: Employees Above E Level, Fall In!_2 Chapter 615: Chapter 464: Employees Above E Level, Fall In!_2 Is there anything I can help with? The employees won’t be here for a few more hours, it’s still early, and there is nothing to worry about as the populace on the territory has the Fire Tree to help with healing… Colin contemplated for a moment, then spoke:
“Yes, how about some morning exercise?”
He had spent a whole night without incident, and suddenly, he had come up with a new offensive skill combination.
He wanted the Saintess to help validate the feasibility of this technique and refine it…
Then he would take it back and also work on it with Big C Teacher.
Shana nodded, stretched out her hand, and dragged a small lantern out of the “Storage Room”.
“Whoosh…”
The pale blue flame inside the lantern suddenly spread out a mystical power.
It pulled both Colin and the holder into a dream state.
The day’s simulation battle began…
Colin’s fiery spirit soared to the skies as he grappled with a group of Shana’s clones.
After several minutes, Colin couldn’t help but reflect that, compared to fighting Shana’s clones, her real body was significantly stronger and much more agile.
The dream was filled with the frantic clatter of combat, but in reality, Colin was sitting alone on a chair.
As if deep in slumber…
Little Red, who had just stepped out, rubbed her eyes and, seeing Colin “worn out” and asleep on the recliner, felt a pang of sympathy. She turned back into the house, fetched a blanket, and then trotted over to cover him with it.
After doing this, Little Red prepared to go back and get a cup for her daily tooth brushing and face washing routine.
However, just as she was about to move, she sniffed.
It seemed like she could smell that glowing sister, but there was no one around.
In the end, she didn’t think too much of it and turned back to her room.
After washing her face, she planned to make breakfast before her big brother woke up, to show off her cooking skills.
…
The battle lasted two hours before it ended.
During that time, Colin had “died” twice.
‘Without using my trump card, I have high burst damage, but my endurance seems lacking, Shana can use that to drag me out and kill me, it’s a bit tough. However, even if I use my trump card, Shana doesn’t seem to be too scared, she has her own, and possibly more…’
‘The biggest achievement of this practice is breaking one of Shana’s main clone’s legs, which is a cause for celebration…’
Overall, Colin was satisfied with his improvement over this period.
Had it been the beginning, he probably would have died ten times in two hours, but now reducing it to two was quite an accomplishment.
“Hmm, who gave me this blanket? Little Red?”
Exiting the “Nightmare Lantern”, Colin looked at the blanket on him and was momentarily taken aback, then quickly realized who would have done such a thing.
However, without much thought, he suddenly realized something else.
He stood up, turned his head, and looked towards the Bonfire, only to see dozens of figures being “spat” out from it.
They transformed into people in various places within the small church.
At the same time, the company task countdown reappeared in Colin’s mind.
“The most dangerous day has passed!”
He breathed a sigh of relief and then called over “Life Mentor Adorable” and some employees from companies with official backgrounds to inquire about the situation outside during the week.
‘I hope nothing bad happens…’
After praying, he heard “Life Mentor Adorable” start to say:
“I haven’t seen any trouble inside the company, everything is more or less the same…”
Hearing his conclusion, Colin nodded and looked towards another employee who had risen to E-level.
“I also haven’t seen any problem…” said the employee known as the “Burial Lotus King”.
However, he paused midway as if he had remembered something, then continued: “That’s not right, it’s not that there’s nothing at all. I’ve heard that in Great Britain, the danger level has gone up again, there seems to be some sort of fusion of anomalies or something like that, and they are asking for help, my boss’s boss has gone to assist…”
“That place… it’s a ticking time bomb.”
Colin nodded, recalling that during the “Ghost Train incident”, the people there had temporarily sealed many anomalies and dumped them outside as garbage, which significantly improved the situation for a while.
But it seemed from these words that the situation there was becoming critical again?
“How much stuff do they have hidden there? I remember last time they threw out a large number of dangerous Containment Subjects, which caused trouble for both the enemy and us, and it’s still not over…” An employee muttered upon hearing this.
The practice of dumping hazardous materials into the battlefield had caused trouble for many.
“I’m not quite sure of the specifics, but there probably won’t be any major issues,” the “Burial Lotus King” said.
“All right, besides these, is there anything else?”
Colin waved his hand, “For example, those ordinary people who suddenly gain extraordinary abilities.”
Those people were “The Rat” specifically created to disrupt the current order.
Colin took this very seriously…
“Haven’t heard anything; it seems like it’s been quiet for a while now,” said the Burial Lotus King.
This question was what Colin had asked him to inquire about before he left last time.
But the official response was that this group of people had suddenly vanished without a trace…
“It looks like, whatever it is, it’s waiting for the right moment to make a big move.”
Colin sighed inwardly, the greatest source of unease for him now was not the high-level Containment Subjects, not the still unknown of 2044, but this stinky Rat.
‘Forget it, let’s handle the situation here first…’
Shaking his head, gathering his thoughts, Colin called everyone into the small chapel.
Standing at the pulpit, he looked down at those below.
After some development over this period, there were no changes among the D Level and E Level people, but many F Level employees had been promoted to E Level, especially those backed by official forces, where four out of ten had been promoted to E.
This promotion rate was still quite high…
With a glance, Colin slowly began to speak:
“Next is the mission concerning ‘Hunger’ that I mentioned to you last week…”
Upon finishing, the faces of everyone present changed.
Without giving them any extra time, Colin continued:
“All E Level and above employees who still have resurrection opportunities, step forward!”
The crowd wore bitter expressions, having all thoroughly experienced the mission instance of “World Code-13” and knew exactly what “Hunger” entailed…
Even the official double-duty employees were tormented to death and back in there.
Because during the mission instance, they could only use company items, with no personal equipment allowed.
Moreover…
They were only E Level!
Was it really appropriate to carry out such a dangerous event?
Shouldn’t such pinnacle confrontations be for Brother Shunzi to handle?
However, with direct orders from Shunzi, they had no choice but to comply, and most crucially, they had resurrection opportunities.
Compared to them, several D Level personnel had little resistance.
They knew from earlier on, if Shunzi didn’t go and sent them instead, they at their level would inevitably have to participate, so they had already adjusted their mindset…
And it was as Colin’s orders were given that a mission simultaneously appeared in their minds.
[Event: Travel to a specific location in the “Black Mountains” and light a temporary Bonfire…]
“Note 1”: As stated above.
“Note 2”: Upon death, return to the “Bonfire”.
“Note 3”: The task must be completed by the last day of this week.
…
“Regarding the precautions when dealing with ‘Hunger,’ I’ve already informed you. Next, I announce ‘Life Mentor Adorable’ as the chief commander, responsible for all matters of the mission.”
“Also, this is one of the upcoming aids; everyone come up and take three later, usage is quite simple.”
Colin took out a box, which was filled with one-gram gold beans.
These were provided as BUFF support by Shana, worried about potential problems…
Of course, as their direct supervisor, Colin was not stingy either. Aside from offering several items for aid, he also provided a large amount of “Colorless Crystal,” and Golden Marks with BUFF effects formed by the Bonfire with the assistance of Shana.
‘Hiss, Shana is really covered in gold. When she makes a move, it’s a bunch of gold, and there’s even a big chunk of gold in that independent spatial area. If it isn’t hollow, it might even weigh a ton…’
‘Once on Earth, Shana would at least be a wealthy lady with financial freedom, beautiful and sweet-voiced, the kind who doesn’t mess with scouring pads…’
‘Wait, does the study of the mysterious here really consume that much gold?’
The thought flickered through Colin’s mind before he grandly gestured and addressed the crowd:
“Next, follow the maps I gave you, and let the mission operation begin!”
.
.
.
ps: I’m begging for monthly tickets…

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - 616 465 The Formal Actions of Employees._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 616: Chapter 465: The Formal Actions of Employees._1 Chapter 616: Chapter 465: The Formal Actions of Employees._1 With Colin’s grand gesture, thirty-one employees with bitter expressions collected their combat supplies and left the territory.
Fifty members of the task force, more than half of whom had to participate in this side mission.
Thirty-one people, divided into five teams, with each D Level leading one team, and “Life Mentor Adorable” as the overall commander.
Initially, Shana had planned to bring along Helena’s knight sister.
But Colin stopped her.
That female knight was not weak, but those heading out this time had more than one life; their fighting approach was probably completely different…
If she were to come along, it’s uncertain whether she’d sell out the employees when it came to fleeing.
“Without Brother Shunzi coming along, I feel insecure…” an employee said anxiously after stepping out of the territory, glancing towards the team leader.
“As if I feel any more secure…” muttered “Life Mentor Adorable” under his breath.
He had completed many tasks, but the ones explicitly related to high-level containment subjects were few.
Especially “Level 0”, he had only speculated whether such a level even existed before Shunzi had come out.
So he, too, was feeling rather uncertain at heart…
However, as the appointed team leader, he knew he couldn’t show his unease.
“Don’t worry, we’re just going to do some menial work, no need to confront the big shots…”
He spoke to soothe the team a bit and reassure them.
As the person with the most experience in the current team, and who had a purple item liberation, with three purple and several green items in possession, “Life Mentor Adorable”, although not quite on the same level as Brother Shunzi…
Still held enough authority to be convincing as a team leader.
And about this mission, Adorable still had a bit of confidence.
Not to mention what he already had, this team included quite a few “nuclear weapons.”
That is, the official personnel.
Their equipment was too extravagant; although it came with significant side effects, its power was immense, even comparable to the effect of purple item liberation…
The only downside was that the adverse effects were strong and could easily harm allies by mistake.
But this time, both Colin and that Saint had done some sealing work on their items.
They were not as ideal as proper items, but much more controllable.
At this moment, he looked back and saw that after they had left the territory, there was a vast expanse of white light covering the entire territory like an inverted basket.
It was no longer possible to see anything inside…
“Let’s go, or we might be too late to catch up,” he said.
“Life Mentor Adorable” waved his hand, signaling everyone to follow him.
The direction they were heading was not towards where the mission was pointing, but another area.
According to the map provided by Brother Shunzi, they were to find a fissure upon reaching that place, light a bonfire, and then wait for an entity known as “King of Madness” to appear…
“Sheesh, it’s hundreds of miles away, when are we ever going to get there? Hey, where’s your big bird? Get it out so we can speed up…” “Life Mentor Adorable” called out.
The leader of Team 2, “Burial Lotus King,” hesitated and then pulled out a ring from the “Storage Room”, but didn’t act immediately.
“What’s the hold-up, hurry up, you just need to say a few lines,” someone urged when they saw this.
Hearing this, D Level personnel of Team 2 glared at him. After hesitating for a moment and enduring a feeling akin to goosebumps, he bellowed:
“You are the proud and untamed eagle above the firmament, you are the divine bird soaring through the skies…
“Your white feathers dazzle and confound, your talons are so vigorous…
“Your form is like the spirit of the wind…
“Your intelligence, so full of humanity, sparkles…
“Ah, you fascinate me so…”
As he recited, employees around him covered their mouths, suppressing their laughter with “pffts”.
Several minutes later, as strong winds arose at the site…
Countless hurricanes converged, forming a transparent, blue bird, its wings spanning more than ten meters.
“Whoooosh~”
Every flap of its wings seemed to stir frantic winds across the region.
“Please take us to where we ought to go…” The summoner, now the deputy team leader, spoke, but unlike before, the blue giant bird formed from the winds did not envelop them in a whirlwind. Instead, it tilted back its head and let out a clear, resonant cry.
“What does that mean?” “Life Mentor Adorable” asked the deputy team leader of Team 2.
The deputy leader of Team 2 replied:
“It says there are too many people this time…”
“We can’t ride?”
“No, it wants extra payment.”
The deputy team leader looked strangely at the summoned creature, then turned back saying:
“Twenty points per person, not one point less, or it says it won’t carry us.”
“Twenty points each? Are you kidding? Why don’t you just rob us?” An employee’s face showed outrage.
“Can’t help it, that’s just how this item works, it needs the points to cooperate, otherwise not even Brother Shunzi could do anything…”
The deputy team leader shook his head. This item wasn’t like this before; initially, the side effect was that users easily caught cold, feared water, and caught colds.
But after the item was repaired, the summon’s “humanity” was restored…
The good news was, it got stronger and more flexible…
The bad news was the side effect shifted from catching colds to demanding points.
Of course, whether that’s bad news isn’t straightforward to say…
From previous communications, it seemed it could also use points to make purchases, though they never knew what it bought.
“All that from a single cry, it had so much to say? You’re not cheating us because we can’t understand it, are you?”
“Come on then, wear the ring yourself, and summon it again to communicate…”

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - 617 465 The Formal Action of the Employees._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 617: Chapter 465: The Formal Action of the Employees._2 Chapter 617: Chapter 465: The Formal Action of the Employees._2 “Alright, alright, twenty points it is…”
Life Mentor Adorable waved his hand. Although the price was a bit expensive, now that Brother Shunzi wouldn’t drive the base vehicle out, besides this bird, they had no other means to travel long distances quickly.
“What’s the use of points for a summoned creature inside a prop?” The third vice-captain was puzzled.
“I’m not sure either…”
After a minor incident, the blue bird formed by the hurricane spread its wings, each claw suspending a dozen people.
About an hour later, everyone arrived at their destination.
“Damn, that was the worst ride experience ever!” Someone complained, tidying up their hair tousled by the wind and looking around.
Finding the rift that Brother Shunzi spoke of wasn’t difficult, because there were rifts all over the damn place!
They were as dense as a spider web; it was impossible to know which one he was referring to.
However, according to Brother Shunzi, he left a scent marker nearby. This vicinity should have an unusual fragrance, and by following it, they would quickly reach their destination…
Most of those present had already mastered the “Body of Tyranny.”
One by one, they lifted their noses and sniffed the ground for a while, finally locating the large underground fissure.
After making some preparations, they followed the scent and traveled beneath the fissure.
Soon, they encountered a man-made underground passage filled with glowing crystals…
Life Mentor Adorable turned to the third squad captain, who opened his coat, revealing several small and large instruments attached to the inner layer, used to detect various abnormal environmental conditions…
They waited a few seconds.
“Good, the Geiger counter isn’t ticking, let’s keep moving.”
The group quickly arrived in the man-made labyrinth, but they didn’t venture too deep…
In an area about a few dozen meters deep, they took out some remains of abnormal creatures and then placed a “flame”-shaped golden mark on top, infusing it with spirituality.
The next second, a bonfire blazed to life.
Almost a minute passed…
It seemed like there was no reaction?
“What now?” someone asked softly.
“Shh, be quiet, wait.”
Kawaii-many put a finger to his lips, indicating that Brother Shunzi probably wasn’t wrong.
However, two more minutes passed…
There was still no reaction here, and doubt began to rise, wondering if they might have got the method to light the bonfire wrong.
But just at that moment.
The entire mysterious underground labyrinth suddenly trembled, the vibrations escalating rapidly from mild to intense…
“Holy shit, an earthquake!”
“Don’t panic, don’t panic, everything is within Brother Shunzi’s expectations!”
The initial chaos was quickly quelled.
It was at this time that everyone distinctly felt that a vast and terrifying entity was spreading from the unknown depths. Its aura was indescribably fearsome, like a natural disaster, with an oppressive force too daunting for a direct gaze.
In their minds, an image formed, composed of mysterious frequencies, large enough to fill every inch of their mental space.
That figure was slightly bending down, looking at those who had arrived with a cold gaze.
‘Hiss, Brother Shunzi wouldn’t have us seek a true god’s assistance with our journey, would he?’ thought Kawaii-many as he took a sharp breath, disbelief shared by everyone present.
After all, this being in front of them could undoubtedly be described with one word—
“God!”
Or rather, this was an entity with a theoretical capability to destroy planets, end civilizations, and qualify as a First Level Containment Subject with a Great Will!
How could such a high-dimensional being kindly help them?
Even if it bore them no ill-will, they might have already dropped dead from merely looking at it!
And it was at this moment that the presence before them, looming like Mount Tai, spoke, “Who is it that disturbs my slumber?”
Kawaii-many struggled to suppress his emotions, took out a gold token from his pocket, and spoke to it with as calm a demeanor as possible:
“Honored ‘King of Mad Sounds,’ Brother Shunzi, I mean, the messenger of the ‘Bonfire,’ has asked me to inform you to assist us in reaching a designated area…”
Having heard his words, the unknown “God” extended a hand and drew the golden token to it.
After about a dozen seconds of silence…
“Indeed, it is a favor from a friend.”
The voice of the “King of Madness” boomed like thunder, causing everyone’s eardrums to itch.
“Then…”
Life Mentor Adorable was about to say something when he suddenly noticed.
The great existence extended His hand with a wave, and everyone immediately felt themselves covered by some kind of force, their bodies becoming strangely weird, and then they quickly moved in a certain direction at a speed they had never experienced before.
‘Damn, Brother Shunzi can actually be friends with a True God, terrifying, so terrifying…’
Some employees were communicating in the team’s minds.
“Look at what Brother Shunzi summoned, then look at what you summoned, flying such a short distance, and still charging…”
“The True God doesn’t even charge, and your lousy bird still does…”
“Exactly, exactly, this riding experience is so much better than being grabbed by yours”
“Fine, if there’s still a chance to use it later, I’ll authorize you to use it, and you can recite the lines…”
“I was just kidding, bro…”
…
Dozens of minutes later, everyone arrived at their destination and exited that special state in a vast space.
They wanted to thank the “King of Mad Sounds”…
But they felt that He might have already left directly.
“We’ve arrived…”
“Life Mentor Adorable” stumbled a bit, “The mission sense is very close, it shouldn’t be too far from here, but let’s rest a bit before heading over.”
There was no feeling during the teleportation.
But after teleportation, everyone was a bit disoriented, feeling a bit disrupted.
It took almost a dozen minutes for the D Level Personnel to return to normal first, but they didn’t rush to act because the E level employees still weren’t online in terms of Status.
Another dozen minutes passed, and everyone recovered and started moving again.
It took some time, but when they found the exit, everyone discovered that it seemed to be a sewer or a well…
Opening the rusted iron door, a strong, rotten stench came through.
“Life Mentor Adorable” wrinkled his brow and after making sure there was no danger, he peered out.
The heavy stench came from the bottom of the well, where a pile of decayed flesh, not knowing how long it had been dead, was soaking in the murky well water.
From some of the skulls sticking to the flesh, it seemed to be women and children, all decayed together, no telling how many people there once were…
And at the well opening, a stone was stuck there, blocking any way out.
The image alone was enough to guess at what had happened here.
Adorable applied a BUFF to himself and climbed out of the well, using some indentations in the wall to climb up, then listened at the large rock blocking the exit before smashing it with a punch.
A hazy light poured into the place from outside…
The stones fell down, but it didn’t affect him much, as they all fell into the well on one side.
The heavy stench surged up again.
Holding his breath, he stuck his head out and saw a rather common small village.
However, after suffering some unknown event, the village was deserted.
Moreover, an unsettling bluish-black fog was spreading around the area…
“Less than thirty kilometers away from here…”
After sensing for a while, Adorable was about to call the employees to continue moving and climb out of the well. Suddenly, he felt a strong surge of panic and sense of imminent crisis.
He turned his head instinctively, looking to the side.
There, unexpectedly, stood a figure.
No, to be more accurate, it was a monster, a creature covered in bluish-black pustules with its chest to belly split open on both sides like a vertical mouth!
It was at that moment.
The creature opened its massive “mouth” and charged at him at high speed.
“Life Mentor Adorable” didn’t panic. His right hand transformed into a beastly arm with long, sharp claws, bisecting the charging aberrant creature at the waist.
The eerie corpse hung to one side, wriggling continuously, its pustules bursting and dispersing bluish-black fog.
Seeing this, he furrowed his brows.
“Is this… a villager contaminated by the ‘Hunger’ aura?”
Fortunately, the problem wasn’t too significant. He called out, gathered the rest of the personnel, and prepared to start the final push.
As long as they could reach that place, the mission would be considered complete!
…
In the territory behind them, Colin was nervously watching the live projection in mid-air through some means Shana had left on the employees, with one hand holding a soda and the other a piece of roasted meat.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - 618 466 The Mantis Stalks the Cicada..._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 618: Chapter 466 The Mantis Stalks the Cicada…_1 Chapter 618: Chapter 466 The Mantis Stalks the Cicada…_1 Inside the small chapel.
“Sizzle… Hah.”
He downed half a bottle of cola in one gulp.
Colin felt at ease and continued to sit on the chair, raising his head to gaze at the shadow screen, sensing the real-time status ahead.
“Is it really okay for us to do this…” Shana said, also holding a bottle of soda in her hand.
Unlike Colin, she had hardly drunk any, feeling inexplicably guilty…
While others were fighting hard at the front, the two of them were eating and making arbitrary comments—didn’t that seem inappropriate?
“Relax, it’s fine. They can resurrect themselves after all, and their strength is not weak. At most, they’ll face some scares but no serious danger,” Colin said, waving his hand to indicate that there was no major problem.
“Tsk, speaking of which, I didn’t expect the ‘King of Mad Sounds’ to start showing its true nature the moment it failed to notice my presence. I had to remotely reveal a hint of my aura before it behaved properly. This guy’s character is indeed a bit unsuitable for great responsibilities.”
“Also, Kě’ài duō’s performance is not up to par. An elite creature forced to use ‘Deadly Insight’ to react…”
“Need more practice, so green.”
While Colin enjoyed the spectacle and snacked on seeds, he played to his hidden talent as a fountainhead strategist, providing assessments from afar.
However, even with his general evaluations,
The employees didn’t have much trouble against ordinary mutations.After slaughtering the small village where all the villager’s bodies had mutated, the employees continued their advance, encountering life forms along the way which had all mutated, demonstrating a very strong desire to feed and had extremely profane forms.
But overall, they were just ordinary life mutations, and the threats were not that great.
Yet, their movements, no matter how covert, were undoubtedly noticed by the “Gluttonous Feast.”
The cultists appeared very surprised, seemingly unaware that someone would dare attack from their rear.
Even the official Kingdom Knight Order did not dare to infiltrate this area because of the enveloping aura of the gods…
And yet this group was so bold?
“Stop them, devour them!”
“Leave their brains for me! I want to taste carefully what gave them the courage to step into this!”
“Devour! Devour! Devour!”
“…”
A mass of “Gluttonous Feast” cultists charged forward.
Their bodies emitted a dark green and black aura, capable of directly digesting everything around them. Upon moving, they resembled mouths that chewed incessantly.
“Too bad, they’re still a bit short when facing the employees, not to mention the ‘company’ has a natural suppression effect,” Colin murmured as he sipped more cola.
So far, aside from the noticeable resistance, everything seemed to be going smoothly for the employees.
Of course, this notion began to change as they ventured further in.
Watching, Colin suddenly felt that something was amiss?
“Their strength, seems a bit weak?”
Colin raised an eyebrow. In his estimation, “Hunger” was not likely to show up in person under these circumstances.
As long as no entity of his level appeared, there should be no problem.
Current intelligence also indicated that the other side did not have such a level.
As for “Hunger,” it was bound by many restrictions, and after the failed operation against Shana, there was no way it had not paid a price.
Thus the path should have been moderately challenging, but now, were the employees’ progress a bit too smooth?
Pushing forward easily, without a single hiccup.
However, just as Colin was puzzled, he suddenly felt a surge of palpitations.
It was then that the projection on the shadow screen flickered as if it were snow.
“Whoosh…”
Colin tossed aside the snack in his hand as flames erupted all over him.
At the same time, the image on the projection twisted as if connecting to an unknown region. This area was filled with endless dark green and black smog…
A terrifying figure sat solemnly in the deep.
Its eighteen soft, twisting arms and thousands of mouths generated the sounds of famished chewing…
Countless sounds of chains reminiscent of accompanying music arose…
But just as the image was rapidly zooming in, even forming some sort of passage, Shana reached out her hand and the projection shattered, turning into pieces on the ground.
Then, intense white light and a bonfire simultaneously blanketed the area, eradicating any potential lingering essence.
Several minutes later, everything slowly returned to calm…
“So that is ‘Hunger,’ truly a dangerous thing,” Shana said as she withdrew the intense light.
“Indeed, but judging by its status, it seems to still be under heavy restrictions…”
Colin recalled the previous image.
Countless chains, seemingly made of iron but actually of some unknown material, restricted that being so tightly.
At least it was restricted much more severely than when it initially attempted to devour the source of Beast Transformation Syndrome.
Of course, this fragment of it was not necessarily bigger, but it was more complete.
“It’s good that we didn’t attempt to confront it directly. With the nature of a ‘Flame Bearer,’ there’s no way to hide once crossing over. It could have pulled us into a direct confrontation.”
“Even if we won, the cost would be substantial.”
“Instead, D Level Personnel, whose strength is moderate, are just capable enough to operate right under their noses…”
Colin suddenly realized why sometimes the big players can’t make an immediate entrance.
With low-level employees under the radar, one can stealthily accomplish many things…
As for him, shining like a light bulb, his appearance would probably lead to a huge brawl.
However, at that moment, Colin suddenly turned his head, looking outside, and faintly sensed something.

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - 619 466 Praying Mantis Catches Cicada..._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 619: Chapter 466 Praying Mantis Catches Cicada…_2 Chapter 619: Chapter 466 Praying Mantis Catches Cicada…_2 …
At the same time.
“Why does this not feel quite right?”
“Life Mentor Adorable” raised his hand, clutching a River and Mountain Scroll. He swung it hard and smashed a Heretic Cultist into minced meat scattered all over the ground.
They had already breached their destination and were beginning the task of lighting the Bonfire.
“What’s off about it?” Team Leader of Squad 2 asked, puzzled.
“Isn’t everything going smoothly now?” a member of the employee squad replied through the comm.
This time, without waiting for Adorable’s response, Team Leader of Squad 5 said, “That’s exactly why it’s not right. So far, we haven’t encountered any heavyweight figures.”
According to the initial estimate, they should have come across at least three strong “God’s Favored Ones” along the way.
Adorable and the others had also prepared for revival countdowns.
However…
Up until now, they had reached the target area of the mission and were on the last step, but instead of three “God’s Favored Ones,” not even one had appeared.
It could even be said that Heretic Believers with substantial strength were few and far between.
Where had this group of people gone?
“Life Mentor Adorable” looked around at the writhing greenish-black haze in every direction and at the incessant attacks by small fry, feeling somewhat uneasy in his heart.
At that moment…
A warm current suddenly flared up from behind.
“The Bonfire has been successfully ignited!”
An employee exclaimed excitedly, but before Adorable could relax even a bit,
lines of captions appeared before their eyes.
[“Coordinates” have been set, target search in progress…]
[Report, target lost.]
[Target lost…]
[Report on materials review rejected…]
“They ran away?” “Life Mentor Adorable” was taken aback.
He looked around, suddenly realizing something, and hurriedly tried to contact Brother Shunzi, but no one responded to his message.
…
Elsewhere, outside Colin’s territory.
“Lord of the Eaters, that’s the place!”
A small-statured man emerged from the barren land, pointing ahead.
There, in the midst of the mountains, was a huge white barrier inverted onto the earth.
“Good, as long as we can destroy that flame, everything will start to improve!”
In the group of a dozen or so people, a man dressed in red with his left chest exposed and a vertical mouth on his abdomen spoke.
Strangely, although he spoke, his mouth did not open; the voice came from his abdomen.
“The power of the ‘Bonfire’ can only be matched by the Divine Envoy of the Bonfire and the Saintess of the Church of Light… others won’t suffice…”
“Now, those two, in order to deal with my Master, will necessarily go to the Black Mountains themselves, attempting profane acts…”
“They will never expect that we would take the initiative to come here instead.”
“By the time they realize it, we will have already destroyed the Bonfire and completely ended their delusions…”
“As for those dozen of people in the territory, although their strength is decent, they cannot stand against us as a whole…”
“Before destroying the Bonfire, refrain from indulging in those ordinary blood meals… Waste no thoughts on them…”
“Within thirty minutes, completely destroy the Bonfire!”
The red-clad man’s abdominal mouth writhed as it uttered a low chant reminiscent of reciting scripture.
“And after the Bonfire is destroyed?” one of the members asked.
“If you don’t want to die, leave immediately. Once everything settles down and my Master awakens from His slumber, the world will be filled with delicacies…”
Though they hadn’t taken it down yet, they didn’t hesitate to discuss the promising future world.
Having said this, they immediately took action and moved swiftly forward.
Each appeared to be just walking normally, yet strangely, they covered hundreds to thousands of meters in one step.
It was just when they were about a hundred meters away from the enormous light barrier that several members of the “Devouring Feast” opened their mouths wide, akin to flying fish, and bit down in front of them.
With their strength, they could easily bite through even high-grade steel and melt it directly upon contact…
However, when their teeth chomped down on the light membrane, there were only ripples spreading out, with no signs of damage.
“I’ll do it…”
The man draped in red stood before the barrier, whispered lowly, and his abdominal mouth stretched wide on both sides, spitting out stinkingly sour, incredibly thick greenish-black haze, charging at the white light, aiming to digest it directly.
A host of ripples dispersed…
Next, he extended a greenish-black arm forward, stretching it rapidly and striking the barrier.
“Crack, crack, crack…”
A mouth opened in the palm of his hand, biting the ethereal light and tearing off a piece, swallowing it.
At the same moment…
A small crack appeared in the barrier.
The red-clad man was about to look through the crack to observe the situation inside and inject digestive fluid to widen the breach further.
Yet, before he could do so, he noticed an eye within the hole suddenly looking back at him.
“?”
In an instant of confusion, he felt a surge of intense dread.
But before he could react…
He burst into flames like doused gasoline, every nerve in his body sending out torments of severe pain from the intense heat.
The skin on various parts of his body and some of his fat were almost instantly melted and ignited…
“Aaaaaaaah!”
The red-clad man endured the excruciating pain, his abdominal mouth sucking in the flames that engulfed him.
Only then did he manage to catch his breath…
“Clap, clap, clap…”
Inside the territory, Colin watched the scene unfold and clapped his hands, “Impressive, impressive. You actually managed to swallow the fire. Normal people would probably have been reduced to ashes…”
“Who are you? No, wait… you’re the Divine Envoy? How come you’re still here? How can you still be here?!”
The red-clad man suddenly realized something, his face filled with disbelief.
This power could only belong to the Bonfire Envoy; it couldn’t possibly be anyone else!

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - 620 466 Praying Mantis Catches Cicada..._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 620: Chapter 466 Praying Mantis Catches Cicada…_3 Chapter 620: Chapter 466 Praying Mantis Catches Cicada…_3 If that was the case, the current situation was completely different from what he had initially expected.
In his original plan, at most, they would be facing a “Light” Saintess. Although they might not be able to beat her, their goal wasn’t to win, but to destroy the “Bonfire”.
They were not afraid of the “Light” Saintess, but they had an innate fear of the Divine Envoy.
Fearful of the terrifying flame on his body that was filled with a desire for destruction…
However…
For such an important matter concerning the Master, shouldn’t he personally go over there? Why was he still in the territory?
Could it be that they had already seen through their plan?
At this moment, seeing a glowing figure standing not far away, he became even more certain of this—
These people had already seen through their plan!
“Since we’ve been seen through, there’s no other way, follow me and charge in!”
The man in red opened his abdominal mouth wide, spewing out a large amount of dense, dark blue mist. These mists didn’t disperse but enveloped him, forming a dark blue sculpture projection with eighteen arms…
A terrifying pressure swept through the area.
Inside the territory, a group of refugees huddled together trembling…
‘I didn’t expect that trying to slack off would lead to encountering big trouble…’
Listening to the opponent’s shout, Colin immediately understood why the employees had been so successful in the light screen projection earlier. It was because this group of “Gluttonous Feast” cultists planned to switch homes tactically.‘Nice plan, but bad luck.’
“Bring the fire!”
Colin raised his arm and called out, and a hundred-meter-tall bonfire within the territory gathered as if summoned.
The rich flames merged with the dark blue projection on the heretic cultist ahead…
And this collision did not last long, and the Bonfire had already shown an overwhelmingly suppressive status.
“Damn it!”
The man in red cursed under his breath. If it were other heretics, even if it was a clash of equal strength, they would quickly digest the power in such a collision, gradually weakening their opponent.
However, the Bonfire could not be consumed at all, and even if consumed forcefully, it could not be digested; it was utterly junk food…
“You, lend me your strength!”
His arm suddenly stretched out, grabbing towards his comrades, the mouth on his palm rapidly widened in the process.
In an instant, he swallowed all of them.
The believers did not struggle at all during this process.
As long as they could offer a bit of strength for the Great Gluttion, they were more than willing!
“Go, as long as you can touch…”
The man in red, who was fighting Colin, suddenly changed direction, enduring Colin’s fatal blow, he turned towards the small church’s Bonfire, his abdominal mouth bulged, and then “pffff” forcefully spurted out a dark blue finger.
“Prime Fragment?”
Colin’s gaze sharpened as he saw the finger shooting towards the Bonfire at high speed.
The light shield, which the cultists found hard to break, was now like a piece of paper, easily pierced and torn through…
He turned instinctively, wanting to intercept it.
Seeing this turn that revealed a flaw, the man in red’s mouth corner suddenly showed a barely noticeable mischievous smile.
At the same time, Colin’s scalp tingled, and he instantly felt an even more terrifying presence locking onto him from behind.
In his mind, an image emerged: a terrifying will looking at him from the enormous vertical mouth on the man’s abdomen behind him…
“No, this isn’t a misunderstanding, their target… is me?”
Colin suddenly came to his senses, immediately turned around, and his gaze became somewhat fixed.
The followers of the “Gluttonous Feast” might not have expected him to still be in the territory, but “Hunger” was different!
From within that gaping abdominal mouth, a strong-aura hand missing a finger, colored in dark blue, extended out…
Space solidified, leaving Colin unable to move, and he could only watch as the hand slowly reached for him.
Just then, at the moment he was about to be grasped…
Piercing siren sounds suddenly reverberated in the area, blinking red and blue lights alternated at a rapid pace.
…
.
.
[Text for revision before and after omitted]

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - 621 467 The Friendship Boat of the King of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 621: Chapter 467 The Friendship Boat of the “King of Savage Sound”. _1 Chapter 621: Chapter 467 The Friendship Boat of the “King of Savage Sound”. _1 “This… am I also bait?”
“No, rather, when did I begin to harbor the illusion that I was not bait?”
The moment he heard the piercing alarm, Colin immediately realized the reason.
The Believers of the “Gluttonous Feast” might have chosen to rob the house by mistake, but the “Hunger” hidden within them must be aware of everything and, seizing the opportunity by the error, came to rob the house as well…
Only, what it stole was Colin himself, and the Believers were its bait.
However, what it failed to anticipate was that Lady Bunny had likely been prepared on Colin’s part, also casting out some sort of bait.
From the looks of it, Lady Bunny’s fishing skills were somewhat superior, having caught a big fish.
Of course, this also related to the “Hunger” not being particularly astute.
[…The agreement application has been approved…]
[“World Code-13” off-site containment action intervention request approved…]
[…]
[…]
[…]
[The designated execution unit for this incident: D Level Employee “Number 654321”, Corps “Zoo,” and “0-09 ‘Hunger'” special operation team…]
…
[“Zoo” for “0-09 ‘Hunger'” special operation team intervention underway…]
Row after row of agreement notification content flashed through Colin’s mind with marvelous speed.
The content was slightly different from what he had seen before, but generally, it was similar, with only some differences in detail.
“A special operation team for ‘Hunger,’ not a Corps intervention like before?”
As thoughts flickered, Colin saw a world flickering with red and blue lights, where a large amount of grey fog appeared, enveloping both him and the group of people, blocking other gazes.
At the same time, the “Hunger’s” restrictive effects on him were lifted.
The giant azure-black hand hanging in midair trembled continuously as if it were locked onto by something, finding it difficult to advance or retreat for the moment.
“Boom…”
Doors bearing the scars of war were sketched out amidst the grey haze, rapidly swinging open, with a hazy figure and thick fog behind each one.
Unlike before, this time there wasn’t a large force of Corps members arriving—only a few people.
From behind a total of five gateways, one person emerged from each, their auras tremendously strong, wearing similar, seemingly heavy armors, carrying boxes with unknown contents; however, the helmets were fashioned like rhino horns, deer antlers…
“Sss, beings as strong as First Level Containment Subjects?” Colin inwardly trembled with fear.
At that moment, when these five figures saw him, they nodded to him in a friendly manner.
“The containment work is about to commence, if you don’t leave, be careful.”
These words surfaced in his mind.
Colin hesitated for a moment but ultimately decided to stay and watch.
It was at this moment…
The figures simultaneously opened the boxes in their hands, from which numerous chains spewing flames flew out, coiling toward the “Hunger.”
The flames on the chains were exceptionally restraining to the azure-black mist.
Gigantic cannon barrels, at this moment, extended from behind each Mist Gate, taking aim at “Hunger.”
Boom!
One figure, donning a deer antler helmet, stepped forward right before the cannon fire.
In this process, his body transformed, turning into countless purple lightning bolts, filling every space, billions of lightning flashes seemingly attempting to further blockade the area…
And not just him, the other figures also began transforming their very life forms.
Some into a special light that could turn everything into grains of salt…
Others into pitch-black thorns that could bind all…
Still others into comet-like starlight falling from unknown places…
…
Facing their attack, “Hunger” wasn’t sitting idly by, as most of its body was still within the Believer’s stomachs, unable to crawl out.
However, as some dangerous attacks approach, the surface of its azure-black body suddenly aged.
Then, like shedding its skin, it temporarily freed itself from some chains.
Afterward, half of its body crawled out from the Believers’ abdomens, flailing its arms, devouring the lightning, breaking the chains…
It even managed to pluck attacks lacking physical form directly out of the air.
Then it swung its palm in a wide arc, slapping them away…
Colin saw that with just such a slap, the deer-headed fellow who had nodded at him was struck from his thunderous guise back into human form, losing one-seventh of his body…
On the far side, “Hunger” instinctively prepared to digest the portion of lightning but perhaps due to the “agreement” protection, it failed and had to spit it out…
“Is it that exaggerated?”
Colin clicked his tongue, “Hunger’s” countermeasures appeared simple and crude.
No fancy tricks…
But they were extremely effective; whatever came at it, a backhand slap was the response, then a grab to stuff it into its mouth, crisp and crunchy.
It was quite the sense of overpowering all tactics with sheer force.
As time trickled by, the entire independent space filled with grey fog was bursting with terrifying auras, and even just standing back and watching was almost too much for Colin.
Gigantic entities writhed and smashed into each other here; an accidental brush that caused a shockwave could leave his internal organs vibrating…
“I’ll watch a bit longer and then withdraw…”
Colin extended his hand to intercept, controlling the flames to encircle his body, continuously protecting himself.
If he had been promoted and was an experienced Flame Bearer, watching here might have been effortless.
But he was currently just a Reservist, especially one not yet C Level…
Just ensuring his own safety while enjoying the show was proving to be quite strenuous.

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - 622 467 The Friendship Boat of the King of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 622: Chapter 467 The Friendship Boat of the ‘King of Savage Sound’._2 Chapter 622: Chapter 467 The Friendship Boat of the ‘King of Savage Sound’._2 The key thing is, these battles between living beings are a bit too abstract, hard to comprehend…
Instead of calling them battles, they’re more like various types of natural disasters clashing with each other.
Like a tornado colliding with a volcanic eruption…
No people can be seen, just all sorts of “special effects.”
However, Colin did notice something, that these individuals didn’t seem like they were about to take down “Hunger” anytime soon.
Moreover, the intensity of the fight appeared to keep escalating.
He had no desire to become the first “Flamebearer” Reservist in history to die from “watching the spectacle.”
That would be too much fun.
So he wasn’t planning to stay much longer and would leave once it felt about right…
However…
At the same time, deep beneath the surface of “World Code-13,” a human-shaped figure transformed by the “King of Madness” pressed his ear against the wall at its edge, listening for noise returning from the outside.
“Why is the ‘Bonfire Company’ fighting with ‘Hunger’ over here?”
The “King of Madness” was surprised; he hadn’t expected a fight to break out right after sending people away.
It just felt like the location of the fight was off?
Wasn’t it supposed to be in the “Black Mountains”?
He had multiple observation points set up there, looking forward to eavesdropping, only to hear nothing, while a battle broke out at the “Bonfire Company” agent’s location?
Although unsure of what accident had occurred, he still rushed to the scene immediately and watched from a distance.
The company’s various shielding was very well-executed, but a battle of this magnitude couldn’t possibly be completely hidden.
Especially with his unique authority…
Through vibrations imperceptible to humans, he could reconstruct most of the battle’s imagery in his mind.
“Strange, it’s not the large-scale Corps like last time, didn’t they say you need more people to trigger the core content of the ‘Bonfire Protocol’?”
“Could there be some special arrangement from the higher-ups?”
“Wait, why do I feel like there are two familiar authority powers inside…”
As the “King of Madness” listened for a while, he suddenly exclaimed in shock:
“What?! That Salt Lord and the guy who emits purple electricity had already become external combat employees?!”
These two were among those who had charged with him at the “World Code” back in the day!
They had just broken through the defenses, claiming to have collided with the “Primordial Fire” Corps, but in reality, they had run into Rosen. The other few hardly participated.
Three against one, one dead, two critically injured…
No, looking at it now, that guy hadn’t died at all, and those two, who had clearly been determined not to submit, one moment later, while he was still in prison, the other two had already become external combat employees for the “Zoo” Corps!
Damn it, he shouldn’t have been so inflexible back then!
The most annoying thing for the “King of Madness” was, according to what Rosen had said back then.
Of their batch of “Ancient Gods,” the first one to agree would mean reduced treatment for the others…
But similarly, if two could stand firm together, they would both receive the best contracts in the future.
The “King of Madness” had been thinking that upon getting the chance to come out, he would persuade this individual again, only to find out that the other had “come back to life,” not to mention defected from their small group.
If he joined now, not only was he likely to lose any chance of receiving benefits, but his period of service might also be extended…
He could sense that an incomprehensible disaster was likely to take place in the very near future.
But the future is the future, and now is now.
All of a sudden, the “King of Madness” became deeply distrustful of others.
“No, maybe I can contact them directly…”
With that thought, the “King of Madness” exerted all his strength to send a message to the two old acquaintances above, hoping they would take him with them when they left for work.
That way, past grievances could be erased, and the little boat of friendship could be righted.
They could still be good friends.
However…
A good while passed, and he received no response.
…
“Time to slip away…”
After another round of observation, Colin chose to exit.
Although if he were to ignite his “Microcosm,” he might not be incapable of joining the fray and providing some assistance. With the “Bonfire’s” remarkably strong counteracting effect against “Hunger,” containment could perhaps be concluded faster…
But doing that would carry little meaning and high risk.
Of course, another reason for choosing to exit was due to an unidentified team member who seemed to send an “Inspiration” his way, suggesting he leave once he had seen enough.
“If I continue spectating, could some unnecessary conflict arise?”
Colin tried to interpret the “Inspiration” message, a bit confused, but he didn’t have time to ponder the reason any further.
As the thought of leaving took shape, a layer of gray fog enveloped him.
In an instant, Colin saw himself retreating from the relentless battlefield…
“Hiss, my eyes…”
Just came out, Colin was met with blinding light all around, causing sharp pain in his pupils.
The world outside was shrouded in an exceedingly intense white incandescence at some unknown time.
However, the next second, all the light converged, turning into a glowing, chubby-looking sphere with six pairs of wings.
Then, the sphere’s glow receded, transforming into the likeness of Shana.
‘Unnecessary conflict, that’s what it was talking about…’
Colin squinted his eyes, rubbing them while he figured out the reason—
Shana, the Saintess, was capable of communicating with the dim-witted Angels of Wisdom in the “Radiant Angel” corps to some extent.
He had vanished without explaining the situation to the other party just now.
If Shana misunderstood and summoned the stupidity angel defense system of the “Radiant Angel” corps.
That indeed…
It could lead to an unnecessary conflict between the two corps.
‘I wonder which corps would be the stronger in a fight…’
Colin thought with a mindset of enjoying the commotion.
At this moment, up in the midair, Shana saw Colin appear unharmed and quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, without waiting for her wings to disappear, they fluttered, and she instantly appeared beside Colin.
Feathers flew out, turning into streaming lights that circled around Colin while Shana spoke:
“What happened?”
Originally, she was in her domain, responsible for protecting all ordinary people, while Colin went out to meet the enemy.
To her surprise, a terrifying aura suddenly erupted from outside.
Just as she was about to take action, she saw a weird flicker of red and blue light in the outer region, then everything disappeared.
In her urgency, Shana transformed herself and faintly sensed Colin’s presence within a “gray mist tumor” high in the sky.
However, no matter how she attacked, it was hard to penetrate that defense.
Thankfully, just as she prepared to communicate with the things inside this “protection zone,” the “gray mist tumor” spat Colin back out, safe and sound.
“It’s okay, the ‘Hunger’ issue should be resolved now…”
Colin briefly explained the situation.
This time “Lady Bunny” didn’t send a large number of people over like last time, but instead carried out some kind of… precise strike.
The vast majority of people from the outside world probably didn’t even know about this incident.
Hearing this, Shana didn’t speak immediately, until after checking Colin up and down for injuries and ensuring there was no damage, she nodded indifferently, “That’s good then.”
‘Thinking about it, if we let the battlefield shift to the outside world, and let these monsters fight unrestrained, thousands of miles around might suffer…’
Colin recalled the terrifying clashes he had seen in that space, and couldn’t help but click his tongue.
The destructive power of high-level Containment Subjects was indeed formidable…
A single blow could cause mountains to collapse and the earth to split; even if they held back in battle, it would still cause great destruction in the world.
Then, as time ticked by…
Almost the next day, a piece of information swept through Colin’s mind.
[Containment work is completed, the current “0-09 ‘Hunger'” accounts for about one-eighth…]
[No other fragment information detected…]
[Preparing to withdraw.]
[Withdrawal complete.]
“It’s done?” Shana also sensed something.
“Yeah.” Colin nodded.
That also meant that in “World Code-13,” within the domains he was currently aware of, all fragments of “Hunger” had been collected.
As for whether there were any hidden in other corners, that was yet to be known.
“Having recollected one-fifth and one-eighth, I wonder where the other fragments are…”
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - 623 468 Blessed with the Wildfire..._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 623: Chapter 468: Blessed with the Wildfire…_1 Chapter 623: Chapter 468: Blessed with the Wildfire…_1 “It looks like the company will have to wait to get the complete ‘Hunger’ back,”
Colin muttered to himself as the recovery mission ended.
It would probably be difficult to find other fragments in a short time…
Of course, the only known piece of ‘Hunger’ that was still out there was the one deeply rooted inside his body, which seemed like a fragment, but also not quite.
However, to recover it, they would likely have to wait until he became a ‘Flame Bearer’ or reached B Level.
Otherwise, even at C Level, he could at most forcefully prevent it from acting up.
There was no way to further deepen its use or deal with it.
“But on the bright side, having ‘Hunger’ attached also has its perks; first, the fragments of ‘Hunger’ might have some kind of invisible attraction to each other, so there’s the possibility of encountering more in the future…”
“And…”
“If I successfully become a ‘Flame Bearer’ in my next step, why do I have the feeling that I’ll naturally be able to master ‘Hunger’ and become a bonafide Jinchuriki of ‘Hunger’?”
Colin arched an eyebrow, realizing that he wouldn’t even need to extract it.
After all, a ‘Flame Bearer’ seemed to naturally harness ‘Hunger’.
By then, as a ‘Flame Bearer’ combined with ‘Hunger’, his stats panel would be stronger than that of other ‘Flame Bearers’ right off the bat.
In that case, he didn’t know how he could lose—
Oh, it seems that’s not entirely true; there are still stronger forces in the world.
Otherwise, Rosen wouldn’t have had control over the complete ‘0-09’ ‘Hunger’ and still met his end.
“Phew…”
Colin reined in his thoughts and, along with Shana, made a round to confirm the area was secure, taking care of all the ‘Gluttonous Feast’ heretics.
After a blinding flash of light, all signs of life were extinguished from the heretics, and even the blood that was still flowing in their bodies was purified into Pure Water that could be drunk on the spot.
Then, they died instantly.
“Hss…”
Colin took a sharp breath, feeling that the scene was eerily strange, even more so than seeing a person being blasted to pieces with a punch.
However, only after confirming there were no issues did they return to their domain.
Inside the domain, under Shana’s protection, tens of thousands of people didn’t even know what had just happened outside.
All they knew was that the ‘Bonfire’s Envoy of God had seemingly called upon the ‘Light’ Church’s Saintess to bring down her blessing light, driving away the darkness in people’s hearts and purifying and eradicating many viruses.
“Praise the great ‘Bonfire’s Envoy of God, for he has brought the holy light…”
“Praise the ‘Bonfire’…”
The clueless Bonfire Followers prayed.
Watching this group, basking in her radiance yet thanking someone else, the Saintess had an odd look in her eyes and an indescribable feeling of mixed emotions.
Ten plus hours quickly passed.
The next day at dawn, a vibration from afar began to be felt on one side of the domain…
A huge shadowy figure was rushing towards them.
Each of its steps caused the ground to shake non-stop.
A group of domain residents who were plowing the fields panicked, dropped their hoes, and ran.
“Don’t rush, don’t run, it’s okay,” an employee called out after a glance in the distance, using a megaphone to calm everyone.
It wasn’t a problem for them to run, but trampling the young potato plants would be.
This was a new field…
As an official of the ‘Bonfire Church,’ his words carried some weight.
The people gradually stopped and took a breath of relief when they saw what was coming.
“It’s the ‘Holy Beast’! Praise the ‘Bonfire’ Church’s Holy Beast, the Corpse Mountain Holy Beast…”
An old-fashioned Bonfire Believer fell to his knees, fervently shouting in prayer.
As he knelt, other refugees also began to kneel, earnestly shouting the name of the “Mountain of Smiling Corpses.”
“┗|｀O′|┛ Wow~~”
Corpse Mountain replied from afar.
‘Ah, there’s really no need for that.’
The employee in charge of the fields looked somewhat helplessly at the Believers kneeling beside him and then lifted his head to gaze at the enormous meatball over ten meters in diameter, using its hands to support its round body as it charged over rapidly.
On its body and within its mouth, there were quite a few employees.
Corpse Mountain didn’t pause. As it neared the fields, it suddenly turned into a shadow and dived underground, quickly moving toward the small chapel.
Without damaging the farmland around…
…
Outside the small chapel.
The shadow shaped by Corpse Mountain arched upward here, transforming back into its meatball form.
Then, with some hesitation and seeming reluctance, it spat out the employees in its mouth like spitting out watermelon seeds.
To avoid them hitting the ground directly, it kindly caught the employees with its hands.
“How did your mission go?”
Colin stood at the entrance of the chapel, holding a bowl of freshly prepared braised beef noodles, his gaze sweeping over the group:
“Looks like no one’s dead?”
“Right,”
“Life Mentor Adorable” lay on a stretcher, being carried over to him.
Colin glanced at him; his body was riddled with bite marks, especially his hands, pocked with more than a dozen holes, and one of his legs, from the calf down, was gnawed to just flesh clinging to a pinkish bone…
The bone was still marked with numerous teeth imprints.
Colin looked past him to the others, who were all more or less injured, varying from unharmed to the most severe with a vacant look, missing their lower half, but still breathing toughly…
“My legs and butt, they hurt so much…” he murmured.
Other employees kindly comforted him, “No, it’s all an illusion, your butt’s in the ‘Storage Room’, it doesn’t hurt, don’t overthink…”
…
Following Colin’s gaze, Kě’ài duō also scanned his own people, and thinking about what had happened before, he couldn’t help but grit his teeth:

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - 624 468 Blessed with the Wildfire..._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 624: Chapter 468: Blessed with the Wildfire…_2 Chapter 624: Chapter 468: Blessed with the Wildfire…_2 “Those guys must’ve used some method that made us feel like our connection with our bodies was unstable; otherwise, we could’ve slaughtered them all without a scratch…”
“Damn it, seriously, the fight was disgustingly annoying,” an employee carrying a stretcher couldn’t help but curse.
Midway through the battle, they suddenly felt as if the “bandwidth” was being siphoned from their bodies.
It almost led to a turnaround by the enemy in what should have been an easy win.
It was extremely frustrating…
Listening to this, Colin translated in his mind, “It lagged, if it didn’t lag, they’d all be dead.”
They talked tough, even if they weren’t that strong.
Well, that’s not entirely true, thinking over the employees’ words, that must have been when “Lady Bunny” deployed her legion.
Perhaps there really was a minor issue with the signal.
Colin waved his hand: “It’s fine, as long as you’re alive.”
After a pause, he continued, “Did you guys bring back your limbs and stuff?”
“We did.” “Life Mentor Adorable” took out a bag from the “Storage Room.”
The bag contained chunks of flesh and bits of organs, as well as some bones and so on…
This was what he collected from the bellies of their enemies afterward; they were still alive, and cleaning them up should make them usable again.
“That’s good,” Colin nodded.
Although they hadn’t brought back any severed limbs, they knew recovery would be much slower without them, even though it could be achieved through various means; employees who often lost arms or legs knew this all too well.
Then, ignoring the thick scent of blood in the air,
Colin summoned the “Mark of the Fire Tree.”
The moment the huge tree appeared, countless aerial roots fell like tentacles, inserting into their bodies and slowly enveloping each wounded person.
At the same time, Colin also had them activate some of their Talents, and had the Little Maid combine other healing artifacts with functional properties.
To treat everyone present…
“They should all recover in about two or three days.”
In this regard, Colin was relatively generous and did not cut back on resources for the sake of saving.
After all, the faster they healed, the sooner the employees could get back to work.
There were backlogged tasks on his territory that needed attending to.
“By the way, Brother Shunzi, how did the mission go?” “Life Mentor Adorable” called out from within the cocoon of roots atop the Fire Tree.
“Everything went smoothly,” Colin gave a “OK” hand gesture.
Hearing this, all workers including Cute Duo, while sighing with relief, couldn’t help but smile a bit.
They expected to receive quite a Points after returning.
‘Successfully retrieved “Hunger,” then obtained a severed hand, and also dealt with the contents of the hidden trade with the “Subsidiary.” Feels like we’re going to score quite a number of Points…’
Colin thought about it and felt that this time, they should have a decent haul.
At the very least in terms of Points, “Lady Bunny” was always generous.
There should be a chance to upgrade “Time Freeze” and extend its range further, and the duration should increase as well.
From 7 seconds, upgraded to 9 seconds.
It might seem like just two seconds, but for a master, that extra time might just be enough to bring in a steamroller.
Shaking his head, Colin turned and went back to the Conclave, letting Shana know she should be able to get a share of Points next time.
“Ah, is that possible…” Shana was stunned.
“Of course, if it weren’t for you, we wouldn’t have found ‘Hunger’ at all.”
Colin nodded, affirming the part this “Saint” played.
“Okay, then, thank you.” Shana nodded in thanks; she had observed over time that these people earned far more Points than she did.
If she dared to hope, perhaps ten times as much!
She wasn’t sure about the specifics behind such disparity, but she didn’t dwell on it too much—firstly because the Parchment couldn’t be helped, and secondly because as long as she had enough Points for her needs, she was content.
Most of the time, she used them to help others, with only a small portion for herself.
For example, entering “Light Dreamland” and summoning a diagram of the tree required spending Points—usually ten for a single entry.
Then again, opening the diagram needs ten Points…
And closing it needs another ten Points.
One trip could cost about thirty Points.
In the past, to save, she would hoard a bunch of tree nutrients before entering to upgrade herself.
Now, thanks to the large amount of Points from Mr. Colin,
things were less tight.
Of course, even if there was no urgency, she had no intentions of spending hundreds of Points in “Light Dreamland” to transform her appearance to “Mythic Form.” That seemed too indulgent—it was like changing clothes without any substantial improvement, and to her it was rather pointless and overly extravagant…
Several days passed quickly, and the time to depart was approaching.
As usual, Shana gifted Colin a meticulously crafted and substantial Gold Mark.
The surging “Light” energy within it almost seemed to overflow.
“Just this mark alone feels like it’s worth several thousand Points,” Colin weighed it in his hand, silently estimating.
Apart from him, Shana also presented smaller Gold Marks to the other employees, which she could easily produce with a flick of her wrist.
Although their effects were not as strong as Colin’s, the employees were elated.
After all, judging from the previous little golden beans, these Marks were really useful!
…
“Dong~ Dong~ Dong~”
The distant and ancient bell sounds slowly faded in the ear…

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - 625 468
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 625: 468 Chapter 625: 468 In his small bedroom, Colin opened his eyes and gazed at the familiar ceiling, his expression somewhat bewildered.
Having been in that realm for too long, even he felt an inexplicable sense of daze.
It took almost half an hour before he began to feel a bit better.
“Sigh…”
