However, hearing her, Akasha’s expression became odd for a moment, then she shook her head. Although the timing was off, she actually found herself with a little anticipation for Erni’s reaction once he awoke?
‘This… once alive, probably could grind out a swimming pool with his toes.’
Listening to those words, Colin thought for a while and decided to be thorough in his kindness, not rushing to the rescue.
He would wait until the man finished saying all the things he never dared to say.
After a long wait, when the black-robed man’s voice had already become faint, Colin began to provide assistance.
He had the Little Maid and the “Fire Tree” join in the healing…
The incision on the man’s body was fairly neat, and since all the organs that should be in place were there, with the Little Maid’s nano-level precision in stitching and filling, coupled with the “Fire Tree’s” repair.
As long as one hadn’t turned into utter rubble or undergone a chemical change, the situation wouldn’t be too severe.
One second of treatment and the next second of awakening meant he could work; in two more days, he could jump and hop around.
For Colin, the current hassle were wounds with various kinds of contamination, like if the man’s lower body had been polluted by a “Mutated Body” with its own ideas, that would be difficult to treat.
“‘Bonfire’ Sir, can he be successfully saved?” Akasha inquired.
This time, before Colin could speak, another D Level Employee, Orange Cat, said, “Don’t worry, this kind of injury is not a problem, I guess in a while he will be able to work the fields.”
“That’s good…” Akasha sighed with relief, seeing their confidence.
At this moment, Colin seemed to think of something and then said, “However, there could be some side effects.”
“Side effects?” Akasha was taken aback.
“Yes, there’s a considerable chance that his power will be completely cleared.
His healing would inevitably involve the power of the Flame Bearer.
To be honest, these people didn’t really qualify as true Extraordinary Ones, whose powers were as hard to remove as tattoos, while these were more like stickers, easily washed off.
Just like Akasha, who had been deeply healed by Colin before, was just someone with many ‘stickers,’ so she could still use some power now.
“As long as he lives, that’s acceptable…” Akasha breathed a sigh of relief.
Immediately, she added, “Of course, we will provide appropriate compensation at that time, we won’t let you help for nothing.”
After the minor interlude, Colin didn’t dwell much longer on the matter.
He lifted his head, gazing at the land filled with twisted flesh and blood.
Giants composed of “Wildfire” strode through here, although many odd Mutated Bodies flung themselves at the flames like moths to a flame, seemingly willing to sacrifice their lives to stop his advance.

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - 655 Sleeping Dragon and Young Phoenix at branch 486._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 655: Sleeping Dragon and Young Phoenix” at branch 486._2 Chapter 655: Sleeping Dragon and Young Phoenix” at branch 486._2 Unfortunately, these things alone hardly posed any effective hindrance to him.
“So, it seems, this world is not as dangerous as Akasha says, huh.”
Colin crossed his arms, feeling that the overall problem was not significant.
If those periodic natural disasters could be avoided without harm, then among the remaining dangers, as long as there was one among the “Night” Believers with strength comparable to Shana’s or his own, most places could be traversed with ease.
The only terrifying things were that natural disaster and the apparently sealed “Night.”
However, it seemed not to be a big problem since the seal was very strong.
…
Several hours later, Colin suddenly saw, in a distant forest, a number of scattered train carriages, amounting to five.
And within these five carriages, there were probably more than a thousand people.
“All Extraordinary Ones, their strength on official classification varies from Level 2 to Level 4, with a small number at Level 5 and Level 6…”
Colin narrowed his eyes slightly, although their strength was not high.
But the quantity was indeed large…
And this was just a small part of the “Rebel forces.”
On the side of the “regular army,” according to Akasha’s words, the number was several times larger…..
The proportion of ordinary people to Extraordinary Ones was frighteningly high.
“We’ve arrived; this is one of our bases…” Akasha pointed there and said.
The train carriages had been stolen one by one in broad daylight while the other side was off guard and not paying attention.
At that moment, when the Wildfire Giant seemingly as tall as a small mountain appeared,
the people who walked out of the carriages were all shocked…
“This… is this really our reinforcement?”
If someone hadn’t come back early to notify them, they would have already picked up their buckets and fled, for this entity before them exuded an oppressive feeling many times stronger than the most terrifying Mutated Body they had ever seen!
Moreover, in the presence of that kind of Bonfire, they could distinctly feel the “Night” power within them diminish.
This made them feel even more unsettled.
“Don’t worry, it’s one of our own.” One of the “Night” believers who had come back early to inform them said.
Then another employee using the “Night” powers expressed his concern:
“If we make such a big move, what if we get discovered?”
“If we get discovered, so be it, it’s okay, they wouldn’t dare come over here,” the “Night” believer replied confidently.
This reinforcement’s strength even surpassed Lavinia’s by a great deal…
If the enemy had even a hint of sense, they wouldn’t entertain the thought of coming over here.
While people whispered amongst themselves, they suddenly saw the entire Flame Giant burst into intense flames, then all the flame rose like smoke into the air and condensed into a huge fireball in midair.
From within the fireball, it seemed that another kind of flame with a different nature devoured this sphere filled with destruction, annihilation, and wildness, and turned it into a more brilliant and noble fire…
That fireball hung high in the sky, evenly spreading warmth they had never experienced before.
“Fire…”
People gazed at the large fireball, their human nature receiving nourishment.
As for the “Night”?
What “Night”?
Unfamiliar.
They could hardly imagine how wonderful this feeling was…
The darkness flowing in some people’s eyes slowly faded away at this moment, turning into the look of a burning Bonfire.
…
“I actually feel someone’s belief transforming?”
Colin was slightly surprised; though he had deliberately changed “Wildfire” into “Bonfire,” aiming to gain some prestige for himself,
he truly hadn’t expected such firm commitment in the beliefs of the “Night” Believers present.
Just showing his power caused some to transform their faith directly…
Even bypassing processes like “doubt,” “shaking,” and the like.
‘It’s no wonder the company felt it necessary to stage a rescue, their biggest problem isn’t the belief in “Night”, but their inner belief. If the former is truly reciprocal, there’s basically no hope, but the latter… there might be a chance for rescue…’
In the blink of an eye, Colin, along with a large fireball, followed a group of people to the encampment.
It’s worth mentioning that the squad leader, who was supposed to have awoken at the “Fire Tree”‘s behest, was still unconscious at this moment, whether truly still out or feigning it, no one knew.
Shortly after, Colin beckoned with his hand, and the giant fireball began to “melt,” continuously converging int his palm.
Eventually, it fully merged into his body…
During this process, those around saw how effortlessly he manipulated the fireball.
Their gazes towards him grew even more reverent.
‘The set of movements designed by Miss Shana for me, are indeed much better than my original ones.’
Colin felt the weight of those stares and silently reflected.
His usual practice was just to snap his “fingers,” and extinguish the fireball.
However, after interacting with Shana, she had helped him to design a set of movements that proclaimed his “authority” over flame, far more than his old method.
It kept people’s focus not on the fireball, but on him, enhancing his prestige.
Making subsequent actions all the more convenient…
“Brother Shunzi… your skills seem to have improved.”
Two employees watched Brother Shunzi’s fluid movements and couldn’t help exclaiming, contemplating how wonderful it would be to have such power themselves.
Although their own strength wasn’t weak, it still fell a little short in comparison.
It was after dispersing the fireball that Colin and the others were led into a spacious train carriage.
Once seated, Colin didn’t bother with pleasantries but went straight to the point:
“Regarding the plan to stop this ‘Eternal Night’ and the proposed action for the train, do you have it ready?”
Upon hearing his words, several of those present looked towards Akasha, who gave a subtle nod, prompting one of the group to speak:
“Yes, generally it’s all here…”
As he said this, he took out a piece of parchment, manipulating it as if activating a kind of memo function.
A multitude of words holographically floated in mid-air.
‘Firstly, leaving aside what the plan entails, you… in these ‘Subsidiary’ offices that are highly likely to fall, still dare to use this thing to record matters…’
Colin could only marvel at the ‘Sleeping Dragon and Young Phoenix’ of this Subsidiary.
Such blind faith, such audacity, and not a hint of crisis awareness.
Noticing his concern, Akasha quietly reassured, “Don’t worry, these parchment scrolls aren’t connected to the company; there’s no need to fear a data breach… ”
I hope so… Colin nodded, his eyes scanning over the text.
The plans of these people in terms of action were not complicated… simply summed up as infiltrating and not concerned about making it back alive, adopting a “take peace with life and death, just do it” philosophy.
But what he was really interested in was not these people’s impulsive arrangements, but the enemy’s setup…
‘The train carriages are currently bound by a device known as the ‘Thorn Device’, with eight main binding devices in total that must be severed simultaneously in a short span of time. Then, there’s also destroying the power supply lines…’
‘Once disconnected, providing the train with some momentum and gaining certain permissions could give us a chance to get it moving again.’
‘The Level 2 Containment Subject they suggest we bring seems to be for this purpose, to provide initial momentum, to reach the ninth station, then to enter the refueling area—I just don’t know where this ninth station is…’
Colin’s mind raced.
Destroying this “Thorn Device” seemed not too difficult.
But, what exactly does gaining certain permissions entail? It wasn’t specified.
After asking, Colin learned that this “permission” was located in a special carriage of the “Dusk Sect” and it was packed with powerful “Night” Believers like the Senate.
But the specifics, even Akasha didn’t understand…
“This sounds like the old ‘how to fit an elephant into a refrigerator’ joke. First, find a fridge. Second, find an elephant. Third, put the elephant in the fridge… and you’re done.”
Colin couldn’t help but scoff internally.
Nevertheless, the “permissions” were definitely located there, and if not found by then, “Lady Rabbit” was likely to provide some hints for the mission.
Next, Colin’s gaze shifted to the status of the “Eternal Night” ritual.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 656 487 Another Former Company Employee_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 656: Chapter 487: Another “Former Company Employee”?_1 Chapter 656: Chapter 487: Another “Former Company Employee”?_1 “The general content of the ‘Eternal Night’ ritual is to pray to a symbolic stonework representing The Night within the train perimeter, then to pour a large amount of blood from hunted Mutated Bodies as a sacrifice…”
“When the atmosphere is about right, one-third of the selected people are allowed to enter.”
“Once inside, they call for ‘Dusk’ to descend, and the ritual usually lasts from three to seven days, the actual duration depends on the number of Extraordinary Ones that appear and the death toll…”
“That’s how power is obtained…”
Colin licked his lips, feeling the ritual was also simple and crude.
Interestingly, before the chosen third enter, they all have Gold implanted in their bodies to carry the power of The Night in the mystical realms; this way, even if the Extraordinary Ones die later, their power can be inherited by recovering the Gold in their bodies, the only difference being, it’s not as good as the original, and there’s no possibility for enhancement—
In Colin’s view, it was a bit like installing a battery in the body.
‘The fact that Gold shines so brightly in the field of mystical materials and can be used in these ways is honestly quite amazing and incomprehensible…’
Colin’s gaze continued to scan the content of the ‘Eternal Night’ ritual, he occasionally asked Queen Akasha and other personnel present for some details.
According to tradition, “The Dusk Sect” was basically adamant about starting the ‘Eternal Night’ ritual tomorrow.
Because from tomorrow, there will be a period of cloudless skies…
That would be the most opportune time for the ritual.
Of course, these people could choose to postpone, but such a delay might be indefinite.
For the next ‘cloudless day,’ no one knows when it will come.
Seated beside Colin, Queen Akasha spoke, “If lucky, it might be in a month, if not, perhaps it’ll take a year or even longer, the more time passes, the greater the pressure will be for food resources…”
“After all, everyone has just survived a periodic natural disaster, and stocks are not plentiful.”
“To survive, public complaints will rise, and the restless mentality of the masses will be even more detrimental to the ritual.”
“I see…”
Colin nodded, he hadn’t expected that the ‘Believers’ here could actually complain…
In other Heretic Churches, if the higher-ups issued an order in the ‘Master’s’ name, the frenzied Believers would probably endure until they starved to death.
Here…
There’s quite a bit of freedom of thought.
“Then let’s start working on it the day after tomorrow morning.”
Having agreed on the time simply, Colin then looked towards Queen Akasha, whose body had by now mostly healed.
Once she removed her black robe and hood, she appeared rather striking, with long, smooth black hair and deep, black eyes with soft, well-defined features.
“By the way, can you think of what to do when the time comes?” Colin asked.
Destabilizing the ritual and releasing the train seemed fairly likely with his involvement, but the method of making millions obey all at once was still uncertain, which made him somewhat uneasy.
Upon hearing this, Akasha tilted her head, thought for a few seconds, and ultimately shook her head: “I’m sorry, I just have a feeling that tells me what needs to be done at the time, I can’t explain exactly how.”
“Alright…”
Colin pursed his lips, hoping that there wouldn’t be any slip-ups when the time came.
Otherwise, even if the ritual was thwarted and the train freed, he doubted he could easily extricate himself, since “Bonfire Company” had so many rules and regulations that, even if his conscience were eaten away and he chose to ignore everyone else, he couldn’t just drive off and escape.
Just the thought of getting mired in this mess made Colin feel weary…
However, regardless of the difficulties, the task still needed to be done.
After praying that “Lady Rabbit” had chosen a reliable woman, he proceeded to the next round of discussion.
They delegated specific tasks, such as who would disrupt the ‘Eternal Night’ ritual and who would destroy the train’s ‘Thorn Binding Device’ and so forth.
Colin was inclined to disrupt the ritual himself when the time came, while the rest, including the two D-Level Employees who had followed, were to focus on destroying whatever ‘Thorn Binding Device’ was on the train.
After all, the ritual would undoubtedly have the most participants at the time.
Plus, with the power of ‘Night’ descending…
If left to those misfits, he feared he might never consider leaving this world again in his lifetime.
After all the discussions were concluded, the sky gradually darkened, and their exchange came to a halt.
The sense of crisis intensified somewhat, but there were no exceptionally puzzling phenomena beyond understanding, which was a relief.
Colin glanced outside the carriage, in some worlds when night came, like in ‘World Code-13,’ the entire world would be shrouded in an oppressive darkness that was hard to articulate.
He had tried to find out more about it, but there were no clear answers.
Shana couldn’t explain it, and the ‘King of Savage Sound’ told him it was probably some sort of special containment mechanism at work.
But the details were likely known only to those with B-Level Authority…
Later, to persuade him, the ‘King of Savage Sound’ said something quite sensible—since a mechanism is currently functioning properly and isn’t showing any major flaws, it’s not necessary to delve too deeply into it.
Otherwise, it could be problematic if just looking at it caused an issue.
Fortunately, there were none of these vexing things here.
At that moment, Akasha suggested, “Shall we eat something?”
“You guys go ahead.”
Colin declined the offer to try food from other worlds, but he was quite curious about what kind of food could be grown in such a bizarre place, as he had felt something indescribably strange about the fields he saw upon arrival…

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 657 487 Another Former Company Employee_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 657: Chapter 487: Another “Former Company Employee”?_2 Chapter 657: Chapter 487: Another “Former Company Employee”?_2 So he followed and took a look at the nearby fields.
Yet, just as he had arrived, he heard a cacophony of noises emitting from within the fields…
“No, not noises, but rather some kind of peculiar spiritual waves that were transformed into sounds? What’s going on?”
Colin’s gaze fell upon the crops as he faintly heard some cries.
“I need water, I need water, I need water…”
“Add some soil to my roots…”
“Hurry, hurry, hurry, my fruit is ripe! If you don’t harvest it now, you’ll miss the prime time to eat it!”
“I want nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium! I want nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium!”
“The seed next door is taking my water, I’m dying of thirst…”
“…”
The strange spiritual waves, like the croaking of bullfrogs, came from all around the fields, with some figures wandering among them, planting according to the “voices” emitted by the plants.
“Hisss, what kind of monstrous farm is this…”
Colin opened his mouth, listening to the chorus from the fields, his eyes drifting into a daze.
“Jesus… I’m losing sanity points over this. Can these things really be eaten?” Orange Cat couldn’t help but draw a breath, feeling that the field not sowed with food but a bunch of demons and ghosts.
“Isn’t this just normal vegetation?”
Akasha commented perplexedly, at the same time stretching out her fair hand to pluck a just-ripened fruit that resembled some kind of solanaceous plant, and placing it in the basket she was casually carrying.
‘I guess only you guys would think it’s normal.’
Colin didn’t respond, but merely silently made his flames burn a little brighter before glancing again at the plants.
Broadly speaking, they were all types of plants that looked familiar…
Some resembled rice or wheat, while some were like apple and other fruit trees.
And what they all had in common was… their abnormally high yields.
For instance, Colin saw a plant about three meters tall, roughly the size of a banana tree, but suspected to be a rice plant, it bore dozens of heavy ears; he sensed that just from this single plant, one could harvest over a hundred pounds of yield.
And just as Colin arrived, the firelight emanating from him seemed to attract these crops.
“Shine on me, shine on me… I’ll reward you with black pearl grapes to eat…”
“Shine on me! Ah! Illuminate me, I can…”
“Come find me quick, and I’ll produce sweet, huge chicken-flavored super mangoes for you…”
“Ah, it’s so hot…”
“Mmm, mmm, it’s so comfortable, shah, shah, so hot, a bit hotter, ah, I’m ripening!”
All sorts of insanity-inducing spiritual waves came forth.
“Hisss…”
Colin suddenly felt a tinge of fear, wanting to incinerate all the crops with a blast of fire, and his steps following Akasha hesitated momentarily.
“It seems like they all really like you!” Queen Akasha turned her head and said with a smile.
I’d rather they didn’t like me; these things are so abstract…
Colin grumbled internally while outwardly maintaining his composure and said:
“Where did you get all these plants from?”
“They were exchanged in the ‘Company’ with points, or you could save your own seeds, but if you keep your own seeds and plant them generation after generation, they start to become abnormal, their speaking voices grow fainter and fainter, and eventually, they stop talking altogether. Without their guidance, we wouldn’t know how to water them, which would affect the harvest…”
Not talking at all is normal!
Colin and the other two Company employees thought near-simultaneously in their minds.
“The ‘Subsidiary”s store sells different things, each one being a bit unique. Over at Shana’s side, there’s stuff like black bread and water, but here it’s seeds for crops.”
Colin pondered to himself.
The Subsidiary’s store offerings largely revolved around strange, talking seeds, each kind producing massive yields and allowing for extremely rapid cultivation with several cycles of planting possible.
Even in this world’s environment, it was possible to get the first batch of fruits in as little as a little over a month, to no longer than six months at most.
Listening to Akasha’s explanation, Colin started feeling tempted to exchange for some “seeds” to study.
But unfortunately, he was also worried these seeds might carry some “virus”…
After all, talking crops are quite peculiar.
But just then, a line of information burst into his mind…
[Task One: Collect seeds of the plants encountered on this mission, three seeds of each variety.]
“Requirement”: Conduct a trade with Lady Akasha, submitting Nine Thousand Points.
“Note”: Upon returning, a batch of seeds will be received, and corresponding points refunded.
…
“Alright, alright, alright, it looks like ‘Lady Rabbit’ also wants these seeds, but spending Nine Thousand Points on these crops, it’s unclear if it’s a loss or a gain.”
“Eh, it doesn’t matter anyway; it’s not my own money, and points will be refunded. It’s just proxy shopping…”
“As long as I make a profit, it’s fine.”
Colin muttered and then proceeded with the trade with Akasha.
She was taken aback but accepted the trade, then couldn’t resist mentioning that buying over a thousand different types of seeds three times over would at most take about Three Thousand Points… This was several times more than that.
“It doesn’t matter, not a big problem.”
Colin waved his hand, indicating that anything solvable with points was not an issue.
After completing the transaction smoothly, harvesting continued. However, when dinner time came around, Colin gave some life-saving methods to the two D Level staff along with a cautionary “Don’t wander around here casually,” before he departed from the territory alone…
Because some new tasks had arisen.
[Task Two: Head to a region in the “Lost Data World” where there’s a broadcast signal being sent out by an unknown Former Company Employee.]
“Note”: Must be completed before dawn.
…
“A Former Company Employee? Rosen? It shouldn’t be; his information is definitive, suggesting this should indeed be an employee of unknown identity.”

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - 658 487 Another Former Company Employee_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 658: Chapter 487: Another “Former Company Employee”?_3 Chapter 658: Chapter 487: Another “Former Company Employee”?_3 Colin’s thoughts flickered with curiosity as to who this “former employee” might be this time, dead or alive.
Then, gathering his thoughts, Colin began to focus on the journey ahead.
Although most places in the Mutated World were not highly dangerous, he could not afford to take it lightly; otherwise, a real accident could leave him as another “former company employee,” then send out distress signals for others to come, which would become a much bigger problem.
In the desolate darkness, Colin steered the flames and kept moving forward.
Along the way, many abnormal mutated bodies attacked.
However, most of them did not pose a great threat to him, just felt slightly troublesome…
“There sure are a lot of these things.”
Colin’s revolver turned into a sword, and with a swing, he sent out a sword energy that instantly took down a mutated body that kept emitting lightning, chasing after him all the way, and then he could not help but shake his head in wonder.
Maybe he would understand some of the reasons once he reached the place where the former employee was sending out signals.
It was only about four to five hours away.
Colin arrived at a deep area that “branch office” employees had never reached before, where mountains were all around, and in the middle of one mountain, he saw a majestic stone gate.
“Did they hollow out an entire mountain?”
Driven by curiosity, Colin landed there.
Two mutated bodies fused with flesh and rock wielding weapons akin to long spears came forward.
“Leave! This… is… the Holy Domain Gate! Mortals… must not…”
“They can actually talk? Is communication possible? Hello…”
Colin “tsked”, looked for a while, attempted to converse but to no avail, then shook his head in disappointment and did not hesitate to extend his hand, clench his fist, and with a couple of punches, blew up one after another.
After making some preparations and activating all the necessary equipment,
he came before the gate and kicked it hard with his foot.
Accompanied by a rumbling vibration, the gate was pushed open a bit, and Colin increased the strength on his foot, leaned forward, and pushed the door further open with force.
It was at the moment the door was pushed open…
Before he had time to see what was inside, countless mutated bodies wearing uniquely styled garments surged out like a flood.
Colin reached out and grabbed a flame, shaped it into a ball, and threw it like a bowling ball.
As the flame rolled forward and expanded…
All the mutated bodies it rolled over melted into a fog of blood and evaporated away.
“Hm? They didn’t char or burn? Seems like there might be something inside.”
Colin raised an eyebrow, then with his hands in his pockets, he began to step inside one foot at a time.
Inside, it looked like a religious or palace-like setting, and it was not dim because many strange gemstones emitting an orange-red light illuminated the interior.
Despite the sense of desolation and decay, the architecture was fairly intact…
Following the guidance of the increasingly vague mission, Colin advanced into the ruins, wiping out the mutated bodies around him as he went.
“It feels like there’s no living presence anymore. Does that mean…they’re gone too?”
Colin was not surprised by this.
But by comparison, this place of death was so much better than the small, decrepit church where Brother Rosen used to be.
Just unclear about the condition of the body…
After about another ten minutes of wandering, Colin walked into a large hall.
He noticed the blood mist from the dead mutated bodies seemed to drift in a certain direction…
Following this direction, he arrived at an extremely spacious hall.
In the center, there was a pyramid-like dais.
Colin looked up slightly, his gaze traveling over each ascending step, and peered at the object at the top of the dais.
Raising an eyebrow, Colin blurted out:
“6.”
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - 659 488 World Administrator_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 659: Chapter 488 “World Administrator”!_1 Chapter 659: Chapter 488 “World Administrator”!_1 At the center of the heavy stone table at the top of the high altar, a pale, delicate object was conspicuously placed.
It seemed to be a strange White Bone Holy Grail, composed of twenty-four pale skeletal materials assembled in a slightly twisted posture, while the exterior of the White Bone Holy Grail was entwined with many black thorns that shone with a metallic sheen.
At that moment, Colin’s gaze was fixed on a string of numbers inscribed on the base of the Holy Grail.
“‘6666666’…?”
Colin’s brow twitched as he looked at the legitimate Arabic numerals, not understanding their meaning at all for the moment.
It felt like some sort of code or serial number, perhaps a containment number?
He wasn’t quite sure…
Afterward, his focus returned to the White Bone Holy Grail as a whole.
Through the slightly stretched, twisted gaps in the ribcage, it was possible to see what seemed to be writhing blood.
The blood mist that had formed after the death of the mutated body inside seemed to be gathered within it.
“What kind of item is this, looks a bit odd.”
Colin murmured and the flames on his body spread out, covering all directions, confirming there should be no traps before cautiously stepping forward.
There were a total of one hundred and forty-four steps leading up…
After ascending them, Colin reached the top of the altar, only to discover that on the stone table, apart from the White Bone Holy Grail, there was one other thing on each side of it.
On the right was a withered object the size of a potato, a seed of sorts.
It too was encased in a ring of black thorns.
On the left was a stone tablet entwined in thorns.
“The whole thing really has a certain mythical sensation, but what are these things?”
Colin stood in front of the stone table and did not rashly touch these objects.
The items on top seemed motionless…
In reality, with just a bit of perception, he could ascertain that these were items of great essence, probably made with the bodily materials of First Level Containment Subjects.
Especially this “Holy Grail,” it felt like human bone, but he wasn’t sure…
However, it was at this time that the mission to seek the signal source suddenly indicated completion.
Immediately following, another new event popped up.
[Event three: Hand over the “Lost World’s” “Thorn Cup・World Administrator Exclusive” and “Ecological Simulation World Tree Seed” along with the “Narrative Stone Tablet”…]
“Note”: Please collect all blood within the hall into the “Cup of Thorns・World Administrator Exclusive” before confirming.
…
Along with this task’s appearance, various inspirations emerged in Colin’s mind.
Then, he couldn’t help but lift his hand to his chin and look at the “Cup of Thorns” with a strange expression.
His intuition from before hadn’t been wrong.
This damn thing was indeed a Holy Grail made from the skeleton of the “Former Company Employee.”
Without a doubt, he had used rib bones.
It was when his gaze settled on the Holy Grail that a line of text, similar to an item description, appeared in his vision.
[“Thorn Cup・World Administrator Exclusive”: A symbolic object of the Administrator, meticulously crafted with the finest materials, proudly commissioned from the “Third Box Garden World” master…]
[Note: The cup is filled with active scarlet blood that makes any onlooker unable to resist drinking it all at once…]
[Note 2: It seems to ensure the material strength is sufficient, there was news circulating in a certain area for a long time about a “Thorn Lady” who did not wish to reveal her name and title having chest pain…]
…
“‘Thorn Lady’? So, the item’s creator is a woman? Does that mean, the Former Employee is this lady? No, it’s also possible that the Former Employee just possesses this item…”
“However, the item description doesn’t mention any uses, so it seems I can’t use it. It’s just this habit of making items out of bones…”
Colin thought, in terms of style and material utilization, it likely wasn’t the “Flame Bearer.”
He had some doubts whether it might be from the faction of “Light.”
“No, that doesn’t seem quite right either, damn, these remnants of the Company are almost warping my aesthetic judgment…”
Colin gathered his thoughts, not in a hurry to deal with other mutated bodies, but rather reviewed the current known information—
The identity of this “Former Company Employee” seemed quite significant as well.
“World Administrator…”
This was his second encounter with such an existence, the previous one being at least a mid-level First Level Containment Subject, the “Father of the Ocean,” and although this one’s name was unknown, he didn’t seem far off either…
If there was anything they had in common, it was…
They seemed to have both died?
There wasn’t much other valuable information.
The only thing worth pondering was whether there was any connection between the “Thorns” here and the “Thorn Device” that locked the train.
“Guess I’ll only know when I see it.”
After that, his gaze shifted to the potato-sized “World Tree Seed” on one side…
[“Ecological Simulation World Tree”: A type of seed distributed by Bonfire Camp, given sufficient raw materials, it could gradually transform the climate, ecology, gravity, and other factors of a barren planet at the macro level within three years, turning it into a habitable world suitable for human life.]
[Details on “Planetary Size Standards,” “Material Requirements,” and more follow…]
…
“Plant this and it can turn a planet into a livable world? A real World Tree…”
Colin clicked his tongue in amazement. He had not expected that the Company had such powerful items at its peak. He wanted to pick up the so-called “World Tree Seed” to inspect it more closely, but worried there might be some dangerous setup and stopped himself.
But judging from this item, it seemed Bonfire Company’s black technology from its prime was quite abundant.

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - 660 488 World Administrator_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 660: Chapter 488 “World Administrator”!_2 Chapter 660: Chapter 488 “World Administrator”!_2 Then, he subconsciously opened and glanced at the detailed explanation, which was dense with all sorts of incomprehensible formulas and such. Colin’s eyes widened, and he suddenly calmed down before closing it directly.
It seemed that, for now, he was unable to use this thing.
He shifted his gaze to the next item…
“Narrative Stele”.
The note said it recorded all the circumstances of this world, but on the surface of the stone slab itself, Colin saw only one brief sentence:
“We have not perished; on the day the veil of night lifts, we shall return from suffering, witness the dawn, witness the future, and strive for all that is good.”
Aside from that, it seemed there was nothing else.
“I guess it has to be turned over to the company before they can interpret it, but does this mean, this ‘Former Company Employee’ still has a chance to be resurrected and return?”
“Hang on, it uses ‘we’, does that mean there’s more than one person?”
Colin pondered for a bit and felt that this might refer to a group of people, or perhaps the entire population of this world.
On second thought, the entire world seemed unlikely.
So it must be about this group here in the temple, the Mutated Bodies that can’t be burned to death…
As for more, I fear that can only be known after the “Night” has dissipated.
Having satisfied his basic curiosity, Colin didn’t waste any more thought and prepared to complete the task at hand.
Clearing the Mutated Bodies did not take much time…
About ten minutes later, all the blood fog that the Mutated Bodies had turned into returned inside the White Bone Holy Grail, and then Colin handed over the Administrator’s set of three items that had been on the table.
Once confirmed, a transparent vortex slowly emerged and whisked the three items away.
“Could it be that the main point of this mission was just for these few trinkets?”
Colin had his suspicions.
Rescuing the ‘Night’ cult followers might have just been incidental; the key could be the retrieval of equipment left by the remnants of the previous era.
“Damn it, the stuff being collected is again bloody related to human tissues…”
He felt like he really was becoming a cross-world organ trafficker.
However, it was after completing this task that two small mission events successively sprang to mind.
[Event Four: During the “Eternal Night Ritual,” assist the action of “Bonfire Company-49-Employee ID 4444444”.]
“Task Requirements”: During the “Eternal Night Ritual,” create a sufficiently large area radiated by the “Flame Bearer’s” flame, which must maintain a strength of level “3.5” throughout the event.
“Remarks”: The event ends when the “Eternal Night” ritual is completely disrupted, the “Thorn Device” has been thoroughly dismantled, and most people have returned to the train and chosen to leave.
…
[Event Five: Hunt a certain number of Mutated Bodies and purify 100 liters of blood using “Primordial Fire” to craft a cluster of “Bonfire Coordinate Points”.]
“Remarks”: Six hours before the start of the “Eternal Night” ritual, have two D Level Personnel light the blood in advance…
…
“So I’m to assist the ‘Subsidiary’ employee ID 4444444 after the ceremony starts? Is this… Akasha? This ID seems pretty good, just as good as Shunzi’s… wait, these task requirements…”
Colin’s attention shifted from the ID to the requirements…
Does this mean that he just needs to create a large fire at the time, without having to fight?
This…
Is this for real?
“If that’s the case, it’d be like just lighting a lamp. How much energy could that take?”
“Wrong, it can’t be said like that… My current peak normal level is 3, to keep a level 3.5 flame burning continuously for three to five hours isn’t a big problem, but any more than that would be strenuous.”
Colin stood on the high platform and thought that he could only rely on the event going smoothly in the end.
Then, he looked at the second event of the mission.
The overall requirements were not difficult; the only term worth noting was “Bonfire Coordinate Point”.
Given this, it seems the company was also preparing to send people over…
“Corps,” “Senior Employee,” and other employees from Earth, or even the summoning to assist Akasha and such could all be possibilities, but while I don’t know who it will be, one thing is certain…”
“Those two D Level staff that are coming as signal towers are probably unavoidable.”
Colin laughed, then closed the mission information, turned around, wrapped himself in flames, and quickly left along the return path.
This mission could be considered a perfect infiltration; when he left, there were no witnesses in sight…
Several hours later, Colin flew back to Miss Akasha’s stationing point.
The slightly anxious Orange Cat and the “Master of the Fish Pond” were relieved to see him reappear. Brother Shunzi could freely speed around in his high-powered vehicle in this ghostly place, but the psychological pressure would be too much for just the two of them.
Fortunately, the man had finally shown up again.
However, they immediately noticed something that looked like a local mutated behemoth trailing behind Brother Shunzi.
“Just in time, I need to talk to you two.”
Colin approached, dragging a mutated creature almost as big as a truck.
The two, who were quickly approaching, paused, and Orange Cat was the first to snap back, “Ah? What’s up?”
“I need to collect blood from this thing, about a hundred liters, but it seems that there won’t be enough here…”
As he spoke, Colin sprinkled some grease on the mutated body and casually set it on fire.
“Do you need our help with this?” Akasha, cloaked in black, stepped forward to offer.
“No need; it’s just a matter of making a couple of trips.”
Colin waved them off but, remembering something from the ruins, he asked the queen-like figure, “Is your employee identity number seven fours?”
“Employee identity number?” Akasha’s face showed a natural befuddlement.
Colin soon learned she was only aware of the company’s ID but unclear about the identity number…
He guessed the reason might have to do with the lack of a “personal resume.”
“Got maps and everything, yet such a basic function isn’t installed…”
Colin shook his head but didn’t pursue the matter further.
If nothing unexpected happened, all the information he had pointed to her having the seven fours.
The only uncertainty was what kind of help she would be looking for…
He didn’t get hung up on it and, about half an hour later, Colin returned to the camp with a bunch of materials. However, what he hadn’t expected was that the previously at least ten-ton mutated creature now yielded less than a liter of purified blood!
“Did it burn that clean?”
Colin looked at the small basin of blood the two were holding and couldn’t help but be somewhat speechless.
The monster’s body certainly contained more blood than that, but after the “Flame” purified it, not much remained.
This task was much more troublesome than he had anticipated!
What he thought would be a simple half-hour task had kept him busy until the next day, and he had only collected between sixty and seventy liters!
“At least there’s a day to prepare; otherwise, with such a rush, I’d even consider taking apart my left hand for materials.”
Halfway through his work, Colin couldn’t resist making a sarcastic comment.
Then, he turned and left the stationing point, plunging back into the Mutated World to collect Bonfire materials.
He didn’t even glance at the smaller entities, skipping them entirely.
The blood of low-level mutated bodies was of very poor quality; burning a hundred for purification might yield less than ten milliliters. Even looking at them felt like a waste of time…
Only the more powerful mutated bodies were worthy of his attention.
“Boom!”
Another massive mutated body fell from the sky, crashing onto an empty space outside the camp.
“Hiss…”
A group of “Night” Extraordinary Ones watched with a twitch in their eye. This time, the mutated creatures he hunted were of a high-level type that they wouldn’t dare even look at without a team of over two hundred people.
But to him, it was like catching chicks; he casually hunted them and then threw them down.
The key point was that he didn’t just kill one of these terrifying beings!
“All the high-level mutated creatures nearby seem to have been wiped out, right?”
Next to Akasha, Vini stared at the burning carcass of the mutated body, numbly commenting.
This external support was frighteningly lethal…
…
…
…
ps: Updating first, and then will revise, trying out the insert image function.

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - 661 489 The Terrifying Enemy from Bonfire_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 661: Chapter 489: The Terrifying Enemy from ‘Bonfire’!_1 Chapter 661: Chapter 489: The Terrifying Enemy from ‘Bonfire’!_1 “Unless something unexpected happens… they have indeed mostly been slaughtered…”
Akasha shook her head uncertainly, also looking at the piles of burning bodies. From the initial shock to now, she felt somewhat numb…
Originally, she thought that the power displayed by the “Bonfire” emissary was the result of some kind of outburst.
It turned out to be the other party’s normal level…
“We need some more help here, there aren’t enough hands to handle the blood,” Orange Cat’s voice suddenly came through, interrupting the thoughts of the two.
“Okay.” Vini, who was beside Akasha, looked around and seemed to notice there weren’t many helpers around.
So, she rolled up her sleeves, stepped forward, and started chopping up the burning mutated bodies, squeezing out the blood to help it burn better.
After all, although the mutated bodies were dead, their flesh and blood still possessed an extraordinary toughness.
They were not easy to deal with.
In the bustle of activity, a few more hours passed.
Following the final mutated body thudding onto the earth, they finally had enough raw material for blood extraction.
“Whew, that’s tiring…”
Colin exhaled, descended from mid-air, took out a “Colorless Crystal” to absorb, and used it to alleviate the fatigue on his body, which seemed tired but not really tired.
‘That being said…’
While Colin was absorbing the “Colorless Crystal” and adjusting his own status, he gazed upon this world.
In his recent killings, he discovered something quite interesting.
In this accursed place, although there were many mutated bodies with various bizarre abilities, it seemed as though all of them were bound by some strange restriction that prevented any anomaly in the entire world from reaching the strength of a Level 2 Containment Subject.
Colin had run over a thousand kilometers at his farthest and hadn’t seen any.
Though a thousand kilometers might be a small scale for the entire world, during this process, no matter how far he sensed, he could not detect any threat from the mutated creatures, which suggested something was amiss…
‘Many ‘mutated bodies’ appear to have had their strength suppressed…’
Colin thought it over, wondering if the missing Administrator had done something, otherwise, such a situation seemed unlikely.
However, before he could ponder any further, he suddenly felt someone approaching.
“Please, have a seat…” A “Night” power user approached respectfully with a wooden chair.
“Thank you.”
Colin thanked him, without any pretense, drew the chair closer, and sat down.
Then, looking at the young man standing before him who had not yet walked away and appeared shy, he inquired with a smile, “If you have something to ask, just speak up.”
Encouraged by him, the young man mustered the courage to speak: “Sir, I would like to ask if we have a chance… to follow ‘Bonfire’…”
Whoops, betrayal, oh, is conversion coming this quickly?
Colin did not immediately answer; his gaze, while fixed on the young man, could see through him to the group sneaking peeks from within the train carriages not far behind.
Even Akasha, despite being quite a distance away, seemed to be eavesdropping.
At this moment, seeing Colin suddenly fall silent without a word, the young man’s heart surged with panic and his mind went blank, unsure if he had said something wrong.
But fortunately, at that moment, Colin spoke up:
“Why do you want to follow ‘Bonfire’?”“I… I wish to have power like yours so that I can protect our people well. With such strength, I could explore a vaster world, whether by staying here or leaving; everything would be much easier…”
“And, I’ve found that the power of ‘Bonfire’ seems to be more suitable for us, no, for all humanity. It doesn’t dampen the user’s emotions but naturally makes one feel warm…”
“Bathed in the light of the flames, for the first time, I truly understood what it means to be human…”
The young man cloaked in black did not speak of faith or the like, but rather began practically, slightly hesitant at first, but then speaking more fluidly as he went on.
However, the far-off eavesdroppers widened their eyes when they heard his words.
“Why didn’t he follow the script from before, seeking Bonfire, praising him, saying we have seen the error of our ways…”
“It’s all over, ‘Bonfire’ is being talked about as if it’s just a tool…”
“If he’s this direct, the other party won’t accept it, I knew I should have gone up…”
“…”
A group of people whispered in hushed tones.
“Haha, pretty honest, but there’s nothing about ‘Bonfire’ worth following.”
Colin said with a laugh and a shake of his head. Hearing his words, the young man felt a sense of loss and subconsciously thought he was being rejected. But before his disappointment could show on his face, in the next second, the young man heard Colin continue:
“‘Bonfire’ is right here; there’s no need for following or not following. Simply walk with me and you will receive Pass the Flame… There’s no need to follow…”
The young man was stunned, his face showing joy, while also sensing that the other’s words offered a new path.
“Walk with the Flame”!
At the same moment, Colin flicked his finger, and a spark soared skyward.
Bursting with brilliance in mid-air, it rained down the utmost warmth…
Gazing at that orb of flame, and even though the “Night” power within him felt a bit uncomfortable from being suppressed, his human instinct craved more warmth.
In a moment, the young man’s eyes brimmed with tears, and going with the flow, he honestly spilled everything about the script, effectively ratting out the entire group in the carriage.
He really was a born betrayer… Colin shook his head and continued:

chapters.title: Chapter 662 - 662 489
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 662: 489 Chapter 662: 489 “Now you can feel the flame, but everything else can wait until after everything settles down. It’s not the right time to receive any kind of power.”
He could, though, grant others power through certain methods, but not too much.
But it wasn’t necessary to turn away an employee that had fallen into his hands…
If there was an opportunity later on, he could attempt to bestow the flame upon these people and the believers from World Code 13.
On the other side, two D Level staff members who were processing blood listened to their conversation and couldn’t help but smirk and chat quietly:
“The kid is dreaming too big, aye. We live under the same sky as Brother Shunzi and never got that strong. He thinks he can get stronger just by following? How could that be possible?”
“Exactly, the kid just hasn’t had enough chicken soup for the soul. Drink more, and you won’t be so easily moved.”
Orange Cat nodded in deep agreement, then commented that Brother Shunzi’s ability to hoodwink had also gotten stronger.
As time ticked by, the task-required one hundred liters of blood was fully collected.
On the ground, within each large container, was the fresh, active red blood that still wriggled slightly…
“This stuff is pretty strange; it never seems to dry up when roasted.”
Colin muttered to himself, then glanced at the time again. There wasn’t much time left until the final six hours when he had to ignite the flame as the task demanded.
After taking a short rest to get his condition back on track.
Colin had two employees come before the blood and briefly explained the situation before igniting the blood with the “Bonfire”.
Then, it seemed like he discovered that the blood couldn’t be ignited?
It could be roasted and evaporated, but it seemed like it couldn’t be lit on fire?
“What’s going on?” Just as he wondered, Colin suddenly saw that the two employees seemed to have received some new task.
Then the two stepped forward simultaneously, one with a blade of wind and the other with a steel needle, each cut their fingertips and dripped a drop of blood into that eerie mutated blood…
The next second, something unexpected happened!
The blood that the Bonfire couldn’t ignite suddenly boiled violently.
Following that, “boom” went the noise!
The one hundred liters of blood burst into flames, and the light was extraordinarily bright.
“Ignited with blood?”
Colin raised an eyebrow, genuinely not understanding the principle behind it.
But it was at this moment that he realized he could to some extent control these abnormally bright flames…
This indicated that odd as they were, they indeed were flames and fell under the jurisdiction of the “Flame Bearer”.
However, the task didn’t seem to require him to control them.
Under the spiritual guidance of the task, Colin reached from his left hand to his right index finger, touching the “Revolver Reverser” that had been turned into a ring.
The next second, surging flames emerged from his body, mixing with the flames composed of blood.
At this very moment…
Colin felt a palpitation in his heart, sensing a pressurized gaze brush over from far away…
He instinctively wanted to trigger the flames, but held back due to an indescribable sense of danger.
His intuition told him that the entity casting the gaze currently couldn’t pinpoint their exact location, but if this firelight brightened up…
The situation could become unpredictable.
“That direction, if I’m not wrong, is the territory of the ‘Dusk Faction’, so are they… ‘The Night’?”
Colin frowned but wasn’t entirely sure.
Without waiting to ponder further, a transparent vortex slowly emerged.
It didn’t sweep up anything but rather seemed to emanate some secret force.
Immediately after, all the flames, as if controlled, swept towards the two employees, seeping into their bodies…
This process lasted quite a while, a full hour, before all of the fire produced by the burning blood was sealed into the two employees’ bodies by the company with some special method.
Overall, both of them emitted a faint glow of fire from their bodies.
At the same time, deep within the pupils of their left eyes, a flame slowly burned.
Colin stepped forward, looked at them both, and pointed to the position of his own left eye: “What’s the situation?”
It seemed like their task had been cut off there.
He wasn’t clear on what was happening with them…
“It seems like in a while, once we reach the area designated by the ‘Dusk Faction’, we’ll directly detonate this fire and create a ‘Bonfire Coordinate Point’…” Orange Cat looked up a bit and sensed the task in her mind.
‘Hmm, does it mean that the Signal Tower has already been built, but to avoid detection, the signal hasn’t been deployed?’
Colin nodded, not pressing for further details.
…
However, at the same time, on Earth, all employees above E level including E level, received a message.
[Support Event: Short-term Descend Support Event in Three Hours.]
[Mission Description: In three hours, all employees who receive this task and meet the criteria will descend into “Lost World-49 (Temporary Code)” through the special “Bonfire Pipeline Network” to provide aid for “Employee 654321”.]
[Detailed mission requirements will be issued after the mission starts. All employees should be prepared!]
[“Note”: Death in this mission results in immediate return, and other non-“company items” cannot be brought along.]
…
As the mission suddenly popped up, the employees were all momentarily taken aback, instinctively wanting to refuse.
However, upon seeing the name “654321”, they stopped in their tracks.
“Seems like the same kind of big-scale support mission as before?”
“What’s happening? Looks like Brother Shunzi’s at it again, pulling off some big move behind our backs?”
“Charge! We won’t die anyway. Follow Brother Shunzi for the good life! I’m already prepared to make some extra cash!”
“I don’t know which world I’m going to or what task I’m supposed to do. I only know I’m ready to go on a killing spree!”
“Ahhh? Why aren’t F Levels allowed this time?! Is it discrimination against low-level employees?”
“F Level kiddos, just play with mud at home. This isn’t for you low-level guys to take part in.”
“@Confused Cutie ①Sob Sob⑦, you dare say that to Brother Shunzi from his F Level days!”
“Hahaha fine, fine. These official try-hards finally got their dog aides banned! Last time around, these guys relied on aide equipment to snatch quite a bit of merit!”
“Is there anyone who can take me along? I want to go on this mission too, boo hoo hoo…”
“…”
Having had the experience of a previous time, they were not the least bit panicked.
Especially when they saw Brother Shunzi’s name, they were even more at ease. After all, no matter what, they could come back even if they died. As seen from the last mission, the return meant coming back alive.
They didn’t have to worry about returning as a corpse.
…
Just as the employees were rubbing their hands in anticipation of taking action, Colin was also preparing to move.
Among the more than fifty thousand “Defiants” with Akasha, except for a part who had lost their power and returned to “ordinary people” after surviving a periodic catastrophe, the other thirty thousand-plus Extraordinary Ones had already sprung into action…
Unable to cross the Mutated World like Colin, they had to set up in advance.
“Alright, let’s move out!”
Colin waved his hand grandly, flames erupting from his body as he led more than a thousand people from this station point to the battlefield.
The towering giant made of wild flames, like a deity, strode step by step across the twisted, mutated land, with all things incapable of stopping its progress.
An hour later, they were tens of kilometers away from the “Dusk Faction” headquarters.
Colin could already see that the world ahead was unnaturally “dark”…
‘Has the ‘Eternal Night’ ceremony been going on for more than a day?’
‘Mm, the power of ‘The Night’ exists, but it feels like its will is not keeping up. Even so, it’s still quite terrifying.’
‘I’ll have to crank everything up to avoid any accidents, and yeah, with so many people here, “The False Powerhouse” can still be useful…’
As thoughts flickered, Colin’s attention turned to the ground, where he could see train carriages stretched out like The Great Wall resting upon the earth.
At the same time, some enemies had already appeared up ahead…
Countless pitch-black assailants surged upon the land, launching the first round of attacks on him.
But Colin did not plan to lift a finger.
Because there was no need.
All the attacks couldn’t even get close before being melted by the wildfire…
He merely maintained his normal state, enough to drive these people to despair.
The first line of defense, set up by the “Dusk Faction” at considerable effort, was so effortlessly broken through.
Not a single surprise, not a ripple of disturbance occurred.
“Not even a slight hindrance was caused?”
Looking at the Flame Giant, with its fire lighting up half the sky, marching on with an unmatched presence and overwhelming pressure, everyone present was gasping for breath, their expressions filled with despair.
The carefully laid traps couldn’t make the opponent pause for even a step.
Such a formidable foe…
How were they supposed to confront it?
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - 663 490 In front of absolute power everything
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 663: Chapter 490: In front of absolute power, everything is meaningless!_1 Chapter 663: Chapter 490: In front of absolute power, everything is meaningless!_1 “The task didn’t require a massacre, but rather to break through to the ‘Eternal Night’ ritual site as before, release the flame, and coordinate with Akasha’s actions…”
“Tch, but until now, it seems we still don’t know whom she’s planning to summon over.”
As thoughts flashed through his mind, Colin controlled the Wildfire Giant, which was fused with his will, advancing relentlessly.
Ignoring all traps and setups, he continued forward like a bulldozer.
Forces from other strongholds who had converged for Akasha looked at this scene and were instantly invigorated.
“Charge! Bring down that unrepentant ‘Dusk Sect’!”
“Charge! Charge! Keep up with the group!”
“Be careful, don’t get too close, and watch out for some remaining traps…”
A chorus of shouts filled the air as people from all directions came together, following the breach in the defense line torn open by Colin.
However, they dared not get too close.
Because the intense heat radiating from the Flame Giant also had a certain suppressive effect on the power within them.
But no matter what, the situation was much easier than they had initially imagined.
Even easy!
In their initial plan, just to break through the few outer layers of defense traps, they would have to pay a heavy toll, losing at least half of their number before being able to send the remaining half into the ‘Dusk Sect.’
Only then would they have a chance to see the figures of the opponents…
But now, at least for the moment, aside from a few who carelessly fell into some of the leftover traps, the rest were basically unscathed.
And as the frontline continued to advance, another fifteen minutes later, Colin saw even deeper into the ‘Eternal Night’ ritual.
The area was shrouded in thick darkness, pitch-black everywhere…
And from within that darkness, faint ceremonial chants of ‘Dusk Sect’ could be heard from the praying mortals.
“Oh lofty and distant serenity and Night…”
“We pray for the ‘Dusk’s’ miracle to manifest…”
“May Your… descend upon here…”
“…”
The almost inaudible whispers were now reaching Colin’s ears.
Millions of people stood in the darkness, encircling a monument of unknown origin, offering devout prayers.
With each chant, the invisible darkness grew a shade deeper…
“This is quite dangerous.”
Colin, looking ahead, felt that this act was akin to standing outside a damaged nuclear power plant, praying to it while simultaneously being exposed to escaping radiation…
This was tolerable for the humans here only because of their sufficient physical strength, otherwise, they would’ve been doomed long ago.
‘They must be descendants of some powerful beings from the past,’ he thought.
Colin’s thoughts flashed through his mind, and he stopped observing the interior of the Night and instead focused on the peripheral areas.
Around the ‘Eternal Night’ ritual, many people were also praying.
But the content of their prayers, which Colin overheard from a distance through some premonitions, seemed more focused on ‘relatives and friends’ health. Even if unsuccessful, they wished not to die, and so on…
Of course, some looked towards him from afar, eyeing the glow that lit half the sky with fear and dread.
And further out were numerous carriages and the like.
‘It seems like although people say after the ‘Eternal Night’ ritual they ascend to the ‘Night’s’ God Kingdom, in reality, most still hope to live,’ he contemplated.
As he pondered, Colin continued to advance.
At this moment, within this region, the only thing that made his heart palpitate was the pitch-dark center area.
Elsewhere, he didn’t see anything too menacing.
Even the followers with the power of ‘Night,’ the danger was just the power they possessed.
But it was to little effect and posed no threat.
As for most of the arrangements in the outer perimeters, the enormous iron arrows thrown from a distance, oddly shaped cannonballs, and the like.
Managing to strike his knee would be considered lucky…
All in all, it was meaningless.
“The overall level of combat here seems to be just a bit more than the early stages of World War II?”
Colin pursed his lips. After breaking through another layer of defense, he continued to advance, quickly covering a distance of several kilometers, when suddenly, an energy barrier, similar to an energy field, yet barely there, appeared before him.
At first glance, Colin immediately estimated that this barrier could withstand an attack from an ordinary official level six or even level seven Extraordinary Ones.
But for him…
“Boom!”
The Wildfire Giant lifted its foot and kicked out.
Waves of ripples spread in an instant…
The first strike did not break through?
“Interesting, it can distribute the force at a single point across the entire shield, spreading the attack uniformly…”
Colin’s eyebrows lifted, instantly realizing the situation, curious about this shield that seemingly defied common sense.
However, such things could be understood later…
Right now, the priority was the task at hand!
As Colin gathered his thoughts, he commanded the Flame Giant to raise its right hand. Energy was charged, and then it straightforwardly punched down on the barrier.
Following that, the entire barrier vibrated and then exploded into a sky full of black matter.
“Pity that all technology is meaningless in the face of absolute strength.”
“If not for interference, not even the barrier ‘Hunger’ personally released could have restrained me. How could this one, merely an indirect and primitive use of ‘Night’s’ power, stand a chance?”
Manipulating the embodiment of Wildfire, Colin continued forward.
And in this process, the giant body the Wildfire had transformed into was also gradually growing taller.

chapters.title: Chapter 664 - 664 490 In front of absolute power everything
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 664: Chapter 490: In front of absolute power, everything is meaningless!_2 Chapter 664: Chapter 490: In front of absolute power, everything is meaningless!_2 From the previous height of a hundred meters, he suddenly surged toward three hundred meters…
The many members of “The Dusk Sect” who had rushed up to attack him couldn’t even manage to “mend their legs” anymore.
This situation only increased their sense of despair…
The members of “The Dusk Sect” were not afraid of death, but they were terrified by the prospect that, even with the sacrifice of their lives, they could see not even a glimmer of hope.
In that case, their sacrifices would seem utterly meaningless!
“Brother Shunzi is really not giving them any chances, heh heh.”
Orange Cat, standing on the shoulder of the Flame Giant, looked down and thought about fighting alongside Brother Shunzi, wildly slaughtering their enemies, and felt an inexplicable… sense of exhilaration?
On the other shoulder, Akasha and the others looked down at the scene below, equally shocked. To tell the truth, if this “Bonfire” emissary didn’t seem to have much desire to kill ordinary humans,
simply passing by would have meant countless casualties among “The Night” believers.
It wouldn’t be like now, being scorched by flames, but merely having the power of “The Night” evaporate inside them, falling into a coma without dying.
Even, if one were to be stepped directly upon by the Flame Giant, it wouldn’t generally result in death…
At most, they would be seriously injured and fall to the ground.
“Thank goodness…” Akasha breathed a small sigh of relief in her heart.
Previously, when she saw the “Bonfire” emissary hunting mutated creatures with chilling lethality, they were a bit worried that if he got vicious, he might burn all their people clean.
If that happened…
It would be unclear whether choosing “The Night” or “Bonfire” was the better option.
After all, “The Night”‘s destruction of the world was just something they felt was going to happen; they had called for the arrival of the “Bonfire,” but if “Bonfire” burned their people first…
Then…
Well, it looks like there’s no need to worry about that now.
And it was at this moment that Colin spoke up again.
“There are several more defensive lines ahead, and I plan to clear them all at once. You can start taking action now, go and destroy that ‘Thorn Device’…”
“Also, when you fall, remember Orange Cat, ensure everyone lands safely. If there’s an accident, I’ll let you know the consequences.”
“Don’t waste too much time, I have other missions to execute.”
“There’s no time to linger here.”
His voice, carried through the flames, reached every person’s ears.
‘Hiss, dammit, all I wanted was to simply give orders for them to go down and execute the plan to sabotage the device, how did the tone turn out like this…’
‘This damn “False Powerhouse,” as my strength has increased, the beneficial effects have diminished, not as pronounced as before, but the side effects haven’t lessened at all…’
Colin couldn’t help but grumble internally.
Though the words spoken were correct in their intended meaning, the tone left himself somewhat speechless.
Upon hearing this, Akasha looked towards the two other employees. Although she didn’t speak, it was as if both of them could see in her eyes the silent question of “Is your boss alright?”
“It’s no big deal, Brother Shunzi has a strange piece of equipment that makes him sound pretentious when he uses it. Don’t worry about it.”
“The Master of the Fish Pond” waved his hand, indicating it wasn’t a significant issue.
While Brother Shunzi didn’t provide details about this device, it wasn’t too unfamiliar internally.
Any employee would have heard something about it…
Of course, even if he sounded pretentious, they had heard that Brother Shunzi’s personality hadn’t changed much. Even when he sounded arrogant, he didn’t forget to remind Orange Cat to ensure everyone landed safely, which was the best proof…
After all, on the Flame Giant’s back, the users of “The Night”‘s power had their abilities compressed to the extreme.
Jumping from hundreds of meters, although they might not necessarily die from such a fall,
landing with light or severe injuries, missing arms or legs was still a possibility.
So it was true… he really…
“The Master of the Fish Pond” shook his head slightly and, without further explanation, leapt down from the giant’s shoulder.
Seeing this, the others followed suit, starting to execute the plan that had been set earlier…
…
“What should we do? It’s getting closer…”
Inside the core circle, a garrisoned employee asked nervously.
The oppressive feeling of that terrifying fire approaching step by step was simply too strong…
At this moment, they couldn’t see any of their allies who had gone to intercept it, as those people’s powers of “The Night” were scorched away by the fire, they became untraceable, and it felt as if they had been reduced to ashes…
So amidst the fear, there was also an inevitable sense of sadness, anger, and helplessness.
However, the white-haired old man who heard his words did not respond right away.
His pitch-black eyes looked straight ahead, clearly seeing the sky, which should have been somewhat dim, now illuminated by a bright orange-red flame…
Everything arranged along the entire road seemed to have little effect on it.
But… even so, the fight must go on!
“Don’t lose heart, we still have several lines of defense. Once night falls, ‘Night’s’ power will reach its peak. With that power, we will surely drive the Outer God Follower out!”
The calm yet powerful voice came from the old man.
It managed to settle the slightly agitated hearts of the people somewhat…
At this moment, the old man placed his hands behind his back, turned slightly, and swept his gaze over the millions of people and the land that had been lived upon for who knows how many hundreds of years…
Although this place wasn’t their ancestral land, the entirety of their historical memories had been spent here.
This land, filled with calamities, bore too many of their memories and history.
Birth and death, as well as perseverance across generations in the fight against the Mutated Bodies, had made it difficult for them to easily let go of so many things from the past to the present…
Yet now, it might all turn to utter ashes under a flame.
No, absolutely not!
The old man narrowed his eyes, took a deep breath, and then turned back around, his pitch-black eyes filled with determination and resolution:
“The people are right behind us, we can’t back down anymore…
“If death is unavoidable, then I hope we old bones can hold out for this last stretch of time…
“When ‘dusk falls’, everything will get better!”
With his words, the emotions of those around him also firmed up once more.
“Good! Let’s fight him one more time! Even death doesn’t matter!”
“‘Night’ will protect us!”
“Yeah, yeah, yeah! After we win, I’m going to use that invader’s head as a goblet!”
“…”
And it was at this moment that someone tasked with watching out suddenly shouted:
“Look! What is he trying to do now?”
Upon hearing this, everybody curbed their passionate emotions and turned their gazes towards the Flame Giant, who was ten kilometers away yet illuminated half the sky with his fire.
At this moment, they noticed that the giant seemed to be shrinking?
Massive flames rose from his body, rising like smoke—
“Is it unable to bear the use of this power any longer?”
Someone’s eyes brightened with a hint of surprise, speculating whether the opponent could no longer persist.
“No…”
The old man shook his head, dismissing the “Awakener’s” guess.
And right at this time, they all saw the rising flames reconverge in mid-air.
They formed a mythological entity like the “sun” from the legends!
And, compared to when it was a Flame Giant, once the flames finished reconverging, they seemed to undergo a transformation in nature, no longer wild, but the radiance they emitted was even more intense!
The once dim “comforting” darkness began to fade perceptibly…
The world became brighter than it had ever been before.
Under the intense light, for the first time, the people could see the true state of the world with bare eyes.
What puzzled and discomforted them even more was…
Even though they were filled with hostility towards the enormous fireball, and were completely certain that it was the fearsome great enemy that they had to prevent at the cost of their lives, the enemy that couldn’t exist under the same sky,
their bodies wouldn’t obey them.
Even within their hearts, a vague sense of pleasure bubbled up, accompanying a faint sensation of heat.
This awkward situation caused some people’s faces to flush with a look of embarrassment.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - 665 491 Praise The Night Victory is Ours_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 665: Chapter 491 Praise “The Night”, Victory is Ours!_1 Chapter 665: Chapter 491 Praise “The Night”, Victory is Ours!_1 “Damn, that manipulative bastard!”
Someone couldn’t help but curse under their breath.
However, before anyone could respond to his words, the old man suddenly spoke up:
“He wants to breach those defenses, charging straight at us to launch the final attack! Be careful!”
No sooner had his voice faded than they saw the gigantic fireball, hanging in the sky whose size was difficult to discern, suddenly stop its relentless ascent thousands of meters above.
Immediately afterward, it began to plummet towards this place!
And with its descent, everyone present felt an overwhelming sense of oppression.
Under the power of that enormous fireball.
The surrounding clouds were shaken apart, and with them, the atmospheric pressure of the area compressed and vibrated unceasingly under the fireball’s fall, making breathing become somewhat labored!
“Can we… really withstand this?”
“What in the world is this thing? Are we really just dealing with an Angel Envoy, and not a True God!?”
“….”
The power that surpassed the Flame Giant caused the resolve that had just been kindled in the hearts of those present to sink once again.
This force had already surpassed many natural disasters!
It even went beyond their comprehension!
In their minds, only those beings invoked in prayers, truly transcendental above all, could be deemed worthy of the name God, capable of unleashing such power!
The only way to contend with it was to invoke “The Night”…
But how could that be possible?
Many among those present had undergone the “Eternal Night” ritual numerous times.
They knew better than anyone…
That what overflowed from that darkness was only an untouchable darkness.
Some so-called “Messengers of The Night,” who could “listen” to His words, people could only confirm he heard something, but what exactly he heard, no one could validate…
“Don’t overthink it, don’t despair!”
“It’s not time to give up yet! Advance with me, coordinate with the ultimate ‘Wall of Dusk,’ block it!”
Accompanying these words, the elder suddenly stood up, his eyes overflowing with intense darkness streaming out like tears, at the same time, a great amount of darkness enveloped him completely.
Then, without looking back, he charged straight into the gigantic fireball that lit up half of the sky.
Not long afterward…
The huge fireball collided with the core defense area’s “Wall of Dusk” without any delay.
There was no sound from the collision…
But everyone couldn’t help but feel their eardrums vibrate, a buzzing noise echoing in their heads.
But fortunately…
This time, the darkness, imbued with countless people’s efforts, finally held back the seemingly indestructible giant fireball…
Instead of, like before, shattering into pieces the moment it was merely touched.
But it was just holding back, with violent ripples spreading wildly.
It looked like it would break just like some of the outer “Wall of Dusk” barriers in no more than a minute!
However, it was at this moment…
The old man, encased in dense darkness like a gushing fountain, managed to brace against it.
The moment he made contact, his mouth and nostrils spilled blood, some blood vessels on his skin burst instantly, feeling an indescribable pressure, but after a moment of mental blankness, he suddenly stretched out his hand, pressing it against the “Wall of Dusk.”
“Sizzling…”
Even through a wall, but the slight force of the flames that penetrated still caused the skin on his hands to peel away.
Some blood and fat even turned into grease and dripped down at that moment…
Extreme agony coursed through him.
But the old man did not let go; instead, he continued to channel strength into the ultimate barrier, holding back the enemy’s onslaught…
At the same time, the members of The Dusk Sect who had recovered their senses also began to move.
Thousands of “Semi-Extraordinary Ones” exerted their force at the same time, and a dense darkness rose from all directions, flowing into the old man’s body before surging towards the “Wall of Dusk” ahead.
The profound darkness and the scorching fireballs continued to wrestle with each other in their clash.
The terrifying charge from the fireballs persisted…
Under the onslaught, countless obscure inscriptions on the “Wall of Dusk” were scorched and burned away by the flames.
But fortunately, as each minute passed, another surge of human dark power rose to withstand the blaze.
In the deadlock, many “Believers of The Night” from various regions collapsed on the ground, utterly exhausted, and passed out…
Even the old man’s consciousness gradully began to fade from overusing his power.
Finally, it was uncertain how long they had held out for.
The immense pressure slowly weakened…
And soon, it vanished completely.
Had they successfully blocked what seemed to be an apocalyptic attack?
“Did we, block it?”
“Haha, yes, we blocked it, we finally did it!”
“If we can block an attack like that, what chance do they have of getting in!”
“Praise ‘The Night,’ victory is ours!”
“…”
Some people couldn’t help but cry out in their exhaustion.
Hearing the voices below, the old man’s bloodied face revealed a slight smile of relief.
However, before his happiness could last long, he discovered that all the “laughter and cheer” suddenly disappeared, and immediately after, his heart “thudded” sharply.
He saw a burning figure standing atop the “Wall of Dusk” above his head.
The figure slightly raised their chin, looking down at him with an air of superiority, and the continual overflow of flames in their eyes betrayed a look that seemed to mock yet also acknowledge him.
And meeting his gaze, the young man enveloped in flames slowly extended his palms.
“Clap clap clap~” came the crisp clapping sound.
The man, while clapping his hands, spoke in a tone that sounded casual, but filled with a certain arrogance and hauteur:
“Not bad, not bad at all. Considering your numbers and strength, it’s truly not easy to have blocked my move that rivals that of a Level 2 Containment Subject…
“After all, even if a Level 2 Containment Subject were struck in its main body, it would turn into a new source of energy on the spot.
“And you, although the level of power used is high, the amount is too little. In my view, it should have been easily penetrated…
“But now, to think you’ve actually blocked it, that is indeed unexpected.
“However…”
His words stopped there.
However, what?
The old man’s heart tightened, sensing a deep unease, wondering what the other had not yet said.
But at that moment, he suddenly noticed something, raised his head, shifted his gaze, and his whole body stiffened, his pupils constricting to the size of pinpoints!
“Another one?!!” he exclaimed in shock.
Behind the halted fireballs, he saw a new round of fireballs that were no less in size and amount than the previous.
This new round of fireballs, in terms of size, scale, and intensity…
were almost indistinguishable from the first.
In fact, they were even slightly stronger!
“How will you deal with this second ‘Sky Light Fall’?” the young man’s indifferent voice reached his ears from above.
..
.
.
More to follow, will edit later!
