chapters.title: Chapter 666 - 666 492 Bonfire Descends from the Sky_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 666: Chapter 492 “Bonfire” Descends from the Sky!_1 Chapter 666: Chapter 492 “Bonfire” Descends from the Sky!_1 “Boom~”
A silent roar shook the heavens…
The “Wall of Dusk,” which had reached its limit, could no longer withstand the assault, bursting like a bubble that had been touched, “pop,” it shattered instantly.
In the old man’s horrified eyes, the reflection of the relentless fire engulfed him in an instant.
And with his fainting, many followers of “The Night” fell on the spot, some even dropping dead.
“Next, there will be no more hindrances…”
Amidst the flames, Colin reached out and grabbed the fainting old man, glanced at him briefly, then a flame attached itself to him, and Colin threw him carelessly to the ground.
After that, his gaze shifted forward.
After the destruction of the last “Wall of Dusk,” the only thing left to focus on was the “Eternal Night” ritual.
‘Aside from the site of the ritual, the other issues aren’t significant, hmm, I need to be at full status, otherwise going in, there might be some problems.’
In the blink of a thought, Colin’s figure plunged down like a meteor.
Along the way, many followers of “The Night” attempted to stop him, but to no effect; at best, they could only delay him for a few minutes, and that was the limit.
This was because Colin had no intention of killing; otherwise, these people wouldn’t last even ten seconds.
Beyond that, the vast majority of “Extraordinary Ones” with strengths equivalent to official levels 2-5 were struck down by the flames as they ascended the sky, their powers erased by the radiant heat, causing them to plummet from high above…
‘Strange, where is Lavinia? Why haven’t I seen her?’
Colin thought, if there was anyone he was particularly wary of, it was Lavinia, who had nearly ambushed him on the train before.
However, he hadn’t seen her during his dive.
With doubts in his mind, Colin charged towards the main site of the “Eternal Night” ritual.
No matter what Lavinia was up to, his only mission was to barge in and set a fire.
Meanwhile, a little behind him, most of the other employees were heading towards a different direction, towards the place where the train was.
They moved a bit slower, but not by much.
Users of “The Night” forces naturally had an advantage in terms of movement speed.
If Colin’s strength were equivalent to theirs, on the same level, then even with stronger overall combat capabilities, his speed might be much slower…
“Firebearers” were not particularly adept at running away.
It was when Colin collided with the last group of elite members of “The Dusk Sect” guarding the periphery of the ritual site.
“The Fish Pond Master,” “It’s Not Orange Cat’s Fault,” and others finally reached their destination and saw the now desolate train carriages, emptied of passengers.
Some enemies ahead eyed them predatorily, but it wasn’t a significant problem.
Most of the strong forces had been led away by Brother Shunzi, and the small fry could charge carelessly!
“Good, good, good, let’s release the flames here!”
“The Fish Pond Master” stopped in his tracks, now encased in a composite Purple Gear suit.
It was a war machine made up of multiple mechanical devices, five meters tall, with each Purple Gear component weak on its own, but combined, they were exceedingly strong!
The only inconvenience was that each use required continuous recitations.
It wasn’t until the “Great Joy of Machine Spirit” was invoked that it could be activated.
“Mhm,” nodded Orange Cat, then gestured for the team to stop their advance and not to attack.
Straight away, the two confirmed their task, and then, they felt a connection to a flame beyond words…
Above the sky, two pillars of fire fell simultaneously.
“I—damn, what’s—happening… can’t… move!”
“The Fish Pond Master” suddenly realized that the super buff he was anticipating, like the one Brother Shunzi received, didn’t appear.
Instead, he couldn’t move…
The inexplicable pressure oppressed him, leaving him to passively bear the flames.
However, at the same time, some ashes were “spewed” from the bonfire upon them.
These ashes rapidly took shape in midair, forming silhouettes of people.
The place, which was originally deathly still and in a standoff with “The Dusk Sect,” began to grow noisy with the arrival of these people.
“Dad’s here! Where’s the enemy? Come out and meet your maker! Damn, the mission says actively killing people might drop our ratings?”
“What does the mission require again, destroy ‘No. 3 Thorn Device’? Anyone partnering up…”
“‘No. 2 Thorn Device’ team, gather up…”
“Speaking of which, where’s Brother Shunzi? Why haven’t I seen him yet?”
“Be careful not to die, apparently we can’t revive repeatedly this time, death means a direct trip home.”
“You guys dying is no big deal, just don’t fail the mission and drag down my ratings and rewards!”
“That’s hilarious, starting now, I’m gonna complete this in one life and grab that Purple Gear!”
“…”
Upon arrival, people immediately found clear and definite tasks appearing in their minds, directing them towards various directions of the long train.
However, before setting off, some employees, such as “Fuer Mushroom” and “Emperor Sun,” turned their heads back to glance at the two fire columns linking heaven and earth.
They couldn’t help but laugh in schadenfreude.
“Finally, it’s someone else’s turn to be the teleport beacon, hahaha…”
“Hey, that mech looks familiar, who is it again? Oh, it’s the Fish Pond Master, why are you standing still?”
“The guy is still in the middle of spawning.”
“…”
On the other side, Akasha’s faction couldn’t help but be shocked by the “demons and ghosts” descending upon them, immediately sensing that these people were not the sort to be trifled with.
One by one, they wielded all sorts of odd equipment, some carrying sinister-looking skulls, some brandishing long swords made of spines that murmured ominously, and others wore terrifying masks filled with malicious whispers…
The variety of props was staggering.
Of course, while these people had a sinister air about them, one thing was for certain: among these more than a thousand individuals, not one was weak.
Their overall strength was quite formidable, not quite on par with the “Bonfire” Angel Envoy, but still very considerable…
However, Vini was somewhat troubled.
With this chaotic crowd rushing in, would they not end up causing more harm than help?
But just then, she noticed that in the midst of the chaos and noise, these disorganized people suddenly split into several teams.
They then started to move in an orderly fashion—
Except for the two who were still on the spot, connected to the flames, the rest began to move.
“You guys should start moving too, just follow them, let them spearhead the attack. We’ve got this place covered, well, actually, we don’t really need to guard it.”
A D Level Personnel approached Vini, finding her pretty, and kindly explained.
This time during the arrival of the fire columns, the two were protected and didn’t need to worry about anything—both columns would only disappear if all the members who had arrived were to perish.
If things really got to that point, the two of them would have to fend for themselves.
“Okay…” Vini nodded, gently waved her hand, signaling the other “subsidiary” employees to move forward together.
Soon, they encountered some enemies garrisoning the carriage areas.
…
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - 667 493 Warning Detected En Route... The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 667: Chapter 493 Warning, Detected En Route… “The Night”!_1 Chapter 667: Chapter 493 Warning, Detected En Route… “The Night”!_1 Facing the fierce onslaught of a group of D Level staff, the forces of “The Dusk Sect” simply couldn’t hold back.
Especially since the majority of the elite had all been called away to confront that Shadowfire Beast.
Some of the peripheral garrison personnel were almost instantly breached by the team of D Level staff and then knocked unconscious and dumped inside train carriages along the roadside.
Of course, the number of believers in “The Night” who possessed power was incredibly large.
There were also some from “The Dusk Sect” who were bent on death, and some who couldn’t help but be severely wounded and killed…
At this moment, the only thing that could delay the Bonfire Company employees for a while was a few small “Walls of Dusk”.
But generally speaking, these things couldn’t hold them back for long.
After all, the number of staff was much smaller than “The Dusk Sect”, and just looking at the numbers, it might take one to fight three or four, but the staff were more powerful and had a variety of props to assist them…
The entire advancement process was exceptionally smooth.
“They’re kind of weak!”
Miss Nell’s Dog laughed heartily, pinching the neck of an enemy from “The Dusk Sect” in his left hand, then, with a right hand wielding “Hypnosis Gloves”, he smashed a punch on the man’s head, knocking him unconscious.
He casually threw him out with force, dumping him outside.
After that, he ignored the gazes full of resentment and unwillingness from some who were not yet unconscious but had their legs and feet broken.
The group continued to move forward.
About twenty minutes later, “Lifecoach Kawaii-many” and others leading the team towards “Thorn Binding Device No.1” came across a very special area.
There, a large number of black thorns with a metallic sheen tightly bound dozens of train carriages.
Someone stepped forward to fire a grenade at it, but to their surprise, these Black Thorns showed no signs of damage.
“This way won’t work, we need to go to the binding device below and the various energy points…”
Vini, who had kept up with them, explained a bit.
Each “Thorn Device” not only had the device itself but was also equipped with multiple energy points.
Some people needed to suppress these energy points…
After all of them were suppressed, others could then destroy the protected “Thorn Device.” Otherwise, the “Thorns of Refusal” that kept growing on the perimeter would make it impossible for them to move even an inch or even get stuck to death inside!
Furthermore, while suppressing the energy points, they had to make sure they could keep it under pressure.
Otherwise, as soon as it was restored, those who had reached the “Thorn Device” would be surrounded by the thorns…
“This is… Why does it feel like it’s following the logic of a game?”
An employee who learned of the situation couldn’t help but complain, feeling a sense of déjà vu.
Vini continued to speak, “When we talk about destroying the ‘Thorn Binding Device,’ we’re actually just going to shut it down…
“These ‘Thorns’ are said to have been made by great sages hundreds of years ago and are very solid.
“Destroying them isn’t generally possible; probably only the people from back then could do it…”
“Alright, no big problem…” Kawaii-many waved his hand casually.
By now, more detailed mission content had appeared in their minds.
Each person’s specific tasks were reassigned.
After a brief pause, the action began again, with Kawaii-many and others leading the way to a train carriage covered in thorns, breaking through its defenses and then discovering a staircase leading downward after entering the carriage.
Going down, they encountered numerous crisscrossing passages.
The original large team split again, with some heading towards different paths…
With the guidance of their mission, they weren’t at all worried about getting lost in these chaotic tunnels.
Ten minutes later, several employee squads, after a deep clash with the “Rebels”, finally saw the first energy point.
The energy point was something akin to “roots”.
It would regenerate rapidly after being destroyed.
According to the mission requirements, they were to keep cutting it down as much as possible here.
When it was time for everyone to successfully liberate the train and when those who worship “The Night” as their deity returned to the carriages to start them, they would consider their mission complete…
As for when those people would return, they had no idea; they could only pray that Brother Shunzi would have a smooth operation.
“Hehehe, unlucky for you to encounter me!”
A D Level staff member wearing a “Demon’s Bargain Mask” burst into a ferocious laugh and stepped forward.
The sinister eldritch power in his hand surged continuously…
Upon witnessing this, members of “The Dusk Sect” looked as if they were facing a formidable enemy. At the same time, when their gaze caught those “Rebels” among the Outer God Followers, they couldn’t help but feel some hatred.
The reason they were breached so quickly was not only because these people were indeed powerful, but also because “one of their own” had been constantly sabotaging them.
Their power was often deciphered by other “Rebels” who also wielded the power of The Night.
This led to their collapse…
Otherwise, even if the Outer God Followers were powerful, things wouldn’t have gone so smoothly!
However, now was not the time to dwell on this.
Looking at the enemy leading the charge with a demon-like fierce face, and eldritch power erupting from his hand, they gritted their teeth, ready to lay down their lives to stop him…
Just then, something unexpected happened abruptly.
With a “thump”…
Members of “The Dusk Sect” saw the enemy, who wanted to lead the charge, suddenly kneel on the ground.
Not only the members of “The Dusk Sect” but also the company employees were stunned.
“What’s happening?”
The employee wearing the “Demon’s Bargain Mask” was caught off guard.
He had just suddenly felt a terrifying invisible presence descend from the dome, and before he could react, he was kneeling on the ground.
In his confusion, he turned his head, wanting to ask others about their situation…
But then…
The “thumps” kept occurring.
All the employees, caught by surprise, suddenly felt an immense pressure descend upon them. Like a sudden drop in blood sugar, the next thing they knew as they came to their senses, they were either kneeling or sitting on the ground.
“This power, ahahaha, is ‘The Night’, the great ‘The Night’, I knew it, It would never abandon us…”
Members of “The Dusk Sect” started laughing uproariously upon sensing that presence.
At that moment, the power of The Night within them swelled like never before.
Then, they turned their terrifying smiles towards the Outer God Followers, as well as the “Rebels” already soaked in sweat.
But as they prepared to move forward to reap the lives of their enemies…
The pressure from the dome suddenly skyrocketed.
With a “thump,”
They too knelt down.
For a moment, both sides were kneeling opposite each other, looking at each other with indescribable awkwardness on their faces.
…
And it was at this moment…
Colin, who had just breached the last defenses and entered the “Eternal Night” ritual, felt an incredibly terrifying gaze descend upon him.
In an instant, the flame on his body that couldn’t be quenched even in water flickered as if it were a candle in the wind.
It was nearly extinguished!
“Warning, a super high-intensity threat is incoming!” the voice of the Little Maid appeared in his ear.
“I know, no need for warnings.”
Colin struggled to stabilize his form, levitating mid-air, and gazed towards the dome.
“Hss… The Night.”
This is just…
‘The company has misled me!’
Wasn’t it agreed that only the power of “The Night” and not its will would appear here?
But complaints aside, Colin suddenly sensed from the dark depths below, a vague and pitch-black figure slowly emerging from the edge of the dim Bonfire.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - 668 494 Lavinia in Akasha_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 668: Chapter 494 “Lavinia” in “Akasha”?_1 Chapter 668: Chapter 494 “Lavinia” in “Akasha”?_1 “Are you… Akasha? No, that’s not right…”
Colin struggled to support himself while staring ahead.
From the edge of the flames, a figure gradually appeared, identical to Akasha, even her face, clothing, and hairstyle were nearly indistinguishable.
However, the one difference was that, in her hand, she dragged a black scythe.
She walked above the half-light, and beneath her in the darkness, numerous “The Night” believers were praying softly.
Those believers still bowed their heads, oblivious to the events unfolding above them, and Colin’s arrival…
“Lavinia.”
Colin spoke slowly.
Compared to his current self, almost immobilized by the intense pressure, Lavinia, a believer of “The Night,” seemed much more at ease.
And because of the slow emergence of the will of “The Night”, the believers here received an epic version boost.
Colin also had to muster all his concentration.
Step by step, Lavinia walked into the light of the flames and looked up at him, “You have finally reached this place.”
“What do you mean by that…”
Colin frowned, sensing something was off.
Moreover, he realized that this enemy seemed to have no intention of attacking.
Beyond that, there was something else he didn’t understand.
Lavinia had maintained Akasha’s appearance to approach him, down to the last detail except the scythe; now…
Logically, if she had been exposed, why would she still maintain this appearance?
Also, where had Akasha gone?
Observing Lavinia, who looked just like an identical twin, Colin suddenly felt that things were far from simple…
“As the day approached, I found out who I am… I know you must have quite a few questions about Akasha and me, but before it all ends, the only thing I can tell you is that I can be her, and she can be me. In the end, I too want to leave this place…”
Ah?
Listening to her words, Colin was filled with confusion, you can be her, and she can be you?
The one thing he was sure of was that Lavinia and Akasha, although they looked the same, were definitely two separate entities…
But now…
What exactly was happening?
At that moment, as Lavinia walked into the range of the bonfire’s light, she said, “But before I leave, I need to clean up the mess made by these foolish outsiders…””
Meanwhile, as she spoke, thorns black as the night, glistening metallically, began to grow from within her pitch-black robes and from her scythe.
They seemed to grow slowly, but in no time at all, the thorns wrapped around her layer by layer.
The sharp black thorns pierced into her flesh mercilessly, breaking every patch of skin on her body, sinking into the flesh, as red blood flowed, gathering at her feet and dripping down…
But the blood that fell turned into mist and rose around her.
Colin couldn’t help but wince at the sight, as one of the leaders of “The Dusk Sect” looked bizarrely eerie yet filled with an indescribable beauty.
And during this process, her aura was undergoing some kind of transformation.
‘This aura, why does it feel somewhat familiar…’
Colin had a vague sense of something.
“These foolish outsiders” likely referred not to him and the other Earth employees, but to those on the train.
And this tone…
Could it be that Lavinia, or Akasha, were the real “natives” of this world?
‘So this cursed world actually has living people, and even mixed among those on the train?’
‘What exactly is her identity now? What does she want to do? Is she summoning the ‘Lady of Thorns,’ who may be dead or alive?’
Numerous thoughts flashed through Colin’s mind.
Just then, as the dome filled with night surged again with a grand, intangible black tide, accompanied by a massive wave of consciousness…
The “Bonfire” next to Colin suddenly dimmed.
The area illuminated by the flames shrank by about a third with this consciousness wave of “The Night”!
This…
This was merely the result of a possible simple “thought” from the other side, without any real action!
Colin felt that the entity seemed “unable to see” him.
Otherwise, it probably wouldn’t have stopped at just “thinking.”
And with that moment, almost all of “The Dusk Sect’s” chosen believers below fainted…
“Gurgle, gurgle…”
An indescribable hunger surged from within.
“Let me… out…”
“Release me…”
“To survive, one must feed…”
The “Hunger” rooted deep within Colin seemed to be stimulated and struggled to break through.
However, as a certain power from the distant, endless void swept over…
The “Hunger” suddenly fell silent.
“Hiss, you’re hitting the ‘Hunger’ inside me through me?”
Colin’s gaze slightly solidified.
This method of attack was somewhat incomprehensible, almost unnervingly precise…
“It must be that ‘Divine’ power cannot exceed too much, or it would be locked by ‘The Night,’ but it seems that the ‘Firebearer’s’ power doesn’t involve much ‘Divine’ power, so it can be safely used…”
“Hiss, ‘The Night’ is still ruthless, just as ‘Hunger’ popped up and cried out it was hungry, and then got knocked out…”
As thoughts flickered, Colin no longer hesitated. With “The Night” inadvertently resolving his “internal worries,” he unleashed all the effects he could activate!
“‘Revolver Contrarian’ Containment Protocol Item Liberation…”
“‘Potential Burst’…”
“Colorless Crystal*30…”
“…”
With various effects stacking, flames on Colin’s body burned and expanded fiercely.
The profound darkness of the place retreated even more…
“I don’t care who you are! Whatever your identity! If you’re a collaborator, summon them now!”
Colin shouted at the “Lavinia” who was enveloped in black thorns, as if she had become another person.
The pressure from “The Night” was growing greater…
That ancient and terrifying entity seemed to have just realized what was happening here, turning more attention this way. In such a situation, even Colin couldn’t guarantee how long he could hold on.
“Lavinia” nodded, and then, Colin could feel it.
A certain active “information cluster’s” power emanated from her…
It was a bit similar to that time in “World Code-13” when they encountered the “branch office” at night, but it was not the same.
‘Indeed, is she summoning that ‘Lady of Thorns’? Hiss, there’s another fluctuation…’
Without any time to think further, Colin focused all his attention and energy on maintaining the bonfire.
The deepening darkness and the light from the flames form a thick mist on the edge where they clashed…
In less than fifteen minutes, Colin clearly saw that the area illuminated by the flames had shrunk again.
At the same time, the terrifying pressure became even clearer…
“Pfft…”
On Colin’s forehead, visibly bulging with veins, a blood vessel suddenly burst, blood breaking through the skin and spurting out.
The very blood that spurted forth ignited fiercely as soon as it emerged.
This indicated that his power had reached its limit.
Yet even so, he was still losing ground…
Not a true “Firebearer,” he simply did not have the strength to contend with “The Night”!
Even with a body augmented by fragments of “Hunger,” it wasn’t much use.
‘Hiss, hurry up, for fuck’s sake, I’ve held on for a year, are you summoning or incubating, why is it so slow!’
Colin cursed in his heart involuntarily.
If you can’t shake them out, then come up and take on the pressure of “The Night.” Let him do the summoning!
First, get ‘King of Savage Sound’ or someone to replace him for a bit…
Now, he truly felt that what was flowing through his veins was no longer blood, but all flammable material…
At best, it was flammable material mixed with a few red blood cells.
If this continued, even if he wouldn’t be devoured by The Night, he’d blow up!
The difficulty of holding fire under “The Night’s” power far exceeded his expectations!
And it is at this critical moment that he suddenly felt a terrifying momentum rising up from where “Lavinia” stood…
With the emergence of this power, the pressure on his body abruptly lightened.
The compressed flames and light spread out again…
It seemed that a force had taken hold of the situation as the great edifice was about to collapse.
.
.
.
There will be another chapter after midnight.

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - 669 495 Lady of Thorns _1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 669: Chapter 495 “Lady of Thorns” _1 Chapter 669: Chapter 495 “Lady of Thorns” _1 “Phew, at last…”
Colin silently let out a sigh of relief.
Then, just as he was about to take a look at who this “Former Company Employee” really was and how they could so easily take over, he suddenly felt his body not responding correctly…
From head to toe, there emerged an inexplicable sense of “joy.”
An atmosphere of horror far surpassing the aura of “The Night” made its appearance…
Colin’s body stiffened, feeling like it might collapse at any moment.
His consciousness began to run wild like an unruly horse, highly disordered!
‘No, no, no! This aura, it’s not right… Not the ‘Lady of Thorns’! Definitely not…’
He struggled to lower his gaze, and now, “Lavinia” was still standing the same as before…
But the demeanor on her body was completely different, with a very powerful consciousness descending.
This “consciousness” was all wrong…
‘Please, please don’t let it be what I’m thinking!’
He struggled to send a message over, “Weren’t you supposed to summon the ‘Lady of Thorns’? So, who… who have you summoned now?”
Hearing these incoherent words, “Lavinia” opened her eyes, and a strange smile tugged at the corners of her extremely pale face, which may have been due to blood loss or something else.
‘This… Has another person changed?’
Colin felt that the person in front of him seemed to have undergone some internal change again.
Rather than a person…
He felt that this fellow in front of him was more essentially like some kind of container!
And the person inside the container kept switching!
“Lavinia” looked at him and blinked, her dark lips parting, “I never said that I was summoning the ‘Lady of Thorns’…”
Before Colin could ask, the oddity on her face grew stronger, accompanied by an indescribable smile:
“She didn’t tell you that I am the ‘Lady of Thorns’…”
You are that “Former Company Employee”?
Colin’s pupils contracted sharply, then…
“You… what the hell… have you summoned? Why do I feel… something’s not right…”
He struggled to control his throat, mouth, tongue, and other organs as he spoke in fits and starts.
However, he stopped midway through speaking…
Because, although the “Lady of Thorns” said nothing, her dark pupils faintly emitted strands of red light.
In the depths of that profound darkness, a vague Red Moon seemed ready to emerge.
The answer was self-evident!
“I… fuck… you…”
Colin’s pupils vibrated violently, his complexion turning deathly pale; this was the scenario he least wanted to encounter!
If he couldn’t beat “The Night,” he could avoid fighting, but bringing this thing here—was it to die together?
“Good colleague, don’t panic, I hope you can hold on a little longer.”
The “Lady of Thorns” nodded with a smile and then her body ascended upward.
At an extremely fast speed, she passed above Colin and kept rising…
The next second, Colin seemed to realize something. Without any hesitation, he did everything possible to surround himself with flames, covering and protecting himself layer by layer.
And it was in the instant after he completed all preparations…
A “boom” resounded.
Above him, “Lavinia’s” entire body exploded…
Organs, bones, blood—all burst into a sky full of blood mist, and at that moment, writhing red light blossomed from within the flesh and quickly reassembled as it bloomed.
However, with the arrival of this force, “The Night” above seemed to take notice.
An unknown force struck…
Just as it was about to coalesce into a round, crimson object, it suddenly exploded.
But unlike the “Hunger” within Colin, it did not dissipate immediately; instead, it continued to reassemble.
A bounty of nascent life spread…
All things within the red light developed new consciousness, emerging anew.
Colin’s “ears” and some other parts began to involuntarily sing a strange whisper— “Life is so beautiful, la la la, rebirth, happiness, I want to live, everyone together, together now~”
This was the first time he heard some of the content from the “Red Moon’s” murmurs.
While its content did not seem peculiar and appeared simple and cluttered, the tone was like a nursery rhyme hummed by a child…
The meaning, it seemed, was calling for “birth,” “the fusion of life,” and so on and so forth.
“Damn it, stop thinking about it, I don’t want to know what the ‘Red Moon’ is saying! Do not pronounce the name ‘Red Moon’…”
“Damn! I said do not…”
“Fuck, a dozen layers of ‘Firebearer’ flame protection can’t stop this thing from corrupting?!”
Right now, Colin truly wanted to punch himself, to knock his increasingly active brain unconscious.
No, to knock unconscious every cell in his body that was gleefully “singing”…
Colin could distinctly feel that this time the “Red Moon” felt a tad different from the aura he had encountered before…
For instance, it seemed quite “joyful,” filled with a sense of happiness.
But conversely…
The Colin influenced by it couldn’t feel happy at all!
The “Red Moon’s” extremely high status, as well as one of its basic authorities “Rebirth,” was every bit as formidable as the dome’s “The Night”!
The two most terrifying entities in Colin’s cognition were battling in the dome, almost extinguishing the flames on his body.
His entire body was birthing a cacophony of “thoughts” under the influence of “Rebirth,” including his brain spontaneously generating “thoughts” out of control, making Colin feel on the verge of collapse…
But it was at this moment that rings of thorns, sheathed in black metal, appeared out of nowhere.
They wrapped around and entwined him directly.
As those cold, black spikes penetrated his skin, Colin’s disordered “thoughts” began to fade away and scatter.
“Add more fire, ‘The Night’ is too strong, it can’t coalesce, wait a little longer, and when more of ‘The Night’s’ will arrives, it will all be for naught…” whispered “Lady of Thorns,” her voice traveling along the surface thorns into his body.
“Who the fuck ‘we’, I fucking want to punch you first!” Colin couldn’t help but curse out loud.
“Okay okay, do as you please after we sort this out, ‘Firebearers’ are different from me, I’ll disappear if I make a move, but you won’t be targeted, I will compensate you, hurry hurry, add more fire…”
Colin’s flames had already reached his personal limit.
Increasing the fire was no easy task…
Even using the Level 2 Containment Subject from the “Storage Room” would hardly be in time.
Because lighting it up would take a considerable amount of time, and it might not even work effectively.
The only way…
Colin clenched his teeth while simultaneously activating “Time Stasis” and “Force – Repulsion.” Then, seizing the brief gap torn by the two artifacts, he grasped his left index and middle finger with his right hand.
“Crack…”
Two fingers were pulled from his left palm and flung into the sky.
“Boom~”
A dazzling “Little Sun” ascended at that moment.
Yet, even before the “Little Sun” could radiate any warm light, it exploded abruptly, directly erased from the darkness in an incomprehensible way…
However, thanks to that fleeting moment.
In the fading glow of the flames, a crimson “moon” slowly rose.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - 670 496 The Night and Red Moon..._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 670: Chapter 496 “The Night” and “Red Moon”…_1 Chapter 670: Chapter 496 “The Night” and “Red Moon”…_1 The nascent “Red Moon” rose upward like a celestial body…
It was like a giant from ancient myths, separating heaven and earth, holding the sky and the ground apart.
The “Red Moon,” once brimming with boundless hostility towards the “Firebearer,” was now investing all its efforts in the collision with “The Night,” seemingly indifferent to making Colin’s life difficult.
This collision was quiet, and although it could be called a “battle,” from certain bystander perspectives, it seemed more like an ordinary natural phenomenon, much like light naturally dispelling darkness.
“To ‘cooperate’ with the ‘Red Moon’ is something I could never have dreamed of in my life,” said Colin.
Colin bowed his head deeply, not daring to gaze at the sky, lest the battle between the two forces obliterate him.
In his opinion, the situation was quite unexpected.
And it made him realize one thing…
What in the world could make the “Red Moon” form an alliance with the “Bonfire Company”?
The answer was “The Night.”
“Heh heh heh, young man, you don’t know, do you? Under normal circumstances, the best way to counter ‘The Night’ is to summon the ‘Primordial Fire’…”
“Second to that would be ‘Light,’ ‘Red Moon,’ and so on…”
“After that strange period, I sent out a lot of messages, trying to summon a C+ Level ‘Firebearer’ to come over and send these foreigners away, but I never succeeded…”
“As for those under ‘Light,’ they might as well be dead,” he continued.
“In the end, I had no choice but to look for other alternatives, and when it comes to sensitivity to ‘The Night’—who would act at any cost the moment they sensed its possible descent—only the ‘Red Moon’ fits the bill…”
“It’s just that there’s a risk of accidentally causing trouble for oneself…”
The voice of “Lady of Thorns” transmitted through the thorns, sounding exactly like “Akasha” or “Lavinia.”
It was unclear whether it was her true nature, or if she was influenced by the “joy” that came with the appearance of the “Red Moon,” but at this moment, “Lady of Thorns” exuded an indescribable optimism and cheerfulness…
She seemed unusually talkative.
Listening to her, Colin couldn’t help but feel puzzled.
‘Not to mention anything else, how did you come to possess the method to summon the ‘Red Moon’? Why does the ‘Red Moon’ harbor such hostility towards ‘The Night’? Aren’t they sort of mother and child in some sense…’
However, now wasn’t the time to ask these questions. He took a deep breath and interrupted the Lady of Thorns’s chatter:
“Cut the crap, what do we do next?”
True, the burden on him had been lessened by the will of the “Red Moon.”
But this didn’t mean everything was over.
Leaving aside the situation overhead for the moment, those “The Night” believers below were collapsing on the ground like lumps of rotten flesh.
Millions of writhing masses were evenly crawling across the ground, a scene both horrific and spectacular.
This was clearly the impact of the “Red Moon’s” arrival.
If it weren’t for that thin layer of skin, the things growing inside these people would probably be running rampant everywhere.
Even so, some individuals had eyes trailing long nerves, singing and jumping outside their eye sockets…
It was grotesque, but not to the worst extreme…
If he hadn’t intensified the Bonfire at the moment the “Red Moon” appeared, the situation below would have been more than just rotten flesh by now.
“What’s next? Well, that’s much simpler. I couldn’t act earlier because these fellows were inhabited by the power of ‘The Night.’ Now that it’s distracted, things should be easier…”
“Of course, you’ll still need to hold on for a bit longer.”
The voice of “Lady of Thorns” again traveled through the thorns that penetrated flesh and blood.
It was as her voice reached him that Colin saw, at the central spot of the “Eternal Night” ceremony,
Thorns with a black metallic sheen began to spread out around the approximately one hundred meter high, black crystal spire that looked as though it could absorb all light.
It enveloped the pitch-black spire in circles, isolating the mysterious atmosphere emanating from it.
At the same time, on the ground, every living being sprouted sharp black thorns that wrapped around them; then beneath the writhing skin, everything began to repair and reset…
However, after the restoration, people had vacant and dull expressions on their faces, as if they were soulless.
“Come, spread the light of the fire more evenly here, pour a little more ‘humanity’ into it.”
What the hell does she think I am…
Colin thought to himself, but still complied with the request.
In the light of the fire, the emptiness on people’s faces faded, their expressions gaining luster, like withered trees revitalized by rainfall.
“Without the threat of ‘The Night,’ once they wake up after a while, they will all be my believers. However, to mark all these people, I had to lurk for a long time, ensuring that each one could be marked.”
“Lady of Thorns” spoke very quickly.
While she acted, Colin could feel from those black thorns that her status was indeed not low. As a “World Administrator,” the logic of her words showed a very “human” nature…
She was levels higher than the “King of Savage Sound.”
However, Colin was unclear whether this “Lady of Thorns” was an Outer God that had fallen from humanity like the “Father of the Sea.”
Or had ascended from humankind herself.
“What about those two above us later on?” Colin asked.
“Don’t worry, the ‘Container’ I provided can only sustain ‘Red Moon’ for a while, and its power has a limit. When the time comes, I will have eradicated the roots of ‘The Night’, and by then, the container would almost be destroyed by ‘The Night’ as well…”
“Then, without believers, they won’t be able to exist here for much longer. Of course, that’s under the condition that you hold on a bit longer.”
“Otherwise, if these people are affected and die from the power above, restarting the train would be troublesome, and with fewer people, the ‘agreement’ might not be triggered…”
“Lady of Thorns” replied very optimistically and indicated that, after her meticulous calculations, no accidents would occur.
“I’ll try my best to hold on, hoping it will go as smoothly as you say.”
Colin, whose body was burning intensely, spoke, and only then did he have a moment to glance at the palm of his left hand, now missing two fingers.
The cut was intensely painful but did not bleed; instead, it was like a flaming gas cylinder, spewing fire!
This made it somewhat hard for him to keep his composure.
‘The power is still a bit out of control.’ Colin thought to himself.
There was too little time to think this time…
It felt like things were moving too quickly. If such a situation arose again, it might be more appropriate to use the two fingers in the back.
‘No, next time? There can’t be a next time! Why the hell am I bothering to sum up these things?!’
Colin couldn’t help but grumble in his heart.
Just then, above the dome, a silent “collision” exploded once again.
Even without looking up, Colin’s mind conjured vague images—
In these images, endless darkness enveloped the “Red Moon,” seeming to dissect it and drag it into eternal darkness, while the dense light blooming from the “Red Moon” rooted itself into the darkness like an umbilical cord of a mother and child, drawing ‘nourishment’ from the surroundings…
This “battle” was much weirder than usual, not something ordinary people could understand.
“Don’t think too much!”
Colin shook his head vigorously and started to maintain the flame with all his might to prevent any further accidents.
.
.
.
Updating first.

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - 671 497 Firebearer Philosophy Class Ignite
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 671: Chapter 497 “Firebearer” Philosophy Class: Ignite Others, Warm Yourself._1 Chapter 671: Chapter 497 “Firebearer” Philosophy Class: Ignite Others, Warm Yourself._1 With the “Eternal Night” ritual stabilizing, the employees kneeling at the various “Thorn Binding Device” points suddenly felt the pressure on them lighten…
Although that inexplicable sense of palpitations persisted, at least they were now able to move.
“Wahahaha~”
The malevolent green spirit flames reignited, and the D Level staff laughed maniacally:
“Now it’s our turn again!”
The battle kicked off once more!
The members of “The Dusk Sect” stationed at the points finally experienced the employees’ various offensive methods: from long-distance curses to strange magic spells to physical attacks driven by some unknown means…
With the help of the “Defiants,” it didn’t take long for The Dusk Sect’s defenses to be breached.
And those who were powerful enough to match the official Eighth Level fighters of The Dusk Sect were too few in number, creating a different scenario than for the ordinary underlings.
They were simultaneously besieged by more than three elite D Level members.
They had no choice but to either retreat or be knocked unconscious.
“It’s so easy, there are so many Extraordinary Ones here, but not a single ‘legion’ combat team has emerged. It’s all freelancers, no regular army, what a waste…”
“Indeed, indeed, and the defense setup below is also so rough…”
“It’s so easy to clear, I wonder if the reward will be less.””
“It shouldn’t be, the company values the actual gains, it doesn’t matter if our process is simple or not.”
“Is that so? Feels like I’m just picking up money…”
“There’s no difficulty at all, I thought it would be like last time, facing a ton of enemies. I’ve even prepared a small nuclear warhead…”
“Damn, you ‘official faction’ guys really can bring anything!”
“Speaking of which, what was with that pressure just now? I feel like it’s something to do with Brother Shunzi; doesn’t anyone want to figure it out? Anyone want to team up and check it out?”
“Damn, @MyLittleBean, don’t talk nonsense if it’s not conducive to survival. Knowing too much will only get you killed!”
“@MyLittleBean, a bro can be useless, just don’t be a nuisance! Don’t end up affecting Brother Shunzi and drag us all into a group annihilation…”
“By the way, how many of us are down now? And how long do we have to hold out?”
“Less than a tenth anyway…”
“As for how long to hold out, that depends on Brother Shunzi; but with the current situation, it’s a breeze to last until tomorrow.”
“…”
After one stronghold after another was conquered, the employees started chatting casually.
The suppression of the energy source device was not complicated; it involved cutting the root tendrils, about two to three meters in diameter, and continuously repeating the process of cutting them before they could reconnect.
Although these things were as hard as raw iron, for the employees,
cutting them was not particularly difficult…
And as long as they cut here, the “Thorns of Refusal” would wither, and then the corresponding employees could easily cut in and sever all the black thorns that sprawled through each train car.
Overall, it wasn’t considered a very difficult task.
At least…
It was like that in the early stages.
As time ticked by, and the task was yet to be completed, with the root tendrils of the “Energy Point” growing faster and faster,
The employees suddenly realized that something was off.
“Damn, what’s going on with the Energy Point? Why have the ‘Thorns of Refusal’ started growing again?!”
“That was close, it almost pierced right through my butt!”
“Come on, Energy Point, put more effort into it! Suppress the energy faster!”
The D Level employees responsible for handling the “thorns” quickly noticed that the black thorns, which had already stopped growing for a while, suddenly “came back to life” with increasing strength.
“Damn, be careful, don’t use ‘items’ to resist forcefully! Those damn spikes can damage the integrity of items!”
Some panicked upon discovering that the integrity of some of their items was actually decreasing under the onslaught of the thorns!
Immediately, some employees, unwary of being trapped by the thorns to death, put away their items after hearing this.
For them, death was acceptable, but they could not accept damage to their items—
After all, repairing items was too expensive, easily costing thousands or tens of thousands of Points, and the rewards from this mission might not even cover the repairs!
Thus, some unlucky employees preferred to suffer a painful death riddled like a beehive than to see their item’s integrity decreased.
Meanwhile, the employees suppressing the energy points had their own unspoken woes.
Just now, not only did the thick root tendrils recover faster and faster, but they also became harder…
The hardness was now comparable to steel!
“How long do we have to suppress this? These thorns are getting harder, they’re almost as tough as titanium alloys! My hands are about to be chopped off…”
“Why are they growing so fast? Waaah, my ‘Tyrant Body’ claws have broken several times…”
“My demonic flames are almost burned out, if this goes on, I’ll have to burn myself!”
“What’s going on with Brother Shunzi, hasn’t it been fixed yet?”
“It’s getting harder, can’t hold out much longer, my exoskeleton armor is running out of power…”
“…”
The employees were drenched in sweat as they focused on suppressing the root tendrils, unsure of why this was happening.
The root tendrils, which could have been easily suppressed before, now required a lot of effort just to be kept in a severed state.
And while everyone was complaining, Colin was in no better condition.
In the midst of an intensely burning fireball, Colin tried his best to maintain the flames; it had been almost an hour since the “Red Moon” had appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - 672 497 Firebearer Philosophy Class Ignite
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 672: Chapter 497 “Firebearer” Philosophy Class: Ignite Others, Warm Yourself._2 Chapter 672: Chapter 497 “Firebearer” Philosophy Class: Ignite Others, Warm Yourself._2 The continuous output of the high-intensity flames was more than even he could bear.
And at this crucial moment, there was no direct way to withdraw…
Having endured up to now, if Colin were to withdraw the flames, not only would all his efforts be in vain, but he would likely fall victim to the struggle between the two entities above his head.
Clenching his teeth, Colin struggled to convey his voice to the “Thorn Lady”:
“How much longer is your ‘little bit longer’?!”
“Almost there, very soon, don’t be hasty.” A whisper emerged from the black thorns surrounding him.
However, Colin, having learned his lesson, did not fall for it again and continued:
“Give me a specific time!”
From the moment “Red Moon” was summoned until now, it was either “very soon” or “wait a moment.” He had thought a mere fifteen minutes would suffice, but damn, an hour had passed and still, nothing.
At this moment, millions of “Dusk Faction” members bowed their heads, each with a crown of “thorns” around their head.
And those who were fitted with this contraption seemed to completely ignore the anomaly above their heads.
“This time it’s really soon, but once they get on the vehicle, it will take some more time…” The voice of the “Thorn Lady” sounded again, now slightly feeble.
“Just a small fraction of people remain without the thorns. Once that’s done, transferring all their ‘destinies’ for the near future onto my true body, letting me bear it, then we can act…”
“Transfer to your body?” Colin asked subconsciously with a hint of confusion.
“Yes, it’s one of my authorities. Otherwise, at their level, how could they possibly have the power to break away from ‘The Night’? This matter is much more complicated than you think; they can’t just run away to solve it. Without a thorough solution, they might just vanish unexpectedly, unable to bear a destiny tied to ‘The Night’… but no worries…”
The “Thorn Lady” said, “The destiny of destruction, I will bear for them.”
Upon hearing these words, Colin was momentarily stunned, suddenly seeing a glimmer of humanity shine through those dark black thorns.
His exhaustion didn’t seem so overwhelming anymore.
In truth, he felt he could persist a bit longer.
But soon, the next words she spoke dissipated that fleeting light of humanity…
“Anyway, the true body has resilience, heh heh.”
That was something that need not have been said…
Colin took a deep breath of flames, suddenly recalling something: “Then we’re also involved with ‘The Night’…”
“The lady who dispatched you has already dealt with everything. You don’t have to worry. Even being directly killed by ‘The Night’ is not a fear, nor tracking through the company’s network…”
Oh, death is not to be feared? Well, that’s a relief… Colin breathed a sigh of relief.
The “Thorn Lady” seemed to realize what he was thinking, “Of course, I meant the batch that’s coming afterwards. The other three including you had better stay out of trouble…”
“Alright.” Colin nodded with a hint of exhaustion.
Feeling the flame on his body starting to wane, he couldn’t help but ask, “Do you have anything that can burn?”
No sooner had he spoken, the “Thorn Lady’s” reaction became quite intense.
“Oh my goodness, wasn’t the first lesson of a ‘Flame Bearer’ Reservist to learn self-sacrifice? How have you jumped ahead of becoming a ‘Flame Bearer’ and learned the lesson of ‘igniting others to warm yourself’? Don’t even think about burning my body!”
Huh? There are such learning strategies? Colin was startled.
Burning others if possible, and only considering oneself as a last resort—that’s how Colin had always operated.
However, he had not foreseen that such practices had been formalized into some kind of ideological course within the past “Flame Bearer” community?
Also, why was the “Thorn Lady’s” reaction so intense?
Before he could speak, the “Thorn Lady” continued, “Forget it, forget it, I’m really fed up with you paranoiacs, seeing everyone as a piece of kindling…
“Alright, it’s a good thing I came prepared…”
As she spoke, a large number of withered “Black Thorns” with a metallic sheen appeared out of thin air.
Colin did not hesitate; the flames engulfed and ignited them.
The roaring fire spread outwards…
These flames were not as easy to control as the “Flame Bearer’s” own, but at this moment, what Colin needed was not the precision of the flames, but to light up the surroundings as much as possible.
Suddenly, with the addition of this new fire, the flames that were beginning to falter regained their stability, separating the “crimson” and “darkness” in the sky from the world below human understanding.
‘Not bad, it seems…’
Colin thought, “The Thorn Lady” really was good material. He’d ask if he could have some to take back and keep once the mission was over.
He didn’t mention it right now, with this batch of “charcoal.”
The pressure had eased quite a bit…
He even had time to check the messages in the mental communication channel for the employee team, discovering that they seemed to be in a tough spot too.
“The ‘Thorn Binding Device’ is yours, isn’t it? Can’t you retract it on your own?” Colin asked.
No sooner had he asked, the “Thorn Lady” instantly replied, “I can’t retract it. That thing is connected to some special defenses of this world. To shut it down, we have to do it together, but if we do that…”
She stopped talking abruptly.
What’s the matter? Colin tried inquiring: “But if we do that?”
There was no response for several seconds…

chapters.title: Chapter 673 - 673 497 Firebearer Philosophy Class Ignite
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 673: Chapter 497 “Firebearer” Philosophy Class: Ignite Others, Warm Yourself._3 Chapter 673: Chapter 497 “Firebearer” Philosophy Class: Ignite Others, Warm Yourself._3 Just as Colin was feeling puzzled, the voice of the “Thorn Lady” rang out again, “I got a little distracted just now and accidentally used some ‘Divinity’. I got tapped by the ‘Night’, well, back to the point, in that case, the ‘Night’ would directly descend upon you…”
Upon hearing this, Colin shivered.
He then continued to listen to the “Thorn Lady”‘s voice coming through: “You should know that people here have never truly connected with the ‘Night’ up till now. Aside from its own issues, there’s also my effort involved.”
“Alright,” Colin didn’t ask any further.
At this point, it looked like the employees were in for more hardship.
‘No, it’s not really a hardship, just driving a ‘wooden stake’ is all. How could there be any suffering in that? I’m carrying two things and not complaining about the aftermath of battle, yet they’re here whining…’
Colin felt justified getting up on his feet.
And as time trickled by…
Almost another hour later, when everyone including Colin really felt like they couldn’t hold on any longer.
The “Thorn Lady”‘s voice suddenly offered proactive guidance.
“Alright, alright, it’s finally sorted! Look at how I’ve nailed it!”
As her words ended, a bright light flooded Colin’s field of vision, and the dense dimness that enveloped the ritual place of the “Eternal Night” dissipated instantly, the power of the “Night” that resided within the bodies of the employees from the various “branch offices” of this world vanished.
It was unclear whether it was transferred, or emptied…
This occurrence made the “Night” above the dome suddenly feel even more distant, like a kite with its string cut.
“Finally…” Colin exhaled in relief, but he still didn’t dare to let go of the fire.
At that moment, above the cloud-covered dome, something giant and majestic began to stir.
Colin caught a glimpse from the corner of his eye, it appeared to be some “black thorns,” only these were much larger than those nearby, and they spanned the sky, extending to the ends unseen, as if wrapping the entire world within.
At that time, countless thorns descended from the sky, their branches intertwining and entangling to form a vague figure dressed in a long thorn-covered gown.
A grand aura erupted from this figure…
The whole world began to vibrate.
Countless figures knelt before her, praising loudly.
‘The Dusk Sect’s change of faith is really swift,’ Colin thought, tongue-tied.
At this moment, the lofty and distant words of the “Thorn Lady” reached everyone’s ears along with her power:
“Heed my words, return to the train, and set sail once again!”
There was no explanation given…
But the will of the True God is not to be questioned!
Everyone turned and walked swiftly towards the train, everything proceeding in an orderly fashion under her watchful gaze, without too many incidents…
After the last person entered the carriage, a task appeared in Colin’s mind.
[Temporary event: Enter any carriage on the “Severed Mist Train”, transfer the personnel of the train, then take out a “Level 2 Containment Subject” and “Colorless Crystal*100” and ignite them to inject initial power into the train.]
“So those things were to be used at this moment, huh?”
Colin contemplated; he initially thought this was meant to be added to the fuel chamber when reaching the ninth station.
It turned out to be just providing an initial power…
“Go ahead, now it’s up to me to hold this place,” the “Thorn Lady” said.
Upon hearing this, Colin hesitated no longer, dived down towards the lower area. Under the amazed gazes of everyone, he entered one of the carriages, after moving people into other carriages, he took out the materials he had prepared earlier.
He then poured a can of “Flame Bearer’s Grease” and snapped his fingers to ignite it.
The next second…
The Containment Subject emitted a scream, seeming to want to struggle, but Colin stepped forward and held it down with a foot, pulling out his revolver and fired several shots without expression.
Quiet returned to the place once again.
Then, after about ten more seconds…
The train, which had been stationary for hundreds of years, began to vibrate, with gray mist spewing out from atop it, and gradually started to move, picking up speed as it went.
“Hahaha, it’s finally moving! It’s finally moving!”
“The task is about to be completed!”
“Wuu wuu wuu, the torture is over, it has ended…”
“…”
The multitude of employees burst into excited celebration upon seeing this, but observed the train gradually moving away.
Standing in place, they suddenly felt something was amiss…
The task was over, they hadn’t been immediately returned, and the train seemed to be moving further away.
“Wait, hold on, we haven’t boarded yet!”
Some tried to catch up while waving their hands and shouting loudly.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 674 - 674 498 All Enemies of the Divine_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 674: Chapter 498 All Enemies of the “Divine”!_1 Chapter 674: Chapter 498 All Enemies of the “Divine”!_1 “Fuck, stop for a moment, we’re not on board yet!”
“Quick, stop! What am I going to do without you, why didn’t you give a heads-up before starting up…”
“Don’t leave, don’t leave, take us with you!”
“How can we live without you!!!”
“…”
The heart-wrenching cries of the employees came from outside the train carriage. Colin heard them, saw them, but he had no means to do anything, as the train was fully automated in some sense, and once set in motion, he simply couldn’t control it…
Or more accurately, he didn’t have the authority.
Outside the window, some employees tried to board the train by various means.
But even though the train wasn’t moving very fast at this point, probably not much faster than an ordinary person on a bicycle, they still couldn’t get on.
After the doors closed, all those trying to board found themselves unable to even approach the train itself…
The short distance seemed to be separated by an infinite expanse.
Some employees attempted to use their own gadgets or talents to try or even attack, but to no avail.
Even for the few who barely broke through the unclear barrier and touched the train.
The outcome was still unchanged…
“Looks like they can’t get on board, the only one with authority to control this train is probably ‘Lady of Thorns,’ and who knows where she’s gone,” Colin shook his head and withdrew his gaze
Just then, someone from another carriage called out his name: “Brother Shunzi? Is Brother Shunzi over there?”
“It’s me, but I can’t leave, what’s up?”
Colin’s eyebrows lifted. The only people who would call him by that name were likely employees.
After a brief thought, he realized that some employees must have been on the train carriage when the train started, then sensed his presence and naturally came over to check.
“Can the train stop now?” Several employees from outside walked past a pile of former “Night” believers in the carriage.
With the feedback from the flames, Colin knew it was “Master of the Fish Pond,” “It’s not Orange Cat’s fault,” and a handful of other employees.
At the moment, they were sticking their heads out from the connection door of the carriage where he was, trying to come in, but getting blown out by the air pressure brought by the flames.
Although the flames had not caused them any harm.
But some effects of the air pressure were still there…
Especially when igniting a “Level 2 Containment Subject.”
So they could only stand outside the door, shouting across the space, seeing Brother Shunzi through the reflections on the window inside the carriage…
“The train itself is not open to us. All the outsiders have been brought on board. Once it started, it can’t stop, at least I can’t control it…” Colin shook his head.
“Okay, then, what about those people?”
“What about them?”
Colin’s gaze passed over those employees outside, looking into the distance. With the battle continuing up to now and the protective arrangements of this place breached, it seemed to also draw the attention of some mutated creatures from afar…
And the employees watching the mirror, who had the “Luck” talent, also looked outside following his action.
Then, they soon had a sense of realization…
How those people would return home, they could probably guess.
It probably wouldn’t be a pleasant experience…
Following that…
“Haha, lucky I got on quickly, or I’d be unable to board like those poor bastards.”
“It’s hilarious. They used to mock us, treating us like dispensable pawns at the teleportation points. Karma.”
“Ouch, there’s a guy who looks like he’s touching the train. Can you open a window and pry his hand off, Brother Shunzi? I’m worried he might actually climb up.”
“…”
There was no sorrow, for knowing they could resurrect and return, all they had was schadenfreude.
Colin shook his head, not surprised by this situation, then he gave them a temporary assignment since they had nothing else to do.
To help as much as possible with treating the injured people on the train.
“Got it!” The group of employees didn’t show any aversion to the task and began to act.
Colin took his attention off these people, glanced at the containment subject at his feet that was twitching in the flames but not quite dead, increased the intensity of the flames, and let more energy seep into the compartment, thereby speeding up the process.
About ten minutes later, the mist around the train carriage became denser and denser…
The faces of the employees outside the windows were increasingly filled with despair, while inside, the employees who had boarded mostly laughed even more joyously.
However, after a few more minutes, the train finally picked up speed.
The voices of those employees outside were no longer heard…
For a time, the carriage fell into a kind of silence.
Although packed with people at the moment, aside from the sounds of the train itself running, the silence felt a bit too profound.
It was then that Colin suddenly heard some murmuring…
“Daddy, will we ever return here? Where are we going now…”
“Daddy doesn’t know…”
Some conversations came from the somewhat silent carriage around him.
Colin observed the “branch office” employees, each adorned with thorns, through the flames. He found them silently watching the outside world at this moment.
Their eyes reflected complex emotions: reluctance, sadness, or perhaps puzzlement and aimlessness—
For many who opened their eyes to this world at birth, the Mutated World was filled with countless dangers; but regardless, it was the place where they had lived and grown up.
This sudden departure after a ceremony seemed so abrupt.
But…
Although they had lost their homeland, they had gained freedom.
Yes, freedom in the truest sense, and likely a not-so-terrible future.

chapters.title: Chapter 675 - 675 498 All Enemies of the Divine_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 675: Chapter 498 All Enemies of the “Divine”!_2 Chapter 675: Chapter 498 All Enemies of the “Divine”!_2 “I wonder if the company has made any subsequent arrangements for them.”
Colin glanced at his current mission, and after taking the people away, there were no other tasks related to them.
The only task was to enter the fuel room when stopping at the ninth station and then “hold back.”
And the employees probably didn’t have much more follow-up — otherwise, they wouldn’t have been discarded so readily after use.
According to the regulations of the “Bonfire Company,” there must be some arrangements for them.
It’s just not clear what they might be.
However, at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded in his ear:
“You actually care about them quite a bit, don’t you? Rest assured, the matters concerning them have been handed over to me.”
Colin looked in the direction of the voice and saw a black robe materializing in the middle of the train compartment, surrounded by rings of black thorns winding around it like vines, as if ornamental.
Then, from within the robe, the figure of a lady gradually became clear —
“Thorn Lady.”
Her face was still similar to “Raniweya” or “Akasha.”
Only, compared to before, her aura had changed significantly, no longer so dark and chilly.
“Is this your true form?” Colin inquired.
“Well, something like that.” The “Thorn Lady” did not provide a very clear explanation.
At that moment, after her appearance, she floated slowly to Colin’s side, glanced at the Containment Subject on the ground, and let out a slight “hmm,” seemingly criticizing Colin’s actions.
“Next, I will take them through maybe a dozen or several dozen stations, arriving at a safe world. After all, they are now my employees, or rather, believers, and I will protect them,” the “Thorn Lady” continued to explain.
“Several dozen stations?” Colin exclaimed, “Can they really endure that many?”
“What’s there to endure?”
The “Thorn Lady” gave him a look and went on, “Although it seems there might be some problems with the train’s trajectory, it’s not a big problem for me.
“Of course, there’s a condition: don’t sit with me for more than three stations.”
“Hm? Why?” Colin was puzzled.
The “Thorn Lady” didn’t respond immediately. Instead, she crossed her arms in front of her chest, as black thorns dug into her skin. Colin winced at the sight, but she seemed unfazed.
She then gave Colin an up and down glance, her expression indescribably peculiar:
“Before ‘The Night’ was around, I didn’t dare show up much. I hadn’t noticed that you’re only D Level! Of course, not that it’s particularly special or rare, but there are some people who are very strong at D Level.” Upon hearing this, Colin instinctively thought of a name— “The Light Chaser.”
At that moment, the “Thorn Lady’s” voice continued: “The key is, you’re a ‘Flamebearer’ Reservist, which is quite unusual. The protective measures for D Level aren’t enough to protect you…
It may be fine now, but if you stay for a couple more stations, you will find yourself outside ‘a wall.’ Then…
She “tsk-tsked” twice: “By that time, I guess I would have to jump off the train, otherwise, I’ll be beaten to death along with you by the enemies that come knocking. Everything chaotic and divine, Tomb Raiser is not just an empty name.”
As she spoke, the “Thorn Lady” also mimed a clapping gesture with her hands, indicating a dead end.
“Uh…” Colin responded awkwardly, without any retort.
The hatred towards “Flamebearers” he had not directly experienced, but he was aware of it.
“Red Moon” was despised because of its actions, not because people hated it…
But “Flame Bearers” were different; their enmity was based on all the immoral things they had done. Speaking strictly of enmity levels, they might even surpass “Red Moon” and the likes of “The Night,” arguably ranking first.
“Of course, don’t worry, I won’t be jumping off the train. I will certainly protect you, but it won’t change the outcome; at most, we’ll be beaten to death together…”
“Well, I have the highest level of corporate medical insurance, and in the end, nothing major would happen.”
“But you can’t say for sure…”
The “Thorn Lady” kept babbling, which was somewhat inconsistent with her initial “aloof” appearance and persona.
However, compared to this, Colin suddenly noticed a keyword in her speech:
“Medical insurance?”
The term seemed oddly absurd coming from a “God,” but he also wondered what kind of insurance gave the “Thorn Lady” such confidence in not fearing death.
“The source is multiple agreements and the association with Level ‘0’ entities — high-level insurance launched in a joint name by the three giants. As long as one isn’t taken away on the spot by a Level ‘0’ life, even if a Super First Class comes after me, I wouldn’t be scared. Just need to hold on a bit, and nothing major would happen. Luckily, I’m pretty resilient, haha.”
The “Thorn Lady,” seeing the desire on the face of this “Flamebearer” Reservist, was a bit smug:
“Don’t even think about it. There were only a hundred units, and we scrambled for them. Now they’re all gone, and they can’t be transferred either.”
“That’s a shame…” Colin shook his head.
If such a thing were available, he would try to buy one unless the price was exorbitant.
However, even though he didn’t get the insurance, one thing was clear…
The “Thorn Lady” must have an inherently cheerful personality, given to chatter, which probably doesn’t have much to do with “Red Moon.”
“Speaking of which, what exactly is the situation with the three giants? For instance, what are their names?”

chapters.title: Chapter 676 - 676 498 All Divine Enemies_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 676: Chapter 498 All “Divine” Enemies!_3 Chapter 676: Chapter 498 All “Divine” Enemies!_3 Colin, seizing the rare opportunity to talk to someone in the know, decided to extract as much information as possible and continued with his questions.
The train is currently en route to the ninth station; the journey might take a long or short time. If you’re curious about something, now is the best time to ask!
“Huh?”
“Thorn Lady” cocked her head at him, her delicate features seemingly veiled in mystery, with an indescribable look of surprise,
“Though it seems the company has indeed undergone some changes, do young people these days not even know about those three anymore?”
Colin shook his head—he had no idea.
Those on Earth didn’t have any clues, and he hadn’t heard anyone outside Earth mention their specific names either.
“Heh, alright, since I’m feeling generous, I’ll enlighten you with some knowledge. The three giants of the ‘Bonfire Camp’ are, they are…”
“Thorn Lady’s” eyebrows arched, and her expression grew serious, “Hmm, who are they again?”
“‘Light,’ ‘Primordial Fire’?” Colin helpfully suggested.
“Hiss… seems right, but also not quite…” “Thorn Lady” didn’t give a definitive answer. She just tilted her head dramatically, extending her pale hand to scratch at the thorn crown adorning her head.
Seeing this, Colin couldn’t help but snark inwardly. This was even worse than him—he at least knew that “Light” or someone deeply connected to “Light” was one of the leaders…
Another one could be among the “Flame Bearers,” but that wasn’t clear.
These two had some clues.
However, there was a third person with no leads at all; he didn’t even know where to start guessing who they were.
Colin’s main curiosity lay with this individual.
“Oh, oh, oh, it seems like some mysterious force has interfered with my cognition. Forgotten, well, it’s not that important. Since I can’t remember, let’s not waste time. You know, knowing too much isn’t always a good thing, ignorance is bliss, hehe.”
“Thorn Lady,” not seeming embarrassed at all, gave a small laugh, ready to let the matter rest.
Colin shook his head and didn’t persist. It seemed there were certain taboos regarding those three in this era—it was impossible to even discuss them.
But “Thorn Lady” clearly knew more than just that…
He thought about it and, with the attitude of not letting a chance for free knowledge slip away, decided to keep extracting some more information.
Like the senior management structure of the company, various protocols, and things related to Rosen or other “Flame Bearers,”…
Or anything regarding the Mutated World to satisfy his curiosity would do.
Yet at that moment, as the train had begun to pick up speed, an earth-shattering roar echoed from outside, vibrating enough to disperse some of the mist clinging to the exterior of the carriage, bringing the view outside back into focus.
Outside was no longer the Mutated World, but the majestic outline of a celestial body…
Around this giant celestial body, wrapped countlessly huge “Black Thorns.”
The source of the roar seemed to be those overwhelming thorns…
“This…”
“It’s nothing, just my body’s instinctive shriek, a consequence of bearing ‘The Night’s’ fate. But it’s not a big issue, lost coordinates, it’s just furious impotence. In a while, I’ll be able to sever all these connections.”
“Thorn Lady” waved her hand and quickly spoke, unconcerned, yet Colin suddenly felt that her words lacked the previous lightness and seemed to suppress an indescribable, profound pain.
However, on the surface, “Thorn Lady” did not show any of this.
“The matters here have come to a conclusion. First, I’ll send this group away and take the opportunity to get some fresh air,” she said.
Then, silence settled in for a moment.
“Thorn Lady” stood by the window, staring at the planet, her eyes flickering with an undefinable emotion.
Sadness seemed to be spreading…
Colin contemplated whether he should step forward to offer some words of comfort but then he seemed to hear the “Administrator” murmuring to herself,
“My precious number…”
“My ‘4444444’ premium account has just been ruined by ‘Red Moon’ and ‘The Night’ together…”
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 677 - 677 499 The hidden secrets of company
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 677: Chapter 499 The hidden secrets of company executives._1 Chapter 677: Chapter 499 The hidden secrets of company executives._1 “Whoo~whoo~whoo~”
The dilapidated ancient train emitted a series of shrill whistle sounds.
The gray fog at this moment intensified once more…
The outside scenery continued to be obscured by the increasingly thick gray fog.
“Hmm, luckily I still have a few fancy numbers, or else I’d be at a huge loss, and I wouldn’t have the face to meet people anymore…”
“Thorn Lady” muttered softly with a look of regret in her eyes, leaving Colin with a headache.
‘Ah, what a waste of my emotions…’
Colin somewhat speechless, had thought it was some kind of melancholic feelings, but it turned out to be just this.
It was just a matter of a few account numbers, after all, what’s there to be ashamed of.
But speaking of which…
His gaze shifted to the outside world wrapped in thorns, gradually obscured by the gray fog, and he felt a chill thinking that according to “Thorn Lady”, this was the actual display of her body’s power…
He didn’t feel any pressure when facing the “split consciousness”, but catching a glimpse of her true form, that feeling of upper-level oppression was truly overwhelming.
Even Colin dared not look too closely…
‘So this is the true strength of a First Level Containment Subject, capable of affecting the entire world, and could easily destroy a celestial body if left unchecked…’
Colin reflected inwardly, recalling the brief description he had about First Level Containment Subjects.And at that moment, as the gray fog became completely dense and nothing could be seen outside the window, “Thorn Lady” withdrew her gaze and gave Colin a once over:
“Your account isn’t too bad, do you want to… Ah, never mind, you’ve tied it down too securely, and besides, even if it weren’t tied down, it’s a bit prickly to the touch, too many things are involved, and it might not withstand it if it were in my hands…”
Hearing this, Colin wasn’t sure how to respond.
But looking at it this way, “Thorn Lady” seemed to have her little quirks.
Like collecting “fancy number” accounts, it’s just not clear how she transfers them.
“Right, you mentioned before that these ‘outsiders’ were confined here because of some special period. What happened during that period…?”
Colin naturally brought up a topic he was interested in.
From what can be seen, all disasters seem to stem from a particular period, during which nearly all of the world’s civilizations regressed, and historical discontinuities occurred.
The Bonfire Company’s main body disappeared at that moment too.
And as an Administrator, “Thorn Lady” having lived so long, even if she knew little, should know something.
“Thorn Lady” thought for a moment, then retreated to sit on a taller chair, stretching her fair legs out from under her black thorny robe and swinging them as she said:
“This thing, I’m not very sure about, but I remember it was maybe some hundred years back, the whole universe was obscured by a grand event. During that period, all space travel was directly interrupted, the worlds that had been connected were forcibly isolated, and all kinds of chaotic events impacted various places, causing severe distortions…
“Like here, with me around, it was okay, but some places, I went out to investigate midway, and they were directly extinct, along with the destruction or mutation of their celestial bodies.
“As for those people, just before the disaster erupted, I happened to have received some task, and along the way moving this group of refugees from other star systems, I bumped into this storm and had no choice but to bring them back to my own world to protect them…
“This continued for sixty or seventy years, a hundred years or perhaps even longer. Such a massive scale of influence only gradually faded away.
“Then afterwards, I made contact with the outside world through some means, and that’s when I learned that quite a lot had happened; the company seemed to be on the brink of collapse…
“But at that time, I didn’t have the energy to investigate too much, so I went into a deep sleep.”
She didn’t hide anything and simply told Colin what she knew.
Several decades? It lasted that long… Colin was startled, having thought it was just a momentary event.
Unfortunately, from “Thorn Lady’s” words, it seemed she could only catch a glimpse of the effects and tried to make external contacts, but couldn’t see the root cause or know the result.
Probably the only ones who knew the situation were some high-ranking “Firebearers.”
But speaking of which, there seemed to be some keywords in what “Thorn Lady” said…
“‘Refugees’?”
“Yeah, I heard they were transferred from the ‘World Code’ ahead, but I’m not very clear about the specifics, as some key information seemed to be highly confidential, and I couldn’t access it.”
Ah, World Code…
Colin’s expression suddenly became strange; could it be the part of the people Rosen transferred after blowing up the planet?
“Why, you seem to know something?” “Thorn Lady” asked curiously.
“I might know a little bit…” Colin thought for a moment and then gave a brief account of his memories about Rosen.
“Hmm, it should be him, but Rosen, the number one lackey under one of the company’s big shots, I didn’t have much contact with him, and my memories are not very clear. I just heard that he seemed to be one of the leaders of the ‘Conservative Faction’ among the Firebearers…”
“Thorn Lady” gave a simple assessment.
As for what Colin mentioned about Rosen going to retrieve something, “Thorn Lady” showed no reaction, whether she was unaware or deliberately avoiding the topic.
The number one lackey under a big shot… Colin thought for a moment, guessing she was probably talking about “Boss Huang He”.
It was just a question whether Rosen’s spirit in heaven would hear this assessment and turn her into a lump of energy carbon for fuel.
“But talking about this gets me irritated, I had to clean up the mess that guy made, and his group of ‘refugees’, seriously… After I bore the brunt of that chaotic influence, I was too tired and just squeezed my eyes shut for a bit, going into a slumber…”

chapters.title: Chapter 678 - 678 499 The secret of the companys senior
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 678: Chapter 499 The secret of the company’s senior management._2 Chapter 678: Chapter 499 The secret of the company’s senior management._2 “So they stabbed me in the back big time, as if there was some rumor that I had abandoned them. Then out of nowhere, they took out a containment subject associated with ‘Night’ that had sealed a part of me and started worshiping it…”
“Can you imagine how I felt when I first woke up, not having a clue, almost having my home stolen by ‘Night’?”
The “Lady of Thorns” said, somewhat huffily.
The history of the “Night” believers turned out to be like this… Colin’s mouth was agape, at a loss for words for a moment.
“So… what’s with that mutated world? It’s the world you’re in charge of, why has it become like that?”
Given the “Lady of Thorns'” situation, since she was capable of preserving the “refugees,” it should be impossible for her to allow her world to fall into such a state, right?
“Ah, that… Don’t worry, it’s nothing; they will wake up eventually, just wait until I fix some things… erm, as long as I am here, they will wake up one day.”
On this matter, the “Lady of Thorns” did not elaborate further.
Colin felt that her so-called “breath of fresh air” might also have something to do with those mutated subjects.
However, since she didn’t want to discuss it further, Colin did not pry.
At this very moment, looking at the “Lady of Thorns,” who seemed like a talkative older sister next door, he felt as if he had forgotten to mention something, but couldn’t quite remember what it was…
After pondering carefully, just as an idea began to form, all of a sudden he saw a line of text appear before him.
[This section of the train will soon merge onto a special track, some turbulence is expected, please understand…]
Following this announcement,
the entire carriage shook violently, much like tossing vegetables in a frying pan.
During this process, the carriage began to self-repair, all the damaged areas, under the irrigation of some special secret force, gradually became as good as new…
The previously… Middle Eastern battle-damaged style of the train, suddenly seemed fresh from the factory.
