Having landed at the frontline base and prepared to collect further intelligence, Colin had just arrived when he heard coughs and gasps coming from all around him.
Even though the “Haze Angel” wasn’t primarily covering this area, but merely slightly affecting it, it still made them extremely uncomfortable.
‘This “Haze Angel” seems to be indiscriminate in its effects, somewhat lacking in distinguishing between friend and foe.’
Colin looked at the crowd and couldn’t help but think.
At this moment, footsteps approached from one side. Colin looked away and followed the sound to see several powerful people approaching.
The leader among them, after arriving, noticed Colin’s previous gaze and voluntarily explained,
“They have been here for several days, they should be rotated out for a fresh group soon.”
“Hmm…”
Colin nodded, noncommittal, and the man continued, “I hear you’ve brought a method to rescue this land?”
“I have some confidence, but I’m not very sure. Let’s try first. I’ve come to ask for specific information about that area, about Containment Subjects and the like.” Colin pointed to the area further away where the smog was even thicker.
“Hmm, please present your documents…”
Hearing the request, Xu Duojin stepped forward and handed over a set of identification proof he had just received.
“Cough, cough, okay… no problem.”
The newcomer glanced at it and coughed twice, then waved to someone, who promptly brought over a briefcase of documents.
“These two are your passage documents; they have protective charms that can reduce the ‘Haze Angel’s’ impact on you, and ensure you don’t get lost in the smog and such. Make sure not to damage them, cough, cough, as that will render them ineffective.”
“Cough, if you accidentally damage them, just wait in place, and we will send someone to you.”
“Secondly, this one contains specific details about Mist City, of course, it also includes other crisis points. However, if you want the latest news from places outside Mist City, you might need to go to the other nearby outposts to get it… cough, cough, cough…”
“Alright.”
Colin nodded and let the Little Maid proceed with the reading.
Meanwhile, he did not linger any longer and after a brief exchange, he began making his way towards the city.
Ten minutes later, the smog in the air became denser.
Even as Colin walked through the gray scene, he inexplicably felt discomfort in his nasal passages and an itch in his throat…
“Even with a layer of ‘Bonfire’ protection and the passage documents’ charms, it’s still like this. The ‘Haze Angel’s’ negative effects are quite alarming…”
Colin enhanced the protective flames a bit before he felt the negative effects disappear.
However, the negative effects were gone, but the bright flames attracted the attention of some other abnormalities.
“Cough, cough, cough… cough, cough, cough…”
“Please help us, cough, please…”
“Passerby with a kind heart, I beg you, don’t abandon us again, cough, cough, cough…”
Layers of whispers made it difficult not to halt in one’s footsteps. Colin and Xu Duojin turned to look and saw a crowd of seemingly ordinary people emerge from the veil of thick smog, coughing and calling for help as they quickly closed in on them.
Not only that, but from various other directions, strange things approached…
From the sky, the ground, underwater, both living beings and inanimated objects.
“Not particularly strong, but quite a variety.”
Colin murmured casually, not stopping but continuing to move forward.
In the process, some of the abnormalities, after getting within a certain distance and sensing the light, retreated for an unknown reason, while others continued to advance…
For example, the group of “people” who first called for rescue.
Their pleas seemed to induce an indescribable, altruistic desire to help in one’s heart, causing a psychological shift…
Colin, too, had his desire to help others stirred, he lifted his hand benevolently and casually flicked it.
Dozens of firefly-like lights flew out…
Then, shortly after, the pleas for help ceased, replaced with screams of despair.
Under the blaze, these dozens of humanoid figures burst and swelled, revealing their true form, a kind of robust, blood-red, humanoid crawling creature similar to The Eater…
“‘Beast of Thousand Roars,’ hunting prey through disguises of voice, flesh, and mental lures, strength below Fifth Level; if in large numbers, might give birth to a ‘King,’ potentially reaching Fourth Level…” The Little Maid’s voice rang in Colin’s ears, providing an introduction.
“Oh, even a ‘King’ only reaches Fifth or Fourth Level, no wonder they died with just a touch. I hope they get the chance to be human in their next life.” Colin retracted his overwhelming kindness.
And while he dealt with these abnormalities, he tried as much as possible not to affect the layer of smog or use the power of “Bonfire” excessively…
After all, using “Bonfire” too forcefully could likely have a significant impact on the “Haze Angel.”
That would probably disrupt the balance here.
“Speaking of which, I still need some firewood…”
Colin’s plan was to stack firewood at the outskirts of Mist City, preparing for ignition, then continue to the next spot; after arranging everything, he would light them all at once, forming a sort of encirclement.
Then he would throw out the “Token”…
This way, except for the intense pressure of lighting the fires at the end, they wouldn’t prematurely alert the enemy.
After pondering, Colin took out a card that he hadn’t used for a long time—

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - 717 517 Containment Subjects of the World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 717: Chapter 517 “Containment Subjects of the World, Unite!”_2 Chapter 717: Chapter 517 “Containment Subjects of the World, Unite!”_2 With the flesh and corpses of these abnormal creatures as materials…
“┗|｀O′|┛ Awoo~~”
Amidst a tremendous roar, a dual-headed “Smiling Mountain of Corpses” made its entrance, taking on the roles of gathering firewood and providing transportation.
Seeing Colin use this prop as a means of transportation, Xu Duojin’s face twitched, feeling it was somewhat wasteful, but he didn’t say anything; instead, he leapt onto the top of Corpse Mountain, watching one flesh ball drag itself forward, while the other picked up the charcoal that Colin had made along the way.
“The containment subjects scattered outside don’t seem very strong.”
Colin muttered, feeling that the pile of firewood should include at least one or two Third-Level containment subjects, right?
Especially in this most dangerous area, it seemed necessary to have a Level 2 Containment Subject as a base.
Otherwise, the flame might not burn strongly enough later on…
But it wasn’t a big issue; there were flammable materials everywhere here. As long as he could find a way, without destroying the “Haze Angel,” hunting down an appropriate Level 2 Containment Subject would suffice…
“I hope we can find a suitable one later.”
Colin pondered for a moment, then continued standing atop Corpse Mountain, with his hands behind his back, overlooking the path ahead, letting it move forward, planning to go to Mist City to see if he could capture a flammable material.
It was during this advance that he noticed some interesting things…
Among the anomalies that could be seen surrounded by flames, many would flee on sight of him, and these fleeing anomalies or aberrant life forms seemed to carry traces of the company’s essence to a greater or lesser extent.
And those with the company’s essence were usually “larger individuals,” at least on the Fifth Level standard.
Below the Fifth Level were all sorts of anomalies that had popped up from who knows where…
“The company had quite a few anomalies escape into this pile back in the day.”
Colin whispered to himself and then, after about half an hour, finally arrived at the outermost area of Mist City, wrapped tightly by the “Haze Angel.”
This wasn’t a layered wrapping, but starting right in front of him, the concentration of haze increased, becoming so dense he couldn’t even see his hand in front of him. Direct Gaze at the area caused stinging eyes, itchy throat, chest tightness, and difficulty breathing.
“Kukuku…”
The Corpse Mountain beneath him couldn’t help but cough at the rich haze, but it clutched its enormous hands over its mouth, trying to suppress the cough as much as possible, so as not to cause discomfort for the summoner riding on it.
And around, he could clearly see the murky particles within the fog, as countless tormented figures stretched out their hands.
One by one, blurry arms seemed to want to grab onto Corpse Mountain…
“Conceptually vague objects really have some indescribable tricks up their sleeves.”
Colin rubbed his itchy throat with his hand and could feel the strong suppressive effect the “Haze Angel” had on various things, especially biological entities.
But… when it was strong, it wasn’t very lethal.
Moreover, the coughing of Corpse Mountain beneath him seemed to possess some sort of infectiousness, which made him feel discomfort again.
Flames spread on Colin, providing protection to Corpse Mountain as well.
So it wouldn’t keep coughing. Infecting him…
“This ‘Haze Angel’ was supposedly born in relation to some unique containment subjects, and it seems to have fused with certain historical fragments, becoming what it is now…” Xu Duojin spoke some information about the “Haze Angel.”
Now the “Haze Angel” enfolds Mist City; it’s like yesterday has come back to life…
Colin nodded without speaking, the flames in his eyes condensing as he peered through the terrifying haze into the depths, gaining from his conscious feedback a series of very strange and twisted scenes.
…
An opulent, vintage British Palace Carriage drove on the highway, rolling over the half-wrapped mummy of a pharaoh on the roadside, and the figure driving the carriage appeared to be a Terracotta Warrior Statue holding a long spear.
Behind a gate of unknown origin, adorned with gems and exhibiting an ancient European style, the Golden Gate housed inhuman sacrilegious creatures peering out constantly, as shadowy beings emerged from it, only to be cleansed by whispers shortly after emerging…
Because coincidentally, at the gate’s exterior were sets of Buddha Bodhi Sculptures muttering sutras.
They were surrounded by a dazzling Buddhist light, with mystical texts orbiting them…
“Bang” went a sound.
A Statue of the Saintess Mary, holding a baby in her arms, with tears of blood on her compassionate face, lifted the stone infant in her hands, smashed a bronze Buddha, and carried the stone baby toward the next “Heretic Believer.”
Not far in the dense fog, a grayish-white statue, continuously bleeding from under its right rib, was dragging a huge Cross step by step towards a group of rigid, twisting human wax figures, making sounds of coughing, heavy footsteps, and the dragging of the Cross in the haze…
In the quiet half-body statue chamber, waves of strange whispers could be heard, as unknown entities conversed about something…
The petrified remains of various Ancient Dinosaur Skeletons, now seemingly possessed by something, clambered haphazardly through the city, clashing with buses with six arms and police sirens with legs emitting piercing sounds…
Slender, hair-like mycelium was inch by inch extending its territory, spewing bizarre spores…
In the sky, there seemed to be lively auroras encircling a spinning Celestial Illusion…
Countless anomalies were active within, the entirety of Mist City was only chaos, disorder, uncontrolled.
…
“Hiss, quite… lively here.”
After watching for a few minutes, Colin retracted his gaze, feeling a mental shock composed of indescribable chaos and distortion.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - 718 517 Containment Subjects of the World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 718: Chapter 517 “Containment Subjects of the World, Unite!”_3 Chapter 718: Chapter 517 “Containment Subjects of the World, Unite!”_3 This kind of charge would cause an ordinary person’s body to collapse on the cellular level and die instantly, regardless of their willpower.
Meanwhile, seeing that Colin had withdrawn his gaze, Xu Duojin changed into a pair of stronger sunglasses and asked:
“How does it feel inside?”
Regardless of what Colin thought, Xu Duojin was certainly terrified.
“The situation?” Colin pursed his lips slightly, his hand unconsciously covering his stomach.
To be honest…
He was starting to feel a bit hungry.
The chaotic and disordered spiritual fluctuations awakened the deep-seated desire to feed within him.
At first, it did seem a bit like a chaotic dance of demons, but after looking at it for a while, they all started to look delicious.
‘Eating them must feel incredible…’
‘No, no, what am I thinking about eating.’
Colin took a couple of deep breaths to suppress the strong desire to go in and have a feast.
Once the feeding desire was suppressed, a feeling of wanting to charge in and set everything ablaze surfaced.
‘Damn, alternating, huh…’
Colin muttered to himself and then said, “We should just wait here for a bit and see if a suitable Level 2 Containment Subject passes by…”
“Passing by?”
Xu Duojin paused for a moment, then quickly realized Colin’s plan, “Do you need my help to find it?”
As a high-ranking member of “Fate Propeller,” if he were to use his ability, he could locate a Level 2 Containment Subject in the next second.
“No need, there are some really dangerous things inside, better not look at it randomly.”
Colin waved his hand. Since arriving here, he was sure that there was at least one First Level Containment Subject present.
And it was very likely that it had escaped from the company.
But its presence was so faint that he couldn’t pinpoint its exact location, though he could at most confirm that it was still under control…
Of course, Colin didn’t want to know the exact location. For him, as long as he could encircle the island roughly, light the “Bonfire,” and throw in Rosen’s Copy, all Containment Subjects would have to shut up.
Having made the decision, the two began to wait as if they were fishing.
“The Level 2 Containment Subject you mentioned, are you sure you can handle it without causing a big mess…?” Xu Duojin asked curiously.
For the authorities, a Level 2 Containment Subject was already an exceptionally terrifying entity.
The anomalous beings that had caused the most casualties among high-level personnel were not the planet-destroying First Level Containment Subjects but the much weaker Level 2 ones.
There aren’t many people in the world who can claim to deal with them reliably…
“Don’t worry, no problem.”
Colin indicated there would be no problem and continued to spy on the abnormal creatures passing by his side in Mist City.
In fact, he had already spotted several Level 2 Containment Subjects, like the Celestial Illusion hanging mid-air, which was roughly the strength of a Level 2 Containment Subject…
But its existence was of a special form, seemingly incorporeal and too massive, making it difficult to handle.
For Colin, the ideal would be to find something not too large, solid…
About an hour passed, and they were still waiting silently.
No target appeared, but they killed a lot of small anomalies, creating a pile of charred kindling that formed a small hill not far away.
“Resources are scarce…”
Colin sighed. Although the place was full of anomalies, he felt like there wasn’t enough kindling.
To be precise, it was difficult to find kindling that met his requirements…
He could find the target quickly using other methods, like turning the site into a giant fireball. In that instant, all the higher-tier anomalies on the island would turn their gaze here.
Colin was certain that his target would likely be among them.
But at the same time, he would be targeted by a large number of anomalies, and the anomalous beings that were fighting each other might well turn their combined attention to the “Bonfire” at the next moment, possibly shouting a slogan like “All Containment Subjects of the world unite!”
The situation would likely take on a different dynamic entirely.
However, just as Colin was considering whether to sacrifice Xu Duojin…
Within Mist City, a woman caught Colin’s attention — she wore an ancient half-faced Golden Mask, a snow-white long dress, and carried a big axe, cutting her way through the crowd.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - 719 518 Mirror London_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 719: Chapter 518 “Mirror London”_1 Chapter 719: Chapter 518 “Mirror London”_1 “This area has fallen, it’s dangerous! Please evacuate immediately…”
“This area has fallen, it’s dangerous, please immediately…”
“This area…”
There seemed to be a broadcasting horn on the woman clad in white, wielding a large ax, as she kept repeating this message loudly.
And as she went along, she madly attacked everything abnormal she could.
“A Level Seven Personnel’s… corpse.”
Colin glanced over, noting the woman’s strength wasn’t great, but the device attached to her body was somewhat interesting.
Its intensity was sufficient to meet Colin’s requirements…
“Grace… an official who served the ‘opera house’ before, perished four months ago during the evacuation of civilians, after an attack by an abnormal entity, and it has been confirmed she was martyred, but her body wasn’t successfully recovered. Some have encountered her being controlled by an abnormal entity, but due to the brief engagement and the urgent situation, it was not confirmed, and the official threat level was designated as a Level 4 Containment Subject…”
The Little Maid’s voice arose beside his ear.
“Level 4? That might be an underestimation. I guess she didn’t unleash full power, and the effect wasn’t as explosive, so the perceived threat was low…”
Colin saw the woman, now driven by an abnormal entity, moving like a phantom. Based on some inspiration from the “Flame Bearer” concerning kindling, he was almost certain this was the target he had been waiting for.
That is: a Level 2 Containment Subject’s combustion value.
To be more precise, it was the Golden Mask on her face, emanating a strong malice.
“After waiting so long, I’ve finally found one that’s usable.”
Colin didn’t hesitate for a moment and decisively took action, bending his knees slightly, pushing off the ground with force, and catapulting himself forth like a cannonball.
Xu Duojin, who was still sitting atop Corpse Mountain, immediately adjusted his glasses, preparing to watch how Colin would swiftly kill the Level 2 Containment Subject.
Although the forces of the two were unequal, he thought it an opportunity to learn something new.
At the very least, it would be quite enjoyable to watch as a bystander.
However, just as he assumed the posture of a spectator, he suddenly realized that the target had vanished…
The entity that Colin deemed a Level 2 Containment Subject and Colin himself had both disappeared.
Xu Duojin’s eyes widened in a hint of panic.
But at the same time, he faintly heard a phrase drifting through the haze.
“I request a fair and just duel with this special abnormal entity…”
“A duel? What’s that? Some kind of necessary statement for using a tool?” Xu Duojin, who was quite experienced, immediately guessed the reason Colin uttered those words.
Still, he couldn’t quite understand where the two had gone, feeling as if they were right there but also not there at all.
Moreover, the effects of the “Haze Angel” made it impossible to see anything…
The desire to watch the fight came to nothing.
Yet, with the “Fate Propeller’s” extremely strong supernatural premonitions, he could still vaguely sense some of Colin’s current situation, listening to what seemed like an ongoing battle… or perhaps a confrontation?
“I promise… this fight… won’t involve evasion… to be fair… the other party must also…”
“…commit to this battle, not using mental attacks… to be fair…”
“…not calling for help from any mighty beings… fair…”
The voices he heard were intermittent, all filled with the word “fair.”
For Xu Duojin, this bit of information was enough for him to roughly understand the situation and then his old face twitched, revealing an astonished expression:
“Damn it, is there such a shameless tool in this world?”
He couldn’t help but think what would happen if he were pulled into such a space and then subjected to a few “fairs”…
The outcome was as clear as if he’d thought with his feet, and it would probably be pretty grim.
The opponent might have some restrictions, and it wasn’t possible to ban all his abilities without conditions, but just a touch on the key elements, like prohibiting evasion…
“Fate Propeller,” which excels in guerrilla warfare, would probably get pummeled pretty badly.
And it was when Xu Duojin was making his associations that Colin directly commenced battle.
Waves upon waves of flames swept the surroundings like a tsunami, quickly raising the temperature and creating territory advantageous to himself.
Next, from within the flames, Wildfire-enhanced Colin extended a colossal Flame Hand toward the abnormal entity, delivering a direct and violent attack.
The woman with the half-Golden Mask raised her large ax and swung it with force against the gigantic Flame Hand, splitting a finger.
A strange power spread through the ax…
She was ready to continue her onslaught and split the whole Bonfire Hand completely.
“Focusing on my Wildfire Hand instead of me, this abnormal entity is a bit too green…”
A thought flashed by, and Colin firmly gripped the Revolver with his right hand, igniting the Bonfire power; then with a blink of his left eye, he initiated “Favor of the Flame Bearer.”
In an instant, the woman who just leaped up ignited violently, unexpectedly burning down to just “a thread of blood.”
From the woman’s mask, jet-black, worm-like tendrils snaked out, infiltrating her facial features, seemingly trying to fully dominate the corpse to oppose Colin.
But the next second, Colin casually flicked his hand, sending out Bone Spur flying, piercing the woman’s chest…
The charred body swelled up, bloating, and black pus flowed out from the cracked burns all over her skin…
This body was completely wrecked.
The Golden Mask’s tendril-like limbs withdrew.
In a flash, Colin appeared before it, turning the Revolver into a pair of long tongs, grabbed the mask with it, and for the brave official who tried to save civilians from abroad, he organized a brief cremation.

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - 720 518 Mirror London_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 720: Chapter 518 “Mirror London”_2 Chapter 720: Chapter 518 “Mirror London”_2 “Huff, huff, huff~”
The flame madly poured into the Golden Mask, dissolving the nearly vanished seal on top.
“There’s a special space inside… this thing is quite big as well.”
Colin sensed the mask as he increased the flame.
As the flame scorched, the special space began to collapse, and things like the Black Iron Threadworm were forced out of the Golden Mask, only to be instantly roasted into charcoal containing terrifying energy by the flames…
Despite the strange, parasitic creatures seemingly accustomed to struggling, at this stage, a turnaround was no longer possible.
Around Colin, there was nothing that could serve as a host for them…
About half an hour later, there were roughly a hundred cubic lumps of High-Efficiency Energy Carbon in front of Colin, resembling sifted powder…
And with their complete death, the “Colosseum” effect was finally lifted.
“Bang, bang, bang…”
The Bicephalous Cobblestone came from afar, dragging along the carbon kindling collected along the way, and began to arrange the bonfire stack under the guidance of Colin’s thoughts.
“Incredible… Is it resolved just like that?”
Xu Duojin stood on the side, looking at the large clump of pitch-black material, somewhat in disbelief.
But from the faint aura emanating from it, it was indeed the remains of a genuine Level 2 Containment Subject.
In the end, before it could even display its abilities, it turned into a lump of carbon in his hands.
“Yeah, it didn’t take many minutes to kill, but it took me quite some time to roast it into carbon,” Colin said afterwards, as if he had only killed a chicken, leaving Xu Duojin shaking his head, not knowing what to say.
Not minding what he was thinking, Colin simply arranged the kindling and continued on his journey to hunt down some Level 3 or Level 4 Containment Subjects…
He aimed to roughly encircle Mist City with the kindling fires.
As for how to arrange these…
Colin hadn’t studied it, but after becoming a “Flamebearer” Reservist, some things came naturally.
“After you arrange them, aren’t you worried about those kindlings being destroyed if you just leave them there?” Xu Duojin asked.
“It’s possible…”
Colin did not deny it but continued, “However, the likelihood is not very high. First, the influence of the ‘Haze Angels’ is still quite strong; we put it outside, and those creatures can’t see it.
“Second, inside the abnormalities, those that are intelligent are generally quite strong. High levels not to mention, the strength of an Eighth Level official is required, but these are mostly contained within seals…
“And the lower-level abnormalities naturally repel the ‘Bonfire’ aura and won’t come close, so the likelihood is not high…”
Of course, the safest approach would be to take the kindling along and only arrange it after collecting enough materials in the end—that would be the most cautious method…
But the problem is, Colin didn’t have such a large independent spatial bag to carry that much kindling.
After hearing Colin’s response, Xu Duojin thought for a moment and said, “Do we need to find someone to watch over it? No, that won’t work. It would be fine at the base, but once you’re outside the base, people themselves will attract monsters, and that’s more likely to create chaos…”
Before he finished, he shook his head and dismissed his own suggestion.
“Yeah, so let’s leave it as it is for now; if there’s an issue, we’ll just hunt again,” Colin said, waving his hand and resuming his activity. It took him approximately six or seven hours to establish a total of twenty-nine bonfire piles around Mist City.
Besides the most important bonfire pile, the others were also stacked with Level 3 or a certain number of Level 4 and 5 materials…
After completing the task, he then headed towards the next dangerous restricted area.
The place wasn’t far from here, just under a hundred kilometers away.
But not long after starting his journey, Colin suddenly paused, noticing something amiss…
There was a perfectly intact city ahead?
Even more, it was filled with a large population…
Colin gestured with his hand for the “Mountain of Smiling Corpses” to stop moving, concentrated the flames in his eyes, and gazed into the fog-covered city at the figure of a white-collar man.
“Cough, cough, cough, this damn weather…”
The white-collar man coughed and cursed something as he entered an office building.
It looked like he was going to work…
No, he was indeed going to work! Because it wasn’t just him; many nearby shops were still operating normally.
Colin watched, unsure of what to say, but it seemed that due to proper protection, the city wasn’t haunted?
“How did they manage it? People outside are considering whether to sink the island, and yet there are still people up there who haven’t noticed anything,” Colin honestly felt shocked.
He knew that there were many survivors on the island who hadn’t been able to leave this country in time, but he had not expected that these survivors could still go to work as usual?
However, the next second, he suddenly noticed something didn’t add up—this city looked familiar…
“Isn’t this Mist City?! Have we fallen for some illusion?” Colin’s eyes widened. They had just come from there, how could they stumble upon another one?
“This city, it should be another of their large-scale special containment subjects… seems to be called ‘Mirror London’ or something like that. The confidentiality level is very high, it wasn’t widely disclosed. During the disaster, many people somehow were transferred inside…” Xu Duojin remarked after a few seconds.
Although he had never seen it himself, he vaguely knew some information.
Colin waited for him to continue, but Xu Duojin just gestured that there was no more to tell.
So you only know the name…
Colin fell silent, then looked towards the city again, noting many details, such as everything in this “Mist City” seemed to be the opposite of reality…

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - 721 518 Mirror London _3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 721: Chapter 518 “Mirror London” _3 Chapter 721: Chapter 518 “Mirror London” _3 It was indeed like a mirror, and it seemed that there was not just one Mist City within; there appeared to be an even vaster area further in the distance.
It was almost like an Inner World.
However, at the same time, Colin also noticed that the flames on his body could not penetrate it.
In his Flame Perception, he could sense that there was a strange yet sturdy barrier between the mirror image and reality…
He tried to ask the Little Maid, but the maid told him that the information provided from that side merely gave “Mirror London” a name, and at most, it contained a warning that no one should attempt to enter, or else they would face the consequences themselves.
“It seems we don’t really need to get involved here,”
Colin said casually, then looked at an area not far away that was enveloped in dense haze. The things inside “Mirror London” seemed to have attracted quite a number of abnormal beings, yet they could see it but not enter.
So they crowded around the edge of “Mirror London” and were then sealed by the “Haze Angels”…
At that moment, there was a disturbance in the fog.
Colin and Xu Duojin turned their heads at the same time, following the noise, and saw a squad led by Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel quickly approaching on a flying carpet.
“You all…”
Before the Red Head Level 8 could finish speaking, Xu Duojin handed over a document: “We are here specifically for the island incident. We hope you can provide some assistance.”
“Alright…” The Red Head Level 8 personnel glanced at the document, assured that it was in order and nodded with a numb expression.
However, in that moment, he cast a more respectful look at Xu Duojin’s slightly bald figure, suspecting some kind of misunderstanding.
Feeling the inexplicably increased respect, Xu Duojin’s expression turned slightly strange, wondering if the other party had misunderstood something.
But there was no time for further discussion. The emaciated figure in the style of ethnic robes, resembling an Ascetic Monk with a red scarf, led the two to a monitoring station not far from here and provided the corresponding intelligence.
It recorded what to pay attention to regarding the nearby “Sealed Area” and other anomalies…
Like last time, Colin didn’t stay long, but took Xu Duojin and headed straight for the forbidden zone.
This time, however, the Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel did not just sit by but organized a small team to follow them…
“Sorry, this place is very important; we can’t afford any mistakes, so the headquarters commanded us to follow. We hope to be of help to you,” said one of the accompanying personnel beside the Red-Scarf Level 8.
Xu Duojin frowned, but before he could speak, Colin waved his hand: “If they want to follow, let them.”
Although he knew they were more there to monitor…
Colin didn’t really care about that.
After the minor interruption, Colin stood atop the “Mountain of Smiling Corpses,” casually releasing sparks to deal with the anomalies attracted by the flames on his body, and quickly moved towards the target area…
The Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel trailing the two, upon seeing Colin’s carefree and easy handling of anomalies, had their expressionless faces grow even more silent.
The support from the rear had told him, an Eighth Level and a Ninth Level would be coming, and he should do his best to cooperate.
Subconsciously, he assumed that the balding, older-looking one was the Ninth Level Personnel, and the young-looking one was Eighth Level. He hadn’t expected…
It to be the other way around…
But it wasn’t a problem.
He withdrew the respect he had for the bald man and turned to give it to the one who appeared young but might actually be the oldest “young man.”
In the extraordinary world, everything was based on strength.
Of course, respect aside, the mission still had to be carried out.
.
.
.
PS: Update first, revise later

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - 722 519 Some Elites of the Human World._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 722: Chapter 519 Some Elites of the Human World._1 Chapter 722: Chapter 519 Some Elites of the Human World._1 The following operation proceeded as before; Colin waited on the outskirts of the blockade point for the right target to take action.
In comparison to Mist City, it took him less than three hours to collect the materials needed for the blockade.
The Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel led a squad and followed behind silently, watching the whole way, becoming increasingly reticent…
Along the way, Colin killed various anomalies, even the more powerful ones, with just a few bullets from his pistol or a single punch that resolved matters directly…
Seeing this, both he and his squad couldn’t help but feel as though the anomalies had become weaker.
Because everything seemed too easy to handle.
They felt as if they could do it too…
So, during that time, the Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel tried to attack a Third Level Anomaly Containment Subject—
And nearly got himself killed on the spot.
Had Colin not come over to help him, he would have likely solved the problem but at a substantial cost.
Afterward, more doubts surfaced in his mind…
Wasn’t this Ninth Level Personnel afraid of losing control? The Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel wondered.
He had never seen such a “belligerent” high-ranking personnel; after all, using their abilities could cost them their lives!
But at that moment, an idea sparked in his mind, and he vaguely realized something.
However, before he could think further, he suddenly heard Colin’s voice drifting from ahead:
“Overall, this place seems a bit complicated, but it doesn’t seem as dangerous as you guys described…”
Not only the Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel and his companions, but also Xu Duojin standing next to Colin flinched at these words, pursed their lips, unsure of what to say.
“Alright, let’s head to the next area.”
Colin turned the anomaly in his hand completely into char and tossed it ahead, then continued on with the next step.
By now, he had a certain understanding of the dangers of this country…
Setting aside those horrific contentious subjects that had a First Level Containment Subject aura but were not confirmed, other more powerful anomalies were largely sealed.
Especially, the Level 2 Containment Subjects that Colin was most concerned about were much more dispersed than he thought.
In these circumstances, he felt the area was not that dangerous, but not entirely safe either…
Regardless, after dealing with the outskirts of “Mirror London,” Colin continued without break towards the next key area…
He encountered many anomalies along the way, but most lacked the merit to block his path.
The scale of the containment anomalies in the other majority of areas was also much smaller than in Mist City, so everything was progressing steadily.
During this time, in some of the safer areas, Colin unexpectedly encountered many survivors who had not been transferred into “Mirror” timely; they were usually not clustered together.
Instead, there were a few dozen here, a few hundred there, with the largest group he encountered amounting to just over a thousand people…
Colin, acting according to mission orders, cleared the anomalies around them and then asked the group to follow him. Although some did not trust him, thinking it was a trap, most of them saw the flame he held in his hands and followed him sincerely.
As for those who refused to leave, Xu Duojin was responsible for dealing with them; “Fate Propeller” handling ordinary people seemed as easy as playing.
Additionally, the strong sense of warmth that came from “Bonfire” made the odds of them following reach one hundred percent.
The only thing that left Colin speechless was that many of the ordinary people following behind him thanked him, referring to him as a messenger sent by some omnipotent The Holy Father or something like that, like a Seraph…
Then they crafted a whole logic: The haze and anomalies were tests and now that the trials were over, the great father had sent a messenger to save them…
There were various other theories, but they were largely similar.
“All sent by someone or another to descend here…”
“Thank you, messenger dispatched by the great father, for granting me strength, so that I may walk untiringly amidst the disaster…”
Sincere prayers echoed from a distance.
‘That’s to be expected, after all, you’re able to keep walking because you’re burning my “Colorless Crystal”…’
Colin felt a bit heartache over his own consumption; it was his goodwill at work, yet the credit was going to someone else.
Of course, he didn’t oppose these people’s assertions.
After all, it facilitated his mission to bring more survivors together without making too many explanations…
Another interesting note was…
The “Mountain of Smiling Corpses” gained another layer of identity as a Holy Beast.
It seemed this entity might become a creature of mythology in the future…
Unaware of what Colin was thinking, the people following behind him looked fervently at his silhouette holding up a small “Little Sun” in his right hand, muttering indistinct scriptures, and walking along the path that the firelight had cleaved through the haze.
Xu Duojin glanced at this group of people.
Despite the lack of any “fate” guiding them besides the flames, they followed as if bewitched.
This effect was almost as good as his forced guidance.
Speaking of which, ordinary people under the “Haze Angel” seemed to be unaffected too greatly.”
Colin, perched on top of Corpse Mountain, lifted his right hand, skillfully crafting an image, somewhat surprised at the Haze Angel’s minimal impact on ordinary people.
Extraordinary Ones below Level 8 who entered here would last at most a week or half a month before a rotation was required.
Yet, these ordinary people seemed to have been here for over a year at most.
If it were the Extraordinary Ones, they probably would have coughed up their lungs by now.

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - 723 519 Some Elites of the Human World._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 723: Chapter 519 Some Elites of the Human World._2 Chapter 723: Chapter 519 Some Elites of the Human World._2 “Indeed, looking at this thing, it’s a tool specifically targeting Extraordinary Ones, or to be more precise, designed for anomalies…” Xu Duojin also nodded in agreement.
However, although the impact is lower, staying here continuously will definitely reduce one’s lifespan significantly.
It’s better to take them out if possible…
In the end, after several more hours passed, Colin led these survivors, numbering around twenty to thirty thousand, to make contact with the garrison team of this area.
It was still a Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel who handled the handover: “We will transfer them to ‘The Mirror’…”
“Not taking them out?” Colin was surprised.
“Can’t take them out… There are too many people.”
The Red Head Level 8 Personnel shook his head, honestly, he hadn’t expected the other party to withstand so many anomalies and rescue such a large group of people…
After a pause, he added, “And, generally, it’s also not easy to find places outside that can take them in…”
“Alright, how you arrange it is your business, I’m just responsible for bringing them here.”
While Colin was speaking, he looked up at a high-rise building not far away, where a man surrounded by a layer of strange flowing light stood on the roof. His skin was severely ulcerated, covered in various crystals that gave off mesmerizing colors.
Beyond that, various golden chains bound him, seemingly to slow the loss of his life somewhat.
Noticing Colin’s action, Xu Duojin followed his gaze, then whispered, “That’s the Ninth Level Personnel in charge of this whole area…”
‘So it is a Ninth Level Personnel…’
This was the first time Colin had seen a Ninth Level Extraordinary One other than Old Master Wu, so he couldn’t help but take another look.
He then realized…
‘The corruption is so thorough that not even the basic appearance can be maintained… Humanity is almost extinguished, he’s about to become nothing more than an empty shell of flesh…’
‘I heard that most Ninth Level Personnel seem to be in a similar state, tsk, seems like the power structure at the top of the official forces is a bit unstable…’Colin analyzed.
This condition was far worse than that of Old Master Wu. Colin figured that if the other party encountered a slightly stronger Level 2 Containment Subject, it would probably take about ten minutes before he would completely lose control and become one of the anomalies…
And there was basically no cure.
This level of corruption, deep into the bone marrow, was far deeper and more thorough than the “Beast Transformation Syndrome” and “Hunger” rooted in his own body.
Unless some extraordinarily powerful individual from a certain company could defy fate, Colin could pretty much be certain of his final outcome.
Of course, although his condition was worse than Old Master Wu…
But as long as there are no accidents, he’s likely to live a bit longer than Old Master Wu.
“Huff…” Taking a deep breath and shaking his head, Colin dismissed the roaming thoughts and continued with Xu Duojin to carry out the last jobs in the “Forbidden Zones.”
After his figure had disappeared, the Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel approached the Ninth Level Personnel.
“Why can this man use his powers almost without limit…” he couldn’t help but ask.
At this moment, the Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel couldn’t help but think of the name “Bonfire Company.” As someone well-acquainted with the higher echelons of the mysterious world, he had a certain understanding…
He knew that after joining, one would obtain something that could significantly lessen the negative effects of their powers.
But… he had never heard of power reaching this level.
“Do not seek to understand what you should not know…”
The man, whose skin was ulcerated and covered with many crystals, spoke without emotion in his voice, but upon hearing these words, the Red Head Level 8 Personnel didn’t speak again, knowing he had been sternly warned.
However, just as he was about to leave, he heard another message from the other party.
“When you rotate out this time, tell those blood drinkers that the arrangements for ‘The Blood Seed Project’ to continue infiltrating eastward can now be terminated…”
The Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel was stunned, not quite certain: “Give up?”
The pressure brought by that “young man” was that great?
“Yes, by suddenly sending this person here, they are probably dissatisfied with our actions over the years, so they sent someone to demonstrate their power as a warning. Clearly, that person’s successor has emerged, thus, stop doing unnecessary things…”
So that’s how it is… The Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel nodded, understanding the reason these two had come over.
Then he remembered some things about the “Bloodline Project”…
The “Bloodline Project” referred to the transformation of the national life form after the catastrophe erupted, trying to acquire the bloodlines, items, and other resources of the Extraordinary Ones from other countries and forces within this extremely chaotic short time, bringing them back to the mirror world to leave this plane with the national main body and look for a new home.
This plan wasn’t just executed by them; it was a joint effort by the human elite from many countries, including those from various Eastern nations.
Generally speaking, it was the plan of the “Spacecraft Faction.”
Of course, the reason they gave publicly was not this but something along the lines of joining forces with local powers to fight against the enemy and so forth…
Although uniting with the locals was part of the plan, it was merely a branch’s insurance measure.
At the heart of the plan, the core was still to take the elites and a portion of the common people from each nation away.
As thoughts flickered through his mind, a Red-Scarf Level 8 Personnel couldn’t help but say, “Facing the future, do we really have no chance at all?”
Ninth Level Personnel shook his head, uttering a murmuring sound, layered and echoing.
“The ‘Sage of Holy Words,’ ‘Star Master,’ and other great prophets have once again confirmed that the chances of staying here are either a return to the ‘Crimson Moon’ or destruction by some kind of disaster and chaos, or perishing in the blaze of glorious stars… Disasters are endless, impossible to deal with, and eventually, civilization will perish… To ensure the continuation of Earth’s civilizations, we must leave…”
“As for those who want to stay, they and those heretics, whether they are ‘The Great Wall,’ ‘The Defenders,’ or whatever ‘Golden Dawn’ and the like, want to persist, let them persist…”
“We will only take the resources we need to take, and we won’t completely cut off their options.”
“However, although failure is almost inevitable, if they indeed succeed, it also means that we still have the opportunity to come back, to return in the guise of saviors, and the world will still be dominated by the elite of humanity, so there will be no loss…”
…
Far away, Colin was unaware that his arrival had triggered an unexpected alert; at this moment, he was grilling a freshly-killed abnormality into charcoal.
However, at this moment, Xu Duojin suddenly spoke:
“I always feel like ‘destiny’ seems to have suddenly changed a bit…”
“What do you mean?”
Colin raised an eyebrow; he hated these inexplicable and elusive things the most.
“I don’t know; it feels vast and complicated, I can only vaguely sense it, maybe it’s a change for the better? Not very sure, it’s a bit beyond my ability, wait for me to go back and ask Mr. Wu…”
“Alright then.” Colin nodded and didn’t press on.
For him, the current mission was what mattered…
“It should take no more than twelve hours, and then everything will be resolved.”
Colin looked up at the world enveloped in a dense haze and continued with determination.
About ten hours later, slightly ahead of schedule, all arrangements were finally in place; Colin returned to the starting point, Mist City.
“I’m exhausted.”
Colin exhaled, sensing all the arrangements he had made, and the “residual heat” of the charcoal he had burned was still present. With the addition of some Flame Golden Marks, he could ignite it remotely.
“Should we give a heads up to the official personnel?” Xu Duojin asked.
“No need, my flames won’t reach them; I can control that. But instead of them, I suggest you not to stay too close to me later.”
“Why?” Xu Duojin asked subconsciously.
“When the flames start burning later, there will definitely be a backlash. I might be fine, but you… It’s hard to say for you…”
Colin glanced at him: “I’m giving you thirty minutes, start running now.”
Hearing his words, Xu Duojin didn’t hesitate, taking off in a certain direction without looking back, a strong premonition of crisis telling him that a deadly battle would indeed erupt for him soon—
The wind is tight, yelling!
.
.
.
One more chapter to go, coming soon

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - 724 I love you
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 724: I love you Chapter 724: I love you “I should start getting prepared as well,”
Mr. Colin pursed his lips, knowing that controlling such a massive scale of flames was not something that could be achieved in a normal state.
He needed every buff he could get, whether it was Item Liberation or other enhancements.
The time it took to prepare was about the same as Xu Duojin’s time to escape…
After thirty minutes of continuous effort, Mr. Colin’s aura had reached its peak, the searing flames like a little sun amidst the mist.
With a “snap”,
Mr. Colin snapped his fingers.
The next second, in the dim nation of islands, torrents of scorching flames rose, with even the smallest bonfire reaching over a kilometer in height.
Connected with these flames, Mr. Colin had a macroscopic view as if the entire island lay beneath his gaze.
Then, before the anomalies had a chance to retaliate, he didn’t hesitate to throw the “token” directly into the massive bonfire outside Mist City, which seemed to burn through the sky…
“Hmm…”
It was the moment the “token” left his hands that Mr. Colin felt a piercing pain in his brain, under assault by a massive psychic attack.
But these attacks were not fatal to him…
And most importantly, the “token” fell unaffected into the largest bonfire.
Then, all the bonfires erupted violently, connecting to one another, forming an immense sea of fire!
Over fifty percent of the island was engulfed by the light of the flames…
Even from space, it was likely visible!
Lighting up a country, this was indeed the largest flame Mr. Colin had ever set ablaze in his lifetime, and it was unmatched!
“Ssss…”
Meanwhile, the people outside the island, bathed in the glow of the fire and shocked by the massive blaze, heard the countless wails of strange creatures and couldn’t help but shiver.
However, within seconds, they quickly realized…
Inside the area covered by the flames, everything seemed to be slowly disappearing, obscured by a layer of smog that was different from the haze, then detaching from reality, drawn into an unknown dimension.
“The ‘Haze Angel’, damn! Don’t burn the ‘Haze Angel’ too…” someone called out belatedly.
Suddenly, a group of people became nervous as they realized something.
And it was at that moment, Mr. Colin ran into trouble. He saw all the haze in the flames reversing, gathering in front of him to form a vague childlike figure with wings of mist on its back.
Above the childlike figure’s head, a halo ceaselessly churned out stinging, choking haze…
This entity, upon appearing, reached out its hands like a child yearning for an embrace, taking slow steps toward Mr. Colin.
Within the haze, numerous figures wailed, as though they were suffering extreme agony…
‘What’s going on?’
Mr. Colin’s expression turned solemn; this entity’s level was not low, but what was odd was that it didn’t have the destructive power of a Level 1 Containment Subject, yet it obviously exceeded Level 2…
Maybe it should be categorized as a top-end special Level 2 Containment Subject, or perhaps he should report back to the company later.
Should they add a new level for containment subjects that are one step and a half into the lower Level 1 category?
While thoughts flickered in his mind, Mr. Colin’s phone suddenly rang. After connecting, Xu Duojin’s voice quickly came through:
“Mr. Colin, the people here have asked me to tell you not to burn the ‘Haze Angel’ too, to keep it for them to handle later, and they are willing to offer a generous reward if you can prevent it from escaping…”
Mr. Colin opened his mouth about to speak, but the signal was abruptly cut off.
And the one cutting off the signal was…
Mr. Colin looked up ahead, to see the childlike “Haze Angel” trembling, as if in great fear.
“Save me… save me… please don’t…”
“Please stop hurting me…”
“I’m begging you…”
“No more pain and whipping…”
“Let me rest a bit…”
“Please… let there be a place where it’s not cold…”
“I haven’t eaten for so many days…”
“I beg you…”
“Please take us with you… warm people…”
From the rolling haze, countless whispers could be heard, along with dense shadows, among which there were children as small as monkeys with limbs crippled by factory machinery, workers wasted away by tuberculosis and incessant whipping, people frozen stiff as they hung from ropes, women, and children who had endured endless torment…
In their innate desire for warmth and heat, they reached out to Colin, trying to grasp even a sliver of warmth and hope.
But the intense resentment emanating from them, thick as if it couldn’t dissipate, left Colin feeling a strong sense of suffocation.
It was as though what he saw wasn’t a crowd of people, but an entire era…
Such suffering, he truly found hard to bear.
Yet it was at that moment that a task notification sprang forth from his mind.
[Temporary Event: “Contain the ‘Haze Angel’ using the Level 5 Containment Sphere and turn it in.”]
Note: The “Haze Angel’s” traits will be obtained in another manner.
…
“Alright, alright, just in time…”
Colin came to his senses and glanced at the “Storage Room,” where he saw a Level 5 Containment Sphere marked with an “M” pattern.
He immediately took it out and threw it toward the other party.
With a snap, the containment sphere opened, and glowing chains shot out, capturing the “Haze Angel,” who put up little resistance, within. In the next second, it was whisked away by a transparent vortex.
It was after this that Colin took a deep breath, feeling the cold sweat soaking his back.
And at this time, he also realized something…
“Xu Duojin had said, it seems they value the ‘Haze Angel’ quite a bit here? Right, I forgot, didn’t quite catch that…”
Colin thought for a moment, then decided not to think too much about it.
The “Haze Angel” had just cut off the communication; he hadn’t heard anything, and that’s how things were.
Afterward, seeing that all the restricted areas within the bonfire coverage had seemingly disappeared, and the mission completed, Colin decided to return home via the mission route.
It was shortly after his departure that a group of officers clad in old-fashioned uniforms, wielding batons and whistles and bearing a special containment device much like an iron maiden, searched the area. Upon confirming that the other party had left, they broke into a torrent of curses.
Meanwhile, an operator, having swiftly reviewed the scene, turned pale and dialed a number:
“One piece of good news, one piece of bad news.”
“Tell me the good news first.”
“Every significant anomaly on the island has been eradicated.”
Upon hearing this, the person on the other end of the phone was taken aback, then said with a laugh, “It seems that as long as there’s this good news, no amount of bad news could affect me.”
But soon, after hearing the bad news, they could no longer laugh.
“About sixty percent of our terrestrial territory has been erased from this world, including the important containment subject ‘Haze Angel’…”
…
At the same time, in another place, Xu Duojin, having re-established contact with Colin’s phone and discovered that the other party had already returned to his own country, fell into a silence as deep as death.
Colin had gone back, so what was he to do?
Xu Duojin looked up, seeing the unfriendly foreign colleagues who had him tightly encircled, opened his mouth to say something, but the awkwardness lodged in his throat, and for a moment, he could not think of what to say.
.
.
.
First update, then revise.

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - 725 521 On the Superiority of Flexible Work
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 725: Chapter 521: On the Superiority of “Flexible Work Schedules”. _1 Chapter 725: Chapter 521: On the Superiority of “Flexible Work Schedules”. _1 “This matter… isn’t really that much of a concern to me.”
Xu Duojin tried to defend himself in the end, but unfortunately, people didn’t let him go because of this justification…
To be honest, just thirty minutes to escape from the island, Xu Duojin thought he ran fast enough.
But unexpectedly…
He outran the distance, but he didn’t outrun fate.
And in that brief time, he probably only learned bits and pieces from these people about what exactly Colin had done, and what consequences it had wrought.
Although he solved the abnormality, he also wiped out a substantial amount of their land and burned down many valuable containment warehouses…
Especially since he burned one of the most important containment subjects here, the “Haze Angel,” to ashes and then ran away.
This…
Putting himself in their shoes, Xu Duojin felt that this matter probably wouldn’t end well.
However, to be honest, in Xu Duojin’s view, these were actually not the key points; the key was that Colin escaped without taking him along!
That was the crux of all the problems!
But, given his power and the force he represented, the group of people, though looking displeased, were relatively “civilized.”
“Take him down, give him a good beating, then contact them and let them give an explanation…” a High Order Extraordinary Powerhouse suggested expressionlessly.
However, he was stopped by another, more rational individual: “No…”
Detain him?
Didn’t they see how the adjacent island just vanished?
If they dared to detain someone today, tomorrow others might dare come over and erase them as well.
But if they didn’t detain him, after such a serious incident, they still needed an explanation, which meant that currently, to detain or not to detain was a very thorny issue.
At the scene, it was noisy and chaotic, with various statements being made around Xu Duojin…
There were those who insisted on a price being paid, on receiving compensation, and there were other local powers saying:
“I don’t care what you do, but you can’t infringe on personal rights…”But it was at this moment that the appearance of a voice caused everyone present to hold their breath and close their mouths.
“Heh, such a lively discussion. What are you all talking about?”
An “elder” with white hair had appeared at some point, coming into the crowd with a gentle smile looking at everyone present.
But for some reason, the group that had been bubbling with fervor became like students afraid of being called on by the teacher, all bowing their heads and not daring to make a noise.
…
“Another big problem resolved for the world…”
Colin hung up the phone with Xu Duojin, gazed at the strange ceiling, and sighed.
Unlike before, this time he resolved a big bunch of abnormalities.
He rarely felt it, but with the decrease of these unsettling factors, that invisible pressure that pervaded the world seemed to lessen noticeably…
‘However, Xu Duojin said I erased their place, but that doesn’t feel quite right. To my senses, it’s more like I applied a mosaic layer, things are still there but disconnected from reality, hmm, but in terms of the effect, indeed it’s pretty much the same…’
Colin pursed his lips and didn’t ponder further; after all, no matter how it was handled, the issue was resolved, and there was no need to dwell on methodology.
As for the subsequent effects that occurred during the process, Colin expressed his regrets and entrusted Xu Duojin to apologize to them, hoping that they could understand.
After all, when has solving an abnormality ever been without cost?
And he had already apologized, what else did they want?
Without dwelling on these minor issues, Colin took out a parchment and checked it.
With the completion of this ring’s mission, the next event jumped out…
The task content hadn’t changed, it was still to go someplace and deliver a “Token.”
But the execution time was for after returning from “World Code-13” next Monday.
“…To drop a ‘Token’ into a certain ‘Blood Lake’, hmm, the seventh mission, shouldn’t be too difficult. What I should be concerned about is the ninth mission…”
Colin reflected briefly; as for him, his coming challenges would likely be the ninth, twelfth, and fifteenth rings, the rest shouldn’t require too much thought.
His only hope was that by that time he would be given enough Points…
“Always delaying the settlement, I’m about to borrow Points to buy backup items needed for the mission.”
Colin sighed, lamenting that due to the lack of “salary,” his equipment hadn’t been updated or strengthened in a long time.
Shaking his head, he closed the mission and prepared for his daily browsing of the internal system, but he discovered that after closing this task, another mission settlement popped up.
[Event “Containment of the ‘Haze Angel’ has been completed.”]
[The following is the settlement for this temporary event — “Bonfire Points*2000,” “Silver Task Certificate*1,” “‘Haze Angel’ Usage Qualification (Semi-finished)*1”]
[All items have been transferred to the “Storage Room,” please check.]
…
Seeing this task settlement, Colin was startled and realized for the first time that the previous task was not considered part of the Fifteenth Ring, but rather, was a separate independent task?
However, right after that, his attention was captured by the rewards included in it.
The Points and Mission Voucher can only be said to be better than nothing.
The key is the third one…
“‘Haze Angel’ usage qualification? Is it some kind of permission? And what does the addition of ‘semi-finished’ imply?”
Colin was somewhat puzzled. He opened the “Storage Room” but didn’t see any item inside, instead, he found a special file.
He took out the file and glanced over its content quickly.
“Placing this file together with the ‘Kindness of the Firebearer’ inside a level 3 or higher Bonfire with fusion effects will connect with the ‘Haze Angel’ and acquire the corresponding abilities…”
Scratching his head, Colin roughly understood its function.
A high-level Bonfire with fusion effects was only available in “World Code-13”.
Looks like he would have to wait until he was over there to proceed with the operation…
“It seems that I can gain many of the ‘Haze Angel’ abilities; just don’t know how well the strength of the effects have been restored. Hopefully, it’s not weakened by a third, making it too weak.”
After reading the file once more and confirming that his understanding was correct, Colin put it away.
Then, he looked up at the clock hanging on the wall.
Following this week’s delivery of the “Token” mission for the three-ring cycle, the week was almost over, and tomorrow would be “Descent Project-13″…
“This…the timing fits quite well…”
Colin fell silent for a moment.
His mission schedule was packed, neatly coinciding with his estimated completion time.
Was this the so-called “flexible work system” exclusively designed for the “Firebearer’s Talent Program”?
There wasn’t a moment to relax…
Taking a deep breath, he asked the Little Maid to prepare some food, and then he arranged some tasks related to supplies for Qin Chuan.
This time going to “World Code-13,” there was no need for an assault mission, just preparing some food to take over was enough.
“The situation over there has generally settled down, however…”
Colin stroked his chin, thinking about the previously blocked logic, and contemplating how to communicate this matter with Shana.
Currently, he felt that the problem should mainly lie in the distribution of Points.
That is to say, Shana’s rewards were likely less than a tenth of what she should receive.
“With the information I have, it can’t block me with the ‘logical point blocking’ method anymore, but just to be safe, I should still make some notes and store them in the ‘Storage Room’…”
After thinking it through, Colin stood up, went to his desk, and wrote a memo.
By communicating with Shana later, he would probably be able to discover a lot…
Hmm?
Colin suddenly furrowed his brows, aware of a somewhat troublesome issue.
It seemed that…
Even if he found out that there was a problem with the “branch,” there wasn’t much he could do about it, right?
No matter how strong Shana was compared to him, her authority was even lower; currently, it seemed she was only an F Level…
The only right she could exercise was to refuse to execute tasks or cooperate with corresponding events.
This…
“Speaking of which, is there a way to get Shana to switch sides to join me?”
Colin pondered that even if there was a way, it would require Lady Bunny to make it happen…
But she was not easy to contact.
Another option, Lady of Thorns, had temporarily disconnected after his return, otherwise, he could have asked her if there was any way.
“Forget it, I’ll take it one step at a time. Tomorrow, after arriving at ‘World Code-13,’ let’s see the specific situation. Yes, I’ll start by reconciling the accounts with Shana.”
Colin ended his reflection.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - 726 522
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 726: 522 Chapter 726: 522 “Ding—ding—ding~”
The distant and ancient bell tolls faded slowly away…
Colin opened his eyes to a serene little church where a bonfire was burning.
“This place looks like it needs some renovation and expansion; otherwise, it’s a bit too crowded.”
In this descent project, he had recruited fifty new employees. It seemed that this time, regardless of whether they were D Level or F Level, they all chose to join, rather than avoiding it as before…
From this point of view, the spontaneous promotion by the employees over this period had been quite effective.
‘The tasks for the first two days of this week should be to go out and find people, um, for them to go out and find people.’
Those who came for the first time had to find others to register in front of the bonfire; it was already an old process…
In the early days, finding people was somewhat dangerous.
But now the situation is stable, the conditions are improved, and each of them is an Extraordinary One.
Their luck might be a bit poor at the start.
But they didn’t have to worry too much about dangers like death…
Even if it did happen, they still had three chances to resurrect.
As thoughts flashed through his mind, less than a third of a second had passed. Colin was about to gesture for the other employees to descend and then allocate the tasks for this time before going to find Sister Shana to go over the accounts…
But then he suddenly heard a pure, beautiful voice, as if a sound from the heavens, coming from the church entrance, so mesmerizing that one could not help but immerse in it.
Looking over, he saw Shana holding Little Red at the entrance, singing with eyes closed…
The entire church seemed to emanate a divine atmosphere because of this voice.
‘Shana?’ Colin surprised for a moment, “pressed” the appearance of the employees, and listened intently by himself.
The song was pleasant, but what surprised him even more was that it… used the language from Earth?
“Ah, the most beautiful future! Don’t be cold to me, don’t be cold to me, do not be cold, I start from zero point, towards the most beautiful future~ towards the most beautiful future, even if it’s a long road, um~ huh?”
The singing paused, and Shana stopped her gently swaying head, seeming to notice something, she looked back at the people, stood up, put down Little Red, and smiled, saying, “Mr. Colin, good day.”
“Right, morning…”
Colin thought the song Shana sang sounded familiar, probably one of the employees had played music aloud while working, and she picked it up from there; it wasn’t a big deal…
He nodded in response and waved his hand.
With a wave of his large hand, clumps of ashes were expelled from the bonfire, then as they landed on the ground, they congealed into people, forming the figures of the employees.
“Let me explain today’s task. As I mentioned in the meeting yesterday, today we have fifty new employees joining us…”
Upon hearing this, the present employees narrowed their eyes and showed cruel smiles.
The time had come to introduce the newcomers to their blessings!
“Brother Shunzi, go receive them, count me in as well… not…”
“Me too, me too!”
“I… never mind, I still have a few patients in critical condition to treat, along with some rehabilitation training and whatnot, so I won’t go… too bad.”
“…”
Going out to find people was a rare “holiday” opportunity, one they would strive for if possible; otherwise, they would be grinding through medication and energy consumption, working nonstop for seven days and nights without rest.
Colin understood their little schemes and spoke up:
“Cute Duo, you organize a group to receive them. As for the subsequent arrangements and such, currently, there’s no special task; you handle it. I can sense that this group of people isn’t too far away, two days should be enough for you…”
Hearing Colin’s words, “Life Mentor Adorable” nodded, indicating no problem.
Now the situation was not as complicated as before, so one or two days were roughly enough. Being an employee ready to push for D+ Level access, he didn’t have any desire to slack off.
After all, hard work here did pay off; the points reward was much higher than anywhere else.
In the end, Colin walked out the door and tossed out the ten cubic meters of material…
After he finished allocating the tasks and everyone dispersed to start working, Little Red was the first to rush over, hugging him and affectionately calling him big brother.
“I was just learning to sing with Sister Shana; her singing is really nice…”
“Indeed, it’s nice. Did you finish your homework?”
“All done! I checked the answers, I got eighty in math!”
“Not bad.”
Colin nodded, pulled out a new workbook from the “Storage Room,” tousled her hair while saying:
“As a reward, here’s your assignment for this week; I specially had experts create these teaching problems for you. Go do them… I have a bit of work, I’ll come find you later…”
“Oh…” Little Red walked away dejectedly with the new workbook.
Then, Colin looked at Shana, who stood quietly on the side. After a couple of seconds of thought, he said:
“This time, when I went back, I think I discovered some things about the ‘company’ here…”
At that point, he paused, considering that this place was, in a sense, still the subsidiary’s territory. In case it threw a fit, the spectacle of a heavenly anomaly or a fire dragon burning the warehouse would be quite troublesome…
After looking at Colin for a couple of seconds, Shana seemed to realize the reason for his hesitation and raised her hand to comb back a few strands of hair from her forehead to behind her ear:
“You don’t need to worry too much about it. Just by understanding some things, it can’t bring us any substantial trouble, nor will there be any retaliation or such…”
“That’s good to hear.”
After some thought, Colin beckoned with his hand, sealed off the church’s main doors with flames, and got ready.
Then, he settled down with Shana at a small conference table beside the bonfire and started to talk about some matters related to allocation…

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - 727 522
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 727: 522 Chapter 727: 522 Under the condition that the “Logic Point Blockade” didn’t take effect, the two naturally started discussing some matters related to Points earnings. Afterward, as Shana shared some details, Colin’s mouth slowly dropped open.
“Huh? How, how much?”
Colin froze, “You’re saying you earn just a few or at most a dozen points per task?”
“Yes, usually it’s like that, just a few points. But after meeting you guys, I often get tasks that are worth a dozen or even several dozen points…”
As she mentioned this, Shana, who was sitting properly on the chair, couldn’t help but recall the time she had planned to exchange a “200+ Points” fortune for a Bone Spur…
Instantly, she felt a bit embarrassed and curled her toes beneath her feet.
“A dozen points…”
Colin muttered to himself, a dozen points for someone of Shana’s capabilities?
His first reaction was nearly disbelief, as this was much lower than he had thought—the small tasks a few hundred points, the large tasks only one to two thousand points for the lowest threshold…
As incredible as it was, what Colin was very clear about was that Shana was never one to lie—it was a guaranteed reputation.
By comparison, that wild and unpredictable “Subsidiary” was another story entirely.
Then, Colin suddenly thought of something, “Do you… do you remember your reward for the first time you helped me repel enemies and the blessings effect you added afterward?”
“The first meeting? I have some impression. I remember it was a dozen points and some black bread. The second time, it was 50 points plus some loose points, approximately…”
“Fuck! Beast!”
Colin couldn’t help but curse out loud, interrupting Shana.
50 points?
He could remember very clearly, in oppression by the “Twilight Angel,” he had reluctantly paid out five thousand points for the summoning cost, and then he had to renew the BUFF every half day or so at several hundred points per person each time…
But to Shana, it ended up being only about a hundred points?
At that moment, Colin desperately needed a word more aggressive than ‘beast’!
It was also at this moment that he finally understood why there was such a huge disconnect between Shana’s actual persona and the “greedy” image when summoned…
In a certain sense, the keywords greed, money-grubbing, and looting weren’t wrong, they’d just been applied to the wrong person.
“What the hell is the origin of this ‘Subsidiary,’ skimming ninety-nine percent?! As far as I know, even the forum with the highest tipping rate I know of only takes nine out of ten…”
“What an unscrupulous, blood-sucking subsidiary!”
Colin couldn’t help but recall the “transparent consumption” posts on the employee forum.
That was the highest skimming rate he knew of…
But he hadn’t realized there was a bigger player at hand. From what Shana implied, this skimming wasn’t even disclosed to them.
In that moment, Colin felt an inexplicable sense of relief.
Relief that this “Subsidiary” hadn’t forcibly taken him to be one of its employees…
Based on this compensation reward, Colin guessed that by now, he might have just managed to gather enough to buy the “Widow Yukionna”—
No, skimming ninety-nine percent was too harsh; he might not have been able to gather enough at all.
‘Come to think of it, this subsidiary has always been suspected of being Rosen’s, but I heard Rosen was somewhat stingy, paying low wages, but it didn’t seem stingy to this extent. Has the… subsidiary gone rogue?’
If not so, Colin really couldn’t understand its unsustainable and exploitative approach.
Then, he glanced sideways and looked at Shana, noticing that after learning she had been given tens of thousands of points but only ended up with a hundred in her hands…
Shana suddenly fell silent, her ice-blue eyes like the surface of a mirror-like lake, her delicate face unexpectedly calm, without a single ripple.
But Colin, sitting opposite her, inexplicably felt a sense of alarm.
He thought for a moment, preparing to say something comforting…
It was at that moment, as Shana, who was motionless and seemingly lost in thought, made a move. She took out a parchment from her sleeve, held it in her hand, and stared at it blankly for quite a while.
Suddenly, she blinked her eyes and shook her head, as if muttering to herself:
“Actually, I might not care so much about the loss in this regard, nor about some deceptions,
“It’s just that if… if it had taken a little less, then, there would have been more choices to make back then, and more people would have survived the disaster until today…
“Why do this?”
Upon hearing her words, Colin couldn’t help but feel moved—Shana’s heart was truly pure. He could sense that she really didn’t mind her own loss, but rather cared more for those who couldn’t be saved…
Unfortunately, faced with her probing questions, Colin guessed that the “Subsidiary” would probably play the ostrich.
This time, it relied on its own earnings of several hundred thousand Points, feeling like it had sucked enough blood…
Perhaps it would just play dead until the next generation of Saints came along.
After all, the “Light” Saint wasn’t passed down from generation to generation but emerged when special circumstances arose.
If this generation was seen through, the next generation would simply be exploited in the same way.
However, to Colin’s surprise, after this thought surfaced, the parchment in Shana’s hands actually gave some sort of response!
[“World Code-13” is unique, many confidential matters and functions require a significant amount of Points, and the Points acquired are also used in maintaining some necessary powers…]
[If some related functions are not maintained in time, the condition here will be far worse than it is now.]
[In the allocation of related domians and the use of Points, there is ample necessity, with no waste.]
…
Reading this response, Colin’s intuition told him it was true information, but whether it was all the information was hard to say.
Because the “transparency” was really quite low…
The whole thing was about “related”, “relevant”, and such, and Colin was not well-versed in the workings of this mechanism; who knew if there was any trickery involved.
But he was 80 percent certain there was some hidden reason why the parchment was so desperate for Points.
Just didn’t know what was being concealed.
‘Now, if there was a chance to bring over ‘Lady of Thorns’, who is also a ‘World Administrator’ and a clerical officer, maybe the situation would be clear, she undoubtedly knows a lot.’
As this thought flashed through Colin’s mind, he glanced at Shana. There was no change in her expression; one couldn’t make out any emotions like joy or anger…
Through Bonfire’s sensitivity to human emotions, he could only feel that her mood was relatively stable.
Just a bit too stable.
At that moment, Shana suddenly looked up at Colin, “Mr. Colin, do you have anything you would like to ask it?”
“I really haven’t thought of anything to ask for the moment…”
Halfway through his sentence, Colin suddenly got curious, “Speaking of which, what essentially are Points? Why does it seem, aside from its monetary value, that it has other substantial uses?”
Before this, Points in Colin’s view seemed just to be an internal digital currency, but from the parchment’s description of “maintaining some necessary powers,” it appeared they were not just a credit currency but had intrinsic practical value like gold.
Yet, faced with Colin’s question, the parchment had no intention of responding.
It seemed to be biased against him.
‘What the hell, it’s having a temper tantrum, huh?!’ Colin grumbled to himself.
Seeing that the parchment was not responding, Shana’s grip on it tightened slightly, and streaks of light seeped into the parchment, then she repeated Colin’s question.
[“Bonfire Points”: A form of currency that circulates within the company and can only be utilized by ‘Bonfire Company’ and the like, it can activate certain company protocols and powers, similar to how energy operates and maintains…]
[Note: Its production and related interpretation are classified for employees below A Level, and cannot be known.]
…
“A Level and below are classified items?!”
Colin’s eyes widened slightly; was this thing’s classification level so high?
The “Stupid Robot” remembered “Lady Rabbit” saying that the security level seemed to be only B- at best, but it turned out that some fundamental aspects of Points were classified above that?
Suddenly, Colin got the feeling that the company was full of pitfalls.
After asking about that, he tried to understand a bit about the “Seed of Light.”
Previously, in the middle of the night, when it came asking for items in exchange for 300,000 Points, it had offered this as a choice—
Which meant that, in its view, this thing was extremely valuable information.
.
.
.
ps: There’s one more chapter coming up.

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - 728 523 Kind Grandfather Colin_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 728: Chapter 523 Kind Grandfather Colin_1 Chapter 728: Chapter 523 Kind Grandfather Colin_1 Unfortunately, even with Shana’s help, it didn’t provide a suitable answer this time.
It only said that the item was special, one of the hopes for the future that should not be overlooked, but didn’t specify what exactly it referred to, what its uses were, making it seem like it was spouting riddles…
“Damn riddle-monger…”
Colin cursed softly, deciding not to pursue the issue any further. Given its attitude, seemingly indifferent to being scalded by boiling water, unless he brought a significant amount of points, there likely wouldn’t be a response.
