Seeing this, Colin’s gaze moved beyond the female employee, who seemed to have become part of the anomalies, and looked at the LED screen behind her.
Upon reaching the second level, there had been some changes to the guidelines on the screen.
For example, the first one “There are only three floors in the outpatient department of this hospital…” disappeared, replaced with “1. This institute has been thoroughly disinfected; there are no unclean things. If you find anything dirty, please do not touch it. If the situation is dire, please call out loudly for our nurses to handle it…”
“Is this referring to those black patches?”
Colin pondered thoughtfully. Based on the information observed so far, whoever inputted this data onto the LED screen seemed to be on the friendly side.
But who might that be?
The mission hadn’t specified, and there weren’t many directions Colin could guess from.
He took a breath and then looked at the other two items, noting that the third one still contained “gibberish,” though it had changed slightly.
It was mostly nonsense; except for a few rare and complex characters disappearing and the addition of the character “help,” the rest was unintelligible.
“I won’t guess about the stuff on there anymore.” Colin pursed his lips, and without further inquiry, asked, “Where do we go next?”
“It’s still the staircase. The first few layers are accessed through staircases. After every three layers, some changes will appear. But starting from the second layer, the range of that special staircase expands. Any building could potentially have it, making it a bit hard to find…” Ashen Holy Body explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - 747 534 The Weeping Psychotic Madman_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 747: Chapter 534 “The Weeping Psychotic Madman”_2 Chapter 747: Chapter 534 “The Weeping Psychotic Madman”_2 ‘Every three levels…’
Muttering to himself, Colin remembered that many things in the company were similar.
“Don’t you guys remember the staircase from the last time you were here?” Colin asked. The hospital, possibly orchestrated by ‘Bonfire Company,’ was immensely large. Searching building by building, who knows when they would find what they were looking for.
Upon hearing this, the Ashen Holy Body on the side shook his head: “We remember, but it doesn’t help much. We’ve only been here two or three times, and its location changes each time. The first time we came, it was the oncology department on the seventh floor of the fifth building; the second time, it became the gastroenterology department in the thirty-first building, and it changed the following two times too…”
“Yeah, right, we also encountered it in two different locations,” echoed Orange Cat. After a pause, he continued, “But no matter what, we will definitely find it. After all, it doesn’t move. The real trouble will be later when we search for the ‘stairs’ on the fourth floor…
“It moves and can appear anywhere, possibly behind the door of some ward or behind a bathroom door, particularly hard to find…”
It wasn’t their first time there; just knowing about the “stairs” key point had taken a considerable amount of time…
“Is that so.”
Colin nodded, said little, and continued with the mission.
This time, with the search area expanded, the speed of the search noticeably slowed down.
‘It’s a pity I can’t use ‘Bonfire’ to observe it; I can only find it with the naked eye. Otherwise, if I just sent out a bunch of flames, the speed could be greatly accelerated…’
Colin heaved a sigh inwardly.
The mission didn’t specify a time limit, but there were only two days left for the overall Fifteenth Ring mission, so it could be assumed that the time limit was two days…
If it wasn’t completed by then, the mission might be in vain, or, given a high score on previous missions, they might receive one chance to correct the failure.
But either way, it’s better to finish it if possible.
The good news was that they were only on the second floor, and the number of anomalies wasn’t high, only a female employee in the outpatient hall suspected of becoming part of an anomaly, and some special black spots.
So there wasn’t too much to worry about in terms of safety…
About an hour later, after roaming nearly a quarter of the hospital’s corridors, Colin and the others finally found the special anomalous staircase in an area marked Building G Inpatient Department.
Compared to the second floor, there were even more of those dark, black patches on it now.
And it looked more and more like the mold spots on the walls at home during the rainy season, giving off a musty smell…
Fortunately, the trouble was still not very big.
Colin left a Bonfire, then covered everyone with flames and continued to lead the team upstairs. In just a few minutes, they smoothly reached the third floor area.
The place they emerged was still the inpatient department building…
But compared to the previous level, the whole world had become even harder to describe, as if there was some indescribable sense of oppression.
“Let’s go back to the outpatient hall first and see if there’s any change in that rule…”
Just as Colin made this decision, his words were interrupted by the Ashen Holy Body, who suddenly exclaimed, “Holy shit,” apparently seeing something.
He and Orange Cat looked in the direction he was gazing, and saw that he was looking towards a balcony window of a neighboring inpatient building…
Where there should have been a two-person hospital room behind the window, there was now a dark, deep staircase leading downwards.
“Holy shit, it’s the staircase to the fourth floor!” Orange Cat also exclaimed upon seeing it.
Compared to their surprise, Colin couldn’t help but raise an eyebrow:
“This convenient?”
“Really lucky, we just happened upon it! It won’t be this easy to find in a bit!”
While they were talking, the strange corridor inside the room began to fade…
It seemed it wouldn’t be long before it disappeared altogether.
“Go!”
After hesitating for a moment, Colin took out a piece of ‘kindling’ from his pocket, which he had prepared in advance, and lit it on this floor. Then he grabbed the other two, pulling them with him as he shot out like a bullet, crossing the distance between the two buildings in less than half a second and directly entering the passage to the fourth floor.
No sooner had he stepped on the staircase than he felt like he was entering another space, the temperature dropping to a chill and becoming stuffy.
The air was filled with the foul stench of rotting protein…
‘The rules usually detail the content of this floor; having only crossed one level, I shouldn’t miss any key information.’
Colin looked back and saw that the way they had come was already shrouded with a gloomy haze.
“If you want to go back now, passing through this fog will take you straight back to the first floor. If you don’t go through, after a while it will turn into a closed road, and then we can only return by completing the mission,” explained the Ashen Holy Body, continuing with the “information” that exploded in his brain like a triggered landmine, “this staircase goes straight down, and you’ll reach the fourth floor after a certain distance, probably over a hundred turns…”
“Any dangers?” Colin asked casually.
“Just watch out for those shadowy spots. After the fourth floor, we might encounter some anomalies that aren’t too dangerous. For now, there’s…”
“Let’s get to it, then.”
Colin waved his hand, still letting a fireball scout ahead while he and the others followed.
Starting from the fourth floor, the shadowy blotches on the ground began to appear somewhat three-dimensional, and eerily started to move ever so slightly. It seemed the deeper they went floor by floor, the closer they got to its true nature.
However, Colin tried to burn them with flames, but still couldn’t burn them away.

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - 748 534 The Weeping Psychotic Madman_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 748: Chapter 534 “The Weeping Psychotic Madman”_3 Chapter 748: Chapter 534 “The Weeping Psychotic Madman”_3 Regarding this, he vaguely made some judgments.
‘This thing, it’s somewhat like a high-dimensional projection, to be more precise, it’s like a shadow projected outwards from the depths of an ‘nonexistent hospital.’ If the source of the infection is not eradicated, then killing it a few times would probably be useless…’
‘That’s probably also why the female employee could still be seen on the second floor, looking neither alive nor dead, because in a certain sense, what we are seeing is just a ‘shadow’…’
Colin had some guesses about the superficial anomalies of the hospital.
It wasn’t that the “Bonfire” couldn’t kill it, but rather that the source had not been found.
Thinking of this, some of the unease Colin felt due to the “Bonfire” ‘failing’ dissipated somewhat.
Following the two people’s reasoning, the three of them moved downward in silence.
The further they went down the stairs, the darker the lighting became, the atmosphere growing increasingly oppressive. To the average person, it might cause great psychological pressure, but for veterans who had completed numerous tasks…
Unless there were tactics such as spiritual contamination hidden away, this mere atmosphere was not enough to affect their psyche.
The descent went smoothly…
At least for the first ten or so minutes, it did.
At that moment, Colin stopped in his tracks, and the two people behind him also stopped.
“Did you say there was nothing below before?”
Upon hearing this, the two exchanged a glance, vaguely realizing there was more to Brother Shunzi’s words.
“Yeah, what’s the matter?”
“There’s some crying sound below…” said Colin.
Below, after several turns, the fireball at the very front picked up some sound feedback. It sounded like the sobbing of an adult man.
“That can’t be, when we were there…”
“What happened before is before, it’s different now. For now, it seems like there’s been some new changes here.” Colin waved his hand, according to their account, there shouldn’t have been that female employee at the outpatient department!
He now even felt that there might be some will within this hospital, luring him deeper and deeper…
‘I am at least a Flame Bearer reservist, faced the ‘Red Moon,’ and chased away ‘The Night.’ I want to see just what thing is masquerading as a god, daring to lure me into a trap!’
As thoughts raced through his mind, Colin became more wary but did not cease his advance.
Left hand clutching three Golden Cards, right hand wielding a revolver with the Bone Spur mounted on it as a bayonet, Colin controlled surges of flames like a flood, rapidly advancing towards the lower stairs…
The already gloomy stairwell space experienced a rapid increase in temperature.
“Brother Shunzi is really powerful…”
The two behind him, feeling the power contained within the flames, involuntarily gasped for air, sensing a full measure of security.
After what felt like the descent of another ten or so floors, Colin noticed that the crying sound that had been approaching him began to retreat with his sudden outburst, moving away towards the lower stairs at a speed exceeding his own…
And after a few more floors, it seemed they would reach the fourth floor.
“Seems like it was scared off?” remarked Orange Cat, relieved by the sound of the retreat.
This encounter was beyond their understanding; if they could avoid it, it was best to do so…
However, just as Colin was considering whether to let it go at that, a series of task events suddenly popped up in his mind.
[Event One: Capture the “Crying Psychotic Madman” and draw one thousand milliliters of blood…]
“Remark”: Receive one hundred milliliters of ‘Psychotic Madman Patient Blood Extract’.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 749 - 749 535 Dont Come Near Me_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 749: Chapter 535 “Don’t Come Near Me!”_1 Chapter 749: Chapter 535 “Don’t Come Near Me!”_1 “‘The Weeping Psychotic Madman’? So, the thing crying below is this kind of creature? But what exactly is a madman…”
“It didn’t mention killing, just capturing and drawing a thousand milliliters of blood, and that’s it…”
“The task seems quite gentle.”
Colin’s mind flashed with thoughts, and within a brief second, he had reached a decision.
Accompanied by a “boom” of an explosion.
His figure seemed to transform into a deep red blaze, surging rapidly towards the stairs below, trying to approach that something inexplicably named “Psychotic Madman.”
To extract a thousand milliliters of blood from it…
But after Colin’s figure vanished in an instant, the two employees behind him were suddenly dumbfounded, three question marks popping into their minds.
“Huh? What’s happening? What do we do?”
In the first moment, a sense of nervousness emerged from their hearts, and they couldn’t help but feel that perhaps some powerful enemy had appeared.
So Brother Shunzi had simply ditched them to cover the rear…
But just as they were lost in wild conjecture, a sentence floated through the air.
“I’m going down to deal with that thing. You guys stay within the range of the bonfire. Don’t move around randomly…”
Although they didn’t understand why Shunzi suddenly went down, after exchanging glances, the two of them obediently stayed still on the stairs covered by the bonfire’s range…
Trusting in Brother Shunzi’s credibility, he shouldn’t have just abandoned them and taken off.
Meanwhile, as Colin continued his pursuit, he suddenly noticed some problems: that thing was clearly much slower than him, yet for some reason, he could never get close enough.
No, to be precise, he could feel that he was closing in.
But the pace at which he was catching up was so slow that it seemed impossible he’d catch it within ten days or eight days at this rate!
And to keep rushing like this for ten or eight days, even Colin himself couldn’t hold out.
‘It feels like some damn rule or something, no matter what, there’s always a floor between us. Can’t catch up, just can’t, wait, ‘rule’?
Colin suddenly thought of the special nature of this “Nonexistent Hospital”: “Can’t think about it getting further away, nor can I think about being unable to touch it. I need to convince myself that I’m getting closer…”
Upon realizing this, he immediately started to hypnotize himself deep down.
Indeed, this time the distance between them finally started to close noticeably. However, Colin could still feel an indescribable force resisting him.
‘If I’m not mistaken, this resisting force should be that ‘Psychotic Madman’. Didn’t he just start flirting far and near a moment ago? How did he suddenly start running so fast?’
Colin murmured to himself, and while engaging in this mental battle, he also kept speeding up.The stairs, covered with dark patches, led down layer by layer. No matter to which level Colin or the “Psychotic Madman” descended, the view of the next level remained, as if it were endless.
“This staircase itself is an anomaly…”
In the midst of the chase, Colin faintly realized that this never-ending staircase might be spliced and integrated into it.
And it was specifically designed as a passage to the “inner layer.”
The “human traces” were quite obvious…
But for now, he could not afford to worry about that and concentrated on chasing down that individual.
Ten minutes later, he suddenly felt a strong sense of mental pressure coming from ahead. At the front end where the bonfire’s light illuminated, he could vaguely make out a blurry humanoid silhouette…
At first glance, it was a man wearing blue and white vertical stripes, looking rather ordinary.
But as Colin got closer, he distinctly felt a strong sense of mental oppression and madness emanating from the other person, like a tangible storm…
For the first time, Colin clearly experienced what was called “the power of the mind.”
“You can’t catch me, you can’t catch me, don’t! Don’t get close to me!”
“I’m not sick! I’m not sick! Don’t come near me! I told you, I’m not sick!”
“I didn’t help him! I couldn’t help him! I don’t know anything, I don’t know! Don’t…”
“Don’t take me back, nooo!”
“Get away!”
“Aaaaah, mom, help me! Mom, there’s a bad person!”
“…”
The disorderly whispers mingled with the maddened mental tide, causing dizziness and swelling of the eyes, even causing the distance that had almost been closed to widen again.
It was only after Colin steadied his mind that he could close the gap once more.
After that, he saw the “Psychotic Madman” weeping and wailing as though seeing a ghost, half rolling and half running as he fled downwards.
‘Is it really necessary? I’m no villain, just going to take a little blood.’
‘But then again, these rule-like phenomena are truly odd. The way he’s running doesn’t look fast at all, just on his two legs and arms, and can’t be faster than my current speed, which is more than a supercar’s…’
‘It seems he makes better use of the ‘hospital rules’ than I do.’
Colin couldn’t help but comment to himself, then sped up even more.
Finally, after another two or three minutes, when he was close enough, Colin swiftly reached out and accurately grabbed the other’s neck.
Immediately after, he tried to subdue and stabilize the guy.
But then, unexpectedly, something happened!
The “Psychotic Madman” let out a loud scream:
“Don’t touch me! I said! Don’t come near me! I told you I didn’t help him! Why! Why are you forcing me!”
As his words ended, the “Psychotic Madman’s” neck twisted around, his eyes protruded from their sockets like snails, and his back split open, the spine dividing into two halves to form a large mouth. From that mouth, an innumerable set of eyes clustered together, emitting a foul, blood-red mist, attempting to envelop Colin.

chapters.title: Chapter 750 - 750 535 Dont Come Near Me_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 750: Chapter 535 “Don’t Come Near Me!”_2 Chapter 750: Chapter 535 “Don’t Come Near Me!”_2 Colin’s expression remained unchanged as he clasped the man’s neck, Bonfire energy surged over his body, burning away that blood-red mist with ease, and he suppressed that power ahead of everyone else.
With the suppression taking effect, all anomalies on the man dissipated at that moment.
“Ah, ah, I don’t want to go back…” the “Psychotic” frantically flailed his limbs, attempting a final struggle.
For some reason Colin thought of, he actually felt the neck in his grasp begin to soften, a viscous secretion appeared, and the man’s entire body began to soften and shrivel as if an invisible shell was forming…
If he did not put a stop to this, it was very likely the man would shrink back into some shell-like thing and become a “snail person.”
“It’s hard to say whether this place is defying the heavens, or if this ‘madman’ himself is defying the heavens.”
Colin clicked his tongue, he probably understood what “Psychotic” meant…
Most likely, it was someone who became mad after coming into contact with some unknowable entities and learning knowledge they shouldn’t have known.
Moreover, given the special nature of this hospital, such a person was extremely dangerous.
However, without dwelling too much on the matter, Colin pinched “Time Reversal” with his left hand, directly reversing time in front of him, returning the “Psychotic” to his state a few seconds prior.
Following that, seizing the opportunity before he turned into a “snail person,” “Bonfire” power completely enveloped him, melting away that mental influence.
He forced the guy who might have been imagining himself shrinking back into a snail, back into his original form.
Gradually, the “Psychotic” stopped struggling, passing out…
“Here comes the problem, how should I draw blood?”
Colin pondered for a moment, it wasn’t that he didn’t know how to draw blood, but it seemed he lacked the proper tools?
But as he thought about it, Colin suddenly gave a self-deprecating chuckle, how could he forget Little Maid?
Right away, he summoned Little Maid, allowing her to transform out syringes and other tools, beginning to extract blood from the man…
Before long, a thousand milliliters of blood were collected, and a confirmation for blood submission to complete the task appeared.
After Colin confirmed, within less than ten seconds from the settlement, he acquired a well-encased syringe of “Madman Blood Extract”…
“Suddenly, I have a feeling this is not particularly good.”
Upon seeing the syringe containing faintly pink transparent extract, Colin fell silent.
He wondered if they were going to make him inject this stuff soon?
At that moment, a new task event appeared…
[Event Two: Take the “Psychotic” to any bed in room 701 on the third floor of the “Psychiatric Ward” on the fourth floor. After setting up protection in the room, with at least one employee, descend through dreams to the ‘Non-existent Hospital’ seventh floor and return to the ‘Outpatient Department’ lobby, observing the regulations…]
“Note”: During the dream state, certain high-risk memories will be treated, please do not panic.
…
“Phew, lucky, I don’t have to inject it, but… descending through dreams to… straight to the seventh floor?”
Upon scanning the contents of the task, Colin was taken aback, not expecting “Lady Rabbit” to provide a method to skip floors so quickly.
In doing do…
The two employees he paid for had been hired for no reason?
“That’s not right, it can’t be considered a waste, after all, they played some role on the earlier floors, avoiding many pitfalls, and later on, when I bring them up to the higher floors, they should be more familiar than those who are here for the first time.”
Without dwelling too much, Colin glanced again at the “Psychotic” lying on the stairs with a tranquil face.
He became somewhat curious about where this guy had come from?
According to “Innate Ashen Holy Body” and “Orange Cat,” it seemed that this “Infinite Staircase” shouldn’t have had this guy in it…
Besides, although this guy had issues, his whole body was contaminated, and he was mentally deranged, he was indeed human…
Amidst his doubts, Colin couldn’t help but recall some of the things the guy had been madly shouting earlier.
“He seemed to have said he hadn’t helped someone? Who is that referring to? And who is after him?”
After thinking it over, Colin guessed that it might have something to do with the later floors, potentially with some anomalies, or maybe even heretics…
Unfortunately, he didn’t have enough information at present.
At this moment, noticing the man’s pallid and listless complexion due to the blood drawn, to prevent him from possibly dying on the spot, Colin considerately injected a “Colorless Crystal” to sustain his body without issues.
After finishing all that, Colin quickly returned and met the two people waiting above a few minutes later.
“Did you just go down there?” Colin asked.
He had chased downstairs for more than half an hour, but going back up, it only took a few minutes, which was obviously not right.
“No.” The two shook their heads simultaneously.
“You must have wanted me to come back quickly, right?”
“Uh…a little.” Orange Cat said, somewhat embarrassed.
‘It seems that because they wanted me back, some kind of “mutual rush” was actualized.’
Colin roughly understood the reason.
This haunted hospital was not only “believe and it exists, doubt and it does not,” but even the people who entered it were affected by this situation.
“Is this anomaly a deep-seated contamination leak, or is the ‘hospital’ itself just like this, only becoming out of control because the ‘Bonfire Company’ has weakened?”
Colin couldn’t help but be curious, but remembering the peculiar nature of this place, he quickly reined in his thoughts.
Avoid bringing forth something that shouldn’t appear because of reckless “imagination”…
Before long, the group exited the Infinite Staircase on the fourth floor…
After coming out, they were still in the hospital ward, but now on the fourth floor.
At this moment, despite the lights being on, the ambiance was darker, and the air carried a strong stench of a mix between formaldehyde and rotting corpses.
And faintly, from somewhere, screams of women and men could be heard…
Colin’s gaze turned to the “patches” densely spread all around, which were no longer purely black but had a dark red hue, and from them some tumor-like things twitched and writhed.
If there had been just one or two, it wouldn’t be much, but they were everywhere.
He had the feeling that the building was on the verge of coming to life…
“No, an illusion! It can’t come to life!”
Colin quickly stopped his dangerous train of thought, just in case it really did come to life, which would be more than troublesome.
The two employees by his side, upon those thoughts, became “moved by the scene” and their originally fuzzy memories became clear all at once:
“The patches on the ground are still the same; don’t touch them, and you’ll be fine. Besides that, there might be some human figures, but they’re not common now. Also, don’t pay attention to those screams; the more you focus on it, the closer it gets, and eventually a ghost-like creature will cling onto you. You can’t kill it, and it’s particularly frightening, but it’s manageable, just shift your attention elsewhere…”
Orange Cat quickly spoke out what was on his mind.
“Yeah, that’s more or less it; apart from that, there are some rooms with people that you can’t enter, and that’s about it,” said the Innate Ashen Holy Body, after finishing his sentence.
“The way to go down to the next floor is to find an abnormal ‘nurse’ dressed in pink, tell her we are seriously ill, with a very severe disease, and let her take us to a certain floor. Follow for a while and naturally we will go deeper into it…”
Find a nurse? This method seems different from “Lady Rabbit’s” suggestion… Colin raised his hand to interrupt him:
“No need, I have another method that can take us directly to the seventh floor.”
Compared to their “primitive ways,” Colin trusted the method given by “Lady Rabbit” more.
Then, without waiting for the two to ask, Colin continued, “Do you know where the ‘Psychiatric Ward’ is?”
“The Psychiatric Ward?!”
One of the employees’ expressions changed drastically upon hearing that name.
“What? Is there a problem?” Colin looked over curiously, not understanding why the reaction was so strong.
The employee opened his mouth as if to say something but found nothing other than fear in his recollection.
“There shouldn’t be a problem on the fourth floor, but it’s hard to say about the levels beyond; anyway, it’s very dangerous. I think we had an incident over there from our previous exploration…” The employee, filled with aversion, mentioned that place.
“It should be fine, do you know where it is?”
“I do.”
“Then let’s go there.”
Colin decisively made the decision, leaving no room for refusal.

chapters.title: Chapter 751 - 751 536 Terror Strikes_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 751: Chapter 536 Terror Strikes!_1 Chapter 751: Chapter 536 Terror Strikes!_1 Psychiatric Ward Building No.3 was located towards the back of the entire hospital.
Feeling some indescribable threat, Colin didn’t proceed as he had earlier, forcefully flying across. Instead, he tried to minimize the irritants to this sinister place and followed the floor markings.
‘Could there be something deep inside the hospital that’s becoming aware?’ he wondered.
Colin tried to interpret that ominous threat.
He didn’t feel particularly scared, but since his mission was not yet complete, it wasn’t time to show his hand.
If the situation escalated prematurely, there was a high likelihood that the mission would be jeopardized…
Along the way, aside from the sound of their footsteps and the occasional conversation, there were constant, lingering cries.
The source of these voices couldn’t be pinpointed, as if they came out of thin air, and inexplicably sent shivers down one’s spine.
“Hiss…”
Orange Cat, walking beside Colin, hugged its arms and looked around the desolate, oppressive space:
“Who the hell created this ghastly place, and for what purpose is it so eerie…”
‘Who made it? You’d likely have to ask Bonfire Company about that,’ Colin thought, but didn’t voice it aloud. Instead, he continued forward, one hand holding onto the “Psychotic” madman and leading the small team.
The dangers on the fourth level weren’t too problematic if one knew how to handle them.
Had it not been for the concern of attracting the attention of something much more dangerous, he would have already gone solo on a rampage here.
“Gurgle, gurgle…”
The sound of a metal door sliding open suddenly came from not far behind them.
“Hiss…” Two employees instantly felt a chill in their hearts and instinctively grasped the weapons in their hands, ready for action.
A nauseating stench of rot slowly wafted from the ajar door…
Yet aside from that, the door was only slightly open, with no creature in sight.
Ashen Holy Body glanced at the lettering on the door that read “Emergency Resuscitation Room”: “It might be one of those cases where a corpse from the resuscitation room becomes animated…”
He quickly briefed the team on the situation, which was that, starting on this level, some mysterious corpses might be present in certain wards, including the “Emergency Rooms”.
Once someone passed nearby, there was a chance these creatures would follow…
But they just followed; they wouldn’t do anything else.
“You make it sound like some sort of toad…” Colin muttered.
“Yes, pretty much, but as far as I remember, they are not a threat…” Ashen Holy Body had only gotten halfway through his sentence
when Orange Cat seemed to remember something and promptly cut him off:
“They are a threat! I remember now, their corresponding locations are similar to those windows that lit up when we first entered on the first level. If you can recall those, we can avoid them…”
“Also, they don’t just follow; they will attack.”
“If anyone in our group becomes unconscious, that’s when you’ll see them make their move…”
“So, the trigger for their attacks is someone falling into unconsciousness or something similar?” Ashen Holy Body caught on to the key point.
“Right…”
“Wait, that patient Brother Shunzi is dragging…” Ashen Holy Body glanced at the person in Brother Shunzi’s hands.
Orange Cat was taken aback, recalling that the man was currently unconscious. Hesitantly guessing, it said:
“Perhaps it’s because he’s a hospital patient, considered one of their own?”
“Perhaps, but it’s not important…”
Colin ended the conjecture, feeling through Bonfire that behind that metal sliding door, amidst the dense stink, twisted figures seemed to be peering at them from the shadows.
From the darkness, the sticky sound of a dense liquid, perhaps blood or some other thick fluid, hitting the floor could be heard.
In his perception, those shadowy figures certainly seemed to be only secretly observing them, showing no interest in the “Psychotic” in Colin’s hand.
‘However, speaking of it, if unconsciousness triggers an attack, does sleeping count?’ Colin couldn’t help but wonder if those creatures would come for them when they ventured deeper into the hospital.
If there was a risk, they would need to deal with it.
“Can we kill them?” he asked.
Orange Cat shook its head: “No use, they can’t be destroyed. Even if we kill them, they’ll reappear from where they came and continue their pursuit until the person wakes up or is completely dead…”
While the two were exchanging thoughts, Colin also noticed another key detail in the dialogue: “Are you saying, after being killed, they will emerge again from the same place?”
“Yes…”
“Then there should be a way to deal with them.”
Colin thought for a moment, took out a piece of Third Level Containment Subject turned into new energy carbon from his pocket, and casually threw it into the metal door.
“Boom!” In a vibration, the room was momentarily engulfed in flames.
“Ahhh!!” The heart-wrenching screams rose but ceased within seconds.
“This fire will last quite a while. If they only resurrect from their original location, then this should resolve this issue… Let’s move. If you see anything problematic along the way, let me know.” After finishing his sentence, Colin resumed his march, not wasting another second on these creatures.
“Wow, that’s some assertive action…”
Seeing Brother Shunzi’s tactic, both were clearly taken aback—
What they had been contemplating was how to avoid confrontation, yet Brother Shunzi had simply blocked the spawning points and eliminated them. This was a path they had never considered.
After a moment of reflecting on how the mindset of the powerful differed from their own, they hurried to catch up.
After about ten more minutes of trek, Colin had blocked off several wards, departments, and even buildings, until at last, they saw the psychiatric ward buildings located further back.
From here on, the once distant and ethereal cries became more “real”.

chapters.title: Chapter 752 - 752 536 Terror Strikes_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 752: Chapter 536: Terror Strikes!_2 Chapter 752: Chapter 536: Terror Strikes!_2 The sense of absurdity in the air grew dense with a sinister and bizarre atmosphere…
Just a simple observation after walking into it, even Colin instantly felt a sensation of heaviness in his head and lightness in his feet…
It seemed as if the various functions of his brain had been impacted to some extent.
So much so that the muscle control throughout his body had become noticeably uncoordinated.
“Hmph.”
Colin grunted softly, the bonfire erupted, dissolving and destroying all that strange mental shock.
Then, under the radiation of the bonfire light, he felt the presence of some hard-to-see “shadows” around him, somewhat similar in form to the shadows on the “Train in the Fog,” but essentially different…
However, at present, the problem was not significant, within the domain of the light, these things could not yet pose a hindrance.
Following the musty-smelling, moldy patches on the staircase all the way up, he arrived at the third floor, and at the end of the corridor, he saw the room labeled “701.”
After pushing open the door, Colin first saw a small area that seemed to be a consultation room, with a desk, several chairs, and a small refrigerator apparently used for storing medicines.
Outside this area, separated by dividers, were five white cloth beds arranged in a row…
Aside from the faint but unavoidable stench of decay that hit him head-on.
The place could be described as clean and tidy.
Colin glanced briefly around, and after making sure there was no danger, he stepped in and covered the entire room with flame, carefully inspecting every corner.
Then, he reached out to the small refrigerator wanting to take a look, but found it was locked.
Yet the lock wasn’t very secure, making little difference to him, and after burning the lock core directly, Colin easily opened it and found some medicines inside.
And, after analysis by the Little Maid, he learned the composition of these medicines…
“Cyanide?”
Colin’s eyebrows lifted as he examined the medicine in his hand. What’s this doing in a psychiatric ward?
Although he could definitely say he was in the dark about most drug names, he was quite familiar with this one, after all, friends who had received capital punishment and been executed by injection knew, this stuff is highly toxic, usually used for euthanasia…
And its presence in a psych ward is clearly unreasonable. It can’t be that they resort to euthanasia when they can’t treat a patient, right?
In his confusion, some text suddenly floated up from the medicine…
[“Cyanide Injection O-3 Type”: Created from living beings suffering from severe paranoid schizophrenia after luring and suggestive prompting, along with special methods, are fantasy-manufactured medical products…]
“Applicable Conditions”: Once injected, it will not cause any damage to the organism itself, but can precisely erase the consciousness of common Third-Level and lower containment subjects.
“Usage Example 1”: After a shapeless demon was successfully modeled into human form, but its humanity turned chaotic and negative, verified as a failed construct, after approval by multiple departments, its identity and all basic rights were stripped, and after all procedures were prepared, it was injected with “O-3” Injection.
Its more negative consciousness and cognition were erased, retaining only a small portion of benign consciousness aggregates. With the help of “Flame Bearer,” it grew and ultimately reformed its cognition, being reborn and becoming a noble and honorable defender of humanity.
“Usage Example 2…”
“…”
“Note”: The use of this medicine requires approval and stamped documents from nine relevant departments, and any missing part makes the injection ineffective even if administered…
“Special Usage Cases”: In special situations, it can be authorized for a single emergency use by three or more Positive C Levels, or one “Flame Bearer,” or a B Level Employee.
…
“A medical product specifically for erasing failed human cognition, nothing too special for Third Level and below…”
Colin was taken aback for a moment. He wasn’t surprised by the effect, as many other means and extraordinary methods could achieve cognition modification.
But this specialized “medical product” was a first for him.
At this moment, as he looked at the item in his hand, his gaze sharpened, realizing that his guess about the hospital’s purpose might have been wrong.
This hospital might not have been built for curing diseases at all, but more likely for producing medicines…
And the raw materials for the drugs were probably these people, no, living beings, with some kind of paranoid delusion.
However, exactly what kind of living beings was yet to be known…
Of course, it could also be considered a place for curing diseases, only that it doubled as a drug production facility.
“But no matter how you look at it, the company is still as unscrupulous as ever…”
Colin shook his head, took a glance at the four or five injectors, and his body honestly pocketed them all.
Although he wasn’t a Firebearer yet, nor could he find the so-called three “Positive C Levels,” there was a chance to be granted the right to use them through “Lady Rabbit,” and who knows when they might come in handy.
After putting everything away, he looked around and began to make “preparation before bed.”
“In a bit, Ashen Holy Body will join me in sleep and we’ll enter the hospital ward behind. Orange Cat will guard this floor, ensuring there are no accidents with our bodies, and if there is no other choice, wake us.”
Upon hearing this, Orange Cat was about to object, claiming the challenge was too great, but Colin continued:
“Don’t worry, I’ll leave some preparations here, starting with this ‘Bonfire Mark’ which you can use. Its effects include a basic stand-in and enable you to use a small-scale one-time ‘Wildfire Addition’…”
Colin had created three such marks in total, each even containing “Flame Bearer’s Grease,” at a high cost…

chapters.title: Chapter 753 - 753 536 Terror Strikes_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 753: Chapter 536: Terror Strikes!_3 Chapter 753: Chapter 536: Terror Strikes!_3 Otherwise, this was originally meant for the people around me, and ordinary employees who don’t light the flame with “Flame Bearer’s Grease” but directly use “Wildfire Addition” would be burned to death by the “Wildfire”; there’s no helping the high cost…
“‘Wildfire Addition’?”
Orange Cat looked confused, not quite clear what that was, but as soon as he took a look at the mark’s effect, he blurted out “Holy shit.”
If this thing is used, it’s practically like a damn cheat!
If I can take it back safely this time, won’t I basically have a temporary hack?
“If nothing happens, can I…?”
“Yes, consider it a reward, but…”
Colin saw right through the kid’s thoughts: “Remember, use it straight away if there’s serious trouble, don’t hesitate.”
“Okay.” Orange Cat, feeling the almost imperceptible yet terrifying pressure, quickly nodded his head.
“For the specific timing of use, if you’re not sure, you can listen to my maid’s…”
As they were speaking, the two saw a maid with cat ears suddenly materialize in the air, her delicate face indifferent.
At the same time, Colin took out a piece of Level 2 Containment Subject-made “Kindling” and lit up a bonfire point.
The bright orange-red flames instantly covered the entire room…
Then, Colin pulled out Shana’s specially made “Sun Mark,” and as his thoughts moved, layers of light began to seal the room with a certain isolation.
“Brother Shunzi sure has a lot of tricks up his sleeve, feels like they never run out…”
Standing to the side and watching Colin take out one item after another, a couple of people couldn’t help but click their tongues in amazement.
Finally, after setting everything up that could be set up, Colin turned to him and said:
“Holding the mark, you can control the power of this bonfire to a certain extent. If that’s still not enough, and the defenses are breached, and you feel you can’t hold on, then awaken me…”
Colin felt that such a forceful awakening might have negative effects on the mental state.
But when that time comes, there’s no concern for those minor aftereffects.
After all, with the measures currently in place, even a Level 2 Containment Subject should be held off for a considerable amount of time. If that still isn’t enough, then he’d have to take care of it himself…
Otherwise, if a Level 2 Containment Subject directly attacks his body, he wouldn’t survive.
‘It’s a pity I don’t have a split body like Shana; otherwise, sending a clone would be no risk at all,’ Colin thought with a sigh.
“Okay.” Orange Cat nodded his head.
After checking over everything once more and making sure there were no mistakes, Colin tied up the “Psychotic” and tossed him aside, then lay down on any available bed.
Realizing the situation, Ashen Holy Body didn’t delay either and also lay down somewhere.
As elite employees of the company, be it Colin or Ashen Holy Body, it was easy for them to voluntarily immerse themselves into a dream state.
Soon, the room quieted down…
Seeing this, Orange Cat grew a bit nervous inside. He glanced at the Little Maid standing by Colin’s sickbed, wanting to say something to ease the atmosphere, but seeing her indifferent look, he ultimately kept silent to avoid making a fool of himself.
However, the wait wasn’t even seconds long when Orange Cat suddenly felt a chill creeping up on him…
An unexpected event!
“Thud, thud, thud…”
A heavy, oppressive thumping noise suddenly emanated from downstairs, as if something was knocking at the door.
Holding the “Bonfire Mark,” Orange Cat, through the connection to the bonfire, had vague images appearing in his mind…
In the first-floor elevator, a figure in patient clothes with rotting flesh and a strong stench of decay stood rigidly, repeatedly banging its own head against the elevator door, indenting it over and over as if trying to break out.
And farther away, a thick, inky darkness spread closer…
Within the darkness, outlines of dead and eerie figures were slowly approaching.
Terror was encroaching!
“Hiss, it’s coming so fast…”
Even within the bonfire’s safety, Orange Cat felt a bone-chilling cold enveloping him.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 754 - 754 537 Real or Fake Innate Ashen Holy Body_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 754: Chapter 537: Real or Fake “Innate Ashen Holy Body”?_1 Chapter 754: Chapter 537: Real or Fake “Innate Ashen Holy Body”?_1 “Huh…”
What made Orange Cat release a sigh of relief was the indescribable sense of dimness that finally stopped outside the firelight, where all the figures also halted.
However, before he could fully catch his breath, he saw an elder’s death-stained hand stretch into the firelight from the darkness.
The next second, a sizzling sound arose as the elder’s palm was instantly charred and cracked, oozing oil.
After a low growl-like scream, the shadowy figure in the dimness jerked back its hand.
“Huh…”
Orange Cat’s held breath was slowly released once more.
But…
As more and more figures gathered around the hospital due to the firelight, the indescribably cold feeling in Orange Cat’s heart intensified again.
Glancing at the other side, the loyal maid stood by Brother Shunzi’s side without any intention to move.
As for what methods this person had, Orange Cat had no idea.
But a strong intuitive premonition told him that this seemingly motionless robot-like being was definitely not a weakling.
In fact, if a conflict arose, it was very likely that he would be the one to die!
“Sigh, I hope this can be over quickly. If there’s any problem, I’m really not sure if I can handle it…”
Orange Cat sighed with trepidation.
Right now, he felt that he was not facing a few anomalies, or a dozen anomalies, but rather the hospital itself… It was unclear whether it was a “will” or something else.
…
Meanwhile, after Colin closed his eyes, he soon fell into a stable sleep.
But even in his dreams, he could still clearly sense his own consciousness, similar to what is commonly known as a “lucid dream.”
“It feels like I’m about to wake up, no, it’s more like moving to another place…”
Colin made a frowning motion.
He knew that once he opened his eyes, he should be able to safely reach the seventh floor.
But he strangely found that he couldn’t open his eyes!
‘What’s happening? Who’s stopping me?’ As Colin’s thoughts raced, he sensed that something unexpected had happened.
At that moment, in the dream-conscious world, glowing fog began to emerge…
Everything was engulfed in thick fog.
Something had invaded his dream world!
“Boom!”
Flames erupted from Colin’s conscious form, protecting him.
‘Fortunately, in this situation, the power of the Bonfire can still be used.’
As Colin silently released a sigh of relief, his conscious gaze focused on the deep depths of the fog before him…
Although he couldn’t see anything, a strong intuition told him there must be something there.
“What is this?”
In his confusion, Colin suddenly heard whispers emanating from deep within the fog.
Initially, they were very vague, faint, like the buzzing of mosquitoes, inexplicably irritating, but as he concentrated, the sounds gradually became clearer…
“Help me, help me, help me…”
A plea for help?
Colin was momentarily stunned, then he tried to communicate, “Who are you?”
Although it wasn’t clear where the voice came from, there was a high probability it was related to something in the hospital, so it was worth a try to see if he could glean any information in advance.
“Help me, help…”
“What do you want me to help you with?”
“Help me, help me…”
“…”
“Help you…”
Colin stopped the inexplicable urge to curse, pursed his lips, and gave up the thought of communicating with it.
It seemed that this thing couldn’t be communicated with.
However, the other party’s plea for help… he couldn’t help but think of the older brother in the company’s internal group.
He wondered if there was any connection…
“Help me, help me…” the whispering continued over and over.
But due to some barrier, communication was simply impossible…
‘If you can’t get help, then just wait to die.’
Colin didn’t continue to waste time on this thing. With a thought, flames burst forth from his body, spreading in all directions, forcibly separating himself from this place.
The next instant, Colin opened his eyes and saw a room that was both familiar and unfamiliar.
He was still lying on the hospital bed, but everything around him had become very distorted, like a painting that had been subjected to heat, melting at any moment…
The dark red shadows that he had seen on the fourth floor had now taken on a three-dimensional form when viewed again on this floor, revealing eerie outlines.
And they seemed to emit an indescribable malice…
At this moment, possibly because of the dream about the dense fog, his mind was somewhat muddled and unclear.
“Brother Shunzi, are you awake?”
A somewhat surprised voice came from the side. Colin turned to look, saw the Ashen Holy Body watching the door, and spoke.
This posture was somewhat strange…
Following the gaze toward the door, Colin’s eyebrows raised as he saw a face without features, dripping with flesh, staring inside through the observation window in the hospital room door.
The skinless face looked ferocious and terrifying. The two rows of teeth exposed to the air snapped continuously, as though making an inaudible sound, and the bloodshot eyeballs were fixedly staring at everything in the room.
And it seemed that upon noticing Colin’s gaze, the skinless head suddenly began to slam forcefully against the door.
“Bang bang bang,” the sound kept coming through the door, echoing in the empty corridor and rattling the nerves…
“What the hell is that?”
Colin exclaimed in surprise, feeling an inexplicable familiarity from the bloody facade.
It was as if he had seen the figure before…
And as he turned to look at the bizarre thing outside the door, he inexplicably felt a sense of danger emanating from behind him.
Instinctively turning around, he saw the Ashen Holy Body was also focusing on the outside, and rapidly said:
“Just now, when I woke up and didn’t see you, I went out to look for you, and got entangled with this thing. It seems like an anomaly, we need to deal with it quickly…”

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - 755 537 The Real or Fake Innate Ashen Holy
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 755: Chapter 537: The Real or Fake “Innate Ashen Holy Body”?_2 Chapter 755: Chapter 537: The Real or Fake “Innate Ashen Holy Body”?_2 His voice suddenly cut off, as if someone had choked him.
The Ashen Holy Body’s face froze, realizing that Colin had appeared beside him at some point, hand gripping his throat.
Colin yanked hard, single-handedly throwing the man down with a “thud” onto the ground, then continued to squeeze his throat while pressing his knee into the man’s chest.
The Ashen Holy Body, subdued by the American-style restraint, tried to resist, but found himself completely overwhelmed, only able to howl in frustration:
“What’s going on, Brother Shunzi, have you gone mad?!”
“You’re putting on quite the act. Let’s see what you really are.”
Having said that, Colin reached out and pinched the face of the “Innate Ashen Holy Body” in front of him, and sure enough, skin and flesh separated easily. His nails caught the man’s chin, and with a forceful tear, the whole face was ripped off.
And what Colin saw behind, made him pause for a second—it looked like a wooden mannequin?
The surface of the wooden mannequin was engraved with various meridian and acupoint diagrams, which looked very much like props commonly found in traditional Chinese medicine clinics…
“Ah, my face, it hurts so much, have you gone mad?!” the wooden mannequin screamed in horror, extending wooden arms and exerting terrifying strength, trying to snatch back its face, scalp included.
Colin kicked it away with one boot but didn’t deliver a killing blow.
He was a bit unsure whether killing this thing would affect the real Ashen Holy Body…
‘What’s going on here? How come upon waking up, the Ashen Holy Body seems possessed…’
Colin stood to one side, holding the limp, dripping ‘genuine leather’ face mask, observing the wooden mannequin and pondering the mechanism behind this anomaly.
“That thing outside is the real person?” Colin thought for a moment, feeling that the face mask in his hands seemed to match up.
But before he could go open the door to let someone in and verify it, he saw the wooden mannequin, stripped of its real flesh mask, shaking off the flames that bound it and rising to launch an attack, but then it suddenly stiffened upon seeing something.
Colin followed its gaze and found there was a mirror…
“How is that possible? My, my face, why is it made of wood! That’s impossible! Ah, my hands, how did my hands turn to wood too!”
The wooden mannequin, missing its real skin mask, groped its face in panic, sensing something wrong. But as it felt along, it discovered even its hands were off.
“Ah! No, this isn’t my body, you’ve cursed me! Give it back! Change my body back! Give it back to me…”
“You’re not Brother Shunzi! You’re a fake, a fake! You damn thing, change me back! Change back!”
The wooden mannequin seemed unable to accept its own appearance, suddenly shouting and screaming in a frenzied state, rushing towards Colin with “a face” full of ferocity.
Just halfway through the charge, a giant flaming hand grasped it.
Colin turned his head, glanced at the door, and beckoned with a hand. A surge of flames burst forth, blowing the door open.
The person whose skin had been peeled off from the collarbone upwards rushed in. He opened his mouth wanting to speak, but no voice came out; he then pointed at the face mask in Colin’s hands, seemingly hinting at something.
“Don’t worry yet.”
After taking a look, Colin produced a seal and spoke, “Fire Tree.”
Following that, a large tree of fire emerged as a silhouette behind Colin, and upon its trunk, an elder’s face appeared, lowering its head and responding with apparent loyalty:
“I am here.”
“Can you handle this?” Colin pointed at the bloody person, attempting to communicate.
Despite what had happened to him, the response given by Bonfire’s perception confirmed the person, indeed, was the Ashen Holy Body.
“He’s been hit by some curses, stripped of some flesh and functionality…”
“Can he be restored?”
“Yes, though it involves some high-level trait abilities, the application is very low-level. Just press the stolen flesh back and resolve the source of contamination, and it should be fine.”
“Alright, then start.”
Colin handed over what he held to Fire Tree, which claimed to have a senior practitioner’s license from “Bonfire”.
The ‘Fire Tree’s roots, like hands, took the dripping face mask, spread it open for comparison, and then various tendrils rolled up to fit the Ashen Holy Body’s face back on, while fine branches began detailed stitching treatments…
If a maid did this kind of stitching work, the results would be very good, but unfortunately, she seemed not to be around.
During the manipulation, the puppet, suppressed by the Wildfire, struggled furiously, shouting:
“Give it back to me! You damned abnormalities! When Brother Shunzi comes, you’re all going to die! All of you, ah!!”
“You can’t fool him! You bunch of damn heretics and sinners!”
…
‘How is it that this anomaly truly thinks itself the real person?’
Listening to this thing’s words, Colin couldn’t help feeling a sense of absurdity.
Honestly, without the existence of “Flame Bearer” powers, it would have been difficult to discern who was who at first. Even at this moment, if it wasn’t for the reflection of the “Bonfire”, he might have doubted whether the real Ashen Holy Body had his identity usurped and turned into the wooden mannequin…
As the Ashen Holy Body’s body began to heal, the wooden man with blood and meridian and acupoint marks on his body became increasingly hoarse, eventually disappearing.
The things that had been stolen began to return.
Once everything concluded and Colin confirmed from Fire Tree there were no issues, he incinerated it to ashes without leaving any remains.
“Phew, Brother Shunzi, thank you…” the significantly recovered Ashen Holy Body said with lingering fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - 756 537 Real or Fake Innate Ashen Holy Body_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 756: Chapter 537: Real or Fake “Innate Ashen Holy Body”?_3 Chapter 756: Chapter 537: Real or Fake “Innate Ashen Holy Body”?_3 To be honest, when he was locked outside the door and saw the wooden figure peel off an entire scalp and, upon wearing it, became an exact replica of himself and started conversing with Brother Shunzi, he truly broke out in a cold sweat from the bottom of his heart.
Even he couldn’t distinguish the real from the fake within, let alone Shunzi, with whom he hadn’t even cooperated for three hours.
Fortunately, Brother Shunzi wasn’t fooled…
“Actually, there’s nothing to worry about. It just looks a lot like me, even without the bonfire, I should be able to tell the real from the fake through the smell of the ‘Beast Transformation Syndrome’… Yeah, tell me what happened.”
Colin waved his hand, signaling to get to the point.
Soon, through the narrative of the Ashen Holy Body, he figured out exactly what had happened.
About half an hour earlier, when the Ashen Holy Body woke up, he found himself alone in the room, without Colin appearing.
At first, he could wait a bit, but as more time passed, being alone in this godforsaken place…
His mind started to wander, and he could not remain calm, so he decided to go out and look for Colin; but not long after he left the room, he encountered some bizarre wanderings, and while dodging, he ran into a dark traditional Chinese medicine office that seemed safe at a glance.
And he just happened to hide under a wooden mannequin…
“That thing touched my scalp with its hand, and I blacked out for a while. When I came to, it had torn off my whole scalp and wore it on itself, and then it turned into me…”
“After that, it wanted to attack, but I blocked it, and we were at a stalemate.”
“But then it suddenly ran off, and I followed it all the way back to the room where I first appeared, and then I saw you, Brother Shunzi, coming. It must have been planning to attack you…”
The Ashen Holy Body recounted his ordeal of despair. Although his face was a bit misaligned due to the recent stitching, it still showed deep terror.
If it weren’t for Shunzi, he didn’t even want to imagine what would have happened to himself.
“It wasn’t an attack, it wanted to continue stripping away your social relationships in reality, to truly replace you…” The Fire Tree spoke up, negating what the Ashen Holy Body had just said.
Upon hearing this, the Ashen Holy Body hissed in shock, not having expected the creature to be so vicious.
Not only had it stolen his face, it wanted to take away everything else as well…
“But actually, it makes no difference. If you were an ordinary person, it might indeed take everything from you, but as a company employee… it can’t possibly take your company identity. Even higher beings can’t do that because it’s directly certified by ‘the agreement.’ If it really managed to do that, we wouldn’t be worrying about something as trivial as losing identity…” The Fire Tree confidently stated.
“All right, since there’s no problem now, none of this is particularly important. So, you mean, I appeared about half an hour after you?”
Colin interrupted the Fire Tree and then looked toward the Ashen Holy Body, knowing his late arrival was likely caused by the sudden ‘dense fog dream.’
“Yes.” After getting a response, Colin thought for a moment and continued to ask if the other had experienced a similar dream.“I didn’t have such a dream…”
The Ashen Holy Body immediately shook his head to indicate he wasn’t sure. He had woken up here and felt strange in his body, a sense of unreality that was both unreal and seemingly real, hard to distinguish.
At least the pain from the scalp being ripped off felt unmistakably sharp…
Now his head was still buzzing, and under the skin of his face, it was both itchy and painful.
“It should be the company’s doing, I don’t understand the specifics. But our real bodies are still on the fourth layer,” Colin answered briefly after a quick sense check.
“Still on the fourth layer? Then…”
Seeing that the Ashen Holy Body relaxed somewhat, Colin interrupted and cautioned, “Of course, although we’re not our true bodies here, it’s best not to have an accident. Even if it’s not fatal, it would still result in serious negative consequences.”
Pausing for a moment, Colin clapped his hands. “Okay, we’ve delayed long enough. Let’s go to the consultation hall now and check out the rules.”
“Yeah…” The Ashen Holy Body nodded, having no objections.
Having reached the seventh level, the useful knowledge he could provide was limited. After all, during their initial exploration, they had pretty much crashed on this level…
All he could do was follow Brother Shunzi and see if there was a chance to see his former teammates again.
But just as the two were preparing to move, Colin suddenly paused and looked towards a corner of the room.
He noticed that the “Psychotic” who was tied up on the fourth floor was also in this room…
.

chapters.title: Chapter 757 - 757 538 The Mutated Female Employee_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 757: Chapter 538: The Mutated Female Employee!_1 Chapter 757: Chapter 538: The Mutated Female Employee!_1 “This guy… actually followed us?”
Colin raised an eyebrow, slightly surprised, yet it wasn’t that strange.
After all, in that room, as long as one fell asleep, one could cross over to the next level, but he hadn’t expected that it seemed not necessary to lie down on the bed…
Hm? Colin suddenly noticed something wasn’t right, he extended his hand and cast out a streak of flame, enveloping the other party.
“This fellow, is the actual body descending…”
After a bit of checking, Colin confirmed this point.
However, the mission didn’t seem to mention how to deal with this thing.
He was somewhat unsure whether to bring it along…
“How did this cursed thing follow us?” the Ashen Holy Body by his side noticed the direction Colin was looking at and, turning to look, also revealed a surprised expression.
“Do you now recall seeing this situation in the hospital?”
Colin asked again, but the Ashen Holy Body still shook his head, indicating he hadn’t seen any “mental patients.”
Moreover, he had no impression at all, meaning he hadn’t come across it in his previous visits.
“Could it be that ‘Lady Rabbit’ behind the mission did some negotiating, got in touch with someone?”
Colin felt there might be some deal going on behind the scenes.
After thinking it over, he asked the Ashen Holy Body to carry the person to avoid the possibility of running out of the one thousand milliliters of blood later on; they might need to draw a little more from this individual.
Afterward, Colin went to the door of the ward that had been closed again and kicked it open with one foot.
Outside the door was an ominously dark expanse, and the air was filled with an ineffable stench, like a mixture of mold, blood, rotting flesh, disinfectant, formaldehyde, and some unknown excrements…
Colin took a whiff of it and, thanks to the super-enhanced sense of smell granted by “Beast Transformation Syndrome,” analyzed it for a bit.
“Still within manageable range.”
Having confirmed this, Colin didn’t delay any longer and walked out with the Ashen Holy Body.
In the gloomy, sinister corridor, the incandescent lights fizzed, flickering frequently as if they were short-circuiting…
Piercing and penetrating cries of anguish seemed to float from nowhere, causing one’s scalp to tingle.
Having just exited the building, Colin saw that all around, shadows like balloons were slowly drifting towards this place, not just a few or a dozen, but a large mass, dense and filling every space.
“Ah! It hurts! It hurts so much…”
A cluster of balloon shadows entered the range of direct flame, suddenly let out a scream, fell from mid-air with a smack, and then frantically thrashed about on the ground — a small boy’s head!
“Sss, balloons made from human heads?” The sight of the full form of the thing gave the Ashen Holy Body an inexplicable thrill of horror.
This head looked just like that of a normal person, but below the neck, it was sewn with surgical string like centipedes, trailing a black string that seemed to be the surgical thread, floating in the air.
Screaming while floating!
The Ashen Holy Body suddenly realized something: “The screams from the earlier floors were emitted by these heads. To avoid them, it’s best not to look at them, block out the hearing, etc., and reduce contact as much as possible…”
Mid-sentence, he suddenly came to a realization and looked at the sky, at those head monsters repelled by the flames.
Seems like with Brother Shunzi, there’s no need to scurry like himself and others did before…
“No big deal, now let’s head to the clinic hall…”
Finishing his thought, Colin stepped forward and asked:
“What was the big trouble that dispersed your team before?”
A threat that could scatter a D Level team was still worth understanding.
If it was just some entities with stronger physical forms, then it was no big issue. But he feared something with rules…
Those rule-based things, even Colin could only try to abide by them and not dare overstep lightly.
“Still can’t remember, it happened on the eighth floor, I think…” the Ashen Holy Body said uncertainly, feeling there was something else in his mind, but it was still very vague.
Based on previous experience, that should indicate an area they hadn’t reached yet.
Otherwise, he would have had an “evoked memory” and remembered everything.
On their way, Colin could sense that in the darkness outside of the firelight, a significant number of uncanny things silently followed them…
Occasionally some would cross the line, attempting to attack, but the result was being directly incinerated into ash by the flames.
Then there was a period of overall quiet…
‘Rare demonstration of a certain level of intelligence, but seeing the power of ‘Bonfire’ and not fleeing, even acting tough and charging at it, is abnormal…’
Colin made a simple assessment in his mind.
At that moment, he was somewhat thankful that his own strength was sufficient; if it had been during his E level or F level days when he was sent here…
This mission, regardless of anything else, would definitely have maxed out the horror atmosphere!
However, speaking of which, the abnormalities here seemed to operate with certain rules…
As long as he could figure out these rules and prepare carefully, it wasn’t impossible to carry out the mission.
Furthermore, if he could fully understand the habits of these strange beings, it might even be possible to guide them into fighting amongst themselves, thereby seizing opportunities.
As Colin walked along, he saw a human-shaped anomaly wearing a security uniform that seemed to attack anything that approached it…
“This damned place, even if it’s not out of control, is no good.”
Colin shook his head in thought.
About half an hour later, he quickly returned with the Ashen Holy Body.
During the journey, aside from encountering a few Chinese medicine Puppet People blocking the way for a bit and being hindered by a nursery rhyme that resembled a choral sound upon reaching a certain area, the entire journey was uneventful.

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - 758 538 The Female Employee Who Changed_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 758: Chapter 538: The Female Employee Who Changed!_2 Chapter 758: Chapter 538: The Female Employee Who Changed!_2 Before long, Colin and his companion had passed through the numerous hospital buildings and finally returned to the “Outpatient Department.”
No sooner had they entered than the Ashen Holy Body’s breath hitched at the sight of the reception area in the center of the lobby. The previous front desk had transformed into a huge, over two-meter-tall beach umbrella wedged into the ground.
This was a company prop belonging to a colleague!
Under the umbrella hung the corpse of a woman who had been suspended for who knows how long, her head tilted to one side, her skin an appalling pale…
The Ashen Holy Body opened his mouth but didn’t know what to say, his last bit of hope evaporating.
Ignoring his emotions, Colin stepped into the lobby of the Outpatient Department, glancing briefly at the female employee’s corpse.
The body was relatively clean, lacking any typical signs of incontinence associated with hanging…
But the corpse wasn’t the focus. Colin’s gaze shifted past her, landing on the oversized LED screen not far behind her.
The LED screen, flickering with a blood-like glow, showed that apart from the guiding message, all subsequent content had changed.
“1. This hospital does not contain anything that defies common sense. If encountered, do not overthink to avoid coming into contact with things that should not appear. Moreover, if you come across anomalies, please look for a nearby sign. If a sign is present, follow the sign’s instructions. If no sign is available, and escaping is impossible, immediately call for a doctor or nurse who will arrive on the scene to aid you, trustworthy…”
“2. I’m “coming” out now, you come find me, I’ve been calling you, it’s fine if you come kill me, I beg, hurry, I can’t hold on much longer…”
“Help…me! Help me! Quick…help…get out…”
…
“Huh? The second item turned into gibberish this time?”
Of the three items, Colin’s attention was immediately drawn to the array of strange characters.
Unable to interpret it, he didn’t dwell on it and directly moved on to the third item.
“Help me? The line from the dream?”
Colin quickly linked this message with those from his dream.
He felt it must be coming from the same entity…
“Could the one altering the rules be Brother Unyielding from the parchment?”
Colin felt there was a possibility, but he didn’t know what the situation with that fellow currently was.
Additionally, the ultimate demand for this visit still had not appeared. It was unclear whether there would be a connection with that entity, or on the other hand, whether their smooth access thus far had involved its helping hand.
“Troublesome…”
Colin shook his head and looked back at the first item.
“Look for a sign, like the ones we passed before, the ‘no smoking’ or ‘the hospital is unattended, if singing is heard, stay away’ sort of thing?”
Colin thought for a moment. He remembered seeing some signs when they passed by, but since the threats weren’t too severe, he hadn’t cared much.
However, the signs were deep with meaning and hard to find, and there was more than one anomaly in each area…
They weren’t particularly reliable either.
As for the doctors and nurses…
They said the first level was fully automated with no actual doctors or nurses, but now they suddenly claimed they exist and are reliable.
Colin pursed his lips, unsure if they were saying reliability was confined to this level or something else…
A wrong choice could be fatal for a low-level employee!
“This damned place seems fit only for ‘Destiny Propeller’ to come, using extraordinary abilities to deduce whether these rules are correct or not, to seek other paths. Without enough strength, you’re doomed.”
Of course, the foresight of “Destiny Propeller” wasn’t omnipotent; misuse could lead to direct contact with deeper horrors.
And that kind of death would likely be quite gruesome…
It was just after reviewing all three rules that a new event promptly emerged.
[Event Three: Proceed to the morgue, randomly select a mortuary chamber with a corpse inside, pass through the chamber to reach the tenth floor, and on that level, seek to hand over the “Psychotic” to the “Red-Robed Nurse,” ensuring they are put into the emergency room, and inject “Psychotic Madman Blood Extract” into yourself as the emergency light comes on, sinking into the next layer…]
“Note 1”: No need to leave anyone behind…
…
“The task contains a lot, but this… finding a morgue bay and lying in it to go deeper? Damn, who came up with this hospital’s method of delving deeper?”
“Why is it all so abstract…”
“Hiss, in the end, I couldn’t avoid this ‘Psychotic Madman Blood Extract’…”
Colin opened his mouth, feeling that his previous relief had been in vain.
However, his body, in essence, wasn’t his own, so there was nothing much to worry about. Even if it were his physical body…
The addition or absence of something wasn’t that big of a deal.
After all, with a multitude of things inside him, even if this substance were to enter, and were not neutralized by “Bonfire,” it would be devoured directly by “Hunger” or the Ancient God level “Beast Transformation Syndrome”…
“It seems that cultivating gu in the body does have its benefits.”
Colin laughed at himself silently in his heart.
Then, he withdrew his gaze, just as he was about to turn and leave, he heard the weak voice of the Ashen Holy Body:
“She was clearly alive when we were on the first floor…”
“Eh?”
Colin was taken aback for a moment before he realized that the Ashen Holy Body was referring to the deceased female employee in the middle of the lobby.
It seemed that she had a relatively good relationship with him, otherwise, he wouldn’t sound so disheartened…
As for what the other party said…
“It might have something to do with the special nature of this hospital,” Colin spoke.
Based on his conjecture, the deeper aspects would project to the surface, and the appearance of the hung corpse on the first floor might be because they subconsciously believed there should be a receptionist at the front desk…
So, essentially a hanging corpse, when projected, became a receptionist—
The kind that could even speak.
However, speaking of which…
“She didn’t die very thoroughly.”
As Colin contemplated, he noticed the female employee’s corpse swaying slightly, and the noose was slackened, its mouth with the tongue protruding, and the jawbone moving with barely noticeable motions…
But the scene seemed to indicate that she chose to hang herself rather than being forced by an anomaly?
Because she couldn’t escape, so she chose death?
“Brother Shunzi, could you take care of her body later?” Ashen Holy Body asked.
“I should be able to, but right now…”
Colin did not refuse, for the task did not specify the need to recover the body nor how to dispose of it. Still, after all, they were colleagues; leaving her body exposed to the elements didn’t seem right.
Without saying much, doing a small favor was still possible.
After all, helping with cremation brings lingering fragrance to the hands.
With a flick of his finger, Colin sent sparks flying for miles, instantly burning both the peculiar parasol prop and the body underneath it.
In the flames, the ghastly white skin of the corpse slowly dried and disappeared…
In comparison to the monstrous creatures consumed by fire becoming charred and hideous, Colin gave her a dignified end.
However, just a few seconds into burning the body, as the water from the corpse slowly evaporated, Colin prepared to reduce her to ashes in an instant after she was completely dried.
But at that moment, Colin suddenly had a premonition, and his actions came to a halt.
Then, he saw the shrunken eyeballs of the female employee’s corpse suddenly move and look towards him.
“I didn’t just burn her alive, did I?” Colin was stunned.
To be honest, the feel of it right now seemed a bit off?
At that moment, the dried flesh of the female employee’s mouth, clinging to her jawbones, opened and closed slightly, emitting a voice as fine as a mosquito or fly.
“Run… I saw it… It’s right there, beside you… all the time… Do not, trust its messages…”
Hearing this, not only did Ashen Holy Body feel chills, but even Colin felt a cold shroud enveloping him.
Was there something that had followed them the whole way?
Colin found it hard to believe, but after the other party spoke those words, a strong premonition pierced through the veil, puncturing something—
Indeed, something seemed to have been following him all along!
However, before he could attempt to understand the specific nature of the thing following him.
The female employee suddenly seemed like a different person:
“Save me, save me, help me, please help, no, no, don’t…”
She seemed to be struggling against something, her eyes filled with a plea as she looked at Colin.
Colin understood, and with a gesture, the flames engulfed her, completely incinerating her. However, after the flames vanished, his eyebrows twitched as he saw the female employee’s corpse reappear…
This was not the source!
“Help me, help…” As the plaintive words echoed repeatedly, the atmosphere of the entire place took a sinister turn.
A strong intuition told Colin that staying here any longer would most likely lead to very troublesome problems!
“Let’s go.” Without any further delay, Colin grabbed Ashen Holy Body and fled outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - 759 539 The Night Red Moon and Primordial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 759: Chapter 539 The Night, Red Moon, and Primordial Fire!_1 Chapter 759: Chapter 539 The Night, Red Moon, and Primordial Fire!_1 The female employee’s corpse, hanging under an umbrella, watched them leave, revealing a creepy smile:
“Help me… It’s following you… No, don’t believe… It’s following…”
Muttering in a low voice, the words that came out of her mouth were indistinct and very chaotic.
It was like one person was speaking, yet it also seemed like several, each shrieking different phrases.
Colin intensified the flame’s protection around himself, doing his best to ignore the voices as he raced towards the outside.
The light of the fire shone through the glass doors of the outpatient department, revealing dozens, perhaps hundreds of twisted, distorted pale faces crowding behind the door.
Each one glared with bloodshot eyes, spying on Colin and his companion as they approached.
“Get out of my way!”
Dragging the Ashen Holy Body, Colin flew forward with a kick, shattering the glass door, the flames instantly clearing the onlookers, directly carving a path through the “crowd” towards the direction indicated by the mission.
An extremely intense sense of crisis surged continuously…
On the seventh floor, there seemed to be something preparing to trouble them!
They had to leave before the strong premonition of threat became a reality!
On the way, an indescribable eerie and bizarre atmosphere thickened, and the abnormal movements became increasingly bold.
Initially, most of them were staring from afar under the bright lights outside the reach of the flames, but now, as that indefinable entity began to influence, they started moving towards the flames.
Moreover, they seemed to be protected by something, allowing them to enter the light for a short distance.
Fortunately, everything was still within the scope of resolution.
But more concerning than this…
What was really frustrating for Colin was figuring out what had been following them all this time?
In thought, he had already passed through several hospital buildings and defeated a large number of attacking entities.
Puppets with abnormal strength and high defense, flying heads detached by surgical cords, and the occasional mysterious figure…
The pressure kept mounting!
However, just after passing a few psychiatric wards, Colin abruptly halted, his gaze directed forward, his brow slightly furrowed.
Ahead of them stood a bizarrely twisted building, resembling melting ice cream, harboring an intense sense of danger that even he could not ignore…
Even the light entering that place became somewhat distorted.
To get to what was beyond, they had to pass under this building, for there was no detour—
This seemed to be one of the rules of this place, one that even Colin could not forcibly break.“We have to get past it, dangerous or not. Otherwise, it’ll be quite troubling if we’re caught up to…”
Colin glanced backward, hearing various screams coming from all directions, near and far, as if sinister figures were closing in.
Besides that, there was that “it” whose nature was still unknown.
If they were caught by this thing that had not existed just a moment ago, suddenly appeared out of nowhere, its origins murky…
Wait, unclear? Murky?
Colin’s breath hitched as he suddenly realized the source of the horrible foreboding, stamping his foot in frustration and cursing loudly:
“Damn it, we’ve been tricked!”
“What’s been tricked?” The Ashen Holy Body then asked, puzzled.
At this moment, it sensed an increasingly close threat, its heart racing rarely with fear, its face tense…
“That female employee’s words were a lure! This hospital… might indeed have dangers, but the danger, as it seems, is one we’ve drawn to ourselves!”
Hearing Colin’s warning, the Ashen Holy Body paused for a moment, then the next second, it also rapidly caught on:
“Shit! That’s damn cunning!”
A prevalent characteristic of this hospital was that what you think of possibly becomes reality.
