That unknown entity attached to the female employee had induced them with the phrase “it’s been following you,” leading them to imagine something unpleasant…
And thus, something unpleasant truly did descend upon them!
This sort of thing, not realizing it at first, was really not easy to come to terms with.
Especially since the other party was once a colleague, there’s an inherent basis of trust, plus from the moment they entered the first floor of the hospital, there indeed was a feeling of being followed.
Later combined with the colleague’s misleading words, it’s like crying wolf, and then “the wolf” really does come!
“Then, her words in the latter half…” The Ashen Holy Body quickly added.
The second part of the once-female colleague’s speech was “don’t believe its messages,” which seemed nonsensical and didn’t sound like it came from the same person…
“She might not be completely dead, or there might be another reason, like a trap or something. Anyway, let’s not worry about her for now…”
Colin was uncertain about this as well.
At most, he could feel that the female employee might have died in a deeper level, and what was here was only her projection, which was too close to the real thing, hence the difficulty in distinguishing them momentarily.
But no matter what, these past few minutes of “belief”…
The “wolf” at their back had become real!
And once it has become real, then it’s no longer easy to negate its existence with the thought that “if you believe, it exists; if you don’t, it doesn’t.”
“Let’s hurry up and leave, then talk about the rest, follow me closely.”
Colin drew the “Revolver Contrarian”, rushing towards that building that seemed to melt like ice cream.
As soon as he got inside, he found the corridor before him unexpectedly lengthening, seeming only about a hundred meters, but in reality, it took tens of seconds to cross!
“This severe psychiatric ward, feels almost like the Psychiatric Ward, but…”
Colin felt like he had entered an intensified version of the “Psychiatric Ward”.
Yet this place was clearly more dangerous!

chapters.title: Chapter 760 - 760 539 The Night Red Moon and Primordial Fire
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 760: Chapter 539 “The Night,” “Red Moon,” and “Primordial Fire”! _2 Chapter 760: Chapter 539 “The Night,” “Red Moon,” and “Primordial Fire”! _2 “Happy Birthday to you, Happy Birthday to you…” The children’s chorus of the birthday song suddenly came ethereally, even drowning out the screams outside the building.
On the walls around, a multitude of child-like chalk abstract smiling faces also appeared at this moment.
The surreal chant emanated from the mouths of the sketched smiling faces.
The Ashen Holy Body wavered for a moment, suddenly seeing before him a delicious birthday cake covered in candles.
An indescribable joy flooded his heart…
He just wanted to open his mouth, to blow out the candles.
But before he could do so, he abruptly saw the “birthday cake” suddenly raise its hand and slap him across the face!
A smack resounded!
The Ashen Holy Body quickly regained clarity of sight, clutching his burning face, and saw the “cake” had transformed into Brother Shunzi, then realizing what had just happened, he immediately sank into intense fear.
“Steady your mind…”
Colin casually tossed over a golden bean: “Use it.”
Although his “Bonfire” was quite powerful in keeping people sane, now was not the time to be concerned with aiding others…
And in this aspect, Shana’s “Light” had a stronger purifying effect on others.
It was after using the item that the Ashen Holy Body calmed down, and then looking around, he was bewildered once more…
He saw that the corridor area of this building was filled with all sorts of abstract creatures.
There were “humans” with bodies and gun heads; four-legged animals covered in eyes; soft-bodied creatures bristling with mouths; twisted-faced entities that shrieked and wielded rulers, dressed as teachers; or a group of children with fierce smiles; or deathly entities with limbs, in the shape of coffins…
From these monsters, both Colin and the Ashen Holy Body could feel different fears brewing in their hearts!
And not far on a wall, Colin saw several lines of blood-streaked, eye-catching slogans!
“Don’t fantasize! Don’t fantasize! Don’t fantasize! The fantasies deep in your heart will transform into imagined entities, becoming the despair of others!”
This content immediately made both Colin and him realize the origin of these beings!
They were all things imagined by people who had come here!
If one were to interpret it…
“War, bullying, hunger, and the physical embodiments of various fears, no, not fears, more accurately, they should be the most deeply ingrained memories in a person’s cognition…”
Colin even saw a dense mass of cockroaches—
Fearing death was one thing, but to think someone actually feared cockroaches!
But before he could think further, he suddenly felt a sense of threat in his heart, and immediately, acting on crisis feedback, he raised his revolver and fired at a certain direction!
There, some creature with a tank cannon for a head had its muzzle aimed at them.
However, before it could fire, it was blown apart by one of Colin’s fire-imbued bullets…
But at the same time, from around them came a dense barrage of gun-headed and cannon-mouthed shots, some bullets even penetrating the “Bonfire,” forcing Colin to strengthen his defenses even more.
Besides that, a series of psychic attacks came one after another, and the battle instantly exploded…
Colin, too, for the first time since entering, was forced to a halt.
However, no matter how fierce the battle was, this “serious mental illness” building showed no sign of falling.
And the road ahead did not seem to shorten…
“We must have been pulled into some domain forged by collective public fear, and although there might be other ways to break free, now is not the time to worry about that…”
Colin took a deep breath, then reached into the “Storage Room” and pulled out a “Firebearer Grease” grenade the size of a watermelon.
Following that, he hurled it with force.
With a thunderous explosion, a great flash of fire ignited!
As Colin’s thoughts flickered, the searing flames turned into a torrent, swallowing everything in the vicinity in a sea of fire!
As a large number of imaginary entities disappeared, the domain’s effect weakened…
Thereupon, Colin seized the opportunity to activate a domain-targeting item, “Force Repulsion.”
As the invisible fundamental force spread outward, Colin keenly felt that the “Domain” began to crack…
But just as he was about to leave this place, Colin suddenly felt an indescribable psychic turbulence brush past, and immediately after, a taunting phrase akin to a child’s ridicule echoed by his ear:
“Na na na, no daddy’s…”
“You’re looking for death!”
Colin clenched his fist tightly, pausing his stepping foot, whirled around to throw a heavy punch, as “Wildfire” surged out of him, directly annihilating the eerie entity that had spoken to smithereens.
Although he knew that this was the spiritual influence of “it” getting closer from behind…
Some things, once he thought about them now, still made a surge of anger well up within him, impossible to suppress!
“No, I need to calm my mind,” Colin took a deep breath.
Then he prepared to leave as quickly as possible, but at that moment, he suddenly saw, in the corridor ahead, a huge parasol appeared, and underneath it, a female employee hanged…
It seemed she had followed him from the inquiry hall!
Seizing the moment when Colin’s spirit was slightly unstable, she or “it” suddenly spoke with a weird smile, “What are you most afraid of?”
Upon hearing this, Colin was startled at first, then his heart skipped a beat…
Without another thought, he knocked out the Ashen Holy Body beside him with a punch, grabbed it in his hand, and let his own flames burst forth and rise to protect himself as much as possible.
And it was just after he had done all this…
Beyond Colin’s position, the entire seventh floor of the hospital turned pitch black in an instant.
The female employee who had asked the question, with a weird smile frozen on her face, then shifted to horror, as if she had seen something extremely terrifying, and the next moment, she exploded!
The terrifying potential had not truly manifested before it could not bear it!
“Damn it, if you can’t handle it yourself, go ask your mother!?!”
Colin, tightly wrapped in heavy flames, couldn’t help but curse out loud after witnessing this scene.
But at that moment, Colin’s heart violently skipped a beat, his gaze freezing…
He saw, in “The Night,” a hazy blood-red light that seemed to spawn everything, born from the darkness.
That was another thing that once terrified him to the core!
“Crack, crack…”
The previously indestructible “Psychiatric Intensive Care Unit” spread countless cracks, and various disparate entities around it, including the outer “Human Head Balloons,” wooden figures, and others, were instantly wiped clean in a flash!
Everything fell into deathly silence, a silence that hinted at rebirth…
The air seemed to solidify, suffocating.
With the arrival of these two entities, Colin felt his body crumbling, countless thoughts racing through his mind…
At such close range, even amidst heavy protection, it was very difficult for him to guard against these supremely powerful things!
“I must think of something, or I’m done for when it really arrives…”
Colin gritted his teeth, and suddenly an idea flashed in his mind!
The entities in this hospital were not born out of fear, but because of a deep impression, so besides the two incredibly terrifying things…
There was one more thing in Colin’s memory that left a deep impression!
“Bonfire”!
When he once touched the real remains of Rosen’s severed hand, he had glimpsed the scene of the “Flame Bearer” invoking the power of the “Bonfire” to issue an “Extermination Order,” a power that seemed like the source of the “Flame Bearer,” something that frightened countless heretics—
“Primordial Fire.”
It was when he recalled that entity that everything suddenly burst into flame around Colin…
“It’s working!” Colin’s eyes lit up.
However, the good news was that he seemed to have guided the power of the “Primordial Fire” here.
The bad news was… even though he was only a few steps away from becoming a “Flame Bearer,” he could not withstand too much of the “Primordial Fire’s” power!
Just as Colin thought that these three entities were about to descend into chaos, and he would die in the AoE,
All the entities suddenly and abruptly dissipated.
An inspiration blossomed in Colin’s mind…
Because the three entities were so terrifying, the “nonexistent hospital’s” seventh floor couldn’t bear it and directly collapsed!
Colin looked around and saw that where the hospital building had once towered, with all manner of abnormal entities on the seventh floor, there was now nothing left, falling into absolute quiet…
At that moment, looking at this scene, Colin suddenly realized something:
“I think I’ve found the code to pass through…”
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 761 - 761 540 The Beautiful Red-Robed Nurse_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 761: Chapter 540: The Beautiful “Red-Robed Nurse”!_1 Chapter 761: Chapter 540: The Beautiful “Red-Robed Nurse”!_1 Thump, thump, thump…
As the secret forces on the seventh floor collapsed, countless hospital buildings fell in succession, creating enormous crashing noises in the darkness.
This area had become a thorough ruin.
“Can’t see a hint of the mysterious entities anymore.”
Colin raised his right hand, letting the flames in his palm radiate as far as possible while he watched the scene, clicking his tongue in wonder.
The three entities only appeared for three or two seconds in total…
They didn’t even attack this damned place, but turned on each other as soon as they appeared.
As a result, they didn’t determine a victor among them…
This entire hospital floor was directly scrapped!
All the anomalous entities related to the hospital also exploded and died.
“Not sure about the other floors, but they should still be fine; otherwise, the collapse would have affected the entire spatial structure, not just a few dozen buildings falling down…”
“However, how come I didn’t think of it before, the hospital’s rules can still be used this way, and with the trait of the hospital granting whatever one wishes for, if I just imagined ‘Bonfire’, wouldn’t that be equivalent to obtaining the secret to clearing the level? No, that won’t do either…”
Colin recalled the sensation of that moment, the power of the “Bonfire,” which even as a “Flamebearer” Reservist, gave him a lingering sense of dread…
It was too colossal!
The instant he summoned it, he felt like he couldn’t grasp it and couldn’t pull it back.
Everything around him, even the “Wildfire” on his body, was ignited.
He himself might have been okay for a brief time, but everything around him, including some items such as the “Innate Ashen Holy Body,” would have been in trouble if the “Flamebearer” powers hadn’t protected them first.
All along, Colin had thought that bigger was better.
But being too big to control was a bit less good…
“Moreover, some of the things that exist within this hospital probably wouldn’t sit by and wait for death, and there might be some countermeasures in place. If everything exploded together, that would be bad, and clearly, taking advantage of higher beings is like playing with fire.”
Colin took a deep breath.
The main issue was, thinking of the “Bonfire” made it hard not to think of other things ranked alongside it…
The first time could be called an accident when those entities might not have realized that something other than their own believers dared to call upon them.
But if he were to “call” again, prepared as they might be this time, they could really appear!
Even looking back at that brief time, Colin remembered that the “Red Moon” kept fostering rebirth in the surroundings while pressing down the “darkness,” as if creating an environment for its arrival.
If the “Bonfire” hadn’t instantly ignited everything, the sudden battle within the hospital might not have ended so quickly—
Can’t withstand the collapse? You must continue even if you can’t!
“Aside from ‘Bonfire,’ it seems I should think of something else powerful, something that won’t go out of control but is still impressive.”
Colin pondered— “Hunger”?
That didn’t seem right; it could easily cause things to spin out of control. But other than that…
Thinking of “Flamebearer,” he hadn’t seen any such “Flamebearers,” so even with association, the effect wouldn’t be especially good in such circumstances.
It wasn’t like he could contemplate the “King of Savage Sound,” the shame of the Containment Subjects, could he?
Moreover, what was shown was only an avatar…
For the moment, besides those three, he couldn’t say there were any other impressionable beings he could immediately think of.
Just then…
“Mm…” A faint sound came from beside him, interrupting Colin’s thoughts.
He looked towards the sound and saw the Ashen Holy Body he had knocked out earlier waking up with still some confusion in his eyes.
Memories surged as the Ashen Holy Body remembered Brother Shunzi suddenly punching him, knocking him out cold. He shook his head vigorously and immediately snapped back to reality, prepared to ask why he suddenly received a punch.
But as he took in the steel and concrete ruins around him, the words died in his throat, and bewilderment overcame him once again:
“What’s going on, where is this? Did I travel through time?”
He just recalled being in some terrifying hospital, and now it seemed he had suddenly traveled to a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
However, before he could finish his thought, he heard Brother Shunzi’s voice from one side:
“Not really.”
Before Ashen Holy Body could say anything, Colin glanced at him and said, “There’s been a little accident; this floor of the hospital is likely collapsed, there’s no danger around now…”
A minor incident… Ashen Holy Body’s corner of the eye twitched.
An entire hospital floor had collapsed, and that’s called a minor incident? Then what’s considered a major incident?
However, judging by Brother Shunzi’s expression, the outcome of the accident must have ended in Brother Shunzi’s victory, but he had no idea what had happened during the time he was unconscious…
As these thoughts crossed his mind, Ashen Holy Body suddenly heard Brother Shunzi say:
“Don’t be curious about what just happened, if you truly become aware of it, I might not even be able to save you.”
At that, he immediately suppressed his thoughts.
“By the way, check yourself to see if there’s anything wrong inside, I’ve looked and there doesn’t seem to be an issue, but I’m not sure how you feel.”
Colin reminded him.
Truth be told, if he hadn’t accumulated enough experience with these events and hadn’t taken emergency protective measures immediately,
Ashen Holy Body wouldn’t be sure if he could lie here properly now…
“My body strangely feels like it’s turned to sand, as if everything is acting independently?” Ashen Holy Body shared his uncertain sensation.
“That’s normal, it will recover gradually.”
Colin did not continue speaking, instead casting a look at the “Psychotic” lying next to Ashen Holy Body.

chapters.title: Chapter 762 - 762 540 The Beautiful Red-Robed Nurse_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 762: Chapter 540: The Beautiful “Red-Robed Nurse”!_2 Chapter 762: Chapter 540: The Beautiful “Red-Robed Nurse”!_2 This one, because he fainted quite thoroughly and was also within the “stoking the fire” range, seemed to have no problem either.
After a brief checkup and confirming that there was no issue, Colin began to lead the team forward again.
This time, the path was clear.
The good news was that since all the anomalous entities had perished, the two of them simply crossed some ruins and quickly found the building that housed the “morgue,” as well as the item required for their mission.
The bad news was…
Because all the mystical powers of the whole floor had collapsed, even if Colin found a morgue with bodies in it and burned the mushroom man’s corpse to ash before lying down in it, he couldn’t jump to the next level.
“Was the destruction that serious?”
Colin crawled out of the cold morgue cabinet and, after dragging out the “Psychotic,” casually shut the morgue cabinet that had who knows how many soul rings attached to it.
“It seems we didn’t jump to the lower level…” said another employee.
“Let’s wait a bit longer, wait for it to recover…” Colin glanced around.
If nothing went wrong, the anomalies of this level should gradually restore after a while.
Indeed, it was about half an hour later that Colin felt the hospital recover from the explosive combat earlier on, as broken pieces of stone began to rise and recongregate…
Seeing this, Colin flicked a spark with his hand, reinforced the kindling fire in front of him to ensure the coordinate was stable, then pulled open the morgue cabinet he had chosen, and lay down inside it along with the “Psychotic” and the Ashen Holy Body.
This morgue cabinet was perhaps not just for storing the human bodies as commonly perceived by the general public, so it was quite large, easily fitting seven or eight people, even with room for a mahjong table…
For Colin, just bringing one or two people was no problem at all.
Soon after lying down inside, he was surrounded by an indescribable numbness…
He felt a bit sleepy.
“Don’t resist…”
Colin reminded him and then embraced the sensation that was descending upon him.
Before long, he suddenly felt a moment of trance, and when his consciousness came to, he found himself in a spacious hall.
“This is… the consultation area?”
Colin looked around and then down at the glass door under his feet, still uncertain.
This place was extremely distorted, with everything misplaced and jumbled…
Where there used to be a door, now stood a window hardly distinguishable from a door, and the actual door was right under his feet. As for the floor and the like, they were on the walls, or in various places…
The overall feeling was as if a person’s organs had been misplaced: the mouth grew on the belly button, the butt turned into the chest, the chest turned into the butt, the eyes grew between the buttocks, the anus moved above the eyes, and the nose became Pennsylvania…
Or it was like some very abstract painting…
In short, it was chaos.
“At least I myself seem pretty normal.”
Colin touched himself and let out a slight sigh of relief.
But strangely, there seemed to be no anomalous entities here?
No, it wasn’t that there were no anomalous entities…
Colin noticed that the originally dark red blotches now lay limp on the ground as if lifeless—
It seemed the previous battle had still affected this place.
“Looking at this, it should remain docile for at least ten minutes… Speaking of which, where is that LED screen…”
Colin looked towards its usual location, but now the LED screen was contorted, and instead of displaying rules, it showed fragments of transparent glass…
But soon, on a floor tile, he saw the rules lit up in red.
The previously unclear rules were now becoming clear…
“1. In case of any problems, immediately call a doctor, they are trustworthy! He he he he he… Trustworthy? Trust…
2. ‘I’ am about to escape, someone come kill me, please, anyone will do, kill me, I can’t, I can’t hold on much longer…
3. Help me, help me, I’ve seen you, please, help me…”
…
“Rule one seems to be broken, and the latter two, ‘I’? Could it be that employee who was trapped on the eighteenth floor?”
After looking at it, Colin thought that if he had to choose someone he knew, it would probably be that employee.
Of course, it could be someone else too…
But no matter what, he didn’t dwell on it much.
He now felt that these rules seemed like a plea for closure from something behind the scenes.
Maybe that person could have held on, but if he spent even a moment considering it, they might indeed not be able to hold on any longer…
Colin hadn’t completely figured out the “Belief Materializes” attribute of this place, and knew he still needed to be cautious where it mattered.
“No wonder they had to wipe my memory, alright, let’s go, let’s look for that Red-Robed Nurse, go to the next level, we should not be far from our final goal… Huh?” Colin froze mid-sentence.
It seemed that apart from the unconscious “Psychotic,” the figure of the Ashen Holy Body was nowhere to be seen.
“Wasn’t transported here, or was there some other accident?”
Colin wasn’t sure of the reason but intuitively felt that they probably hadn’t died.
And feeling the gloominess slowly reviving around him, Colin for the moment couldn’t be bothered with the whereabouts of the missing veteran employee, but instead rapidly grabbed the still unconscious “Psychotic” and started looking for the “Red-Robed Nurse” on this floor, following his instincts.
The degree of abnormality on the tenth floor, as well as the atmosphere within, was quickly catching up to that of a Level 2 Containment Subject.
And it was one of those particularly special Level 2 Containment Subjects…
Even though Colin could handle it, it was not particularly easy.
Taking advantage of the aftereffects of the recently occurred powers’ clash, the sooner he could figure out the situation, the better.

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - 763 540 The Beautiful Red-Robed Nurse_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 763: Chapter 540: The Beautiful “Red-Robed Nurse”!_3 Chapter 763: Chapter 540: The Beautiful “Red-Robed Nurse”!_3 As he acted, he couldn’t help but think of “The Unyielding.”
This old guy, somehow managed to stay on the eighteenth floor for so long…
“It feels like with one or two more layers jumped, it would enter the strength of a Level 2 Containment Subject, and this is only the twelfth floor, there’s still a long way from the eighteenth, there must be something at least as horrifying as ‘King of Savage Sound’, or even, behind all this, there might be the strength of an upper-level first-class containment entity, no, perhaps even higher, it’s reached beyond the top-tier!”
Thinking of this, Colin momentarily didn’t know whether to admire “The Unyielding” for his luck or to pity his misfortune.
A few minutes later, he saw the so-called “Red-Robed Nurse”; this thing wasn’t hard to find, looking quite similar to a person at first glance, decent in figure and appearance.
Beneath the tattered red robe was a slender, tall, and fair body, exuding seduction. Just by its silhouette, it could cause some of the less resolute people to lose control…
But should one look at its face, it would immediately snap them back to reality.
On the front of its head, there were several faces, bulging out like worms trying to break from a cocoon, appearing to be on the verge of splitting open, sending a chilling shiver down one’s spine.
“The hospital is very dangerous, please cooperate with me and follow to the safety area, anyone who hears this voice, please immediately follow me to the safe zone, we will protect all surviving humans…”
The several rosy and seductive cherry mouths opened and closed incessantly, emitting a pleasant voice.
Then, it seemed to realize something, its dozen beautiful eyes whirling around to look at Colin who was sizing it up from a not-so-distant spot:
“You are sick, very sick indeed, please come with us for treatment immediately…”
While speaking, it rapidly approached Colin’s location…
With just a few steps through the few dozen meters, she closed the distance almost instantaneously as if teleporting.
“Leveraging the power of rules?”
Colin’s eyebrows rose as he looked at the nurse’s face with its dozen eyes, feeling not a hint of panic but instead stuffing “Psychotic” into its arms before retreating swiftly, overusing “Badge of Humility” at a higher frequency.
His presence rapidly diminished…
He didn’t need to completely disappear, he just needed to seem less noticeable than “Psychotic.”
And after seizing “Psychotic,” a voice transmitted from some speakerphones…
“Emergency department in building 2 has a medical emergency, requesting support…”
The next second, Colin saw another group of Red-Robed Nurses pushing a stretcher at a speed that, seeming slow, defied the laws of physics, placing “Psychotic” on it, then rushing towards an emergency room…
As Colin followed all the way, he saw the “surgery in progress” red light came on.
Without hesitation, Colin took out “Psychotic Madman Blood Extract,” and jabbed it into the muscle of his left arm.
As the liquid was injected into his muscle…
Colin felt his body begin to “melt” rapidly, a question popped up in his fading consciousness:
“Won’t I become a psychotic from this injection?”
Then, everything plunged into profound silence and blankness, as if he had slipped into a rare deep sleep.
But he hadn’t slept for long before intense pain awoke him.
“Ahh!!!”
Colin groaned in agony, opening his eyes to find himself lying on a bed, the light above being a shadowless lamp — more precisely, a white light-emitting eyeball.
He could not attend to that right now, the excruciating pain in his abdomen instantly soaked him with cold sweat…
Gazing downward, Colin’s pupils quivered!
He saw a Red-Robed Nurse with numerous faces just sliced his abdomen open, mechanically pulling it apart with two hands reaching in — those ice-cold hands gripped his intestines, seemingly trying to pluck them out.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 764 - 764 541 The Survivor in the Depths of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 764: Chapter 541 The Survivor in the Depths of the Hospital_1 Chapter 764: Chapter 541 The Survivor in the Depths of the Hospital_1 Beneath the cut skin, the large intestine entangled with the small intestine formed a mass, writhing as if it was an oversized infant, cradled by a pair of slender hands smeared with fresh red blood, half pulled out from below Colin’s abdomen…
In an instant, Colin’s vision flashed with stars, feeling as if his body had been hollowed out.
The intestines made gurgling noises as they moved, akin to the cries of an infant.
“For fuck’s sake, at least wear some gloves for hygiene, and also, give me some damn anesthesia!”
Colin gritted his teeth in extreme pain, his sweat pouring down in cold beads.
It was in the midst of these flashing thoughts that the violent physiological changes caused by his waking up triggered alarms from the various surgical instruments, and suddenly, dozens of faces turned towards him…
Colin strained to raise his hand, intending to use the “Flame Bearer’s” power to incinerate this abnormal being into ash.
However, he discovered that his body was limp and weak, as if it had been injected with some drug…
But more crucially, he couldn’t use the “Bonfire” power anymore?
“What the hell?!”
In the midst of his pain, Colin couldn’t help but be greatly alarmed.
The “Bonfire” power could be suppressed or sealed, but it was impossible for him to sense it yet be unable to use it!
However, in the next second, just as his confusion surfaced, he understood the reason!
This body seemed to be that of a “Psychotic,” not his!
‘Was the effect of that extract to make my soul transference into this body?’
In an instant, he realized the reason.And it was during this brief, possibly less than a second of contemplation, that a dozen icy-cold hands pressed down on his body, pushing him back onto the hospital bed.
“Please remain calm, your condition is very serious, please cooperate with the treatment, we will provide you with the most advanced life-extension methods!”
A multiplicity of voices tainted with mental contamination spoke from the mouths of five nurses’ faces.
“Who the fuck does organ removal for psychotic treatment!”
Colin, dripping with sweat from the pain, internally ranted crazily before seeing a red-robed nurse turn around with a syringe, seemingly intending to add some measures to him.
‘I can’t let her inject that into my body!’
As his thoughts turned, Colin quickly came up with some countermeasures. Although he couldn’t use “Bonfire” power, the “Storage Room” was still accessible…
Colin summoned his strength and managed to pull out a big eyeball ring!
The next second, a ghostly silhouette in icy blue passed through, stirring up a blast of frigid wind, and within the operating room, all five “red-robed nurses” were precisely turned into ice sculptures…
However, the sculptures had just frozen when they began shivering as if they were about to break free.
Not giving these things a chance to thaw, Colin recalled “Yukionna,” letting her adhere to his body, using her to control his own movements, pulling out the strongest tool in his possession from the “Storage Room,” “Time Freeze”—
“Za Warudo!”
Thud thud thud…
With invisible engine-like roars, everything around was pulled into stasis.
Seeing this, Colin continued to extract a white bone spur, enduring the agony to strike each “red-robed nurse,” then pulled out another officially-acquired electrifying tool.
Rolling thunder erupted, paired with “Yukionna’s” frost, and before “Time Stop: Pause” ended, it was all over!
When ten seconds passed, time began to move again.
Seeing that they had predictably perished, turning into a mess of rotten flesh on the ground, Colin finally felt relieved.
He was about to strengthen himself with the “Light” Golden Mark and add a healing tool.
But accidentally, with an excessive move, a sharp tearing pain surged, his body felt dizzy, and a veil of darkness descended before his eyes.
The intestines, not yet retracted back into the stomach, fell out with a splash through the ten-centimeter cut, mixed with blood; the sensation of them dragging down to his knees almost made him pass out from the physical shock.
Even though this body wasn’t his, the pain he experienced was no less intense…
But it was at that moment a very cold pair of hands embraced his organs and tried to stuff them back in; though well-intentioned, the stimulation made Colin jolt again.
“Ah, stop, don’t move…”
He stopped Yukionna’s actions, then summoned the “Fire Tree.”
“Fire Tree” appeared and suddenly brightened before dimming again upon clearer inspection of the situation.
Colin didn’t notice this detail at the moment, he simply threw two “Colorless Crystals” to the Fire Tree, urging it to “hurry.”
With his words, dozens of tendrils swiftly pierced into his back from the Fire Tree, their roots releasing various effects rapidly, suppressing every pain in his body and swiftly stitching up all wounds, the fine roots working to sew…
“Phew, finally…”
Colin exhaled deeply, and only now did he have the time to sort out the current situation.
“I knew my body couldn’t possibly be cut open so easily by a few Third Level Containment Subjects that hadn’t even touched me, turns out it wasn’t my body at all…”
“If they had told me that the extract injection would lead to ‘soul transference’, I would have been prepared.”
“How could I have been so passive.”
Colin shook his head and sensed his current body.
It was weak, probably just a bit better than he was when he was F Level and had three injections, and there was a kind of indescribable “chaotic noise” in his head, as if the previous soul hadn’t completely died off.
At the same time, fragmented memories from the “Psychotic Madman” wandering around the hospital began to surface in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 765 - 765 541 The Survivor in the Depths of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 765: Chapter 541 The Survivor in the Depths of the Hospital_2 Chapter 765: Chapter 541 The Survivor in the Depths of the Hospital_2 Incoherent, one must piece together and interpret on their own.
About three minutes later, Colin had roughly figured out the situation.
“Indeed, there isn’t just one ‘madman’…”
Most of these fragmented memories of Colin happened in either a room or a certain area.
Among them were many entities similar to “madmen”, either psychotically unsound, split-minded, or bound all over, constantly muttering to themselves about becoming immortals, unable to distinguish reality from illusion…
The key was that they all seemed to actually produce some special phenomena.
However, no matter which kind of mental patient it was, when they saw the “nurse”, they would fall into a state of intense fear.
Moreover, what mostly drew Colin’s attention was a strange “voice” lurking in the depths of the “madmen’s” memories…
“Escape, escape…”
It was after the voice appeared that all the “madmen” in this area, including him, escaped—some with black tentacles sprouting all over their bodies and a dark sword in their mouths as they crawled, some imagining themselves riding on an inflatable doll, and others fantasizing about using a mop stained with feces, along with various other bizarre objects…
A host of patients each displayed their divine skills, breaking free from the abnormal entities that were both nurses and doctors, and escaped from there.
But why Colin hadn’t seen any other “madmen” and only encountered this one escaping to the lower floor was still unknown.
However, that voice urging escape did sound familiar.
It was somewhat like the “help me” he heard last time he infiltrated this place.
“I feel a familiar sense of being arranged.”
Colin pursed his lips, feeling that “Lady Bunny” must have exerted some influence behind the scenes, and in addition, maybe some of the “employees” who entered this place received the message, thus contributing a bit of effort?
And what is it that I have to do next?
The task seemed to be just for him to wait until the “madman” was brought in and then inject the medicine.
Now that they have arrived, what else should he do?
And it was at this time that the completion of the task was long overdue.
New tasks popped up in Colin’s mind.
[Event: Investigate the 12th floor of the “nonexistent hospital”, try to expand the scope to collect as much information as possible…]
“Note”: Current progress is 4%.
“Note 2”: Please complete the task within six hours if possible!
“Note 3”: Find the passage to the 13th floor, and this task will be considered completed.
…
Seeing this new task, Colin’s brow twitched, “This is already the 12th floor?”
If he were here in person, he might feel it was quite challenging but not panic, but now he was acting by possessing the body of this madman…
This could be problematic!
“I’ll do as much as I can. Now that I’ve come to this floor, if I haven’t completed it, the next task I pick might be even worse, a waste of time. Furthermore, if I’m not given another chance to reselect the Fifteenth Ring, but have to start from the first ring again, then that’s a huge loss!”
If the task were to fail, the consumed items would be non-refundable.
Thinking of this, even if Colin felt helpless, he had no choice but to grit his teeth and go on.
“The threat on the 12th floor should be at the Level 2 Containment Subject standard, but the Level 2 Containment Subjects here are a bit special and probably a bit stronger.”
Colin thought about what he could use at the moment.
“It doesn’t seem that difficult to withstand… The ‘Bonfire’ Golden Mark and the ‘Light’ Golden Mark, stacked status should be about one-third of my original version? No, it seems not even that much, can’t use Talent…”
Although he said it was Soul Transference, it was closer to “consciousness” attachment; he couldn’t use the Talent “Mad Flame·Mad Flame Possession” of his main body.
And the feel of using all the items was a bit off as well.
To perform at a third of the regular state of his main body, he would have to stack everything up.
Aside from that, Colin always felt that there must be some way for him to exert more strength…
It’s just that the “hardware” of this body was really battered; even simple thinking felt a bit fragmented, and he couldn’t pin down the key point at once.
And as he tried to understand the situation, suddenly heavy footsteps came from outside the corridor.
“Clang clang~”
The heavy footsteps seemed to drag a chain of metal chains slowly approaching.
Colin’s breathing became tense, sensing a strong danger, at least for this body; if it was cornered in the operation room by the other party, it could be a big problem…
After pondering a moment, he decided to flee first.
Immediately, he quickly went to the door and pushed hard…
It didn’t open.
“So hard? Oh, forgot…”
Colin remembered something, and while thinking it should be easy to push, he managed to open the door smoothly.
As the sliding door was pushed open, even as Colin held his breath and clutched the “Proof of Humility,” he could feel a heavy stench of blood hitting him in the face…
The eerie sight made his eyes wobble for a moment.
Flesh riddled with pus, wriggling veins, shattered human heads… Pieces of flesh covered in velvety granulation sprawled across every visible part of the world before him.
The ground, the walls, the ceiling, the door, shadows of them were everywhere…
The knowledge from fragments of some “madmen’s” memories let Colin understand that all these chunks were dismembered people.
At this very moment, they were still alive, despite being sliced into countless pieces, and from the squirming flesh, mouths and eyes—sensory organs—grew out, with granulation moving slowly like snails at the edges of the flesh, dragging along chunks of flesh that murmured unintelligibly as they moved.
It seemed they were instinctively searching for their own body parts, trying to reassemble themselves into their original human form…
But more often than not, it was just the organs that didn’t belong to each other clinging together, tearing each other apart, devouring, and forming massive mountains of flesh.
“Are these what those ‘fungus plaques’ actually are? They’re all just chunks of flesh? Who turned them into this?”
Colin pursed his lips, and as he pondered, he sensed his mission progress jump by about five percent.
Knowing meant that the situation was probably as he suspected…
And the first thing that this crimson horror brought to his mind was the “Red Moon.”
But on closer inspection, he didn’t sense the power of the “Red Moon,” and in terms of detail, although the Red Moon would also turn people into various separate parts, most of the time each part was a complete organ.
Not like here, where everything appeared to be cut into various chunks as if by a bone cleaver…
“Clang clang…” The sound of metal chains once again accompanied by heavy footsteps approached.
This time it was much closer…
“I should be fine if I’m careful, better not to engage with that metal chain thing for now, to avoid more trouble. It’s time for further investigation.”
Colin held his breath and was ready to act on his intuition to investigate further.
But at that moment, he suddenly noticed, the creature dragging the chains quickly passed him by, appearing in the direction he had instinctually wanted to explore…
Colin was taken aback and then realized that the other party was probably not coming for him.
It was…
Another direction?
Was there something there?
After some thought, Colin decided to follow, keeping a long distance, trailing for about fifteen minutes.
He repeatedly saw a creature about six meters tall, with a body full of suture marks, skin in patches, like a man-made patchwork giant.
Its body was filled with shackles, emitting a heavy aura of resentment, and with each step, numerous chunks of human flesh were ground to pieces…
Its strength should be within the range of a Third Level Containment Subject.
But it wasn’t just there; he also noticed many other anomalies slowly converging in that direction, for some unknown reason.
“It’s a pity I don’t have teammates with me, otherwise someone could use the ‘Book of Fate: Fragment’ to probe the situation.”
Colin murmured to himself.
The confusion didn’t last long; nearly an hour later, as Colin took a breath, he suddenly felt a faint human presence in the air!
An alive person, someone relatively normal!
It was at this moment that he saw the Human Patchwork Monster suddenly start sprinting.
Toward a distance, the creature charged at a hospital building that resembled a castle.
There, a large number of anomalies were gathering, launching an attack, seemingly targeting a group of equally numerous Red-Robed Nurses.
Actually, more accurately, the target was the crack in the hospital building, but for some reason, the Red-Robed Nurses were furiously blocking it, not allowing any anomalies to enter.
At the moment, both sides were roughly at a stalemate, with countless anomalies being sliced into pieces by the Red-Robed Nurses…
But with the Charge of the Iron Chain Patchwork Monster, a Third Level Containment Subject in strength.
“Boom!”
A large number of Red-Robed Nurses were torn apart, and the crack in the hospital building was struck open wider.
Behind the gap, a number of faces full of despair watched this scene unfold.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - 766 542 I Come as the Will of the Bonfire._1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 766: Chapter 542: I Come as the Will of the “Bonfire”._1 Chapter 766: Chapter 542: I Come as the Will of the “Bonfire”._1 “It’s the ‘Corpse Tyrant’, we’re done…”
Behind the hospital building, whose doors and windows had been sealed with various iron plates, more than a hundred humans of no weak strength watched as a six-to-seven-meter-tall “Corpse Tyrant,” built of blocks of flesh sewn together, step by step withstood their attacks, forcing its way through the cracks and squeezing in.
Despair was written all over their faces…
The “Corpse Tyrant” was one of the terrifying calamities of this world, with an extremely powerful physical constitution. It was basically impossible for them to deal with it with their strength.
Even in normal times, upon encountering one, they had to find a way to attract a large number of “Red-Robed Nurses,” let it die from anomalies, trigger a Third Level alarm, and have the “Dean” appear to fight and reclaim it…
But now, with insufficient conditions on hand, they were unable to cope!
“Why has this happened, why did the Deep World suddenly crack open, why, when we usually go out to search for supplies, we never even see a ‘Corpse Tyrant,’ yet today we suddenly encountered three? Are we destined to die on this expedition…”
An explorer from the Calamity Zone muttered to himself upon seeing this.
Not long ago when they encountered the “Corpse Tyrant,” they had barely escaped with significant sacrifices.
The second time they met one, a strong individual of unknown origin lent a hand, and although after fighting desperately with them, they managed to defeat the “Corpse Tyrant” for the first time…
But soon after breaking out of the encirclement of various anomalies and returning to their fortress, they encountered another one.
For the third time…
Who could help them now?
And…
He looked at the person not far away wrapped in bandages, his eyes filled with doubt. Who on earth was this guy?
Why was he so strong, and was this sudden appearance of a crack in the Deep World related to him?
If it was… With this thought, a surge of hatred filled her eyes…
“Smack!” Before her anger could rise, a solid slap landed on her head.
“Don’t take out your anger on others,”
a tall woman brandishing a special wolf-tooth club, burly and swollen in muscle, rising over two meters two, said in a deep voice, “If it wasn’t for his sacrifice to help us, we would have already been dead.”
“Squad leader, I…”
“Enough, no need to say more.”
The tall woman, referred to as squad leader, who stood over two meters tall, raised her hand to cut off her words and turned to look at the “Corpse Tyrant” crazily squeezing into the corridor:
“In at most five or six minutes, it will break through all our defenses and rush into the hall…
Teams one to seventeen, when the time comes, follow me and break out, draw it away, and buy time for the shelter so they have time to deal with the ‘Corpse Tyrant’…”
“Yes!”
“Yes!”
Several figures responded.
They knew what this meant, but they readily accepted.
“You are all warriors, I salute you, and of course, myself as well.”
The squad leader nodded, offering words of encouragement, then turned her head and continued:
“Teams nineteen and above, make sure to protect him and bring him back! We have to figure out what’s going on with this man, even if we can’t understand the situation. Keeping him here is also an option…
I’ve checked, and he has an extremely good genetic sequence. My sisters will like it.”
In fact, to risk their lives to protect this stranger, it wasn’t just because he had saved them, but also because he possessed an astonishingly stable genetic makeup!
If used for breeding, this was much better than those madmen grabbed from the “Mental Asylum”!
The likelihood of giving birth to undying lunatics would be minimized.
Regrettably, she had covertly groped that man’s tender buttocks, terribly soft to the touch.
She herself wouldn’t have the chance to experience it.
“Everyone, inject the Power-Injection!”
Having said that, she pulled out an injection needle, jabbed it hard into her neck, and her muscles began to grow extraordinarily tough, with all her attributes rapidly surging.
Streams of blood and qi burst forth from the pores of her skin, converging into armor-like protection, an awe-inspiring sight.
This was a powerful method only true fighters could wield!
Just as the effects erupted, while everyone was in strict readiness, the “Corpse Tyrant” barged in with steps that shook the earth!
Several small squads, made up of four to seven warriors, immediately channeled their blood and qi into torrents, charging at the “Corpse Tyrant.”
The rolling blood and qi momentarily stalled the “Corpse Tyrant’s” stride, but in the next second, it stretched out its arms and tore apart the blood and qi torrent before them, and with a bloodthirsty frenzy, it attacked the crowd…
Seeing this, the squad leader knew that the dozen or so people from the three squads were doomed!
Sure enough, with just one touch, several explorers from beyond the earth had their energy armors shattered and were twisted and flung away.
Grinding her teeth, she was ready to continue the action, waiting to take over the battle, to draw the “Corpse Tyrant’s” desire to attack to herself, and then guide it out of this place.
But, just as the words “Follow me charge” were about to be shouted, a sudden change occurred!
Pale, orange-red light burst forth violently in front of them.
What followed was the sound of heavy falling.
After a moment of stunned silence, when everyone recovered, they were all incredulous at the sight of the “Corpse Tyrant” lying on the ground.
Standing on its back was a small, frail figure in blue and white stripes who, with incomprehensible strength, was pinning the “Corpse Tyrant” firmly underfoot, suppressing it on the ground, unable to move—
“How is it possible?!”
Everyone exclaimed in disbelief.
The squad leader herself held her breath as she watched the man who had both hands spread wide, palms up, with a dazzling and serene ball of white Light in his left hand and a swirling, unextinguished ball of orange-red Flame in his right.

chapters.title: Chapter 767 - 767 542 I came in response to the will of Bonfire._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 767: 542 I came in response to the will of “Bonfire”._2 Chapter 767: 542 I came in response to the will of “Bonfire”._2 Gazing directly at the white light, the idle thoughts in their hearts seemed to be purified and dissipate…
Gazing directly at the flame, they only felt that everything within themselves began to feel more… “full”?
For a moment, they couldn’t think of how to describe this sensation, but instinctively, they wanted to get closer, even to touch… but reason stopped their actions.
At this point in time, even though their figures appeared quite petite and frail, and the power in their hands seemed obviously gentle, it was this “gentle” method that effortlessly subdued a “Corpse Tyrant”!
One of the most dangerous things they could encounter on this floor!
…
“This damn place, there actually are people here…”
While being observed, Colin was also sizing up this group. He truly hadn’t expected that people could still be alive on this floor, and even seemed to have formed a small community like some of the doomsday worlds he had encountered before…
However, aside from not being clear on other things, the moment he saw this group, Colin knew that he wouldn’t be able to escape the task of transporting and resettling workers.
Then, glancing at the mission progress bar that had soared to thirty-nine, Colin pondered how to approach and communicate with this group.
So far, aside from being slightly taller and seemingly possessing some extraordinary abilities from their innate talents, there was nothing particularly special about them.
They could be summarized as normal humans—
At least compared to the Fishmen, Silicon-based Crystal People, Stone People, and the Tree People who grew from the fruits on trees, as well as some beings without human form but able to speak and acknowledged as people within the company’s scope…
They were relatively more normal.
But it was still unclear what their internal situation was like, whether it was good or bad.
However, just about ten or so seconds after Colin appeared and during the standoff, a faint voice came from the side:
“Shun, Brother Shunzi…?”“Hm?” Colin looked over, surprised to see that an employee who had gotten lost was actually here.
But the employee’s condition seemed pretty bad, wrapped up in bandages, severely injured, being held by a robust woman about two meters thirty or forty, like a half-grown child…
It appeared as though he had woken up from his near-death illness due to sensing his power.
“What’s your status?” Colin frowned, causing everyone’s mood to sink.
On hearing this, the Ashen Holy Body struggled to sit up straight; until now, he wasn’t sure if the person was Brother Shunzi.
Because the body was clearly not a human’s, but aside from the body change, everything from the tone of speech and more was exactly like Brother Shunzi.
But now, with the other party not denying it, he knew it was indeed Brother Shunzi.
Taking a deep breath, he said, “I’m alright, Brother Shunzi, be careful with that thing under your feet, it… it will self-destruct!”
If not for that, he would have been injured, but not to the point of being paralyzed.
“Self-destruct? Don’t worry, it’s not a big deal…”
Colin glanced at the Bone Spur stuck in the Third Level Containment Subject’s back, the filthy, stinking black water continually pouring into the stitched creature, causing it immense pain.
Had Colin not been standing on it, it probably would have been thrashing in agony on the ground.
Eventually, it would burst and die within less than two minutes…
Colin pursed his lips, disdainfully saying, “Even if I have become weaker, it doesn’t mean this thing has become more threatening.”
As he spoke, he pressed down forcefully, pinning the monster beneath his feet to the ground.
After all, it was still just a weak Third Level Containment Subject, he could easily deal with it using tools, or even by unleashing “Yukionna” or a three-headed “Mountain of Smiling Corpses,” so it wasn’t a big problem.
The real trouble was this godforsaken place, with the existence of an unknown Level 2 Containment Subject, and even faintly, something more dangerous lingering in the depths…
‘There must be a Level 1 or higher Containment Subject within the hospital.’
He had been uncertain before, but now he could be sure of it.
On the other hand, hearing Colin’s confident words, the Ashen Holy Body with severe injuries all over breathed a sigh of relief.
After all, when Brother Shunzi said he could handle it, there had never been a failure heard.
Because of this interruption, the sturdy women’s wariness towards Colin had diminished significantly.
“There seems to be quite a bit of trouble outside. I can’t keep blocking this opening forever. Where do you plan to go next?”
While speaking, Colin turned to glance outside.
The crack behind him was still there, and if it weren’t for a bonfire he used to block it, a bunch of anomalies would likely surge in. Of course, this also meant that the hospital itself couldn’t repair itself…
So, if there was a chance to change locations, it was best to move to another place.
Upon hearing this, the leader among the group of tall women hesitated, then, instead of rushing outside, she turned and pointed in a direction: “Follow me, retreat, and bring the injured…”
The situation wasn’t dire, so there was ample enough time to evacuate everyone.
Colin nodded, took out a three-liter barrel filled with grease and a mixture of substances from his pocket, planning to leave a surprise for the anomalies that would enter after the flame went out, then followed at the end of the group, volunteering to cover the rear.
Soon, Colin saw that these people swiftly entered the first underground level, opened a room, and revealed a hidden underground passage where everyone dove in.
“Digging tunnels really is a timeless method,” he commented.
After everyone had entered, Colin followed suit. Below was a grey concrete tunnel about five meters wide and eight meters high—a fairly large sewer tunnel.
‘There are quite a few anomalies here…’ Colin sniffed the air, detecting a considerable amount of decay…
However, although there were many anomalies, these women seemed to have their own set of routes. At some passages, they suddenly broke through the walls, revealing their own dug-out tunnels.
Once everyone entered, the concrete walls began to repair themselves, making the route hard to notice.
Then, about ten minutes later, Colin was transferred to another hospital building where, as usual, various bizarre creatures were all over the place.
But they were all within manageable limits…
Just as Colin thought they might stop here, the procession of a hundred or so people continued their relentless march.
They went through another secret underground passage, winding here and there for a considerable distance, eventually arriving at a sealed underground area.
Here, the scent of humans suddenly intensified.
“There must be several hundred to a thousand people. Was this area formerly used as some kind of warehouse?” he wondered.
Colin looked up at the “ceiling” about a dozen meters high, patched up with various steel plates, then examined the homemade buildings and rooms beneath the steel dome…
This place was like a special shelter, or perhaps a densely populated mini-society.
He had to admire the survivors of the “nonexistent hospital” who somehow managed to hold out in this hellish place, particularly on the twelfth level.
“Our chief would like to see you,” a tall woman approached, slightly bowed her head, and spoke to the fair-skinned, small-framed man.
“Alright,” Colin replied, not surprised by this, and followed her.
They passed through a series of makeshift houses reminiscent of a slum but much cleaner and tidier. Many tall women peered out curiously at him.
“What do they eat to grow so tall and strong…” Colin mused in his mind as he noticed the average adult size was around two meters.
Although these women were tall and robust, their faces were surprisingly decent.
But before he could ponder more, in a hall converted from a hospital room, Colin saw an Ashen Holy Body lying on a hospital bed and a sister so tall that sitting up almost made her his height, staring at him intently.
The woman he had met earlier, who seemed to be the chief, was seated at the deputy position next to this tall woman.
“What’s your background?” the deputy chief asked
“I come from beyond this world, carrying the mission of ‘Bonfire,’ arriving in response to the pleas of the weak and innocent, to liberate, move, and save the survivors here,” Colin responded without hesitation, having done similar work more than once and already having a set of prepared words.
Although he hadn’t heard anyone’s plea upon arrival and didn’t know of other survivors aside from the employees who had stumbled here, nor was his actual purpose to save the survivors…
It didn’t hinder him from saying so.
After all, given the company’s nature, he would still need to evacuate people later, and there would be no second person knowing the actual situation.
After a pause, he added, “Of course, before that, you’ll have to cooperate with me and answer some questions.”

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - 768 543 The Darkness Has Arrived Goodbye
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 768: Chapter 543 The Darkness Has Arrived, Goodbye, Friends._1 Chapter 768: Chapter 543 The Darkness Has Arrived, Goodbye, Friends._1 Hearing Colin’s cagey intro, everyone’s brains went blank, forgetting all the questions they originally wanted to ask.
Crucially, when Colin spoke, he used “Light” and “Flame” for the special effects.
It had a very strong, convincing feeling…
Of course, the greatest role in this was the sense of reassurance those two powers carried with them.
But after a brief moment of regaining their senses and noticing his description of them…
“Weak, weaklings…” a strong woman who was among the strongest there opened her mouth to object.
In this area, although they were not the strongest, they could be considered as having rich experience, quite decent…
But recalling the description given by the former expedition leader about Colin: a terrifying strength capable of crushing the “Corpse Tyrant”.
She found herself unable to object…
Meanwhile, on the other side, the “Innate Ashen Holy Body” lying in the hospital bed and undergoing treatment, was equally baffled by Brother Shunzi’s performance.
He had taken part in the “Ghost Train” incident and the “Thorn World” rescue operation; he knew Brother Shunzi was exceptionally strong, at times nearly capable of a Direct Gaze with an Ancient God level terrifying employee.
But he had never seen such a state of fooling someone, the two special effects matched up perfectly to suggest a True God had sent him.
Just then, before she said anything, the slightly shorter lead woman sitting in the center suddenly spoke:
“Are you saying that you are here to save us?”
“Yes.”
Colin nodded, holding two Golden Marks in his hand, maintaining the interweaving of “Light” and “Flame,” his gaze as piercing as a torch, compelling others to instinctively avert their eyes, not daring to meet his gaze—
Even though the “Light” was also so damn bright, during a conversation, once you avert your gaze.
It often means you’re giving up some ground, if only slightly.
Looking at the progress of the task, which was currently around forty percent, Colin used the knowledge Shana had taught him to take advantage of the other party’s psychological easing, stating proactively:
“If everything goes well, perhaps I can take you out of this place, to a relatively safer area compared to here, where there won’t be so many anomalies.”
Colin wasn’t too clear whether the transfer would be to Earth or somewhere else at that time.
But in any case…
It was definitely going to be much better than this twelfth-floor hospital.
The level of danger here was almost catching up with the outskirts of the “Disaster of Magic Fog,” although it seemed that the number of oddities was not as endless as the Mist Disaster, Colin had observed that the anomalies here could not be killed by conventional methods.
Even he couldn’t do it…
The anomalies in this damned place don’t drop anything when killed, indicating they are only somewhat like “projections”.
And to truly resolve the situation, one would have to delve deeply into who knows how many layers.
But even Colin, a “Flamebearer” Reservist, had no idea what lay beyond the hospital, not to mention these “ordinary people” here who only had a bit of power at their disposal.
“Leaving here…” the leading survivor fell silent upon hearing his words.
Although the mysterious strong man’s words were tempting, they still felt very unreal to them.
Of course, despite the sense of unreality, she couldn’t help asking, “What’s outside?”
Good, being interested in the outside is good…
Colin thought to himself, luckily these were not like the silicon-based beings from the shattered crystal clusters he had met while delivering messages before. Those creatures had poor heat dissipation, preferred cold areas, and when Colin spoke of warmth, each of them thought he was describing a fearsome hell.
It caused some unpleasant misunderstanding…
“There are foods sufficient to solve hunger, there is a giant “Flame” called the ‘sun’ suspended in the sky that appears regularly, showering warmth and light when it’s time, giving people hope and courage, as well as, lights that allow people to pass through the darkness, tools that enable one to easily cross thousands of miles…”
Listening to Colin’s description, the people showed wistful expressions.
Especially that “sun,” according to records, people had indeed lived in such a world a long time ago.
And sometimes, the people who were bred from a biological substance obtained from “Psychotic Madmen” would receive their information, conceiving strange memories in their minds.
Among them were memories of such a fascinating world.
‘How did Brother Shunzi manage to turn everyday things into content as sacred as the Bible?’ the eyes behind the bandages of the Ashen Holy Body widened.
But despite his surprise, he also carefully recorded Brother Shunzi’s expressions and movements.
After all, he couldn’t be sure if a similar task would require such details in the future…
After a while, having listened to Colin’s descriptions, which weren’t much of a deception, the hospital survivors’ leader spoke:
“It’s a tempting world, but, I don’t believe it.”
Pausing for a moment, she added: “Instead of these intangible words, we trust things that can be held.”
“What do you want? As long as it exists, I can promise you anything…” Colin felt she might want some items or something.
But the next second, he saw her lick her lips, and a bad feeling suddenly surged in his heart.
“I want your biological reproducibility biomass… not too much, just ten milliliters will do.”
“Huh?”
A puzzled look crossed Colin’s face, and he took a moment to grasp what the biological reproducibility biomass she referred to meant; then, even with his wide experience and numerous missions completed, he drew a sharp breath…

chapters.title: Chapter 769 - 769 543 The Darkness Has Arrived Goodbye
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 769: Chapter 543 The Darkness Has Arrived, Goodbye, Friends._2 Chapter 769: Chapter 543 The Darkness Has Arrived, Goodbye, Friends._2 At that moment, the woman stared at Colin with intense eyes and licked her lips, making him involuntarily avert his gaze.
“You can offer yourself to us, or we can take you by force. Of course, we will use only the finest bodies to conceive new life, and we will certainly not disgrace your genes…” the woman said in a strangely eerie tone.
For them, this was, in a certain sense, not too shameful of a matter…
There was even some excitement.
After all, given his terrifying strength, just imagine how powerful the offspring would be if he were to mate with them?
Colin on the other side could feel something in their gazes, and he finally understood the weird looks he had received from the women along the way…
If the roles were reversed, their expressions were just like those of middle-aged men who had spotted a beautiful woman!
“No… this, this is not okay.”
Colin pursed his lips and chose to refuse. He really hadn’t expected that when he wanted to lead these people out, they actually wanted to draw him in for breeding.
The leading female seemed somewhat disappointed but then pointed to another person wrapped in bandages:
“Then… he can also suffice.”
“Him?” Colin was a bit tempted this time by the idea of not dying alone and turned to look at the Ashen Holy Body, but immediately saw him shake his head like a rattle-drum.
“Brother Shunzi, no, this kind of XP is still a bit too advanced for me…” the Ashen Holy Body struggled to sit up and protested, despite his condition seemingly improving.
If it were just a fleeting moment of springtime, he might have been able to adapt.
But the thought of leaving descendants was a bit too much for him.
It scared him in the same way that being sent out as a “Legal Representative” did.
‘What an ungrateful fool!’
Colin muttered in frustration within, although the women were a tad too muscular, a bit taller than average, generally over two meters tall, and even reaching two and a half meters, looking rather imposing.
But they still had their charms, and yet this guy had refused them!
Nonetheless, he didn’t insist, shaking his head as well, “He’s not up for it either. Perhaps in the future I could bring someone who is willing, but until then, none of us are likely to accept…
“Of course, I have a suggestion. When there’s a chance in the future, I’ll bring some interested people here, or maybe I’ll take a group of you out, and then you can try to… mate.”
Hearing this, the female leader nodded, “That’s acceptable. What do you need our assistance with next?”
Even though the negotiations were not going ideally, it was still important to not let relations sour too much.
“I want to understand some of the history of this place, the situation here, and other information…”
Colin said directly.
His mission progress was still in the forties, and after gathering this information he figured he should just about be able to complete the collection.
Hearing this, they exchanged glances and whispered among themselves for a while before nodding in agreement to Colin’s request and began to share some basic information…
Several hundred years ago, their ancestors entered this area as refugees seeking sanctuary, fleeing a catastrophe that was said to bring the downfall of all things.
In the early days, this place wasn’t as dangerous, but over the decades, as the world outside fluctuated, it became increasingly perilous.
The white-robed nurses who had provided protection and care suddenly disappeared one day and did not return.
It was over a decade before they showed up again and brought with them a “medical order.”
“The situation deep within is becoming tense, please avoid our scrutiny, carve out suitable areas for refuge…”
After that, the white-robed nurses disappeared for several years.
The refugees began various underground works, digging out shelters following the medical order.
After a considerable time, the nurses appeared once more.
This time, they brought another “medical order”: “The Dean is making a final stand against those things with the doctors; massive sacrifices are occurring, and the situation deep within is growing tense. Please hurry, we can’t provide much more time…”
After delivering this message, many years passed once more before the nurses showed up again.
“We apologize profoundly, even though we still wish to fulfill our sacred duties of protection and healing, unfortunately, we will no longer be able to carry out these responsibilities. From this moment on, this place will no longer be safe, please survive as best as you can, hope is in tomorrow…”
After relaying this last piece of information, the white-robed nurses blockaded the entire hospital and activated something unknown.
Subsequently, people entered their self-excavated sanctuaries.
They thought it would be a long time before they would see each other again…
But this time, it wasn’t long before the nurses clad in white returned and presented one final “medical order.”
“Darkness has arrived, goodbye, friends.”
After that, all the nurses’ uniforms turned blood red. They would wander everywhere, capturing any humans that might appear. Many of our tribesmen who went out to the periphery to search for supplies were captured, disassembled, and transported to the depths to be “preserved.”
…
“Probably something from around one or two hundred years ago…”
Listening to the female employee, Colin calculated in his mind. It was that same time point again, probably around when “Bonfire Company” went bankrupt.
It wasn’t just here; the entire area under the jurisdiction of “Bonfire Company” experienced unimaginable drastic changes.
All sorts of disasters and tragedies, far too many to count.
And through the rapidly increasing task progress, Colin knew that most of what this elder sister was saying must be true.
However…
“How do you remember everything so clearly?”
Colin was astonished for a moment.
This was the place where he had heard the most complete range of information so far, with clear recollections of what happened in which year, the specific words of certain people, and even what they looked like.
“From the memories in my brain, I’ve already lost a lot…”
The woman pointed to her head and continued, “Those ‘Red-dressed Nurses’ aren’t entirely bad, though. Besides refreshing themselves, they can also come when we call for help. If there are other anomalies at the scene, the ‘Red-dressed Nurse’ will prioritize resolving the anomalies before coming to us…”
By this means, one could use the nurses’ power to preserve oneself as much as possible.
“Is that so…” Colin nodded, then inquired about the current situation.
For instance, in the description of the other party, the early refugees didn’t seem to be all female?
And they appeared to be normal people; their statures weren’t so exaggerated.
“I don’t know why it’s like this. Probably after the disaster, things started to get more and more serious…” said the woman who was the leader.
Although with some breeding techniques in the hospital, they, the same sex, could also combine.
However, the offspring born that way were prone to various defects, such as disordered memory inheritance, congenital deformities, and so on…
To resolve this, one could only go to special mental asylum wards to capture the “Psychotic” refreshing there for breeding…
Sometimes, the elder sisters would find a way to damage the wards, and the people inside would escape.
Then they would be captured by those lying in wait…
Although the “Psychotic” had some mental issues, the offspring they bred, apart from being likely to be female, had no other problems.
At this point, the leading woman looked at Colin with a gaze filled with regret.
She now knew that something had attached itself to their “quality” breeding resources.
‘Hiss, so the “Psychotic” could escape because of you? And all along, the reason we couldn’t find those who had escaped is that they were captured by you for breeding…’
Colin didn’t know what to say for a moment. He fell silent internally, then continued to ask:
“Then where do those ‘Psychotic’ come from?”
“Don’t know. But after a period of time, they always refresh. Soon after they come out, they die, then their bodies disappear. No idea where they go…”
The leading woman felt that this might be some sort of assistance given by an enigmatic presence that had listened to their plight.
But thinking it might not be appropriate to say this out loud, she kept it to herself.
“Alright.”
Colin nodded, not pressing further on the matter. He checked the task progress, which had already soared to eighty percent.
Asking a few more details should allow him to complete the task.
He thought a bit, then started to inquire about how many survivors there were and the like.
But in this regard, the other party only gave him a relatively vague number, maintaining around thirty thousand. As for their locations and distribution, she didn’t provide Colin with specifics.
After contemplating for a moment, Colin suddenly had an “epiphany” and thought of something:
“Do you remember a Bonfire Company employee like us passing through here a few years ago?”
.

chapters.title: Chapter 770 - 770 544 We Lost an Employee_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 770: Chapter 544 We Lost an Employee_1 Chapter 770: Chapter 544 We Lost an Employee_1 “Similar to you, outsiders?”
Upon hearing Colin’s words, some of the female survivors seemed to have recalled something.
A moment later, the leading woman nodded again and said, “There was one, about two and a half years ago. Indeed, there was someone like that who came by, but I’m not sure if he’s the person you are looking for, and there’s another thing, the one who made contact with him at that time wasn’t us, but another shelter…”
“Another area? Can you tell me more about it? Or perhaps, I can promise some normal conditions in exchange for his information.”
Colin was surprised; he was just asking casually and did not expect any answer.
After all, the area covered by the hospital, layer by layer, was still very large…
Had he not possessed a sense of smell far exceeding that of normal people, among other abilities, he probably wouldn’t have been able to meet these people even after living here for quite some time.
But unexpectedly, there actually was a lead?
However…
‘Two and a half years doesn’t quite match up. According to the forum, he should have only been in there for over half a year, less than a year, but most of this information is his own account and may not be true…’
As Colin’s thoughts churned, he decided to understand more before speaking further.
At that moment, he heard the female leader continue, “There’s no need for an exchange for this information; I’ll just tell you, we were providing support to them at the time and had some contact. Although it wasn’t much, the impression was still very profound.”
Soon, through the leader’s explanation, Colin understood what this “profound” meant—
It was a person terribly afflicted by misfortune.
Drinking water could lead to choking, speaking would occasionally result in biting the tongue, allergies would constantly plague the body, walking could result in being inexplicably tripped by a small stone, and furthermore, all sorts of unusual “accidents” would always find their way to him…
If it were not for his exceptional strength, he would have likely died in one of those disasters.
While describing this, the female leader couldn’t help feeling a bit of admiration, for that guy was one of the rare strong individuals who managed to return unscathed from disasters like the “Corpse Tyrant” and even stronger entities like the “Puppet Tide” and “Corpse Feast.”
“This description must be correct.” Colin knew at once upon hearing it; it was that old unlucky fellow.
After all, if it weren’t for “misfortune,” it would be quite difficult for a normal E level extraordinary one to trip over a stone while walking or to choke when drinking water.
No, this would have a certain level of difficulty even for ordinary people.
Not to mention someone who had been injected with “Gene Compensation Medicine” several times, with bodily coordination far surpassing ordinary people by who knows how many levels, a formal employee of the company.
Yet, all descriptions matched perfectly.
Only the timeline was slightly off.
‘As far as I remember, the earliest distress signal from that guy, measured in precise months, was sent seven months ago, and by his own account, approximately one to two months after being trapped inside, his mission ended, and he found the opportunity to send out the message.’
‘But if what’s said here is accurate, then it’s been two and a half years, and that introduces a significant conflict…’
Colin then spoke again to the female leader to confirm, making sure the information he received was not lost in “translation.”
“So, you’re saying that the actual time he was trapped could be longer than his own awareness? Or is there a time discrepancy? No, if there were a time discrepancy, he should have realized it himself, just like ‘World Code 13,’ it wouldn’t happen that he spent two and a half years inside but was oblivious to the passage of that time…”
Colin remembered the rules posted in the lobby of the hospital outpatient department.
Although he had long suspected it had something to do with that employee, suspicion was one thing, and actually making a connection was quite another…
“Actually, speaking of which, that person is of some importance to us, if not for him, we might have been surrounded by various disaster entities at the time.” The female leader seemed to recall something, speaking with residual fear.
“Unfortunately, when we tried to find him later, not long after establishing contact, he was forced to escape alone into another anomalous area due to being targeted by the ‘Dean’… As for what happened after, we are not sure, because we never saw him again after that. Based on our estimation, it’s highly likely that he was either devoured or dismembered and taken far away.”
‘It sounds like neither outcome was particularly good,’ Colin pursed his lips.
At that moment, the two-meter-tall female leader continued to ask, “What is your relationship with him?”
Up to this point, she had not been informed of the exact nature of their relationship.
“If there’s no mistake, he is probably an employee from our company who went missing…” Colin said succinctly.
“I see…” The female leader nodded, unaware of the exact meaning of “company,” but from the other party’s words, it seemed to refer to a power similar to a religion, gang, or something akin to different shelter managers…
Having cleared up the leader’s confusion, Colin turned his head to look at another employee lying stiff on a bed:
“Right, do you remember how long ago you received his message?”
As he spoke, looking at the injured employee lying on the hospital bed wrapped in bandages—seeing the state of him, Colin suddenly couldn’t help but wonder, if he hadn’t come along on this trip, would this guy, after healing from his injuries, end up being pulled by this group of strong women for breeding purposes?
But before he could ponder further, the Ashen Holy Body sat up with difficulty, enduring the pain all over his body: “Cough cough cough, I, cough cough, I remember it was about five months ago, he, cough cough, and the earliest he appeared, by current calculations, seems to be around nine months…”
