chapters.title: Chapter 771 - 771 544 We Lost an Employee_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 771: Chapter 544 We Lost an Employee_2 Chapter 771: Chapter 544 We Lost an Employee_2 Listening to Colin’s conversation with the locals, he also discovered some clues.
This “The Unyielding”…
Definitely had a problem!
First possibility, either he intentionally concealed something, and thus deliberately lured people over for rescue, or secondly, he might not even know what was happening…
Truly believing he had only been here for just over half a year or eight to nine months.
As for the reasons, there were many possibilities. Either the person had been controlled, replaced, or contaminated…
Everything was possible.
But no matter which possibility it was, the situation didn’t look good.
“I think he… cough cough cough…” the Ashen Holy Body spoke, but couldn’t help coughing violently, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth.
“You better not talk anymore, I pretty much understand what you mean. Let me treat you first.”
Colin raised his hand to stop the other party from speaking and then continued to summon his own medical model employees.
The next second, the Fire Tree appeared before the eyes of the crowd of ladies. It was like a banyan tree, but its leaves were clumps of flames, and it extended hundreds of aerial roots, which pierced into the skin of the Ashen Holy Body like raindrops.
On the side, the ladies all took a sharp breath when they saw this…
Yet, amidst their horror, they also noticed that on the Ashen Holy Body, the wounds so severe that a normal kin wouldn’t survive were rapidly healing.
Soon, he could even get out of bed and walk!
Know that not long before, the other party had been blasted, his internal organs ruptured, limbs shattered, almost as if he were dying.
But now he was actually able to get out of bed and move…
For everyone present, it was almost like witnessing a miracle of resurrection!
“If any of you need it, you can also come here for treatment.”
Colin looked at the ladies with wide eyes and directly made a decision on behalf of the Fire Tree.
Not to say that the “Fire Tree” was truly capable of bringing back the dead in terms of healing, as the company and even the official resources had many medical items that surpassed it.
But its range of knowledge was indeed very wide.
Not to mention the normal carbon-based human body, but it had also delved into many stone silicon-based beings and knew how to treat them. It could easily handle pollution of the Third Level or below, qualifying as a general practitioner.
And hearing Colin’s words, the ladies hesitated for a moment, but ultimately chose to accept this “generosity.”
After all, many of them had suffered very, very serious injuries. If there was a chance to be healed, that would naturally be best.
‘The task progress is over ninety percent, almost there…’
Colin glanced at the current progress of the task.
Gathering information through casual conversation for investigation tasks was not only less risky but also much faster than randomly killing things outside. If it had been outside, he estimated that he might not have even reached halfway by now…
‘I should learn some more about the local current ecological environment, anomalies, and the like, and then I could complete it.’
As his thoughts flickered, Colin began to ask about related matters.
“In this hospital, in the lobby on the first floor of every building, or in the inpatient areas, food that can be used may refresh anywhere from every three to fifteen days. During this time, we send out exploration teams to collect these supplies…”
“If we don’t collect them, they’ll just be left to rot, and then the ‘Red-Robed Nurse’ will take them away and dispose of them to continue the refresh…”
“Yeah, not just food, some medications also refresh, but for this, each different department refreshes different medicines. For mental illnesses, you have to go to Psychiatry; for broken legs and arms, go to Orthopedics or the Emergency Department…”
Of course, although they might not necessarily need medical supplies, they would definitely collect as much as possible if they could.
Because medication could not only be consumed: with proper processing, it could be turned into explosives, poisons, toxic gas weapons, and so on.
‘It does seem like a lot of medications can essentially be used to make explosives. But what’s this? Is humanity’s Talent just to blow up wherever they go?’ Colin pursed his lips.
To tell the truth, from the information given by this female leader, the group of people who had fled here…
was likely a group of ordinary Earth humans with some abilities.
An example is that the language here is a rare mishmash of Earth languages, and although there are some self-created characters, more are direct uses of original characters from Chinese, English, German, and so on.
So the “Bomber Faction” Talent might be because they are “Earth people”?
And at this moment, the female leader continued:
“Along the way, we might encounter ‘Puppet People,’ ‘Laughing Nightmare,’ ‘zombies,’ ‘Corpse Tyrant,’ ‘big-headed crazies,’ ‘Shredded Flesh Horde,’ and dozens of other anomalies. Ah, the ‘Shredded Flesh Horde’ is those chunks of flesh on the ground. We suspect they might be what people turn into after being captured by the ‘Red-dressed Nurse,’ impossible to kill no matter how you try…”
As the female leader elaborated bit by bit, Colin’s mission progress also came closer and closer to one hundred percent.
‘I was curious where the hell the food in this place comes from, never thought it would automatically refresh… and it seems to be quite nutritious too.’ Colin muttered to himself inwardly, thinking this place was simply a “Saintess trap”…
If Shana knew of a similar place where one could get food without any moral burden, she might well visit it daily to “zero-cost shop” even if there was an “Ancient God” guarding it, braving the risk of injury—
After all, Shana had indeed done something similar before, fighting over eight hundred Points with an “Ancient God”…
‘Damn, that’s tough. No, shit, those bastards at the branch office really don’t treat people like humans, conning my Shana to fight with that kind of existence for eight hundred Points! If anything happened to her, I would tear them apart!’
Shaking his head to dispel the thoughts, Colin continued to listen silently for information.
He then heard the female captain next to the leader mention that they didn’t know what had happened, but the entire hospital world began to shake, numerous anomalies and the ‘Red-dressed Nurse’ died in droves, and a terrifying fissure cracked open…
But it was this very fissure that led to something emerging from deeper within the world.
Colin’s expression turned odd for a moment: ‘This couldn’t have been the result of the top three fighting, could it?’
He had previously thought that the effects would only reach the surrounding few layers at most, but never expected it to cut so deep?
After asking for more details, it seemed it really was the case.
The impact of the fight had reached further and more deeply than he had imagined, affecting even the twelfth layer and beyond…
“By the way, do you guys remember why you ended up with such an imbalanced male-to-female ratio?” Colin asked out of curiosity.
The female leader had previously skimmed over these matters and hadn’t been very detailed.
“We’re not very clear on the situation either. There are guesses it’s due to the food, some think it’s environmental reasons, and there are also some fragmented passed-down memories that could be a factor…”
“Fragmented memories?” Colin asked.
“The memories we pieced together ourselves suggest that a hundred years ago, something incredibly terrifying broke free from deep within the hospital. As it passed through here when it left, it seemed to have affected our bodies. The timing lines up with that event. Later, we observed that the thing, may not necessarily have left, or it might not have left at all, or it could even have come from outside our world, wanting to enter here…”
That part of history was too broken to restore, and they generally assumed it was something from the depths that had left.
But there were many possibilities, nothing was certain…
“What was it, do you have any impression?” Colin became more curious, what could have merely passed by and caused such mutations in people’s genes?
The female leader said uncertainly: “I vaguely remember it might have something to do with a burst of ‘Red Light.’ We suspect the ‘Red-dressed Nurse’ might be caused by it, because since that event, the ‘Red-dressed Nurse’ appeared for the first time…”
But before she could finish, Colin suddenly raised his hand to signal her to stop talking.
Upon hearing the word “Red Light,” Colin stopped probing further…
“Red Light” passing by and not causing genetic damage, allowing these people to stand here instead of turning into a pile of organs crawling everywhere, they’d have to thank the Bonfire for that.
Of course, the most crucial thing was…
As the female leader was speaking, the investigation mission indicated it was complete!
That meant, after Colin made the confirmation, a new cycle of events appeared, this time apparently the final event!
…

chapters.title: Chapter 772 - 772 545 Three Celestial Bodies World_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 772: Chapter 545 Three Celestial Bodies World!_1 Chapter 772: Chapter 545 Three Celestial Bodies World!_1 [Special Event One: Within twelve hours, assemble all willing survivors from the twelve levels and evacuate them through the temporary bonfire ‘Evacuation Passage’ to the train outside the doors of ‘Inquiry Department’ on the first level of the ‘Hospital that Does Not Exist’.]
“Note 1”: When the time is right, please tear the “letter” and create the passage.
“Note 2”: Spread the news about the transfer as much as possible.
[Special Event Two: After the ‘Evacuation Passage’ is open, it will attract the scrutiny of deep-layer aggregated entities. Please complete interdiction actions at the twelve-level site to prevent these entities from entering the ‘Evacuation Passage’.]
“Note”: It can only appear as an individual. If this fails, the mission is considered a failure.
[Special Event Three: When it appears, please kill it and, while the connection is not interrupted, deliver the “Token” to the area beyond the thirteenth level.]
“Note”: Completing this event is considered as completing the entirety of the event.
…
“It’s again three task items, but overall it’s more or less a single mission.”
Colin pursed his lips, examining the tasks closely.
The first mission required a transfer. The moment he saw rational people upon his arrival, he had a premonition, so it was not a surprise to him.
Glancing at the note, Colin, with a sense of understanding, opened “Storage Room” to take a look.
Indeed, there was a special letter inside.
‘Not surprisingly, it should contain some special contract or something… Sigh, when can I also sign some documents and directly mobilize forces from other places through thin air?’
Colin felt envious, but soon, he began to feel a headache coming on…
How to assemble these people?
From what he had seen so far, life here was not too miserable, for food would replenish itself. They’ve gotten used to any anomalies over the decades and have developed their own social operation patterns.
Moreover, these people fled here as refugees, and their impression of the outside world has been one of a destroyed “apocalyptic” landscape.
There was a certain resistance to the outside world, albeit not strong, it was still present…
So, related work was not that easy to handle.
Unlike some places from where they originally came, where they had the concept that the world was about to end and they wanted to transfer to somewhere else.
Of course, not to say they had no problems whatsoever, after all, they currently face a jumble of issues such as some disorder in their “genes”, which made it hard to find suitable mating partners…
‘This is a bit troublesome…’
Colin raised his hand to pinch the bridge of his nose, feeling somewhat troubled—no, that’s not quite right, he suddenly paused his movements: “Is it all survivors willing to leave?”
It doesn’t require all personnel?
Colin paused, realizing the problem might not be so big.
Then, he looked at the second part: “So, something will follow along, trying to escape through the opportunity?”
Colin suddenly understood why the note for Event One advised spreading the news as widely as possible.
It was most likely a ploy within a ploy.
Because according to the description above, if that thing didn’t come down and didn’t appear desiring the outside world, it would be impossible to kill it and thus impossible to use it to open a passage to the deeper levels and throw in the severed hand…
“So, deep-dwelling entities, even knowing the risks, will gamble on a future?”
After thinking it over, Colin felt it resembled a “sunshine plot.”
“Lady Rabbit” had laid the opportunity and bait out there; in any case, it had to attempt it…
As long as it defeated Colin, it would have a chance to leave.
And as for why it would still attempt despite knowing the trap, after experiencing so much, Colin had an idea that with a certain time drawing near,
often not attempting something would mean truly having no chance at all.
For example, the likes of “King of Madness”, apart from being atrociously tormented, could feel an ultimate moment approaching, and if it didn’t leave, there would be no chance left…
As thoughts whirled around, Colin suddenly realized that the “engagement” between influential figures was often out in the open.
There could be secrets and conspiracies, but they were not the greatest part.
“However, according to what I know, after throwing the severed hand in, the ‘Hospital’ will be safe in a sense. But the ‘self-service feast’ might not refresh anymore at that time…”
Colin thought about it, not entirely certain.
But since the mission didn’t mention it, he figured it must have been taken care of, so there was no need to worry too much.
‘Next is figuring out how to find some people who are willing to leave.’
Considering for a moment, Colin suddenly looked up at the ladies in front of the table who were waiting for him to finish his contemplation.
“There’s something I would like to know, are there any people or forces here who want to leave?” Colin inquired.
“People who want to leave?”
The female leader thought and nodded, saying, “There are some, a small portion of the shelter’s people always think about leaving but haven’t found a suitable opportunity…”
After so many years, indeed not everyone wanted to just stay put.
But from past to present, most attempts to leave ended tragically…
This time, however, she didn’t mind doing Colin a favor by putting him in touch with those people.
After all, if there truly was a viable place outside, these people could explore and then send back the news, leading to further attempts to venture outside…
Just as she was about to say something more, a tall woman walked in.

chapters.title: Chapter 773 - 773 545
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 773: 545 Chapter 773: 545 And he quickly approached the female leader, whispering, “Lady Bai has personally brought a support team over…”
“Lady Bai? She came herself?” The female leader was startled for a moment but soon remembered that they had sent out some distress signals to other refuges when the former female squadron leader had an accident during an exploration mission.
Lady Bai was indeed the Administrator of another refuge…
The reason for her personal arrival was with a not so small probability due to having heard some rumors about “outsiders.”
“Bring them directly here,” the female leader instructed.
After sending the person away, she nodded at Colin, saying, “Good timing, they are very ambitious and strong, one of the few groups that are interested in reaching out.”
Colin noncommittally replied, “That’s quite fortuitous.”
Soon, another group of tall women approached.
Some of them carried cannon tubes, some shouldered large swords, and together with the subtle, swirling aura around them, their overall strength was quite decent.
‘Should I also increase my size a bit?’ Colin couldn’t help but think.
Compared to this group, the body he currently inhabited was only a little over one meter seventy, making him look like a child.
However, before he could act, the female leader stood up and briefly introduced Colin’s situation to the newcomer with a sword about two meters long on her back. When Lady Bai first laid eyes on Colin, her eyes suddenly shone.
This mental state and so on, so young, makes one unable to resist the urge to play with… Lady Bai took a slight breath, sat down not far from Colin, and both sides briefly understood each other.
‘Why do I feel like this woman’s gaze is so starkly naked…’ Colin was somewhat at a loss for words about his own emotions.
After talking about his situation, Lady Bai also restrained something in her gaze:
“Do you mean to say, you’ve come to lead us out of this dangerous world? How can you prove you can do this and ensure it isn’t a scam?”
Although they were quite interested in leaving this place to find the true blue sky and the real world,
it didn’t mean they would blindly trust anyone’s words.
Upon hearing this, Colin pondered for a few seconds and eventually shook his head, “To be honest, I really can’t provide concrete evidence right now. All I can do is take an oath in front of ‘Bonfire,’ after completing all of this, to ensure I haven’t lied…”
An oath taken in front of “Bonfire” allows both parties to feel the establishment of a ‘contract.’
Regrettably, the foundational conditions for the faith in “Bonfire” are absent here…
The other party might not even give him the chance to take the oath, to avoid potential dangers.
“‘Bonfire’?” Lady Bai tilted her head, looking at him.
“Yes, that’s it.”
Without hesitation, Colin lifted his hand and snapped his fingers with a “pop,” while covertly using the “Bonfire” Golden Mark with his left hand.
The next second, a burst of flame erupted, filling the entire hall!
The warm flame emitted from above made everyone present feel a long-missed comfort and a rather positive emotion…
“We’ll talk about the oath later, first you need to tell me, what is the outside world like?” Lady Bai shot an aggressive glance at the collar of Colin’s shirt, licked her lips, giving Colin goosebumps and making him involuntarily pull his collar up a bit.
‘Why does this negotiation feel like selling oneself…’ Colin was not used to this odd atmosphere.
It felt like the people here would strip him bare…
At that moment, Lady Bai smiled and said, “So, what’s the outside world like? You must be able to tell us that, right? And after leaving, you ought to provide some information about where we can survive, right?
“Otherwise, if we leave and everyone shuns us, and it turns out to be worse than here, wouldn’t that be leaving for nothing?”
If the outside world is beautiful, but if those people are unwilling to accept them, then going there would become an invasion…
Wars would inevitably break out, and countless people would die.
If that’s the case, then there’s no need to leave.
“That’s easy to answer, assurances for living space and treatment can be promised. As for what the outside is like…”
Colin brought out the “Light” Golden Mark and activated it according to his thoughts.
Interwoven beams of light appeared in the air, projecting images of the outside world with orderly high-rise buildings, lush forests, meandering rivers, and three enormous suns above the sky… Huh?
Three suns?!
No, that seemed not to be suns, but rather… supersized bonfires replacing the sun?
‘What’s going on?’ Colin was taken aback, what he had intended to display was not like this!
It was at this moment that he noticed some of the buildings in the image looked excessively sci-fi, not something commonly found on Earth.
And in the clouds in the sky, there was one after another “Sky City” drifting.
Suddenly, an inspiration struck.
Colin realized the scene was from “The Second Box Garden World,” a corner of the safe zone of that world!
That is to say, the destination of the train wasn’t Earth, but this place?
“It looks so advanced, I want to go myself…” Colin murmured to himself.
Having visited many “Other Worlds,” this was the first time he saw such a seemingly very safe place.
And when Colin displayed the image, everyone present was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - 774 545 Three Celestial Bodies World_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 774: Chapter 545 Three Celestial Bodies World!_3 Chapter 774: Chapter 545 Three Celestial Bodies World!_3 In his mind, memories from the “ancestors” surged forth, and those fragments started to correspond with the scene before him, sufficiently proving that the imagery wasn’t just fanciful, but real!
As for the small differences, such as there being not one but three suns in the sky…
But so much time had passed, a little change was normal.
And it was more likely that there was just a minor issue with the ancestral memory.
“The real world…”
Some people, overwhelmed with emotion, couldn’t help reaching out to touch, but their hands merely passed through the light and shadow…
On the other side, the largely recovered “Innate Ashen Holy Body,” after initially seeing nothing amiss in the projection of light, began to feel something was off upon noticing there was more than one sun.
Considering there were so many people present, asking questions would be like slapping Brother Shunzi’s face, so he ultimately swallowed his words.
After a long observation, Lady Bai reluctantly withdrew her gaze, “Can you guarantee… that I can go there, and that there will be a place for me to live?”
All the things contained therein were immensely vast, exuding a great sense of oppression.
She was well aware that a group capable of building such things was certainly beyond their ability to defeat.
‘If it wasn’t for the mission’s guidance, to be honest, I can’t fully guarantee it myself,’ Colin thought, initially assuming he was going to Earth where, given his status, he could definitely ensure preferential treatment.
Just like those children who had come from “The Seventh Box Garden World,” who were now being strictly protected.
However, the problem wasn’t too significant…
Colin felt that he was now negotiating on behalf “Lady Rabbit,” and the promises he made were as if “Lady Rabbit” herself had made them.
And a high-ranking member of “Bonfire Company” wouldn’t likely renege on such a basic issue.
“Yes, the oath in the Bonfire will include this,” he said.
“Let’s try then…” Lady Bai paused for a moment, ultimately consenting, and didn’t let her subordinates try but stepped forward herself.
Soon after, a special Bonfire was kindled.
In the presence of “Bonfire,” Colin made some promises on behalf of “Lady Rabbit.”
After quietly listening, Lady Bai, following some inexplicable guidance, reached out her hand and pressed it upon the Bonfire.
“Contract review passed, the terms of this event shall be protected by the ‘Bonfire Protocol’…”
A line of fiery red captions appeared before her eyes.
In that instant, even though she found it hard to describe the feeling, she was certain that these oaths were indeed valid…
“I trust you…” Lady Bai nodded her head.
“Then, let’s take action now, notify all those who wish to leave, find a suitable location, well, you all come together, how much time will you need?”
Seeing her agreement, Colin also relaxed somewhat.
At last, the first step was taken.
“There are many inclined to leave, possibly tens of thousands, but only about three thousand are as resolute in their decision as I am. Regarding time, at least a day or two, since there’s a lot of danger between the shelters, and sometimes we must wait for the danger to pass before we can move on…”
However, before she finished, Colin interrupted, “What if there were no dangers on the paths between the shelters?”
“No dangers? Ha ha, that might just take a few hours then, but how are you going to accomplish that?”
Lady Bai was just about to shake her head, declaring it impossible.
But the next second, an incredibly startling flame suddenly erupted before them, the intimidating presence sweeping in all directions, shaking everyone profoundly.
Amidst the flames, Colin slightly tilted his head back, surveying everyone with a confident expression:
“Because I am the one who can make the journey free of danger.”
.

chapters.title: Chapter 775 - 775 546 The Cost of Leaving_1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 775: Chapter 546 The Cost of Leaving_1 Chapter 775: Chapter 546 The Cost of Leaving_1 “Whoosh—”
A streak of flame shot out like a sharp arrow.
Along its path, any aberration in the way burst into flames upon the slightest contact with the fire, screaming as it turned to ashes.
At the end of the fire arrow’s trajectory, a creature made up of numerous broken limbs instantly died.
And with it, the entire area became a surging inferno, transforming into magma…
“Too weak, can’t even take one of my moves, sigh, it looked quite big, didn’t expect it to be like this. Had I known, I wouldn’t have exerted so much strength. But it’s also my fault, not controlling this frail body well, not having a good grasp on my power.”
Colin led the way to the front, hands spread open, shaking his head and sighing helplessly as he spoke.
By his side, Lady Bai, who had been leading the team all along, followed numbly.
Previously, when Colin said that the journey would be safe, Lady Bai and the others didn’t quite believe him; after all, she wasn’t aware of his strength but was very clear about the capabilities of the physical entities here.
Unexpectedly, these creatures, in his hands, often didn’t last a single round before being killed…
“Could these monsters have become weaker now?” a member of the survivor team whispered from the back of the group.
After all, he seemed to handle them too easily…
It felt somewhat fake!
One touch, one kill, it felt completely unlike what they usually encountered!
At that moment, not far away, there suddenly came an attack from a “test Bunny” as large as a small car, skinless, with its flesh monstrously twisted, emitting a distorted aura.
Seeing this, she immediately broke away from the team and rushed forward, bringing her greatsword down on its head.
However, with a heavy thud, her two-meter-tall body was sent flying away as if it were made of paper.
The gigantic “test Bunny” opened its pitted front teeth and lunged at her head.
Despite her teammates opening fire in retaliation, the “test Bunny” continued its assault unfazed…
Just as she felt her skull was about to be crushed, a fire that had exploded on the Bunny suddenly blazed, burning the entire test subject to cinders.
Amidst the fluttering flames, other than her hair and some parts of her clothing being burned away, the woman who broke away from the team seemed to be unharmed…
“Good thing I reacted quickly. But don’t wander off on your own, lady, I may not always be able to save someone that easily…”
Colin’s figure had appeared beside her at some point, extending his hand: “Just follow me closely.”
“Uh-huh…” She opened her mouth, but in the end said nothing. She placed her hand on his, which he reached out to her, and he pulled her up…
During that time, she couldn’t resist pinching his soft, warm hand.
“When we get back, you’ll do ten rounds of penance…” Lady Bai’s voice came through, severing the whimsical thoughts of the team member who had doubted the weakening of the monsters, causing her expression to change, but she nodded in understanding nonetheless.
A single round of punitive training was enough to shed a layer of skin, let alone ten…
As Lady Bai turned her gaze away, she apologized to Colin and couldn’t help but marvel again at his strength.
As for the “strange words” Colin spoke, they didn’t feel much embarrassment, even thinking this was the attitude a strong person should display: confident! Boastful! Unstoppable!
She had thought he was just a boaster, a common man speaking sweet words.
But as for her own emotions, the Ashen Holy Body at the back didn’t have much to think about, since Brother Shunzi’s strength had been very “restrained”…
Before, when Brother Shunzi took action without restraint, wherever he went turned into a vast sea of flames.
All abnormal entities would burn to ash, looking like the end of the world.
Just one glance could burden one with the original sin.
Where could there be survivors like now?
Of course, it was normal for Brother Shunzi’s stand-in to be less powerful than the original, but Brother Shunzi seemed to have used some kind of item, making his words sound strange…
Meanwhile, up ahead,
“We’re a few hundred meters away from another shelter,” Lady Bai, a step behind Colin, pointed out the direction.
“Uh-huh.”
Colin nodded and continued forward.
For this trip to bring people back, he only brought a few dozen, leaving the vast majority with the female leader.
During the mission, despite displaying a seemingly “arrogant” exterior, Colin had plenty of caution in his heart, and his mind was also constantly thinking of various things…
‘After gathering everyone to open the portal later, and after confronting that guy to the thirteenth dismemberment, this round of the mission will be over. Does this mean giving up on the employees that were left here before?’ he thought.
‘Not really, after so much time, they’re most likely dead. With the situation unclear, it’s impossible to save them…’
As he reflected, Colin couldn’t help but think of the brother trapped on the eighteenth floor…
Given the mission details, it seemed there was no hope for the brother to come out.
‘Good thing I didn’t ask him for information at the start. Otherwise, if I’d made a promise to rescue him, that would be awkward…’
Colin always tried not to go against his promises.
If he made a promise and then reneged, his remaining conscience would ache…
Shaking his head inwardly, Colin refocused his thoughts and concentrated on the present. The main source of his current strength came from various items, as well as two Golden Marks.
The strength he exhibited was roughly comparable to his own power at the mid to late E level.

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - 776 546
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 776: 546 Chapter 776: 546 This body had already reached its limit of endurance.
Any further, Colin suspected, if he attempted anything like “Item Liberation”…
Highly likely within thirty minutes, no, maybe he couldn’t even last ten minutes, his body would turn to ashes within those ten minutes.
However, although he was a bit weaker, it was sufficient to deal with everything here before the possible arrival of a Level 2 Containment Subject…
At least he could maintain it for about seven or eight hours.
“Boom” went the sound.
After blowing up half a building, Colin took a deep breath to ease the weariness in his body.
‘Now I understand that feeling of restraint when the Ancient Gods descended into external Containers.’
Colin pursed his lips, indeed feeling a discomfort, as if his body could explode with the slightest misstep.
He had to be extremely careful with everything he did…
‘However, before the passage opens, the things deep inside probably won’t come over so easily. There would be some unspoken understanding, umm, just like now, at most encountering some ordinary creatures—not too strong, nor too weak.’
Having executed similar missions several times, Colin just needed to sense the surroundings to know what kind of trouble these anomalies were holding back.
Perhaps even if his plans went awry, the thing behind the scenes would have to lend a hand.
Both parties, after all, maintained a kind of “understanding” in these matters.
Of course, Colin wasn’t opposed to this…
After all, at least until the passage opens, there wouldn’t be too many nuisances. In a way, both parties’ interests aligned at the moment.
As for what happens after this phase, it would be a question of who has the stronger fist.
In the midst of these fleeting thoughts, Colin led his group across the massive hospital space, and in just about ten minutes, they arrived at another refuge carved out a hundred years ago.
A group of muscular and tall women, clad slightly differently, came walking out.
There weren’t many, just about a dozen, each with a face full of solemnity and suspicion as they regarded Colin and his companions.
Their approach had been marked by blazing flames and trembling earth—it would have been impossible to overlook them.
“I’ll go up and talk to them…” Lady Bai stepped forward out of the group, walking toward those women with barrels and hostility.
“White Rose, you…” The person about to accuse her of “betrayal” was interrupted before they could finish.
“I’m here to tell my people, the action begins, we shall be the forerunners, to leave this place before the others,” said Lady Bai swiftly and succinctly.
Upon hearing her words, the personnel of the responding squad fell silent for a while.
They indeed knew of Lady Bai’s audacious plan, or rather, for centuries, every time point has had such people unwilling to “settle for the status quo.”
Only, compared to those who paid a tragic cost and still ended up with an unknown fate,
this time seemed different…
“This time, is it because of this person?” The personnel of the garrison squad looked at Colin as they spoke.
“Yes, he is an outsider, and he has promised us everything…” Lady Bai briefly and quickly outlined the situation.
Pausing, she continued, “Of course, it’s not without cost. In return for leaving, we need to work for them for twenty years, nine hours each day, doing some basic work to pay off the debt…”
The oath also included details such as regular holidays, wages, and provisions for food and lodging…
Beyond that, there seemed to be a bunch of delicate young men—that part she did not say aloud.
But from what Colin introduced, it seemed like the outside world was such, abundant with men and scarce in women, practically a paradise…
Colin had negotiated for them relatively favorable work conditions as much as possible.
The garrison squad didn’t quite understand Lady Bai’s words, finding them a bit unreal.
Though it seemed unrealistic, after listening, she was very curious and asked Colin, “Can you… show us what that world looks like?”
“Yes, I can.”
Colin did not refuse. With his hands extended, the scenes from “The Second Box Garden World” emerged once again.
Meanwhile, he continued in a solemn tone, “The time for parting has come. I shall harness the power of ‘Bonfire’ to lead everyone yearning for a better life away from this world ravaged by disaster.”
With the blessing of two powers, his body was surrounded by flames, and the holy light overflowed, making him seem like a saint from mythological stories.
The people present couldn’t help but be somewhat convinced…
Eventually, she stepped aside and pointed to Lady Bai, “I will only allow you to enter, join me in taking your people, and some others who wish to leave.”
Lady Bai nodded, apologizing to Colin, and then followed her into the town.
Colin didn’t think there was any problem; he continued to bolster the flames, standing still, occasionally sparking some sparks to kill some anomalies that were tracking them.
He waited for quite some time, almost half an hour later…
Colin saw that the well cover in the flower bed next to the entrance of a hospital was suddenly pushed open. Then, a head peeked out, curiously surveyed the outside world, and then carefully climbed out.
After she came out, others began to “flow out” in succession.
For several minutes, when the last person emerged, there were a total of four hundred and thirty-one.
What surprised Colin was that among these people, there were actually dozens of “little girls” who were of normal height, roughly the same size as him.
There were even some who were obviously children, shorter than Colin…
“There are others as tall as me?” Colin was taken aback for a moment.
“Those you see, aside from some who are still around eight years old, are mostly malnourished. Their bodies can’t even reach one meter eighty and are only this tall. However, in a shelter, their numbers won’t be many, typically only having a one percent chance of being like this…” one of the ladies explained quietly upon hearing Colin’s words.
“I think this is what’s normal…” Colin pursed his lips.
Among a mass of abnormalities, what was normal started to seem unusual…
No, even if it’s “stunted growth,” it is much taller than an ordinary normal person.
As she explained to Colin, the tall assistant to Lady Bai observed his expressions to ensure that he was not annoyed at having to take the malnourished and even when he said that this seemed normal, she felt somewhat relieved.
About one-third of the people wanting to leave were “malnourished.”
It wasn’t because they loved adventure, but because they were the most oppressed, so when propaganda about establishing a new world order was spread, they were the ones who responded more…
Before long, the group gathered, and Colin led several hundred people to the next area.
Refuge after refuge, some people responded to the call to leave in each one.
Some contained thousands, others only a few dozen.
The reasons for leaving varied: some had made mistakes, others were injured and disabled, or they were simply persuaded by Lady Bai’s words, etc…
In total, nearly five hours later, the group had swelled to more than seven thousand people.
Colin took everyone to the twelfth floor’s consultation section, began making protective arrangements, and set up defences against potential anomalies during their departure.
‘There are too many people, I’m not the real entity, I hope this can sway the people…’
As Colin made the arrangements, he “hinted” in his heart. Meanwhile, several girls about one meter seventy-eight approached not far from him and watched him with blinking eyes.
“Do you need something?” Colin asked with a smile.
“I just, I’m just curious about the outside world…”
The little girl said timidly and, encouraged by Colin’s supportive gaze, asked curiously:
“Mr. Envoy, the sky seems so high, so very high. If it breaks, how do you fix it?”
“Ah?”
On hearing this, Colin was taken aback for a moment. How could you fix the sky?
His mind short-circuited briefly, then quickly understood why the little girl would ask such a thing.
From the beginning of their memories, the “sky” was the assortment of steel plates overhead. If they were not reinforced, occasionally, some particular anomalies could fall from them…
However, while he understood, he didn’t know how to answer right away.

chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 777 547 I I Killed Brother Shunzi _1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 777: Chapter 547: I, I Killed Brother Shunzi?! _1 Chapter 777: Chapter 547: I, I Killed Brother Shunzi?! _1 After a moment, Colin couldn’t help but let out a wry laugh:
“The sky doesn’t need fixing, and as for why, you’ll understand once you go outside and see for yourself…”
As he spoke, he wanted to ruffle the little girl’s hair, but to his embarrassment, he realized that even though she appeared to be only a few years old, she was already well developed, tall enough to be half a head taller than himself—
That was awkward.
However, the little girl suddenly seemed to understand something, obediently bowed her head, allowed him to ruffle it, and revealed an expression like that of a contented cat.
“There, take these and go have a drink, don’t disturb Mr. Messenger’s work.” Lady Bai, who was standing nearby, handed out several bottles of glucose solution and shooed away all the “little girls.”
Is this considered a local specialty snack?… Watching those bottles of glucose solution, Colin pursed his lips, then casually pulled out a handful of White Rabbit Creamy Candies from his pocket for the children:
“You can also have some of these.”
He tended to like well-behaved children more.
After the brief interlude, Lady Bai, seeing Colin scatter some strange objects around, finally couldn’t restrain her curiosity and asked, “What’s the use of these things?”
The items he spread around seemed to be common objects like glass bottles.
Some of the glass bottles contained something that looked suspiciously like human grease…
Many things didn’t look special, and their functions were unknown.
“To detonate.”
Colin explained succinctly.
Since he wasn’t his true self this time and was dealing with the various needs of thousands of people, plus they hadn’t received a “gathering command,” he didn’t dare skimp on the magical materials.
‘If we could get all the D Level Personnel here, it would undoubtedly be better, but unfortunately, there’s been no movement…’
‘However, now that everything is almost in place, even if a First Level Containment Subject comes, we’d be able to hold it off somewhat.’
‘But what I really fear is them playing dirty tricks…’
Colin took a look around, informed Lady Bai to be ready, as he was about to open the passageway.
“Okay.” Lady Bai took a deep breath, turned around hurriedly, and informed the staff everywhere to prepare for any contingencies.
Seeing that everything was ready, Colin, under everyone’s gaze, attached the “false former” he had just torn off to his body, then took out a five-pound can of pure grease and some kindling, and set them ablaze.
With a loud “boom,” flames shot up into the sky.
This elicited exclamations from the crowd.
Feeling his own strength rapidly increasing, Colin tilted his head slightly and looked around at the distant locations, where he could see staff from other shelters observing from afar.
They had no intention of leaving but also did not want to miss what was happening here, offering support in everything but the action itself.
‘If things go smoothly here, everyone will likely want to come out, but by then, if ‘Lady Rabbit”s objective is achieved, she might not bother to come to transport people.’
Withdrawing his gaze, Colin then gave the flames another inspection, confirming their burning condition.
The Bonfire site was established; it was time for the next step.
He continued to take out the letter that “Lady Rabbit” had given him methodically.
“Tear~”
With a crisp sound,
The letter was torn open and quickly ignited.
Following that, Colin’s mind was flooded with the simultaneous combustion of several “Bonfire Ritual Points” he had passed along the way, spinning wildly like a vortex capable of devouring everything.
And within the vortex, a passage about three meters wide slowly became visible, with a quiet and spacious hall faintly discernible at its end…
In the darkness outside the hall, indistinct grey mist drifted.
Colin swept his gaze across the middle of the hall and saw that the employee who had hanged herself previously was nowhere to be found.
She must have been taken care of when that presence behind the scenes staged the “suicide.”
“Move out!”
After observing, Colin quickly issued his command, “After crossing through the first-floor hall, wait there. If you see a train, something like this, get on it straight away.”
He conjured up an approximate image of the “Train in the Fog” using light and shadows.
“Heard that? Get moving now, what are you still waiting for!” Lady Bai immediately organized the team and called everyone to enter the flame passage, to leave this place.
With that said, she ordered her deputy to lead the team in.
Then she looked toward Colin, “Do you need my help?”
“A small scene, I alone can suppress it!”
Colin refused offhandedly, though, of course, his real thought was that Lady Bai might also be only at Late Stage F Level or maybe didn’t even have the standard of Employee Level E, so she wouldn’t be of much help.
The upcoming battle would require at least a general D Level Standard to qualify for participation!
“Alright.” Lady Bai looked at the huge flames above Colin’s head and without any fuss waved her hand and led her team into the “Bonfire Passage.”
The flames were peculiar, lacking any scorching sensation but rather giving a sense of warmth.
Stepping into the flames felt soft like cotton, yet oddly stable to walk upon.
And one’s body received relatively positive feedback in all aspects!
The passage wasn’t long, probably just a hundred meters or so, and when she crossed it, she immediately found herself in an exceedingly… orderly hall.
She knew this was still the hospital, but it felt like another world entirely.
Everything was precisely arranged without a hint of distortion…
Even the Shredded Flesh Horde commonly seen on the ground were nowhere to be seen.
In such a place, even just standing still made one feel as if some of their cognitions were slowly being “corrected” from distortion.
However, before she could ponder any further, a deafening explosion came from the direction of the Bonfire Passage.

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - 778 547
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 778: 547 Chapter 778: 547 Along with people’s cries of astonishment…
A massive, eerily powerful presence descended!
“It’s those things from the depths!”
Her heart tightened, and she nervously looked back, faintly seeing that a battle seemed to have erupted and heard the envoy of the “Bonfire” whisper from afar—
“I am here to suppress all enemies!”
Colin raised his right hand, his fingers piercing into the giant fireball above his head, and he grasped “Force Repulsion.”
In the next instant, the huge fireball exploded, bolstered by the powerful repulsive force, and like a meteor swarm, it shot toward multiple directions in the world, mounting a preemptive strike on those slowly approaching figures!
“Ah!”
Some of the places hit by the fireballs suddenly heard screams of agony, as if someone had been gravely injured.
But in other areas, the flames dispersed, and a figure rushed toward the passageway while shouting, “It’s me, I’m one of us! One of us!”
“An employee?” Colin looked at the person, frowning slightly.
“Please, let me through. I want to leave…” Another man, in disheveled shape, rushed over.
In his hand, he still held company equipment.
From several directions, similar figures appeared, totaling eleven people!
“You, you’re ‘Happy Prawn’? You’re alive?” The “Innate Ashen Holy Body” nearby suddenly stared at one of them in shock.
After seeing the female employee dead, and all the horrors encountered along the way,
He had assumed that his teammates who had explored with him were all dead, never expecting to see a living person again!
“Yes, yes, that’s me, please, tell me what’s going on, I’m one of us, let me leave…” The man known as “Happy Prawn” stood at the edge of the light, pleading.
The Ashen Holy Body frowned, but before he could say anything, he suddenly felt a chill in his heart.
Suddenly, that teammate appeared at his side; one half of the face seemed to be asleep, while the other was filled with strange colors against a black backdrop, as if controlled by something. When he reached him, a sinister smile curled on his lips, and a hand reached for his neck.
The Ashen Holy Body’s gaze sharpened, but at this critical moment, his body instantly turned metallic, and he raised his hand to block, making a deafening metallic clashing sound upon collision.
At the same time, his metallic body rapidly expanded, transforming into a three-meter-tall humanoid giant wolf the next second!
“Super Alloy Transformation·T3 Level” paired with “Tyrant Body: Standard Edition.”
The combination of the two talents activated instantly, allowing him to avoid being taken down in a direct confrontation.
However, that was merely to avoid instant death, as the attackers weren’t just one person. At that instant, a large knife stabbed diagonally into his back, sinking several inches into his metallic body.
The Ashen Holy Body crushed a “Light” Golden Mark.
In the burst of intense light, he escaped the attack radius, and at that moment, without needing anyone’s reminder, he knew that this teammate was probably long gone.
“Close call. It seems they can’t use the equipment anymore. Otherwise, that attack would have at least cost me a leg,” he muttered, feeling the partially severed left leg with a shudder.
He remembered the large knife; it was supposed to be a piece of equipment, but the “equipment”‘s power hadn’t manifested. If it had, it wouldn’t have been just a minor injury.
However, the attack, retreat, and escape from the circle all happened in less than a second, yet it was incredibly dangerous…
But there was no time to dwell on this; he immediately looked towards Brother Shunzi, about to warn him to “Be careful; these people are deceitful,” when he saw a blaze of fire rapidly expanding and engulfing everything, including himself, in the Bonfire.
Bang, bang, bang…
Several fiery figures fell one by one from the sky, landing on the ground with flames crackling on their scorched bodies, life or death uncertain.
“Hmph, that’s all,” said Colin, “Soul Transference” into the body, wearing a blue striped psych ward outfit. Grasping a woman’s neck with his left hand and wielding a revolver in his right, he said arrogantly,
“Bring out someone with real strength. With this situation, just stay put here, no need to think about getting out.”
In an instant, every attempt to bypass him and rush towards the rear failed.
However, this was also because this group of people seemed to be in states not their own, unable to use equipment or activate talents, which is why he could swiftly kill them all…
If nine fully functional D Level Personnel really came at him, Colin wouldn’t be able to wipe them out instantly with this “alt.”
Yet, even so, the sight still somewhat shocked the Ashen Holy Body on the other side.
Out of eleven, only two attacked him, and the remaining nine all went for Brother Shunzi. He had almost been seriously hurt by those two, but on the other side, Brother Shunzi had instantly retaliated against the nine…
The key point was that he was still just the backup…
Meanwhile, in mid-air, right after Colin finished speaking, he suddenly noticed that the figures he had just defeated had all vanished…
“Another ‘shadow’?”
Colin mused and then noticed that they were reappearing from various places…
And this time, anomalies started to emerge from everywhere.
The atmosphere of the entire hospital became very strange…
But unexpectedly, in addition to various anomalies, the figures of red-robed nurses also appeared out of nowhere.
They did not rush towards the Bonfire but unhesitatingly lunged at the anomalies.
Just as the local survivors had said, in the presence of anomalies, they always prioritized dealing with them first!
“Although it’s a bit contradictory, this makes us even,” Colin noted, as he saw a pile of red-robed nurses torn into countless ragged corpses, and nodded in approval.

chapters.title: Chapter 779 - 779 547 Did I Did I Kill Brother Shunzi _3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 779: Chapter 547 Did I, Did I Kill Brother Shunzi?! _3 Chapter 779: Chapter 547 Did I, Did I Kill Brother Shunzi?! _3 However, at this moment, some stronger individuals broke through the attack of the red-robed nurses…
Among them was the “Employee” who had just been killed.
“Still some old tricks.”
Colin said disdainfully as he raised his revolver to counter-attack, while also feeling a bit worried that the “individual” that was hosting that thing wouldn’t show up.
After all, this retreat was not only about withdrawing people but more importantly, it was the company’s old trick—fishing.
Colin was actually a bit worried that the other party wouldn’t show up, resulting in the failure to complete the mission.
Just then, as Colin started to face the enemy, he suddenly felt a numbness in his body, followed by an urge to go through the “Bonfire Passage”—
“This body?!”
Colin realized something, and in his moment of shock, a large number of individuals had already charged over.
Some of them rushed towards the “Bonfire Passage,” while others charged towards him…
In the crucial moment of internal and external troubles, Colin did not panic, but instead used the hospital’s special features to frantically contemplate a strong, handsome, resilient, and kind figure—
Himself!
When previously considering whom to call for assistance, Colin thought of many people, including Old Master Wu, “Thorn Lady,” or “Lady Rabbit” and so on…
But in the end, it seemed none of them were suitable.
After all, some of them, like “Old Master Wu,” “King of Savage Sound” and so on, might not even sense this place if thought of, and their strength was probably not enough; it was very likely that they would end up assisting the enemy instead.
Some had enough strength, like “Lady Rabbit” herself with a heap of restrictions, but the issue was, if it was so easy for her to come over, why send him?
Who else, really, could be summoned and would surely come, other than himself?
Although Colin could clearly feel that the qualities of “Belief Materializes” seemed to have weakened a lot after the events earlier,
there were still some left.
This was the very instant when the figure in his mind was successfully outlined.
“He” took yet another step further and come onto this current body!
“Boom!”
Like a volcanic eruption, flames that seemed to devour heaven and earth spread out, and in that instant, all the enemies were repelled by Colin.
After dealing with the externals, Colin suddenly felt that the environment of “Belief Materializes” had been lowered to the extreme.
“He” was sent back again.
At the same time, some strange fog began to surge around, similar to the white haze seen not long ago.
Deep within the haze, a voice came intermittently.
“Please, save me, Brother Shunzi, no, don’t, kill me, I don’t want to…”
“Please kill me, kill, save…”
“Kill… help… waaa…”
“Be careful, don’t let it get out!”
Accompanied by the last scream, Colin saw a figure burst out from within the white fog.
The figure looked almost exactly like him…
But the eerie thing was that there were several faces on its face, some crying and begging, some sneering, some expressionless, some seemingly in fear, with a rich array of emotions…
Like the “red-robed nurses,” as if there were several people within one body, fighting for control.
“The Unyielding?” Colin wondered aloud.
“Yes, it’s me, it’s me, please Brother Shunzi, kill me, help me, it wants to replace me… it’s going to run away, it’s going to, no, I don’t want to, I won’t allow it to leave under my identity, to meet my family, my friends…”
“Please, Brother Shunzi…”
“Don’t believe its words, Brother Shunzi, let me out, if only I get out, it will be left behind…”
“Help me…”
“Save me…”
Several faces, frantically fighting for words, it was a chaotic scene.
Colin frowned, the other was too deeply corroded, merged too deeply, even he could not make out the situation.
So his right hand surged with flames, ready to burn first, then talk; letting the other leave was too costly, no matter which was real or fake, only the “The Unyielding” ashes was a good employee.
But it was just as he contemplated this, he suddenly felt a chill down his spine, and heard a scream-like warning coming from behind:
“Be careful!”
Colin’s gaze sharpened, wanting to turn around, only to find his body had lost control.
A consciousness more suited to this body had seized control!
‘Damn, was this body copied from “The Unyielding”?’
A lightbulb went off in Colin’s mind, he realized the reason.
At the same time, an image emerged in his mind, the “The Unyielding” that was just in front of him had somehow appeared behind him, and one of the mouths, like a toad, opened up, pierced through his flame, and swallowed him.
The next second, “Colin” was close enough to stand on the ground with a pair of legs hissing blood…
“I… I killed Brother Shunzi?”
At that moment, “The Unyielding,” deeply corroded, came to his senses, and suddenly knelt on the ground, wailing and crying.
If Brother Shunzi was dead, who would stop him?
“Waaa, I killed… Hahaha, finally, no one can stop me anymore!”
Kneeling on the ground, as he cried, the faces on one head slowly changed from “∩” to “∪,” revealing a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 780 - 780 548 The End of the Cry for Help. _1
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 780: Chapter 548: The End of the Cry for Help. _1 Chapter 780: Chapter 548: The End of the Cry for Help. _1 “Finally, finally, I can… leave! Haha, hahaha!”
Dressed in tattered mental hospital clothes, “The Unyielding,” his faces distorted with uncontrollable emotions and streaming with tears, slowly rose from the ground. As he did so, that other fragment of consciousness swiftly dissipated…
Even as he stood halfway up, he couldn’t suppress his longing for the outside world.
Using hands and feet in an extremely twisted and uncoordinated manner, he crawled darkly on the ground, like a gecko, quickly charging toward the “Bonfire Passage.”
But no sooner had he crawled halfway, that a golden metal werewolf, its muscles swollen, burst forth and blocked his path—
The “Innate Ashen Holy Body” had arrived on the scene.
He had already seen the “pitiful state” of Brother Shunzi.
It was clear that he was no match for the Containment Subject, but he believed that if only he could hold it off for a moment,
Brother Shunzi’s true self would be able to come out and end the battle!
“Stop right there!”
The Ashen Holy Body swung its beastly claws, combined with its own artifacts, unleashing a blade charge that tore through its surroundings.
However, facing his attack, the foe didn’t react in the slightest, still laughing madly as he charged toward the Bonfire Passage. The impact that could tear through solid steel plates merely left a few white marks before dissipating from an invisible force.
Immediately after, “The Unyielding One,” ignoring the person in front of him, charged directly at him and sent him flying, his muscles and bones badly injured…
“Leave, leave, leave, I’m about to…”
Brother Unyielding, looking at the Bonfire Passage now within arm’s reach, ignored those retreating through the passage and watching him in horror. He tentatively reached his hand into the flame, and upon realizing that although the flames would burn him, he could actually enter the passage, he became even more excited.
But just as he was about to step fully into it, a burst of flame erupted from within the “Bonfire Passage.”
At the same time, a giant hand of fire descended from the sky and pressed down hard on him.
“Don’t panic, I said I could suppress any foe, and I will suppress…”
In the center of the Bonfire Passage, flames coalesced, forming the figure of Colin, who flashed forward. Before the creature could break free from the “Wildfire” hand, Colin kicked him fiercely and sent him flying away.
The man flew through the air, almost forming a “V” as he was propelled thousands of meters away.
Yet, only halfway through the air and before touching ground, he violently came to a halt in midair, all his momentum gone.
Multiple faces shouted simultaneously, “You should die! Let me pass, aaaah!”
His figure was like a wraith, elusive and rapidly approaching. On his right hand, a terrifying vibrational wave burst forth, lunging towards Colin with such force that the ground tore asunder and buildings collapsed, the sheer impact vibrating the entire space.
“Is this… a ‘Repulsion’ shockwave?”
Colin’s gaze sharpened, as thoughts flickered, realizing that the other had stolen his skill.
And had done a rather convincing job of it.
But…
“A counterfeit will always be a counterfeit.”
Colin similarly raised his right hand, the effect of his “Force – Repulsive Force” artifact empowering his hand, a vibrational charge erupted, pounding the even more formidable force that could topple spatial planes.
“Boom!”
At the impact’s center, the shockwaves, compressed to the extreme, burst forth again, instantly shattering several buildings, with lightning-like fissures appearing in the sky, as if it had been torn asunder.
In the crowd of surviving bystanders further away, some fainted on the spot, others were shaken to the ground unable to rise.
If they weren’t far enough, and had Colin not restrained somewhat for their sake, minimizing the force of the shockwaves with bonfire aftereffects, each would have likely had a significant chance of being crushed to death on the spot.
Nevertheless, he couldn’t be too concerned about them, as the will deep within the “hospital,” fully fused with Brother Unyielding, once again attacked.
“Make way! Your defiance of ‘God’s’ will is grand treason! Make way! I offer you a way out!” From Brother Unyielding, more “faces” tore open, and with them, his aura crazily surged.
It seemed as if more abstract things from the depths of the “hospital” were gambling on this body.
Each bet represented a face…
“Boom!” A dreadful thunder suddenly burst forth from him, dense and filling the whole world, carrying a powerhouse to shatter everything through the lingering shock vibrations in the air, striking towards Colin head-on.
“Make way? Has the hospital stayed with you so long without being able to cure your mind?”
Colin’s body surged with Bonfire, ensuring that no one would be easily killed by the battle as he coated each person with the light of flames. Revolver in hand, he strode alone boldly to the front lines!
In an instant, beneath the torrential lightning, an incarnation of the Wildfire Giant hundreds of meters tall shot up from the ground.
Once again, the space was forcefully compacted into a spherical area by a mighty force during the collision.
Brother Unyielding, now covered in dozens of faces, had one face open its mouth as if to activate some skill, and his body suddenly dispersed, closing in on Colin.
Then, several different faces looked towards Colin.
For a moment, lightning, repulsion, strange gleaming lights, psychic interference…
A confluence of terrifying attacks fused into a destructive death ray, rushing in an instant.
“Such a low-efficiency, boring way of using power, like a caveman throwing stones, tossing whatever comes to hand.”
Colin, disdainful of this onslaught, gestured with his hand, and his “Wildfire Giant” was hurled out to collide with this terrifying destructive ray, nullifying the attacks…
Despite his outward derision, he took them very seriously within.
‘These things, they say ‘First Level Containment Subject,’ but they seem to lack substantial authority; their power obviously isn’t enough, like paper tigers. Could they be classified under Level 2 Containment Subject? Their stature seems quite high; what on earth are their origins?’

chapters.title: Chapter 781 - 781 548 The Fall of the Cry for Help._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 781: Chapter 548 The Fall of the Cry for Help._2 Chapter 781: Chapter 548 The Fall of the Cry for Help._2 ‘Is it a “consciousness entity” that was stripped of authority by the “company”? Something like the legendary “Deity Consciousness”?’
As Colin pondered, he suddenly felt an itch on his body, only to see yellow pustules and tumor-like growths appearing all over his limbs as if infected by a virus. They spread rapidly…
One of the faces seemed to have the terrifying ability to transmit the horror disease through the air!
However, he didn’t panic. Following the previous steps, he gripped the revolver in his right hand and instantly activated “Item Liberation”.
“Contrarian Revolver 5% Item Liberation request!”
In the flash of a thought, a whisper of power that once belonged to a “Flame Bearer” surged into Colin’s body.
All contamination vaporized, and his physical form began to resemble a state of flowing flame…
“Rejoice! You will have the honor of dying by my hand in my prime!”
Colin’s eyes targeted Brother Unyielding with a glare, deploying the “Favor of the Flame Bearer” to hinder his escape.
Yet, an attack that should have set his entire body ablaze only ignited one of his faces! Although it was just one face, it seemed to imply that the consciousness of one entity had lost the possibility to leave!
Seeing Colin standing in their way once again, they started to go mad.
And vaguely, there was a sign of all the faces merging:
“The Gods” have rarely united in agreement to leave! They have decided to eradicate you! It’s time for you to understand what the Direct Gaze of The Gods is, what Divine Fury is!”
With that statement, dozens of faces turned towards Colin…
In an instant, an indescribable oppressive feeling arrived, as if dozens of invisible hands tightly grasped every part of Colin’s body, as though trying to crush him completely…
But the next second, all pressure vanished, and Colin was unaffected by the oppression.
Instead, face after face screamed in agony, not knowing what they looked directly at.
“Pure power struggle, I’d mostly waste time, but it’s funny that you even dare to try oppressing my soul directly like this…”
“What crap divinity, what era is it still talking about gods and gods, I dare to summon ‘Bonfire’, do you dare to call upon ‘unknown’?”
“Since you dare not, now, only the ‘Primordial Fire’, stands above all!”
Colin stood in front of these bizarre faces with a wildly uncontainable aura, frivolously lifting his revolver to aim at the enemy:
“Time to return to where you came from.”
With a “bang,” flames burst from the muzzle, engulfing the person before him.
All the faces screamed in agony, then gradually dissipated…
Some force was pulling them into a deeper layer of space because of their weakness.
‘Some kind of safety measure inside the hospital?’
Colin vaguely sensed that, as they were dragged away, an “oralike” beyond normal vision appeared ahead…
Behind the hole was an even more distorted, abstract “hospital”, even breaking down into pieces like concepts.
Some areas within were no longer “physical objects,” but had turned into two-dimensional planes.
Even more disconcerting for Colin was that, in the deepest depths of the “hospital,” there seemed to be a terrifying “hole” that was unclear whether space or channel, which did not seem like part of the “hospital” itself.
It looked more like an eroded opening…
Within which writhed unimaginable horrors.
However, without looking too closely, Colin decisively took out the “Token” and threw it into the deep hole the moment it opened.
The next second, as the severed hand burned and entered, everything quieted down.
As if noisy ducks and geese had their heads chopped off.
‘Good, it seems the effect is still outstanding.’
Colin nodded, and seeing the mission’s completion, suddenly felt an indescribable sense of relief.
Fifteen missions, eh! Fifteen missions without any reward!
Heaven knows how he managed to endure those fifteen tasks…
Now it’s time to settle up!
He hoped when he got out, they’d reward him with something good!
However, Colin suddenly thought of something, his gaze shifted, and he looked at “Brother Unyielding,” who was trembling from time to time.
The abnormalities on the other’s body had temporarily subsided, but that didn’t mean they were eradicated…
He had been contaminated too deeply, penetrating into the marrow, merging into the soul, and it wasn’t just contamination; it seemed that there were also many puppet-like “split personalities.” Saving him would be very difficult.
Even his primary personality wasn’t here but residing deep within…
But no matter what, his primary personality was currently the main one, so perhaps he could be woken up to handle his affairs.
After thinking for a moment, Colin flicked a strand of “Bonfire” onto him, awakening this “clone” that seemed to be cultivated from an original:
“Do you have anything you want to say?”
Collapsed on the ground, scorched all over, severely burned, “Brother Unyielding” uttered with difficulty in a hoarse voice amidst trembling:
“No, there’s nothing… Brother Shunzi, just kill me. My words… I can’t even trust myself. Most of me is imprisoned deep down. If I don’t die, they will still try to come out. I can feel it. Brother Shunzi, you have the power to eliminate all of me here. Don’t let ‘it’ get out again. My related remnants are all here, but I’m not sure if they’ve left any contingencies…”
He shakily brought out a “bundle” with spatial properties.
Colin glanced at it, confirming it was indeed an item, but didn’t plan to pick it up.
“If that’s what you say, okay then.”
Colin wasn’t one for sentiment, his right hand raised the revolver, his thumb expertly spinning the cylinder, “Bonfire” energy pouring in, and he aimed at the other’s head.
However, just as his index finger was about to squeeze the trigger, Colin’s expression suddenly turned odd.
“Do you want to live?” Colin asked.
“No, I… I can’t live… I don’t want to become one of those things’… puppets… Brother Shunzi, I know you’re a good person, but I can’t be merciful…Some things just can’t be faced with compassion… ”
“It’s not as hopeless as you think, just listen to me,” Colin interrupted him, glancing at the new task information that popped up in his head.
[Special Event: Inject “Cyanide Injector O-1 Enhanced Custom Type” medicine into employee number “442514” to treat him.]
“Remark”: Please awaken his positive personality’s will to survive before proceeding.
“Note”: After the treatment, please advise the employee to operate his own will and sleep by the deep “Bonfire,” waiting for his humanity and self-awareness to become complete again, in search to leave…
…
‘Isn’t this the medicine found previously in the ‘Psychiatry’ ward? Turns out it can be used this time? But the fact that it can be used means ‘Lady Bunny’, with her B-Level status, gave me authorization? At critical moments, it’s still ‘Lady Bunny’. She wouldn’t give up a chance to save…’
Colin, while looking at the mission, explained to “Brother Unyielding.”
Truth be told, the pollution on Brother Unyielding was a bit deeper than “intimately united,” on par even with “Big C Teacher” from back in the day. The difference was, Big C Teacher was a C-Level elite, having some resistance, able to struggle a bit.
This one’s only D-Level; for an ordinary person with cancer, that’s like having metastatic cancer cells in every part of the body…
It wasn’t that there were cancer cells in the body, but rather a bit of human component within the cancer cells.
From Colin’s observation, there was nothing else to do but wait for death.
Yet unexpectedly, there was still room for rescue…
After explaining with the aid of inspiration techniques, Colin once again asked, “Tell me, do you still seek death?”
Upon hearing this, “The Unyielding” was silent for a while, seemingly contemplating, or perhaps struggling to speak due to the immense pain, but after a few seconds, he sincerely whispered:
“I want to live…”
“What did you say? I didn’t hear you.” Colin frowned.
“I want to live.”
Colin was still unsatisfied, staring at this scorched, bleeding, and secreting man, he chided:
“Louder! Your vocal functions aren’t impaired, just some external injuries and you can’t even speak clearly? You want to live like this? You want to seek revenge like this? Might as well be dead.”
“I WANT TO LIVE!!!”
Hearing Colin mention those “Gods” who brought him immense torment, Brother Unyielding used all his strength, raising his gruesomely burnt head, roaring with fury.
From a pair of eyes scorched white, tears of torturous pain flowed.
Those beings brought more than just physical and soulful agony.
They were also constantly threatening his family, friends in the present life!
This hatred, one day, must be avenged!

chapters.title: Chapter 782 - 782 549 Follow-Up Handling of the Nonexistent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 782: Chapter 549: Follow-Up Handling of the “Nonexistent Hospital” Incident. _1 Chapter 782: Chapter 549: Follow-Up Handling of the “Nonexistent Hospital” Incident. _1 It was at this moment, sensing that the time was right, that Colin took out the “Cyanide Injection O-1 Enhanced Custom Model” and jabbed it into the other person’s neck, pressing and injecting the liquid.
In an instant, Brother Unyielding felt his body—no, more precisely, a tremendous splitting pain deep within his mind.
He could feel the consciousnesses that had been fostered under the corruption of those horrific beings rapidly being erased, screaming, struggling…
This process was extremely painful, lasting for several tens of seconds before he felt a bit better, but then came a great emptiness. He felt “clean” to be sure, but his body was riddled with holes and hollow inside.
The feeling wasn’t as intense, but the awareness of it was no less torturous than the pain…
Excruciatingly so.
“Take all your stuff and leave it. You don’t have to give it to me. I’ll take care of this body here to avoid any incidents. As for the deeper levels of your body or soul, you’ll have to use all your strength to crawl to the ‘Bonfire’ with the severed arms while those things are heavily damaged. Accept the warmth of the flame to slowly recover until you’re complete. Then you can think about the rest. Otherwise, it’s still a dead end,” Colin instructed.
He had seen the effects noted on this particular injection before.
To erase the negative parts within the body and then slowly nurture it back to health through “Bonfire,” which seemed to work as well on demons as it did on humans.
“Thank you, Brother Shunzi, the flame, it’s so warm…”
“Bang.”
Colin nodded, raised his gun, and with one shot exploded Brother Unyielding’s head, incinerating it in an instant until not a trace was left.
He had done all he could; whether the other could make it out alive was up to his own fate now.
If all went well, Brother Unyielding was highly likely to recover at some future time, but exactly when was hard to say—perhaps a few months at least, or indefinably longer.
But if things did not go well…
One could only say that since the dismembered hands had already been cast, even if he failed, he would no longer continue to pose a threat.
“Struggle to survive.”
Colin shook his head, gathered his thoughts, and looked at another “special event” besides helping “Brother Unyielding.”
[Special Event 2: Please find all employees lost and controlled in this place, dead or alive, and after sealing them with the power of the “Flame Bearer,” send them into the “Train in the Fog” exclusive carriage.]
…
“Does this mean others can be saved too?”
Now that the mysterious forces in the hospital’s space had significantly weakened and with the guidance provided by this mission, Colin was able to sense the locations of the staff who had attacked him earlier.
It seems that the vast majority were between the eighth and eleventh floors…
Except for a few whose bodies were beginning to smell, the others seemed to be still alive.
They were either passed out with tubes inserted in the intensive care unit or their bodies were dissected into hundreds of pieces, stored in various bottles and jars.
Without hesitation, Colin swiftly set into motion while the mission was not yet finalized…
Twenty minutes later, Colin found the bodies of eleven staff members. Unlike “Brother Unyielding,” even if dead, their level of corruption wasn’t as deep.
It was mostly like a few bottles of mineral water with some grease in them…
“The most critical part is that their souls and spirits are still relatively pure,” Colin observed a few employees who were in a deep coma due to the deep parasites and whose limbs were missing.
Though they were missing arms and legs and it didn’t look good, they were still alive, which meant it wasn’t so bad.
Not to mention the company, even he was confident he could bring them back to life.
Of course, whether their minds would be normal afterward was another question, as he wasn’t in charge of specialized rescue…
Without lingering, Colin’s gaze shifted to three other staff members laid out separately…
They looked peaceful, more so in death than the previous ones, their skin pale and even showing cloudy, striated, or patchy scars, their bodies emitting a faint odor of decay…
At that moment, the “Innate Ashen Holy Body” who had considerably recovered came over and looked at the mess of employee bodies, interrupting Colin’s reverie:
“Brother Shunzi, can they… still be saved?”
“Saved? I don’t know…”
Colin shook his head and spoke without false promises:
“In theory, the company has the capability, but considering the current state of affairs, you as a D Level staff must understand a bit. My current task is to send them back and not to follow up on the rest…”
While speaking, Colin glanced at one of the female staff, who had a clear ligature mark on her neck.
Of course, besides that, her lower back and abdomen also had openings, and there was damage and loss of internal organs.
But he had already had the Fire Tree sew her up…
This was the “receptionist” he had seen in the lobby, dead in the outpatient department on the ninth floor.
Colin guessed the reason she chose suicide might have been not wanting to be replaced, or perhaps she was severely injured and too desperate at the time. Anyway, it seemed that she was now gone.
Of course, this was just from his perspective.
Given the powers the company had shown, he believed she could be saved.
That was during the company’s peak.
Now, with the company dysfunctional, it was hard to say whether sending her back would lead to rescue, cremation, or cryopreservation.
Hearing Colin’s words, the “Innate Ashen Holy Body” fell silent for a while, his gaze resting on the other two for quite some time before he eventually let out a long sigh, not asking any more questions…

chapters.title: Chapter 783 - 783 549 Follow-Up Handling of the Nonexistent
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 783: Chapter 549: Follow-Up Handling of the “Nonexistent Hospital” Incident. _2 Chapter 783: Chapter 549: Follow-Up Handling of the “Nonexistent Hospital” Incident. _2 After lingering on the three bodies for a few seconds, Colin’s gaze shifted to the ground on the other side, where two employees had been disassembled into thousands of pieces—although it looked a bit frightening, they were at least still alive.
Their status was much better than that of the others who were starting to smell a bit.
It was just that each organ, each patch of skin, could only respond instinctively, and their brains seemed peacefully asleep as if dead…
At that moment, the Little Maid and “Fire Tree” were stitching and reassembling them like complex Gundam models, making them whole again.
Otherwise, it would be troublesome to seal such a large pile of bottles and jars, and difficult to put them on the train.
However, while waiting, Colin observed his surroundings and thought about the IDs of this group of people, suddenly hesitating whether it was really a good idea to rescue and remove these people.
Even within the company, their names were somewhat abstract and belonged to the more shady variety.
Colin glanced again at: “Salerne Ma Fen Ni One Half,” “Old Stem Sharp Turn,” “Shang Yang Knows Horse Strength,” “Eagle Catching Chicks”…
Oh no, there seemed to be a normal one, but mixed in there, it wasn’t very certain.
Among these IDs, it was hard to think normally about the normal ones.
“But then again, they probably won’t be returning to Earth,” he mused.
Looking at these scattered individuals, Colin then looked at the task requirements and felt that these people… probably had a high chance of not being able to return to Earth.
Because the station where the train was currently stopped was supposed to be “The Second Box Garden World,” not the one for the return mission.
The deeper reason might be because that place had the technology to heal them, or they were contaminated too severely to return.
As Colin’s thoughts began to drift, suddenly a mechanical synthesized voice of the Little Maid came from one side:
“Mr. Colin, all employee body processing is complete.”
Colin turned toward the voice and saw that the two scattered employees had been pieced together, looking as though they were a complete whole.
