However, Colin didn’t pay much attention to their words. About half an hour later, he suddenly felt the atmosphere around him thicken and become oppressive…
The deeper he went, the more solid the space felt; without the flames surrounding him, it would have been difficult to move even an inch.
But after a while of proceeding…
Colin saw from a distance, in the center of a plaza, a giant canvas several meters high stood erect, and before it, a giant rat-like figure with its back to him stood on a chair, repeatedly applying paint to the canvas.
A twisted artwork dominated by red luminescence.
With just one glance, Colin felt an extreme discomfort and was slightly shocked—
This guy, is he actually depicting the “Red Moon”?
At that moment, despite his arrival, the other didn’t stop his movements but continued to paint, spreading the paint with his clawed hand.
Colin didn’t act immediately, but with a pondering gaze, he turned to another side, his pupils vibrating slightly.
There, on the ground, lay several scattered bodies, like blocks fallen apart…
Seemingly cut by some sharp weapon, they lay in pieces.
Among them were parts of Xu Duojin.
His familiar old face had been turned into more than a dozen chunks, like a pig’s head on a meat market butcher block, chopped into pieces, with eyes that seemed still filled with reluctance…
Aside from him, the other bodies indeed matched the information he had received earlier: a team of Eighth Level Personnel along with a Ninth Level member, none missed being among those shattered fragments.
He had foreseen this outcome; after all, the enemy was very strong.
Even Colin showing up might not have been helpful, much less them?
He fell silent for a moment, about to divert his gaze back to the giant rat-shaped man, ready to take action.
But just at that moment, he suddenly saw innumerable pitch-black threads burst forth from all the body fragments, which then suddenly dispersed into smoke and vanished on the spot…
“Huh?”
Colin was taken aback, and it dawned on him quickly, this… was the exclusive ability of the “Fate Propeller”!
“Save and Load”!
Previously, during the Ghost Train incident, he had seen the power user of the “Book of Fate” cultivated by that company use similar means!
“Does that mean they’re not dead yet?!” Colin’s eyes widened as he became excited.
It was at this moment that the giant rat, who had been painting, finally turned around and looked over, seemingly somewhat helplessly opening his mouth, “The features of the ‘Book of Fate’ are as troublesome as ever…”
As he spoke, not far away, Colin saw Xu Duojin and the others’ figures reappear.
Even if they performed a “Save and Load,” their condition seemed to be quite poor, missing arms and legs, with injuries all over their bodies as if they had not managed to completely “Save and Load”…
“I am, we…” As soon as Xu Duojin appeared, his form swayed, and although he had no memory of the previous fight and his mind was somewhat muddled,
One thing was very clear to him, that he had died once.
No, likely more than once!
Because if it had been only once, given his condition, the injuries on his body wouldn’t have returned with him!
Just as he was still trying to grasp the situation, Colin sensed danger first and decisively took out “Time Freeze.”
“Buzz!”
The sound of an invisible engine roared suddenly, pulling everything within several kilometers into stasis at that moment!
But in the next second, Colin abruptly discovered a secretive spatial power rapidly cutting towards them.
“Power working within ‘Time Stop’?”
Without any hesitation, Colin activated two more Golden Card effects “Force Repulsion” and “Force Attraction”!
Xu Duojin and the others’ bodies swiftly flew backwards towards him,
while the Repulsion Burst rushed towards the spatial cutting power…
In an instant, the two forces canceled each other out.

chapters.title: Chapter 822 - 822 565 The Lunatic Planning Red Moon _2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 822: Chapter 565: The Lunatic Planning ‘Red Moon’! _2 Chapter 822: Chapter 565: The Lunatic Planning ‘Red Moon’! _2 The repulsion had slightly weakened!
Colin had left a group of senior officials behind and had finally managed to save them preliminarily.
“Tap, tap, tap”…
At the same time, the effect of Time Stasis was lifted.
“Whew, finally managed to save them,” Colin sighed in relief.
“Mr. Colin?” Xu Duojin, noticing the flames nearby, was startled when he saw the man’s figure.
“Yes, I’ll take over from here, you all should evacuate immediately.”
Colin didn’t say much more.
Hearing this, Xu Duojin opened his mouth, and eventually nodded, “Okay.”
His memory was extremely chaotic and fragmented, but through his spiritual intuition, he was very clear about one thing: he had probably “died” three times by now.
This was already the absolute limit for him as an Eighth Level “Fate Propeller.”
In fact, if it hadn’t been for the significant effect of the Golden Mark given by Colin, he could have only resumed once!
The second time was a low-probability event and required Mr. Wu’s “blessing.”
Now, succeeding three times could be solely credited to the Golden Mark.
As he retreated, he quickly transmitted some unsorted fragmented memories from his mind to Colin’s mind through inspiration.
The other senior officials were also in bad shape, and if not for the flame’s protection, they might have lost control by now.
However, seeing Xu Duojin make the decision to leave, they didn’t object.
They evacuated together immediately…
The brief exchange lasted less than three seconds, and the giant The Rat quietly watched without seizing the opportunity to attack.
Shifting his focus, Colin also looked back.
On The Rat, he could feel a strong sense of “confidence” from the other party but did not feel any sense of oppression.
‘Indeed, this rat itself is weak, but it probably has some extremely troublesome item or something on it.’
In a flash of thought, Colin quickly made some preliminary judgments.
“Clap, clap.”
The Rat suddenly raised its almost inhuman palm, clapped twice, then opened its mouth to speak, “Not a bad reaction, managing to fend off my sudden attack. You indeed have something commendable.”
While it spoke, the effect of “Favor of the Flame Bearer” in Colin’s left eye activated, but strangely…
The attack was fired, but it didn’t take effect?
Through some things in Xu Duojin’s memory, he immediately realized that the opponent was highly skilled in some unknown spatial ability, and the recent attack had probably been shifted by the opponent!
“Hehe,”
The Rat sneered disdainfully, its red eyes staring at him, then continued, “No need to hurry to fight, I think now we might be able to have a proper talk and resolve some misunderstandings between us.”
“What misunderstandings could we possibly have?”
Colin furrowed his brows, raised the “Contrarian’s Revolver,” and shot directly at the opponent.
As the muzzle flashed, bullets shot out.
But in the next moment, all the bullets completely disappeared.
‘It’s this strange thing again…’ Colin’s frown deepened.
He couldn’t even observe how the opponent’s methods worked!
“Of course there are some misunderstandings.”
The Rat continued to speak while casually scooping a lump of dye from a dye vat, spreading it on a canvas, and painting something as it spoke, “I don’t deny the role of the ‘Flame Bearer,’ despite their obnoxious stubbornness, but in today’s era, ‘Primordial Fire’ is almost out of the game. How do you plan to bring it in?
“The real great era, the most terrifying conflicts in history, are about to begin…
“Now, with the way of the ‘Primordial Fire’ nearly vanishing, do you really think you have the ability to bring it forth?
“Struggling on this unstable path is simply irresponsible to humanity as a whole!”
“How do you sound like you have a plan?” Colin casually said as he continued to attempt an attack.
Combining the situations from before when he saved Xu Duojin, he had some ideas—
To kill the adversary, the only way was to do it during the duration of the “Time Freeze”.
This also made him understand why “Lady Rabbit” had asked him to upgrade this thing.
At the same time, hearing Colin’s words, The Rat’s eyes lit up, and, excitedly spreading its hands, it exclaimed,
“Of course! Of course!! I certainly have a method to succeed!!!
“Are you curious? Then let me tell you, I’ve said before, comparing to the unstable path of the ‘Primordial Fire’, and without knowing whether ‘Primordial Fire’ can even be summoned, my choice is the correct one!
“I will use the ‘Red Moon’ that sits atop the firmament as a partial baseline, melding everyone’s flesh and soul into one—unlike the ‘Red Moon’s’ inherent ability to absorb all life, because this will be dominated by our will!
“We will merge with the ‘Red Moon’ and avail ourselves of all matter, with us at the core of this collective, capable of facing any adversity, stepping into a new future, and overcoming that so-called ‘Ultimate Hour’…
“I will lead ‘humanity’ to eternal greatness! Cast aside divisions, settle all disputes, and become a magnificent human race!!!”
As it spoke with a hint of madness, it noticed the man enveloped in flames bore an indifferent expression.
“Heh, you still don’t agree?” Its tone became colder.
“You think so beautifully, do you really believe that after merging with the ‘Red Moon’, you can become its leading consciousness?” Colin was not adept at debate, but he understood well that it wasn’t as simple as the other claimed.
During their conversation, he kept attempting to attack, but most were blocked.
“Of course!” The Rat confidently said, “I have made all the preparations, and I also have enough relevant experience…”
Ironically, the ‘Red Moon’ was also thinking the same, Colin thought as he looked at what he wasn’t sure to call cunning or “naive” rat, falling silent for a moment.
That creature actually dared to scheme against the ‘Red Moon’, wanting to inject the consciousness of an ordinary human into the ‘Red Moon’ entity to merge with it… This was unexpected—
No wonder the ‘Red Moon’ seemed to somehow cooperate with the rat.
After all, such a “simple” creature was rare.
“Do you know how many people your scheme has killed?” Colin thought about the various tragedies of ‘The Seventh Box Garden World’ and many other things in this world.
This rat seemed to also have an insider identity within the company, could siding with them this time avoid a lot of losses?
Too bad, in the end, it was a delusional schemer…
“That’s just the necessary sacrifice.”
The Rat carelessly said, “As long as I succeed, when all biomass returns, their souls will be reborn!
“And now, since ‘Fate’ has not appeared, it means that the Once Great Leader has not denied my actions!
“You, and that lady behind you, you don’t still think she can help you, do you? Hahaha, impossible, even, by the time I succeed, even she can only silently consent and acknowledge the failure of the ‘Primordial Fire’ path!”
Having said that, it extended a hand toward Colin:
“What do you say? If you consider joining me, I can forgive past actions and reserve a special ‘chamber’ for your existence, and after the ‘Ultimate Hour, allow you to exist independently from the ‘Union’…”
Looking at the oddly colored rat’s palm, Colin fell silent for a moment, then burst into flames and charged forward:
“I join your fucking mother!”
“You harbor too many prejudices against the ‘Red Moon’; in reality, It harbors no malice… Ah, forget it, since you disagree, then I have no choice but to kill you.”
The Rat sighed and then its eyes showed a fierce emotion.
The next second, a pale golden light radiated from its body.
The space underwent a change again!
Colin, almost existing in a form of flames, suddenly felt a sharp pain at his neck.
Then, starting from his neck, his head began to move, seemingly about to be cut off!
However, he wasn’t nervous, his Golden Card took effect.
“Time Reversal!”
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 823 - 823 566 The Rising Red Moon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 823: Chapter 566: The Rising “Red Moon”! Chapter 823: Chapter 566: The Rising “Red Moon”! The severed head, spinning as it flew out, and the blood squirting from the neck, all instantly returned to Colin’s neck as time reversed…
And it was at this moment that Colin saw what the spatial ability of the other party was.
Inside the “Human-faced Rat,” there actually existed a pale golden card!
The form was extremely familiar—it was a card!
“‘Spatial’…”
Colin felt the basic ability direction of the card and, at the same time, instantly understood the type of injury he had sustained.
However, there was no time to observe more as he quickly shifted his attention back.
Because more invisible “cutting” was on its way!
He immediately used “Force Repulsion” to shake off all the damage.
“Hehe, even with multiple advanced items, what use are they? With ‘items,’ as long as you specialize a bit, you can deal with most troubles…”
The Human-faced Rat raised a hand, and the space in all directions was cut once more.
This time, Colin found that apart from “Time Freeze” being relatively effective in dealing with the other party,
The effects of his other Golden Cards were significantly less effective.
The power that evaporated from the cards was basically in a suppressed state.
Only with the combined power of the cards and the Bonfire could he barely fend off the opponent’s attack.
‘How can this spatial card be so powerful, and its usage rate so high without any side effects? Or is it because the item has been liberated, or some other reason?’
Dodging another “Spatial Cut” attack from the enemy, Colin finally understood why Lady Bunny had asked him to upgrade a few advanced items for subsequent missions.
If he hadn’t upgraded, today’s battle would indeed be very risky.
No, even with upgrades, it was still tough to fight!
Under the attack of a spatial storm of wind blades, Colin felt he could be reduced to pieces at any moment.
This type of cutting would shatter his body upon contact; he simply couldn’t withstand it.
“Now, do you feel the disparity between you and me? Before my artwork is completed, I can still offer you a chance. Just submit to me, and the promises made before will still stand…”
“But if you wait until the artwork is completed, then you’ll have no chance left.”
The humanoid gigantic rat continued to draw while speaking, seemingly with ease, thwarting Colin’s attempts to get close.
However, Colin gave no response to its offer of surrender.
During the fight, he tried to lock onto the opponent with the “Shield of Fairness Adjudication” but to no avail.
It seemed to be at that place but also seemed not to be.
‘This guy is really troublesome. However, it seems unwilling to let me get close. While it speaks of surrender, it probably can’t handle me after all.’
‘And it hasn’t stopped drawing, which probably means it can’t stop. I should try to interrupt that somehow. No, it’s very difficult to strike at it; I’ll have to go after the drawing…’
Thoughts whirled in Colin’s mind. Xu Duojin and the other high-ranking individuals had struggled for a long time and seemed to have barely managed to reach in front of the creature.
But sadly, the last hopeful attack launched at The Rat itself did not actually take effect.
It was as if they were not on the same layer, passing straight through.
This time, Colin waved his right hand, the flames and the Repulsion Burst shaking out together, dispersing the dense spatial cuts.
He then flickered forward, braving numerous cuts on his body, chunks of flesh lost, and finally managed to draw near.
“Now’s the chance!”
Colin swung forcefully, and a torrent of flames surged forth, but shockingly, the flame simply passed through the surroundings, whether it was The Rat itself or the canvas, without any impact!
That “Spatial” attribute Golden Card had taken effect!
“Hehe, too bad, you guessed wrong. Your end is…”
The humanoid rat mocked him, its enormous red eyes flickering with red light: “Death!”
“Hmph…”
Colin’s mind was stunned, almost forced out of the “Flame Bearer” flame state, blood spurting from his eyes and nose, but he did not care about that, as another terrifying spatial cut was on its way!
Beginning right at his brow, a line of blood appeared as if to vertically bisect him!
Enduring the intense pain in his brain, Colin quickly prepared to initiate “Time Freeze,” but just then, he suddenly remembered something.
He pulled out the “Shield of Fairness Adjudication.”
The next second, with consciousness locked on, both were pulled into a special Colosseum!
“Success!” Colin rejoiced inwardly.
“Oh? You can withstand this attack, a ‘God Vision’ combo?” The humanoid rat said in surprise, seemingly unfazed by being dragged into the “Colosseum.”
But Colin did not respond to it; quickly stating three rules, he decisively launched an attack on his opponent…
“Heh, interesting item, but sadly, its completeness is insufficient, and it’s not easy for this thing to trap me.”
The humanoid giant rat scoffed, and the effect of the “Spatial” card on its body activated, causing it to disappear from the spot!
And with its departure, the whole “Colosseum” collapsed!
‘What’s going on?! Is your Golden Card using some kind of cheat? Is it so much better than my ‘Shield of Fairness’?!’
Colin widened his eyes and then saw again the figure of the opponent at the original scene, still drawing.
A large number of invisible and silent “Spatial Cuts” swiftly assaulted him…
Faced with an overwhelming offensive, Colin didn’t try to fight head-on and had to retreat.
“Perhaps I can’t enter that ‘Colosseum’ across space, but getting out of there doesn’t pose any particular difficulty for me. You should know, even among Golden Artifacts, there are disparities!”

chapters.title: Chapter 824 - 824 566 The Rising Red Moon_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 824: Chapter 566: The Rising “Red Moon”!_2 Chapter 824: Chapter 566: The Rising “Red Moon”!_2 “Especially when it comes to developmental level, in my hand, a single Golden Card is enough to deal with everything you have!”
The giant humanoid The Rat revealed a human-like sneer, still trying to shake Colin’s conviction:
“Besides, I might as well kindly inform you, don’t think that becoming a ‘Flame Bearer’ means everything will be fine. Even if you or someone else succeeds, at that moment, you’ll likely become a puppet of the ‘Primordial Fire’!
“You probably know a thing or two about this matter; I’m not just trying to scare you!
“The outcome is likely to be quite unpleasant.
“Compared to the irresponsible path of the Bonfire, today, I will unite the three and achieve the Great Will, bringing the true dawn of the future, right now…”
‘God damn, why so much bullshit!’
Colin was feeling somewhat annoyed, but then he realized, this was probably what the enemy wanted. He took a brief breath and steadied his mind.
At this moment, he had some ideas about how to deal with this thing…
‘When it attacks, it must briefly appear in reality, just as it did before. If I strike during that time, I can actually hit it, but at the same time, I’ll have to face a massive amount of Spatial cutting. One wrong move and it’s easy for something bad to happen…’
‘Also, although getting close seems pointless, once I get close, it seems to stop painting.’
‘That means it has to be in ‘reality’ to continue painting…’
Amid the flurry of thoughts, Colin quickly came up with an idea and decided to try again here!
Immediately, armed with a few Golden Cards, he charged once again towards the incessantly babbling enemy.
And launched an attack.
“What, you don’t want to live?” The humanoid The Rat’s body flashed with golden light, appearing to dodge reality once more, hiding from the incoming attack.
Surrounding flames enveloped the area, but with a wave of its hand, all flames disappeared.
‘It feels like the flames were teleported away!’ Colin had a premonition; the flames didn’t disappear but went to a very distant place.
There was still a very faint connection…
But he couldn’t attend to that now. As soon as he saw his enemy attacking, Colin, braving the terrifying invisible Spatial cutting power, clenched a Bone Spur and flung it casually.
A Bone Spur shot out, aimed straight at the opponent!
“Very clever, you’ve actually noticed some of my weaknesses, but sadly it’s useless. Have you not considered that I deliberately sold you this weakness? Hahaha!” The Rat sneered, directly transmitting information through an ‘Inspiration’-like method.
The Bone Spur pierced its body but didn’t actually make contact and ended up embedded in the ground behind.
“I make far better use of this artifact than you ever could! Now, enough playing, at this distance, you can die!”
As it spoke, one of its hands, armed with sharp claws, extended.
Layers of golden light spread, and the entire Spatial area looked like a shattered mirror with numerous irregular fissures appearing.
Colin’s gaze sharpened, as dozens of fissures appeared on his body, and he simultaneously used two cards, “Stasis,” “Counterflow”!
After holding off the fissures momentarily, he steadied his flesh from turning to pieces, and his figure retreated as if intending to flee.
“This time, I won’t let you escape. Die!”
In the frozen Time, the humanoid The Rat seemed unaffected, watching Colin mockingly, as it uttered, “Solidify!”
As the words fell, Colin suddenly felt the Spatial pressure from all sides, rendering him completely immobile.
However, just as this “Flamebearer” Reservist seemed destined to fall right then and there!
The humanoid The Rat suddenly jerked, its eyes widening as it trembled and turned its head to look at its lower back, where, unbeknownst to it, a white Bone Spur crisscrossed with pitch-black cracks had been inserted.
“When did!?”
Its eyes almost popped out of their sockets as excruciating pain erupted from the lower back!
Upon seeing this, Colin once again unleashed a “Repulsion Burst,” breaking free from all restraints, then showed a smile on his face:
“Have you ever considered that when I used Time Reversal, it wasn’t on myself? But on the Bone Spur I just threw?”
“Ah!!!”
The Rat’s response to Colin was a high-pitched, ear-piercing scream.
Despite its high level of artifact development, its body wasn’t particularly strong, and a single stab brought excruciating pain, causing it to howl and roll on the ground.
“If you had paid more attention, you would have noticed a little trick with my Bone Spur. After I threw it and it flew a distance, it was pointed at me. If you’re not careful, you might just think it spun around, but…”
Now, it was Colin’s turn to reveal a mocking smile.
What it thought was a use of “Backflow” to escape was actually Time Reversal on the Bone Spur, letting it reverse course to hit the still, unsuspecting foe from behind!
It likely never imagined falling to such a petty trick!
As for the effects of the Bone Spur, even Shana, with her non-human physique, took a good while leaning against a wall clutching at her waist to recover after taking a stab from Colin.
It was then that he saw a faint hint of golden light attempting to rise again on the humanoid The Rat.
He wanted to cover it with Flame and burn it to death completely, but various negative effects from the artifacts surged, and he could only rein in the Flame, holding it inside him to suppress the negative effects.
Immediately thereafter, without any hesitation, Colin rushed to his foe’s front, swung his fist, and crushed its wailing rat head with a punch.

chapters.title: Chapter 825 - 825 566 The Rising Red Moon_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 825: Chapter 566: The Rising “Red Moon”!_3 Chapter 825: Chapter 566: The Rising “Red Moon”!_3 “I’m sick of you throwing around ‘necessary sacrifice’ like it’s nothing!”
“I’m tired of you constantly scheming ‘Red Moon’…”
“And all your talk of greatness!”
“This punch is for the people of The Seventh Box Garden World!”
“This punch is for the ‘Father of the Ocean’!”
“This punch is because you talk too damn much!”
Colin straddled his opponent, his face twisted in rage, as he pummeled the Rat, smashing from its skull, sternum, to its limbs—gradually breaking them all into pieces.
Blood and bone shards sprayed everywhere.
Countless unseen swarms of rats frantically surged forward as if trying to save their master.
However, no matter how many came, they burned to ashes like moths to a flame…
Meanwhile, as he continued punching, pleas and screams from the Rat echoed in Colin’s mind.
“Let me go, let me go…”
“No! You can’t kill me! Everything is already set in motion, you cannot! Once I die, some of the constraints that I, as the ‘responsible party,’ have put in place will fail, and the true instinctual consciousness of ‘Red Moon’ will break free!”
“Once it ascends and returns to its body, everything will end…”
“Those ancient beings will also disrupt the world…”
“Let me go; I can be your aid, even though the path of the ‘Primordial Fire’ is highly uncertain, if you win, I am willing to admit…”
“No…”
“Everything I did was for humanity, without sacrifice, there can be no future, you have no right to judge me, who has made such significant contributions to humanity!”
Roars kept emerging in Colin’s mind, initially causing some mental shocks and attempting to persuade Colin to listen, but unfortunately, as the punches fell, its voice grew weaker.
As its body continuously turned to mush, its consciousness got more blurred, and in a daze, it seemed to see a dreamlike scene…
In this scene, it successfully merged into the core of “Red Moon,” swallowing all the high-level containment subjects it had secured, fulfilling its desire—
All existing humans unified under its leadership into a grand new race!
Countless lives sang praises of its glorious deeds.
However…
For some reason, the scene cracked.
“No!”
It attempted to grasp it, but alas, a flame consumed everything.
“You’ll regret it; the ‘Flame Bearer’ you yearn for can’t sustain this era …”
With those hate-filled final words, the Rat, now fully turned into mush, was definitively dead.
“Clap, clap, clap—”
Sounds of countless firecrackers exploding echoed from all directions, and those invisible “Rats” started exploding one by one.
Colin staggered to his feet, his face and the skin under his clothes full of cracks from which blood constantly seeped out, adding to the side effects from a slew of high-level tools; he looked as though he might collapse at any moment.
The combat didn’t last very long, just over an hour…
Yet, it was perhaps the most intense time he had ever used the Golden Card.
Every card, used at least seven times in a short span!
Had his physique not extensively improved from before, the side effects alone might have been unbearable.
After a brief respite, Colin took out a “Golden Seal”, and a thick, tangible light, white as milk, spilled from the Seal into his body, alleviating the negative effects within.
At the same time, taking advantage of the moment, he took a deep breath, using the flame from “Revolver Reverser” to stabilize himself, pushing back the dense blood traces cut by spatial displacement to prevent turning into a pool of himself.
Once both actions took effect, he felt much better.
He regained consciousness from the bizarre time perception disarray and severe symptoms like a heavy head and light feet.
Then, Colin looked toward the front, bent down, and picked up a Golden Card from what looked like a mushy corpse…
“Space: Transposition”!
‘That cutting, it was like slightly shifting space like a Rubik’s cube, but it really utilized it to a great extent…’
What surprised Colin was its integrity, which was 99%!
This was his first time encountering a tool so close to a hundred percent intact.
‘Is this why one card could suppress the other cards? Just missing a few points made such a huge difference! Nearly crushing me with several Golden Cards!’
Colin, still astonished, couldn’t linger on that thought as, at that moment, following the Rat’s complete death, a terrifying anomaly suddenly occurred!
He, no, including him, all humans, whether Extraordinary Ones or ordinary people, felt a strong palpation emerge out of nowhere.
“Thump! Thump! Thump!”
Heart pounding violently as though having a heart attack, so painful it turned faces pale, teeth chattering, and cold sweat dripping.
However, besides the physical pain, what made everyone tremble and panic even more was a vision that started to emerge in everyone’s mind, arising from their inspiration, whether clear or vague.
A modern yet ancient city floating above the sea’s surface, somehow merging with reality…
From this ancient city, a fantastical yet solid scarlet celestial body, following the Rat’s death, finally seemed to break free from some kind of spatial-binding restraint, flying out from the city.
Then, without stopping for any creature in the real world, it ascended towards the sky at neither a fast nor slow pace…
.

chapters.title: Chapter 826 - 826 567 The Chosen of the Gods
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 826: Chapter 567 The Chosen of the Gods! Chapter 826: Chapter 567 The Chosen of the Gods! When he gazed directly at the consciousness ascending into the sky, an inspiration flashed through Colin’s mind.
“Is this thing a part of the Red Moon’s instinctive consciousness?”
Colin had an inkling.
He could see that it was constantly rising, intending to return to its body…
And its body was…
The moon!
That was the thing that the humanoid Rat had been scheming!
Once successful, it would be like two pieces of nuclear material reaching critical mass, exploding with terrifying power, and nothing could be salvaged!
“No…”
Colin wanted to move, but he couldn’t suppress the negative effects of the tool for a moment, and his body simply could not hold together, crumbling into pieces on the ground.
However, the next second, all the pieces melted like heated wax, merging in the flame and recongealing into Colin’s body.
However, intense splitting pain came from him, and his body was covered in dense cracks.
These injuries could not be simply brushed aside with a reformation…
But at that moment, Colin’s heart sank, sensing terrifying figures, also from Higher Life Forms, arriving by unknown means, appearing right beside him.
Those majestic silhouettes, indifferent, watched over him, encircling him…
“Do you want to kill me?” Colin’s gaze sharpened.
Although these figures seemed not to be their real bodies, their number was so large that they were no less formidable than facing a high-dimensional being!
Moreover, the spiritual intuition from “Space: Transposition” made it clear to him that at least one-third of these entities had been brought from other worlds by the Rat and bound mainly by “Spatial” power.
Now, due to the Rat’s death, most of them had broken free from their constraints.
As for the other two-thirds…
Their origin was unknown, but given the nature of the “Bonfire Company,” he couldn’t think of any other reason why these beings would find him besides wanting to kill him.
Yet in the very next second, he suddenly felt the negative effects on his body being forcibly suppressed…
The spatial cutting injuries that penetrated deep into his bones were also rapidly healing.
Simultaneously, Colin sensed countless powers, endowed directly by various authorities, emerging within him, most of which, almost like being spoon-fed, actively poured into “Bonfire,” causing flames on his body to burn like never before—
Blessings of the Gods!
‘What’s going on?’
Colin was taken aback, aware of the changes within himself as well as those strands of power, not understanding the reason for their actions, suspecting whether they had surrendered?
But the next second, more “inspiration” came to him, revealing the real reason!
The reason for these blessings was simple…
They dared not directly face the “Red Moon” consciousness entity ascending, and wanted to find someone who could.
Clearly, theoretically, the “Primordial Fire,” an old rival of the “Red Moon,” was one of the best options.
“Hahaha, so that’s how it is, cowardly enough…”
Colin sneered, took a deep breath, and the terrifying flames spread out in rings with the expansion of his heartbeat; within dozens of kilometers around, everything that touched the flames, except for the Gods’ illusions, was directly burned to evaporation!
Fortunately, there were no innocent lives around.
Because this foie-gras-style burning flame was even somewhat uncontrollable for Colin.
He had a premonition that even if he were to casually spit, the effect was likely comparable to a Little Boy bomb!
Feeling this surging power, Colin couldn’t help but mockingly laugh a few times, but in the end, he seemed to make a decision—to face the “Red Moon.”
Although he was very clear that these “Gods” all harbored ill intentions, merely wanting him to be a sacrificial lamb.
But similarly, as the so-called “The Gods” began to break free from containment, humanity still had a chance to struggle…
If they allowed the “Red Moon” to succeed, then everyone was doomed!
But before that, Colin, feeling stronger than ever at this moment, did not immediately act but instead spoke up:
“If you want me to be your shield, it’s not impossible, but I have a few conditions!”
As he spoke, he spread out his demands through inspiration.
Soon, part of them were agreed upon…
Conditions such as not actively slaughtering ordinary lives, and even providing certain protection when necessary, all of these were granted. For them, ordinary humans are almost like ants, hardly worth noticing…
However, while the majority was agreement, there were still some who remained silent, giving no response.
Compared to these indifferent demands, after the other demands were proposed, most responded with silence or denial, with not a single agreement, namely: not to harm Colin or the employees of the company after the battle…
In the feedback, not harming the company’s employees, most didn’t give a clear agreement or opposition.
The attitudes of “The Gods” in this regard were ambiguously unclear.
But when it refined to not being allowed to harm him personally, most were negative—
Simply put, the company’s employees might not be targeted, but after cleaning up the “Red Moon,” they would definitely come for him!
“I am just a ‘Reservist,’ after all, what is there to be afraid of…”
Colin sighed, knowing this was the best outcome he could hope for.
As for whether they would abide, Colin was not worried. There is a price to pay for breaching promises of this level…

chapters.title: Chapter 827 - 827 567 The Chosen of the Gods_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 827: Chapter 567 The Chosen of the Gods!_2 Chapter 827: Chapter 567 The Chosen of the Gods!_2 Moreover, under the witness of the company’s power, the cost of breaking a promise was not low.
Then, he stopped overthinking and chose to turn around, his body enveloped once again in even more terrifying flames, ready to charge towards the “Red Moon” consciousness.
Holding the freshly acquired “Space: Transposition,” Colin, in a flicker of thought, appeared directly above the ascending path of the “Red Moon” instinct.
Looking down at the glowing phantom body below, even Colin, blessed by the Gods, felt his mind momentarily in disarray.
One eye spinning wildly, the other bobbing up and down like it had lost all reason.
Fortunately, the turmoil was quickly suppressed.
Following that, without any hesitation, he used five cards simultaneously, employing the powers of “Time,” “Force,” and “Space,” to attack the terrifying upper-tier life below!
However, what made Colin’s eyes widen was that this powerful attack was practically ineffective.
The “Red Moon” entity withstood all damage and, in an instant, its powerful new status was fully restored as before.
And it continued to rise towards the sky!
‘This damn spatial card, solves everything in that guy’s hands, in mine, it’s completely useless, washed-out and weakened too fast…’
Watching that indifferent celestial phantom, Colin gasped.
The gigantic instinctual body of the “Red Moon” did not pause due to his actions and continued to rise unhurriedly.
Simultaneously, with its ascent…
Above the dome, the bright moon gradually turned scarlet, as if revealing its true form.
“Looks like I have to use ‘Bonfire’ now…”
Colin took a deep breath, took out two-thirds, about seven hundred liters, of “Flame Bearer” grease, threw it out, and ignited it.
Then, in mid-air, he raised his arms high.
Terrifying flames gathered along his arms above his head, quickly condensing into a huge fireball that expanded rapidly…
Blazing light showered over the entire land.
From a distance, he resembled a deity, holding up the sun with his hands!
When the fireball expanded to its limit, Colin bellowed and hurled this “sun” violently at the “Red Moon” phantom below…
During this, his entire body’s muscles tore, and his skin sprayed blood under immense pressure.
This blood ignited in the air and merged into the “sun”!
This move had no technique to speak of, it was all about “loading materials.” In front of this “Red Moon” entity, none of the skills Colin mastered mattered; the only way was to fight hard!
“Boom~”
As the “sun” collided with the “Red Moon,” a powerful shockwave erupted where they had clashed, spreading a terrifying force. Colin saw that the “Red Moon” entity paused for a moment and was ignited by the flames!
A bizarre scream came from it, causing Colin’s body to convulse…
However, just when he thought his all-out effort might have been enough to handle the adversary, he suddenly saw the “Red Moon” instinct continuing upward after a brief pause, piercing through the “sun” and still travelling upwards…
Though now covered with more hollows and charred areas than before, it seemed merely wounded, not deadly.
And if it didn’t die, then the unfortunate one would be Colin, still in mid-air!
This time, Colin could feel that everything around him, including the air, seemed to come alive, constraining him on the spot. Under the “Red Light,” even the “Space Transposition” seemed unable to function…
‘Feels like every point is sealed, as if there’s some technique specifically countering me, has this thing ever dealt with enemies holding a ‘Golden Card’?’
Colin’s pupils constricted, feeling as if, apart from the “Bonfire,” the effects of other items were inexplicably like being blocked from shooting by a clogged gun.
Just then, amidst the despair, an intense hunger surged from his belly.
Accompanied by the hunger was a series of ancient whispers.
“Release me… release me!”
“Quick!”
“Let me out!”
“To fight it, I allow you to use my power…”
“Eat! Eat!! Eat!!!”
“…”
“It seems, this is the only way.”
As the “Red Moon” entity drew closer, Colin was about to cut open his stomach and release “Hunger.”
However, just at that moment, a familiar voice suddenly appeared in his ear.
“To harm the will of a True God with a mortal body… you’ve done quite well.”
“Old Master Wu?!” Colin was startled.
When the “Red Moon” rose, Colin thought Old Master Wu might have already met with an accident…
For Xu Duojin had implied that Old Master Wu usually dealt with this red moon!
“Yes, next, let me do it. Keep what’s on you to deal with the crisis of ‘The Gods,’ you still have a chance…” After a response, he suddenly saw the instinctual entity of the “Red Moon” stop.
Stopping it were numerous black hands capable of manipulating the Threads of Fate, emerging from the ground below, grasping onto the ethereal mind of the “Red Moon” and dragging it downwards…
And at the end of the countless black hands, Colin detected Old Master Wu.
At this moment, his form was bizarre, no longer human, but turned into a mountainous, quivering bundle of black threads, from which silk threads shot out continuously, turning into black hands…
In the middle of the thread bundle, there lay an invisible “book” encased.
Accompanied by some “assistance” given by the gods.
The “Red Moon” was being slowly dragged back into the original Dark City.
Countless black hands, like ropes, tightly wound around it, sealing it…
“Be cautious of Them, be wary of the Moon…” As the last words of Old Master Wu fell.
Colin then heard, by his ears, a surreal and misty rolling of dice.
Following that, the unknown book inside the black thread mass suddenly flew out, opened from the middle, and rapidly expanded, wrapping up the Dark City and the Red Moon inside.
With a “bang,” the sound of the book closing crisply, the Red Moon and the city vanished as if they had never existed.
Yet, the crisis was not resolved.
Under an intense sense of palpitation, Colin turned his head to look at the sky.
He saw that the Moon had unknowingly turned blood-red…
The entire world, bathed in its glow, seemed as if overlaid with a blood-colored filter.
Even more perilously…
As the conscious entity of the “Red Moon” pulled, it had left its original orbit, now slowly crashing towards Earth…
The air of the whole world seemed compressed by its descent,
becoming oppressive…
“Gurgle…”
Colin flew mid-air, lifted his head, swallowed, cold sweat seeping on his forehead, his eyes filled with the sight of the entire Moon:
“What are we supposed to do?!”
The instinctual entity of the “Red Moon” was only akin to a celestial body, but the Moon, this was undeniably an actual celestial body!
Moreover, had this thing been merely an inert object, not all hope would be lost because Colin had the chance to destroy it, minimizing the impact of its fall…
But this celestial body was the actual physical part of the bloody “Red Moon,” ordinary means were simply ineffective against it!
It seemed the only solution was to unleash “Hunger.”
But…
“This enormous body of the ‘Red Moon,’ if it were really devoured by ‘Hunger,’ this thing…”
Colin had a premonition, “Hunger” highly likely would lose control!
A true, absolute loss of control!
It could be overcome by the instincts within the Red Moon’s entity, or it could completely sever from the “Bonfire Company,” or any other situation…
All these probabilities were exceedingly high, and none bore good news!
Aside from “Hunger,” Colin really couldn’t imagine anything else he possessed that could block this thing.
His “Bonfire” was nowhere near strong enough to oppose such a being!
Not just him, even if he had grabbed the “King of Madness,” no, had grabbed any Grade 1 Containment Subject and put them in his place, it would be a certainty of death, no other possibilities!
And should it fall to the ground…
In Colin’s mind, even a vague image emerged: Earth itself would directly merge with it, becoming a bizarre existence…
As for the life on it, one need not think to know it was surely doomed!
However, just as Colin was somewhat at a loss facing the descending celestial body, a large amount of “Blessings of Gods” arrived again.
But this time, “The Gods” didn’t demand that he face the entire blood-red “Moon.”
Instead, they wanted him to use the Bonfire to tear a tiny path,
To give them a chance to strike at the “Moon”!
….
Wait, there is still another chapter.

chapters.title: Chapter 828 - 828 568 Fleeing and Releasing Yukionna
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 828: Chapter 568: Fleeing and Releasing “Yukionna Chapter 828: Chapter 568: Fleeing and Releasing “Yukionna ‘The red aura surrounding the “Red Moon” is absolutely fatal for “The Gods,” and once touched, unless one is at Super First Class or Level ‘0’, it’s essentially like being stuck with a piece of burning white phosphorus…’
‘The only way to get close is for me to create an opening, allowing them to directly attack the Moon itself!’
Colin understood the reason.
He took a deep breath, his body ablaze with Bonfire, and faced the skies.
The scorching flames continually drove away the crimson moonlight surrounding him…
A path tore through the pervasive red light filling the world.
This task was not difficult, as the “Red Moon” itself did not put up any resistance or counterattacks, it just kept falling…
The only difficulty was, as Colin drew closer to the “Moon,” he felt the consciousness within his body becoming increasingly chaotic.
Every part of his body seemed to resist.
Even his once utterly loyal left and right brains were “persuading” him not to harm the body of “Mother” and not to fall into the trap of The Gods.
‘Were it not for the Blessings of Gods, feeding power to the Bonfire, I probably wouldn’t even have the capital to approach this thing.’ Colin suppressed the chaos within him and couldn’t help but lament.
Several hours later, when he had torn open a passageway straight to the “Moon.”
The “The Gods,” hidden until now, no longer hesitated and chose to descend at this moment!
High above in the heavens, terrifying figures appeared one after another.
Some as large as mountains, others as small as dust particles…
The size of their forms did not seem to affect the display of their might.
At this moment, although it seemed that their true bodies had not arrived, their presence was still terrifyingly formidable…
Upon appearing, they did not hesitate at all, united with each other, moved along the path opened by Colin, and launched an all-out assault on the slowly sinking “Moon.”
“They even want to kill me along with it!” Colin saw that the strikes included him.
However, he wasn’t surprised by this and was prepared, using the ability of “Space: Transposition” to mark a location just as The Rat had once escaped from the Colosseum, instantly moving to a point below.
It was only after the shift that Colin’s spirit shook violently, seeing that “The Gods'” attacks had indeed struck the “Moon.”
Moments later…
“Boom!” a sound echoed.
On the crimson Moon, starting from one point, a multitude of spiderweb-like cracks spread out.
This Moon, which had once illuminated the ancients, was now shattering!
And in the heavens above, it started to disintegrate at what seemed a slow speed, turning into numerous uncountable fragments…
But before everyone could rejoice, an invisible scream spread out with the celestial split.
Not everyone was privileged to hear this innate scream from the “Moon,” but the phantom presences of The Gods were undoubtedly among those who did.
Just at the moment of hearing, the will of all the descending Gods was instantly wiped out, eradicated, making it impossible for them to mount even the slightest resistance.
Even the main bodies hidden behind the scenes suffered serious injuries!
At the same time, the “World Barrier,” which had been somewhat retained and barely maintained Earth’s mysterious structure, also completely collapsed at this moment.
And this also meant…
The world was completely heading towards chaos…
Colin could feel that many of the seals set in the past were quickly losing control.
But before he could observe more, Colin in midair was also “fortunate” enough to hear this “scream,” although he was not the main subject affected by the innate scream of the “Red Moon,” his suffering was no less severe.
The flames engulfing his body, blessed by The Gods, flickered like candles blown by a fierce wind, quickly extinguishing.
Following that, Colin felt like an ordinary person hit by a dump truck, everything went dark, and he plummeted straight towards the ground…
“Boom” a sound of a massive crash.
However, the descent into darkness did not last long.
Along with the “thump-thump” of a heartbeat, Colin opened his eyes again in the pit.
A scene immediately surged in his mind…
He, standing here, evaporated on the spot in the next second, and around the evaporating mist, several large irregular shadows appeared nearby and further incinerated the evaporated mist.
‘Speedy enough.’
Under intense premonition of crisis, Colin reversed the “Space: Transposition” in his hand, intending to leave immediately…
However, he discovered those creatures seemed to be prepared, making spatial transposition here extremely difficult.
But, Colin did not panic and immediately thought of a place—a special independent world village during his severed hand period, which seemed like the “Hunger’s” “food storage room.”
Colin had left a personal “Bonfire Ritual Point” there, which could serve as coordinates for transmission!
The next instant, with a thought, Colin activated his backup plan, and before various attacks arrived, he left the area at once.
…
In the independent space once consecrated to the Green-faced Kitchen God, situated at the center, a Bonfire some ten meters high suddenly trembled.
Following which, the flames converged, and a figure emerged.
“Here, I should be able to hide for a while…”
Colin felt he had temporarily shed some gazes, but how long he could keep them at bay was uncertain.
These creatures seemed absolutely determined to kill him, the “Reservist.”

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - 829 568 Escape and Release Yukionna _2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 829: Chapter 568: Escape and Release ‘Yukionna’ _2 Chapter 829: Chapter 568: Escape and Release ‘Yukionna’ _2 For this, he was even willing to cross boundaries in his severely injured body to find Colin for one last blow!
He took a deep breath, took out the parchment, and glanced at it to find the content dimmed, as if for some reason, it was temporarily offline; it still displayed the same information as a few days ago.
“From what I can see, they’ve broken free from containment, but it’s not a complete escape. To speak of it, their quick consent to not actively attack ordinary people probably has something to do with some ‘agreements’ still lingering on them—they themselves aren’t supposed to lash out against ordinary people…”
“Just that I have further reinforced that particular content.”
“However, compared to these past containment subjects, this one is the real major trouble…”
Colin raised his head, his gaze piercing through the barriers of the ‘independent’ micro-world, spying into the outside.
From a macroscopic perspective below, one could clearly see that in the heavens above, the Moon seemed intact, but upon closer inspection, it was splitting, crashing down.
During this process, it was foreseeable that it would break into countless fragments, ‘slowly’ falling—calling them fragments, when each one was, at the very least, as massive as a mountain.
With such mass, once they all hit the Earth, that alone would be enough to alter the planet’s surface.
But because the main body had already been shattered…
This thing no longer posed a lethal threat to those ‘higher beings’ now.
But for ordinary people, it was still an utterly catastrophic disaster.
Even if one didn’t consider the impact of the Moon fragments’ mass, just the lingering contamination on them, which wouldn’t disappear anytime soon, was enough to drive one to despair…
Yet, as Colin was observing the outside, pondering how to respond, he suddenly paused.
It felt like there was some redundant ‘information’ in his mind.
Soon after, as this piece of content was interpreted, he quickly understood: it was a piece of ‘spiritual’ knowledge that Old Master Wu had subtly imparted during the dice rolling session…
Due to the specialty of the situation, being observed by The Gods, the information was concealed.
Now, temporarily safe, it emerged on its own.
Generally speaking, the content was about predictions and analysis for Colin’s immediate future…
Now that The Rat had been defeated, the remaining ‘Bonfire’ powers and the clashing of ‘Fate’ and ‘Red Moon’ had led to mutual destruction…
“The Gods” exerted effort but not their lives, seemingly wounded, but they had not been truly damaged at the core.
“Based on this ‘inspiration’, the most dangerous time for me will soon be after ‘The Gods’ have recovered, and then they will frantically search to take revenge on me…”
“No, the revenge has already started, their consciousnesses have constructed a ‘shell’ among themselves, creating a blockade around the entire Earth, and it’s even affected some of the parchment’s functions.”
“However, as long as I can weather it, once the Moon fragments have fallen to a certain distance, ‘The Gods’ will retreat, and the shell will shatter.”
“Because even as fragments, the ‘Red Moon’ contamination hasn’t immediately disappeared, and for a short period, they dare not touch this hot potato…”
“As long as I can withstand this assault, and get through this period, then, before the ‘Red Moon’ contamination fades, I will have a fairly long time to hold out on the surface.”
Colin swiftly deduced the current situation.
He couldn’t help shaking his head, never expecting that the ‘Red Moon’ he had just shattered would turn into his umbrella…
Moreover, according to Old Master Wu’s foresight, the first Moon fragment to hit Earth should arrive in about seven or eight days; this wasn’t a direct timeframe given by the inspiration.
Instead, it was inferred through subtle hints, deducing the extent of calamity on the surface…
What lies beyond that remains unseen.
For when the ‘Red Moon’ fragments hit the ground, cataclysmic devastation would erupt upon Earth, and any observation would directly link up with the ‘Red Moon.’
Even as fragments, interacting with them would be suicide.
After all, the ‘Red Moon’ wasn’t truly dead, just temporarily sealed by the Book of Fate.
“With this in mind, the next day or two, before the ‘Red Moon’ physical fragments breach the atmosphere, will be my most dangerous time. If I avoid that, once the fragments penetrate ‘The Gods’ jointly created ‘Consciousness Blockade’, the parchment should temporarily recover… I have a feeling that when that time comes, I’ll be able to attract a wave of enhancement, and then, I should have a greater chance of holding out…”
Colin distilled key points from the information given by Old Master Wu, forming some rough ideas.
At that moment, a profound sense of crisis began to emerge…
Time was running short.
Colin thought for a moment, then took the opportunity of the last gap to pull out a Big Eyeball Ring from his pocket and released the “Yukionna” within.
“Huh?” The ice-blue silhouette of Yukionna made a sound of confusion.
Colin showed a smile, his forefinger and thumb on the ring exerting light pressure, and with a “crack”, he crushed it:
“Now, you’re free. Remember to hide well later, don’t come out; wait until the blockade is done, then try to leave this world.”
The situation to come was extremely dangerous, and he wasn’t sure he’d survive; there was no need to include “Yukionna” in his potential demise.
“Huh?” The semi-transparent Yukionna was stunned, not particularly elated—
Seemingly puzzled, why had he suddenly crushed her room and was now driving her away?

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - 830 568 Escape and Release Yukionna _3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 830: Chapter 568: Escape and Release “Yukionna” _3 Chapter 830: Chapter 568: Escape and Release “Yukionna” _3 Colin opened his mouth, wanting to explain something, but sensing the imminent danger, he immediately took out an Official Pass and stuffed it into Yukionna’s body, while simultaneously pulling out “Space: Transposition.”
The main skill of this card had several functions, one of which was to transport any person or object to places he had been to and left footprints in. Of course, there were many limitations, such as not being too far away, and the teleportation area couldn’t have too much interference, and so on…
Next was coordinate swap positioning, which was similar to the previous one but with stronger effects.
That Rat sneakily swapped him into “The Seventh Box Garden World,” using these skills.
In addition, by slightly “transposing” the spatial configuration, one could wield an ability akin to twisting a Rubik’s cube to execute a “spatial slash”…
“The effect is very strong, unfortunately, there’s no time to get used to it.”
As the thought flickered through his mind, Colin infused the card with spirituality, in a flash transporting “Yukionna” to an icy, snowy land where he had once invested his “Severed Hand”…
If it wasn’t necessary, “The Gods” were unlikely to break through such places.
After all, these higher beings were not all of one mind.
Releasing more “Ancient Gods” would only increase the number of enemies.
For now, they were momentarily united solely because Colin was not yet dead. Once he died, these entities would likely splinter and engage in internal strife in an instant, beginning to vie for the resources present on Earth…
Besides, on Colin, the only things sensible were the “Fire Tree” and the “Nano Intellectual Maid.”
“Fire Tree”… If it didn’t harbor any other ulterior motives, Colin might have released it.
But for now, it had better continue to shine and give off heat.
And as for the Little Maid, unlike “Yukionna,” she could still provide a substantial use, so she had to be brought along.
It was after making this plan that Colin suddenly felt a jolt in his heart. Followed by several figures appearing outside the little world, clinging to some kind of barrier-like wall, attempting to peer inside at Colin and launch an attack.
However, in the next second, each of these higher beings had just made their appearance before they were suddenly erased from existence.
That was because those hiding amongst them, the “Flamebearer” Reserves, had already escaped to an unknown region…
The chase between the two parties persisted relentlessly.
Equipped with five Golden Cards, initially, Colin managed to flee successfully from their pursuit. During the entire process, he made sure to move through unpopulated or less populated places to avoid casualties.
But as time went on, the situation grew more dire…
A day later, an exhausted Colin, having ducked into a small-world-like area again, glanced at the few survivors there and immediately used “Transposition” to send them away.
Then his figure staggered and fell to the ground.
“Cough, cough…” As he wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, he ignited it and reabsorbed it into his body, while also popping several “Colorless Crystals” into his mouth, staggering back to his feet.
Ignoring his wounds, he was contemplating a matter he had just noticed.
“Why does it seem like all the places I can escape to are on land, and there’s no way to get into the ocean?”
He had travelled all over the globe and found that all accessible locations were cut off from the sea—
Were these great beings specifically blockading the ocean?
“What’s going on? Is there something unknown yet stirring enough to unify these creatures about to emerge?”
Colin frowned, considering that although previous missions had involved the Earth’s oceans, the information revealed had been scant, and he didn’t know if something had happened at sea…
Yet, it didn’t seem entirely unrelated either.
“Lady Rabbit” had some arrangements in the deep-water world of “World Code-4,” which might be connected to the oceans in this world?
These beings might have deduced something he himself was unaware of!
“Forget it, I can’t worry about that right now…” Colin shook his head, his hand gripping the revolver clenching tightly, drawing more power from the “Flame Bearer.”
Suppressing the negative effects like Time Perception Disorder and Spatial Perception Disorder.
Then he looked up at the sky…
The Moon began to crumble, breaking into countless fragments, slowly breaching the atmosphere.
If he could just hold out for another day or half, he would make it…
However, employing the power of the “Flame Bearer” also attracted the sidelong glance of certain beings.
He didn’t linger and immediately pondered a small world he had previously visited, planning to jump there…
But at that moment, his heart sank with a thud.
Due to an ever-stronger onslaught of Time Perception Disorder.
This transfer… was half a second too slow, and in such a situation, that half-second was definitely fatal!
It was at that moment within Colin’s field of vision, that one after another phantom began to solidify!
He was cut off!
This time, he seemed to have nowhere left to run…
…
Asking for monthly votes…

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - 831 569 Promotion to Level C Employee (10K)
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 831: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!) Chapter 831: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!) In just two to three days, the world had become a horrific sight of wounds and scars.
A city once by the sea, the earthquakes had not stopped, high-rise buildings torn like pieces of paper, dust filling the air, streets riven with huge cracks, countless people trying to struggle amidst the cries and wails, but ultimately being engulfed by the subterranean, thunderous vibrations that drowned out all sound.
And in the coastal regions, tens of thousands of ships of varying sizes lay stranded on the dried-up seabed, shattered amidst the roiling, filthy mire that surged like ocean waves.
However, as celestial fragments tinged with a red glow pierced the atmosphere, bringing their force earthward,
the prisons built by higher beings through constructs of consciousness were suddenly breached with a “hole.”
Almost simultaneously, a will from beyond seemed to seize this moment, slipping into this world through that “hole.”
The intangible force soon quelled the earthquakes, storms, extreme cold, and other natural and man-made disasters of The Collapsed Azure World.
Gray haze began to form at predetermined locations around the world…
“Drip—”
Pale, hollow, monotonous flute sounds arose from various parts of the world.
“The Train in the Fog! It’s the train! How could it appear?!” In the ruins, an employee, bloodied and now towering at thirty meters tall in the form of a Mist Giant, cried out loudly upon seeing this scene.
But a second later, a special inspiration made him and all surviving employees understand why.
“The Train in the Fog” had come in accordance with some long-standing contract, to evacuate the civilians!
It was also at this moment that he felt as if there were a clear bell ringing in his head.
Immediately afterward, a first-ever global-scale mega-event occurred since he had joined the company!
[Global Event: Transfer ordinary lives onto “The Train in the Fog” as much as possible. The onboard passengers will later be moved to various safe refuge evacuation points after a considerable amount of time.]
“Note”: Mission countdown 11 hours 59 minutes 37 seconds.
…
At the same time, the internal communication network formed in his mind, and the employee immediately connected to it, discovering that in just a few minutes, there had already been a flood of messages.
“Guys, don’t ask so much for now, hurry to the train! The fight has just started, ordinary people can’t handle it!”
“Never mind all that, save people! Save them!!!”
“…”
Watching a stream of messages, the employee transformed into the Mist Giant opened up, liberating thousands of people from a shelter he had been protecting: “Hurry onto the train!”
The people, still etched with panic on their faces, didn’t understand the situation, but under that roar, they were somewhat brought back to their senses.
They then rushed towards the opening gates of the train.
At the location of the train, a fully armed staff member with six mechanical arms and two auxiliary mechanical heads stepped out from each doorway.
Some arms swirled with signalling lights, guiding people to discover this place; some arms brandished laser weapons, striking back the encircling anomalies; others waved like a conductor’s baton, directing swarms of drones against the enemy…
“Please hurry over…”
The distressed survivors, looking at the guide, for some reason naturally felt a sense of trust; they rushed over the shattered ground, undeterred even as sharp objects pierced their feet or as broken stones cut their arms and legs.
That not-so-large train doorway was one of their few, remaining hopes for survival!
“Though I don’t know where you come from, I can feel you’re an employee like us; I leave them in your hands…”
The staff member, shaped like a Mist Giant, carrying scores of young and old who couldn’t run, approached the train, placed the people down, and called out to the six-armed and three-brained armed reception staff member.
The operative’s facial lights flickered, signalling something like “Leave it to me,” and with a wave of their hand, shapes of light began to shimmer beside them, casting dozens of three-dimensional light projections.
Oddly enough, these projections could interact with reality, and they began to help the injured into the train cars.
Seeing this, the employee, shaped like the Mist Giant, nodded his head and was about to leave when a child stopped him: “Big brother who can become a giant, where are you going…”
Hearing this, he let out a rough laugh and turned around: “I am going to be a hero.”
With that, he walked away.
If he remembered correctly, a government shelter lay not too far away, just a few dozen kilometers.
There, a large number of ordinary people still needed to be evacuated.
The armed staff member watched him leave, raising a hand in salute, then began their own work.
However, not all evacuation efforts in the area were going so smoothly.
“Save me, take me with you, or else I’ll, I’ll blow us all up with a bomb…”
“Just because I’m a Heretic, you refuse to save me?!”
“My dog, my dog is dead, I don’t want to live either, don’t touch me, I don’t want to live anymore sob sob…”
“Haha, it’s the apocalypse, it won’t make a difference where you run, just let me enjoy… ”
“I have superpowers now! My System has awakened! I am the favored child of heaven, hahaha…”
In a less devastated area far from the core battlefield, only having experienced something akin to an Eighth Level earthquake, several employees looked at the chaos in the city before them, unsure where to start.
The disaster was terrifying, but the chaos caused by the millions of survivors was even more draining on the spirit.
“What to do, what to do in this situation, at times like these, shouldn’t we all unite? Why are there so many trivial issues…”
An Employee Level E, not highly-ranked and covered in blood, murmured to himself, shielding some innocent people behind him while confronting a mad Awakener.

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - 832 569 Promotion to Level C Employee (10K)_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 832: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!)_2 Chapter 832: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!)_2 He had thought that rescuing people would be enough, but he didn’t expect…
that the people themselves might also be a disaster!
There were heretics, those tainted by evil, those who had lost loved ones and were in despair and grief, and then there were those who mysteriously gained extraordinary powers as Awakeners, and even some who weren’t heretics but lost their sanity after witnessing the “apocalypse,” trying to do things they wouldn’t dare to do normally—rape, torture, and satisfy extreme desires…
Even just now, among the elderly, women, and children he had rescued, some had contemplated attacking him from behind, attempting to snatch his belongings!
The reason was just… even though they were grateful for his help, they wanted the power to protect themselves more.
The E Level Personnel felt very sad and even wanted to laugh inexplicably…
Although… there were moments when humanity shined here, it… wasn’t enough!
Far from enough!!
It was when he was facing the chaos, somewhat bewildered, somewhat clueless, that a piercing siren, like an air raid alert, suddenly rang out of nowhere. The moment the sound erupted, the E Level Personnel and many others at the scene couldn’t help but recall the usual disaster drills.
Following this, as people’s thoughts resonated, an indescribably immense entity slowly descended.
The E Level Employee lifted his head, vaguely sensing that the arriving entity, though massive, was not easily observable by the naked eye; however, in perception, it was ubiquitous, filling every corner of the city ruins.
Only those with sufficiently strong inspiration could feel it through intuition.
At this moment, it seemed to envelop and cover the entire city, extending innumerable fine lines from its vast body, each thread precisely connected to a person’s heart.
And it was at this moment that a flash of inspiration struck.
“A collective human consciousness?” The E Level Employee felt he had seen it before but wasn’t sure. Yet, even so, he still named it.
This entity was discussed to some extent within the company, so it was not entirely unfamiliar.
In an instant, with the rise of a powerful “heartbeat,” countless people who had lost their reason and moral compass suddenly fell to the ground, lifeless, deprived of life.
Those whose sins were not as grave were stripped of their consciousness, standing numbly in place.
“What on earth is going on?” The E Level Employee exclaimed in shock, quite puzzled, but at the same time, he breathed a sigh of relief.
He was alarmed to see a line also connected to his own chest and feared he might drop dead at any moment.
The relief came from seeing that some other relatively normal people were unharmed and, under the manipulation of some “greater consciousness,” all emotions suppressed, they walked woodenly toward a misty area in the distance.
If he wasn’t mistaken, that should be where the train appeared…
As the E Level Employee was lost in thought, he suddenly heard someone speaking nearby:
“This is like what you said, ‘a collective human consciousness,’ connecting to everyone when you signed up voluntarily for the drill…”
The E Level Personnel turned his head and saw a man with black hair and eyes, covered in wounds as if he’d just been through many battles, his body seething with a vigorous aura. He was holding half the head of a creature that was at least a Third Level Containment Subject.
“I am Rogue, a member of The Great Wall’s Elite Rising Stars,” he briefly introduced himself.
But hearing this explanation, the E Level Employee knew: the authorities had entered the scene.
After Brother Shunzi led them in a collaboration with the authorities, names like “The Great Wall,” “Golden Dawn,” “Future Observatory,” “Numerical Research Institute,” “Fate Execution Center,” and many others under the “Global Supernatural Alliance” were not unfamiliar internally.
“The ‘collective human consciousness’ is one of our tools to cope with scenarios like this. After all, we can’t always rely solely on human nature itself; effective management is necessary. As for me…” the man who claimed to be an Elite Rising Star of The Great Wall tapped his head, “you can verify the truth through your internal network.”
The “collective human consciousness” didn’t have the “permission” or ability to erase life, even those who did evil, in the beginning…
But drawing on the experience provided in several documents about ‘The Seventh Box Garden World’ and ‘apocalypse’ brought by a high-ranking official from “Bonfire Company,” after some time of debate, global governments unanimously passed this “permission.” Otherwise, the collapse of human morality alone would have triggered massive chaos.
Even with it, many disorders still occurred.
Due to a previous uprising and the sudden collapse of “world barriers,” the effect of the “collective human consciousness” was not complete and could only perform at a third or even less of its theoretical value. Its effects continued to weaken as chunks of a red moon fell from the sky…
Meanwhile, the E Level Personnel nodded his head upon hearing this. Reminded by the other party, he noticed that his mind, unknowingly, was connected to the internal communication network that usually only appeared during team missions.
This communication even seemed to be bound directly to parchment?
However, without much thought, he found that there were already many employees rapidly exchanging information.
“What is that thing? Something official?”
“Yes, it’s a united will, or ‘a collective human consciousness.’ It’s not much use for us or some stronger individuals, but it can prevent riots, quickly restore order, facilitate action, and even use it to immediately figure out where there are survivors for better rescue…” employees who understood the situation kept explaining to new joiners.

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - 833 569 Promotion to Level C Employee (10K)_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 833: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!)_3 Chapter 833: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!)_3 “Alright, alright, alright, with this thing, rescuing people is a whole lot easier. Damn it, there was an idiot yelling about his son being in trouble, so I busted my ass only to dig up a dead dog, then I found out his son was a dog. And then he accused me of killing his dog because I was digging too roughly. He insisted on rescuing his dead, dumb Teddy, or he’d drag us all down with him. Sickened me to death…”
“Folks! Be careful of the Heretic members! Some bastards are posing as officials and performing blood sacrifices. Official personnel will have a badge on their chest that can be matched with the ‘Human Consciousness Aggregate’ to verify identity. If they don’t have it, you’re better off keeping your distance…”
“Guys, I need backup… There are too many people over here.”
“Post your exact location when you call for backup, how the hell is anyone supposed to know where you need support with you just yelling like that…”
“…”
He quickly processed the information in his head, especially the last few messages. His attention then turned to the self-proclaimed “The Great Wall” Employee, noting the work-like badge on his chest with the name “Rogue” and other identifying details, he breathed a sigh of relief.
However, before he could speak, the voice of “The Great Wall” Elite echoed once more:
“Friend, sorry to trouble you, but from now on, you’ll be covering their evacuation by train. After all, there’s still quite a distance to cover, and plenty of abnormal species are invading. A few hundred people shouldn’t be a problem for you. The rest of us will take over the battle here…”
Before the most terrifying “God disaster,” there had already been large-scale attacks by abnormal and Heretic races, which could be somewhat withstood. But when the most intense period of the “God disaster” came shortly afterward…
Disasters struck one after another, and it seemed like the Earth itself was on the brink of collapse.
They, the “ordinary people,” didn’t even have the credentials to get involved. Only now, when things had calmed down slightly, did they have the chance to come out and provide rescue—
Of course, according to some “Fate Propeller” masters, this rescue operation wouldn’t last very long…In a day or a few days, disaster on the scale of the “God disaster” might strike again.
All that could be done now was to evacuate ordinary people as quickly as possible, transporting away as many as they could…
It was as he spoke that a rumbling noise came from behind the Elite named “Rogue” who stood watch over “The Great Wall.”
Assisted by some observation tools, the Level E Employee peered into the distance and saw, at the end of the wasteland of ruins, thousands of steel machines rolling forward on tracks, protected by a dense swarm of drones…
From within, artillery barrels flashed continuously, firing shells.
Yet, what truly shocked him was not this, but rather, following the mighty steel tide, a two-hundred-meter-tall Flame Giant that inspired immense shock as it approached.
It slowly followed behind the army, traversing the land of ruins.
On its ghostly body, faces opened their mouths periodically, projecting horrifying jets of flame toward the unknown enemies in the distance.
Among the sizeable support troops, beyond these beings, he also sensed some double-qualified “official” Extraordinary Ones!
Seeing this, the Level E Employee nodded, doubting no longer, and led those he could save toward the nearest train station.
“The current mission, protect and rescue at full strength. If you can send people away according to the previous contract, then do it. If you can’t, bring as many as possible back to the shelter. Then, Squad Four, follow me to sweep this area thoroughly. We’ll hold off those Heretic Races here, buying more time for the operations of Shelter No. 2, bracing for the next wave of enemies…”
The Elite from “The Great Wall” spoke as such. As an Elite Rising Star, he had some knowledge of top-secret information, aware there was a limit to how many people the train could transport. He didn’t know the exact number—it could be a lot, but he knew it wouldn’t be enough for everyone…
Adding to the chaos, disasters, and invading races, it wasn’t feasible to put all hopes of survival on this single point.
Fortunately, they had several other plans.
As he pondered, he looked up into the sky, witnessing the terrifying red-lit fragments drawing ever closer and feeling the stir of those eager to wreak havoc, he became acutely aware.
The war was far from over; it had barely even begun. A strong premonition told him that this place might be where his life would end.
But, what of it?
Just then, as if sensing something, he withdrew his gaze and soared into the sky to look out into the distance. He saw an incoming tide of terrible blasphemous creatures.
Their movements stirred up clouds of dust, shaking the ground.
On another front, mountainous beings issued dreadful roars, emitting waves of force that tore the ground apart…
“Everyone, attention! Prepare for combat within ten minutes! We are going to build The Great Wall here, to hold back the flood!”
…
Meanwhile, within the Employee’s inner channel.
“Speaking of which, where’s Brother Shunzi? What’s happened to Brother Shunzi? Let’s hurry to Brother Shunzi’s side…”
“Can’t do it, he’s at the core of the battlefield for this event. We just ran into him. If Brother Shunzi hadn’t taken all the damage and used some Spatial Artifact to move us, our group would probably be gone.”
“Quit the bullshit talk, what’s the situation with Brother Shunzi now? Hurry up and support him!”
“It’s tough, you know what’s happening here? The God Battle Center! An ocean spanning thousands of kilometers was just vaporized, man can’t get there, don’t go…”

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - 834 569 Promotion to Level C Employee (10K)_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 834: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!)_4 Chapter 834: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!)_4 “He was surrounded by those ‘Gods’ like powerful beings.”
“Damn, why am I so weak! Why am I so weak, if I were as strong as a First Level Containment Subject, how could things turn out like this, how could it possibly be like this…”
“No, I must go, I can feel it, Brother Shunzi needs us, at least ten D Level staff must get to his side…”
“Count me in after the train leaves and the transfer operation ends!”
Some employees were not giving up and seemed to have a sense of wanting to go help.
However, at this moment, one ID’s message paused all other voices.
“654321: Don’t come, save people first, don’t worry about me, try to relocate everyone, and then leave if you can, don’t look back in the short term…”
After sending this message and cutting off their thoughts, Colin wanted to say something more but realized that the communication had been cut off.
“Ahem, the blockade is really lethal…”
Colin covered the bloodied hole in his chest and coughed twice.
At this moment, just when he was once again surrounded in a desperate, life-threatening situation, he used the “Shield Badge of Fairness and Justice” to issue a duel challenge to the Little Maid, gaining some breathing space…
He was now in the “Dueling Arena,” where external interferences were hardly possible.
But, in no more than nine hours, this “Dueling Arena” would be dispersed. Although surrounded by mere phantasms brought about by the will of the Gods—far inferior to the original entities, plus some restrictions—it felt like pinching an ant inside a balloon from the outside, unable to exert full strength.
