However, the overwhelming number meant that he could not withstand them, and even the artifact would be scrapped by then.
At that moment, lying in the arms of the Little Maid, as he tried to repair himself as much as possible, Colin suddenly realized something and took out a parchment from his pocket…
The parchment, which seemed to have had poor signal due to the blockade of the Gods’ will, had finally been restored!
The original “A Special Mission” event had been completed!
This also meant…
[Congratulations, you have been granted Level C promotion eligibility!]
[Your corporate authority level will be adjusted from “D” to “C,” and your company powers will change as follows —]
[“Storage Room”: 10m³→100m³+10m³ (10m³ for exceptional talent: can hold life).]
[“Talent Grid”: 2+1→3+1.]
[“Trade Mall-Marketplace”: available items for purchase have increased, please open the “Marketplace” to check the details yourself.]
[“Office · Containment Unit” functionality has been unlocked for you, you can place some eligible containment subjects into it for further control, research, and trait extraction, etc.]
[Your various authorities will be adjusted, please understand progressively…]
…
“Finally!”
Colin was exhilarated, knowing it must have been a fragment of the “Red Moon” that broke through the barrier of the Gods’ will, enabling the update!
And crushing The Rat’s conspiracy, preventing the Red Moon, stopping a planetary-level catastrophic event…
That’s what had earned him this Level C eligibility!
“The tenfold expansion of the Storage Room is quite good, Talent Grid, this extra talent is stronger, but I don’t have time to search for a talent now. As for the Marketplace, it’s not very practical with minimal refresh, and the Office is of no current use…”
These function changes didn’t seem particularly special to him.
Colin’s attention went to the bottom of the parchment, what he truly cared about was this: authority promotion!
“From now on, I finally have the ability to release that First Level Containment Subject from ‘Passionate Paradise,’ yeah, ‘King of Mad Sounds’ too…”
“No, a spiritual sense tells me ‘King of Mad Sounds’ is too far away, might not be able to release, I need to go personally, but, I probably can’t make it, those things won’t allow it…”
Colin frowned, having only one First Level Containment Subject to help was still not optimistic.
However, he hadn’t put all his hopes on this after all.
Right now, his real trump card was…
As a legitimate Level C Employee, especially aligned with combat, he was finally eligible to officially request to use “Hunger”!
Yes, one of the true underpinnings of the original “Bonfire Special Containment Company’s,” 0-09 “Hunger”!
Although it’s a restricted usage, it also meant he finally had the capacity to fight against those higher beings!
“But, with a time limit, one month within, at most only one hour can be used, I might be able to extend it a bit, to reach three hours…”
“But the key trouble is the negative effects, these negative effects, although not lethal, I’ve stacked too many things on my body already, combined might cause trouble, have to pick the right moment to use, even better not to use it if possible…”
“No, not using is not an option, after all, those things might also make a final counterattack, but as long as I can last, wait for the ‘Red Moon’ fragments to fall a bit more, they will have to temporarily withdraw, then, I’ll have a longer period to rest…”
Colin took a deep breath, his biggest issue right now was his body full of negative effects was at a critical point.
“It still feels like being at the end of one’s resources…”
Colin sighed, and without further ado, took out the “C Level Gene Compensation Medicine (Injectable)” he obtained from the last mission.
Looking at the injection, and after confirming its usability, he had no hesitation, directly targeting his arm and stabbing it…
In an instant, Colin shivered slightly, not from pain, but because, various negative effects on his body suddenly alleviated some with the “optimization” he administered, providing significant relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - 835 569 Promotion to Level C Employee (10K)_5
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 835: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!)_5 Chapter 835: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!)_5 Unfortunately, this medicine injection can only be given once…
And even if there were a second dose, it couldn’t be used now.
Because while the conditions to purchase the second dose aren’t too stringent—points plus a voucher can resolve it, although it’s incredibly expensive—at least it’s solvable…
But the requirements to use it afterward are quite strict, and one must meet a large number of demands:
It requires using something unheard of called “Cosmic Principle Type 3 Calculation Core” to optimize oneself once, it requires “ten percent of a First Level Containment Subject’s condensed energy produced by burning,” and it requires having a formal job position among other conditions.
The entire list of requirements amounts to over thirty items, of which he currently fulfills less than a third…
In the short term, the chances of collecting them all are very slim.
“No wonder it’s a limited position, not like before when taking a shot and doing two tasks was enough.”
With a sigh, Colin’s spirit suddenly relaxed, and in that moment, a wave of negative effects invaded.
Instantly, his eyes glaze over.
The oncoming “Time Perception Disorder” made time stretch as though it were years long. When he came back to his senses, he felt a strong sense of disorientation, then shook his head vigorously, widened his eyes, and exclaimed with horror,
“How much time has passed?”“Not even three seconds…” the Little Maid said soothingly.
“Phew, that was close; scared me to death; I thought seven or eight years had gone by.” Colin let out a sigh of relief.
Then, shaking his head again, he hesitated for half a second and began to carefully sense the condition of his body—previously, he had been afraid to look at the accumulated negative effects within, much like a middle-aged man of humble means who dared not get a medical examination.
Following that, Colin made a heart-pounding discovery…
Even after the injection, he was almost in a “light at the end of the tunnel” kind of status.
He wasn’t dead or unconscious just yet, hanging on by sheer willpower alone.
“There is a not insignificant chance that after the injection, my injuries and negative effects will stack up and kill me…”
Colin muttered to himself and suddenly realized that a new event had appeared!
[Special Event: “Find the cognitive sea and enter it, alleviate your own injuries, and guide the ‘sea water’ into the world…”]
“Find the ocean?”
Upon seeing this requirement, Colin had an epiphany; no wonder there were higher beings mysteriously evaporating the sea before, they might have anticipated this…
To this, he wasn’t surprised; after all, there were numerous such entities, and probably with predictive means as a First Level Containment Subject.
However, according to the mission, could he ensure his recovery after finding the ocean?
“The ocean should still exist, but it’s far away, unable to break through. I should first ensure my own survival as much as possible. Then after the ‘Red Moon’ shards fall and the blockade is completely broken, start to take action…”
Colin prepared to proceed in two steps.
First, survive.
Second, wait for the Red Moon to fully break the Gods’ will blockade, then seek out the ocean.
Otherwise, with the heavy military presence, even if he could leverage a small portion of “Hunger’s” power, going there would most likely result in death.
“‘Hunger’ is currently in a state of starvation; let’s see if I can get some stuff to kick it into gear later. Right now, even if I use it, it can’t exert much actual power; first I need to buy some items and feed it directly to recover some strength.”
“By the way, can the Golden Artifact be eaten?”
Colin suddenly thought of this, but was quickly met with a strong spiritual knowledge feedback—
It can be eaten, but it would only cause indigestion.
Currently, “Hunger” can only quickly use “Purple” level items on the artifact scale.
And even then, he would have to trigger them first before it could “eat,” and even so, because of the artifact’s own characteristics, if it consumed a few more, it would still get indigestion, and ‘Hunger’ would reject eating anything related to Bonfire Company…
“Damn it, what timing to be picky!”
Colin cursed under his breath.
Of course, if it could be completely unleashed, then it would eat anything.
Including Colin, its user!
Shaking his head, without dwelling further, he took out the parchment, ready to make purchases.
Unfortunately, although the task could be completed, the severe blockade meant the signal was weak, and the items had not refreshed…
Finally, after a while, the “signal” reconnected.
Colin glanced at the auction house; there were only a few dilapidated or ordinary pieces of equipment, none even green, and fewer in quantity than usual, but he wasn’t picky and bought them all.
As a C Level Personnel and a “Flamebearer” Reservist, he could ignore certain restrictions and stockpile.
Then, after thinking for a moment, Colin opened the chat channel, planning to seek assistance from others.
He discovered the messaging was fast though less frequent than before.
Obviously, casualties were rapidly mounting…
“Does anyone have advanced items for sale? I need some materials; post anything on the points market that isn’t unreasonably exaggerated; I’ll take it…” Colin’s message quickly went out.
And after being sent, the previously sparse messages surged again…
“Great! Brother Shunzi, you suddenly went silent for two hours; I thought you were gone, wuwuwu…”
“What do you need, Brother Shunzi? I’ll send it right up…”
“Me too, I’ve boarded a train; I won’t have to fight next.”
“…”
For a moment, seeing Brother Shunzi’s message once more, the employees were more excited; during this time, Colin’s strong presence had also become a kind of symbolic figure of morale.

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - 836 569 Promotion to Level C Employee (10K)_6
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 836: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!)_6 Chapter 836: Chapter 569: Promotion to Level C Employee! (10K!)_6 Having worked together for so long, even in the most desperate times, they could always hope for a bonfire to descend from the sky.
Hope that figure riding the flames would come to save everyone again!
It was at this very moment, after Colin had reappeared, seeking some assistance, that the originally deserted auction house suddenly filled with an abundance of items.
And on the company’s internal channel…
“Loyalty’s Anthem”: Brother Shunzi, and my brothers, keep it up, I’ve sent everything up, take whatever you need…
“Professor Cute Cuddle”: If you gave everything away, what will you do?
“Loyalty’s Anthem”: I…
The message seemed to cut off mid-sentence, then suddenly went dim.
“Fool’s Mushroom”: I can’t hold on any longer, you guys take it, if there’s a chance, coming to collect my body would be enough…
“Sea God Bright Moon”: I’m almost done for too, if there’s a chance to collect my body, remember to bring a shovel, I’m nearly beaten into a pulp, donated the items…
“Two-Faced”: Quickly apply for the ‘Nonexistent Hospital’ event quest, if it’s approved, you can hide here! It’s temporarily safe…
“Wandering Speedy Lad”: Not going… I have dozens of survivors behind me, including my family, if I leave, what will they do?
“Little Building in the Fresh East Wind”: Brother Shunzi, keep it up, I… logged off… there are still some victims here, if there’s a chance… save them… everyone, goodbye, all items are put up, this time, don’t worry about the money…
“Only Lustful Images Reign Supreme”: What the hell, it turns out everyone had plenty of Purple Gear, usually, I never saw any, I thought you guys didn’t have any, come on, let’s give everyone a lesson, Golden Artifact incoming!!! Alright, it’s equipped, I’m logging off, use it well, this is my last gift…
“Confused Cutie ①Sob Sob⑦”: @Only Lustful Images Reign Supreme, what’s wrong! Why log off, hang in there! I’m coming to save you, I’ve just evacuated a group of people, I remember you’re not far from me…
“Don’t come, there’s a tough character here, I’ve got… just half a head left…”
After saying this, the name “Only Lustful Images Reign Supreme” suddenly turned grey.
Colin stared blankly at this scene, his eyes a bit moist. He hadn’t expected that his request would cause such a reaction.
The once expensive Purple Items, hard to obtain even after a lot of effort, were increasingly appearing at the auction house.
Included among them were the Orange Items, normally considered priceless and rarely seen by people…
Even those ultra-rare Golden Artifacts that no one had ever seen, aside from himself!
And their listed price, typically “0”…
Among the many donations of assistance, some came from those who had withdrawn, but more than that, after various other gifts, came from the last remains of the sacrificing employees.
However, once these gifts were acquired, it also meant in a certain sense, those who had left the battlefield were returning here in another way, rejoining the fight once more.
Then, Colin saw that some people had @ him…
“Life Mentor Adorable”: Brother Shunzi, right, Brother Shunzi, the Descend Quest is about to start, you can go first, we may or may not make it, but you can’t, you can’t die like this here…
“Surfing for Pigs”: Yes, yes, yes! How could I forget there’s the Descend project…
“Arsonist·Tao Tie”: Let’s retreat first, go to World Code 4 or 13, we can’t worry about not having firewood with the green mountains preserved, don’t forget, there’s a Little Mermaid Princess waiting for you at World Code 4.
“Miss Nell’s Dog”: Right! And World 13, Little Red, the Saintess, those followers, they too… Brother Shunzi, you’re the hope of the entire village! We’ll hold the fort here! You go first! And later, come back to avenge us all!
…
Seeing this, Colin was rarely moved.
Nevertheless…
“I can’t go, those creatures are watching me, and if they’re not watching me, they’re going to charge at you, and no one will get away, so if there’s a chance, you guys go, do not come back after going, after three denials, you will stay there for a long time, don’t worry, I… have accepted everyone’s gifts, I won’t die so easily.”
Colin sighed as he gave his reply.
Caught in the center of this maelstrom, he deeply understood that those things would not let go of him.
Even if he traveled to “World Code-13,” it would pursue him… the “God Calamity” here is on a completely different level of scale and intensity compared to the one in Shana’s world!
On the other side, they are just exerting force through coffin boards, needing only to press them down, but here, a foot is already stretching out from the coffin board!
The intensity is not at all on the same level!
As for “Lady Rabbit,” Colin didn’t have much hope either. According to The Rat’s saying, “Lady Rabbit” was facing quite a bit of trouble at this very moment.
She struggled to get away…
Everything had to be left to himself.
While reading through some messages, Colin couldn’t help but think of the Little Mermaid, Little Red, and… Shana. She couldn’t come either.
Even if she did, it would only be a weaker avatar…
To truly make a difference, it would probably require the original body, but in a way, Shana was “beyond the wall,” which made it hard for her original body to arrive here.
But now, in this situation, even if she came, it was death…
‘It is… somewhat good news, though.’
Colin inexplicably sighed, grateful for not having said some things to the Saintess but regretting that he hadn’t expressed some of his thoughts to her.
But now, there was no time to think more about that.
“I am not dead yet. If it really comes down to it, during the final flashback, I will think about these things then, hoping to have time for a life review before I die…”
Colin adjusted his mindset.
Afterward, he gathered his thoughts and looked at the Purple Items he had received.
He had taken a total of ten Purple Items, but did not collect any Golden Artifacts, because his current maximum was just overloading and exploding the Purple Gear—simply using Purple Gear would hardly affect a First Level Containment Subject.
But feeding it to “Hunger” was a different story!
However, at this moment, holding these items and recalling the remarks he saw when collecting them, Colin fell silent.
“Sage’s Spiritual Brand”: Keep it up, no matter who you are, I hope it can help you…
“Demon Lord’s Magic Cloak”: This, this is only lent to you! Survive, and one day return this artifact to me! By your own hands!
“Assassin Gloves”: Don’t let my artifact accrue soul rings! It will be worthless! Keep going, listen to Brother Shunzi, believe that we can win…
“Instantaneous Movement: Thunder Walk”: Buddy, don’t give up!
“Power Gloves”: Hey, man, keep it up, help me get revenge…
“Death Script”: Colleagues! The time for human sacrifice has come!!!
…
Colin closed his eyes, rubbed his moist eyelids, took a deep breath, and with a renewed determination in his gaze, his pupils flared like a bonfire:
“Don’t worry, I won’t easily fall here, I will do my utmost to survive, to change the situation here… to become the ‘Brother Shunzi’ you’re all expecting!”
So many people have given him gifts at the expense of their lives, how could he lose!?
“‘Hunger’… I hope you won’t disappoint me in a bit!”
Colin felt the authority he had received and murmured to himself.
According to the feedback…
He would be able to mobilize 0.3% of the total essence of “Hunger” as his combat force for the upcoming battle!
.

chapters.title: Chapter 837 - 837 570 Release 1-24 Formless Mother
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 837: Chapter 570: Release “1-24 ‘Formless Mother'”!!! Chapter 837: Chapter 570: Release “1-24 ‘Formless Mother'”!!! “Rumble~”
Inside the “Duel Arena,” there was a sudden vibration, as if it might be breached at any moment.
However, Colin didn’t even lift his head, as he was certain the Shield Emblem could at least withstand a few more hours, so there was no need to panic, and he kept focusing on his current preparations.
At this moment, his left hand clutched a section of white phalanx bone, from which a dense white light, almost solid in nature, surged out, forming an exceedingly blurry figure with wings.
The figure’s twelve wings fluttered gently, infusing Colin with white light for purification, reducing and suppressing various negative effects.
And in his right hand, he held the “Item Liberation” mode of the “Revolver Contrarian,” continuously drawing strength from the Bonfire into himself, enveloping every part of his body as though forging it.
Especially around the heart and brain areas…
“Come to think of it, the ‘Item Liberation’ of the orange gear increased from the original five percent to fifteen percent, and moreover, I already qualify for the Golden Card’s Item Liberation, although it seems I can only liberate five percent…”
“However, it’s a pity that liberating the Golden Card isn’t worth it right now.”
The prerequisite for using “Hunger” is, after all, having the power of the “Flame Bearer” locked onto one’s humanity and rationality, etc…
To prevent oneself from collapsing immediately after summoning.
To liberate a Golden Artifact would prevent drawing a large amount of Flame to use “Hunger,” which is a bit of a loss.
Unless there’s a Golden Level “Flame Bearer” item.
But… rather than fantasizing about that right now, it would be more practical to dream of someone becoming the “Flame Bearer” and descending from the sky.
Colin shook his head slightly and continued to put on the “Crown of Suffering” gifted by the “Lady of Thorns” onto his head.
His body’s tolerance capacity, at this moment, gained another boost.
Following that, he began to ponder which item to use for the upcoming encounter, and after some thought, he took out the “False Mighty One” for a glance.
Although this item seemed ineffective at C Level, if triggered for an overload explosion, it could still be employed.
It could quickly compensate for some of the shortcomings he had at this new level.
Besides, there were other offensive Purple Items, some acquired from employees’ hands, and some from official trades, like the “Hammer of Thunder” and the like…
Such objects, when thrown at Level 2 Containment Subjects, unless they are of a special type, would result in surefire destruction upon overload explosion.
Not to mention instant annihilation; admission to the ICU would be guaranteed.
But against a First Level Containment Subject, the situation was not so clear.
Most likely, it would only serve as a temporary stop before the end.
After choosing his items, Colin began to adjust his current Status to ensure no critical issues would arise later.
Almost another two hours passed…
The effects of the “Colosseum” were weakening; Colin could already sense the “The Gods” outside, baring their fangs and claws.
It felt as if he was just a fish in an aquarium.
Then, a bunch of wild cats, greedy and eager, pressed their faces against the glass, contorting their features as they watched him with weird smiles.
“Children, you’ve slept long enough, it’s time for you to work…”
Colin rubbed his left eye, which was endowed with the “Favor of the Flame Bearer.”
Within this eye resided a very special Level 2 Containment Subject “Haze Angel”—in the impending battle, it should be able to play a certain role.
In an instant, with Colin’s call, the cough-inducing white haze drifted out…
Within the white haze, figures of children, women, and overworked laborers appeared, rapidly spreading to the surroundings.
Then, Colin took out a cord, tied up Shana’s phalanx, and wore it like a necklace around his neck, continuing to draw its power non-stop.
Next, he took out the Bone Spur…
When all preparations were ready, Colin took a deep breath. He said nothing about rushing out; instead, he stayed put.
The outside was already ensnared in a web of heaven and earth; being early or late by two seconds wouldn’t make a notable difference in difficulty, and his main goal was still to delay time—the longer, the better…
After another half-hour passed, Colin, who sat meditating, suddenly opened his eyes.
“Crack!”
A sound of shattering suddenly rang out.
At the moment of the fissure’s appearance, the “Arena of Honor” was directly torn apart by a massive influx of strange powers.
The “Shield of Fairness Adjudication” immediately entered a state of complete destruction, returning to the “Storage Room” of its owner Colin!
Under the gaze of many figures, the thick haze burst out explosively, rapidly spreading to all quarters.
However, the haze had not spread far before it was forcibly halted.
Not a speck of dust could break through their Blockade!
A Godly vessel of the human form plunged into the haze, swung its hand decisively, and tore the haze, which even ordinary Level 2 Containment Subjects found challenging, into two, catching a glimpse of the flickering flame within…
At the moment he acted, other figures exerted their strength in unison.
Under their various strikes, the region seemed as if its dimensions had been lowered, turning it into a vastly abstract place.
Only in the radiance of that flame could things barely function as usual.
And sensing the aura contained within that flame, The Gods hesitated for a rare moment, seemingly recalling something unpleasant.
After hesitating for a full half a second, another vessel, carrying the consciousness of an Ancient God, broke the silence and charged into it, attacking the flame!
With its lead, other figures followed suit, launching attacks through various means.

chapters.title: Chapter 838 - 838 570 Release 1-24 Formless Mother_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 838: Chapter 570 Release ‘1-24 Formless Mother’!!!_2 Chapter 838: Chapter 570 Release ‘1-24 Formless Mother’!!!_2 The white fog screamed miserably as if struck brutally, beginning to retreat.
The leading human container rushed into the fog, its arm suddenly stretching long, reaching toward the figure of a man in the flames, seemingly trying to drag him out from the depths of the fog.
However, at that moment, a terrifying suppression exploded from within.
The human container bearing the power of the Ancient God seemed to realize something, and just as it was about to retreat, it felt a terrifying burst of black lightning strike down from the sky, instantly evaporating it…
At the same time, the gods’ incarnate wills that had not ventured deep, all looked up.
Above the skies, silent black thunder had appeared at some unknown time.
Dense black lightning twisted and circled above, covering almost every visible range!
And from where the black lightning was emitted was right above Colin’s head, an enigmatic and eerie formation portal.
Inside, it seemed as if some terrifying existence was about to arrive!
Some existences took the opportunity to launch attacks, only to evaporate under the silently falling black lightning, which was as enormous as mountains!
“I’ve been watching you shake down others, now it’s my turn…”
Colin, almost like flowing flames, calmly faced the gods and then shouted,
“‘1-24’ ‘Formless Mother’! I’ve released you within ‘Passionate Paradise’! Please fulfill your promise, stand with us, and assist me in breaking out!”
As soon as he spoke, various terrifying existences once again launched attacks directly at Colin, but in a blink of an eye, countless, seemingly sky-tearing black lightning fell from the dome, blocking this wave of assaults.
Meanwhile, from the formation portal, sticky black viscous fluid like oil flowed out…
Above the tentacles, black lightning surged incessantly, continuously erupting.
The terrifying aura spread in an instant to hundreds and thousands of kilometers away, and was still spreading at an extremely fast rate, bombarding nearly all god-like incarnate silhouettes with saturating black thunder!
“This is… the true might of a First Level Containment Subject!”
Colin watched the massive columns of black lightning, shocked to his core.
Having always dealt with the useless ‘King of Mad Sounds,’ he now understood how strong a First Level Containment Subject really was!
‘No, it’s not quite comparable,’ ‘Formless Mother’ is a mid-tier First Level Containment Subject, a tier above the ‘King of Mad Sounds.’ Of course, it’s natural to be stronger…’
In the flash of thought, Colin tried to stabilize his condition.
This existence appeared just in itself and was also on his side; he had to defend with all his might!
But, at that moment…
Inside Colin’s mind, he received an inspiration, a conscious insight given by the “Formless Mother.”
Immediately preparing himself, at the same time, countless streams of pitch-black lightning surged toward a certain direction, tearing a gap in the surrounding blockade.
“Spatial Displacement!”
With a Spiritual Infusion Gold Card, Colin’s figure instantly moved out of the blockade area.
But just as he came out…
He saw many existences attacking like maggots on bones.
Yet before they could hit him directly, they were sealed back by the pitch-black viscous “Formless Mother” through the black lightning.
Although the “Formless Mother” had suffered tremendously in ‘Passionate Paradise’ and was not in its prime…
Other advanced containment subjects were not much better off.
Most importantly, they were mostly not entirely severed or genuinely cooperating, so facing the full output of the “Formless Mother” in its original form, they were also somewhat overwhelmed…
But because of their large number.
Even though Colin saw many high-level existences stopped by the black lightning prison constructed by the “Formless Mother.”
There were still many strong lifeforms attacking…
And there was one more thing, this ‘Transposition,’ although indeed escaping the encirclement, did not reach the location he desired!
Halfway through, it seemed the endpoint was twisted by some force, leading to a dangerous area.
“Boom!”
Without any hesitation, sensing the various attacks spreading nearby, Colin immediately pulled out a Purple Item, instantly detonating it!
A bizarre glow instantly spread, forcing everything back.
Taking advantage of this moment, Colin quickly surveyed the outside situation.
“The ocean is completely blockaded, even seems to be a key target, priority not even lower than killing me, which doesn’t make sense. It seems, in marine aspects, there indeed might be ‘Lady Bunny’ or some other critical fallback…”
“Now, better to stick with the original plan, in two steps.”
“Just drag it out, wait for them to be driven back by the power of the Red Moon, and then think about what comes next after I survive.”
Colin no longer held any flukes about directly entering the ocean.
While deciding his strategy in a short moment, he observed the approaching humanoid incarnation containers, along with some terrifying lifeforms’ silhouettes and various strange attackers, also keeping busy with his actions.
“Are you all so afraid of my growth, afraid of the return of the ‘Bonfire’ era? How pitiful.”
“Sadly, your attempts are destined to fail.”
Speaking at this point was no longer appropriate, Colin mocked directly through “inspiration”—of course, not because he was idle, but somewhat couldn’t help it after detonating the “False Mighty One.”
This thing made it hard to suppress some weird talk, even at C-level.

chapters.title: Chapter 839 - 839 570 Release 1-24 Formless Mother_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 839: Chapter 570: Release “1-24 ‘Formless Mother'”!!!_3 Chapter 839: Chapter 570: Release “1-24 ‘Formless Mother'”!!!_3 Fortunately, aside from the strange speech, its negative effects were almost nonexistent at present.
At the same time, flames burned fiercely on Colin’s body, followed by “Repulsion” that he directly smashed out.
He had discovered that these Heretic Races were not so fearful of methods like “Space: Transposition.”
It was only in the face of the Flame Bearer’s fire, especially the flames created by the direct burning of “Flame Bearer’s Grease,” that they behaved as if they were encountering the “Red Moon’s” red light, avoiding contact if possible.
Unfortunately, Colin’s strength was insufficient, and he wasn’t able to ignite the sufficiently pure “Primordial Fire.”
Otherwise, the battle would not have been this difficult.
After igniting a large amount of flames and breaking through once again, Colin quickly found that nearly every possible foothold was awaited by these higher beings, ready to launch an attack…
‘Earth, it’s still too small,’ Colin couldn’t help thinking; even high-level Containment Subjects, when restricted, could sense him almost anywhere in the world.
There were simply no places to hide…
And each encounter would erupt into a battle of earth-shattering proportions.
Majestic mountains stretching for miles collapsed, and the flat land was ripped open with bottomless pits.
Even if he used “Transposition” to enter some smaller worlds he had previously visited, Colin would quickly be detected and a multitude of higher beings would flood in.
If he was lucky and left early, those small worlds might be preserved.
If he was just a bit slower, these independent small worlds would likely shatter alongside everything else…
It was as if an undying pursuit were on him, with hardly a moment of respite.
Finally, after enduring for another period, Colin was once again surrounded.
At that moment, his body seemed like flowing flames, and most conventional injuries could quickly heal, but even in such a state, many parts of his body were seriously wounded.
Blood flowed from wounds that could not heal; characters that couldn’t be wiped away clung to his skin like labels; dizzying piano sounds echoed in his mind, whispers in a peculiar tone…
The intense variety of attacks had made it difficult for him to move a step, and several times he nearly fell from great heights.
However, fortunately, the aspect Colin was most worried about—the negative effects of the items—hadn’t erupted due to the accumulation of injuries.
This meant that the preparations made beforehand were sufficient.
Otherwise, at this point, any small thing could have been fatal.
Enduring the numerous serious injuries all over his body, Colin pulled out the Bone Spur, and as his thoughts turned, a terrifying and sinister anomaly burst forth from the tip of the Bone Spur with explosive speed.
This anomaly, that had been contained at the price of a Saint’s death, rapidly condensed into dark red clouds above Colin’s head upon its emergence.
Within it fell crimson Rainwater, filled with an unclean aura.
Everything that the Rainwater touched, no matter what it was, would feel unimaginable, horrific pain, as if the very genes of the order were being destroyed and disintegrated, and would rapidly be contaminated, corrupted, falling into madness and a heretical downfall!
‘The effect is a bit horrifying, but it’s a pity it’s not really a high-level Containment Subject; it can’t hold for long.’
Colin saw that some figures were already braving the crimson rain curtain and assaulting!
The entity within Bone Spur indeed halted the enemy’s advance.
But it didn’t stop many.
“Still have to see if I can reach someone…”
Colin, while dealing with the enemy, sent signals to the beings he recognized as possibly able to help him, notifying them in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - 840 571 King of Savage Sound
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 840: Chapter 571 ‘King of Savage Sound’! Chapter 840: Chapter 571 ‘King of Savage Sound’! “Boom!”
A small world suddenly shattered, its woods withering and falling as if plagued.
A “Coconut Egg Tree,” clustered with thousands of heads at the top, suddenly exploded.
Countless heads burst apart…
Seizing the moment of their demise, Colin had already escaped and moved towards a new hiding direction.
Until now, the signal he emitted, maybe due to being too distant or some other reason, was confirmed sent by Colin, but no feedback had yet been received.
Whether it was the “Thorn Lady” as a C+ Level Employee, the “King of Madness,” or others in the “World Code-4-Deep Sea World,” it was the same…
However, he didn’t rely too much on others, quickly sketching out a corner of the area he wanted to reach in his mind.
He planned to exchange places with the air in that region using a spatial card.
Thereby leaping, earning either a few more minutes or even just ten more minutes of respite.
But just then, Colin suddenly stopped.
A sharp pain attacked his heel, as if something had bitten him, and from the bitten area, a cold, stiff feeling rapidly spread.
Then Colin noticed, at a distance, a short creature, neither human nor canine, with a mouth full of sharp teeth, biting onto a barely visible footprint he had stepped on earlier…
Speaking of footprints, it was actually a small pit burned out by flames when he landed.
Nevertheless, the creatures still launched a deadly attack based on this!
“These creatures’ methods of attacking are truly diverse!”
Normally, Colin was extremely cautious, not daring to let his shadow or any bodily fragments scatter, fearing the enemy would use this as some anchor for an attack.
Unexpectedly, he was still caught off guard!
It was then—the humanoid canine creature, having restricted Colin’s leap, revealed a disturbing, exaggerated, human-like but more deliberately eerie smile on its face.
It thought it had succeeded and instantly split into hundreds of similar shapes rushing towards him.
Other heretical and terrifying existences didn’t just watch; they seized the opportunity to launch a saturating, overwhelming strike…
However, just as numerous shapes thought they had blasted the area into chaos, believing they had finally succeeded, subconsciously revealing a victorious smile similar to “humans,” they heard four shockingly tormenting words burst from Colin’s throat:
“—Feast!—Grand!—Devour!—Banquet!”The atmosphere froze in that instant!
And at the center of the encirclement, Colin, whose skin was worn away leaving only muscles exposed in a hideous state, managed a grotesque smile with his featureless face as his cheek muscles tensed…
At that moment, his hands plunged into his navel, enduring severe pain, he slowly drew them apart.
This action seemed like a ritualistic movement, not even the Gods could interrupt!
However, instead of wriggling intestines, what emerged behind the torn navel was a fathomless, toothless vertical mouth!
A dark green, dense mist surged out…
At the same time, a dark green ancient Buddha figure appeared somewhat visibly behind Colin, its eighteen arms wavering softly like seaweed…
Its shape wasn’t particularly large, just a dozen meters, but when it appeared,
its terrifying might surged overwhelmingly.
For a moment, all pursuers stopped in their tracks, retreating in shock, not daring to advance!
The guttural chanting of the ancient Buddha spread around, and everything seemed to inherently feel a strong sense of “Hunger” rising from within.
The nature of the chase changed at that moment.
Colin no longer felt so powerless.
“This is… the contamination and assimilation of a concept…”
As the thought flashed through his mind, Colin pulled out several “Purple Gear” and directly overloaded them to explode before swallowing them.
The intense “Hunger” felt slightly soothed…
Even some weaker “injuries” and “negative effects” were overpoweringly devoured, turned into nutrients in his stomach!
It was then, as Colin’s thoughts shifted, the eighteen arms of the Ancient Buddha behind him reached for a special Ancient God projection of a canine.
Ignoring space, ignoring distance, several arms seized it everywhere!
“Like biting me, huh!” Colin roared, and with a “rip,” the Ancient God projection was brutally torn into multiple pieces amidst its screams!
Following that, Colin’s huge mouth opened wide to turn all the fragments into nutrients, temporarily gaining its special traits, and so on…
But just then, the startled Gods seemed to finally react.
Colin felt phantom pain in some arms, the nutrients not yet absorbed were abruptly interrupted.
He only managed to eat a little bit…
“‘Ancient God’… tasty… delicious, eat… eat!”
Colin couldn’t help but lick his lips, a hint of desire to eat appeared in his eyes burning with flames.
However, he quickly shook his head vigorously, suppressing that whim of desire, and leaping toward another location to break through.
Seeing him trying to escape, a crowd of figures hesitated for a moment, but ultimately chose to follow.
Only now, unlike before, they no longer dared to attack recklessly because any careless attack might just satisfy the “Hunger” and make them smack right back to where they came from!

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - 841 571 King of Madness_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 841: Chapter 571 “King of Madness”!_2 Chapter 841: Chapter 571 “King of Madness”!_2 “Snap!”
As a blocking projection in front of him was shattered into pieces by Colin’s swift slap,
the newly formed encirclement was violently torn apart!
The other ancient beings didn’t give up their pursuit, still chasing with all their might. In a brief moment, they realized something—today’s “Hunger” was minimal.
As long as they avoided being consumed in a certain amount, there was not much to worry about.
But of course, there was one most important point.
Although they couldn’t handle this small portion of “Hunger,” they had the chance to deal with the person using the “Hunger.”
Once he died, the “Hunger” would be retracted…
And then, their era would arrive!
The chased Colin also quickly realized this point. Their attacks started to lean more towards harassment, never daring to get too close, eliminating any possibility for the “Hunger” to consume them…
At that moment, Colin finally grabbed a God Descend Vessel, but unfortunately, he didn’t manage to consume it.
The residing will withdrew swiftly…
“Haha, what if you caught me? You’re almost unable to hold on, killing me is meaningless. Success may not lie in me, but it must involve me—” sneered the container of the Heretic Races, being a lackey.
But before he could finish, Colin clenched his fist and crushed it into pulp with a squelch.
Such trash, he didn’t even bother digesting.
Then, within his murky gaze, Colin targeted another silhouette of the gods.
Rather than constantly fleeing, if he had a chance to consume one…
The situation might just take a turn.
But sadly, these fellows were all quite sly, never giving him much of an opportunity.
…
Meanwhile, in the deep chambers of the Underground Great Labyrinth, “World Code-13,”
a human silhouette composed of frequency bands had its ear against the wall, seemingly listening to the external world. Unfortunately, this time the listening yielded no content…
“Why does it feel like no one has come over?”
“King of Madness” murmured to himself, pressing his ear against the wall, who typically sensed some vibrations, but this time, there was none.
It was normal for the “Flame Bearer” Reserves to occasionally not show up, as it had happened a few times before.
What was abnormal was, it seemed that not a single employee had come this time…
Coupling this with the words of that high-ranking reserve from before, he had been restless these past few days.
As a high-rank “Level 0” Containment Subject with intense spiritual intuition by nature, it constantly fed him a very bad premonition.
He felt something bad was about to happen…
No, something bad was already happening!
And being completely in the dark about this matter only added to his unease!
However, just as his panic and unrest reached their peak,
a message that seemed to have traveled from afar emerged…
The message appeared directly in front of his main body within the “Containment Divine Kingdom!”
[You have received an invitation notification. Accepting this notification will involve certain risks. Do you accept?]
It was a notification, waiting for his confirmation!
“King of Madness” was momentarily stunned, then let out an earth-shattering laugh:
“HAHAHAHA! The opportunity to achieve merits has come!!!”
He could clearly sense that the initiator of this visit was that “Flame Bearer” Reserves!
Without any resistance, he immediately ignored the risks and accepted the invitation!
This was the opportunity he had been grovelling for a long time, and to hesitate even a second felt like an insult to his past sufferings!
In this era, to not fight was to die, and one would suffer immensely before death; so why not fight with all might?!
If he won, he would then have a formal position!
It was right after agreeing that a specific message popped up:
[Feedback received. The charge for this message transfer: 100,000 Bonfire Points.]
[Note: Given you currently cannot pay this amount, the fee will be recorded on your personal account. Please return the points within the deadline. Failure to do so will result in penalties and affect promotion, political review, etc…]
“Ah?”
“King of Madness”‘s smile stiffened on his face, frozen for a few seconds.
But before he could respond effectively…
Some protocol seemed to activate.
The ancient and distant tolling of a bell resounded one after another in this place.
He couldn’t care less about why he suddenly owed one hundred thousand Points, but was fully focused on the Descent Protocol, offering a certain degree of cooperation—
At last, he could get out!
No, it seemed he couldn’t get out…
But it was close, although his main body was still in the “Containment Facility,” they had begun to summon his power, which meant the organization was truly taking notice!
As long as he performed well and made notable contributions, why worry about not getting out?
The future prospects looked great!
Soon, following the Descent Protocol, he sensed a significant part of his authoritative power manifesting in an unfamiliar world.
The moment he arrived, he felt an extremely terrifying oppression.
The composition of the oppression was complex, including an indescribable suppressive feeling from the world itself, like a rural farmer suddenly entering a magnificent palace, and then…
“What the fuck?! What’s going on!!!”
“King of Savage Sound” was shocked and felt bewildered upon sensing his surroundings—had he just stabbed into the lair of a high-level Containment Subject?!
This was way beyond the few Ancient Gods he had mentally prepared for…
Merely by sensing, there were over a dozen, not to mention many more observing from afar!
Some of them even possessed mid to high strength!
If it weren’t for the fact that most of them were in a restricted status, “King of Savage Sound” felt like he could surrender right then.
Even in the “Containment Divine Kingdom”, no, even five hundred “World Codes” combined, there weren’t as many as here!
Even more horrifying was what he saw in the sky…
“What is that? Red… Red…!?”
He was getting quite unsettled.
Numerous advanced Containment Subjects, along with fragments of “Level 0” Containment Subjects…
What divine land was this?!
It couldn’t possibly be the giant’s Land of Death, could it?
Otherwise, why would it attract the gaze of so many terrifying beings?
But, he didn’t have time to ponder the details, as right after descending, various attacks empowered by his authority came from every direction.
“King of Savage Sound” reacted hastily. Compared to these beings, his only advantage was that he belonged to the “regular forces” and was not subjected to the suppression between heaven and earth.
However, as soon as he arrived, he was thoroughly thrashed. “King of Savage Sound” was furious and assumed his identity at the moment:
“Dare to revolt against the company, have you considered the consequences?! Wait till the High Order ‘Preservers of Flame’ arrive, none of you will escape!”
However, unfortunately, facing his words, these beings didn’t stop their actions.
They even mocked him with incomprehensible sneers.
And once again launched an attack, no, more precisely…
They launched an attack at something behind him!
What was behind him?!
“King of Savage Sound” turned to sense behind him and was so shocked he almost exploded on the spot!
“What the fuck! ‘Hunger’!”
“King of Savage Sound” was shocked. He didn’t expect a massive terror was hidden not far behind him!
The presence of the other was extremely low at first, making it undetected upon his arrival.
But soon, he realized something was wrong…
“No… it’s you!”
Seeing the figure under “Hunger,” “King of Savage Sound” immediately guessed it was his “leader.”
However, seeing the other’s pitiful state, he felt the situation seemed a bit dire…
The other looked almost inhuman, as if they had undergone countless tortures, floating in the sky like a tattered cloth, their horrifying injuries even extending deep into the soul!
“Seems I’ve come a bit late?”
“No, you’ve come just in time…”
The “leader’s” voice was inexplicably calm, yet it made “King of Savage Sound” shiver. The next second, he continued to hear the other say:
“I need you to lend me a helping hand!”
“Huh?!”
“King of Savage Sound” immediately had a very bad feeling upon hearing this!
And frustratingly, this bad feeling was immediately confirmed in the next second…
.
.
There’s more to come!

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - 842 572 Humanitys First Counterattack
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 842: Chapter 572: Humanity’s First Counterattack! Chapter 842: Chapter 572: Humanity’s First Counterattack! “The King of Madness” saw the terrifying phantom that swayed its eighteen arms suddenly reached out toward him. Palm after palm, each bearing a toothless gaping mouth, locked onto him…
At the same time, numerous figures attacked; many of the entities that had been observing now took action!
“Tearing apart ‘Authority’ might lead to your death too! Leave now, and I will allow you to receive ample rewards after this!”
“Little one, if you choose not to participate, I will grant you a share of the same substance of Authority!”
“Being devoured by ‘Hunger’ will lead to total downfall; it’s a trap!”
“Do you really want to betray your own ‘Divinity’?”
“‘Primordial Fire’ has already withdrawn from the world, and ‘Hunger’ has long become a thing of the past…”
“…”
Urgent whispers came one after another, desperately trying to stop the actions of “The King of Madness.”
Although the nature of that “Hunger” isn’t much, letting it eat a portion of a First Level Containment Subject would change everything!
That guy absolutely must not succeed!
“Bonfire Company” is as specially attacked by “Hunger” as “Hunger” is specially attacked by Them!
At this moment, with the assistance of “The Gods,” “The King of Madness” needed only a thought to swiftly avoid those god-frightening palms and escape the fate of having his Authority torn apart—
Such an event had a certain probability of leading him to death!Of course, refusal meant that the support event would be an utter failure, and he would return to that cage, sealed for eternity…
In the end, he gritted his teeth and advanced toward the dark green hand willingly:
“This is a test!”
Colin had invested too much in him; he couldn’t afford to give up now!
“Excellent!!!”
A face as compassionate as a Buddha statue appeared on Colin, as he stuffed “The King of Madness” into his stomach.
In that instant, “The King of Madness” nearly fainted…
The tearing apart of Authority was many times more painful than he imagined!
Even expecting it, he couldn’t help but wail in agony, his furious voice nearly spreading across the entire world…
Pain, so much pain, unbearable pain!!!
On Earth, almost all life heard the soul-deep, bone-chilling screams emitted by this being!
“The King of Madness,” including the consciousness of “World Code-13,” felt as if it had died when that part of “Authority” was torn and devoured. It completely wilted, shaking and curling up into a ball in pain.
“So good, so delicious… It’s been so long since I’ve tasted something this appetizing… Hehe…”
Colin couldn’t help but let out a crazed whisper, his face breaking into a twisted smile.
A massive array of attacks that were originally aimed at “The King of Madness” now turned toward “Hunger,” as if hoping to “rescue” him before he was fully digested.
However…
“It’s too late.”
Behind Colin, the previously translucent and barely noticeable “Hunger” solidified at this moment.
Its dark green skin shone with the texture of jade…
After a pause, facing the overwhelming attacks, Colin raised a fist:
“Watch closely, ‘King of Madness,’ this is how your power should be used!”
A Secret Force spread out, and everything in the space seemed to freeze in that moment.
Those attacks all stopped not far in front of his fist…
It was as if time had stopped.
Yet, the standoff didn’t last long.
“crack—crack crack—”
Colin clenched his fist and pushed forward, and suddenly the grating “crack crack” sound of shattering ice resounded through the air.
Invisible fissures spread out from his fist.
And with a “crack” sound!
The entire area exploded like a shattered mirror!
Countless forces shattered under the power contained in this punch, which bore the might of the “King of Madness” Authority.
At this moment, even “The Gods” had to withdraw to avoid the edge!
They might not fear the power of “The King of Madness,” but they dared not be injured. Once hurt, giving “Hunger” a piece of flesh to tear and swallow would lead to the worst of situations!
Seeing them retreat, Colin’s abdomen opened wide, and he spat a breath of dark green acid toward the ocean conceptually sealed…
At the same time, his fist raised again, charging up.
“Come, come, come! Feel the power of the remnants of the old era! Feel the power of ‘Hunger’!”
The terrifying vibration cascaded toward its target…
If they could breach the sealed ocean while the tide of attack and defense changed, it might make things a bit easier.
Unfortunately, there were several extremely powerful entities sealing the maritime area this time.
Even with the power of “The King of Madness,” it couldn’t breach it absolutely…
Unless they added “Formless Mother,” but likely she would not let him have a taste, and since summoning “Hunger,” Colin had realized he could no longer sense her presence or location.
He didn’t know if she was surrounded or had already left.
‘It’s been conceptually sealed, unreachable. I must wait for the power of “Red Moon” to strike; now the chances are slim.’
Colin watched for a while, finally choosing to retreat.
Seeing him show signs of retreat, a horde of terrifying creatures stuck to him again like a stubborn plaster.
Facing such persistent tactics, Colin had little means but to try constructing a temporary safe zone to protect himself, enduring this final period…
When the summoning time for “Hunger” was nearly up, Colin transferred all the nutrients to the “Stomach Wall.”

chapters.title: Chapter 843 - 843 572 Humanitys First Counterattack_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 843: Chapter 572: Humanity’s First Counterattack!_2 Chapter 843: Chapter 572: Humanity’s First Counterattack!_2 Then, he completely inverted himself along with an entire area.
“Phew…”
Colin stood on the ground, staggering a few steps, intending to find a place with support to sit down, but no sooner had he taken a step than he collapsed on the ground due to extreme exhaustion…
At the same time, the dark cyan figure of the ancient Buddha behind him also dissolved and vanished.
Colin’s abdomen, stretching upwards to his chest and downwards to his belly, was torn open, seeping a blackness that now hid, revealing writhing organs.
However, the organs were prevented from spilling out from the tear.
The Little Maid had started stitching them up layer by layer even sooner…
“Whether I’ll live or not is not for me to say anymore.”
Colin shook his head slightly, reached up to his head, and took off the “Ring of Enduring Pain” to take a look.
Cracks were beginning to appear on it…
He had exhausted all his methods, and the various negative effects were beginning to be uncontainable.
All he could do was to absorb the negative effects; if anything else were to attack, he would have no way to resist…
Everything was now left to fate.
Colin’s eyes lost focus as his body trembled periodically, slowly accepting the negative effects he had previously suppressed.
In the space covered by the dark cyan “Stomach Wall,” only the sizzling of the flames burning could be heard.
Or perhaps the vibrations caused by the impact on the “Stomach Wall”…
Time passed indeterminably, and Colin felt the oppressive sensation of being watched by countless gazes dissipate, but immediately after, another strong oppressive force spread downwards.
“Finally… ‘Red Moon’ pieces have further fallen.”
Colin murmured to himself, which also meant that he had survived the toughest period!
However, just as he thought this…
A slit suddenly appeared in the dark cyan “Stomach Wall.”
A crimson eyeball pressed against the slit, looking over at him.
Colin let out a breath that was both a chuckle and a sigh of regret, making no move, nor could he make any.
“It seems this is where it ends…”
The sinking of the “Red Moon” power also caused his “Stomach Wall” to “crumble,” allowing an attack to break through this barrier at this opportunity.
‘Only a Level ‘0’ can better deal with a Level ‘0’ Containment Subject, they are not stupid…’
As thoughts flickered, Colin sighed in his heart, but before the attacks of “The Gods” could reach him, he was stricken with “Time Perception Disorder.”
The flow of a moment seemed stretched infinitely long in this instant.
Colin’s pupils lost focus again…
But just when he thought he could never open his eyes again, he saw himself enveloped in pitch-black shadow, being transported away from this place by some means…
“Someone… saved me? Who is it?”
Colin moved his eyes thoughtfully, catching a glimpse of a figure standing firm against the fearsome beings, blocking all incoming attacks.
The figure was terribly familiar…
But his mind was in turmoil; he dared not confirm, nor could he bring to mind who it might be…
His pale, cracked lips quivered, intending to offer thanks or to inquire, but he was rocked by a surge, falling back into a daze.
When he came to his senses again, Colin found himself within a ruined building.
The world in front of him was shrouded in an indefinable crimson terror.
Above the dome, fragments descending from the shattered Moon were clearly visible…
The presence of “The Gods” had almost completely disappeared.
Evidently, as the terror-laden fragments of the “Red Moon” descended, if they did not want to be contaminated, they would have to retreat at this very moment.
The higher their station, the more terrible the contamination!
Because they could glimpse the essence, which ordinary things could not.
And Colin, sheltered by the power of “Primordial Fire,” was also largely unaffected by the red radiance—at least at this height, the red light was still “harmless” to him.
At this moment, compared to the myriad of fragments in the sky, Colin was more puzzled about who that figure was.
Why had they come to save him?
Alas, his brain, as the main recipient of the negative effects, was a disaster zone, and foreseeably, his time in a daze would become even more frequent and prolonged…
Each moment of lucidity was very brief.
With the regret of not realizing who the person was, Colin closed his eyes once more, losing consciousness.
Nausea, severe pain, an inescapable nightmare.
A series of negative effects caused Colin to twitch and dry heave from time to time, even when he was deep in stupor.
He even harbored thoughts of ending it all, thinking it might be easier to just deal with himself.
Sometimes, in the same spot, he would alternate between wailing and uncontrollable laughter, speaking madness—this also suddenly reminded him of Big C Teacher from before. He never understood why, for a period of time, the teacher would fight him while crying.
Because this was one of the side effects of “Bonfire”: a loss of emotional control…
However, this emotional instability was minor compared to other negative effects of artifacts.
Meanwhile, the Little Maid Jing stayed by his side, doing her best to tend to his physical injuries, trying to alleviate his suffering.
As she worked, she would occasionally look up to the sky, where rounds of halos turned in her silver humanoid pupils, suggesting certain concerns.
According to her calculations, the impact of these falling fragments would have extremely adverse effects on Colin. She could even sense that, drawn by some inexplicable force, some of them seemed intent on falling their way…
This was a very bad omen!
Just at that moment…
The Little Maid received a request from the official forces of Research Institute No.1.
The content was simple: they asked her to take full control of the existing nuclear missiles to intervene with the celestial debris breaching the atmosphere, ensuring they would be shattered even further…
“Mr. Colin, I have received a request from the various shelters. I believe the intervention is necessary…”
The Little Maid whispered in Colin’s ear, respectfully.
Unfortunately, Colin, deep in the negative spiral, was unable to respond.
He couldn’t even perceive her words…
The Little Maid repeated the sentence expressionlessly, patiently waiting for authorization.
Without it, she could only stay and carry on with limited tasks.
And as her calls went unanswered one after another,
she showed rare signs of urgency.
Time was running out…
Just when the fragments were about to cross a certain threshold beyond rescue even with intervention,
a sudden message appeared out of nowhere.
[At this moment, Colin abruptly woke up for a while…]
“Was it a ‘Fate Propeller’?”
Colin opened his eyes and saw he had been placed on a mattress that the Little Maid had somehow procured.
He recognized immediately that the message, appearing before him like a Narrator, most likely came from a “Fate Propeller.”
But, Colin was well aware that if it wasn’t a Ninth Level “Fate Propeller” to act, just the effect of this sentence would have probably required the sacrifice of an Eighth Level official powerhouse.
But now, there were more pressing matters.
“Go on, go ahead.”
Colin opened his mouth and with great effort uttered permission to the Little Maid.
No sooner had he spoken than he blinked…
He felt that not much time had passed, but he found himself already transferred to an underground room, completely sealed.
Yet through a strong psychic premonition, he could clearly “see” that the “Red Moon” shards had descended further…
This meant that this “blink of an eye” must have lasted a long time.
And just then…
Loud rumbling sounds that deafened the ear came from all around, the whole air vibrating.
Colin squinted his eyes, and using a small portion of the authority of the “King of Savage Sound,” a picture formed in his mind…
Above the land, humanity’s strongest physical means on Earth, an array of missiles equipped with various types of nuclear warheads, spewing Mach rings of fire, ascended under the complete control of the Little Maid, charging towards the falling Red Moon fragments…
This was humanity’s only move since the disaster unfolded.
Its purpose was very simple: to break apart those chunks of flesh as much as possible, to mitigate the calamity!
“With the power of the ‘Book of Fate’ above, has a Ninth Level Personnel been born? Who could it be…”
Colin pondered intermittently.
Merely the nuclear bombs themselves would hardly impact the “Red Moon” fragments; something extra was needed.
But before he could think of an answer, a terrifying explosive sound came from the heavens.
The nuclear counterstrike had begun!

chapters.title: Chapter 844 - 844 573 An Unexpected Visitor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 844: Chapter 573: An Unexpected Visitor! Chapter 844: Chapter 573: An Unexpected Visitor! …
Rumbling echoes of explosions traveled from afar…
On a shattered piece of Earth, some officials who barely survived a brutal battle were supporting one another as they crawled out from the blood and stench of corpses, sitting down on a piece of wasteland that was relatively flat.
A seasoned member of The Great Wall sat down and watched missiles rising into the sky and the Red Moon descending, but his thoughts were not on them at all; instead, he was wholly recollecting the battle and couldn’t help but say with a sense of awe:
“Man, the feeling of using Extraordinary Power to its full extent is seriously thrilling!”
Since becoming one of the Extraordinary Ones and acquiring supernatural abilities, he hadn’t been able to go all out because of the severe side effects every time he used his power.
He had never fully unleashed it until today, until now, truly exploding with all his combat strength—
It’s just a shame that you get to burst forth your “Microcosm” like that only once in a lifetime…
After saying this, he waited for a compliment or two from his comrades, but none came.
His breath hitched, and he turned his head to see that, at some point, his teammate had slumped down against the wall, lifeless with half-open eyes frozen over with clotted blood.
“Weren’t you still moving just now? How come you can’t now? Old Li, I’m closing your eyes for you. It’s not too much to ask for one of your cigarettes, right?”
Former elite member of The Great Wall, Rogue, pursed his lips, closed his colleague’s eyes, then fumbled through his pocket and pulled out a tin box of cigarettes, casually taking several out and sticking one between his lips.
“Xiao Cao, any chance you can light this up for me…”
He then looked over at another body that was going cold and couldn’t help but grumble, “Seriously, you were just moving a minute ago. How come none of you can move now? We’ve just completed our mission, were lucky enough not to die on the spot…
“Don’t you want to chat with me a bit and relive the battle? Leaving so soon, in a hurry to reincarnate or something…
“Yeah, guess that’s not too bad. You guys die early and maybe queue up for me, I’ll have a smoke first, then I’ll be right over.”
With a “click,”
While mumbling to himself, he fished out his lighter and lit all the cigarettes, shakily placing one in each of the mouths of his comrades.
Then, he leaned against the wall with effort and sat down, taking a deep drag.
He continued to stare blankly at the “countdown” in the sky, reminiscing about the recent battle—
Being able to use Extraordinary Power freely without worrying about any negative effects, that kind of battle…
Was really just too thrilling!
“Finally got a taste of what those show-offs at ‘Bonfire Company’ feel like…”
As an elite member of The Great Wall, he might appear very young, and truth be told, he was young, but needless to say, his skill level was naturally top-notch. To be blunt, in the realm of the Extraordinary, he was one of the talents at the very top, seamlessly merged with his own power, earning titles like “Super Rookie” and “Supernova,” the spotlight of tens of thousands—
At least before those show-offs showed up.
But ever since they appeared, he was shocked to discover that his own life-threatening threshold of Extraordinary Power was less than their effortless baseline…
After he would use his power explosively once, the negative effects would torment him to death; those little bastards would sleep it off like nothing.
It was like being hit by a dimensionality reduction attack.
To give another analogy, it was like a person who was very skilled with a sword suddenly meeting someone with a gun.
Decades of hard practice couldn’t match the power of a bullet fired by someone pulling a trigger.
The gap couldn’t be bridged by talent or the lack thereof.
“Sigh, I just progressed too rapidly in the beginning…”
He sighed and shook his head; the lower limit for using that kind of drug was Level 6 and below, and because of his outstanding talent, he advanced rapidly, exceeding this level in just a few years—
And then, within a month, the people from “Bonfire Company” appeared.
He nearly had a mental breakdown during that period.
However, looking at it now, nothing really mattered…
“Huh…”
Another puff of smoke filled his lungs.
Rogue squinted his eyes, more regretful that he hadn’t had the chance to properly fall in love before it seemed his life was about to end…
But he didn’t dwell on it for too long.
At this moment, with a “boom,”
Another nuclear explosion could be heard in the distance, the deafening sound piercing through the air, and even from a great distance away, it could still be clearly heard.
“Cough, cough… Can’t even enjoy a smoke in peace!”
He coughed twice, about to take another drag when he suddenly noticed, the missile overhead that had flown for a long stretch seemed to finally make contact with its target.
He raised his right hand, flipping the middle finger towards the falling objects in the sky:
“Bastards! Humanity will prevail!”
As soon as the words left his mouth, a blinding flash of light erupted from above, and a devastating shockwave fixed all of his perceptions in that moment.
…
As fragments of the “Red Moon” fell across the world, many seals were breaking down, and a multitude of abnormal life forms cast their gazes outward, only to retract upon seeing the fearsome crimson light.
Nevertheless, with the collapse of numerous seals, many “Inner Worlds” and other special spatial dimensions on Earth began to rapidly merge with reality.
Some of these spaces were even more vast than Earth itself!
The world was expanding at an unimaginable pace, layer upon layer, like a swelling abscess.
Perhaps from an astronomical standpoint, Earth hadn’t changed and remained the size of an ordinary planet.
But once someone entered, they would discover that beneath the layers of interwoven spaces, the world had expanded by tens of times and was still rapidly growing!

chapters.title: Chapter 845 - 845 573 An Unexpected Visitor_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 845: Chapter 573: An Unexpected Visitor!_2 Chapter 845: Chapter 573: An Unexpected Visitor!_2 And a part of those who had previously escaped Earth watched the fragments of the Red Moon gradually fall from above their heads, watching this familiar world of disaster, they couldn’t help but reveal faces of utter despair—
They had thought they escaped the sea of suffering, but had not expected to end up so utterly alone.
…
“Boom!”
After a long flight, another missile, carrying a nuclear warhead, made contact with its closest target on the ground.
A fiery ball erupted in the crimson world…
The blinding flash of light briefly obscured the scarlet in this area.
The chunks of flesh that were hit let out a faint mental wail, then disintegrated into numerous fragments.
“These fragments… simple high temperatures can’t burn them away…”
Witnessing this scene, Colin couldn’t help but think.
Superweapons capable of causing destructive blows to many things on the surface could only shatter that thing, not manage to vaporize it…
However, Colin was not surprised by this.
After all, if a strike from a group of high-ranking beings had hit an ordinary, unprotected celestial body, it could have shattered the planet.
But when it hit that satellite, it only managed to shatter it as well.
Nowadays, weapons created by human intelligence alone, combined with some extraordinary power, being able to achieve this was already quite remarkable.
Without giving it much thought, after a brief period, the shockwave from the high-altitude explosion was thrown onto the ground, causing the entire city, like a ruin, to roll and vibrate again as if a stone had been thrown into a calm lake…
Colin’s gaze became vacant for a moment, and he once again fell into some kind of unconsciousness.
With his physique, there was no need to worry about being crushed to death by a simple collapse.
Even if he were to be thrown into lava, he would emerge unscathed.
But, his dazed consciousness didn’t last long; Colin seemed to hear some faint screams, his unfocused pupils forcefully concentrating once more.
“Someone nearby…?”
He muttered to himself, previously during transportation, he would try to avoid areas with living people as much as possible.
But…
This time, someone else had brought him here.
Colin once again recalled that figure; unfortunately, he could only feel familiarity, but couldn’t remember who it was for the moment…
And in his memory, the ones who could face the Gods unflinchingly for his sake, and had the ability to do so, were most likely Shana at full power, or Old Master Wu, or perhaps the “Thorn Lady”?
But none seemed quite right.
The nature of that power didn’t resemble Shana’s, it fell short compared to the “Thorn Lady,” and as for Old Master Wu…
What abilities the Ninth Level of the “Fate Propeller” could have, Colin wasn’t familiar, but it didn’t quite seem to fit either, plus Old Master Wu seemed to have perished alongside the consciousness sealed in the “Red Moon”…
So it shouldn’t be him either.
Who could it be?
His mind felt forgetful, as though he was about to recall it, but couldn’t match it to anyone.
However, another scream came, causing Colin to blink and snap back to reality… Now was not the time to be concerned about it.
These ordinary people…
His body was strong enough not to fear the ruins and the stones weighing tons or even tens of tons…
But ordinary people were different.
“Anyway, I’ve already suffered so many injuries…”
Colin sighed, with a “might as well” attitude; using all his strength, he shakily lifted his hand and placed it on the “Ring of Enduring Pain” on his head, an invisible force spreading out, taking all the damage upon himself.
At the same time, some of the people in the earthquake surprisingly discovered that even though they had received fatal injuries.
Nothing happened!
And guided by some inexplicably strong intuition, they quickly started to take cover.
At this moment, as various crushing damages arrived, Colin once again fell unconscious.
Just as he fell into unconsciousness not long after, a group of seemingly normal people, but with stiff movements and eyes full of blood, seemed to have discovered something because of his recent action of protecting the mortals. They suddenly gathered together, entered the underground area, and made their way straight to his room.
An indescribable sense of crisis welled up inside him, but Colin had not awakened, and as a result, fell into a terrible nightmare, with flames on his body flickering weakly and then strongly.
Who knows how much time had passed, Colin suddenly awoke, vomiting a mouthful of blood the first thing.
Feeling the injuries on his body due to the “Ring of Enduring Pain,” he couldn’t help but think sardonically:
“My body is pretty tough, quite enduring, huh, no, something seemed to happen just now…”
He was halfway through pondering when he suddenly realized the “sense of crisis” he had felt while unconscious.
His eyes moved, and Colin saw the door to the small basement that the little maid had found for him had been torn open at some point, and a group of figures were standing there motionless, in the posture of entering.
These figures were covered in frost, looking for all the world like statues.
A delicate-faced, mature-bodied, yet child-hearted ice-blue specter suddenly appeared before him and blew a breath onto his face:
“Hoo~~~”
“Yukionna?!” Colin exclaimed in shock.
“Huh huh huh~” The ice-blue beauty puffed again, a bit grumpily, toward him.
She seemed a bit angry, and the reason for her irritation, judging from the “inspiration” she provided, was probably related to her being squeezed into her house (ring), and then being kicked far away…
Colin couldn’t help but smile wryly, what a time for this.
At that moment, however, he suddenly remembered something and asked with difficulty,
“Were you the one facing those things just now?”
He recalled the silhouette that had faced the gods.
“Mmhmm!” Yukionna nodded.
“Impossible.”
Colin immediately dismissed his own speculation, convinced that the mature-looking young lady before him couldn’t possibly have the strength; she must have thought he was referring to the heretic believers at the door.
Then, he couldn’t help but want to ask how “Yukionna” had come here.
But just as this thought occurred to him, Colin hadn’t spoken when he suddenly froze, looking at this innocent-faced creature, his gaze slightly solidified, and a nameless chill rose in his heart…
Yes… he had severed all connections at the time, how… did she find this place?!
“Gurgle…”
Colin swallowed, becoming acutely aware.
Although it was a reunion with an old friend, it might not be a good thing…
However, in response to his words, “Yukionna” simply replied that she found her way by searching…
‘Never mind how dangerous the journey might have been, or how you ignored the red danger lights, I’m not even sure where I am right now, and yet you managed to find me…’
Colin fell silent.
Rather than believe “Yukionna”s’ words, it would be more believable that a sow might climb a tree – after all, sometimes a sow really does climb a tree.
However, by her look, she seemed genuinely unknowing…
‘Just pray you don’t bring any big surprises…’
Colin sighed silently in his heart, having seen no sign of danger for the time being, and since he had no capacity to worry further, all he could do was hope it wasn’t bad news.
And then, as more nuclear bombs began to detonate, violent vibrations turned the world upside down.
“Be careful…”
After uttering the last word, Colin handed the “Mountain of Smiling Corpses” to Yukionna, and with a sense of strong unease, he slipped back into a nightmare, his face distorting under potent negative effects…
“Ah!”
Yukionna spread her hands, blasting out cold air with all her might, freezing and fortifying all the nearby buildings, and even created an ice wall dozens of meters thick that covered this small underground area.
However, as terrifying blasts of energy arrived, they shattered her ice wall to pieces…
All Yukionna could do was play the plasterer, trying to patch the cracks in the ice wall as best as she could.
Amidst earth-shaking and heaven-overturning turmoil, after an indeterminate time of struggling, the explosions slowly subsided, then after some time passed, the surface of this area began to be littered with small red chunks of flesh, falling like a curtain of rain.
These scraps of flesh began to combine with everything around, turning into terrifying creatures of extraordinary power, roaming the broken earth, or forming strange and eerie anomalies, wandering about…
After a long while, “Yukionna” felt that the “rain” outside seemed to have lessened, but there seemed to be a lot more wandering monsters…
Scary!
She dragged Colin into the depths of an icy cavity and, clutching the purple card, dared not move a muscle.
But before she could continue waiting, some figures suddenly arrived, seemingly closing in.
And they were purposefully destroying the ice wall she had just reinforced!
“Ah!”
“Yukionna” was somewhat frightened, subconsciously wanting to shake Colin out of his sleep, but seeing his pained expression.
Hesitating for a moment, she withdrew her hands.
In that instant, though full of fear, she still mustered the courage to try to confront these enemies…

chapters.title: Chapter 846 - 846 574 Guidance of Fate
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 846: Chapter 574 “Guidance of Fate. Chapter 846: Chapter 574 “Guidance of Fate. Facing those restless figures, “Yukionna” warned them first, just as Colin had taught.
When the warnings were ineffective, she had no choice but to attack, encasing all of them in ice.
Having followed Colin for so long, her mind was clear and straightforward, yet her fighting ability was actually quite strong.
Most of the time, she didn’t feel as though she was engaged in a life-or-death battle; it seemed more like playing…
But not now.
Especially since Colin had passed out, she was even more frightened!
However, having just dealt with those enemies, Yukionna saw some monsters radiating red light seeming to be attracted and approaching. She suddenly screamed, found a sack out of nowhere, stuffed Colin into it, slung him over her shoulder, and started to flee…
In the outside world at this moment, it was almost covered by a terrifying crimson light…
Everything illuminated by it was rapidly undergoing strange transformations.
Numerous terrifying creatures, upon sensing living beings, immediately attacked the fleeing duo!
Under waves of enemy attacks, she felt increasingly powerless,
But she never considered abandoning her friend to escape on her own; she was single-mindedly carrying him in her flight.
“Ah!”
While running, “Yukionna” let out a feeble sound, seemingly suggesting, can we not fight…
Unfortunately, this naive response didn’t receive any feedback.
The enemies pursuing them only grew in number!
Then, as she was desperately fleeing, Yukionna suddenly froze in shock upon seeing a large number of corrupted monsters suddenly die explosively, as if incinerated by some kind of glowing flame.
Without waiting to think further, a beam of light landed not far from her.
It seemed to be a door.
Graceful music slowly emanated from it.
“My master has heard your prayers and sent me. Desperate one, the gate of the Mundane Paradise has opened for you. Step through this doorway, become my master’s disciple, escape from suffering and despair, and embrace the immortal rebirth…”
A grand voice resounded in her ears.
It was as if a believer was delivering the supreme will of a higher power.
Yet, upon hearing this, “Yukionna” was not relieved but even more frightened. Dragging the sack containing Colin, she screamed and turned to run.
However, numerous strange pale beams of light blocked all her routes of escape.
