While doing so, he directly alerted the barely recovering Yukionna through inspiration:
“This thing isn’t dead yet, be careful…”
It was just as he finished speaking, countless pitch-black, worm-like shadows gathered in the spacious, grand hall, once again revealing the woman’s figure.
“I almost fell for your trap, but with this God-given Holy Relic, within my domain, I am undying! Hahaha!”
The woman looked at Colin and others and scoffed derisively, “You are strong, but unfortunately, can your body truly withstand the intensity now?”
‘That artifact, was it that cup from before?’
Colin noticed that although the long sword was still in her hand, the silver cup was nowhere to be seen.
Perceiving some invisible domain surrounding him and feeling its terrifying essence, Colin knew she wasn’t lying — that object truly was God-given, with a sufficiently high level of authority.
The domain it created, even a powerful punch from him might not be able to break through.
More force, using “Bonfire,” or the “Repulsion” or “Spatial Displacement” from the Golden Artifact would be required to dispel it…
But doing so could lead to even worse consequences.
“Bonfire” could expose him, and in his current condition, he simply couldn’t sustain another “divine battle.”
The negative effects from using the Golden Artifact previously hadn’t been sufficiently dissipated yet; using it again might well be the straw that breaks the camel’s back.
‘I need to find a way, see if I can discover a fatal weakness in her actions, then power up for a strike from within.’
‘Otherwise, if we truly clash, I’ll be at a disadvantage…’
‘And I must act quickly, lest the noise here attracts the attention of something else.’
Colin had some ideas.
However, more unnerving than being blockaded currently was…
Given the level of authority displayed by her artifact, from his knowledge, it probably wasn’t just blockading the area and letting a barely Level 2 Containment Subject enemy continuously “regenerate” that easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 859 - 859 579
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 859: 579 Chapter 859: 579 Although he sensed something was wrong, there was no time to think further. The woman, seemingly bolstered by “God-given” power, charged at him again.
Yukionna immediately defended, blocking all attacks for the slightly dazed Colin.
After several clashes, Colin seized the moment and mocked her a few more times, causing the woman in the grey cloak to become more deranged:
“It’s all his fault! He is the one who ruined the world, who disrupted the Master’s descent and thwarted a beautiful future. The disaster should never have happened…
“Why! Why! I just want to kill this sinner. Why does everyone stand in my way!”
Amid her frenzied screams, her attacks grew more extreme, even seemingly reckless.
She began to forego all defenses in her wide swings.
This allowed Yukionna another opportunity. She froze her solid and then summoned the “Mountain of Smiling Corpses” to swallow her up and crush her to pieces.
Yet, just as the woman in the grey cloak had previously mentioned, within this domain, she was an undying presence…
Her death didn’t weaken the blockade in this area.
Not long after, countless shadowy worms converged in a corner, soon reforming her figure nearby.
The “reborn” her seemed to have recovered somewhat.
A new round of battle ensued…
But it wasn’t long before the enemy went mad again and was promptly killed by Yukionna.
‘This creature’s death seems to be becoming somewhat deliberate…’
Colin narrowed his eyes and realized there was definitely a problem. He immediately communicated directly with Yukionna to delay the killing…
But it was still in vain.
After dragging out the time, the opponent would go mad on her own and die in a self-destructive attack.
Moreover, each time after “rebirth,” the rational period shortened and the madness arrived faster, and after each death, the domain’s aura grew stronger.
Observing this for a while, he vaguely understood the situation—
Each of the opponent’s “deaths” acted like a clear and forceful “echo.”
And the entity behind her could lock onto their specific location through these repeated “echoes”, just like a bat.
Moreover, the “domain” began to integrate with the existence behind the opponent…
Once the timing was right, that hidden existence could probably descend directly using the female heretic as a one-time God Descend Vessel to strike him.
“Ordinary means won’t work, I must take action myself, have Yukionna and the Mountain of Corpses blockade her…”
With this thought, Colin also began to act.
While the opponent, in her madness, was frozen again, he charged his right hand, combining “Vibration” waves with “Repulsion,” hoping to directly tear apart the space…
Then, through “Transposition” transfer— what remained was to pass out under the strong negative effects, letting Yukionna continue to run with him.
Whether or not he would wake up was left to fate.
However, just as Colin was about to move, he suddenly felt a surge of crisis in his heart…
Immediately after, the female heretic, frozen like an ice sculpture, violently shattered the frost and cold on her body, turned her head, and fixed her gaze on him.
In those eyes, there was no longer the original consciousness of the woman, but another horrifying and indifferent will.
The next instant, Colin’s face twisted as he felt his brain being jabbed by an iron rod!
…

chapters.title: Chapter 860 - 860 580 The Girl Who Walked Out of Script City
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 860: Chapter 580: The Girl Who Walked Out of Script City. Chapter 860: Chapter 580: The Girl Who Walked Out of Script City. “Damn it, this guy is definitely descending to some extent, but he’s playing possum!”
Colin realized this the instant he was attacked.
Unfortunately, it was too late. Accompanied by this distraction, his right hand, which contained multiple forces, hadn’t even thrown a punch before it exploded like a misfired gun, turning into too many chunks of flesh to count.
His entire body shook, and he fell backward once again.
It was at this time that a gaze from a higher place seemed to arrive, accompanied by a message.
“Forsake the bonfire’s error, become my disciple, and you shall be reborn.”
‘Please, can’t you come up with a new line…’
As these thoughts flickered through Colin’s mind, he glanced at his right arm, now reduced to a small piece of flesh, understanding that this explosion was mostly caused by the “King of Madness”‘s power…
He still wasn’t proficient in controlling its power.
As for the items, they usually retracted on their own when there was a problem, not causing much harm to himself.
However, if he had used the repulsion to push out the “vibration” in the emergency just now,
He could have saved his arm…
It was just that his status was so poor that he didn’t react in time.
Taking a deep breath, Colin withdrew his gaze and responded with a cold tone, “Being cautious to blockade this place, do you intend to devour me alone?”
“Following my path is the most suitable choice for you now…”
“Is that so.”
Colin remained unmoved, ready to break free from this predicament at a certain cost: “Unfortunately, I don’t think you’re qualified to be acknowledged by me.”
‘If I can escape quickly for a short time, the risk of dying isn’t very high, it’s just that I will suffer for a longer period afterward, yeah, the key is to ensure that my ‘soul consciousness’ doesn’t continue to take damage…’
As he quickly calculated the price he would have to pay, Colin finally had some understanding of the hardships faced by the “official Extraordinary Ones” of the past.
Every time he used any ability, the first step was to calculate if he could withstand it and what the cost would be.
Otherwise, if he was not careful, a great problem might arise…
Even direct death was a possibility.
However, just as Colin made up his mind and prepared to break through the blockade using an item before the opponent’s descent conditions were ripe,
An abrupt change occurred!
A pressure incredibly intense exploded suddenly from the outside in!
The next second, Colin saw that within the gray domain, large amounts of black lightning surged in. This lightning made no obvious sound but possessed a terrorizing force that made it seem as if space itself were being ripped open…
“Is this… ‘Formless Mother’s’ power?! Is it here? I thought it had already left?”
Colin was suddenly dumbfounded.
Since the first time he used the “Hunger” power, he hadn’t sensed the presence of the “Formless Mother.”
And without any surprises, Colin surmised that it must have left this land.
Since it had already accomplished its mission of blocking an attack for him, there was no reason for it to continue to intervene…
However, the present black lightning seemed to suggest that the situation might not be as simple as he had assumed?
Meanwhile, great amounts of black lightning, upon entering this sealed space, immediately swarmed in disorder like black serpents, gradually filling the entire domain…
Soon after, they seemed to discover something and turned direction rapidly, slamming towards the heretic woman in the gray cloak.
The woman, occupied by a higher consciousness, immediately began to retaliate…
She tore open her chest garment with both hands, revealing that her flesh had vanished from the front of her torso, leaving only bloody ribs engraved with strange patterns…
Beneath the ribs, like boards of a coffin, was the confinement of numerous gray, eerie, and terrifying life forms.
At this moment, her expression indifferent, she opened the “rib gate” on her chest as if she were pulling open a grand door.
In an instant, gray substances gushed out flood-like from behind her chest, blurring this place as if suddenly covered by a mosaic, rendering it indistinct.
Amidst the haziness, numerous bizarre creatures, like shrill banshee witches, let out piercing, soul-snatching screams as they collided with the black lightning.
Any stray black lightning that touched anything immediately evaporated it.
On the other side, as the two forces collided, Colin, well-prepared, retracted the “Mountain of Smiling Corpses” back into the storage room. Then he pulled Yukionna behind him, his hand pressing on the white phalanx on his chest…
The pale and thin light, seemingly as fragile as the petals of a dandelion, protected them steadily within its shield, shielding them from the impact of the mighty duel.
And behind Colin, Yukionna, peeking her head out, widened her eyes curiously watching the terrifying battle unfold before her.
At this moment, even she could tell that the strange woman in the gray cloak, carrying a fragment of a higher will, didn’t seem to be a match for the black lightning at all…
She was almost continuously suppressed.
Of course, what made her most curious was that the black lightning reminded her of a kind of fear as if it were etched into her very bones.
‘This thing, indeed, still had a trump card…’ Colin thought rather hazily as he watched the rib gate being pulled open.
Fortunately, the thing was forced out by that being resembling the “Formless Mother,” sparing him from continuing to face it.
Had it been him, although he could fight past it, he would likely waste some energy—
This thing was probably out for his life from the beginning!

chapters.title: Chapter 861 - 861 580 The Girl Who Walked Out of Script
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 861: Chapter 580: The Girl Who Walked Out of Script City. _2 Chapter 861: Chapter 580: The Girl Who Walked Out of Script City. _2 Of course, if he could “surrender,” that would certainly be the best option for the existence behind the scenes.
‘However, it seems like I still can’t escape…’
Because of the activation of protection, the output to suppress negative effects had decreased, and Colin’s condition had significantly deteriorated. His thinking speed and intensity had both declined a lot, perhaps not much better than an ordinary person.
Under normal circumstances, the thinking speed of an ordinary person is adequate, but during combat, if it remains so, one might get decapitated without even realizing it…
But, outside of combat, Colin reflected for a moment and could also vaguely realize that something was a bit off with this “Black Lightning”…
It claimed to be here to help him, but as Colin tried to look for an opportunity to flee, he noticed that the Black Lightning seemed to form an invisible blockade on his escape route—
That is to say, the situation seemed like a large domain encompassed by a smaller domain.
He couldn’t escape at all.
But to say it was here to harm him, Colin found that all the Black Lightning avoided him in its attacks, and even carefully blocked any possible spillover from the attacks.
Until now, although Colin had set up a light screen for self-protection,
Actually, no attacks had come over…
This also made it much easier for him, giving him more space to analyze the situation.
‘This power, perhaps, does not necessarily come from the “Formless Mother.” Otherwise, given its rank, it wouldn’t cause just this little commotion, and besides, it has no obligation to come over again.’
As thoughts flashed through his mind, Colin had a bold guess, but he was not very willing to confirm this guess immediately.
Several minutes later, the waning strength of the unknown high-ranking existence became increasingly apparent, and the intense collision finally came to an end…
The terror residing in the grey-cloaked woman subsided, her body first burst apart, then under the effect of that item, it reassembled. However, this time, she seemed not to realize what had just happened…
Then, just as she was looking at Colin and about to attack again.
“Snap!”
The door was suddenly pushed open.
“I’m very sorry to have disturbed you…”
Accompanied by the cool voice of a young girl, a foot wearing high heels stepped into the room, followed by a beautiful young girl wearing an elegant black dress, entering as if she were attending a banquet.
“Who is this?” The heretic in the grey cloak was shocked at the sight of the intruding figure.
Her barrier, breached so easily?
But the next second, her pupils vibrated violently, and she screamed in a lost voice:
“First Level Direct-Lineage Creature!”
However, facing her emotions, the girl in the black dress did not respond. Her fair and clean face, with bright and delicate pitch-black eyes, scanned the room in a circle.
Her gaze first paused on Colin, who was injured and on the ground, giving a small nod, and then furrowed her brows when it landed on Yukionna.
But it seemed like she had confirmed something, and she relaxed, sighing and holding her chest:
“Just now, I heard a girl’s voice shouting so loudly and highly inside; I thought that at this time, you faithless person would still be in the mood to play with women. Fortunately, you aren’t so foolish…”
Looking at the extraordinarily beautiful young girl, Colin’s gaze became somewhat frozen. He hadn’t expected her to appear at all. Opening his mouth, he spoke weakly:
“You…”
He had just begun to speak when the heretic woman, who had just lost her memory of the fight, suddenly interrupted him, “Hey, you! Who exactly are you? If you have a grudge against him, we can collaborate…”
The young girl’s look towards Colin clearly contained hatred, so from this standpoint, cooperation was not impossible.
After all, what she wanted was for that guy to die, no matter how.
She didn’t mind sharing the pleasure of torture.
Especially since this was a First Level Containment Subject’s direct follower, not a human by nature, but undoubtedly a mythical creature!
And judging from the terrifying rank exuded by this aura, stronger than a typical god!
But as she was speaking, the heretic woman suddenly felt a sense of suffocation.
“Shhh…”
The beautiful girl in the black dress held up a finger to her lips, her pure black eyes flashing with a cold and fatal gleam, as she regarded that lower life form:
“Don’t speak. Having another female voice in this room besides mine is already very uncomfortable for me. But now, I will give you another chance…”
“Chance?” The heretic woman felt bewildered for a moment, not understanding the meaning of these words.
But at that moment, the beautiful girl in the black dress blinked her clear black-and-white eyes, casually took out a small bottle, and casually tossed it over:
“Find a place for yourself and drink this. Don’t make too much noise. It will let you die quietly…”
After a pause, she looked at Colin on the floor, severely wounded and suffering from numerous negative effects to the extent that he could barely speak:
“In his presence, I don’t want to appear too harsh. If you could kindly take care of it yourself, it would make it much easier for both you and me…”
“Die?” The heretic woman looked at the small bottle not far from her feet in shock, but she quickly realized what was happening, and a dark aura erupted from her body:
“What are you talking about! You’re asking for it!”
“Ah….”
The young girl couldn’t hide her sigh, “Well, I’ll do it myself then…”
Speaking thus, she drew a small knife from her waist that appeared to be used for cutting fruits:
“I rushed over here in a hurry, dealing with too much stuff, my weapons are all used up, so I’ll just make do with this little knife to take care of you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 862 - 862 580 The Girl Who Walked Out of Script
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 862: Chapter 580: The Girl Who Walked Out of Script City. _3 Chapter 862: Chapter 580: The Girl Who Walked Out of Script City. _3 “You should die!”
The female Heretic’s expression turned even more frenzied as she prepared to move, but then her vision suddenly blurred.
The dazzling Black Lightning erupted from the beautiful girl without making a sound, flashing for a mere tenth of a second.
By the time she regained her senses, she realized the beautiful girl with envy-inducing black hair had appeared before her at some point, and she suddenly felt as if she were facing a formidable enemy.
However, she then noticed that the girl had no intention of attacking. Instead, she was wiping a fruit knife with a tissue while walking over.
Just as she thought to strike first, she was shocked to discover that no matter how she tried to move, her body would not respond.
Her mind was still agile, but it felt as though she had lost control over most of her body’s major muscles.
Attempting to exert force only brought a sensation of numbness and stiffness.
“You…”
The female Heretic fixed her gaze on the beautiful girl in the black dress, about to say something.
But the other party ignored her, walking straight past her, and as their shadows crossed, the girl suddenly raised her hand and elegantly snapped her fingers with a crisp sound.
Bang!
Hundreds of cuts appeared densely across the female Heretic’s body…
“How could this…”
Amidst intense unwillingness, her face filled with horror, she couldn’t even scream before she turned into a pile of bloody flesh.
This time, there was no coming back to life.
“Dead bodies shouldn’t talk; I don’t like to listen,” the girl said, disregarding the carnage behind her as she walked step by step towards Colin lying on the ground with scarcely any strength, her eyes scanning his wounds, a complex emotion flickering in them.
Colin lay there watching her quietly, his gaze equally complex, making no significant movements as he was unable to…
However, just as the girl took another step, about to reach Colin’s side, a piercing coldness surged.
A foggy chill passed over her, causing her dark black dress to sway in the wind, her slightly curly long hair to flutter, but that was all…
This deadly cold fog, capable of instantly killing any Containment Subject below Third Level, seemed mere a breeze to her, having no effect.
It couldn’t even bring a trace of frost to her!
“And you…”
The girl stopped in her tracks, tilted her head slightly, and her pitch-black eyes looked towards the icy blue specter trembling in fear yet courageously blocking her, floating above Colin.
“Considering you’ve always been protecting him and indeed nothing has happened, I won’t kill you. But, don’t make me angry,” the girl said softly, her tone sending a shiver of coldness through “Yukionna.”
“Yukionna, don’t worry, come back. She won’t harm me…” Colin managed to part his dry, bloodied lips.
Hearing this, Yukionna hesitated, glanced at Colin, and sensing the eerily dangerous and lethal atmosphere at the scene, she eventually shrank back into the ring in Colin’s pocket that had been snapped earlier.
It seemed she wouldn’t necessarily die; as for what would happen next… She didn’t care anymore!
“Hmph, running around everywhere with a pretty monster every day!”
On seeing this, the girl cocked her delicate nose, pouted her soft lips, and let out a muffled hum, clearly very dissatisfied with Colin’s behavior!
However, with no one else around, the girl’s aloof façade softened considerably. She walked over in her high heels, the distinct click-clacking of the heels meeting the ground as she lifted her skirt to avoid it touching the ground, and slowly squatted down in front of Colin.
A face of radiant beauty watched him for a good while before she started to speak with complex, hesitant eyes:
“It’s been so long, Colin. Do you… still remember what my name is?”

chapters.title: Chapter 863 - 863 581 Liu Yun
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 863: Chapter 581 Liu Yun Chapter 863: Chapter 581 Liu Yun “I certainly won’t forget that…”
Colin nodded slightly, took a deep breath, and looked at the beautiful woman before him, “Liu Yun… it’s been a long time.”
At the moment she heard her name, Liu Yun opened her mouth, but before she could say anything, her eyes shimmered, as if her emotions were getting the better of her, her eyes welling up.
She raised her hand to wipe her eyes with the cuff of her sleeve, took a deep breath, and then grunted,
“At least you have some memory left!”
After a pause, she seemed to remember something, stood up, moved back, lifted her skirt with both hands, and twirled gracefully in front of Colin,
“How about it, do I look pretty now?”
The girl’s elegant figure, enhanced by a gorgeous long dress, appeared noble and graceful, but that beauty, amidst the ruins, seemed ironically out of place…
“You’re beautiful.” Colin looked haggard, wanting to nod, but alas, given his current status, even this small gesture was delayed.
To be honest, the current Liu Yun, other than the inexplicable emotions towards him that hadn’t changed…
She hardly seemed like the same person.
She used to look ordinary, wearing a simple school uniform, black-rimmed glasses, a shy girl with a literary air.
As for her appearance, it was mostly described as delicate…
But now, clearly made up with care, she was radiant and captivating, destined to be the focal point wherever she went.
However, appearance was not the primary concern; Colin was really concerned about the state of her memory.
That “City of Scripts” was constantly adding and removing “settings”, and it tormented him to some extent…
With the current status, he had no idea what the situation was…
“Do you regret it? Not being with me.” The girl crouched down again, her eyes clear and fixated on his, speaking softly.
She was faintly nervous, seeming to yearn for some anticipated answer…
But this time, whether it was due to “Time Perception Disorder” or some other reason, Colin’s gaze suddenly became empty, unresponsive. After several seconds, she saw a flicker of awareness return to his weathered eyes…
“What did you just say?” Colin’s voice came again.
“I…”
At his words, Liu Yun became a bit angry and also, inexplicably, somewhat relieved, then as if claiming credit, she said:
“I said, I was the one who helped you escape before.”
“I know, I recognized you the moment I saw you, thank you…” Colin replied sincerely.
He remembered that during the divine battle, there had been a figure who had resolutely stood before a host of divine beings.
At first, he had just found the figure somewhat familiar; there were several guesses at the time, but none seemed to match, and with his wretched condition, he couldn’t think of any names. The few times he later recalled, he eventually had some guesses, but was always uncertain.
Only now, seeing her in person, did he dare to be sure…
Upon hearing this, sensing the polite yet natural “distance” in his words, Liu Yun, with her sensitive mind, bit her bright red lips, her hand unconsciously touching the hilt of a knife, about to say something, when she saw Colin cough twice, wounds all over his body starting to split open, blood oozing out. Noticing the countless injuries on the person she longed for, her anger dissipated, her tone softened, and her eyes filled with pity as she let go of the knife handle:
“You really are in a sorry state.”
She reached out, and black lightning shot from her fingertips, gathering the scattered flesh and bone of his right hand from not far away, fusing them with a special technique, and then carefully cradling the right hand to squat beside Colin, carefully placing it on the stump of the missing right arm, and reattaching it.
After handling this minor injury, she once again stretched out her hands, placing them on Colin’s chest, her pale and cool hands melting away, a strand of strange black lightning spreading, seemingly attempting to use a special technique to ease his wounds.
But soon, Liu Yun withdrew her hands, disappointment clear on her delicate face as she said:
“I can’t heal your wounds; they are very complicated, and there will almost certainly be bigger problems…”
Colin responded with a groan of both acknowledgment and pain. These injuries were his own, the negative effects of artifacts, as well as those borne and transferred for the sake of ordinary people…
The complex injuries, not even Old Master Wu in his ultimate state could resolve, or rather, were too difficult to deal with, let alone Liu Yun, who was not adept at healing.
Taking a deep breath, Colin bearing the tremendous suffering from his physical and soul-level injuries and loss, forced himself to speak quickly:
“I know you’ve come here… maybe to help me, but please, leave now. Since you found this place, it means other dangers are close at hand, and if you don’t leave soon, you’ll be in great peril…”
He felt himself on the verge of passing out and needed to take a certain toll to leave this place before he fainted.
However, before he could finish, the girl suddenly stretched out her soft and cool hand, gently covering his mouth, and spoke quietly:
“My arrival is not just a simple act of help; I will see it through to the end. Although, I can’t do anything for the injuries on your body, my mother told me. If I manage to take you to the sea, you will survive, continue your affairs, continue saving the world, saving those people… and most importantly, saving yourself!”
“Do you… understand what this means?”
At this, Colin was taken aback, having thought that Liu Yun’s arrival was perhaps just to lend a passing hand…

chapters.title: Chapter 864 - 864 581 Liu Yun_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 864: Chapter 581 Liu Yun_2 Chapter 864: Chapter 581 Liu Yun_2 But it seemed that the other party wanted more than just this.
Was this the directive of the “Formless Mother,” or perhaps the goodwill of the “City of Scripts”?
Regardless of whose intention it was, as long as they acted together, then Liu Yun…
“This is too difficult, you will die,” Colin shook his head, refusing the other’s offer of help.
Though the Red Light had weakened the Gods’ power, it didn’t mean things would be easy…
Even if Liu Yun seemed to be blessed with unexpected strength, it was still tough to succeed.
Old Master Wu’s prediction was right; when the Red Light fell, there was indeed an opportunity, but such chances were few and hard to seize.
Colin would continue to strive, but he didn’t want others to die for him.
For that reason, he had left some contingencies with Yukionna to ensure that if something went wrong with him, she could be immediately shifted away.
Yet, upon hearing Colin’s words, the young girl still showed no intention of leaving, instead reaching out with a warm hand, looking at him with what seemed to be a pitiful gaze:
“You are really kind…”
Alas, this kindness wasn’t always directed at her.
Without letting Colin speak, Liu Yun shook her head and spoke first:
“I know it’s dangerous, but it doesn’t matter, I came for you.
“Actually, even before I met you, I always thought about taking you back to our place, even erasing your unnecessary memories, just living on in a room with only the two of us…
“But you, you probably wouldn’t want that… What I hope for is to see you happy, and the only thing I can do is support you, no matter the circumstances.”
“Why…” Colin sensed her determination, and wanted to say that their collaboration with the “Formless Mother” was over.
But she spoke first.
“Why?”
Liu Yun, the young girl named, slowly stretched out her hands, cupping his face, her intricately dark eyes gazing into his, sparkled with determination as she distinctly said:
“Because I like you, for you, there’s nothing I can’t do!”
“Uh…”
This naive declaration left Colin slightly stunned, feeling abruptly awkward and unsure how to respond—
Was it just because she liked him?
Colin, who was used to acting with deep deliberation, found it somewhat difficult to grasp this naïve, simple-minded notion.
Earlier, he had contemplated various reasons for Liu Yun’s arrival, including the possibility it was an arrangement by “City of Scripts,” a directive from “Formless Mother,” among other plausible speculations…
But the one thing Colin had not considered was that it might actually be Liu Yun’s own idea.
But, seeing the deep emotions in the young girl’s eyes, he couldn’t deny them, and for a moment, his mind raced with thoughts. When he thought of how she had looked at him when in “City of Scripts,” compared to now, there was hardly any difference—
Except for a touch more madness!
It was this indescribable madness that had, in a sense, signified she was “out of control,” but it had created a peculiar balance from what Colin perceived as “false” emotions…
At that time, Colin had felt that the emotions scripted were overly false and forced, bordering on stiffness, but now he realized…
That was just his unilateral feeling.
Perhaps in Liu Yun’s heart, the situation was entirely different.
“But, I…” Colin truly didn’t want to drag unnecessary people into sacrificing themselves with him. He wanted to tell her the whole truth and then reduce the unnecessary deaths.
When he first entered the “City of Scripts,” all his experiences were out of necessity. Her memories were just something scripted…
He had even barely spent a few hours with her.
If it weren’t for the extraordinary memory of the Extraordinary Ones, Colin estimated he would have probably forgotten the tiny episodes that happened, not to mention that minor episode which involved a non-human girl whose name he hadn’t even bothered to listen to a few times…
Now it was time to reveal everything; there was no need to linger on him.
At this moment, Colin didn’t want to use her to do something that might have no consequences.
But unexpectedly, just as he opened his mouth to speak a few words, the girl who had been very graceful and beautiful in front of him suddenly widened her eyes in a very ungraceful manner and screamed loudly:
“Don’t say ‘but’!!!”
Afterward, Liu Yun took a few deep breaths to calm down a bit. Then, leaning her upper body towards Colin, she once again stretched out her pale, soft, seemingly boneless hand, held Colin’s cheeks firmly, and for the first time, ferocity appeared in her beautiful eyes.
Dark thunder vibrated deep within her pupils—
It seemed that the words about to be spoken by Colin had stabbed her heart.
But soon, she withdrew that ferocity, slowly lifted Colin’s upper body, and embraced his head into her bosom.
After a while, she began to sob tremblingly as if confessing:
“Actually, you don’t have to say it, I already know, I know everything, I know some things might not be so real.
“I know I might just be born of something Mom did, I know you… might think of me just as their tool, and everything is just false…
“But, you don’t understand, for me, what I’ve experienced, my memories, everything I have, it is real!
“In my eyes, we grew up together, we are close friends, every time there was danger, whenever someone bullied me, it was always you who stood in front of me, no matter when, you were always with me, always thinking about me, silently contributing…
“For you, I secretly learned all kinds of games, understood topics boys talk about, imagined handwriting when conversing with you, and observed the styles of girls you liked to look at on the streets, then carefully dressed myself, just to have more topics with you when we are together, to draw your eyes more on me…
“But, but I haven’t even had the chance to share all these things I learned with you, haven’t shared…
“Suddenly one day, you just left.
“I searched for you for so long, every day I confided my longing for you in my heart, every day I searched for your traces, every day I hoped you would appear, every day I waited for you to come back, every day I prayed before the gods, praying for your safety, praying nothing bad would happen to you…
“Then, until one day, I suddenly understood everything.
“Somebody told me my everything was false.
“In my dreams, there actually wasn’t you or me…”
She bit her lip, her tears soaking Colin’s shirt in front of her, then suddenly raised her head, gazing at Colin, forcing out a tangible resentment from her quivering, hoarse throat.
“But! But ah! Obviously, all the memories I have with you, in my view, are real! Why! Why suddenly tell me it’s all fake!!?
“Obviously, as far as I’m concerned, from my understanding, every moment we spent together from childhood! Every conversation! Every detail! All are so clear, so real, we grew up together, we were childhood sweethearts, we, we… sniffling, why say these are all fake!
“I don’t accept it! I don’t care! I don’t mind! For me! It’s real!
“So… please don’t talk about this anymore… What’s real, what’s fake, obviously everything is so real, I remember every detail of us being together, I remember you standing up every time there was danger…
“In my heart, there’s only you…
“I’m not begging you to remember me… but, don’t shatter the dream of you and me being together, even if it… might really, really, in your eyes, not be so real, okay? It, I really have only this left, please…
“Don’t… don’t tell me it’s fake anymore, no hints, don’t say it, please… My memories are not fake, at least to me, they are real, I’m so foolish, please, I can’t distinguish it, nor do I want to.”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 865 - 865 582 The Arrival of Light
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 865: Chapter 582: The Arrival of ‘Light. Chapter 865: Chapter 582: The Arrival of ‘Light. As he listened to her emotionally breaking down, Colin’s eyes were more complex than they had ever been. He really hadn’t expected that after leaving “Passionate Paradise,” he would almost forget everything that happened there. Yet, there was still someone who had been lingering there all this time, constantly thinking about him, deeply contemplating him.
In the midst of his fleeting thoughts, Colin, with a tinge of guilt, slowly reached out to touch her back, trying to calm her agitated emotions and wanting to say he was sorry.
But the girl seemed to sense his intention first; she looked at him with eyes red and brimming with tears, gently shaking her head as if she wanted to stop him from continuing the subject…
She didn’t care about the truth or falsehood; what she cared about now was the person in front of her, the person she thought about every day…
That was all.
Colin fell silent, his emotions in turmoil. He only waited for the girl to vent for a while before tremblingly raising his right hand, hoping to wipe away the tears on her cheeks.
Unfortunately, due to the strong negative effects and his recently repaired right hand, he stopped halfway…
But Liu Yun seemed to have anticipated this as she gently cradled his palm to her cheek, rubbing against it like a little cat drawing warmth, then sniffling as she wiped away her own tears with her hand and placed Colin’s hand back.
Afterward, she raised a finger to each cheek, trying to pull off an optimistic smile, but unfortunately, no matter how she tried, it was imbued with a haunting beauty:
“Now, don’t say anything, just be quiet. It’s going to be very dangerous here soon. I will protect you, take you away from here, just like… just like what you did for me before. Regardless of whether this situation is somebody’s plan or not, at least for this moment, this is my will, my choice. Like I said, for you, I am unstoppable…”
She reached out and slipped her hands under Colin’s neck and the crook of his knees, lifting him from his waist and turned tail from the hall, rushing towards the thorny path outside before the terror-stricken gazes could catch up.
This journey was bound to be difficult.
But she didn’t care, even if it cost her life!
Beneath Liu Yun’s comforting, Colin unknowingly fell back into a heavy sleep…
After several checks that Colin was indeed asleep, Liu Yun melted in front of him, slowly pulling him into a special spatial area within her body for protection.
This would prevent the upcoming battles from accidentally causing him harm.
The transfer of work was far from easy…
It wasn’t long after they left that Liu Yun encountered attacks from many creatures. Even with some of the power bestowed upon her by her mother, she struggled under the relentless assaults.
However, she noticed that as long as she didn’t show any intent to head towards the sea, everything seemed manageable…
But if she made any corresponding attempts, or even just thought about it, things seemed to get worse.
No matter how carefully she hid herself…
Enemies would still find her in ways she couldn’t comprehend.
“Is this their blockade, huh? It’s just too excessive, not giving any room for maneuver.”
Liu Yun spoke softly, sitting in a room that had been cleaned spotlessly. Meanwhile, Colin was seated in a thick, comfortable chair, his eyes half-shut, motionless.
Several seconds after she finished speaking, Colin finally seemed to react, emitting a faint “Hmm.”
It wasn’t clear if it was a response or just an instinctive moan.
Still, upon hearing it, Liu Yun, dressed in elegant black attire, couldn’t help but smile with joy:
“Now, the blockade is weakening, but it’s not yet the right moment. It’s hard to break through their blockade. This isn’t me purposely dragging out the time to spend more with you; it’s just the reality of the situation…”
“Hmm…”
“If you have no objections, we’ll wait a few more days, and when it’s about time, I’ll take you through.”
“Hmm…”
“Anyway, I will definitely help you succeed!”
Liu Yun prattled on, saying many things. Occasionally, when Colin completely succumbed to unconsciousness and couldn’t even offer a basic response, she would sit at his side, resting her elbow on the table, and quietly watch him.
Only when she sensed some danger approaching, or Colin woke up, would she end this state of “relative stillness.”
During those times, she occasionally stood up, took out a comb, and, like dressing a doll, she would tidy up Colin’s hair, adjust his collar, and straighten his appearance…
Every now and then, when she saw that special finger bone pendant hanging on Colin’s chest, she seemed not to notice and simply ignored it.
As for “Yukionna,” for the most part, she chose to ignore her. Yet sometimes, she would bring her out, asking about Colin’s past. Hearing those harrowing adventures, Liu Yun would cover her mouth in worry, fear, and relief as if she had experienced them herself.
Undoubtedly, those experiences seemed incredibly perilous to her.
But when she heard some amusing stories and their gains, she would share in the happiness too…
The only regrettable thing was that she had no involvement in any of those stories—after leaving, he seemingly had no plans to return.
As for the reason…
Every time Liu Yun thought about it, the smile on her face would slightly fade.
“Wow!”
Yukionna, looking more mature and fuller than Liu Yun but still innocent in nature and no longer as afraid of Liu Yun, reached out her hands and made unintelligible noises. It seemed like she was describing something immense to Liu Yun, completely oblivious to her role in “betraying” Colin.

chapters.title: Chapter 866 - 866 582 The Arrival of Light._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 866: Chapter 582: The Arrival of “Light.”_2 Chapter 866: Chapter 582: The Arrival of “Light.”_2 “A very large creature, with a human upper body and either a snake or fish-like lower body? A mermaid? Hmph, lucky you, always encountering beauties wherever you go…”
Liu Yun pursed her lips displeasedly, glancing sideways at Colin and muttered softly.
Although Yukionna couldn’t quite understand her emotions, feeling a bit of Liu Yun’s anger, she still comforted her in her own way, clearly regarding Liu Yun, who came from the same hometown, as a friend to some extent.
Of course, for Liu Yun, Yukionna naturally felt some envy, like a kid on a shabby bicycle watching a sleek sports car, the other seemed far more perfect, stirring a great desire within her.
“You’re not so bad yourself, your development isn’t even complete, venturing out in a state that could almost be described as premature, logically, you should have turned into a monster by now, and the fact that you didn’t lose control and grow this much is actually quite miraculous…”
Liu Yun patted Yukionna: “Of course, you’re also quite lucky to have met him, with that flame constantly fueling you with humanity, stabilizing your condition, and having enough interaction, you’re just about able to be considered ‘graduated.’ Otherwise, it would really be hard to say whether you’re human or ghost…”
“Ooh~” Yukionna nodded somewhat understandingly, then pointed at her chin, seemingly thinking of something.
“You say you still can’t speak? This is a bit difficult to fix, most likely due to incomplete development. If you want to learn, as far as I know, you might have to go back to your hometown for a while because it’s not just about simply being unable to speak.”
“Premature, with incomplete structures, there are always some strange defects…”
“But this defect isn’t too significant, going back just for this wouldn’t be necessary, I guess you wouldn’t want to go back either, and even if you did, you might not be able to leave, yeah, even getting in might be difficult now, it’s like a fortress…”
Liu Yun explained bit by bit to Yukionna, having grasped most of the relevant knowledge from her direct superior, the “Formless Mother.”
Yukionna, not understanding much, shook her head fearfully at the mention of going back.
Then, subconsciously wanting to run to Colin, who was sitting next to Liu Yun, she only made it halfway when Liu Yun, sensing something, with a dangerous gleam in her eyes, reached out her hand in advance and grabbed Yukionna, pressing her down on the other side:
“I’m here, don’t be scared. Right now, as long as you can communicate, it’s not a big problem, at worst, you can use the wind to mimic speech, the principle is the same as how humans produce sound, just feels a bit different, or maybe there’s some item that can interpret thoughts and speak for you.”
Liu Yun raised her hand, smoothing her hair on her forehead, her distinct black and white eyes looking at Yukionna who was left aside: “So, this isn’t a defect worth going back for, you can figure out a way to solve it… oh, I recommend you also try to increase your wisdom a bit.”
Yukionna immediately showed approval of her words, nodding vigorously, oblivious to the slight incident that had just happened.
“Hehe, right…”
Liu Yun smiled, about to ask something more, but then stopped suddenly, her expression turning serious, “Looks like another ignorant creature has come…”
As she finished speaking, silent, pitch-black lightning flickered, and a battle ended in a very brief moment.
She didn’t breathe a sigh of relief nor linger there, but instead had Yukionna return to the ring and quickly left the perhaps already exposed location with Colin, seeking shelter elsewhere.
Time passed day by day in hiding, the days sometimes mundane, sometimes dangerous, but on the whole, they were somehow blissful…
Especially when Colin occasionally woke up, even if only managing a few words, it always lifted Liu Yun’s spirits.
During this period, Liu Yun’s exploration of the sea did not stop, although there were several opportunities that unfortunately got intercepted, and once she almost stepped into a trap…
Luckily, Colin woke up just in time, offering some help that allowed her to escape smoothly.
“It’s really tough…”
Standing in front of a mirror, Liu Yun murmured to herself, the reflection showing her body distorted from continuous encounters, looking like a melting wax figure.
But the next moment, as if realizing something, her form sharply consolidated back to a delicate and pretty appearance.
After making sure she looked fine, she picked up a small basket and pushed open the door, “Are you awake? Feeling any better?”
“Yeah, alright.”
Colin nodded, then said, “I just might not be able to stay awake for too long, these days have been hard on you…”
“Hard? No, acting for your sake never feels hard, I’m actually happy; however, you are still too kind. If you hadn’t taken on the hurts at the shelter last time and moved them, you would be much better by now.”
Liu Yun shook her head but knew it was no use convincing otherwise. She didn’t linger on the subject. Instead, she put down the basket in front of Colin and pulled out a soup bowl.
“Come on, open your mouth, chicken soup.”
Colin didn’t refuse; the sweet broth slid down his throat, and he felt a long-absent sensation of human appetite being somewhat satisfied.
Since the battle had started, he hadn’t really eaten in a long time.
“This… where did you get this?” Colin’s voice was hoarse, as he slowly and curiously asked.
“I grabbed a chicken along the way as we fled,” Liu Yun explained simply and then blinked, expectantly asking, “Is it good?”
“Mm, your cooking skills are excellent…” Colin spared no praise.
“That’s good, I learned specifically for you…”
Liu Yun smiled, and after finishing feeding the chicken soup, they talked for a while until she suddenly realized he was silent again.
Turning her head, she saw he had once again fallen into a deep slumber…
Seeing this, a hint of fatigue surfaced in Liu Yun’s eyes. Then, she lightly patted her cheeks with both hands, invigorated herself, and began tidying up slowly while softly humming a lullaby-like tune:
“Sleep, sleep…”
Days turned into months in the blink of an eye.
When the power of the “Red Moon” fragments peaked like a breath, Liu Yun finally saw an opportunity. She decisively carried Colin, facing the dangerous red glow towards her, and forcefully broke through to the Deep Sea.
About ten days later, a ragged humanoid creature, dragging a trail of blood, finally broke through and reached a shattered port, seeing the sea shimmering with crimson reflections…
“Colin, we’re about to make it!”
The excited young girl in an exquisite black dress exclaimed.
Unfortunately, Colin, who was carried in front of her and had passed out from the intense battle, hadn’t heard her words.
But just as she held her breath to sprint the final distance, her steps suddenly halted…
“Trap?” Liu Yun was startled, feeling various terrifying wills slowly descending on this spot.
Merely under their gaze, the scene began to transform.
Sensing the rapidly approaching danger, she looked at the figure in her arms, gritted her teeth with a flash of reluctance, regret, and guilt in her eyes, prepared to transport him away from this place.
Although the sea was indeed just ahead and was already faintly perceptible, both she and Colin were too exhausted to advance further.
And sending him away this time might mean they would never see each other again.
However, just as she was about to act, she suddenly felt an inspiration burst forth in her mind—its message was simple—
“Seize the opportunity and move forward.”
The aura contained in the inspiration was very unfamiliar, yet somewhat familiar…
The next second, a blinding light suddenly burst before her eyes.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 867 - 867 583 Shana and Liu Yun
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 867: Chapter 583 Shana and Liu Yun Chapter 867: Chapter 583 Shana and Liu Yun Liu Yun squinted her eyes and saw that from Colin’s chest, a cluster of white, pure, intense light suddenly erupted.
And, in the blink of an eye, before she could even react, the light leaped into the center of the sky, bursting forth like the sun with an even more blinding brilliance!
Under this radiance, even the “Red Light” was shielded and repelled within a certain range.
Meanwhile, one terrifying shadow after another, hidden through various means, was illuminated by this abnormally pale light…
Within the range enveloped by the “Light,” nothing could hide!
Everything except the two protected by the light curtain below rapidly evaporated.
However, this did not include those vessels bearing Higher Life Forms.
“‘Light’…”
Supreme thoughts echoed through space, shaking the earth and stirring the Deep Sea.
Bathed in the glare, the powerful creatures, which looked like dark silhouettes, seemed to recognize this equally unwelcome threat to them…
Immediately after, without any superfluous words, battle erupted.
Some of them launched an attack against the vaguely human-shaped white silhouette, while others struck directly below, where Colin was.
All attacks were unfettered…
It seemed that the intensity of this small portion of “Light” was not enough to confront them.
But just as the “The Gods” Incarnates felt that this time, everything would come crashing down, they found their attacks unexpectedly blocked by something.
The next moment, they saw that around the human-shaped light silhouette, the brilliance had unknowingly split into a multitude of scattered lights.
These beams of scattered light intertwined, woven together, and condensed into a total of nine uniquely shaped symbolic icons.
These symbols seemed to represent different forms of Authority.
It was these that blocked their attacks…
And then, in an extremely short time, these symbolic icons directly transformed into different “Projections of Light.”
Moreover, the aura of status emanating from these “Projections of Light” was even not weaker than theirs!
Everything happened in a flash.
Formless figures, like a black hole, coldly observed their adversaries, while continuously assaulting those “Projections of Light”…
Amid the shocking collisions, this place seemed to become a region of Chaos, where many things vaporized into nothingness, but the defense forged by the nine figures of light withstood this extremely fierce onslaught.
“Ahahaha, surprise, surprise, your ‘King of Mad Sounds’ grandpa is back!”
One of the weakest “Projections of Light” made the loudest noise, but the output from its hands did not hinder the output from its mouth.
“At this time, choosing to join them, are you disregarding the final reckoning, moreover, even if he can reach the Deep Sea, he will only recover from his injuries, the ‘Primordial Fire’ still cannot descend…” A high-ranking life form emitted a divine thought, seemingly trying to dissuade.
“What unit are you from? Whether the ‘Primordial Fire’ descends or not, is that something you can control!?”
“King of Savage Sound” responded powerfully, and the vibrations swept across heaven and earth.
Although the presences here had all arrived through their own Incarnate mediums, the intensity of battle unleashed through “Authority” was not diminished in the slightest.
The luminous figures summoned by the glowing human silhouette worked together in the rarest of cooperations to build a strong defense, thwarting attacks from multiple dimensions.
At least, behind them, Liu Yun and the others under the core protection were not largely affected.
It was at this moment that Liu Yun, her body riddled with scars, her decline hard to conceal, still tried to appear as beautiful as possible, lifted her delicate chin.
She slightly narrowed her eyes, ignoring the fierce battle erupting outside, her clear black-and-white eyes intently fixed on the translucent and dimly outlined figure floating in mid-air, eerily beautiful:
“Are you… the one who gave him the necklace?”
Having said that, without waiting for an answer, she headed towards the seashore while nodding to herself:
“Right, that bone, whether it’s the breath of life or the nature of the Extraordinary Power, all seem to match up. There won’t be any surprises, no, it’s impossible for there to be any other surprises, hmm… you really are, a beautiful person, no wonder when I appeared before him, he didn’t compliment my beauty, having seen too many beauties, eh.”
No sooner had she finished speaking than her eyes narrowed, and in an instant, a mass of pitch-black lightning burst forth from her, striking towards that high-altitude figure.
The silent and sudden explosion of lightning was abrupt.
Yet, the dense and terrifying might of the black thunder, upon approaching the figure formed of light, was easily dissipated and neutralized within the bright light, vanishing without a trace…
And facing her attack, the person within the light, only faintly visible, showed no intention of retaliation, merely watching her calmly.
“I also wanted to say, to use black thunder to stop just one centimeter from your face, to see how scared you would look, to see your flustered expression, even just blinking would probably make me very happy. Unfortunately, I can’t do it…”
Liu Yun seemed somewhat disheartened; from the feedback just now, it seemed even at her peak, her power was likely unable to break through the other’s defenses…
If she at her peak couldn’t do it, how could she now, nearly exhausted?
Unless she called her mother to help her get “justice”.

chapters.title: Chapter 868 - 868 583 Shana and Liu Yun_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 868: Chapter 583 Shana and Liu Yun_2 Chapter 868: Chapter 583 Shana and Liu Yun_2 But the other side also had a very powerful ally, neither soft diplomacy nor hard power could surpass them…
And such matters weren’t appropriate for asking Mom to step in from behind the scenes; doing that would mean her complete defeat.
“Sigh, she’s beautiful and strong, and she seems to have a pretty good temperament, I’m jealous.”
As Liu Yun kept walking, maintaining her speed towards the sea, she asked the figure as if nothing had happened just moments ago,
“By the way, do you mind if I ask, are you his current girlfriend?”
Upon hearing this, the hazy and aesthetically pleasing figure did not respond, simply moving with her progress.
It seemed to be supervising her to prevent unnecessary actions, or perhaps it was protecting them from certain attacks…
Or maybe it was a bit of both.
“Don’t like to talk, huh? But it looks like you are, according to the knowledge my mother has given me, some of it matches you. You’ve come into contact with her not long ago. According to her observations, it’s impossible for you to be here at this time, at this place…”
“From what I see, you’ve made a great sacrifice for him, coming from a great distance. I don’t believe that’s something a mere friend would do…”
“Of course, the most important thing is that he even carries a part of your body, and most likely, it was a gift from you… Ordinary male and female friends, how could they possibly…”
She prattled on, feeling like she had discovered the truth, her words full of unusual emotions.
This time, the figure behind the light let out an almost imperceptible voice, “Mhm.”
However, at this, Liu Yun suddenly let out a light laugh.
“No, despite the evidence of your closeness, I don’t believe it. My sixth sense tells me, you two… are just a bit short of the mark, maybe there are feelings, but perhaps neither of you has pierced through that final layer of relationship… unless, unless you two mate fiercely in front of me and have a big, chubby baby, hehe…”
Saying this, without waiting for the shadow of light to react, Liu Yun suddenly changed the topic and said with a laugh, “I’m just kidding. But, I really do want to do just that in front of you. Mm, I’m going to have so many!”
Despite these offensive and provoking words, the glowing figure remained unfazed, simply watching calmly.
“Boring…”
Facing this “impervious” “tactic,” Liu Yun felt like she was punching cotton, which gave her a sense of inexplicable powerlessness…
As she stopped trying to amuse herself with speaking, the place quieted down, leaving only the sound of footsteps hurrying along.
She didn’t ponder too much on the matter. As she saw the sea drawing nearer, the latent psychology of wanting to compete was gradually replaced by another emotion…
It was a feeling she couldn’t quite describe, fear? Reluctance? Resentment? Or maybe a nervousness like nearing home… unease?
This short journey was coming to an end…
Liu Yun didn’t stop walking, but she suddenly broke the silence, “Please take good care of him from now on, okay?”
She paused, then added,
“Not as a favor to me, but protect him from your heart, or maybe because you like him, don’t have regrets…”
“Mhm.”
The glowing figure nodded, giving her first clear and explicit response.
Liu Yun looked at the unconscious Colin as if explaining something and at the same time consoling herself,
“But don’t worry, I haven’t touched him, and I can’t. It’s like fish in water, gazing every day at the stars reflected on the lake’s surface. They seem so close, yet I’m perpetually unable to touch them; the reality is far away from me. But I’m easily satisfied… Dreams are pretty good, too.”
As she talked, she looked at the glowing silhouette with an indescribable envy, opened her mouth as if wanting to say something, but in the end, only showed a complex smile that seemed both content and difficult to let go.
Then she stopped walking.
Because the arduous journey was over; the sea lay at her feet…
Taking a deep breath, Liu Yun withdrew her gaze from the figure radiating blinding light and then squatted in front of the rocks, gently placing Colin into the water.
At the moment of touching the water, something strange seemed to connect with the figure in her hands…
Ripples of pale blue spread out from Colin’s body.
“It seems like the power of some ‘pact’ is being activated…” Liu Yun realized something upon seeing this.
As a being born of intelligence in that world, she was extremely familiar with the aura of various “pacts” but was limited to recognition and did not know what they specifically entailed.
Just as she could look at a car and know it can run, she did not understand why it ran, what technology was used inside, whether it required fuel or charging, or what theory and configuration data it had.
However, just as they had let their guard down, an unexpected change suddenly occurred!
“Thump…”
“Is there something inside his body?!”
Both Liu Yun and the luminous figure in the air, in an instant, directed their gazes toward Colin’s head—could they vaguely sense something alive that had just made a sound akin to a heartbeat?
Despite its faintness, it didn’t escape the two, who were completely focused on Colin and had their minds set on him!
Through their mutual reactions, both confirmed that this was a situation they had not known before!
The first thought that crossed their minds was whether something had taken the opportunity to parasitize inside Colin’s body when they were inadvertent…
‘If it really is an enemy, it would be terrible, hidden so deep within his body!’
Liu Yun clenched her teeth, and dark lightning surged wildly over her body, flashing ominously in a way that seemed to obscure the sky.
At the same time, her entire figure began to twist, no longer maintaining a human form in front of Colin, instead seeking to unleash all her power.
Meanwhile, up in the air, the glowing figure began to show rare emotion, growing solemn.
Behind her, layers of Wings of Light unfolded.
Upon the wings, a beam of light, special and exceedingly bright, descended.
It appeared to be a light gate. Behind it, the sounds of chains moving could faintly be heard, as if some ancient and grand entity was being dragged…
In an instant, the atmosphere seemed to become tangible!
However, just when things were on a knife-edge, a weak will transmitted into their ears, explaining the situation.
Only then did the atmosphere begin to ease.
“What, some ‘Deep Sea incident’ task force…”
Muttered Liu Yun to herself, drawing back the all-encompassed dark lightning into her body, she looked at the figure in the water and, without any further hesitation, released her grip on Colin.
Then she saw the waterborne figure rapidly sink to the bottom…
During this process, as she felt a heavy weight finally lift from her heart, she suddenly discovered that Time seemed to slow down abruptly, like a carousel of lanterns.
Her mind replayed scene after scene that was hard to forget.
Among them were both “unreal” and “real” memories, intricately mixed, making it difficult to distinguish between the two.
But what was undeniable was that this man who had stumbled into her life had become her entire world, in spirit, memory, and even self-awareness.
As long as it concerned him, she found herself unable to let go, real or not.
Unfortunately, some foreseeable fates seemed unchangeable…
All she could do was to harbor a dream deep inside her heart, where she could brazenly love and pursue within the dream, pouring out her deep feelings in a corner unknown to him, feelings he would never hear.
Then, occasionally leaping from the water, she would try to reach for those unattainable stars…
At the closest point to them in mid-air, she closed her eyes.
Dreaming a dream that would never come true.
Just like right now…
Liu Yun sat down weakly against a rock by the sea, stretching out her slender legs, crossing her hands over her lower abdomen, watching the figure disappear into the sea, her tense consciousness finally relaxing.
Just as she was about to sink into the long-awaited dream to seek her own “reality,” a call that others couldn’t hear echoed by her ear.
“Mom? Oh… I’m not coming back, I’m so tired, don’t worry about me. If I wake up, maybe I’ll go looking for him again, I need to be beautiful for it…”
The girl’s murmuring voice grew lower and lower.
Finally, the ragged creature by the sea, too weary to maintain human form, closed its eyes and fell into a hazy slumber…
Not knowing what she dreamt of, her closed eyes revealed a sweet smile, tears of happiness spilling from their corners as she mustered all her strength to raise her soft, boneless hand and tentatively extended her ring finger towards the empty air, murmuring her last dream speech:
“Yes, I do…”
A sudden “splash” of a wave crashing onto the shore drowned out all the sounds at that location.
…..

chapters.title: Chapter 869 - 869 584 Death Immunity
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 869: Chapter 584: “Death Immunity”! Chapter 869: Chapter 584: “Death Immunity”! Accompanied by Colin’s successful descent into the sea, the light above the dome, along with the nine beings projected over extreme distances through “Light”, did not last long before they seemed to reach their limits, one by one voluntarily vanishing on the spot.
The fact that they were able to block for so long, setting aside the point of “The Gods'” will not being unified, could almost be called a little miracle.
Continuing to persist would be meaningless, and there was a possibility of shattering the descending consciousness…
It would not be fatal, but it would result in considerable damage.
After Colin sank into the deep waters, the entire “Ocean” seemed like a man dead for who knows how long, who suddenly once again showed a sign of life, and moved its “fingers”…
“Boom boom boom!”
Above the horizon, countless Dark Clouds gathered densely, innumerable silvery white lightning danced, connecting the heavens and earth hurricanes swept up, and the tempestuous and wild ocean showcased the terrifying might of nature…
Some ancient beings, from a far distance, tried to attempt a final kill but found that the other party seemed to have disappeared.
Meanwhile, the “Ocean”, originally Blockaded by the gods, was now breaking through its containment!
…
At the same time, in the depths of the seemingly bottomless sea, Colin gradually regained consciousness.
The first thing he felt was that the various negative effects on his body seemed to have been significantly weakened…
Or perhaps more accurately, they seemed to have been suppressed by a stronger power.
However, the suppression of the negative effects did not make Colin feel much better because that force was also pressing down on him firmly…
Accompanied by the immense water pressure, the sea water felt like it was being squeezed into every part of his body, bringing an extremely intense sensation of suffocation…
The sound of bones cracking “crack crack” continued without pause.
The bones throughout his body seemed as though they were laid out on the ground, to be rolled over by a steamroller, while his brain and nerves were like they had been injected with a stimulant, allowing him to keenly feel the agony brought by every fracture.
“Ugh…”
And under the terrifying sensation of suffocation, even a painful moan from Colin seemed particularly difficult.
However, even though he felt on the verge of death, he did his best not to resist.
Because what went against his consciousness was…
He distinctly felt he was about to die, yet he did not have any sense of “crisis”!
This contradictory feeling was extremely paradoxical.
Time passed, unknown how long, the sensation of being close to death grew more intense.
In Colin’s mind, flashbacks of his entire life even emerged, as if they were swiftly passing scenes, and he couldn’t help but recall his entire life.
After the “lengthy” time which, in reality, did not take long, the terror of death suddenly engulfed Colin, just when he thought he would sleep forever…
Colin suddenly found that all the negative effects on his body, along with the original pain, had disappeared!
He seemed to shed his shell like some kind of soul-like state, detaching from his original battered “body”.
“What’s going on?” he questioned, but immediately following he felt something highly connected to him, something he had almost forgotten about, dissipating…
“Second Self·Death Immunity”!
‘I actually forgot about this thing?!’ Colin was stunned, as if only at that moment realizing he still possessed a purple, special one-time use item.
Its effect was to be activated upon his death…
Similar to what is called a “resurrection shell”.
“If I had known that dying once could have directly triggered this item and gotten rid of all negative effects, I would have cut my own throat…” Colin couldn’t help thinking.
When the shell was shed, the original body was about to appear.
But precisely at that moment, he suddenly felt his body as if shaken by some heavy hammer.
Following that, at the soul level, he felt myriad powerful suction forces coming from all directions, seemingly trying to tear him into different places…
Behind each pull of suction, he could clearly sense the presence of a sublime life form.
Almost in an instant, Colin realized that these were some special measures “The Gods” had left within him, which were also only triggered upon his “death” or when he would be most powerless!
However, it was at that moment, Colin saw rings of deep blue terrifying aura bursting forth from himself…
“This power… somewhat resembles the ‘Father of the Sea,’ but it’s definitely not him… No, is it that egg?! Is it exerting power?”
Colin realized something in a flash.
When he left “The Seventh Box Garden World,” the “Father of the Sea,” in his dying moments, had entrusted him with a special egg containing an unknown entity…
But since leaving, it had never made a move, and Colin only knew that some of “Lady Bunny’s” arrangements above the “Ocean” might be related to it, yet he knew no further details.
Now that he saw it finally stir, Colin was not too surprised…
The sound of waves lapping continuously emerged.
All suction coming from other directions was blocked as much as possible, but even so, Colin, in an extremely weakened but not frail state, still had to endure the pain of his soul being torn apart.
‘No wonder, it had to be entered into here…’ Colin understood the situation.
Aside from this place, there was probably nowhere else that could provide protection as nearly complete as here…
And it was at that very moment, Colin felt from within his mind, the egg seemed to send an indescribable request, he didn’t even take a closer look, and immediately approved…
The next second, he felt unknown waters approaching, the “Ocean” itself was becoming even more vast.

chapters.title: Chapter 870 - 870 584 Death Immunity_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 870: Chapter 584: “Death Immunity”!_2 Chapter 870: Chapter 584: “Death Immunity”!_2 Faint images began to form in his mind…
Within the world, previously blockaded sea levels started to rise!
The ocean seemed to become a massive, unified life form slowly engulfing and wrapping everything…
The original coastlines kept disappearing, as the murky waters covered the scarred earth, and in the process, suppressed all anomalies within the world…
Gigantic tendrils formed from torrential rains, fierce winds, and lightning ceaselessly dragged those trying to escape major anomalies or non-human races into the ocean for entombment.
And during this process, as the heretical anomalies acting as “signal” towers were suppressed…
The silhouettes of many “foreign” terrifying entities became blurred.
“Sea water? What the hell?! Are you kidding me?” A person outside a high-altitude refuge, observing the situation, stared in shock at the approaching waters, his face filled with disbelief.
They were on the loess plateau, a high-altitude region—it shouldn’t be possible for them to be inundated!
At this moment, the ocean’s advance could not be said to be very fierce, it could even be described as quite gentle…
But still, many terrifying lifeforms as massive as mountains were dragged into the water by tendrils reaching from the sea!
“Quick, take cover in the shelters! Our shelters are waterproof!” someone shouted, pulling back all the external personnel.
It was then that someone couldn’t help but curse, vaguely understanding something—no wonder they had been suddenly instructed to start installing various underwater apparatuses after the shelters were built, expending great effort on waterproofing requirements… Some “Fate Propeller” or someone must have known about the current situation in advance!
Besides, in other regions of the world, people with no place to go due to the destruction of shelters, also received some kind of “enlightenment” when directly gazing at the ocean, and those who couldn’t find anywhere else to hide could temporarily seek cover in underground parking lots, empty rooms, and the like, to avoid the initial “Deep Sea”…
Though uncertain of its veracity, those helpless wanderers deprived of shelter could only trust their instincts and find the nearest suitable place to hide.
As the waters spread, some found that when windows and doors were shut, the water strangely would not seep into the room or building, and all sighed in relief.
And some other small worlds and independent spatial domains were either engulfed directly by the waters or had their entrances sealed off, once again preserved to a certain extent…
…
At this time, in “World Code-4.”
“Damn it!”
A person on an independently floating island cursed under his breath, shocked to discover through special deep-sea detection equipment that an adversarial underwater power was mobilizing the entire submerged island’s force to inch closer!
It didn’t take much thought to realize that the opposition undoubtedly aimed for all-out war!
On the opposing island, similar observers issued the same furious curse—at least in their view, it was the opposition moving towards them, not the other way around.
“Prepare for battle! We can’t let them approach…” someone wanted to fire the first shot.
“No, we absolutely can’t shoot…” another person at the same location discouraged: “Have you forgotten the ‘Harmonious and Friendly Civilization Mutual Aid Freedom Union Committee’…”
The mention of that name cooled everyone down, as if recalling anew the image of the elite strung up at the center of the island by the “Harmony Committee”…
After the Dark Sea underwent a round of bloody cleansing, anyone who dared to disrupt the “friendly atmosphere” met with a rather unfriendly fate.
To initiate conflict would surely make them the next to be sanctioned for “crimes against humanity”!
The ghastly visages of the formerly ruling elite of the underwater domain loomed before their eyes.
“Combat readiness! We won’t fire first, but we won’t just let them hit us either…” the tone of a garrisoned island personnel relaxed quite a bit.
Currently, as long as they didn’t provoke trouble, merely retaliating seemed not to be a major issue.
“Right, notify the higher-ups immediately, clarify the situation to avoid any misunderstandings…” they hurried to say, fearing that they might all be blown away together should any issues arise.
Then, just as they were preparing to report to their superiors and inquire how the “Harmony Committee” would deal with the situation, someone discovered that it wasn’t just one floating island invading—other islands too began to emerge over time!
Indeed, on some level, it wasn’t just them—the entire Deep Sea World seemed affected.
Almost all garrisoned forces noticed others approaching their “homes”…
In the past, without notice, this almost certainly meant the outbreak of full-scale war!
But now, no one dared to fire the first shot…
Moreover, the most troublesome issue was that they couldn’t get in touch with the personnel from the Committee at all.
It was in the midst of this widespread panic that the signals finally got through, and information from above spread quickly, easing the tense atmosphere throughout the Deep Sea area.
The good news was that all the events were a misunderstanding; no one was planning to start a war. The sudden approach of all sides was due to some other reasons.
The bad news was…
The whole Deep Sea was shrinking constantly, and the reason for the sudden closeness was that it seemed the water had been siphoned away.
“Where could all this water have gone?!” someone exclaimed in perplexity.
However, more pressing than this, some people couldn’t help but ask after a moment of silence, “So, can the water that’s been ‘borrowed’ be returned eventually…?”
If the islands truly weren’t approaching each other of their own volition, then…
What previously took about ten days to reach one of the floating islands now seemed like it might take only two or three days to get to the intended destination.
The Deep Sea World appeared to have shrunk by more than half.
It was truly unimaginable just how much water had been siphoned off to result in this situation.
…
Meanwhile, as time progressed, from the perspective of the planet, the sea gradually engulfed the majority of areas, and the chaos of the entire world finally began to subside to some extent…
The sky-darkening red light had vanished, and countless anomalies had been suppressed at the very bottom of the sea, motionless.
However, the spread of the Deep Sea had the greatest impact on those high-level beings…
As the turmoil came to a standstill, some of the world’s own defenses began to restore. Although these beings still could descend, it wasn’t as easy as it had been during the previous chaos, when they could come and go freely.
At the most “central” location of the ocean, Colin felt that the direct gaze of those “great beings” was finally blocked out, and his soul, which had been torn asunder by them back and forth, had finally found peace.
Along with the disappearance of a pile of negative effects and such, his body seemed to have mostly recovered to normal. The only trouble now was a single “fatigue,” an extreme weariness that made him want to sleep deeply…
It was at this moment that Colin saw the “egg” in his mind suddenly float in front of his eyes.
Some information was conveyed through it by will…
“It’s not over yet, hold on as much as possible, don’t fall asleep, I will dilute you, then gather you back together, it won’t hurt, but it will be a bit uncomfortable, and there will be some aftereffects, you can handle it as you see fit…”
“And, be sure to wake up quickly! to clean up the current mess—so many anomalies and escaped containment subjects, I can’t suppress them all, I’m just a child…”
“Even though I am a prenaturally born human life, my consciousness was born less than half a year ago, why do I have to do these things, and why are these events so similar to the experiences of the ‘Father of the Sea’…”
“I don’t want to, I don’t want to follow in the footsteps of the ‘Father of the Ocean’ and turn into a pile of rotten flesh just after being born!!!”
“Waaah!”
Colin originally wanted to inquire about the origins of this thing, but while it started off fine, the more it talked, the more childlike and chaotic the crying became.
However, a word in the other party’s speech made him vaguely understand what had hatched out.
“A prenatally known human life… the strength of a god, with an almost entirely normal child’s personality…” Colin felt it was very likely the result of another experiment the company had conducted in this domain.
But before he could ponder any further, he suddenly found himself rapidly diluting, like ink into Pure Water…

chapters.title: Chapter 871 - 871 585 The Deep Sea Returnee
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 871: Chapter 585 “The Deep Sea Returnee Chapter 871: Chapter 585 “The Deep Sea Returnee In a continuous expansion, Colin’s consciousness struggled to take shape, the time for contemplating a single thought growing ever longer, and soon enough, he fell into a deep sleep.
Rather than being plunged into nightmares due to the various terrifying negative effects as before, this time he truly slept heavily.
Unable to perceive anything, like death itself…
Who knows how much time had passed, when suddenly the calm sea surface arched upwards, and then, a figure wrapped in water was spat out, tracing an arc through the air before landing with a splash in a dilapidated city near the ocean.
After rolling several times, the figure came to a stop amidst the rubble, motionless…
Then, there was no further movement.
Only God knows how much time later, a group of shabbily dressed people suddenly arrived, totaling fourteen.
“The detector indicates that the anomaly index of this area is relatively stable, so there probably aren’t any dangers…” one of the fourteen, a middle-aged man of average height and agile movements, glanced at a detector in his hand.
According to the feedback, the vicinity should currently be a safe zone…
“Boss, this is a great spot! It looks like a zone just revealed by the receding tide, unexplored by anyone yet!” one of the survivors from after the disaster looked around, noticing the absence of any traces of activity, and his eyes lit up.
