“It does seem like no one has been here before. Let’s start searching for supplies nearby, prioritizing medical supplies, then any functional items, followed by canned food, and then various fertilizers, or anything that can be used for composting…” the leader of the scavenging team instructed.
For common folk like them, the most valuable assets were undoubtedly various medical resources…
And then there were items from the days of old, already difficult to reproduce.
As for food… it was generally the last priority.
Because whether at the top shelters or the lowest enclaves of disaster victims, none were particularly short on food. New crops were widespread, and with suitable environments and some fertilizer, it was always possible to quickly produce sufficient primary agricultural products.
So, even though the world had collapsed, at least having enough to eat wasn’t a problem…
Of course, if they came across food, they wouldn’t refuse it, after all, food from bygone days could also be traded for a good amount of money.
After finishing his instructions, the middle-aged man paused and added, “Oh, pay special attention to the ruins of that mall, there’s a chance to find some gold and silver from before…”
“Really!” At the mention of gold and silver, everyone’s faces showed excitement.
Even now, these things were still very valuable. Many forces and shelters would be willing to exchange many valuable goods to acquire this real gold and silver…
As for why, it was said that some specific precious metals seemed to be able to hold extraordinary powers…
“If we can find a few dozen pounds of gold, remember to upgrade our medical equipment,” a tall woman with an ordinary face said happily.
“Yes, if there truly is any, we will certainly trade…” the middle-aged man nodded, “but, priority still has to be updating our weapons first, then swapping out a batch of crop seedlings, as our plants are still a bit monotonous…”
After finishing their brief exchange, the people began to explore, mostly in groups of three.
It couldn’t be denied that these ruins, freshly revealed by the receding tide, could indeed be called fertile. Before long, they found a bounty so rich it would nearly fill five pickup trucks, even finding a good amount of gold and silver.
The middle-aged man observed the situation and prepared to have everyone start evacuating.
Though there were still plenty of places unexplored, they understood the adage “bite off more than you can chew”…
Carrying too much can be dangerous, making it hard to even run if trouble arises.
However, just as he prepared to order the evacuation, the only female member of the team, who was also the only doctor, suddenly reported a new discovery.
“We found a child?” the middle-aged man was startled and then walked over.
Before long, he saw a child sitting quietly amid the rubble.
Appearing barely over ten years old, the child was wearing adult clothes that were loose and dirty, but his skin was fair and his eyes pure, though he looked somewhat dazed.
He didn’t panic at the sight of their long guns and rifles, only blinking his round eyes and looking back at everyone.
In this environment, suddenly coming across a child was eerie, but in a sense, it was not that eerie…
“What a cute kid,” the accompanying female doctor couldn’t help but squat down, taking out a wrapped candy, ready to coax, but feeling something was amiss, then curiously asked, “Little one, do you know who you are?”
“Colin…” the child nodded quickly in response.
“Is there anyone else here?”
“I don’t know…”
“How did you end up in a place like this?”
“I don’t know…”
Clad in the loose clothing, Colin sat on the ground shaking his head, unable to remember much. It felt like he had experienced many things, but just couldn’t recall them for the moment…
And as their conversation continued, one of the members of the exploration team saw the middle-aged leader arrive and came over to whisper:
“It looks like he might be a ‘Returner from the Deep Sea’…”
“Yes, I think so too.”
The middle-aged man nodded, relaxing his vigilance slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 872 - 872 585 The Deep Sea Returnee_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 872: Chapter 585 “The Deep Sea Returnee”_2 Chapter 872: Chapter 585 “The Deep Sea Returnee”_2 “The Returner from the Deep Sea” wasn’t something extraordinary…
The reason for its emergence dates back to nearly two years ago, during a time of natural and man-made disasters when the endless ocean suddenly erupted, submerging the world. It was believed to be a catastrophic disaster that would destroy the earth, but unexpectedly, the Deep Sea Era, which submerged almost all the land, did not last long before it gradually receded to its original position…
Humanity then reemerged from various shelters, discovering that the once prevalent calamities and horrors had been cleansed by the ocean like the air after rain…
Although abnormal creatures still existed, they were, at least, not as overwhelmingly numerous as before.
Not long after, people discovered that many individuals who had been submerged were occasionally “spat out” back onto land by the sea.
It was also called the “Deep Sea Return Phenomenon,” and it was established that it wasn’t particularly threatening, as the people spat out by the ocean were the sufferers submerged by the sea the year before, and generally, they were unproblematic…
It was quite common at first when the sea receded.
Even in this team, there were several members who were “Deep Sea Returnees.”
As for why this happened, why the ocean occasionally spat people out, no one knew; they only suspected it involved some unknown terrifying entities, implicating a great hidden secret.
Of course, according to those factions that worship the “ocean,” it was because the holy and mighty will of the ocean couldn’t bear to see humanity destroyed. Thus, with its tremendous power, it swallowed countless anomalies, saving all the sufferers, and eventually returned them to land at the appropriate time…
Whether or not this was actually the case, it seemed no one was clear.
“Captain, can we take him with us…” the accompanying female doctor asked, with a pleading tone.
Leaving such a frail, helpless, and pitiful child alone here would likely lead to a predictable fate; surviving in this post-disaster world would undoubtedly be impossible…
However, no sooner had she spoken than someone else in the team shook their head, “Honestly, I don’t recommend doing that, it could be dangerous…”
Although “Deep Sea Returnees” were generally fine, there were still risks.
The risk did not depend on the act of “returning from the Deep Sea,” but on what kind of person this individual had been previously…
If he was a Heretic or one of those contaminated, then it would still be very dangerous.
“A kid not even up to your waist, what danger could he pose?” spoke another who was also a “Deep Sea Returnee.”
“We have to pass through a dangerous area on our way back, and we might not even be able to take care of ourselves, let alone a child.”
“Oh! You really! I shouldn’t have used anesthesia when suturing your wound! Better to let you die in pain!”
The female doctor cursed, then looked towards a robust middle-aged man, “Captain!”
The middle-aged man hesitated. The team was almost evenly split between those who agreed and those who didn’t, leaving the decision up to him…
Now, bringing one more person back to the refuge was no issue, as it was just another mouth to feed, and it wouldn’t cause them to run short of food…
But, those who disagreed were also right; this child knew nothing about his past.
Taking him back rashly could pose a risk…
Yet, before a decision could be made, suddenly, a “beep beep beep” alarm sounded at his waist.
At the same time, a mysterious roar came from a distance…
It seemed something formidable had been attracted by the noise here!
Everyone’s faces changed instantly, and the middle-aged man finally made a decision, gritting his teeth, “Leave some supplies behind, let’s take him!”
With the decision made, there was no further dispute. The agile female doctor immediately stepped forward, lifted the boy who claimed to be Colin, and ran madly in the opposite direction.
In no time, the group reached their electrically modified pickup trucks parked by the roadside, preparing to leave directly.
However, just as they approached the vehicles, a sudden, dramatic change occurred!
The air pressure seemed to solidify in an instant, making it hard for everyone to move. From high above their heads, something was descending!
Frozen in terror, they looked up to see a flat and enormous monster descending from the sky!
It almost enveloped everyone within it!
“It’s over…” just as everyone thought that.
No one noticed that Colin, held by the female doctor, slightly squinted his eyes and muttered quietly,
“Dead.”
In an instant, a vibration frequency that was even imperceptible to the bystanders surged from below, and following closely, a huge, flat monster that almost covered everyone exploded.
It turned into a rain of blood that fell around…
“What happened?”, the survivors who escaped death were stunned.
“Was it the captain?” Someone saw a middle-aged man picking up a peculiar black rifle that emitted a black aura, aiming at the sky.
“I…”, the middle-aged man started to say that he had no time to shoot, and even if he had, it wouldn’t have had that effect, but hearing footsteps in the distance, he couldn’t afford to think about it; he quickly instructed everyone to get into the pickup truck and talk later.
All along the way, the middle-aged man was full of doubts; he clearly remembered that although he had taken out the weapon, there had been no time to use it before the aberrant life form exploded…
While it looked somewhat like the effect of a rifle, the difference was still significant!
However, he could not afford to ponder this; before long, they heard sounds becoming clearer from behind…
“Bang bang bang—”
The heavy footsteps were methodical, yet they effortlessly followed behind, getting closer!
Someone looked back and could faintly see a humanoid creature made up of a mass of wriggling muscles, all soaked in blood, chasing after them…
“A ten-meter ‘Flesh Devourer’!”
The middle-aged man was shocked, and besides the giant “Flesh Devourer,” many smaller but faster “Flesh Devourers” were also rushing towards them.
This thing, reportedly mutated from biological matter contaminated by the overwhelming “Red Light”…
It was also one of the most common abnormal life forms in the world…
And the most dangerous type!
Because they generally have a very strong desire to attack any living thing, trying to amalgamate all nearby life forms; once encountered, unless one escapes or defeats them, they can chase relentlessly for thousands of kilometers!
“Fight! We must drive it back, or we can’t escape!” the middle-aged man shouted.
People from several tricycle convoys immediately grabbed some homemade weapons and fired.
Although the noise of the battle might attract other monsters, at this moment, they couldn’t worry about that.
As several “whoosh” sounds followed, various bombs were launched…
However, the weapons they had were fine against smaller individuals, but they were somewhat weak against a ten-meter “Flesh Devourer.”
And watching the “Flesh Devourer” approaching, someone couldn’t help but look at the captain again, “Captain, give me that thing; let me try…”
“No need; I’ll handle it…” The middle-aged man took off a small backpack hanging on his body.
He pulled out a rifle emitting a dark aura…
This thing, from a shelter of the Extraordinary Ones, didn’t need bullets for every shot; it could fire a bone projectile with great strength, but it seemed to evenly draw a portion of the user’s bones…
Just that would have been fine, but the key issue was that the more it was used, the more “fragile” the user’s bones became.
The last user died because his bones shattered after firing repeatedly…
But now, if he didn’t use it, he would die; he didn’t have time to think and aimed the gun at the monster.
The ten-meter monster, feeling the threat, suddenly leaped toward them, drastically closing the distance in a short time…
If it jumped again, it could likely land right in their midst!
He confirmed his aim and was about to pull the trigger when he suddenly saw the huge creature, having just come within about thirty meters, explode again!
…
Wait, there’s another chapter.

chapters.title: Chapter 873 - 873 586 Fuguang Association
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 873: Chapter 586 “Fuguang Association Chapter 873: Chapter 586 “Fuguang Association “Captain, how did your weapon suddenly become so fierce?!” Some people who had seen the effects of the equipment were stunned.
I remember the power wasn’t that great before, right?
Meanwhile, the middle-aged man who had just positioned himself to shoot held his breath and stared ahead, somewhat dazed.
Not again!
The first time that special type of monster appeared was one thing, but this “Flesh Devourer,” as he understood, was definitely not supposed to self-destruct like this!
And so far, the only change in the team…
He subconsciously moved his eyeballs, glancing toward another pickup truck and saw a little boy being held by a female doctor, calmly watching the monster in the distance—
That was definitely not the expression a child should have!!
Could it be, was this once an Extraordinary One, and one of considerable strength at that?!
However, given the current situation, which had been particularly noisy and attracted quite a few things, he couldn’t afford to think more about it and continued to direct the convoy to escape the current predicament.
At least for now, it didn’t seem to be a bad thing.
…
And at this same time, within a giant white building that glowed with white light and was situated near the sea,
A somewhat chubby sphere of light with sixteen pairs of Wings of Light suddenly contracted, coalescing into a hazy human silhouette surrounded by ribbons formed from the wings.
Many people saved after the disaster noticed this and immediately caused a stir, showing their respect to what they recognized as “him” or “her”…
In the eyes of different people, this silhouette always had different divine images.
However, no matter the image, if it weren’t for this Pure Light Bodhisattva who had descended half a year ago with great compassion, they might have long perished in the disaster…
Of course, there were also people who knew that this so-called “Pure Light Bodhisattva” was most likely just an Extraordinary One with formidable power, far surpassing ordinary Ninth Level Personnel.
But considering she seemed friendly and had some influential individuals vouching for her, the surviving forces maintained a relatively friendly attitude towards her.
And these influential individuals were employees who still maintained “The Descent Project.”
However, at this moment, Shana, who had followed some employees’ suggestions to change her hair color to black and turn her wings into ribbons to better blend in and carry out actions in this area, didn’t respond much to the crowd.
“It seems to have appeared…”
Shana, under the guise of the “Pure Light Bodhisattva,” moved to the sky, her dark eyes scanning her surroundings. Just now, her keen Spiritual Intuition had detected that longing figure.
It seemed he had appeared again!
However, she could only feel that he had appeared but wasn’t clear about his exact location…
It was unfortunate that the finger bone she had given Colin as a gift, which had been completely used up as a sacrificial summoning for her own descent in that critical battle by the sea two years ago, was not there anymore. Otherwise, she would be able to appear by Colin’s side right now.
But at this time, a mark symbolizing some sort of authority sketched itself out nearby and spoke, “Saintly Sir, it seems like my power is being used…”
Nowadays, the only other person beside him who could utilize his power was…
The Master!
At the thought, the “King of Savage Sound” was almost moved to tears; after so many days, there was finally a piece of good news: Master, don’t die, Master. Without you, we can’t live…
And we mean we really couldn’t live anymore!
“Yes, it should be, I just felt Mr. Colin too.”
“You felt it too?” The “King of Madness” was taken aback. He sensed it because of his own authority; what about her?
However, before he could ponder any further, Shana continued to speak directly,
“Can you pinpoint his exact location?”
“I have a rough idea, but I’m not sure, and it’s a bit far…” The “King of Savage Sound” immediately responded and gave Shana the direction.
This world doesn’t seem big from a planetary perspective, but once you enter, you’ll find that its true size is made up of many overlapping worlds, much larger than what the planet looks like from outside…
It wouldn’t matter if it was just large, but it’s also especially dangerous!
The presence of various high-level Containment Subjects was so numerous that the “King of Savage Sound” couldn’t have imagined it in the past.
And according to some information he had gathered over the past six months from some “acquaintances” who were once transferred to the Containment Realm by Rosen, he was almost certain that this place was so peculiar because it probably belonged to a certain tycoon’s permanent residence.
The world is somewhat calm for now, but it won’t stay calm for long because once the “Red Moon” completely fades, the true “God War” will erupt—
By then, even as beings of higher existence, there will be a risk of perishing!
“It’s alright. If it weren’t for the thousands of transit points we’ve come from so far, this distance wouldn’t matter. Since we have a rough direction, let’s start notifying everyone to take action…”
Shana spoke briefly.
In the past six months, her dozens of powerful avatars had established different organizations based on the local features in many of the world’s major regions…
In the direction provided by the “King of Savage Sound,” there were some forces that worshipped her.
This even included some non-human special races…
After speaking, she silently prayed in her heart, “Colin, wait for me, I’ll find you soon.”
As long as she found Colin, she would see if there was a way to take him to a safe place…

chapters.title: Chapter 874 - 874 586 Fuguang Association_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 874: Chapter 586 “Fuguang Association”_2 Chapter 874: Chapter 586 “Fuguang Association”_2 As for the rest, save the person first and discuss later.
…
A few days later, outside the disaster survivors’ gathering point.
“Colin, Colin, how old are you…” Children who seemed to be under ten gathered around Colin, curiously sizing up this fellow youngster.
“I don’t know, but I feel like I should be a bit older than this…”
Colin casually responded to the children while curiously looking around.
It seemed to be a corner of a former underground mall, but now it had been transformed into a gathering point for the survivors, bustling and somewhat like a marketplace…
People dressed in a chaotic manner, many faithful of different beliefs were seen passing by hurriedly.
Colin’s gaze swept across these believers of varied faiths—
Some instinct told him that these things should be hiding in dark corners like sewers, not openly scurrying above ground…
But for now, he didn’t feel a surge to deal with all these people.
His habit told him to investigate…
‘I… who am I? Why do I seem to understand so much at just a teenage age?’
Colin instinctively began to think.
The clearer memories he had were of recently gathering “scrap metal” to sell with some friends at a construction site, but various feelings indicated that it was a long time ago…
Not to mention his cognitive abilities, which seemed to be not that of a child.
‘Amnesia? It doesn’t quite feel like amnesia, more like waking up from a long sleep, mind a bit muddled, knowing, but somewhat unclear…’
Colin sat on a stool, properly pondering over things.
Meanwhile, a middle-aged man stood not far away, occasionally glancing at the young boy named Colin…
Although there was no solid evidence yet, he felt that his guess might not be wrong.
The one who had detonated all incoming abnormal beings along the way was this guy!
If it’s later confirmed, forging a good relationship in advance might mean they could all have a better life!
Being an Extraordinary One still held a high status currently…
This might be an opportunity.
Of course, if they were to proceed, they had to move to a better shelter, not this disaster survivor gathering controlled by the “Fuguang Church”…
The middle-aged man vaguely had the idea of sending Colin to a shelter in exchange for a better life.
Over the next few days, he continued observing, everything seemed normal so far.
The only time he was terrified was when some children, unable to stand Colin, banded together to trouble him and decided to teach him a lesson, while others were fine, the middle-aged man almost soared out of fear…
Fortunately, by the time he arrived at the scene, although everyone had been beaten up, with some seriously possibly having broken bones, thankfully no one died, which relieved him.
He then apologized and soothed them properly, but Colin showed no particular reaction, just saying it was nothing.
Back afterwards, the middle-aged man felt somewhat amused when he understood the reason. These kids wanted to teach Colin a lesson simply because his demeanor and looks were beyond his peers and many little girls liked him…
‘This old man seems to have some sly plans…’
The young Colin, looking at the middle-aged man, thought for a moment, but didn’t feel much malice, so he didn’t pay special attention.
At this moment, the things in his mind became clearer, and it felt like it wouldn’t take long to remember everything.
However, a vague feeling told him that once everything became clear, something very dangerous might happen…
“Ah, just take it one step at a time.”
Colin sighed, no longer racking his brain to recall, feeling like he wasn’t quite prepared.
In the following days, within the territory, Colin also participated in some activities. Everyone in the gathering had to engage in certain work, transporting things and building defensive fortifications, among others…
He also figured out various things; this place seemed to be a territory under something called the “Aurora Society.”
“It feels like something dirty that needs to be eradicated…”
Colin looked at a group not far away, collecting blood from catastrophes survivors, clothed in red and white, their pupils blood-red – the people of “Aurora Society,” and his brow furrowed slightly…
According to what they said, these were the upper class humans of the “Aurora Society.”
But looking at these “superior humans,” Colin couldn’t help but feel a sense of disgust rising within him…
And at his side, some children were even more terrified, not daring to look too much.
The blood donation this time didn’t require everyone to participate; as long as the quantity was sufficient, so, including Colin, the children were spared from this “responsibility” as much as possible.
It was at this moment Colin withdrew his gaze and looked somewhere else.
A middle-aged man, covering the blood-draw spot on his arm, pale-faced walked over to Colin, seeming to have something to say, yet appeared somewhat hesitant.
“What do you want to say, Uncle Cao Wen?” Colin asked curiously.
“There’s a chance tonight, we might leave, so don’t rush to sleep…”
“Okay.”
Seeing Colin did not refuse, the middle-aged man sighed in relief, if Colin had not agreed, he wouldn’t have been able to leave, after all, the main goal was to introduce him to the shelter.
Upon securing a connection, then he would take his group of several hundred people away from this assembly point…
When the blood donation ritual was over, the time approached evening, Colin, as usual, sat cross-legged in a small room, pondering…
Awaiting the action later in the night.
But then, a disturbance outside caught his attention.
He saw, on the broad street, people all coming out of their dwellings, gathering together, each holding a torch, all singing something loudly while marching toward a certain direction step by step…
Unsurprisingly, they probably intended to conduct some sort of ceremony.
Colin guessed if he wasn’t mistaken, that place seemed like a square or some other broad space.
Considering what the middle-aged man had said, he felt, most likely the other party wanted to take this time to leave the gathering point without attracting attention.
“Leaving like this isn’t ideal…” Colin rubbed his chin.
He always felt, perhaps it would be more appropriate to burn all these heretics before leaving…
But doing so would be very risky.
It seemed it might invite some extremely terrifying danger…
“Strange, I have such a good temper, and I usually don’t pick fights with others, why do I feel like there are enemies everywhere?” Colin’s thoughts were slightly diverted.
At that moment, he suddenly heard some noises…
He thought it should be that middle-aged man, but unexpectedly, a few children who usually had a better relationship with him came into the room, all tearfully.
“What’s wrong?” Colin scooted over to the side, making space and asked curiously.
“Doctor Sister has been chosen as a Fuguang Messenger…”
Upon hearing this, Colin’s eyes slightly narrowed, a flicker of fire seemed to stir deep within, but his face showed no emotion as he said:
“‘Fuguang Messenger’? Isn’t that a good thing for you?”
He had no clue what that was, but he seemed to remember that people here had some sort of faith to some extent.
“We, we don’t want Doctor Sister to become a messenger, if she does, she won’t recognize us anymore…”
While sniffling, they continued to speak intermittently, and Colin began to understand the situation.
Once someone becomes that “messenger,” they would become Extraordinary Ones, with greatly enhanced abilities, but their personality seemed to be completely altered, transforming into devout followers of the “Aurora Society’s” “Master.”
Eventually, they would completely forget about these children, and never see them again…
Listening to their description, a term popped up in Colin’s mind—
“God Descend Vessel.”
“These damn scoundrels…”
Suddenly, an indescribable loathing surged, Colin took a deep breath and said:
“Take me to them…”
Regardless of the risk, some things, indeed, need to be thoroughly burned!
In a flash of thought, a flame flickered deep within Colin’s eyes.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 875 - 875 587 Why Dont You Kneel
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 875: Chapter 587 “Why Don’t You Kneel? Chapter 875: Chapter 587 “Why Don’t You Kneel? Leading a group of children with red-rimmed eyes, Colin made his way directly toward the crowd engaged in the ritual. He did not initiate conflict, but instead intended to proceed as a participant of the ritual.
The people did not obstruct their arrival, but instead, moved forward with varying degrees of piety towards a certain direction in the back…
Colin and the others easily blended into the crowd that seemed to be in worship. Then, he observed these people, instinctively calculating something in his mind.
“It seems that most of them are not deep Believers. There is still some value to be salvaged here, although a small portion hold very deep beliefs, but that’s not a big issue…”
“As long as they haven’t undergone a transformation of life’s hierarchy, there’s still a chance for reversal.”
Looking like he was just a little over ten years old, Colin, as if self-taught, quickly understood many things.
It was as if he often engaged in such activities…
And behind him, five children of about the same size followed.
Although they had some conflicts with Colin earlier, after being taken care of several times, each and every one of them became obedient and began to see him as their “leader” after watching Colin occasionally intervene and defeat the adults with ease…
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have sought out where he lived the moment something went wrong.
However, just as Colin entered the crowd, a middle-aged man of medium stature who had agreed to bring Colin back recently saw that the ritual was in progress and that no one noticed him, immediately planned to call people to leave first.
According to his plan, they would move in a small group tonight without drawing attention, leave first and then communicate with the refugee camp authorities. After thoroughly negotiating terms, they would then relocate their group of over a hundred people…
In his view, given the strength demonstrated by Colin, he would definitely become a valued guest at those powerful refugee camps.
And he and his fellow “referrers” would thus enter a better environment…
But just as he was fantasizing about a bright future, he discovered that he had come up empty-handed upon his arrival and then learned of Colin’s situation from a few children who had not yet moved…
His face changed instantly, and he hurriedly turned to find his way out.
Luckily, he found Colin, who was leading a few children, in the crowd quite quickly.
After all, the other party wasn’t hiding…
But, not so good was the fact that Colin did not seem to plan to leave with them as previously discussed…
Right then, the middle-aged man wanted to step forward and stop him, but for some reason, looking at the “child” who was probably not much taller than his waist, he suddenly felt nervous.
Still, after a moment of hesitation, he stepped forward and placed his hand on Colin’s shoulder.
Then, he tried to hold onto him, only to find that the youth had astonishing strength, and was completely immovable…
“I…” The middle-aged man just wanted to start speaking, asking him not to act rashly, but then he saw Colin stop in his tracks, stand firm, and turn his head to look at him, “I’m preparing to get Dr. Xiao Chen out. Is there a problem?”
His tone was very calm, but the middle-aged man tensed up inside, clearly feeling some dissatisfaction in the other’s voice.
Dissatisfied that he had not spoken of the female doctor’s situation…
In the subtly electric atmosphere, he wanted to say something, like being chosen as an emissary is not necessarily a bad thing, or that confronting the enemy with such directness would likely lead to the death of everyone, and so on.
But in the end, he couldn’t bring himself to say these words and could only withdraw his hand…
Colin didn’t say much and continued with his actions, and behind him, a few children who had always followed also started to get a bit scared, “Colin, are we really going over there…”
Facing the absolute “hegemony” within the congregation point, their emotions stabilized a little, but they began to feel somewhat frightened again.
“Don’t worry, although I can’t explain the reason, I am actually quite confident in my strength.”
Colin casually finished speaking, paused, then added, “However, for safety, you all shouldn’t follow up, better hide…”
After convincing them to hold back, Colin continued to move forward.
He could faintly sense the situation of the entire refugee congregation point and discern that there were not many places in this area that could pose a threat to him.
Even those “Extraordinary Ones,” who appeared superior in the eyes of many, felt to him as if they were not much stronger than ordinary people.
“A normal person could be killed with one punch, these ‘Extraordinary Ones’ are probably about the same; at most, they can withstand one punch, but no more…”
“The only potential problem could be me using certain abilities…”
“Well, just need to be a bit careful in that aspect.”
As thoughts flickered, Colin saw that a few meters behind him, several children had been dissuaded by him, but for some reason, the middle-aged man followed.
He did not pay it any mind and continued to advance.
At the same time, as if by habit or instinct, Colin reached into his pocket and opened an independent spatial area…
Within the space were many strange objects, though most of them had some cracks, as if damaged.
Colin looked over them for a while, then casually grabbed a sticker that was somewhat torn and ragged with cracks. Although he did not know what it was, he had a general understanding of some effects—
It could enhance one’s physical constitution.
“Feels like something I use often, should be no problem.”
Colin didn’t think much of it and stuck it on his arm.
He felt the upcoming battle was almost a sure win.
But he had to avoid injuring the innocents, which required more strength because he not only had to ensure his own safety.

chapters.title: Chapter 876 - 876 587 Why Dont You Kneel_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 876: Chapter 587 “Why Don’t You Kneel?”_2 Chapter 876: Chapter 587 “Why Don’t You Kneel?”_2 According to Colin’s observations over time, his understanding of the “Aurora Society” was that they were relatively milder compared to other Heretic Forces—although Colin couldn’t recall any other Heretic Forces at the moment.
But that was just a feeling, at least on the surface, the “Aurora Society” seemed somewhat milder.
Still, they were not mild by much…
Colin remembered that Dr. Miss once mentioned that the powers under the “Aurora Society” seemed to regularly go out to rescue a group of people at various gathering points.
After being saved, this group would inexplicably become fervent believers in ‘Aurora,’ willing to make certain self-dedications.
At least from what she knew, most of the people were not necessarily willing to be “rescued” before they were assisted.
“Heretics must not be kept.”
Colin pursed his lips and started walking, vaguely feeling that his mindset seemed to have undergone some insignificant changes.
A few minutes later, he saw the main body of the ritual…
Dr. Miss and several other chosen ones, surrounded by an assembly of believers dressed in white with mysterious red patterns, were moving toward a brightly shining area deep inside.
Tens of thousands of disaster survivors, torches in hand, followed—
The reason for following, however, was not because everyone was a believer, but because extra supplies were distributed here, so they followed.
Colin looked at Dr. Miss in the crowd, her expression very calm, but within this calm… there seemed to be some indescribable struggle.
Others might not perceive it, but for some reason, he could feel it more clearly.
This also meant that things had not reached the last step…
Then, Colin wanted to continue following to see what exactly the “Aurora Society” was planning to do at the end.
But for some reason, he walked straight out of the crowd…
“What are you doing?!”
Upon seeing Colin enter this area without kneeling to the moving delegation, but continuing forward, a person in charge immediately walked over quickly.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
Colin wasted no words, drawn a revolver, and shot them in the knees.
The sudden change made everyone’s expression freeze for a moment…
The next second, accustomed screams spread as people scattered in all directions, and although the ordinary believers without Extraordinary Power were startled, those who survived were not utterly disoriented by this incident…
They immediately looked for cover and began to fight back!
“Invade! Invade! An Extraordinary One from a Heretic Force is invading us!”
“Quick! Fight back!”
“Go and get the masters from the ‘Aurora Society!’ Also protect the ‘True Believers!’ We must not let these heretics succeed in ruining our ritual!”
…
The ordinary believers of the “Aurora Society,” dressed in white clothing with red mystical patterns, communicated loudly while pulling various firearms from under their robes…
Suddenly, gunfire erupted…
Shortly after, they discovered an unbelievable scene—all the bullets shot toward the intruder fell to the ground for unknown reasons…
After a bout of fighting, aside from adding a few more people clutching their knees and crying out to their side, no results were achieved.
The opponent, holding a revolver and walking while firing, forced them into a corner with sheer firepower!
“Damn, what kind of pistol is this! It’s more powerful than a few of our light machine guns!” someone cursed helplessly.
“If you drop your weapons now and raise your hands to run, I might temporarily spare you,” Colin’s voice was not loud, but it clearly reached everyone’s ears.
“It’s not possible!” someone shook their head vehemently.
“Alright then.”
Colin pursed his lips, raised his hand, and aimed a shot at the knee of a believer trying to resist next to him.
“Ah!!”
Instantaneously, the person was crying on the ground, clutching their shattered knee.
“Just a shot to the knee, and he’s like this…” The person who just opposed Colin, seeing his companion so fragile, shook his head disdainfully while pulling a homemade double-barreled pistol from his pocket, demonstrating his resolve…
“Aaah!!!”
However, the next second, as the gunshot rang out, he clutched his knees and let out a scream more piercing than his peers.
Seeing this, Colin’s lips curled into a taunt,
“Sorry, these are special type bullets. Even when they hit the body or even the head, they might not be fatal, but they do bring immense pain. However, I don’t have many of these bullets left, so I hope you all can be sensible…”
During his speech, his weapon began to glow due to everyone’s stares.
And a bright aura burst forth…
Although it didn’t serve any practical purpose, it made him appear stronger to others—and then he really did become stronger!
Eventually, a large group of ordinary Believers, cornered and overwhelmed by the ever-approaching Colin, saw their defenses collapse and raised their hands, fleeing…
When they saw the young man, bursting with energy, not attacking after lowering his weapon, more people began to drop their weapons and run.
As long as it was out of fear and retreat, it essentially severed their willingness to return to the “Aurora Society.”
“Die, Heretic!” a disguised member of the Fuguang Association, having neared Colin, suddenly charged at him…
With this speed, the opponent definitely couldn’t react fast enough!
“Bang!”
“What were you thinking? Aiming and shooting takes less than a tenth of a second…”
Colin said casually.
Soon, most of the crowd had left, but there were still about a dozen who hadn’t moved, blocking their bodies in front of Doctor Miss and a few other “sacrifices.”
“If you don’t leave soon, there won’t be much time left…”
Colin walked slowly forward, looked at the staff, and without any courtesy, shot each one, knocking them all to the ground.
However, just as he was thinking about how to restore Doctor Miss and others to their normal Status, he suddenly felt something, turned halfway, and looked towards a nearby group…
Several figures clad in white with red patterns and fiery red eyes charging towards him.
The Extraordinary Ones of the “Aurora Society!”
Red mist swirled around them, dissolving everything it touched.
Then, upon seeing a child not even chest-high to them, raising a pistol at them, the Extraordinary Ones, initially serious and believing they were facing an invasion by Heretic Organizations, couldn’t help but burst into laughter…
“Is this it?”
One of them sneered, “It seems executing ordinary people has given you some unnecessary courage; let me show you what really distinguishes an Extraordinary One from an ordinary person…”
Before he could finish, he suddenly felt an intense sense of peril.
Then…
“Boom!”
The muzzle flashed before him, and before he could react, the next second, his vision spun wildly, and his head seemed to be uncontrollably thrown off…
The massive 155mm bullet, upon hitting his chest, completely obliterated his thoracic cavity.
“Too much talk.”
Colin tersely commented, showing no mercy against these beings who had undergone certain lifeform transformations.
Amidst the sound of gunfire, Colin casually strolled into the core square of the ritual as if he were walking off a meal.
Ahead in his line of sight, a white statue, encircled by numerous wings, stood imposingly.
A large number of Aurora Society Believers stood before him, looking calmly at the approaching young man…
“I see you haven’t killed any ordinary people and have shown mercy. Why then do you resort to killing upon meeting the ‘Master’ who has saved countless from disasters, and His Believers? And why won’t you bow down?” an elderly voice echoed from one side.
Colin withdrew his gaze from the statue, casually replying,
“Who would kneel to a domesticated animal?
“Besides, if we’re merely discussing who has saved more, then I think, it should be kneeling to me.”
…
…
…

chapters.title: Chapter 877 - 877 588 The Masters 13 Disciples
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 877: Chapter 588 The “Master’s” 13 “Disciples”. Chapter 877: Chapter 588 The “Master’s” 13 “Disciples”. Beside that giant statue, which was sanctified yet filled with a certain grotesquerie and absurdity, Colin encountered the person whom he had just spoken with.
An elder in white robes, his visage aged but eyes extremely bright and spirited, gave off an impression of being exceedingly amiable at first glance…
And surrounding him were dozens of believers from the “Aurora Society,” all donned in white garments.
Each person had a serene, uncontested gentle warmth on their face…
It seemed as though they weren’t the slightest bit angered by Colin having killed more than a dozen of their Extraordinary Ones on his way here.
Behind them, the middle-aged man and others who were in hiding had thought about escaping with Colin if things went south and he couldn’t win.
After all, with such a commotion, it was highly likely that the people from the Aurora Society wouldn’t let them off…
Instead of waiting to die, it would be better to wait for a “mutually assured destruction” before making a move.
What they didn’t expect was that this “Returner from the Deep Sea” they had picked up from the beach would be so powerful. Against those once-invincible and terrifying Extraordinary Ones from the Aurora Society, he won with ease, as if slaughtering chickens!
You should know, although the Extraordinary Ones’ bodies couldn’t exactly be immune to bullets and could still be damaged if hit,
the issue was their physical prowess, which made it near impossible for ordinary people to even land a blow on them!
But this circumstance completely failed against that “youth.”
Even if the enemy was fast enough to leave afterimages, too swift to catch with the eye, Colin could still casually hit them with one shot at a time.
One shot per person, coupled with some kind of special protection on his body, the enemy’s long-range attacks seemed to be stopped by an invisible wall of air upon reaching him.
Thus, all along the way, he appeared unmatched, faced with virtually no obstacle as if he were entering an uninhabited land…
‘I have brought back what kind of freak exactly?’
The middle-aged man, crouching behind cover, was dumbstruck. In his silent muttering, he suddenly noticed a pile of shattered limbs on the ground, along with parts of bodies that were mostly mutilated but still twitching, not completely dead yet.
He couldn’t decide whether to marvel at Colin’s strength or the tenacity of the Extraordinary Ones’ lives; even reduced to a bloody mess on the ground, they still seemed to struggle a bit.
It was precisely when the middle-aged man’s heart was shaken that Colin, staring at that elder who seemed to be the Bishop of the Aurora Society, was also rapidly pondering some things in his mind:
‘Compared to those from before, these are probably what you’d call true believers…’
According to the customs of the Aurora Society, it seemed they did accept the allegiance of some other Extraordinary Ones…
Their level of belief wasn’t very high, more like a mixture of fear and some respect.
But this group around the elder was different; because their belief was sufficiently deep, a faint white light glimmered on and off their bodies, giving them a rather sacred and peaceful appearance.
However, that was not the reason Colin stopped his attacks. He refrained from continuing largely because he felt a similar aura coming from the statue.
But it was just a semblance; there seemed to be quite a few differences…
Meanwhile, upon hearing Colin’s earlier “blasphemous” words, a small fraction of the people around the elder, who was faintly radiating white light, showed signs of anger, wanting to say something.
But the elder raised his hand to stop them, then clearly yet rapidly began to speak:
“I can see, even towards the most ordinary humans, your attitude is relatively amicable and willing to exert effort on their behalf, and this is also what my ‘Master’ practice, to carry out as much salvation as possible amid cataclysmic disasters…
“You and I ought to walk the same path; now, there might be some misunderstanding between us…
“Perhaps, we could try to communicate and unravel the misunderstanding.”
As he spoke, the faint white light on his body became more distinct, radiating an indescribable power that invisibly influenced those around him into submission.
Nevertheless…
Colin was unaffected.
“The same path? I reckon you’re thinking too much. I’ve probably seen enough of those shouting about saving the world, but I’ve hardly seen a few that truly possess mercy.”
Colin said this as his attention shifted from the elder to the comparatively familiar sensation of white light on his body, frowning—
If there wasn’t the need for some enforceable life transition or a total change of thought, turning someone into a certain type of believer…
Actually, everything might be forgivable, even so-called ‘blood donation’; if some power needed it at a crucial moment, Colin thought that it might not be unacceptable.
After all, in essence, it was about using that power to protect more people…
But besides that, the near complete cognitive conversion equated almost to eliminating a person.
It was one of the lines Colin deemed uncrossable.
This group not only crossed it but seemingly took it for granted.
Even if he felt a strange familiarity with the white light, that couldn’t absolve their transgressions.
“My ‘Master’ is certainly kind-hearted. He has personally promised us that before the calamity comes, He will open the gates of paradise for the weak and helpless…”
The elder stared at Colin, his gaze faintly flickered with white light.
Hearing this, Colin felt an increasing discomfort, but before he took action to settle this place completely, he inexplicably felt he should be more cautious and gather more intelligence to avoid making a misjudgment.
After all, the deeds of the Aurora Society and even the nature of the light itself instinctively repelled him, yet the familiar feeling made him worry about potentially harming his own people.

chapters.title: Chapter 878 - 878 588 The 13 Disciples of the Master._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 878: Chapter 588 The 13 Disciples of the Master._2 Chapter 878: Chapter 588 The 13 Disciples of the Master._2 “What is it that you believe in? What do you call it…”
Hearing Colin’s words, the old man clad in a red-striped white robe, his face covered in wrinkles, revealed a devout smile:
“My ‘Master’ is the arch-enemy of all evil, the light of hope that responds to the helpless…
“When that most wicked era descends, under the celebration of the thirteen chosen disciples, messengers, and those who follow and adore Him, He will cast His merciful gaze…
“His disciples will pave the way for us to a serene and peaceful future…
“…”
Listening to the other’s words, Colin furrowed his brows; he just wanted to ask a name, to clarify some things, but why didn’t it ever end?
As the thought flickered, he was about to interrupt the other party’s monologue, when suddenly a chilling sensation arose.
At that moment, he vaguely felt as if something was watching him…
He abruptly woke up and noticed that the twisted and bizarre sculptures had seemingly grown somewhat larger in just the short two minutes of the conversation…
Moreover, the sculpture, which was originally wrapped up like a cabbage, had also unfolded quite a bit.
This allowed him to see, in the gaps where the layers of wings spread, something wrapped up, curled up like an embryo.
That thing, with its large eyes closed, gave off the feeling that they were about to open at any moment!
‘No, this isn’t right! This thing… and this old man, claim to be answering my question, but it seems more like some kind of chant, and from the beginning, it probably affected my status. Otherwise, given my character, I should have already disposed of them!’
Colin blinked fiercely and immediately, through his own “rich” combat instincts, realized the cause of this situation.
He definitely wasn’t seduced by the other’s words, never once considering whether to comply…
But the other’s methods sidelined that, to an extent, tying words to dampen some of his murderous intentions, making him relatively calm—
This influence was slight and could even be considered a positive “enhancement.”
After all, many times, Colin, or normal people, would need to calm down, stabilize, rather than be muddled.
Through some “positive” influences, the other party objectively led him into a trap!
If it were someone else, someone without those combat instincts, they might not have even realized what was really going on!
At that moment, Colin didn’t hesitate, quickly drew his gun, and aimed it at the old man’s head.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
Large-caliber “bullets” flew out, but they passed through their figures…
Optical illusions… Colin raised an eyebrow, and under the instinct of his body, he turned his gun, preparing to rapidly fire towards a direction in the field.
However, before he could pull the trigger, a certain distortion occurred in the scene before him.
The “lights and shadows” twisted, resembling looking through a kaleidoscope.
“Whoosh…”
In Colin’s pupils, fire surged, dispersing the chaotic world, and without hesitation, he immediately pulled the trigger.
This time, a tactile feedback of hitting a solid object came through…
And in that moment, the area before him, like a shattered mirror, revealed the true situation.
There was not much difference in the arrangement from before, except that everything had shifted slightly.
The direction he had originally looked in and where the enemy actually stood were entirely two different directions, hence the initial missed shots.
“Uh…”
Despite many believers shielding him in front, the old man, with his right limb and part of his chest blown open, was stunned, not expecting that everything seemed to be going well, only for it to turn around in an instant.
Moreover, the visual displacement that was very effective against other high-ranking members of Heretic Organizations was easily discerned!
But fortunately, by now…
he was just one last step shy from completing his task!
Just that final step, and he could summon a “Disciple” from the “Aurora Society” within the current holy site, to either kill or subdue the enemy before him!
Numerous believers moved forward, using their bodies to shield from the gunshots, sacrificing their lives in an attempt to block the powerful attack from the enemy.
As they sacrificed themselves to protect him, the old man’s eyes widened in anger, and he shouted loudly:
“The third disciple of the ‘Master’…”
As he spoke, a twisted light emerged from the center of the sculpture, and behind the light, a vague, tall yet deformed hunch-backed figure could be seen, its hand dragging a weapon that resembled both a scythe and a cross.
The terrifying aura, despite the distance, was still heart-pounding.
‘A second-level individual bestowed with higher powers, is relatively troublesome for me now…’
‘Without utilizing certain tools, it’s hard for me to eliminate him instantly; I need to resolve this prior.’
‘Otherwise, even if I manage to survive, the ordinary people here won’t withstand this level of confrontation.’
As thoughts flashed through his mind, Colin saw, amid the mockingly smiling old man’s lips.
It was as if everything was already too late…
Unaffected, Colin calmly and swiftly drew out a golden card.
However, just as he was about to solidify the current area and eradicate all hazards, a sudden change occurred!
The gradually forming Gate of Light suddenly halted and then directly collapsed…

chapters.title: Chapter 879 - 879 588 The Masters 13 Disciples._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 879: Chapter 588: The “Master’s” 13 “Disciples”._3 Chapter 879: Chapter 588: The “Master’s” 13 “Disciples”._3 And behind that old man, a young man in the same church attire used a dozen spear-like “Light” javelins to pierce the old man’s body completely, ending his last call for help.
“You…” His trembling gaze shifted, he looked incredulously at the one he had thought was a devout “Believer.”
Facing his gaze, the young man glowing with white light returned it with a smile:
“That was close, almost let you heretics bring disaster here…”
While speaking, he detonated the “Light” javelins, blasting the aged body into pieces scattered across the sky…
Watching this unfold, Colin furrowed his brows.
The power emanating from the man and the aura of the “Aurora Society” were very similar, yet a closer look revealed clear differences.
For instance, that white light on the man seemed more “extreme” and pure compared to the “Aurora Society”…
Yet peculiarly, this “extremity” did not repulse Colin; instead, it evoked an inexplicable sense of familiarity.
“What’s your situation?” he raised his revolver and aimed it at the man.
Seeing the young man point his gun at him, the young man quickly raised his hands in explanation:
“Don’t get agitated, I’m… not exactly one of you, but I definitely mean no harm. My main aim for infiltrating here was to disrupt the ‘Disciple Ritual’…”Although Colin appeared very young, he was not one to be taken lightly.
The man quickly conveyed his situation through “Inspiration,” coupled with his words, to avoid any misunderstanding.
Before Colin arrived, he had left his own refuge to seek vengeance, infiltrating one of the “White Night” Heretic Forces, the “Aurora Society,” for quite some time.
He had even managed to become one of their “elite Believers.”
Then, hearing the lower-ranking selection ceremony for the “Disciple Ritual,” and when others couldn’t make it, he immediately came here as a deep believer of the “Aurora Society,” prepared to cause disruption.
But unexpectedly, just as he was contemplating how to stop the event, an unexpected change occurred.
A “child” appeared out of nowhere, taking him by surprise with the most brutal methods, fighting his way straight through to the inside…
Although he still did not know the details of this boy, he felt there shouldn’t be any issues.
Furthermore, upon being questioned by Colin, he simply identified himself as coming from a refuge and, due to certain reasons, had been saved and become an Extraordinary One through the “Light” pathway, with strength roughly at the Sixth Level, approaching the Seventh…
As for more, he did not seem to reveal any intention of disclosing.
Colin nodded and did not inquire further. Seeing this, the young man breathed a sigh of relief, sensing that the misunderstanding had likely been resolved.
Now, he just had to figure out how to communicate with the boy to understand his origins…
During their recent exchange, the man had shown a clear understanding of the official hierarchical system, preventing him from concealing too much information.
However, just as he thought they could continue communicating, he suddenly saw the boy raise his hand toward him…
The young man was taken aback but had no time to react; it felt as if a force pulled him, and he flew directly towards the boy…
He couldn’t even resist this force!
Just when he thought he was done for, he found that the boy had merely grabbed his collar and flung him behind him.
“I’ll do my best to evacuate everyone soon; you are responsible for keeping them stable…”
The Sixth Level Personnel from the refuge was startled by these words, and following the boy’s stern gaze towards his original standing spot.
Glancing over, he saw the Heretic Believer corpses that were scattered around began to transform, turning into a multitude of gentle white lights. They floated up like rising dandelions, flying toward the twisted God sculpture in the center of the area.
Meanwhile, what should have been the followers of the “Aurora Society” turned into silhouettes of light, kneeling on the ground devoutly.
“Disciple? I thought I had severed the path… No, that’s not right, not disciples, it’s, it’s…” The young man’s eyes widened as he realized a chilling possibility and instantly turned pale!
“God Descent?! Impossible, how could a mere point of convergence being destroyed trigger a ‘God Descent’!”
He uttered in disbelief.
As far as he knew, since the “Red Light” had descended, these great beings would definitely not descend for such a “minor disturbance” during this time period.
Because it required a significant price to be paid!
He even doubted whether he was hallucinating.
But the very next second, before he could finish speaking…
A terrifyingly immense pressure suddenly descended!

chapters.title: Chapter 880 - 880 589 The Ceaseless Descent of Terror
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 880: Chapter 589: The Ceaseless Descent of Terror. Chapter 880: Chapter 589: The Ceaseless Descent of Terror. Disaster survivors gathered at ground level, in the center of the square.
In front of the devout believers kneeling and praying.
A twisted yet sacred-feeling stone angel appeared to come to life at that moment, slowly unfurling its wings, and from beneath those wings, emanated the clear sound of a heartbeat, like that of an embryo’s, still unformed as a baby.
Along with the rise of the heartbeat, rings of gentle light began to spread…
Its tightly closed eyelids trembled slightly, as if they could open at any moment.
Even though He had not truly arrived, a terrifying oppressive presence already covered the scene!
Everyone in the area, and even those farther away, felt this rapidly approaching, dreadful aura, recalling the earth-shattering calamity that happened just a few years before.
In that horrible disaster, the same suffocating sensation of despair erupted daily.
Almost two years had passed since then, and that kind of presence had not manifested much during that period.
Everyone thought those beings had finally left.
But unexpectedly, they had appeared again!
In an instant, ordinary people lost their reason and plunged into extreme fear, collapsing on the ground in weakness, shuddering in tears, or screaming shrilly, completely succumbing to an indescribable emotional breakdown.
Moreover, a section perhaps due to faith in the “Aurora Society’s” Great Will, or maybe being too close to the God Descent site, fell trembling to their knees, faces void of emotion, whispering indistinct prayers…
“How the hell do you fight this…”
The young man, barely meeting the standards of a Level 7 official strength, stared at the scene before him, his expression somewhat dumbfounded.
At that moment, he felt that he could stand there, closely directing his gaze at such a presence without dying, not because he was strong, but because the “Light” within him was special enough.
After all, numerous examples had proven that it could greatly preserve the sanity of lower-leveled Extraordinary Ones when facing various terrifying enemies!
Of course, excessive use could also make one’s emotions grow numb.
But compared to that, the young man was baffled in his heart, unable to understand how such a trivial matter could provoke the descent of “White Night.”
Only weeks before, beneath the wings of “White Night,” the “Second Disciple” and “Fifth Disciple” had been killed by three Ninth Level Personnel, in collaboration with several senior company employees, without causing a God Descent.
After all, what he did was nothing more than disrupt a disciple ceremony that didn’t even count as a final selection.
The entity behind one of the disasters had actually appeared…
Wasn’t this overestimating him far too much?
However, amidst his shock and unwillingness, the young man suddenly noticed something: “Why hasn’t He descended?”
Withstanding the overwhelming terror coming from in front, he struggled to lift his head, moving his eyeballs to look ahead, and noticed that with each opening of the immaculate stone statue’s wings, they would contract slightly, and those slightly trembling eyelids—it wasn’t so much trembling…
Rather, it was as if for some reason, it simply couldn’t open its eyes.
As though it was caught in a struggle at a stalemate.
And the reason for the stalemate…
Thinking this, under some intuitive guidance, he turned his head to look at the “young man” who had brought him here and then cast him aside…
Only then did he recall the words that seemed to hint at something before the descent of “White Night.”
It was as if he had been instructed to take care of the ordinary people and leave later?
He wanted to ask for clarification, but the oppressive presence made it hard for him to move, unable to even open his mouth.
Taking a deep breath, he quickly inquired using his still unrefined “Inspiration” technique.
“Can you escape?”
Although he had not observed any actual signs of combat, intuition told the young man that, were it not for this youth, that dreadful entity might have already arrived!
In response to him, Colin did not immediately answer, instead continuously fixating on the statue that seemed to come more and more to life.
Only after delaying by two seconds did Colin imperceptibly nod his head.
Compared to the young man, who knew nothing, Colin was very aware that this thing was coming for him!
Now, with his left hand in his pocket, he was touching the card “Time Reversal”!
If not for using this card at the crucial moment to hold the other back, bringing the scene into a continuous state of “Reset,” a disastrous event would have likely already erupted.
But for now, that was all he could do.
Because the moment Colin restrained the other in urgency, he also felt a strong oppressive force converge entirely upon him…
If he avoided it, that “God’s might” would erupt.
Everyone in this area, even the official Extraordinary One beside him, would not survive!
‘This guy, is he trying to confine me here with ordinary people? Either I run away myself and all the survivors die, or I move everyone away and I stay here alone…’
The former was the easiest choice…
But Colin chose the second: “No matter how you look at it, it wouldn’t be right for these people, who’ve barely survived disaster after disaster, to die here all because of me…”
However, right at that moment, the young Sixth Level official personnel saw him nod and seemed to make a decision!
“Then hurry and take those people and leave! I’ll hold it off for you for a while! Since His target is you, we absolutely cannot let Him succeed!”

chapters.title: Chapter 881 - 881 589 The Endless Arrival of Terror._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 881: Chapter 589 The Endless Arrival of Terror._2 Chapter 881: Chapter 589 The Endless Arrival of Terror._2 Although he still didn’t know the origin of the child before him, the fact that White Night would descend especially for him meant that it must be prevented!
As a member of The Gods before him, no matter what they intended to do, there was only one choice—destruction!
As for the price…
After that “unremarkable” day a few years ago, he had already gradually lost all he could lose, what remained was nothing more than a wretched life, like an ant, daring to defy The Gods.
His only plan was to create as many obstacles as possible for this entity and figure out ways to foil Their schemes.
Colin was momentarily surprised at the suggestion, but then he shook his head, responding under the pressure:
“I appreciate your kindness, but what I am facing is definitely not something you can withstand.”
Although the “Light” on the other person did have higher resistance to certain contaminants.
It was too weak and of little significance.
He wouldn’t last even for a moment; Colin barely needed to release a fraction of the pressure he was enduring for the other party to likely die on the spot.
The other party must have thought of this idea because they saw him standing here “too easily.”
Thinking he himself could do it—
‘Not everyone is capable of making a sacrifice.’
As the thought flashed by, Colin didn’t make further associations and prepared to act, planning to quickly activate a series of card effects to transfer everyone out of there in a short period of time.
But, at this moment.
A gentle glow suddenly emerged before his eyes, and for a moment, Colin seemed to see a figure enshrouded in numerous wings, whispering to him:
“Do not be wary of me, for I am the Light, and also the beacon of hope…
“You should trust me, and follow without reservation, offering up your loyalty…
“And I shall provide you assistance, point out a new path, and grant you the right to stand at my left hand.
“When I descend, a brand new world will come.”
In the generous murmuring, there was a hint of a child’s naivety.
However, this naivety did not affect its standing, but rather made it appear even more Divine.
“Just you?”
Colin raised his head with an arrogant expression: “Have you been in the asylum too long, lost your mind?”
He could feel the incessant Divine light of the Angel Envoy trying to alter his brain…
But as soon as these invisible spiritual disturbances entered his body, they were like stones sinking into an ocean, completely incinerated, unable to influence him at all.
Simultaneously responding, the movements of his hands did not cease.
“Boom!”
With the sound of an invisible engine, everything within a radius of several kilometers was pulled into an invisible stasis.
The still-forming, un-descended vessel of God Descent, having to struggle against both Time Reversal and Time Freeze, also found it difficult to exert force…
Seizing the opportunity, Colin, relying on a mix of intrinsic physical intuition and memory, activated the effect of a new card!
“Spatial Displacement.”
The power to slice through space like a rule rapidly spread out, and within mere seconds, one could almost say that people began “disappearing into thin air” in large numbers.
The young man beside him sensed this scene and was immediately shocked because he hadn’t seen how the other had acted at all!
“A power of some rule?”
Unable to detect any trace of the Extraordinary Power’s operation, he could only see its effect, such a scenario is perhaps what legends refer to as “Authority” or the power of “rules.”
And just as the other was about to transfer him away as well, a sudden pulsation arose within him.
He felt in the depths of his mind, amidst the essence of his own Extraordinary Power, a subtle ripple reaching out to him.
This made his thought processes extraordinarily swift at that moment.
All things seemed to slow down in his eyes as though in a movie’s slow motion shot.
At the same time, he realized what this subtle vibration was…
It seemed as though some powerful existence from the same path was attempting to acquire some information through him.
At that moment, the young man recalled incidents from the past.
The peculiar aspect of the “Light” path was that among Extraordinary Ones there seemed to be an innate way to sense each other, and through this, sometimes they could receive support from other Extraordinaries on the same path.
He had heard about this phenomenon before but had never witnessed it…
Yet it had actually happened to him!
And just then, some information emanated from that glow, which he began to understand—
“Seems like I need to provide the view to pinpoint this location?”
Without much thought, seizing the moment, he “lent” out his own view.
Then, as the young man was wondering what the other party planned to do through him next, the scene before his eyes suddenly shifted.
In the change of scene, he found himself in a unique space that seemed covered by lava.
Here were ordinary folks all around, looking utterly confused…
“I’ve been moved?” The young man was taken aback, then he realized that as soon as he arrived here, the person communicating with him had left through the path.
However, it appeared that the other’s objective had been accomplished…
“That’s the last I can do for you, bro…” the young man let out a breath.
He then began to approach the survivors, who, along with the ground beneath them, had been transferred here…
…
Meanwhile,
Colin noticed that during the transfer of the young man, he suddenly felt a very familiar gaze glance at him.
But the situation at hand didn’t give Colin a moment to contemplate this; within this Time Stop, after transferring everyone, he wasn’t just sitting idly.
He lunged forward, closing the distance between them, and within the effect’s range, he directly used “Repulsion Burst.”
A terrifying shockwave burst out toward the stone statue sculpture in front.
With a “boom,”
The pristine giant statue fragmented as if a shattered mirror, its pieces flying outward…
However, just as they flew outside the effect’s range, they reassembled, morphing back into the lifelike giant statue that seemed about to open its eyes.
But Colin also noticed that it seemed as though it had no intention of opening its eyes…
“Is it unable to open its eyes for some reason?”
Colin was taken aback, faintly understanding something—it was probably related to something that hadn’t dissipated in this world.
However, the crisis was not over yet!
“Thud!”
Suddenly, a painful, booming knell echoed out from the White Night statue.
A pale orb of light appeared in response…
Inside the orb, there was a single figure, kneeling as if in prayer, holding a weapon like a scythe or perhaps a cross, slowly standing upright.
“The First Disciple, my first follower, go forth, you are meant to be here, to execute my will…”
“I obey Your Will, my Master.”
With that, the figure stood, its one pair of wings incomplete as if still undeveloped, suddenly spread open and from beneath the wings, hundreds to thousands of chains condensed from light burst forth.
“Hmph.”
Watching the chains, Colin was not tense. He extended his hands forward, and a powerful wave of force charged out like a barrier.
On the first collision, all chains were deflected.
And it was at that moment…
“Thud!”
As the resounding bell tolled, another orb of light emerged not far away.
Inside it was a similar figure, but atop this figure shone flickers like half-burned flames of lightning.
Without waiting for White Night’s whisper, this figure spoke up reverently on its own, “My ‘God,’ do You wish for me to bring down divine punishment upon the sinners?”
Before the voice had faded, it seemed to receive the answer, propping up with the cross scythe, and slowly rising.
“Crackle!” Like flames, blazing white incandescent lightning burst forth.
Another “Disciple” wielding strange lightning attacked towards Colin!
Colin, slightly flustered, dodged the attack and then, pointing at the first “Disciple” through the Golden Card, he endowed “Gravity” upon them.
Everything including the lightning, except for Colin, was pulled towards it.
This seemed to hit hard, causing a fair number of feathers to fall…
However, there was no time to celebrate.
“Thud!”
Within the prolonged bell tone, yet another “Disciple” arrived instantly.
“The Seventh Disciple…”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 882 - 882 590 Dont be afraid leader Im coming
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 882: Chapter 590: Don’t be afraid, leader! I’m coming! Chapter 882: Chapter 590: Don’t be afraid, leader! I’m coming! “Thud!”
“The Eighth Disciple…”
“…”
“Damn it, will this ever end?!”
With another misshapen figure rising from the white glow, its wings adorned with bird feathers, a towering form stooping with a scythe cross in hand, Colin finally couldn’t help but curse under his breath.
This guy wasn’t only prepared for battle, outnumbering his opponent without any honor in warfare was one thing, but he just kept on summoning reinforcements…
You hear about Disciples summoning the Master, but this was the complete opposite!
Moreover, each of these “Disciples” possessed considerable combat strength…
Just a few exchanges were enough to level the entire area, once a gathering point for disaster victims, into a new expanse of ruins amidst the terrifying aftermath of their clashes.
The thing that troubled Colin the most was the incredible resilience of these “Disciples”.
Even direct hits from the Golden Artifact were withstood without much trouble…
In a few minutes of intense fighting, Colin’s best achievement was taking advantage of a moment when the Fifth or some Disciple left an opening, using “Swap” to slice him into dozens of pieces and scattering those fragments hundreds of kilometers away.
Theoretically, he should be dead, for “Swap” severes all connections between each fragment.
But seeing “The First Disciple” survive the Charge unscathed, one second shattered and barely alive, the next fully revived, Colin suddenly felt uncertain.
It seemed that these things could hardly be killed unless they were instantly eradicated…
And if they weren’t dealt with quickly, they seemed to keep summoning endlessly, impossible to kill off!
From “one” to “eleven”, excluding the “Fifth” he had just killed, eight Disciples had already arrived on the scene!
‘Really picking on me for having no one to summon…’ Colin fought with increasing depression, the power of “Vibration” erupting from his hands, creating fine black fissures through space.
Then, he combined it with “Repulsion” and blasted it all away.
One punch dispersed all the figures…
At the same time, he concentrated that force to create a protective area around him.
At this moment, after battling for several minutes, the only piece of good news was that after the accumulated summoning count reached eight, the tolling that had Colin’s heart pounding had finally stopped…
Whether it was because there were none left to summon or for some other unknown reason, no new figures were added to the battlefield aside from the dissected “Fifth Disciple”.
Of course, this didn’t mean the pressure eased…
These Disciples, each with a “White Night” trait at their core, managed various types of extraordinary powers: some excelled in close combat, others at range or stealth attacks…
A full array of tactics were at their disposal, and Colin’s “young” body had already accumulated multiple cuts.
His left leg bone was completely fractured; had it not been held together by flesh, it might have just fallen off…
Besides these, that semi-animated “White Night” giant statue, though no longer summoning, began to change tactics, casting a kind of special white light…
Under this light, Colin had no trouble fighting, but he just felt extremely uncomfortable.
Every move he made felt awkward and unnatural.
In stark contrast to his discomfort, the Disciples seemed amplified, becoming even more resilient!
With their recovery strength further enhanced…
“Boom!”
Within the invisible roar of engines, Colin once again employed Time Stop, pulverizing a Disciple skilled in “Deception” and “Illusion” into a bloody pulp.
He didn’t even have time to check the results of his attack, seizing the moment to tear open a rift and flee.
Regrettably, he had not gone far when hundreds of chains blocked his escape route…
It was just a brief hindrance; the Disciple he’d almost turned into sauce recovered swiftly and launched an attack on him. In a hasty exchange, the others under the will of the “White Night” giant statue joined the fray.
“Common tactics are ineffective at killing these things; their powers are too balanced. Trying to escape, but because it’s fixated on me…”
Colin felt the weariness in his body and the heaviness in his heart. Although the true power held within his Golden Artifact was strong and could extricate him from the current predicament if fully unleashed, any one of them could aid his escape.
Regrettably, he was unable to maximize their potential…
So while they were good enough to hold his own, to truly break free from trouble, he was missing something crucial.
“Now, to break through this situation, do I have to control the Bonfire again?” Colin felt the terrifying force of the Flame within him—
It too was eager to burst forth, desperately longing to incinerate everything before him.
Colin believed that this power he “had never used” was strong enough to change the current state of affairs.
But…
An equally intense sense of crisis warned him.
Once unleashed, the situation could escalate in an instant to an unimaginable degree.
However, it was just in the moment of hesitation and distraction that Colin violently felt a strong sense of impending doom in his mind, and an image of death flashed before him:
A figure not unlike the other Disciples, covered in white flames, stabbed its scythe into his ankle. This blow wasn’t fatal, but it led to the other Disciples swarming him.
Countless glowing chains, the tips of scythe handles piercing from all directions, tore through him.
In a rush, Colin quickly countered, using all kinds of artifacts in combination to narrowly escape the seven Disciples’ combined death blow, and then, after a moment’s thought, decided to try something on the giant statue.

chapters.title: Chapter 883 - 883 590 Dont be afraid leader Im here_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 883: Chapter 590: Don’t be afraid, leader! I’m here!_2 Chapter 883: Chapter 590: Don’t be afraid, leader! I’m here!_2 The thing dared not open its eyes, and if it got close, it would find a way to force it to open its eyes.
That might trigger some unknown mechanism, forcing it to leave this land, this world,
And thereby find another turning point…
However, just as he started to move, Colin’s figure halted, and a sense of deadly crisis surged wildly in his heart—before the previous image had even fully dissipated!
He knew only that a major threat was coming, but he didn’t know the specifics.
“Damn it, is this a combo specifically targeted at my ‘Deadly Insight’? Just a bit more time until ‘Time Stop’…”
But under the intense premonition, all Colin could do was rely on instinct to make an emergency defensive maneuver.
The next second, accompanied by a “crack”,
The protective barriers around him suddenly shattered, and Colin saw, an Apostle, unbeknownst to him, having appeared behind him and to the side at a high velocity, both hands grasping the middle of a scythe handle, and using the spear-like tip at the end to thrust into his ribcage.
The powerful thrust far exceeded the effect of a bullet entering the human body.
Had Colin’s physical constitution not also been strong enough, just this alone could have caused an explosion similar to a regular person shot by Barrett.
Colin’s left hand tightly gripped the scythe handle, preventing the other from continuing to stab inside him.
Otherwise, continuing onward would directly pierce through many organs, destroying the heart—other places could be damaged without much of a problem, but the “heart” seemed even more special.
It seemed to be the gathering place of “Flame” within his body, and its destruction in such an unprepared state,
Would be a disastrous outcome.
“Sizzling…” The hand Colin used to grab the spear corroded with a sizzling sound, emitting the aroma of grilled meat, as if it were being scorched.
And because of the Charge, a tangy, rusty taste surged in his mouth.
However, why?
Hadn’t all the “Disciples” present already avoided it?
Colin was puzzled for a moment, but the answer quickly came to him; this was the Fifth Disciple he had “dismembered” before!
‘He’s not dead, and that thing pulled him back? Damn, I was a bit careless, my attention was on the others all the time, and I forgot about this…’
