“Only by staying alive can we possibly succeed in the end!”
“Understood,” several nodded their heads, assuring Colin that they would do their utmost to complete this mission.
Seeing that their morale was good, Colin looked up at the sky, where in the heavy lead-gray clouds, there were faint hints of vermilion glow, breathing in and out weakly…
But overall, it was fading away at an imperceptible rate.
The group watched Brother Shunzi’s “bold” move with some apprehension, watching those things in the sky directly…
It wasn’t something ordinary people could manage.
One could easily encounter significant problems…
But it seemed like Brother Shunzi should be fine.
A few seconds later, Colin withdrew his gaze and spoke:
“The matter should be actionable during this period, prepare yourselves…”
He needed to wait until the next “Red Moon” essence dropped below his mental expectation before considering action.
That way, he could minimize the risks as much as possible.
After all, he only had one chance for his act; once the Bonfire flared up, he would be exposed under the high-level Containment Subjects’ sights, and there would be no easing then…
So, it was necessary to prepare as well as possible.
Then, leading this group of employees, Colin came to a desolate and silent little world that seemed to have undergone something.
Although called a little world, its area was also about half the size of Asia.
Perfect for a battlefield…
“The rest is just waiting for the opportunity.”
Colin murmured to himself.
This time, he didn’t have to wait too long; almost on the eighth day, around 16 hours and 31 minutes, Colin suddenly sensed something and then closed off.
In a flash, he invoked the power that hadn’t been used in a long time inside him.
“Whoosh!”
A terrifying blaze erupted from Colin’s body, the scorching flames shooting up to the sky like a volcanic eruption, and within seconds, piercing through the heavy lead-gray clouds, puncturing the overcast veil…
“Hisss…” Upon seeing this, the employees, even though they had witnessed Brother Shunzi’s outburst several times before,
were still taken aback upon seeing it again…
However, the fiery light between heaven and earth did not last long and suddenly dispersed.
Colin lowered his head, seeing next to his hand, there was a special letter from “Lady Rabbit.”
Inside, there was what he needed.
A heart, a skull, several special cards, some inspirations from other “Reservist Flame Bearers,” and a few other “small items.”
“Today, knocking at the gate, I want to see, what ‘Primordial Fire’ is like, why it always seems like it could be successful soon, yet it never manages to draw the fire…”

chapters.title: Chapter 895 - 895 596 Almost Approaching Primordial Fire. _2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 895: Chapter 596 Almost Approaching “Primordial Fire”. _2 Chapter 895: Chapter 596 Almost Approaching “Primordial Fire”. _2 Colin made a decision, and with his right hand, he pulled a burning eye from the “Storage Room” while holding it up to his left eye socket and pressing it slightly, his left hand summoning a blazing flame to burn the envelope.
…
At that moment, he slightly paused his movements, feeling a tremendous amount of somber gazes directed at him.
Underneath the far distance, the ground vibrated and cracked…
A large mass, like oil, continuously oozed eyeballs and mouth-like bubbles from all over its body, extending countless dark tentacles and seemingly sketching some bizarre curse, launching a distant attack against the blazing flame.
On another front, within a small world, members of the Heretic Church spreading evil beliefs exploded one after another. Their flesh and blood transformed into strange streaks of light, converging and melding together, then streaking in a certain direction.
Elsewhere, it seemed like nothing was there, but suddenly the air became exceptionally murky, and wherever this murky air spread, everything was enveloped in layers of grime.
Not only this, at the same time, from every direction, terrifying life wills arrived in various ways.
Most harbored aggressive animosity and mixed emotions of fear towards that throbbing flame—
In the distant past, their actions were mostly instinctive, although they were innately powerful and possessed high intelligence related to their own authority.
However, their wisdom, when it came to humans, was extremely abstract and incomprehensible.
As the years changed and the world shifted to its current state, they no longer acted purely on instincts from the past but were driven by something they had never experienced before, known as “emotions.”
They launched an attack on Colin.
Moreover, numerous ships of varying sizes, flying in the sky and at least ten kilometers long, began to charge.
Once they locked onto their target, they prepared to strike.
However, it was just when various beings had just torn through some defenses and burst into the small world particularly chosen by Colin.
A terrifying and invisible shockwave exploded, blocking the incoming attacks as much as possible.
“Let’s see who the fuck dares?” Amidst a furious roar, the “King of Madness” confronted the first wave of the most ferocious enemies.
Between battles with giants composed of abnormal frequencies, suddenly he pointed at the dome and the ships, “Is this a battlefield you ants can participate in? Die for me!”
As if capable of splitting space, the vibration spread, activating and then exploding numerous ship shields.
In the sky, like candelas of dazzling fireworks.
Still, despite blocking numerous attacks, the number of enemies was too vast, managing to restrain only a few, with more beings surpassing him, attacking the core area of this continent-like small world.
At this moment, along with Shana, all the Containment Subjects who had followed her were desperately fighting to protect Colin!
It wasn’t just a mere effort, but a desperate exertion!
This was their sole chance!
They couldn’t confirm whether this reservist “Flame Bearer” would succeed, but, regardless, they had to eliminate all external factors that could influence success!
The terrifying battle instantly reached an intense stage.
There were no probes, no tugging, just the most direct clashes!
The reasons for some high-ranking Containment Subjects fighting with all their might were equally straightforward—the reservist “Flame Bearer’s” success was unclear to them, but they knew, should it succeed, their fate would be worse than death.
In the clash of authorities, many regions of the small world spread out countless, like chaotic mists…
Some real objects, even within a specific extent, were directly reduced to two-dimensional or even lower dimensions.
It was foreseeable that the small world could not last much longer.
…
At the same time, outside the small world, numerous xenomorphic races were rushing in a certain direction, seemingly guided by some beings, approaching the core area of the battle.
However, at this moment, some employees charged out with their teams.
They launched fierce attacks against these enemies.
“Charge! If we can’t beat the big ones, can these small fry still hold me back?”
Suddenly, a door appeared out of nowhere and opened, and from within came humanoid “angels” whose torsos were wriggling flesh but heads, hands, and feet were all huge modern firearms.
Bearing only half a body, it was lifted into the sky by a pair of wings composed of bullets and firearms.
“Boom!” Suddenly, an electromagnetic cannon fired from the far sky, targeting the head of this “Gun and War Angel.”
No, it was targeting a Ninth Level Personnel entity starting from the waist down, fused with the head of the “Gun and War Angel.”
“Damn bitch! Eat your daddy’s big bullet!”
Amidst the man’s furious roar, the “Gun and War Angel” raised its two giant firearm-composed arms, firing energy particles into the sky.
In an instant, the massive bullet completely blew up a warship outside the atmosphere!
…
At the same time, the doors of a post-disaster super massive refuge opened under the control of a silver super Nano Intellectual Core, and hundreds of thousands of densely packed unmanned mechanical legions surged out.
There were also a few powerful human fighters among them.
This battle was crucial for everyone involved, encompassing every individual!
They had to give it their all!
Usually hidden, human fighters now ambushed key sites, launching fierce offensives against forces advancing toward Colin’s position.

chapters.title: Chapter 896 - 896 596 Infinitely Close to Primordial Fire
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 896: Chapter 596: Infinitely Close to “Primordial Fire”. _3 Chapter 896: Chapter 596: Infinitely Close to “Primordial Fire”. _3 …
In another large shelter…
“But if we do this, we’ll quickly use up all the ammunition, and if we run out, the situation could become very dangerous, leading to a destructive future…” a high-level shelter official said.
But before he could finish, he was rudely interrupted by a company employee who had been promoted to Shelter Manager, “Future? If we don’t fight now, there will be no future!”
“Fire! Fire everything, explosive or not, just get it arranged!”
“Anyone who fucking spews nonsense, drag them straight to jail! Anyone who dares defy me, shoot them on the spot!”
…
As the last bit of dissent was suppressed, missiles, both large and small, were launched toward the eerie armies surging across the Earth like phantoms.
…
When Colin burned the envelope and tried to charge at the “Flame Bearer” with a feeling that was almost right.
The once barely calm world of Earth boiled over again!
In this chaos, the only slightly safe place was at the center of all the vortices, also protected by the “King of Madness” and others—where Colin stood.
Under the bright orange and red firelight, everything still seemed normal.
However, even with the protection of “Bonfire” powers,
Thirty employees still experienced varying degrees of mental disorientation, and some even temporarily fainted.
Clearly, the mere proximity of those higher beings caused much mental instability…
“It’s still too high of an inspiration, if they were ordinary people, it’s unclear what would happen, it might even have been better.”
Fortunately, these were not life-threatening, so Colin felt no need to intervene.
At that moment, under his feet, a patch of “Flame Bearer’s Grease” was burning, his left hand held a burning “Flame Bearer’s” heart retrieved from the “Ghost Train Incident,” his right hand carried a revolver filled with “Flame Bearer’s Breath,” his left eye socket housed a special device made from a “Flame Bearer’s Eye,” and in his pocket was a severed hand with a mouth…
At that moment, Colin continuously activated these items, then drew in the breath to bring himself infinitely closer to being a “Flame Bearer.”
Or rather, at this moment, he had become a makeshift “Flame Bearer.”
He continually absorbed this terrifying power…
His aura also grew increasingly closer to the real “Primordial Fire,” to the truly meaningful “Flame Bearer.”
“I feel I’m getting closer…”
Colin muttered, his eyes swirling with flames, as if he saw the “Primordial Fire,” yet also as if he didn’t.
He could feel it, in the place where he “couldn’t see.”
The “Primordial Fire” seemed to be everywhere…
But when he looked, he found nothing, unable to touch anything.
After a while…
Colin suddenly fell silent.
Had it failed?
Unable to grasp, unable to see, he didn’t even know how it had failed.
It seemed within reach, yet he could not touch it.
Colin felt he was infinitely close to the “Primordial Fire,” even certain that he might have been luckier, gone further than others…
But still, the result hadn’t changed.
Just as Colin was about to sigh, he suddenly saw, less than a hundred kilometers away, strange plants suddenly sprouting from the ground, beginning to spread toward them.
“Has it been breached to here already? It looks like… we can hardly hold on.”
Colin sighed.
But before that thing got completely close, millions of incandescent light orbs suddenly rose from beneath the Earth.
The next second, an enormous amount of light shone on those advancing plants, casting a bizarre and terrifying shadow.
Shana didn’t hesitate and immediately launched a silent, yet fiercely violent attack…
Billions of lights focused at one point, pushing back that shadow which first broke through the hundred kilometers.
However, Colin knew when the enemy reached this distance.
The situation had probably already turned very bad…

chapters.title: Chapter 897 - 897 597 Kingdom in Cards
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 897: Chapter 597 “Kingdom in Cards! Chapter 897: Chapter 597 “Kingdom in Cards! “Boom!”
The space suddenly vibrated…
Amidst the dazzling light, Shana tore open a portal of light, pulling out a glowing orb resembling a “small world,” within which strange scenes flickered now and then.
Sometimes it was buildings, sometimes it was peculiar clouds glittering with gold…
Then, she swung this exceptionally heavy “small world” with the most brutish force, hurling it directly at a group of enemies.
As the orb flew, the radiant light on it kept shrinking.
Though it seemed to be diminishing, the core of the light grew more blinding and purer, making it hard to look directly at it.
Moreover, the surrounding light appeared to be absorbed by it, and despite its extreme brightness, it failed to illuminate anything.
Finally, accompanied by an explosive spread of “light” after the collision.
The entire area was enveloped by an intense blaze of light, forcing many figures to retreat as if they had seen a ghost…
Such power was highly corrosive for them.
A slight mishap could lead to contamination by the “Light”!
However, some entities were not overly fearful…
A figure, resembling a mummified corpse with hollow features, dry black skin like tree bark, dressed in a black robe, emerged. It bore a striking resemblance to the attire of ancient fortune-tellers.
But obviously, that was an image of the past; now, his body had already been taken over and turned into a vessel for invaders.
At that moment, he opened his mouth, reached inside, and pulled out a strange rattle wrapped in yellow talismans and stained with blood clots. He then shook it in his hand…
Seemingly conducting some kind of divination.
He shook it for the ninth time then suddenly stopped.
“Any action to stop Colin is very auspicious!”
From a mouth that had not spoken in ages, a spine-chilling whisper emitted.
And with those words, a pallid figure suddenly emerged, its torso resembling an underdeveloped yet immense embryo, flapping countless wings.
Under some mysterious enhancement, it rushed toward Colin.
The first to respond, Shana transformed into white light to intercept; however, another terrifying entity arrived and attacked her.
Though the impact on her was small.
But this brief delay was enough for the pale figure to break through the defenses and attack Colin from behind.
In haste, she could only conjure countless Chains of Light in an attempt to block.
But the figure called White Night, flapping its numerous wings, opened its wings, throwing out some “Disciples.”
“Prove your loyalty to me!”
In the “Master’s” whisper, they gave their all, their expressions frenzied as they blocked the incoming attacks, providing robust feedback for the “Master’s” push toward victory…
And at the center of everything, Colin stood quietly at the original spot, watching this scene unfold.
Watching the first figure that broke through the defense, watching it launch a deadly attack at him.
Colin and the figure seemed to be locking eyes across space, but in reality, his attention was not on his opponent at all. The failure to “attain the truth” left a trace of confusion in his eyes.
He felt an indescribable hollowness, as if all his efforts were in vain and meaningless.
But just then, Shana’s anxious voice reached Colin’s ears, snapping him back to reality somewhat:
“Watch out!”
Before her words even fell, a glaring light flashed before his eyes.
However, Colin’s thoughts were severely fragmented right now, with a significant part still caught in bewilderment.
Only a part of him barely looked forward…
It was clear that these higher beings were striving hard to erase him, a potential threat, even though, in a way, they still considered him a failure. Yet, they were still willing to pay a hefty price to completely erase him.
But before Colin could act, he suddenly felt as if someone magnified the negative emotions in his heart through some means.
Plunging him back into a state of utter listlessness.
“‘Primordial Fire,’ what’s going on with it? Why does it feel like it exists and yet does not? Why does it seem as if it has never existed? Why does it appear as if from the start…”
Colin muttered absentmindedly, lost in profound doubt.
Now, he felt that the “Primordial Fire,” in a sense…
Had never descended!
Not just now, but including the past, in all known ages, it had actually not appeared.
If so…
What “Fire” is being nurtured by the Flame Bearer?
Lost in thought, Colin felt deceived, experiencing deep depression and confusion.
It was as if after straining to the utmost, he found nothing at the end.
But before he could ponder further, a strong sense of crisis allowed him to regain some awareness from that turmoil, then he saw dozens of light spears flying towards him.
Most of which melted as they passed through the firelight.
The intensity of the “Bonfire” at the scene was enough to mitigate the direct attacks from upper-tier beings, even without him having to do anything.
Yet, a few light spears, carrying various intents as additional effects, broke through the encirclement…
And directly penetrated the body of Colin, who was immobilized on the spot.
An indescribable pain, fatal curses, and various additional attacks engulfed him in an almost death-like sensation—
However, this somewhat revived Colin.
Then he heard Shana’s voice, sounding unusually panicked.
She had not expected Colin to stand there immobile and take those absolutely fatal attacks!

chapters.title: Chapter 898 - 898 597 Kingdom in Cards_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 898: Chapter 597 “Kingdom in Cards!”_2 Chapter 898: Chapter 597 “Kingdom in Cards!”_2 “No, I can’t keep focusing on the ‘Primordial Fire’ anymore. There are more important things to handle!”
Colin looked at the dozens of melting light spears on his body, shook his head forcefully, and freed himself from those intense feelings of failure.
“O, envoy of the ‘Bonfire’, you should be extinguished here. I shall carry the world, for I am all hope, I am the light, I am death, the salvation that all the unfortunate crave…”
“Choose me, follow me, submit to me!”
“Become my cherished and sole ‘Disciple’, and you will gain supreme glory and the power to disperse The Night…”
“The sun will also rise once more.”
“I will forgive the sins of humanity, letting them become my people, eternal together with me in my God Kingdom…”
A pure and pristine-entity made of radiant light, unknown when it had approached, now hovered in the sky, flapping its vast and holy wings, its erect crimson pupils fixing on the figure below, extending the invitation once again.
In blood and excruciating pain, Colin straightened up, arched his back, raised his head, and met the gaze of the so-called “pale sun” that seemed capable of dissolving everything.
Then, slowly, he stretched out his right hand…
As if to touch that redemptive “light” and seek liberation for his soul.
“The right choice…” “White Night” whispered, then, under the glow of fire, approached Colin.
A wing transformed into a hand, reaching out toward Colin.
The pale light, bringing redemption, also brought a tsunami-like oppression…
A blessing from “The Gods” was being conferred upon “White Night.”
Though their success would mean adding a terrifying force under their command, it also meant that the threat of ‘Primordial Fire’ would be completely wiped out!
Faced with two evils, they chose the lesser.
They were carrying the vision of the Gods who wished not to see the ‘Primordial Fire’!
However, just as the light hand was about to touch Colin, it seemed suddenly startled, retracting rapidly and flapping its wings, apparently trying to burst outward…
But, at the same moment, Colin’s right hand flipped, and suddenly there was a revolver in its grasp.
Then, Colin raised his hand, aimed the revolver at the other party, and pulled the trigger without hesitation.
A loud “bang” was heard.
The muzzle flashed, and an inconspicuous bullet, in a conceptual manner, hit “White Night’s” crimson eye.
Blood fog exploded from the eye socket…
“Ah!!!”
At that moment, “White Night” suddenly burst into intense flames, letting out a earth-shattering scream.
“Without you, the sun will still rise, dumb bird!”
Colin suppressed the sense of decay in his heart and grinned, laughing.
“Did it work?”
Feeling the deadly threat to Colin, “King of Madness,” who had returned to defend at great cost, saw this scene, saw the familiar figure, and was immediately gripped by immense fear.
Until the next instant, when he realized he was almost safe, he breathed a sigh of relief.
And some higher life forms nearby also retreated together…
But soon, they realized that the opponent had apparently not succeeded, and what was happening now was more like a “final glow.”
At this moment, amidst the screams of “White Night,” Colin said with an indifferent gaze:
“Nowadays, I am in my strongest state. I didn’t expect that, in such circumstances, you would still dare to come close…
“I don’t even know who gave you the courage.”
“Look at those beings behind you; they are much smarter than you.”
As his words fell, fire danced in Colin’s left eye, and immediately, the flames on “White Night” intensified, countless feathers burning and falling like snowflakes.
Even “Light” can be ignited.
Colin continued to reach out with his right hand, making a slight gesture.
Its physical part, that undeveloped embryonic body, involuntarily flew towards his palm.
During this process, a spatial power emerged.
It compressed the half-mountain-sized “White Night” gradually, turning it into the size of a heart, which Colin held in his palm.
He casually tossed it up and down, weighing it:
“Although you are not the main body arriving here, there is at least about one-third of it here…
“But, no problem, let’s collect some interest first, and the rest, just wait nicely in your containment unit.
“I’ll come and burn you in a while.”
After speaking, he exerted force suddenly with his fingers and crushed the “embryo” in his hand.
At the same moment, inside a separate containment unit, the semi-detached “White Night” instantly wilted, as if it had lost all movement…
“Is it… almost gone?”
Nearby, Shana was taken aback, clearly sensing that some powerful life form within the same pathway was rapidly wilting.
Then, bewildered, she realized how difficult this thing was to deal with.
Had Colin managed to inflict heavy damage on it remotely?
“It was merely a slightly stronger half-finished experiment; the real danger should be them.”
Colin casually remarked, then looked up into the distance, seeing countless attacks rapidly approaching, seemingly intent on erasing him and his very existence.
“Seeing me in this state, they don’t run but instead charge at me…”
“Do they want to force me to use more power and completely suppress me?”
“Fine, then as you wish! Let me show you the power of ‘Flame Bearer’!”
While muttering to himself, Colin took out a skull engraved with numerous mysterious patterns, held it in his palm, and while looking down at those hollow eye sockets, he mobilized his authority:
“Brother Rosen, lend me your strength once more!”
As his words fell, the skull burst into flames, emitting a fiery, bright light.
Then, it slowly rose into the air, like a miniature sun.
At that moment, time seemed to warp, and everything appeared to slow down.
This enabled Colin to methodically make his final preparations. He took out a set of cards from his pocket and spread them out one by one…
“Special Card: Sealed Right Hand.”
“Special Card: Sealed Left Hand.”
“Special Card…”
Despite the various cards, fundamentally, whether “foot” or “hand,” they were actually clones of the flesh of the “right hand,” assisting in interpreting certain information uncovered through the skull, ultimately created.
As these cards were displayed one by one, they instantly transformed into streams of light and shadows, merging into Colin’s limbs.
Then, Colin gestured with his hand, and several Golden Cards appeared in his hand.
“Time Freeze,” “Time Reversal,” “Force Repulsion,” “Force · Attraction,” “Space: Transposition”…
“‘Item Liberation’ fifty percent…”
“No, it’s still not enough…”
Colin whispered, then from the skull above, twelve more flames fell down, coalescing into a translucent “Golden Card.”
Many cards weren’t real, merely reproductions of some projections.
And they looked severely incomplete…
Yet, even so, Colin seemed to think they were enough to handle the current situation.
Immediately, he slid his hand, grabbed all the cards in his hand, then casually glanced at them before tossing them away.
The incomplete seventeen cards were enough to change the current scenario!
However, to fully initiate and have “Card Divine Kingdom” descend into reality, one final condition was needed.
Colin took a deep breath, suddenly half-bent over, veins bulging, with a burst of momentum, he roared:
“‘Hunger’!”
[Your application has been approved, current quality: 5%!]
Endless blue-black fog burst forth and spread, a terrifying figure enveloped Colin…
Its eighteen arms twisted softly, and thousands of mouths produced sounds of hungry chewing and swallowing.
Then, under Colin’s will, the eighteen blue-black skin-hued arms suddenly stretched out, with seventeen hands each grabbing a card and swallowing them through the mouths in the palms.
The last one grabbed the burning skull in mid-air.
The next second, “Hunger” began to twist, forming a vortex.
Finally, behind Colin’s head, it transformed into a halo made up of seventeen golden lights surrounding a group!
Majestic divine might erupted tumultuously.
With Colin as the center of everything, pressure, reverence, and supreme power instantly enveloped the entire planet, and spread outward at a rapid pace!
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 899 - 899 598 Flame Bearers in the Darkness
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 899: Chapter 598: Flame Bearers in the Darkness! Chapter 899: Chapter 598: Flame Bearers in the Darkness! “From this moment on, in this land, ‘time’ flows according to my will, ‘rules’ are determined by me, ‘force’ operates at my command, ‘matter’ exists because I create or destroy it, ‘fate’ is woven by me. Everything’s trajectory cannot deviate from my will…”
“Kingdom in Cards, I am the King!”
Colin declared under the innate guidance of a prop.
Although all this seemed to have taken a lot of time, it had in fact occurred in an extremely short time.
When everything unfolded, “The Gods” were already too late to stop it!
However, terrifying figures were now in a predicament where, even knowing it was unstoppable, they had to brazenly step forward…
They were aware that this status could not last!
‘Kingdom in Cards is some kind of ‘toolized’ divine power…’
Colin sliced through the projections of several “The Gods” close to him, then assessed himself, feeling clearly that his mindset had become extremely indifferent—human rationality was rapidly evaporating.
He felt an assimilation towards something…
However, with the power of the “Flame Bearer”, he could still stabilize his self.
And although it was an enhanced version of the same power possessed by ‘God’, he used it critically, experiencing the narrow divine power within the confines of the small God Kingdom.
It wouldn’t take long, no big issue.
“Bang!”
Colin met their direct gaze, pulled out his revolver, and slowly raised his hand to pull the trigger toward the sky above him.
The gunshot wasn’t loud, but it clearly entered the ears of everyone present.
“The first shot, proclaiming my arrival!”
The flame-attached bullet tore through the skies, shot into the clouds, and the next second the earth shook, and behind the layer of clouds, flames surged…
Countless meteors penetrated the clouds, falling to the ground with immense force amid thunderous noise, targeting every presence there, leaving them no escape!
“Our own people! Our own people! Boss, I’m one of us! We’re all from the same side!”
Apart from Shana, entities like the “King of Madness” and others on our side who felt targeted suddenly started shouting in panic.
These meteors contained a special power, getting hit by one would be disastrous!
Colin turned his gaze to Shana, who nodded, and he then lifted the targeting.
“Colin…” Shana looked at Colin, sensing that there seemed to exist remnants of several others within him, no, several other presences lingering.
Not alive, but some kind of echo from those tools.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have failed to recognize “his own people.”
But before she could think further…
“Bang!”
Another gunshot that made one’s heart thud, Colin’s indifferent gaze, from a high-dimensional perspective, overlooked everything under the firmament, and slowly stated:
“The second shot, proclaiming the start of judgment!”
As his voice fell, Colin’s gaze turned towards a xenomorphic race.
On this land, they had committed unforgivable egregious crimes against ordinary people, and furthermore, these acts were driven by their entire race, with no innocent among them…
Without a doubt, they should be exterminated!
The next second, Colin’s will ignored distances, descending directly on their homeworld.
This place once belonged to a subsidiary of a company…
Unfortunately, it seemed the humans there had long been cleansed.
Without hesitation, Colin pointed, covering the area with his power, directly altering the internal pressure of the star system’s sun and blockaded all exits from this star system.
The rapidly expanding sun and the exploding celestial bodies would devour everything!
“No! No!” some scattered individuals witnessing this screamed aloud.
But before they could finish, they were ignited, turning into ashes.
…
At the same time, with another xenomorphic race, Colin used “Spatial Displacement” to throw a part of the erupting “Supernova” their way.
And he executed precise killings on the remaining individuals outside…
…
Elsewhere, with another xenomorphic race at their homeworld, once Colin confirmed the presence of a First-Level Containment Subject considered “God” by them, he sealed the space and directed a beam of light there.
Here, the light rapidly expanded, striking devastating blows to all living xenomorphic intelligences within an incredibly brief period…
…
Through various means, Colin promptly dealt with several xenomorphic races, evenly executing the “Extermination Order” on every sinner among the heretics.
In an incredibly brief period, he executed a massive number of heretical xenomorphs.
At the same time, company employees across the universe, through various means, after deducing predictions, suddenly widened their eyes—
That familiar scent!
It was the “Extermination Order”!
Emotions welled up in the veterans stationed in different branches everywhere!
After so many years, they finally felt the resurgence of such power, and what excited them even more—
If the “Extermination Order” has come, could the “Flame Bearer” be far behind?
However…
At this moment, Colin was not so optimistic; this power had only been activated for a short while, not even a minute, and his body couldn’t bear it.
His skin cracked extensively, and blood, under internal pressure, spurted out like fountains.
After staggering, the halo behind Colin collapsed, and the dark shadows emitted seventeen beams of golden light, then dispersed—while seventeen golden lights returned to their card form, then twelve completely disintegrated, leaving five tangible cards that slowly drifted down…

chapters.title: Chapter 900 - 900 598 The Firebearers in the Darkness_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 900: Chapter 598 The “Firebearers” in the Darkness!_2 Chapter 900: Chapter 598 The “Firebearers” in the Darkness!_2 Colin’s vision turned dark, and his body fell backwards amidst a splash of blood…
A pair of hands caught the falling Colin.
“Ha… It seems… still not enough.”
Colin tilted his head slightly, and after seeing Shana, he spoke with a hint of helplessness.
“It’s okay,”
Shana shook her head, and as their eyes met, she revealed an angelic smile.
She reached out to wipe the blood from Colin’s face and tried her best to contain the injuries inside his body. Then, as Shana was about to say something, she saw Colin slowly raise his hand and pass over a spherical orb of light.
Rings of light radiated from the orb.
Emanating from it was an extremely terrifying power…
“I never had the chance to give you anything, but now I finally do. This is a gift for you, a trait I just acquired,” Colin said hoarsely, lying in her arms.
“Thank you,” Shana accepted the thing.
The trait, containing a portion of “Authority,” was absorbed into her being as soon as it was obtained.
As a being of the same origin, she already had enough accumulation to quickly assimilate it completely into a part of herself.
And she could ensure that she wouldn’t be too disturbed…
However, this required a certain calm period, which she did not plan to leave for.
“I will stay with you until the very end, through pain, death, or eternity,”
Shana clung tightly to Colin, having agreed to come here and accept such a fate, with no regrets… and once again, she expressed her feelings to him.
Compared to other Saints, she felt she was fortunate enough.
She had found like-minded individuals; she wasn’t fighting alone.
“Hmm…” Colin did not say anything else.
Although he had previously destroyed a large number of entities, at the same time, Colin realized that beyond these ‘First Level Containment Subjects’ that had descended, there were many superior beings so powerful that even ordinary lower echelon subjects trembled in their presence, waiting indifferently for something.
Colin wanted to take them down, but they chose to avoid his edge, leaving him unable to strike.
Even, to be realistic, even if he pursued them, he couldn’t resolve them in a short amount of time.
Soon, it would be time for their true descent…
Almost nothing could withstand the backlash from these real “upper-echelon First Level Containment Subjects.”
But, Colin could no longer fret over this issue, as he felt darkness enshrouding him, as if something was swallowing him…
Possibly the “Night”?
Somehow derived from the trait of “Primordial Fire,” an inspiration made Colin aware.
All those who failed in their ultimate breakthrough would be devoured by the “Night.”
This entity did not affect anyone around, targeting only him.
“Colin?” Shana was the first to notice that Colin’s body was becoming “hollow,” as his rationality almost completely evaporated.
However, as for why this was happening, she had no clue.
And without time to think more, terrifying beings quietly descended.
With her lustrous wings, she wrapped Colin, and stood in front.
But, facing those dreadful beings, her and the “King of Madness” along with all the others could do little, and unable to retreat, the battle did not last long before Shana was gravely injured.
And farther away, many others also felt the utmost terror, praying dully.
After a while, nearly exhausted, Shana fell to the ground with Colin, turning into a ball of light, and fiercely protected him beneath her.
Terrible blood-red lightning struck down from the vault of the sky…
The light emanating from Shana trembled, yet there was still no sign of releasing her grip.
However, just as the upper-echelon terrifying powers were about to completely obliterate her, erasing all signs of her life, Shana, with a heart resigned to death, suddenly felt all the attacks vanish into thin air.
Before she could even wonder why, she suddenly felt Colin underneath her stir…
Shana hurriedly looked down, only to see Colin looking around blankly, unresponsive to her calls.
“Who is calling me…”
Colin rose, his eyes seeing only pitch black and within that darkness, countless voices seemed to be praying, praying for warmth, praying for hope…
“When the Night arrives, there should be one to light the Flame, illuminating all directions.”
This phrase echoed in his mind, and Colin with a near-blank mind, made a choice from the deepest part of his inner self, slowly stretched his hand into his chest, and with a gentle tug, pulled out a beating heart.
The moment it was exposed to the air, it burned intensely!
Then, like lifting a torch, Colin slowly raised it high.
“No need to fear, for I shall light the night,”
Colin began to speak slowly, watching the burning flame, as his human nature swiftly returned.
In that instant, the warm firelight responded to every shivering weakling.
And at that moment, it transported them one by one.
Several seconds later, accompanied by a sigh, Colin’s hand began to tremble, gradually lowering, and even though reluctant, it was to no avail…
“I have done everything I could. Will there be more hope for the future…”
Colin’s voice grew fainter, and as his hand slowly dropped, the light of the fire dimmed and disappeared.
And as his words fell silent, he did not move, as if he had lost all signs of life.
“Yes, you’ve done very well…”
Shana knew he might not hear her, but still spoke softly, then hugged Colin’s body tightly into her arms.

chapters.title: Chapter 901 - 901 598 The Flame Bearers in the Darkness_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 901: Chapter 598: The “Flame Bearers” in the Darkness!_3 Chapter 901: Chapter 598: The “Flame Bearers” in the Darkness!_3 Blood spilled from both sides mingled together, sitting in a pool of blood, silently waiting for the end.
When the final flicker of light dissipated, their fate could be predicted.
Before long, terrifying beings arrived once again. This time, just as she braced herself for the end, she abruptly realized something was amiss…
These beings did not attack her; instead, they seemed to block those from outside.
These…
If not mistaken, appeared to be some neutral, higher beings who had been, in a sense, mere spectators. Why had they suddenly come to assist?
It was then that she suddenly thought of something and turned her attention to Colin in her arms.
…
Meanwhile, in the darkness that shrouded everything.
Colin could feel the presence of a flame somewhere in the pitch black ahead, beckoning to him, but regrettably, he had no strength left to move forward.
The flame in his hand was not enough.
Humanity, too, evaporated as the flame dimmed, as if he was about to become a “living dead,” nourishing “The Night.”
“Alas…”
Colin slowly knelt on one knee, letting “The Night” draw closer bit by bit, to completely engulf his soul…
However, it was at this moment.
His shoulder felt as if someone had lightly tapped it…
How could that be possible in such a place?
Colin turned his head in surprise and saw a familiar figure, one formed of fire.
The figure was tall, his muscles knotted, looking very robust.
Big C Teacher?
No, not the living one, but an echo of the will he had once left behind.
After patting Colin’s shoulder, the figure didn’t make any extra movements but continued forward, leaving behind clear, fiery footprints in the darkness of The Night.
From that figure, Colin seemed to hear a whisper.
“I will carry the flame and expel all enemies!” The voice sounded young, presumably something Big C Teacher had said in his youth.
It was also the essence of his lifelong will.
At that moment, Colin seemed to realize something. Despite his body being exceptionally tired and strengthless, after receiving a portion of the fire reflected from Big C Teacher, he began to support himself and stood up.
Then, following those footprints, he walked towards the unknown darkness…
Just as he hadn’t walked far, Big C Teacher’s figure suddenly faded, and the fire gradually vanished.
Eventually, his figure disappeared a few meters ahead, and his footsteps came to a halt.
However…
It was at this moment that Colin witnessed an extremely shocking scene!
After guiding him to this point and disappearing, Colin saw, from the eternal darkness, more burning figures stepping out, heading in the same direction, leaving a trail of clear footsteps in The Night…
They were the former “Flame Bearers”!
Billions of lights seemed to break through the darkness.
Pointing the way forward for him, who came after!
Colin’s body felt warmer in the light than ever before, and he went on, following their steps.
Under the heavy, oppressive darkness, lines of fiery figures illuminated each other, sharpening their way forward.
Walking with the fire, whispers without consciousness echoed beside him…
“To live, to make humanity’s existence more valuable, that’s why I walk towards death.”
“To ensure humanity’s continuity, I willingly ignite myself, embrace the flame, give my all.”
“I will become humanity’s blade, crushing all of humanity’s enemies…”
“Those who betray humanity, kill.”
“Those weak who plead, I will shelter, even if my soul fades and my body has died.”
“…”
From them, Colin heard wills that seemed to be as concentrated as those of Big C Teacher, driving them to move forward…
Whether in life or death.
And among the fiery figures, some felt familiar to Colin, as if they had interacted in the past.
But at this moment, familiarity was not important.
Everyone moved forward, all on the same path!
They joined in this long relay that spanned time and space…
Towards the end, there were fewer and fewer burning figures, but using the strength passed down from each figure, Colin advanced step by step.
At some point, there were no more footprints around him.
However, at this moment, he, empowered by countless wills of fiery assistance, was no longer lost.
He continued to move forward in The Night…
Leaving behind a lonely but determined trail of fiery footprints.
The road didn’t seem long, but Colin’s journey was extremely difficult, each step as if exhausting all his strength.
He didn’t know if he would be successful, but it didn’t matter!
“I must go far enough!” Colin’s eyes were determined as he gritted his teeth. If he failed, others would follow this path and carry on!
Just like those who had left footprints at different times!
Finally, after an indeterminate time,
Colin stopped, slowly looked up, and saw a bright bonfire suspended infinitely high above his head.
It looked very ordinary, like an inconspicuous little flame, yet it held unmatched symbolism!
It was this that made the era of “humanity” possible!
On direct gaze at it, Colin could feel the rapid return of his evaporating human rationale.
“‘Primordial Fire’!”
Colin struggled to speak. He didn’t understand why the fire, a symbol of “humanity,” was in the depths of “The Night”…
But the moment he saw it, Colin was overjoyed as his heart was cleared of uncertainty.
Because it meant…
The “Primordial Fire” truly existed, it wasn’t false!
He composed himself, about to reach out to touch the flame, only to find an insurmountable distance remained…
A sense of powerlessness surged over him, and he began to fall backward.
That’s when a hazy, fiery figure appeared from behind, propping him up back to back, followed by more figures emerging, reaching out their hands to lift Colin little by little.
They willingly became the foundation.
Lifting Colin up, lifting those who lifted Colin, lifting the lifters of the lifters…
Elevating his position layer by layer…
Finally, surrounded by countless figures, Colin was lifted in front of the fire.
Driven by an instinctual desire for humanity…
He stretched out his hand, straightening his fingers, reaching as far as he could for the entity called “Primordial Fire.”
At that moment, the “Primordial Fire” responded, descending like tendrils or fingers of flame.
In the instant fingertips touched,
The “Primordial Fire” arrived.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 902 - 902 599 The Revival of the Flame Bearer
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 902: Chapter 599: The Revival of the ‘Flame Bearer’ Reservists! Chapter 902: Chapter 599: The Revival of the ‘Flame Bearer’ Reservists! The flowing flame came along his fingers…
Colin gazed at the flame, and a very primordial abstract image emerged in his mind.
In the darkness, a cluster of flames ignited.
Perhaps it was merely by accident or mere chance, with no special reason, that the flame simply appeared.
It startled many incomprehensible entities in the boundless darkness, yet some creatures, because of their own frailty, endured fear and despair, eventually drawn to the warmth of the flame…
Under the illumination of the flame, they shed ignorance and birthed the first wisdom.
At this moment, Colin understood even more why “human nature” was enhanced under the “Primordial Fire.”
Because, in some sense, when the first human distinguished himself from the savage beasts, despite the fear, came towards the light of the flame for warmth, observed the flame, and lifted it…
The first “human nature” gradually came into being.
The relationship between humans and “Flame” is exceedingly close, with most of their major achievements being completely compatible and consonant.
For non-human beings, the “Primordial Fire” radiates “human nature,” but there isn’t just one life form that is reflected in the flames, indeed, one could say, not just one type.
The reason it is so named is primarily because humans were the first to trace it back, understand it, and interpret it.
And they succeeded in establishing an accurate, clear, definitive definition.
Thus, it is commonly known as “human nature.”
“Is this the ultimate answer that those from the ‘Bonfire Company’ sought all their lives, paying countless prices for?”
Colin muttered to himself.
In the pursuit of the flame, the “Flame Bearers” are the true mighty ones born on this path, innately theirs.
Such power is harmless to humans, but for other things, it could be deadly.
Just like “Red Moon,” “Night,” these transcendent existences, it could directly deconstruct their foundations.
And at this moment, Colin seemed to have a sudden enlightenment, realizing his path or perhaps his mission since leaving the company era.
To reshape and establish the path based on “Primordial Fire” at its core…
Truly kickstarting the era that belongs to “human nature,” not letting those alien outsiders steal the fruits.
Thinking this, Colin reached out, pulling the flame completely onto himself.
Through the flame, he could directly leave this area that seemed to belong to the “Night,” yet appeared even more primordial.
As he escaped, his consciousness, belonging to Colin, condensed, also resounding through the darkness.
“I will win, keep winning, until everything ends!”
A trail of burning footprints was clearly visible in the darkness, and when future “Flame Bearers” are born, they must also walk the same path.
This time, the journey would not be so difficult.
…
“Whoosh~”
A faint flame ignited on Colin’s body…
Compared to the usual mountain-eruption-like noises, this flame was not loud, merely silently burning; if one didn’t pay attention, they might not even hear it.
But when it ignited, it instantly illuminated all the spaces within this small world.
Under the flickering light of the flame, even the residual red glow from the “Red Moon” was fading…
Terrifying figures felt their bodies stiffening.
The entire battlefield seemed frozen.
Be it allies or foes, everyone appeared stunned.
“What is this?”
Cradling Colin, just a second ago, Shana still felt the body in her arms growing cold, then the next second, inexplicably, a cluster of flames suddenly sprouted from him.
Being closest to Colin, the moment she felt the flame, she clearly realized this “Flame” was extremely unusual; although it seemed similar to what she had seen before, the difference was enormous.
Under its illumination, the part of Shana’s inner self that had become indifferent due to previous encounters with the “Light,” felt like it was rapidly filling up, becoming more complete—
It was believed impossible before!
At that moment, several screams interrupted her thoughts.
“Ah!!”
The heretics closest to the flames underwent a transformation, their life forms distorted, forced to shift from their original Higher Life Form state into human-like forms!
Then they even uttered the shock typically associated with humans: “How, possible?”
Impossible! There was no reason!
Previously, there were “Reservists,” even more powerful ones had failed.
Why could this one succeed?
It shouldn’t!
They could not accept this outcome!
As opposed to some incredulous guys, the battered “King of Savage Sound” and others had the exact opposite reaction.
“Did it work? It worked! It worked!! Hahaha!!”
Feeling his inner “human nature” rapidly solidifying, the “King of Madness” started to laugh madly.
At this moment, if anyone was the happiest, it was undoubtedly him and a group of rash “buddies” who had followed—
Protecting “Flame Bearer” reservists, they had succeeded in the impossible years…
It was settled, their lives were definitely saved!
But there was no time to think further, a sense of crisis erupted, an overwhelming amount of terrifying attacks came from all directions, their force far superior to before, seemingly desperate to go all-in!

chapters.title: Chapter 903 - 903 599 The Revival of the Flame Bearer
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 903: Chapter 599: The Revival of the “Flame Bearer” Reservists! _2 Chapter 903: Chapter 599: The Revival of the “Flame Bearer” Reservists! _2 “The King of Savage Sound” and his group had long anticipated this, ready to desperately defend themselves.
However, those who were prepared to fight suddenly saw some previously neutral entities appear in front, taking a considerable part of the attack.
“The King of Savage Sound” felt the pressure decrease but became more vigilant.
Facing his questioning gaze, one of the many “neutral” entities turned around, flashing a smile:
“A thousand-year-old fan, here uninvited…”
“Heh heh.”
“The King of Savage Sound” responded with a cold laugh, sensing that the reply came from a being “slightly above the lower tier,” close to the “lower-middle First Level Containment Subject,” whose strength was far above his own “lower-lower tier.”
In the past, he would have certainly fled…
But so what?
The past was the past, the present is the present, and once the company is functioning again in the future, when he sees him he must address him in whatever position he still holds!
Supporting Colin in completing the final step…
He couldn’t even begin to imagine how great his own contribution would be!
In the future, he would be truly and officially employed!
Not just some formally contracted external worker, nor a simple consultant, but someone who would have the opportunity to rise up the ranks, a truly official employee!
Perhaps he could become D+ level…
No, C+ level, no, no, no, even reaching B Level was possible!
The coming of the “Primordial Fire” held truly immense significance!
But just as he was getting distracted by his thoughts, a voice interrupted his mood:
“It’s a bit too early to be happy now.”
“Who!… Oh, it’s you, boss…” He turned around to find Colin looking his way.
Colin looked somewhat weak, being helped up by Shana.
As he opened his eyes again as a “Flame Bearer,” Colin could clearly feel that the world before him was completely transformed, the first sensation being that everything around him was flammable…
Next was his strength; he could approximately confirm that he had invisibly crossed a certain threshold. Even having just ascended, his combat power was enough to match many of the weaker First Level Containment Subjects.
Of course, that wasn’t the point; the point was…
The current powers of a “Flame Bearer” are really significant!
The company had prepared everything possible for the “Primordial Fire,” this “aircraft carrier” from personnel to weapons to escorting items, now it was just up to him to activate it…
But before Colin could learn more about the situation, he suddenly felt a terrifying aura descending from the sky like tidal waves.
In an instant, the clouds remaining overhead dispersed, leaving Earth exposed directly under the pitch-black night sky…
The outside seemed dark at the moment, but the next second.
Looking up from the ground…
Countless stars in the sky began to twinkle in an unprecedented, dense, and violent manner, lighting up the entire Earth as if it was midday during the polar summer!
At this moment, all the high-ranking beings at the top of the universe cast their gaze this way!
Even at a tremendous cost, they intended to crush their opposition right here!
This entire starry sky, just because of these “gazes,” was already boiling!
Together with the sun, all celestial bodies seemed to flicker like candle flames blown by a fierce wind…
“We can’t let these damned things come here!”
Colin felt his mind becoming confused, gritted his teeth, forcefully revived his spirits, looked up, and saw the gleaming stars that seemed to be getting closer.
But just then, Colin suddenly realized, their arrival didn’t seem successful…
Because the main paths they used appeared to have been dismantled early on and thoroughly blockaded.
Every direction and dimension, a severed hand was wildly ablaze.
At least, for the moment, their arrival was unlikely.
‘Lady Bunny’ had prepared for this long ago, hadn’t she.
Colin realized that the previous mission in the Fifteenth Ring was perhaps prepared for this moment.
However, although they couldn’t arrive, letting them continue to watch would also be extremely dangerous!
Because aside from external threats, many enemies still existed within…
Even though these were essentially existing in the form of “Containment Subjects,” it didn’t mean they were no longer a threat.
“Not before, but now, it is time to band together.”
Through some company mechanisms, Colin sent out a “Rally Command” in all directions!
“Bonfire Company”‘s remaining strength, once banded together, was still quite impressive!
And now, he had the credentials to have everyone head in this direction!
Colin raised his hand, a gentle flame in his palm erupted instantly, the terrifying blaze broke through the skies, enveloping the whole world, illuminating like a torch, dispersing the darkness for everyone, marking the direction and coordinates!
…
The first to sense and respond to this command were a group of people who had no choice but to choose slumber due to failure…
They too were once the closest existence to the “Primordial Fire.”
Only because of one reason or another, they didn’t succeed.
Now, when the “Primordial Fire” arrived, in that split second, they all revived…
On a non-human planet, within a colossal building shaped like a torch, there was a head imprisoned and drilled with multiple holes.
The head was connected to countless tubes, seemingly brain dead, but not allowed to rest, continuously tortured into screaming.
However, at this moment, it suddenly stopped screaming and emitted a strange laugh.
Next second, the head melted and burned, recondensing into human form.

chapters.title: Chapter 904 - 904 599 The Revived Flame Bearer Reservists_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 904: Chapter 599 The Revived “Flame Bearer” Reservists!_3 Chapter 904: Chapter 599 The Revived “Flame Bearer” Reservists!_3 “Hehehe, hahaha, fantastic, at last, someone succeeded, huh…”
He laughed insanely, assuring himself that he was only slightly mentally disturbed due to the torment, nothing serious, then with a gesture, a terrible flame descended from the sky:
“This is the power of the ‘Flame Bearer,’ this scent… Just right!
“Heretics, it’s time to settle the scores.”
The dreadful flame devoured the whole world in an instant, but pressed for time, he didn’t seek extensive revenge on the heretics who tormented him like the “Conservatives” would have.
He merely kindly detonated the entire planet, eradicated it thoroughly, and then left.
…
On the other side, in a galaxy, a celestial body orbiting a star received a certain signal and suddenly trembled, followed by streams of magma breaking through the surface, completely enveloping the celestial body…
Then, the body, seemingly made of magma, came to life and broke away from its original orbit.
Before leaving, it bid farewell to the star in the center of the galaxy:
“Dad, I’ve heard the call, I’m leaving…”
Through some enormous vortex, she arrived at a space region where a battle was erupting; the terrifying flames on her devoured all external foes and repelled a First Level Containment Subject.
The people of a subsidiary company’s territory watched in bewilderment at this fearsome existence nearly the size of their own planet.
Not knowing what this creature was…
And it was at this moment that this living celestial body, through a psychic transmission, issued a kind and gentle female voice to those present:
“Children, don’t be afraid…
“I am a D Level Employee, a follower of ‘Primordial Fire,’ and also a ‘Flame Bearer’ Reservist ‘Fusion Star’…
“Now, the ancient starry paths have been reignited, the rallying horns have already sounded.
“If needed, I will take you with me, responding to the ‘rallying command,’ and intercept all enemies of humanity…”
…
Battles erupted everywhere, many aimed at Colin, who wielded the “Primordial Fire.”
But there were also many actions targeting the ‘Flame Bearer’ Reservists…
A recently awakened ‘Flame Bearer’ Reservist, stepping out from the grave and about to act, was intercepted; these formidable beings seemed determined to hunt him down to weaken the ‘Bonfire’ power.
“Hunt us down?”
“In this era of extinguished fires, our place among the bonfires is because we are inherently powerful!”
A figure formed of flames responded disdainfully.
Then, he kicked over his own grave and pulled out his old body.
“Kindle my old form, sublime ascension!”
With a roar, terrifying flames burst forth!
…
Moreover, in a barren asteroid belt, billions of asteroids suddenly ignited, ancient war machines from a past generation slowly revived under the illumination of ‘Primordial Fire.’
Countless pieces of information were exchanged at faster than light speed, with frequent flashes of light.
“‘Primordial Fire’ Corps First Legion ‘Kindling Fire’ has received the command…”
“‘Bonfire Pipeline Network’ application submitted.”
“Preparations for total war entering phase…”
The mechanical voice echoed in the empty universe, causing some watching Containment Subjects to tremble.
At the same time, surrender requests were hurriedly issued to this seemingly unmanned war corps from the past.
It would be too late once they were fully activated…
…
At this time, compared to those dozen Reservists and some other ‘Primordial Fire’-related entities, other existences also became aware of the situation there.
“Did that little guy really succeed?!”
In a stretch of stars, standing on the front of a train, dressed in a black long dress, her body wrapped with looping thorns, bare ankles on the head of the train, the “Thorn Lady” spoke in surprise.
At this moment, having received a “rally” command and through some perception, she clearly saw the darkness that had conceptually obscured this universe retreating under the illumination of a cluster of firelight…
Given time, this veil covering much of the universe could likely be driven out.
The fact that it hadn’t illuminated everywhere yet also meant.
“Primordial Fire” really has arrived!
“Is it really ‘Primordial Fire,’ should we continue on the same path?” another female figure spoke from beside her.
“Primordial Fire’ is here! What’s there to follow! Change course, change course!”
“Thorn Lady’s” eyes lit up, and then sensing that a large number of enemies were approaching, apparently intending to launch a deadly attack on the newborn ‘Primordial Fire’…
Her gaze sharpened; she rolled up her sleeves un-ladylike, and spoke to an old friend she had found after a long search:
“Let’s go, annihilate these aliens!”
Having said that, she turned the train’s direction, but firstly not towards there, but back to her own planet, and with giant thorn chains, she bound it up; then like a small car pulling a big ball, she dragged this celestial body towards the distant direction in her mind, like a torch, embarking on a sacred expedition!
This time, with the consent of the ‘Flame Bearers,’ they didn’t have to worry about being rejected outside the walls.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 905 - 905 600 A Starving Camel is Bigger Than a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 905: Chapter 600: A Starving Camel is Bigger Than a Horse Chapter 905: Chapter 600: A Starving Camel is Bigger Than a Horse In a sparsely decorated, long-silent dark office, the lights suddenly turned on, and a woman in professional attire appeared behind the desk.
“Finally, we have reached this point…”
She seemed to sigh in relief as she thought this and calmly took out several documents.
The title of the first document read: [Incident: “Unyielding Guardians.”]
This was a mission issued years ago, which involved verifying if a member of the Descenders had infiltrated the main body of the company, with the requirement that the personnel involved expel them.
The rewards for the mission were extremely generous, offering a guaranteed million points or more upon completion, and the promotion to B Level Authority among other things…
She picked such special tasks every time she chose to be a Reservist.
By these means, she could send out some of her personal points and resources in a relatively “reasonable” manner at critical moments…
At this moment, this task, influenced by her and dispatched through certain mechanisms,
was to be retracted.
Her pen swiftly moved in her hand, and she wrote:
“After confirmation by employee number ‘654321,’ the intruder of this incident is the abnormal employee codenamed ‘Lady Rabbit,’ who, after cunning negotiation, has now been expelled from the core area…”
After finishing the writing swiftly, she wrote down her own employee number as another reviewer.
Then, she took out an almost entirely blurred seal and stamped it onto the document.
It seemed as though she wanted to force it through…
But at that moment,
[Notification: There is an anomaly in the details of this mission event; it will be submitted for review…]
Seeing this, “Lady Rabbit” showed no emotional fluctuations, seemingly not surprised—
In the present era, the only ones who had the qualifications to review the stamp in her hand were those with “emergency state special action rights” known as the “Flame Bearers.”
And there was only one “Flame Bearer” at the moment!
When the document entered the “review phase,” “Lady Rabbit” didn’t hesitate to take three crucial core documents from the desk.
On these, in simple black text on a white background, the codes for the anomalous Containment Subjects starting with “Level 0” were written.
“0-17 ‘Wall’.”
“0-09 ‘Hunger’.”
“0-19 ‘Is It a Coincidence?’.”
“…”
“Lady Rabbit”‘s gaze flowed over these, seemingly pondering.
These items had been used in the past but only very limitedly; now, they were to be fully unleashed.
After hesitating for a moment, she made a decision, began writing the related content, and through various agreements, opened up the true mechanics and conceptual forces of these entities for use across the company at all levels, to address the current crisis…
The current company needed some time to consolidate its power before it could proceed to the next step.
And then, if all went as expected, during this period, the “Primordial Fire” would guide some of them, including her, slowly back from beyond human cognition, of course, the return would also include those formidable foes that even the company dreaded.
So, even with the risks, it was essential to activate some high-level items now.
Before the appearance of the “Primordial Fire,” as long as this chapter was stamped, these few Containment Subjects were bound to cause significant issues.
But as long as the “Primordial Fire” existed, the “agreement” would be absolutely reinforced.
No matter how they lost control, they would remain within a controllable range.
Especially “Hunger” which would become a crucial force for many D+ Level frontline and other frontline employees…
“Snap!”
When everything was ready, the moment the stamp was pressed, the already cracked seal shattered completely.
But at the same time, the document had been approved and was about to enter the implementation phase.
…
On Earth.
A noisy, chaotic whisper descended from above.
Colin looked up at the frequently flickering and rapidly twisting starry sky, his scalp tingling.
At this moment, the universe was no longer pitch black, but filled with bizarre and eerie colors, flowing with indescribable terror.
From the current situation, the threats varied by region, simply dividable as the “Solar System” and a vast area blocked off by some kind of wall-like barrier known as the “Inner Circle.”
This was also where the majority of the rampaging First-Level Containment Subjects were located…
Then, there were those enemies beyond the “Wall,” who pretty much all existed in the current universe, powerful, yet not the main threat.
The truly horrifying causes of the “starry sky” flickering were those entities in the “outermost periphery”…
And that outermost scene, much like a raging sea, with dark clouds rolling, thunder flashing, and terrifying entities emerging atop the foamy waves…
Some existed in a microcosm beyond human imagination, some so vast they transcended scientific understanding, merely their figures completely obscured numerous galaxies, some resided in dimensions hard to detect…
In this surge, they cast terrifying gazes this way, attempting to influence by their means.
There was a feeling.
Colin felt that in this scene, many exceptionally powerful entities, seemingly shouldn’t exist in the current space-time…
But because of the “Primordial Fire,” they could look this way.
And at this moment, if it weren’t for the protection of the “Primordial Fire,” just facing this scene would cause significant mental trauma.
The only way to block the gaze was first to turn off the “Primordial Fire.”
But dispersing the “Primordial Fire,” might cause everyone to die instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 906 - 906 600 A Starved Camel is Bigger than a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 906: Chapter 600: A Starved Camel is Bigger than a Horse_2 Chapter 906: Chapter 600: A Starved Camel is Bigger than a Horse_2 So he had to hold on…
But by holding on, he would attract their attention.
The situation seemed to be getting worse.
However, it was at this moment that Colin felt an odd barrier start to strengthen…
Immediately after, the terrifyingly bright stars slowly returned to normal and dimmed, becoming a somewhat distorted, whispering but barely normal night sky.
“Phew, it’s darkened. My intuition tells me that ‘Lady Rabbit’ exerted her force, she… activated something very dangerous?”
In the flicker of a thought, Colin furrowed his brows, feeling it was somewhat like fighting poison with poison.
For now, the urgent matter needed resolution…
“Being a ‘Flame Bearer’ does come with troubles…”
Flames surged in Colin’s eyes, even though the external crisis seemed temporarily resolved, he could still feel it.
Ever since the “Primordial Fire” had descended, battles had erupted in almost every direction overhead, and each one seemed connected to the “Primordial Fire” and to him…
A massive number of enemies seemed eager to rush here to intercept him.
However, there were also many ally “branch members” blocking from all sides…
He even sensed the presence of some “Flame Bearer” Reservists from afar.
Upon further inspection, he discovered…
Among these still-living Reservists before becoming “Flame Bearer” Reservists, many had strengths seemingly surpassing his own?!
“What kind of monsters are these, so strong, and here I thought I was the most formidable one…”
Colin didn’t dwell on this awkward realization but shifted his gaze back to the battle before him.
Compared to the terrifying and desperate scene from earlier, he didn’t even know what words to use to describe the situation here…
“A farce?”
Many who were originally just bystanders wanting to see if they could snatch something here, decisively started picking sides—
No, it wasn’t when the “Primordial Fire” descended but just a moment before, perhaps a few seconds before, when Colin was still in the “walking” phase, that they had already made their choices.
“Can’t say much about other skills, but these guys sure learned how to speculate and profit quickly.”
Looking at some of these “pure bystanders” who outwardly and inwardly indicated intentions like “defending ‘humanity,’ supporting ‘Primordial Fire,’ it’s my unshirkable duty” or “that year watching the company collapse, sitting in the containment crying uncontrollably, now having the opportunity…”, “nowhere to serve, wandering many places…” Colin’s feelings were mixed.
Many “high-level” Containment Subjects had terrifying powers and were not lacking in intelligence, but their emotional expression was far simpler, far from the level of the “King of Savage Sound.”
And Colin didn’t know exactly what was inherited in some “humanity” traditions; he always felt these guys expressed themselves in oddly abstract ways.
However, these matters weren’t so important; at the moment, Colin indeed needed fighting power.
Besides, there were some higher entities originally besieging him, but suddenly they switched sides, showing intentions as if they had been “lying in wait” for many years just for this moment…
‘It feels like things are veering towards the magical.’
Colin muttered to himself internally, but overall, it appeared relatively safe here.
More accurately, including Earth, the Solar System was temporarily safe…
Although there were still about five or six high-level Containment Subjects, who seemed to realize they were completely “dead” with no chance of release, hence fought with all their might.
But they were caught up in the righteous brigade of the “Primordial Fire,” hardly causing any significant stir.
Even so, Colin felt that he could now utilize his privileges to immediately lock these high-level containment subjects nearby, cut off their signals, and solve the problem at its source.
He hadn’t done so because firstly, he had just gained these privileges and was not yet fully familiar with them, and secondly, it was to give these suddenly increased “reinforcements” some work to do.
Of course, another main reason was…
Colin discovered that in the nearby area, including things like containment facilities, launching many things required Points, needed an initial driving force to activate them…
Not much, possibly just a million points or a few million.
For a collective, this amount of points wasn’t much, but for an individual…
It was a bit troubling.
Especially for Colin who had just risen to this position and truly didn’t have any.
The points in his pocket, not to say there were none, could also be described as barely significant.
‘I thought ‘Points’ were some kind of credit currency, never expected they aren’t, and their production method, though complex, essentially, are burnt from the ‘Primordial Fire’? Similar to the ‘electricity’ on Earth, it’s kind of a universal material, but it’s more versatile than universal… This is using goods directly as currency?’
Colin murmured to himself, troubled about money, when assisted by Shana, he raised his hand and pinched his forehead.
Then, an unexpected event happened.
Suddenly, he discovered that a certain auxiliary function was activated—
[“King of Madness”: Renewable energy, approximately 12,100 Points can be obtained for each hour of processing…]
“Affiliation”: Unspecified.
“Review”: Although already depleted and basically drained, a dying camel is still bigger than a horse, adding fierce flames for more roasting is still viable…
…
“God, a dying camel is still bigger than a horse…”
Colin was speechless; this function was somewhat unscrupulous, but it did open up some of his thinking.
Next, as he thought about letting everyone contribute their part, if they had a leg to contribute, a leg, if they had a hand, contribute a hand, fundraise and start burning it up, initiating mechanisms near the company, a message came through the company channels, asking for his review.

chapters.title: Chapter 907 - 907 600 A Starved Camel is Bigger than a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 907: Chapter 600: A Starved Camel is Bigger than a Horse_3 Chapter 907: Chapter 600: A Starved Camel is Bigger than a Horse_3 “Lady Rabbit?”
After a quick scan, Colin’s expression was somewhat strange—
It was about the task, or rather, it was “Lady Rabbit” playing pranks.
Without hesitation, Colin, as if guided by his own instincts, exercised the “Special Action Rights” to approve and recognize the validity of this contract.
Then, after receiving the points reward, he immediately used them, activating some remaining mechanisms.
The next second, outside the Earth, ten celestial bodies’ apparitions emerged.
They did not affect the planet itself, seeming like illusions, but as they appeared, numerous anomalies were directly pulled by various forces into these celestial bodies in the sky for temporary containment measures.
The defensive mechanisms gradually activated, causing the unauthorized projections of the gods to cease abruptly.
And then, soon after Colin sent a distress signal from one of those illusion-like planets, a war group named ‘First Legion of the ‘Primordial Fire’ Corps: ‘Kindling Fire” sent an entry request.
The crisis on Earth could basically be declared over.
It was after Colin approved this request that a meteor-like blaze appeared from the periphery of the Solar System, entering at a speed exceeding light speed…
At the feel of this presence,
all First-Level Containment Subjects on the scene couldn’t help but shiver.
It seemed like they were recalling a time when they were dehumanized…
“The ‘Kindling Fire’ of the ‘First Corps’ is essentially an unmanned rapid response force. The main machinery of the First Legion can undertake most galaxy-level ‘Extermination Orders’, proficient in ‘Plane Strike,’ ‘Rapid Network Pipeline Transfer,’ ‘Stellar Explosion Technique,’ ‘Dark Domain Creation,’ and so on…”
“Can this be used to temporarily replace some major wars? Hmm, this major war seems a bit too vast, can just this one corps take on the outer Galaxy?”
Colin clicked his tongue in amazement at the power of this legacy force.
However, the primary objective was obviously not to launch any expeditions but to have them “escort.”
And furthermore…
In the information following this, even more messages came in, and in less than a second, Colin’s “inbox” was flooded!
His mind even started to lag a bit…
Fortunately, at the crucial moment, Shana next to him noticed something and quickly used the “Light” to soothe his brain.
Substantially elevating his cognitive speed made things a bit more bearable.
Afterwards, having seen the messages returned in response to his “distress signal,” Colin fell silent for a moment overall; there were two messages, one good and one bad.
The good news was that, judging from the signals that had already reached over a million in number and were still rapidly increasing,
there were still many survivors out there; even if only one-tenth of the company’s territory survived, it was a number beyond ordinary human comprehension.
The bad news was…
Most of the responses to Colin’s distress signal were also distress signals.
“Help! Help! Please help us; over a thousand of our branch worlds are being invaded by several main forces of the Bizarre Worm Swarm…”
“SOS! SOS! The company’s machinery has rebelled…”
“Respected ‘Flame Bearer’ sir, please help us, quick!”
“Hello, I am… a subordinate,… the administrator of the company, our world is being invaded by Chaos, request ‘Primordial Fire’ to arrive, to safeguard sanity…”
“…”
For a moment, Colin was somewhat amused and frustrated.
He felt like telling those sending “help?” not to ask for help when they were meant to be offering it.
“Don’t ask for help from those who are asking for help, ah! I’ve just stabilized myself, excuse the bluntness, but I’m practically just rescued from the ‘ICU intensive care unit’ and not yet off the respirator…”
“And after this, can one manage over a thousand worlds? There seems to even be corps and such, isn’t this power stronger than all the forces I hold now? What kind of terrifying swarm is this that it can invade such places…”
“If I really went, wouldn’t I just turn into a delivery guy?”
Colin casually glanced at the few million distress signals, which included all conceivable and inconceivable disasters…
He took a deep breath, Colin didn’t refuse but now simply wasn’t the time.
He needed to wait for more forces to regroup before sending assistance.
Besides that, Colin also saw requests from acquaintances like the “branch office” of “World Code-13” asking him to investigate “World Code” together…
Like the “Thorn Lady” telling him she was bringing her family and dragging her planet and its billions of population to seek refuge and reminded him to keep the “door” open…
The variety of requests was overwhelming.
For some he could respond to, he made some simple responses, then Colin realized how unusually tired he felt and retracted his thoughts, no longer focusing on this…
“This information is too voluminous; it seems I need some kind of supercomputer to assist me in handling it, otherwise, it’s just not solvable. Hmm, Heaven’s Principle Computer, perhaps…”
With this thought, Colin released a torrent of vast and chaotic knowledge from his mind.
Even ordinary “Gods” struggled with this overwhelming information, needing some kind of assistance to cope.
Then, he thought of the Little Maid, this “Nano-smart Machinery.”
Previously, he didn’t understand, but now, he figured it out. She was part of something from “Bonfire Company” called “Heaven’s Principle Type 2 Calculator,” albeit a very small part.
Because, the knowledge in Colin’s mind explained, the “Heaven’s Principle Type 2” was a device with a mass close to half of the Earth’s and had functions that were much more comprehensive, including stabilizing star systems, defense wars, various macro and micro scale numerical monitoring, and more.

chapters.title: Chapter 908 - 908 600 A Starved Camel is Bigger than a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 908: Chapter 600: A Starved Camel is Bigger than a Horse_4 Chapter 908: Chapter 600: A Starved Camel is Bigger than a Horse_4 Some special war models could even regionally alter physical constants…
Unfortunately, type 2 did not seem to have these features.
However, it was still good; given the current poor state, it was likely that it had been bombed during the disaster period of “The Seventh Box Garden World”, with only a tiny bit of it still existing.
“Not a big problem, I’ll just release all the restrictions on the Little Maid’s body, provide resources, and should be able to quickly rebuild, replicate one out… otherwise, I feel like there are a few worlds where such devices still exist, should bring one over at that time…”
Colin seemed to have some ideas, then took a deep breath, closed his eyes, and allowed his overheating brain to stop and cool down.
Not long after, when he opened his eyes again, he heard Shana’s voice.
“Colin, how are you feeling now?” Shana’s gentle voice, slightly hoarse, pulled Colin out from the state of receiving various new knowledge.
“Not too bad, thanks for your hard work…” Colin said, grasping Shana’s somewhat icy hand, covered in scars with barely any intact skin, and suddenly felt a pang of sympathy.
