The other party certainly had the ability to heal, but to ensure his status, she had to assist him with all her might.
Without hesitation, Colin then ruthlessly transmitted the power of “Primordial Fire” over.
It quickly helped Shana stabilize her reason, and with stable reason, she could directly ignore the cost of the Extraordinary Ones using Extraordinary Power, directly transforming herself into light, healing the wounds on her body…
Seeing Shana rapidly recovering, Colin increasingly understood the importance of “Primordial Fire.”
“I’m fine, just a minor injury,” Shana said, relieved to see Colin’s normal state.
“The situation seems to be clearing up now…”
Colin briefly updated her on the current situation, then saw the ferocious wounds on Shana’s body healing, and her slightly tired expression.
He sensed the surroundings; basically, no other accidents would occur, then suddenly hugged Shana’s waist, lowered his head to her head, and kissed her…
“Hm?” Shana’s pupils dilated, somewhat surprised; she had thought that with Colin’s personality, such actions would probably wait until the time was right, allowing her to take the initiative…
But no matter what…
She did not refuse, her arms wrapped around his neck, returning the passion.
Smooth wings enveloped the two, shielding all visions…
After a while, after they parted, Colin leaned over and whispered in her ear:
“Once I handle some miscellaneous things at hand, we’ll take care of serious matters together.”
“Mhm…”
Shana raised her hand to brush the golden strands off her forehead, her ice-blue pure eyes showing a rare smile that was a bit shy, a bit embarrassed, and a “I’ll wait for you” expression.
Holding Shana tightly once more, Colin’s thoughts shifted back to the “Bonfire Containment Company” —
Even now, it still hid many secrets.
With the advent of this “Primordial Fire”, Colin could be certain it was the first appearance of “Primordial Fire”; in the past, its power might have existed, but never “descended”…
So, what exactly was the situation with the “Flame Bearers”?
To understand, or rather, to clear some of the confusion, he might only find that “Bunny” lady.
It was also during a kind of tacit waiting…
Colin felt an invitation coming from a familiar office.

chapters.title: Chapter 909 - 909 601 Negotiation there is nothing that cant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 909: Chapter 601: Negotiation, there is nothing that can’t be discussed. Chapter 909: Chapter 601: Negotiation, there is nothing that can’t be discussed. Having accepted the invitation, Colin’s vision blurred momentarily before a familiar, yet modest office appeared before his eyes.
The “Lady Rabbit” he hadn’t seen for a long time appeared behind the large desk.
“Please sit,” “Lady Rabbit” said without getting up, continuing to write the seemingly endless stream of content at her desk.
‘What on Earth does she deal with every day?’
Colin nodded, attempting to glimpse what she was processing. Unlike before, when he could see nothing, he now vaguely sensed that she was dispensing some tasks and approving some kind of authority applications, or perhaps issuing policy guidelines and so on.
Not terribly complex matters, but they certainly couldn’t be left unattended…
Then, without further thought, Colin took a few steps to the desk, pulled out a chair, and sat down.
After he sat down, “Lady Rabbit” seemed to finally finish the last item on her agenda. She then looked up at him and said, with a tone similar to before,
“Congratulations, you’ve successfully become the ‘Flame Bearer.'”
Her voice remained calm, revealing no additional emotion.
“Thank you,” Colin said earnestly, expressing his gratitude.
His success was significantly aided by “Lady Rabbit,” and though he may have once suspected she had plans of her own, any schemes against him now held little significance given his position in the company’s hierarchy.
Without waiting for Colin to ponder, “Lady Rabbit” continued,
“After this exchange, we are unlikely to have another conversation like this for some time…”
‘Is it because of that expulsion mission?’ Colin thought, nodding pensively. He remembered one of the conditions for completing that mission was for “Lady Rabbit” to kick herself out.
Although he didn’t understand her reasoning…
It had to be said that, unlike her meticulous temperament and tranquil tone, “Lady Rabbit” had rather elaborate methods when it came to missions.
In doing things, whether tasks or otherwise, she wasn’t constrained by the obvious rules and structures.
However, in the current environment of the “company,” this was probably a reluctant measure…
‘But, with my authority, I could directly negate any corresponding blame, couldn’t I?’
The notion suddenly occurred to Colin, but the feedback from his intuition indicated that, while it seemed feasible, it would be rather troublesome given her level in the company.
He was still in the process of receiving company authority and hadn’t fully assumed control. He would need to complete that step to handle things better.
At that moment, as if “Lady Rabbit” knew what he was thinking, she said, “Matters relating to me are of lower priority. They can wait until you’ve fully assimilated the rewards from the mission before addressing them…”
“By assimilated, do you mean… after B Level?”
Seeing “Lady Rabbit” nod, Colin considered it for a moment, feeling it shouldn’t be too difficult. He just needed to gradually take over some company authority and naturally reach that level.
Even higher, likely!
Because in a sense, he was almost at the top of his ascension.
“Besides that, is there anything else?” Colin sat up straight, resting his hands on the desk, and asked curiously.
“I suppose I’m here to offer some advice and guidance for your upcoming tasks and, also, to answer any queries you may have,” “Lady Rabbit” replied directly.
…That seemed about the same as previous meetings. Colin nodded and waited for her advice.
“Even now, the ‘company’s’ power is vast but extremely scattered and fraught with various complications,” she continued. “I believe you sensed this at the moment of your success.”
As Colin nodded, “Lady Rabbit” went on, “Consolidating them is a priority for you now. Resolve the issues around you first, then gradually expand outward…
“By the year 2024, you should at least resolve issues within ‘the wall’ and some crucial outer points.
“However, the manner in which you carry out your mission will change. Besides your immediate surroundings, you’ll mostly need to assign employees to act because, in most cases, you should be on Earth, receiving signals from all over and playing your symbolic role…
“Of course, the most important thing is that only on Earth can you better receive some of the core authority.
“Receiving these isn’t difficult, merely a process of re-authentication. But the company is so vast, and its contents so numerous and complex, that it requires a significant amount of time…
“However, there’s a time limit involved. You have about a decade, during which you need to take control of at least fifty percent of the core content, especially the ‘interpretative authority’ of some agreements.”
‘So, it means I just need to consolidate the authority to myself? That indeed doesn’t seem too hard. But ten years to fully receive authority?’
As his thoughts flickered, Colin was taken aback, realizing that given “Lady Rabbit’s” style of assigning tasks, these “ten years” were probably a safe estimate.
Slacking off might not allow him to meet the requirements.
Was the company really that expansive?
Afterward, Colin nodded, then suddenly had a thought, asking, “I’m a bit puzzled about certain things concerning the ‘company’ itself. What exactly are those ‘agreements,’ and where do they originate?”
There was still something he hadn’t asked…
Before becoming the “Flame Bearer,” Colin hadn’t felt it much, but after acquiring the title…

chapters.title: Chapter 910 - 910 601 Negotiation there is nothing that cant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 910: Chapter 601: Negotiation, there is nothing that can’t be discussed. Chapter 910: Chapter 601: Negotiation, there is nothing that can’t be discussed. Colin faintly realized that the “company” didn’t seem like an inanimate object; instead, it possessed an indescribable vitality, especially those “protocols.”
What exactly were these things, and why did even some of the Super First Class Containment Subjects have to abide by them?
“I can’t answer too many questions in this regard. I can use the protocols to some extent, but that doesn’t mean I fully understand what they are. However, when you can steadily control all the authority, you should gain a more essential understanding of it.”
“Additionally, as far as I understand from my own perspective, the main framework of Bonfire Company is composed of various protocols centered around the ‘Bonfire Protocol,’ but I’m not aware of the origins and causes of these protocols.”
In a sense, she was like a computer expert, but that did not mean she had the capability to decipher which sand was used in each chip.
“Lady Bunny” briefly explained and then seemed to glance at Colin:
“Moreover, ‘Bonfire Special Containment Company’ is not entirely inanimate. On some levels, they can be seen as part of the ‘Primordial Fire.’ If you want to fully activate it, firstly, you need to receive enough authority, and secondly, you need enough kindling, Points, to completely activate it…”
She paused for a moment, adding, “And as for understanding it, perhaps, saying the ‘company’s’ full name a few more times now might give you a more direct experience.”
Say its full name a few more times?
Colin tried this on the spot, and suddenly his breath hitched slightly. He could feel a bloated and immense terrifying entity emerging from within his mind.
And then, some inexplicable inspirations emerged…
If the “company” were seen as a person, then ‘Primordial Fire’ would be the brain, and other things, such as the protocols, would be its various components…
How did the company originally create the “protocols”?
Colin was shaken.
At the same time, he was now fairly certain that “Lady Bunny’s” authority was likely around B Level, but he was yet unsure whether the other party was “+” or “-.”
Moreover, the counterpart seemed to have more than one job title, but likewise, it was unclear what specific positions these were.
And at the level of “Lady Bunny”…
If she were an enemy, she seemed to have some right to resist, even against him now.
Of course, this wasn’t because he wanted to do something to “Lady Bunny.”
Rather, it made Colin realize that the authority he held wasn’t absolute.
Facing all the “internal” situations, he was sure he could protect himself—just as no one dared to easily strike at an “Emperor.” However, this “Emperor,” when dealing with some high-ranking officials, also found it hard to act at will.
Even, some “officials” might be waiting for him to be “soluble in water.”
However, Colin estimated that as he methodically and securely climbed up and controlled more authority, these situations would diminish.
Following this, after a brief exchange, “Lady Bunny” continued:
“This matter later on is a direction for practical implementation. Currently, many requests for help can be handled to a limited extent, just need to use your own authorization to unlock some protocols, which should essentially resolve the issues.
“So it’s not really a big hassle.
“The company indeed has some problems currently, but this doesn’t mean we are non-functional.”
“This is indeed…”
Colin quite agreed with this point; the existing company’s “legacy” was still vast, like a palm, where each finger might not amount to much individually.
But if gathered together into a fist, the situation would be quite different.
Afterward, “Lady Bunny” spoke about some things that piqued Colin’s interest.
“When you have spare capacity while dealing with peripheral areas, perhaps you could try initiating some investigations on ‘City of Scripts’…”
“‘City of Scripts’?” Colin’s gaze narrowed slightly.
“Yes,” “Lady Bunny” nodded, then further introduced him to this entity.
“‘City of Scripts’ is also a major response plan launched by a giant to address ‘2044,’ although I’m still not clear what specific arrangements lie within, I can feel that when ‘Primordial Fire’ appeared, its importance would escalate, becoming our next target…”
“Additionally, you should also realize that your ‘Flame Bearer’ power is indeed strong. What you can demonstrate now is not complete because it lacks certain systems and legacies.”
“And in ‘City of Scripts’ it’s like a company’s ‘Black Box,’ holding all of the company’s extraordinary pathways, along with many props technologies and so on from those times. Of course, some might be lost, but it’s certainly more complete than outside.”
“However, due to some reasons, it has now been completely sealed and hidden away, finding it might also require some effort…”
In “Lady Bunny’s” slow narration, “City of Scripts” was an entity like a kind of independent microcosm, a super-scale colossal composite world.
It was constantly growing, and also constantly destroying.
And based on the investigation feedback received by Colin and some employees acting inside,
the situation inside might not be very clear.
If possible…
They needed to intervene as much as possible, making those arrangements yield results beneficial to them, not allowing it to just become the trousseau of other entities.

chapters.title: Chapter 911 - 911 601 Discussion there is nothing that cant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 911: Chapter 601: Discussion, there is nothing that can’t be discussed. _3 Chapter 911: Chapter 601: Discussion, there is nothing that can’t be discussed. _3 “I will definitely investigate,” Colin said, reflecting on how Old Master Wu had connected the “Lifelines of Fate” of many people injured in various disasters.
So many people had been thrown into it…
Colin couldn’t just ignore it.
Of course, with “Lady Bunny’s” words, whether for the resources or the people within, he had several more reasons to set out.
Then, “Lady Bunny” provided some other directions.
“In addition, there are matters related to the ‘Box Garden World’. They serve different functions from worlds like ‘World Code’, mainly used by the company for experimental research in various matters in the past…”
“Currently, there are roughly 39 ‘Box Garden Worlds’ still in existence, with about five having relatively complete systemic structures.”
“The first, third, and sixteenth are all under control and have significant forces from the ‘Zoo’ Corps stationed there. I will transfer the corresponding command authority into your hands.”
“Of the remaining thirty-six, including the ‘Seventh Box Garden World’ you visited, twelve have been pacified by the ‘Zoo’ Corps, but only pacified without further follow-up actions being taken…”
“You can reach the ‘Box Garden Worlds’ via the ‘Mist Train’ protected by the ‘Primordial Fire’.”
“Right, a few years ago, when the ‘Mist Train’ was moving, most of those survivors were sent to those three worlds; the number of successfully relocated people was about one hundred and twenty-two million…”
“There are also several dangerous worlds within the ‘Box Garden Worlds.’ If they cannot be resolved, you can seal them with Primordial Fire’, blocking them off, and temporarily putting them aside…”
“After the action starts, you can use them as your bases to initiate the reclamation of various star sectors within ‘The Wall’…”
“Lady Bunny” spoke methodically, without much attachment, as she handed the “corps” command into Colin’s hands.
Then, even after combining methods of “Inspiration,” it took about seven or eight hours before “Lady Bunny” had roughly finished discussing the related action plans.
The counterpart provided as detailed advice and planning as possible for his subsequent actions in every area and direction; it was so meticulous that Colin started to get some ideas.
‘It seems that “Lady Rabbit” really won’t be able to make many more arrangements in the short term.’
Colin had a bittersweet feeling.
However, she seemed indifferent to these matters and said, “The arrangements are roughly like this. There are many more things, and I will send them to you in another way when the time is right…”
“Right…” Colin nodded, thinking of what he had to do, he couldn’t help but smile:
“It feels like I’ve started a new ‘Bonfire Containment Company’ on my own.”
“In a sense, that’s true. As the holder of the current ‘Primordial Fire’ interpretation rights, if you wish, you can even change the name of ‘Bonfire Containment Company’ to something like ‘Bonfire Kindergarten’…”
“Lady Bunny” seemed to make a rare joke, but her tone was still calm and meticulous, leaving Colin slightly uncertain.
Of course, if she now reminded him to establish a “new ‘Bonfire Containment Company,'” to deal with multiple stakeholders, to remember not to be by the river, and to remember to wear a helmet.
Only then would Colin be sure she was joking…
At this moment, he heard “Lady Bunny” say: “The B-level path has been laid out; once you gain A-level Authority as a ‘Firebearer,’ the authority in your hands will surpass that of the three former giants…”
“Surpass the three giants?” Colin was surprised for a moment.
“Yes, actually, in terms of status and how much you’re valued, you are already not inferior to them. For you, what remains is to avoid accidents and acquire more time.”
‘The level of attention probably means how many beings want to kill me…’ Colin muttered to himself, his expression growing serious as he brought up another point:
“There’s something about ‘Firebearers’ that I don’t understand. Before, I had a feeling that the ‘Primordial Fire’ seemed to be descending for the first time, so what’s the situation with those former ‘Firebearers’?”
To Colin’s question, “Lady Bunny” seemed to ponder for a moment before responding:
“According to my knowledge, although it is widely believed that the ‘Primordial Fire’ has descended, in certain higher circles, there are also some uncertain messages…
“And from your feedback, these messages might indeed be true, that is: ‘Primordial Fire’ has never actually descended, but at that time, perhaps due to in-depth studies of ‘human nature’ or for reasons I am not sure of, its power appeared and led to the birth of ‘Firebearers’…
“However, because the ‘Primordial Fire’ seemed never to have descended, it led a small fraction of people to believe it was some sort of ‘phantasmal’ power; although strong, it was not quite real.
“That’s why there were many who did not support it.”
Such topics are typically taboos within the company, but obviously.
Now, with Colin’s status, unless he loses it or simply doesn’t have it, there’s nothing he’s not allowed to know.
In essence: discuss, there’s nothing that can’t be discussed.
After reflecting for a moment but gaining no insight, Colin couldn’t help but remark, “The secrets of the past are still numerous…”
It seems that relevant clues could only be pieced together as he rose through the ranks.

chapters.title: Chapter 912 - 912 601 Negotiation there is nothing that cant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 912: Chapter 601: Negotiation, there is nothing that can’t be discussed. _4 Chapter 912: Chapter 601: Negotiation, there is nothing that can’t be discussed. _4 “Just, when ‘Lady Rabbit’ across from him heard his words, she suddenly spoke in a peculiar tone with uncertainty,”
“we might not necessarily be from the past…”
“Ah?” Colin was stunned. If not the past, then what could it possibly be?
But he just saw ‘Lady Rabbit’ saying uncertainly, “You could temporarily consider it as ‘the future,’ but don’t cling to that idea because I, or the ‘previous generation’ you recognize, might not necessarily be from the past…”
“Could you clarify a bit?” Colin scratched the back of his head.
However, the other party just shook her head, indicating it was just a spiritual intuition she had when she heard his words.
Not the future and not the past, could it perhaps be something like a parallel universe?
Colin asked further, but it didn’t seem quite right.
“Right, I’ve heard from some sources that your current ‘status’ seems quite special?” Colin carefully began to probe ‘Lady Rabbit.’
This topic was relatively sensitive, just like telling Liu Yun to her face that her dreams were fake.
Who knows what adverse effects could appear…
“Mm, from my perspective, I feel like the current me is me, but not quite real…” ‘Lady Rabbit’ shared a statement that seemed no less cryptic to Colin than “the future now.”
“What about beyond ‘time’ and ‘space’?” Colin pondered and tried to remind.
“Maybe, the only thing I can confirm is that I and some related beings, whether friend or foe, are currently in a state heavily influenced by ‘Mechanical Descension’. Some people call us, in this kind of status, as the unreturned from beyond ‘time’ and ‘space’…”
‘Mechanical Descension’ he thought?
Colin pinched his forehead. The initiator, ‘Boss Huang He,’ had made a big move and then disappeared, and since then, he wasn’t sure if he was still around…
At this moment, ‘Lady Rabbit’ continued unabashedly with the information she had, “However, once ‘Primordial Fire’ lights up, us so-called ‘unreturned’ will gradually return. By then, perhaps I can tell you more. Of course, you should be cautious then, as many real troubles will also return…”
“Alright…”
Colin nodded, not further pressing on this matter.
Then, he thought for a moment and switched the subject, “Right, there’s another thing I want to understand, about the ‘non-existent hospital.'”
This “hospital” could be reached through initiating missions in the early stages of the disaster.
Some employees escaped from catastrophes using it.
Colin guessed, ‘The Unyielding’ might have put some effort in…
But since the disaster, it suddenly disappeared without a trace, even some messages on forums seemed to have been cleared. Up to now, Colin hadn’t sensed where that “hospital” world was, so he wanted to understand the situation.
However, after listening to Colin’s words, ‘Lady Rabbit’ suddenly asked another question:
“Can you verbally tell me about the events that occurred in the ‘non-existent hospital’?”
Seeing ‘Lady Rabbit’s’ attitude, Colin realized something was off and nodded, recounting the events in detail…
When everything was said, Colin saw ‘Lady Rabbit’ fall silent for a while.
Then, he heard her say:
“During your mission at the ‘non-existent hospital,’ due to some reasons, I didn’t issue any extra side missions beyond the main quest, nor did I provide you with a drug called ‘Cyanide Injector O-1 Enhanced Custom Type’…”
Upon hearing this, Colin was shocked, a chilling dread surged through him.
“If it wasn’t your side mission dispatched, then…who could it be?”
.
.
.
.

chapters.title: Chapter 913 - 913 602 The Companys Nuclear Bundle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 913: Chapter 602: The Company’s “Nuclear Bundle”. Chapter 913: Chapter 602: The Company’s “Nuclear Bundle”. Even now, looking back on his previous experiences, Colin did not feel there were any significant “loopholes”.
The only thing that felt off was that “Lady Rabbit” had not given her task insignia at that time, but then, the aura he sensed from the task was almost consistent with the past, so he did not harbor any suspicion…
Could he have mistaken it?
Colin subconsciously thought of the time when The Rat had swapped him into “The Seventh Box Garden World”.
It was now known that the other party had managed this through “Space: Transposition”.
After being badly duped that time, Colin began to be vigilant with every task he took on.
He needed to be mindful if it was something unknown dispatched from somewhere…
At the same time, he would also try as much as possible to use his own spiritual premonition to detect, ensuring that even if there were threats in the task, they were indeed within the scope described in the task.
And not concealing some unknown twist…
“I remember feeling like I didn’t mistake the task?” Colin furrowed his brows.
Unless that fellow’s situation is sorted out…
He was somewhat uneasy.
Otherwise, who knows what kind of mine might have been buried beside him?
At this moment, “Lady Rabbit” spoke, breaking into his train of thought, “There should be no significant issues, and indeed, you did not mistake it.”
As she spoke, Colin saw “Lady Rabbit” open a drawer on the right-hand side, grab some fragmented stone artifacts, and place them on the table.
Although they were quite shattered, it was still possible to see that it was a small item.
If there were no surprises, it should be a simple and unadorned seal or something of the sort…
The most crucial point was that in past tasks from “Lady Rabbit”, that distinct aura seemed consistent with it.
“Yes, this is the feeling.”
After taking a look, Colin spoke and lifted his head, thoughtfully questioning “Lady Rabbit”:
“Do you mean to say, you’ve found some direction already?”
“There is some, but it’s not possible to confirm the specifics. However, currently, it appears that the person has no malice. At the very least, being in possession of this seal signifies that even if his goals and paths differ, he would not deviate too far from ours. He would be someone on the same path as us; however, if that individual does not come forward on his own, it would not be an easy task to find him…”
After finishing, “Lady Rabbit” pointed at the fragments on the table, indicating, “When you leave later, you may take them and cast them into ‘Primordial Fire’ to feel carefully. Having a sample would allow you to quickly detect subtle differences in the future, even when encountering similar situations, there would also be a chance, using these fragments, to forge a faint connection of fate, roughly perceiving that unknown third party…
“As for now, let’s put it aside for the moment.”
“Is that so… Alright, got it.”
Colin reached out and took all the fragments, placing them all into his pocket.
He was quite curious about what that person’s situation was—looking at the implication behind “Lady Rabbit”‘s words, that concealed individual, in terms of power or authority, seemed to be close to her?
If that was really the case, it would be an extremely powerful individual.
‘Overall, the development at that time was indeed favorable… If not for that person, Brother Unyielding would likely have died, but if there was any dangerous arrangement, then the situation would be another matter…’
As thoughts flickered, Colin decided to thoroughly investigate once he went out.
Whether for peace of mind or to glean more information, he needed to attempt to make contact.
Then, after conversing with “Lady Rabbit” for a while longer, he prepared to get up and leave…
“Then, goodbye, Colin.” “Lady Rabbit” rather rarely stood up from her office desk, offering a half-blessing.
“Yep, I hope everyone’s actions go smoothly…”
Nodding, Colin finished speaking and glanced at “Lady Rabbit”.
She showed no difference from the first time he had met her, tall, straight legs beneath a dark-colored female professional suit, her every move extremely proper, giving one the feeling of rigidity, seriousness, meticulousness…
But what caused a slight suspicion in the depths of Colin’s heart was…
Until now, he still could not make out “Lady Rabbit”‘s face!
When he looked directly at her head, all he could see was a blur, unable to form a clear picture of her true appearance in his mind, despite the impression from other body parts that she must be quite beautiful, it was impossible to see clearly…
This…
Although it seemed not too important, Colin felt there was something not quite normal.
He always had the feeling that she was like some kind of peculiar ancient painting, with every figure in the painting lively, yet none had eyes—as if by simply dotting the eyes, those figures would spring to life.
“Lady Rabbit” gave Colin such a feeling.
However, it could simply be that she did not wish to reveal those details, so Colin did not dwell on it much and did not delve deeper into this unimportant matter. After all, compared to seeing a clear face, whether walking the same path was what mattered most.
But it was right at the last moment before leaving the simple office.
Colin suddenly felt a pang of surprise, as the “Lady Rabbit” before his eyes underwent some changes.
In an instant, Colin’s inner thoughts quieted down, and he understood why he could not make out “Lady Rabbit”‘s face.

chapters.title: Chapter 914 - 914 602 The Companys Core Bundling._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 914: Chapter 602: The Company’s ‘Core Bundling’._2 Chapter 914: Chapter 602: The Company’s ‘Core Bundling’._2 At this moment, in his eyes, the completely “real” appearance of “Lady Bunny” was revealed…
It was more an entity composed of a large number of “labels,” like a special kind of information combination, than it was a person.
[Hair: Black], [Impression: Efficient], [Outfit: Black professional women’s attire], [Shoes: Shiny common workplace high heels], [Gender: Female], [Tone of Voice: Stable and clear], [Demeanor: Calm and reliable], [Demeanor: Possessing a hint of mystery]…
A large number of information entities like “labels” had aggregated to form a “person.”
These “labels” numbered in the thousands, perhaps tens of thousands, and at the outermost layer of this dense information were the lexical labels representing “appearance” that Colin saw.
This also made Colin understand why he “couldn’t see through.”
Among the “labels” that formed this person, for reasons unknown, whether intentionally or not, there were no components related to the “face.”
So…
Since it simply didn’t exist, how could he possibly see it?
“Lady Bunny” seemed to belong to a particular extraordinary pathway of manifestation? Like Shana’s so-called ‘Mythical Life Form’…
As thoughts flickered through Colin’s mind, he pondered and also clearly realized.
That his own essence of life and overall aspects had greatly improved…
Otherwise, if it were just when he had first ascended to D Level, or even during the Late Stage D Level, Lady Bunny’s mere showing of this life form would have been enough to give him a severe headache for a while.
An ordinary D Level Employee might even drop dead from just Direct Gazing!
At the same time, Colin had some understanding why some entities, like the “World Code-13” branch, would say that “Lady Bunny” didn’t seem real.
Because what she currently manifested was essentially a mass of information.
From Colin’s current status, after seeing the “information” that was “Lady Bunny,” there seemed to be a “remote control hand” vaguely behind it.
It was precisely because of this that she, who was supposedly outside of “Time” and “Spatial” constraints, could barely intervene in the situation here.
‘Although ‘Lady Rabbit’ has always appeared to be rather ‘delicate’, now it seems that her life station is not low either, even if she is not a specialized combatant, her strength should not be underestimated…’
Thinking of a corresponding existence, Colin couldn’t help but recall “Thorn Lady,” who also claimed to be in a clerical position.
But if it really came to blows…
Even an entity like the “King of Savage Sound” might only have the option to flee.
Afterwards, Colin gave a slight nod as a gesture of greeting, knowing this should be considered a form of honesty from “Lady Bunny.”
Immediately following, this time, Colin did not feel himself being transported away.
Instead, he saw the plain office disintegrating bit by bit, like a bubble bursting in slow motion…
Everything vanished as if it had been a mere illusion.
“Can’t perceive it anymore…”
Colin sighed and then looked around to find himself still standing in the same spot.
The pure light, with a trace of liveliness, enshrouded the area…
As Colin appeared, the somewhat dazzling white light began to regress, first transforming into a cluster of light with several pairs of broad wings, looking somewhat chubby…
Then the light further retracted inward, condensing into a holy and beautiful girl.
Compared to before, today’s Shana seemed, due to a small part of the “White Night” characteristics, stronger and even more sacred and lofty in appearance.
“Hmm…”
Colin reached out and grabbed her arm, a trace of “Primordial Fire” emerged, safeguarding her “humanity” and alleviating the impact of some merging force.
Holding her soft white hand in his, Colin kneaded and played with it as he spoke, “How long was I gone?”
“About nine minutes…”
Shana replied briefly, not rejecting Colin’s “profane” advances, going along with him and accepting that warm power that soothed and stabilized her body’s state.
“Nine minutes…” In the office, Colin estimated the time it took to receive the various suggestions from “Lady Bunny.”
At least a day had passed, but not much time had gone by in the outside world.
However, Colin felt that this wasn’t the effect of time, but because in that space, their thoughts were running at speeds like ten or even fifteen times faster, everything seemed to be functioning normally.
But in reality, everything was operating at high speed.
“I feel that my office could also use some training to create a similar situation…”
Colin raised his hand and stroked his chin, considering the task was not difficult to accomplish. The simplest method was to use Shana’s light to significantly enhance their thought speed.
Then everyone’s brain would become like “fiber optics,” and then he just needed to adjust their perception of time.
That way, he could achieve a situation similar to that of “Lady Bunny”…
It might not be as smooth and natural, but it wouldn’t be far off.
Following that, Colin wanted to continue exchanging ideas with Shana, but the frenzied battle among the advanced containment subjects before him had just ended, and many things were on standby, awaiting his next instruction.
He needed to go and take care of it.
At this moment, even though only a short while had passed since the emergence of “Primordial Fire”…
The surrounding battle had already come to a close.
When the “Primordial Fire” was ignited and Colin blocked the view from the outside, the internal enemies were also quickly dealt with.
This group of “The Gods” that betrayed because of “Primordial Fire” effortlessly expelled all the remaining internal foes from this domain.
Of course, they were only expelled, as killing them was quite difficult…
Especially since most of them were accustomed to fighting across prison corridors, which meant that they couldn’t “kill” a God.
However, it wasn’t a big issue, as Colin would have plenty of time later to personally visit each one of them.
“Leader…”
The “King of Savage Sound” came over to report the current situation to Colin.
The small world they were in and a vast surrounding area had already been secured, and about sixteen advanced containment subjects indicated their willingness to submit.
Added to the batch including the “King of Savage Sound,” the total number had reached twenty-six.
It sounded like a small number, but in reality, it was an exceedingly large count.
According to the “King of Savage Sound,” this was only possible within “the wall” because of the “Bonfire Company.” Elsewhere, even if one measured the distance by light-years, it might not be possible to find even one—
Although in the scale of the universe, it still wasn’t a large number, the corresponding physical distance was a significant barrier for most advanced containment subjects.
Therefore, one could imagine how complex the situation on Earth was at that time…
Colin felt that the mere existence of Earth, no, the Solar System in such circumstances was indeed quite miraculous.
“In this regard…” The “King of Savage Sound” seemed to share a similar sentiment, explaining on behalf of those who submitted:
“Actually, they dare not destroy this place. Even during the previous chaos, many ‘neutral’ or opposing members were actively fighting against the ‘Outer Gods’…”
By “Outer Gods,” he obviously didn’t mean himself but referred to those malevolent higher-dimensional beings or civilizations outside “the wall,” or even “beyond the universe.”
Upon hearing this, Colin’s mind swiftly grasped the reason.
The superior containment subjects trapped here, whether they were enemies of “Primordial Fire” or not, all wanted to escape, or at least have a bite to eat…
But those “Outer Gods,” they not only wanted to flip the table, but also eat the beings inside the containment as their meal.
If They were limited to just targeting “Primordial Fire.”
Then those inside the containment wouldn’t mind…
But to flip the table and destroy Earth as a “symbolic place,” let alone the Solar System, that was a bit impolite.
Once there was severe destruction here, many of the containment’s internal “self-destruct” mechanisms would activate directly. Even though those might not necessarily cause Their deaths, the outcome would not be much different.
‘The tactics of the Company are quite insidious, ensnaring them in one go…’
Colin didn’t know what to make of it.
For the time being, although there were still some beings on the side of Earth, the overall situation was fairly clear.
What remained was to begin the judgment, then reward merits, and afterward continue with the next phase of action…
Firstly, it was certain that several beings, including the “King of Savage Sound,” finally had the opportunity to be released from the “containment” and obtain the contracts they deeply desired—no, wait, the employee contracts…

chapters.title: Chapter 915 - 915 603 Bonfire Containment Company (Finished)
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 915: 603 Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished). Chapter 915: 603 Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished). “Fantastic! Fantastic!!!”
Upon receiving this piece of news, the “King of Madness” was nearly moved to tears—it had consumed so many “pretend pies,” and now it had finally tasted a real one!
Along this journey, he had truly given his all.
The entire world seemed to shudder under his maniacal laughter until Colin reminded him with a phrase, “shut up.” Only then did he restrain his laughter.
After that, it was time to deal with those who had “submitted,” the so-called “neutrals”…
This group constituted the majority of the recent subjects, accounting for about half.
There wasn’t much to say. Colin promised to improve their conditions within the containment facilities, then let them continue to wear their shackles inside the containment units, contributing their share of strength to the company.
Though it wasn’t possible to release them shortly, at least there was a chance. Their status was equivalent to the “King of Madness” during his first act of loyalty.
As for them, overall, Colin mainly planned to observe them for a while longer…
Then there were some who couldn’t really be called neutral, nor could they be said to be faultless. They were somewhat criminal, with some errors present.
Even though they hadn’t intended to act this way, they had still harmed a portion of the populace and affected certain things, albeit the dangers weren’t severe.
There were five or six of them, and Colin intended to subject them to “Primordial Fire” transformation, infusing them with a compassionate “humanity.”
Every day, they would undergo “Primordial Fire” roasting for eight hours, with the possibility of extending the roasting time each day depending on the situation, but never exceeding sixteen hours, continuing for at least a hundred years—
Regardless of whether this universe would last that long, but the terms were set first!
Although the “Primordial Fire” roasting was bound to be extremely painful, it wasn’t a big problem. Initially painful, it would feel more comfortable later.
Because once “humanity” enriched them, and all their values aligned with those of normal humans, the “Primordial Fire” wouldn’t make them feel particularly different.
As for the hundred years… for higher beings, it wasn’t an issue as, in any case, they at least had a goal. So long as there were no accidents, their lives seemed almost eternal…
A hundred years would pass in the blink of an eye.
As for being infused with “humanity”…
The environment of this universe had already changed, and their thinking had long ago started leaning in this direction. Otherwise, they might not keep up with the updates, so it didn’t seem to be a significant issue.
When deciding on the punishment, Colin was prepared that some among them might object or even turn hostile.
But unexpectedly, not only did they not show such signs, but they even seemed to breathe a sigh of relief…
Following that, from within the “Primordial Fire,” some faint “Inspiration” came through, from which Colin understood the reason.
Based on past situations, beings like them would usually be violently disassembled and sent to research institutes for experiments—being dissected here and there…
Moreover, they couldn’t escape the fate of being “fire-roasted,” and such contracts typically started from three to five hundred years.
A hundred years?
To them, was that any different from nothing?
“Level One Containment Subjects” could tolerate things within a limited timeframe, as long as the time wasn’t ridiculously long, they generally didn’t care too much. What they really feared was an endless scenario.
‘Ah, this is my first time as a ‘Flame Bearer,’ so I’m not too familiar with the sentencing standards…’
Colin thought of the contract previously drafted for the “King of Madness.” At that time, the “King of Madness” and this group had some similarities, with no “malice” in intention.But indeed, they had breached the “World Code” barriers and caused several disasters.
If Colin remembered correctly, the work term was three thousand years, non-stop. Although they would try to avoid it dying during the “work” period, this wasn’t guaranteed…
Of course, now a hundred years was just a “penalty period.” How long the work contract would be hadn’t been decided yet.
It might be worth referencing the experiences of the “predecessors” later on.
‘But speaking of which, I currently need a force that can be used right now and don’t have the conditions to dismantle them for research…’
‘Also, each of these ‘Containment Subjects’ is pretty intact. If they cooperate, sustaining the burn could earn a few thousand points per hour—jeez, one could provide up to a hundred thousand or eighty thousand a day…’
Colin felt almost like relying on them alone could directly cause “inflation.”
However, although the points were coming in larger quantities, many company relics needed to be activated and maintained, and the “points” required for this were also an incredibly exaggerated figure.
Relying solely on the points earned from burning these containment subjects, when compared to the expenditures, seemed a bit strained.
Unless he directly used them as firewood in the real sense…
However, clearly, those who sided with him couldn’t be aggressively burned in such a manner.
“No big deal, many high-end containment units still house many higher containment subjects waiting to be resolved; it’s time to settle accounts with each of them…”
Colin sipped his lips, feeling it was time to start preparing for the next step.
Currently, he had to review these three categories.
None required extreme measures. After all, they weren’t foolish—those who could consolidate themselves here didn’t have significant issues.
Those with issues knew they had no way out and wouldn’t come to submit.
In a flash of thoughts, Colin looked at the crowd before him and slowly began:
“In the next seven days, I require the resolution of all external forces on Earth. Not a hundred percent, but at least ninety-nine percent.”

chapters.title: Chapter 916 - 916 603 Bonfire Containment Company (Finished)._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 916: 603 “Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished)._2 Chapter 916: 603 “Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished)._2 “The ‘Primordial Fire’ First Legion will participate in the operation, and you all need to cooperate fully…”
“I hope none of you will let me down.”
Amidst the flames that light up the world, Colin spoke his demands to the group of entities before him.
Although the unmanned army of the ‘Primordial Fire’ Corps’ First Legion was already approaching,
the forces that arrived first were not many. Under such circumstances, if one wished to pay a smaller price to save more humans, the assistance of the motley crew before him was clearly indispensable.
“Rest assured! We guarantee to complete the mission!” the ‘King of Mad Sounds’ and other entities immediately assured.
Afterward, without further delay, Colin allowed the ‘King of Mad Sounds’ to carry a faint whiff of ‘Primordial Fire’, to initiate a visit to the ‘Containment Divine Kingdom’, and then obtained permission to leave.
Although Colin’s rank was still C Level, it was already completely sufficient for some general approvals…
“Ah, I’m finally out~~~!”
The moment one of the cells in the Containment Divine Kingdom opened, a terrifying aura spread quickly throughout the entire ‘World Code-13’.
At this moment, whether it was ordinary humans or the Extraordinary Ones, everyone felt the ground beneath their feet and the air around them trembling slightly.
“What’s happening? What’s happening? Is the earth angered?”
Inside a factory, some people stood up nervously, looking around, their faces somewhat pale. But at that moment, another person, who was ‘Light’ Bishop and factory manager, suddenly realized something and was immediately pale with shock:
“God Descent?!”
No, that’s not right, it wasn’t the type commonly understood as ‘God Descent’ by merely using a container for possession. It was the actual ‘God Descent’!
After who-knows-how-many centuries, some terrifying higher being had truly descended!
For a time, a great many people fell into panic.
In the top meetings of some nations, while some expressed their fright, they also affirmed with certainty…
Long: “It must be those outsiders’ ‘good deeds’!”
In addition, there were a few, such as some company employees left in this world as refugees, who were somewhat familiar with the ‘King of Mad Sounds’, and now, witnessing the appearance of the ‘King of Mad Sounds’, faintly understood something.
“Brother Shunzi… could it be?” Some of them showed surprise on their faces.
The news of Brother Shunzi’s reappearance was well known on Earth, but there had not been enough time for the message to travel back.
“How’s big brother?!” Little Red, who had grown a bit taller and was now a young girl, hurried over.
The chilling crimson aura enveloped the place, forming strange red frost crystals…
An employee felt uneasy about the nearby red ice; being touched by it meant the body would begin collapsing at the genetic level…
Noticing her own lapse, Little Red quickly controlled her emotions and apologized before asking again.
“We’re not sure yet, we’ll need to make contact with ‘King of Mad Sounds’ before we understand. But for now, it seems to be heading in a positive direction, Brother Shunzi should be alive…”
As she finished speaking, before Little Red could react, she suddenly heard a voice.
“The great ‘Primordial Fire’ Highest Will Executor, the sacred and inviolable corporate senior, the noble Agent Lord Colin, has successfully embraced the flame, becoming a ‘Flame Bearer’…”
The ‘King of Mad Sounds’ thus proclaimed to the world, reaching the ears of everyone, including Little Red, the company employees, and the believers of the ‘Bonfire Church’.
“Big brother is still alive, that’s wonderful!” Little Red said with tears in her eyes, then couldn’t help but start crying.
Elsewhere, cries of surprise and joy also arose…
Most of them did not understand the specific meaning of the ‘King of Mad Sounds” words, but they all vaguely felt that everything was good for the ‘Bonfire’, and this news was a major positive development!
Soon after, the vibration that affected nearly half the world subsided…
Under the watchful eyes of the ‘Radiant Angels’ war machines, the ‘King of Mad Sounds’ awkwardly retracted his powers, then prepared to travel to Earth.
To continue working for the boss in person rather than merely sending an incarnate…
Realizing the other party was about to leave, Little Red’s eyes flashed with crimson light as she asked:
“Can I go find big brother with you?”
After years of effort, she had managed to control her power to some extent…
On some instinct, the ‘King of Mad Sounds’ abandoned the thought of prying into the essence of the crimson red. Originally planning to brush her off and leave, he then remembered that she seemed to be one of the boss’s close associates. Patience reinforced, he stayed…
…
Earth.
Colin was sitting in a train, preparing to go to a closed small world, also located on Earth. He planned to start by getting his hands on a high-level Containment Subject.
At this point, he had inherited a range of large and small authority, including ‘Train in the Fog,’ the ‘Zoo’ Corps, and more, from ‘Lady Rabbit’.
‘This train is quite convenient, able to pass through most places within ‘the wall,’ especially within the Solar System, almost unimpeded…’
‘As long as the stops have a certain degree of closure, and it’s clear that there is an anomaly, that works. Well, ‘Bonfire’ can also directly replace the anomaly. At present, the reason the train stops where there are anomalies could be because it’s utilizing some of its unique properties…’
Colin pondered, as knowledge about the train surged through his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 917 - 917 603 Bonfire Containment Company (Finished)._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 917: 603 “Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished)._3 Chapter 917: 603 “Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished)._3 It was a well-known composite device within the company, and it was unclear exactly who manufactured it. It was likely that not just one person, but many of the company’s top fabricators had a hand in its creation.
The rank exceeded the general understanding of a “Golden Artifact,” and it was extremely special in its own right.
Its trajectory was far beyond the vicinity of Earth…
The extent of the company’s reach back in the day was enormous, and so was the range this device could access, equipped with various types of carriages to carry different classes of “humans” and to undertake different tasks and jobs, among other things.
‘If it weren’t for insufficient spatial-tier, it feels like it’s almost touching the edge of Level ‘0’…’
‘But speaking of those ‘Dark Shadows’…’
Colin glanced at the dark humanoid shadows quivering under the “Primordial Fire.”
Nowadays, with the “Primordial Fire,” they hardly needed those things anymore. Even the powerful First Level Containment Subjects dared not look directly through the train’s special windows to spy on the essence of the “Primordial Fire.”
Back when the “Primordial Fire” had not yet descended, accidents would happen, and they might vanish into a massive flame of unknown origin…
Now that the “Primordial Fire” had descended…
That would be a suicidal act, as they would definitely be devoured by some kind of flame.
You must understand that what Colin had seen in the darkness before due to some kind of “resonance” was likely just a small wisp of “Primordial Fire,” but in the material world, its projection in a certain special dimension was… boundlessly immense.
But in the end, Colin still chose not to handle it for the time being—if it could function normally, then he would let it continue to do so.
Otherwise, who knows what kind of incompatibility issues might arise if he rashly removed the “Dark Shadows” and replaced them with the “Primordial Fire.”
“However, if there’s a chance later on, I should find an opportunity to release an ‘Extermination Order’ in a fallen world, just to see what kind of fireworks it would create…”
“I’ve grown up without ever seeing what an ‘Extermination Order’ looks like when deployed.”
Colin couldn’t help but mumble softly to himself.
“What are you talking about?” Shana, sitting beside him, turned her head to look at him.
“Just about the ‘Extermination Order’…” Colin didn’t hide it and simply shared his curiosity.
This made Shana somewhat torn between laughter and tears, but she still leaned in closer to Colin and whispered in his ear a reminder not to indulge in that power.
“Don’t worry, the ‘Bonfire Protocol’ is in place, so I won’t act recklessly…”
Colin waved his hand.
Today, his authority wasn’t just because the “Primordial Fire” was exceptionally powerful but also because there was “no one above him,” so it didn’t mean that he could just break the agreement…
Of course, even if he could disregard the risks, he couldn’t do so.
After all, the current nature of the “Primordial Fire” was the “benevolent side of humanity.” If he acted recklessly, it would be no different from denying himself, akin to committing suicide.
Pausing briefly, Colin leaned closer to Shana and whispered so only she could hear, “But speaking of indulgence, we could indulge elsewhere.”
“Hmm?” Shana was puzzled at first, but then catching the look in Colin’s eyes, she quickly understood and gave him a light elbow nudge in reprimand.
Then, she continued sitting beside Colin without pursuing the topic further and asked curiously, “By the way, where are we going now?”
Just before, Colin had suddenly summoned a train with multiple superior Incarnate Beings, taking her along without disclosing their destination or what they were going to do.
“Well…”
Colin reached out to straighten the light golden hair on Shana’s forehead, tucking it behind her ear:
“I’m going to give you a surprise in a bit.”
“A surprise?”
Shana tilted her head and smiled with a hint of anticipation, “Then I’ll look forward to your surprise.”
Not long after, as the train began to slow down, the scene outside the window gradually revealed itself through the dense fog…
It was an eerie, broken space, like a barren wasteland of ruins, but from within these ruins flowed an extremely rich and soothingly serene pale light.
Although it appeared almost heavenly, in reality, ordinary people and even the Extraordinary Ones couldn’t step into this domain; almost any attempt to enter would result in death.
However, it was obviously different for Colin and his group.
When the train stopped and the doors opened, a group of formidable humanoid beings emerged one by one, ignoring the effects of the light, and stood outside waiting.
Soon, Colin and Shana stepped out side by side, following at the rear.
In this space, it seemed the white light had nullified gravity, and everything floated about everywhere.
But, this wasn’t a big issue…
As soon as Colin’s feet touched the ground, feeling that there should be gravity, so there was gravity in this little world.
All sorts of floating debris, like rocks and the like, clattered to the ground.
Following this, he slowly walked towards a certain direction in the strange space, the light of the flame emanating from his body effortlessly dispelling the unusually dense white light…
Behind him, a dozen superior Incarnate Beings silently followed.
“This place was carved out by an enemy before, yes, the Rat Monster…”
Colin briefly explained the origin of this place to Shana. Although it was his first time here, he vaguely knew what the situation was like.
That Rat had left “The Seventh Box Garden World,” and it clearly wasn’t alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - 918 603 Bonfire Containment Company (Finished)._4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 918: 603 “Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished)._4 Chapter 918: 603 “Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished)._4 With numerous special small worlds much like this one…
Each one held a “Level One Containment Subject” that was nearly completely restricted, and the opposition originally planned to offer these “Level One Containment Subjects” as sacrifices to the body of “Red Moon” during its possession, in order to achieve some kind of confrontation and balance.
But sadly, Colin wouldn’t allow it, and so all these schemes had failed.
After about a dozen minutes passed, his footsteps stopped in front of a damaged containment unit as massive as a mountain.
The containment unit was full of cracks, and through these cracks, one could see a life form with numerous wings, yet heavily injured, lying within.
All the light within the entire small world radiated from it.
It had only begun to float again after Colin’s arrival, at the center of the countless wings.
A huge eyeball, filled with bloodshot veins, looked towards the newcomers.
“Tsk, still alive huh…”
Colin pursed his lips. When the “Card Divine Kingdom” was activated, he had struck directly at this thing, including its main body.
He had thought that if it hadn’t died, it should be almost finished.
But now, seeing that it could still stand up…
“The path of ‘Flame Bearer,’ verified by you, ‘Primordial Fire,’ if needed, I can choose…”
“Heh, too late…”
Colin interrupted the other’s words, showing a mocking smile: “Moreover, I don’t see a shred of sincerity in you, not even a willingness to address me with a ‘you’…”
Of course, whether there was a “you” or not, the other party deserved to die either way.
For Shana, who was close by, it was not a good thing to let such a being continue to live.
As long as someone was constantly thinking about the special traits of his Shana…
The mere thought of it kept Colin awake at night.
Following that, with no intention to carry on with the pleasantries, flames surged around Colin; he extended his finger, pointing to the sky.
“Whoooosh!”
A ball of flame, as bright as the sun, condensed in the heavens.
From it, the light directly suppressed all of the power traits of the “White Night,” a Level One Containment Subject, and then Colin directly linked his consciousness to take control of the system within this containment unit.
With a set of movements, the Containment Subject in front of him was once again firmly suppressed.
“Make it quick.”
Colin gestured for those following him, and immediately, a throng of beings showed twisted smiles as they looked toward “White Night.”
Then, following the boss’s wishes, they launched a righteous siege against that guy.
For beings who step into the realm of Level One Containment Subjects, expelling or defeating them is relatively easy, but completely eradicating them is not.
However, for Colin, this wasn’t too big of a problem.
With “Primordial Fire” performing a thorough suppression on a foundational level, Shana conducting deconstruction alongside due to sharing the same origin, and a host of various Containment Subjects exerting their strength…
Colin didn’t even need to make a move, and shortly after, he acquired a fresh trait, emitting a rich white “Light.”
Thinking it over, Colin exerted force in his hands and combined some basic tool-making knowledge inherent in “Primordial Fire” to promptly, there on-site, mold it into a “ring” made of condensed light.
“How does it feel, is the size right?”
Colin looked at Shana, whose eyes widened slightly in surprise, then he took her slender, fair hand and slid the ring onto her finger, “It seems a little rough…”
“Not rough, unique.”
On seeing this small world, Shana had already guessed what the “surprise” might be, but clearly, this surprise was somewhat more astonishing than she had anticipated!
Then, she looked at Colin, blinked her pure ice-blue eyes, suddenly reached out, grabbed Colin’s collar, and pulled him toward her, pressing a firm kiss upon him.
Her large, angelic white wings unfurled, enveloping them both.
The other superior beings on the side prudently kept their distance…
After a good while, she finally let go, “Thank you, I really like it.”
“Yeah, after we sort out the current troubles, we’ll throw some parties or something…”
Colin gazed at her lips, licked his own, and then said, with her merely blinking and silently nodding agreeably, “With or without doesn’t matter, either way, I’ll always assist and support you.”
Currently, “Primordial Fire” had just ignited, and a true counterattack had not yet begun.
Earth was still in a state of collapse for the time being.
Colin collected his emotions, his eyes ablaze, and as the leader of the “Flame Bearers,” he issued his formal commands to the beings around him.
“The official counteroffensive starts now!”
“I only have three demands for this operation!”
“Efficiency, efficiency! And fuck it, efficiency!”
“The surviving humans have endured this disaster for a long time, we must end the suffering quickly and restore everything to normal!”
As he spoke, Colin also communicated more detailed rules for implementation during the operation through an “Inspiration.”
Things like various rewards, as well as ways to respond to various sudden and difficult situations…
The moment the order was issued, all the terrible beings sprang into action, fearing they would be a step behind the others.
Keep in mind, the tasks on Earth now were not too difficult, but the rewards were significant, and most importantly, they could make a good impression in front of Mr. Colin!
This way, in the future, they too could have the chance to become a member of the company structure, just like the “King of Madness!”

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - 919 603 Bonfire Containment Company (Finished)._5
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 919: 603 “Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished)._5 Chapter 919: 603 “Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished)._5 Becoming an employee of “Bonfire Company” not only allowed one to leave the containment unit but also to cling to the great thigh of “Primordial Fire”!
This was equivalent to the absolute pillar of the era of the “Night” at its peak!
Afterward, there was a chance to advance further in one’s own life level!
When the last figure left, Colin had not stopped his movements; instead, he directly accessed some company systems through his own consciousness, thereby connecting to all the employees of this world.
The next second, after obtaining the coordinates of all of them,
Beams of Bonfire descended from the sky, landing on each employee.
This also meant that the full counterattack had begun!
…
The battle was essentially divided into two parts; the first was the “high-end battlefield” formed by the “Primordial Fire First Corps unmanned rapid response unit” as well as the “King of Mad Sounds” and others assisting in battle.
These battles were transferred outside Earth, taking place in space…
Within each fireball wrapped in flames, special mechanical figures continuously issued various commands.
They either modified local environmental rules, attacked using “Primordial Fire” power, or created barriers, cutting off the retreat paths of certain higher consciousnesses, with a dazzling array of attacks…
And the “King of Mad Sounds” and other allied “Light Avatars” assisted in killing those consciousnesses that descended,
Trying their best to find more “kindling” for the company.
After all, judging by the new leader’s implication, there seemed to be hints: the company was urgently lacking points to start up; if they couldn’t find something to burn.
Then what came next to be burned might well be them!!!
So, each one was working extremely hard, and after letting loose without reservations, the battle above was intensely fierce.
This part of the universe even “flickered” because of this battle.
This level of battle, rather than being called a battle, seemed more like various “natural disasters” colliding in ways incomprehensible to ordinary people.
Colin even doubted whether any of the eight planets would remain afterward.
“But it seems pretty stable now…”
Colin withdrew his gaze, still watching but not continuing to focus all his attention there…
Instead, he turned to another battlefield.
That is, the battle on the Earth side; he seemed to be sitting at the rear, not moving, but in reality, his will had descended upon every company employee.
And the employees carrying his power would receive his direct assistance, possessing combat power boosts not inferior to his “Flame Bearer” Reservist late-stage.
Essentially, he had provided a cheat for every employee!
“But speaking of which…”
Colin raised his hand and stroked his chin, looking up at the sky through the connection with “Primordial Fire.”
He was vaguely able to make weak, blurry contacts with those “Flame Bearer” Reservists scattered across the universe…
Then Colin discovered something…
Among all the “Flame Bearer” Reservists, even at his strongest, he seemed not to be the strongest.
“What the hell, how could there be a ‘Flame Bearer’ Reservist stronger than the ‘King of Mad Sounds’? Can this still be called a Reservist? I suspect that he might not even be beaten one-on-one by regular troops, no, not just one, there’s another one, and something seems a bit off with his size; so large?”
Colin couldn’t help but complain inwardly.
But sensing them briefly again, he didn’t feel much surprise; these guys, even without the power of the “Flame Bearers,” were very strong.
It belonged to a kind of “bringing assets to share”.
Not dwelling too much on this, Colin cast his eyes on each and every employee.
…
Within a narrow crevice,
Some stubborn heretics, neither particularly good nor having done anything particularly bad, suddenly found their perfect hiding spot discovered by the forces of the old regime, for some reason.Then they were immediately surrounded and blockaded…
“Dogs of Shelter No. 2, give up! We will absolutely not submit!”
“When you didn’t let us in to take refuge and ignored us in our time of death, and now you still want to recruit us, dream on!”
“Only the Great Master, at our moments of life and death, blesses us with power!”
“To respond to my Master’s mercy!”
“We have resolved to offer everything for the Great Will!”
“…”
“Can these people really be persuaded…” the personnel from Shelter No. 2, blocking their way, listening to these words, were somewhat skeptical.
These types of heretics were the toughest to handle…
Their consciousness had already twisted, and in most cases, they would rather die or suffer than surrender.
“It’s fine, those who are willing to surrender, let them; those who are not, just send them to meet their Master. It’s not a big problem.”
A “double-duty” employee who had become part of the leadership said.
At this moment, a flame that made one feel inexplicably stable flickered on him.
This was the BUFF that Brother Shunzi had applied to everyone!
With it, the “double-duty” employee was more confident than ever, even feeling like he could stand a few blows against a higher being.
Of course, he was also aware that he’d probably be gone after the first strike.
However, handling this situation here was definitely no problem.
Seeing that these enemies did not come out to surrender as in some kind of “Revelation,” he was considering whether to break through actively and legally deal with the heretics inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 920 - 920 603 Bonfire Containment Company (Finished)._6
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 920: 603 “Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished)._6 Chapter 920: 603 “Bonfire Containment Company” (Finished)._6 But at this moment, he suddenly realized the inside had quieted down abruptly.
He immediately raised his hand, stopping his subordinates who were about to stir, signaling them to continue waiting.
Sure enough, after another ten minutes or so, they saw a dark door materialize out of nowhere in the depths of the quiet rift…
One by one, the heretics, not of an extreme kind, dropped all defenses and walked out from it.
“‘Official’ friends, there have been some misunderstandings before, we are willing to collaborate from now on…”
The expression of the leading heretic was bizarre, as if his entire worldview had been washed anew, but still in accordance with the “Master’s” will, he showed goodwill towards the “official” personnel outside.
While speaking, he recalled the “Master’s” arrangements.
Surrender wasn’t a big deal, but what had left a deep impression on them was the “Master’s” request to change how they addressed him.
From now on, they couldn’t call him “Master,” but “colleague,” and if that didn’t suffice, “leader” would also do…
No idea why this suddenly became the case…
However, although the reasons were unclear, perhaps there was a bigger flag being raised behind the scenes?
At that moment, he suddenly saw that official personnel, whom he had met several times before, who was initially powerful and now utterly inscrutable, flash beside him in an instant.
“What misunderstandings? We’re all good friends…” The “double” employee showed a gentle smile and patted his shoulder.
Scorching flames surged into the heretic leader’s body, letting him know that things were definitely not as friendly as the other had said.
Just a tiny move from him, and he would probably explode in the next second.
But at this moment, the heretic leader remembered something and took the initiative to say:
“Oh right, there are also these, once sinners among our peers, we’ve controlled them according to ‘Master’s’, no, a ‘colleague’s’, no no no, a ‘leader’s’ request… ready to be handed over for your judgement…”
After the handover was completed, the former heretic leader looked up into the sky, saw a brilliant sun hanging high, felt the mild warmth showering down from it, and realized clearly…
From this point forward, the skies would change.
But with his limited knowledge of the secretive scheming, he did not know whether this was a good or bad thing.
…
From another direction, the entrance to a domain of a xenomorphic evil life form was broken through, and a female figure wreathed in flames slowly walked into it under the terrified gaze of numerous xenomorphic beings.
“Don’t come any closer! Let us go, or else I’ll take you down with us and kill all the hostages!” The twisted xenomorphic life form yelled.
“Sorry, I don’t accept threats.”
Facing its threat, the young woman didn’t hesitate for a moment, raised her hand, and wielding the flame that even gods couldn’t directly gaze at, she entirely consumed both the enemies and the hostages.
Following that, she sent up an application.
Soon after, a Secret Force descended, and she saw that everything except herself was rewinding in time, and the previously dead hostages were being restored to life.
This did not include the xenomorphic races.
“Brother Shunzi’s power… really terrifying, being able to manipulate time…”
The D Level female employee couldn’t help but exclaim in her heart.
However, without much time to think further, she suddenly heard some of the people who had been experimented on by xenomorphic beings, tormented, either emaciated or obese, or covered with various tumors, huddling together, looking at her with a mix of desire and fear.
The female employee didn’t approach, just supported the flame, silently offering them the warmth they had longed for.
In that standoff, the atmosphere was slightly awkward, so quiet it was as if a pin drop could be heard.
A few seconds later, among these survivors captured by xenomorphic life forms, someone finally gathered the courage to break the silence and asked:
“Who are you? Where are those monsters?”
“Don’t be scared, I am an employee of ‘Bonfire Company,’ and of course, I was once part of Earth’s ‘Supernatural Alliance,’ sort of an official member, but now, none of that matters…”
The female employee, with a smile on her face, stepped forward, in front of the crowd of hunched people, and slowly reached out her hand:
“The company has seen your suffering, heard your prayers, and decided to lend a hand because its goal is to save all humanity that’s fallen into despair.”Looking at the hand emitting warm light, a small girl with yellow skin, distorted features and covered in tendrils hesitated for a moment before finally embracing it.
And similar situations were playing out all over the world.
This day, those oppressed and frustrated people, with the courage granted by Bonfire, raised their hands and began to question the gods that once ravaged the heavens and earth!
Vowing to conduct a thorough reckoning and pull them down from their lofty thrones!
Under Colin’s will, and the tangible great hand, humanity was quickly reclaiming the rights to this world, returning to their former stature.
Meanwhile, light from the “Primordial Fire” was dispelling the “dark curtains” that had once shrouded the universe.
One after another, the highest command was sent out among the stars.
The one who settled Earth’s crisis would stick to the original plan, allowing the “Emblem World” to fulfill its true symbolic meaning, quickly regathering the forces under “Bonfire Company.”
Thus, the path centered around the “Primordial Fire” could be effectively and powerfully implemented in the world.
And from this day onward, lives across the universe knew something:
A special containment facility named “Bonfire Containment Company,” awoken from a distant slumber by the birth of “Firebearers,” also issued invitation letters to people everywhere praying for hope and a future—
“When The Night comes, someone must light a fire to shine across the vast reaches.”
At the same time, it brought a prophecy.
When the ultimate end comes, a terrifying disaster will once again sweep across the entire world!
